I have purchased fresh bread from here and a delicious, over-priced sandwich on a previous visit. I couldn't wait to go back.  However, the last visit was a huge disappointment. Buying stale bread is not a big deal, but from a bakery in the morning?? Shouldn't it smell like fresh bread in a bakery? The bagel was not too bad, but not that much better than the bread company. The donut and the croissant was old and not good. The chocolate was amazing though.  St Louis has way better options.
Everything is very fresh tasting! Don't come here if you're on a no carb diet. Can't resist eating the fresh breads.
The Donut + Dog is an instant classic. This place takes pride in everything they do and it shows. Whether you want the grab yourself a couple of donuts or a hot dog the food is top notch.

Great service! My boyfriend and I have ordered from here a few times and the owner remembered us each time. The cheeseburger is really good! Fresh condiments .. including delicious pickles. Yeah pizza looks good - might try that next! Definitely recommended.

I was super excited about going to this place because I've never had a veggie dog!!! So was actually surprised after looking at their menu online. So a little torn on how many stars to give this place because the veggie dog is not really vegetarian. So all of you vegetarians out there, think twice before you make the trek out here. The veggie dog is cooked in the same oil as all the meats. If you want your dog grilled, they can grill it for you but it's on the same stovetop as all the meat. I was super appreciative that they were transparent about this but not so happy after not having much of a menu to choose from after finding this out. Overall, an okay experience.

Not only is the food delicious and the beverages top quality--- the playlist is straight out of 2007 and I am HERE FOR IT. The young man running the show behind the counter has greeted every single person cheerfully and uniquely since I've been here (almost 45 minutes) and the place is hopping! I don't know if he's just a happy dude, or just really loves his job, but whatever the case he is handling this lunch rush like a seasoned pro. Also very much appreciate the beautiful latte art that he constructed in the midst of this chaos. Overall, 5 stars for product quality and many, many gold stars to the fine employees. (Probably going to have to find this playlist on Spotify so please feel free to link it for me xoxoxoxo)

Found this place randomly on yelp and love it!! The dough for the hot dog bun and the donut is soft and flavorful. The meat they source for their dogs are never frozen, is locally sourced, and organic (everything except the chorizo I believe!) I got the elote dog and and the truffle fries. It's a little extra for the truffle fries but well worth it! We got one donut - glazed with Himalayan sea salt sprinkled on top - I think my favorite donut in town! They say they change their flavors daily but I'd be fine if the was the only one they had! Can't wait to come back!

If you're willing to work around its limitations, MetroLink Rail gets the job done.

Trains only come every 20 minutes during the day (10 min during rush hour). And the extent of the lines is limited (think of the whole system as a sideways Y).

However, it's very reliable. Download the "Transit" app on your smartphone, and it tells you exactly when the next train is arriving, so you won't need to waste time in the train station waiting. 

You can go to many specific destinations, such as the airport, Washington University, the Amtrak/Greyhound station, Busch Stadium, the Arch, and Central West End, among others. 

The train system is clean and people are polite and quiet. It's also safe, with police making regular rounds. 

It's honor-system based, so make sure you buy your tickets (and validate them!) before you board. You may have officials come around and ask you for your ticket.
I have officially had the greatest sushi ever. All others will be compared to this place. I had a salmon skin roll, state street roll and shishito pepper tempura. Tomorrow I will try 6-step salmon!

Delectable food made with real ingredients--this place is legit! A bakery set in an industrial area (West StLou Campus location), we loved the lentil soup, tuna salad sandwich, tough love salad (avocado, feta, sunflower seeds, edamame, tomatoes & spinach), as well as a macchiato. The bread was excellent and dessert was a worthy indulgence.

If you want to eat pastries that taste like a little piece of heaven, then this is the place! It is operated by the owners; the friendliest cutest couple ever. Everything made with fresh ingredients! You can taste and see the difference. Go today and try it!

Went to Sun Sushi with a girlfriend last week and it was amazing. We ordered the spicy crispy tuna rice appetizer (delish, a must try), and I got the salmon 6 steps. We also split a botte of the unfiltered sake, a perfect pairing :) The quality and freshness of the fish was on point. This will definitely be my new go to sushi place in Santa Barbara.

I been going here for the last 2 years. Every visit there a new set of staffs and they do X-Ray every time, I don't know why. On top of that my lip was cut from just having a regular cleaning done. Also, they keep constantly telling me I need a deep cleaning which cost me to paid out of pockets. Do I need a deep cleaning every year? I'm done with this place!

I've been here twice and will certainly been coming back. Mongolian Grill, Hot Pot, Sushi, Cocktail Shrimp, and surprisingly good chicken wings highlight this place for me. Honestly, even if they didn't have all of the chinese food, the mongolian grill and hot pot are well worth the price. My wife and I went for lunch today. She asked one of the cooks if there was any veggie sushi. About 8 minutes later, he comes to our table with a fresh roll that he made just for her. It was pretty quiet at the time, so I don't think this is something they'd do during a dinner rush, but it stood out for us!  The rest of the chinese food is just ok, but there is a very good variety, including apps like 4 soups, crab rangoon, dumplings, and the like.  

Summary: Stick with what they excel in and you're in for a great deal and very good food.

This is best for someone who needs motivation to workout. I felt for the price, I could do the circuits on my own. I like group classes but I found the workouts here too similar to the workouts I do on my own. The instructors do an awesome job motivating people, so I would recommend this for someone who needs to get kicked into shape! The instructor will certainly do that!

I had an issue come up with my food and called the restaurant to complain. within. ten minutes the OWNER himself came to us to apologize and explain what had happened. This is exactly what customer service should be, and this man exemplifies what it means to be a business owner, and a leader.

Sun Sushi is a great sushi experience and hidden gem in Santa Barbara.   The fish is incredibly fresh with two kinds of uni the day we ate there.  Staff and chef were very friendly and the sushi beautifully presented.  They have a lunch combo tier with the chefs selection of nigiri, hand roll and edamame that was perfect! Decor was is that of a Japanese Sushi house.  Quiet and tasteful.  What a gem!

Nice sit down restaurant for sushi.  Very friendly staff.  And the menu has a lot of options.  They are attentive and very kind.  Parking lot is happy full so we usually park over by Janines because its closed in the evening.

I've been coming to the auto shop for years but lately, over the past year, They're quality of service has gotten worse. I dont know if its due to lack of employee since they have the 'We're Hiring' sign and/or if its due to them doing a rush job but it seems like I always have to bring my car back a 2nd and 3rd time.

Recently, I was surprised that when I came in around 10:30am on a sat because I was concerned about my brakes. I was turned away. I was asked to come back during the week, a work day. 

The guys are the front desk are good people but the quality of work is not reliable as it used to be. I'm disappointed to say the least.

This place has really gone downhill. I don't know what's going on. 

They're constantly understaffed. Nobody is at the sushi bar ever and it took us 30 minutes to get some soup at their noodle bar.

Their Chinese food is still decent however, I'd rather go to New Taste across the street.
I had the chicken noodle soup yesterday, and it was absolutely fantastic along with the cornbread. Cornbread was super moist!!

Terrible staff. One disinterested rude order-taker, some other random employee wiping nose with hand then filling drinks with ice, 10-minute wait for a cold, greasy, pitiful excuse for a burger. BTW girls, you're their to work, not goof off and try and be all cool with one another. Seriously folks, there ARE better options at this airport REGARDLESS of how much of a rush you think you're in. DO NOT give your money to businesses like this one; the don't DESERVE to be in business.

I just finished a 3 day juice cleanse (no food) from Catalyst.
I was curious about trying one and had been feeling sluggish and blah.
I read about them in Philadelphia Magazine and took the plunge to order.
You can start on a Monday or a Friday (I went with a Monday to avoid distractions) and I picked up my juices locally in Bryn Mawr which was very convenient.
I received 3 bags of 6 juices, all labeled with #s and ingredients.
I received some basic instructions but could have used more (the delivery man provided verbal instructions that were not online or in the bag and I felt they were the most important) and I see the BP Cleanse has loads of information on their website.
Anyways... I loved the juices.  Yes, they were different but it's your body getting used to the taste of real fruits/veggies and not just processed foods.  I drank loads of herbal tea (decaf) and water and even had energy for my workouts (just toned down a bit).  
I didn't experience any stomach issues - I never experienced a caffeine withdrawal (and I drink LOTS of coffee) - and I didn't really mind when my husband made his dinner.  I felt like my body was on a mini vacation.

At the end of the day - what I would say:
I would absolutely do it again.
I would recommend to a friend.
This is what I've been looking for the past year in STL. Great coffee, great sandwiches, great salads and great pastries. Everything they make hits the spot.

I...did not like it.

The Metrolink was cheap, clean, and efficient. I was able to take the train from the airport to my stop at Union Station in 20 minutes. 

However, some of its passengers were extremely loud and...SCARY. I did not feel safe at all on the train OR at the train stops (especially the one at Union Station). I definitely had this uneasy feeling that I was going to get robbed, and I saw no security guards at the Union Station.

The worst part is, no one checked our tickets, which meant the train ran on an Honor System. This allowed a lot of people to ride the train for free, so you can get the worst of the worst bunch. The guy sitting next to me was definitely on crack. He had bloodshot eyes and fell asleep within seconds after he laughed at a raunchy joke his friends made. 

The whole ride to my stop, the guys acted lewd and voiced out degrading jokes about women.  I was very disgusted and couldn't wait to get off my stop and get a rental car. The extra $$$  was worth it for my peace of mind. 

It was a terrible first experience on a public train. I have used mass transit before, but in a smaller, college city, so take my review for what you will.

I would NOT advise any Washu students to take the train from airport to the university, especially if you have your luggage with you. Take the cab, or even the shuttle. You might have to pay more, but it's worth not getting robbed. 

If you absolutely HAVE to take the train, make sure you have a friend with you and DON'T use the train at night.

I visited this quaint little spot about an hour ago. I got a few things on the menu since I was excited to be trying this place. I got the power lunch ($9.50) which was the B. A. T. hot dog, fries and a drink. I also got two specialty donuts ($6 something) and an individual side of frito pie ($6). My total came out to $24.85 and I tipped $4 on top of that. When my order came, I didn't get fries. I questioned where the fries were and the waitress stated she'd check on that. Well the waitress never came back to me but instead, continued to deliver orders to tables until I called her over a little bit later. I questioned where the fries were and she explained that I ordered the frito pie as an upgraded side (which I can assure you I did not because when the cashier asked if I wanted to do that, I said no. The cashier understood and even made a joke so she knew what I ordered.) The waitress decided to try and explain and even though it didn't make sense, I didn't argue as the place was busy. But tell me this, if I got the power lunch ($9.50) and an upgraded side of frito pie ($3) and two specialty donuts ($6 something) that still only brings my total to $18.50 give or take. If my total was $24.85 as stated in the beginning of my review, were taxes $6 then? Because if so, that's not right. Unfortunately, I did not print my receipt as I didn't think I'd be cheated out of fries. It may not be a big deal to some, but I paid money and should get my money's worth. I'm an unhappy customer and will not be returning.

The trains are not very safe.  Just Wednesday a man got on and was harassing a woman who was by herself.  He would not stop and of course there is no security anywhere and this was 10am.  The problem with Metro Link is no one checks tickets.  So anyone can get on and not pay.  If you only let people on the platforms who paid for a ticket...that would probably cut out most if not all of the crime.  But Metrolink does not want to spend any money,,,,they could care less if a few people get robbed or killed.  I would not ride it again (even during the day) unless i was carrying a gun.  It is just too dangerous...even at 10am...just think how bad it is at 10pm.

I will be honest. I am not normally a huge fan of Cracker Barrel. This is the first time I have been to one and we had fast service, hot food and everything came out right the first time. We went with a party of 12 people and they were awesome!!  Everything came out correct the first time, service was fast and the food was hot. I have been to the Mt Juliet one and the food is normally cold and not what we ordered so imagine my surprise when we went here. Well done Goodletsville team!!

Very friendly sushi chef.  Sit at the bar and talk uni.  Fish was fresh and rolls were excellent.  They need to work out the kinks, because the service was slow, but otherwise this place has potential.

Sun sushi is hands down the best sushi in SB. I haven't ordered anything hat wasn't top of the line. The Box Roll and six steps are absolutely incredible! Sit at the sushi bar to talk with their really outgoing and talented chefs!

So I have followed this Instagram account for awhile. I have always said if I made it from California to Nashville I would go.  On Saturday I made it to Nashville and this was one of my stops.  It was delicious. The staff was super friendly and helpful. I had a great time

We went there with 2 other couples for a B day celebration. Even though they have a bakery, we asked if we could bring a cake and were told sure thing! They refrigerated the whipped cream cake and served it after our meal. The staff also sang HB to me!
We ordered 6 different entrees and all were delicious. The salad was very good with one caveat. The oil and vinegar dressing was too much vinegar. All in our party were very satisfied and said they will return. There were leftovers for 4 out of six with 2 piggies who ate it all up! The marinara is first rate and they gave us extra to take along with my wife's leftover chicken dish.
Worst internet provider in Tucson... they have the worst reviews I've seen on yelp. I'm switching ASAP

I've been waiting for this studio location to open for months now, after trying a free class at the Foothills location.  Per recommendations of several friends, the OTC Workout brings a whole new level of motivation to my workouts that I probably wouldn't push myself to do if I was working out at a regular gym.  First of all, the class squeezes maximal effort into an hour of fast paced intervals that push you to your upper cardio zones mixed with bench workouts, suspension training and water rowers. The trainers are there to make the class exciting and fun and they keep the energy up with high intensity workout music.  Throughout the class, you can track your progress on several monitors throughout the studio and push yourself even harder (everyone wears an OTC activity monitor to accomplish this).  My personal favorite is the variety of weight and TRX exercises you can take with you to workouts elsewhere.  If you're looking for a group fitness class that boosts your energy, strengthens your fitness goals and is designed to enhance your metabolism long after the class is over, give this a try!  They have several membership packages depending on how often you want to take classes.

Just about ok - compared to BluePrint Cleanse and Organic Avenue.
Just so you know - i'll label it an embarrassing cleanse. Why? I have done similar juice cleanses in the past and none upset my stomach so terribly.
Just to see the difference, I did BPC one day and catalyst the next day, and i just hated the feeling catalyst cleanse gave me - made my stomach rumble like MAD.
Will Never do it again.

This was the worse buffet we have ever eaten. 1st time I've wanted to walk out on a bill. Food was OLD, HARD, not a lot of selection, and NO fresh food coming out. The floors were so sticky, you could hear my shoes sticking with every step. Employees didn't care if our experience wasn't good, still insisted on charging full price (even though I told them we were unsatisfied and would NEVER return). DO NOT EAT HERE!!!!! You will be wasting your time and money! Only giving it a star because it makes me! I would rather give them negative stars!
Best donuts in town! Unique and creative. I highly recommend checking this place out. Very nice and helpful staff. Get there early!

I don't frequently write reviews, but after visiting Donut and Dog for the first time today and being welcomed as if I were a regular, I feel compelled to! I ordered one of their "power lunches", which included a bacon-wrapped local dog, avocado and tomato, along with fries and a drink. Service was prompt, and seeing as I was camping out at my table waiting for my flight out of Nashville later in the day, the employee working the counter offered me a delicious complimentary donut. Will be making this place a staple during future visits to Nashville.

I had never heard of this place before a yelp friend suggested we go there for lunch.  Now that I know about them, I will certainly be back.  In fact, I've already decided which of my customers will be my next lunch invite to the place.

I had a soup & sandwich combo.  I was expecting a smaller portion of each that would add up to a whole meal.  What I got was more like a whole sandwich and a bowl of soup with a fresh pretzel breadstick.  Probably a meal and a half.  

Everything was delicious!  The au jus that came with their interpretation of a French dip was beefy without being overly salty.  The bread was soft with a nice bit of chewiness.  The beef was not the star of the sandwich and that was a little bit of a letdown.  The high point though was the cheese.  French dip is generally a very tasty sandwich but everything is better with brie!  I also had their roasted red pepper soup.  I probably should have consumed it first but I got really excited by the sandwich and that plan went right out the window.  I did finish my soup and I enjoyed the salty, chewy breadstick very much.  I ate more than I had planned to eat for lunch but everything was just so good!

A few quick observations:

* They seem to develop a line to the door at lunch.  Go early, go late or plan to wait.   
* Don't do the soup & sandwich unless you're really hungry.
* They have small brownies for a buck or so.  I'm trying to avoid eating dessert with lunch these days but they were awfully tempting.
The only Italian that is really Italian food. chef Sal is the best Chef in Florida.

The service here was amazing! The chef/owner(I'm assuming) and staff were incredibly helpful and very passionate about what they do. The hot dogs had a lot of variety and a ton of flavor, which was even more accentuated by the amazing brioche buns they put them on. Then, there are the house made brioche donuts that are flat out incredible. We were fortunate to get some right out of the oven, making them that much better. It is obvious that they put a lot of thought, experience and love into their trade.

Excellent, HONEST!!!! 

I brought my car here because I was worried about it getting louder than usual when I accelerated. They took it for a test drive and put it up on the thing and looked at everything. This could have been a golden opportunity for a less trustworthy type to rip me off and make up a bunch of bullshit. Instead, they told me they saw nothing wrong! I was pretty shocked and at the same time super relieved.

I have been looking forward to trying The Donut +Dog, and it did not disappoint! I had a smoked caramel latte, which the barista, Nicholas, made perfectly for me, not too sweet, just a hint of caramel--and literally smoked in a little glass box.  The donuts...all I can say is, I'll have to come back & try them all! I had a "dirty OG", which is a glazed brioche donut with cinnamon & sea salt. So good. I met the owner too, who was super friendly & helpful.  The shop is small but has lots of seating, a working fireplace, & a pretty little patio. Can't wait to return!

Been in a few times and always had great food. I'd like to highlight and give props on the Buffalo Chicken Pie. Made NY proper with blue cheese. Too many places slaughtering the Buffalo name with ranch around here. #FriendsDontLetFriendsDipInRanch

So I was visiting here from Chicago and used the light rail system a few times and I pretty much agree with everyone's comments
I couldn't believe that I could just walk on to the platform without having to go through some sort of turn style. And then my cousin told me that there were a few times when he almost went a month before someone checked his monthly pass. I was quite astonished.  I don't agree with the honor systems, since to many people can and will take advantage of it. I don't think it could ever work in a larger city. Plus it hurts your revenue and Op Income. Another thing i don't get is free parking at the MetroLink terminals. Talk about a major perk for taking the train downtown.

After all is said and done I'm a fan of the service. The MAJOR reason is the fact that it's on time. After using the CTA for so many years I didn't believe my cousin when he said there will be one coming at 11:25am(on the dot), because it always comes at that time. Sure enough the the time came and the train was pulling into/at the station.
Finally the train was in spectacular condition, clean, smelled great and the platforms were in great condition

I've boarded my lab regularly at Hilltop for the past 3 years and highly recommend them. The staff is top-notch:  prompt, courteous, and professional during drop-off and pick-up, and they genuinely care about the pets. Most importantly, I do not worry about my dog while he is boarded here. He has a blast and loves the staff, and I wouldn't take my pets anywhere else.

I am utterly appalled by my experience at this food establishment. I was sitting near my gate for departure in terminal A when I realized I was hungry, so I decided to go to a fast food place to bring on my flight. I had realized that my gate was quite some way from the fast food restaurants and my flight was boarding soon so I walked very fast paced and saw a Wendy's that caught my eye immediately. I had noticed that the line was pretty long but I took my chances and got on line before it was too late. I had noticed that there was ONE female worker getting the food AND taking the orders of the customers but I gave them the benefit of the doubt because maybe they were low on staff. I then look and there were four employees in the back seemingly doing nothing. No wonder the line was moving so slowly.... Finally, it was near my turn to order. The gentleman in front of me who had placed the order had mentioned he had a coupon, and a very snappy women came out and in a very rude tone said that they don't take coupons and that he shouldn't have had it. He steps aside and as I am walking up a green haired female employee approaches me and in the nastiest way possible tells me "Oh I am not serving you, we are closing." I ask "Why?" And she again said "Uhh because we all want to leave and nobody else is here to work so... sorry." She was speaking to me as if I was wasting her time. Now I am boarding my plane with no food and shocked at the rude, unorganized service. Might I add there was ZERO WARNING of the eatery closing. That was extremely frustrating. If you were expecting anything from this establishment, don't. I suggest Wendy's and the Nashville International Airport learn how to run a restaurant successfully. Thanks

This place is so neat and ecclectic. This is a constant when I'm visiting STL, especially for tasty bakery items and breakfast/bagel sandwiches. Companion seems so original, and I love how discreet the location is.

I'm confidently reviewing Sun Sushi is a gem in Santa Barbara. I have heard good things about them but been hesitating to try since their location is a bit drive for me from east beach. Being a regular patron at Arigato and Sakana (known to be best sushi restaurants in town) I could say Sun sushis quality is comparable. I'm impressed how fresh their fishes are. I tried the Salmon six steps, buttery, fresh, melt in your mouth. I also had the Tuna Delight roll. I preferred not to have crab meat in the roll and the chef was flexible to sub it for me. The jalapeño was quite spicy so I took a few slices off, but if you can handle the heat this roll is perfect. I also ordered some appetizers like Veggie tempura, seaweed salad, miso soup, and avocado roll. The tempura batter is light, the veggie is fresh, I will surely have this again. Their miso soup is generously served, bigger size than anywhere else in town. 
They serve beers, wine, sake, and shochu, great variety on drinks especially sakes. The sake menu is really informative, tells you the degree of dryness and sweetness on every single one. 
Their service is on point, nothing to complain. The sushi chefs are friendly, attentive, flexible, and really proud of their work. I was happy to enjoy my dinner at the bar and I will come back again to support their business. Glad to recommend Sun Sushi to friends and family!

Dinner was excellent, dessert not so much. Walking in first thing you see is a beautiful display case filled with desserts. I do how I just picked the wrong one the eclair I was served was semi frozen and I think was made in pompei before the valcano.  

I'll give the place another try as our dinners were wonderful

I have to be totally honest with you, after living in Saint Louis all of my life I have never stepped foot into a Companion Cafe until today. Well to be totally honest with you I had planned on meeting up with a fellow Yelper for lunch and much to my surprise someone in the office brought in Companion bagels this morning, so I was treated to Companion twice in one day.

First off their bagels looked delicious, however as usual I opt for the cheese bagels with light cream cheese. The bagel itself was good, however cream cheese selection was limited to a single spread, never less it was still quite tasty yet not quite to the standard as Panera or even Einstein Brothers bagels.

Fast forward to lunch time, I arrived shortly before 11:30am and we were able to place our orders without any problems, it wasn't until a few minutes later when our food was delivered that we started to notice a line start to form as the lunch hour rush started to build. Despite the long line, it seemed to move pretty fast. For my lunch I ordered a small soup and a small sandwich. For my soup I went with the Creamy Turkey Potato, which was quite delicious, and the perfect size to pair with a sandwich. The soup had generous portions of both turkey and potato. For my sandwich I went with the Oktoberfest, which was ham & Swiss with a house made honey mustard served on the Bavarian Pretzel, again this was perfectly sized and quite delicious. 

Overall prices were reasonable and the staff was fast and friendly. The inside is large with two window walls looking into the bakery allowing you to see some of the products being prepared. Seating was plentiful, so much so that it seemed to handle the lunch rush just perfectly. In addition to inside seating there are several tables available on the patio for those warmer days.  Soft drink options consisted of a Coca Cola Freestyle Machine, so you can get creative with your inner mixologist and create that perfect soda, or you can just enjoy some refreshing iced tea. Overall Companion delivers a solid lunch experience with a more casual feel, especially when compared to places like Panera.

Ahhh the MetroLink, aka the Crime Train.  St. Louis' "bustling" mode of light rail transit.  Fun fact: my brother had a birthday party on the newly opened Crime Train when he was like 8.  We've come a long way since then.  Regressed, if you will.

The only reason why I'm not giving the Crime Train two stars or even one is because I haven't been robbed or beat to shit while on board.  I've only been asked for money and harassed a couple of times.  That's nothing.

The Crime Train has plenty of positives.  It runs on time.  It's affordable to ride.  It doesn't derail.  It gets you to some of the top places you want to go in STL: Airport, Busch Stadium, and East St. Louis.

Also, it is growing!  We had just one route from 1993 to 2006(that was extended further into Illinois in 2003). Now it has exploded into two routes! And guess what? The city government is working on getting a third line approved!!!  

I'm a little worried about this third line, though. I've seen so many air travelers with luggage confusedly get on the non-airport route and head for Shrewsbury. I'm not sure this city is ready for the proposed third line just yet. The Crime Train map is an intricate web of lines that only the genius can navigate. It's one long line that splits off into a shorter line part way through. It gives me a headache just thinking about it.

The big downside is clearly the troublemakers.  We're not talking vandals and people not paying for tickets. I mean bad dudes that'll knock you down and out and take your money. 
Related: When I google search "MetroLink", I get a mix of links about LA's and STL's Metrolink. When I google search "Metrolink attack", I get nothing but STL stories. Take that, LA!

As everyone else has mentioned, the simple fix is A) far more security, B) some kind of turnstile system at the stations, C) both A and B.  I imagine the turnstile system is far off because most stations are out in the open at ground level.  It'd be far easier to get around the turnstiles here than at the elevated/underground stations in Chicago and New York.  But hey, how about some more security?? 

I will continue to take the Crime Train when necessary. I live in Soulard and it's nice to uber to the Busch Stadium station and ride to the airport for a total of less than $10 rather than take a $50+ cab ride.  However, I won't go out of my way to ride it.  I'm back in school at UMSL and we are given a free ride pass for MetroLink each year.  I didn't pick mine up until a few weeks ago.  I probably should have gotten it sooner but the emails I would get from the school discussing the latest attack at the UMSL station made me hesitant.

Great donuts with great service! The employees were very friendly and helpful in explaining the different flavors they had. I bought the blueberry and basil, the guava and cream cheese, and the "99 problems but..." which had raspberry and a bit of cayenne. For the blueberry+basil, you can definitely taste the basil, so it may be a polarizing flavor. Two of us liked it, but one of us didn't. The other donuts were also delicious, but I think the "99 problems but..." could have had more cayenne. I think I only noticed the cayenne because I already knew it was in there. Can't speak to the hot dogs, but I've heard they're also good. The main reason I docked a star was because my friends and I all thought there was a bit too much dough for the topping:dough ratio. Other than that, all three donuts tasted great, weren't oily, and the dough was light yet dense!
The service was awesome and the food was amazing.  Definitely recommend trying the Sweet Baby Jesus donut.

Friendly & fast service. Prices are good & the sushi & rolls were delicious. We noticed there was a good mix of locals, college students & tourists. The menu has a good selection without being overwhelming. The only thing I would have liked is a sashimi option that was a smaller portion. There is a chef's choice option for $65. Perhaps if requested there are other options. Still a very nice dinner & just a short walk down State Street from our hotel.

I love this place so much! The flying Hawaiian is my personal favorite. The staff is super friendly and very helpful. I've never not had a good time here. If you are a tourist or a local this is definitely a must try! The donuts are great too but you have to get there earlier than later if you want a donut cause they go fast!

This place is my go to in the neighborhood.  Great fast food options with nice taste and spice, especially the boom boom sauce.  The people that work there are always nice and accommodating.  The options are also vast so you don't always have to get the same thing!

I absolutely abhor the "honor" system. Not only does turn-style ticketing provide for safer, cleaner, and more efficient transportation, it also provides a high-revenue grossing system in which you can use to sustain the service (instead of asking for X millions of dollars from the city/state).

With that said, everything else about the Metro is spot on. I like how trains are on time, and I love the lights that they use in the underground station to signal approaching trains. The railways and platforms are for the most part well kept, and I have yet to meet a "crazy person" like I do frequently on Atlanta's MARTA.

I ride the Metro frequently, from Wash U campus to Barnes Jewish daily, as well as occasionally to the airport. I was and will be more than willing to pay taxes to keep the Metro alive, but they need to help themselves.

Fire your current business managers and hire new ones. The Metro needs to be self-sustaining, and relying on the "honor system" to turn in that revenue is just not going to happen.

Usually I get the breakfast meals, but today I went for the Reuben sandwich plate.  This is a great sandwich.  Its probably the 2nd best Reuben in Nashville. (My opinion). The  waitress was very nice, and the food came fairly quick.  If you like Reubens , you gotta try one here.
The sweetest girls at the front counter. Gave us a couple free donuts for no reason! Love the environment and friendly staff. Great coffee and donuts!

So good!! Located in a very cute historic bungalow. The owner was at the front desk and was so friendly and helpful. I chose "the stairway to heaven" donut. It was the most amazing donut I have ever had. Do not hesitate to try this place while you are in Nashville!
Excellent food, and the service was phenomenal. Debbie was great and so nice. All Cracker Barrel's are good, but this one was above and beyond.

Yes!  I've been a resident of Francisville since 2010 and I've slowly watched new eateries open up over the last 6 years.  Some good, some completely forgetable.  Luckily ZuZu's is the former and not the latter.  At first glance you might think this is a pizza joint...and you wouldn't be wrong about the pizza part.  However,, it's much more than that.  It has Arab items like Shawarma and various other standard dishes with a kick of middle eastern spice.  On my third visit, i decided to go simple with a chicken cheesesteak with jalapenos, beef bacon, and mushrooms.  They hit it out of the park.  On my first trip i jammed on the beef shawarma, and it didnt disappoint one bit.  I also ordered up the banana pudding,  which was when I learned that they have all their desserts made by a local bakery.  In other words, try the desserts!

Never write reviews, the coffee was good but was having a conversation in the back corner and I guess we were "being too loud" so the barista came out from behind the counter to shush us...didn't know it was a public library! Next time I'll go to Starbucks!
Best sushi in town! Fish is so fresh and you can taste the quality, perfect rice taste, perfect size, affordable price, great service and ambience!

Eat like a local. The bread they bake here smells great! Similar to a Panera style menu. Sandwiches, soups, bread, baked goods.
Reasonably priced and good customer service. Packed lunch special gets you a sandwich, a side and a baked treat. A smaller version gets you 1/2 a sandwich, which is perfect if you don't want to be stuffed!

Great place with an authentic menu. My wife and I grabbed lunch and enjoyed the entire experience. Service was great, and food was creative and well portioned. Recommend the Reuben Dog with the Truffle Fries.
Love the work outs. The atmosphere always get you in the mood to work harder then you would on your own.

Pros: good margherita pizza & wings; friendly workers

Con: rude owner. Refused to acknowledge or greet us when we walked in. Called a worker over and stood there watching.

Overall, the food is reasonably priced, but on the fence about returning.

An elegant Asian & American Buffet with a variety of soft drinks and smoothies. With different professional chefs for sushi, Mongolian grill, Hibachi grill, and for Vietnamese noodle soup. If you would like the full traditional Asian experience try out the hot pot.

Day 1:

Thank you Jason for great recommendations we truly enjoyed our meal. Please support this business as their craftsmanship of in house handmade items is superior.

Day 2:

Welp we are back. Will informed us to not miss the doughnuts on yesterday and so we came back this morning. They are amazing and the Smoked Latte is great too. 

Tip: Park in the back as it's free and for their customers only. Make sure to check behind the bush for Ninjas though if you're not picking up a doughnut or dog.

Attended a brioche-making class at The Donut + Dog.  What an amazing experience (not to mention fantastic donuts to take home)!  The owners, Will and Nicole were gracious hosts and very accommodating for our time and questions.  Will did an outstanding job in explaining the brioche-style donut and the pain-staking, time-consuming, steps it takes to make a perfect donut every time!  If you ever have the opportunity to attend, don't hesitate!  They sell out quickly!
Very good service,I'm very happy ,doctor CAstro is the best very professional and I can see he loves he's job

Everyone knows that Companion is in the business of baking bread. But what I did not know was that they are also in the business of serving AMAZING soups, salads, and sandwiches. Let me tell you about my two favorite meals to order. First is the Greek Goddess Salad. It's the perfect combination of greens, feta cheese, tomatoes, and Companion's Greek dressing.  Second is the Picnic Basket Salad. Bleu cheese, fresh strawberries, and candied pecans all on top of fresh baby spinach. Absolutely wonderful. If you are looking for something a little heartier consider the Fiesta Chicken Sandwich. It's served with Habanero jack cheese, peppered bacon, and chili mayo. I simply cannot say enough about this place. What's absolutely awesome about this place is watching the team of bakers working from the open-view kitchen. I love watching people stir, knead, fold, and toss the dough. The online ordering is super-efficient. However, I highly suggest dining in this hip industrial warehouse. I highly suggest Companion for those looking to host a lunch meeting or mid-day date.

I wanted something sweet and he wanted something savory. We couldn't have chosen a better place!  We were greeted by Will, co- owner to only find out he is from San Diego!  The place is cozy and welcoming especially on a brisk and cold day! The marshmellow cappuccino was amazing!  They blend their own coffee here and I will definitely purchase some online when its available next month!
Best sushi in town. The fish is fresh and staff attentive. My new favorite place to eat. Max the sushi chef is the greatest!

If I could give this company 0 stars I would. 
I deployed and cancelled my account after verfying the final charge that would be presented and received a charge 2 months into my deployment. After disputing it they "credited" it back only later to find out they were sending a collection agency. 
They are incredibly unprofessional and take advantage of their customers any chance they get. Will never recommend and will never do business with the  again.

great food for kids and if you like traditional foods come here it is very nice Phil is the best and the environment is a nice cool kudos to everyone there !! they won't disappoint you your wallet or your stomach  come here and be impressed!!!

LOVE THIS WORKOUT! Imagine a group personal training that is part "game" where you try to get your heart rate up to different colors (optimally ORANGE) to get the best workout value. I really enjoy it - it's a hard work out and you can honestly do it at your own "pace" so you can walk, jog or run. It's like "yoga" where you do the best you can and no one is judging you - just motivating you to do the best you can. The instructors are so friendly and motivating!

My review is 1 star for take out experience. On the phone, the girl taking my order took forever to "find" the items I was ordering, even though I was looking at their website and going off their menu posted there. Girl, you need to just write it down and figure it out later if you haven't learned the menu yet. Then, I showed up exactly when they said my order would be ready (25 minutes) and the girl at the front told me it would be another 5-10 minutes without apologizing, and tried to act like I had showed up early. Then, I was happy bc I didn't end up having to wait that long but as I found out later, it was because they forgot one of my rolls! I didn't call to complain because I was already pretty far away but I'm annoyed at having spent so much on pretty mediocre sushi. They also only gave me one pair of chopsticks for a big order and I had to go back in to ask for another. I should have double checked my order too at the time :( I don't like to leave bad reviews but this was just too many things going wrong for me to give them anything less than one star.

Came up here to try one of the special Friday the 13th halloween donuts they were offering but ran out when I got there :( 

I also couldn't just leave this place without getting something since it's trendy, hipster-y, and every Millennial/Gen Y college student buzzword you can think of. 

I went with the Bluegrass Mule donut, which had a meyer lemon/key lime filling, ginger sugar dusting, and a little pipette/squeeze bottle filled with a honey bourbon filling that you squeeze into the donut! (Remember what I said about the trendy, hipster stuff hahahaha!) 

I was pleasantly surprised at how good it was. Packed to the inside edges with the best citrusy filling ever. The bourbon filling gave it that extra touch of fruity tanginess. 

Free parking in the back too!
Great trainers & staff, plus an awesome workout. I love that the workout is planned for you. And the trainers motivate you to be your best and push you harder.

Best donuts in Nashville. 
We moved to Nashville from Chicago and have been looking for a good donut place. These donuts are great. The restaurant is a little hard to find but it's worth it.

Looking for a lunch place, when we street parked(paid parking), The Donut and Dog Restuarant was there. The outside seating and porch looked inviting so we ventured in. There is seating at tables and a couch area. The decor is interesting - don't forget to look up- bicycle hanging - very unique. 
The counter person was very helpful in suggestions for our taste. He was friendly.
Disappointed that you can't sample a beer before purchasing a glass of beer. But you can buy a flight.
The donut descriptions in the menu looked interesting to try, but didn't see any to purchase. Didn't think to ask. 
Our food was tasty. I got a plain dog and chips. 
This place is worth a try.

Long story short: my friend "wants to drown upstairs in Sweet Baby Jesus filling, be cremated in the fireplace in the lobby, and sprinkled on a specialty donut like the Dirty Churro". Needless to say, we had an amazing experience. Great donuts with even better company. We're definitely going to be those slightly irritating regulars who you may or may not look forward to seeing every week. I will be taking all my friends and family here, no doubt.

ok, just writing this review is making me drool thinking about this place again. It sounded like a weird combination but once we got there and tried it, we were all glad we did. Donuts, hotdogs, draft beer.... DONUT BURGERS?!? I mean c'mon, what's not to love. My friend had a donut, enjoyed it so much she went and got another. She was embarrassed, but we all thought it was great. They did an amazing job w this place. Such a cute concept. The donuts are not ur boring, everyday donuts. Just reading the menu without looking at the actual donuts should make ur taste buds dance lol. Donuts sell out quick. I called once and she said i could place an order. Not sure if that's something they always offer tho

Being dropped off in the middle of downtown St. Louis this past weekend--I wanted to get my exploration on! Oh yeah! [I love traveling, ask any of my friends] 

With being from Chicago, reading the downtown metro map was easy. Their trains only run in two directions. East & West. So the simple structure was easy to figure out. 

The St. Louis Metro was easy, clean & fast. They even have a posted schedule!?! What?!?! A train that runs on schedule? Get outta town! There were plenty of seats, and they were wider than the Chicago L train. 

My only complaint is the price of the Metro. I thought Chicago was expensive, but for a 2 hour ride/pass it is for $5.75! That is the same price for a Chicago ALL day pass. For the all day pass it was $7.50. Whew--pretty pricey. However, what I also liked is that you take the ticket with you, you don't put it in terminal, it is based on the "honor" system. Which is awesome, but I doubt it would fly in Chicago. 

When I come visit this awesome city again, I will for sure use this public transportation. Who needs a car? Not this girl!
Don't you love when you walk up to the counter and the cashier just stares at you, no greeting no smile? What has happened to customer service?

Rode Metrolink trains several times, and it was pretty good. Never had to wait too long for a train, at least one security guard seems to be on duty at all the stops(even saw a bust going down on one of the station platforms west of Civic Center), and the seats inside the railcars appeared to be clean for the most part. OTOH, I disliked how the area immediately outside of the Civic Center station(by Scottrade Center, and Amtrak station) had real aggressive panhandlers(to the point where I wish it was better patrolled by their security), but to the credit of their security I did see a bust occur on one of the platforms west of Civic Center while I was riding the train. I totally agree with other reviews that they should have turnstyles before entering the platform area at all the stations, rather than only doing random fare checks at times and doing an 'honor system' at all stops. And I thought Metra(Chicago's commuter rail) was bad during infrequent times in this regard, since I have infrequently rode it when I never was once asked to pay my fare. I know Metra has since cracked down on this and are asking riders to pay fare on the train a lot more often, so I'd hope Metrolink does resolve this issue on their trains. Train platforms for the light rail also appeared to be cleaner and more maintained vs. the 'L in Chicago, but that doesn't surprise me considering Metrolink is a newer system.

The vending machine threw me off slightly, since I didn't realize that you have to leave your card in for about 2-3 seconds, before removing it. There is a 'remove card' prompt I didn't realize you have to wait for, before taking your card out of the machine when you purchase your fare, pass, etc. to ride the train. As for the bus, except one time where I swear one of the buses must've not ran at the scheduled time for whatever odd reason(and as a result ran into a Walgreens at a nearby shopping center to that bus route, to kill 20-30 mins), the buses seemed to run fine, based on the timetables I'd printed out before my trip. Since I took the buses out to a suburban area where I spent time in, I did like how the buses were clean, ran on schedule for the most part(sans for a lone incident where I swear the bus didn't come at the time it was scheduled to do so), and actually run late for bus routes in a suburban area, unlike the fact that a lot of Pace routes(bus system in Chicago's suburbs) seem to end early. Their bus system reminded me of the one in Milwaukee where all buses seem to run later into the evening, which I really appreciated.

Great system, and the fact that the trains and buses ran as well as it did(moreso the trains), is one of the factors where I'd be encouraged to do a return trip to St. Louis again.

Less than $20 gets you a car wash BY HAND and an exterior vacuum and wipe down.  Everyone is friendly and they do a good job.

- cash only
- entry only off 10th street going east
- honk to have the door opened to drive thru; if no one opens the door, get out and walk inside
- as them to show you the cool old fashioned washing machines they still use
- save them time and have your car empty of junk before you take it

Not impressed. Sandwich with side and cookie is $11.25 before tax. No drink included for that price. Extremely limited menu. You would think since they close at 3PM daily, they would serve breakfast until then like other brunch-timed places do, but they don't. Self service, ordering at the counter. I was excited to try it since I finally was able to get there before they closed, but I am not interested in returning. Don't understand the excellent reviews.

This is one of our favorite spots in Santa Barbara. It's become one of our regular date night spots. The sushi is fantastic and fresh. Our regular order is the salmon, blue fin tuna, scallop, halibut, a couple rolls and then whatever else the chefs at the counter recommend. We always leave full and satisfied. Oh the rare occasion that our sitter can't make it our son helps us devour our rolls and our daughter loves the chicken teriyaki. After a few visits to Sun Sushi our son has decided Japanese food is his favorite cuisine! I think it's mine now too!

Why is the service here so painfully slow? The girl before me wanted 15 minutes for her food to come out. For a QSR "quick service restaurant" it wasn't very quick considering how many people they had preparing the food behind there.

I only ordered a medium fries thank god but it also was slow to come out. Also why does this airport not have anything healthy to eat lol

I have been here once with my coworkers. It is not your typical Chinese-American buffet. For starters, the decor is actually pretty nice and the place was quite clean with plenty of servers and buffet attendants. However, there was pretty graphic bathroom graffiti, in Spanish, for trans sex, including a phone number. It kind of brought the "nicer decor" thing back down to level. We are on West 38th, afterall. 

All the food I tried was pretty good. Hot, fresh, with good variety. Everything was clearly labeled. Although the American favorites of Bourbon Chicken, Egg Rolls, and General Tso's are available, there are also actual Chinese dishes like chicken feet, sauteed long beans, and tendon-y beef. There's a small dim sum bar and a small sushi bar. Most of the sushi is about the same: krab with sauce and veggies, perhaps deep fried, but there was also inari and some nigiri. Super delicious octopus salad. This is what bumped this place up from 3 to 4 stars. I LOVED that octopus salad!! 

The dessert bar is quite huge and includes single-serve ice cream cups (not soft serve). Our drinks were kept regularly refilled and service was polite. 

What really sets this place apart are these features:
very fresh Mongolian Grill
make-your-own-Pho bar
HOT POT!!! Yes, at your table, they'll bring you a pot with a burner. You get your own raw meats and veggies from the bar and go to town. 

I realize many people judge the authenticity of an ethnic restaurant by the ethnicity of the diner. There were lots of Asian folks enjoying their food...not just workers from the area, but older couples too. So if you want to re-think your opinion of a Chinese buffet, give this place in Lafayette Square area a try.

Interesting concept in the former home of The Dog. The dog menu is quite limited.  The sides have some choices that sound great. The selection of beers is also quite limited and more upscale than The Dog. The brioche bun was tasty, but buttery to the point of greasy. Truffle fries appeared to be twice fried and quite tasty, but not super hot and also pretty greasy. The beer was fine. Service was slow, despite few customers. Here's the final deal breaker. Pretty plain dog, side if truffle fries, small beer - $19.00. Way overpriced. Not worth a second visit for me.

Absolutely the best!!!! We stopped by the lot just looking knowing we had bad credit and nothing to put down and we drove off the lot two hours later fully approved with a 2006 suburban! Not exactly what we expected, but they were all very friendly and helpful. They got us approved for what our family needed very quickly and easily! I would recommend to anyone and everyone

One of my favorite donut stops in Nashville, with a couple prior reviews, but on this occasion, I went specifically to check out their new line-up of artisan craft hamburgers, between brioche donut halves - how great does sound!  I was thrown a curve-ball though as I meant to try their Left Coast O.G. Donut Hamburger, but ended up ordering the "Hangover" Donut, with two 4-oz patties, cheese, bacon, and fried egg between two maple glazed brioche donut halves.  Think this sounds good - check out the pictures (with video) on IG!  Combined with their house chips (served warm - yum...), this made a great combo!  

While there I has the opportunity to try two new 20-hour artisan brioche donuts - The Great Pumpkin and Big Bad Wolf.  Both were great, as always, although the TGP had a creme bruelle type burnt caramel topping that was a bit too hard and stick-to-your-teeth chew for my taste.  However, the brioche donut with spicy pumpkin filling were yummy!   The BBF was a apple cider glaze with house-made caramel and cinnamon & sugar dusting on their famous brioche donut. A must donut, and more, stop whether a local or visitor.  Let owner, Will, know that Lonny with Donut Explorers sent you!  Happy eating...

Insanely slow download and upload speeds. The cost is cheaper than Cox but for a reason. The service is complete garbage and the sales staff are completely apathetic and not understanding. I had them for a year and a house in 85730 and it worked moderately OK. Then I moved to the 85712 (grant and swan) and we were stuck in a contract that forced me to pay for the 20mbps speed when that option isn't even available for customers at my location. The most they could give me was 0.5 MBPS?! I couldn't stream audio on that! Yet I have to either pay out the rest of the 9 months of internet coverage where I wouldn't have any coverage ANYWAYS... No one would listen or have a useful solution that didn't end up with me being screwed out of a paycheck.

This place is awesome. Sal has a great business on  US19 and he does Italian food well. Try the 2 for $20 for an excellent deal. The bread they give you before the meal is delicious...lot's of flavor and great aroma. 

The pastries and sweets are really good too. I wish it was closer to us and we would eat here a lot more often. it blows anything in Spring Hill out of the water!

I've been here over 200 times since they opened. The Iced Coffee is the best.  They make some great frozen drinks including the Granita that's fantastic.  Eats are average and they have a toaster and microwave for customer's use.  The muffins are the best thing going for food here.  The service is always quick and precise.  If you're coming for a bit, they have free wifi.  Please leave at least a buck tip for the hard-working ladies making drinks.

We met a friend here for breakfast and realized we had visited their cafe in Clayton before it closed. The food was very fresh and you could tell that they used quality ingredients. The pastries and breads looked so enticing and the lunch menu looked really good. I had the the Claytonian sandwich on a crescent roll and really enjoyed the flavor. Hubby had the oatmeal and a coffee and said the oatmeal was a solid choice and the coffee was very good. Sarah said the hot chocolate is awesome! 
This place has plenty of seating both inside and outside and is a great place to meet people or to just go by yourself and enjoy some good food.

After eyeing these brioche beauts on instagram for weeks, I finally gave in to temptation and stopped in for a treat. The person behind the counter, who I assume was the owner, was so friendly and welcoming. I opted for a Dirty Churro and a Stairway 2 Heaven. I also got an Iced Horchata Cubano. I got these to go and honestly wasn't in my car 30 seconds before diving in (hence no photos) and didn't stop until all the evidence of my first visit was gone. The Sweet Baby Jesus donut was sold out and it's the perfect opportunity for another visit soon. 

Also, not saying anything bad about FDB, but man it's nice to see the menu with descriptions of what the flavor is. It makes my indecisiveness a little less annoying. 

Keeping baking delicious goodies, and I'll keep coming! Can't wait to try the dogs.

Most of my Companion experiences have been pleasant. I am a weekly visitor and often order from Companion for team lunches. I work 5 mins away, I love your curbside service and your salads are so much better than that other soup and sandwich place at Westport. I am a sucker for overpriced salads, what can I say? They are tasty. 

Today the experience was infuriating. The service was awful. They rolled a new online ordering system that apparently hadn't been tested. I had issues trying to order through the new system, so I called my 8 item order in at 10 am in order to pick it up at 11:45. I arrive at 11:45 to find a line of people waiting for their order. The employees are not even acknowledging any single person in line. There is no way to know if they know who's arrived for their order or not. After waiting 20 mins, I am now 5 mins late back to my lunch meeting for 8... Nobody has acknowledged me, so I go around and ask a manager about it because I also needed to pay for my $100 order and I didn't want to wait in one line (pickup) only to go get in the other (in store) order line to pay. He tells me "we're working on it." He seemed sorry I was waiting but it seemed out of his hands. I wait 5 more mins to pay, and still now closer to my food coming out. I ask a manager and the cashier exactly how far behind they are because I am now 15 mins late for my 12 pm lunch meeting...that I am bringing lunch for. They don't know. "They're working on it." There is another man in line who waited 1 hour for his lunch that he called in to pick up at 11:15. I waited 45 mins for mine. Meanwhile, I watched other patrons come in, wait in line, sit down and get their lunch and start eating....yet I am no closer to my lunch order I placed by phone 2 hours prior. I could have canceled my order, went back to my office and ordered Panera faster than I got my call-ahead order today. I walked out with my food at 12:35, 50 mins after I was supposed to pick it up and 35 mins late for my meeting.

Here's the deal, Companion. I like you. I like your overpriced salads. I get it. Your new computer system was a POS and you got your arses HANDED to you today in way that would drive a recovering alcoholic to drive straight to the liquor store. But there is no way you should let regular customers, who waited 45 mins to an hour, OUT YOUR DOOR without offering SOMETHING... a discount off today's order, a discount off your next order, free cookies. I don't care... today, you acted like you didn't care about my business. And that kind of treatment is remembered and talked about. Do better next time your service is so crappy. Show your customers you care that their experience was awful instead of ignoring them and a tepid, "thanks for your patience" as you hand me my order.

I just have to give a huge shout out to wonderful staff at Hilltop Pet Resort!  They are always wonderful.  For some reason, Briley was not feeling well this time.  The staff quickly identified this and changed him to a bland rice food to help him.  They communicated with me through the entire time.  They gave him extra loving and attention.  I have total confidence in leaving my 3 babies in the care of Hilltop!  What a wonderful and trustworthy place to board your babies.  Can't say enough good things about them!

Entire staff...is super professional. Very nice to feel at ease when walking into a dental office. This place deserves 10 stars SUPER DUPER CLEAN, especially with every step of the way-from getting x-rays to having fillings to just using the restroom! That's a plus when a dental office is very clean. I love that. Melissa is a sweet heart and truly cares for the patients. Melinda is literally the most calm, relaxed yet professionally honest receptionist over the phone and also in person. Dr. Raj is a very diligent hard worker of a dentist. I forget the guy who does a lot of the main works name...however, he is gentle and does excellent work as well. I had to get 10 cavities filled & it was successfully and pain-free, I might add, and done in ONLY 2 visits! This is now the place I will come for any dental procedures. They have earned my trust for sure Today I got an extraction done by Dr. Zitter & her assistant Jessica. THEY ARE SOOOOO GOOD! Don't be scared to come to this dentist office because your well being is top priority with a capital "T!"
Great service, they went above and beyond the call of duty to help me with my bad credit get into a nice lil truck. I will definitely recommend them, also very clean lot and good selection!

Friendly, quick service with Wendy's stnadard menu, but I goofed up by ordering the BBQ Ranch Salad.  All the salads here are overflowing with sugar, but the BBQ Chicken salad seemed like the best option.

The Wendy's lady described it as a "glazed BBQ chicken breast over greens", but found the chicken floating atop the sauce and with all the corn, it was way too much for me. It had more sugar in it than a Frosty.  Yuck.

Went to have my car inspected and all it needed was new tires. They put new tires on and I go to dive it over 50mph after they put the tires on and the car is shaking. I call and they say bring it back in, so I do - to have it rebalanced. I drive the car over 50mph again after that and it's still shaking. I call them and tell them it's still not right and they say they have to buy a new balancing machine. So I bring it in for a THIRD TIME after they get the new instrument and they still couldn't balance the car. I took it to a shop in Lansdowne and they actually balanced the car and told me the people at mineke just kept adding weights and they had to take weights off and actually balance the car. 10/10 would never bring my car back here ever again.

ZERO STARS!!!!  It MAKES ME PICK ONE.  The absolute WORST, WORST, WORST. I switched to Century Link when I dropped cable TV. They offered a $19.99 1 year contract. I bought my modem from them. They charged me modem rental, and NERVER gave me the $19.99 rate. They said I only paid $249 for December - August but I actually paid $67 ($603)month. They gave me a new account number in September and never told me. They changed me $37 a month and a disconnect notice. I did get a credit on my 1 st account but now my service is disconnected because they did not take the credit to pay the new account. I will NEVER EVER RECOMMEND  Century Link!!!! They will
Steal your money!!  I have a $200+ credit and no service right now. IDIOTS!!!!

I can't, just can't, I mean Sweet Baby Jesus!  

The coffee was great!  The Barista was fantastic, but that donut!  Creme Brûlée is an amazing dessert, with that beautiful crackly sugar top.  Now, to bring this into donut form with that crackly sugar top?  You win! 

You had me at hello.  You complete me Donut and Dog.

This place is just the cutest! I always love trying local favorites when traveling and The Donut + Dog came up multiple times when looking for a fun stop. Anything with dog usually wins me over! We went in on a Saturday morning and easily were able to order donuts and find a seat outside. Everything looked amazing from their mimosa flights to the donuts - they have much more than that too! Even the southern charm decor was fabulous! We landed on the two donuts of the day, which were was a Brown Butter Glazed topped with Toffee and a Cinnamon Glaze with Sprinkles. Both were divine and especially loved that richness of the Brown Butter Glaze! Such a great spot for a breakfast or lunch visit!
Amazing everything. I love this place. The owners are the bakers. Cinnamon rolls are just like grandma's.
This airport location was convenient. It is in a newly renovated location. I ate here because they had a short line. I ordered the chicken sandwich in a value meal. The food was hot and fast.
Dinner was very good, we had the Dragon roll, rainbow roll, and the volcano roll. Very good and fresh, I highly recommend this restaurant for an enjoyable evening

Call-a-ride is a joke. I have been informed since using them by their phone operators that I have to call 24 hours in advance for a ride the next day. Tried that today and not only can they not get me to work on time (my first day), the operator proceeded to act like I was a liar because I had informed her that I was always told to call 24 hours in advance. She said no one at Metro would tell me that...really? So if I've been misinformed it's my fault? Don't use them or pay the ridiculous $8 round trip fare...

Didn't expect something so nice in the Westport area. It is a lot of fun to eat while watching the actual baking process through the glass windows. The food is of course delicious, made with Companion breads. The combo of soup/salad/sandwich is $10 which is about $2 more than some of the other establishments. Totally worth it though.

This updated Dog and Doughnut hut offers an epicurean recreation of these culinary also rams in a way that leaves wanting for. Try the elote in any combination you want and snag a few of their signature brioche doughnuts for the morning after and. You won't be disappointed

Orange theory is very difficult to end your membership. It's ridiculous.You have to do it 30 days in advance & at the location you purchased it.They charged me for a month ( w/ o me attending) & the girls were SO extremely pushy. I know this is how they are trained ...It's not about the money it's about convenience I just wanted to call & cancel but no I had to drive all the way there & fill out paperwork,listen to the many options to stay & still get charged for a month. You guys there has to be an easier way ....
This place is amazing delicious. We got the 99 problems - the basil is strong! Super interesting flavor over this soft and flaky donut. We will definitely be coming back to try the other flavors!

This place completely exceeded my expectations. Too bad I didn't get the chance to try the food. 

I had the smoked caramel latte and the honey vanilla latte. I ordered both at 1/2 sweet and this matched the donuts I ordered as well. 

What's special about the smoked latte? Well, it's places in a glass cage and smoked in front of you! The smoke settles into the milk and this matches the slight bitterness of the coffee so well. You can taste the smoke too.

The honey vanilla wasn't too special, but what was great about both lattes was how thicccc the foam was. It sat on top for nearly 2 hours and didn't sink into the drink. That's when you know it's good!

My two donuts were Spring Into Summer and Bluegrass Mule. I liked how they heat it in the microwave for you before served. 

The former is a raspberry basil glazed donut. The basil cut the tartness of the raspberry very well and made a balanced mix of flavor.  Once I cut into the donut, the rest of the donut caved in- it was so fluffy and soft!! 

The latter was a little disappointing. It's a lemon filled donut with a bourbon honey reduction. Sadly, it lacked the wow factor the previous donut had. The filling was thicker than I had hoped as well. A pretty standard donut I felt that I could have gotten anywhere. 

The cashier gave a great pitch on all the donuts and desserts. Overall, service and attitude was the best I have had in any coffee shop. Would return one day if I ever come back to Nashville :)

Great sushi - fresh, interesting and tasty. California Roll was very good and their special rolls, like Crunchy, was outstanding. Service was fine. Interior is sparse. It feels fine, however. Concrete floor works.
Pretty good sushi and very good at making dietary changes (I'm allergic to sushi). A bit disorganized waitstaff but everyone was super nice and we enjoyed ourselves!

This location is near my office, so convenience is key. Typically a good experience. However, today I was in a rush so tried the online ordering. My order was ready when I got there. The employee repeated back to me what I ordered, so I took it back to work. Shame on me for not looking in the bag. When I got back to the office I found that my vegetarian South of the Border salad was actually a chicken/bacon Caesar. I'm also dairy free and had ordered a vinaigrette dressing. Called the location to tell them if the mistake and asked they have my correct order ready when I returned. Was handed a bag with my correct salad but a full on dairy dressing. Also, no one offered me anything extra for my inconvenience. At this point I simply returned to my office and am currently eating my salad with no dressing. Again, shame on me for not checking the dressing was correct, but how about offering a little something for your initial mistake?

Companion Cafe is my JAM guys like this place is my obsession. When my husband asks me where I want to go for breakfast? I say Companion...what about lunch? Oh umm Companion...Its Companion or bust for me. 

I am obsessed with the Spring Chicken sandwich this is my sandwich of choice. I always order the Petite Sack lunch which comes with a sandwich of your choice and a salad and a dessert. I of course always get....ding ding ding yep you are right the Spring Chicken and a chocolate chip cookie (drooling) 

Oh trust me I have had other items on the menu and have never been disappointed. My second go to? the Greek Goddess salad or the Tough Love salad but If I am really feeling feisty I will get their Buffalo Chicken Chili Oh Mah Gahd this is the holy grail of Buffalo Chili. I stalk the daily soup board because they have a different soup everyday and when I see it I change all lunch plans and go to Companion for this. I know at this point you think I'm crazy.... My husband loves the French Dip and for breakfast they have an egg version of the Spring Chicken with egg on a bagel okay now I am getting hungry

Aside from the really really good food I love this locations. Its HUGE. Its perfect for work meetings, mommy outings or group dates. They have window walls where you can watch them bake and kneed dough. Toss flour around, its perfect for distracting kids! 

Okay so when you go get the Spring Chicken and/or the salad and invite me too please!

I really liked this place! I had seen it on yelp and other places and had to give it a try. It was very good- the oj donut and fries were delicious. Hotdog was excellent too. Very yummy and will go back if I get the chance!
This company is horrible, service is terrible, the product is useless and internet keeps going out over and over and over. Lost internet over a dozen times in the last 24 hours

Awesome food! And the owner was very friendly and knowledgeable about culinary arts. I ordered their special sandwiches and pizza, all of it was tasty and the atmosphere was just right for a pizza place. Im glad they are next to my job and always coming back ! Thank you Zuzu Staff and Owner

I ride the Metro from Clayton to Stadium with a friend every time I visit St. Louis over a weekend. Its the cheapest and fastest way to get downtown. The train is always packed immediately after ball games. Yesterday, when we got on the red line westbound to Lambert at Stadium, the entire STL PD Bicycle Unit must have been on the train. They blocked entries with their bikes, making it difficult to get on and off the train for riders. I assume they were doing training since there were so many of them, but I would recommend choosing a different time to do that exercise rather than right after a ballgame.

In terms of safety, I have always felt safe during peak rider times (before and after games) because of the number of people riding. However, if you plan to stay downtown after the game for drinks, food, etc, I would recommend driving. The trains empty out the later it gets, giving way to some sketchy characters. I have moved cars several times before later at night because of feeling unsafe. Plan ahead and this is a great resource to utilize.
The sushi was amazing and the prices were reasonable. The staff is amazing! The 6 steps salmon was excellent.

We decided to pay The Donut + Dog a visit on our most recent trip to Nashville.  OMG, y'all.  Those doughnuts.  We picked up some doughnuts on the way over to Loveless Cafe so we could have something to eat while waiting the bazillion hours for our table at LC.  Best.decision.ever.

These brioche doughnuts are fantabulous.  So light and fluffy.  We picked up a selection of about 6.  My favorite was the S'mores doughnut.  Yummy fluffy doughnut drenched in chocolate with a torched homemade marshmallow on top.  I was greedy and wanted this beauty all to myself.  I made my doughnut companion get his own S'mores doughnut.  NO SHARING ALLOWED.

Closed Mondays - it's the best in town. High quality fish impeccably prepared. Love the yellow belly and Toro and the Uni is to die for and probably local! The service is first class and every moment you're there you feel attended to. Each mouthful is exquisite - trust me it's the best!

I arrived at the bakery around 8:00 AM on a Tuesday.  There wasn't a lot of items in the cases but what was there looked fantastic.  I selected a caramel pecan sticky bun and a cherry almond danish like pastry.  The cost was just over $11.00.  I ate the sticky bun for breakfast and it tasted okay.  The problem was the sugar in the caramel was not dissolved enough.  There were some solid sugar chunks in the middle.  The cherry danish was enough for my family of three to have it for dessert that evening.  Everything about it was perfect.  The only reason for the three stars is the sticky bun and the cost.  I will definitely return and may write another review if all goes well.

Visiting Nashville and gave this place a try. The owner and employees were so friendly! The brioche donuts are unique and delicious. The sweet baby Jesus is exactly like a creme brûlée. The dirty OG is a slight twist on the classic glazed and is awesome. We had the campfire mocha  and the smoked caramel latte. The latte is literally smoked, not just a smoke flavor. Yum! We didn't try the hot dogs but would give them a try if we come back. If you're in Nashville come give this local business a try! It's in a cute house with a porch.

This place has awesome sushi.  Gotta try the Amber Jack and Hamachi.  Service was great and enjoyed every bite of what we ordered.  I have to say that the miso soup was great too.  Loved that they put a good amount of seaweed and tofu in their broth.  Thank you!

I never eat fast food because I'm a health nut, but I knew I wouldn't eat until late if I didn't eat before my flight. The lady taking orders was extremely snippy and rude. I asked if the salad I ordered came with got or cold chicken - I hate cold chicken on salads. I mean who thinks that's ok anyway. She ignored my question even though she obviously heard me, and asked if I wanted a small or large. I responded and repeated my question and she literally ROLLED HER EYES and said it's hot with an extreme attitude. The food was ok, but the service was totally deplorable.

Was excited to try this place out based off the reviews. The interior design was nice. However the portion sizes of the rolls were completely lacking. It's basically a half sized (maki) rolls for a full priced roll. The flavor was all there it tasted great  but overall it was disappointing.

Century link is no good. Plz take all the bad reviews seriously! I've tried calling so many times for several different reasons and the only thing they can actually resolve is shutting my account off! I hate to be so straight forward but I wouldn't go through the trouble of texting all this out for you guys if I wasn't serious about how terrible everything is!

I've never actually bought the food here but they have a pretty nice play area outside that my daughter really enjoyed crawling around in. This location is extremely busy. Good for their business, but bad for the noise levels.

Friday afternoon at zu zu's was fast and delicious! We ordered a chicken cheese steak w/ pepperoni, beer battered onion rings and a piece of Buffalo chix pizza to go. 10 min later the food was ready and we home enjoying. The foyer of the spot was very welcoming and clean. The employees were also so nice. Give this gem a try.

Worst Wendy's Ever! Stopped for breakfast after a long weekend in Nashville. Line was long for which I discovered was a result of the extremely slow counter help and slower kitchen. Slower than a herd of turtles. One woman was working the counter and seemed annoyed to even be working. She spoke softly so you couldn't here here and after taking my order once, she asked me to repeat because she did't punch it in computer.
