After about 15 minutes, I got my breakfast sandwich and chicken biscuit. Both were dry and tasted like they came out of a microwave. No ketchup to be found. It's Wendy's so I wasn't expecting prime cuisine but mediocrity would have been nice and maybe a smile from the employee. Skip this place if you can.

I had went to my dealership for my car to get exhaust done. The prices were a bit outrageous and they recommended I go to a smaller place and get it done cheaper. Their prices were 1/4 of what I would have paid and it was done within 3 hours. Was really pleased and it was so easy to get it fixed.
Very tasty pastries, friendly people.  We liked the almond croissant the best.   Late' was good too, not too sweet or overly flavored.
Stairway to heaven donut may be the best sweet thing I've ever tasted. This place is adorable. Will definitely be back.

Best sushi in SB, bar none. Ming and the rest of the crew are incredible, and serve the best/freshest fish in town. From Albacore, to Toro, to Scallop, it's all amazing. Better prices and quality than anything on state street.

Understaffed. One employee taking orders, making drinks, yelling for customers to pick up there orders and not doing anything else until they have, while the line grows and grows.  The manager needs to staff this operation properly or fire himself.

Yum!!! Donuts were soooo good.  They are brioche donuts and being that I am already a big brioche fan these were perfect.  I had the churro donut with the campfire cappuccino and it was the best afternoon snack.  Service was fast and friendly.  I highly recommend trying it out.  :)

Such a sweet place! I took my cousin there for her birthday and they made us feel very welcome.  We had the pinwheel pastry and it was out of this world delicious. We were also lucky enough to be there when she took a coffee cake out of the oven and we got to try that!

I stopped by Zuzu's Kitchen off the recommendation of a friend and it did not disappoint! From the interior decor and the friendly staff to the creative menu, this is definitely my new go-to spot. I ordered Zuzu's salad and the only thing I can say is WOW! The ingredients are so fresh and I especially loved the avocado and artichoke! While I was eating I decided to order Zuzu's special pizza to bring home and eat with my roommates. Lamb on a pizza??? I figured if the salad was this amazing, the pizza has to be too! (I mean, it is a pizzaria after all) Holy CRAP!!! Best. Pizza. Ever. Lamb is my favorite and so is pizza. Both combined? HEAVEN. The lamb is obviously great but the 2 different cheeses and chickpeas on top really seals the deal. I am not in this area often but I plan to be here a lot more! The owner was great as well, I asked him a lot of questions and he was very knowledgable about everything on the menu. You can really tell that this is his passion.
Quality and freshness is very very good.  Not the cheapest but you get what you pay for.   The only downside: Parking is a nightmare.

Good, fast and friendly service. They take cards and cash now. They were able to take off all the bugs from the front of my car and tree sap that had made body and glass super sticky. Couldn't have asked for more for $10. Mats, wheels and waxing available at extra cost. Make sure to come in via 10th St.

Try the gooey butter triangles. Affordably priced. The correct size. The operation here is totally transparent they make the bread behind a wall of glass. Very futuristic. Clean. Looks like a bakery from Gattaca with Ethan Hawks. A lot of polos and khakis. Subway tiling and pine tables. Good breakfast or lunch spot.

Enjoyed our visit very much. Great atmosphere for a rainy Saturday afternoon. The staff and owner were friendly and informative about the menu. Donuts are delicious and flavorful. The freshly made chicharrones with the semi thick cheese were a great afternoon snack. Prices are reasonable for the area. Had three donuts, a coffee and the pork rinds for about $22. Will definitely be back to try the dogs since they looked tasty. Saw they had an horchata cubano espresso that I'll have to give a try as well.

Incredible, melt-in-your-mouth donuts!! I am a donut fanatic and these are the best I have had. The coffee drinks are right to scale with the quality of the donuts. While the prices are a little high for donuts, once you try them you'll understand why- they are special and absolutely worth it. The staff is so friendly and takes time for each of their customers; and the decor is cute and stylish. I haven't tried the dogs, but I have confidence that they only serve the best.

So happy I found this place. Quick delivery and food is always on point. The hummus is delicious- better than anything you can buy in the store. Their menu is huge and everything is good. I keep trying new things and I haven't been disappointed. Definitely my new go to for delivery.

I have been attending OT for approximately one year now (age 64) with my partner (age 70).  I do not usually write reviews but after reading some of the negative I have two things to say... first, it is a business.  You can cancel your membership at anytime however they have rules that you have agreed to when you signed up...2nd... KNOW YOUR BODY!  You do not have to push it to the limit and hurt yourself!  No one is standing behind you with a whip! 
As we age, unless we have stayed in shape our whole life, it is unrealistic to think you can go all out at the beginning without injuries.  I guess what I am saying is stop blaming others for things that are in your total control.  A year ago it was hard for me to get through the 55 minute work out... I now develop a sweat, will feel my body a day after where I have used muscles that needed some attention and continue to grow stronger.  
I highly recommend OT.... especially to those who really choose a life style and not a quick fix.

Omg!!! This place is a must visit. The donuts were amazing! I also got the smoked campfire cappuccino which came with a super cool presentation. The people working in the store were so friendly and welcoming. There's an adorable little patio area. I can't say enough good things about this place.

We've boarded our dogs here since last summer and we love hilltop! The dogs get super excited whenever they get here. The staff is always so friendly and accommodating. If we can't be at home to take care of our babies I'm so thankful for a place like hilltop!
Decent place food wise, but they illegally spam our mailbox with flyers despite not paying postage and ignoring the official no flyer sticker on our door.
Not very good, I expected much more coming from a place right next to the beach and the fish isn't fresh. Doesn't make sense.

This place is absolutely amazing! Everything is organic, local and fresh. I highly recommend the Little Italy Hot Dog and The Dirty OG Donut! The specialty drinks are also bomb. The setting is cozy and welcoming and the staff is super friendly and helpful. Five stars! Don't miss out on this place!

Delish...and I'm not a big fan of hot dogs.  Took my kid here after an appointment and indulged in the chorizo dog, as suggested by the guy behind the counter.  F*A*N*T*A*S*T*I*C.  My only suggestion is to stick with regular dog buns for the kids, or at least offer the option.  My little tag-a-long refused to eat his plain dog because the bun looked funny *sigh*....but I still enjoyed mine!

The fish is very fresh as all the reviews report. I like the sake list and how it indicates how dry it is. I would never order sushi here again though because the seaweed was not crisp. There's no excuse for wilted seaweed. Our server was friendly and we liked the green tea dessert at the end of our meal. Imported from Japan, it was a new taste but it's small.

This is such an amazing place! I am visiting from out of town, and I am so glad that we put this on our list of places to visit. 
The brioche donuts are perfect! They were not too heavy, had a great chewy texture, and the right degree of sweetness. 
The customer service was exceptional. You can tell that they go out of their way to make sure you have a good experience! We paired our donuts with a beer flight, and it definitely enhanced them in the right way. 
Whether you're visiting or a native, this restaurant is a place to go. You won't regret it!
We had the elote dog with truffle parm fries, the more than maple donut, beer flight and bulletproof coffee. It was all excellent, great customer service and a very cute place!
Can't say enough good things about this place. All their food is excellent. Personal favorite is the zuzu sandwich!

I would fully recommend Brooke's agency. We were first time home buyers, so there was a lot we didn't know that she helped us figure out. She is very knowledgeable about homes and maintenance, able to pinpoint the pros and cons of a house quickly which is invaluable when you are new to wandering a potential home. Her staff is also quick to respond!

Wasn't great but wasn't terrible. I didn't think I got the amount of food that it was priced for. The service was slow. The vegetable roll and vegetable tempura were both $7.50. I enjoyed the vibe of the restaurant and it was clean.

I love this place! These guys are trying really hard. They make their own hot dog bun. That's saying something. And it's delicious! I had the chorizo dog with corn and cheese. So tasty had a zest but not too spicy. I didn't want it to end..and the chips were a perfect compliment. I've had a couple donuts too. The key lime wasn't my favorite, but the s'mores one was on point! I don't understand why there is never a line, but I'm grateful I never have to wait and the staff is always very friendly and helpful.
Amazing!!! They have Kaldi's Coffee and their bakeries just perfect. You must try Baked eggs and bagel. The butter cake was yum!

Thinking about just sending these people back their wireless equipment and ordering hughsnet instead. I was originally scheduled to turn it on 16 of May, now it is 31 of May, the Technician came out to hook me up- and some other dimwit stole the line I was supposed to be hooked up to. Lousy customer service too. DONE if it's not in today as promised.

Amazing service & delicious sushi. Sat at the sushi bar and the 2 guys working back there had great customer service, were funny, & made amazing sushi. The food came very quickly and the employees food recommendations were great. New favorite sushi place.

Searching for a local Italian place, we came across this place.  It's most of what you would want in a local Italian restaurant.  From what I hear, this location is almost if not twice the size of their former location.  It was a Friday night and barely a wait even though the place was packed.  The salads were great and so was the bread with marinara sauce.  They have 2 entrées for $21.95.  My inlaws got that and I got the chicken parm.  My wife ordered a cheese pizza (due to Good Friday).  Everyone enjoyed their meal.  It's right across from Carrabba's which seems to be a chain Italian restaurant around here.  We will be back here next year when we come to visit.
Best sushi bar I have been to. Great staff Ming, Max and John. Kelly is a great server couldn't ask for better

I rode from the airport to WashU at 3PM on Thursday and back to the airport at 4PM on Friday. 

The ride on Thursday felt pretty unsafe. Once you leave the airport, more and more people of the sketchy variety get on. For example, a homeless man got on and started beatboxing. He then proceeded to ask everyone on the train for money. The rail runs on the honor system, which likely adds to the number of sketchy people that get on. 

It was much better on Friday, and it felt safer because it was busier. Probably because people were using it to commute home after work around 4PM. 

Remember to watch which line you are on! I got on the blue line instead of the red line on my way back to the airport. The underground section on the blue line didn't look familiar. However, it wasn't till a nice lady who saw me with my luggage told me I was on the wrong line, that I realized my mistake. Take the red line to get to the airport!! 

The MetroLink also goes pretty slowly in comparison to the Houston MetroRail. It takes about 25 minutes from the airport to WashU. 

It costs $4 from airport to your destination. I'm not sure why they force you to buy an all day pass at the airport. It only costs $2.50 on the way back to the airport. Overall, a much cheaper option than an Uber/taxi. And it is safe during the day, even though it might not feel like it.
Called in take out and only got half of my steak dinner! A steak and a potatoe...that's it! will be a 50 mile run to get the rest of my food!!!

Great and friendly staff as soon as you walk in! They are very knowledgeable about their products. Unfortunately we came later in the day and the donuts were pretty much sold out. I got the power lunch which came with a hot dog fries or chips and a drink. The chips were fresh and delicious. I'd recommend this place!

The Iron Sheet/Royal Grill's advertisement in the Indy Star says "The Largest and Most Elegant Asian & American Cuisine Restaurant." The place is neither large nor elegant.  It's a standard Asian buffet with an average number of selections.  Some of the selections are unique to this place, but most are common simple fare like vegetables and beef, egg rolls, so on. The food is mediocre, but the price is not too bad.  In general, there are better buffets to eat nearby, Asian, Indian, and American.  I won't return, and doubt it will stay open longer than a year.
This will be our go-to when we're in town. Delicious, friendly & fun! We loved the dogs & donuts so much we bought the t-shirt!

We sit at the bar. Really like the interior of this store. We ordered tempera udon, salmon sushi, baked green mussel and Unagi Donburi. The salmon taste fresh. Unagi Donubri taste great but the udon is too salty. If you don't like salty food don't forget to ask for less salty udon! Overall really good restaurant! The service is nice and the sushi chef is really easygoing. Will definitely come back!

The only sushi restaurant I keep going in town. They have the best uni in town, also the 6 steps sushi is bumb! For dessert, definitely don't miss out on the cheesecake, I even buy a dozen to go with me afterwards Everytime.

Fantastic experience.  The resort is up a road through a neighborhood which was a little off putting at first, thinking it's just going to be someone's house, but once I came up on the property, I actually said, "oh my god WOW" out loud.  It was beautiful.  When I pulled my car up and parked, two staff members ran out to help me get my dogs and items out of the car.  They took my dogs back to get them settled while I filled out paperwork at the front desk with another staff member. I guess one of the dogs had gotten excited and had an accident on herself.  They immediately bathed her off, no questions asked, no issues.  Everyone there just seems to really care and are SO sweet.  Good people, gorgeous facility.  And our dogs came back bouncy, happier than they've ever been.  OH, and we had asked that they get baths before coming home, and they were given cute little bandanas after their baths to take home.  I love this facility and will definitely be using them in the future!

Meh. If you want to run on a treadmill and end up with major back problems (I ended up with a herniated disc in my back), this is your place. Also, oddly enough, the studio only seems to hire young 20-something men who don't seem to understand aging, or issues with women's bodies after becoming a mom.

Also just want to point out it is not locally owned, hence the owners have no community connection.

Bottom line: you're better off going to a local fitness studio with women/men/people that actually care about you, not just taking your money.

Great Italian food!

The chicken parmesean and stuffed shells were excellent.  Our server was very nice and my Aunt and Uncle really like the breaded veal at Argento's.  

They also have a full bar and display case packed with Italian pastries and baked goods.

If you visit or live in the Spring Hill area, check this place out.

Amazing!! I've been wanting to try this place out since It opened but never had a chance to go. I was able to stop by today for lunch and It surpassed all of my expectations. Parking was easy and It was just before lunch time so the place wasn't crowded. Ordering was simple and the employee walked me through different options since It was my first time. I ended up getting the flying Hawaiian hot dog accompanied by truffle parm fries, a more than maple donut and a nitro cold brew. I can't even pick which was my favorite because It was all so delicious. I had to wait for the donut because It was in the process of being made but It was def worth the wait and is one of the top donuts I've ever eaten. I will def be coming back here again so I can try some of the other offerings.
Great staff....great atmosphere... Decadent food...both dog and Donut were amazing....good conversation while you wait and cant wait to try more
Orangetheory is the most motivating workout. Its a great workout fir all fitness levels. Orangetheory casas adobes has great coaches and atmosphere and is my favorite gym in Tucson.

Love zuzus!!! Very impressed with their pizza. Highly recommend the boom boom slice! Full menu with very reasonable prices! Inside is clean and very modern looking. Have nothing but good things to say!
Ditch the donuts, get the dogs and fries!!! The donuts are so dense but the flavors are good, not as amazing. The fries though AMAZING!!!!

If you want really bad service with a bad attitude and poor quality food this is the place for you. 

Nasty lady behind the counter was full of hate and couldn't have been meaner. 

We were laughing at how rude they were to me; then I got to sit down and eat the horrible food that i just ordered. 

If you have to pick eating at this Wendy's or starving. Might wanna starve, it will be a better experience. 

Dave Thomas did not have this place in mind when he started up his fast food chain.

Nestled away down the road from the Belcourt Theater lays The Donut + Dog. A friend recommended it. I loved the quaint intimate atmosphere small batch brioche donuts- they make about ten kinds per day. Their donuts are thick but texture wise are light and fluffy. They don't weigh you down. The hot dogs some in a variety of flavors. I had the BAT dog! The place is amazing and I love the neighborhood atmosphere of the area!
This place is so tasty. Really love their chucks #39 chicken salad sandwich and their creamy mushroom soup. The bread is so good that this place will make you forget about your gluten-free diet.

1 of the only casting agencies in town now-- if you're called in for an audition or go here for an open call, you'll be trekking across town to the outskirts of fishtown.  If you get a chance to take one of the occasional classes offered by Pat or Diane or Jason, they know their stuff and how to teach you what it takes to make it in this business and so you don't get taken advantage of . Pat, Diane and Jason are seasoned veterans of the casting world, take their business very seriously, and cast for all of the additional roles for most of the major films that are made in the city and the Philadelphia surrounding areas.  TO NOTE:  this is generally not a casting call farm.  If you submit your headshot and resume, just like in the major markets like New York and LA, you will only get a return call or email, if they want you to come in for an audtiion or you are submitted by your agent.  They simply don't have time to respond to every inquiry.  I might add that if you hope to get anywhere in this business, it's worth developing a thick skin early.  If you want to be taken seriously, invest in some real headshots (by a "headshot photographer" not your sister's friend from work or your cousin -there are several in the city, including Paul Sirochman on Girard ave) solicit them to an agent and interview several, and most importantly, seek to develop your craft and take classes.  I saw one review critiquing them for not being "professional" or considerate and replying to their submission.  If you are truly a "seasoned" veteran, you know that simply isn't standard practice, and if you are looking for reassurance and validation, acting is probably not your business.  I say that with all kindness.

Tonight was our FIRST and LAST time visiting this place...we were in the mood for sushi and normally go to a place in Castleton but we decided not to because we had the kids and boy was stopping here a mistake! 

Mind you it was just before the dinner "rush" and the trays of food were half full and room temperature (probably left over from lunch), we all ordered waters and asked for lemon in them but limes were put in instead, the sushi bar was half empty and again looked like it was lunch leftovers...we only stayed because our daughter had already started eating and would you believe it they started making new sushi when it got busier but only after we had gotten done eating and we're getting ready to leave.

I told the man when we paid that we would not return and he asked me why and when I told him he said he would make it up to us on our next on our next but I said don't worry about it because we will be coming back but instead going to our usual place 20 minutes away.... It was $26 that I would've much rather saved, eaten somewhere else or paid 10 or so dollars more to eat at our normal sushi place.

The sushi selection was terrible the other food was subpar and on top of that they have a sign at the table stating they have the right to charge your final bill an extra 20% fee if you do not clean off your plate from the food that you took from the buffet during your visit...one more thing ~ there was a family of 4 who sat down, the husband went and got his food but when he got back to the table they all got up and walked out because of how bad it was...wish we'd have done that ~ so I tell you again this place is not worth your time, drive or money!

One of the shift managers suggested I complete the survey mentioned on my receipt and hooked up my family with ice cream cones! She was really nice and the other staff were friendly as well. It was helpful that the fries were deliciously fresh this time.

My S2000 was full of bugs after a round trip to LA, and surprisingly they were able to remove all of them and left the car super clean and scratch free, all for only $1 more than an automated wash at crew or similar! Will definitely come back.

I e really wanted to try this place ever since a coworker brought donuts from here to work. They looked amazing! Not just the boring old box of donuts. Everyone knows you eat with your eyes first and they are beautiful! I liked the injectable ones with the syringe. 
When to the location today and the service was outstanding. The two girls behind the counter were sooo friendly and seemed genuinely excited to tell you about everything they loved on the menu. 
I had the chorizo dog and BAT to split with a friend. Both were good but I loved the sauce on the BAT( bacon, avocado, tomato). The black truffle fries were KILLER!!

Visited on a recent family trip to PA and fell in love with this adorable pizza/sandwich place. Despite bar stool seating and a lack of high chairs, it was extremely family friendly, with enough space inside for our kids to eat in their stroller. The food was AMAZING, especially the Zuzu pizza (lamb on pizza? Yes please!) which the kids and I all loved. I also got to taste the Zuzu sandwich, which was phenomenal. The staff was welcoming and very accommodating.

We'll definitely go back at every opportunity because it was just that good!

About half-way through eating, I realized that the interior of my grilled chicken sandwich was raw. The counter person gasped and took it into the back. The manager on duty was not at all disturbed. She told me that the grill had been giving them problems and offered me a refund. She showed zero concern about the possibility of giving more uncooked sandwiches to more customers.
Great bakery items and simple lunch/breakfast fare.  Great for a simple lunch, best for loves of bread to take home.

ordered delivery here a couple times. all terrible. first time took 3 hours to show up. 2nd time a cold cold margarita pizza. third time decided maybe i should just go pick it up. some how... still... a cold pizza...

ZuZu on that beat! Place is great, cheap tasty grub that will satisfy. I always order through Grub Hub and the food arrives super quick. My only complaint is I wish the menu were a bit more diverse but otherwise it's awesome. Cheeseburger is great, buffalo chicken wrap, among others.

I went into my first zuzu's kitchen eating experience  blindly, reading no yelp reviews beforehand. I really did not know what to expect, except the fact that they had burgers and pizza. The restaurant was decorated nicely which reassured me upon ordering the zuzu cheese fries, which at one point during the order I regretted. But I didn't care. I was hungry AF. After me and my woman walked through the blistering cold we got home and I housed the fries. They were delicious! The truffle oil was a nice touch. Her chicken sandwich was dry so she had to add ranch but that's chill, she still ate it. Now the cats are bothering my allergies and I'm gonna have to blow my nose 15 times. Merry quanza

We will never purchase a car from any auto ranch again. Our salesman was great but beyond that it was a nightmare. We were told the car we purchased came with a 3mo. warranty on the power train. After having the car for a less than a week we started having problems, which were part of the power train go figure. They would not honor what we were told and then sent us in the mail the letter in the photo informing us we had just been screwed. They were not honorable. My husband has spent so much time and money fixing this car.

Came here with my family on a Saturday around noon. The line was long, which was to be expected on a nice day and a game day, but we stood in line for 10 minutes and hadn't moved an inch, so we went somewhere else for lunch. Came back around 2:30 to grab a donut, and while there were only 3 people in front of us, it still took over 20 minutes to get through the line. The guy taking people's orders was moving just as slow as he pleased, and the woman making drinks was in and out of the kitchen. I heard them tell anyone who ordered an espresso drink that it would be an additional 10 min wait, so I switched my order to a regular iced coffee and got out of there. The food looks great, but unless you've blocked off the whole day, unfortunately not worth the wait.
Wonderful sushi, first time for kurodai, best eel ever! Lovely people, great sushi chef.

An unexpectedly hip industrial warehouse serving up delicious breakfast and lunch fare in between slices of absolutely killer breads!
Came in for a late breakfast and yummed our way through an Oh La La plus bacon (per the very sharp staff member's recommendation) and an insanely good Philly egg dish. Each turned a standard egg sandwich into something memorable. The brie, roasted tomatoes and brioche in the former and some savory garlic cream sauce underneath a tasty bavarian pretzel roll in the latter.
Soups are also stupendous.
What a find! Thanks Yelpers. Wouldn't have found it without you.

First and foremost, the service is an 11/10. Extremely attentive and genuinely friendly, I feel very welcomed to come back and dine here next time I'm in town. I'd recommend making a reservation if you want a table. Two of us came in on a Friday night without a reservation and was seated at the sushi bar (which I prefer). Sitting at the bar alone made the experience better for me, on top of the great quality fish!

We each got a Six Step Salmon, each step was melt-in-your-mouth delicious. Although wished the menu or sushi chef described the six differences between each step, I would've asked but the chefs were slammed. Next time! Two rolls to share and then 6 nigiri pieces to share of Toro, fresh scallop, and Uni. It definitely satisfied our sushi craving and will be back! Thank you Sun Sushi!

Such a cute place! Donuts are good. They run out of certain ones as the day goes on, so if you are wanting the full selection get there earlier in the day. 

The coffee is good too! I got a colorful latte and loved it!

What a strange and wonderful combo this place is.  They should add "Joe" to their name because they also have amazing coffee.   If you're in the mood for some great donuts, coffee or hot dogs, check this place out.  Even if you aren't looking for any those things, check it out anyway.  Who doesn't love a great donut?  Psychopaths, that's who.  You don't want people thinking you're a psychopath so get here before they get suspicious.

Different industrial venue with a good selection of breakfast & lunch options, sandwiches, soups, salads in different configurations. Very fresh breads and sweets, excellent coffee including specialty espresso options. 
Seemed to have a steady stream of take out customer and lots of room for eating in with an entertaining view of the bakery production factory floor.
First time here and the donuts were yummy.  Loved the donut of the day: guava filled and the dirty OG. Definitely a place to try again!

Walked in at 6:15 am and there were people in the building but the definitely weren't busy. All I wanted was a scoop of hash brown casserole and some sausage. If I had known it was gonna take over 5 minutes to be acknowledged by a server AFTER the hostess already called for one, and another 20+ to get my order I would've just gone hungry. I had time to use the bathroom, pay my bill, take a call, and send some emails before I received my undercooked hash brown casserole. I never knew it took that long to literally scoop out an order. Absurd. 
The lady working the register was very sweet, and literally the only credit to the whole restaurant.

Delicious!! My daughter and I had a blast while enjoying a lunch we both loved. You obviously can't go wrong with gourmet hot dogs and donuts. Love the indoor and outdoor seating options. Another plus is that this area isn't absolutely packed like the rest of nashville!!

We met with Will - owner, entrepreneur, baker, and overall great guy who lives by his belief in organic customer service. All customers were personally welcomed and we felt at home in this casual atmosphere.

We sampled the donut-of-the-day "Stairway to Heaven" - brown butter glaze, cinnamon, sugar, and raspberry. An amazingly light, yet firm consistency that melts in your mouth, plus the equally amazing "Sweet Baby Jesus" - a creme brulee shell with vanilla filling. So good! Then, devoured the "Elite Loco" - churizo (spicy) hot dog with Mexican street corn, along with truffle parm fries!
Came up to Santa Barbra to visit brother and was very impressed with quality of food. Service was good and fast. The place gets very packed right after opening.

If you like Panera Bread, you will love Companion Cafe!  For lunch, I had the 1/2 sandwich and 1/2 soup combo.  My choices were Fowl Weather, a roasted turkey avocado with honey pepper jam sandwich with Chicken Noodle Soup.  The jam was very unique and made it sweet and savory.  The soup had lots of fresh ingredients and tasted homemade.  The only thing I didn't care for was the side of French baguette - I was expecting fresher bread, and this tasted old.  I would absolutely return for lunch, but go with one of the other breads for your side.  There were some outlets along the wall for working if needed, but it became very packed during the lunchtime peak around 12-12:30 so plan accordingly.

I have been here a few times now and left feeling different each time about the food. What was consistent is very little fish on the rolls and almost paper thin slices at times. The rolls are also on the smaller side. I ordered the spareribs twice. The first time was delicious; therefore I came back and ordered it again, but the meat was chewy and not good the second time. Staff is friendly.

My daughter and wife (who had been here 1x before about 2 months ago) brought me here this morning for a sugar rush treat before heading to Radnor State Park for a walk around the lake. We arrive around 9am and literally no one was inside (which scared me a bit but I guess many sleep in Sunday's in Nashville during the winter). This was a great place for a little hipster experience with donuts and coffee (didn't try it I e any dogs) soooo here we go:

The Ambiance:
Hipster urban vibe around the Vanderbilt campus that screams artsy and eclectic vibes. The entrance had painted donuts on the walkway up to the door and inside is a combo farmhouse / industrial feel with art hanging from the ceiling and a huge neon sign on the wall.

The Food:
Donuts and Coffee on the menu today as our attendant went through 6 different donuts of the day derailing each one, the ingredients, the name, and it's toppings / sugary additions. We opted for the chocolate xtreme (my wife's speed) and I wanted the snowy white (white chocolate buttermilk donut) but since she doesn't like white chocolate and she  wanted to share - I opted for the trailblazer toffee donut. Both were flaky and light from a base perspective which was nice vs.the heavily fried or very dense normal cake or other base donuts from any of your typical donut joints. Both were very flavorful just a bit too much chocolate on the. Green for my liking. My wife lived it however. She also ordered the campfire cappuccino which they threw a marshmallow in and toasted it with a blow torch right at your table. 

Our son and daughter also opted for the smoky latte which they smoked in a glass. Obtained at the table providing a light "smoke" flavor to the cream on too...super interesting.

The Service:
Great service from the start - we were greeted right as we walked in and were fully informed on all the coffees and donuts that could be ordered at our pleasure. Follow up at the table was also prompt and friendly while the music playing was 80 and 90's retro.

The Price: more than your typical donut place but well worth the more artsy nature and the experience. Coffees were avg abt $5 per.

Overall:
A great place for a donut and a coffee if your looking for dessert for breakfast with your coffee and a quaint little place around the university for your morning.
I had the snap dragon donut and flying Hawaiian dog and OMG SO GOOD. I can't wait to go back and try more. My boyfriend had the brunch dog and loved it.

I love Cracker Barrel but I must admit they have the most unfriendly morning hostess I have encountered. I visit here often but I have never seen her smile she never says hello just How many?  She may be a nice girl but you would
Never no it by the way she greets the guest.

My my my. What a delicious dog! I had the 'Reuben' hotdog and it was phenomenal! The fries are crispy and savory as well. Incredible service and hospitality from the staff. This was an all around incredible experience. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants a taste of something more than your average hotdog.

With in 2 secs of meeting the manager Bryan I felt like I knew him for years!!!! His greeting was so genuine that I wish they could clone him & let him run every store in the country!!! He presented him self like a hard worker- always checking the dining room, delivering food, small conversations!!! Service was on point!  Food even seemed better then ever!!! We stop here every time we drive from Cleveland to Dallas!!! Every visit is five stars I felt bad one visit I tied my dog pearl jam up against the tree & she dug up the mulch & kicked it all over the parking lot.  Out $20 that day tipping the bus boy for cleaning it up lol other then that we normally don't FSU when Rollin through town!

Took a stroll through our neighborhood in Hillsboro and ended up at the cutest little house/donut/hotdog shop called Donut + Dog. What a treat! The barista Parker was so sweet and knowledgeable and went through each of the donuts of the day with us making them all sound so tempting. We landed on the "dirty og" and "stairway to heaven". Wowza!! The dirty og was delicious with the perfect balance of sweet and savory sprinkled with cinnamon and Himalayan pink salt. The stairway to heaven had this buttercream glaze that literally melts in your mouth. Our donuts were accompanied by delicious bulletproof coffee and cold brew and a warm and inviting ambience. Thank you Parker and donut + dog team for a great first visit! We will be back :)

I have always loved going to cracker barrel but I had to walk out the last 2 times we went. We sat for almost 10 minutes without the waiter that walked by us even acknowledging we were there. When he did, you could almost hear the eye roll. I did not even talk to management this time because the time before they just said "okaayy?" Then stared at me as if he wanted me to tell him what to do...fix it!! Have not been back since and I sure do miss the Hashbrown casserole

Won't eat here again. I ordered an avocado roll and what they served me was shocking. The avocado was brown and black (literally) all over. It was so gross I had to send it back, and you know it's bad if you have to send avocado back. My thought is if they'd serve me avocado this way, what's up with my spicy tuna roll?? Check please!

This is going to be my new favorite sandwich place. They have really good quality and quantity sandwiches, especially their sack lunch menus. We liked the 2 sandwiches ordered: Fowl Weather and Fa La La La La (awesome names right?) but looking around, everyone's dish looked good; they baked fresh bread and bakery daily. We'll come back earlier to try their almond croissant and other bakery choices. 

Tip: Spend a bit more money and get their ooey gooey butter BAR instead of the slice b/c it's much more moist and "gooey." Their brownie was also super soft.

We stayed the night in the Westport area and found this little gem for Sunday breakfast via Yelp.  Being a bakery, the breakfast offerings are limited to egg sandwiches, bagels, pastries, fresh fruit, and yogurt parfaits.  Between the four of us, we had velvety baked egg sandwiches on the FLAKIEST croissants, satisfyingly-delicious bagels, and a huge chunk-of-a-serving piece of banana walnut bread.  All YUM!  We ended up adopting one of the boxes of gooey butter cake and a loaf of sour dough bread to take with us...which were far superior than anything else commercially made in town!

We heard good things about Sun Sushi, but unfortunately we had a bad experience. The most disappointing was the sushi. Both such rolls (Box and Rainbow) has no flavor. The fish was too cold and very low grade sushi. 

We've been all over the world eating sushi and even lived in Asia (Japan for 2 years) for more than 6 years. This was some of the worst restaurant sushi we've experienced. When we got home we both had to eat something to get the taste out of our mouth. 

We're heading back to Arigato Sushi -- they are consistently great with sushi.

Very disappointed in Orange theory, the subscription plan, and client services. Work outs are great, trainers are friendly however this is not a course that I would recommend to friends to do for a limited time. It is very difficult to cancel your membership once you have signed up, so I would caution anyone who commits to Orange theory to understand they will make it very difficult to cancel your membership. Had an experience where an Orange theory staff member would not cancel my membership. Instead she said they would suspend the membership and you would not be charged again even though that is not what I asked for. Also ended up paying for that month that I attempted to cancel. Then January rolls around and I am charged $89 again. Apparently the account was reactivated without my permission. I asked yet again to cancel and was told by a manager, that I could cancel but there would be another $89 charge for cancelling. How is this okay? I have not been to Orange theory in over 4 months, I was charged the month I attempted to cancel and then charged in January and charged for a cancellation fee. I am very disappointed because this was a program that was fun and I would have considered rejoining but I don't want to commit to a company that is going to have hidden charges and terrible customer service by both staff and management. The kicker to all this was the fact that the staff member that would not let me cancel no longer works at Orange theory. Management used that as an excuse, as if some how it is my fault that an employee that used to work for you made a mistake, and Orange theory does not want to take accountability. Unfortunately will not be signing back up and will not be referring anyone to Orange theory. Its one thing to make a mistake, no company is perfect and unfortunately things happen, but if they aren't going to take any accountability or attempt to make it right, it is not a company I want to do business with.

We walked in and we were greeted in a friendly way.    My son and I were walked through the menu and told about the coffee and donut options.  We ordered and sat down.  Our meal came with a drink and chips.  The chips were homemade kettle style.  They were perfectly seasoned.  He loved his kids hot dog.  The Banh mi veggie hot dog was delicious. We got the donut of the day and loved it! The owner. Will, was very nice and friendly and very sweet to my very excited 6 yr old!  We will be back again!

This is a very typically boujee place for Hillsboro. The hours are pretty limited so I only just got around to coming here on a Saturday morning. Full of people with their dogs, children, and scarves, to give you an idea of the clientele. The place is very cute, well decorated and cozy. Definitely a place for a date or for families. It was pretty busy when I came in - most of the seating indoors and outdoors was taken. 

Obviously they offer donuts and hot dogs. Plenty of options for both, and they have their brioche donuts in the window pane for you to see. They all look very tantalizing, and there's no shortage of appealing options. They also serve coffee and beer. Service was nice and pretty friendly. 

I got their pumpkin and nutmeg latte, which was pretty solid. Though pricey at $5. The donut was similarly priced, but really so worth it. I got the Southern Belle donut, which was filled with peach jam. It was damn good from the first bite, and the peach jam works well. It is very dense, and certainly has a lot of sugar, but trust me when I say it's delicious. 

I'll definitely come back sometime to try their hot dogs, and definitely try out some different donuts. If only they were open later!

After I left a review about how awful this place was they tracked me down and called me and harassed me. And now, 2 years later they are still calling me trying to get me to come back in!!! What the heck!! This place is awful!!! Would never step foot in here again................,

I've been here a few times but I felt compelled to write a review after coming here on Thanksgiving. The staff is always so friendly and I always feel welcomed and they somehow always remember that I'm a repeat customer. They opened on Thanksgiving morning to give people an extra chance to pick up donuts, and as someone in the service industry who had to work up until 11pm the night before Thanksgiving, I appreciate this more than I can explain. The icing on the cake to all of this-- the donuts are amazing!!! Best in Nashville, in my opinion, and I've tried almost all of them  Thanks, Donut + Dog! So grateful for local businesses like you. You guys really knock it out of the park in every regard.

People. You hear a lot about places with five stars and how great their food is, and this place is no exception. We went in for the "Dog" part the first time and I can tell you they were heavenly. I don't eat red meat so it's been over 8 years since I've enjoyed a good old fashioned hot dog but I'm please to say that The Donut + Dog features vegetarian (maybe vegan?? Not sure) hot dogs as subs! The bun was top notch, the hot dog was to die for, and those truffle fries? Don't even get me started. With food this good, you would think the review stops there....and then we met Will. Will is the entrepreneur who so graciously opened this establishment to please the taste buds of Nashvillians everywhere. He was the kindest soul I've met in this industry and has even more plans to grow the food category in Nashville! (Coming soon, can't tell, was sworn to secrecy...sorry). The food was what we came for and it didn't disappoint, but what we left with was a full heart after a genuine conversation with the owner, samples of their DELICIOUS fried Oreos and other goodies, and the mindset that we need to go back when the donuts are not sold out.... can't wait to try those brioche donuts!!

Thanks Will, I'll be back often!
Absolutely amazing experience here at Sun Sushi. Quality cuts and fantastic service. Get the six step salmon and uni. You will not be disappointed.

Waited in line for over an hour for a chance to experience this little gem.  Yes it was hot outside, but we were in line with lovely people who we chatted with and passed the time with, so it sped by.  Staff was friendly and helpful, and served us with a smile.  The hot dogs were very flavorful and fresh, and we loved that their iced coffees come in a pouch with a silly straw! Highly recommend the donut of the day, the beer flight and the Hawaiian hot dog.  We will be back!!

Mary Maimone is an amazing realtor! When I was in the market to buy my first home she set me up on her MLS and was very helpful. When I wanted to view a few properties Mary set up the appointments and we viewed them together and discussed each properties potential. Mary is a great source for lenders and just about anyone in the industry you would need for any work done. She helped me through the entire process and even got me a great deal on my house through her negotiation tactics. Before I bought my house I have been through dozens of realtors when I was looking to rent a property, but she was honestly the only one that really cared about finding the perfect fit. I will be using her in the future again when I buy an investment property and I highly recommend her to anyone who wants to buy a home for personal or an investment, Mary's your gal!

We've been searching for a while to find a favorite sushi place near Goleta. Sun Sushi is the best we've found so far - high quality ingredients, fast & friendly service, great atmosphere, and of course yummy yummy sushi.

The atmosphere here is adorable! Delicious drip coffee and fun donuts - we enjoyed a cinnamon glazed one (one of the more plain ones on the menu). The workers are SO sweet and friendly - service was out of this world. Highly recommend for Nashville tourists and locals - one of the highlights of our trip! :)

Zuzus is a little Francisville spot but convenient for a quick bite to eat. The pizza is alright good crisp and fresh would recommend the zuzu sauce for little extra pow. The wings are top notch, saucey and fully cooked. Panini are a solid choice as well. Fairly priced and quick service.

My wife and I consider ourselves donut connoisseurs so we had to try this new place. Guys, they are amazing. Definitely on the fancier, more pricey end of the spectrum, but the flavor is worth it. Think more of a 5 daughters (although pretty different style) and less of a Duncan or Krispy Kreme. We talked with the owner for awhile about the process. They use brioche dough with some seasoning and then it takes 15 hours to get the finished product, resulting in a super soft texture different from other donuts you have had in the last. The flavors were amazing and they cycle daily. We had the "sweet baby Jesus" which was a creme brûlée with vanilla custard and we also tried the "stairway to heaven" which was cinnamony and burbony (if those are words) with a raspberry on top.

Vibe is really relaxed and the owner is super friendly and knowledgeable. It might be a little expensive to cram down 2 or 3 of these donuts, but the flavor is there, so it may become a special treat spot every now and then. We will definitely be back. Great coffee too!

I went to bed thinking about how I was going to get an iced king cake coffee. I got up early went to PJs to learn that they didn't have any at 7:02 in the morning. You just opened. How is this so? Anyway, settled on a latte with soy. It was too sweet and just not that good. In the past I have purchased an almond crossiant there and it was pretty good so, I wouldn't give up on this place just yet. Maybe it was just an eh morning.

Absolute worst customer service! When they did not deliver the cleanse  I pre-ordered in June for an August delivery, I contacted them. They replied in an email saying the business had closed two weeks prior and would not be delivering any of the cleanses purchased. Still trying to get a refund!

Finally there is delicious sushi in Santa Barbara!! 

Everything we ordered was fresh and tasty. Honestly, I thought it was better than the sushi in Montecito, which is more expensive and a ridiculously long wait time. Sun sushi is much more casual but great quality. 

The salmon 6 ways is a must! We loved it and would order again. The albacore sushi was very fresh as well. The edamame was great and I don't trust a sushi restaurant with bad edamame so I'm glad this one met my expectations. 

I give 4/5 stars because of the service, two servers were constantly asking us if we wanted to order more and we felt pressured by that which is uncomfortable during a meal. Still would definitely come back for the sushi!

I have been trying and trying to disconnect and cancel my CenturyLink account and service for 8 months now and every time I call Centurylink to get my account disconnected it says to call back during normal business hours. This happens even when I call at 3:00 PM on a Thursday (today) and the stated business hours are 9:00AM to 6:00PM Monday through Friday. I googled the number thinking maybe the one on my bill is just a bad number. During that conversation, they stated that my account belongs to a different branch of Centurylink and they gave me a 1800 number to call 18002441111. When I called that number I got the same answering machine that said to call back during normal business hours exactly like before (again at 3:30PM this time on a Thursday)!! I finally resorted to their online chat service so there would be a record of our conversation. The end result was after an hour chatting with them and several transfers of the chat conversation, the chat session ended abruptly while the "agent" was "looking up my account". Everything here is Fuego montego on the real. Like y'all don't even understand. Zuzu's Chicken sandwich is a party up in my mouth with all dat flavor

Decided to stop in for the first time to try something new and grab some fresh baked goodies, the atmosphere is absolutely great the building is beautiful inside and out, you can watch the employees make baked good through the glass while you eat, it's awesome atmosphere gets 5 stars hands down, I got a heated Momo bun and it was absolutely delicious but my fiancé got a "one love" sandwich and it was fair at best, a very average tasting sandwich with a price out of this world, I'm giving it 4 stars because of the cost (it was expensive) and the non-bakery food not being awesome. Also got the cold brew coffee it was tasty. Overall we will be returning but probably not for lunch.

Oh geez
Don't waste your time really

Wings are pretty good

Burger was ok

Cheese fries....yuck

Horrible chocolate cake...acme quality

The donuts here truly are fantastic.  I've eaten a ton of fancy donuts, and the thing that sets these donuts apart is that it's shockingly rare to put enough focus on the donut!  These donuts would have been delicious without any toppings on them, the brioche dough was perfect, moist, slightly chewy but soft enough.  Then the toppings came on, and what was already a very well made donut became a 5-star donut.  I'd highly recommend The Donut + Dog if you're in the are and have a craving for some delicious donuts.

I tried LA Fitness, the Y, other gyms and after a year I can say that Orange Theory Fitness is the BEST investment I have made in my health.  I look forward to attending, I feel motivated by the coaches, the front desk, the studio music and the workout environment. I encourage everyone to try it for OTF will change your life for the better!

I had the opportunity to work with Mary Maimone to get my first apartment out of college. I had absolutely no idea about the nuts and bolts of this process and had many questions. Mary was welcoming and very friendly when I met her and answered all the curiosities with the same interest as me. My college was located a couple of hours from the city which meant that I could not go back and forth easily during the semester. Mary went above and beyond and gave me a virtual tour of options via video chat. The first time I saw my current apartment was after signing my lease - that is how confident I was in Mary's choice when she said she found a great listing for me. Definitely would recommend her especially to those looking for their very first apartment!
Love this bakery and cafe. A great selection of desserts and sandwiches for a quick brunch or lunch.

I wanna really like this place but when this place is backed up, there's nothing speedy about grabbing some donuts and a coffee. But I will say that the indoor/outdoor space of an old bungalow house has tons of character and they place great music. Only thing is you'll be sitting through an experience of people coming in and out in waves and lines that wrap wherever depending on how long the wait becomes. But if you can find a time that's off-peak, I say do it and have some goodies.
The Hangover burger hit the spot this morning.  Nice atmosphere, friendly staff, unique selection of donuts.  Would definitely come back while visiting.
Buses felt safe to ride on, trains somewhat. My ride from Brentwood to Skinker on the MetroLink wasn't bad though. It's really an efficient way to get to WashU/Forest Park.

Toro and blue fin tuna were their special of the day, and it was specially tiny!

They charged full price and gave food actually worse than all you can eat sushi place.

This is a pretender. Similar price like high end sushi places but no class here......

Save your money!

Add me to the cult of Cracker Barrel. I made my first visit Saturday at the suggestion of a friend, and it was love at first bite. The servers were genuinely folksy, older women who poured on the "honeys" and the "darlin's" and tolerated my insane need to make conversation and ask questions like we've been friends for a decade.

I had the shrimp po' boy (limited time offer) with cole slaw and fries. As much as I loved those sides, I really fell for the hashbrown casserole, fried apples, fried okra and onion rings. And Cracker Barrel considers all of those foods "vegetables," which is fine by me.

I was a bit disappointed in the gift shop, as I collect post cards and couldn't find a single one.
Grabbed a quick lunch to go. Was in and out in less than 5 min. The BLT is probably one of the best I've had. Cuban veggie soup was good.

Fantastic job of people moving after Rams/Bears game.  Lots of extra staff all over. Hand validating tickets was a good move.  

As an outsider I'm very impressed.  Metro anticipated.

Dont even think of trying it. Me and my wife took the Metrolink.from Lambert to.civic centre with total 13 stops. I work for transit in vancouver and work at Downtown east side which im not scared. Middle of the trip around 15-18 young youths high on drugs and crack smoking inside the cabin  obnoxious  and vulgar. Trying to touch my wife and me and intimidating me . I saw 2 guards at every station but they dont come in coz i think they themselves are scared shit. I have never felt so scarec in my life and i expected the worst for me n the wife. Shame on the people who manage this.. i can still go on. I took uber after that but the fear is still there. Give me a first class ticket and accomodation to go back. Hell no!
My dogs love Hilltop!  Caring and kind animal lovers on staff.  Will continue to use.

The tangibles: Every single donut I have had is nothing short of amazing. Even if a particular fruit or flavor isn't your favorite, you can't help but still appreciate it all: fun names, creative flavor combinations, and beautiful design. My non-donut go-tos are the Parmesan truffle fries and the campfire cappuccino! Flying Hawaiian is my dog of choice.

The intangibles: Will and the team know how to warmly invite you to the table filled with D+D lovers, casual engagers, and newbies. Every person who walks in is treated like family! This place has taken such good care of me. Will remembers when my family is coming into town to visit, thanks me for coming in and spreading the word to just about everyone I talk to in Nashville, and genuinely asks me how I am doing- all things you don't NEED to do but that he delights in doing.

Dr. Wu and the rest of the staff was amazing! I walked in needing an immediate extraction and they  went to work to relieve me of my paid.

Great Job & Thank You

ZuZu's is awesome and a great addition to the neighborhood. The staff is very friendly and always so welcoming. Food is delicious and never disappoints. We always pop in here and it's a go-to for quick dinner nights. It's definitely a healthier, lighter option than the standard, local pizza shops. ZuZu Chicken sandwich is a must and the ZuZu's cheese fries are a must have guilty pleasure.  So glad this place opened up!

My favorite sashimi place in Santa Barbara!! I've been coming here for two years. The house special sashimi bowl is the best. The fish are very fresh. They also serve Hokkaido uni, it tastes better than Santa Barbara uni. Don't get me wrong, I like Santa Barbara uni too!!

As far as Cracker Barrels go I'm very disappointed in this store.  The last 3 times my wife and I have visited there, the wait staff was great and very attentive, but food has come to us cold, overcooked, they are out of staples such as white beans, pinto beans, etc. We took a chance and visited yesterday ( 10/13 ) and got the same issues.  My grandsons baked potato was tiny, my wife's vegetables were cold and had to be sent back twice, and my fried chicken was overcooked badly.  We love Cracker Barrel stores but I guess the White House store or another store will get our business from now on

Had been going for 10 yrs, always preferred going to Swancy, compared to auto car washers because they usually scratch your finish from their roller brushes filled with debris from previous dirty vehicles. Although it's old fashioned and no frills, Swancy usually did good service, until recently, 1st, its not the easiest place to enter since its on a one way street corner, 2nd, many times before on  sunny days it has been closed with no signage and no voice messages

First thing, I noticed was the arguing among the manager and the workers, who asked the non working workers to stop sleeping on the folding chairs and work, I thought about leaving then, but they had already started watering the outside of my car. They washed the outside and opened the doors to vacuum the insides. Only 2 workers was cleaning my car. After, they finished, I paid my fee. Thanked them and was on my way.
When I stopped at the store, I parked and reached for my visor for my handicapped placard... and it was gone! Couldn't go back because it was Saturday after 6pm and Monday was the holiday, went back Tuesday morning, asked for the manager, who was in her car outside of the car wash, explained that my placard was apparently stolen and she immediate ly became angry, sprewing, that it's an 41 yr old business, and she trusted her workers and never, ever did she have such a incident. Then, she said, "You must've of forgotten where you put it and misplaced it"

i've been going here for over 10yrs, and how pathetic is it, that you run a business that stoops this low! A handicapped card! I told her, "You lost me as a customer and at least 10 or more of my friends, I won't be back" I probably told everyone I know!  I don't recommend this place and I'm sure it will be closing very soon.
All I can say is continue to go at your own risk!
Great spot! It is a small place with great donuts and combos. Their donuts are baked fresh everyday. I love the chili and beer cheese dog. Must visit when in the ares!!

This is probably one of the best sushi places I've been to in America. After going to japan, my bf and I are sushi snobs.. this place is comparable to Japan. Very fresh sushi! The servers and chefs were very welcoming and so nice! Will definitely be back!  Thank you sun sushi!

Okay Folks. Theirs some new owners on the block. So i had to give this place another try. Just walking in felt different. I understand that Covid-19 is still going on. So I made sure to wear my mask. I notice right away that everything was socially distance including the on the floor signs. The pastry area was fully stocked and looking delicious. But what shocked me the most was the owners were their helping their employees and greeting the customers as we walked in. I've never seen that done in New Orleans. Im pretty simple when it comes to coffee but this day i actually did one of the holiday drinks and it was very good. Free WiFi is all you had to offer mixed with good customer service and Im supporting your business. I invited a friend and she was impressed as well. We'll definitely be back very soon.

I've been coming here for a few years and generally I like the place. The sandwiches are tasty and the service is friendly, so I do not have a real issue with it as a whole. I do not like the pizza though and I am writing this review because of recent changes in the pizza quality here that I noticed. 

I grew up in an area of the country well known for high quality pizza so I admittedly have high standards. I always thought Zuzu's pizza was mediocre until a few weeks ago when I randomly went in for a plain slice and I noticed the crust was remarkably thinner and crispier than it had been in the past. It tasted just like the pizza I grew up on and I was truly excited that they perhaps improved their recipe, since this is a local neighborhood place for me.

Sadly that didn't last for whatever reason. I ordered a pie last night and the crust was spongy/rubbery, perhaps even more so than it had been before. I don't know if they changed staff or are experimenting with different recipes but I am certain there was something very different about the pizza for a bit at the beginning of this month and it is now back to being mediocre to bad. If the owners are reading this, I highly recommend going back to the thinner style from recently, there is no comparison.

So good!  My daughter and I had to try this place and we weren't disappointed. I had the Southern Belle I believe, filled with peach jam and topped with a buttery tasting glaze. It was perfection! She had one that was topped with vanilla buttercream and lemon curd. There wasn't a crumb left. And I didn't get to try that one, which means she lived it. Highly recommend. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable about their product. I will definitely be back!

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, many of us with a culinary interest are familiar with the old saying that you "eat first with your eyes."  Well I would say that it is almost equally true that you "eat first with your nose."  Little Kitchen Pastries is a symphony for your nostrils before you even put any of their creations in your mouth.  Seriously, the first time I walked in the door I just stood there for a moment and enjoyed the smell of all the freshly prepared baked goods.  It was quite simply amazing.

Baking is not my forte at all (in fact just ask my wife what happened the last time I tried to make a pie crust) so I more than appreciate the skill and effort required to make a good pastries, and the ones at Little Kitchen are very good.  The various danishes are spectacular as are the croissants.  The staff is incredibly helpful and friendly.  On one visit I got a cinnamon roll literally fresh out of the pan.  Great stuff all the way around.  I love to support passionate, local businesses and Little Kitchen absolutely fits the bill.

I have to hold back the fifth star for a couple reasons though, and they may seem "nit-picky," but I do try and reserve five star reviews for the nearly flawless.  The first minor issue is mostly a consequence of the type of business this is.  The selection of items is limited and you don't always know exactly what is going to be available from day to day or even different times of day.  Now to be fair, this could also be seen as a positive.  It means that every item is made fresh based on what is available and what the chef wants to make.  Absolutely true.  However that isn't much of a consolation when you REALLY want that ham and cheese croissant or that cherry danish.  So you just have to accept that your personal favorite may not be there at any given time.

The other minor issue is simply one of personal taste.  While I really enjoyed their danish and croissant, I did not care for the cinnamon roll at all.  I'm not a fan of raisins and while a "too sweet" glaze can certainly be off-putting, I found theirs to be almost tasteless.  It added very little to the roll aside from getting my fingers sticky.  But that's just a matter of personal taste, your mileage may vary.

Bottom line folks, if you are hungry for a great danish or croissant, or just want a "feast" for your nostrils, stop by Little Kitchen Pastries.  It is an awesome local business and you know what you are getting is made from scratch on site.  Your stomach and your nose will thank you.

This has always been my go-to sushi place. I usually order takeout and am impressed by the plating and impeccable quality of Sun Sushi but that could not be more opposite from the container I received today. Half of the pieces of my Box Roll were lacking fish and I didn't receive any ginger which feels like a sushi staple. I feel like I could have gotten better quality sushi at a Ralph's  for half the price. It's been a while since I've come in and it's apparent the quality has gone down.

Thanks to a Buzz Feed video this place has exploded in popularity. Everything I've had (Reuben hot dog, truffle fries, southern belle donut, the OG) is amazing. I highly recommend if you have a chance to check this place out. Just come early as donuts sell out quickly!

Okay picture this. You want to get back to the gym but you don't know where to start when it comes to workouts. This place offers all of the above to include nutrition. I did the 3G class and it's the group's alternating rowers, treadmills and weights. My first class was engaging and they set up a great rate monitor. Ideally you want to be in the orange zone to maximize your heart rate as you work out. Great cardiovascular workout and motivation. Like having a trainer in your pocket. The science is there. $28 pay as you go or $59 a month for 4 classes.

I've been going to Orangetheory routinely for over a year and I still cannot believe how ridiculously effective it is. It is a motiviating & challenging workout regardless of your fitness level. The coaches do an awesome job of teaching challenging templates with tons of variations and modifications while still keeping it squarely high intensity interval training. Every workout is different and the coaches encourage you to push yourself. 

I will say we all have our favorite coaches. I find Michelle Skog to be incredibly inspirational and I often think to myself of her sayings when I find a challenge outside of the studio. Stacey is encouraging and always lets you know that she's seen that amazing personal best you've just acheived. Callie makes you think you can do it and finish regardless of where you start. Renee is always there on the weight floor and tweaking your form to get you the best results. 

I can honestly say I've never had a bad coach or a negative interaction here. I am so happy to be an OTFer!

My absolute favorite breakfast/brunch spot when I visit Saint Louis. The service I receive is always wonderful, and the food is always delicious. The mission and overall environment is something to experience. You won't have any trouble finding something to eat or drink here!

Won't find a place to go for lunch during work better than Companion Cafe. Not only do they have great food overall.. their staff is so kind and friendly every time I'm there (which is about twice a week) 

Highly recommend if you ever want to take a client out for lunch or just craving goooooood food. 

Highly recommend - Fiesta Chicken Sandwich in Pretzel bread. You won't regret it!

Wish I could do negative star.  
Don't EAT here!! Cold food/poor service. 
Don't ONLINE order!!!  Wait, wait, wait, if they don't misplace your order. 
My how the Cracker Barrel company fallen. 

If you can't service your customers, SHUT the DAMN doors. McDonald's you are not and never will be.

I happened to be scrolling through Facebook and this spot popped up as a "must visit" in my newsfeed (thanks to a BuzzFeed video). The donuts looked amazing from the little promo video, so I made a note to visit when in Nashville.

Fast forward to arriving in Nashville, and coming here directly from the airport as we were pretty hungry. We arrived at approximately 2:00pm, and although the actual building is visible from the street, the signage is not. We noticed that several of the tables outside were filled with groups eating donuts and/or hotdogs, and all of the tables inside were seated. 

The friendly young man behind the counter advised before we even walked in all the way to him, that they had run out of donuts....now, it's early afternoon, and a donut shop...has run out of donuts...4 hours before closing...on a Saturday. We saw the dozen empty trays with a few crumbs stacked nearby. I don't know if this is purposeful supply and demand or what, but it seems like very poor planning to only make a small number of items that are your namesake and simply run out or stop baking that early during a shift. The donuts may very well be tasty, but just imagine how much business was lost during those latter hours due to poor planning.

This is a franchise store, but the owner is always there and has great customer service.  They don't appear to have any turnover, because I go here often, but the same employees are ALWAYS here.  (that's good).  Creamy cafe-au-lait, not too burnt like the national chains.  THe cranberry-orange muffin is my favorite.  Bathrooms are clean and there is plenty of quiet seating to enjoy your muffin.

Amazing staff! We enjoyed dinner here while visiting SB. After dinner, I accidentally left my purse behind. The waiter came out to find me, but I had already left. I called the next day and he happily located my purse and shipped it to me. The staff is so nice and I highly recommend coming here!
Donuts were SUPER tasty, Coffee was extremely mediocre. If you are like me and want a good coffee with your donut, then I recommend BYOC. ;)
I threw up three times at home after eating this sushi, bad memories. I ordered two of rolls, sweet shrimp sushi. Salmon and oyster. It's like good taste but something isn't fresh.

Flying into Santa Barbara and will be driving out later, I decided to meet up an old friend at this establishment for dinner, given the local vibe and reviews I've read.  

Parking is really tight and you might have to wait a while. You can park to the hotel/motel adjacent to the place but it's a bit sketchy. I got lucky and parked in the diagonal slots right next to the restaurant. 

Through the front door you are greeted by the host who will put you on a waiting list (parties of 4 or more) or ask you to get seated immediately (party of 2).  Since it was just me and my buddy, we got seated right away. 

Once inside, there are 6 tables that seats up to 4 and 4 tables that seats only up to 2; there's also the 6 seating at the sushi bar as well. 

I ordered a few appetizers and a few rolls to share. We both were not that hungry so we went light. I ordered a Seaweed Salad and a plate of Takoyaki. For the rolls, I ordered the Special Spicy Tuna Roll and a Lobster Baked Roll. Now, you're probably wondering why I Gabe them a 3 star. Well, it was both the time it took to order, the wrong roll that was brought out, and the customer services that was provided not just to us but to the other parties around us; it's hard not to eavesdrops on what's happening around us because each table was quite close. Long story short, food was good but not the best tasting rolls I've had. The Special rolls was mistakenly brought out to us for another roll. It took the waitress longer than expected (I timed this to almost a good 10 mins) before coming to ask how we were doing; this also happened to other guests as well. 

However, maybe under a different night and time, I would go there again. But for the taste of the food/rolls, if you're not picky then this is the right place for you. 

Not highly recommending this place but it's descent enough to eat at. Price wise, it's typical of sushi places.

This is hands down the best donut I have EVER tasted! Unique flavors, brioche donuts that just MELT in ya mouth!!! The velvet revolver had just enough subtle heat to give it a kick! The peach was filled and iced with seasonal peach goodness. I wish there was one closer!!! This is unlike any other donut! Addictive for sure.

This sushi spot is a gem, no doubt. I never have been here and I am wondering to myself why it took me so long to try it. Now I have come two days in a row so far. The sushi is fresh, from the rice being prepared perfectly fluffy and to the vegetables having the perfect crunchiness it's perfection.

Toro and blue fin tuna were their special of the day, and it was specially tiny!

They charged full price and thgave food actually worse than all you can eat sushi place.

This is a pretender. Similar price like high end sushi places but no class here......

Save your money!

Max, when you charge Full price for Toro and Blue Fin, you are essentially dealing with customers that enjoy these type of food regularly. 

Don't go to SUN Sushi if you expect high quality Toro/Blue Fin, let alone tiny portions. If you go, and not satisfied, tell Max you saw my review here!!!

The first class experience started with the convenient and free parking in the back. The staff were helpful and friendly and took the time to explain their donuts and items on the menu. Even the customers were so nice!! 
The smoked caramel coffee was an entire experience. The guy brought it to the table and smoked it in front of me. It was AMAZEBALLS. The parm truffle fries are fabulous, paired with the BAT hot dog, it was a delicious balance of flavors.  They even serve beer!! This place is pretty much perfect. 

Only regret is that I came for lunch and there were only 3 flavors of donuts left when I arrived. I'm not surprised they sell out. There was a part of me (maybe my wallet and stomach) that was glad they didn't have a lot of choices, otherwise I probably would have had to buy all the flavors. 

Atmosphere: 5
Staff: 5
Food: 4.8

I cam here for the first time today and was very impressed with the quality of the food and the portion sizes.  I ordered the "Sack Lunch" which comes with a sandwich of choice, a side of choice, and a cookie or snack bite.  I chose the Mermaid Sandwich (Tuna Salad) with a side salad and chocolate chip cookie.  Each items was very good; the ingredients and the presentation of the food were all exceptional.  I had never heard of this place before and seems to be a somewhat hidden gem.  I'm glad I discovered Companion Café as I will be coming here more often for lunch during the week!

They also have a very nice outdoor seating area for nice weather days.  They also have plenty of seating inside too.  It appears they get pretty busy right at around noon so do not be surprised to see a line and wait a few minutes before ordering and getting your food.  I would say that the price is somewhat on the higher end of a bakery, but the food quality and portion size is right on line with what you pay for.

Worst internet service ever.  The representative that sold me in switching lied about how fast my internet will be in comparison to comcast.  I'm in transition right now but I will be leaving century link as soon as I find a better internet servicer.

I ordered the Catalyst Cleanse due to the Rue La La coupon. It was actually a few weeks over the expiration date, but they were ok with that (yay!). After a few emails, I had my 3-day cleanse scheduled. I had the juice shipped to my office in DC and the juices didn't arrive until about 4pm, which was a little inconvenient since I was hoping it would come a little earlier in the day. 

Though I didn't do a full on 3 day cleanse with no food, I did enjoy the juices. The green juice takes a little getting used to, I really had to force myself to drink it. However, I liked all of the other juices- spicy lemonade, carrot, beet, and cashew. The spicy lemonade definitely had a kick to it- I diluted half a bottle at a time with water. The beet and the carrot ones broke up the day a bit so it wasn't all greens. I don't know if it's my taste buds, but I thought all of the vegetable juices were a little on the salty side, maybe it's the celery? The cashew milk was creamy and filling (in a good way!). It gave me some good ideas for combinations to juice at home. Overall, I did like the juices, but I don't have lot to compare it to as my first juice cleanse.

Went to visit after a round of beers and cheap oysters elsewhere. We wanted end the night with something of good quality! I came around 8:30pm yesterday on a Saturday and it wasn't packed. Sat at the bar with my boyfriend and grabbed a large Asahi. 

We ordered:
1. yellowtail delight roll (spicy yellow tail roll, cucumber inside with yellowtail, avocado, and jalapeño on top (with spicy mayo and ponzu) 

2. halibut fin nigiri (seared with soy. fatty and melty  with a firm bite on the uncooked part, SO GOOD)

3. salmon delight roll (spicy salmon roll, cucumber inside with salmon, avocado, tobiko, jalapeño  in top (spicy mayo and ponzu) 

4. flying fish nigiri (wasabi, grated garlic, green onion, ponzu - also fresh, firm, delicious)

5. amaebi nigiri plate (aka sweet shrimp) - fresh and live! Sweet tasting. I appreciate how they freshly fry the head for you with a side of ponzu. Very crunchy and great way to end with a cooked item. 

I was satisfied by the end of my meal. It came to around $80ish after tips which I find worth it for quality sushi in the area!! I'd rather save my money for this kind of treat than eat bad sushi : ) my only gripe is their special rolls are on the small side, BUT they are offering really fresh fish and the chefs are super quick. 

I'm looking forward to ordering a chefs special sushi and sashimi order once I budget for a "treat yo self meal"   Quality sushi can't be beat. Glad I tried this place and hope it stays consistent in this area.
