This was your typical Cracker Barrel.  Restaurant and restrooms were clean, servers were friendly, and food was served hot.
Authentic atmosphere, with wonderfully fast and friendly service. Sushi was delicious and beautifully presented.

Great sushi place. Parking can be tight but it's Santa Barbara so...
The food was great. I felt like I was in Japan. The waitress was very nice and the service was fast and great. 
Would definitely go back.
My favorite spot for lunch. I work nearby and have never had a bad meal here. Fa la la sandwich is my favorite.

Supreme excellence.  I am very picky about the dentist and have been to very excellent dentists in the past, but this was the best dental exam I have ever had.  Dr. Tomlinson has a fine chairside manner, knows what she is talking about, showed me all my xrays and explained their significance on a TV in front of me, and my cleaning was the most thorough I have ever had.  The hygienist explained things to me about my teeth that no one had taken the time to do before. Highly recommend this place.  Also they provided me the exam, xrays, and cleaning for $95 through a promotional coupon, with no insurance.

Welcoming little place away from the hustle and bustle of downtown. Limited but delicious varieties of Donuts. We also got the pretzel bites and the Mexican corn, which was an instant hit with the family. The staff is polite and friendly. Would definitely revisit when

I came on a Sunday for lunch. I was worried it would be crowded, but it wasn't. There is ample outdoor seating, and parking in the back of the restaurant. There were friendly faces at the counter eager to answer any questions. I had the Flying Hawaiian dog with parmesan truffle fries. The fries were superb. Each fry was perfectly crisp. The dog itself was a bit overly roasted for my preference, but still super tasty with the spicy pineapple relish. We also ordered, the Dirty O.G., the Stairway to Heaven and Donut of the Day (peach filled with brittle topping.)

YOU GUYS. THESE DONUTS. OMG!
(and I don't even like to use OMG)

If you haven't had one -- please do yourself a favor! The brown butter glaze on the Stairway to Heaven was absolutely divine. I'm just thankful I live far enough this place can only be an occasional treat. Otherwise I'd have to invest in some bigger britches.

I can't imagine having gone through the process of finding/buying our new home without Brooke! To begin, she came highly recommended by family and friends- having represented them in buying/selling/buying several homes. As a first time buyer, my wife and I were a bit overwhelmed by what was in front of us regarding the process of finding a home, placing offers and all the financial components. (As any first time buyer would be.) From our first meeting with Brooke, I was able to put my mind at ease and know that she would be there with us through the process. When viewing homes on the market, Brooke was very clear to point out both positive and negative things that caught her eye- I actually learned a great deal from her regarding inspection related issues. With a background in law, Brooke was able to help us through some bumps in the road with a crooked seller (yes they exist) and actually gave me a better understanding of the financial process than our actual lender did!  On top of all this, Brooke was incredibly fast in responding to emails/texts/questions and always made herself available.  She also has a great team backing her up! (Thanks Juan!) After looking at a ton of homes we found a beautiful house that we fell head over heels for. Brooke gave us an edge with putting in our offer- alongside several other offers- and ours was accepted without even going into a bidding war.  (the house was on the market for only 4 days!) We have since moved in and absolutely love our new home! I honestly feel like we didn't have to settle in any aspect of what we were looking for. I can't thank Brooke enough for guiding us through the process of finding and purchasing our new home. Her knowledge and experience is as good as it gets- and she was always in our corner when issues would arise. I have and will continue to recommend Brooke to all of our friends looking to buy/sell a house. Thank you so much Brooke!!!

This is my all time favorite sushi spot. Even after having tried sushi spots in Los Angeles after unfortunately having to move away from SB, this is still the top. The spicy edamame is very flavorful with just the right amount of punch. The gyoza and accompanying sauce is delightful. The crunch rolls are delicious and the filling on any of the sushi rolls are generous. I also love the beef short rib and the fried chicken appetizer. Overall, I have never had a disappointing meal here and it will always be my go-to for sushi. I just wish I wasn't an hour and a half away from this place now.

This place is the best sushi in Santa Barbara hands down. It is pure fresh fish and somehow they've elevated the sushi game since first opening. We're regulars at this point and Sun Sushi has perhaps spoiled most sushi for me anywhere else. I added a picture of the flying fish sushi from Friday night. After serving it up this way, they fried up the fish head to tail (like the head of the amaebi, which we also had.) We started with plenty of fresh sushi including my all-time favorite amber jack(!), a couple of oysters and halibut carpaccio. We finished with the volcano roll and the State Street roll - absolutely delicious. Best, best, best.

Yet another very very good dinner and experience at Argentos. Today is my husband's birthday and I invited 18 of our friends to join us for dinner there. On Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday they have a special for 2 dinners for $20. A nice choice of dinners that includes soup or salad. They serve the most wonderful garlicy rolls that are crusty on the outside and warm and soft on the inside. They serve them with REAL butter and dishes of their red sauce on the side for dipping. They keep bringing and bringing the rolls too.

The service here is consistently excellent and I wish I had gotten the name of our server as she did a terrific job with such a large party. I have to mention what I ordered and usually do because it is SO delicious! It is called Chicken (they also have veal) a la Sal.  It is a chicken breast with mushrooms and spinach with a sort of buttery scampi sauce served with linguini. I mean this is sooo very tasty that each time I go to Argentos I can't seem to get myself to try anything else on the menu. I can tell you that everyone in our large party ordered various dishes and everyone was raving over their food. A few of our friends had never been to Argentos and were thanking us for getting there to try it. 

Now here is what I really want to mention and give them a big kudos. I called earlier in the day to make a reservation and told them I had bought a cake and asked if they minded if I brought it in. They assured me it was fine. Not only did they allow me to bring our own cake in but they brought it out with candles burning and then cut and served it to everyone. Now if they had declined my asking to bring the cake in I would understand because they have their own amazing Italian pastries and cakes right there! I guess though...  it is service like this that keeps us going back again and again.

Kaitlyn was a BLESSING of a server.
We had a lot of unique requests and she was able to fulfill them happily!

First time having a sirloin steak at Cracker Barrel, and it was DELICIOUS. Tender and perfectly cooked at Medium.

The bacon still needs work to not be so crispy...

But overall, a good experience!! Thank you Kaitlyn!

Pretty cool spot.  The bread is made fresh here and you can watch the production of it being made.  I thought that was pretty cool.  You walk up to the register and order, and they bring you out your food.  We came here for breakfast and my favorite thing here was the green eggs and ham.  The croissant was very good.  It was soft and flaky.

So glad I finally tried this place! I've been living a block away for several months and never knew this place existed! My friend ordered two slices of pizza, and I ordered a gyro with fries. Everything was delicious, and the men inside were so friendly. Can't wait to go back!
Incredibly frustrated. Trying to cancel my service and I've been waiting on hold for 1 hour and transferred 3 times.

Visited here all the way from NH and it was so worth it! The owner and staff are incredibly friendly and so good at what they do. Donuts were the lightest fluffiest flavor bombs, coffee dogs fries beers I had it all and I loved every bit. My only complaint was I couldn't get my hands on one of those fried chicken donut sandwiches, just means I'll have to come back again  thanks guys keep doing what you're doing!

My how the great Cracker Barrel fallen. Once upon a time this was a great restaurant to visit, but the last 10 years you can't be guaranteed a good meal.  Haven't been to this store in a while because I wasn't sure what I would receive for my money. 
Tried breakfast this past Saturday. 
Slow service
Barely warm food
Small portions
Less than a half bowl of gravy & grits
Couple of pigeon sized eggs
Hard biscuits

If they close it, maybe Dollar General could reopen as an office complex. Ha!!

My favorite place to unwind when I'm not dead from work :)  great array of work outs with the most caring coaches.  I was terrified of Orange Theory prior to my first visit but you go at your pace and the coaches are wonderful at helping achieve your goals.  Alex, Ashley, Stacy and Marc are a few of our favorites. Can't forget about MORGAN (she's the BEST)!

The best part they are all the same menu. This place was fast bringing food out. My wife decided on the Pecan pancakes. While I went with the egg white breakfast with fruit. Not Military friendly location.

I thought comcast was bad specifically due to the continual price hikes. Century Link on the other hand takes the cake. I have had CL for over a year - never had good service. Half way though they told me that I didn't have enough mbph (or whatever it is). I paid more. 5 months later they told me the PROBLEM WAS THAT MY LINE WAS DEFECTIVE AND AH OH I COULDN'T HAVE GOTTEN THE INCREASED MBPH EVEN IF I DID HAVE A WORKING LINE. Guess what they refunded me.....$50. In their feeble minds this was the 5 months of $10 per month I paid for increased mbph when it wasn't even available. AH....WHAT ABOUT THE DEFECTIVE LINE. AH???????
Good food, terrible and unreliable delivery. Waited over two hours for an order that never arrived.

So the sushi was pretty good. Nothing life changing but definitely worth visiting if you're down for some reasonably priced sushi. What really struck me was their out-of-this-world customer service. Every single server who passed by would scan our table real quick to check if we needed something. And it seemed like they did that for all the tables. The service was so quick and efficient that I even timed how long it would take for someone to grab a crumpled up piece of straw paper from the table and it was seriously something ridiculous like two minutes. lol these guys are so great, so welcoming, they deserve all the business.

I had a lovely time at The Donut + Dog on my most recent visit to Nashville. 
- Atmosphere: The Donut + Dog is in a cute little house with a porch in Hillsboro Village. I went to catch up with a friend, but it also seemed like a nice place to do work.
- Service: The service was top notch. The barista was friendly and helpful with recommendations. He went out of his way to ensure we had a good experience. He was even kind enough to ask what amount of sweetener I wanted in my matcha latte.
- Food / Drinks: They had a great selection of unique donut flavors. We split a raspberry brioche donut, which was tasty. Next time I'm in Nash I want to go back to try more flavors. We also split the pretzel bites, which were delicious. My matcha latte was perfectly sweetened. They also have hot dogs and beer, so you can really find something for everyone.
- Value: The drinks were priced like your typical independent coffee shop, but I thought the pretzel bites were a steal at $5!

Hilltop Pet Resort is so great. My dog and several cats (decline to state a number) have stayed with them for years. The Mt Juliet location is convenient for dropping/picking up when I'm going to the airport. Everyone there is friendly and great with animals. Their grooming services are much appreciated as well. 
My dog loves it so much, he gets excited several miles away when he figures out where we are going.

Service was horrible ! Not sure is waitress was new but Rita was having a hard time bringing things back in a timely matter ! We received food with no silverware to eat with it! Time has gone by and still no silverware. Had to go to hostesses stand to  get myself. My mother's catfish wasn't cooked. We asked for biscuits only to be told it would be an additional 15 from the 15 minutes we were already waiting for it. A manger did come over to provide another plate for my mother ! I did not  get the broccoli I asked for instead they bought green beans . 

Overall horrible service!

I about didn't eat here as on TA it only had about 25 review. I'm so glad I did bc it was amazing and a good value and different. The people were Also very friendly. It's a must every time I go to Nashville now.

Wow! Roosevelt was the best server I've ever had! He anticipated everything I needed, was fast, courteous, efficient and very impressive! I waited tables and bartended in fine dining for many years and am a bit of a service critic because of it and Roosevelt didn't miss a beat! I noticed that he even bussed his own tables when it slowed down even though they had a busser. You have a treasure there and you should make him a corporate trainer or a manager. Thanks! Great job!

These donuts are nuts. So sweet and rich - treat yo' self for sure. We also enjoy the street corn dog. Super tasty. There are always new flavors. My only regret is not being able to try them all in one sitting.

Honestly, who would have thought that hot dogs and donuts would actually taste good together?! It's an interesting idea and it works well here.

Loves:
+ elote loco is the most popular and duh, bc it's good
+ stairway 2 heaven and dirty churro are best donuts
+ space is cute bc it's a converted house to shop
+ cool staff who get that you might take 2349802 years to order ;)

I came here due to a recommendation from a local and it was worth it. Not to mention, our visit here was super special because we got some comp'd beers. So YAY!!! What a great time. :)

I used to go here when it was Ahi Sushi and was big fan. However, if you order from this place like it is your typical sushi restaurant, you will be sorely disappointed. That was our first and only mistake. The basic rolls are nothing special. You can find those at any place in town. We also got some basic udon. But I think we recovered nicely.

Being the big eaters that we are and out for a birthday, we decided to splurge. We added on the salmon 6 ways and we were very happy with the dish. First, it's displayed beautifully. The waiter basically said we were not allowed to use soy sauce on that dish. Each slice of salmon was dressed differently with subtle but sophisticated differences in flavor that would be masked by soy sauce (I rarely use soy sauce with good fish anyways). We finished it off with green tea ice cream and black sesame ice cream. These desserts do not have a lot of sugar. You can really taste the green tea and black sesame.

We would have tried the omakase meal but it was sold out. The waiter said that they get their fish straight from the Tokyo market, so when they run out, they are really out. I think the shipments come in every two days. We happened to be there on the third day. So we will have to try this out another time.

Also of note, because I think some people care, the sushi chefs were all Japanese.
Cold food, soggy bacon, dry hashbrown casserole, forgot side order of apples, very disappointing compared to other Cracker Barrel's

Went here for a quick/easy after work bite and was not disappointed! I ordered a veggie burger which was very filling. You could see the peas and beans and other veggies which is always pleasing.the fries were cooked perfectly, not too hard and not undercooked. The guy at he counter was very nice and I was impressed with the inside decor considering i thought it was just another pizza joint. I will definitely be returning thanks to he service, the food and the ambiance.

First trip to the donut +dog and it was a special treat. I went on a Tuesday morning after trying to the weekend prior (the line was to the sidewalk and I didn't feel like waiting). This place does get busy on the weekend, because it's good, so be prepared for a wait if you go once the college kids and hungover tourists start rolling out of bed.

I got the South Beach Diet donut and the Hangover Burger. 

The donut was big, cream filled and also had a little bit of rum infused into it, which was fun. The donut flavor was a little too tart for me, it might have been blackberries or some other fruit used in the frosting.

The burger was the star of the show. It is served with 2 patties, cheese, bacon, a fried egg (over easy) on a maple donut as the buns. I don't think I've ever actually had a burger on a donut before, although I've dreamed about it a few times, and it was worth however many calories it was. The egg was a little runny for my liking, the whites didn't feel fully firm, but I'm sure next time I can ask for it over medium or hard. The burger does not come with fries, it's an additional cost.

Price was a little steep in my opinion. For the burger  (with no fries), a donut, tax and tip it came out to just over $20 which I feel is a little tough to justify for breakfast for one person.

I came here on my birthday to meet a friend for lunch and it did not disappoint! It was the perfect afternoon treat. It's in the Hillsboro neighborhood, up the street from the Belcourt Theatre. Parking in this area can get busy and tricky but no worries, The Donut + Dog has FREE parking in the back. The cafe/restaurant is located in a cute old house and has a nice porch that will be perfect in the warmer weather. 

When walking in, you already feel warm and cozy. To the right there is a nice fireplace with comfortable antique furniture around it. When's the last time you went to a coffee shop and sat by a real fireplace?! The industrial counter with hanging lights adds a really beautiful touch to the already stunning building. The decoration in this place is so on point. No detail is left unnoticed. I want to live here. Even the bathroom is beautiful. 

The service is incredible. Everyone is so friendly and they are more than happy to explain everything on the menu. It's a very interesting mix of things. They have hot dogs, donuts, fries/chips, coffee drinks, soda, and beer. The brioche donuts take 2 days to make and sell out quick so get there early. The donuts are all-organic meat and served on a brioche bun. And I believe their beer is Ballast Point (yummy). 

For lunch I ordered the chili & queso dog with fries and a soda. My friend ordered the veggie dog and two donuts for us to split. We tried the donuts first. Holy heaven. So soft and fluffy. So dreamy. Filled with custard. Topped with a raspberry glaze. I died and went to donut heaven. Just when I thought it couldn't get any better, the hot dogs came. You may be thinking "it's a hot dog, how good can it be?". Really really really really good. The meat is so flavorful. The bun is so fluffy yet crispy. The chili and queso are the perfect combo. It was the best hot dog I've ever had. The fries are also top notch. Great seasoning and perfectly cooked. I cannot recommend the food enough! I can't wait until summer so I can grab a beer and food and test out the porch!

I've been to most of the sushi places in town and this is by far my favorite. The staff are wonderful and welcoming, the food is fresh and delicious and always comes very quickly. I used to go every couple weeks. I wish I still lived across the street from it.

Great sushi bar in the heart of SB. Really nice quality of fish with some not often seen stuff. The live scallop OMG!  Chef was such a cool guy and just a really amazing dining experience!  You won't be disappointment!
Sushi is amazing and fresh. They don't use mass amounts of rice in their rolls, and they're very affordable.
I love this place. The staff is always friendly and the slices are big and delicious. Not to mention the decor is unique and inviting. Great neighborhood pizza place/grill.

These guys are a smooth talkers. They have one mission, to separate you from your money. Their fee to do the sales paperwork is at least $100 higher than I have ever seen. Why question them about it they told me it was because they provided such great service. Yeah OK. We also tried to sell me a $299 window etching extra claiming that if my car was ever stolen it would help get it back. Anyone with half a brain knows that's ridiculous. The police go by a car's license number and vehicle identification number not the etchings on the window glass. If you have a trade-in prepared to get lowballed. But that's pretty much standard for any dealer. On a positive note, they usually have an inventory of some pretty decent cars. I was happy with the car I got but I didn't like all the sneaky stuff they tried to pull. Since the purchase I have been spammed relentlessly via US mail and email for automotive related products and offers I have absolutely no use for.

Been watching on Instagram this restaurant and knew when we got to Nashville we had to visit it.
The hotdogs were simply amazing , I highly recommend the Reuben! Donuts were good as well but definitely get a hotdog

Wow! One of those finds that makes your day on the road better! I had the "special eggs" and almond croissant and I could not have been happier! 
Very unique view of the action in the bakery is entertaining-They have great coffee too (Kaldi's)!

We decided to try a new sushi place, were a little unsure from the outside but followed a couple in and the sushi was AMAZING!!! Dragon rolls, different, one with eel, other with shrimp tempura and tuna, big rolls, two were plenty for the two of us. Great service, nice people!!! We are picky and we'll be back!!!

If I could give zero stars I would, customer service was terrible by the young lady with green and purple hair acting like we did something wrong by walking up and wanting to place an order. No communication about the no "cheese sauce" for my baconator fries so were left standing there with no clue. The young my lady at the cash register bouncing while she is taking my order and saying she's ready to go home....really????? Please just do better!!! People come from all over to get a quick bite without all the attitude and shananagins. I believ

So good - 
This is the only place we've "dined in" since covid, but they did a great job keeping everything comfortable and distanced. 

Really damn good hot dog (we had the elote loco) and that nashville hot chicken sandwich on the donut bun is something serious. Oh and the donuts (lumberjack pictured below) are AWESOME.



Do yourself a favor and check these peeps out - really great customer service.

Better to call ahead and make sure that they have donuts. We arrived around mid day and they were sold out. We decided to get the hangover, the hot chicken, and the grilled cheese. The grilled cheese was wayyyy to sweet. The person at the counter also did not let us know the meals did not come with a side. We spent over 50 on 3 entrees with no sides. I def think during busy times in Nashville or weekends they should ensure to make more donuts than normal to ensure that they won't run out at 12. Especially being open until 6. They should also automatically serve fries for a side especially with the price of the sabbdwiches. The area is super small and not a lot of table space.

This place is ridiculously wonderful!  Located off 21st St. in a cute bungalow. This is great for brioche donuts or hot dogs. These aren't your average dogs!  Great choices! I had the Reuben dog on a homemade bun!  Love love love the buns! The dog was juicy and had a nice snap. Perfect amount of toppings. My husband's had avocado on it which he loved. 
Save room for a brioche!...or have it first. I had the holiday special which was soooo tasty. It was big enough to share my hubby....not that I wanted to share. The variety of flavors are unique. I'd love to go in the morning when they are still warm. Yummm

The worst service I have ever experienced all around. I think they are trained to do their best to scam and take your money. You can't speak to a supervisor after they lie to you and charge you. The guy refused and told me he has no supervisor. I called back and they send you from one person to the next in an attempt to tire you. Pathetic I'm sure they will reap what they sow soon.

Great local take out
More than a pizza shop other great medaterian food
hummas was awesome
no tables
pricing fare
I will go back

Just signed up for internet and phone.  Was quoted 64.95 per month locked in for 3 years. It also shows on their website for $64.   After receiving my first bill, I had to call them to ask why I was being charged $134.  I understand that $30 was for installation but this was still high.  When I asked the agent what my future bill would be, he said it would be $20 higher.  This includes tax and "hidden fees".  No one said anything else about additional fees.  I have been scammed and will start inquiring for new service.  They have misrepresented themselves and it is disgraceful!
Omg! I was going to eat here but there was a fight in the kitchen! 2 girls were yelling at each other and the manager was yelling at them telling them to stop! I walked away.. don't eat here!

Staff were super friendly and excited to chat about the interesting donuts... you can tell they're proud of their work. Donuts were unique and amazing- nitro cold brew and a beautifully poured mocha topped off a great experience.
Definitely one of the few good restaurant you can find in Santa Barbara. Fresh food, I like to order sushi 6 steps and I recommend it to people who would like to go to the restaurant, please try it!!

I am amazed at how poorly managed this internet service provider is !
We are in an RV and came to Tucson for three months. I have had issues with their sending Billings to the service addresses when I instructed them to send to my home. Then, they change account numbers when you move RV. I paid third month online but against 1st a/c number (was not aware of new account number)  and they returned payment to bank rather than assign to new account number. Then they charged me $ 12.50 returned check charge and the company policies will not allow for waiving fee.

The customer wait times for service is long and often I was passed from one employee to another. Often told computer is down and call back. One can only wonder how this company stays in business. A classic study in how not to run a business! The customer in this oligopolistic industry is left with many frustrating experiences. 

Tom from Colorado

This is a great place for fresh, delicious fish! I don't know how I had never tried this place. I eat a lot of sushi here in Santa Barbara, but this might be my favorite in town now. Great value and variety of fish. Absolutely delicious!! I will be coming back regularly. The blue fin tuna melted in my mouth. So good! Thanks for a great meal.

Looks like a cronut, taste and texture like bread. Picture of dirty churro was nothing like what they serve, just a dusting of Oreo cookie. No bueno. Also disappointed that we couldn't get a dog IN a donut, and they don't serve dogs till 11am. Lastly, espresso is medium roast for those who care...I prefer dark roast for a latte.
Got the corn dog (even though it was on the kids menu) with regular sea salt fries and fried oreos! It was delicious!

The worst internet provider I have dealt with.   They have drop my service 10 time in one week.   Working from home is a joke.   They drop me in the middle of a presentation on Friday.   May loose my job because the cannot do their job.   They claim they are upgrading.   To what.



I would give hem negative   The worst company ever. Very disappointed in all aspects of their service.

Excellent food. I have loved everything I've tried. I am partial to their lamb burgers, ZUZU burger which is a double mild spiced hamburger with a fried egg and an orange sauce. I've enjoyed other things there and have not been disappointed. Thank you!
Best donuts and coffee ever! Friendly staff, cute atmosphere. Amazing donuts for a great price

The salmon six step is quite good and very unique!
And the folks here that run the restaurant are super and very very friendly

Let me start by saying that the associates in the store portion were  very sweet and nice.  Now, the reason why I have given 2 stars is because the dining portion of it was Horrible! We had to wait 15 mins for a party of 6 while a party of 4 was seated right away (not too happy about that). Then when we were seated we got a waitress who was very rude.  She took our order but had an attitude the whole time.  We were in the middle of eating and she comes out with our bill when we hadn't even asked for it nor were we done eating. She didn't tell us to take our time nor did she ask if we needed more coffee, etc. When I needed a box and more coffee We had to ask a different waitress because she wasn't anywhere to be seen. She  made my time there not too welcoming.

Simple yet delicious concept - donuts and hot dogs. They have a "Power Lunch" for $7 which includes any speciality hot dog, chips or fries, and a fountain drink. The dog and donuts are really yummy and very unique flavor combinations! They even have a donut hamburger on the menu. 

The staff was so friendly and even noticed my husbands firefighter shirt and she told us next time tell them and they give firefighters, cops, military a discount which I thought was very sweet and cool. 

Located in a very busy and up and coming area, but they also have parking in the rear of the building for customers.

I actually didn't realize when I went in search of a hot dog fix, that I would stumble into a life changing food experience! I was looking for "the dog" and I drove by The Donut&Dog TWICE because I didn't see the Dog. But then it hit me on the third time back thru that I had seen on yelp something about a place that opened up about a dog and a donut. I REALLY wanted a hotdog so I said what the hey. Thank goodness I did. Best "hot dog" I've ever had. That hot dog BUN is so good you would punch-slap-kick your mommy! It was fluffy and crisp and snuggled the juicy frank just right. The chilli and beer cheese was a union made in heaven. Now the kicker, THOSE FRIES!!! Dang, they set it all off!! 

I ate the donuts the next day and they were the bomb.com as well! 

Added to my places of must eat at!! At least once per month.

Incredible food, incredible service. The men behind the bar were professional, engaging, and talented. The servers were prompt, attentive, but not invasive. 

We had several rolls, all of which were incredible. The Toro Mexico was delightful.

Excellent sake selection (we had the Dassai 50) as well as the Shochu.

I would absolutely recommend going here. We had good good and a great time with the staff. 

Keep up the good work!
I wish this existed in Chicago! Amazing, ethical company with the most delicious, fresh, quality ingredients. All of it is good: bread, pastries, sandwiches, soups, salads. My favorite place!

Been wanting to try this place for a while we have been there twice in the last two weeks Both times closed for special occasion at around 12:15 not great way to impress new customers. Don't know if I'll try a third.

Breakfast at 5:30 am at the airport. At least there is a choice?!

Wendy's Sausage and Egg Biscuit was good enough as reasonably priced airport food. 

There are not too many option anyway at BNA. I guess it could have been worse.
2000 Honda Accord with a rotted exhaust pipe, cracked right before the muffler. Yes, it works but be prepared for your $150 repair to look like this. Date of service: 2/13/2020.

The food at Companion is excellent; the service is not. Today I got yelled at for coming inside to pick up a curbside order, even though I had been waiting in curbside for twenty minutes. Their staff is generally unfriendly. But man is their egg salad delightful...
Food was decent, service was good. My chicken was piping hot and juicy. You can't go wrong here - everything is good and consistent.

Hands down the best sushi I have had a long time. It was so fresh. We sat at the sushi bar and the guy recommended some of the best nigiri ever. We are not from this area so next time we visit we will definitely be stoping by!!!!!

The cashier was short with me and didn't seem to want to help me and made me uncomfortable, didn't tell me where to wait for my Togo order, and the person that brought out my food told me what was in my bag but didn't show it to me, and the thing that put me over the top to even give a review is because the lemon pepper trout had barely any seasoning on it and when I tried to ask the person who brought it out she took off without checking on me. I've never had bad service at this location until today but it was enough for me to not want to come back.
I've been trying to get arrive put in for almost a month. Today a technician by the name Eduard came to

One of the most friendly staff groups I have very met. 

I can't believe that I forgot to take a picture of the donuts! They were more like a pastry than a donut in my opinion. Our personal favorite was the southern Belle. It was soft, fluffy, and filled with some delicious peach jam (maybe?).

All of the other donuts were great as well.

The got dog was much better than our expectations. The Elote dog has a nice spicy kick to it. I was most supposed by the bun. It was made of some very sturdy but buttery Texas toast. The host dog did not even show signs of falling apart.

I highly recommend getting both s donut and a dog here
I tried Unagi bowl today, taste not that good, a bit dry. The price is above average based on the amount of Unagi. Teri in Fairview area is much better.

Zuzu's Kitchen is a decent place to grab some carry-out on days when I don't have time to cook. It's primarily a take-out place but they do have a small section of window bar seating that accommodates maybe four people. I walked in and placed my order at the counter and waited and the food didn't take long to get ready.

Chicken cheese fries sounded like something I had never eaten before and so I ordered them. They consisted of fries on the bottom with cheese sauce, fresh jalapenos, and breaded fried white meat chicken cut into strips and placed on top. Comfort food doing what it's supposed to do, nothing amazing but filling and satisfying. The Mahi Mahi Tacos were good but far from the best I have had. The fish was good but the rest of the toppings left something to be desired. The lettuce was refreshing but added no flavor and the pico de gallo even seemed a little bland and it's a pretty simple salsa as it is. The boom boom sauce had some spice and was a welcome addition to the tacos.

Altogether, I would stop in again. The prices are good with everything under $10 except for some of the pizzas and the menu has a large variety of items. I liked what I tried without being blown away. Solid neighborhood take-out.
Delicious! The food was superb and the service was assiduous and quick. Try the six step salmon!

9 am.  Sunrise sample.  Keep the white gravy though and bring me apple butter instead please :)

My waitress was great.  My coffee cup was kept refilled. I was a happy happy girl :)
Great specialty donuts. Cute quaint atmosphere. Loved it. Will be back next time we visit Nashville

I am huge on customer service. I work retail, and it really does make a huge impression on how the business is ran. Even if food doesn't always come out right, it's still fixable -- all it takes is a great employee to go out of their way to help. 

This location did nothing when I tried to order carry out. I called, asked to place an order, and was put on hold for 10 minutes with no response. Drove to the location to place an order, and there was no one at the front that would place my order. The manager was standing at the front counter, and said she would get someone to take the order, but no one ever came. I walked out after wasting 30 minutes waiting for someone to take my order. 

I'm not sure what their food is like, but I hope you have a better opportunity to try it than I did.

This place is up there with places like donut friend in LA & Donut plant in NYC. They also have a burger made with a glazed donut. I didn't eat that but it sure looked appetizing with tomatoes, avocado & hot steaming burgers. The hot dogs are served in a brioche bun not a basic hot dog bun. The fries are unbelievably delicious even after they get cold & hard you'll still finish every last bite!

Never heard of a breakfast place selling donuts and hotdogs but I was definitely intrigued by the idea! 

We came in around 1pm on a weekend and it wasn't too busy, aside from a few families eating their food in the restaurant. You order at the counter in the back, where donuts are displayed in a glass case.

I ordered the Elote Loco hotdog for about $7 and a donut for around $4. The hot dogs only come with a side (chips or fries) if you upgrade it to a meal for $10. The service was relatively fast - waited about 15 minutes for all my friends' orders to come out (6 of us). I enjoyed the flavor of my dog, although I did think it was a little too greasy and oily. The donuts were amazing though - love the taste and airy texture of the brioche donut. The donuts were not overly sweet and had the perfect texture. 

Only critique is that the hot dog price is a little expensive for just a dog with no sides.

Been there several times and last night was the worst. If they serve the way on the first time, I'd have never gone back. We ordered a lot of nigiri and there is not much rice at all. Very disappointed. May need to find a new place in SB.

So, one of the many curses of having grown up in New York is that you kind of can't help being a pizza snob. And for this Brooklyn girl, I am sorry but Zuzu's plain  pizzas are kind of mediocre. I'm willing to give them a shot for their pizzas with toppings, because that's where some restaurants really shine, but I would never get the margherita again, and the plain cheese is mostly interesting because of the spiciness of the sauce. The cheese isn't very flavorful and the bread is ehh, so I really hope that I'll like the veggie pizza because this is my nearest pizza spot, and the prices are pretty agreeable. 

Pretty much the only good thing about where I lived in Brooklyn was that there were multiple great pizza options, so now I'm spoiled. Goddammn you Brooklyn, still finding ways to mess with me.

I loved this little hidden place. When we pulled in we thought it was actually closed. 10am on a Sunday and we were some of the only people there! 
Being able to watch them make the pastries and bread was an amazement for our 3 year old.

The breakfast was DELICIOUS! So much so that as I write this I think I may want to swing by this place again!

The worst customer service I have ever received. The waitress not only forgot parts of our order she had to be reminded about what she forgot. Never once was an apology given. We will NEVER be back to this location.

Great find in Santa Barbara! Sushi was fresh and great service. Parking tricky-but they said to park in the hotel next door. Very well priced sushi experience. Our party tried Salmon sushi, Albacore delight, Philly Roll, Yellowtail sushi. All good and fresh. Will be back!

I've been getting donuts on and off from here since they first opened, and they've just gotten better with time! Donuts are tasty and creative (pricey but not out of range of similar places, and one really fills you up), and their smoked latte is delicious and fun. The staff are also great and friendly--overall a nice option for brunch or breakfast (their donuts sell out quickly on weekend mornings, just fyi). 

Also, there's a parking lot in the back that might not be apparent on first glance.

We worked with Brooke back in 2012 to buy a house in the 'burbs. When we stumbled on our dream house in 2019 and needed help in a hurry she referred us to Mary on her team, who helped us buy the house we wanted and turn around our old house within a month. Couldn't have gotten through it without her!

Donuts and hot dogs...need I say more? I had the Elote loco which is a chorizo dog topped with basically sweet corn, lime, and cotija cheese. I could devour one of those every day of my life. The other dog my friend had was Bahn Mi which is their take on the Vietnamese sandwich. Also delicious! The donuts were indescribably amazing
Sushi and teriyaki chicken were both delicious! The service was fast as well. I appreciated the complementary tea :)
Amazing. I would eat this for my lunch time break every.single.day and never get tired of it. So fresh, so much variety and the taste is always quality.

Great pizza, outstanding service!! 
Their speciality pizzas are wonderful.  Very quick and served fresh.

Found this spot online and since I love donuts and my husband loves hotdogs... we had to give this a try. 

The sweet y lady, Parker, that took our order was great at explaining all the donuts and hotdogs... then we got to mee the owner, Will, and made the experience even better. We had the OG and a Sin-u-Rita donuts which were so simple yet so rich... at that point we had to have the hotdogs. We had the Flying Hawaiian and the Elote Loco

Food is great and the owner and employees make it even better. We returned the next day after our hike at Mossy Ridge Trail and had the Sweet Baby Jesus

Came for the donuts and ended having it all... SO WORTH IT
awesome food - definitely a great addition to the neighborhood. The buffalo chicken pizza is amazing.

Despite all the negative reviews, just had service installed because last provider not honest about performance and blamed me for system speeds. Century link Tech set clear expectations on performance before i signed up, now service up and performing as promised, much more performance at lower cost than prior provider. 

Open issue is the tech  and admin support, hope i don't need any.

Me and my boyfriend love this place and we keep coming back to it. Sun sushi has become our go to sushi spot in SB. 

I think that everything's reasonably priced for sushi. The fish is pretty good. Not mind-blowingly amazing, but pretty good. This is the kind of place where I would order nigiri at, and I can't say the same about other sushi places in the area. (The quality of the fish has to surpass a certain level before I'm willing to order nigiri rather than rolls.)

This is our second time dining here and both experiences were divine. For modern sushi with amazing sauces, we go to Sakana. For traditional Japanese sushi and the absolutely freshest fish, we love Sun Sushi. Forgot to take a picture of the 10 piece chef's selection tonight - because it was so beautiful and so delicious. Next time...

Went in for a routine cleaning and exam. Dentist came in, looked at my xrays and stated I needed a deep cleaning that my insurance would not pay for and needed to pay $1,100 for. I politely declined, the average cost is from $75-$300. Staff was nice but would definitely not ever go back.

We used Hilltop Pet Resort for many years while living in Nashville. Even when we moved out to Brentwood, we would make the drive to leave our pups there. I always trusted they would take excellent care of them. We loved their facility and that the dogs had a private run to play in during the day.

 The staff was always friendly and made such a fuss when we brought the corgis in to stay. Our older dog, Tank, has a sensitive tummy when his environment changes, and I always received a call after we picked them up to make sure he was feeling better. 

Now that we aren't in Tennessee, we really miss boarding our dogs here. We have yet to find another place that even holds a candle to Hilltop Pet Resort.

Parking is impossible, including the "free parking in the back" (4or 5 spots), and they've sold out of donuts at 3 pm on a Saturday. Pretty lame when you're open until 6. Try harder if you're going to be so hard to get to. Definitely not worth an hour finding parking and filling up a meter. Complete waste of time.

Surprised my husband for his birthday yesterday.  Can't believe it took us so long to finally go here!  The donuts are unbelievable. Service was top notch (enjoyed our conversation with Adam).  As a side note, they appear to be doing a fantastic job with the COVID-19 procedures of cleaning and masks.  Highly recommend!

Will be definitely coming back again! Nice Sushi place. Located in a crowded plaza but could park your car in the parking lot of the motel next to the restaurant. Fish is super fresh and good taste. I love the salmon six steps that I ordered. Six different kinds flavored salmon and all taste good. 
If you are the toro fans you should try toro here. The toro just melt in your mouth.  They have too many special fish. I would like to try more next time.

Worst. Take-out. Experience. Ever.  My military family and I frequent this location during our travels to visit family in the area.  We either eat in or grab take-out, depending on whether or not we have our dog with us.  Last night at 7:45 PM, I walked into the restaurant with my son and placed a take-out order for four with Alicia.  Then we milled around the Cracker Barrel store, periodically peeking at the take-out desk to see if our food came out, while looking at toys, checking out the candy selection, and listening to a Cracker Barrel employee tell us how a large tree fell on her house but miraculously caused only minor damage.  30 minutes later, still no food.  My wife texted me to ask what's taking so long.  35 minutes later, I asked the hostess what's taking so long.  She said sometimes it takes a long time (a rather unsatisfying response).  She didn't know where Alicia went, so she suggested I ask the cashier what's going on.  I reluctantly got in line to talk to the cashier.  40+ minutes later, I was about to talk to the cashier, and Alicia walked up.  She said my order was delayed because they were out of sweet potatoes (part of my wife's order).  At this point, I was fuming.  I told her that a 40 minute wait is completely unacceptable, and I needed to call my wife to see what she wanted to do with her order.  After a very brief conversation with my wife, I turned around and Alicia was gone.  At this point, 45 minutes after I originally placed my order, I figured that even if I found Alicia and modified my order, either (a) the rest of the order had been prepared and was probably cold by then or (b) nothing had been prepared, so I would've had to wait even longer to get my entire order.  I decided that I'd rather go hungry than deal with this extremely poor customer service, so I just walked out.  I thought about calling the manager from my car, but I was so angry that I feared I'd say something inappropriate in front of my kids.  Thanks, Cracker Barrel, for the worst take-out experience ever.  What a colossal waste of our time.  We won't be back anytime soon.

This place has some of the best hot dogs I've ever had! The staff is really nice and it's a cute location. I would say the donuts are ok. They were good but definitely not the best I've ever had. Still 5 stars though because the hot dogs. So moral of the story: stick with a hot dog and fries and you can't go wrong. Also prices are reasonable, honestly I expected it to be so much more expensive. 10/10 would recommend.

This review is for MetroLink / Light Rail Only. 

To go from Lambert Airport to Downtown, Metrolink beats a cab hands down in terms of cost, and if it's rush hour in terms of speed. The ride is relatively smooth and you don't get jostled around like some transit systems do. 

If you want to check out the Gateway Arch riding Metrolink is the best way to go. You avoid the hassles of finding a space at the Arch parking garage or with street / surface lot parking and the related costs. The Light Rail stop is located literally inside the West end of the historic Eads Bridge so you can stand on a piece of American history right there on the platform. This stop also gives you easy access to the riverfront, for those who want to go to the Mississippi River's edge. 

A word of caution: Beware of the Ticket Vending Machines. I've fed them cash and had them fail to spit out a ticket. I've had this problem more than once and at more than one station. When I sent a letter about it to Metro, the group that runs MetroLink  they replied that they couldn't do anything about it. 

Note: Metro offers an unlimited 2 hour pass that's a good deal if that works for your schedule. The 1 day pass is $7.50 so it only pays to get it if you plan to ride more than 3x in a day.

The Zuzu Burger is honestly one of the best burgers in Philly. The other items on the menu have always satisfied.  Whether it is a quick pizza, sandwich, salad, or onion rings and fries - they tend to knock it out of the park.

On top of that, they have shown great respect for cleanliness and social distancing guidelines during the pandemic.

A true gem to have in the neighborhood - you won't be disappointed!

I have been wanting to stop in and today I finally got the chance to a little after noon.  It was a delight to say the least.  There was a very friendly gentleman who helped me make a selection of a Mocha Velvet Ice. He offered me flavors like salted caramel, chocolate, and I decided to get regular caramel and chocolate. The beverage was just what I wanted. I had it made with almond milk and it was so fresh and smooth, next thing I knew I was slurping up the whipped cream from the bottom of my cup.  Good thing I was in the car by myself.  I also chose a cranberry orange muffin. There was a very nice lady behind the counter who offered to warm it up for me.  It was fresh, sweet, with huge pieces of fruit. I was very happy with my selections and have no complaints whatsoever. I'm glad too because this place is close to my job and I will definitely be stopping in regularly.

Just wow. The shima aji was incredible. Best sashimi i have had in years.

They treated me with kindness and enthusiasm. I will drive through SB just to have this again.

The customer service was not great this morning. I ordered online around 9:40am.The order was said to be ready at 10:35am and delivered by door dash. We got a call from our driver who stayed the order was not ready and a driver before her had to wait two hours before they received their order. I got dressed and went to the Cracker Barrel myself. When I got to the desk, the employee looked for a good three minutes, in the system to find my order. I asked her if she saw it & then she looked behind her at the completed orders and still didn't find it so she tells me that my order is not ready yet. I asked her if she knew when it would be ready and told me that she couldn't tell me. I don't think she could find my order, but the money was already taken out of my account so I know they received the order. I waited a little while longer & the order was still not ready. I left without food or a refund. I am so displeased.
One of the better sandwich places in the area. The bread is fresh and the counter service is good.

This place is amazing! I highly recommend the campfire latte and ALL of the donuts. Each and every one of them are perfectly made and delicious. Be sure to show up before noon to get the full selection for the day. The employees are also super friendly so that's a plus.

I love sushi and i love sushi even more here on the west coast because the yellowtail is OFF THE HOOK. So much more flavorful than i'm used to!
So Sun Sushi is great because they really do focus on sushi- there are a few other dishes they offer like tempura but i mostly saw sushi on the menu. I love love love spicy tuna on crispy rice- consider trying it because it is yummy. We mostly got regular rolls and only tried 2 of their special rolls. 

Parking is tough but you can park on the side lot in between sun sushi and the hotel next door!
First stop for breakfast on our trip! We ordered the French toast and loaded hash browns. Food is delicious and service is friendly.

Jennifer Bayzdlo was a pleasure to work with throughout the entire house hunting and home purchasing process. A friend had recommended her to me as Jenn had represented them when they bought their first home. Not only was Jenn able to schedule showings for me on short notice but she was also able to understand what I was looking for in my dream home and recommend properties accordingly. She stuck with me over the course of many months as we toured a variety of properties in a variety of neighborhoods.

Once we found "the one", Jenn helped position me to act quickly, and through her hard work I was able to make the most attractive offer to the buyer. We closed on time with absolutely no bumps in the process, something the seller knew would be the case when working with Jenn, and I can't thank her enough for her services. As a realtor who is also a zoning and land use attorney, Jenn brought a lot of useful insights into the process and helped advise me on where I might potentially be making a bad decision. I'd recommend Jenn and her team to anyone looking to find their dream home in Philadelphia!

Thanks again, we love the house!!

So-so.  Ordered and shared a lunch special bento box ( tempura and teriyaki beef), supplemented by a side of edamame and miso soup.  Soup warm, not hot.  Beef very dry.  Perhaps we should have ordered sushi roll, but we thought the bento box was a "miss", despite good tempura.

I can't believe it. There's delicious sushi in Santa Barbara!

If you've been in the area long enough, you'll know that the Asian food around here is meh -- especially the sushi. For a city with some of the best seafood in the world, they really lack qualified sushi chefs and fresh ingredients for these fishy delights. However, Sun Sushi will blow you away with their hospitality and delicious dishes.

Unfortunately, their omakase is no longer on the menu. They still have the six-step, however, and plenty of original rolls. Dishes like a dragon roll (eel, avocado, and a California roll) may be typical, but are done with very high quality fish. The seared tuna topping their box roll was buttery, slightly taut from the sear, but delicious with just a light dab of spicy mayo. I'm generally not a fan of cream cheese in rolls, but the variety of fish in their State Street Roll makes it all worth it.

Their nigiri is also delicious. We skipped the fish ones and went for tamago (steamed egg) and inari (sweet bean curd). The rice comes wrapped in the tamago, which looks incredibly impressive, and the inari is light and refreshing.

And their service? Fantastic. The servers are very responsive and attentive. One waitress was taking good care of a table where a woman spilled her water and hurried off while she cleaning up the area, and none of the people at her table even thanked the waitress for it. Here's your friendly reminder that the folks that work here may be paid to serve you, but you should treat them with respect and regard for the fact that they're likely working a job you said you wouldn't touch.

I wish I could give them a fifth star, but I kept finding bones in my eel earlier today. Hopefully, this is a one-time occurrence, as I'd really like some more eel from here. It was just that well cooked.

If you're willing to pay the premium, Sun Sushi is the way to go. We spent $34 each, and as folks in college and/or riddled with student debt still, it was a delicious meal we won't forget. You might have to hear some rude fellow customers, but please make this place your first stop when you want sushi in Santa Barbara.
This place is amazing, not many places where you have great dogs and donuts, topping it with good beer!!! This is a must stop for all, cant wait to visit again

This place is great! Staff is extremely friendly and attentive. The donuts were very good. My friends and I decided to get different donuts and split them so we could try different kinds. The key lime pie and the chicken and waffle donuts were a big hit. They have a very nice patio with plenty of picnic tables that is dog friendly.  The mimosa flight was about 16$ (you get three tall glasses) and every donut is separate. It was a fun experience would definitely recommend.

We adored everything about this place! It's charming, the staff clearly love what they do, and the donuts are some of the best we've ever had. Seriously delicious!

Did I mention the homemade marshmallow they toast in front of you for the campfire cappuccino?

We found this place on Yelp, so there's like 4-5 Japanese restaurants near Santa Barbara that showed when I typed in search. Although this is a new business and 25 reviews with 4.5 star rating, we decided to give it a shot and hope it is a hidden gem. 

We came in for a quick dinner before heading back to Orange County from Sequoia National Park. Starving so you know we were gonna basically think anything is damn yummy by the time the food is served. 

SO WRONG!
Probably the worst sushi I've had. 


We ordered:
Toro and Ikura sushi
Chicken Donburi
Avocado and eel roll 
Tempura Lobster Roll
 
Check:$61.74

Here is what we felt inadequate and needs improvement:
1. Toro and Ikura sushi and avocado and eel roll: quality is like eating at a revolving sushi place or fast food sushi places. Worse than supermarket sushi. Honestly. 

2. In the menu, there's chicken donburi and chicken teriyaki. When I placed the order I specifically asked the waiter if the chicken donburi was like oyako don.  Waiter said no it's chicken teriyaki. Then why call it something else and mark the price higher than the chicken teriyaki and beef teriyaki?

3. Lobster roll was cut in 6 pieces. Thinly cut. Each piece is about 1.5 cm thick. Look it up on metric ruler if you don't know. The worst park was that it got pieces of lobster shell in the roll and I almost chipped my tooth. 

4. Price was ridiculously high for the quality and quantity of the food. 
 
If this restaurant opened in LA, Torrance or OC it won't last a year. 
You can trick someone with limited experience with eating sushi but you can't fool with people who eat this kind of food almost every day. 
 
UPDATE *****
By the way, just an hour after I left I noticed that I'm getting rashes.  And I am not allergic to shrimp, or any food. 
Will I come back? no

Not recommended unless disappointment is your thing.

Pros:
- gormet hotdogs 
- gormet hamburgers 
- organic
- atmosphere 
- selections 
- donuts 

Cons:
- price
I haven't had a bad meal at this cafe. The bread is outstanding. Salads are tasty and the sandwiches are some of the best in town.

The metro system that I love and hate all at the same time.
Reasons I like the metro system: It goes to Busch Stadium, the Scottrade Center, the Edward Jones Dome, the Arch, the Landing, Union Station, and WashU. In a matter of minutes, I can arrive at my St. Louis downtown destination without having to worry about a designated driver or the general hassles of a car. WashU also provides students with free passes too, so I try to take advantage of free transportation. 
Reasons I hate the metro system: It only runs a little past midnight! If my friends and I go out for the night, we don't have a way back unless we either find a cab, find a sober friend, or wait until the metro opens at 4am. The metro also doesn't go that many places. If I didn't live directly on the line, I would probably have trouble accessing the metro. I also still can't get to many places via metro.
I think that metro is a good step in the direction of a great rail system, but it needs to be expanded. With that said, I do take advantage of the existing system and enjoy taking it because of its reliability.

The tofu came with lid not tight, all sauce drained. Luckily the sauce is not too difficult to make ourselves. But what's worse, I bite an iron stick in agedashi tofu. Very disappointed and would never go back.

It's hard to find a good sushi place in Santa Barbara with the limited options we have, but this place never disappoints. The outside look of the restaurant may throw you off, don't fret -- the inside is cute and pleasant. We have tried a lot of the menu and one of the favorites is the salmon sushi... it seriously is so good. The rest of the menu is really good, it'll be hard to go with a bad choice. 

Definitely come here if you're looking to have a reasonably priced sushi dinner with good flavor and freshness.

Cool modern cafe and bakery with counter service and plenty of seating in an open area. Attached to a factory where you can watch people making the bread. Bottomless serve yourself Kaldi's coffee. I ordered a Claytonian sandwich (egg, cheese, and bacon or veggies) on a wheat bagel. They let me have both bacon and veggies. The bagel itself was very good, however the eggs were really weird/creamy and the veggies were not too fresh. The egg also fell all over the place when I tried to eat it. Friendly staff
This place is amazing. Friendly staff, my favorite sushi restaurant in Santa Barbara. Highly recommended

The hotdogs are gourmet style and very good. Everything tastes great and homemade. Very good donuts too. Everything here is above average, which you might not expect from a "donut and hotdog place". Also the staff there is top notch!! I go here often, 5stars.

Stumbled upon this sushi spot for a late dinner and we are so glad we did. My boyfriend and I love sushi and trying new places-- this one is a new favorite. Everything from the mango iced tea to special rolls was delightful. Their miso was especially tasty, the rolls were well crafted and had super fresh fish, and the staff was outstanding. Very fast service, wonderful food, and a welcoming, friendly staff. We will definitely be returning.

Pricey and probably the smallest rolls I've ever seen.  Ordered edamame and it didn't come until after our main courses.  Service was so-so.  

Disappointed.

Definitely the best Sushi option in all of Santa Barbara. The quality of fish is unparalleled here as the sashimi here is incredibly fresh. The mixture of ingredients is very on point as most places either place too much emphasize on the fish or rice, or even stuffing the sushi with avocado. 

Highly recommend the Salmon flight as it is a 6 step tasting menu with each salmon sashimi increasing in fat content, it was to die for. 

The service here is definitely also very great, very attentive to customers!

Menu had two main options Chicken or Shrimp.  Arrived for dinner and they were out of shrimp.  When you have such a limited menu do not run out of one of only two options.  Also Chicken was good but your gravy is bad consider switching to a brown gravy.  Also creamy coleslaw would be a great option.

Walked over one morning for some coffee and donuts. I got the iced salted caramel latte - great coffee. Where I live it's mainly Starbucks that dominates the coffee shop world (not as many local / mom & pop shops here like there are in Nashville), but this coffee was so much better. There was a good variety of donuts; not overwhelming, but I had a hard time deciding which one to get because I knew I could only eat one. We had a food tour later that afternoon, so we didn't want to be too full, but we did go back the next day to try the hot dogs. We had the elote and chili and cheese. The bread was amazing. If we had to pick one of those two hot dogs to get again, we would definitely get the chili cheese one and then try another one on the menu. I love little coffee shops like this, and it was walking distance from where we stayed. I'll definitely be back here the next time I'm in Nashville.

This was by far the worst oil change experience I've ever had. THEY FORGOT TO PUT OIL IN MY CAR. The more insulting thing is when I took it back, they tried to say that I wasn't reading the dipstick right. Not only that, when they realized I was right, they didn't offer an apology nor did they offer me a free change. Unprofessional, rude and down right idiotic staff. DO NOT GO HERE. 
Also, I found oil on my steering wheel and the interior of my car. Clearly sloppy work

If I could give this place 0 stars, I would

Sun sushi is the absolute best Japanese restaurant in Santa Barbara. Ive never had a bad experience and the customer service is top notch. The owner Max is very generous and friendly. They do such an amazing job  with takeout orders and the atmosphere eating in is just as great. The sushi is always fresh and by far the best i've ever had. I would definitely recommend trying this place out!

The kids were at a Valley Zoo birthday party, so the adults decided to spend the last hour waiting for them in the Wild Earth Bakery. My wife said that she had been to this location before and had liked it. She started rattling off the menu from their web page until I agreed. From what I had heard, my expectations were high.

I must say up front that the cafe's ambiance is nice. It's a large space with large windows that look into the zoo's courtyard entrance. It was enjoyable to sit here. However, it might have been a good idea to have some windows facing into the zoo proper so you could watch some of the nearby animals. It's not necessary as I've said, the ambiance is nice, but I think they missed out on an easy win that would have provided this cafe with some uniqueness.

With that out of the way, let's delve into why this is only a two star. Honestly, the expected food options gleaned from the webpage was not what I expected. It's possible to give them some leeway because it was late in the day, but there were no baskets of muffins, no cakes, no breads, and no sandwiches. There were a few cookies in jars, and 6-8 wraps and maybe 3-4 salads in the the display. Essentially, according to the website I was expecting to be spoiled for choice as there were 26 different categories of food, from breakfast to savory, to sweet. With not much choice, I selected the breakfast wrap which was meant to be:

"Chopped egg with peppers, onion, with a hint of heat offered as a vegetarian or with ground chorizo sausage".

As I chomped into the premade microwave warmed breakfast wrap (for $7), all I could taste was the whole wheat wrap and a bit of egg. The hint of head was just some guy saying, "Hey buddy, I'll give you a hint, there ain't no heat here. Here's a side dish of some salsa." Eventually, when I got down to the last 2 cm of the wrap, the chorizo made an appearance. And it's appearance was of ground pork, not chorizo. There might even have been some peppers and onion mixed into the chorizo section. I'm not positive about that though.

Okay, so that's a bit strong about the single dish I've had, thankfully I have this green tea latte, which is local code for matcha latte, I guess. I ordered that because I've had atrocious tea lattes elsewhere, but have never had a poorly made matcha latte. I mean...how can you screw that up? It generally just steamed or frothed milk and a couple tablespoons of matcha powder. Maybe if they want to make it fancy, there's some syrup thrown in, but I kinda like it without syrup, so if that's not part of their process, I'm happy. What I have in my hand though is a warm cup of what looks like dark green froth. I suspect that the matcha powder was added to late or something, because the froth should not look like that. After tasting...I was intrigued. That was good froth...way too good. So good because the matcha was mixed through the froth, but there was very little left in the cup. The only significant matcha in the cup was the clump left stuck in the bottom edge. I guess a matcha latte can be made poorly.

My wife ordered a coffee and cup of soup and all four things came to nearly $25. Ignoring quality, that seems way too much for what we got.
I love this gym! It is the best workout hands down. And to top it off, the coaches and staff are amazing! Come in and join!
1st time going here and amazing customer service and food is GUCCI!!! So Dam Good. The music selection was great and they have parking in the back for free.

What a great find! Stumbled across this place on Yelp when another place that looked good had a phone number that went straight to voicemail when I called for reservations. This place got similar stars and we were able to get 8:30 reservations at 7pm for tonight.

It's hard to remember all the great things we tried and loved thanks to Kelly's expert recommendations. He recommended so many wonderful dishes we couldn't keep track. Service was great as was the ambience. Will be back for sure.

Wow we were very surprised. This restaurant is not sold in an industrial area and we weren't sure it was open. Very vibrant, although it was an echoey environment due to the architecture.
The food was very fresh, the staff was friendly, and there was a glass wall behind which you could watch the bread being baked. Many people had placed online orders and were picking them up, assembly-line style. Will definitely be back.

My friends and I stopped here to find a cozy place to wait before leaving for the airport. The establishment has a cozy ambiance and nice staff. The exposed brick and wood decor creates a cool atmosphere. Great donut selection and beer options. It's worth stopping by!

Internet speeds are inconsistent and fluctuate wildly, keeping me from streaming anything reliably. I cannot watch anything on Netflix, Sony Vue, or Amazon Prime without constant interruptions of insufficient network speed.

Is this place still in business? I submitted my info on-line and never even got an automated "thanks for your message we will be in touch" kind of response e-mail. These are some of the best doughnuts I've ever had.  Not only are the flavor combinations creative, they are tasty. I've been to Donut + Dog three times now.  Twice for doughnuts and once for lunch. The sausages are amazing, too. I had the Elote Loco with truffle fries and my husband tried the Flying Hawaiian.  We both agreed that my selection was the tastier of the two, but both were wonderful.  The fries were amazing. 

As for donuts, we have tried so many and they've all been awesome.  Recent standouts include the Southern Belle and 99 Problems. 
 
This past weekend, my friend got a coffee drink with Horchata and he raved about it.

Thomas is terrific.  He responded to our email within 15 minutes and gave us a quote to replace the defective receivers in 3 of our ceiling fans.  We set up an appointment and he showed up a few minutes early!  He is very professional and knowledgeable about all areas of repair.  We have an ongoing plumbing issue which he researched and we discovered that it is a builder's warranty item so we were able to get that replaced by the builder thanks to Thomas.  Thomas will be our go to guy from now on.
I love this place so much that words can't describe. They have great food and lovely environment. You will enjoy.

Words can't express how enamored I was with this place. The chili and beer cheese bacon wrapped hot dog and fries were amazing. I ordered a flight of beer and a flight of donuts. The donuts are HUGE but light and super tasty. They are not greasy whatsoever. I had a sliver of the dirty churro (amazing)  and wolfed down the Pillow Talk which is Guava and cream cheese. That made my parts tingle with delight. Definitely a must experience

Hidden gem! Great food and service with a smile. Placed an order for pick up and it was ready in 15 minutes! The Zuzu burger was amazing, as were the chicken southwest egg rolls! You can tell that the food was fresh, not frozen tasting. Amazing!

Just went to the pre-open of The Donut and Dog. Coffee, beer, donuts and dogs. First, let me say that I am really not a donut girl. But in the spirit of the night,I did the beer and donut thing (don't judge), and my fave, FAVE was the Sweet Baby Jesus creme brûlée donut. It was sweet and crunchy and top..so good...and filled with creaminess. So tasty, and not too sweet. My hubby is the dog fiend, and he loved the Elote Loco, with siracha and street corn. But he sampled several of the other dogs, and said there wasn't a bad one in the bunch. We didn't sample the bacon-wrapped dates or pretzel bites that were on the menu...next time. The building itself was renovated with an airy and open feeling, and I feel certain that when the weather allows, I'll be spending a lot of time on the porch. With coffee and donuts. Or beer and donuts. Again, don't judge.

I really wanted to like this place.  The donuts looked amazing online.  We (5 of us) got there just before noon on a Thursday.  Very cute place. The line wasn't intimidating at all.  You place your order, get a number and they bring you your food. They have fountain drinks in a back corner that you help yourself too. While in line I kept hearing the large group that was ordering call people in their group back up because they were out of whatever.  There were 4 donuts that we could see. We surmised on our own that they were almost out of donuts. REALLY? We still waited in line.  By the time we were ordering there were only two.  It wasn't even noon yet.  I of course mentioned that we were hoping to have donuts.  They apologized and said that Buzz Feed posted a review and they had been running out because of this.  Hmmmm, seems like someone should be making more donuts.  Since they are out of donuts, any of the items on the menu that involve donuts can not be ordered.  These are 20 hour donuts so they can't just go in the back and make them.  There was quite a line when it was our turn to order.  I told them that they should tell everyone in line that there were no donuts so they would haven't to wait in line.  That didn't happen, but people were listening that were close to the register and started leaving.  When we did place our order they asked if we could all be on one ticket so they could give us one number.  They seem to be short on numbers for the tables too.  We said yes to move things along. This involved placing our order, getting our drinks, finding a place to sit then going back up to pay once all 5 of us placed our order.  The food that they did have was delivered and was OK.  Two of our party ordered the last two Smores donuts and said they were good.  If you have Donuts in the name of your restaurant, and donuts are the key ingredient in several of your menu items, you should have them to serve.  It was an interesting experience, but I will not be back even if they have donuts.  Too many other wonderful options in Nashville.

The quality of fresh fish is excellent. When it comes to sashimi and nigiri, there is no way of hiding or masking subpar ingredients. I had both the toro, uni, yellowtail and a few other times which were all very good.

I can tell they value quality over quantity and when it comes to fresh seafood, that should always be the case.

Highlight: Toro / Uni.

Honestly the absolute best donut I've ever eaten.  The Sweet Baby Jesus is a brioche dough creme brûlée donut and was incredible.  Overheard other patrons groaning over how great their other donuts were.  Coffee good.  Hot dog menu looked creative.

- Juice 3 the carrot based juice
- Juice 5 was the beet based juice
- Juice 6 was the cashew milk which was almost dessert like and filling for the last juice of the day.

Overall I would NOT recommend this juice cleanse at this price ($129). I love cities with easy public transportation that includes the airport and downtown. The Saint Louis MetroLink does exactly that.

The MetroLink is the 11th largest light rail system in the United States with 38 stations and 46 miles of track. It is the only light rail system to cross state lines as the rail crosses the Mississippi River between Missouri and Illinois. Construction began in 1990 and was expanded to include the airport in 1988. 

There are two separate lines that overlap for the majority of their track length. The Red Line includes the airport where the Blue Line goes more south and terminates at Shrewsbury. They operate together from Forest Park through Fairview Heights (in Illinois) where the Blue Line terminates and the Red Line continues for a few more stations to terminate at Shiloh-Scott.

I rode three times and there was security present for at least a few stops each time. I've heard stories, so it was nice that there was security present. That said, if you're concerned, you will want to sit in the front car closes to the driver. The cars were clean and free of litter. No eating, drinking or smoking is permitted on board.

MetroLink uses a proof-of-payment system. Tickets can be purchased at ticket vending machines at the entrance to all stations and must be validated before boarding the train. Single ride tickets are good for up to two hours in the direction that a passenger initially boards. 

Each of the stations I visited is handicapped accessible but I don't know if they are all such. Enjoy your ride!

I really liked the glaze (you could definitely take the black butter), and the pecan brittle.  I really didn't like the peach jam. Coming into this property you are welcomed with a painted road of hotdogs and sprinkled donuts to lead you into all the goods. 

Coming in before work I didn't want to devour a hotdog but will be coming back for one after seeing their menu. 

All the donuts are visually pleasing but I had to get their "dirty O.G." on my first visit. I also ordered a coconut cold brew coffee which was served in a BAG! 
 
The dirty O. G.  was very good, with a blast of cinnamon flavor and it was perfect with a sip of my coconut cold brew.

Yes they're open!
Great casual place for a Hot Dog!  Staff is friendly and they have donuts!

A cute little stop. It is a small restaurant serving donuts, dogs, beer and coffee inside of a house. It was pretty expensive for what it was. It was $20 for an espresso, iced coffee and 2 donuts. Pretty much the same cost of what we paid for our breakfast right before walking over to this place which was a ton of food.
The donuts were good but overpriced.
Always super solid food, friendly staff, great atmosphere, and even better music. Their hot dogs are incredible, I try to get a different one each time to mix it up and haven't been disappointed yet.

I began attempting to cancel my centurylink service a month ago.  

I have been transferred countless times, I have been hung up on and "fake can't hear you'd", told to call back on a different day.

They are now adding more and more fees because the account is still open.

I have tried to be patient for this company but they have been rude and completely inflexible.  

They have clearly made cancellation near impossible to make fleecing their customers easier.

Centurylink will never receive another penny from me. 

Maximum 40 Mbps in 2020 is a total joke as well.
