I am giving Metrolink 3 stars because I am torn. I have been riding Metrolink for around 5 years now and it's a great service for a reasonable price. The problem is the employees that Metrolink hires. You will hear the conductor of the train yelling at people over the intercom, shutting the doors on people as they are running up to the train and then laughing, and if they are off shift and riding the Metro you will even hear them sexually harass passengers. 

Customer service is definitely not strongly emphasized at Metro and I wonder if they even train their employees on good customer service. They really need to have undercover employees monitoring their conductors and other personnel. I usually stand right by the conductor at the front of the train, so maybe I will start recording what they say. Maybe send the recordings to Metro to see what they say or maybe create a website called "Metro's Great Customer Service". 

I hate to think what visitors to the St. Louis area think of our customer service/friendlieness after experiencing a ride on Metrolink!
Good sushi good atmosphere. Easy in and out. Casual. Friendly staff. Clean. Will definitely be going back.

Best sushi bar in town. Simple, fresh, friendly staff. Can't be beaten. 

The salmon sampler is an especially good. A very good way to taste the subtle differences in the fish. 

The sake selection is good.
Great sushi and service. Prices were a little bit high for amount of sushi received but overall enjoyable experience.

The donuts were really good and far better than Shipley's or any other chain donut place.  I would rate them a 7.8/10.  The hot dog was so-so.  I didn't think it was anything special.  The best thing by far was the parmesan truffle fries.  The fries were amazing and if I came back it would be for them.  Customer service was great and the ambiance was quaint and nice.  I know 3 stars might seem low but it's because the two things that they are supposed to be known for were just ok to me.

I lived in walking distance of here for 1.5 years, got food at least once a week from here. I've tried almost everything on the menu, everything is so great that I can't even get into rating all the items because it would take too long. 

My top 3:
1. Zuzu chicken sandwich 
2. Wings
3. Lamb burger (I like to put a little BBQ sauce on it)

All of their pizza's are fantastic, you can ask them to leave it in a little longer if you like a crispy crust like me. 

Definitely eat here, go through the whole menu. Its very worth.
Chicken n dumplings are just like my Grandmas. Won't eat them at any other restaurant!

Sun Sushi is one of the closest sushi bars to our house, and the food is pretty legit. In fact, the salmon skin roll is my favorite in town (it's always cooked perfectly). The Sun website also has a convenient online ordering system for takeout, which is great.

But if you're wondering why the 2-star review, it's because the takeout pickup situation is consistently atrocious. If you order at a busy time (Friday or Saturday night), there's just kind of a weird sea of people standing around out front with no real queue or organization. On our last visit, earlier this evening, my girlfriend stood waiting in the takeout "line" for over 15 minutes while other guests cut the line directly to the host stand both for takeout pickup and to get seated. Meanwhile, our sushi sat at room temperature the entire time. None of Sun's employees were addressing the chaotic takeout pickup line in any way. Even though she's usually pretty well-mannered, she eventually had to cut the line to get the host's attention and get our food.

Needless to say, the whole takeout situation was extremely stressful, and our rolls were kinda limp and sad by the time we got them. I know this is a hard time for small businesses everywhere and I am sympathetic, but we probably won't do anymore takeout from Sun for the time being.
Best sushi place in SB by far! I recommend this place to many based on the items I've had here. The salmon six step is unique and amazing. The spicy albacore roll is amazing- everything is good.

Yummy and creative hot dogs! The donut I had was not the best, but maybe I ordered the wrong thing, as I came later in the day and all the favorites were likely sold out.

Banh Mi Hot Dog: 5/5
This was absolutely delicious! The hot dog was flavorful and juicy, and I loved how the foundation was a New England hot dog bun that was toasted to perfection. As for the toppings, they successfully did their job of emulating a banh mi sandwich. The basil-Sriracha aioli and jalapeño slices provided some heat while the carrots and cucumber balanced things out with their freshness.

South Beach Donut: 2/5
I loved the concept of this donut and thought the rum pipet was a fun touch. However, when it came to how it actually tasted, I hardly detected any flavor except for extreme bitterness. The donut itself wasn't bad, as it was light and soft, but it didn't make up for the disappointing flavor profile.
The food is great and the staff here is so nice. I highly recommend this place. The chicken cheesesteak was delicious.

My only regret while visiting Nashville is not coming here a second time. The food was wonderful, and the service was great! We had a little bit of everything- street corn, grilled cheese, fries, truffle fries, a donut, and a beer flight!

The light rail has quite a bit of value. It goes straight from the airport through the park, Wash U, and downtown before crossing the river to fairly remote suburbs. It's not a streetcar; it has its own space and runs quickly and regularly. It's quite cheap, either for a ride or a day pass, and it wasn't hard to pay with credit.

Of course, being aboveground raises some weather-related concerns; there are some heaters at some of the exposed areas in the stations. There are two train lines, but most of the city remains without a train; it's not an extensive network. The cars didn't have a ton of free space for luggage.

The crowd is very mixed. I didn't see some of the really bad behavior that others commented on, and indeed it was the chattiest public transit I've ever been on, with a lot of people either seemingly running into acquaintances or trying to make new ones. Maybe it's a Midwestern thing; it's very rare in my experience to see anyone try to start a conversation on transit, but someone asked me about the game I was playing on my iPad, and there was a lot of other conversation going around at times. I could see people's concerns though; there wasn't a ton of security and it seemed like some more order was needed.

Saw this place on a Facebook post and really wanted to try their donut flight paired with beer, but sadly they had run out of donuts when I got there, which was really disappointing. I highly recommend getting there real early if you want to try their donuts because they sell fast. Decided not to leave empty handed and tried their Elote Loco which was a chorizo sausage topped with "Mexican Street Style" corn on a brioche hot dog bun which was really delicious! I also tried their white hot chocolate, which was not too sweet and perfect for the cold weather. They have outdoor seating which is perfect for those who may have a furry friends but some outdoor heating might be a nice addition. The inside was cute but I took a point off for not having toilet paper in the ladies room. Overall, service needs improvement but the food was great. I would definitely come back to try and see if I can finally try a donut.

Sun sushi was a pretty good hidden spot where locals like to go in Santa Barbara. I really enjoyed the albacore delight roll because it was the best role there! I also got the volcano roll which was pretty good because the scallops did not taste fishy which is really hard to perfect in most restaurants. The baked lobster roll was okay not much flavor was probably my least favorite but still good. The stuffed jalapeños were not good at all but the waiter was kind enough to remove it from the check which I appreciate because I did not eat more than one. And the miso soup was good like every other place. However, the best part of the entire dinner was the spicy Mayo because it was freshly made and you can tell because it doesn't have the same taste as most places and it was lighter and creamier. If you go to sun you have to order buckets of spicy Mayo it is sooo good and tastes amazing with everything! I really recommend trying this spot but dining because I have heard takeout can be a bit challenging.

Not satisfied. Paid startup fee for modem on August 25 in order to begin online classes. It is now October 30 I received the modem but no internet service. I've made several calls and not given answers about the delay other than they are having construction issues and put my service request on a Facilitied hold. I'm surprised with their unprofessional service as I've had good experience in the past.

Great sushi in this area isn't all that common, oddly enough. Sun sushi however DID NOT DISAPPOINT!! From the miso to the quick and generous service, this place is great. Will definitely be coming back for more. Recommend the state street roll and the salmon delight roll.

Not sure about the restaurant as a concept, but the Horchata Cubano is exactly what I needed on a cold and rainy day. As pricey as your high-end coffee shop, it still delivers for a satisfied customer.

Zuzus kitchen is my go to pizza delivery place. I find the prices are very reasonable ($7.99 for a medium cheese pizza). They claim to make everything fresh and I believe you can really taste it. In addition to the delicious pizza, I have tried the southwest spring rolls, mozzarella sticks, and caesar salad. I have never been disappointed with the quality of the food. The delivery is almost always super fast. I will continue to order from Zuzus, because as of yet I have not found better quality and better tasting pizza for delivery in my area!

Tried to contact them. All I received were computer generated "canned" responses. When I finally got a salesman named "Justin Tucker" via email, he was a rude, condescending smartass. Why I'm surprised I do not know, as he is a car salesman. I'll do business elsewhere!
I did like them in the beginning, they was really good when they just opened, but now a food quality is not the best.
What a great little gem.  So glad that we tried them out. The six step salmon entrée and the toro nigiri were so fresh and the staff was so accommodating. It a must!

My wife, mother and I stopped by this location on Thursday April 4th, and it has to be the worst experience any of us have had at a Cracker Barrel. It started off with us not even being acknowledged for 15-20 minutes before our waitress came over to speak with us. After she brings our drinks, she takes our order. I ordered the meatloaf and couldn't wait to taste it. Now keep in mind the store isn't very busy, but there are a few people there. We had good conversation so nothing was ever mentioned about how long it was taking. About 20 minutes after our order was placed, our waitress comes back to inform me that they are out of meatloaf and that some more wouldn't be ready for an hour. I was frustrated but never let this young lady know that. I knew it wasn't her fault. So I ordered something else. About 5 minutes later she comes back with my wife and mothers food, and because we came in together, we wanted to eat together. So we asked her to take it back and bring it all out together. She says that the manager told her to bring theirs out so it wouldn't get cold. The manager comes out and talks with every other table but ours, until my wife calls him over. He says he didn't know anything about it and says he'd look into it. After another 15-20 minutes the manager brings our food out and we were finally able to eat. Of course they just let my wife and mothers food keep warm under a heat lamp. Let me add that we don't go around looking to get free meals or even discounted meals. Just like anyone else, we want good food and good service for our money. We have always gotten both at Cracker Barrel. We will continue to go to Cracker Barrel, just not this one. When we left, I paid the full bill and still left our waitress a nice tip.

Food came out quick, service was fast and most of all the sushi was delicious with perfection. This is one of the best sushi restaurant in California that I'd recommend to anyone, memorable place that I'll keep in my mind. Thank you to the Sunsushi crew :D

Me and my friends were walking around town in the rain, it was muggy.  The bad weather made us want something nice to eat.  So we went to this place called the donut dog.  The donuts were good but the dude's abs were better. Gotta give credit where it's due. Keep it up. 5 stars for the 6 pack and the donuts. Great place, friendly, ate outside, they sell donuts

BEST SERVICE! Great coffee always and the workers here are so helpful and kind. Go above and beyond to assist customers and never a long wait time. Tasty coffee is always a good thing too! Love iced cappuccino during the summer.

My wife and I came here for the first time for our anniversary dinner and wow, it was amazing! We ordered omakase with hot sake. Pricing was very reasonable. Each piece (10 in all) told us a unique story of premium quality and craftsmanship. Fish was all really fresh and so delicious. This was a very memorable meal for us. We'll definitely be coming back and highly recommend to sushi lovers!

Was greated with the nicest staff. They went over the menu with me about different details and flavors. Ended up getting a chilli cheese dog which was soooo good. Great cheese great chili and the dog was very flavorful. I got the farmers market donut. Which was so good.

Brooke is great.  You can completely trust her through this process if you are selling or buying a home.  She knows the market, she knows what she's doing, she is very available, responds quickly.  She really just guided me through everything and it all worked out perfectly.

Dr. Tomlinson has been great she is very knowledgeable and takes really good care of you. One of the great things about the location is the staff that was there and recently one has left but the new guy is nice and competent as well which is really what seems to matter when it comes to teeth. Prices are fair as well!
This place is cute. The service was amazing, and Danny was super on top of it. I'm glad they are able to stay open, and have an outside seating spot.
Awesome place! You got to check it out! The food is amazing and the owners are super cool people!

This place freaking sucked and my food was cold, only gave me half a portion of dumplings, and had nothing but excuses. Cracker Barrel is always the same and I know what to expect with their service. Very disappointed...

A cute little coffee shop off the main road, we had breakfast around the corner and was looking for somewhere to sit and enjoy a little dessert or coffee. We found this place was nearby and gave it a try. Any place that you can bring your furry friend is a place i LOVE. The staff was so sweet and nice i really loved the vibes inside. The maple donut was so so good with a nice cold brew. Really enjoyed this place and glad we found it.

If you're looking for fresh rolls, look no further than Sun Sushi! The fish used here is so succulent that it tastes like it was just caught straight from the waters of Santa Barbara minutes before being prepared and served on my plate. Compared to other joints I've had in Isla Vista and Goleta, Sun Sushi on State Street stands out from the rest, & it is relatively nice -price wise- for the quality of food that you're receiving. Come at lunch service for the special lunch deals and you'll be able to save some money while also enjoying the best sushi in SB :)

I really appreciated the two-day job Thomas completed for us last month. We have a new dog and found to our horror that she could slip through all of our fences and balconies. Thomas thoughtfully installed a strong plastic mesh that totally secured the entire yard, and all possible openings - including very difficult gates. He was pleasant, creative, reliable and fairly priced. I'll call him again when I need a terrific handyman.

I have been here several times and have not had any bad experiences. Came here through multiple recommendations from friends. I am a BIG fan of the Zuzu burger and their hummus! Their desserts are mediocre, though it is delivered from a bakery in Drexel Hill.

Just delicious.  The tuna and rice appetizer was awesome.  We had the uni, sweet shrimp sushi and salmon roll.   I'm a fan.  Staff was maxed out with to go orders, but were very nice and did their best to be attentive.

Absolutely horrible customer service. My daughter scheduled and install, but had to reschedule. They approved the rescheduling, and then did not show. When she called to check on the install, she was told that they cancelled the first appointment, but never entered the new one. SO she would have to wait another week or two. Imaging that, a company screws up and the customer is expected to suffer because of it!! Yeah, I want to pay for that kind of service. Then I called their 800 number, which sends me to Tech Support. After explaining everything to them, they say "You need to speak to our 'Customer Care' " and transferred me. The lady at "Customer Care" only seemed to care about dumping my call as soon as possible. She said "you need to speak to Technical Support" and before I could say "That's who sent me to you", the woman hung up on me. Not even a Tranfer!!! So then I tried the Chat bot, what a joke. It tried to get me to a human, but every time I got a person (Rafael M), the connection dropped. 

With Customer Service like this, no wonder their stock is tanking and they keep missing earnings. Your technology may be wonderful, but your customer service sucks. You just lost another customer!!
Good donut. I got the cream brûlée. I didn't care for the crispy top, but I should have realized it would be hard. I'd get something else next time.

I'm all about a cute little coffee shop and this place checks all the boxes. Mom and Pop feel (even though they're growing which is great) with cute decor that makes you feel like you're at home but enough space to be open and inviting. It was nice outside so I found a spot on their patio. I got the Campfire Cappuccino and it was delicious. The foam design was too pretty so I made them give me the marshmallow separate instead of their standard of roasting then placing into your coffee. It's very cool, they try to make it a full experience- go try one for yourself. They're so popular that the donuts were slim to none when I arrived around noon so I only had the option of the Velvet Revolver, but it was also very good- sweet with the hint of cayenne, a nice balance. Fantastic service, everyone was super friendly and welcoming. Looking forward to becoming a regular here.

My favorite sushi place in town for fresh fish that's priced just right. I am very picky with my sushi and having lived in Japan, I am very used to a certain quality of fish! I've come to enjoy some other sushi restaurants in town but I find that most other restaurants tend to be very pricey and not affordable if you like to eat quality sushi often. I can honestly put Sun above many other restaurants in town in terms of how much quality fish you get with your sushi. I can't speak on behalf of the rolls since I usually only order the sushi, but I have enjoyed other appetizers that are delicious too. Service is wonderful and I've always felt very welcomed in there. I love recommending this place to anyone who appreciates sushi!

I love me some Sun Sushi! Always so fresh and delicious, the toro and blue fin is excellent .  Hands down some of the best sushi in town.  To top it off everyone that works there is so nice and provides great service.

I absolutely love going to OTF Casas Adobes! Every class is different and pushes me to the max, the coaches are amazing and motivational, the staff are kind and helpful, the music is very entertaining and perfect for the workout, and the facility is clean and modern. I always feel good at the completion of every class. I am a very happy OTF member.

Great neighborhood joint - fresh fish at reasonable price.  Service was efficient and friendly.  My son ordered his usual-teriyaki salmon and loved it, nice char and decent portion.  It comes with salad, miso soup and rice.  My daughter ordered salmon lover, not spicy, and it was on point - her favorite salmon roll of many places thus far.  I had Uni - small in size but high in quality and oh so sweet.  My Engiwa was  nicely seared with a slight crunch.  Two favorites are the hamachi jalapeños carpaccio and lobster roll.  Lobster roll reminiscent of $38 roll I recently had in San Diego for only ~$20.  And The hamachi was fresh, well dressed, decent size slices and simply delicious.  Would frequent again when we're in town.

Compared to other train systems (e.g. Boston, Chicago & D.C.), the Metrolink lags way behind.  I agree with previous reviews about the lack of turnstyles & the bad "honor" system.  Bad design is all I can say about this mode of transportation.  Lack of maps to take with you at any Metrolink stop makes it really bad.  I agree with previous posts about only having 2 lines & wishing they could expand to North & South St. Louis.  Free parking is pretty much the only thing I liked.

The also offer a variety of pastries. We tried a few, and our favorite was the zucchini bread. Highly recommend trying it!Companion Bakery is a cooking school that offers food for purchase as well. They have a small selection of breakfast sandwiches and other breakfast options in the morning.The food was good, and the service was excellent.
Not intimidating like other gyms. Super welcoming and motivating. Wonderful coaches and great workouts!

The food is hit or miss, and the service could be better. Out of the 3 times I've been here, they never had the lamb that they said they had on the menu...they also never put my online order through the second time. Then, the third time, the wings were just shards of bone and the avocado on my panini were the smallest-most unripe slices I've ever eaten. Either way, I won't be back.

Not a sit down joint - they do have some counter service, but I always ordered takeout. They were always prompt on the delivery or the pick up time. Lots of menu options (HUGE - wide variety of sandwiches) and is reflective of mediterranean cuisine. Lots of spices & flavors, and great combos with meats & vegetables. Their speciality pizza is FIRE - comes with lamb, chickpeas and a spicy sauce. This is my favorite thing to get here. They have a wide variety of sandwiches  | lots of menu options | speciality pizza with lamb and chickpeas is amazing. Really affordable, and more than worth it if you are local to that area of Philadelphia.

I can't believe I never went here before.  I live a mile away and have driven by it so many times.  

I only had 3 items here.  I thought 2 out of the 3 were delicious.  

I had the Box Sushi, which is a seared fish and crab sushi.  I was really delicious.  I will be back for that very soon.

I also had the tofu agedashi which is fried chunks of tofu in a beautiful light broth.  This was also delicous.  

The only think I didn't like was the crunch roll.  I'm sure other people would like it, but after eating the box roll I wasn't impressed.  

I can't wait to go back!

I love to go there for a slice or for a whol pizza. Sometimes we order salads and burgers. But mainly we go for the Boom Boom chiken pizza. And they never have it ready. Or I call and they said -we will have it at 7pm - I go to get my sliced at 7 and no. They don't have it. So I would just looove that they always have it or at list one pizza a day. 

Sometimes you can tell that they don't want to do it. :(

Real, real pricey.  Came out quickly (though without a mask-a must during the pandemic), but I was shocked to be charged $175 dollars for labor for a job that literally took 3 minutes and required no parts.
The whole staff here was super friendly and the food was amazing! I'm definitely miss it! I wish they had one here in California

Great service and food! The place is amazing and smells amazing!!
I will definitely be going there for lunch.I had the Claytonian sandwich for breakfast and it was delicious!
Convenient spot. I order from here twice, the teriyaki chicken with rice. Food was fresh and good.
Never disappoints. I love the mermaid sandwich and Greek salad. The bread here is delicious and the cookies are awesome. Great service.
Slick and smooth from airport, to the Arch, to hotels, and to the ballpark. This is an easy to use system, safe, clean, and convenient from the burbs, downtown, and all around St Louis.

Peg was our server and I simply love this place!!!
The food, service and everything thing is 5 stars plus.
I can't put into words of how wonderful Peg's service was with us made me feel like she was my family member like an aunt.
I can't wait to come back here.

Zuzu's is the best and most affordable food in fairmount. When you're looking for a filling and delicious meal and the best bang for your buck, look no further than Zuzu's kitchen. The staff is friendly and will soon have your order memorized. They are humble and and hardworking and will always greet you with a smile. Zuzu's is simply zuzutastic!

We had a family member find a video online of this place showing donuts and beer and they sent it to us.  We made the pilgrimage to Nashville (we live 1.5 hours away)  and boy was it worth it!  We ordered four different donuts, a flight of beer and a gourmet hot dog with fries.  Everything tasted amazing...now this is a special occasion for us since we are retired and want to live a lot longer (it's not healthy but dang it was good)  so we will pace ourselves and come back again when we have company.  So fun and worth it and the staff were great too.

Metrolink does not compared to the NYC subway, but it has its advantages.

Metrolink is easy to use and it is CLEAN and cheap.

We brought four  $7.50 pass from the airport and used it for 2 days.
We were never asked to show our passes on the metrolink. I surpose that people do jump the fare.

The metrolink and metro bus got us around town. It took some research but using goggle, we were able to travel around St. Louis.

Metrolink ran every 20 minutes. There are 2 lines-red and blue.

My only complaints with metrobus was that there were some hourly buses.

Well worth the price for tourists.

Excellent donut! Super friendly staff who take great pride in their offerings. I will be back to try the dogs. In the meantime this donut shoots to one of the best in Nashville. And well worth the splurge in calories and blowing the diet!

The Metro in St. Louis reminds me of an improved version of a simple light rail system; that is, it runs on dedicated tracks but is generally at street level, and the best part about it is that it doesn't have to stop for vehicle traffic.  However, a few things are a little fishy about this system.  For one, ticket fares are only somewhat enforced...  and they work on an odd "hourly" system (one hour pass, two hour pass, etc) instead of a per-ride system (although day passes and longer are still day passes).  Also, depending on where you want to go, stations can either be very convenient (as they thankfully were for us) or quite far from where you need to go.  As near as I could tell, there really is only 1 main line, which branches at one point to become two lines.  Stations are a bit tricky to find, and it's hard as a tourist to find a good map of the surrounding area at any given station to get your bearings.  Note, however, the availability of plenty of free "entertainment," as you bump elbows with some potentially unsavory folk.  Also be warned that, due to what I'm assuming is the frequency of occurrence of said entertainment, the Metro security are a little racist in their attempt to catch troublemakers.  We witnessed an incident where a young man caused an incident that caused our train to be boarded by Metro security, who then proceeded to question a couple of other men of the same race rather than try to track down the actual culprit (who eventually snuck around behind the guards and ran away).  Nonetheless, if you do what we did and stay near the airport, the Metro is a reasonable way to get into the heart of the city without too much fuss.
Tasty but the place is so tiny it's hard to get a table and the food definitely isn't healthy.

We were blown away by the quality of the sushi. I wasn't expecting much but was overwhelmed by the service and presentation. They have an excellent selection of sake and have limited inside and outside seating. Overall we will really loved this place and will return again!

When I came to St. Louis 10 years ago, I didn't use Metro much. I thought public transit was only for big cities like NYC or Chicago, and while I used transit without fail there, it didn't occur to me that St. Louis' "rinky-dink" system could get me around very well. In the last decade, I've converted and am a happy transit rider.

Metro is a system of light rail, bus and Call-A-Ride. I've only used the bus and rail, and I've been quite happy with both. 

Metrolink light rail trains generally are clean and are almost always on time. They hit the downtown highlights very well and are great for going to the airport or commuting from Shrewsbury, Brentwood or the East Side. They also go to active, dense neighborhoods, Forest Park and many of the area's universities. Light rail is pretty to figure out, and the lines are shown at station platforms as well as in the trains themselves.

Metrobus is a bit harder to figure out than the train, but it's no less useful. St. Louis buses don't always drive along a parallel route like buses in other cities do; instead, they meander within the denser parts of neighborhoods. It means more planning up front, but as a bonus, you just might see a new restaurant to try. The buses sometimes are within five minutes early or late, depending on the weather and traffic, so you must account for that when you head to a stop.

To use the system, you must buy a ticket from vending machines or pay cash fare on the bus. If you haven't ridden before, t's a little confusing knowing which tickets are accepted on which method of transit (People often wonder if a Metrolink ticket can work for the bus as a transfer, and vice versa). The vending machines just got a bump in functionality, though -- credit cards now are accepted at most. No more cash!

I find security at the rail platforms adequate. Security often is posted at platforms that have a lot of teens, and most platforms are guarded after dark. 

Visitors and residents alike complain about Metro's honor system, but it's what we've got right now. I agree that smartcards and turnstiles would be more functional, but money to do that has to come from somewhere, and Missouri as a state is among the lowest in transit funding. I disagree with other people's experiences, though, as I'm asked nearly daily to show my pass. It does depend on time of day, I think. 

For the uninitiated, Metro didn't decide to expand to Shrewsbury, East-West Gateway did. Metro isn't allowed to make final decisions for expansion.

For my current and previous dwelling in St. Louis, I purposefully chose to live along multiple transit lines (rail plus bus) so I could drive less. I purchase a monthly pass and use transit for work, shopping, dining and sporting events. It makes me a MUCH calmer person.

St. Louis County dwellers: You have a big vote coming up in April. Please support transit and vote yes for Prop A! Once the county passes this minor tax, the city's tax also will kick in, and the St. Louis region will have that much more to maintain and expand our transit options. St. Louis does need more rail and bus lines to dense neighborhoods that aren't yet represented, but that can't happen without funding. The more we fund now, the better the system will be 10 years from now and beyond.

This place has such great fresh tasting sushi and customer service! The menu is pretty big and has so many amazing and interesting options. We tried a few different rolls and everything was outstanding! Takeaway only right now due to covid but the measures they have taken are extremely safe and convenient, they do an amazing job! Definitely will be going back (:
As a visitor headed to the Cards game, I loved the Metrolink.  $2 each way, not crowded, and a very smooth ride.

Love the vibe, love the feel of this location. Just a few miles away from UNO & SUNO campus, this is a study & meeting haven for the masses. 

Also great, is a few yards away is a grocery store & a few eateries; feed the brain during you're study break.  That's just in case you don't wanna munch out on the pastries & other goodies in the glass case.

Tables, chairs & a sofa, plus outdoor seating, make for ample room to grab a nook or cranny to get your study on.  WiFi is "free" but there's a sign posted that clearly states its for PAYING customers, but there's no lock or passcode to access, so patronize that facility & surf away.

It's normally very quiet in here, less someone having a meeting or two, but that's more of the exception than the rule.  This is like an extended library, shhhhhhhh don't tell them.

I find the staff to be friendly & patient while deciding upon your drink selection.

Friendly staff, pastries & other munchies, ample seating & "free" WiFi all make this a great spot for studying or meeting whichever is your pleasure.
Great place, that made us know the meaning of southern hospitality. Food, drinks, and service was amazing!
I am not sure why this place gets such high reviews.   I especially do not recommend anything fried as their oil smelled and tasted old.  Also they got my order wrong.   Really disappointed.

The service was just top notch!  And the food matched!  Our favorites wet the state street roll, the firecracker and the crunch roll.  When I travel,  I expect so so good.  This was just what I needed.
From the hostess..waiter...quality of food.. and service... I can't ask for anything else... the experience was a superb one!!!

Another thing covid has ruined for me...dining out.

Serious staffing shortage here, waitresses clearing  tables between orders, service was slow, and my food was cold. Tasty, but who wants to eat cold bacon? I don't. 

Remember to tip your servers no matter what the service level is. These people have to work in an environment with a labor shortage.  For all I know they are also washing dishes in the back.

I've lived in Santa Barbara since the 70's and have eaten in every Sushi place in town. That said, Sun Sushi has to be the absolute best Sushi place that has ever been in the entire Santa Barbara area. Ming and his entire staff are  professional, efficient and very friendly, which only adds to the great environment at Sun Sushi. And as wonderful as the service and atmosphere are they both pale compared to the level of the food, which is spectacular. Each and every dish I've had there has been so well prepared, so well spiced and or marinated that I've never needed to use soy sauce as it would only take away from the incredible flavors of each dish. If you enjoy Sushi, you absolutely need to make Sun Sushi your Go To place.

I don't know why this place has 4.5 stars. I ordered the beef tacos and 10 mild wings. As you can tell from my pics the food was just weak!! I know it's delivery food but there was barely any sauce on my wings and the tacos were nothing special. Also I provided specific instructions to the company on how to drop off my order and that was a complete disaster. The driver was lazy and acted clueless. Overall I'm not impressed with the food nor the delivery service so I will not be ordering from ZuZu again.

You never go wrong at this place. I've been at this restaurant many times. Great food, excellent menu and good service.
The fish is fresh, presentation is great and the taste is perfect. Way to go!

My husband and I visited Donut and Dog while stopping over in Nashville! We've watched them from San Diego, CA for quite some time and even found out that the owner is from San Diego which was super cool!!! We're on a foodie adventure to find the best food in the country and we have to say that they live up to the Hype and the photos on IG!!

We always thought it was such a random combination, but damn they legit!!
When we saw the donuts we didn't expect for them to be as MASSIVE as they were!! We briefly talked with the baker, who was incredible and you can really tell she LOVES her job and providing the highest quality donuts out there!!

The donuts were all incredibly fluffy and had such a solid base flavor!!
We had seen the crazy donut with chicken on top called the Lumberjack and knew we had to get it!!! We are SOOOO glad we did!! We hadn't had the best Hot chicken experience so were nervous about the flavoring of the chicken, but honestly the hot chicken they made was BETTER then the original hot chicken spot in TYN!! The spicy aioli chicken was super crunchy flavorful, juicy, mild in spice, and the waffle on top had a crunch on the outside while being fluffy on the inside. All this sat on top of an amazing, lightly sweetened maple donut, Each of the ingredients could easily stand on their own and together they were fire!!! It truly saved Nashville hot chicken for us and all the ingredients were high quality!!

Some of the other donuts we tried were:

Boss hog: Had a crunchy Smokey bacon, with a crunchy pecan brittle that was a mix of sweet and salty. A little more sweet than maple flavor and the donut was light and fluffy. It was the best maple baconwe have had plus the snap of the pecan was nice and crunchy.

Egg nog: light and fluffy with more like a cinnamon nutmeg glaze donut.
Apple: It was like a cheesecake apple pie with crunchy soft streusel and apple pie filling. Reminded us of a caramel apple pop feel.

Cranberry: Had a slight tartness which was amazing! The ginger was light but present and hints of what felt like honeysuckle within, nice spiced gingerbread crumb. Crumb on outside had wonderful texture.

Creme brûlée: sweet baby Jesus is right. Not overly sweet with the best crunch on the outside that you MUST VIDEO with the SOUND ON plus the light custard inside was very prevalent with vanilla bean which was amazing!

Unfortunately we weren't able to try their hot dogs cause we showed up right when they opened, but we can imagine that they rock just like everything else!

The environment is SO CUTE!! Its a little house with fun lights and even outside seating!

You MUST check them out even if you fly to Nashville just to experience them! LOVED LOVED LOVED!!! Thank you!!

Check out more videos and pictures on IG: Fitfoodiesonwheels Facebook: Fit Foodies on Wheels

I have compassion for restaurants reeling from the pandemic, but a lot of people are looking for work so why not find employees that care?  Pick up order was ten minutes late getting our and it was clearly sitting for that ten minutes because it was cold. Liquid from turnip greens was spilled into the compartment making fried fish soggy. Missing tarter sauce. Loaded bake potato had no sour cream and was hours old - it was yellowed inside and obviously held too long. Biscuit was dry and cornbread burned on top. No condiments like salt or plastic ware. 

There was zero effort put into food quality.  It's easy to be patient with items that aren't available, wait times etc. but no excuse for serving food to takeout customers that would have been sent back from the dining room.
Food was disgusting, wait time was horrible, waitress was disrespectful. We waited 20 mins to get a refill on drinks. At the end we didn't eat anything.
Very fresh and delicious. Excellent service. California rolls very fresh, yummy salad, and I enjoyed the miso soup and tea.

I went to the Dog and Donut with my boyfriend before catching a movie at the Belcourt this weekend. We were craving hot dogs and hadn't been before/wanted to try a new place and got to the restaurant at around 5:20pm Saturday. Oddly enough, this place closes at 6pm on Saturdays, which for an area like Hillsboro seems unusually early.

We ordered at the counter and were told they were out of donuts (which was fine because we weren't going to order that anyway) and they were also unfortunately out of the bacon jam for the 615 dog, so we settled for the Bahn Mi and the Hawaiian. I had planned to order a beer, and they carry 4 varieties, 3 of which were Sculpin. I asked the cashier if I could taste the Pale Ale as I've had the IPA before and like it well enough but wanted to see if I liked the Pale Ale better. She told me that unfortunately, due to the owner's policy they could not give out samples because they were "new and poor" but told me all the beers were very good. I explained I was familiar with a couple of them and if I tried one I'd definitely get one, but since it had been a minute since I'd had a sculpin I just wanted to try the one variety. She continued to say they couldn't give me a sample and she'd tell me what they tasted like if she could but she wasn't 21 so she didn't know... well ok that basically contradicts what she said about being able to verify the beers were all good. Since apart from the Sculpin they only had Modelo, (which I didn't want to pay $6 for a 10oz glass of, I stuck with water.)

Personally, I think not offering samples of beer (especially when you only have 4 on draft and aren't running the risk of someone wanting to try 10 beers) is pretty ridiculous. If there was in fact a policy from the owner about not doing samples, he or she lost $6 from me that I would have certainly paid if I had been able to try the Pale Ale. Even if I hadn't gotten it (which I probably would have) I would've reverted back to the IPA, but it was really more the principle of the thing for me, after paying like $20 for two hot dogs and fries, I can't get a tiny sample of beer? I would recommend the owner change the policy or have a 1-sample policy because the current one doesn't really build goodwill or endear customers in my opinion.

We then went to go sit down, (normally we wouldn't eaten outside but it was pretty hot/there weren't any shaded tables open,) and the two empty tables were really dirty, both the tables themselves, and in the case of one, the floor beneath. We moved to a second table and ended up bussing it ourselves because it seemed like the people working FOH were more concerned about closing down then keep the dining area clean for customers.

Something else that really blew our minds. A few people came in at 5:30 and the cashier told them they were no longer serving food but encouraged them to come back some other time. What??? If you're going to be open during the dinner hour, be open for dinner! I understand they open at 8 for breakfast, and if they closed at 10 or even 9 and decided to stop serving at 8:30 or 9:30 then I would understand, but it's a pretty dumb idea in my opinion to stop serving food at 5:30 when you close at 6, that's literally in the middle of dinner time. I think it would even make sense for the restaurant to close at the slowest point of the day, maybe 2-4 on Saturdays and reopen for dinner from 5-8 or 9. 

Anyway, on to the food! Both our hot dogs were very good, though we liked the Bahn Mi better. The fries were excellent and house made chips were really solid too. I think $9 is a little steep for both these hot dogs, even with sides included but overall not super unreasonable as the hotdogs were good and the rolls were delicious. 

As far as décor, (and this doesn't weigh into my rating, just more of an observation) it's cute if you don't look to closely, but then if you start to look more closely, it kind of looks like a bunch of different pinterest trends threw up all over the restaurant. Not my personal taste, it all just felt trendy and a little unorganized. 

TL;DR-

The food is pretty good if you're craving a hot dog or fries an in the area, and I honestly wish the company well/hope they take some suggestions for improvement because I think they could succeed in the area, but I personally would not go out of my way to return for dinner, though I would consider coming back to try a donut if I was nearby.

First things first. WOW what a menu of absolute favorites. I couldn't think of 4 more perfect items to add to a menu: coffee, donuts, hotdogs, beer. A winning menu. And not only do they have the best items to eat, they're delicious. The hotdogs are on delicious bread and have great offerings as far as toppings and sauces. This isn't your average hotdog, no. This is one of the best hotdogs you'll ever eat. Second thing... have the employees always been THE MOST cheerful? Or did working here make them the absolute most pleasant staff? Like, Trader Joe's staff type happy! They're kind, helpful, gave great suggestions and seemed like they were genuinely so thrilled that I came into their shop that day. It's great customer service. I enjoyed my hotdog and beer, and the donut was good. I guess that's my only criticism - the donuts are brioche, and they're THICK, and therefor, a little dry in my opinion. The toppings on the donut and the drizzle were amazing, but I couldn't eat the whole thing (especially the bottom half of the donut) because it was a little on the dry side. But I'd be willing to give the donuts another try - maybe other flavors aren't as dry. Overall, 5 stars is very fair and I loved this place. I'll be back.

Companion Cafe is located in the Westport Business District.  I have gotten take out far more than my Yelp Check In count shows.  This place produces high quality, fresh, real food and baked goods.  This baking campus has a cooking school, working factory, event space, cafe', and large parking lot.

The cafe' offers many self seating options from community table to booths, to family tables.  You order at the counter and food is brought out to your table.  Many of the tables offer a view inside the working factory.  Bakers are busy producing the fresh baked Companion breads for local restaurants and grocery stores.

My favorite items on the menu to date are the Prom Queen Salad, Tough Love, and Catycorner Chicken Salad.  Companion offers two different Chicken Salads, so make sure you read the menu carefully.  The portion size at Companion is larger than the competition.  Half of a Salad and Half of a Sandwich seem huge.  I have always needed a to-go box with the food I have eaten in-house.  The salads really stand out here.

I  wish they offered a night or two with expanded hours.

Of course it is hard to leave without some fresh baked bread or baked goods.  Be warned, you may want IT ALL...
Our experience was AMAZING! Great food & drinks, fantastic employees and service, awesome atmosphere! The highlight of our nashville trip!

Delicious, fresh sushi and ample portions, but expensive. The teriyaki beef we ordered was good quality, but would have been more complete with some vegetables added (I don't eat bell peppers and they said the beef would have come with some sliced peppers).  The salad that came with it was  a plastic container of mixed lettuces and nothing more.

Get the salmon six step and box tuna rolls. This unassuming place has the best sushi in town by far. The staff and chefs are super friendly and place is very clean. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. They offer curbside during the Covid 19 pandemic. I've been to most of the local sushi spots and this place is hands down the best in town.

I went to Sun Sushi and Arigato back to back and the verdict is that Sun Sushi has the best sushi short of a trip to LA.  I enjoyed sitting at the sushi bar much more than sitting at a table.  The reason is that cooked food here aren't all that special, what they excel is fresh seasonal fish and the best way to eat here is to order a la carte nigiri.  The chef was personable and was very proud of his creations, so don't you dare soaking those delicate sushi in soy sauce.  I tried some less common species like bigfin reef squid and itoyori dai.  The itoyori dai had a meltingly tender texture and I loved the squid's gelatinous but chewiness texture.  The amberjack and kinmedai were also incredibly fresh with a natural savoriness.  In comparison, the scallop, while fresh and sweet seemed almost mundane.  Sit at the sushi bar and experience sushi in its unadulterated form, just a few specks of sea salt, a light brush of soy sauce, or a couple drops of yuzu.

I went here for the first time today, and I'm not sure how I've survived living in Nashville almost a year without trying this place!! The donuts are SO good and filling. I was really impressed--especially because I'm typically not a sweets person. It's hard to eat just one in one sitting, so leftovers are guaranteed. The menu has great variety, and we wanted to check out the more savory options too. We got The Hangover Burger and Bavarian Pretzel Bites w/ Beer Cheese. All of the above were SO good. Great portion sizes and very tasty!! We ordered only the two Dirty Churro Donuts, and they gave us two additional donuts just to be kind. Very happy with both the food and the service! Always happy to support local and definitely will be back for more!!

The food was good.  My daughter had the children's hot dog plate.  It was a nice size dog on a good looking bun.  I ordered the chorizo dog.  It was very good and tasty.  My other daughter ordered the hangover burger. She loved it except the bun was a donut and she didn't realize it.  We did not get a donut but they looked amazing.   Why the 3 then?   We are in the middle of a pandemic and restaurants just opened up and all employees are required to wear masks.   Not a single employee was.  Not the person who ordered my food, not the person who delivered our food, nor the person who gave us our to-go box.  And we all were because.  They had to notice that and still did not care enough to do what they are already required to do.

Delicious sushi! We ordered the yellow tail delight, state street, and spicy yellowtail roll. The fish tasted fresh and The chef (who i think is the owner) suggested deep frying the spicy yellowtail. We took his suggestion and it was great! The customer service was wonderful from both the chefs and waiter. Would come back again.

I never like writing bad reviews. I instead typically check in but don't review restaurants that I don't like. But this time I am writing to save people from experiencing what I did. I generally eat salmon and albacore sushi and usually choose a bento box for lunches. I order the salmon and it looked overly frozen and strange. The albacore was a brick. It had tons of sinew and was rubbery. I showed the chef (who made it) and I sent the albacore back. He had a look on his face like "woops. She caught me." He knew he should not have served that awful piece of fish.

I ordered an iced tea and what appeared was passion fruit which i cant drink. So I sent that back and received the option to get green tea iced tea. I was thinking the type of tea that starbucks serves (clear and a light green, yellow color). What arrived was what I would describe as green mud. It smelled like rice and was green muddy, opaque and tasted like seaweed. Just awful. I ordered the bento box (#6) with vegetable and shrimp tempura and teriyaki salmon. The tempura was soggy and the vegetables were pretty raw. I was so grossed out. The salad was a mixed green with balsamic. Who eats balsamic at a Japanese restaurant? Skipped that. The teriyaki Salmon looked frozen but actually tasted good. The miso soup was awful. I usually love that soup and this had WAY too much miso base in it. And for this pleasure i paid $51

Will never come here again.

So many fun things to try!! We tried the Banh Mi, Chili & Beer Cheese, Jaleo and the kids hot dog! These BUNS! Oh my word! So good! Even the kids hot dog was good! Then, we also got a maple & bacon donut, peach filled donut and campfire cappuccino. The peach filled donut was amazing and I loved the house made marshmallows! 

A few things I didn't like was the kids meal was $9 and I definitely felt it was way overpriced for a plain hotdog and 10 fries. The maple bacon donut was good, but a really dry. We went at lunch time so it might have been fresher in the morning. 

Overall, we'd for sure come back- I want to try the hanging grilled cheese!!

Great authentic and high quality sushi, with some fun options as well! I ordered the salmon nigiri, Inari, and red dragon roll, and it was all very fresh and delicious! The tempura shrimp in the dragon roll was cooked very well, it wasn't chewy at all. Very tender and delicate (I'm very picky about shrimp lol). My partner ordered the sushi box and it had crab and tuna, the crab was very sweet! We also chose to sit at the bar, and had great conversations with the sushi chef. Matsu's a very entertaining and fun chef :) Highly recommend sitting at the bar if you're able to! It makes the experience more interactive, genuine, and enjoyable. Also the Mochi at the end was soo good!
They will say your food will be ready in 30 mins but expect it to take 1 hr and 15 mins. Once you get it it won't be right.
By far the best sushi in SB. Red dragon roll + albacore sushi is our go to order - so good!

I love Orangetheory!

The coaches are motivating and walk around the room giving correction for improving form in the weights area and rowing machines area. They also encourage the treadmills to keep paces and inclines at challenging levels. 

I have a little experience with weightlifting, but have never really pushed myself on cardio workouts. My nervousness at joining with such little experience was short-lived. The atmosphere is fun and the coaches are knowledgeable. It's definitely a challenging workout, but the results are worth the work.

Such a cute eclectic place. I went there with my lil fambam. My lil one got the chocolate croissant, the hubs got the cinnamon roll and I decided on the sticky bun. The pasties were very tasty! The owner was sweet and very nice. We will definitely be going back again.

Straight fire. Stopped here with a group of friends and baby daughter for lunch while caravaning to Georgia. We all got a mix of stuff but I had a chili dog that was super good and a pineapple cider that was amazing. Friends had a variety of donuts and hot dogs and we had a plate of fries for the table. Sat outside on the cute little patio and enjoyed. Everybody's donuts were looking so good I grabbed one to go and an iced coffee for the road. Staff was super friendly and I would definitely recommend coming here for lunch,brunch or anything really. Only suggestion I would have would be to put a changing table in their bathroom but we managed! Would come back again for sure.

I primarily get coffee here when I visit- it's better than Starbucks, but there are many coffee shops in this area and I would not say this is my favorite. 

The donuts are good. Definitely try some. 

I chose to rate today because it was a particularly memorable experience. As business begin to reopen I decided to get a coffee today & was disappointed that the staff were not wearing masks. This is a standard CDC precaution widely adopted by restaurants. There is no reason the staff shouldn't have masks. 

I ordered a cold brew with cream & was disappointed to see my cold brew topped with Great Value brand half and half. I expect better from a supposedly "fully organic" coffee bar that claims to serve high quality coffee.

Long wait for dinner but super fast service once seated. Everything I ate was melt in your mouth delicious. Even the mango ice tea was tea and not diluted water unlike in some restaurants. Overall a great experience.

The more comfortable I am with a city's geography, the more comfortable I am using its public transportation.  And so, on my first visit back to the Lou as a non-resident, I finally got on Metrolink.  

This thing goes everywhere important and at $7.50 for a day pass or $2.50 for a one-way trip, you can't beat the price vs. a rental car with a stick!

Sure, you might need connecting cabs here and there - but call Laclede Cab (314 652 3456) and tell them what Metrolink station you are at.  Now, I say "where you are at" because technically you're not supposed to call them until you are at the station.  But let my experience be your benefit: when you are two stations away from your stop, call and tell them that you are "already there" and "at the platform."  Then, when you step off the train a few minutes later, you'll only wait a few more minutes for the cab instead of 10-15. 

Easy and cheap way for locals and visitors to get around.  Oh, and clean too.

Wanted to try out this spot for awhile. It is right on State Street so the location is great. My husband and me both had the rainbow rolls and the crispy spicy tuna and we loved it. 
COVID SAFE? Yes. The staff are wearing masks and face shields. Tables cleaned and sanitized. Tables spaced out well. The main part of going out nowadays is making sure places are safe to go and this place was very clean.

I tried this place for the first time today. 
Upon entering and waiting for the "manager" to finish and the cashier to finally take my order mind you no one else was inside. I began to feel a bit uncomfortable due to the manager eyeballing me with an unfriendly stare. 

I ordered the hibachi chicken and shrimp. Protein was good amount however lacks flavor and everything was soaked in liquid presumably from veggies and no teriyaki sauce. The fried rice lacked flavor, no egg a few kernels of corn just bland. Ive had Chinese food taste better than this. 

This is definitely not any hibachi I ever had at either a take out restaurant or a an actual hibachi restaurant. Needless to say I  wont be back. Waste of money.

Had a great experience while visiting Nashville at this store. We had the best waiter. He was friendly fast and so much fun. I can't remember his name and I hate that.   Maybe Steve or Steven. He really made the experience that much better. The food was great and the wait time was minimal. The lady that checked us out was also very friendly and explained to me the stars on their aprons. Good food and good people!

I've done just about everything fitness wise from yoga to crossfit . Orangetheory has the best trainers that keep you pumped and going the whole time . Not to mention the most positive atmosphere I've ever been around . Everyone who works there is amazing and I would hire them for my own business because of how friendly and awesome they are . Thanks Orangetheory Casa Adobes !!!!!!!

This is a recent find for us. We are very pleased with everything that we have tried here. Love that you can upgrade combination platters beyond just pork fried rice as a side. Soups are better than the competition as are the hibachi combinations. Also when I stopped in to pickup I couldn't help noticing how clean the kitchen appeared to be. The place has been there for a while but looks as if it's brand new. It seems that there's an attention to detail here or just a desire to be the best on their part. Well we noticed and will continue to keep ordering at your place.

The Zuzu's burger is the best burger I've ever had. I was vegan for 4 yrs and slowly started reintroducing meat into my life and this burger's the only burger I genuinely enjoy eating. The truffle oil is stupid good. They're falafel is amazing and the owner is always soooooo kind. Just eat their food, you'll never regret it.

The drive through on this place could use a lot of work hence the 3 star review. Upon driving up you get to look at the menu but not order where one would normally. Instead we drive up and order at the window you'd normally just get food. This would be completely fine if they had a menu visible here but they don't. We got two cold brews, one black, and one with almond milk and a single shot of caramel. The drinks were great! We also wanted two chicken Swiss egg white sandwiches. We couldn't quite remember what they were called and did our best describing it (hence use for a menu). They ended up being out of one of the chicken Swiss croissant (which is what they thought we wanted). We got one of those and one spinach feta croissant. They were hot and okay overall but not what we originally intended/wanted. The staff was very nice as well through this process. Biggest complaint is fix the drive through so we can know what we're ordering!
Great donuts, awesome coffee. Gets pretty crazy crowded though, so locals might wanna check it out on a weekday and not a Saturday morning  totally recommend the dirty churro and the horchata Cubano

Just had a fabulous dinner at Sun Sushi! What a hidden gem this place is! Very high quality sashimi, delicious rolls and good service! The owner was preparing our dinner in front of us and he was great to talk to. Not super fancy, more kick back atmosphere that really was comfortable. Try this place. It is one of the top in SB.

Over all love this place!!! Can't wait to come back!! If your in Nashville you need to go here! It's a small place but they make the best of the space. There is outside sitting! The staff was super friendly and happy to answer all of our questions. Also checked on us a bunch to make sure we were enjoying everything. 

The chocolate donut was the donut of the day. It had dark chocolate chips and a ganache in. It was topped with a homemade mush mellow. Delicious!!!
Boss Hog was a maple and bacon flavor with the perfect amount of pecan brittle on it. Again pure deliciousness!! 
The tiramisu donut was amazing. Simple put just get it.. 
Sweet baby Jesus was also delicious.. The employee said it was a favorite and it didn't disappoint!! 
The lumber Jack has a twist to with having "Nashville" hot chicken on it with a little piece of waffle!!! This was probably my favorite!!! Go get it!!!!
The bad Santa was very unique. It had a vanilla chia glazed with a Rum Chatta pipette.. Was a good choice.  

The campfire cappuccino, was soo good! Not to sweet and the mush mellow was perfect to mix in. 

Just go to this place you won't regret it. If I had to say one thing that was a little bothersome, prices are a little high for donuts. BUT that being said lightly because this are amazing donuts!!!

Best blueberry muffins hands down.  I don't know how they do it, and nor do I care. My daughter decided long ago that when she wants a BB muffin and she's deserving of the best, it's PJ's all the way.  

I surprised her with her fav muffin when she was feeling under the weather and it really brightened her morning.  This PJ's has a friendly staff and their coffees and pastries are delicious.

Local Gentilly PJ's, black owned. Very friendly and efficient. This location saved me during the last hurricane when I was dying for my morning coffee and no one had power. However, they are located in the same shopping center as Rouse's, and power was already running 7 am  the morning after... I've had great coffee and service every time I've stopped in.

I cannot imagine worse customer service.

All I'm trying to do is change the address for an upcoming installation. Cannot do it only; waited on hold for 25 minutes; call was answered and promptly disconnected by their agent. 

I think I'll cancel the installation instead...  I'm not interested in dealing with this kind of service, ever.

I am a huge donut girl, and lets be honest- Nashville is extremely lacking in the donut department. I followed The Donut + Dog on Instagram and their donuts looks so good and amazing!! They looked so big and fluffy, and had a bunch of fun flavors. The even had these whiskey infused donuts that I needed to try.

Starting off, the decor/location is perfect!!! The little house is painted in bright colors, and the painted donut and hotdog walkway leading to the door is so stinkin cute!! Parking was also not a pain, which is always a perk.

My fiance and I ordered 2 hotdogs with fries, and a donut to split. Mainly bc there was sadly only like 3 donut choices (no whiskey infused one) and at 4.50 each, im not going to spend that much on a flavor I dont really want. 
After we both said we wanted fries as our side, The guy at the register told us we need to try the truffle fries (ok, sure) but didn't tell us its like a $2 up-charge each. They were really good, and Im not against paying extra- but I like transparency or it rubs me the wrong way. 

The hotdogs were good but kind of expensive for what it was. I guess I would go back if Im ever craving a hotdog? However, i was most bummed bc the donut was such a let down :( 
For almost $5, we got this little nugget of a donut that was 1 bite each once we split it, and it was just okay... it did not deliver as much as I felt it would from their instagram pictures.

In the end, we paid over $30 for the 2 of us, left not completely full, and stopped at Krispy Kreme down the road. Sorry Donut + Dog, it was a miss for me :(

Updating review to 1 star for lack of customer service with petty response, as included in additional photo. Apologies on missing the notice of selling out in the business description - it can be easy to miss if your yelp approach is mostly looking at other Yelpers' reviews or photos. If doughnuts are your specialty, and you've been experiencing a burst in traffic after being featured in a popular video, as noted by your staff upon our visit, increasing production is what most others would expect. Understand taking pride in your quality, but don't think responses like that are warranted for one review that isn't going to ruin you

Saw this place on buzzfeed and was extremely excited to see what the hype was all about! Total disappointment that they ran out of doughnuts on our visit. Still tried one of their dogs and it was good, but nothing phenomenal. Would also recommend adding heaters or something similar to the patio to accommodate for cold weather! Saw this place on buzzfeed and was extremely excited to see what the hype was all about! Total disappointment that they ran out of doughnuts on our visit. Still tried one of their dogs and it was good, but nothing phenomenal. Would also recommend adding heaters or something similar to the patio to accommodate for cold weather!
Not appealing from street but food was good. Loved the tuna sashimi and Mexican roll. The fried jalapeños were bomb!

Love Orangetheory but this location is awful. Highly recommend signing up with the Foothills location instead. 

I called and left several messages with the studio over the course of over a month trying to cancel my membership as I had a newborn at home, was recovering  and with COVID was not comfortable going out. 
I never received a call back which in itself is extremely frustrating. After I was finally able to get through and speak to someone, I was told there was nothing that could be done for the month I was charged because I didn't cancel in time. It's really hard to cancel when you can't speak to someone. 
A similar thing happened to my sister at the other location in Tucson and they were more than accommodating in refunding her, which she is actually now resigned up with. Apparently from what the person I spoke with at this location (Casas Adobes studio)  is that they are corporate owned so they have no control over the policies?   

Anyways long story short Orangetheory is amazing but sign up with a different location.
Food was amazing. The chicken fried rice was so tasty, I've ordered from this spot on a few occasions! Great addition to the town!

This place is awesome! By far the best hot dog I've ever eaten.

I got the Elote Loco, a crispy chorizo "hot dog"/sausage with corn and cotija cheese on top. The chips on the side were perfectly crispy and homemade. 

I got a donut to go - the OG glazed which had a hint of vanilla, cinnamon, and spice. The flavors change out seasonally and some sell out fast! It was amazing. That perfect, glazed, melt-in-your-mouth donut!

Not only was the food delicious, the staff was exceptional. Friendly and helpful, they made it feel like home. I'm happy they are expanding, the world deserves to have more Donut + Dog! Definitely check this place out while you're in Nashville!

Do not use CenturyLink anywhere past the Tucson mountains. It sucks! See my attached pic.  They promise 10 mbps and you get way less than that using the hard line which we got an average of 2-6.  Now the WiFi gets worse which you can see the pic.  I even compared it to my In laws house which is right up the street on 15mbps with Comcast.  It's has been like this non speed for the last 6 months we had them.  It's not good at all and I would recommend paying the extra money for Comcast and the arguing with them over rates every year over non working internet service, because at least I would be arguing over costs while watching my streamed shows.

This is such a good place! Brown butter latte was really really good, and the donuts were yummy and interesting flavors! By the time we got there, all donuts were out except for pre-made Valentine's Day bouquets, so we got one of those! Place was packed which is a good sign. We will be coming here again in the future to try out more of their unique flavors :)
best sushi ever! my favorite restaurant in santa barbara!! highly recommend the agedashi tofu :)

I just joined Orangetheory about a week ago. I am in love! This particular gym is clean and well maintained. I was nervous on my first day of working out, but a friendly staff member went through all of the paperwork with me and toured me around the studio. 

Orangetheory is different than any other gym that I've been to. OT coaches are always there to correct form for all group members. Workouts take place in a group setting, but the emphasis is to focus on YOUR own individual workout. 

The music that blasts in the studio is a mix classic rock/EDM/pop. Great energy in the studio. This is a great facility to get a killer workout in, but it's also awesome for my mental health! Thanks OTF!

Guys.. This is by far the best sushi I have ever had in Santa Barbara!! I will not go anywhere else for sushi!
Sun Sushi is a tiny spot that you almost wouldn't notice because it's in the corner of a small shopping center.. parking lot can be quite annoying because there are very limited  spaces, but I don't care, I will wait forever just to eat here. I come here a few times a month and I'm never disappointed. Service is amazing  and the sushi is SO FRESH! 
Its a little pricey, not too much more than Kyoto (which is down road )but the food at Sun Sushi is definitely higher quality.
I took 9 of my pickiest family members who always have something negative to say and ALL of them were happy! 
I couldn't believe it!

DONT  SLEEP  ON  THIS  PLACE  

I always go for the state street roll! See pics!

We ordered from Zuzus during coronavirus after a friend recommended It to us. They definitely had plenty of orders coming in and were swamped that night but continued to provide AMAZING customer service. We called to get an update and they were always honest. The food was delicious and for a local spot we will always continue to support them. They are wonderful

Trying to live a healthy lifestyle in the paula deen driven culinary world of BUTTAH, Mayo, and other fancy condiments i extremely hard!

I thought a 3 day cleanse would be a great way  to give my insides a much needed break,
The process of ordering is Super easy and the staff is very friendly and efficient . Emails were responded to super fast , I asked several questions regarding pickup, types of drinks, foods etc. 
For customer Service this business gets 5 stars.
The review over all is a 3 star unfortunately . 

The juices all tasted the same with the exception of (Juice #2 agave , lemon and cayenne pepper) and (Juice #6 the cashew, agave, cinnamon dessert drink)
I went into this knowing that these wouldn't be very flavorful but they all tasted like cucumber and celery and BLAH BLAH BLAH BLAH ...
I really tried to follow through with this but after the 4th drink and the same BLAH flavor i gave up and just drank water for the rest of the day.
I guess i was more annoyed than anything else bc the reviews on the website are all stellar. People talk about how much they love the drinks i guess my palate isn't very sophisticated.

Id like for my taste buds to be burned off it took forever for the BLAH taste to go away. After giving up i thought about whether id post a review for the price (180.00) i thought is necessary to warn people . I did get my juice from a deal so i only paid 90.00 so i don't feel too bad about the money spent and i REALLY tried 
 I wanted to like ALL the juices but i just didn't maybe you will have a different 
experience.

Century link is the worst company I have ever signed up with. I moved into my own apt in 2014 and was interested in the pricing Centurylink was offering at that time. When we had a technician come and install our cable and internet he said our apt was facing in the opposite direction to recieve a signal. As dissapointing as that was, I was not upset. I am a very understanding person who believes sometimes things just are not ment to be. I immediatley contatced the 1-800 number to cancel the account and returned all equipment I ever received. A few weeks later I received a bill of $70. When I contacted customer service to have the situation resolved, all I got was the run around. No one could find my account (because I had closed it). I was constantly transfered to every department and no one had answers for me. Representatives would have me on hold for long periods of time. Basically the situation was never resolved. I am now in collections and my credit score has been negatively affected. Centurylink was unable to resolve a problem that was not my fault what so ever. I would never recommend a comapany who cannot properly resolve issues. I do recommend comcast as a service provider. Anytime I have had an issue comcast was always able to quickly resolve my problems.

How much time do we spend trying to contact & problem solve with " customer service " reps? I called Century link 6 times (45$ for life no contract I've had over 5 years) my streaming was difficult ,speed slowed down , slower than ever. Thanks for answering! I'm 
told I need to buy or lease another modem for a 100$ , I refused , then transferred to loyalty Dept in Guatemala City .
Seemingly competent rep  tries to  upsell  me the faster service , mine was fine for 5 years ? Then I need to buy  new modem 100$ I refused so they made concessions . Called back to confirm the changes and no extra charges , off shore agent drops my call?? No call back ? 
This new modem and up selling similar to new programs on the iPhone that slow it down so you need to buy the newer model? 
So much for one price for life? I'm a " global " person but it's hard to understand ?
Sometimes I feel like I'm playing a " shell game" in the street , you think you resolve issue , your bill comes and it's not what you agreed to? That's why I called back , but call was dropped  by agent.
Corporations like politics are infected with greed, ego & power?
Update sixth call maria in loyalty Dept in Boise Idaho solves & clarified issues said the agents off shore probably didn't know how to read coded information ( or would not take time to decider coded info) , thank you maria in Boise! 
This is a grueling process customer service" please try to keep it on shore in the country your serving for clarity & keep jobs local?
Wonderful staff and incredible donuts! Highly recommend to any donut lover in the Nash area. Online ordering available. Highly recommend  Southern Belle and Pillow Talk

Just keeping the public updated. My SIXTH order was suppose to be installed today, 12/12. Guess what, 5:00pm, no centurylink. Still no wifi. A month into my first order, still haven't got it. Required to work from home. Get ahold of someone today, now they say my install date is 2/8/21! From my first order on November 24, I have been canceled 6 times and now told I'm 2 months out. Worst company is the history of business. Use your cell phone hot spot before getting centurylink. Trash company

Decided to order delivery from Zuzu's because I wanted to support other restaurants during quarantine other than my usual go-tos, and their menu had a lot of different options. Not only did they deliver super quick, but the food was so good! We ordered the chicken tacos, boneless wings, lamb kefta wrap, and beef cheesesteak. The stars to me were the tacos and lamb wrap - the chicken was seasoned so well and the boom boom sauce added just enough heat. The lamb wrap was simple, but packed a lot of flavor and spice, it was very satisfying. Will definitively be ordering again!

This was an unexpected treat.  This pizza shop is a rare gem here in North Philly.  The quality of food mixed with ambiance makes it a place I'll glad come back to again again.  I recommend it to any and everyone looking for great food and great times.  Can't wait to try the entire menu. 

Great staff,  friendly and personable.  They make you feel like family.

Seriously the best place around. So good and great quality. I have never had a bad meal
from them. Would absolutely recommend!

Fan, but $15 (food+drink+tax) for a large healthy lunch in a sparse partial self-service warehouse workaurant keeps away that extra star.  This is an order @ the counter, take a number & cup for drink then go find a seat to wait food type place.  Employees are very friendly & helpful, but by design this is not true table service.

Food is great.  Whole salads & sandwiches fill me & doesn't make me nap afterwards. (Also offer pick 2 halves or soup... plus just halves (about $7) for lighters eater)

$2.50 drinks are free refill of both tea & the newer Coke machine with all the mixed drink selections.

The warehouse setting has a clean modern feel, but no sound absorption.   The crowd has been subdued when I have been there (weekends) with a few excited babies & toddlers.

This is a really neat place. We found it here in Yelp and it did not disappoint!  Real live working bakery action is available for watching while you eat your sandwiches, salad, and soup through the floor to ceiling windows separating the restaurant from the bakery. I highly recommend the tough love salad. So light and delicious and yet filling!

So, i do like the coffee here...not love, but like. It's convenient to my mom's house in New Orleans and the hours typically fit our needs. On this particular visit on 12/31/18, we stopped on our way out of town to get some coffee for the road and some flavored for work. We were served quickly but it seemed there was some confusion as to who was going to do what. One made the road drinks and one went to the back to grind the flavored coffee. She asked what grind to use and I told her that i wanted it a little finer than normal drip grind. This seemed to utterly confuse her and she made it sound as if there were only 3 settings: Turkish, drip and coarse. Finally, i asked her to just make it for drip and she proceeded to do it. When she came back, she got took our pastry order. She also went to the back to get the pastries and told us to just microwave them all for 45 seconds each.
