We microwaved them in the store and got on the road. As we unpacked our food we found that our food order was wrong. My coffee had about twice as much syrup as it needed and it was luke warm. My son and husband were satisfied with their drinks, but I was disappointed in the service and drink. The bag was even taped shut with the wire closure stuck sideways on the bag. It was a lot of small things, but added up to a sloppy encounter.

Dave (the manager) hooked me up today. I dropped my car off to get the splash pan reattached as it almost fell off from hitting a pothole. I went to pick up the car once he called to tell me it was done and he did it free of charge.

For just $2.50 you can take the light rail between the airport and downtown.  There's no possible way you can beat that price in an Uber/Lyft or a taxi.  

I took the Metro several times on my recent trip, the trains were clean, and I never felt unsafe.  With the exception of one guy telling a sob story and begging for money for bus fare to Texas, the passengers were all quiet and well-mannered.  Try finding that in NYC, DC, or Chicago.

Arguably a lunch hour favorite of mine, with never once a disappointing experience.

Interiors - bustling and moderate to loud setting for lunch. This place has been packed for lunch, every single time I've visited. The viewing windows into the bread process is fun and interesting. I'm a real fan of Companion's breads and pastries; they really are done well.

Online ordering - is a real deal and super efficient. More times than not, I'm utilizing the online ordering. Their online ordering platform is clean and simple to use. Upon pickup at the cafe, my orders have never been mistaken or resulted in any errors.

Favorite breakfast: New Yawker - Icelandic salmon, cream cheese, capers, sesame bagel. 

Favorite sandwich: Frenchie - turkey, Brie, sprouts, honey Dijon mustard, Parisien bread.

Favorite pastry: Bread Pudding - it's amazing, need I really say more?

If i could give a zero I would. 

This is the worst company in an industry I have ever dealt with. I ordered service on 11/24, its now 12/7 and i haven't even got a technician to my apt yet. And centurylink is the only provider allowed in this complex.

First install date 11/30, i get called at 8:15am they ordered the wrong product  and would hear back. Only to find out the technicians cancelled my order. 

Then i reorder and get told new install date is 12/7. Guess what, get a call at 8:15 they ordered the wrong product and can't do install. In a pandemic, when everyone is working from home. 

Went through customer service after the 1st mistake and was getting comped for the install fee.

After the second install mistake i was told they wont honor that compensation and I was now going to pay full price. And then after an hour with customer service in getting another new order I'm told to now call this number to get my old account reactivated and when i called its a 90 minute wait. 

I hope they go out of business, i'd rather use earthlink dial up again than ever have to deal with centurylink. Absolute garbage company with absolute garbage products and services. Get out of the business

If I could zero stars, I would. I took my car in because it needed oil. It started fine and drove fine on the way to the shop. I left the car to go to work and received a call of the diagnosis from a mechanic saying my car wouldn't start and they had to jump start the car. Of course the list of repairs were extensive. They did something to the car. I asked to review the video of them jump started the car and there is none. They're scam artists. This practice is common place. Do not use this business

This review is for the Metrolink train system only.

Coming up on its 20th birthday, Metrolink provides a clean, safe, inexpensive and efficient way to travel around metropolitan St. Louis.  During a recent visit to the city, I took six lengthy trips on Metrolink and was impressed.  The Red Line to Lambert St. Louis International Airport was particularly handy.  $2.25 to travel all of the way to Lambert?  A virtual steal. 

Two thumbs up for Metrolink!
First time trying a new place. Excellent service and very delicious food! The Best Chinese we've had in a long while.

This was our first visit here and we loved it.  The hot dogs are amazing and so are the fries! The donuts are sooooo good!!! Also, the place is really cute with a great vibe and the staff are extremely helpful and friendly. Awesome find, will definitely be returning!!!

Layered, airy, crisp, but soft brioche donuts! Unique flavors. It's hard to find brioche donuts, let alone good brioche donuts. We drove over three hours for this, and definitely they didn't disappoint! Cute cafe style place has a charm. Daniel was very nice and helpful too!

Favorite sushi spot in Santa Barbara County. Everyone there is so nice, and the fish quality + pricing is exceptional. Salmon and Tuna 6 step will show you just how good this place really is. Great sake selections as well.

What a great concept and delicious food!! I ordered the elote loco dog + ultimate s'more, and would definitely do it again. The dog was cooked well and the other flavors of "Mexican street corn" were incorporated so well with it. I loved that they used a large piece of toast for the bun rather than a hotdog bun. It gave it a crunchy rather than soft texture. Also got loco fries on the side, which complemented my dish well but would also be great with any other hotdog. The donut was amazing! Just the hit of a chocolate sugar rush I was hoping for. The staff were so friendly and really interested in feedback. The cafe has both indoor and outdoor seating! I loved the decor and atmosphere.

I was looking on yelp for a sushi place because I am new to this area and Sun Sushi had so many great reviews so I thought I needed to try it out. When looking at it from the outside it doesn't look like anything special but trust me, the sushi is amazing! I came here with my brother, who is a very picky eater and he said that their beef teriyaki dinner was the best he's ever had. I highly recommend the caterpillar role - the eel was delicious. This place is definitely a must when in SB!
Walked in to a dead Cracker Barrel  and  ordered food to go. 45 min later I get my food. No one cared or did anything.  No one was here. Really bad. Will not be back. Don't even care about food.

I came in for dinner, because I really wanted donuts. Unfortunately, they had run out of donuts :(((. I was super sad, but the worker guy was really friendly. He offered me a hotdog instead and I said ok. He recommended the elote loco and I said ok. It was delicious! The chorizo hot dog was pretty salty but it balanced fairly well with the rest of the ingredients. The fries were the best I've had in a while! Super super crispy with some sort of paprika seasoning. 

It's a cute small place with about a dozen tables inside and out. The guy offered me a water cup without asking. They have beer and make some other drinks. 

Really the only star off is because they have donuts in their name, but ran out of donuts (they were also out of burgers). I hope I can add the star when I get to eat their donuts!

Yelped the best sushi restaurant in Santa Barbara and this place came on top with nearly 200+ five stars reviews. OMG! I can't believe it! I should have read more reviews or checked the photos in details. 

For the mediocre quality and taste, the food here is absolutely overpriced. The bill for 2 person with tips was $100+ for 6 pieces of sushi, two small appetizers, 2 sushi rolls. 

In summary, we paid $$$ for dining at a decent/good sushi restaurant but the experience felt like getting street food for a food truck.

The Japanese fried chicken was plain and dry, with no dipping sauce. And some of the pieces were overcooked. 

Ordered toro and blue fin tuna. When the waiter served the dish, he said: this is toro, this is blue fin tuna. THEY ARE DIFFERENT. He emphasized. First of all, the pieces looked identical (the color and texture of the fish). And they tasted the same too. All were badly cut, I don't understand why it had small cuts on the fish?! 

The Uni sushi had some weird taste. 

The tuna roll and special tuna roll were similar as what you can get in Whole Foods. Perhaps more reasonable priced as compared to the other dishes. 

The service was mediocre.. I really did not appreciate the waiter always in a rush and "throwing" the dishes on your table. 

I'm traveling to Santa Barbara. I felt bad for folks that gave their 5 starts reviews for this restaurant. If this is the best sushi restaurant in SB, you guys have never had good sushi before.

I seriously love this place! I was never really into fitness before joining and now I can't get enough. The workouts are always different and the coaches really work with you if you need modifications. When I go, I feel like I am visiting with my friends, clients and staff. I particularly appreciate the friendliness of Sales Associate Lindsey. She has been so helpful recently and is always so friendly!! 
Shout out to all the coaches too; Callie, Skog, Stacey, Ashley, Alex, Mark, Rene (I hope I didn't miss anyone)

Came here on a Sunday night. It's a nondescript location but we stepped in and it's was legit Japanese: servers, sushi chefs, sake bar, bamboo decor. Food was spot on. The volcano roll was fantastic (came with siracha mayo) and the spicy scallop hand roll melts in your mouth. The vegetable udon was spot on. And you know it's a legit place when the wasabi is coarse instead of the usual paste. I would definitely come back. The service was also great. Folks are attentive here. Bravo!!

Okay, so here is my timeless review. My wife and I were out for a pre-Father's Day dinner and it was my choice...yay. I had heard about this place on TV and thought I would try it. Half we did. First of all if it has both Donuts and Dogs in the name you have to do both. It's a requirement, punishable by ridicule (at least in my opinion). The Dirty OG is an amazing donut. Think cinnamon roll has an illegitimate baby with a Krispy Kreme. 
Then you get to the dogs and I really enjoyed the BAT. I'm not telling you what it means, you just need to go. All-in-all, I'll be back. The staff is awesome too. Great concept and if you don't enjoy it, something is wrong with your soul.....nothing the Sweet Baby Jesus donut couldn't help with.

As a bakery they are excellent.  As an egg maker - they fail miserably. 

I ordered one of their egg sandwiches on a bagel.  I asked for the bagel to be toasted.

I got some strange, nasty egg casserole on a bagel that was not toasted.  I would give this 1 star.

I did try a slice of their gooey butter cake and it was spectacular.  I would give it 5 stars.

Best sushi in Santa Barbara. I know you'd probably expect it at Ahi or Sakana, but the quality of the fish is honestly some of the best I've ever had and I'm super picky when it comes to finding good quality fish. The Salmon 6 step is insanely good and everything I've ever had from here has been delicious!

I am new to the area and needed to find an oral surgeon, found this place on the web and decided to try it out. I have a wisdom tooth that needed to be pulled so I made an appointment and since I didn't have any dental insurance, I was told that I would be charged $50 if I brought in my own X-rays. when I got to this place, I gave the doctor my X-rays and she saw that my tooth was horizontal and she could not do the procedure, because it was too difficult for her. She spent not even 5 mins with me. when I got to the front desk, I was told I needed to pay $57, which was ridiculous when first of, I was told $50 over the phone and plus she's gonna charge for something she couldn't even do?!?! I felt like I got robbed, how can they charge you a visit fee if she was just gonna tell me she couldn't help me?! I will never recommend this place, they are a rip off! now I have to find someone else and be charged again!
Awesome food, super fresh sushi, great service, exciting new beers.

Morning, noon, or night, D+D is great for a bite! Cute country cottage location, sweet and savory menu options, friendly staff. As the name implies, you can get donuts or hot dogs here, and I had to try them both.

DONUT: They're a unique brioche style donut with a 15 hour preparation time. Don't worry if you don't come by in the morning, they also make a fresh batch in the afternoon around 5 or 6 and you can reserve specific donuts in advance through their social media. The Sweet Baby Jesus, with creme brulee crust and raspberry-cayenne filling, was such a treat! I'm not much of a donut fan, this was my mom's pick, and it was such a unique find.

DOG: Opted for the Chili Queso dog, which was tasty. Upon ordering this item, we were assured all items are organic when available and the queso and chili are both made in house and buns are baked daily. The dog itself was well-sized and easily shared, and the queso was my favorite part. Dogs come with a side, highly suggest upgrading to truffle fries for +$2, they were crispy and delightful. They also offer an elote side, which we added on, and that was just okay. 

Service was friendly, food was tasty, and the shop itself is super cute. Utilize the outdoor seating if the weather is nice, check IG for daily donut/dog specials!

The best Italian Restaurant around town.  Homemade Italian food and pastries including fig cookies (which are extremely hard to find).  Always a friendly staff and the owner really cares what you think.  Will make food to order if asked.  Love this place!

I'd give a -5 star if I could. Please read the warnings yelpers give you beforehand because it will save you money. Do not go to this dentist office because they are the most unprofessional and obnoxiously rude every time they "greet" you or schedule an appointment. They do not care about their patients and will make you wait several weeks for a "SCHEDULED" appointment and sometimes, they FORGET that they scheduled said appointment. How does that work? They scream at you if you're late by just even 5-15 minutes like it is really unnecessary drama that you don't need in your life. Once again, do not come to this location EVER!

Very good pastries and their ham and cheese croissant was amazing. It has a country cottage charm. It's like a bed and breakfast without the bed. They make everything from scratch, and it shows. The couple who run the shop are very hospitable and fun to talk to.

Zuzu's has the convenience and affordability factors going for them but not necessarily fantastic quality. It took me a while to find something really delicious here but now that my I've found it will probably continue to order the same thing. Their steak boom boom pizza is amazing. They also have good Buffalo chicken pizza. Wraps are okay, mozzarella sticks are also just okay. They are super quick which is nice.

I visited last Sunday for an early holiday family gathering. 

There was hair in my meatloaf. I nearly vomited. When I complained, the manager grabbed my plate (without asking me what I wanted) and returned with more hairy meatloaf. I told him I didn't want hairy meatloaf and neither did the rest of my family. 

They did nothing for the other meatloaf entrees. 

I have contacted customer service twice and received no response. 

Not only do they not follow basic health standards, they don't care at all about customers.

Fries were hot...made fresh

Service was friendly.

Not much more I can say about an airport restaurant where no one before or after me sad thank you to the cashier.

My friends and I ordered takeout from here and I got the Sun Roll. This roll was reallyyy good and flavorful! I love cream cheese and avos in my rolls, so this was the perfect roll for me. I definitely will check this place out again to try out other rolls!

Had been going for 10 yrs, always preferred going to Swancy, compared to auto car washers because they usually scratch your finish from their roller brushes filled with debris from previous dirty vehicles. Although it's old fashioned and no frills, Swancy usually did good service, until recently, 1st, its not the
 easiest place to enter since its on a one way street corner, 2nd, many times before on  sunny days it has been closed with no signage and no voice messages
 I guess I tolerated the unprofessional ism because it's an inexpensive price. But 3rdly, just last week, I went in and asked for a basis wash, no wax, just exterior and vacuuming the inside. First thing, I noticed was the arguing among the manager and the workers, who asked the non working workers to stop sleeping on the folding chairs and work, I thought about leaving then, but they had already started watering the outside of my car. They washed the outside and opened the doors to vacuum the insides. Only 2 workers was cleaning my car. After, they finished, I paid my fee. Thanked them and was on my way.
When I stopped at the store, I parked and reached for my visor for my handicapped placard... and it was gone! Couldn't go back because it was Saturday after 6pm and Monday was the holiday, went back Tuesday morning, asked for the manager, who was in her car outside of the car wash, explained that my placard was apparently stolen and she immediate ly became angry, sprewing, that it's an 41 yr old business, and she trusted her workers and never, ever did she have such a incident. I responded, two of the workers who washed my car that Saturday, wasnt there today, and how could she be so sure. Never, did she asked the crew that was there if they knew anything. Then, she said, "You must've of forgotten where you put it and misplaced it"
Never did she say I apologize or I'm sorry for what happened,  I explained to her, No, I, didn't and have had that placard for 3yrs. Then she said, "There's nothing I can do, why dont you leave?"  I responded angrily,
i've been going here for over 10yrs, and how pathetic is it, that you run a business that stoops this low! A handicapped card! I told her, "You lost me as a customer and at least 10 or more of my friends, I won't be back" I probably told everyone I know!  I don't recommend this place and I'm sure it will be closing very soon.
All I can say is continue to go at your own risk!
Great food!! Management really good!! Fixes problems if any really fast. Newly remodeled.

Stopped on the recommendation of my friend Mike, who highly recommended it.  Had the cinnamon roll, big enough to share.  I loved it, so did my family.  Think I dealt with Kay, who was friendly and delightful.  I'll be back, want to try Mike's favorite - ham and cheese croissant. 
Brett
The food is very good, there is a clean environment, and the delivery was fast in 15 minutes when they said about 30 - 40 minutes

Y'all go here!! Even if it is just for the kindest service! The man working the counter was the sweetest, most polite employee I think I've ever encountered. 

Other then the service being fantastic the food was phenomenal as well. I wanted picky food as I was craving fries all day so of course I ordered them BUT let me tell you about the fried wontons I had ! I could probably eat them for every meal! GO HERE!!

This place hasn't been around long, but it's instantly become one of my Nashville favorites! The Donut + Dog does a lot of different things, and it does them all exceptionally well. 

For one, their hot dogs are super creative and delicious. For instance, you've probably never imagined a hot dog with Mexican street corn or bahn mi toppings on it before, but the Donut + Dog has both, and they are amazing. At lunch, you can get a dog, side, and drink for ~$10ish, which is an absolute STEAL. I especially recommend the fries, which are incredibly crisp and well-seasoned.

The donuts are fantastic too. They're amazingly rich, and just as inventive as the hot dogs. Our favorite is the Sweet Baby Jesus (i.e., creme brulee) but really, it's all good. We even had one on our most recent visit that had a raspberry-cayenne filling, which speaks to how creative the flavors are here. They also seem to rotate offerings quite a bit, so you'll have a different experience each time.

Finally, there's the coffee. The campfire latte, smoked caramel latte, and horchata cubano are all delicious. Even if they didn't do donuts and hot dogs here, the coffee would be good enough to be the main draw. It's that good.

It's a small place with a pleasant "homey" vibe. The staff are incredibly friendly, too, and happy to take the time to explain the menu or answer questions. I'd recommend it for a quick lunch, or even just to bring a laptop or book and work/study for a little while.

A final pro-tip: there are a few parking spots behind the restaurant. If you street park, though, feed the meter to be safe. In the past, you could've gotten away without it, but I've started seeing more cars get parking tickets around this area recently.

Cute place, great customer service, and delicious, inventive food! It is a bit pricey, but I feel it was worth it! 

We tried the seasonal pumpkin spice donut which had a flavorful pumpkin puree filling of some sort. It wasn't too sweet and tasted like real pumpkin - no artifical flavors here. I liked that it wasn't overloaded with filling!

We also had the hot chicken donut sandwich which was amazing! The spice/heat level was perfect and the slaw complemented the chicken very well. You don't even think twice about donut buns being a little unusual. 

We rounded out the meal with a matcha latte (with oat milk, yum!) and the nitro cold brew. Both were great! I'd love to go back and try the browned butter latte and the hot dogs, of course!

These guys are awful, I hope you know plumbing. Tried to charge me $5500 for a water heater replacement. I feel so sorry for anyone they take for a ride. Call a reputable plumber before you pay top dollar for this company.

Came here after a meeting in the area. Was hoping for breakfast but they had dumped it already (a minute shy of their 11am switchover) all good. I like to clean as I go too. 
In a panic I opted for a Greek salad (very good) with a side of cornbread (amazing!!) and sampled a side of peach pie (also amazing!)

Cool view of people baking in the bakery. Not overly appetizing but interesting. Giant patio space outside too. 

I want to come back for breakfast!

Kind a hole in the wall but we were excited to find a place that wasn't all frills when it came to sushi, cute locale. We were seated quickly and the place was full of people and we still got great service. I was pleasantly surprised by the sushi being pretty yummy, we'll definitely come again.
Companion is delicious. Which ever salad and/or sandwich combination is always really good. It's healthy and I always leave feeling full and happy.

Took a very expensive day off of work because my installation time is 7 am to 5 pm. I haven't heard all day from them so I call, wait 30 minutes to get a hold of someone and they called the technician who says he will be by at 6 PM!! Absolute BS. I have company in town from CA and have plans tonight and traveling out of town next week.

Thomas just finished helping us build our 12x9.5 greenhouse roof and he did an awesome job! My husband and I tackled the 4 walls but when it came to cutting angles for the roof, we felt too intimidated and we didn't want to screw it up and risk wasting materials so we put an ad for some help & Thomas came to the rescue! He built the framing for it one day by himself & then we painted it within a couple days. After painting, my plastic material arrived and he came back to help us install it. He basically took charge and handled it like a boss. It was a huge relief to find someone that is a) knowledgeable, b) affordable, c) reliable and d) genuinely kind. I had many responses to my ad and I got more than a few quotes. Thomas came in mid-range but we felt most comfortable with him (call it a vibe) & the quality of the work is really great. I love my new greenhouse roof! He's coming back to help get our door frames made for it when we get to that phase. I've asked for his help on a few other projects we have here at home too. There's always little things that come up that we just can't do ourselves so having a great handyman you can call is a wonderful thing! Thanks so much, Thomas!

If your craving a californi roll this the place for that, but I ordered crispy rice appetizer, the crunch roll and the volcano roll and I'm sorry to say this but I think I'm going to be sick  SB is not a good place to eat sushi. I'm from LA so I'm comparing restaurants that are out there and this was just not it. Plus sushi is mad expensive

Service is very slow, the first time I experienced slow service at this location, I dismissed it because Cracker Barrel's in general are wonderful. 

Today is the second time we've experienced bad service. Food has taken (on a Friday morning at 11) literally 30 minutes and our server blamed the kitchen having "training". 

Several tables seated after our four top were served their food before us.

This place is awesome! The portions are huge and the food was delicious. The menu was huge there was so much to chose from. I got shrimp lo mein and my girlfriend got seafood mei fun and both came with a ton of meat in our dishes. We also got crab rangoons which were very good and edamame, which would have been perfect if they came already salted (but many places don't do that so I don't mind). The delivery time was a little longer than I would have liked but the restaurant is a little far and the food was still hot when it came so it was worth the wait. Definitely our new go-to Chinese spot!!

I've had centurylink for a long time now and the customer service is almost non existent. It's a slow connection all the time and multiple outages a week. This week it's been daily outages. Definitely cancelling my service and would NOT recommend this company to ANYONE.

Was on my way out of Philly and had to grab a Philly Cheesesteak before returning to NY! Found this small kitchen spot right before closing time and ordered myself a beef Philly cheesesteak with everything on it - lettuce, tomato, olives, green and red peppers, grilled onions, mayo and ketchup, salt and pepper on a warm toasted white hoagie/sub (depends on what you call it from where you're from ). 

The staff was also super friendly and lively when I had came in. Definitely made me feel welcome from the get go. When I come back to Philly I'll definitely come check this spot out again!

I am amending my rating of CenturyLink on account of them sending someone to get me connected to the internet. I believe they did their due diligence to rectify this issue. Thank you CenturyLink, I can now continue with my education.

My home internet bill has been 36.49$ w tax yesterday bill came it jumped to 68.99$ w tax !!!! Do the math it went up 32.56$ what's that 90 % it increased closed to former cost of monthly internet without tax! 
FYI my internet went down 3 times in last two months . I call  they say will return by 11 pm , never returns until the next working work time when their repair guys show up? Beware!!!

We picked up Sun Sushi tonight to have an end of the week treat. Currently, it's take out only and you can order online conveniently. Ordering was easy, and they texted when the order was ready, which was actually on the lower end of the 35-45 minute estimate. When I walked inside, my food was ready and I paid and left. The food was well packaged, fish was fresh, and everything was delicious.

One thing to keep in mind is their ordering process is awkward and is setup in a way that can trick people into double tipping. When you place your order, it asks for a tip (typical) but the default payment method is to pay in person. When you get there and they run your card, 20% of the receipt is a section for gratuity. So if you are not sure that you previously added a tip line from home, or your spouse picks up the order, there's a good chance Sun is getting a percentage tip on top of your total + tip from earlier. Not a big deal but something to keep in mind.

We took our Goldendoodle to Hilltop Pet Resort for over two years (before we moved) and I think she started to enjoy it more than being at home!  The staff is very friendly and takes excellent care of all the animals at the resort.  They pay special attention to all of the needs of your dog so you can rest easy while you're away.  They are also extremely good about answering the phone or returning your call quickly if you want to check-up on your dog while you are away.  I would HIGHLY recommend Hilltop Pet Resort to everyone and anyone looking for a reliable place their dog can stay while they are away, knowing 110% that their dog will be safe.

Just as a disclaimer, my dog would take her toys out in to the "play area" and not bring them back in to her room.  While the staff tries to keep up with what belongs to who, I'm sure it gets very difficult.  I say this because if your dog has an absolute favorite toy, I would leave it at home as there is a chance it could get lost and/or go home with another dog! :)

Came here with high hopes and hoping to really enjoy this place on a Wednesday night. Sadly we were very underwhelmed by the food. We got: tempura, spicy Dragon, tiger, and spider rolls. They were just very mediocre.
The service was great - quick seating and attentive service from our waiter. 
No bonus points for vibes or views, either.

I've had my fair share of bad sushi (I mean this is Santa Barbara to be fair) so a highly rated sushi spot in Goleta made me riled up. But for a place with a close to 5-star rating, I was surprised at how little this establishment had to offer. 

A friend and I had the rainbow roll and tempura lobster roll. Rainbow roll: fish did not taste that fresh, quality was lacking. Tempura lobser roll: tempura batter tasted stale, lobster was rubbery. Both rolls lacked much flavor and were super plain. This would have warranted it just a 3-star rating but I have to dock one more star for the serving size. For the price, the servings here are TINY. Don't expect to be full after one roll when each roll here is cut into 6 measly little pieces. 

Honestly just a veryyy mediocre sushi spot, even among SB standards. I was thoroughly underwhelmed and probably wouldn't come back again.

We eat at Sun Sushi whenever we feel like Japanese food.  It's quick and easy to pick up when we don't feel like going to sit down somewhere. Prices are on the higher side but everyone's increased their prices due to Covid.
Food was fresh and so good & staff was so helpful, friendly, and funny! loved the ladies @ the front counter!

Tried this restaurant for the first time this weekend,  it was quiet, basic and affordable. You should try the omakase menu, it was a great experience with a good amount of food for a decent price, I had the 7 piece for $34.95. They have a sushi-6-step, which is 6 pieces of sushi that was also tasty. Sushi was fresh, service was very attentive, I'll definitely be going back.
Cool neighborhood sushi spot. Excellent all around service, quick to your table & friendly. Every piece of sushi, sashimi, & all rolls were excellent. All 4 of us will be back !
Came here for dinner and they set up a table for me to eat on the patio. Very gracious and efficient service. Good food. Would definitely recommend.

Horrible customer service for Internet. I suggest anyone who is limited in their choices at their location of Internet not to select this one. Right now I'm kind of broke, and I cannot make a change I'm just gonna take them four days to get my Internet back up? I asked to be sent to the service department for a four day credit and I think I got blown off. Really lousy customer service, poor Internet connection, and they're always blaming everybody else for what they're not providing.

There's no dollar amount you can put on hard working folks doing good work for not a lot. My truck looked great and I felt totally justified giving a tip equal to the service charge. And all I had to do was honk, pull in, and eat my lunch. 
This is not fancy, but it's the best bargain for a hand wash you're going to find in Nap Town. 
(Won't post my photo for whatever reason)

Installed new service 6 weeks ago, forgot to bury line
Since then had 2 service visits to complete work order to get line buried, called again yesterday they have no record of a work order!
They must be out of cash and can't take care of customers unfortunately 

I sent a note to their ceo last night trying to get help

I am not sure how we lived in Santa Barbara for some long without going to sun sushi. This review is for take-out during the pandemic which we have done multiple times. We have always called it in but they also have online ordering. They typically have it ready within 30 minutes. We love to get the salmon and yellowtail sushi as well as rolls such as the Mexican roll, eel avocado roll, and state street roll. Picking up the food is easy and the staff are following covid19 precautions. We always look forward to sushi night!
Cute restaurant to hangout with friends. The donuts are amazing. The employees are hip and kind.
This is my favorite sushi place in Santa Barbara. The staff are all extremely friendly and the fish is fresh and tasty. The salmon six steps are to die for as well as the box sushi.

Mediocre at best. I've lived in Fairmount for approximately 3 years now and it's a hit or miss spot. Prices are fair so I will give 2 stars, but don't order and expect much. My last visit consisted of an order of hummus and two sandwiches to share with a friend. The hummus tasted store bought. It lacked substance, flavor and sadly salt. I had to doctor it up to salvage my 6.00 container. They offer pita with it - it's warm which is nice but it tastes store bought. The ratio of pita to hummus is disappointing. - would not recommend wasting your money.
I asked for an ingredient swap on one of my sandwiches and that was completely disregarded - despite me waiting around patiently for my order to be completed. I can live without this place in the future. Can't say I'd recommend the place, but if you're local and in need of food in a pinch, it will possibly do.

For a city that's located right along the Pacific Ocean and has an abundant source of local seafood, the sushi here is lacking. The quality just doesn't match LA, or the price point doesn't justify the costs. I came to Sun Sushi on a whim, not really expecting too much. But to my delight, I left pretty satisfied and wished I splurged a little more.

The restaurant is located along the upper side of State Street, in a plaza next to Spudnuts. Parking is a bit tight but spots are available at the Rose Garden Inn as well.

On the menu, you will find your standard appetizers, as well as some interesting options. The soft shell crab was a delicious start to the meal, I would recommend that one. They also had Korean short ribs and Japanese fried chicken, which I was tempted to try but held off to leave room for more sushi. Maybe next time.

Out of all the rolls, Box Sushi was the clear favorite. Rice is pressed into literally a rectangular prism to give it a boxy shape and then overlaid with a mix of tuna and crab before finally topped with eel sauce. The roll has a little kick to it, but the spice is absolutely tolerable.

We didn't order any other specialty rolls, but the rest of the dishes we had were decent. The rice was well made, and they used the right amounts for their fish. It was my first time choosing sweet shrimp nigiri over regular shrimp, and it was well worth the premium and I've been ordering it since.

When it became clear that we were moving 1200 miles for a career opportunity, we knew that we needed to find an agent with a stellar track record in our neighborhood and a keen eye for detail that we could trust to manage the sale while we were settling into our new home 8 states away. 
Brooke rose to the occasion and exceeded our expectations. She made everything so easy and went above and beyond with her level of service and professionalism.
Not only was every aspect of the sale taken care of, but afterward she and her team went out of their way to send us some personal items that we had inadvertently left behind.
Brooke made sure to connect us to the very best stager and photographer to ensure that our house looked its absolute best for listing.
If we had to do it all again, we wouldn't change a thing. Brooke made a complicated move very easy for us by making our home sale go flawlessly.

What a cute little place!!

There is a ton of street parking, which didn't seem to require pay for the Saturday that I went. 

It's an old house converted to the cafe. There's outdoor seating and indoor seating- not a whole lot! 
You go in and form a line to the right which takes you in front of the donuts - there you order what you want and they give you drinks and donuts - a number if you order from the menu. 

They bring your food to you and you enjoy!

I guess it isn't terribly expensive for what you get but I wouldn't go everyday. 

I got the flyin Hawaiian dog, blonde donut, and shogun flight of beer. It was some good stuff!

Was expecting so much more. They don't park the beers with the donuts you pick which ever. The donuts are huge and impossible to finish, they get really hard and dry after a few hours.. and very very expensive I spent 50$ on donuts and a flight of beer. The food did look good though but I didn't try it

EDITED: Donna from corporate called me and we talked through this. I really appreciate the prompt response and how she seemed sincere. 

Original 1 Star Review:
Sincerely disappointed in the customer service we received when we went to lunch today (10/8/21). I usually LOVE the food here, but the "managers' boss" was extremely unhelpful. I ordered the To Be Or Not To Be (chicken Caesar salad. Salad came to the table with Italian dressing (I could tell by the consistency and the smell). I asked for Caesar dressing. She came back with the same Italian dressing. I again asked for Caesar dressing. She allegedly went back and got "fresh" dressing from the cooler. It was still Italian dressing. She kept trying to tell me it was Caesar. I had my husband taste it. Definitely Italian dressing. 

How are you in a position to be the "managers' boss" but not know your own products? My lunch was ruined - I had been looking forward to this place reopening but now I don't know that I'll be back. 

The "managers' boss" did give us a gift card to try to resolve the issue but it's outrageous that someone would try to gaslight a customer into thinking the dressing they're being served is the right dressing when it doesn't look, smell, or taste like the correct dressing.

One of my favorite sushi places in SB! I have eaten at the restaurant and ordered to go and both times I was very impressed with them. The fish was always fresh and the rice is seasoned well. This is my go to sushi place in Santa Barbara for sushi and they never seem to disappoint. I really liked their rolls especially the yellow tail delight and the spider roll. Their special sushi and sashimi is also great and you get 10 pieces chosen by the chef that day.

Most buses stop on the schedule on Grand don't show up after 10pm. Your lucky if one finally come at 11:09 at Grand center. Every night everybody be complaining about buses never showing up that's on the schedule!
Yup I'm the guy that smashed their salmon skin salad, red dragon roll and steamed edamame within seconds. Customer service was outstanding as well.

Some of the best sushi I've had in a decade. Go sit at the bar, drink some sake, and get the six step salmon plate.

10/10 coming back again.

TINY "wings" drowned in Buffalo sauce. There was no meat on the bone! Just bits of overcooked skin. 

The mozzarella was also burnt, overcooked, and hollow. No cheese inside the cheese sticks. Lol. My boyfriend and I loved Zuzus but they are getting sloppy and lazy with the orders. Truly disappointing.

Ordered the omakase for takeout and was really pleased. It came with miso soup and salad and even an extra nigiri! Fish was fresh and there was a nice selection of fish. Pickup service was also friendly

We stopped in for coffee and the place is so lovely! Not a lot of choices for someone who is gluten free but the coffee was good. The chai latte was a bit too sweet, the Cuban coffee could have used more condensed milk, but the nitro coffee was great! Thanks!

Wish I could do negative star.  
Don't EAT here!! Cold food/poor service. 
Don't ONLINE order!!!  Wait, wait, wait, if they don't misplace your order. 
My how the Cracker Barrel company fallen. 

Here I am again on 07/06/20, why? Thought some vegetables would be nice & we were close.  Well, maybe 8 tables of customers. 25 minutes for a vegetable plate, serious. Slow service again. Dirty windows on the inside, flies on the tables & windows. I would say they're not meeting basic sanitary guidelines much less Covid-19 guidelines. New plastic covered menus, can't tell if they are being sanitized after each use.

I just wanted a coffee, but after seeing the selections of donuts I couldnt help myself. I got a Kickstarter: brioche donut with crushed toffee, cold brew icing, and espresso drizzle and then for later a Blondie: bourbon vanilla glaze, rolled in toasted coconut, caramel swirl. Both were absolute units, just massive but light as air and so delicious. My only issue was that there were so many people in line and just two working on a Saturday, those poor people were doing their best but definitely could have used a hand! 
Shop is too cute as well, keeping this place on my list for next time I am in the area. Great place, definitely come see them!

In my experience they will do anything to charge your credit card. I thought I had canceled my membership in early 2019 but found out it was only frozen (on hold). Randomly and without notice I was charged $89 in June. After visiting the studio I was informed that the account was reactivated and I needed to provide a 30 day notice. I signed a cancellation form and told I will not be charged. On July 6th I was charged again. I've left multiple messages and emails with the studio to resolve this quickly. No one has reached out even though on the recorded line the message says that someone will return my call in 1 business day. It has been over a week and I'm still waiting. I understand the facility is closed but as said the recording provides the expectation of a call. Good luck if you need to resolve an issue with this studio. Shady business. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
Their eggs are not free range nor do they have good vegetarian options. Fresh breads yes but not a very progressive place. Too bad.

The staff is very friendly, and they're pretty fast especially early in the morning. I have yet to go wrong with anything I choose among their extensive pastry section (though the sausage and cheese biscuits and the almond croissant are my current favorites), and free wifi is a lovely bonus. I live close by and there isn't another coffee shop anywhere nearby but even aside from that necessity it's a great place and should receive full stars except for one major detail. For the last few months I'm pretty sure the owner has been working the early morning shifts and she regularly shorts the drinks. When I remember to say that I don't want room in my coffee she leaves about an inch unfilled from the top and when I forget to say anything she leaves almost two inches. Lattes and other hot drinks are similarly reduced though iced drinks usually come a bit closer to being full. I have not experienced this issue with any other barista there and I don't know if she thinks she's saving money or inattentive when she's in a hurry, but I'm sick of paying for medium drinks when I end up getting a small.

I go for annual inspection and Mieneke 4846 Spruce St, Philadelphia, PA damaged my car.

First of all, I should preface by stating that I rarely write online reviews.  However, I wanted to share my experience with the community that occurred on September 29, 2018. On the day before Sep 29, I made a 8 am appointment for my car to be inspected.  I arrived at Meineke Car Care at 7:30 am just to be sure that I would be first few customers in line.  Dave Gordy, the Manager of this store, checked me in at 8 am and stated that it will take less than 2 hours to complete the inspection.  I decided to wait rather than going back to pick up my car.  At 9:30 am, I inquired with Dave Gordy about the status on my car and he stated that my car is next in line for inspection and it should be done very quickly. At last, they finished my inspection at 12:30 pm.  Basically, two hour wait had turned into 4.5 hours with NO Communication and better yet, he kept assuring me along the way that my car will be inspected within 2 hours.  After talking to other customers for 4.5 hours, all of them stated that the same thing. Poor customer service, double to triple the time to complete the job than originally quoted.  All they want is your money.

To top everything, when i returned to my car, my driver side and passenger side doors would not unlock with my keylelss remote.  I have two eye witnesses that witnessed me using the keyless remote at 7:15 am (prior to going to the Meineke store) and it worked perfectly.  As I confronted to Dave Grody about this situation, he stated that he can not do anything about it and I should file an insurance claim with Corporate Meineke.  

Furthermore, he told me leave the store before he kicks me out.  I have it video taped and trust me it is very bad on how he treated me and other customers were also shocked on his treatment towards a customer.  This is what a good paying customer gets - Getting kicked out of the store for the damage that Meineke did to my car with no apology and explanation on how to rectify this situation. 

I truly felt Meineke is just out there to screw customers and give them the run around so they do not have to pay for their faults.

Absolute worst customer service system I've ever experienced. Over an hour of talking to a robot, then having a representative transfer me to a different department in a repeated cycle. They had entered my email wrong when linking it to my account number, so I never got to register. Was charged $20 extra for their service than what my apartment complex representative had listed because it automatically opts you into paper billing, not paperless. The internet worked fine most of the time, but dealing with all the customer service issues turned me off completely

My family and I went here Saturday night to have dinner together. We had a rather long wait time for a not so packed restaurant. When we got seated at our table our server was rude and lacked any kind of personality( she acted like she'd rather been anywhere but there), she never introduced herself and as soon as she handed us our menus she wanted to know if we knew what we wanted to eat, this was before taking our drink orders. We waited about an hour to get our food  after we placed our ordered with our waitress. There were several tables that were seated before and after my family that waited for what seemed forever as well, even causing a couple tables to give up and walk out. We only seen our waitress twice the whole visit; when she took our order and brought us our food an hour later. We asked for to go boxes from her and she Ben another waitress but never received them. Our waitress also never brought us our bill to pay so after we gave up on to go boxes we went to the check out counter and told them what was going on and what we ordered so we could pay for our food and drinks there. I have been to many Cracker Barrel restaurants but I have never been to one that ran as poorly as this one did on Saturday night! It was a terrible experience all around and I know for fact that five other tables felt the same way as my family did!

Horrible! Absolutely horrible and horrible! I will never come back to this place, the Dentist is the coldest person ever, they just really care about the numbers. They are Scientologist and of course don't care about the people just themselves. I waited for a long time at the waiting room. What a poor and so horrible service. The positive thing on my visit? Mia at the front desk. Don't go there. It's a very cold place! I am wondering what OSHA would say about this office. Are they following all the protocols? Hmmm, may be not, and what about confidential information everywhere? Def not happy about this place at all. Can I give them less than one star?
Went there yesterday with a friend. Food was not fresh, dry wasabi, too much rice in rolls... will not go back
The food was hot a delicious . The hot and sour soup was exceptional.  They were very accommodating when I asked them to add broccoli to my chicken fried rice.

I'm confidently reviewing Sun Sushi is a gem in Santa Barbara. I have heard good things about them but been hesitating to try since their location is a bit drive for me from east beach. Being a regular patron at Arigato and Sakana (known to be best sushi restaurants in town) I could say Sun sushis quality is comparable. I'm impressed how fresh their fishes are. I tried the Salmon six step, buttery, fresh, melt in your mouth. I suggest everyone should try this special. They also have bluefin tuna six step, I will try this next time. I also tried the spicy Tuna Roll in Special rolls menu. I preferred not to have crab meat in the roll and the chef was flexible to sub it for me. The jalapeño was quite spicy so I took a few slices off, but if you can handle the hear this roll is perfect. I also ordered some appetizers like Veggie tempura, seaweed salad, miso soup, and avocado roll. The tempura batter is light, the veggie is fresh, I will surely have this again. Their miso soup is generously served, bigger size than anywhere else in town. 
They serve beers, wine, sake, and shochu, great variety on drinks especially sakes. The sake menu is really informative, tells you the degree of dryness and sweetness on every single one. 
Their service is on point, nothing to complain. The sushi chefs are friendly, attentive, flexible, and really proud of their services. I was happy to enjoy my dinner at the bar and I will come back again to support their business . Glad to recommend Sun Sushi to friends and family!
Not bad. Not best sushi of my life but good. We are not Santa Barbara sushi experts as we don't live locally but may return if in the area. No complaints.
I had the crunchy sushi roll to go and it was OK. I will make sure to dine in after the pandemic is over to give it another shot!

Cracker Barrel was once one of my favorite restaurants. While traveling it was one I could always depend on for great food. Sadly to say in the last year I have received much different experiences at the many locations I have visited. The quality of food is nowhere near what it used to be. My last visit was yesterday in Mississippi but I have also received the same experiences at several other locations in other states. The biscuits I was served yesterday were tasteless as well as dense in texture so i couldn't eat them. My husband's  country steak was dry and stringy. At other locations, the dumplings, which is one of our favorites, was also tasteless and the juice was thick and pasty. The new fried chicken isn't nearly as good as the Sunday fried chicken breast. This I  dont understand. I am so disappointed in the overall quality of our once favorite American restaurant. Hopefully management will be successful in returning Cracker Barrel to its former quality.

STAY FAR AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY!
We purchased a car from Meridian Auto Ranch on December 10, 2019 for our daughters Christmas present. We were told that the car was marked down as a "mechanics special" We immediately inquired about what exactly that meant since we were not looking for a car needing major repairs. We were told multiple times by Tony and TJ that they have the best mechanics that go through each used car bumper to bumper before it ever hits the lot. The ONLY thing that was wrong with it was the sunroof didn't slide back and they didn't want to put $900 into the car to fix it. They told us the car had been serviced, including an oil change and even offered us 2 free oil changes to use anytime this year. We trusted them and believed they we being forth coming since we asked them directly. 
The day after Christmas, December 26th, our daughter took the car out for her first drive. She came back saying the car wouldn't accelerate. We immediately took the car back to the Auto Ranch to find out the transmission needed to be replaced. We had only put 30 miles on the car! After 2 weeks of the Auto Ranch avoiding us and making empty promises, we finally agreed to pay for the transmission at "their cost".  Many times we were promised call backs from Geoff, Tj and Darren, which no one ever called us back. We were told to come by and speak directly to the general manager Darren. When we arrived he wouldn't even face us and sent a runner to communicate between us.
The day we got the car back we checked the oil and to our surprise it was sledge like and crusty. We took it to a local oilery where we were told oil hadn't been changed in at least a year and was 2  1/2 quarts low! We paid $100 to have an engine flush and air filter changed as the air filter was filthy and covered in hay. 
Just this week we found out the car needs a complete brake replacement. There is no way this car went through any type of "bumper to bumper" check by Meridian Auto Ranch. We were completely lied to and now paying for a mound of car repairs.

Modern family owned take out, delivery with some eat in seating.  Fast, friendly service with good prices and yummy selections.  A wide variety on the menu. A big step above your regular Chinese take out place.

Stopped in to grab a half sandwich on my way to the airport today. I ordered a Cinco de Mayo sandwich with no special instructions or substitutions. When I unwrapped it to eat they had forgotten the turkey. So basically I paid $8 for a kind of sad BLT. The bread was good but thats all I can say. Be sure to check your orders before you leave
This place is amazing! Their Loco fries are thin, crispy and perfectly seasoned. Their dogs are my new favorite in town. So delicious!

I couldn't have been more impressed with this place honestly! The staff were super personable and accommodating. The atmosphere was light and comfortable with the cute fireplace and fun artwork. The food...oh Lordy, the food was beyond fantastic. From the drinks, to the donuts, to the dogs, to the fries...we literally were not disappointed with a single thing. My husband and I even had a fun moment reminiscing on the 90's alternative music being played. It's hard to believe that we visited this place randomly because it wi forever be a staple to visit when I'm in town. They apparently also have different locations I other states too! Super stoked for them, it is well deserved!!! Can't wait for next time!

BEWARE BUYERS! I took my truck in for a trade in on another truck. Of course they low balled me on trade in. December 1 2020 is when this all took place. Today is January 5 2021 and they still haven't payed off the trade in to the bank. I'm making payments now on two vehicles! I've made multiple phone calls and their excuses are " check is in the mail" it's been 34 days! I should of know better with a used car dealer. They said they sent pay off to the bank December 3 2020 but after talking to my bank they said Auto Ranch called them December 17 2020 so how they of sent a check December 3 but called bank December 17 ? Another lie! So here I'm making payments on both vehicles and Auto Ranch excuse is " check in the mail " BEWARE POTENTIAL BUYERS! No honesty!!

I wish I worked by this place again! I use to intern at an office close to downtown Meridian, and would visit this place almost once a week in the mornings. You walk in and first off are surrounded by the fresh smell of pastries that just come out of the oven. The grand selection makes it a difficult choice, but my personal fav and go-to is the ginormous chocolate croissant. It's serious so. Dang. Big!

I was walking down a random street in Nashville when I spotted The Donut + Dog. On a whim I decided to venture inside with my crew and I was completely blow away. 

D+D is exactly why I love Nashville. It's hip, cute, quant and yummable(patent pending on word). We had the pleasure of meeting Alex who is way to crushable. I ordered the campfire latte and several donuts. They were all scrumptious. The drink was incredibly tasty as well. 

The vibe is super chill as well. Eclectic decor. Love the string lights.

Great concept and very cute converted house into a restaurant.   There is paintings of donuts and hot dogs on your way into the house, very instagrammable.  

Service: amazing!! 

Donuts:  $5/each.  Don't come after noon for a donut, because there is either a limited selection of donuts or they are all sold out.   We basically came back a 2nd time for some donuts, the first time we opted for some hotdogs.  All their hot dogs are on a Brioche bun.    
- Smores: tasted premium.  
- Peach: was so delicious!  It has a perfect peach jam in the middle of it.   
- Original: was probably my favorite with a slight hint of cinnamon 

HotDogs: $9.95 / each was kind of pricey for the hot dog, but it was made a brioche bun.  All hot dogs are nitrate free, so my friend who was pregnant was able to have them too! 
- BLT: delicious!   The avocado really elevated the hot dog.   
- Little Italy: was probably our least favorite with the least amount of flavor 
- Chili dog: was good!  The only thing was I am not exactly to used to sweet chili but it was good! 

Side: $5 
-Elote: I actually didn't really like the corn at all.  It was a little oily, and didn't taste very good.  
-Chips: was handmade and it's good 
-French Fries: was delicious, perfectly fried with not too much oil.

I have been wanting to try this place out forever! I've heard such great things about it. It's located on Upper State in a little plaza, it might be easy to miss! There's plenty of parking around the area though.

We came in mid week and there was no wait time, but did end up getting busy! The service is super fast and the food, even better.

We got the popular 6 step blue fin tuna and it was a MOUTHGASM each bite!! So simple and flavorful, like butter. I can't wait to try the salmon one. The uni sushi was also fresh and creamy, worth every penny. We also got two simple rolls (avocado/eel, spicy albacore) and a special roll (yellow tail delight roll), which were all fantastic and filling.

Dessert was cheap and who doesn't love some mochi to round out a dinner!

Can't wait to come back here for another sushi night!

DONT DO IT. I used to have cox, but decided to try century link since the house we moved into had the century link wiring set up already. 
MISTAKE. the internet stopped working 2 months into the service and we are renting a modem from them!! 
Plus, they want to charge us $85 fee if the tech says it's a problem with OUR wiring. 
I've never had an issue like this with cox. I think I'll be going back to cox.

When anyone asks me for a sushi recommendation within Santa Barbara, I always point them to Sun Sushi. Besides being all the way up on Upper State Street with primarily locals and hidden in a strip mall near The Tee-Off, what sets them apart from the rest of the competition? Let me break it down for you...
- Arigato: More expensive and less authentic
- Goleta Sushi House: More creative yet uses excessive sauces
- Hibachi: Basic, often dry and what you'd find in a chain restaurant
- Kyoto: Too much rice to make up for the low price point
- Wabi Sabi: Missing out on ambiance being within the market

When I visit Sun Sushi, I always make sure to sit at the bar. This allows me to peruse what the specials are on the chalkboard and what is freshly flown in from Japan--yes, it's true! Not to mention, Sun Sushi is family-owned with the owner and the same group of fellow sushi masters behind the bar. It is fun to interact with them and they get to know you on a first-name basis, along with your preferences.

Two dishes that I order at every visit and that are unique to Sun Sushi are the Salmon (or Tuna) 6-Steps (literally 6 cuts of salmon or tuna each prepared differently and placed photogenically on bamboo stairs--Instagram and Yelp worthy for sure!) and the Box Sushi (seared tuna and spicy crab meat pressed and formed into a bamboo box with sesame & eel sauce). Both are extremely unique from one another given that the steps are modern yet simplistic and the box is more of a tasty American creation.

If you're not into rolls, they also offer classic Japanese dishes like a Bento Box, Beef Teriyaki, Donburi, Udon and Short ribs. While I have enjoyed all these, the sushi is where it's at.

I was really bummed out about this place. We went there for the first time and I got food poisoning. My boyfriend and I ate the same exact thing except I ordered one extra thing. Yellowtail. 
It was all delicious and if that didn't happen, we would have definitely been back.

Came here to celebrate a friend's belated birthday. We ordered the Sun roll, Volcano roll, crunch roll, box sushi, and the albacore delight roll and the teriyaki chicken bowl. Looking outside the restaurant, first impression is that it looks like a more run down restaurant but I wasn't going to base it just off looks.

The sushi is sooo good! The fish is super fresh and all were really good. The volcano roll however is a hit or miss since its served hot and wrapped in foil which is what you don't expect when eating sushi. The teriyaki bowl was okay, chicken was pretty bland. But I would definitely recommend the sushi. 

Sun sushi however is a little on the pricier side so expect to pay more. However the quality of the sushi is well worth it. They were super stingy on the wasabi and ginger. There were 4 of us but only served one mini plate for all of us to share. The waitress was nice enough to bring out a little more but only when we asked.

We all ordered green tea ice cream for dessert along with Mochi. Can never go wrong with green tea ice cream! They even were sweet enough to sing happy birthday to my friend with a candle on the ice cream which she enjoyed very much! The waiter also offered to take pictures of as well too.

Overall the sushi was great and the service was awesome!

Salmon 6-Steps $19.95 (Scotty, Atlantic, and Ocean-Trout)

Three types of salmon prepared multiple ways. The fish was super fresh and buttery!

swancys hand car wash is a hidden gem. i live downtown and have a maserati that must be hand washed and swancys is the only place i would ever go. they do such a great and wonderful job and the value is awesome. high recommend if you want a professional service done by some terrific local small business owners.

This is my second time here - I've tried the donuts before, and now I'm reviewing the hot dogs. Specifically - the Banh Mi. It's styled after a traditional Banh Mi, with sliced carrots,  jalapeños and sriracha aioli. The bread is toasted and rich with butter. Absolutely delicious. Had a side of truffle fries, which were also excellent, savory and topped with parmesan cheese. Unfortunately, they had run out of donuts, so we skipped dessert. *sad face*Nonetheless, everything was great, and service was friendly and efficient. Will be returning again!

Terrible. I have been canceled 7 times. I've had install dates for 
11/24, 11/30, 12/4, 12/7, 12/12, 12/15 all have been canceled because of "wrong product ordered" but they're the only provider my apartment allows so how could they possibly not know once, let alone 6 times. Unprofessional. Been transferring around 10+ times. No one has an answer or knows anything about what is going on. I could go on and on. Save yourself the headache, use a different company

Add another star and let's call this 6 stars! 

I visited on a weekday morning around 8:30 and it wasn't busy at all. Before I entered, I couldn't help but notice the inviting exterior approach. The communal outdoor seating area was very cool and I figured the interior was also going to be super cool. Yup, it was! 

The Interior is gorgeous! I love the use of wood, glass, and metal. The variety of lighting is impressive, too. I mean, you wouldn't expect to go into a jewelry store and not see diamonds sparkle under the mr16 lights. Just like bling in a jewelry store, displays of bread, sweets, and savory dishes also need to be showcased. They do a great job of that here and everything looked amazing! 

I had the Beef and Blue sandwich with Balsamic jam, which was probably the best thing I've ever eaten- no joke! There was a little of the jam nestled in the nooks and crannies of the slightly-crunchy bread. Paired with roast beef and blue cheese, this combination was incredible! I opted for 1/2 sandwich, side of fruit and a small piece of gooey butter cake, which was new to me. I'm from Ohio and this intrigued me. 

I savored my meal and watched the worker bees make the bread, which was very entertaining. The dining area and working kitchen were impressively clean. The service and atmosphere were top notch. Plus, they have a Coke-Free style machine! I had water but nothing beats the ice from a Free-style! Trust me- I'm an ice chewer. 

I plan on taking an 8-hour road trip to the area and sharing this great gem with my children.

Eating here now. Really great place. I'm a local to Santa Barbara, wanted to try something new and found this place. Hands down this is now my new place. One of the owners was in here too. We are eating at the bar. Highly recommend!

the sushi here was amazing. the fish tasted so fresh. my group got quite a few rolls and each one tastes amazing. my favorite sushi was actually the salmon nigiri because the salmon was so thick and the ratio of fish to rice was amazing. really enjoyed it here

This has literally become my most favorite place. The Horchata Espresso is to die for, my kids and their friends get excited to try/compare new favorite donuts (literally best donut in Nashville, by far... Boss Hog, BlackBerry Smash and Kickstarter are my personal favs), the Dogs and sides are Insane. I think in the past 2 months we've tried them all, but Loco and Hawaiian are repeat orders. And do yourself a favor and get the Hot Chicken and the Grilled Cheese! If I remembered my dreams, I'm positive both of these would make appearances. 

This is a super awesome spot. Parking and pickup are easy. I've taken a dozen or more folks by for take out in the past few weeks and can't wait to enjoy a sit down visit soon. 

Go and try them!!!

Wow. Just wow. I really loved my first time at Sun Sushi. My friends and I came in around 6, and there wasn't too many people (which was nice for us, because we didn't want to wait to get seated). The menu definitely has a good variety, but if you don't want to spend too much money on sushi, this might not be the best place. However, the prices are set for good reason- the quality of sushi here is absolutely amazing. 

I ordered the Blue Fin Tuna 6 ways which came with miso soup, and salad. I couldn't really care less about the salad, but the miso was a good starter. The tuna though- oh my goodness. Everything tasted so fresh and the tuna would melt in my mouth- so good. I also got two scotty salmon sushi, which were also delicious.

My favorite appetizer here is the crispy spicy tuna, which is spicy tuna with avocado sitting on a fried piece of rice (kind of like a rice tater tot). So delicious, I could order 4 of them.

Parking was easy for me, but that's also because places were closed around there (like the brunch place within the same plaza). 

I almost don't want to recommend this place because I'm selfish and don't want people to flood my new favorite restaurant in SB, but it's honestly the best sushi I've had in my 8 years of living in California.

Came back and this time ordered the special zuzu's salad, Greek salad and zuzu's chicken sandwich. 

The zuzu's salad was so good and refreshing! Loved the artichokes and all of the toppings inside. I would highly recommend this. Greek salad was just okay I would skip out on this next time. Maybe if I added chicken it would have been better.

The chicken sandwich was SO flavorful and spicy! The sandwich is on a hoagie roll and is very big and filling. Great prices and great service again!

Such a great spot to get your sushi fix! I got the salmon flight (not what it's really called but forgot the real name) and agedashi tofu. I wish the tofu had a bit more flavor but it was still yummy. Also, they have super quick service which is a huge plus!

For authentic sushis, this is a good place to go to. They are not very fanciful but I do like their 6 steps Salmon sushi. The service is good and relatively efficient depending on the crowd in any particular evening.

Came here on a Saturday night for a party of 6 and my experience here was pretty good. Great service and very attentive servers. 

Yellowtail nigiri: 10/10 the most memorable one. Thick piece of fish on top with a tad bit of wasabi tucked inside. I'd order this again.

Masago nigiri: 10/10 nothing wrong with this one. But it did tasted more salty like the sea than it being sweet from the eggs

State street: 7/10 falls apart easily. It was okay. I like the ingredients inside but I felt like it was missing something. I'll probably get an item on the crunchier side next time.

Spicy tempura lobster roll: 9/10 also falls apart very easily. However, the texture and flavor was delicious for this one. The crispy lobster and cucumber makes a huge difference.

Btw are you guys selling your mugs that you serve your hot tea in, because they are cute as heck

The worst place ever!!!
They will scratch your car as they did with my and they will tell you ghat it was like yhag before!

My car is brand new just from the dealership and I picked up this car wash because I trusted reviews. It was the biggest mistake!!!

Unprofessional, rude, dumb manager never apologized!

Do NOT go there! This place should better be closed!!!

They also used old dirty rags

Pathetic service 

I hope that owner will see this review And if he is interested to save his business, he will do changes and fire those unprofessional rude people 

P.S. Looking forward to hearing from you

The service was good.  The servers were attentive and efficient.  On the other hand, the portion for the sushi and the premium rolls are small compared to the price they charge.  Four and a half stars is overrated.
We went in late last night and they sat us no problem. The sushi was absolutely amazing but our server was even better. A must go!

First time trying Sun Sushi and I've truly been missing out! This place came highly recommended and it didn't disappoint.

Food - I didn't know what I was expecting but the sushi was far better than I imagined. I had the Eel Avocado, Salmon Avocado and Yellow Tail Avocado Rolls. The fish in each of them was fresh and firm, very high quality.

Ambience - Located on Upper State in a strip mall, this place is easy to miss if you're not looking for it. The interior is nothing special but it's intimate and has a nice neighborhood sushi bar vibe 

Service - Came in on Friday night without a reservation and they seated me immediately! The sushi chef took my order and served my food in less than 15 minutes. I'll come back just because of how efficient they were!

I didn't have the opportunity to eat at Companion, but I did attend a pizza making class for some team bonding! If you have the opportunity to do this, go for it! It's tons of fun, you'll learn a lot, and you leave with some recipes and a fun plate. 

To start our class, we were greeted with a beer and given spaces to stow our belongings. After a bit of mingling we set in to make our dough. Our host was just the right blend of sassy/sarcastic and informative teacher. We learned how to measure correctly, knead, and eventually toss our dough to make some crispy and pillowy crusts. There was a fun demo with the stand mixer and more beverages before grabbing our upside down trays and working our way through the topping bar to make our personalized pies. 

Our host kindly fired the pizzas for us and we promptly stuffed our faces. We were treated with some surprise bread pudding cups, which I placed in my to-go bag because I was crazy full. It was pretty tasty the next day, though I think my pizza won the battle of sweet vs. savory - a rare occurrence for my sweet-tooth-filled mouth. We also left with printed recipes for the dough and roasted tomato sauce, which many folks on our team made a few weeks later at home. 

The building is beautiful, if in a seemingly random area (at least to this out-of-towner). I'd love to return sometime to learn to make something else!

I had lunch at Companion Cafe during a recent trip to St. Louis and I have to say - I was impressed!

I love the overall vibe of the cafe including the decor and the windows where you can watch the production of the bread. I'd never tried their bread before, but the lady ahead of me in line mentioned that it was the only bread her family would eat. 

My lunch choice was the turkey bacon sandwich and southwest salad. The bread was so fresh and all the ingredients were top notch. I ordered a small salad but they serve you a hefty portion, which is appreciated. The salad dressing had an interesting zesty flavor that I couldn't quite make out...kind of tasted like there might be a little curry in it, but it could've been something else. 

The people taking the orders didn't appear to be too familiar with the menu since they couldn't answer a few simple questions, but that's okay. 

The food was delicious and I definitely plan to eat here again if I ever make it back to St. Louis.

Love the industrial warehouse vibe on outside/inside. There are large windows to the baking area where you get to watch everything in action! The decor is cool and it's clean. Service was great and the line went quickly. Our sandwiches, were delicious! Homemade bread, quality ingredients. We enjoyed our sides of salad and fruit. We ended the meal with gooey butter cake......so good!!!! Would love to come back!

My wife and i bought our first house recently, and I'm so glad we worked with Mary Maimone. Our homebuying process took us all over Philadelphia, looking at quite a range of different houses. But she was always positive and upbeat, with a strong dose of realism. She has a thorough knowledge of Philly's neighborhoods, as well as personal experience with owning an old home. Over the course of several months, she guided our search with a perfect mix of enthusiasm and wisdom. Not letting us buy the wrong house, but keeping our spirits lifted. Finally she saw our dream house go on the market, she raced us over there to see it. When it was crunch time, she hustled to make our deal go through and here we are, living the dream! Mary Maimone is an honest and diligent real estate agent and an amazing person who we now call a friend.

Update: August 17.

I wanted to add to my review, as I've been to Sun Sushi many times after the first review. I am leaving California tomorrow and I think that my saddest moment will be that Sun Sushi is not going to be near me anymore.

The chefs and all of the employees are very very professional, friendly, and also very funny! They all have a great sense of humor, which is what I really love and appreciate. The servers are great, the people who come around to refill waters are great! Max has been excellent in his responsiveness on Yelp, and his service. I am very grateful that I have met everyone here, because I always have a great time here.

I would highly encourage everyone to try their specials on Thursday. And some rolls. And their appetizers. And their ice cream. Basically, you should try everything here, because everything is amazing. This is my favorite restaurant in California. I will miss it so much, but when I come visit, Sun Sushi will be the first place I will go to.

Thank you Max, and everyone else for such an amazing experience. I will miss you all and hopefully I will see you all soon!

I'm from the Bay area and our Bible study group decided to go to Santa Barbara for the weekend.  Our group went here to have dinner for the very first time.  We were surprised how delicious and fresh their food were.  The service was also good.  We will for sure go back when we are in the area.
They for it turned on the day after and they have been smart enough so far to not charge me for time not accessible: I miss my former provider though.

How can you go wrong with a place that serves amazing hotdogs, donuts and coffee? Set in a quaint house and nestled in the cozy Hillsboro Belmont village area, Donut + Dog is the perfect place to enjoy sweet and savory treats. They have plenty of unique donut flavors but I am a big fan of their S'mores donut. What makes their brioche donuts so special is that they are super tasty but very light. They don't leave you with that full, heavy feeling you get from eating other regular donuts. The hotdogs are also wonderful. My favorite hotdogs here are the Chili Queso which is wrapped in bacon and the Elote Loco which is made with Chorizo, "Mexican Street Corn" and Cotija. They use a very high quality bread that is slightly crispy on the outside. I also really enjoyed their   Chicharrones and Queso as a side dish. Lastly, they have an excellent selection of coffee. My favorites are the Campfire Cappuccino and the Horchata Cubano. The service is exceptional. The staff and management are among the nicest in Nashville. They really are extremely passionate about providing the best possible experience for their customers.
I just went here for the first time today. Got the salmon roll. I've been puking my brains out for the last hour. Pros: tasted good, nice people. Cons: I can't leave the bathroom

Disclaimer:  this is a 'Rona review...

Pet Friendly:  yes

Free easy parking:  yes

Nice atmosphere:  yes

My ole lady and I came here for a lite breakfast snack...

The coffee was pretty good.  Not epic.

The donuts were too doughy, not flaky.  I have had much, much better.  They were heavy.  Again, not like and flaky.

Rumor has it that E'ville might once have had an opportunity for a Metro line, but it didn't work out.  Too bad.  I love Metro. We tend to use it for almost any special event downtown: restaurant, hockey game, band competition, car show, road race, festival, or Cardinals game. Parking is free at stations like Fairview Heights (our preferred) or East Riverfront (Casino Queen, East St. Louis). Automated machines sell one-ways at $2.25, ticket windows open for special events/high volume sell "round trips" at $4.50.  Better prices for day passes or longer.  If you're going to a Cards game from the Illinois side, you can get off at 8th and Pine (say you're going to Mike Shannon's and want to walk south), or just get off at Stadium (just west of the 3rd base line). Last night, trains were running east to west every 6 minutes, and west to east every ten minutes.  There are two lines, "red" and "blue," and trains are marked with signs on the front car.  VERY EASY to figure out, especially compared to more complicated east coast systems in Boston, NYC, New Jersey Transit, Philadelphia, and D.C.

Amazing service. Amazing food.
