The negative reviews here are all correct. They have the worst customer service anywhere. They are extremely rude, and the owner/manager is the worst of everyone there. Avoid this place at all costs. There are a lot of great tile places in Nashville - do yourself a favor and choose one of them instead.

In a town where great Chinese food simply does not exist, Chinatown is pretty darn delicious and the closest we've got.

We ate here for lunch today after 18 months of living in Nashville.  How it took us so long, we'll never know!  We came after an intense workout and were HUNGRY, so we were able to sample quite a few items on the menu and enjoyed nearly everything we ate.

I chose the Mongolian Chicken lunch special, which came with brown rice, egg drop soup and a chicken spring roll.  It was a great deal for less than $7, and while the portion was small, everything that came with my lunch was freshly prepared and piping hot.  The soup was nicely flavored and not too salty, but the Mongolian Chicken was greasier than I like, especially because I asked for the dish to be prepared with as little oil as possible.

The fiance ordered Black Bean Chicken - a favorite of his from his lifetime of living in NYC - as well as the steamed dumplings.  He very much enjoyed his chicken, though remarked that something was missing that made it different from what he's used to.  However, he did like the nice pop of spice that Chinatown added to their recipe and said he'd order the dish again.  The fiance was also excited for the steamed dumplings, which he thought might be similar to the soup dumplings he misses so much from NYC.  They were indeed similar, though smaller and less soup-filled than the ones he loves.  Again, though, he'd order them upon returning to Chinatown.

Though we both enjoyed our food, we were a little put off by the service we received.  We found our waitress to be flippant and unfriendly, and we never received the soup noodles, oranges, or fortune cookies we saw other tables receiving when ordering similar items.  Considering we ordered from both the lunch and dinner menus and paid a nice (though reasonable) price for our lunch, we were disappointed that we didn't receive the same treatment as the other customers in the restaurant.

Regardless, for Chinese food that actually tastes like Chinese food, we'll be coming back soon for more.

I found some beautiful-looking tile on their website, and decided to go ahead and order some samples. 
In a nutshell: a month after placing the order, I'm still missing 2 of the 3 samples I ordered, and the shop has been essentially unresponsive about it.
At this point, I am not holding my breath that they will process my request for a refund, either.

I'm glad I'm only out the cost of a few samples and not a full order, but I definitely don't appreciate my time and money being wasted this way.

Caveat emptor.
Horrible service. The staff was very rude and took 1 hour 45 minutes for delivery when they stated it would be 40 to 45 minutes. Not sure how the pizza would be warm but it wasn't that great cold.
I love the cozy & comfortable setting.  Food is probably the best & authentic Chinese in Nashville.

Chinatown used to be wonderful.  Excellent food, friendly staff, and we loved going there.  Then they changed.  About the time they remodeled (about two years ago), they changed chefs.  What was once delicious, now is just average.  We used to love their General Tso chicken - it was so unusual in that it was so very lightly breaded and so flavorful.  Their egg drop soup was exquisite.  Since the remodel, we kept on trying it again, hoping it will be as good as it was.  Last visit was yesterday and it will be our last.  Alas, woe are we as it is now just another average Chinese restaurant in Nashville.

I have been going to this restaurant for years, but the last few year the ownership changed hands..and so did the dishes. The soups used to be fabulous and now they use water as their stock.. They are so disappointing. The Peking duck was unrecognizable. Please address the tasteless food issues! I want my Chinatown back!

Menu selection is pretty big. Food was tasty. Ordered peking duck, green beans, ma po tofu and braised pork. Only thing I didn't like was the ma po is supposed to be extremely hot. It was about as hot as a jalapeno pepper. 

Went around 7pm on Friday. Place was packed but service was good.

This Burger King should be closed.  It's worthless!  They are slow, they can't get an order correct to save their own necks, the place is dirty, the food you do get is lukewarm at best, do I need to continue?  No matter how many times I've tried them or how many different things I've tried it has made no difference.  They are just awful!!  The last time they served us RAW chicken after we waited 15 minutes for our food, which we of course didn't realize until we got home.  Enough said.  Go there at your own risk and if you have the patience of a saint.  Mine ran out with the raw chicken.

The food is great reminds me of New York Chinese food by far the best in Tennessee. I order from them all the time love the food! I would give 5 stars but Only problem is Delivery takes forever sometimes
This place is ridiculous, go To Louisville or Dal tile or traditions or somewhere else they are great places this place is the definition of sucking

I met Joe from Main Line Risk Management at a group event. He was a very fun and friendly guy. I had a couple insurance questions that he helped me with. He didnt pressure me or try to convince me to buy insurance from him. 

He is very knowledgeable in his field and friendly guy. I would recommend him to anyone who needs quality advice on insurance.

This used to be one of my favorite Chinese restaurants as the food was really authentic.  I don't know what has happened but my last several visits have left me very disappointed.  We had to send out hot and sour soup back the last few times as it was cold when served.  We got combination chow fun noodles last trip and they were tasteless (no seasoning) and you had to HUNT for the protein.  Supposed to be chicken, shrimp and beef but in a whole order I found 2 tiny shrimp and the chicken was in little pieces about the size of a pencil eraser.  The beef was nicer little slices like an inch square but you only got 5 pieces.  Only veggies I found were onions (green).  They used to serve a great ginger lobster dish for about $25 sometimes less if on special and that was a favorite.  Now the Lobster dish is $33 and change which is too much to get very often.  The time before my last dining experience we got a stir fry chicken dish (I forget the exact name on the menu) and while it had more seasoning (spicy) it was short on protein - had to hunt for the chicken - all veggies no chicken.  I think they are doing this to control food costs but I would prefer they raise the prices $1 or $2 and put the protein back on the plate.

AMAZING!! The food was fresh and delicious.  The bartender/waitress Natalie was cheerful and on top of it. As the bar got busier than service was still great. I will definitely be eating lunch here again & again..

It's not bad, it's not great.

My biggest complaint is so many freaking onions! Really, this place will have you thinking China only has meat and onions. So many onions. I mean, if onions are your jam, I got the place for you. They also didn't take out the digestive tract in shrimp.

But the green beans are awesome! Crisp tender and oily but not too much. I would be happy to eat green beans with seasoned meat all day.

In the other places I've lived this would have been a 2. But it's 'Chinese' in Nashville so what can we do?
The most reent time I visited, my dining companion ordered the country style tofu and the straw mushrooms were back! I was so excited to order it the next time I go.
I've been going to Chinatown for years....really enjoyed our dinner this weekend

I was having visitors and placed a large order.  The delivery time was reported to be 45 mins....it took over 2 HOURS!!!  I called in a couple of times, got lots of excuses and was told the drivers is almost there. Got our order and it was cold and soggy.  Our estimation was that it wouldn't have tasted much better hot and fresh.  Gyro calzone had two strips is gyro meat in it.  The Buffalo Calamari had no sauce and was the worst calamari I've ever had.  My card had already been charged and no credit was offered.  Was told I would have to call in and talk to the manager to get some kind of concession.  Manager wasn't available and didn't call me back.  NEVER AGAIN.

FIRST AND LAST TIME ORDERING FROM THIS PLACE!!!

I am extremely disappointed with the service provided by Pizza Famiglia for 4 reasons I will list bellow:

1- Delivery was estimated at 45 minutes; it took them 2 hours; the flier under my hotel door said fast delivery;

2- The pizza was ice cold and mediocre in taste and quality at best;

3- A free 2-liter-soda was to come with my special order; the delivery man said they had run out of it and gave us 2 cans of Pepsi (I ordered diet Coke).

4-I had called twice asking why it was taking so long and, I kept getting the same answer: "It will be there any minute now".

In conclusion,NEVER AGAIN!

Got delivery, actually ordered it through the hotel "in room service" called OrderInn.com.  Was told the order would take 45- 1 hour.  But he would try to get it out sooner if possible.  1.5 hours later, I called back and he said they got a bunch of orders and they would be here in 30-45 minutes.  Why didn't I cancel?  I should have.  The pizza wasn't hot.  It is hard to review a pizza that has been sitting out too long, so I won't.  The driver was polite and apologetic, but no offer to discount or waive the $23.20 for a 4 topping 16" pizza.  

So many things wrong with this one, I blame myself for not heading the warning signs.

We went for lunch last Sunday.  The restaurant was about half full.  

What I didn't like:
The portion size, even for a lunch portion seemed too small to me.  I was not expecting a large vat of food, but I left still hungry.  
I am one who likes the sauce that stir-frys come with.  I like to let the rice soak it in.  Sadly, the sauce was lacking. 
I ordered "extra, extra, extra spicy".  They made some effort, but fell quite short.

What I liked:
My order was not right off the menu, but they accommodated my special request without question.  
The small egg roll that accompanied the lunch special was quite tasty and the best part of my meal.
The service was quite good.

I live quite a ways from Green Hills, so I most likely would not go back there.  Even if it were close by, I think I may go elsewhere.

Loved it! The nursery had GORGEOUS potted flowers at 50% off and there was an awesome selection for it being Mother's Day. The flower shop across the street where you can pick your flowers and pots or vasew whatever. I got some orchids, roses and calla lillies along with vases for under $40 bucks for 4 moms. Who knew!? Any other place would have the regular rose bouquet at $15 already wilted. Definitely coming back.

One of my go to stores!! Staff is very friendly Kila one of the best cashiers there, she is amazing.. super friendly and nice to everyone. The specials on red meat are unbeatable there are always fresh and priced very well. If you have the chance to be served by Ben is the meat department he would do anything and everything to give you the best service that you can imagine. 
The store is now going under a renovation, but the great service doesn't stop... will be one of my favorite stores!! 
Great job!!

I stopped into this Burger King late morning for a REAL breakfast.   A Whopper!   This is a very nice BK.   Clean and open.  I liked sitting at the high top table in the middle of the dining room.  Service was quick and very friendly at the counter.  Whopper was great.  Overall experience was 5 star.

Chinatown is my go-to takeout place. The food is consistently yummy. No, it isn't the most authentic but when you are in a rush, there isn't a better place for takeout. The best part has to be the staff. They are always extremely friendly and offer free drinks while you wait for takeout. If they run out of something, they will go out of their way to make it right with you.

I think this place just hires the Wrong People? How hard can it be to have 12 mini Cinnibons ready with 18 hrs Notice??? Acted like they didn't even have an order. They did rush the Oder as we waited!

Absolutely the slowest drive through in existence. My fault ultimately though... Seems like I forget after six months and decide to give it another shot... Nope still the same. Actually writing this review while waiting in the "pull forward" spot. Last time I do this, and will remember to bookmark this review so when I forget just how bad it is I can help myself to a refresher before wasting another 20 minutes of my life sitting in this drive through.

We were referred to Mission by our contractor, and based on the showroom and initial design consultation we were initially impressed. However, we experienced let downs at every level of their operation and so I would avoid this place and go to the many other great tile companies in Nashville. Here is the run down:

Pros: 
- Nice showroom
- Convenient location

Cons: everything else
- Showroom - displays many brands of tile that they no longer can obtain. We settled on a design scheme we really liked only to be told during ordering that they were unable to order some of the tile we had chosen from their showroom. Very frustrating, but we were able to order from a competitor very easily (props to Esco at Triton Tile in Nashville)
- Ordering - after placing the order and getting charged, we found out that the sales person did not actually order the tile. This set our job back by a week.
- Order fulfillment - after getting an email from them that our tile had arrived, our contractor went to pick up the package only to be told that the tile wasn't there. He went back after they notified us again of the arrival only to be told AGAIN that the tile wasn't there. He was resourceful and talked to somebody else, and they found the tile in the warehouse.
- Order packaging - when our contractor opened the tile, he found that the tile had been packed in a way that the protective plastic sheets between each sheet of tile had adhered to the bottom. This ruined the rather expensive tile since it can't bond with the plastic on the bottom. 
- Customer service - we called Mission after each of these snafu's and they could never give us a straight answer. They referred us to a new manager who is based in DC and he never really delivered either. I gave him the courtesy of responding with some explanations prior to posting this review, but he was brusque and not interested in smoothing things over.

Summary: 
- Problems at every level of the organization. Avoid if you want a timely and smooth project.

It was literally disgusting. I couldn't even force myself to eat it. I ordered the vegetable delight and it was terrible. It came out all one color: pale green in a clear sauce. It was gooey and looked like spit with some broccoli and cabbage stuck in it. I also ordered a bubble tea and it was okay but you could taste the dust of the mix in it.
Not great!!!! We ordered food from here after the game (we're from out of town) after waiting an hr for the food everything was ice cold we had to reheat everything. Never again!!!

Have ordered from this place a few times hoping it would get better. Today I have waited 1 hour 10 minutes for a Caesar Salad and lasagna. Perhaps this is the last time I order.  My order came 1 hour and 40 minutes after ordering.  The lasagna was good, but for the wait, I could have cooked it myself.

Chinatown is a solid choice for a Chinese dining experience!  For starters, our waitress was extremely friendly.  The place was clean and, while not packed, had a fair number of diners.  We tried Mongolian beef and the hot and sour soup both of which were standard, delicious Chinese food fare.  While it was nothing spectacular, it was exactly what I wanted at the time and it was delicious.  I think this will be my new go-to place for take out.

I ordered takeout, and the lady was super friendly on the phone and in person. The food was delicious and was ready in less than 15 minutes. I will definitely be adding this place to my take-out list!

This place is my regular midnight joint to grab n go food! I love their fries and their burgers...the staff is super friendly and requests the Customer's very promptly to wait for their order if there is any delay, not every time though!
Whenever I feel hungry during late nights, First thing comes to my mind is checkers...I'm never a macD or 
Burger King fan however I love burgers...checkers has it in them the bun they use has sesame seeds and the chicken is fresh and very tender, their fries are out of this world and crunchy until the last bit of it:))) I recommend this place to many of my friends;)

This is one of the worst locations in the St. Louis County area. The locations on The Rock Road and Manchester are much better. The staff will argue with you about your order if it's wrong.

Beware when you order here.
Great place!  Better customer service than others. Should make sure they have their beer stocked if they are going to offer it as a part of the deal.

For us, Chinatown had always had the best "American" Chinese food in town but we've never been huge fans of that style.  So when we heard that they have moved on to offer more traditional Chines offerings we had to give it a try.  We made a slight mistake going on Chinese New Year (it was packed!) but the food was worth the wait.

We only had two dishes (stir fried green beans and the crazy spicy chicken) but it's clear that they are on the right track to offering the most authentic Chinese food north of the Corner Asian Cafe in Brentwood.  That said, they still have a ways to go--the spicy chicken was only mildly spicy and while both dishes are obviously Szechuan-inspired, neither had any Szechuan peppercorns.  That was slightly disappointing but  not a deal breaker

We're eager to go back to try other dishes.  It's definitely worth a look.

We went in here on Saturday 1/7/12 with Gift Cards we had received for Christmas. I am not a Burger King fan in ANY way but thought I would give them a try since it was a gift card. We gave them our order, gift card in hand, and when we went to pay with the Gift Cards the cashier said "our Gift Cards are down, I can't accept that". Now at that point I should have told her to void the order & walk out, but we paid cash instead. I filled my soda & when the manager (an older woman named Barb)gave us our food I said "Can we have your number here so we can call ahead next time to see if your gift card machine is working before driving 20 minutes to get here?" She RUDELY said "Our Credit card machine is down so we cant accept gift cards". She never apologized, never gave me their number, nothing. I said "Maybe you should hang a sign on your door or register then so people dont order then find this out". At this point I was boiling because I just dont get where these people with such attitudes come from in service positions. I watched the manager, she was snippy with every customer that she had communication with. The other thing I noticed (I had my eye on every customer the cashier rang out to see how they were paying) was that the cashier took credit cards from almost everyone. So what was Broken?! The Credit Card machine, debit card machine or gift card machine?! I would think they would all be ran on the same machine, but who am I?  

They still had their Gift Cards sitting on the counter for customers to buy. Why would they not take the display down or hang a sign on it stating the machine (whatever that means) is broken? It was 2 weeks after Christmas, did they not think people would be coming in with Gift Cards. 

My friend told me "after" I had already bought him the gift card for Christmas that 5 years ago he had a heck of a time using a BK gift card because he couldn't find a BK to take them. I thought, surely that was 5 years ago & things have changed. NOPE!! Had I known BK doesn't like to honor their gift cards I NEVER would have bought him one. Mine was given to me as a gift also, I intend to pitch mine & will NEVER visit a BK again. 

The employees here are rude. Food not worth the money. Gift Card redemption sucks!!! Stay away!!!
i got the general tso's chicken, which is my favorite dish. i was disappointed because there was too much breading. i couldn't even taste the actally chicken. :(

I'm not a big camper...in fact, I'd only ever been camping once before the weekend I rented from Fireside.  The owner put all my fears to rest over the phone and scheduled me to come and take a look at the tents and other camping supplies.  The service was very friendly, AFFORDABLE, and convenient (I rented on a Friday and was able to return it on Tuesday for no extra charge) which was ideal for my cramped time schedule.  I highly recommend Fireside!

We stopped in here to browse around for the first time the other day. The store was smaller than I was expecting. However they have a well curated collection of camping items. It's definitely on the pricier side but I appreciate that they carry items that are American and locally made. I think they could benefit from having some more inventory in store. They do rent tents and other camping supplies. All of that info is on their website or you can chat with someone there or on the phone. Very helpful when I called to ask about camping tent rental for my wedding. Nice shop and great place to grab an outdoorsy gift or supplies for yourself.

I went in after shaving my head to get my neck shaped up.I explained that I wanted to keep a feminine, soft vibe. Torie shot straight with me and shared her opinion and recommendations. She explained exactly what needed to be done to the back and sides to pretty things up a bit. She understood what I was hliI'm definitely coming back and next time, she can do the whole thing. 

Update: 8/22/2018
I came back for a haircut with Torie and she did a beautiful job. Aside from giving me a great haircut, Torie is a light! Full of positivity and beautiful energy. Your day will get better just by talking with her. Thanks again.

I love Chinatown! The service is always exceptionally friendly and attentive. They have a great selection of vegetarian dishes. The Curry Vegetables are fabulous - great flavor, fresh veggies. I often add fried tofu to my dishes, which they offer as a side dish. The menu is very affordable and the quality is high consistently. This is actually the only Chinese restaurant in Nashville that I go to. It's not fancy, but it's good.

This Winn Dixie had finally earned 5 stars!  Once they brought the new manager Dave in,  he has done a great job turning this store around.  Fresh produce,  better selection and consistent supply of meat,  and just a much cleaner store.  The cashiers seem to be better trained as well.  Keep up the good work!

Susan was wonderful! She is helpful, knowledgeable and kind. She never made us feel pressured into buying a bed and didn't try to push us into the most expensive option. 

They use a pressure sensor bed to help you find your sleep number (pretty cool) and they let you try ALL the beds out to feel the differences.

It felt like their main goal is to get you into a bed that is best for you. We just put ours together last night (which was easier to assemble than most IKEA furniture kits) and we're loving it! 

The bed feels and looks like it is made of quality materials and even has a 25 year warranty! I can sleep easy (haha) knowing that I have 100 days to return the bed if I am not 100% satisfied. 

Check out their financing deals they have going on... Just an idea: if you can't afford one of the nicer beds you could get a basic model and then buy a foam topper from somewhere else (Costco?).

One star is harsh, but this place rarely gets my order right. No exaggeration, including today, I'll bet they've forgotten to give me an item 4 or 5 times. That's out of maybe 7 visits in the last year. 

Judging by the strange dual drive through waiting spots, they're being pushed for speed. It doesn't work out well when they can't assemble a complete order.

I was having a tough time deciding how to review this one.  The food just wasn't quite right but I couldn't put my finger on it.  Then a few days later I got the rare opportunity to eat at my favorite Chinese place back home and that made my review crystal clear.

I ordered to go and got Sweet and Sour Chicken, Vegetable lo mien, chicken fried rice and a couple of spring rolls.  I don't know if the time of night had to do with it, but the sweet and sour chicken and chicken fried rice were slightly dried out.  The sweet and sour chicken was tiny, hard pellets of chicken.  The lo mien wasn't edible, leaving me unable to find edible lo mien in the city so far.  Nashville lo mien as a whole is best described as inedible goup in my experience.  The spring rolls were delicious though and while slightly dry, the rest of the food was at least edible.

I can't tell you how disappointed I was, especially since I was told this was one of the best Chinese places in Nashville.  Looking at other reviews leads me to believe that some of their dishes are better than others, so I will go back and try their "best" dishes.

The service was excellent and the food was the most edible Chinese food I have found thus far, so I gave it that third star.   I agree with other reviewers that the food is average at best.

Well the five stars is for the morning drive through crew today. I don't eat BK food but on this rainy Tuesday I pulled in for my caffeine . The squak box at drive through had a very pleasant female greeter. U proceeded to the window And Angela was so upbeat she energized my day. She then advised my first coke was prepaid by the car ahead of me . Totally great karma here. Come back just for that. If I was hiring Angela would be dONE at BK .
Very friendly with good food. Got lunch sweet and sour chicken and Szechuan chicken both good with good portion. Came with small egg rolls.

Only complaint..the egg rolls are dinky and suck. Other than that everything was fantastic...fresh ingredients, hot, great flavor.  I'm a snob when it comes to Chinese delivery, and even w the eat24 delivery fee I'll order again.  2 thumbs up
Egg rolls a joy as always, but....they've gotten smaller so if you're looking for nice size egg rolls this isn't the place. I love that they are made fresh, just too small.

We tried out this place without checking yelp reviews, so we were relieved that the food was great and offered real Taiwanese platters.  We ordered  a fish with black bean platter, bok choy with mushrooms, and shrimp steamed dumplings.  I can honestly say that it was all amazingly good! Y husband is Taiwanese and gave his approval of the food as well, which is a plus for me!  I also enjoyed the free wonton crisps and dipping sauce, they give when they seat you.  Staff were all very friendly and helpful!  Overall it was a positive experience and we would definitely recommend this place.

I'm a female with short hair and I've gone through countless people trying to find the perfect haircut. Erin nailed it on the first try. She has consistently given me styles that are edgy but feminine. She is very patient and caring; she takes a ton of time to talk through what I want, and patiently teaches me how to style it. She's the best in Nashville for short cuts on women.

I had delivery.  It was disappointing.  The lasagna had more sauce than lasagna & the portion was small-very small for the price.  No parmigiana cheese was included.  The pizza was basically fine but, nothing to jump up & down about.  If I reordered -it would only be for pizza.

The food was pretty good. Bubble tea is great! Service left us looking at each other every time she walked away. When we asked what was in the steamed dumplings she said idk..... Chicken? If you study the menu before you go and know what to order right away. Like as soon as you open your menu you'll be good. Will be back for bubble tea.

Probably the best chinese in Nashville.  Don't make it up to green hills too often, but it is good, old school and has great, fresh made egg rolls. Unlike a lot of the Chinese that use prefab, Chinatown seems to be cooking from scratch.
Great food, even better service!! Even won some money gambling at one of the machines. Tasha is a wonderful bartender not to mention beautiful! All around great atmosphere!! I'll be back for sure!!

Now I didn't actually go full on grocery shopping, so I can't compare the prices based on Winn Dixie, Publix or Walmart.  But, it was very clean and had allot of variety.  It's the small things that are important to me, like variety in cheeses, spices, sauces, and what they have in their own brand.  I always go to Walmart for the low cost & array of choices, but I think I may try sweetbay for my next full on grocery experience

Okay um... Yesterday I ordered a order of  10 wings and a large fries and I have to tell you the wings had no I mean absolutely no sauce on the wings no what so ever poor taste and the wings also tasted aged...it was my first time ordering there but that won't happen ever again!!!!!

I go to this Burger King every once in awhile. The food is always good. The restaurant is pretty clean. The soda machine is usually either out of the soda I want or the nozzle is broken and spays every where. One of the managers there is not very friendly and gets on my nerves. Today they had a new employee, who has been on the job for three days, and he is awesome. Very friendly, welcomes everyone as they come through the door, walks around during down time and asks if every thing was good and takes trash from the tables to the trash can.

This Checkers location has decent food. Its not the best but ive never had a bad meal. Beware, if you decide to sit out and eat there, you will be asked for money from local homeless people and people just getting out of jail. It happens to me everytime.  But I go there on late nights for ice cream and its really good.

Very professional business. I wish I had called them first. Mr. Sauter explained everything clear, concisely and made recommendations based on his professional experience and my needs.

I had attempted to work with several other companies and they were either unavailable, didn't respond or attempted to schedule a series of appointments "Your Chimney Sweep" accomplished in one day.

I would be happy to do business with them again and most likely will with no reservations.
Knowledgable and friendly staff. Top quality products and dog friendly.  Awesome get togethers over smores, camping classes and such.  Great store.

Took the fam to dinner tonight and was delighted that the kids enjoyed the food. Family friendly and great/friendly service. The gentleman running the restaurant told my boys that if they ate their food he'd give them ice-cream - it worked.

Not the most authentic, but yummy.

I come to this location fairly often. The management is very nice. The service is good, the employees are respectful. Everytime the food comes out hot. The cleanliness is above average for a fast food establishment. There is not much more you can ask for from a fast food restaurant. The only reason I am not giving them 5 stars is that it is still fast food.

I love this place. I come here for lunch almost every time I come to green hills. I've tried several different items and they are always fresh and delicious. Staff is friendly And fast. Prices are great for the food, portions are always generous!

I should have read reviews before trying this place. I got a flyer at my apartment and wanted to try somewhere new, supporting non-chains...I was asked to wait on the phone for 5 minutes and told me to wait when a customer walked into the store, but I let that go... I ordered Mozzarella sticks, eggplant parm (comes with tossed salad and breadsticks) and a cannoli.  I asked if there was a way I could pay a little extra to upgrade from a tossed salad to the antipasto.  When I completed my order, he told me the order came to $25 (He took 1 dollar off of my bill for the change in pasta... thanks) and told me my food would be delivered to me in 45-55 minutes. When they finally arrived, it had been an hour and 25 minutes, and on top of that, the delivery man forgot a pen then proceeded to be on his phone the entire time (I don't believe in not tipping, so I begrudgingly gave him a $3 tip). The mozzarella sticks were luke warm, the eggplant was mushy, and the salad was not what I expected.  To top that off, I never received my breadsticks.  I was hoping the saving grace would be the $3 cannoli. Being Italian and having wonderful cannolis from the North End in Boston, I had pretty high hopes.  Even so, it was terrible. The shell was abnormally hard, and the filling was way too watery.  I feel like I way overpaid for what I got. Needless to say, I won't be ordering from there anymore and not recommending to others around the USF area. Terrible service, and disappointing food.
Ordered delivery - it was the worst Chinese food I've ever eaten.  I couldn't even eat it.  I don't like giving negative reviews but felt compelled to warn others about eating here!

Oh me, oh my.  I so wanted to love my chicken chow fun today, but it was really very forgettable.  Chicken was nonexistent, thin, overcooked, tasteless.  The flavor in the dish itself was non-existent.  The noodles were thin and lifeless.  I was hoping for the real thing, but real Chinese in Nashville is just a pipe dream.  No, I'll have to go back to Boston or San Fran for Chinese food with state of the art flavor and preparation;  I even had a Chinese meal a month ago in Boynton Beach, Florida that rivaled Chinatown by miles.  Nice people, like the spiffed up décor but I don't really care what the place looks like as long as the food rocks.  Of course, local folk who have never tasted authentic Chinese food may enjoy this place (it was packed today), but my memories are just too good to fool my tastebuds.

What an amazing experience. Christina and her staff are kind, friendly and professional. The salon itself is gorgeous- white brick with gold accents. I got hair extensions and I LOVE THEM!! Christina applied them and did an incredible job. I loved getting to know Taylor and Danni, they were so sweet and wonderful. If I could give more stars I would. Thank you to Christina and her entire staff! I will be back!!!

It's hard to find good Chinese food/resturants in Nashville and I'm not near as picky as I used to be having been raised in NY.  I've found some tasty if not on the money authentically good Chinese in town and this wasn't it. Neither the service nor food was to my satisfaction. Thank God I saved  via an Entertainment coupon. 

 .............. First of all nobody greeted us because one was napping and the other was reading .... and they didn't notice us. Then, the waitress was rush rush about everything, she came back like every 30 seconds to see if we knew what we wanted to order, later kept checking to see if we were ready to pay after giving us the check .... and we were still eating. There were 2 of us and we got 2 agreed upon dishes to split.  We didn't know egg-rolls came with it.  I overheard someone else giving their order later on and apparently you get to choose soup or egg-roll, which I would have chosen soup if asked, but she just delivered a couple egg rolls without asking.  They were tiny and looked and tasted more Thai than Chinese.  The beef and broccoli had decent texture but the sauce was thin and its taste was bland. Adding soy sauce only really salted it but didn't add the missing flavor.  The sweet and sour chicken had a good batter but the sauce was thin and bland as well.  

We will NOT be back.

I live in NY and the restaurants around Chinatown are usually pretty crappy.

This spot deserves better than 3.5 stars for being in Nashville. You just need to know what to order.

Ginger and scallion lobster
Sautéed snow pea leaves
Crispy tofu 

Are all pretty good
I go here every so often. I have never had a problem with receiving the wrong food. Service is decent. The only down side is sometimes the drive through takes forever.

Had lunch here on Friday. There used to be a restaurant reviewer on the radio in Los Angeles named Elmer Dill. I used to listen to him every Sunday, after the Dodgers game. He used to go back to a restaurant several times before giving his review to make sure one visit wasn't a fluke. 
He also had a "rule" that I've found true over the years. He'd always order soup, because if the restaurant couldn't make good soup, don't have high expectations for the rest of the meal. I've tried most of their soups now, and Chinatown doesn't live up to Elmer's expectations. Nor sadly mine any longer.
I love this place...calzones are not what im used too from up north they seem kind of empty but i love the pizza here.

I always walk out of Rudy's feeling confident and looking good.The stylists there are really down to earth and personable. They are all very talented! I recommend Erin, but you can't go wrong with ANY of these talented people.

This is one of the nicest Winn-Dixie's in the area. it is large, has a wide variety of food, in offers the best customer service I have found at a Winn-Dixie store.

I find the store to be welcoming, clean, and have a friendly knowledgeable staff. the produce is always fresh and there is a wide variety available. The meat is cut fresh daily and offers some fair prices. Actually one of the things is their varietyand of seafood & the prices that they offer it at.

The deli in the bakery are not as extensive as a Publix but, it offers a wide variety of different types.of products. Check out was easy and I had no problem finding anything in the store. that always makes everything better than having to search for everything.

What's a girl to do? Go to the stores that offer the items you like to eat at a fair price.

I live in Nashville and have eaten at Chinatown numerous times plus take out dinner very frequently as we'll.  I ate there tonight for the first time since they remodeled. The restaurant itself is much nicer inside and very inviting. They have a fresh fish tank like ones I have seen in other Chinese restaurants in large city Chinatowns. I ordered the Hot and Sour soup which was good as usual. For an entree I wanted fresh fish since they had live fish in the tanks. What a disappointment! There was much skin, tail, head, bones, but very minimal edible meat. This was a huge disappointment especially considering the price of more than $19. I will go back but never order the "fresh fish" again.

Whoppers! Whoppers! Whoppers! And no, not those nasty chocolate malt ball candies, eww... We're talking flame-broiled burger with lettuce, tomatoes, onions, cheese and mayo, even extra-mayo if you're feeling daring. And boy, am I a daring guy, haha. 

Now, eating at Burger King is something I try to keep to a minimum for the obvious health reasons. But every now and then, I go and grab a Whopper meal. It comes with the juicy, flame-broiled Whopper, fries and a drink. Brings me back to the "big" days when I used to eat five of them in one sitting. Mmm, mmm, mmm. 

The Burger King in Creve Coeur is definitely the closest to where I live, and the service is nice and friendly. If you're on the go near Creve Coeur and need a cheap meal, grab a Whopper meal!

This restaurant was recommended by so many friends as the BEST Chinese around town, so I decided to give it a try after 3 years of living in Green Hills. I was pretty disappointed. I ordered Chicken Fried Rice and it was not great what so ever... 

We also had Mongolian Beef and that was much, much better! I would give it another try and would NOT order chicken fried rice!

I went in after shaving my head to get my neck shaped up.I explained that I wanted to keep a feminine, soft vibe. Torie shot straight with me and shared her opinion and recommendations. She explained exactly what needed to be done to the back and sides to pretty things up a bit. She understood what I was going for. I'm definitely coming back and next time, she can do the whole thing.

My husband and I have been searching for a place in Nashville with good Chinese take-out. We were hoping Chinatown was "The One," but unfortunately it was just OK. 

We ordered Mongolian Beef and Kung Pao chicken. While it tasted healthy, we found the dishes lacked meat and flavor. 

The prices are ok (around $8 an entree), and all the employees are super nice. 

I am definitely willing to give it another try, but our quest for good Chinese continues.. to infinity and beyond!

This Chinese restaurant beats all the other Chinese restaurants in town. I tried Kung Pao chicken and man oh man, it was really delicious! I also tried their general tso and it was just as good. You must also try their bubble tea. It is really good! The place is super clean, has really nice decor and very friendly staff. I went to this restaurant with a group of friends on one of my friend's birthday. We surprised my friend with a cake and the waitstaff was accommodating to bring the cake at the end of the meal to
Surprise my friend. They even stuck around to sing happy birthday! Overall, really good food and ambiance. Give this a place a try, you won't regret it. The best Chinese restaurant in town!

The only reason why I give this 4 stars instead of 5 is because I felt like it was missing something. Overall, good food!

Ugh - it pains me that these are closing.  I am thankful for the one that is near my house.

1.  The produce is always fresh.
2. They have a great meat selection - for a really good price.
3. The liquour store attached always has a special, which I appreciate.

The staff is always helpful and willing to go the extra mile whenever asked.  I will continue to support this location as long as it stays open.

B. Major Grade: A

One of my favorites in Nashville when I'm craving Chinese.

I used to pass Chinatown every day on my way home from work, and when it was raining, I would often be lured in.  What is it with rain and craving Chinese food?

I always had very pleasant experiences here with the service.  Whether I called in an order to go or ate in, everyone has always been super friendly.  

They have good lunch specials that come with soup, an eggroll, and fried rice plus a generous entree portion.  I love their hot and sour soup and fried rice.  I also like their lo mein a lot and sesame chicken.  I've never had anything bad here.  

The atmosphere is plain but welcoming and cozy, and usually not crowded.  They serve wine and that makes me happy as well. :)

Sudden and dramatic decline in food taste. Chinatown used to be my favorite Chinese restaurant, but the last 2 times I visited, the food was unbearable bad. The same friendly waitresses, but terrible untasteful food. I wonder if the cook or ownership changed in the past year.

Given the glowing reviews left here by others, one would think the food would have actually been good, but it was merely mediocre. 

I ordered food through Doorstep Delivery; that service, prompt and professional, was the ONLY bright spot of my whole experience. 

I ordered crab rangoon, hot and sour soup, and garlic shrimp. Pretty straight forward fare, but again, given all the great reviews about having found good Chinese food in Nashville, I had high-ish expectations.

The crab rangoon was unremarkable. It was accompanied by what seemed to be a bucket full of that bright red colored high-fructose corn syrup they give people for a dipping sauce. If diabetes caused by morbid obesity has a flavor, it's that cloyingly sweet, thick, florescent red dipping sauce. Mmmmm . . . yummy.

Much to my dismay, the hot and sour soup I ordered turned out to be won ton soup. It tasted like every other won ton soup I've ever been given mistakenly in my Chinese carry-out or delivery orders: watery chicken broth accompanied by a couple of glutenous, tough dumplings containing a few microscopic grains of some strong tasting mystery meat. That is why, as a general rule, I don't order won ton soup. I don't know why I seem to get won ton soup 2 out of 3 times I order soup from a Chinese restaurant, but I'm beginning to think it's a conspiracy to bore to death people who like food with flavor. 

The garlic shrimp neither smelled nor tasted like garlic. I think if a dish is going to have garlic highlighted as main ingredient, they ought to use some garlic in the preparation of said dish, don't you?  $13.95 for a handful of crudely cut zucchini, onions, formerly frozen pea pods, canned water chestnuts, and bell peppers with a few small shrimp waved over the top of the aforementioned brown, garlic-less sauce cost about $8 more than it should have. 

If you are looking for good Chinese food in Nashville, skip this place. The food here is just as bland and awful as almost every other place in town. I swear they all get the same pre-prepared junk from the Chinese equivalent of Sysco or Gordon's Food Service; as such, Chinatown might as well be Applebee's.

Ridiculously rushed service ruined what was intended to be a nice family dinner. I ordered the edamame and hot & sour soup to come out together with the other entrees, since we ordered four apps to start. First my soup came out, followed a few minutes later by the four apps, immediately followed by my edamame.  She even presented it to me by saying, "your entree" while trying to find space on the table. When the other 3 entrees were delivered just a few minutes later,  the guy delivering our food just stood there, looking at our completely cluttered, full tabletop with appetizers we hadn't had time to finish and asked if he should bring it back later.  Our waitress just proceeded to push and stack plates to make some room.  So, now on the table: soup, edamame, 4 appetizers, 4 appetizer plates, 2 bowls of rice and 3 different entrees.  We just looked at each other in shock - it was 2 hours until closing time, we didn't understand the rush.  We had no choice but to roll with it.  The worst offense was when our waitress actually brought to-go boxes to the table when we were clearly still eating. (And hadn't asked for boxes.) We had been seated for less than 35 minutes at this point, so we certainly were not just lingering.  

The pros: hot & sour soup was good, pineapple shrimp was very good, pan-fried dumplings were good. 

The cons: obviously the service.  We'll give it another chance, making sure we are in another server's section.  Also receiving negative points is the duck.  My boyfriend had to cut around a lot of bones and gristle, and said that the ratio of actual duck meat to gristle was not worth the price or effort.  

With so many good reviews and a few dishes with promise, we will give it one more shot (asking for a different server) and hope that this was a one-time fluke.

Ioved here from new York and honestly I pretty much gave up on any food that would "taste" like n.y. As soon as I arrived with my brother in law I said that " if they give the good old crunchy noodles and duck sauce" before anything else that is a good sign. Mannn.... They brought the "fat super crunchy noodles. Awesome start! Speeding up here, the service was ridiculous from beginning to end. Nothing was forgotten and they seemed to know when to check on the table. The food tasted like home... No I'm not from China because if I were I would have asked for kung po frog legs and veges mandarin style. " Don't think that they have that. All around href! I even felt bad paying a bill of 23$ for 2 meals, soup and a nice spring roll appetizer. As I was leaving I asked the owner if any of the chefs are from n.y. or at least spent a significant amount of time cooking in restaurants there. Yep! Anyway... Great for a date or just to go enjoy with a friend. I know that people differ in their taste preference from state to to state but give them a try! Nice people that work hard to give you a great experience.

The food is just GROSS! I am relatively new to Nashville and am on the look out for a good To-go Chinese Restaurant.. This is definitely NOT the place... Everything here was terrible... Never ever coming back here again... I had to throw out my leftovers.. the thought of eating it again made me sick!

Great service and great Chinese food!

Their shrimp is excellent along with their General chicken. Bubble tea is okay too. I'm always treated like royalty when I come here. The servers are super sweet!

It's my new favorite Chinese spot!
The best Chinese food I've found in Nashville. I always get the kung pao and it's always great. The owners are super friendly, portions and pricing are good, too.

Definitely a solid Chinese restaurant! They had a big selection, the hosts were super friendly and nice, and the food was tasty. The Spring Roll was a little small, but still tasted good, and the portions of the meals were quite large. Great place to find when passing through Nashville
Worst pizza ever! The delivery took about an hour and a half, and the waiting wasn't even worthy, horrible pizza, it was cold, just some pieces of ham and  chewy mass

I was staying at a local hotel and had this menu under my door. i decided to order dinner tonight tuesday at around 4pm. while the delivery was fine my food was not. i ordered a childs portion of spaghetti and  meat balls. the size was good but there was about 2 tablespoons of sauce on it. I basically got noodles and some meatballs. I also ordered the pasta famiglia which contained chicken and shrimp the shrimp weren't done and the food was luke warm bordering on cold. Very unappy with my order 2 pasta dishes cost me around 15.00 and it was not worth it

First customer of the day so service was pretty quick.  They bring wantons out to the table with a sweet sour type dip, kinda like Mexican restaurants do with chips and salsa. Place is very clean and comfortable atmosphere.  I had the lunch special pepper steak.  came with fried rice, eggroll and soup.  Price was very reasonable.  Food came out very quicklly but I was the only table when I ordered.  about 5 more tables were sat while I was there.  Egg drop soup was very good as well as the pepper steak.  Lunch portion is on the small side.  I would consider it a lite lunch.  If your really hungry order a regular portion.
The service is always nice! The starting appetizer is good and free! You can get very authentic Chinese food here!!!
This place was a find. Great thin and crispy crust and nice fresh toppings. We had the 2 mediums special, a pitcher and a 2 liter soda for $30. We loved it! Thanks guys!

Had to write a great review because I love this place and come here regularly with my boyfriend or roommates. First of all, the staff are all personable and friendly. They really make you feel at home and welcome. Their deals are AMAZING. Where else can you get 6 wings a slice of pizza and a soda for 6.99? (PickUp) Not only that, but everything tastes great too. My favorite are their mild wings, prob one of my favorite places to eat wings. Def. Recommend.
Food here is amazing, all of it. The chef, Brad, has love for cooking. Angela is the best bartender in Reno when you're looking for mixed drinks.

First, let me start by saying this isnt nearly as good as the chinese food you find in New York City's Chinatown - but, for Nashville, its the best we have found in town by far. 

I really like this place. We order pretty much the same thing every time we go. Start with the green onion pancakes and crab ragoons. Both are always hot and delicous. They aren't greesy and are served with appropriate (and different) sauces. For mains, we always order off menu general tso's beef, beef belly in hot pot and either sizzling beef or mongolian beef. The beef belly in hot pot is amazing - it comes out already boiling in this beautfiul stew sauce, large beef chucks braised down and tender and served with baby bok choy thats been still holding its form with a bit of crunch but soft and tender - so delish! 

For chinese food in Nashville, this is the place to go!

We went to busch gardens and received a flyer for Pizza Famiglia at our hotel. I went and picked it up. It was waiting on my arrival. We got a large pizza and salad. It was quite economical aound 17$. All the food was good. Nothing exceptional. Better than fast food pizza, but not great.

This place is pretty terrible. We ordered soup dumplings. These were obviously frozen and bought from across the street at Trader Joe's. Do yourself a favor and go to the farmer's market. Green Asia is much much better!

Ordered cashew chicken for take out. Was terribly disappointed. Chicken was far and few between (really....no more than a few bites) and the entire box was filled with cheap filler veggies (i.e., celery). Friendly/funny owner but subpar food. Will not be going back.

They were improving. Honestly, they were! New owners, imported chefs. No MSG. Using potato starch instead of corn starch. Oh, they still didn't have spareribs, and the food was hit or miss, depending on which chef you got, but they were actually turning into a real Chinese restaurant.
We had high hopes of an actual Chinese menu, complete with jellyfish.
Alas and alack. All their energy - and their good staff, and their good chefs, and Joyce the hostess who actually listened and went to bat for things like "Please, make it really hot!" - are all concentrated on their dim sum restaurant. (I've only been there once, it was miserable, but in fairness I would try it again just in case.)
Our order tonight, and thoughts on same
Hot & Sour Soup: Oh for Pete's sake, this is a staple! We ordered a large, which turned out to be hot liquid poured into two cheap plastic containers. The soup was all right once I doctored it with a ton of chili oil. 
Moo Shu Chicken, no egg: Pancakes were actually under-cooked, tasted like raw dough. Moo Shu was pretty tasteless.
Brown rice: Was okay. Steamed, maybe. Flavorless.
Salted Crispy Whole Shellless Shrimp: 1. Was supposed to be spicy. Not. 2. Dreadfully overcooked. Dredged in something (flour? panko? who knows) and fried within an inch of their lives. If you tried to peel away the outside, the shrimp came with it. 3. With shells attached, as well as tails. 4. Tasteless.
Bok Choy with Black Mushroom: This used to be a house favorite, but it was so bad that we ended up throwing it out. How you can make something so tasteless is beyond me.

I really do wish Nashville had ONE "basic Western Chinese" restaurant. New York style. Garlic sauteed spinach. Spareribs. All the regular stuff.
By the way, they've gotten skimpy on the mustard, too. We got two containers, each about 1/4 full of hot mustard. Which wasn't hot.
As I said to my wife, "This is always a good reminder not to eat Chinese food in Nashville." Sad but true. Stick with Vietnamese and Thai.

YCS came highly recommended and i'm so glad we picked them! Bryan came out to clean & inspect our 1915 fireplace. It was decided that a wood-burning stove insert was the best option for our circumstances. Joe, Bryan & Dan came out and installed it. Then Joe gave us the wood-burning stove 101 tutorial and gave us oodles of important information to properly use our stove. Bryan gave us the name & number of a great guy to get our wood from. We really appreciated how informative, trustworthy and great the guys were. And Jenny, who answers the phone was always so very friendly. We're so glad we chose YCS!

They slipped a flier under my hotel door. Wanted someone who delivered and thought I would give them a shot as it was not a chain restaurant. 

Ordered 2 pizzas and some salads. 

Pizza was average. Salad was basic but fresh. 

Delivery was estimated at 45 min and took 1 hour and 5 minutes. Not cool. 

They forgot extras that I requested: marinara and parmesan cheese. 

I would not order from them again if I lived here.

I love this place!!! I first found Rudy's when I lived in Seattle a few years back...great service and a relaxed welcoming vibe. I found the exact same experience today at the East Nashville location.  I was greeted and told ahead of time I could get an hour and half free parking just out back of the shop. Everyone was so friendly and my stylist was precious. She was very professional with the way she cut and styled my hair, but also very easy to talk to. It was my first time ever to have any kind of color on my hair...but I'm 54 and those crazy grays were popping out!!! She was so careful and reassuring with me. The outcome was fabulous!! Thank you Kirin and thank you Rudy's for being the company I remember.

On the basis of one visit, Nashville seems to finally have a Chinese restaurant worth eating at. For those who know the authentic cuisine, it is not the same as what one finds all around town just like BBQ sauce from a bottle on ribs does not make for real BBQ to those who love the smoke in the South. Of course, Chinatown is hardly new--it has been delivering the standard Americanized fare for years-which led me to avoid the place like I did so many others. But when I heard from the wholesale supplier of ingredients ingredients to Chinese restaurants in Nashville that they had hired new a new chef and revamped their menu, I could hardly wait to try. And the meny does include many things that are not for the faint-of-heart from beef tendon to chittlins. Indeed, if there is any pattern, it is that menu shows some Taiwanese dishes for the first time in Nashville. On the one visit, we tried the beef tendon appetizer, squad and pork, and pea greens. While I have had more tender, um, tendons (these were not sliced through and picked up like a line of paper dolls), the flavor with chili inflected oil was tasty. The Squid and Pork was a solid dish with some cabbage and black beans. The pea greens--long a favorite--did not disappoint--we were enraptured just to find it here. And so apparently were the number of asian patrons enjoying the food. So here is a hearty agreement with Nathan B. Now is this the best Chinese comparable to The San Gabriel Valley in California, the San Francisco Bay area, Flushing or Chinatown in New York City etc? Well not quite. But it good enough to save a trip to Marietta or Chamblee-Dunwoody for the the real deal. We are looking forward to returning...with our Chinese friends so that we can try more dishes.

TIP: If not getting a lunch special, try ordering a variety of dishes and sharing all dishes among your entire party (i.e., family style) for greater variety and a more authentic experience. 

FOOD: The food is is quite tasty and decently authentic (not the most authentic, but more so than typical American Chinese fare). I love their hot & sour soup.

SERVICE: Great service, very friendly and attentive staff! Very friendly! :)

PRICE/VALUE: The lunch special is really where it's at--so reasonable! GREAT value! If not ordering lunch specials, it gets a bit pricier. That said, it's still a good value.

OVERALL: Definitely recommend trying this place out, especially for lunch!

Sometimes it is hard to find a decent Chinese restaurant to go to. But after visiting Chinatown for my first time yesterday, I am hooked!

My fiance and I were both craving Chinese food recently after I finished my shift at work, so we decided to visit Chinatown and have an early lunch. The staff was very friendly and welcoming, and I loved the environment of the restaurant. Our waitress took our order (I ordered Chicken Fried Rice and an order of dumplings, and he ordered Sweet and Sour Chicken and an order of crab rangoons) and even brought us wonton soup and an egg roll on the house! Wonton soup is one of my favorite soups and it was delicious, and so was the egg roll.

Our food was brought to us very quickly. I had never tried crab rangoons before, so I was definitely excited to try them. Both the rangoons and the dumplings were delicious! The chicken fried rice was amazing...I almost couldn't finish my plate because the portions were so big. My fiance's sweet and sour chicken looked quite appetizing, and it was nice to see that they put the sauce on the side instead of slathering it all over the chicken like I see in typical Chinese restaurants.

All in all, I had a great experience and hope to visit again soon!
The food is isn't fresh, they have very fatty pork ,Made us sick all night in the bathroom.  Wont  be going back. Horrible experience.

Got delivery from this place. Ordered a medium Hawaiian pizza, hot wings, 2 liter of Pepsi and a gyro. Delivery time was quoted at 30 to 50 minutes. Took just over an hour, and they forgot my 2 liter of soda. Pizza was pretty good - Crust, and sauce was good. Ham was mushy... Hot wings were fantastic! Gyro was not very good at all.. I know, should have known better than to order a gyro from a pizza place right? Came to $29. 
The price was right on the wings. I recommend the hot wings, and the pizza.

I recently got take out from here - pan fried dumplings and Mongolian chicken. As I've only tried it once, I'm hesitant to give too stellar a review, but the food was great. I'm not a connoisseur of Chinese by any means, but I found it all more than satisfactory. The service also really pleasant. I agree with earlier reviews that it's maybe a little overpriced, but it's a lot of food, easily enough to make two meals of my one order. I'll definitely eat here again.

finely a good Chinese establishment in Nashville . great service.  the food is way better then other .  the soup was awesome . place was clean and comfortable. they give you yummy sweet sause and what looked like chips to dip while you wait .  I will be back
I have been to China, so I know how authentic Chinese food tastes like. So far this is the only place in Nashville that I know serves real Chinese food.

i was unsatisfied with my experience. i ordered the baked ziti for delivery, which included breadsticks and a salad. when i received my food, the first thing i noticed was that i did not receive my breadsticks! when i went to eat my salad, the lettuce was beginning to brown and i also received the wrong dressing. the baked ziti was extremely flavorless as well. i feel that perhaps because my meal was ordered to-go they did not put much attention towards it and just threw it together with no care. unfortunately this turned me away from this restaurant and i will not be returning to give a second chance.

I am posting my first online review due to the terrible customer service I received when attempting to order online samples of a mosaic tile. After ordering two mosaic samples (paying a $4.50 and $5 packing fee plus shipping) I received no further communication about my order except the initial order confirmation email. After about a week, I called their number listed on Yelp to inquire about my status - the woman who picked up the phone was courteous, told me I should be getting the tile soon and gave me the number of their main office as apparently only the main office deals with online orders. After calling that number, I talked to a woman who said one of my samples was backordered and might be in end of this week, might be in next week. Similar to R.S's review experience, she was unapologetic. I asked if they could ship out the other sample which was in stock and she said not unless you pay additionally for shipping (?!). I do quite a bit of online shopping (who doesn't nowadays) and I have never had a company refuse to ship out the in-stock portion of my order and actually ask me to pay additional shipping charges when a product that was listed as ' ships in 3-5 days' wasn't actually in stock. I cannot understand a business that won't just eat the shipping charge (in this case, what $6?) considering the possibility that I may place a much larger tile order in the future after seeing the samples. The unapologetic, just-deal-with-it attitude of the woman on the phone (who specifically said Mary - I'm assuming the boss - wouldn't ship out the in stock portion) was just the icing on the cake. I haven't been contacted with any updates concerning my order as of today (order placed morning of Aug 30), and frankly, while the images of the mosaics on their website certainly do look nice, I would be very hesitant to order from MS&T due to my experience with their customer service.

UPDATE 9/10
First to clarify, in my initial call I did not speak to Mary, I spoke to a woman who said she didn't think 'Mary would ship out the in stock portion without you paying additional shipping'. 

Mary contacted me via email on 9/8 after reading my yelp review and said she had been on vacation for the past two weeks, apologized for the delay in shipping and offered to ship out the in-stock portion overnight. The backordered sample came in in time to be shipped out with the other sample. I received both samples today 9/10 and so am updating my review accordingly.

Received the flyer in the mail so decided to try it out. We ordered a supreme pizza with pineapple and wings. The pizza was alright. The toppings were applied very sparingly. I literally had only one pineal piece per slice. The wings were tough and dry. Overall it is a mediocre place and I wouldn't go back.

Just left the store and what has happened to customer service?! That is why stores are going out of business! If you don't have a great shopping experience then people are going to shop online. Well at checkout I am pushed out of the store! My bags are still on the counter and he is on to the next customer so I have to put my bags in my cart and with my arthritis!  I will have to move on!

I've been coming here for lunches for over 20 years. Very clean, quick and friendly service and better than average food. Yes it's american chinese menu and it's not New york or San francisco but it's at the top in Nashville. Try the Hunan Chicken and the spring rolls are the freshest and best! Try it and don't believe the negative reviews some have posted. Great deal for lunch especially. Good soup, spring roll and entree for under $6.

I recently ordered tiles for three bathrooms that we are renovating. Since I live in California, I did everything online, choosing Mission Stone and Tile according to a rating that placed them as 12th best in the country. After dealing with Teresa Davis, I came on Yelp to applaud and thank her for such a positive experience, and was shocked to see all the negative customer service reviews.

Since I was new to tiles, I didn't trust myself to make the order online, so I emailed my shopping cart to  Mission Stone & Tile asking for help. Teresa Davis was the one to respond, instantly coming across as competent and reliable. 

We spoke every day for a week, and exchanged triple the amount of emails. Mine was a complicated project, filled with possibilities for error and confusion, requiring a great deal of concentration and attention to detail. 

Teresa managed the demands on her  time with mastery, tending to my every need, answering my numerous questions, and even going as far to entertain hypotheticals, to help me determine cost projections and materials. She stayed late at work in order to take  advantage of the quiet time she needed to focus. 

I used to recruit for large corporate companies, so my habit of assessing potential candidates for the job, lingers on. Teresa falls into the category of those unusual people, who stand out above the rest, able to handle any obstacle put before her, and do so with grace. I am unfortunate for no longer being in the position of offering her a job, as I am certain that she would have succeeded, as well as made me look good.

My experience with Mission Stone & Tile was probably one of the most positive ones in years, and I can only surmise that everyone who left negative feedback, could not have had the pleasure to deal with Teresa, without whom, I would have never been able to pull off that kind of order.
Just purchased Beveled Arabesque Tile from #missionstonetile It's absolutely beautiful! They have so many choices and prices are fairly reasonable.

This is our favorite Chinese place. We probably go here at least a couple of times a month, and we've never had a bad experience. The servers and hostesses recognize us now and are always so friendly. My husband studied Chinese for a few years and sometimes asks if it's okay to speak Chinese with our server to practice, and everyone he's asked has been so enthusiastic and helpful. The food is reliably great. Go, you'll like it!

I had Joe come out and clean my chimney. He thought that he had found a problem with my fireplace. He was very thorough checking to make sure it wasn't a problem using the camera to take a closer look, looking up the manual, and calling numerous people to check. He also had me look at the camera and explained what the problem was. He was able to fix it before he left. He was very helpful and thorough. I would definitely recommend them.
I waited 20 minutes out side the only person in line at 1100 pm what a joke of a chain for the people that work here and start over what a joke and the food sucks

Usually I prefer Publix over Sweetbay, but this Sweetbay is rather impressive. Good selection of beer. Unique layout. Staff is rather young, even the supervisor looked young.

One thing Sweetbay has on Publix is hours. Publix usually closes at 9 and most of the time Sweetbay will be open to 11pm. When your busy, sometimes it is best to do your shopping at night.

Publix always has better meat, whether lunch meat or from the butcher, Publix kicks butt. But Sweetbay can do pretty good when it comes to veggies. This Sweetbay was pretty well stocked with veggies, and none were gross. It was one of the easier times I had picking out veggies. None were gross. Usually I have to put a couple back because they are scary looking, but not this time. 

Overall, there was no crowd, some pretty good specials, and I really really liked the unique selection of beer they had here!

Amazing service. I work close to here so I just walk over to pick up lunch and I must say these people are amazing. I mean, AMAZING people. Every time I have ever been there they make me feel so welcome and the food is awesome! If you like Chinese food for a decent price... I definitely recommend this place for a quick lunch or dinner. Lunch portions are like dinner, definitely worth the money. I just love this place!

We used to love checkers. It seems like a dirty place now and I'm adding it to my list of places I will not go to. We waited at the drive thru speaker (passenger side one) for a long time and nobody ever came on. Several cars went through the other side. Eventually I had to back up and go to the other side. Maybe it was broken? But no cone or signage. We waited forever at the other one too. The food wasn't great when we got it either.

I CANNOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE.  Within a week of completing our master bath renovation, we began to have issues with the glass mosaic tile installed on our shower floor, on an accent wall, and a portion of the ceiling.  We weren't sure what was going on, but after a few weeks, the issue continue to spread.  We took photos and sent them to Mission and asked for their help/input.  They in turn consulted the tile manufacturer.  At about this same time, I began surfing the web to see what I could find out about our tile problem.  I found the tech support link for the tile manufacturer, and sent them an email and asked if this particular tile was suitable for a shower floor (wet application).  The answer I got was "no, not at this time, but it was being tested"   I was NOT happy since Mission sold me this tile for inside a shower - and now I have a BIG new shower that will have to be torn out.  Within a few days, Mission replied via email (to the photos) that they didn't have an answer as to what was happening but they would refund my money and pay for the tile to be torn out and replaced.  I took them at their word, and should NOT have.

After I picked out new tile, and ordered it, my contractor put together a price to do the work. (chip tile off a floor and up one wall and on a small ceiling area, so yes, very complicated and tedious work.  Not to mention they would need to protect the glass shower doors and the tiled shower walls, limestone bath floor, haul off, etc)   The next day, my contractor went to pick up the tile, and Mission refused to release it to him saying the cost was "too high" which was later followed by an email to me saying the same thing.  So I responded that they were welcome to get estimates if they had people they knew that could do the work. (which they never did, or if they did, they found the cost about the same.)

Today, Mission (Mary Elizabeth, who I've never met)  advised me via email that she has referred it to the tile manufacturer"They will be contacting you directly with their settlement decision, if any.  I hope they can resolve it quickly, for your sake." Sounds like they are trying to bury the problem and may respond to me in a month, six months, or a year???  

First of all, Mission SOLD me a tile for a shower, that was not supposed to be installed in a shower. I expected that they would assist me to the full resolution of this matter. Secondly, what does she mean "if any"??  Now they are saying that it may not be the tile at issue.  So in the meantime, what am I supposed to do?

I really just want to get this tile removed and new tile down and put this behind me, but I don't like the sound of her email "IF ANY" and "HOPE THEY RESPOND QUICKLY, FOR YOUR SAKE"   Really.... for my sake??  

I DO NOT RECOMMEND MISSION STONE & TILE based upon my situation and how they have handled it.

UPDATE:: after thanking me for my yelp review, MST did refund me the cost of the tile.  Also NEW information to share - the replacement tile they ordered for me, which they refused to release....turns out it is NOT recommended for shower floors either.  I checked the manufacturer's website since it is a glass tile also, and it said Recommended Uses:  Walls."   So I called the manufacturer to verify and they confirmed that they do NOT recommend it for shower floors. Glad I found this out first. (before ripping out bad tile and replacing with another tile not recommended for shower floors)

Went to this location this morning on Olive boulevard, there was a gentleman ahead of me when I walked in who had already placed his order but was waiting.  I stood in line for 5 minutes while the person who was suppose to be taking orders fiddled around with drive thru orders.  On 3 different times he turned around and said I will be with you in one minute, just needed a large coffee it not to tough, BUT during this time the counter person could take the time to assist the three African American customers who came up to the counter.  The white older gentleman ask the same person when his order would be ready and the man said it will be ready when it ready.  Welcome back to Saint Louis, thank goodness I am only here a day

I finally got to check this store out for some holiday shopping... I ended up getting several things for myself and for others. Though the store seems small, they actually offer a ton of fun and useful products whether you are buying for an avid camper, beginner camper, or someone who doesn't even camp. They sell neat items that most people would love such as moccasins, wallets, jewelry, incense (that smells more natural and outdoorsy) and decor. It's a very comfortable spot. I felt like I could have hung out there all day.

The people who work there are extremely helpful. The woman who was there when I went even helped us compare prices on a percolator and gave me lots of advice about the products I bought. Will definitely return!

I've been coming here for years, and no, it's not incredibly authentic Chinese food and it won't change your life. But it's pleasant, it's cheap, the food isn't bad at all and it's a Nashville institution.

The staff are always friendly and really do their best to make sure you have a good experience. But for the easiest time in and out, call ahead for pickup - it usually only takes about 10 minutes for them to prepare it. 

The only bad thing I have to say is that I wish they hadn't changed their recipe for country style bean curd. I liked it better with more mushroom variety.
dope food. I lived for a year in China, this place is legitimate. not sure who these jokers are, going "wah wah I wish it was NYC". do you even New York? sheesh. eat here, enough said

Very busy Chinese restaurant nice flavor in their food the Mongolian beef is chewy but the food tasted good check ciao my husband had chicken chow fun he wants to come back to this place . good service came very quickly prices were very good

I DO NOT RECOMMEND MISSION STONE & TILE and here is why...

I typically don't write yelp reviews but I was so appalled by the behavior of the owner I had to share. 

I was delighted to find this place after seeing it listed as a seller of a tile I wanted on HOUZZ.com.  I saw the negative reviews but thought I would give the place a try as the negative feedback seemed to be unrelated to the type of project (kitchen backsplash) I needed to complete.  

The gentleman I spoke with at first (Chris) was very helpful and polite.  I informed him that I wanted to place an order but needed to coordinate the delivery date to ensure it would not be delivered while I was out of the country (week of Aug 24th). He was very understanding and told me that it would be no problem for them to delay the shipment to me to ensure it was delivered after I returned home.  he said they had to order the tile and it would take about a week for them to get it.  After that they would coordinate the ship date to ensure the tile was delivered after we returned.   

A week or so later I received the call from another nice gentleman (John Mark) to let me know that my tile had arrived to their store. I called him back to discuss the date they could ship the order to me to ensure the tiles were not delivered between August 24 - 29, as I would be out of the country, as previously mentioned.  He told me he needed to confirm the # of days it would take to get the shipment from Nashville,TN to the city where I live so he would need to call me back.  

After a couple of days (august 22nd, 2 days before I leave for vacation), I called John Mark back to see what he found out.  Unfortunately, he was not available so I began explaining to the person who answered the phone (Mary Elizabeth) why I was calling. She responded "He called you yesterday! Your order was shipped to you yesterday per your request!" (At this point, I'm thinking she has me confused with another customer as I have not received any calls from John Mark since he told me he would call me back 2 days ago.  In fact, the reason I am calling today is because I have not heard back from him.)  

When I attempted to explain the reason for my shipment arrangements/request she interrupted me and said "I KNOW ABOUT YOUR ORDER....EVERYONE HERE KNOWS ABOUT YOUR ORDER!!!!".  I think my mouth fell open.  Based on that response I'm guessing, my need to coordinate delivery dates had somehow annoyed her and her staff.   I don't get it.
