It just doesn't make sense especially since I communicated this BEFORE I even placed the order.  i could've just waited until I returned from my vacation to place the order to avoid ths nonsense.  

What frustrated me even more was that instead of trying to figure out where the breakdown in communication occurred, Mary Elizabeth started telling me I was to blame for the error because this was what I requested.  HUH?? She & I had never worked together on my order so how would she know what I asked for? Everything she knew about my order was what she learned from someone else.   Most importantly, why isn't she helping me to resolve the issue instead of being combative???? 

Then it dawned on me.... she was the same person I had spoken to briefly days before when I called Chris to check on my order. Coincidentally, she was rude and provided me the wrong information regarding my order. (I'm noticing a trend here.)  When I spoke with Chris he told me she misinterpreted his notes but everything would be fine as he understood what I needed.  He even walked through the shipment arrangement details to make sure we were on the same page. 

When I brought it to her attention that she & I never discussed my arrangements /request and that I had only communicated those details to the men (Chris and John Mark) I spoke with, she HUNG UP!!!!! When I called back to get the tracking details she answered and pretended to be someone else!!!  and then sent me to someone else's voice mail. WTH??  Who does that?   That is not behavior I expect from a professional adult.   Anyone who handles their customers this way does not deserve my business.

After many months of trying to find a particular backsplash found on Sarah Richardson's portfolio I found it here on mission stone and tile! It didn't give much information on the web site so I ordered 2 samples pieces and received them right away. I totally love them and I know it will make my kitchen! I emailed a representative and my email was answered the next morning so I ordered the rest of the tile. Will update with 5 stars if the rest of my order comes through without a problem. I can't wait!

The female that works the bar on Thursday nights, on Plumb....  She really, really, needs to work on her people skills!!! Really 
That's all I have to say.  The fricken food is off the hook, me like very much, great bar food.....Need to work on the other thing
Thanks

Mostly inauthentic Americanized Chinese food, but a pretty good version of it!  Good Chinese of any kind is just not very easy to find in Nashville (where Worst Wok passes for average), so a place that does the Chinese-American classics well in a nice setting is refreshing. Their fried wonton strips with sweet sour sauce that they offer as a free appetizer are addictive, and their moo shoo offers a large serving that's well seasoned, if a bit oily.  The owners are super friendly and would often bring out a free desert - fried wonton filled with chocolate cream and drizzled with hot fudge, which was just straight up delicious in addition to being a kind gesture.

I've given it a couple weeks to see if it would get better, but I still really don't like my haircut. The parking lot is a pay lot with the first hour and a half free, so that might be why it felt a little rushed even though everyone working there had nothing to do and was just on their phones when I walked in. I really didn't feel like talking and wanted a quiet haircut because I tend to overshare but Erin wouldn't stop prying, I got uncomfortable at how much I had to converse with her and just played along, but it was miserable and I wanted to leave as soon as could. The circumstantial services were nice, they offer beer, they shampooed and "styled it." I just don't like my hair, it's really choppy and has awkward lumps in places. I've had way better haircuts for less money, maybe I just went in on an off day or something, I don't know why the reviews are so good for this place.

I thought the hot n ready was pickup and go but every time I'm here they have no pizzas....they have to be made.

The time frame is between 4-8 and I'm usually here around 5:45 so I'm rather confused.

I never would have known about one of these dishes if it weren't for Yelp. I saw on Chinatown's pictures a soup dumpling called Xao Long Bao. Of course, it's not ON the menu. Makes me wonder how many other dishes require a secret handshake, or is there a special authentic Chinese menu not for the un-hip? C'mon Chinatown, "I want to know all the secrets in your garden." (That's a Barry White song.)
Anyway, The dumplings came with the standard vinegar sauce. They had sausage inside but no soup I think. Good dumplings, not bad but not a real soup dumpling either me thinks. Wikipedia described the real one as containing aspic which is a savory jelly made of meat stock which melts into soup as the dumpling is steamed. They had a little juice in them but I think it's just the fat from the sausage. Way better than the gummy frozen ones you get most anywhere else. If you know where there are real soup dumplings in Nashville, slide me a message and enlighten this wayward traveler.
One thing that was on the menu was Tofu with crispy bean blend. No idea what beans are used or how they're processed because they don't look like beans at all. All I can say is the effect is that of bacon bits. Salty, crispy little bits of fried bean with green onion that gave the tofu a lovely flavor without being too salty. I'm glad I didn't reach for the soy too soon. I like this dish very much.
This is far and away the best sesame chicken in nashville, at least for my taste. I ordered it extra spicy. It had lovely crunchy pieces and this is what I love! It was, however, not spicy at all.

#MissionStoneTile
I just sent for a sample tile.  This was the only place I could find the orange glass tile color.  If we like it, we will purchase.  I just wrote this review to get the $5 off the very expensive price of a single sample tile.

Update:
I'm pretty impressed that Mission Stone & Tile really cares about the customer reviews and comments.  I received an immediate reply and discount for the sample tile - makes me feel much more confident about purchasing what we will need for our kitchen.

This place was really good both times I ate it. I mean I was pretty drunk both times but I remember really liking it . I love the big thin NY slices that you can fold . Good sauce to cheese ratio which is important to me because I cannot stand when I get pizza that's liek all cheese and no sauce . I like this place .

Sadly, this restaurant let many of its customers down on Christmas Day.  When I arrived over an hour after placing my online order for pickup, I arrived to find a restaurant with 20+ people waiting there for their take out orders.  After waiting an 45 minutes in the restaurant, which was very chaotic, I finally was able to speak to the hostess, find my order and ask her to check the status.  When she returned from the kitchen, I was told my choice was to take the order that had been sadly sitting abandoned by some customer who had given up at least 30 minutes earlier or cancel my order.  Sadly, they were still taking orders when I gave up 2 1/2 hours after placing mine.  I do not understand why they continued to take orders when it was very clear they were not staffed to accommodate the business.  The worst part was that those of us that placed online orders had paid online.  Now a call to my credit card company is also required to make sure I am not charged.
They left a flyer in our hotel, but then when we called they said they wouldn't deliver. Very annoying.
I love the food here. Their chicken Alfredo is really good. They also offer delivery through UberEats. Download the UberEats app and use code UE-uaduw for $10 off first order!
China Town is hands down the best Chinese restaurant in town.  Best Kung Pao chicken!

Your chimney sweep is very friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and clean! As they were cleaning our chimney the vacuum that they used, instead of filling our house with the smell of ashes, have a very nice fragrance. It was just those small details that meant a lot. Joseph Sauter Took the time to sit down with me and explain all of my options for now and for the future. The prices were very reasonable and they are highly recommended!

If you are in your 20's or 30's, your parents probably took you as a kid to a local Chinese restaurant that had ugly plastic table cloths, dated, uncomfortably padded chairs, Chinese-inspired art on the walls, and that decorative folding "wall" that a famous actress changed behind in any movie from the 40's.

Chinatown still looks like THAT restaurant from your childhood.  It's kind of funny.. but I'm sure not intentionally so.  Really, the best thing I have to say about my experience (other than it being very inexpensive) is that all of the food was served PIPING hot.  Props for cooked-to-order food.  However, the eggroll was really greasy.  The "fried" rice was cooked but barely fried.  The Kung Pao Tofu was in a very generic, Asian-style sauce that could hardly be characterized as Chinese.  And the veggies in the dish were barely al dente.  I'm talkin' considerably raw, folks!  

I suppose if you're out of options and want an ethnic meal (as I was and did), this is a place you can walk into whenever and be served a hot meal by nice people.  But I really wish the sushi place next door had been open instead....

Chinatown offers something a little different from the cookie-cutter American/Chinese places you find all over town. They have most of the dishes you'd expect, but they're usually a good bit different, and much better, than what you're used to. Definitely go for lunch; their lunch specials include soup, a spring roll, fried wontons, and a generous entree portion for around $6-7.

We are in the middle of new construction and this was my first stop to peruse granite and tile. I was approached by a sales person shortly after walking in. I briefly told her what I was looking for. She shuffled me into a corner of the showroom to look at samples and took off. I would expect a little bit more attention from sales staff when I plan to spend lots of $$$. Needless to say, will be making my purchases elsewhere.

When inside tonight for a quick dinner. Walked in there  no one at the counter and then one of the managers walked in to the counter area and bent down to work on the safe. Never acknowledged us nor said anything.  the two women at the drive-through stared at us for about 30 seconds without making real eye contact. 

Then they both stared at the drive-through window which no one was in line.   

We have been standing there for about another 30 seconds. No one said hello except the manager then talk to an employee who was clocking in at one of the first registers to explain to her that he had called her several times and she hadn't picked up her phone.  

Finally about 25 seconds later one of the girls came back from the drive-through still there with her hands on her hips and then said oh do you need help. 

Next she pulled her drive-through headset off partially to listen to our orders.  

Why am I telling you this because this is what constantly happens at this location. I'm sick of it and I'm not going back... However it is very close to my office and I enjoy the food normally.   

THE SERVICE SUCKS AND THE PEOPLE ARE HORRIBLE INCLUDING THE MANAGERS DONT GET IT!  

I even called their offices ...no one cares!!!

This Burger King has consistent drive thru problems.  If you want your order the BK way no problem except for fish sandwiches.  The fish buns are so hard as in overheated that you could break a tooth.  The staff is either under trained and covering it up with arrogance or just arrogant.  And the manager is no better.  Fix your drive thru screen and more than likely the orders will be correct before the customer comes to your window.  Such a shame...it just gets worse and worse.

I despise leaving a business one star, but my experience here was one of the most disappointing dining experiences I have ever had.


Food: Worst Chinese food ever :(
I ordered General Tso's chicken with white meat, and they gave us a full plate of greasy dough pieces with a heap of sauce all over it. The fried dough was edible but we wanted chicken not dough.
I ordered fried rice with egg and received a bowl of steamed brown rice...I didnt expect to have great fried rice here, but I at least expected a piece of carrot or a few pieces of egg. There was nothing in the rice whatsoever, and the waitress confirmed that was the order of fried rice :/
I saw another review on here with their General Tso's chicken and it looked great! perhaps they changed chefs or ran out of chicken this time.


Service: The waitress was nice, however, she didn't pay attention to our questions and food orders. ie. brought us shrimp egg rolls despite us mentioning (twice) how my mom "absolutely could not eat shrimp" (shrimp allergy). Sometimes a shrimp will end up somewhere when a restaurant serves seafood, but these eggs rolls were primarily made up of shrimp...thank goodness I took a bite before my mom did. She also got another part of our order wrong, but it was hard to get her attention (perhaps she was a little frazzled?)

Ambiance: Nothing worth noting.

Cleanliness:The table and floors were sticky. The floors had food and sauce all over.

I am unlikely to ever return. If this is one of the best chinese food restaurants in Nashville, I won't be eating Chinese food for a longggg time.

PS: As we were dining in, another customer left while shouting he was never coming back, not sure what happened to upset him, but I can relate!

Dad and I came to Chinatown restaurant on Christmas night, and it was a perfect way to end our Christmas Day. The service was fast and friendly, they were always attentive, and we loved the food. I live in a city where Chinese food is abundant, and the quality and authenticity of the food here seemed to exceed the Nashville average where standard greasy Chinese food is the norm. 

The steamed dumplings were perfect, and we enjoyed the spicy chicken (Princess I think) sautéed with chili peppers and peanuts -- a Szechuan specialty. Dad and I shared an entree, and it was plenty for us both, especially with the dumplings. 

I"m happy that Chinatown is in Nashville, and it's a great and nice addition to Green Hills options.
These guys were a little behind when we came in but won us over with kindness and eagerness to please. Awesome sesame chicken too.

We met some friends here for lunch on our drive back from New York City.  Like some other reviewers have said, this is NOT New York City caliber Chinese Food, however, this was some good Chinese food!  I ordered the General Tso's chicken (this is my go to dish) and I was a bit disappointed.  The chicken pieces that were used were very fatty and not of good quality.  The impressing that I received upon entering this Chinese Restaurant was all the ingredients used in their dishes would be of high quality.  While I did order the lunch special of the General Tso's chicken, that should not dictate what type of chicken is used to make up a dish.  I will give this place another try the next time I am in Nashville as their Fried Rice was pretty freakin' good.

Ordered through drive through. A pretty large order. Inventorying the items after getting home, I noticed a burger was missing. So back to the store I went to get the missing burger. The person remembered me and filled the order. The manager asked if she could help me, and upon finding out the issue, turned around and avoided me. She offered no apologies and decided not to act on the discrepancy. At least the line worker apologized. Needless to say, BK is off my list, and I will drive farther to other options.

Chinatown has changed a lot in the last year.  They totally redid the interior and it's now much nicer, and they changed the menu (got rid of the sesame beef...heartbreak) and added some Taiwanese things.  Like pig intestines.  Which, if you're into them, they're apparently just about at the level of quality you'd want pig intestines to be at.  It's also busier, but they are so nice here that I don't mind.  I'll go here for my inauthentic Chinese food rather than PF Chang's any day.

Ordered a large cheese pizza today, very nice people but the pizza is garbage. The dough tastes like it's frozen, doesn't taste like fresh homemade dough from a pizzeria, the sauce is lacking and the cheese doesn't taste like 100% mozzarella. Save your money, this place is not worth it

I recently received my order of arabesque tile. I excitedly open each package. Unfortunately there were quite a few broken & chipped pieces. The next morning I talked to Suzanne at MS&T about the situation. Later that afternoon I received an email letting me know all the damaged tile would be replaced by MS&T. It made my day! Thanks for the great service!

Really liked it!

Pros:

Tasty food
Big portion
Very reasonably priced
Restaurant is clean, cozy booths

Cons:

Service wasn't great, took a long time to refill waters

I love this Winn Dixie. The staff is always willing to help and find what you need, from seafood to veggies. If you're an oyster lover visit the seafood section, if they don't have it, they'll order it!
Filthy dirty. Place needs a good cleaning. Had the loaded biscuit. Biscuit crumbled couldn't be eaten as a sandwich.

It's tough to rate this restaurant with respect to Chinese cuisine. As noted in the many reviews here, it is not authentic Chinese fare. I ordered spicy lamb. It wasn't spicy and the hot chili oil we asked for, to remedy this, equally was not hot. My partner ordered Singapore noodles. The noodles were nice, but the chicken was ground up like minced meat. Also, she reported, even though she asked for extra hot, there was none of the traditional Chinese heat in the dish. 

So while it may serve food which is described as the best Chinese in Nashville, Chinatown misses the mark by a wide margin. It is definitely asian in style and it is not bad food. It's just that it doesn't measure up in the Chinese-traditional department.

The place itself is quite nice and the service was efficient, if a little impatient. It is cheap and the food fills a hole. But as good Chinese restaurants go, Chinatown is disappointing.

I am a design professional here in Nashville, so I deal with businesses such as Mission Stone & Tile on an almost daily basis- and Mission is an absolute delight to work with!  Their selection of quality, unique product is better that other places I've shopped at and is competitively priced.   Knowledgeable, helpful staff (Suzanne is especially wonderful to work with) that have good design sense, complete knowledge of the product,  and have always been very attentive to any issue that's arisen on a project.  I could not be happier with my experience at Mission- I highly, highly recommend them!

#1 or #2 for most authentic Chinese food in Nashville. Complementary soup was large portion when we did family style for 6 people. Sautéed sweet tea leaves and bok choi was tasty and delicious. Pork belly was a great cut of meat and the fat was buttery smooth. The chitlins with tofu could have used a little more spiciness but overall was well done. Bubble tea is also available and good.The roast duck should be avoided; overcooked and dry. Also more bone than meat/fat combination.

Overall, the food is excellent for the reasonable prices. I hope they keep it up.

This LC takes their phone off the hook whenever they feel like it. I'm currently sitting in the store waiting for pizza because 1) they have nothing hot and ready and 2) because I tried calling for an hour before I was going to be here and got a busy signal every time. If I were a business owner, I think the heads up would be appreciated-- I don't understand the actual disregard for people wanting to order ahead (esp when it's not a hot and ready item). Then, once I ordered and had waited for about 15 minutes, they came to tell me they forgot to put one of the pizzas in. Get your act together, loughborough. This will be my last visit.

Chinatown is not my favorite Chinese restaurant in Nashville, nor it is my favorite movie set in California, but both are passable, and will do for the average day.  

Chinatown restaurant is your somewhat standard American-style Chinese food, all somewhat sort of tasting the same.  When I went with a friend recently, I tried the lo mien, and was not terribly impressed.  I plan to go back and try something more exotic and reserve the right to change my rating at that time.

Ah, Chinatown.  There's never any wait, the food comes fast, and it's consistently pretty good.  My standards for Chinese restaurants are basically just "Is it gross?" and this place isn't too bad.  Pei Wei and PF Chang's are more upscale, but pricier.  This place does the job.  The crab won ton appetizer is nothing fancy but it's delicious. The sesame beef is my standby, not too much sauce and never with the gross unchewable pieces I hate to find. The sweet and sour chicken is good too, though the radioactive orange sauce grosses me out.   The waitress we always get is a little strange, but very attentive.  Parking is easy, carry-out is fast as long as you give them 15 minutes notice.  Probably the only place I'd give three stars to that I eat at that frequently.

Amazing!!! I've never had customer service quite like I experienced with Walter Knoll. I had a terrible experience with one of those Internet companies and was determined to use a local florist this go around. So here's my magnificent experience....

I wanted to surprise my fiancé and send her flowers to work as a thank you for being my rock over a particularly difficult weekend filled with very unexpected family medical emergencies. I called WK Monday morning and placed my order with a very nice and efficient gentleman. He offered up the confirmation code but I was driving and unable to write it down, so he assured me they would take care of me. 

A few hours later my fiancé text me and told me that she was leaving work early because she was sick!!! Oh no! In a panic I called them back and explained my situation. The woman I was talking to immediately jumped into crisis solving mode and placed me on hold and got in touch with the delivery driver to see if he could make his next stop be mine. Luckily he was in the area and made a detour to get them to my love faster! She even made sure to verify my phone number so she could call me back to make sure that my fiancé in fact relieved the flowers. 

Not only did she receive them, but they were absolutely gorgeous and helped make her feel a little better too!!! 

Unbelievable service from an even more unbelievable company! I will never order flowers from anywhere else again! Strong work Walter Knoll!

Beautiful tile, but the absolute worst business transaction that I have ever engaged in.  Shop elsewhere or at your own peril.

I ordered backsplash tile from Mission Tile in late January 2014.  Due to severe weather the shipment was delayed.  No problem, I had ordered the tile early and didn't need it for several weeks.  Soon after, I heard from a customer service representative that a second shipment may have been sent to me; they weren't sure, but could I let them know if a second shipment arrived.  I told them that I had not yet received my first shipment, but that I would let them know if two shipments arrived.

In mid to late February my first shipment arrived.  It was perfectly packaged and looked just as good as advertised.  Two days later, the second shipment arrived.  My wife watched as an unmarked van pulled down our driveway and the driver literally threw two packages in front of our fence.  Our contractor brought the packages in and noted that the boxes were falling apart.  Inside was our second order of tile, in different packaging and with several tiles saran wrapped to the exterior of boxes.

I immediately informed Mission Tile that the second unsolicited shipment had arrived.  They asked that I send it back.  I told them that because the shipments were so different (I didn't know which one was correct, but clearly that both were not), I asked if I could hold on to both orders until the work was done and I was certain that I had the right amount of tile (note:  the tile was oddly shaped, so it wasn't merely a matter of counting tiles to determine coverage).  They refused my request and demanded that I repackage and schedule pick up for the tile.

Once I was able to examine the second order, it was obvious that at least one third of the tiles were either damaged (i.e., chipped or cracking) or completely broken.  I told the owner, Mary Elizabeth Hulsey, about the condition of the tile and that she could schedule pickup, but that the packaging was unusable.  She demanded that I repackage her shoddy work and, when I refused, charged my credit card - without authorization - for the second shipment.  I have challenged the charge.

The bottom line is that there are a number of reputable companies that do business in a professional and ethical manner in this space, and life is too short to deal with businesses like this one.  I wish that I had read the reviews here before I had placed my order because, though we really like our tile, no tile is worth the headache and exasperation of dealing with people like Ms. Hulsey.
The owner is very nice to us, we have a good experience to eat there, we will back when we get chance to go to TN again:))

Ordered Roast Duck for 15$,bm but got roasted bones with some skin on top. Barely any meat.

Salty crispy chicken was good though
Great authentic Chinese food. Service was good and fast. Loved their cumin lamb, string beans, and tofu dishes. Wish the portion is a bit larger.

The other nail salons on the block were busy so I decided to try this place. I went in with a complicated design and the young lady tried her hardest to do it, but it didn't work out. The manager apologized and they redid my nails with a more simple design. Sheerly based on customer service, I would go back. However, this salon isn't what I'm looking for when it comes to having trendy nails.

Not great. Ordered Sesame Chicken for delivery & Crab Rangoon. The latter was fine, the former was a lot of dark meat and undercooked pieces. Not worth $27 (w/ delivery + tip). Good fortune cookies tho

The best thing about Chinatown is the old Chinese grandma waitress who bosses you around. "No don't eat that with that sauce, use this!" "Everyone share, don't eat one dish by yourself!"  

Nashville is a Chinese food desert. Of the restaurants there are Chinatown is pretty much as good as it gets. We had the beef chow fun, mu shu pork, Mongolian beef and chicken fried rice. All classics that are hard to screw up and all were totally acceptable. Decent flavors, normal sized portions. 

Nothing special here but nothing egregious either. My overall sentiment is "meh" but if you're desperate for Chinese it'll do.

Short Version: Do not be afraid of the negative reviews. My online order was great!

Long Version: Let me start this by saying that 99% of the time I listen to online reviews. I weigh them heavily when buying items online. So, I was leery ordering from Mission Stone and Tile given the mixed at best reviews.  However, I was too in love with the textured essential subway tiles after searching for backsplash tiles for months to not attempt to get them. 

So, I did something I very rarely do and ordered the tiles from the poorly rated company. In the ordering process you have to verify that you read the return policy and viewed this as a likely foreboding sign as I braced for the worst.

Two days after placing my order I got a call from the company letting me know the bullnose tile I ordered was backordered, but I worked with the very nice caller to find an alternative option. She said she would package up the tile and get it to the warehouse that day.

I anticipated getting a shipment confirmation quickly after but never got one. So on the following Monday (After placing my order the Sunday before), I called to get an update and no one answered. However, less than an hour later I received a call from the freight company saying they had a delivery from stone source in Nashville!

Today. just over a week after ordering the tile, I received the shipment and I LOVE the tile! They are just as it was pictured! I could not be more thrilled and overall had a great ordering experience!

I don't think I will ever buy my flowers from anyone else after visiting Walter Knoll. I was picking out flowers to plant in the front of my house and I had a hard time because everything at Walter Knoll looked healthy and beautiful. The prices were incredible as well, I was given 50% off of my entire purchase and since the cashier forgot to ring something of mine up, he gave it to me for free which was above and beyond great customer service. The staff was also very knowledgable and helped me pick out flowers that will thrive in my yard.

This is the first time I've written a review for anything online in a long time, but this one has to be done. This place very blatantly scammed me and tried to make me look like a liar. Here's the story:

I bought some tiles that were called: "Copper - 3x6 Glossy Subway tile". When they arrived however, I was disappointed to find that they were actually ceramic tiles with a copper color. I figured I must have made a mistake, so I went back to the page where i bought them from. There was nothing on the page to indicate that the tiles were in fact copper colored not actually made of copper.

I then inquired about a return since the tiles were not what I wanted and the site was misleading. I was told that my return would not be accepted because it was a 'special' order, even though it wasn't. I was then told that EVEN IF my return was accepted, I would get back just $2.10 of the $96 I paid, after shipping and restocking fees. All of my coorespondence was directly with Mary Hulsey, who is the owner and President of the store. All this would be bad enough, but....

I also noticed that the website was changed soon after and the product I bought was called "Copper - 3x6 Glossy Ceramic Subway tile". Still, I assumed the best, that they were just updating the website and still planned on granting a return for me.

But then they told me that the site was never changed. They do not know how cached websites work apparently, since I was easily able to get a screenshot of the old version in which the word "ceramic" did not appear. Also, if you look at any of their other subway tiles, the material is not specified. It only says ceramic on the "copper" ones I bought. What a coincidence! They clearly were trying to make it look like I made to whole thing up to deny my return. Ever since I called them on this obvious scam, I have not gotten any personal responses and instead Mary has gone around deleting my posts and avoiding my emails.

The bottom line is they run a dishonest business with a ridiculous return policy. I have posted many times before but my posts keep getting deleted. I have asked repeatedly for a personal response to my situation but have not heard from them. Avoid this place

This place was absolutely terrible. The servers didn't know anything about the food. They served me non cooked noodles like i could've bought that shit at kroger, ramen for 50 cents no sir. Then took the noodles and did nothing to change it. They charged me full price for a terrible meal that was NOTHING like the picture on their menu. they really had me messed with that nasty shit. Chinatown is CANCELLED.

I hope this is the right location.... Anyway, had a few hours to kill before having to be at the airport and didn't feel like paying $15 for an "airport Miller", so we drove around and found this place. Skeptical at first, but I was SO wrong!! Walked it and it was dark, it's a bar after all, but everyone was SO nice. The gal behind the bar (sorry forgot her name) was super fast and on top of our order, even setting out a 2nd beer before we finished the first, talk about service!! Chatted a bit with her and some other patrons at the bar. The people just couldn't be nicer! Even to this "Californian"! We chatted about football and the upcoming season, The Raiders moving etc etc. They all made me feel as if I was a regular and had been going there for years! Even got caught up on some of the bar "gossip" with the actual regulars. I didn't want to leave, it felt like my neighborhood. I really hope I get the chance to come back when I'm in town again and this time I'll remember the bartenders name because she is just a gem!! Truly great customer service! Sorry, didn't try the food, it was a beer only pit stop. But it gives me a reason to come back.

After craving some local chinese food for months, and PF Chang's being unable to satisfy my cravings, I finally convinced my fiancee to go to Chinatown, which is right next door to another favorite restaurant of ours, Ginza.

Since I was last here they had redecorated the place considerably. While I like the new look, it seems a little spars in decor. That being said, onto the food!

My fiancee ordered the chicken fried rice and an order of steamed dumplings, while I ordered the sweet and sour chicken lunch combo with an order of crab rangoons/puffs. my meal came with fried rice and an egg roll as well, but they also gave us  some wonton soup and an extra egg roll on the house. The food was very good overall, particularly the crab puffs and, chicken fried rice, dumplings and egg rolls. The soup was okay, though the wonton was a little cold. Also the fried rice that came with my combo was barely fried and had only egg in it. At the very least it could have been fried a little more and had some seasoning and a few veggies. Such a shame, but still overall really good. Now if only they had more sweet and sour options on their menu, like pork and shrimp.

THERE WAS A BUG IN MY FOOD!!!! And they weren't even willing to cover the check as an apology! It's not the cost that was the issue, the response was all wrong. WILL NEVER COME BACK. Be warned... look at your food carefully before taking a bite!

This place is great! The people are so friendly, and the food is great! I got the General Tso's Chicken, I ordered it extra spicy and when the owner brought the mountain of food, she said that I was very brave. I soon knew what she meant. It was so spicy! I loved it. The food was very quick and hot. The atmosphere isn't P.F. Changs so do not over expect, but who cares what the inside looks like as long as it is clean (which it was) and the food is good (which it was). I believe that newer places is bumping these mom and pop stores out. This place is great and it deserves to stay!!!

My wife and I since moving from Alabama have been looking for a good Chinese place. This is it, we have been to other places and there food is processed and typical Chinese, in that everything is deep fried and just terrible. This place shines above the rest!

The technician was knowledgeable and helpful in explaining nuances of my chimney where I am not familiar. My chimney was cleaned thoroughly and the technician even cleaned where previous sweeps missed. I would recommend and use again.

I Have used Mission Stone and Tile many times, in fact my whole family has.  I have been so impressed with every part of their entire business.  They have a first class showroom and have offered us some wonderful suggestions for all of our homes.
I recommend them highly!

5 Stars for service especially for first-time home buyers. Joe has been incredibly helpful, patient, knowledgeable, and quick to respond. We've asked many questions, and we've always received prompt, helpful answers. I'm also really pleased with the quality of Erie coverage for home and auto insurance. It's far above what we've seen from other companies, and I was able to make informed choices with the information we received from Joe who went far and above to help us.
Everything great so far. Much better price than houzz.com. I'll update once I get the tile.

I had a wonderful first experience here going in for a consultation. 
I recently had a disastrous experience at another salon, and lost a ton of hair I had been growing out for 5 mos.
BC I had worn extensions 
once before I really wanted to see if it was an option again. 
The place is beautiful, streamlined,modern, and they have a private consult
room to watch a series of comprehensive videos before you have a discussion with your stylist. 
Taylor was extremely knowledgable and confident and had no ego issues about deferring to her boss for questions. 
She and Christina were extremely sweet,professional,
helpful,and explained in detail what would be needed for the most natural look.
I thought the pricing was very reasonable for all it included.
I could not make a decision at that moment bc it would involve a commitment I wasn't sure I was ready for,but I'm fairly certain I will follow thru when I am ready .
I left very confident they would do a terrific job!

Only place in Nashville I have found that serves Xiaolongbao "soup dumplings". 

Being from new York this is truly something that I miss, so I was very happy to find these steamed little soup filled buns here.

I will most definitely be back.

The lo mein side is super plain and dry. The sautéed pea greens were drowned in oil, not much flavor. The green beans were good, so I'm giving them 3 stars. Nice delivery guy, on time. Not worth the money though, I'm afraid :(

For years this was my Chinese go to for take-out. However, tonight I picked up food for the second time and was very disappointed. The dinners had very little of the ingredient in the name of the dish. For example, the seafood hot and sour soup lacked seafood. It had a small amount of sliced imitation crab meat and a couple shrimp. This Szechuan chicken was mostly cooked onions with a minimal amount of small pieces of chicken. The scallops in garlic sauce was mostly sliced vegetables with four pieces of very thinly sliced scallops. The egg rolls were half the size of a traditional egg roll. Perhaps they give better portions for those that dine in as they are there and can complain. As for me, tonight was the last time I'll be ordering.

We ordered delivery; sesame chicken, wonton soup, spring rolls and tofu lettuce wraps.  It was all mediocre.  The spring roll was a tiny egg roll, the sesame chicken was basically just chicken skins with very small pieces and little meat.  Tofu was ok but not great.  Won't order here again.

This place is pretty bad. Had the duck rice and it came out like reheated old food.

We also ordered the small steamed buns, they seem to just be store bought ones - also did not have the appropriate vinegar dip. 

Probably better food from Panda Express....
Absolutely gorgeous tile! I've searched for months for the perfect Arabesque tile and I finally found it #missionstone&tile.

It has been at least 2 years since I have eaten here.  7 years ago when my wife and I were dating I would take her here to eat for her lunch/dinner break from work.  It was her choice.  She has always liked this place even in college 20 + years ago.  It has been here a while.

They have made some changes since we were last in.

The decor is much more up scale.  There are now 2 huge fish tanks in the back.  One with live lobsters and the other with tilapia.  These are there for freshness as you are looking at your dinner if that is what you order.  Very cool!

The menu has some of the traditional American/Chinese dishes but I was very pleased to see real traditional Chinese dishes.

The service was excellent!  The waiter checked on us just the right amount of times without ever being a bug.

About 1/2 way through our meal I looked at my wife and told her, "this may be the best Chinese food in Nashville".  I am not totally sure about that as there may be some whole in the wall place where some little Chinese lady is making XO Shrimp in the back of a small kitchen or some 5th generation chef is making braised chickens feet in a spicy brown sauce from some street cart that I would dream to be eating.  Until then, I will continue to try new places.  Until some other place really knocks off my socks,  Chinatown is my favorite.

Very pleased and will go back.  I am looking forward to our next trip there.

We were in Tampa and wanted a dinner delivered to our hotel.  The desk person recommended Pizza Famiglia.  Although the only review on Yelp was so so,  we tried it anyway. It was terrific.  Food was delivered to our door,  on time as promised  and was very tasty, fresh and hot.  And a lot too . The calzone was hugh  4 people could eat it and not be hungry.   So glad we tried it.

Joe at Main Line Risk Management has been exceptional to work with.  He responds to my emails quickly, always picks up the phone, and helps answer questions I have about my insurance needs or the policies themselves.  Joe has been an excellent partner as my insurance requirements have expanded for my business, rental properties, commercial vehicles, and more.  I'm in the middle of moving all of my policies to Main Line Risk because of Joe's outstanding service.

HORRIBLE service, after meal was done we gave the waitress our cash for the meal, she then proceeded to stand next to our table and waited for her tip. She kept demanding it and caught me completely off guard with how rude she was. I felt completely disrespected with how she treated us, it's a restaurant, you leave the tip in cash once you leave so we can finish talking and it will be sitting there when we get up. The words "Now you tip me" should never come out of a servers mouth. I will never be returning, such an awkward rude staff, and i suggest no one ever go here ever.

Man!!!! These pizzas are sooooo good...


When they're fresh. The bacon and pepperoni are my fave. Oh and honey the hot and ready pizzas are like $6 and not even worth it. Just spend an extra dollar or two and get the one with more cheese. It's worth it.
Went to sneakers to shoot some pool nice atmosphere 420 friendly and cool with open carry  will be back

I've ordered from Mission several times, and Connie has been a pleasure to work with. Whether my project is large or small, she treats me as if I'm a VIP customer. Their prices are better than many of their competitors, and the selection is superb. I wish they had longer hours, or at least half a Saturday, as I've had to take off work to visit the showroom before.

I visited Chinatown for lunch today for what I thought was the second time.  Maybe the remodeled from when I went many years ago.  They have a decent amount of lunch specials and the restaurant had an adequate amount of lunch patrons to be successful.  I ordered the Ma Po Tofu with pork which came with an egg roll.  It came out very quickly in a Hot Pot fashion with a side of rice .   The serving size was bountiful.  At first I found the dish overly sweet, but the peppers begin to counteract the sweetness with spiciness and it becomes quite good.  I'd order it again, but there are many other things I'd like to order first as this is one of few actually authentic Chinese restaurants in Nashville.
I'm glad that they didn't go out of business but I do notice a change of staff. They don't seem as happy as before. But I love their meat and they're the only place that carries Krakus ham!!!
Fucking horrible service!! From start to finish took me 20 mins to get my food. 1 hamburger.. Could've just went and sat down and ate

A revision and retraction of my earlier negative post:

I was contacted today by the owner and she has addressed my concerns. It seems there was a 

misunderstanding about whether the "copper" tiles were copper material or merely copper color.

She has agreed to refund my purchase price and I want to amend my earlier post. All of us, even with 

good intentions, make mistakes. A fair way of judging a business or person is not whether they make 

mistakes (we all do), but on how they handle those mistakes.

Judged by that standard, Mission Stone and Tile has conducted itself professionally and honorably in 

resolving my prior complaint.

Main Line Risk offered me savings and expertise in automobile and homeowners insurance.  

All correspondences were fulfilled when I needed letters of coverages in an expeditious manner.  The agency is knowledgeable and now earned by business.  

Peter Chin, MS

Couldn't really tell you about the quality of the food, but I can tell you whoever the lady was that answered the phone is probably costing this business plenty of money. She was rude to a point that my wife and I simply hung up and ordered elsewhere, I'd save yourself the time and not even bother calling in the first place.

The food is fairly good however it's not hot. Soup, egg roll and rice was all lukewarm. Also sit at a table not a booth the booths are old and if someone is sitting behind you every time they move, you move. It's pretty sad.

This place is a rip off. They charge you $1.25 for an egg roll that is the size of a fortune cookie, and the sesame chicken looked like leftover scraps of breading that they fry the chicken in. I'm not even sure I got any chicken, it may have just been breading! And the wonton soup - I ordered two orders and the two orders was just three small wontons in some salty water. Never ordering from there again. Certainly not worth the price.

I ordered the Gyro pizza and a Greek salad. It was really really phenomenal food. The potato salad on the Greek salad was actually very tasty. And the pizza was extra cheesy and the meat was seasoned well. I would recommend to anyone. I ordered delivery, and it was on time and fresh. My only suggestion... offer a side cup of marinara to dunk the pizza crust in. That's my favorite 'extra'. Great food!! Will definitely order again.

For what they are doing, Little Caesar's is doing a fine job. Take out pizza whenever you're ready or have one freshly prepared while you wait. We opted for a supreme and it only took about 6 minutes to cook. The pizza was really, really fresh. Not simply hot but made with super tasty vegetable. My only wish is that they kick up the tomato sauce, it left something to be desired. Also, selling the dipping sauces is fine, but the portions were kinda small for the price.

I've always drive by this place wondering if it was anything good. Well to my surprise this place is a hidden little gem. I ordered food the french fries and the cook made them with cajun yumminess along with a grilled chicken salad that was super fresh. The bar is bigger than I imagined and has a bunch of pool tables.  Dave the bartender is awesome! He maintained my thirst quench with being attentive with the drinks. I highly recommend this sports bar!

My first time at this location. I called in an order due to the fact that my son was having a slumber party. Once I arrived to pick up the order I didn't have to wait and paying $37 for four pizzas is not bad. I tasted a slice and it's not bad for party pizza.

First time, I ordered Szechuan chicken and it tasted as it is supposed to taste, spicy hot but not TOO hot. I've also had the Crazy Spicy Chicken and it was great -- confession, I removed all the chili peppers and it was perfect to my taste, but if you like hot, just leave all the peppers in. This place comes in second place to Lucky Bamboo, which is on Charlotte Pike west of White Bridge Pike.

We have been using Your Chimney Sweep for over ten years, which makes us happy repeat customers.  They are knowledgeable, experienced and excellent at their work.  In fact, I believe that Joseph also trains others in the process and safety required for chimney sweeps.

The equipment used keeps your house dust-free.  With some of the new methods and technology, it may not even be necessary for them to climb on your roof (depends on your chimney and situation, however).  They show you before and after photos so that you can actually see the amount of soot or creosote removed. 

One year a baffle was warped and needed to be replaced.  They were able to alert us to this problem and to install the replacement.  If there are any issues with the fireplace, they will let you know.

Communication from the office is another plus because you always know what to expect. They are always dependable and on time.  If they are running early, they will call to be sure you are home and available.  I don't recall their ever running late.  You can easily make appointments for a year in advance for anyone who is a regular at wood burning.

We always recommend Your Chimney Sweep to our neighbors.

This is a really good Chinese restaurant. I've had soup dumplings in many restaurants in NYC. This one is the best. Don't be discouraged by the mediocre reviews. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our meal there. It saved me a trip to Flushing, New York. I had pork ribs cooked with cummin and hot chilli, it was delicious. The tofu dishes are great, and my vegetarian wife found the waitress so helpful in choosing dished that did not have meat. We will be returning to this restaurant.

Recently had R&L come out to install sod. In the process they also replaced my sprinkler system and set it to water twice a day. Two weeks later the sod was laying over and browning. Although Rich said he would stop by to check on it periodically, I never heard from him, even after repeated texts. Finally he came out to say the lawn died because of too much water. I told him he set the watering schedule and then he blamed it on people walking over the lawn. After nearly $6000 my lawn looks horrendous and will likely need to be replaced. He is completely uninterested in even discussing how to fix the issue. I have had numerous landscapers work on my yard over the years and have never experienced anyone so unprofessional. Unless you want to have a nightmare experience, my advice would be to steer clear.

I was there this past Saturday evening around 7pm with two others. One of us ordered the spinach dip which like someone else said was probably the best thing we had. I shared the seafood platter with another person. The fried catfish and shrimp were unseasoned and had no flavor. I ate three shrimp and two bites of catfish and was done. There were fried oysters that didn't look appetizing but my friend ate so I don't know. There were several hushpuppies but no crab balls. We inquired and were told that they were out of them and that's why we had so many hushpuppies. Well crab costs much more than hushpuppies. The waitress said they were going to prepare some crawfish balls for us instead. Well at this point I wasn't impressed or interested in anything else. When the crawfish balls arrived my two friends tried them and said they were too salty and they didn't finish them.  The mac and cheese wasn't impressive. It appeared to be macaroni noodles and cheese and pepper. The cornbread was sweet and tasted decent. Bottom line. I will not be back

The absolute BEST and most ADORABLE/GORGEOUS SALON IN STL! All of the girls are so sweet and talented - Ive been going to Tamara for my color and extensions for almost a year and couldn't be happier. I've never got so many compliments on my hair! If you're looking for a new salon I wouldn't suggest anywhere else but Christina White!

Jennifer was hired for an in-home brunch in a rental home, and she was awesome.  Exactly as promised (and then some), the food was impeccable in both taste and presentation.  She was even able to work around an oven that didn't want to work, but you would have never known it by the end results.  Strongly recommend Jennifer and her services.  A+ all around.

This restaurant is one of the very few in Nashville that offers authentic chinese food. The menu offers a large selection of different style of Chinese food so chances are you'll find what you like here. The staff is also extremely friendly and helpful.

This is really the only semi-decent Chinese restaurant I have found in the Nashville area. The staff is wonderful. They treat you with such kindness and add extras (drinks, dessert) to the order for free alot of times when you come in to pick up and order. I have found many of the menu items to be hit or miss. My favorite is the sesame chicken, but they cut the chicken into tiny pieces, which makes it difficult to eat. I don't love the fried rice, but it is better than nothing. I most recently had the salty crispy chicken which was a little greasy and soggy.

This is the only Chinese restaurant in Nashville I will frequent. It gets five stars due to the fact that is so much better than anything else around here and because BUBBLE TEA.

I've spent a decent amount of time in China (on my own, not on one of those micromanaged tours where they won't let you order your own food), which doesn't make me an expert, but does give me a good frame of reference for what mainland Chinese food should taste like. The Chinese food on the menu at Chinatown is basically a greatest hits of Chinese cuisine- a few Szechuan dishes, Shanghainese soup douplings, Beijing duck, and some American Chinese favorites. Not much Cantonese food to be found, but I'd actually they rather not try to do that AND all of the other stuff they're doing. 

Anyways, Chinatown offers a mixture of authentic and American-influenced dishes at reasonable prices with good service. The xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) are decent and can't be found anywhere else in the area, at least as far as I know, and I was happy to find that the twice cooked pork had the same flavor profile as the twice cooked pork I used to eat in Shanghai. The dishes here aren't overly sweet or cornstarchy; my only quibble is that I wish they could serve food at something closer to the spice levels I'm used to. Having heard a customer berate the owner for serving "inedibly spicy" kung pao chicken, however, I understand why we can't have nice things. 

I'm interested to see how they continue to balance the need of the average consumer to eat what they think of as Chinese food with their apparent desire to become the kind of Chinese restaurant that has a fish tank (all of the real fancy Chinese restaurants I've been to have fish tanks).

ALSO IMPORTANT ADDENDUM THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE IN TOWN TO GET DECENT BUBBLE TEA AFTER THE SAD DEMISE OF FAT STRAW. There are a couple of other places with boba, but they have in my experience been pretty gross.  Chinatown is serving bubble tea somehow in conjunction with Quickly, which is a popular chain of bubble tea restaurants on the coasts. They have items like pudding tea and lychee jelly that I've never been able to find here/generally outside of Asian immigrant communities before.

Came here for dinner one evening. Upon sitting down was immediately greeted and the waitstaff was attentive. I got an egg flower soup. I also ordered the Taiwanese Style Braised Pork. I found that to be not what I expected but it was still good. The pork pieces were what seemed to be a pork belly (high in fat). The flavour was still fine though. I couldn't finish it all because of the fattiness and also the salt content. I will not give bad marks to this place though because service was good and food was fresh and lovingly made.
The chicken cashew dish is what we ordered and not impressed.  Shrimp in fried rice smelled funny.  Perhaps they were having an off night?  Leftovers were discarded.

Horrible , every time I have been there the food is awful old and cold . 
This morning I ordered hash browns . They were cold and hard as a rock , as in old / overlooked . When I took them back inside the manager couldn't even apologize . Handed me new ones I said were those from the same batch as the others she said no they just came up .

I put one in my mouth at the counter and I said no these are old and hard . The hash brown wouldn't even break , I told her go ahead try one . She asked if I wanted something else and I decided it was to much work for them to cook fresh hash browns so I said can I just get a coffee. 

Worst Burger King I've ever been to. 
I've been in the management part of fast food restaurants for over 20 years. It's sad to see what managers today are like

Asked my husband to pick up dinner for me from here since he was eating with his friends. The XLB was just ok.

The lobster in ginger scallion sauce was delicious despite it being in the car for about 30 minutes. I enjoyed every bite.

For years we have enjoyed a predictable meal for take out at Chinatown however in the last months things have changed.  Always you got mustard and sweet and sour sauce with egg rolls, soy sauce and fortune cookies with order..Plum sauce with Moo Shoo Pork. Not anymore. When meals arrived or picked up most or all were not included.  Is there new ownership? Very disappointing to have to remind them of these items.

Came here for dinner with a couple of friends and we really enjoyed the food here.

The location is near Greenhills Mall so it would be a perfect after shopping meal. You can probably get here in a 5 minute walk from the mall.

There is plenty of seating for you and your group. The menu has a wide variety of authentic Chinese food and the prices are super reasonable.

I ordered the beef noodle soup and really liked the taste. The portions are massive so your tummy will be satisfied after the meal. 

Took one star off because we were a bit rushed to finish our meal near closing time. Away from that this restaurant is a must visit if you are craving Asian food.

So tired of coming to this store and finding expired stuff. Im constantly finding things expired. Do they not do daily product checks. Its ridiculous.
Also customer service at this location is the worst 
I came here yesterday and the cashier was rude and sat there waiting for me to bag all my own groceries while he did absolutely nothing. He even got me bags to bag my own while he had a whole set in Front of him. Not sure why they put bags for them if they dont help with bagging. 
I will continue to shop at my publix where i know food quailty and customer service go hand to hand.

OMG PLEASE DONT EAT HERE!! 

I'm from Chicago where pizza is amazing , I've even lived in LA where it's not so great but nothing can compare to how bad this pizza is. They 100% used faked cheese! It's not real!! 

It will not melt. I've even tried putting it in the oven it remains shredded I am so extremely upset about this it is not OK to sell products with synthetic food! 

I have pictures I'll post to show. I'm sorry to slam them with this bad review but this is unethical.
I love them the impossible Burger is great and the nuggets my son says there to die for

We hired Jennifer to do a dinner party for my wife and I and one other couple. Five course meal! It was fabulous. But she can do 3 or  4 courses. She can cook! She also provided a choice of wonderful menus to choose from based on our likes or dislikes. Organized everything and kept me informed. 

She bought the groceries fresh the day of the dinner. Brought everything to the house, including cookware, prepped, cooked, served at our table and cleaned everything. 

It was delicious. What a treat!! She's professional, she undersold and over delivered. I don't give a lot of five stars.

I see the negative review here and all I can say is we had a complete opposite experience. We'd do it again and had no problems at all. We're considering her to do pre-prepared meals for us if we can make it work. We're in NW Hillsborough and she's in SP.

Avoid at all costs.  No effort customer service.  They forget food on the regular.  I went in to get breakfast and they forgot one of the sandwiches.  I went back and had a full on argument on whether they put it in the bag.  I really like burger king, but I will never drive through or step foot in this one again.

Ordered take out last night great food.
I usually get steamed rice my brother gor fries and it was really good.

Love the food , service is great and the atmosphere sets the tone for a great time . I love chicken and 2/3 of the time I dine I get the chicken and it's it's crispy and juicy just like I like it . The mac and cheese is so cheesy and Make sure you get there for Sunday brunch ! So glad you're back open

I really did forget this place reopened until I started searching creole food. I really really like the fried chicken, gumbo and potato salad  The sweet tea is pretty good too. The parking situation ain't perfect but it's worth it. Sorry to forget about yall Dunbars but glad yall are back in the community. Please make us proud.
Had whole fish, Sichuan chicken, and Mongolian beef. All very tasty, good service too.
Went to see Emma @ The Colour Room. Loved the vibe loved the energy. my hair came out amazing and the cut was too cute. will be back soon for the agave treatment!

Probably the best Chinese food in Nashville. The chef understands the concepts of subtlety and layers of flavor. Best Kung Pau shrimp I've ever had. Been going here for the last 15 years or so, and the current iteration is clearly the best.

Can't help it, sometimes you just have to have a Whopper. And at 2/$7, not a bad deal! 
I always use the drive thru and check my bag before leaving. No complaints. I don't like or buy many of their products, but they do a nice Whopper.

I was really impressed with Sneakers on Plumb Lane.  I was a little hesitant as I remember the prior establishment.  This place was very clean and the staff was extremely friendly and attentive.  I ordered a beer from the bar and placed my food order there as well.  I had heard great things about the mushroom swiss burger, so I gave it a try.  The chef cooked my burger to order and it was perfect!  He also brought the burger out to me and came back to see if I was enjoying it.  YUMMM!  I will be back for this burger.  I would have taken a picture of the behemoth, but it was so good that I didn't get the chance.  The total for my beer and burger & fries was $13.  Not bad at all!

It took me a long time to find a salon that I trusted after a few bad colorists.  But I have been seeing Christina and her team exclusively for nearly a year and a half now.  They totally understand what I want, and are incredible in how meticulous they are in applications.  For my trims and upkeep in my hot pink coiffure, I will go no where else in St Louis

I ordered pizza online over an hour ago and it still isn't here, which usually is understandable but I called multiple times to check on the order and nobody answered any of the times and now the restaurant is closed. No notification of cancellation or anything.

My girlfriend and I were craving Chinese food and didn't think we would find a spot that served Cantonese style Chinese food (or a place that didn't just serve sesame chicken, chicken and broccoli or the like). We found this spot but was hesitant because of some of the reviews and the fact that Nashville doesn't really have much of a Chinese population so most Chinese restaurants most likely don't serve what we are use to having back home in NYC. But to our surprise, this restaurant served what we wanted and had a lot more authentic Cantonese style food than what we ordered. We order duck noodle soup, Cantonese style lobster, tofu with pork stew, and pea leaves. They even had bubble tea! The food tasted just like how it does back home in NYC. Definitely recommend this restaurant if you're looking for some authentic Chinese food.

The gumbo was very .  The fired shrimp platter was delicious as well, but the portion-size was too small for the $18 price.  However, I look forward to returning in the coming months to see how this newly opened restaurants work out some kinks. #goodfood

Stopped for brunch. Ordered chicken & waffles ($9). The chicken was really good. It came out so hot that I had to use my fork to eat. 

The brunch menu was limited to about 7 items (forgot to take a pic of the menu), but the most expensive item was the breakfast steak and eggs meal ($15). 

It was just really cold in there for some reason (to me) and it'd be more convenient if they invested in some actual dinner napkins (cotton/cloth) instead of actual paper napkins. My meal was quite messy...and thin paper napkins just didn't seem to cut it. 

The waitstaff is young, so be patient. But they are all well groomed and kind. The service is still good...

Other than that, good meal.

I stopped in to this burger King after an interview at a nearby business. The lady at the register was super nice and my food was made promptly. I sat an ate and was working on some personal business and charging my phone. A young man approached me and asked if I had a boyfriend. I said yes and he walked away. He then proceeded to come back and ask me if I could have friends and if he could have my number. I said that I have enough friends and no he couldn't. I actually asked him where the nearest gas station was and he told me and proceeded to tell me that he was on break and he could walk me there. I said, no thanks. He continued to stand there and try to ask me to be his friend. I told him, "I said no!" Then, a girl, I'm assuming she worked there too, said so that I could hear her, "that b**** has a bad personality"... well check out this personality, your customer service sucks, try to find employees who are respectful towards people!!!!

Terrible. Ordered late-night delivery to our hotel- pizza with mushrooms and olives, salad for me, hot wings for boyfriend. You would think they'd throw in plastic utensils, seeing as we ordered to a hotel, but no. It was okay though... Apparently you have to specifically tell them you want salad dressing when you order a salad or it comes without it. Tomatoes were mushy. Boyfriends wings were a weird pink color with barely any sauce and what sauce was there was not good. And New York style pizza my butt. Coming from NJ, I don't appreciate how good our pizza is until we are outside of the NY/NJ area. This pizza was awful. Nevermind that the mushrooms smelled funky and overpowered the pizza. The sauce was totally tasteless. Seriously my boyfriend and I actually used his blue cheese dressing from the wings ON THE PIZZA just to make it taste better, and I don't even like blue cheese. If we hadn't been starving we would have just thrown it out. At least the delivery guy was nice.
MOLD... and not just a little. A LOT. This has been my favorite place when visiting Florida. I'll never visit another Checkers again, Florida or not. I'm so disgusted.
will not hire again. if you do, pay with a check or credit card and have all  work detail written in the invoice. pl

The salon I used to frequent on the next block was closed (Google said it was open on Sunday...they weren't) so i came here. I didnt want anything fancy, just needed my nails done ASAP.

 My pedi came out nice and the person who did my nails was soooo friendly. However she seemed inexperienced with acrylic, but there was only 2 people working. My acrylic overlay and gel mani were the worst I've ever had. I had to keep making requests but still ended up without the almond shape I asked for, acrylic and polish all around my cuticles, and at the end there were suddenly bubbles in the finish (there was clearly something wrong with the top coat used). 

Also, I will second what one of the other reviewers said - their selection of regular polishes is ABYSMAL and most appears to be old. She used thinner to be able to even paint my toes. The gel polish selection was pretty extensive though. 

I tipped based on the good pedi and the fast that she really did try to give me good customer service. But I would not recommend this nail salon.

In town so I wanted to try the best of the best.  This place was recommended so we stopped.  Everyone ordered something different and was pleased with their order (Oyster po-boy, fried chicken, mac-n-cheese, red beans, etc).  I'd recommend and return next time in New Orleans.

I've been going to Christina White for a few years now so I feel like I've given this salon a good chance to redeem themselves.  Their pricing is definitely inconsistent and extremely deceiving.  I've been requesting the same style, cut, and color to my hair for years now (I even show the exact same pictures when I go in) and I never come out paying the same price - have only changed stylists twice so the pricing difference isn't from that either.  I started paying around $150 and this last appointment was $375!  Nothing had changed with what I requested and my hair definitely did not look like anything special (good but not GREAT for that price).  When I asked why the price had gone up so significantly I was told "Oh, I'm not sure.. maybe your stylist level jumped or had to use extra color?"  Unfortunately, I won't be back because of the inconsistent outrageous pricing (for just color and cut - I do not get extensions).

My daughter went to see Jenna the hair stylist.
She was supposed to do a basic color and style but was very disappointed when it wasn't done properly.  Jenna rescheduled continuously for 6 weeks to correct her error. Never following through with the appointment but just making excuse after excuse not to do it.  What makes matters worse is that Jenna canceled hours before the appointment not respecting anybody else's time. 
She refuses to give my daughter her  money back so she can have a professional stylist repair the damage that was done.
It sad that Jenna took advantage of a young girl promising her a professional outcome giving her alot of money and delivered less than industry standard. I wouldn't trust her styling my dogs.

This entire experience was a Major Disappointment. 1st with No party ahead of us & empty tables, we waited close to 15 min to be seated, once seated we waited another 15min for drink order or try to get water! Meals were awful ,as waited 25 min for entry's, Cornbread was tasty buy crumbled when tried to eat .. Red Beans n Rice were the Worst--adding Crab Boil Liquid doesn't make the dish Creole by any means...the chicken was deep fried too HARD. the Mac n Cheese was Tastless of any Cheese. ONLY dish w Flavor was Stewed Okra,Thankfully.Wasted over $90 on a Disappointing Dinner. The waitress was nice and apologetic HOWEVER what came out the Kitchen was inappropriate & unappetizing and shamefull. The Restroom was Dirty, but had Hot water at least,see pics..We herd this place was good but its Nothing like the ORIGINAL Dunbars, will Never go back nor Recommend to locals nor visitors!! Waste of Time & $$

This location isn't closed! It was acquired by Stone Source. This location still has most of the materials previously available - and now includes all Stone Source materials, as well. Thank you to everyone who has provided a review previously. Our team has worked to create a positive customer experience, and we look forward to working with you in the future.

Only half of the order arrived and some tiles from the 1/2 order I did receive came in damaged. Suzanne was very nice when I placed this order but was nasty, arrogant and totally uncooperative when I called to complain.  She told me that there was nothing she could do for me and referred me to Tracy who I think is Suzanne's boss.  Tracy was just as nasty, arrogant and uncooperative as Suzanne was.
