3.5

It is what it is. Unfortunately, Nashville is not SF. We don't have the depths of certain cuisines found in other cities. In time, we'll get there. In fact, I'm sure there's some small mom & pop joint in the city serving up delectable, addictive fare. It just hasn't been yelped yet. It'll get there. Until then and that said, Chinatown offers up a lot to enjoy -- you just have to know how to order. The restaurant tries to straddle the line between authentic and Americanized and the trouble comes in trying to serve two masters. I understand the latter perspective -- it's located in Green Hills and has been around for a while. Know your audience. It makes sense. The last few years, though, have been transformative to/for Nashville. The Chinese restaurant that capitalizes off the influx of and demand from foodies (hate that word) will win big.

And, again, what you get out of Chinatown is directly proportional to what you put in. Back in my Chicago days -- and before I placed a fatwa on him -- I was a huge fan of Tony Hu. Any restaurant/endeavor he opened, I was at. I'd never experienced the focus on Chinese regionality when it came to food and he served it up well. Soup dumplings, spice profiles, meat heavy, fish heavy, etc., there was a method to it all. It makes sense. China's ginormous. 'Chinese food', therefore, is a massive undertaking. So, if you do your research, find out the region(s) Chinatown best represents and the dishes that best represent that region, you're assured to have a slam dunk experience. If you're truly seasoned in Chinese fare, ask for the Chinese menu and go to town.

I know all this. But, when I came in on a cold Monday night, I just wanted some Americanized Chinese food to eat with the porter that was chilling in my fridge. I ordered the garlic chicken with white rice and engaged in some chit-chat with the front of the house. She was very nice and the restaurant was packed (good sign). After long enough to make me know that my food was made to order but not so long that I got restless, I paid $10 and was on my way. Was it tasty? Yep. Did it make me weak in the knees? No, but that's my fault (see para. 2). Will I come back? (With a group after doing some research and diving in to the full offerings?) Yes.

Split part of tree from neighbor was hanging over my garage roof attached about 15 feet above ground to tree. Without notifying me R & L Tree Service workers came onto my property several days later climbing my roof, apparently hired by neighbor who is in Florida. No protection was placed between my roof and the limb. The limb was not secured with ropes or other means to keep it from finishing to detach & fall on my roof. Workers cut back the branches touching my roof which allowed the suspended limb to now complete breaking off from the main tree trunk causing a protruding limb to come down on my roof cracking a shingle and damaging my gutter. Due to the amount of snow I didn't notice it right away. Once I did I left message with R & L to call me. I did not hear back so the following week I left a second message to call me. After a second message was left I received a call from the owner who stated he was on that job and they are not responsible for the damages. He told me to contact the owner of the tree. I have photos of the intact, undamaged gutter with the tree branch suspended above the roof, a photo that shows the section of branch in the gutter & photos of the damage done to the shingle and gutter. Owner of the tree will not pay for damages. My homeowners insurance company stated it is the responsibility of the tree company as they don't cover damages by third parties.

Tried their new ch'King sandwich. Totally gross. The chicken was under cooked and chewy. The breading was overcooked and tasted almost burnt. The entire sandwich had very little flavor, overall. I had to throw away about a third of the sandwich because it was too chewy and un-edible. Their old crispy chicken sandwich was a thousand times better. You guys should stick to making burgers and not even try to compete with Popeye's or KFC. Huge failure!! Don't even waste your time or money  on this chicken sandwich. Blah!

Enjoyed a delicious and very substantial lunch of Lima beans with shrimp and fried drum. The staff was friendly and helpful. The restaurant is attractive and spacious allowing for social distancing. Look forward to going back.

This was my first time here. Food was absolutely delicious. Gumbo seasoned just right. Hot fresh corn bread served at each table. (My favorite!) especially with cabbage I will definitely be back and will tell all my friend about this place!

We picked this place because the menu was slipped under our hotel door and we were starving. So glad we did, they took great care by calling to confirm our complicated order, (wife can't do dairy and we split the pizza with only half with cheese and a ton of other requests) they were courteous and food arrived hot and quick. Fried mushrooms were really great and big hit with the kids (2 and 8). They do not skimp on cheese, someone had the chicken parmigiana and when I handed it to her I could not see past the cheese. I had a chicken gyro and it was excellent, grilled chicken, fresh lettuce and chopped onions, I did ask them to hold off the tomatoes. Would order again for take out

I was not impressed. I have been searching for good Chinese food since my move to Nashville, and people had recommended Chinatown. Finally got to try it yesterday for lunch on my day off. The staff was very nice and attentive. But the sesame chicken was not very good. The pieces of chicken were minuscule and had a weird sweet flavor. Very sugary. Also the fried rice did not have any vegetables or anything in it. It had a few pieces if egg. It was pretty boring. Also the spring roll was not as good as some I have had. They do get points for not having that bright yellow fried rice that seems to be so prevalent in Nashville. My search continues for decent Chinese food (besides pei Wei) in Nashville.

We got grubhub to deliver from here. The food was really good. But the red beans had spilled all over. They didn't add my condiments that I had requested. They didn't include silverware. They canceled the Bread Pudding AFTER we completed and paid for the order. 
Fried food was fresh and tasty, which is tough to get when you order delivery! 
Red beans and potato salad were average. But the sausage is great.

They mean well. They told me they take the skin out of the eggplant with garlic sauce because customers prefer it that way. There is only garlic oil but no actual garlic so it became a bland tasting sautéed  skinless (spineless) eggplant. 

They use the oolong tea does not have the usual sediments from steeped tea leaves (nor the crumbles that you normally see from loose leaf steeped in a tea pot because customers asked "What is that"? As I said they mean well.

I saw the huge posters on the windows for something called the Impossible Whopper.   Inside on the digital menu flashed the Impossible Whopper in stunning colors.   They obviously want me to try it.    I ask the cashier for this Impossible Whopper you have advertised all over your store.   "We don't have that."
Oh really, you sure would have fooled me.

There are very few restaurants these days where you can get fried chicken that has been prepared fresh.  It takes about 15 minutes, but it was definitely worth the wait.  It was perfectly seasoned and very tasty.  I was served three pieces and took one home.  I also had some very good potato salad and some hot cornbread, which while it fell apart was very tasty.  The dining room is really nice - stylish and airy, but not loud as so many places are these days.  I do wish they would add fried okra or fried green tomatoes, but that was my only point for debate.  I will definitely be going back!
Old lady who manages the place is a crazy, evil bitch.

Came here on a recommendation. Food and service are decent. Decent prices. Available menu items are limited. I had the fried shrimp with Mac N Cheese and red beans & rice. Like others said the breading on the shrimp isn't good. The texture and seasoning are lacking. Wouldn't order again. The free cornbread was good though. Red beans good, Mac n cheese avg

I contacted Jennifer to purchase a gift certificate for my father, who's been saying he wants to learn to cook. She worked with me to develop a custom shopping and meal preparation package for an affordable rate. I'd recommend her services to anyone.
These guys are soooo unbelievably rude. You have to fight them for a few pairs of to-go utensils. So ridiculous.

Tues Aug 20, 2019... We ate at Dunbar's using a Groupon... No hiccups. Wait time was average. Our server, Iris was good. My Mom and I shared an oyster poboy and the cabbage special... Both dishes were A+... the poboy bread was delicious.  Oysters were well seasoned, crispy and juicy, perfectly delicious. Cabbage and fried chicken were scrumptious... Now, my hubby and sister both ordered the seafood pasta. Neither loved it. They got nice portions, with lots of shrimp and crawfish. The taste was not milk and cheesy creamy, but tasted more like from a jar...Thumbs down on the pasta...  We also had the bread pudding; very, very good... I give this visit a 4.5 out of 5 stars.... We'll be back soon; no pasta though...LOL

Wonderful restaurant you can go authentic Chinese or you can grab the Americanized staples they offer both. The service is friendly and fast and very attentive it's always a nice time and the prices are pretty decent especially given the large portion sizes! When I'm on this side of town it's the place to go to!
Just as good as it always was. I had the red beans, smoked sausage, potato salad, and cornbread and everything was perfect.

This place is amazing! I'm from Baton Rouge and i got the seafood pasta and the spinach dip and both were amazing. I come to New Orleans often looking for a new place to try and my friends and i came here after a basketball game and i am so happy we did. I will def be coming here with my mom. I also love that they are black owned, however i do think they need some more staff cause they seems to be understaffed. But i will be returning.
It is quite delicious and tasty Chinese foods in Nashville and we have been quite often to go about every week since we do not know there is any better around.

Left overs from Seafood Platter: 2 fish, 7 shrimp, 4 oysters, 3 crab balls. And I ate a considerable amount w/exception of fish (came w/3 pieces). Crab balls didn't wow me. 2 sides: mac & cheese (least favorite but not awful), side salad (Let & Tom). Comes w/French bread buttered & toasted. Overall solid meal; great value.

The previous review only talked about checkers in general. My review is for this specific location. 

The biggest issue with this location is where it is. Since it is right down the road from the Pinellas County Jail and Safe Harbor, a shelter, you have to understand the people that hang around here. 

Mostly everytime I have gone here, I am bombarded with people with their sad stories, they walk up and tell you how they just got out of jail and only ate jail food for weeks. That doesn't fly with me. When I got out of jail, I walked home and ate when I got home, I didn't push my problems onto people that were trying to get themselves something to eat. It annoys the shit out of me.

Then you have all the homeless people from safe harbor and the bus stops that love hanging around, either asking for food or spare money. And if you plan to eat there you will see them looming around looking for who to ask. Its pretty annoying and the management should do more to keep them off the property. I am not evil, I have been homeless before, but I dealt with it myself and fixed my life. Hard times hit everyone but checkers is not the place to look for help. 

Now the food at this location is not bad. I have had a couple times where the fish or chicken was so overcooked you could chip a tooth, but I brought it back and they fixed it and did not give me any problems about it. They even threw in some free ice cream or drinks for messing up, which is pretty cool. If it wasn't for the surroundings, this checkers could flourish. Unless you are going there in drive thru, watch out for the bums and transients. 


P.S. If someone offers you spice, do not smoke it, they love spice here.

WELCOME BACK!!! We missed you!!!! And it's evident in the patronage.  I personally had to wait for the crowds to die down a bit; good decision on my part. 

Service was good, the food was as well. The cornbread was tasty & a great treat before the entrée. Who doesn't like cornbread, don't answer, I don't wanna know that person. 

No adult beverages here, but water, tea, soda, lemonade and the like are available. 

The food was delivered in a timely fashion & was good. Not like it USED TO BE; I guess it was my hope; but STILLLLLLLLLLLLLLL a GREAT place for Soul Food. 

The day I visited, it was super packed; but I anticipate on a Sunday the opposite will be true. 

I plan to frequent this establishment for the food, the history & the great Family that own & operate.
I am not happy with the bed I bought or the customer service from Sleep Number.  I am sorry that I ever bought it!
Great staff - fast and friendly.  Fun selection of beverages to choose from too. You gotta stop here!
Slow. Rude people. Got my order wrong. Again. I live two blocks away, and come here every six months to see if it is better than it was. It isn't.

Staff are good, just short. About 3/4 staff work through out the week. They get the job done and they have a variety of gel, mood and beautiful polishes. Be sure to know any card purchases will be a $1 fee.

I often find myself going to this particular store when I'm in need of a certain ingredient that my local Publix, Sprouts, or even Whole Foods does not carry: - such as green tomatoes, smoked ham shanks - I'm talking soul food, y'all!  

They also carry an awesome salad topper - WD brand no less - light, crispy fried jalapeños!  Although recently I did find that Sprouts carries their own version - also delicious - but they are hard to locate: look ABOVE the lettuce - they are hanging. on clips?  Weird.

So WD is my place to go when I'm craving fried green tomatoes & some black eyed peas.
After 50 minutes waiting for one pizza ordered online (that was supposed to take 15 minutes), I called to cancel. Didn't even get an apology. I'll never come back.

Wow... great customer service. SUPER friendly! The coffee is better than anything I've had... and I've tried a lot of coffee places in my life. My husband got the Jack Sparrow (delicious cold foam on top) and I got a iced oat milk latte with toasted marshmallow sauce. Not too sweet at all. It tastes phenomenal... so smooth... so refreshing. 

Thanks for the great service! Loved the drive thru feature. :)

Apparently my visits to Chinatown predate my getting on Yelp, or at least Yelp having Check-ins.  That puts it back a spot indeed!

Several years ago The Better Half and I came here with my folks on a Friday night and waited a REALLY long time for our meal.  I think that had the effect of souring us on this place or at least moving it down to the bottom of the list.

Having said that, for the most part in our visits here service has been swift and friendly.  This visit was no exception, well, except for the waitress who kept reminding us "Lot of Food Coming!".  We had ordered the dinner "Special" which includes two entrees, soup, egg roll and dessert. We joked amongst ourselves that we fatties must be the only people that order it!

If anything our food came TOO quickly, within just a few minutes our table was stuffed with EVERYTHING we had ordered! But the food was delicious and we left feeling as stuffed as the table!

I had heard some raves about this place, but I was skeptical because $14 for a catfish platter just seemed like a lot to me. Well, I'm here to eat my words...and some delicious catfish.

I stopped in here for lunch and we were told to sit anywhere. The place is large and gorgeous and made to handle big crowds. Lucky for me, I came for a late lunch, so the place was pretty empty. After hearing all of the "oohs and aahs" about the catfish platter, I decided to go for it. My two sides were the veggie of the day, green beans, and I also had some red beans and rice because it was a Monday and those are the rules. We also started with some nice spinach dip and some complimentary corn bread was brought out to the table.

The spinach dip was great! It was a generous serving, served super hot with really salty chips, exactly how it's supposed to be served. The catfish platter came out and I was impressed. There were four nice-size pieces of catfish piled up in between my sides. The catfish was nicely battered, but the batter didn't compromise the flavor of the fish. The fish was thick cut and juicy and it was really fresh with a lot of flavor. The green beans were good and the red beans and rice were delicious. They were perfectly spiced (even though I added come Crystal sauce, because I always do) and the tasty cornbread went nicely with the entire meal.

Staff was friendly, even though the food took a while because it's all cooked to order. I didn't mind waiting a little longer for fresh cooked food, so that wasn't an issue. I am definitely going to have to get back over there and try the chicken, because I've also heard that their chicken is beyond good.

Horrible service!  Been several seasons now and we're still trying to recover from their substandard service. For example deep tire tracks in lawn and a cracked driveway from their equipment!! So frustrating.

This place puts my son Johnny second in place for best accidents! 
I had a medium iced coffee with two shots of hot espresso  on the side and blended in well. This place through me off to its location and sits right next to a pasture with cow's grazing on grass. I loved this experience as much as the coffee, idk if it's coincidental with the cows and coffee, but it makes the best duo!
The food is delicious and consistent. The atmosphere was very at home like. My favorite is the salmon and the Mac and cheese.
Really Good Lunch!!!  I had the red beans and rice and white meat chicken cooked to order.  Everything was wonderful!!!
All of our breakfast dishes were awesome. Biscuits were off the chain. The fried fish is one of the best in the city. If you want a down home meal this is your place

I absolutely loveeeeeee the breakfast here . I haven't actually been inside and always order through a third party but i am pleased every time. The catfish is amazing, seasoned with love and greatness. You get great portion sizes and the prices are reasonable. Definitely recommend

I've driven by Kaffeina a million times and keep saying I need to try it.  Well today I did.  Luckily, no one was in line so I didn't feel rushed.   I ordered an iced pumpkin macchiato. Delicious! They have an order and a pick up window which helps with keeping the flow of traffic and they made my drink pretty quick. Both girls working were super friendly and helpful.  I'll definitely be back.

Sub par gel manicure. Although he seemed really meticulous in the beginning, but sadly in the end it was barely a decent manicure because of the frayed edges, just not neat enough.

Pros include pleasant service, gave me matte finish.

Worst service experience I've ever had.  They didn't explain we needed a code to get in for the pick up so my husband was asked to leave then he called me for the code and they didn't give us our full order... no crazy bread?!?  Come on!  They were even rude about it and hung up before answering my call back to them to ask about the crazy bread.   Not going back there

Perhaps I came on an off night, but my experience at Dunbar's was not great. I went for a mid week dinner, and the place was empty when I arrived. The service was friendly and attentive. The food was my issue. We ordered chargrilled oysters that were so over cooked the oyster had turned into a paste on the shell. We also got spinach dip which was the best thing we ate. Most everything else just seemed old and dry. It was as if it was cooked another day and reheated. The cornbread was incredibly dry. My husband and I Got chicken and macaroni. The macaroni was mushy and dry, with separated cheese that told us it had been microwaved. I did not eat it. The chicken was crisp on the outside, but the inside wasn't juicy and was weirdly firm. The skin was very salty. Unfortunately, I will not recommend or return.
R&L creates beautiful backyard oasis's!!!  Great Company!

If I could give zero stars I would but Yelp won't let me. 

I just moved in this area a month ago and boy are they consistently terrible! 

The 1st time here drive thru was super slow, no big deal it was lunch rush. 

2nd time drive thru again super slow not busy AT ALL,so I didn't see what the issue was. Also the  older African American lady at the window was very unpleasant (I'd hate my job too if I was still in fast food at 50-60 years old) 

But this past experience today at around 6:35pm was a complete joke! Drive thru Lines were AGAIN slow! Yes I went in the drive thru again;No I'm not fat or lazy. I work 10 hour shifts standing on concrete! It was not busy AT ALL so again what's the issue? Every single employee DID NOT have a mask on. If they did it was over their chin not covering their nose and mouth. Watch the cameras I'm not lying. All of the guys back there had no clue on how to do their jobs. 3 cars were pulled forward like it was a drive in movie theater (no clear direction that the first person was supposed to park in the actual parking spaces ahead. I struggled to get out. 

This experience was so bad I had to call the customer complaint number. I NEVER CALL AND COMPLAIN! I don't have time for that. But I made time today! 

And to the GM. I'm not trying to be ugly but you don't deserve that position if you think that your Restaurant is up to par with following the new guidelines for COVID-19.

I'm not sure how people said they have negative experiences here but this is the first time i ordered from here and there pepperoni pizza was amazing not only that their wings are on point i have been searching for a place that had good pizza and wings especially since I'm from Jersey they came kind of close
Food and service are ALWAYS excellent.  Try the Mongolian Beef!  Wonderful flavors, tender beef and savory flavor.

The flowers to be delivered to my fiance for a special occasion at work were beautiful.  However, they were to be delivered by 5pm on Friday the 11th.  When they did not arrive, I told her I had ordered her flowers and I was so sorry they had not arrived.  The finally did arrive just before 6pm.  Had she not worked late, she would not have received them at all and she did not get them until after I blew the surprise.

Winn Dixie - North Dale Mabry

I will no longer shop at your store as you are not wiping down the carts due to COVID virus.

THE ONLY BAD THING I HAVE TO SAY IS PARKING IT'S SPOTTY DURING THE DAY!!! There's other businesses in the strip and the one right next to this place has inconsiderate employees. One of them was getting dropped off and I pulled in behind them. Apparently they didn't care if another car was waiting because they say there in front of the business doing what ever. I had took back up out of the parking lot, Go back onto Earhart and go around. ‍. I almost pulled off but since I really wanted to treat my daughter I stayed. After that foolery, we had a pretty good experience! The food was good and so was the service! Everyone was friendly and inviting!
Rachel did an amazing job on my tape in extensions!!! I absolutely love them! Had a great experience here! Will be back!

Stopped by for New Year's Day.  They were opened and advertise a good meal.  This place was recommended and reviews were good.  However, this was not a good day.  They were out of some food items.  The menu was limiting.  The service was slow.  People left.  When the food arrived, there is a lot of food on your plate.  Location is nice and clean.  Normal pricing for a soul food place.  Food is good and spicy, but they must learn to be more reactive to customers.

This place is secretly spacious! Much LARGER than the typical salon suite. Just well designed to provide every salon the flexibility to create their own dreams. My stylist has a suite here and I'm blown to pieces with the incredulous amount of space here and the serenity of the decor. I never hear conversations from other suites and the location is beautifully secured for safety.

Quick and efficient. My house stayed nice and clean (I expected some sort of soot mess) and we were provided with photos showing what was done. I appreciated the technical knowledge and will have them back for all my chimney cleanings. Highly recommend.
OMGGGGGGGGG , best philly and the most fastest fries definitely looking forward to trying everything else on the menu !
Great! Ordered Crab Ragoon, Orange Chicken, General Chicken, white rice, & lo mein! Loved it! I highly recommend this place for Chinese!!! I give it a 5 star!

We have been here 3 times. The first 2 times would have gotten a 5 star review. The fried chicken is AMAZING!! Some of the best I've ever had. Service was good both times. 
Today, the chicken was equally as amazing as before. The husband ordered red beans, I ordered Lima beans. Both arrived cold, before the horrible waitress even brought our salads (?!). Then she took the beans back to reheat- one plate at a time (?!). We asked for extra napkins and butter for the (excellent) cornbread. She brought the napkins, then went back and got the butter (?!). Then she ignored us for at least 10 minutes after we finished. We got our own to go containers, she never came back until we got the hostess to go get her. 
We will go back. Food is too good! But we will make sure that we don't have to suffer through lunch with this clueless person again. Also, a manager/supervisor has never approached us to see if our food/experience was okay in the 3 times we ate there. You guys need to up your game with the service- I've seen lots of places that had good food close due to not being run well. Don't let that happen...

There is nothing fast about this fast food restaurant. We have been sitting in line for 30 minutes and there are still two cars ahead of us. It's 4 pm so there is no excuse. Burger King is one of my favs but this is extremely disappointing and I'm sure the food will be subpar with service like this.

I order here a lot as it is close and usually quick. Tonight was a different story. I ordered online for a pick up. I waited the 15 minutes it said online and went up there. My pizza wasn't in the portal so I asked about it. The lady yelled at me and told me it would be 10 minutes. Then yelled at the lady behind me who wanted a refund. An hour later I finally got my pizza after being told that I hadn't been waiting that long. The lady behind the counter needs to go.

Finally full leaf collard greens.  Winn Dixie like most stores has a decreased amount of groceries. Although, this one did have paper towels and toilet paper.  But, those elusive antiseptic wipes there were none.
Giving WinnDixie an extra hollar.  They did have plenty of whatever meat you are looking for the holiday weekend.  With a bit of a price change from before.
Nice vegetable department with mostly fresh looking fruits and vegies. Huge seafood display.  If you get a chance you should make the drive.  Maybe they have something in store for you.

I visited based on hearing good things about Dunbar's and how good they were before the hurricane.   I must say this was a waste of $21! The quality of the food is the worst! I ordered the combination catfish and shrimp plate with macaroni and cheese and potato salad to go....Don't get me wrong the macaroni was good and it had a nice sauce to it, but the potato salad was hot!  I don't know if it was just made or what but how do you serve hot potato salad in New Orleans and expect your customer to be satisfied?   The problem I really had with the plate was the catfish! The catfish was this artificial water fish that you would expect to get from the corner store!  It was fried to perfection but it had very little season!  The batter did not have a good taste to it! The shrimp were nice big shrimp but it had no flavor!  You also get a piece of garlic bread that became soggy under all of the fried  seafood...Dunbar I know you are probably making a comeback to the city and you need to make your money but you will need to lower your price on this plate as the quality is not there! I gave 2 stars based on presentation because it was presented nicely and I thought it would be delicious but it was not! I could have brought a supper plate from a church and it woulda been better then this! I was clearly disappointed!  Also the staff was nice and courteous over the phone, and I felt they were nice and welcoming when I picked up my food!

Pretty rough experience.  I ordered a junior bacon king. I got a cheeseburger with no bacon.  I ordered chicken nuggets but got no sauce.  I ordered a value soda, was charged for a small soda and got a water instead.  LOL

Meanwhile, three people at the drive-through window stood and chatted the entire time I was there.
Yes. Yes. Yes. Fantastic coffee like I'm in the PNW. Go here. Caffeinate. Feel happiness.
I finally tried Dunbar's Cajun cuisine and was very pleased. The smothered okra it was delicious fried chicken crust was delicious but the chicken was a little undercooked by the bone.

The red beans and rice with fried chicken and corn bread is awesome. The oyster poboy was perfect. And the smothered okra with fried fish keeps me coming back. The wait staff is very friendly and my coworker and I will continue to make this place a regular lunch spot. Yum...
Thanks

Dunbars has came through for me more often than not.  From .99cent breakfast awesome.  To dining in and being the most talked about place of my not so easy to please foreign family guests,  I'm happy I gave Dunbars a try.  I need to try their dinner sometime.

Everything was delicious. My son & I dined in early June 2018 & ordered a to-go plate for my hubby. We had the cabbage and fried chicken special. It came w/candied yams and cornbread. My first thigh was slightly under cooked, but was quickly replaced with a pipping hot, fully cooked, juicy, and deliciously crispy thigh. My cornbread was fluffy, crunchy on the end, and hot. The yams were sweet and yummy. My hubby met us & ate 1/2 his plate there. He had the red beans w/chicken. He was pleased also. I have since ordered to-go x2 and each meal was a yummy as the 1st. The service was good, sort of "NOLA" style... LOL... 

I'll be back... I'm pleasantly satisfied

Just so happen to drive by and noticed they advertised a .99cents breakfast. It comes with a biscuit,grits or hashbrowns,eggs and your choice of sausage or bacon. All of this for .99cents! 

This is how everyone should start their day. Everything was delicious & I had low expectations. They were surpassed. U have the option to dine in or take out. I did a quick take out as i was on the move but I'll make sure to check out the rest of their menu on my next visit for lunch or dinner.
This place is great. Perfect seasoning. Seafood stuffed baked potato is a must. Creole fried  chicken wing app is best I have had in NOLA. Red beans are awesome. If I could give it a 6 stars.

I really really didn't like my experience here. The food was so terrible. I can't really compliment anything about it minus the fact the parking lot had spaces to park in an otherwise congested area. Service was hit and miss. Usually, I do not hold heavy expectations for Chinese food, but I held a higher standard here since it is more of a sit down establishment than take away. Quality was just a complete miss with all of our dishes from rubbery tasting beef to bone filled duck with little meat to be had. Just no... not worth my time or money spent again.

Excellent service. Great food. I was pleasantly surprised to see your folks wearing the "racial justice" T Shirts, particularly in Florida. I will definitely will spread the word that you folks have courage, along with good food. 
Okay
Fried chicken mac and cheese. It's felt like I was in my kitchen. It was so good . Hubby and I would come back again and bring some friends.

Chinatown is a consistently satisfying restaurant--great food, speedy and friendly service and clean space.  Our family of 4 has now had 3 terrific meals here.  We have typically split 2-3 entrees and 2-1 appetizers and have just the right amount.  Plus, it's pretty affordable (~$40-$45 for the 4 of us).

We plan to go here whenever we are in the mood of authentic Chinese (Cantonese) food.

Sauce tastes like it came out of a can, bitter and acidy. apparently no one at this joint knows how to add sweet basil and rosemary to balance it. The cheese they use tasted and melted like it came from Walmart. There extra large The calamari was so overcooked it was like little rock rings and the jalapeno poppers were surprisingly bland. 2 medium sized, 1 topping pizzas that they call "X-L" and a small handful of rock hard calamari and poppers out of a freezer bag= $42.75.

Then there is the fun and games with the charge. If you add your $10 tip on the tip line they demand, not ask for cash in barely discernible English. Probably because the house rips off the driver. No good deed goes unpunished.

If you mention that the calamari was overcooked the middle eastern management yells at you and says "You lie!". Incredible rude people, different management from just a few months ago.

There are too many good pizza joints in town like New York, New York to ever want to go here.

I used to go here in the 80's and 90's with my grandparents. It was always crazy delicious compared to most Chinese fare around Nashville. They were bought out around the time my daughter was born. Sadly it was quickly converted from a nice sit down restaurant with nice decorations, menus, etc to you standard paper menu with a billion dishes (*red indicates spicy!) generic garbage that dots Nashville. Very sad... I absolutely loved their hot and sour soup, the garlic was superb, even their steamed dumplings were top notch. What the hell happened?

Their food is absolutely amazing! The presentation of the food is great upon serving, even for takeout! I'm not originally from New Orleans and it was my first time visiting and the server took her time to gather my preferences and recommended some amazing first try's!

Love love love it!

The fried chicken here is incredible!!! The three piece dark is so juicy and flavorful. They will be my go to for fried chicken in the city for now! The gumbo is delicious too and packed with flavor. The gumbo has shells in it which I am finding out is common in gumbo here. The cornbread was soft and sweet and the garlic toast was on point. My server Ashley was nice and gave me good service. I can't wait to come back here!
Went late and the food took forever and tasted like it had been sitting all day.  I do not recommend.

The food was absolutely delicious! We really loved everything and the staff was very friendly. We got our food to go and everything was hot and fresh and absolutely delicious!
We will visit again. My husband had the smothered pork chop and I had the fried chicken meal, our daughter had the seafood platter.
Awesome, hot, well seasoned and delicious!

Once great, now very disappointing.  New owners, food quality way down, prices way up.  Loved it for years, not going back. Fried rice without egg, peas, anything other than rice.  They said something about using a tiny egg!  I can do better with Uncle Ben's!

I went to this salon for years, I have mixed feelings as the stylists I went to were all very nice but overall I cannot get over the inconsistent pricing. Also, the constant upselling. I always felt pressured to add on a service. Also, the prices seem to increase with every appointment. I had an issue with my extensions once that was extremely painful and when I called to see if someone can help I felt like I was bothering them. It is a very stylish salon with a lot of very nice people but I prefer to go to a salon I trust with consistent pricing and more inclined to fix a problem.

Absolutely great meal. No matter when you go and what you get, you'll always leave full..

Can't wait to get back to the city and go again.

I'm huge on customer service I receive before I give my money. I got in touch with Emma originally by iMessage text and she responded in a timely manner to my messages however I didn't book because i was still undecided on what I actually wanted to do to my hair. I have long black hair that I don't let just anyone touch. Not everyone knows how to work with black hair. So then later a month or so i got in touch with her again by instagram. She did not respond to me at all what so ever I waited past 2 weeks. So I ended up removing my messages cuz she was obviously ignoring me (mind you , everyday she puts a post on Instagram and constantly tells her followers to ask her questions) but okay. I let it go. I texted her by iMessage via iPhone and still no reply. I guess she mad cuz I didn't book right away as if I'm wasting her time! Please there are plenty of talented people who would love to take my money! What's the point of paying her almost $400 when customer service is shit? No point ! Can't stand cocky ass "business owners" like her.

One of my favorite coffee places of all time!! It's kind of hidden but you'll see it back there! So worth the stop! Coffee is amazing, food is great, smoothies are out of this world. Highly recommend to anyone in the area. Beats the normal chain coffee like dunkin and sbux for sure

If you're looking for a selection better than Starbucks or Even a great quality classic latte or coffee... Kaffeina is a MUST. Moved here last year and have tried every coffee place within a ten mile radius. There are other good places but I am a regular here due to the selection, friendly staff, and consistent quality  

Seriously must try and if you're looking for something unique try their monthly specials.... I've been obsessed with the Jack sparrow cold or hot
Dunbar's has the most amazing food and desserts created and served by the most amazing people. What more can you ask for? Oh yeah a Oysters Rockefeller hamburger!

My best friend and I ordered from here via UberEats and felt compelled to leave a stellar review because the food was dank, for lack of a better term.

Our entrees, baked ziti & spaghetti, tasted so good that i literally started tearing up. After taking a bite of our desserts, red velvet cake & tiramisu, i'm pretty sure God looked me directly in the eye; it was really good.

Not sure what all the negative reviews are about, but they seem a little bitter and over dramatic, so don't let them sway your initial impression.

LIVE MOUSE NEXT TO TABLE.  It won't allow a 0. Waited to be seated for 3 or 4 minutes by desk person. They were not busy. Seated at STICKY table. Cordial waiter brought water and menus.  He came back to take our order and MOUSE falls off his pants into middle  of aisle. Multiple people eating see it. He goes to kitchen, gets broom and dustpan.  Scoops up very alive mouse and returns to kitchen. We exited. Had not been here in 5+ years and had hoped to enjoy Chinese New Year. Used to eat here often. TOTALLY GROSSED OUT.  Won't be back.

Wow... this place has gone downhill!!!  Terrible service without care for the customer.   This used to be a great restaurant with great service and great food.   Have used this restaurant for catering many dozen times over the years and used to live within walking distance of here and have been dining here for more than 30 years for perspective on this review.    

Food was slow to arrive (about 40 minutes).  For a table of 4, the first 2 dishes came out prepared whole with the other 2 meals arriving 8 and 12 minutes later.    No apologies.   My food came early, so by the time my daughter's food arrived, it was no longer hot.   I have no plans to return as long as they are under the current management.

This is probably my favorite restaurant in town. If you're going to splurge, this is the place to do it. Mrs. Dunbar (Owner) as well as her employees are welcoming and unfailing polite. I was amazed at the speed of service.The ambience is nice, the food is to die for. At different times  the employees were efficient and helpful. The service I received was prompt. Customers are provided with affordable prices and fast service. I couldn't have been more pleased...I can confirm that Dunbar's restaurant is committed to providing each customer with the highest caliber of customer service, an act that demonstrates a genuine desire to satisfy, if not delight, a customer. I highly recommend Dunbar's restaurant.

Respectfully Submitted
Gmarie Hall

CC: YELP
Google review

I'm glad they were able to finally re-open! I'm sure there will be improvements along the way (speed of bringing out items and processing payments) but it's good to see them back in business.  The fried chicken was amazing and the homemade lemonade and cornbread hit the spot!

Pros:
Remodeled and relatively clean. High top seating available. Multiple TVs inside. Check app for coupons/promotions. It's worth it! The Impossible Burger tastes good for the vegetarian and even the carnivore.  

Cons:
The TVs were tuned to inappropriate channels/shows. My children were eating and watching tv, only to hear cussing and watching inappropriate behavior / things you wouldn't find on regular tv. I think they were internet streaming. Definitely not a family atmosphere. Also they were out of chicken fries and honey mustard, in addition to drink flavors in the soda machine.

Won't be back, if you are with several people your whole table should be eating at the same time. Our table food can out literally 5 minutes apart, until we had to consistently tell her she was forgetting people food. The Mac and cheese was so greasy until you couldn't even eat it.  The menu was very very limited. I'm very disappointed

I'm very happy to see Dunbar's reopen, and was a fan and patron of the old restaraunt on Freret St. The new digs are kind of strange, the building is odd as is the interior. Like most post-Katrina reopenings, everything about the interior is cheap and unfortunate.

The service at Dunbar's is excellent as always. The wait staff is very attentive and friendly.

The food is good but if my memory serves correctly not as good as I remember the old restaurant being, but they just reopened so I'll hold off on that. They're definitely putting forth a big effort so I'll refrain from being overly critical until the restaurant has been open a year at least.

I've looked forward to the reopening of Dunbar's, they were great when they were located uptown on Freret Street.  They had great red beans & rice, and fried chicken,  Gumbo, cabbage and other favorites.  Well, today I dined at the new location on Earhart Blvd, I ordered a cup of gumbo and red beans & rice, with fried chicken.  VERY DISAPPOINTED!  The gumbo was not tasty, and the red beans were not creamy, or cake like, and the fried chicken was simply awful! I didn't eat most of it....it had a hint of fried hot sausage taste to it.  Maybe it was fried in the same grease.  I don't know, but I won't be going back!  Mandina's  still has some of the best red beans & rice, and fried chicken in New Orleans.  I pride myself for being borned & raised in New Orleans, specifically Treme!  We know how GOOD FOOD taste.  Not anyone can cook Good Gumbo nor Good Red Beans!  I went to school with Buster (Homes)Bean's in the French Quarters two older sons, Tyrone and Clarence. We use to hop the fence at McDonald 41 (Armstrong Park now) to eat lunch there...lived two blocks from Dooky Chase!  That being said, I know how good Creole Food taste!  I know "What It Means To miss New Orleans!

While I had a great hair experience the one time I went, I would recommend caution. This salon seems to be less concerned about excellent customer service and more about attaining money for their next build. I created an appointment at 9pm on 10/6. The next morning I realized that I had inadvertently selected the wrong date and promptly alerted them. The salon never informed me in person nor on the website that there would be a $25 cancelation fee. I created the appointment within less than 24 hours and canceled as soon as I discovered the error. They still insisted to charge me a $25 cancelation fee. For a high end salon, this feels completely unnecessary given the circumstances. In addition, know that if you sign up for a "gold member" account as I did, that there is no recourse for cancelation of you are unsatisfied for any reason. A salon that purports to be high end should also have high end customer service. There are many other salons in the St. Louis area, I would recommend going elsewhere that doesn't seek to take advantage of the money of their clientele.

DON'T BUY A BED FROM THIS COMPANY WHATEVER YOU DO!!!  THEIR POLICIES ARE TERRIBLE!!!

We purchased a customized poster bed, base, and flex mattress from sleep number. We waited 6 weeks for everything to be delivered since the poster bed is customized.  We counted the days and we where so excited for our new bed to arrive. It came on time and we thought everything was great up until we received the bed. The poster bed was not what we were promised, it was not the right size so it would slide side to side and back to front, for a bed of this price ($8,000), we really had high expectations, but they didn't even meet the basic ones... 

We contacted the store and we were told to contact the customer service hotline. When we called the customer service, It took us 2 hours of waiting time to get to anyone. If you want to resolve any issue with them you have to speak to a case manager, it took another hour to get to the right person. The first time I called, I spent 4 hours total on the phone, just trying to explain the issue.

At this point we thought we were on our way to resolving the issue, they sent a few technicians to our house to fix the bed post, but they were not able to fix it because the measurements of the bedpost were too off. The technicians agreed that the product didn't fit the frame or mattress, and that they were unable to make any adjustments because the bed post was just too large for our frame and mattress. They said they would speak to their supervisor and see what they could do. They told us we would receive a call within the hour to discuss our options, but of course they never did. The next day came, and we still hadn't received a call. I had to call the technicians back several times with no avail. I left several voicemails desperately trying to get the issue resolved as soon as possible. No one called us back until 4 days later. I called Sleep Number again waiting for hours to speak with the right person. At this point, I was so frustrated dealing with them, that I had to ask them to give us a full refund cause the customer service was so terrible, and they could come pick up the bed. This is an $8,000 dollar bed, including the frame and mattress, everything should be perfect for such an extravagant cost, but it's not. 

Every time I see the bed it is just a reminder of how awful this company and its customer service is, we started off excited about this product, only to despise it, all due to how Sleep Number worked us around. The whole point of a bed is to relax and sleep, but this whole experience has been so ridiculously stressful that I find myself not being able to sleep out of frustration for how little they were willing to do for us. 

We would understand not accepting a refund if the mistake was on our part, but it wasn't. They offered to take $100 off the bed post they had screwed up on, and waive the shipping fee for the product they had gotten wrong (we still have to wait 6 weeks for it to arrive, that is not a proportional compensation for how long we have to wait... again). That is not a solution? The bed post should be free and without any charge considering all we had to go through to even try to resolve the issue (it still hasn't been resolved). The responsibility should be on sleep number for sending us the defected and wrong product, but they refused to do that. 

Now, I am still stuck with a defected product and have to wait another 6 weeks for them to send us a new one. Despite having spent a little over $8,000 dollars on this defected product, this is  what we get from this company, no resolutions at all, just bandaids. 

Everyone hates a Karen, but this is easily the worst customer service experience I've ever experienced. 

I should mention that the customer service representatives are very polite and only doing their job, it is not the individual people we spoke to that were terrible, but rather the company policies and the organization of getting things resolved. They need to manage their hotline better. 

Once again, please don't buy a bed from this company, the bed isn't even worth it, nor is the headache.

BEST CATFISH hands down in New Orleans!! Our Uber driver recommended Dunbar's as a great choice for catfish. I must say IT WAS MORE THAN DELICIOUS!!! The potato salad and sides were phenomenal!!!
Having traveled to NOLA  numerous times and dined in various restaurants and cuisines -  we rank Dunbar's as TOP TEN places to eat!! 
Trying to decide where to eat our last meal before ending our stay in the BIG EASY and we find ourselves headed back to Dunbar's!!

Just had the premier chimney sweep, Joe, from Your Chimney Sweep out for his biennial chimney inspection.  He and his assistant were efficient, capable, honest and friendly.  Joe has schooled me in proper fireplace do's and don't's. This being my first fireplace, I have been grateful.  His no-nonsense, with a hint of humour, demeanor has been appreciated.  Thanks for a job well done.

Just purchased an older home in Indy, with our very first fireplace. Your Chimney Sweep sent Joe to get us cleaned up and schooled. He did a fine job, we feel secure and wiser for his visit.  Your Chimney Sweep will be our go to experts for our fireplace needs.  Thanks so much!!!

We just had the most horrible experience.  Because nobody would help us when we walked in, we ended up using the ordering kiosk.  My husband and I, with our 3 children, ordered 5 impossible burger meals (was supposed to include drink and fries).  We waited over 20 minutes, we were totally ignored.  The people working there wouldn't acknowledge us and even when they handed us our meals, they walked away when we said thank you...without giving us our drinks.  Assuming they were getting our drinks, we waited another 10 minutes and they all ignored us even though there were NO other customers there.  Then an elderly woman came in, ordered a shake and they messed THAT up and didn't apologize to her.  She left looking so sad.  Finally when my husband asked where our drinks were, the person working the counter shrugged and walked away again.  Seriously, we have never been treated this badly at ANY restaurant.  The kids had already found a place to sit and our food was cold, microwaved, not even grilled.  The french-fries were stale and cold.  There weren't any condiments on the burgers except for some floppy pieces of lettuce.  When we asked for a manager we were ignored.  Finally, as I took a bite out of my burger and had to pull a very long hair out of my mouth, I got upset and went up to demand our money back.  This time there was a woman there who claimed she was the manager.  All she did was tell me how they didn't have to make us happy, she didn't care what our food was like and oh - my favorite - that lots of people get hairs in their burgers.  We stood there stunned.  Finally my husband demanded the money back, I got the children from their half eaten meals and we all walked out.  Besides all this, the floors were sticky, the tables were dirty, there were flies on the counter and a cricket by the garbage can.  We are still shocked and troubled by the terrible treatment we received.

DO NOT do Business with this company online.
Nutshell - they sent the wrong tile and took three weeks to process a refund for the return.
We ordered tile from Mission Stone and Tile online.  A salesperson on the phone emailed a picture of two rows of tile, one white and one blue.  We were assured that the item we ordered was the blue tile. They sent the white.  

We tried to return the tile.  They sent three boxes of tile, but had FedEx pick up only two boxes, then had to send FedEx back for the third box.  

It was a parade of excuses from them trying to get the return completed. It was our fault for ordering the wrong tile, for not telling them they had sent three boxes, it was FedEx's fault for not delivering the tile back to them yet, it was American Express' fault for not processing the refund.  Over the course of three weeks, we heard that the tile was actually blue and we couldn't tell blue from white, that the owner of the company was getting married so couldn't deal with us, that the salesperson had suffered storm damage to her house so couldn't deal with us, that no one was working in the office on several days.  The person answering the phone was only a temp so couldn't help.  After several weeks of this, I got the following email from the owner of the company.  Here it is in full:

"Please stop driving us crazy with your phone calls.  We will forward you documentation from Amex today."

This was regarding the credit card company failing to process a refund that, it turned out, they hadn't submitted yet. We did not get that documentation.  It was the credit processing company's fault.
And on and on.  Don't do it.  

I thought they were shady for a while, now I think they're just incompetent.  Regardless, it is not worth it.

Food was largely quite wonderful at a very reasonable price point, and we were having a great time at this unassuming, no-frills soul food spot... until my mom found a hair in her eggs (which, she said, had previously tasted great). While this is a thing that can certainly happen anywhere, it truly puts a damper on a meal. 

Nevertheless, that this isn't now a 1 Star review is a testament to how good some of the rest of the food was. The steak was phenomenally seasoned and cooked perfectly (though this particular rib-eye was very fatty). But the true stars were the side dishes: the potato salad, rice pilaf, and hashbrowns were AMAZING. Yes, I realize those are typically three of the most bland sides, but Dunbar's has managed to give them zest and life and TONS of flavor - we were licking the bowls, it was THAT good. 

Other food: The chicken 'n' waffles were... fine: crisply crusted, juicy chicken over a slightly undercooked waffle - however, because the pieces of chicken were wings and drumsticks rather than strips of breast meat, it was impossible to eat the chicken'n'waffles together in one bite of chicken'n'waffle because you have to bite the chicken off the bone separately, which kind of defeats the purpose of chicken'n'waffles. Logistically it just didn't quite work. The syrup was also lackluster, and I had to ASK for hot sauce! (gasp)

Additionally, despite having $2.50 mimosas on the brunch menu (a great deal!), they told us they weren't serving any that day, nor were they serving any other alcohol for a reason that wasn't provided to us.

Despite all this, I find myself wanting to go back to this old NOLA institution! That fried catfish I saw on a neighbor table keeps calling my name!
Whatever you do, AVOID booking with Jenna Quagliana. She is extremely unprofessional and RUDE. Please save yourself the disappointment and book with a real stylist.

OK, so this is definitely not my supermarket of choice for so many reasons but had to come in here recently due to the convenience of it being in the same shopping plaza that I was already in and the fact that I didn't feel like stopping again at my preferred grocery store.  My visit just reaffirms why I don't like coming here.  The place is dirty and unless you have the Winn Dixie card, you don't get the deals.  I don't have a card and didn't want to sign up for one either since I don't come here but did remember that my grandmother had one under her number which I supplied to the clerk and it worked.  The produce never looks great and I never purchase anything other than boxed or canned from here when this is the only option available.  I've had friends that purchased meat from this grocer that later got sick so I don't trust what they sell.

Came here on a hunch before going to a seminar. Only had $6 to spend on breakfast to no be hungry during this class. The staff was very friendly through all of my changes in my order & indecisiveness. The food was wonderful & the atmosphere was a joyous one. I was awake & had a better attitude before entering the half of my off day seminar. I would definitely be visiting again!
You can never go wrong with this place. The good is delicious and affordable! They have some good punch as well! Love this place!

If you are visiting NOLA and don't go to Dunbar's, you are missing one of the great food experiences to be had, not only in this town, but perhaps the entire South. And if you live here, you have absolutely no excuse not to go, not only for the superb food, but to support this legendary restaurant.

I was last at Dunbar's on July 14, 2005, when it was still on Freret Street, with a group of friends as part of that year's Dining for Life NO/AIDS Task Force benefit. Suffice to say, a lot has changed since then.

What hasn't changed is the friendly service, the Bob Hope letter on the wall, and the AWESOME food! If you haven't been here before, run, don't walk (M-F, 11-5, that is), for simply the best Creole Soul food around!

I ordered the hush puppies appetizer, thinking I'd get 3 or maybe 6. What I got was a dozen of the most perfect puppies on the planet! (Tho maybe I shouldn't have had them all at one sitting, fabulous as they are. Lol)

The gumbo, filled with crab, shrimp, chicken and sausage was absolutely heavenly as well. It was as tho each of the individual components had been personally and lovingly placed in the cup.

I also got the Tuesday Special "Cabbage with Yams served with barbecue (or fried) chicken" for $9.95 -- who knew rice came with it as well?!

The chicken was tasty, the cabbage could make anyone a cabbage aficionado, and the yams are so wonderful they could be served as a dessert!! (Note: Yams are only on the menu Tuesdays and Thursdays. I asked why and it's because of the amount of preparation they entail from peeling each one to a long cooking time to get them so perfectly tender.)

Hope they'll be staying open later again for dinner soon!

The salon is cute and the final product of my hair was pretty good. However, the price they told me it would be vs what it was was $100 off. I have short hair and only wanted to change a few shades darker and was charged for 2 things of additional dye. I wish I would have known the price would be so drastically different. I do not think I will return.
Ok, Thursday's menu is hands-down the best. The "only" thing anyone should order this day is their special of the day which is always greens with fried chicken. DELICIOUS!!!

I have been an R&L residential customer for five years.  Services used include:  weekly lawn mowing and trimming, spring and fall cleanups, mulch, snow removal, and tree maintenance.  I have been very pleased with the quality of all services received, and at a fair price.  I highly recommended R&L for your residential needs.
Awesome place for a drink or two, play a few slots and grab a bite! Delicious food, cold drinks, good slots and awesome staff!

I enjoyed this spot.  Like I really loved The Seafood platter. So y'all let me say this...... The waitress are are very knowledgeable and make really good suggestions.  So me and my two co-workers came here and we were very blah about the spot at first but the.minute we sat down we had a good time. Now the wait time is really long but it is worth it. We were served hot cornbread while we sat and waited . me and a co worker ordered seafood platter with red beans and Mac And cheese. It was sooooo delicious. Also the platter had fish,shrimp,crab balls,and oysters nd it was everything i wanted. The other two co workers ordered something else that still was great. The Sweet Tea.....it was too damn GOOD!!! Everything was at a good expense. I enjoyed everything and will be back.

I really wanted to love this place due to the positive reviews I've seen everywhere else. I'm gonna assume that I just caught them on a bad day. I went on a Saturday afternoon and they were very busy with several large groups of people. Service was nice despite the crowd and they actually were pretty efficient. The downside was the food. Maybe I was just expecting too much since I had heard such great things. The fried chicken, which we were told was fried to order, was hard and appeared to have been sitting. It didn't have any real flavor. I asked for 2 legs and a wing and instead got a leg and 2 thighs. The fried fish my boyfriend ordered had absolutely no flavor and wasnt even warm. The sides (Mac n Cheese, shrimp pasta) were equally bland. It kinda reminded me of something you might have at a wedding- neither good or really bad- just kinda ok. They give you cornbread while you wait. That was pretty good. We didn't try dessert because we didn't want to be further disappointed.

Do not try the salmon here. It was dry and over cooked. The side dishes came in very small plastic bowls. The serving size was too small. The dried seafood is to die for. They have the best sweet tea. Our waitress was very polite and She brought out some cornbread and butter while we waited. It was delicious. I will go back and try other things.

I moved to St Louis 2.5 months ago and found this salon on Instagram.

The team are great and they use Oribe products! They know current hair trends and have a great members gold club for those who want to take advantage of 10% off all treatments.

Jamie is the best and Tierney is super sweet and so is Christina herself who is often on the salon floor too
I only tired their catfish sandwich which was so yummy and also the cornbread was a five stars

Worst service! My boyfriend walked in at 8:35 pm this evening to get a hot n ready pizza. They did not have any available and the worker refused to make him one. WTF?? He said they were closing soon. They close at 9:00. IN 25 MINUTES!!! That's plenty of time to make a pizza!!! We are livid.

What a great experience here! My coworkers and I had a group lunch here recently and everyone really enjoyed it. We had 17 people and the staff was very friendly and efficient. Even with a group this size, we were able to get in and out in a little over an hour. They gave us cornbread while we waited...im not typically a fan but theirs was fantastic.  It was a bit crumbly but the flavor made up for that. 

I had the fish plate with red beans and mac n cheese. My fish was crispy..huge plus for me. I hate soft, soggt fish. The sides had just the right amount of seasonings. I didnt have room for dessert but the bread pudding looked awesome. This was my first visit here...not sure why...but i would like to return.

Wonderful service... they really do care about customers they make sure that you're fully happy before you leave. Very friendly helpful nice group of people. Will return again to get my nails done. Also very up on fashion and different Trends in the Beauty World love that about them.

Excellent full service salon!  The team is very through from consultation, color, extensions, cut and color they explain with great detail and friendly service.  You can really tell this team really likes where they work and that makes for a great customer experience.  Just learned they now do make up application so I can't wait to utilize that service too!  I've had so many compliments on my hair and the best part is most people say they can't really tell I have extensions.  I have a whole new confidence thanks to the folks at Christina White salon!
I've ordered here several times and it's fantastic. Great people and even better pizza!

I've heard about Kaffeina so much, and I'm glad I finally tried it. We ordered two hot coffees and two croissant breakfast sandwiches. 

We both tried January special flavors for coffee. I enjoyed the Peanut Brittle (peanut butter and toffee) and my hubby liked the Dream Weaver (chocolate, hazelnut, and salted caramel). The coffees here are subtly flavored, so they weren't as sweet as I thought they might be considering our flavor choices. So definitely try all the creative combos! Mine had a peanut butter undertone and the dream weaver had slight chocolatey notes.

The presto sandwich was really flavorful from the pesto and roasted tomatoes. My husband had the Huevo with sausage, but we agreed it wasn't super flavorful like the other sandwich.

I'd be back again for more coffee in the future for sure.
Do not recommend! Not happy with final product; from the quality of materials to the service!

Here is why my family cannot recommend this chef:
Unprofessionalism:
After cooking us two weeks of food, I offered some feedback. There were some great meals but a few meals I let her know we didn't care for. I have 2 young children so I expected that, was not upset, and it was not a deal breaker for us. Being that I'm pregnant I was just thankful for having someone help us out!

Well, the day before she was to come cook 10 more meals for us, after I already approved her menu, she cancels and says she will no longer work with us, not giving a reason and no notice. We were shocked at the way this was poorly and unprofessionally handled.

If you are a family with kids, looking to hire a chef to help shoulder some of your load, I would look elsewhere unfortunately. Kids can be difficult to figure out with taste buds at times and she seemed to not tolerate this and took it personally.
Good burger with a reasonable price.  I really like the fries, they are crispy with a soft potato inside.  Milk shake is thick and tasty.  Drive thru time is reasonable.

Considering everything going on in the world these days, I loved everything about my experience at this salon. They took my temperature upon check in, all masks were present, and hand sanitizer was out and ready. 
Onto the hair: I'm obsessed with it!!! I love that Kaleigh took care of everything from start to finish. She asked lots of questions during our consultation, gave suggestions, and clearly stated the prices of everything before moving forward. And it was a bit pricy! But I knew exactly what I was getting myself into- worth every penny! Thank you!

Boyfriend got the "Extra Most Bestest" special tonight. It was supposed to be extra cheese and extra pepperoni. Nothing extra most bestest about this one. I would say there it was extra crust, at best. We'll definitely be sticking to the normal menu from now on.

Comedy Night at Dunbar's @Dunbarscreolecuisine 2.3.18!! Doors open at 8PM Show starts at 9PM. Hosted by @Shervey1 Featuring @JiveBrady @Ritabrentcomedy @ShaddyFeelgood and Special performances by @_singingbeauty_ & @coolnastyband Tickets are available for sale at Eventbrite.com or Dunbar's Creole Cuisine 7834 Earhart Blvd.

Absolute worst service I've ever experienced. We went her in attempt to support and with being the only table there it was over 38 min on our app which were wings that came out not done. I could continue on to when I complained and got up to se about 10 employees talking and laughing all while my table and another couple that came in were far from satisfied. After speaking with the no one came to the table at all. Don't waster your time.

Dunbar's has long been famous for their Creole food, fried chicken and daily specials.  There new location has been decorated with lots of bright colors and they do have off street parking.  They have a great selection of items on their menu and there should be something on there to please most tastes.  Dunbar's fried chicken is always among the top options in the New Orleans area when discussing the best fried chicken in the area.  They have also added some enormous burger options and their entrees are really great.  The service here is friendly and they keep your drink refilled along with being very good about explaining daily specials on offer.  

Overall this is great place that needs to be on your must visit list to experience the great food joints of New Orleans.

My video review of Dunbar's Creole Cuisine is here:

https://youtu.be/kOf-JmHhD_w

I frequently order the 3 pc fried chicken meal with Mac and cheese, red beans, yams and cornbread and it'll last me about 2-3 days. You definitely get your money's worth and the food is ALWAYS amazinggg 10 out of 10!!
Food was okay. This is probably lunch spot for folks who work near. Maybe I'll be back if I'm in the area again but I won't drive from another part of the city.
Food was cold forgot some of the things I ordered need to have fresh fries and learn how to be accurate with orders and food need to be hot

Came in during our visit to New Orleans from L.A. and everything we tried was excellent! From the gumbo, to the Mac, to the wings, to the ribs, the sweet tea and and the LEMONADE!!! Allll good! The service was excellent and and the ladies were very sweet! When we come back to visit, we're definitely going back again!

Rudy's is great. I love their online booking or call and they usually have same day appointments available. My go to guy is Philip. He's super chill easy going and give great cuts. One time I treated myself to a blow out and I felt fab after. You can't beat their affordable prices. I also like the fact that they have their own lot with free 1.5 hour parking. Winning!

nicest people ever!! I was so fortunate to have stopped by one morning while working on this side of town. I ordered the huevo breakfast sandwich and an iced mocha. coffee was perfect! smooth and well balanced. the sandwich was steaming hot and clearly freshly made. truly made my morning! they also gave me a little piece of a lemon cranberry muffin to try and it was divine! I almost turned around and went back through the line to get one lol. don't miss this place!!

I got the food delivered to the hotel I was staying at. i ordered catfish poboy, chicken wings, veggie and lemonade. The poboy lacked flavor and bad quality of veggies, the chicken wing - the first piece I took a bite had some weird metal object - So nasty that I didn't even want to take a chance to eat the remaining 5 pieces. my dinner at New Orleans was a huge disappointment. I called the restaurant and they would not refund. what a customer service.

When you walk into a restaurant and it doesn't smell like food...turn around like I wish we had. We had the gumbo which was mostly bone and gristle.   New Orleans is a must stop for great food except for here.  The red beans lacked flavor. The waitress was nice.

I've visited Kaffeina now too many times to count and just had to upgrade them to 5 stars. Out of our numerous visits, we only had one occurrence of a less than perfect coffee. My hubby and I had different flavors, mine was iced (pb&j flavor) and his was hot (Nutella flavor), so it must have just been an "off" batch of coffee at that time. Other than that, we have tried so many monthly coffee flavor combos, as well as created our own and have been super happy. I think my new favorite is Almond Joy: mocha, almond, coconut, with chocolate drizzle and cold foam. Followed by Jack Sparrow: bourbon caramel, butter rum, with caramel drizzle and cold foam. This is my new favorite coffee spot. Looking forward to many more fun monthly combinations to try for years to come!
If you miss that old school cooking , come here . Every bite I took brought me back to my childhood memories . Fast friendly service and great prices.

We really enjoyed the red beans and rice and fried chicken. My wife had a stuff seafood bell pepper. A party of 5 we enjoyed our food and we took a pic with the owner. Our waitress was friendly and nice. I definitely recommend Dunbar's.

The chicken was seasoned pretty well, moist, and crunchy. However, I ordered white meat and was served with a breast and leg. I opted for the smoked sausage. The beans were regular in flavor, nothing major. Also, it came with cornbread, which I didn't receive until the end of my meal. I had to basically ask for it. The sweet tea was indeed sweet. 

Customer service could be better, for example, actually having a host be there to serve customers to their tables. I think it's really importance, since the menus are in the hostess area. Also, there's a need for napkins on the table. I only had the napkin from the utensils. Mind you, I was eating chicken, which I will say again, HOT AND DELICIOUS!!  

Overall, it's a nice place and locally owned.

If you want a friendly, reasonable and talented stylist then book with anyone BUT Jenna Quagliana. I'm not one to usually give negative reviews but this is a nasty and unprofessional woman and I would avoid her at all costs.

I wanted to try out somewhere near where I was living for the summer, so I went here. Turned out to be a major mistake. Not only is their nail polish selection minimal, my nails were cut incredibly unevenly. I left when I started bleeding from being stabbed with the cuticle cutters after repeatedly asking the technician to stop because she was cutting my skin.

There are far better places to waste your time on this one. I ended up leaving with crookedly cut nails and bleeding, unpolished, and still had to pay $10 for 5 minutes worth of service.

Never again.

A+++++++++ service. Thank you for coming out, doing what needed done, being honest and genuine. Good companies are hard to find but great companies deserve recognition.  Finding honest people without having to pay an insane fee to find them can be a task within itself. Thankfully, I found this company and their five stars matched their service!  Fast, efficient, reliable and honest.
NOT authentic Chinese cooking as they stated! All the dishes I ordered were very typical Sichuan food, and without exception they all failed!

Dunbar's is by far the best meal I've had in New Orleans so far. The red beans and rice with the fried chicken was absolutely phenomenal. The amount of food that you get for an entree is huge! You won't be let down! Our service was great. The sides were amazing. We had yams and Mac n cheese. Both were delicious. Last but not least, the bread pudding!!! It came out in this beautiful glass bowl and might be the best bread pudding in New Orleans! All in all, the cozy, laid back atmosphere with all the great creole cuisines is exactly where you need to be to have the best New Orleans experience
it's always a win winn here at winn dixie!! i have been going to this store for the past 4 years and i've always had an amazing experience!
The best breakfast in the neighborhood.  Their pancake meal is without comparison.  I also love their fried chicken and shrimp po-boy.  This neighborhood was waiting for this kind of greatness.

I went to pick up my order last night at this location. At first this lady behind the counter said that I never called in, then she found my order and had added a bunch of items to it. Stopped in quick while in town.  I had the shrimp po boy and my wife had the seafood pasta.  Added bonus:  cornbread!

The waitress was great and was eager to accommodate our young child, and the price was reasonable.  We will be back when we are around the area again.

Good taste, Scrooge with meat, and over priced when it comes to cost per portion matrix if I had one. I do really enjoy the taste and they are quick and right around the corner from my house. If they upped their portion a tad I'd be going weekly.

I have ordered not delivery and pick up from here several times and they never disappoint. Delivery is fast, even on nights/weekends. I absolutely love and missed Dunbar's.  I got a chance to go back for the first time since their re-opening and the catfish and red beans and rice are still banging. The service is usually quick and attentive and the prices are beyond reasonable.  This is a good, laid-back spot for authentic New Orleans food.
Good food and great service on top of all that we saw Juvenile. I will be back for the red beans rice and fried fish

AMAZING catfish !!! came here 2 mornings in a row !! 
first morning i ordered cart fish and grits. which came with 2 eggs and a biscuit as well. 
when i say WELL SEASONED !!! omg the catfish was soooooo good. they also have a 99 cent breakfast that comes with scrambled eggs, sausage patty or link & grits & a biscuit... ALL FOR 99 cents !!!!

I just left the restaurant and I am highly dissatisfied. I decided to try the smothered okra with fried chicken, which additionally came with potato salad and cornbread.
