The last time I came here I ordered a whiz wit, they literally gave me two little pieces of onions. The steak is not good quality meat. It's not worth 9 bucks.
I can't say enough about this place. We have the one and only Carrie Demont as our instructor. The woman knows her students and how to engage. She is amazing. We are always bummed when we have a sub.

I had such high hopes for this one. Alas, we prefer to drive to The Cup in Edwardsville or go to Nothing Bunt Cakes if we catch them before they close. The complaints are the cakes are sometimes a little dry and they certainly could add a little more icing. We go periodically hoping for improvements.

WHATS UP WIT THAT MEAT? So ever since this place changed ownership, my tastebuds have told me that something tastes COMPLETELY different. I wanted to clarify so I went today and bought an American Wit & Sauce. Horrible... The roll was the best part. I purposely pulled some meat, naked, to concentrate on its taste & im now wondering; what the heck am I eating? This meat doesn't taste like what they originally served when they first opened years ago. It doesn't taste anything like my favorite cheesesteak stop also in NE Philly, which at one time I actually compared them too at their inception. I would love to see a response as to exactly what this meat is. The cheese Doesn't taste right either. It seems watered down or thinned out... When they first opened, I loved their sandwich & gave them rave reviews, now not so much. The wait was too long & the staff was robotic too but I don't care as much about that...
This place is a fat girls dream. Minus two stars because the damn thing fell apart into my lap.

If I had a place like this back home I'd pretty much live there. 
Friendly southern hospitality greets you at the door. The atmosphere is clean and sleek. The menu is southern, food is comforting. 

AND THEY HAD LIVE MUSIC FOR BREAKFAST on the Saturday morning I was there. 

Not your usual tourist cafe, this was a real gem to find. Highly recommend it.

Just one word: AMAZING.  Everything I tried from rice and beans to the empanadas and the entrees such as their signature Roasted pork plate was fresh and flavorful. I'm from the SF Bay Area which is a Mecca for Latin American cuisine, and this little place in Nashville TN blows them out of the water. I knock off one star for the subpar service. Definitely will be coming back here as a regular.

Review is not for the food. Came here because reviews on here are pretty good. My server was very nice but didn't seem too efficient. Although the staff was inviting, the place was not in my opinion. Shades drawn and place rather dark. Not a warm feeling. It was more frustrating than anything just to get a cup of coffee. I decided not to start my day off being aggravated so opted to leave. Wish them well. Not my type of place. I wanted to like it. Oh well.

I have had comical service, been invited to sit down even though I arrived 10 minutes later than posted times, had an evening where utensils were scarce and I've also had consistently great food. When you ask for India Hot in this restaurant you get it - love the place for all it's wackiness and more 
Latest visit was not so impressive, hopefully it was just an off night..shame if not

I think this place is pretty solid. I ordered 2-medium plain and veggie pizzas and I got exactly what I wanted in a reasonable amount of time (about 30-40 mins after placing the order). The pizzas tasted great!  They use fresh ingredients and the crust on the pizza is soft but slightly brittle, almost like the consistency of a biscuit or cracker. The crust was also not burned at the edges. The cheese tasted pretty much how it should! Cheesy! And, the tomato sauce they use has a very nice herb flavor and slight hint of spice to it. The Veggie pizza was pleasantly different from what I have experienced at other pizzerias. Instead of it being, what I have had (traditionally) in the Midwest as veggie pizza, this pizza came as a "white" pie. You can request  to have marinara on it but I figured, "Why not try something new?", and went with it. Tasted great with the vegetables not all burned into the pizza the way PizzaHut does it. Looked authentic, tasted authentic. I will definitely order from England Pizza again.

I love Cuban food. 
We tried a couple different things so let's get started!
Mariquitas: I've had plantain chips everywhere and I really mean every where: Ghana, Costa Rica, Guatemala, etc... These are a solid representation but fall short of "best I've had".
Chicken Empanada: I will be dreaming of this. Amazing.
Medianoche: I would have had the Cubano but they were out. Pretty good.
I tried some of my friend's rice and beans, they were great. We also shared some flan which was good and tres leche which would have been good except it had fake whipped cream which I hate. I scraped it off but dos leche isn't quite the same thing. 
Overall, the best Cuban food you could expect outside Cuba, Florida or New York. I'd give 3.5 stars but since I had to choose, rounding up! 
(Although the service kinda made me want to round down)

Stopped in for lunch on a business trip. Small restaurant in a strip mall. Friendly staff clean place. Surprised to see a Frita on the menu so wade cited to give it a try. Was just ok.. Giving them a 4 star review for trying. Coming from Miami I have to admit I am used to the best. Other items looked on the menu looked authentic.

Coño! Haha this spot hits the spot I had the lechon asado its pork with rice and beans and maracuya drink aka passion fruit the workers are very friendly the owner brought over our drinks and made conversation with us it feels cozy. I would definitely recommend you come by food is superb

Demont is a phenomenal place for your kids to learn how to swim. We do a variety of activities soccer, gymnastics etc. Demont is hands down the best activity in Tucson. It is so well thought out with regard to skill building. I would highly recommend it.

Okay so if I could give this place Zero stars I would.  

We went to celebrate a friend's birthday so we were just in the mood to enjoy each others company.  We did not have extremely high hopes for amazing food or amazing service.  During the course of the meal, we waited an extraordinarily long time for our food and had to ask where it was.  

Attempt #1 - When it finally came out we all thought the food looked odd, and when we tasted it confirmed that this was not the food we ordered.  A few minutes later another waitress came and asked what we had ordered and figured out that we had been given another table's food.  They took our food back and said they would bring out the correct dishes.  

Attempt #2 - They got the dishes correct, but the heat levels on our food were definitely not what we asked for and in addition to that the Shrimp in the Shrimp Biriyani was NOT cooked (actually still clearish in color).....We sent the Biriyani back and told the waitress not to worry about recooking the dish, that we would just share the food we had. 

A while later the waitress comes back with the Biriyani and said that the chef insisted that she get her Shrimp Biriyani.  By this time we were already full and only had a few bites of the Biriyani.  We then asked for a box and the waitress brought it along with the check.  
Lo and behold, the Shrimp Biriyani was still being charged to our table.  I asked the waitress about it and she stated that the Owner had written the bill himself.  

We then asked to speak to him and he came to our table and stated that we got the Biriyani and we should pay for it and then accused us of changing our original order and that's why he had to remake the food.  I advised him that they brought out the incorrect dishes to begin with and that is why he had to remake the food and we had to send it back again because the shrimp wasn't even cooked.  He then was very gruff asked where the Biriyani was, grabbed the to go box and finally said he'd take it off the bill.  

Aside from the poor service the Shrimp Biriyani was pretty flavorless.  The heat level on the other two dishes we ordered were not what we had asked for and the overall taste of the food was just so-so.    I will definitely never recommend this restaurant to anyone and will not be dining here again, the words Customer Service are definitely lost on the Owner of this Establishment.

I wish they had a menu so I can name everything I had to write about it.  Everything was delicious. I had pulled pork plate with rice and black beans.  Everything was delicious and the portions that came out were huge.  I also had some croquetas that we so very good.  I will definitely try more items here.  It could be a little more clean in here.  Check the hours because they are not open every day.

My son and I have been going here since he was about 2 months old and he's almost 17 months now. We love it here! We are moving in a couple weeks but this place has really set the bar as far as swim schools. We have been learning life saving skills we will take with us. Miss Megan was our instructor for baby splash and now we have Miss Christy. Both are wonderful instructors and we will miss them both! If you want your child feel comfortable in the water while learning life saving skills look no further!!

Make sure to try the yum yum yummer's coffee after your meal - they offer it to go if you want to savor the little sips of heaven.
(First line in case people are browsing)

I've been wanting to try Back to Cuba for awhile now, after my Cuban born Miami raised friend Inez told me it was good, it did not disappoint - but maybe since I'd been meaning to get there for SO long it didn't quite live up to all my glorious pork lovin' expectations.

Ambiance was cute, drums, checkers - big family tables. The ordering is at the counter and the menu is literally a reader board, but if you have bad eye sight (I was suffering an eye infection and wearing old glasses) the server is happy and friendly enough to guide you ;)

Empanada's were great! Literally quite perfect. I got a beef and a chicken, the chicken won hands down, juicy and flavorful meat and the yummy infused oil dip was sinful but divine. For dinner I stuck with a simple cubano sammie. Whenever I try a place for the first time I like to get the classics to see what they do with it. So, the sandwich was pretty humongous, after my appetizers I could barely eat half and it was good.

Oddly - the reason they get one star off from me; it was not the best cuban sandwich I've had in Nashville and this is the only strictly cuban place in town!! I think its pretty important to get that right, but hey, I'm a white girl from Oregon, so take it with a grain of salt. 

My husbands beans and plantains were super and the rice was fluffy and decent. They also offer cuban softdrinks which were fun to try, although they didn't taste so different from regional soda's here in the states. (Pinneapple Kroger soda and Big Red, respectively)

For sure I'm going back here though, I wanna try some platters!
The best Cubano I've ever had!  It was very reasonably priced as well.  I wish I was closer to this restaurant so I could eat it more often.

I had a great experience at this restaurant. I had the Chick Tikka Marsala and Nan bread. They cooked it to my specification (extra spicy). They filled my wine glass to the top which is always great! The decor is laking though.

Amazing. No other words can describe their pork. Don't believe ANY bad reviews about this place. It's tiny, so we always get it to-go. Pork comes with yucca, rice, and beans...and I can't describe its deliciousness. So much food for the $$ - always makes for more than one meal.

The Cubanos were huge easily sharable
I would have liked them to be pressed a little moras the center was not hot
Chicken empanadas were great
Very large well stuffed and a killer chimmicurri on the side
Inexpensive and will return again for that cuban fix

I have been doing business with Dash Automotive for over 15 years and highly recommend Donnie and his team of professionals.  They give personalized service and will make sure your automotive repair issue is fixed properly.  I am impressed that they go above an beyond to insure that the customer is satisfied.  Between my wife and kids, I have a family with 4 cars and they have kept them all running well.  I have done the full range of repairs including tires, brakes, tune-up, electrical, suspension..etc.

India Grill is one of the best Indain Restaurants in the area. Who cares if the owner doesn't smile, he may have a reason! Lunch Buffets are cheap, thats why some people like them, and also for people who have never eaten Curry to experiment. Their Dinner menu is very good, not spicey enough, but very tasty. One of my favorite Restaurants.

I finally got to try this place yesterday and was beyond pleased. This seems to be as authentic as it gets. You know the food is gonna be good when it's a small place with a small menu. I got one of the daily specials, the Pezcado en salsa Tropical. It was a grilled whiting filet of fish in a mango salsa. It was amazing. Sweet but with a kick. The fish was a large piece too. It was served with yellow rice and one of all time favorite sides...sweet plantains. I can't wait to go back.

I actually like this place. They have the option to get it chopped or in slices which I think is a great option to have. Love their fries. They have gourmet root beer too =} I really enjoyed their plain cheesesteak wit and the chipotle chicken cheesesteak was dripping with melted Mexican-American goodness =}

I think they're very underrated. The place is always clean, and the option to have your steak chopped or in slices is great. It's always made fresh and hot, and I can't really complain. Basically the same thing as Steve's Steaks, but I  had a lot more meat on my steak without the price or the wait.
This is the perfect hidden gem! The ambience is to die for. Great food and exceptional service.

I keep coming back and I keep loving this place. I went alone yesterday so I could explore the menu a little more. I had the roasted pork dinner (rice, black beans, yuka), the cafe de leche, and the tres leches cake. And of course a beef empanada. It was all so good. 

Perfect way to spend a leisurely lunch on a Saturday afternoon.

I noticed this place sold Spanish platters in addition to your standard pizza joint menu, so I decided to give it a go. 
I ordered a small plain pizza, an order of fries and the Spanish steak and rice platter. 

The pizza was pretty good, fries were crisp and the platter was beautiful. The steak and rice came with maduros (sweet plantains) and a nice sized side salad of lettuce, tomato, avocado and feta cheese. 

The only bad thing so far was that delivery took longer than expected and the food was a bit cold. What can I say? You win some, you lose some, but the quality and variety is good enough to order again.

Great spot!  All of the dishes are authentic and delicious. Cuban sandwich is spot on and I think better than ones in Miami. If you want to try some different items, grab a few sides, an empanada, and I can't remember the name of the last one but it was ground beef inside a mashed potato ball, deep fried. Amazing. Grab a fruit shake and your meal is complete. If you like a adult beverage you are able to bring beer and wine in with you. Check it out if you like Cuban food!!

The food and service is always good. Fast delivery . Very tasty tomato sauce. Very consistent. I can feel confident when I order here the food will be good. It's hard to find places that are like this. My only suggestion would be to put a little more sauce and cheese on the pizza. There are only two places I consistently order from in the NE. England is one of them.
Not my favorite. Cheese fries are good but the cheese steaks are mediocre. There are much better places to go where you'll be more satisfied.

I never had cuban food. 
My husband is from island too. 
We actually liked the food. 
Me and my husband ordered a lot of food. 
Cuba coffee : very strong. Small cup of esperesso. Taste good actually. 
Mango juice : husband had it. Im not a big fan of mango. But husband enjoyed it. 
Shrimp taco : failed. I didnt like it. Regret ordering it. 
Beef patty : the fried one stuffed with grounded beef. Idk what is the name. Its so good. We ordered 4 more to go lol
Shrim with sauce, rice and salad : so good. Shrimp tastes good. 
Steak with rice and black bean : steak is on fire. Rice good. I dont eat beans.

This is my second go around with this establishment, I must say after 2 years they really change for the better. The food was actually better. Steak was pretty good. The price is cheaper than Steves steaks which is their competitor around here. They are not nearly as good as Steves steaks but if you're looking to pay less, come here. I would come here again
OMG! The Strawberry cake was divine! Prices a little steep, 5 dollars for detox water is a bit pricey. But I will definitely be back to try other things on the menu, especially the key lime cake.

I definitely like Back To Cuba.  Being from Florida, I usually eat at Cuban restaurants all the time, however I have yet to find a good Cuban place in Nashville, until now.  The food is pretty authentic, but lacks some of the authenticity that restaurants at home have.  However, I think the food is really good and if you have never had Cuban food, you should give it a try.  I don't know the correct spelling but I think the dish is called ropas veaijas, which translates to "old cloths"  its basically steak, rice and beans all mixed together...so good!

We LOVE DeMont Swim School! Our daughter started when she was 5 months old in their complimentary classes (through 6 months). She could not wait to jump into the water with us each week so we signed her up into the Little Froggies Class. It has been over 5 months now and she is doing fantastic! Her teacher, Michelle is AWESOME! Very patient and loving with the babies and tots and makes learning fun and exciting. Class size is 5-6 kiddos so they have plenty of time to focus on each child's growth and development each week. This is definitely the way to go vs. ICLR. Teach your child to love the water and be comfortable in a swimming environment - that is what DeMont excels at and their staff is exceptional. A++!

Unfortunately, not impressed.  They were out of the Cuban sandwich, then the group and skirt steak were dry and lacking flavor. I've ate a lot of cuban food in Miami and this did not meet expectations or yelp reviews. I will give them one more chance and try the sandwiches but expectations are low. At this time, I would not recommend.
What happened to this place? The cheesesteak used to be slabbed, now it's chopped. It was okay, but nothing spectacular.

The specials they have here are awesome. The prices are fair and the food is far better then your average pizza place. We've had the buffalo wings which are some of the best I've ever had. The pizza and cheesesteaks are also above average. I just moved into an apartment around the corner and ordered from here our first night, and now it'll be a weekly occasion to order from here.

If you're in the market for some off-brand deodorant, slightly musty pre-read romance novels, or a new bong, this is the place to go. 

In case you misread my sarcasm, this place houses a lot of garage sale crap and what is obviously a couponer's haul of off brand toiletries. It used to have decent flea market finds, and it's a big place, so maybe if you dig deep you'll find something worth it, but you'll definitely need a shower after.
Love the lunch specials here.  I always get whatever the daily special is and I've never been disappointed.
This time around I was much more satisfied. The staff was more pleasant and the food tasted better. They have redeemed themselves. I will definitely go back.
Ask for the Indian spices! Boy are they hot! Food, not so bad either :-) Been here several times since.

I live close by in Crieve Hall, so I appreciate the convenience and proximity. My fave is the Cubano. I love that fresh, chewy, toasted bread! I've had the empanadas- very tasty. Also, I'm a big fan of flan and theirs does not disappoint.

This was my first time ordering and I got a Stromboli special! Needless to say it was worth the buck plus $1.00 off Monday special. The only flaw is that it lacked flavor and sauce! Fast delivery also helped!!

Inconsistent is too kind a word. I've had the lechon asado and yes, it is good: sometimes. Other times I've seen them reheat a chunk of pork on the flat top and serve it to me. Of course it was tough as hell and old tasting. Shameful. 

Their beans can be a revelation or a workout with your teeth. Yes, I've been served undercooked beans. Yucca is bland and boring. Their tostones could use some work. Jamaicaway does plantains better for sure. 

Cubano sandwhich is pretty good and very consistent. They have them pre-made in the case (they only need to be toasted), so if they're not there, they're out. 

Cuban coffee is magnificent. Order it when when you come in, even if you're getting your order to go. It only takes a second to drink. 

If you're getting it to go, remember to ask for bread.It's pretty tasty.

Unfriendly service, don't have a welcoming vibe. they dont pick up their phone so you have to drive there just to be let down that they dont have half of their good menu items. they don't have their 'most popular' sandwich's available on the menu for weeks at a time. Seems lazy because the ingredients could be gotten at any supermarket (ham and cheese). The food may be okay and authentic but its not worth the lack of care put into keeping menu items available and caring about customer service. very disappointed with this place. hopefully they change because it could have better potential. they need a better server and more thought going into having menu items AT ALL TIMES
Ordered a milkshake for pick up, the girl grunted when I ordered it and when I got there wasn't ready. 15min later
Food very bad and service sucks called to complain and they hung up on me.Stay away!!!!!!!

So I love Indian food...

India Grill never disappoints me. The price points are great, the food is fresh and the staff doesn't talk your ear off. I've gotten food here to go, as well as dined in (a lot) and it's always so good. 

I've actually never tried the lunch buffet, but from what I hear it is amazing! Of course it is, what isn't at India Grill?

I would recommend one thing but I always switch it up because I want to try everything. Yummy! I tried the Indian place across the street from India Grill and it was really gross, and smelled funny. 

My only complaint is that sometimes it is hard to find parking, as it is street and downtown St Pete gets busy at night! But that is not the fault of India Grill.

This is the first and only Cuban restaurant I been to so I don't have much expertise but I enjoyed back to Cuba.  The Cuban sandwiches were tasty and also there chicken plate.   I highly recommend to check this place out

As a foodie I've been wanting to try this place out.  Went today for the first time.  I'm ready for more!  Right now!  Pollo Asado was fantastic and the fried yucca was the best I've had.  Love the fact that cell phones are not allowed (who wants to hear some loudmouths conversation).  Co-worker had the Cubano sandwich and we both agreed it was one of the best we've had.  Great bread makes this sandwich.  The food was fresh and made to order as it should be and the Mango juice was very refreshing.  I'll definitely be going back, and soon.  Great food and great service.
Dr. Joyce was very pleasant and professional. I had a great annual eye exam experience. I would come back for next exam.

Best Cuban I've had in Tennessee. Only Tampa tops this. Back to Cuba is located in a small convenient store/gas station and small business center. There are not many tables but there is a long counter for ordering your food.

The staff was friendly and made food to order. It was very good. We ordered the Cuban, the Croquetta sandwich, fried yuca (outstanding) and black beans (soup). All was excellent. Very impressed. 

Although we live 2 hours away, this will be a great stop before or after visiting the Nashville Zoo.

Lechon Asado. There is no better way to go. This dish consists of perfectly cooked pork, deliciously seasoned black beans, rice, and yuca. They bring bread to accompany the dish also.

If you are feeling brave, ask for the hidden spicy green sauce. Very spicy, but so good.
One trip and shall never return. Chewy meat with an "off" taste. (a great sign of quality). Rolls and cheese were ok. Fries were also ok. Poor man's Steve's at best.

Drove 2 miles out of my way from Hwy 40 for what Yelp showed to have good coffee. It's 652am, Yelp says they've been open since 6am, the door says they're closed. I called the place and the recording states it's a nonworking number. There's lights on inside, hello I need coffee or I'm going to have a stroke...

This place is great.  Now, my frame of reference may be unique: I live in Center City and was dedicated to keeping my eye care with a longstanding practice across the street from where I live.  The office staff was professional yet distant, nice but not very helpful.  The office was clean but essentially unchanged from the time it was constructed in the late 1970's.  I think the equipment was that old, too.
I decided to make a switch because I needed to find an office close to where I work, not where I live.  Schwartz Eye Care had a great online reputation.  I was immediately impressed with its contemporary atmosphere (again, I was loyal to a 40 year-old practice).  The building is pristine; the office is spacious, well-laid out and sparkling; they have diagnostic equipment that I didn't know existed, but has probably been in use for years.  It made my visit much more pleasant, and I felt confident in what they were doing because the space and equipment were so stunningly nice.  I had a wait time of fewer than 5 minutes.
I saw Dr. Joyce, who was a refreshing change from my prior eye doctor.  She confirmed my suspicions that the previous optometrist may have jumped to conclusions and made an incorrect diagnosis about a reaction to contact lenses.  She reassured me that we will find the right lenses for me and I have complete confidence in her.  She was well-spoken, professional, patient and gentle.  She also very clearly is well-educated in her field.
The office staff was kind and informative; I never felt rushed.  I was given insight about my eyesight (you're welcome for that) that I'd never had before.  I look forward (again, welcome) to a good, long relationship with this practice.
This place is garbage. If you actually appreciate Indian food then you will regret eating here

Excellent food. Had the Cubano sandwich. Bread was fresh and crispy. Large portions. We also had the Bistec Palomilla. The meat, onions, beans, rice, and plantains had great flavor. Small location. but great atmosphere!

Been here twice, and will most likely return because it's close to where I live.
The decor is pretty bad, but what to expect from a hole-in-the-wall?  I do love that they have bollywood movies playing on a screen.
The service was excellent - friendly, funny, attentive.
The food was good. I had lamb curries and they were okay, small portions surprisingly.  
I'll return because of the great service (big thing for me), close to my place, and I support local immigrant business when i can.

I discovered this place by accident.  I was driving to my usual stomping grounds during my bi-annual visit to Nashville and noted the location.  Later in the day, I was looking for something just right - not too heavy, not too light - since I has a mid-afternoon lunch.  I ordered a whiting fish sandwich and fries.  When I initially received my order, I was a little surprised by the number of strips of fish (2).  I was expecting more, three-ish or four-ish; it's whiting.  However, after eating my meal, it proved to be just right.  It hit the spot and I didn't feel like a slug afterwards.  
The place has ample parking and a nice, contemporary atmosphere.  If I come here again, I will probably stick to ordering a dessert.

This place used to have ok pizza, good cheesesteaks, and awesome hoagies.  Cheap too.  Have gone a few times after Mike(the old cook) left...  Just not the same anymore.  Now it tastes like what I can get home in Virginia. Prices are still cheap, but when I'm in Philly, il be going elsewhere.  Marinucci's for hoagies and Frusco's or Steve's for cheesesteaks... until I find something better.

I'm sorry for being away so long, Yelpers. But now I have returned, and with it, a bevy of tasty reviews in my skull ready to be shared on the Internet.  

So let's kick v 2.0 off with this joint, Wit or Witout? Having since moved to the NE Philly area, I've gotten to try out a whole lot of joints I otherwise wouldn't have when we left off last when my digs were in Center City. Anyway, I didn't know much about this place, other than having seen the billboard for it numerous times.

After a day at the zoo, I suggested to my comrades that we give Wit or Witout a try. 

So we did.

So we never shall again.

My review on Foursquare for this joint was a short and succinct "This place sucks." Well, I guess I can elaborate more on that here since I know you folks like to read more than three words, and who can blame you? Why does it suck? Because...everything.

The meat for starters. No, this isn't the chipped cheesesteak variety that 99% of the steaks are created with. This is the cuts of beef style, as popularized by Steve's Prince of Steaks. The only difference between Wit or Witout and Steve's is...everything, that's right.

The meat is too chewy. It reminded me of when I was a kid and mom would make Steak-Ummm samitches. I hated them then. Having them served to me for three times the price over doing it myself is still no better. Chew, chew, chew. And not very tasty, either. Hell, I'd wager a lot of us can enjoy Taco Hell when the urge strikes, because even its low grade goodies serve a purpose at times, but not this meat. This meat is no treat.

And for whatever reason, the goofballs working there that day decided to turn my cheesesteak into a a "cheesesteak hoagie," which, honestly I didn't realize until a few bites in. The hoagie version includes tomato, lettuce, and mayo. Seriously, WTF? Who would ever do that on purpose? Mayo on a steak samitch? Sheesh.

I tried a bite of my friend's unencumbered steak samitch, but it was just as unexciting. No one was enjoying this stuff, and we had a group of six. You'd think at least one person would have liked it, but this is pretty dreadful stuff, even more low rent than Steve's Steaks on South Street (see review from ages ago).

The fries were crappy as well. And, I don't know if they actually enforce this there, but on the menu it says drink refills are a dollar. Seriously? I suppose the only thing worth getting would be a drink, but there's no real point to that venture, is there?

So please, fellow Philadelphians, and tourists alike, don't waste your money or time at Wit or Witout? Steve's Prince of Steaks is literally less than a five minute drive up the Boulevard from here. And there you can find some damn fine steak samitches. Wit or Witout tries desperately to pull off the Prince o' Steaks style, but falls flat on its ass. No character, no atmosphere, and no good eats.
It was good and cheap when they opened it. Now sucks and expensive.

Small bakery and cafe tucked away.  The staff were all beyond friendly. We walked in to live music and were immediately greeted. Sat down and looked at the menu.  There are no bad choices.  I got the breakfast bowl which had exactly the right amount of each different food item and was amazing. The music was perfect level that was nice but you could still have a quiet conversation if you wanted.  After everything was done (to include drinks from the bar) we got the check and was floored on how inexpensive everything was.  Definitely a hidden secret of Nashville
Amazing plantains!!! This place is truly authentic and delicious! Probably my favorite restaurant to date! I will absolutely be headed back again soon!!! Stop reading this and go eat here now!
Amazing! This place is the real deal. Truly a hidden gem in an unlikely location. Authentic Cuban food, made to order, at a fair price. Highly recommended!

I have loved this school and think it is great for parents to take their kids there when kids first learn how to swim.  However, my son learned to swim over the weekend and I told them(kaitlynn the pool deck person) and she seemed annoyed that I was talking to her and seemed to busy to listen.  I was told by the front desk to tell them about my sons achievements and they would test him.  It didn't happen. I was upset because he was so excited about showing his teacher he could swim. Love the school a lot but feel they hold the kids back.

If you want to experience Caribbean atmosphere , this is one of the places to check out in Nashville. Initially I was skeptical about this place because it is located in the vicinity of a gas station that sits in between heavily trafficked roads. However, the place feels like serving authentic Cuban cuisines, with Caribbean music (I think) and some tropical arts displayed on interior walls. Plates are bit salty but yummy and delicious. Price is also good. People who work there are very kind and nice.  Best place for take-outs and casual dining for a group of 2-3 people. Probably not suitable for romantic dates or family dining because the place is rather small.

Yep, definitely the closest thing to Cuban food for me so far here in Nashville. Maybe I'll update this sometime if I find something better, but that has yet to happen. Anyways, I'm going to preface this with the fact that I am Hispanic, speak spanish, and previously lived in Miami for 12+ years, so I've had tons of Cuban and Caribbean food. That being said, you can't ever compare places outside of Miami to those in there, but MAN this place comes pretty close.

I came here with a friend, and we got the cuban sandwich and the steak sandwich, so we could both try a half of them. We also got the maduros, and she got a Guava shake. Now I personally don't like Guava (strange, I know) but she said it was amazing. Meanwhile, the maduros were authentic and delicious - and what I particularly like was that they weren't super greasy.

As for the sandwiches, the cuban was amazing. Thick and filled with all the right meats and cheese and nice toasty bread and..... now I'm salivating thinking about it. Point is, it was made very well and I'd definitely put it in the top 10 cubans I've had. Meanwhile, the steak sandwich was pretty good as well, with tender meat and cruchy fresh lettuce. I did feel it was lacking something, upon which I realized I forgot to add cheese to it. Maybe it should be included in the sandwich itself, because it really should be there, cheese on cuban steak sandwiches is amazing. Then again, for me, cheese on ANYTHING is great, so I might be a bit biased, heh.

Overall, amazing place, and will be coming back whenever I need to revisit my cuban food here in Nashville.

Brand new spot that is an adorable all day breakfast cafe. Casual vibe and great prices. I came by for lunch and was immediately greeted and seated. It has a counter up front and a room behind it where you can dine in. My waitress was very kind and attentive. I got the Breakfast Bowl which has potatoes, peppers, cheese, scrambled eggs and sausage. It was delicious! I thought it was the perfect size and for $8 it was a great deal. The peppers added a lot of flavor and a bit of spice to the dish. My waitress brought me a glass of pineapple iced tea for me to try which was fantastic and would recommend you to order. The breakfast burrito also looked like it was a great dish, I'll try that on my next visit. On top of all day breakfast, they have a selection of sandwiches. I did notice there were not vegetarian options- which would be a good addition. 

The service was top notch- the chef came over and asked me how I liked my dish and the manager said hello too. 

All in all, I would definitely recommend this as a spot to get fast, tasty food in an adorable yet casual environment. Their selection of pastries looked pretty great as well! I will be back!

We love this place!!! My son has been going for 2 years and is becoming an excellent swimmer. We tried a couple of other places before Demont and the difference is significant. They have excellent staff and an amazing program!

Decent Cheesteak, I'm more of a chopped up steak person, but they slabs of meat taste good to. Not definitely when you get a Philly cheesesteak you need the wiz and fried onions and they do that really nice! The store can be somewhat mobbed at times and I think it needs to be ran with more upkeep, sometimes the condiments are all over the place and it just gets pushed back in with the rest. The overall cleanliness of the place would get a "D," fries scattered everywhere along with napkins and ketchup on the floor. I most certainty like Wit or Witout, just maybe a few things could change...A-ok in my book.

I drive by here every morning at 7:30. I can't count on the morning crew to actually be at work and open for breakfast. Sometimes they are there, sometimes not. The next closest place is 10 minutes out of the way. 

They're not consistent in food prep either. Missing seafood today. Last time missing eggs. Before that flatbread. Too unreliable for a chain. Get it together.
Always an amazing meal!! There is nothing bad on the menu. The owner is awesome!! The environment is a perfect little Cuban restaurant! Try the lechon, bistek, empanadas and sandwhiches.!!

It is unfortunate that this restaurant has such positive reviews. The truth of the
 matter is the food here is awful! There is no flavor in their dishes.  The curry chicken had no taste of curry whatsoever. The butter chicken just tasted like melted butter that makes you nauseous once it was tasted. The samosas tasted like ground beef without even salt and pepper added to it , let alone Indian spices. If you have ever tasted Indian food, please do not go to this restaurant because  you will surely be disappointed. The wait staff was also inexperienced and inattentive. The positive things about the restaurant include the mango lassi was excellent, the decorum was very nice and the employees were pleasant. It's unfortunate that the food lacked the taste of authentic Indian food.

Incredible! Perfectly seasoned, so good! Nothing fancy, just great tasting food! Wish it was closer to city center, I'd go more often. I can't believe it took me this long to try! Get the whole snapper- it's worth it! The roasted pork was super good too!

My first time there was amazing. Everything on the menu looked good. We got whole red snapper cuban rice and plantain cakes and flan! We ordered from the counter then had a seat and enjoyed all the art hanging. I wish I had noticed the record player and cabinet of records before it was too late. We accidentally stayed about 20 minutes after they closed, but no one was rushing us or being rude. 10/10 would recommend

I am a super beautiful half Cuban gal from Miami.  Is the food here authentic? Yes. And its absolutely delicious.  Is the staff authentic? No, they are not actually Cuban but I guess it doesnt matter much.  They are nice and the food is a good value. I recommend.

This place is awesome! We have been waiting and waiting and waiting for a coffee shop to open in Cleveland park, and finally it's here. Went for breakfast, and the people who run it are super nice, and the food was great! The breakfast bowl was amazing. My only minor complaint is that we went to pick up some lunch and dessert at 4pm on Monday, and it was closed; the website and Yelp say it's open until 5, so we were a little confused. But we love it and will just call ahead if we are planning on coming in the afternoon. Plus we know the business is new and it takes time to fine-tune everything. Super excited to try the desserts, they looked phenomenal!!

I've been a customer here for years and was glad to introduce a friend. The food is very authentic. During a previous visit, the owner sat with us and shared stories of life in Cuba and shared a photo album with my friends. Today I ordered a fish sandwich, my guest ordered the Miami sandwich. We shared the halves so both of us had both sandwiches. They were both less than 8 bucks and were far larger than expected. It would be a great size for two to share. Both were delicious, with fresh ingredients. The fish was flaky, not oily. The flavor very good. The only negative was somewhat minor, in that the bread was crispier than I'd have preferred. They also have the most interesting drinks. I had blackberry juice, and this is the only restaurant I've ever known to serve it. This is a great spot for lunch, and worth the drive from anywhere in South Nashville or Brentwood

The girls are idiots and don know how to mute phones, and talk crap, also they try and tell you once something is processed by card over the phone they can't change it, that's bullshit sweet hearts you have nothing with a customer signature so technically that's not even legit yet, also I worked in retail and pizza shops you can fix it. Or if you can't the damn people in charge can. How do you think you refunded my money when I cancelled my order? Duh!!!! Food isn't all that great any way. I only order the pizza when I babysit for my friend because her kids like it, I personally think there is no flavor. So I'm only giving them one star.

Refugees from Castro's communist oppression eat here, and their American friends. I always look in their case on top of the counter which holds little meat pies and other tapa-like yummies. The nice senora jefa is no amiga of Fidel or his brother Raul.  Conveniently located in south Nashville. Best Cuban food in Tennessee.

Driving from Beloit, WI to Madison ten days after getting my car back from D & A Auto Body... I was driving on I39 North behind an 18 wheel flat bed truck and a tarp came flying off the truck and hit my car.  Voila... another front bumper needed after the tarp put cracks in mine and took away part of the grilll under the main grill and fog light fitting.  Never fear D&A is here!  I am going to give them another 5 stars even before I get my car back b/c I have 100% confidence in them.  Anthony and Ed are just great people.  They go behind the call of duty to fix your car... They also make sure that no aftermarket parts are used when fixing the car... They fight for you when dealing with the Insurance companies to make sure your car is fixed the right way.  I would never ever goto a nother body shop.  I'm not even sweating this latest accident b/c I know that I will get my car back fast and in 100% tip to shape.  Out of any review I have done  these guys get the highest rating and if I could give them 6 stars I would.  By the way... none of these accidents have been my fault.  In the past 26 months they have repaired, including this bumper, 3 front bumpers and 2 rear bumpers.  Again, none of which were my fault... Twice I wasn't even in the car when my car was hit.  Just use them and never look back!

been here a few times. Food has always been good. The empanadas rule and the Cuban sandwich is delicious...the fries, which are pretty not memorable, are even good. They are just frozen shoestring fries but still. The only complaint is that they seem to run out of Cuban sandwiches alot. I got the last one the last time i was there and it was only 1230. I know it might seem kinda odd but a Cuban restaurant should not run out of its stereotypical main item.....its really good though if you can get it.

This place is a great find. The empanadas are amazing and the Cuban sandwhich is enough for 2.
I will be back to Back to Cuba :)

Cuban sandwich.  Steak entree that I cannot pronounce very well.  Either way you will leave so damn happy.  Plus the Blackberry Milkshake (not made with ice cream, it's a cuban thing) is the best thing EVERY OMFG EAT IT NOW!!!!

Italian hoagie was put with the hot stuff we ordered.  Hoagie was wet and bread soaked. 
Very small for a large price. Never order here again. Disappointed to say the least

I'm always searching for good Cuban food and noticed that Back to Cuba is located just off of I-65, so we detoured and went for dinner.  What a pleasant surprise.
It is small, family owned and located in a strip mall.  Don't let that throw you, give it a try.
I really wish they had their menu posted as I can't remember the correct names.  Our main dishes were the Cuban sandwich, another cuban type sandwich but on different bread and grilled chicken.  Sides were fried sweet plantains, rice and black beans.
The Cuban sandwich was very, very good.  Rivaling anything I've had in FL.  And it was huge, enough for two meals.
The "other" sandwich was also very good, but much smaller.  It appeared to have been pressed in a panini type press.
The chicken was a grilled, flatten chicken breast.  Cooked through and moist, but could have used more seasoning.
The black beans were amazing.  Large bowl, but they disappeared too fast.  The rice is, well rice.  Fluffy.  The plantains were super sweet and we ended up eating them for desert.
We also shared a mango milkshake.  They made sure they had the fresh ingredients before letting me know it was still available.  It was pretty darned good.
As for the owner, it appears he is an acquired taste.  One of our party ordered their meal with the correct Spanish pronunciation, and it was obvious they were a Spanish speaker. When they then ordered water, he said, "No."  They repeated water, and he said no again, what is the right name?  Aqua got the water ordered.  It was all in fun.  He appears gruff but made sure that we were happy customers.
Being so close to an I-65 exit, we will definitely be back.

I have been going here since they originally were across from williams park. The atmosphere is ok but they have THE BEST biryani I have ever had! The masalas that they have are good but not the best. They do, however have some of the best tandoori chicken. Prices are normal for Indian cuisine.

I really like this place! The staff and teachers are very friendly and kind, the facilities are clean, and it's a good convenient location on the NW side of town. I also think the monthly rates are very reasonable. Yes, they ask you to commit to a minimum of 8 lessons. But that's really for the child's best interest. We've only gone 3 times so far, but my kids are learning and their comfort in the water is growing by leaps and bounds! Like other commenters, I've had a problem with other parents reserving changing rooms (which is in direct violation of the contract). Maybe unlike other commenters, I don't care. I just go right into the room (with other peoples' stuff in it) & change my kids anyway. Yes, I've gotten a dirty look from the other family when we emerged and they were standing there waiting. But guess what...NO RESERVING ROOMS! So I don't feel bad. I've mentioned it to the front desk staff and they do seem to care about it. They made a big deal about the rule when I signed up and I knew it was likely to be an issue from reading others reviews. So I just use the room anyway, notify the front desk staff of violators, and go about my business. No biggie. For the quality of swim lessons and price, it's a small thing to contend with. I'd definitely recommend them!

I love Cuban food and do backflips every time I walk into Back to Cuba. First off, the energy, music and attentive service never fails to make me feel at home. The Cuban coffee gets me going for the rest of the week and the food is spectacular. Nashville, do yourself a favor porfavor and try the Lechon Asado (Cuban Pork). Every dish here is worth five stars. The owner is as passionate about his patrons as his food. Great job Back to Cuba. You just gained another fan!

I heard a lot about this place prior to giving them a try. I specifically made a trip to NE Philly to try either Chinks or Wit or Witout. Fate landed me at Wit or Witout. I was very disappointed to learn they don't have mustard. That's a huge downer for me cause I like ketchup and mustard on my cheesesteak. The steak is kept whole, which isn't that big of a deal, but I prefer my steak chopped. Overall the steak was average at best. They do offer special meal deals during the week, which is a nice touch if you live in the area. Unfortunately for me, the day I visited was a weekend. One thing I noticed immediately is that this place was one of the cleanest most orderly steak joints I've been to. Kudos for that!

Authentic, delicious Cuban food. If this was in Seattle, people would be lined up around the block to get in. The cubano sandwich was big and tasty. Great white roll with crispy outside, delicious meat inside. Chicken soup was fresh and homemade. Great tastes. Divey goodness in a strip mall with a liquor store, two other restaurants and a gas station.

So ordering your lunch may be a little ambiguous when they are busy. Everything other than the Cubano sandwich is top notch. The fried plantains are so good and highly addictive. Back to the Cubano sandwich....only thing on the menu I don't recommend. The bread was like cardboard and cut the roof of my mouth. Can't go wrong with the fish or steak options.

This is our place! Besides the fact that they have me in their computer as Shawn instead of Sean they are amazing. They get it right everytime. Whenever we order from somewhere that isn't England we always look at one another and ask why we didn't call our favorite place. They have given free food to us from cancelled orders during a pick up. They also take credit card orders over the phone. This is especially convenient for me since I rarely carry cash and sometimes can't leave the house since I've got little ones. Do yourself a favor and don't drive by this one, you will be pleasantly surprised.

I'm  not a big fan of auto repair or bodyshops because they are usally sketchy and try to milk you for every last dime. Not here.
 
A family owned and operated bussiness on Emily Rd in Levittown.

My family has been using there services for years with awesome results.  I had a recent issue with getting work done there. The owner, Anthony and his wife, went above and beyond to make sure the problem was rectified.  It's nice to see such professionalism and dedication to customer service. As residents of Levitown since 1987, we have tried other larger shops in the area, but if you want great work from nice people at reasonable prices, this place takes the cake.  It's the only body shop I would take my cars to in this area.

We've gone there many times. Admittedly it is a flea market, it's not Walmart or Costco. The employees have always been friendly and polite. The selection is always amusing. You never know what you are going to find that you didn't know you needed. Some booths have real good deals, others seem to be out of touch with the real world. There is also a good infusion of new..... stuff..... from week to week, so if you didn't find it today, go back next week. The only drawback to their format is that most of the venders aren't on site, so if you get off on haggling with the seller it is a bit difficult. Now that being said if you found something that you would like to try and get cheaper, you can go to the front desk and they can try and call the owner and see if they are willing to deal on it (just a little bit of a hassle). Overall, it's always fun to kill an hour or so hunting through the "treasures" hidden within.

I stopped by here after it's been burning a hole in my bookmark pages. I haven't had many Cuban sandwiches but even the 'eh' ones are still pretty good. The sandwich here didn't disappoint and I came in during a slow period so the counter service was friendly, though a little limited in the English. I ended up with the Cubano with the key ingredient: the crusty, toasted bread-which separates the men from the boys when it comes to the sandwich. I thought it was a little light on the roast pork-part of why Cuban sandwiches are so awesome since it's two types of pig in one convenient package. Still, the crusty, crunchy bread and the satisfying snap and crunch from it is still on my mind even after a few days. Just give me a second to recollect...

Ok, I'm back.

I got the passionfruit milkshake which was bright and fruity and surprisingly not super tart, more like a smoothie. Definitely worth the trip south.

My 4 1/2 year old daughter started swim lessons this summer at the DeMont Family Swim School with no prior swimming experience.  The swim staff at DeMont helped her become comfortable in the pool within a few lessons.  Their ability to make swimming fun and enjoyable took the fear out of going under the water and transitioning to moving independently through the water.  In a few short months she has moved from back floats and diving for rings to learning how to make big scoops and her favorite move belly/bottom!  As a bonus, the indoor year round lesson are great! I would highly recommend it!
Night and day difference today. It's possible that the owner running the show today is why the experience changed. Very nice gentleman that interacted with all patrons.

I can't say enough about DeMont.  Our son has been attending classes here for about two years.  The facility is clean and has parent-friendly features (strap in seats for lo's in the changing stalls, books and toys in the viewing/waiting area,etc.).  Once our son moved into the independent classes, we began receiving e-mail report cards letting us know how he was progressing.  The staff is terrific.  It is one thing to instruct, another to capture a child's interest and keep things fun.  The teachers we have had have been just amazing in this regard.  Love it!
Wonderful to work with, wonderful job, fair pricing, very detailed and customer satisfaction oriented.

The food definitely scratched the surface of nostalgia (I lived in Miami for a year), but certainly didn't reach the depth of soul.  Poor receptionist/waitress/busgirl was an impressive one-woman show trying to hold the place together, which deserves recognition.  Perhaps they are recovering from a hiatus (came by twice before the previous week and they were closed for renovation)?  The pork was a tad too salty, the beans slightly too sweet, neither good enough for me to finish on-site.  I'll let second impression be the judge this time.

I really wanted to enjoy my experience at this restaurant, but I left quite disappointed. The best words to describe this establishment are disorganized and inefficient. 

Service: this was the most disappointing part of the experience. When we walked in, it was unclear who worked at the restaurant and who were patrons.  Finally, a woman asked us how many we had and I guess put us on a list.  As more people entered she tried to keep track of who came in first. Once we were seated, we received our drinks rather quickly and placed our food orders.  We waited almost an hour to get our food. Our waitress did not come to our table once to check on us, until I literally waved her down. Still at this point she didn't give us any update about our food.  We spoke the owner about how long we had been waiting, and she told us that burgers, which I ordered, take a long time.  I've never had a burger in my life that took an hour to cook. 

Food: as our food finally came out, it was a mess. My burger that supposedly took an hour to cook was as thin as a McDonald's dollar menu burger.  When I asked the owner about this, she said, oh we probably should have given you two patties. Seriously?! My husband's omelette was runny, my sister in law sent her waffle back because it was cold, and we were missing an order of potatoes for another 10 minutes.  Not to mention, my sister in law ordered a grilled cheese for her baby, and let's just say the cheese was not melted AT ALL. 

We expressed our concerns to the owner who told us she would comp some of our items due to our extreme inconvenience. She sounded sincere, so I was ready to give this experience the benefit of the doubt. When we got up to the register, she tried to go back on her word. She told us she decided not to comp anything on this meal, but she'll honor it the next time we come so that we will come back. UNACCEPTABLE. My brother in law expressed that they were from out of town, so she needed to stick to her word, so she finally did and adjusted the bills. Overall, it was way too much of a hassle and there are many other much more efficient brunch places in the area. 

Also, there were no desserts available or on display. Super sad because all the other reviews talked so highly of the dessert spread.

The staff is always friendly, very knowledgeable on all the flavors and happy to discuss the daily specials. The cupcakes are excellent and I enjoy the variety of cupcakes they provide. A nice addition has been the cold drink fridge that pairs nicely with the flavors.

"Back to Cuba" is a solid choice for a good lunch. In the restaurant 'no man's land' near Grassmere Park this place is one of a handful of options. It is nestled in the modest strip mall on the corner of Harding Pike and Grassmere Park.

You can get Cuban Sandwiches, pork tacos, or sauteed shrimp and fish to name a few options. I've had the shrimp plate with rice; the shrimp was cooked well, and had a nice tomato based sauce. It had a side of plantains which was awesome, then it had some sliced avocado (yum), and iceberg lettuce which was just alright, and then slices of tomato (these were not ripe though). I've also had the Cuban sandwich, no complaints there! The sandwich is huge, yummy, and very well priced. 

The lunch was prepared quickly and I was able to get in and out on a lunch hour with no trouble. The atmosphere is cheerful and cozy, it is a simple restaurant, family run and worth a visit if you work or live nearby.

I was rushed to the ER with severe symptoms the other night and was treated with excellent care, especially by the RN, Janice.  The team was knowledgeable and accommodating and I would feel confident returning here in an emergency.

I'm part Cuban. I lived in Miami for many years before I moved to Nashville. I was sooooo glad to find this place. 

The food is very authentic and delicious!!! Two words people "Lechon Asado".

Sometimes the plantains are a little hard (I prefer them soft and sticky), but the black beans are as good as you're going to get North of Miami Lakes, FL, with the exception of my house and Ybor City, near Tampa, FL. WHY?.... Because you probably wont find any north of Tampa except my house and Back To Cuba.

Don't expect white table cloths... you wont find any in Miami or Cuba either.

The mojo (pronounced mo-ho) sauce on the yucca is better than the bottled stuff I've had to settle for since leaving Miami.  

Arroz con pollo is my second favorite entree. The sandwiches are made with REAL cuban bread (which you cant find in any grocery store here in Nashville...Trust me, I've tried).
Order to go if you don't want to eat there.

BTW, Cuban food IS NOT the same as Mexican food... You've got to try this place.

Te quiero Apoye a Cuba!

Great food, amazing service. Cool hidden gem in Nashville.

Would recommend to a friend .

Many people think that a new hospital building in the area means better care. I'm here to tell you, don't judge a book by its cover. I was in serious pain and went to Mercy Suburban Hospital and was given outstanding care. The nurses and the attending physician couldn't have been more knowledgeable, compassionate, and I felt that I was their only patient.  I would definitely return again if I needed ER care.

Overpriced food is always decent but the attitudes of the women that work there is horrible. Sometimes you get bread with your meal other times not. Ask for their red or green sauce today and you would've thought I asked her to swim to Cuba. Hours are 11am-9pm but today they closed at 2:30. If my boss did not pay for our lunches here I would never return.

Philly girl born and raised. I'll admit if I'm in the city I'm going to go to Tony Luke's, but if I'm in the NE and need a cheese steak I'm going here.

Some cheese steak places have gone nuts on the pricing. They have a fair priced combo. I also like how you get to pick if you want the meat chopped or in slices. Fries were perfect, but no containers or packaging for to go orders which made my Whiz fries a mess! This needs to be evaluated! Metal tons, lids, anything! 

The pickles and peppers are better then some of your competitor. The cooks and cashiers were fun to talk to when It was a slow time. 

Please open up further on bucks in the Oxford Valley/Fairless Hills/Sesame Place Tourist attraction!

What a wonderful hospital with a great community feel. Went in today to the Endo procedure unit and I didn't feel like a lined up number waiting to be called next.  It was private and relaxing! Not like the new big hospitals. I'm a marketing director for 19 urgent cares and I really feel this is so important to continue to make people feel relaxed no matter how big we get! Kudos to everyone from the minute I walked in Mercy Suburban to when I left. Please continue this even after the change occurs.

It's been awhile since I've had a breakfast as delicious as da bomb.  The stuffed biscuit was incredible with the perfect amount of filling to biscuit ratio. The staff was all incredibly friendly and made you feel right at home.

Met my wife here for lunch, we had been looking forward to eating here.  Unfortunately, we didn't get to try the food because of the time that it took to come out.  Our order was promptly taken after we sat down.  I ordered a grilled chicken salad and my wife spring rolls.  Over forty minutes later neither had come out and my lunch break was well over.

I wanted Empanadas. The Yelp lords showed favor via the App to a place near my house. I have been here before, but never had their Empanadas. Shame on me!

The order consisted of two empanadas, one beef and one chicken. Both of the pastry goodness delights were encased in large shells. The meat pocket was on the small side leaving a large crimped edge. Each treat is less than two dollars and is packed with tons of flavor.

The savory filling of beef was mild and had a green olive in the mix. It was easy on spice and nice light flavor. It paired well with the chimichurri sauce that I asked for because of its herbal garlicky bite.

The chicken filling was really amazing. Although I was craving a beef experience, the chicken event stole the show. Wow! The stewed meat was flavor packed with a spicy depth of flavor and just a hint of heat. Good greif, it was good. I tried with the condiments offered on the counter, but it didn't need any assistance. 

The rich buttery crusts of both treats left behind "chips" that that I used to douse in the spicy condiments and herbal chimichurri. 

For good measure, I enjoyed a Cafe Cubano which was deep in coffee flavor and the sweetness of pure cane sugar. Oh, my, add a slice of their Tres Leches Cake after a couple of empanadas for $10 for the meal, you will have been transported to wonderful place.

OMG!!!!!!!! The phone service, delivery and FOOD is toooooo die for. WOW!!!!!!

We appreciate you all!!!!!  Truly grateful!!!!

I cannot say enough about this little place. The absolute best Cuban sandwich I have ever had. The black beans were seasoned to perfection, and the plantains...oh the plantains! You definitely don't want to miss this little taste of Cuba!

After watching a Travel Channel special about Cubanos, I suddenly had a craving for one. After feverishly searching online for Cuban restaurants in Nashville, I found this restaurant cozily nestled in a strip mall. 

The atmosphere is quaint. It is extremely small (maybe three or four tables), so don't bring a huge group of people. It also looked like it had a small stage for a band there. Although there was no band playing while I was there, they had authentic Cuban music playing in the background and that was certainly nice. 

 I was on a quest for a basic authentic Cubano, so that is what I ordered. It took probably about 30 minutes for my order, but it was well worth it.
YUM YUM YUM!!!! The bread tasted like it was freshly made, warm and delicious. It was deliciously toasty on the outside and jam-packed with hot delicious meats, cheese and pickle on the inside. I can't wait to go back to try some of the other menu items!

On a side note, don't bother ordering fries with the sandwich. I found my fries to be a stringy, overcooked and flavorless. Besides, the delicious Cubano is more than enough for one person by itself. Save the extra 1.50 to go towards another Cubano during your next visit. Enjoy!

In my last 3 years in the St Pete area I have been hard pressed to find a decent Indian restaurant. After a few terrible experiences other places I had resorted to teaching myself to make my own stuff at home. 

Recently I had family visiting from out of town. After giving them a good dose of local seafood they were in the mood for something different and specifically requested Indian food. I was at a loss for where to take them so I asked a coworker and he said hands down go to India Grill. He couldn't have recommended anything better.

The ambiance is still a work in progress at, from what I understand, their newer location, but the staff and food make up for what is still lacking. 

When we were all about to place our order one of my family members dropped his beer, which shattered and sprayed all over under our table. The waitress was so gracious about the situation and quickly moved us to another table also replacing his beer on the house. 

The four of us each ordered something different so we could all get a sampling of what they had to offer. Our total order consisted of Butter Chicken, Chicken Korma, Lamb Vindaloo, and Lamb Palak. We had a couple orders of Punjabi Naan and Paneer Naan in addition to a round of Veggie Samosas for the group. We all had a tough time deciding which dish was best. 

This is now my household's staple Indian restaurant and a place I would be sure to take friends or family visiting from out of town.

Last time we went, the salad was wilted, and once again...... skimpy choices.
I've been here on several occasions thinking, next time WILL be better than the last.... hoping that someone decided to throw in some savory spices or different menus items. I'm always sadly let down.
The servers rarely smile. Nothing is spicy like real authentic Indian cuisine. Over priced and I would not consider this a "buffet". Emphasis on NOT.

I went for lunch buffet with my girlfriends after seeing "Best of Tampa bay" sticker on their window.  The place is very dark and just looks dirty and old.  

Their buffet selection is very limited and they have only chicken or veggie. No shrimp or lamb.   The only good thing they had was the Butter Chicken...very creamy.  Everything else was just blah.

The service is not good either.  They were just doing the minimum work and since I have tried some Indian lunch buffet at other places, this place did not impress me at all.  I would like to know how they got the BEST of TAMPA award .  If they were able to get one, then it is like almost everyone should get one too.
Great for lunch. Loved the Uncle Pauly. As far as values goes its a deal. The Uncle Pauly is the best deal in the city

This is one of my favorite places. The sandwiches and other foods are amazing. Sometimes they do run out of certain meats for the sandwiches but its ok because there's other stuff on the menu that's just as delicious. The best sandwiches are the Cubano and the Miami. I had a pollo Empanada today and it was only a dollar. I could have bought 3 of those an been full. The food is awesome and worth a try. They do have plates like meat and sides but the sandwiches are where its at. Also fried plantains there and their milkshakes are pretty awesome. Don't expect it to be like a thick American milkshake though.

When you walk in its very small and seating is limited but I like the feel of restaurants like that. I've never had bad service and the staff has always been friendly to me.

Upon arrival we had to wait in what seemed like a "we don't know your here" situation, and we feared the worst based on hearsay of bad service. After about 10 mins our orders were taken and once we were served food (rather promptly I might add). It was like magic in our mouths! The camerones enchilados, the flan! The flank steak! Yes we shared and indulged in Cuban heaven! We will return and be happy to wait for what is arguably the best Cuban food we have ever had.

We love DeMont! I've been taking my daughter since before she was a year old and is now almost two years old. She's had one instructor most of the time we've been there. We have also met some of the other instructors and they also very knowledgeable, are appropriate with teaching her age group, and have a plan for the class to help advance the students along. The staff has always been friendly and professional, from front office to instructors. I (along with, I'm sure many other people who go there) normally don't do reviews for establishments I'm happy with, but they deserve the recognition for being so great!

Loved the Cuban menu. I don't know why I never went there, I guess it is the location. It's crammed in next to a gas station. It looks like a hole in the wall, but when you get inside there is so many options to choose from. We tried several things,  and they were all flavorful. The staff joked around with us and treated us very well. I hope to return soon

Great food. Cool place. Wouldnt have tried it without these yelp reviews. first time Cuban food experience was worth the drive to exit 78. Take out maybe a better idea next time since there is not much of an ambience. It's a cafe not a restaurant

I think their steaks have greatly improved from when they first opened, because I did not care for them. However, I do enjoy indulging every once in awhile, and I love there "wiz wit" steak. They also now offer salads, wraps & hoagies. They have a hot pepper, pickle bar also to add to your sandwich. And you can always look around for coupons.
Pretty tasty Cheesesteak, meet was flavored nicely. The place was pretty clean, plenty parking.  Definitely recommend this place!

We got one of almost everything (well one of what was left) they had been super busy earlier that day. We only got bakery things like cupcakes, cookies, layer bars etc...haven't tried the food yet, but if the bakery goods we had are any indication of the quality and taste that the lunch and dinner will have then this will be a restaurant to be reckoned with. I also know the sisters from where I work and they are very sweet ladies and I did not know that this was their place until we stopped by.
Maybe a little more expensive than I would like, but the food holds up for the price. The Cubano is great. I totally missed out on getting a milkshake, though. Next time, Gadget ... next time.

Not the greatest cupcakes I've had but also not the worse. I expected the cupcakes to be mind blowing especially since they were on cupcake wars. I've tried quiet a few places that were on cupcake wars and this is definitely one of the bottoms on my list. 

What we got..

Coconut: tasted like tanning lotion. Disgusting period 

Boston creme: the entire concept is great, but when you think of Boston creme you think of the most important part, the filling. The one we had barely had any filling :(

Peach cobbler: this was probably the only cupcake I enjoyed. It was very moist and tasted good. I wish they would put more peaches, my cupcake had 2 little chunks lol 

Chocolate caramel mocha: ummm where's the mocha? I asked them if the cake was coffee infused, they said yes along with icing. I'm a coffee fanatic and did not taste a bit of coffee. My brother who absolutely hates coffee said there was no coffee in the cake. There was little coffee grinds sprinkled on top but very little. Very disappointed as I was super excited about this one. 

Overall, I personally think the cupcakes here are a little overpriced. They're 80 cents more expensive then The Cup and they're smaller than The Cup too. BUT BUT BUT Smallcakes taste a tad bit better than the cup. The cake is moist and not as drying. Also, there are other cupcake places that are way cheaper and they also give a slight discount when you buy multiple. Not here but they do have one incentive, a punch card. 

I'll be back when I'm craving a cupcake and will update if it's better.

LAWD. delicious, moist, fresh, homemade. yes I'm aware this is a franchise but they bake fresh every morning and have certain flavors of the day. if you can make a vanilla cupcake (I'm a chocolate girl) make me want to cry with happiness, you are a win in my book. must try the wedding cake, to die for.
Classic Philly cheesesteak. Perfect combo of great meat and a great roll and the people were very friendly. Would recommend to anyone.

I'd seen these guys in a lot of food truck posts; the pictures looked great so I was at nampa art in the Park saw them in the food court figured I'd try. I did the "loaded fries"; which was a little bit of an understatement more fries and "bbq" sauce than meat. The bbq sauce they use has a definitive ketchup flavor profile and come across on the pallet as very sweet I'd venture to say overly sweet. The fries had a small serving size of pulled pork drenched in their bbq sauce and that was it. The pulled pork had very little taste no smoky flavor at all just mainly you got the taste of their overly sweet/ketchup bbq sauce. The key to great bbq is the smoke/flavor of the meat and your bbq sauce; their bbq sauce clearly needs an update. Major disappointment I ended up pitching most of it after the pulled pork fries and overly sweet bbq sauce just are not my thing. Can't say if I saw them again I'd try any other bbq items on their truck.

All the high prices you come to expect of Indian fair, but none of the flavor. My first experience was during the lunch buffet and then I decided to give it another try.. The dinner was disappointing as well. India Grill doesn't belong among the quality local restaurants in St. Pete.

OMG! This place is amazing. I had the Vaca Frita and I thought I was in Miami. 
FANTASTIC!

As a Cuban that grew up in Miami, this place is the real deal. The black beans are off the chain! Anything you get here is awesome. Love Alex, the owner. He's your typical, know it all, loud mouth Cuban. That's how we are.

I had the pan con bistec & it was amazing. The bf ordered the palomilla steak with rice & bean plus French fries. My other friends ordered lechon asado with rice, beans & yuca. All was AMAZING & totally authentic. 

For the dessert we all ordered cafecito, rice pudding & flan. Will definitely come back while in Nashville.
It's okay. Better than a lot of places in the area but not the best in my opinion. Interestingly they have two size pizzas. I don't see that often these days. Good crust but bland sauce.

Wife and I made first trip to "Back to Cuba" on a Saturday. We don't have a ton of experience with Cuban food, so we stuck with the Cubanos (each although we could have shared one), a beef emanados, and plantains. All three items were very good and I will definitely return here.

Either I've never had a Cuban sandwich before, or I've never had one this good. The bread was light and crunchy, and the meat was hot and tender, so that each bite broke away from the rest of the sandwich perfectly.

I've been thinking about going to Back to Cuba for some time, so finally my wife and i went there for lunch. Having been warned, the were one of the first ones through the door. The place is small and the tables are few, so once that door opens, he who hesitates is lost.

We shared the huge Cubano  sandwich. It was piled high with meat and only the half really was enough for a lunch. Nevertheless, I ordered the pork tacos. The pulled pork lay on a flour (?) taco flavored with cilantro. Unfortunately, I decided to spice up a taco with salsa verde and got way too energetic. The cool can of Iron beer. cooled my blazing mouth Oh, Iron beer is a soft drink that originated in Cuba in 1917 and tastes a lot like Dr Pepper.

The meal served -to at Back to Cuba was all really good. The price was very reasonable considering the quality of the food. My wife said, emphatically, "we are coming back here". I agree.

Back to Cuba is a tiny little restaurant that's smushed between a few other places. It's not really well lit at night, and I wasn't sure if my Uber driver was dropping me off at the right place. Thankfully, it was and I was able to indulge in Nashville's Cuban food. 

You order at the counter, which isn't really clear when you walk in. Their menu is handwritten on some chalkboards on the walls. I ordered a Cuban sandwich and some tostones. The food came out within 10 minutes and I was able to start eating. The Cuban sandwich was crisp on the outside, and then juicy on the inside. The meat was flavorful and I was very happy with this choice. The tostones were okay, nothing to really rave about. I've definitely had better - these tasted a little too sweet compared to what I'm used to when I order them. 

There's a $10 credit card minimum - I was able to hit that with my cuban sandwich and tostones. You pay at the register when you're ready to go. I'm sure when it's busy that causes some confusion considering the lines for ordering and paying would wind up intertwining a little.

Wow, first of all.  It's a solid 4 stars.  
But I don't get the name, b/c how many tennesseans have been to Cuba to begin with?

Anyways, the food wasn't good enough for me to buy a plane ticket to go down south, but I would go back to "back to Cuba."  

One of the more popular dishes in Cuban food are the pork sandwiches.  However, I wouldn't suggest you get one here.  The sandwich is made with deli sliced "Boar's Head" ham, which is really good quality stuff.  But I'm used to my Cuban sandwiches made with cutlets of pork.  So their Cuban sandwich doesn't taste very Cuban, but rather just like a hot ham panini sammich.  

BUT THAT'S OKAY.  Cuz they do great with their other stuff.  The chicken empanadas were humbling.  I felt so grateful for being allowed to eat them.  The Lamb was delicious.  It's slow cooked to give your teeth a rest.  

I rank it high in revisitability (and yes, I just made up that word).  I definitely had separation anxiety when I left.  There were so many other things on the menu I wanted to try but didn't have the room for it.   

The important point to make here is that this place made my stomach smile.  I know that's a gross visualization b/c stomachs don't have teeth nor do they make for attractive faces even if they could smile, but nonetheless my "tummy" said the food was yummy.  Worth making a trip

My wife is Cuban, raised in lil Havana, and we recently moved here from Miami so we know Cuban food. Back to Cuba delivers from the iron beer (oh so cuban) to vaca frita all the way to the dominos table.  It's like being at the Sergios in Miami without the high prices!!!
