They used to have a great cheesesteak here.  Now, the quality of the meat seems sub-standard.  I wonder if that is why they now chop the steak rather than serve it flat?  They did not even ask for a preference, but just served the meat chopped. The sandwich tasted like a steak you could get at any other NE Philly pizza shop (maybe not even as good as some). I was awfully disappointed...

Ehhh... It was good but not GREAT like I was expecting from reading the reviews. The Lechon Asado (Roasted Pork) and Yuca (Casava) were very good. However I wanted to sub the white rice and black beans with moro's and they would not do it. They would though sell me a side portion of moro's. BTW in case you don't know rice and beans is the same as moro's except that with moro's the rice and beans are cooked together at the same time. Go figure. In Miami this place would not be the go to place, but in TN it is. The staff was friendly and attentive, but the chicken poop with not sub'ing out the rice and beans was a bit sophomoric. I ordered a Cuban Sandwich to go and just finished woofing half of it down. It was top shelf. We will go back, but next time we will know what to expect. If you're in the area you should give it a try. It's located right off of I-65 off of exit 78A.
They have really cleaned this place up in the past year. Found some great bargains and must haves! Will go back.

Such a pleasant place to enjoy a relaxing brunch. There was a man playing a guitar and taking request who was absolutely fantastic. I ordered the breakfast bowl and was completely full. The staff was polite and accommodating. I look forward to returning to try their breakfast buffet!
This past Saturday I came here from New Jersey to try my first Philly cheese steak & I was  impressed with the food their fries was good to I would come back for another cheese steak
I've used Funez Drywall for several clients and they are always punctual, professional and they do great work.  Truly top notch drywall services!
So yummy! My happy place!!!! The churrasco is good, the chicken breast, the sandwiches, everything g is so good here!!!! This is very authentic except tacos, Cubans don't eat tacos

Nashville Opera had a rehearsal hall near here many years ago. I was a chorus member and we frequented this place on breaks. That was before I signed up for Yelp! I went back there today and it was as good or better than I remember.

Five star ratings from me are usually reserved for great food and ritzy dining areas. I am giving this high rating based on original flavor profiles and a great casual atmosphere.

So, how does this Polack become a judge of Cuban food?, you may ask. Easy. I dated a Cuban lady and enjoyed authentic Cuban food her mother prepared.

Over the years at this restaurant, I have been haunted by memories of home cooked Cuban food. Every time I've visited, I recall aromas, tastes and conversation of my experiences in mom's kitchen in an apartment north of New York City.

Today, I had a simple meal of one empanada. In years past, I've had croquettes, sandwiches and main dishes. All of them have been great. I wish I lived closer. Great taste memories.

WTN is Nashville's talk radio station. While it's your typical conservative talk radio, there are varying and very different hosts that talk throughout the day. Getting me to listen to them was a hard sale for my husband because they do play the Bill O'Reilly.

I enjoy the Michael Delgiorno show in the morning, he's a Republican but he's honest about everything, and I've heard the man chewed out on several occasions by his own kind for sticking up for various democrats when credit was due. 

Financial guru Dave Ramsey's show also plays on here, but considering he's based here in good old Nashville I'd be sad if his show wasn't played. One day I'm going to take his advice and only pay in cash.

Point is if you like to get both sides of an argument, here's the Right and a little extra.
This place is the best. I've been coming here for a decade and it's always great. It's a fast cafe style place with tremendous Cuban food can't reccomend it enough.

Such a sweet and wonderful atmosphere! Food was great. Cake and cinnamon rolls were yummy! The best part is the staff! We danced and sang and clapped and hugged! We felt loved from the moment we walked in! A family affair all around.

I moved to Philadelphia a bit ago and tried my first cheesesteak only to be let down. I've tried all the big name spots and even some of the top rated local places and all have let me down. But for some reason tucked away in this random corner of the northeast lies a steak chain that is clearly underrated. I don't know why, I don't know how, but wit or without it has the best cheesesteak I've ever had in philly/pa period. The meat was thick, tender, had a little crisp on it. The onions were perfect, little jewels of tasty joy and the cheese was heavenly. Melted to perfection and oozing from the seems. also everyone's super nice there. Thanks for the good steaks!
Love this place. Needs more condiments on the Cuban sandwich but I always ask for extra. They're so nice there too.

I try to stop in as often as I can! I love this food, chicken and beef empanadas are excellent, oh, with the green dipping sauce mmmmm
 ! Had the Media Noche for lunch today, the cubano was also delicious! Mango smoothies, perfect! Authentic Cuban, never disappoints.

After living in Miami for several years i got to love the culture, the people, the music but specially the food so i always look for good Cuban restaurant in new cities and I finally found it in Nashville. 

Hidden in a street mall this tiny little place is my spirit animal. 

Nothing fancy, but when the food is good, it doesn't have to be. When you see the steady stream of folks coming in to eat, you suspect this might be a hidden gem. 
Great music and decor. 
About the food ... The grilled chicken has a great flavor cooked perfectly. We had both the breast entree, pan con pollo sandwich, the garbanzo soup, Cuban style rice and black beans could be a meal in themselves. The plantains were cooked perfectly. We ordered the empanadas. First they were HUGE. These can be an entree. Of course to finish Cuban coffee.

The hot and spicy green sauce goes well with all the dishes 

The menu is tacked to the wall. The items and specials change.  We will be back to Back to Cuba.

One minor issue I see is the young woman is tacking orders, cooking the sandwiches and working the register all at the same time with not gloves or washing her hands after touching money and credit cards that's why I gave a 4 star not a 5.
Food was delicious. Waffle reminded us more of a cake than a waffle...yummy!! Despite COVID-19, service was exceptional and food was even better...

Visiting from out of town and saw this place. I had chicken and waffles and my wife had Da Bomb (stuffed biscuits). Mine was really good, but hers... literally the best biscuits we ever had. Will definitely visit again next time we're in town.

Zsuzsi is amazing!  She uses only zero VOC paints that are safe for your family and pets. She has an incredible eye for detail and did a beautiful job on our house - all three floors. Highly recommended.

We tried to eat here but after waiting 5 minutes at the counter to order, then the server walking away to take a phone call while we were in mid-order (and all we wanted was a couple of sandwiches) and then waiting another 8 minutes for her to come back...we left.

Surprisingly good lunch spot in a run down strip mall attached to a gas station. The outside is not much to look at, but inside the staff is welcoming, and the food is good. Traditional Cuban fare, the pork rice & beans being the house special (see pic). I have the feeling you really can't go wrong with anything here as the line is usually long and open tables are rare
The wait staff was friendly and the Cubano is PHENOMENAL. I will definitely be coming back... Thank you!

THIS PLACE IS GARBAGE: I've been to this location 4 times in the past two months each time I've been more hesitant than the next. This last time I'm went I ordered two foot longs one turkey breast on whole wheat flatbread with spinach and a footlong chicken bacon ranch I tried to use my coupon and the lady says you rang it up an a 6inch and continued to charge me the 14 dollars instead of the 2 foot long for 10$ coupon I had what ever happened to the customer is always right. She didn't even give the coupon back f*** this place I'm tired of WASTING my hard earned money on your bullshit
So fun! Food is super tasty! Save room for an authentic dessert!
Great place to take your kids to learn to swim in a comfortable setting. They take great pride In teaching the kids an important skill!

My car had been sitting in the garage.The battery was dead. Ryan came to my house installed a new battery, checked everything out, advised regarding tire pressure. Ryan is hard working, honest, reliable and very pleasant. Took care of everything quickly. I will definitely use Lightning Mobile Services in the future and highly recommend Ryan.

I have had this amazing painter in my home for the last week and she should get 10 stars!
On top of being on of the nicest people you could ever imagine,  she is meticulous in her work and takes such pride and is immaculate at the end of each day cleaning up.
She is prompt and a total joy.  I will be having her work for me 3 weeks a year in my home and factory she is that good.
They just changed their name. Use to be Wit or Witout. Prices went up and steaks are half the size, literally. Go to stoli's on bustleton Ave, much better.
Had a couple of problems with my wrangler car and they came to my help quickly and efficiently. lightning indeed!

We had a leak in an upstairs bathroom that had to be repaired through the first floor ceiling - of course leaving a nice sized hole in the drywall. I contacted this company based on the positive online reviews and I'm glad I did. Andy gave us a prompt and fair estimate and even put his own plans aside to accommodate us and schedule the repair. Andy and Ivan were punctual and did wonderful work. They worked quickly and carefully...even cleaning up after. The final product was flawless; you'd never know there was a hole in the ceiling. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone needing drywall repair. You won't regret it!
Ridiculously good chili dog. The chili was on point, just the right amount of spice, and the owner was great to talk to.

Great place for breakfast/brunch. Great Bloody Marys and Mimosas. We were in town for a wedding and our rental house was across the street. Which was incredible. We went every morning they were open. The food is great and the owner and staff are awesome! Strongly recommend to everyone.
Absolutely lovely staff. The experience was great and my cinnamon roll donut was even better! Can't wait to go back!

I love this place and am sad that I just experienced it.  I had the Picadella special which is too hard to explain but it was amazing.  While it only had 4 stars it deserves more.  The staff was friendly.  It was very affordable and the music in the background was a nice touch.   It's in a small shopping center that from the outside doesn't look like much but on the inside felt like home.  I will be back soon and often.

Had a custom birthday cake made from here and it was out of this world!  Was going for a Key Lime Pie, but was suggested that the baker was more comfortable making a cake so I went with their suggestion.  It turned out both great and colossal.  It literally fed half the neighborhood and was towering with several layers of cake and creamy frosting.  A great indulgent treat and a great opportunity to support a local, minority-owned business!

Never really liked this place since it opened ... Stopped here 'cause I wanted a cheese steak and didn't feel like driving further down the blvd to Steve's . I'm glad I stopped in and gave it another shot, the cheese steak, fries and soda combo was a really good deal and was surprisingly awesome,  the cheese fries and steak were loaded with cheese and the portion was pretty insane. I felt my heart stop a few times during lunch but that's just part of the experience. 
Only complaints : the pickles suck bad (bread and butter pickles ?? Also cut too thick)
Fries and napkins were scattered on the floor...

I was extremely disappointed by the Fork & Fire food truck when it came to UA. We all ordered the BBQ plate and were most excited for the smoked mac & cheese listed as the side dish. After paying and waiting for our food, we were served a BBQ plate with tots instead of mac & cheese. The cashier was not informing customers that they don't serve mac & cheese, even though it was listed multiple times on their menu! We, and several other customers, were extremely disappointed when we were served something we didn't order. On top of that, the pulled pork was dry and flavorless, and the "tots" were also just merely home fries. The workers were NOT welcoming to our complaints. The cashier was not knowledgeable about any of the menu items and had to yell back to the cooks to ask for clarity. Also, I attempted to use my phone to pay using their contactless card reader (which was advertised on their window), but it was not functioning properly. As a new business, I would expect workers to be going above and beyond to win customer loyalty. At Fork & Fire, I was met with abrasive workers and disappointing food. I will be sure to warn others about ordering from this food truck in the future.

D and A Auto was recommended to me a few years back, taken all of my vehicles there ever since.  They  do excellent body work! They take care of all my vehicle needs.......and they even deal with all the insurance details! Stress free. Thank you D and A auto and collision!

We were at Enigma several times. The menu is typical for Turkish restaurants. Food is always great. People are very friendly. They serve hot pita bread with food. The portions of everything are pretty big. Definitely recommend finishing with Turkish tea.

I'm giving the store 3 stars - the store itself and associates are very nice. Our problem is with the travel center. We have been loyal Boscov's travel center clients for well over a decade and have booked many trips - many Disney trips (at least 4 or 5), Bermuda, Jamaica and we always finance through the Boscov's card. Our last trip booked was to Jamaica (May travel dates) which was cancelled in March due to Covid. We have STILL not received a refund even though we have made several attempts at contacting both Boscov's and Apple vacations. Both of the couples we were traveling with booked through online sites (separate ones) and both have received full refunds from those companies weeks and weeks ago. It is a shame that Boscov's and Apple vacations have destroyed their decades long relationship with us for all future trips due to their lack of returning our money in a timely manner. It took a few seconds to take our money, there is no question that since the trip was canceled not by us, the refund should take 10 minutes at most. We have now been forced to get our money back through other means.

Wow!   You all make some incredible food!!!!   Everyone at our party is still raving about how good it was!  I know I thoroughly enjoyed my loaded mac and cheese with chicken!   My husband enjoyed the pulled pork plate!!   We enjoyed it so much that we ordered more to take home for lunch the next day.   The street tacos were the best street tacos I have eaten in the 25 years I have lived in Tucson!

In addition to the food, all of your staff were happy, friendly, professional, helpful, and personable!    Overall, a very successful evening for our party!!!  Thank you!

My niece has gone into the business of selling empanadas. When her dad came to town I decided to take him and my mother to Back to Cuba for lunch and give their empanadas a try.  Everyone enjoyed their empanadas. I have also had there Cuban sandwich and chicken there before. They do magic with plantains and everything is at a reasonable price.

With the Latin music wafting in the background and a great environment with easy access, this is a great hidden gem on the southern side of downtown Nashville

We had to stop going here unfortunately. They say they enforce masks to protect the children but they don't. There are parents, children over two and maintenance employees walking around maskless and nothing is said despite there being signs all over the place. You have to check in when your child enters, why don't the front desk employees say something????? 
What concerns me the MOST is some of the swimming teachers pull their mask forward to talk during the class. Omg!!! That defeats the purpose ladies!! I've also seen some of them remove it when explaining things even when they are 3ft away. I just don't get it and disappointed. 
Beyond safety, I just feel it's not challenging enough and redundant.

Summary: they have a punch card for savings, it's about $36 for a dozen, but you get a "free 13th" for either that day or a punchcard. Selections change daily (with a few consistent flavors that are always there). Friendly staff. Clean place. Moist cupcakes.

They have boxes for a dozen, one cupcake or two cupcakes, but you can order in any denomination and they will make it work. I've pretty much had every flavor at this point and all have been good. I buy about a box a month to bribe the guys I work with.  They staff has ALWAYS been pleasant. It is in a strip mall next to Jimmy Johns, but it's easy to get in and out because there is a stoplight RIGHT there.

First time trying this place out always heard good things yet never had the time to actually check it out for myself I must say I'm picky lol and everything I had was delicious with covid and everything going on I haven't really been trying anything new. I normally stick to my go to restaurants which are only a few if you haven't been yet I would highly recommend going I got my order to go, I believe you can dine in if you choose to. I will definitely be back might even make this my new go to spot oh in the prices aren't bad either so far the henny syrup is my favorite. I also love how they have turkey sausage not sure if they serve turkey bacon haven't really asked but being that I don't eat pork that's good enough for me. The inside is really nice as well if you all ever decided to or thought of adding some art that would be pretty dope! Just a suggestion for the owner or owners' be something different, Oh also I think there is a bar as well unsure but if correct they do serve drinks correct me if I'm wrong overall nothing bad I could say honestly. In as far as parking not sure if they have a extra lot or something so may have to ask about that as well. Thanks again in see ya soon

Someone told me about this place and I had not realized I've been here before.  It is the best Cuban food this side of Miami!  Don't worry if they don't speak any English, just read and point or say what you think it says on the menu.  Did I say Authentic?

Our kids (now 4 and 7) have been coming to Demont for over 2 and a half years. I have always been so impressed with the swim school and love them even more for how well they are handling Covid-19 restrictions.

After they closed for the first few months of the stay at home orders they sent out several surveys to swim student families. When they reopened you could really tell they took out input and CDC guidelines into account. They even sent videos of walking through the swim school with the new precautions in place so students could get used to the new protocols in the comfort of their homes. 

New Protocols: Masks are required inside.  Classes are now limited to individual students or 2 siblings per teacher. Each teacher in the pool wears a clear Duke full face scuba mask. Stickers are setup 6 ft apart to stand on before class. Only one parent per family is allowed inside. No more showers or drinking fountain use. 

I know this sounds like a lot but it means they can safely stay open and I think that is pretty epic! This is such a great way to get your kids active and having some fun during an extra difficult time! Thank you so much to DeMont staff for doing this safely.

It's hard to find a good place to eat out in the far North East, so this place used to be a haven in all the Taco Bell's and McDonalds. But the last time I came here I was really disappointed and probably won't be trying this place out again anytime soon 

First is the portions. We order large cheese fries to share, which we were told would fill a to-go container. When we got home to eat, the container was not even half full (which was explained to the normal for a "small" order). So we over payed for, not even, a small order. That or the employee taking the order just gave us incorrect information we based our order on. 

The cheesesteaks were so bland. The Cali cheesestake barley had any Lettie's and the meat was tough and hard to chew. 

Really hope this isn't the norm for this plce but I don't plan on coming back in the near future to find out.

Ever since I moved to Nashville, I've been looking for delicious, authentic soul food! Thank goodness my realtor recommended this place!! It was so yummy!! Please do yourself a favor and order the Peach Sangria! I felt like I was at my cousins house, not a restaurant. There was great live music, friendly customer service, and the owner actually gave us all a hug before we left!! I can't wait to return!!

This review is for the location in Feasterville. 
I ordered the lightweight cheesesteak with American cheese with onions. 
First off, had I known ahead a time that the cheese would be cheese whiz consistency,(all melted and a mess)I would have ordered a plain steak or requested for the cheese(Hopefully it's not processed cheese) to simply be placed on the roll, then put the hot steak on it. The roll was not great. A bit chewy. The steak itself was fair to good. 
I may try it again and voice my preferences.

I have been waiting for a good Turkish restaurant to appear in Bucks County for a long time.  We got a takeout order with an assortment of entries and shared them for a memorable Father's Day celebration for four. We got lamb iskander kebab, fellafel, adana chicken kebab, spicy veggies, babaganush, dolmas, and Mediterranean salad.  The food was very authentic, right up with restaurants in Turkey.  We finished off the meal with an order of baklava.  The staff was very friendly.

A nice little Gem located near our AirBnB stay.  We loved everything about it!   Owners and staff were very friendly.  We visited twice and had a wonderful brunch, accompanied w mimosas, and Bloody Mary's.   They even had live entertainment - a bluesy/jazz singer.   It's a must try if you are in the area!

Wow!! I cannot say enough good things about this place and above all, the service was AMAZING!! We came on a Sunday morning and they had a live guitarist playing mellow acoustic music so such a cozy ambiance! I had the waffle and it was so light and fluffy. The owner actually introduced herself to us and had us try a free glazed donut and let me say it was LITERALLY the best donut I've had in my life! It was so warm and fluffy and fresh! Highly recommend and come before too many people discover it-truly a hidden Nashville gem!

This was my first place that I visited when I came to Nashville, and it definitely set the bar for me. From the food to the drinks to the customer service I am 100% satisfied. If you are in the area you must visit.

I've been taking my kids to DeMont consistently for the past year and a half. I love the group classes for the kids 3 and up. My kids tend to do better with their peers rather than in the Mommy and Me style classes and progress much quicker. 

The kids are encouraged to be independent in these group classes. They walk into the pool by themselves guided by the color of a wrist band they are given to the matching colored frog. There are swim teachers standing outside the pool to help out any kids who look lost. Then the kids sit down at their edge of the pool and go in with their teacher.

The Deck Manager comes out at the start of lessons and gives you a quick run down on what skills they are working on each class. They also let you know what groups are being evaluated although once kids have hit their skills they may be advanced  the next class at any time.

Pro-Tip: if you have an anxious kiddo tips posted in the parent observation area on what to do if you have a kiddo who tends to cry at the start of class.
Not impressed.  Bread on the Cuban sandwhich was stale and the croquetas may have had chorizo in it... not Cuban style.  Wish there was another option for real Cuban food in the area.

We had a drywall installer redo our outside lanai ceiling. Within 4-5 months the area close to the house started to bubble. The guy came back and did a poor repair. Two months later it started to peel off. We were so fortunate to find Andy with Funez Drywall and Painting. He has been in Business for 15 years. This young man is so professional and has great attention to detail. He was able to repair the areas that had failed and even made it match the existing ceiling. He also took the time to inspect the ceiling in my house and found two other areas that he repaired. He cleaned up everything when he finished and made everything look original. His price is reasonable and his work is excellent. We were blessed to have him do the work.
The BEST Cubano sandwich EVER!! Love the fried plantains and the juices are to die for. Mango is my favorite. We eat here every chance we get.

I decided to give them a try after seeing the food truck several times. What a mistake! I ordered the loaded tots with pulled pork and the 4 cheese smoked Mac. The pulled pork tasted very basic/plain and the "tots" were actually just soggy home fries on soggy paper. What a disappointment! The smoked Mac tasted like it was boiled in dirty tap water for far too long and was very runny. There was some sort of baked cheese on top maybe just panko? I honestly couldn't taste any cheese other than Parmesan. I'm not trying to be mean it's just not what I expected for the price I paid and the portion/quality I received. Wouldn't recommend/won't go back.

Notice the time? Closes in 37min..2nd time we drove 30min to this place & they decide to close early. Both times people are still in there eating, lights on, we walk in & get turned away b/c they randomly decide to close early. Pathetic. Save yourself a drive.
Seems they do deliver! Love the cheesesteaks here and one of my favs to get cheese fries! I honestly like them better then Steves... Better prices too.

Wow!!! So please come to this place... Sunday brunch is unbelievable. They have so many choices from breakfast items to lunch items and desserts!

Service was super attentive and nice. The food was delicious and fresh. Very flavorful and well made. They had eggs, bacon, potatoes, the French toast were so yummy. They had catfish, chicken and veggies too. The live music just puts the cherry on top! 

Great place definitely and I will be coming back for more!

Located in a parking lot on Bustelton Pike, this is a real hidden gem. The food is fresh and fantastic. The Adana kebab is made with love and very juicy. The service is very welcoming and friendly. The place is nice but a little chilly. It is not luxurious but with nice finishes that you would expect in a nice Northeast Philadelphia restaurant. I had the mixed grill and it was HUGE and delicious. You can taste Almost everything they have on the menu. I also tried their Kunefe and it's great! Not too sweet and not soggy but perfect! Just make sure you order it early as it takes about 7 minutes to make. Would definitely recommend as a destination for a nice day especially that they have outside seating.
The worst meal I've ever had delivered to my home. This place needs to be shut down. Do NOT spend any money here, you will regret it.

Beef & chicken empanadas were ok. For appetizers, you could eat these for your entree, they're hearty portions and definitely filling.

Cuban sandwich was decent. 

Roast pork plate was my favorite, meat was tender and the garlic fried rice was perfect! 

Will definitely come back to try their other sandwiches.
I never understood the hype with wit or witout. Ive had alot of cheesesteaks in my life, and wit or witout never was anything impressive to me.

The empanadas were pretty good. The service is bad. The girl taking orders was really rude. She and the other girl took forever to even acknowledge us and take our order. She was very unfriendly and it was like I was inconveniencing her for even being there.

Chicken and waffles, and bacon and tator tots waffle were both very good, and I appreciate the extra efforts regarding mask wearing and social distancing. Unfortunately the order we called in got lost, so when I arrived to pick up, it wasn't even started. I know times are challenging so I can't be too hard on them.

I love this place. I just went there for my 2nd visit and can't wait to go back for more. The food, as last time, was amazing, authentic, well-prepared, and I couldn't have been more impressed. The owner spent some time with us, sharing pictures and stories about Cuba. We left knowing a lot we didn't know before. Thank you!

Edit: I forgot to mention two things: 1st, you must order in Spanish! It's a rule! 2nd, no cell phones are allowed while you're eating. The owner encourages you to enjoy the food and converse with each other! He's a lot of fun and it made our trip more enjoyable!

I really enjoy Brian Wilson on the way to work every day, Phil Valentine on the way home is stimulating and interesting.    How in the hell Dan Mandis and Michael Delgorno are on the air baffles me.    They are terrible.    I listen to both today on May 10 and it was unbearable.    They fired Ralph Bristol who has more talent that Mandis and Degorno combined.   I will not listen to 99.7 from 9 to 3 as long as these two are on the air.

Our Airbnb was right across the street from Shugga Hi and I'm so glad we decided to try their Sunday brunch before heading home. They had a large buffet with a lot of options. The fish was delicious! The live music made our visit even better and all of the employees were super friendly!

I couldn't be more pleased with the service I received from All Women Painting... I needed a job done FAST and ZsuZsi made herself immediately available to visit my trinity and check out the scope of work.   She turned around a quote fast and completed the job in less than two days!   I was most impressed that she went above and beyond...She offered to help with some other "fix it" touch ups I needed and just didn't have the time to do...  I was thrilled with the results!  She even took out garbage for me and offered advice on how to make the place show better as she knew I was listing the property for sale right away.   I whole heartedly recommend All Women Painting and will refer them to all of my friends... Thank you ZsuZsi!!

The food was great and so was our server. Just realize that the kitchen is slow. It's BYOB,  so you can be prepared for a leisurely time.  You should probably make reservations since it is small inside and there are a few tables outside.

This crack team of chefs is following our bike riders across Arizona and New Mexico. Our riders are thrilled with the food at the end of the day!! Rave reviews!! I'm vegetarian and Josh has done magic for me!! These guys are amazing. Very savory and tasty!! Run don't walk to their truck!!

Fantastic cheesesteak! Excellent seeded roll stuffed with Ribeye!
Good enough to win a contest!
Ask for the heavyweight!
Totally delicious!
My favorite cheesesteak spot in the northeast. Excellent cheesesteaks! The price is inexpensive and the best part are the two for one combos.

Ryan came out the same day I called about a potential dead battery. He performed the diagnostic and installed the battery without me having to get a jump or leave my house. He checked my other electrical components and I feel satisfied that my car is running well again. He was very communicative and came when he said he would. I would highly recommend to anyone who needs quick, attentive service.

Amazing!  Please go to see Ms Cathy and her wonderful staff! We didn't know there was live music but thoroughly enjoyed the musician playing jazz while we are. Not too loud so we could still have a conversation. The food is phenomenal and so is the atmosphere!  I had the chicken and waffles, which were exactly what I wanted and exceeded expectations. My friend had 'da bomb' with one meat and one veggie and both were so good. A perfect combination of fillings wrapped in a biscuit.  This will definitely be a staple when we come back to Nashville.

Favorite lunch spot in Nashville. Reasonable prices for amazing authentic Cuban food. I feel like I'm back in Miami, enjoying a good Cuban coffee and homemade dishes with a little attitude. Order a single shot (cafecito) or a double shot (colada) or one with milk (cafe con leche). I eat in but many order to go for lunch. I'm still trying all the dishes but I have loved both the Churasco (skirt steak with chimichurri) and the Vaca Frita (flap meat with mojo sauce). The black beans take me back to a mom and pop diner in Puerto Rico that I'll never forget and have been chasing ever since. I like them with a side of fresh diced onions, and of course with the rice and plantains that comes with most dishes. If you haven't had Cuban food before or are a veteran/lover, come try out Back to Cuba!

Having lived in Key West for years, I expected the same Cuban cuisine from "Back to Cuba" given the high rating and rave reviews. I was very disappointed about every aspect of my visit, which started with a rude reception. The menu was a series of disorganized, neon colored cut-outs arranged anarchically across the wall. I ordered a Cubano, which is my favorite sandwich in the world, and an Iron Beer soda. The woman whom took our orders gave us our ticket leaving us to discern the ambiguous seating and payment arrangements. My sandwich was improperly pressed, too crisp, parsimoniously dressed with meat, cheese, and a couple pickles--not what I expected. The room temperature Iron Beer soda was the perfect accompaniment to the sandwich I ordered. Normally, I enjoy a Cafe con Leche, but I dared not order one from "Back to Cuba." I would not recommend this establishment to anyone, nor would I ever return. My visit was on a Saturday evening at 5:30.

Hit up the new TREV'S Steaks in Feasterville on Bustleton Pike. I grabbed the "small" which was far from it. I added extra onions, American cheese and chopped fine with a side of cheese whiz. I didn't want to over do it since I also got a amazing footlong next door at Cheesedawgs.

The steak was pure perfection. Perfectly seasoned and well grilled. Beautifully held together in a just chewy enough pillowy roll.
They offer a bigger steak, next time for sure I'm going to tackle it. The meat was seasoned well and I really thought the way it was grilled set it apart from many other top steaks on the group.

I liked I just walked in and no need (for now) to call ahead it was ready lickity split. Kudos for that. Great place, friendly and stupendous food. On my top go to list for sure now. Bravo guys. Take a bow.....

I made an order through yelp and it was fulfilled by grubhub. I liked what I thought detailed description in menu and made my choices. The only thing it did not exactly match the actual delivered food. Ispinakli borek were not served feta cheese. Very salty chicken gyro from sandwich section was served over rice. Tomatoes from karisik kabob was a quarter of single tomato. And so on...
In summary the food was not perfect but OK (I am a big fan of middle eastern cuisine). And inaccurate description worsened the overall experience.

If you have ever eaten anything traditionally Cuban you would know just by walking in that this place is 100% Mexican cuisine with a Cuban name next to it. Never have I been so utterly disappointed by a meal. I asked for a Pan con bistec. Which traditionally used marinated flank steak and put on warm fresh Cuban bread with ketchup,mayo, lettuce,tomatoes,piknik potato sticks and a nice and tender marinated flank steak. What I was greeted with was a total abomination that is a slap in the face to not only a pan con bistec but to the Cuban people as a whole. What I got was a piece of flavorless shoe leather on TORTA BREAD!!!!!! Not Cuban bread. The veggies were soggy and definitely not fresh at all. I feel bad for anyone who has never tried Authentic Cuban food and think this bio hazardous waste dumpster fire of a place is what you have to go by because this is simply not it. NOT EVEN CLOSE!!! Come to Miami with that and try to pass it off as "authentic" will get you hung in the middle of the street. This place is an abomination to Cuban food and is downright disrespectful and should just board up and change to what they're really good at, cooking Mexican food.

Excellent work. Andy and Ivan came out on short notice and repaired a wall damaged by our large dog. They completely removed a large section of our wall, beefed up the original wall studs and installed new drywall. The finished product fantastic. Andy and Ivan are professional, fair and very detail oriented. Painting or drywall - these are your guys.

I've been here quite a few times and the food is always GREAT!

It's a small, family owned pizza place and the owners are always so friendly.  They are always creating new dishes  (I once had a pizza on a tortilla and it was amazing) and the prices are always so low!

Fast and friendly service and great food!

Customer service is terrible. No acknowledgement when we walked in. Wasn't sure what to do. I finally walked up to the counter to order. I tried to order sandwiches and was told they had none. 2 ladies sitting next to us were each eating sandwiches. Needless to say we walked out. Don't waste your time.
I was looking for a good Turkish Restaurant - Enigma just opened!! I purchased two chicken gyros- Baba Ganoush- fresh baked pide- And Baklava! everything tastes delicious! I highly recommend!

We saw the review in East Nashville mag and tried this fantastic place out last weekend - it was amazingly great! I have a thing for chicken waffles and I must say this chicken was simply the best I have ever had matched with a  great waffle, but then there was this syrup that has a secret added to it and that completes the absolute best chicken and waffles I have ever had. My wife tasted it as well and she wanted to order it - but she got the very special "De Bomb" (vegie) which is a perfect biscuit stuffed inside with cheese, spinach, egg, etc. then drizzled with honey-butter - ok you just can not image how that melts in your mouth - just simply one of the best new places we have found in Nashville - Hands Down! I would highly recommend.

Delicious food !!! Wow best I have ever had in Tucson !!
Meat was beautifully cooked and sauce was exquisite, this is a must try for everyone !!! Thank you for an amazing lunch and I will be following you around for the tastiest food ever !

My husband and I saw an article in the Nashville Business Journal about this place and decided to run by and pick up something sweet.   Quick, Warm & Friendly Service.  I kidded around with the server about giving us a big piece of cake & he laughed and gave us a HUGE piece - he was very generous.  There was live music in the restaurant side which sounded great (soulful jazz sound).  We will definitely come back and have dinner & live music.  Don't pass up the strawberry cake! 

Great Strawberry Cake, Excellent Cookies, Very Friendly, Great Music

Says they close at 9pm i  TRIED  to came in at 8:26pm and the  door was locked! I then called the store she picked up the phone very rude like and was like "subway" that's all. And I asked if they were open and she just ignored me and hung up!

The food is great, the service is HORRIBLE. After running my card for an $8 sandwich I asked for a drink & the rude counter girl wouldn't give it to me unless I paid cash, stating that their policy is a minimum of $10. Cool, except that a- you just charged me for $8 & b- I JUST ORDERED A SANDWICH TWO SECONDS AGO so a drink would put me above 10. Worst service ever. Also, the workers really should stop assuming who does and doesn't speak Spanish. Te entiendo muy bien odiosa. Con servicio así no entiendo cómo quedan abierto. Da pena.
Delicious! Well seasoned, rice a little crunchy but still worth it. The owner is a sweetheart, customer service great no complaints will definitely come back.

I love this place, and their Cubans never fail to disappoint. I haven't found sandwiches like this anywhere. I've also had the media noche sandwich which is quite good! We haven't had the sides and desserts yet but they look delicious. We like to pick up sandwiches to go. If you're in more of a hurry, you could call ahead.

Ordered an Italian hoagie with oil.  Got an Italian hoagie with mayonnaise.  How disgusting is that???  And how hard is it to follow that directive??  Italian hoagie with oil....  If I wanted mayo I would have asked for it.
My go to for breakfast. I love going there on Saturday mornings for breakfast and jazz. Great people and food. A true neighborhood gem!

Great location...easy parking....friendly people....and most important a great cupcake.....not sure what else to tell you....if you want a good one its in your backyard without having to drive to the city.

One of the (VERY) few things I miss about Miami is the abundance of Caribbean fare. When the skies are overcast and things are hum-drum, there's nothing quite like some variance of calypso music and permutation of rum, beans and pork to liven the mood. Living in Miami Beach and in Downtown, I took quality, cheap and tasty Cuban food for granted. Moving to Nashville, I had come to accept that my media noche days were at an end.

Or, were they?

Who would have thought that in this part of the metro (Crieve Hall, right?) one would find a real deal slice of My-am-mee? Readying myself for a dose of Miami 'tude, I was pleasantly surprised to find none whatsoever. Refreshing. I came for lunch on a busy Wednesday but as long as you know what you wanted, the process was efficient and fairly quick. After all, your food needs to be prepared. This isn't a grab-n-go or a sit-under-a-heat-lamp sort of place. You'll appreciate the freshness. After studying the menu, I ordered (in Spanish) the pan con lechon with a side of moros y cristianos. The lady behind the counter told me to cop a squat and wait for the goodness, so I did so. It was hard because the air was filled with delectable aromas. I have mentioned that I am trying to get away from eating pork but that becomes a real hardship when eating this sort of food. That is, a delicious hardship. Oy. This non-pork thing...

In no time at all, my food was ready. I paid, grabbed my sack of grub and hit the road. Once I got home, I tore into that bad boy. Oh man. I'd really missed this: pressed, crispy bread, wonderfully seasoned, tender pork, onions, MOJO!!! Oh man. Every bite was pure bliss. Man, Miami. Why are you such a messed up place to live? I need to eat your food on a regular basis. Not wanting my moros y cristianos to get cold, I broke out the hot sauce and started in on them. For those who might not know, moros y cristianos is black beans (moros) and rice (cristianos) made with garlic, onion, pepper, some sort of pork product, and herbs. It's a fairly ubiquitous side that can go wrong very easily (rice & beans ain't easy, y'all). I'm pleased to report that Back to Cuba's myc is well-made and I'd, gladly, order it again. 

Despite Nashville's growth, it might be a while before there's an abundance of Latin Caribbean eats in town. Fortunately, until there's more, Back to Cuba offers up a real deal menu to keep us all full & happy. Next time, I'm eating in.

Honestly, the REAL deal! I moved to Nashville from Miami beach and it is better than most places in Miami. The best Cuban food in Nashville by far! Alejandro has been nothing but amazing to me and my family. I do not understand the negative reviews - those people obviously do not know what real Cuban food tastes like.

Had the Cuban sandwich with ham roasted pork cheese pickle mustard.  It was a large sandwich for 8 dollars but very average tasting.  Very average not very flavorful not enough pickle  and mustard.  Bread was good crispy nice crunch but I felt I was eating a supermarket sandwich I could have anywhere except only for the bread.  

I wouldn't run here only if I was nearby and wanted something but I will keep looking for something better.   Speaking of Tasty Good Eats at the franklin farmers on Saturday she made a Jibarito Cuban which was much more flavorful.  Definitely check it out if you are looking for a more authentic Cuban sandwich.

Loved this place!! Family run and super friendly staff, we even got to meet the owners while we were there. A group of six of us stopped in for brunch and we were served in a timely manner. The veggie bombs were divine to say the least! The Hennessy syrup with the chicken and waffles was killer too!
Amazing sandwiches. Try the pork. And empanadas. And everything here. Very reasonably priced for a lot of delicious food.

This place is a hidden gem. The food is homemade and delicious! We had a party of 9 and the food was plenty and came out quickly enough for us. It's also BYOB which is great. The employees are super nice and the chef even came to the table to see how everything was. I highly recommend this gem of a place.

Gloomy days call for comfort food, and what better than Chicken & Waffles from Shugga Hi   

Located on the Dickerson Side of East Nashville, Shugga Hi is only open 3 Days a week, but the wait is WORTH IT! The vibes of the staff, the atmosphere of the cafe, all add the wonderful experience that is topped off with incredible food!
Excellent work, hired to build a closet and paint the entire inside of my home as well as garage. Very clean, friendly and completed the job on time as promised. HIGHLY RECOMMEND ANDY AND TEAM.

If you really wanted to be interesting, you'd offer more than talk hosts just shy of Alex Jones or Breitbart. Mark Levin? Michael Savage? I stopped listening long ago. Listening to one side over and over is not intellectually stimulating- it's propaganda.
Burnt fries cheesesteak wasn't bad but not that good. I wouldn't go out of my way to come here

Overcharged me $2 without given me this information over the phone for different sauce, which was on the board for special of the week. I asked once I saw the total about the price difference and was told that it was for the sauce. Fish taste like it had freezer burn. Usually a nice place to visit, but I was very disappointed l.

If I could give this place zero stars I would.  The service here is the worst I have ever seen.   The girl behind the counter rolled her eyes at me when I automatically didn't know what I wanted after she tells me that they didn't have any way of making a Cuban.   After hearing how supposedly great their Cuban sandwiches are that's all I wanted really and I hadn't had time to try and select something else. I mean who runs out of ingredients for their most popular sandwich?!?!  (Which by the way I hear this happens ALL the time)  She then proceeded to give me an attitude when I told her I didn't want to order anything but my friend did.  And the reason I didn't order anything was because I'm not going to give a business like this my money.  It was like I was inconveniencing her that my friend was ordering but not me.   The other girl didn't know what anything tasted like after my friend asked how something was before he decided he wanted to order it.   After he asked her about like five different food choices and her saying "I have no idea how that tastes".  I mean really?!   You work there but yet you don't know what your food tastes like??   So if you want to take a chance and try to order from a place where you can't get what you want because they are out of everything then more power to ya.  But watch out for the girl behind the counter.
What an incredible little place the food is so flavorful and just down right delicious. The staff are incredibly kind and don't get upset that you will probably butcher the pronunciation of words .

Awesome! Simply put. We went for Sunday brunch. I called to ask for the wait for a party of five and when we got to the cafe the woman remembered me and said she'd held a table for us!! Talk about true wonderful southern hospitality. Also all the staff were super nicer and super attentive.The mimosas are awesome being bottomless. The breakfast is all solid, but the lunch food, oh my goodness!! The collards are out of this world. Donut casserole was inspired and so was the chocolate cake, don't leave without trying to the chocolate cake! Seriously! The grits bar was also great! The price is higher than on the website but I felt I def got my monies worth. Also they had an awesome performer. Do yourself a favor and go

Demont offers a baby splash class for 2-6mo old babies and we just graduated to lil froggy. I think the instructor and facilities are excellent. They take it slow with the little ones to get them happy in the water. The pools are indoors which means classes always carry on as

We are visiting from Florida and happened upon this place after touring the Traveller's Rest. Such a surprise! I had the friend whole red snapper with yellow rice and tostones! It was great! My husband loved his bistro pallomila and of course, his favorite- plantains! We finished it off with flan and cafe con levee.  Real authentic Cuban food! Highly recommended.

I just heard that the strip where this restaurant is will be taken over and businesses will have to find a place to move to in 2-3 weeks! I pray that the owner will find a better location even better than this one! She will keep and get new customers because of the amazing food she deserves!
one of my favorite finds since moving to nashville a year and a half ago! the staff was very friendly, the food was A+. the Lechon Asado is a must. a true hidden gem.
Stopped by last night by chance.. glad we did! The pork tacos were amazing! The Mac and cheese was also awesome! Will defiantly try them again when they are back in OV!

We have been going to schwartz eye care now the eye doctor for years . The level of care is extraordinary. The customer service is excellent and pleasant. The eye wear purchasing  department staff is very knowledge and pleasant with very detailed consideration of your needs. They do not let you leave until you are completely satisfied.We would recommend this office to anyone needing great eye care.

Great service. 
Great mechanics. 
Honest people 
I would highly recommend Dash for all your needs.  That includes imports!

Just found out from an ex-waitress that they do not receive their tips!! Tips left in the tip jar and on the table are placed in the jar by the register and that money is out into the register at night..... not evenly distributed to the wait staff. Tips left on credit cards are not given to the wait staff. They only get to pocket their tips if they are given it cash directly. And they are not compensated hourly for this waiter; they're promised tip compensation when they are hired but never given it. Food is amazing. Go get the food. Tip the wait staff by hand in cash.

Probably the worst Cheese Steak, i ever tasted!!! With or Without, use to be good when they first opened 5 years ago!! Now, since they downgraded their Italian Rolls & Switched to Sirloin, from Rib-eye, they're horrible!! Like a Fast-food Cheese Steak Restaurant, that might appeal to outsiders! People visiting Philadelphia & searching for a Cheese Steak place to eat!! Locals know their food is Crap!! Such a Pity that, With or Without, at one time in my opinion, had a Cheese Steak comparable to one of the Best in Philly, Steve's Prince Of Steaks!! In fact, the next day i had to go to Steve's to get a real Cheese Steak, after that unpleasant experience @ With or Without!! Location on Red Lion Rd, next to Wendy's!! Also, HORRIBLE SERVICE WITH A RUDE COOK!!!!!!!! French fries were good,but that's it!!!!

We recently had the opportunity to try the Fork and Fire food truck in our neighborhood. We ended up ordering the mac and cheese with pulled pork and the slawdog millionaire hot dog. The hot dog was pretty messy, but the flavors were excellent (the dog also has some of the pulled pork as a topping). The mac and cheese was very creamy and had a great smoked flavor. The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because the pricing seemed a little high for the portion sizes provided, but overall, I was really impressed with the quality of the food. I would definitely be willing to give this truck another try!

Very disappointing bbq. The loaded fries are just covered in bbq sauce that tastes like ketchup and a few bites of pulled pork. The fries were also pretty soggy and not worth eating. Tri tip sandwich sounded promising but was just two small pieces of tri tip on a hot dog bun.

I haven't been back to Back to Cuba in years, but this shouldn't discount the validity of my review.  The food is honestly good...or it was.  But I experienced some truly terrible/rude customer service (from someone I assumed was the manager or owner) there a few years ago, and I've NEVER gone back.  The man had a scowl on his face from the moment we walked in until the moment we left, and he was a total d*ck to me as I was paying for my order.  You're seriously going to give attitude WHILE you're taking customers' money?

I crave Cuban food occasionally and wish there were more options for it in Nashville, but it isn't worth it to me to give these people any more of my money.

It's his right to be a "Soup Nazi"-type restauranteur, as it's my right to avoid this place like the plague.

This is a beautiful restaurant really close to downtown Nashville. 
I have been here 3 times, twice for the Sunday Brunch and once to pick up some sweets.

The brunch is fantastic. There is a variety of food that is seasoned so well and replenished often. My favorites are the chicken and waffles, gravy biscuits, salmon, greens, and kale salad. As you can tell this brunch is on another level!! 
Oh and I must mention the live band that you get to enjoy while eating. 
Oh and the mimosas that you can purchase to accompany your meal.
Oh and the dessert table that's included with your brunch.
Oh and the very nice staff and owner (she came by several tables to chat with her customers) +

They are going to have to expand really soon, which is a great thing (IMO). It's tight seating, but I don't mind. You may have to wait a bit to enjoy the goodness.

The service was terrible.  The beer was warm. The chicken wings were over cooked. The chicken on my salad was dry and old.  The Ahi on my husband's salad was terrible.  The music was extremely loud. I am never going to this resturant again.
Thank you, to lightning mobile service. You guys came out fast, got the job done quickly and was sucker friendly :-) ! So fairly priced that we will be using them for mom now on !!

Dr. Schwartz retired over a year ago, and the "MY Eye Doctor" does not or will never be the same.
 I gave them a try and must say they fail to live up to the quality of care and I now must find another Eye Care facility that can match the level of care and experience of Dr. Swartz, he will be missed.
The food was delicious and the prices were good. If you like middle eastern cuisine, definitely check this place out.
Awesome place love the atmosphere everyone was very helpful and nice...great place dor family and friends...very friendly...food was awesome

This is a little hole in the wall authentic Cuban restaurant. It is connected to a gas station and you wouldn't find it unless you were looking for it. The seating is very limited, and take out is usually best. I have been here on several occasions and everything I've had is delicious. The plantains are one of my personal favorites. The cuban sandwich is amazing of course. Very cost effective as well.

OMG!! AMAZING FOOD!! My husband and daughter were at Brandi Fenton park today. He was waiting for her while she was in Kung fu class. Came to you guys for 3 pulled pork tacos...came BACK for another 6 to take home, and 18 garlic parm wings. SO SO SO DELICIOUS!! We will definitely be looking out for you guys!! #GOEATHERE!! #5STARS
Cubanos. Literally any sandwich. Empanadas. I've never been to Cuba but I can speak to the quality of this place.  Have recently moved away but wish to go back for a meal.

This is our second time and it was even better! I just got done finishing my yummy leftovers for lunch, and I can't wait to go back. Food came out in a more reasonable time, but it's not quick since it's probably made to order. Also pretty reasonable prices and great staff.

What can I say? I've had Fork & Fire several times now (both their food truck and catering) and it's absolutely delicious. I've had the pulled pork sandwich, the slaw, the chili, and the pulled chicken and loved it all. Although their pork and chicken is to die for, their chili is what I end up always wanting more of. It is BOMB. A little spicy, perfectly seasoned & they have tons of options for how you can eat it. I love that they serve noodles with lots of their meals- it's a fun twist that I questioned at first until I tried it all together! As for this new pandemic world, ordering online was easy. You pick a time to get your food and it was ready when I pulled up. Seamless and contact free for the most part. The truck is usually parked off Orange Grove, I believe, but when I drove past it on La Canada I knew I had to change my dinner plans to include BBQ. Please support these guys.

Bottom line: Bomb a$$ BBQ

No visit to Art in the Park would be complete without an order of Fries w/ Fry Sauce from The BBQ Guy. Mitch and Luke use high quality french fries and their homemade fry sauce is delicious. Their barbecue looks amazing too, but I have yet to try it. If things are a little slow and you have a chance to visit with him, I encourage you to chat up Mitch. He is somewhat reminiscent of Rodney Dangerfield, albeit at a much funnier version. 

Highly Recommended!!!
Very small portions my hands are pretty small. Went because of the pic. Doritos weren't soggy, yay..

It's Subway.  Not many surprises.  It's 3 stars because I'd say my expedient was average/normal.  The one interesting thing about *this* Subway is they have a drive-thru!  You place your order via a touch screen.  There was a credit card slot, but the machine directed me to pay at the window.
My sandwich was made quickly considering I saw only two employees and a few customers inside.  The sandwich was delivered as ordered. They were kinda skimpy on the veggies though.

No frills, just fantastic food. I've had several of the sandwiches, and they're all packed full of flavor and hearty. The pork and chicken dishes are always delicious and flavorful (make sure and check for a daily special). The empanadas are made fresh and are the best in town. After saying all that, what you really want is the Skirt Steak with Chimichurri....one of the best meals in Nashville. All and all, you can't go wrong here.
With that being said, the service is a little "what are you doing in here, take a number" type vibe, which may play in Miami but it feels odd in Nashville. The food is so good it doesn't really matter.
Food was amazing! Service was too notch, owner came by tables to say hi! Atmosphere was very nice and inviting! Will definitely be back!

Honestly the tacos are my favorite forrrr Sure! Food is amazing. I for one dont usually go anywhere that is/has bbq foods, mainly because it's always a disappointing experience. However with Fork & Fire I found something different!! As I think about it,  I don't think I would even call this a  "BBQ Truck!! I mean we are talking about some of the best midwestern chili I have ever had, this means chili dogs, chili cheese tots, or just a fully loaded bowl on these "chili"Tucson afternoons. This truck has a mix of everything, pulled pork, smoked sausage, and all kinds of chicken dishes including a very unique yet very delicious version of he boring old chicken salad sandwich. Here's the kicker...it's all homemade recipes (yea that's right!!) As good as the food is, so can not express enough how great the guys are who own and run this truck. Great family, great people, great food, everything else is just extra!! We love Fork & Fire!!!

I used them a couple of times for painting, their work was good, if a little expensive. Recently booked them for a time sensitive job turning around a rental unit. A week and a half before the start date for the project they responded to my check in that they were no longer available. That they had a booked a different job during the time I had reserved with them. Were they even going to tell me? Completely unacceptable. What is the point of booking a time if they can't even stick to it? Not recommended.
Nice music, lovely biscuits, breakfast bowl tasted good. Service a bit slow and not as attentive as I would like. No baked goods available on Sunday.

12/26/19 

**The workers I encountered here were ALL professional** I really was pleasantly surprised at the highest level of service.  I really enjoyed the lady at the candy counter, the cashiers (all three) were friendly and kind. I love how they will also assist customers in the dressing room if needed! They will get you different sizes and even help with a zipper! This is something to be said for service! You can't get that interpersonal touch from no human contact online. I would love to commend ALL the Boscovs staff at Coventry!

WOW JUST WOW! In all the decrepit,  decaying stores in Coventry Mall lies Boscovs. I've typically just rushed through to go to Coventry Corners (soon sadly closing) Bath and Body, etc. I always figured their clothing and wares would be overpriced. Im not a "designer" label person I just like to look nice! As in , I can get better from Gabe's. Gabe's quality can be hit and miss. I digress! Wrong wrong! I saw a brand that HSN carries that is really hip, "One world", another brand that I was drawn to was "Ruby Rd" that has a cool ethnic cultural feel that I'm really really into lately.

I scored some velvety soft leggings in Juniors that look like watercolors, or maybe the background of Munch's The Scream. I found some others at 3.99, an irresistible Halloween pair for 1.99, and a great pair for St Patrick's with lucky shamrocks aplenty! I did get a super cool cardigan too in ladies department in colors I typically don't wear with oranges, blacks, browns and olives. The price was right!

I was elated to see Enstrom's toffee at their very old fashioned candy counter. Something from yesteryear past. Enstrom's  are sold on qvc at a much higher price. If you love real butter toffee  you MUST taste Enstrom's.  2.99 for a box is unheard of!

I think I'm tired of online shopping. I want to touch and try on. Shipping clothes back can be costly. It's a let down too.

I think today I'll try Plymouth Meeting Boscovs!

So this place is sick. And I mean like the bomb .com. Its amazing. I went once just to see what was there since I live so close, and I think I've gone back like...six times in the last three weeks? I just keep finding random awesome crap. Like a vintage floor lamp for $12 bucks, random architectural salvage turned art (tin celings? seriously? yes. yes. yes.), oil paintings, brand new beautiful rugs for suuuuper cheap, antiques, a giant letter L for my last name, really nice furniture for cheap (and I'm not just saying that), and a bunch of stuff to turn into other stuff, cuz I like to do that.

Its sort of dirty inside and the outside looks a little rough but if you're expecting something different out of a flea market, you should go home. I'd actually say its better than a lot I've seen. The people inside weren't even shady either. I feel like that's compulsory at a flea market, but not here! This place is my favorite!!!

I had placed this place with a 5 star previously but now I'm giving it 0 if possible I have never disrespected them with anything I have been a great customer for over 3 years now and they told me I couldn't order from their no MORE because I decided to cancel my order I would order here about 3 + a week because their pizza was one of a kind so now I'm pissed they did this about 2 weeks ago luckily their is so many pizza shops in philly that I can order from LOL SO ST THE END ITS HER LOST NOT MINE.... (fyi I still got my food that day and I paid for it)
It seems like it would be good. Both times so far I ordered ahead of time for 4pm. Got there at 3:40 expected to wait a little bit. Nope food was ready and already not hot. Not even warm.

Nashville was a stop on our road trip from Michigan to Texas. Once we got in town, we fired up the Yelp app and looked for a place nearby to eat. Ever since the movie Chef came out, we have always enjoyed a good Cuban sandwich. We saw this place, the positive reviews, and then we were on our way.

I am pretty sure the guy that waited on us was the owner. When we first came in, he had a little bit of a tough exterior. However, he melted in the presence of my 22 month old daughter. We ordered some empanadas and 2 Cuban sandwiches. My daughter has a dairy allergy, so we asked if he could make half of one of the Cubans without cheese. He said he doesn't normally do that, but he would do it for my daughter. 

While we were waiting, he brought out some pastries that he said were on the house. He then brought out the empanadas, followed by the Cubans. Instead of giving us 1 and a half Cubans with cheese and half of one without, he ended up giving us 2 Cubans with cheese and a 3rd Cuban without cheese.

All of the food was really good, but the treatment from the owner of our family really meant a lot to me. He treated us like we were family and gave special attention to the most important one in our party. I thanked him for his kindness towards my family and promised to return if we ever make it back to Nashville.

Overall, this place had great food, but even better service. I wish only success and happiness to this establishment and all that are associated. Thank you for a great experience.

It's a Subway so this review will be pretty short. 

Based on how nice and new this place is plus it's really clean and the fact that the sub was good it would normally get five stars. (Of course I'm only comparing it to other Subways) but I dinged them one star because they had one lone worker who was clearly overwhelmed. It was bad enough that there were four people in line but then she also had to wait on the drive up lane also. Seriously it's too much for one person but she tried hard.

We were super excited to eat Fork & Fire's food. We waited and waited and waited. The advertising said that they would be at Button Brew House at 5pm. Yeah, they were there at 5pm, but they weren't ready to serve food till about 45 minutes later. That was a drag. They need to show up at 4:30 and be ready by 5 if they're going to say they were going to be there by 5. You expect that food would be ready to go by then.

The food... not good. We ordered the Loaded Tater Tots. Very small portions for $8. They weren't even Tater Tots. They were home fries (square cut potatoes) and the pulled pork that was on top didn't even taste like BBQ. They were pretty bland and didn't even stand out compared to the other flavors on the potatoes.

Granted, at a brewery, they filled a spot that was a half hour late, but we really wanted to try them and love them. I know they're new to the food truck scene, but you can't advertise Tater Tots and not even give you Tater Tots. And if you're going to call yourselves a BBQ joint, you'd better taste like BBQ and not just throw some beige pulled pork on stuff.

I will say that since you're brand new, we'd love to try you again. Please be ready by the time you advertise to be there. Show up early. People are waiting to give you a try. 

Good luck and keep going! There's potential.

Hateful and divisive - I honestly do not understand why anyone would listen to people who spin every topic into why one has to "own the libs." It more hype to divide the country. This is the angry man station

Tried this hole in the wall Cuban place. Its next to a gas station and doesn't look like much from the outside. I had the Cuban sandwich and plantains. The plantains were amazing. The Cuban was really good, But pretty standard. Everything was super affordable for what you get. Look forward to going back.

I keep trying to eat at this restaurant but every time I pull in the parking lot it is closed for some reason or another. Today it was that they close for dinner (for the staff) so they close in the middle of the afternoon. I needed to pick up food for a party and I would have planned around a closure if it was posted anywhere other than their door. The food is fine but customer service is severely lacking.

Like everyone else's reviews, their staff are wonderful people. So helpful and always on point. The downfall is their store is outdated and their items are overpriced.  I can understand that it is beyond their control, but I would not shop here unless I have to.  I had a gift card and instead of making the trip to the store I ordered items online. There was a fee for shipping, no matter how much you spent, and they sent me the wrong items. I was forced to go back to the store to make the return or pay for shipping, even though it was their error. I was ttold the item they had online was never in stock and should not have been advertised. It really put me off from the store and have 0 plans on shopping there again.

Enjoyed the food. The service was pretty bad. There was only one server but the restaurant was not crowded. Took forever to get water and even longer for a glass of champagne. Orders did not come out correct. The owner was super nice about it & the displayed desserts looked great. 

The Dickerson Sunrise ($6.95) was pretty good. Grits were a tad watery. Eggs cooked nice & fluffy. Standard sausage & typical toast. Would've ordered more champagne but I didn't want to wait another 30.

Fork & fire came to our RV park for an event. The pulled pork was DELICIOUS as were the square tots. The smoked mac and cheese was tasty and cheesy and not to heavy handed with the smoke ( which I appreciated!) Seemed like everyone had a great time at the event and everyone raved about the food. Thanks Fork & Fire for making it a fun and tasty Saturday afternoon for our campers.
Good food good employees only problem is finding out where they're located at, since they move around often

I got a to go order with a co-worker. I had the Cubano, fries and a guava pastry. The Sandwich is immense and delicious. Crispy, meaty, goodness. The fries were soggy by the time we got back to the office, but I imagine they would have been good if we had eaten there. They were unnecessary though as the sandwich was as big as my head. The guava pastry was very good as well. a little messy, but only because it was so flaky. The lady who waited on us was polite but seemed a bit nervous. We will definitely go back.

I cannot think of the right words to describe how much I loved this place. The veggie bomb was phenomenal. The biscuit was perfect and the honey butter on top was amazing too. Great love music, wonderful service, family owned. We went on a Sunday for brunch as a party of four and we all were raving!

Outstanding food and service on weekends. Live music on some Saturday's or Sunday's . The chicken or fish and waffles are delicious. They serve vanilla and lemon waffles and they're the best I've had. It's a great spot that I go to whenever in Nashville

Pros:  easy ordering, fast delivery, food was hot, cheez wiz fries were good

Cons:  ordered two cheesesteaks, one with onions, both had onions; meat was very chewy, would probably benefit from being chopped instead of sliced

Just wasn't very enjoyable food overall, disappointed, should've read the newer reviews before ordering.

Back to Cuba has been on my list of places to try for quite a while.  I finally got the chance to go last weekend.  As others have written, the restaurant is very small and is in a stripmall and gas station.  Don't let that dissuade you from trying this place.

We had a group of six people.  I would not advise this, since most of the tables are two-tops and you have to be very lucky to arrive at a time when you can push three tables together.  No reservations.  No hostess.  It is counter service for ordering.

The menu is quite simple - sandwiches and entrees.  They had two specials the night we went and I tried the Ropa Vieja special.  They do not serve alcohol, but you probably can bring your own.  We waited 10-15 minutes for our food to be brought out.  Not long to wait except I was starving!

The food was very flavorful.  A bit on the salty side.  My entree came with fried plantains that were absolutely the best.  Slightly sweet and perfectly cooked.  There was a huge scoop of rice and a pretty good size bowl of black beans.  The Ropa Vieja was served in a little dish on the side to keep it from running all over the plate.

We ordered empanadas to share.  They were huge!  Lots of filling in the middle but a lot of empty crust around the edges.  I wish it had been spread out a little more but what was filled was delicious.

We were there at 6:30 and around 7pm, the owner put a sign on the door.  It turns out, they were closing the restaurant early because they ran out of food!

I can't wait to go back and try out more items on the menu.  Definitely a can't-miss-place to visit in Nashville.
Called a few times, left 2 messages asking to be called back. Owner called 2 weeks later apologizing. However, we hired another painter already.
Fish was so good! Grits were a bit bland but atmosphere was so good! Live music is a bonus as well! Family owned establishment!
Delicious street tacos and slaw! The flavors of the bbq meat pop and make you take notice - no "ho-hum" here - We'll be back to sample even more of the menu!

I originally made an appointment with a doctor as follow up to cataract surgery. I was called the next day to reschedule because the doctor was on vacation the week of my appointment. When I arrived, it wasn't busy and reception was apathetic at best. I was there one hour (50 minutes after my scheduled time) to finally see the doctor. Absolutely unacceptable.

I was screamed and cussed at by an employee for no reason. When this business were parked directly behind me in my apartment complex, I took a lot of time carefully backing out of my spot and getting out of my car to check to see how much room I had left so I wouldn't hit their truck or trailer. One of the employees suddenly got out of the truck getting close to me SCREAMING not to hit his truck and calling me a stupid bitch among other things. Super professional.

Lunch buffet HURRAY!!!!!

The lentil Daal was awesome and had flavor complexities beyond a typical daal. The spinach dish and the chickpea dish were great too. Loved that the Chicken Biryani had white chicken and was much more flavorful than other biryani's I have had. BF loved the Butter Chicken and Tandoori Chicken. Fresh hot Naan was delivered to the table. 

Super friendly staff, comfortable restaurant, amusing music videos playing on the large screen TV.

Will be back!

Love the station and love the hosts. I listen on the way to and from work; two hours a day. Why the one star?  Fix your darn transmitter or whatever it is causing the dead air and interruptions. Been a loyal listener for years but I'm not sure how much more I can take.
99.7 jockey Pamela Furr is worried about Al Franken's job.  really?  does this represent the whole station????  What about the pain he has caused women that he sexually assaulted????  Thats okay?

Fantastic service, super friendly staff, and phenomenal food!! I got the veggie "da bomb" and the biscuit was light and flaky, veggies cooked to perfection, and the honey butter was the perfect compliment!! Highly recommend!
One of the best Turkish Cuisine in The area. Everything I had was delicious. Lahmacun, Turkish pide, Manti, cold appetizers. I am super happy that we have been here.

The café con leche has made mee drive  across town on a Saturday morning. And I'm not a morning person. This place brings me back to my  grandfathers living room where he made homemade café con leche that was of equitable quality. Great service, great food, supporting a local small business. Every time I leave, I feel a little closer to my Hispanic roots. Get there early to get a pastelito before they run out! (At $1 they are a STEAL!)
The food is amazing here!  Everything was tasty and grilled to perfection.  Even the bread was  amazing.  The portions are large and the staff is friendly.  I highly recommend this place!

Shugga Hi Bakery and Cafe is one of my FAVORITE spots to eat in Nashville! Nashville can be very tourist focus and so can a lot of the restaurants so if you are looking for a more local feel this is the spot. They are so nice, the cakes are delicious, and the Lemon Pepper Chicken is amazing. I also would recommend the waffle burger or chicken and waffle with a coffee!

I was so disappointed coming to this place... I ordered the churrasco medium well with white rice and black beans and tostones. The churrasco was practically raw. It was so gross I absolutely lost my appetite.

I made an appointment the day before and they said I could come in immediately at opening. I needed an alignment after hitting a curb. Anthony at the front desk was very patient and obliging. And they went to inspect as soon as they got my keys.

They did not try to upsell me, they did not condescend or make comments about my cars condition they showed me all of the issues with my suspension system and were super amiable and professional. I left with a full alignment and two new tires for less than $450. If I had any other issues I'd return here, as I feel they are prompt and trustworthy.

Amazing food made by the sweetest people. Growing up in south Florida, I crave Cuban. This is the most authentic Cuban food in Nashville. So heartbroken they are closing soon! We will miss you terribly!!

Excellent! We had a really bad experience w swimming lessons in Seattle right before the pandemic hit. We came to Tucson to be w my mom and I found Demont in April thanks to a rec from our pediatrician. My son is 5 and was sooooo nervous for his lesson, feigning a tummy ache (which he never does). Everyone was kind and welcoming and encouraging at Demont. His instructor was magic. He came out of the lesson w a huge smile on his face and said he loved swimming now :) He's progressed three levels in a few months and can swim across the pool and float on his back already! and most importantly he absolutely loves going to swimming. I am so grateful to Demont

I'm sorry to give such a poor review to a small private restaurant, but this was truly terrible. They only good I can say, was waitress was nice and the white rice was fine & the bread was ok,although I HATE restaurants that use margarine instead of butter.
