I ordered the special, Picadillo. Only flavoring I could taste was salt and the green olives. Just terrible, bleh. Black beans tasted straight out of the can,with maybe a bit of bacon or something added. 
Even the plantains were bad! I make better plantains. They were not ripe enough to be fried yet. Plantains should be very sweet. Not these. 
I was planning on order Flan for dessert and tres-leche to go, but figured the chance of them being good were slim.
Dark, depressing atmospher also.

The food is phenomenal. Coming from Miami and living in northern states for a while now, I do not take finding good Cuban food for granted. Yes the place is simple and outdated but you will not care about that once the food comes. The beef empanada is authentic, moist, and big. The beef is perfectly seasoned as well. 
I had the churrasco for the entry. The meat was good but not the best I've ever had, a little dry. But the rice and beans is one of the best I've ever had (for a person that grew up on rice and beans that's is saying a lot) . The plantains are perfectly cooked and sweet (not the frozen crap you get in some "cuban" restaurants) . 
The mango juice is boxed, so I would skip that. 
Finally the cafe con leche (milk and coffee) is so so good and pipping hot. 
I cannot wait to return and try the rest of their menu including the cortado and cuban sandwich. :) 
Again, so not let the simplicity of the establishment turn you away from this gem.

Horrible ! I'm visiting family from New Orleans and wanted to try a new place since I'm in Tennessee a lot and usually eat at the same places . BIG MISTAKE ! Fish was thin although seasoned good i couldn't eat or enjoy it because the was just breading ! The waffle was burnt and literally had no bread to it. Just a burnt nasty waffle. Highly disappointed
The Philly cheesesteak was awesome. Full of flavor and not too greasy. The WoW sauce is a must. Delivery was quick and everything came hot! Definitely recommend this place.
No hay manera de explicar la excelencia que caracteriza este hermoso y bello lugar, sin duda mantiene la cultura y la tradición cubana.

The food here is AMAZING reminded me of my Nana's kitchen growing up  Amanda and Manny give life to this tiny little Cuban place. Don't be discouraged about location (behind the mapco gas station in a little strip) or the fact that it's counter service. They are super attentive and kind -so kind- and cleanly too! 5 stars, recommended and I'll definitely be back.

Periodically, when that bbq'd brisket, ribs, pork, beans, slaw etc kicks in, I try once again to see if the NW Tucson bbq wasteland still remains before accepting I must drive beyond...My eyes must have deceived me or YELP made a misprint...corner Oracle/Orange Grove....no....not possible!  My suspicion was so deep, I called!  Indeed, they are there!!!!  

I'm on my way back today.  Great group of fellas interested in making folks happy and serving up good bbq.  Most important it is good!!  It will satisfy!

Amazing Cuban restaurant in South Nashville. Their Cubano is amazing. The roasted pork tacos are also amazing. The empanadas are as good as you would expect. Pricing is good and the portions for the price are also very reasonable. I eat here now probably once a week at least. Definitely check it out!

Ring from Chicago and having plenty of Cuban choices I was happily surprised to run across Back to Cuba. The Palomilla was awesome and the Tostones were perfect. The black beans reminded me of my grandmas. If you like some nice authentic Cuban food hit them up. Small little spot with great food.
Sooooo good!! Great portions, just delicious! Great price as well! $7.50 for a huge a Cuban can't beat that

I've been trying to get to this place for weeks but I'm either too early or too late.  Well I had time today so I stopped by twice.  I got 8 cranberry oatmeal cookies and they are absolutely the best.  Perfect texture. I also got a slice of rum cake. Let me tell you about their rum cake. It is outstanding. Moist. Flavorful.  Delicious. I highly recommend this place to any and everyone. The employees were very warm and attentive. And the baked goods are delightful.  They just acquired a regular patron.

I was dying to like this place. We've ordered food there several times over the last 8 months. They amost always get it wrong, or make the food carelessly. They aren't very nice when the owner isnt there or on the phone. Tonight, we ordered for the 4 of us, my wife ordered a grilled chicken salad. They gave us breaded chicken, so I called and they said they would take it back. When I got there they were rude and said they don't sell the salad I ordered. I told them we ordered it online from their menu. They made no attempt to accomodate, by say, putting the grilled chicken they put on the cheese steaks on it. They just kind of shrugged. I asked for my money back. My cheese steak was also terrible, had very little meat on it and most of the cheese was on the outside of the roll. If you are gonna charge 10 dollars for a cheese steak it should be decent. Honestly, it's just a waste of time ordering from this place. The foods sucks, the service sucks, they don't seem to care at all and it's expensive. So, we're done. Never going back. Stay far away from this place.
This was an awesome place. The food was great and the service was amazing. The people were kind and showed great personal interest. We were very happy to  enjoy this local treasure.

This is hands down the best pizza spot in all philly perhaps.!!! It's price is convenient fast and very tasty food I love love love there pizza.!!!! Cheesesteak fries too and there buffalo wings are pretty big too

My boyfriend and I visited Back to Cuba the other day and got the Cubano, Lechon Asado and platanos.  Everything was delicious and the Cubano was huge!  My only critique would be that the Cubano did not have pickles on it, as a traditional Cubano does. The young lady helping us and the rest of the staff were nice and quick with service as they were a bit busy considering recent COVID adjustments.
Gracias, we will definitely be back!

Oh. My. God. The cake! Thank you Miss Sandra for making this incredible cake and making me the most popular person at the office, at least for today! I got the Neapolitan cake with strawberry, white, and chocolate cake layers. She put a magnificent strawberry buttercream on top. So so good. Made my day.

Good chicken and waffles at this spot.  It's pretty small so their was wait and the service wasn't quick, though the meal made it worth it!  It's black-owned as well, which in my book is always a PLUS!
The veggie bomb is so good y'all! That honey butter got me salivating at the thought. I love this black owned business.

I have been a patient of Dr. Schwartz for over 10 years as well as most my family. Sadly they sold out or merged with MY EYE DOCTOR. I called the office for an appointment, the rude girl asked me if I was a current  patient. I told her yes for 10 tears. I was told the best she could do was 7 to eight weeks away. I told her I was out of contacts and my script was over a year old and she said sorry. She told me that they need more doctors and are working on it. 
So I found another doctor and then came the struggle to get my records. It was like pulling a hunk of steak from a loins mouth. After three phone calls and getting angry I was told they would fax them over when they had a free min. 
I will never recommend a "My EyE Doctor"center or sadly Dr. Swartz as much as I like him, the place is not the same patient first office. There are many good eye doctors that still control their own practice.

When you check the ratings, look at the most recent as this place has changed drastically!!! Sorry Dr. Swartz, you were a gem before the change.

Fantastic food ! My first try here and I got the pork pulled Mac and cheese.my boyfriend got their slaw dog millionaire.  The max and cheese was creamy and the pork was very flavorful. 
The only thing I'd say is the price was a bit steep for the portions we got. But other than that I hope to order from this truck again !!

I don't know about the food but the 7 layer bar is phenomenal, the lemon cake is delish. I found the red velvet donut flavorless, but 2 out of 3 isn't bad. And all of that for less than $10. Yeah, I'll share. I am SO thrilled that this establishment is open and I only wish it was in Madison.

I have lived in the Greater Nashville area for years and heard of Back to Cuba Cafe but just never took the time to stop and eat. Oh the wasted years! They are known for their Cubano sandwich and now I know why...fantastic. I haven't had a Cubano that good since I left Puerto Rico. My wife let me try her Camerones Enchilados, it was amazing. True Cuban cuisine in middle Tennessee. A must try.

Don't go during the day on Roosevelt Blvd. screwed my order up once and it was only a couple hoagies. Gave them a second chance with the same order stressing what I wanted about 3 times and messed it up again. Unbelievable really. Threw both orders in the trash.

If you haven't been to Smallcakes Cupcakery, you need to go there ASAP! They offer some of the most delicious cupcakes and quite the unique variety. I had the chocolate with a cream filled center. My wife ordered the wedding cake cupcake and my daughter enjoyed chocolate cupcake with pink icing. 

Follow their Facebook page as they are always posting their flavors of the day.

I'll start this off like I have for other reviews I've written for Cuban         restaurants. I was born and raised in Miami, so I have a pretty high bar for expectations when it comes to Cuban food. With that said, this place is pretty good!

You get to start of your meal with Cuban bread(real Cuban bread!!!) toasted with garlic butter. Hard to go wrong with that . For a main meal I've had the Lechon Asado(roast pork) and Pechuga a la Plancha(grilled chicken) in all of its garlicky mojo goodness. Both have been tender, flavorful and delicious. 

All of the sides have also been very good. The beans with the black beans and rice are cooked perfectly. The yuca and sweet plantains are also worth ordering if they don't come with your meal, though it seems most of them come with some combination of these sides. I could probably eat a meal of the sides alone and be one very happy full person.

The place is very small, but I've never been there when there has been a big crowd. It may be a tiny bit pricey especially if you are there for lunch, but you do get a lot of food. Also, if you're craving this place on Sundays or Mondays they are closed.

If you have never had Cuban food you really need to go here and try it. It isn't 100% like home for me, but it is definitely good enough to satisfy my cravings and keep me coming back.

We have a 3 month old daughter and just learned of DeMont Swim's free splash class for babies. It was easy to get into the class and she can attend until she turns 6 months old. What a wonderful way for kids to learn about water safety and beginning to swim! The front desk staff was inviting and helpful when we arrived- we got a tour and everything was properly scheduled for us. The splash class is in a heated baby pool, where the cheerful instructor leads songs and helps the parents swim with their babies. So much fun!! Definitely get your kiddos enrolled here. It's so worth it!
Touch screen outside does NOT work and the employee refused to take my order. Shit service

The owners, staff and ambiance, warm and welcoming, will draw you back and make you want to try more of the menu or deliciousness in the glass case. The unlikely combo of a waffle burger is very likeable. Fantastic quality and seasoned beef is used for the burgers and the waffle batter is unique, in fact they have more than one kind. I'd much rather have a waffle than a bun. And that Hennessey syrup takes it all over the top. They serve up good fries, too. Not hand cut, my preference, but they have the timing right. 

Lemon cake is still my favorite, so moist. The key lime cupcakes we're trying to knock it from first place but nope!

I'm not sure what made me reminisce about our experience at Demont this morning, but I decided to see what others thought of them on Yelp.  While their staff is very friendly and good with the kids, I can't help but agree with Summer's review below.

We were with Demont for probably 4 years.  I credit them with helping our children feel comfortable in the water.  However, after a while, our son seemed to get 'stuck' in a particular level - in spite of having demonstrated all of the skills for that level.  For several consecutive months, we received feedback that he was missing a particular skill - even though he had received an 'awesome' ribbon for that same skill a long while back.

Even with that minor frustration, we would have been happy to continue at Demont if it weren't for the fact that we encountered some of the most rude, self-centered parents I have ever met.  Demont has a 'rule' posted on signs in all of the changing room areas saying not to reserve the changing rooms or leave your items in the changing rooms.  People simply ignored those rules.  The result was that all of the changing rooms were 'in use' while the kids of these parents took up all the showers and the other kids shivered cold waiting for a shower or a place to change clothes.

Several times I pointed this problem out to the staff at Demont.  They did nothing about it.  I suggested that they have a staff member monitor the changing rooms after lessons, but they would not.  I suggested that perhaps there needed to be consequences for families who purposely inconvenienced others and could not follow the rules, but they did not want to alienate their parents. (Better to upset the long-time customers who follow the rules...)

I really do not like confrontation, but after months and months of dealing with the increasingly rude behavior in the changing rooms, I decided to point out to a couple of the parents that they were not supposed to be doing that and they are leaving other kids to get cold while they wait.  I was told that they would do whatever they want.  So I asked what kind of example they were setting for their children if they ignore the rules.  They simply cursed at me.

After that, I had a similar experience to Summer's review below in that I was refunded the rest of our lessons in a gesture that implied, "Please don't come back."  It is sad, because I think they are a promising swim school - and with a little more attention to detail they would be a great place to have your children learn to swim.

This is undeniably the best subway that probably exists. Aside from it being super clean the staff is amazing. The two ladies who were working on 11/13 /21 were super nice and conversational making our experience awesome, they really are what made the experience so great. We normally take subway to go but we were in such a great mood we dined in. This subway also has a drive through and soup!! Hands down the best fast food restaurant in the entire St.Louis/ St.Charles county area.

Probably the nicest/cleanest place I've ever ordered a sandwich at, and the steak was really good. Meat is NOT chopped, which to me almost always means that it is better than those who do chop it. Pretty fast service, the standard fixings bar, etc.

They are not too far from Steve's Prince of Steaks, so if you're in the area, try a taste test, I think Steve's is just a little better for the steak, but Wit's fries are pretty good when they are hot.

Also, Wit has a good meal deal with a steak and fries and a drink for like $7.50 or so during the week, can't be beat.

In town for TSU homecoming and our Airbnb was across the street from this restaurant.
Of course we found it on Yelp now on to the restaurant.
I absolutely thought it was cute.
It is woman owned and she gave us the history of the restaurant. We got there right when it opened so they were still kinda getting settled and such!!
Overall the food was good. I'd say they would need a few more staff members.
I really don't have anything negative to say!
I'd recommend and say that everyone should try this restaurant and I'm excited about sharing this!

They have a touch screen for the drive-thru, but the thing varies between barely working (having to poke repeatedly in various spots for it to register), to just not responding at all.

Subway: Either fix your touch screen, or replace it with a traditional intercom.

Everyone else: Just go inside until they do.  Though judging from some of the other reviews, you might want to think twice about that too.

Everything was amazing! I had the fish and waffles with a side of cheese grits... I wish i would've taken some catfish to goi keep thinking about how flavorful it was! My son had chicken and waffles.. he's very picky and there was no food in sight once he was done.. so i assume that was good! My sister had a side order of collard greens!!! Now those i did get to go!!! AMAZING! I also had a strawberry and a watermelon mimosa... the watermelon was my fave! And last but not least the glazed donuts! Holy smokes.... better than Krispy creme!!!!! Mrs Kathy the owner was very sweet! I will DEFINITELY be back!

The food is amazing! 
Not only is the food awesome, the friendliness of the staff made you feel at home like part of the family. 
Chu or chuck - was our waiter and he was the best! 

I had the " Da bomb breakfast " OMg!!!!  Yummy! 
Daughter had the waffle burger the waffle was very good .
Husband had the waffle and Spicy chicken. He loved it. 

Bringing everyone here!!!!!

Me and the wife heard great reviews on this place but the experience wasn't all that it was cut out to be.  Don't get me wrong, the food is great but the service was horrible!!  And the man whom I assume is the owner is just plain hateful.  We had 2 Cuban sandwiches and 2 Cuban coffees.  Sandwiches came before the drinks and they forgot our order of flan.  Haven't decided if we'll give them a shot again but we'll see.

Miracle workers!!! I called them on a Sunday morning at 7am when all other shops were closed. They were out to me in a few hours and hd me back on the road in under an hour. Honest, afordable and fast!

Really wish people had higher expectations of how a Swim School is suppose to be run. then, maybe, there wouldnt be high stars, for this school. 

My son has been in the school for two and a half months they told me thatt he gets monthly reviews.  I was told on the date of the review I would receive a email of the review, that night. Never received anything. Went and talked to the ladies up front and found nothing was ever check marked on his file. They had the deck manager come out and give me a review but they did it for the class he was in that day. She went over everything he needed to know but when I pointed out that he already knows his bubbles she said, that should have been checked.

 I brought the review home and found other things he already knew how to do, were not checked off on his review. I also found that one thing on there, he is supposed to learn, has never been taught in the class at all. I'm trying to figure out, how he can pass that level, without ever doing one of the things that he needs, to pass. I'm only staying as you need to be with them for a number of months, before you can leave, or be charged extra fees for, leaving early in the contract.

Update; came home from vacation and found a letter from the owner stating that they saw my yelp review. They were hoping to see me again to correct any areas lacking. I was refunded the 3 months my son was there. And they hope to see me in the future. If I would have received a call in regards to this, I would have let them know I was not leaving and would have spoken with someone once I got back. Thank you for the refund but it felt more like we got kicked out for our review.

Today is #thankfulthursday and I wanted to drop a line to thank you for your business in Nashville. Truly one of the best restaurants in the city and you're doing food your way. I love it and I'll continue to evangelize and support  y'all! My absolute favorite is the chicken and waffle with henny syrup. 
The omelettes are fire  as well.

Back to Cuba is a simple storefront in the parking lot of a gas station, serving some traditional Cuban fare. They do have some colorful Cuban decoration up all over, but it's pretty quiet inside. There are a few tables and you order at the counter. I got the bistec palomilla, which comes with a big bowl of black beans, white rice, and sweet plantains. Also tried the empanadas, one chicken and one beef, and shared a Yerba Mate soda. 

My steak was a 2/5 in terms of taste, but it was a good portion. It was really thin and limp, but cooked well. It sufficed, but I've had better, heartier Cuban steak. The black beans were badass, though. I could've had a meal of just that. Rice and sweet plantains were standard, liked both. 

The empanadas were really big, but about halfway filled with meat. Both were good, but I liked the beef one more. 

The soda was good! I've never had one quite like this. It didn't really taste like Mate, but it had a tea aftertaste that I thought was refreshing. At 42 grams of sugar a can, though, yikes. 

My boyfriend got a fish plate and that was a good one. I think it was better than mine. It was a thick filet covered with cheese. I recommend that one over mine. 

Service was fast. It's an incredibly low-key place, so I wouldn't say to go out of your way, but it's a good side stop for a quick, filling meal.

Wit or Witout is not one of the best cheesesteaks in Philly. The cheesesteaks are pretty good, however there are many many other better cheesesteaks around. I come here once in a while if I am close by and happen to be in the mood for a cheesesteak. The restaurant is very clean and well kept. The staff is professional and courteous. If they were situated anywhere but Philly they would have one of the best cheesesteaks but being in Philly, there is just too much competition. I will continue to patronize this establishment. They are good for killing a craving. I would definitely recommend giving them a shot if you have never been here. It is a unique experience that everyone should have. They have their own parking lot so it is easily accessible and very convenient.

This place is good for a quick stop to grab a bite. I ordered a chicken Philly cheesesteak with everything and fries. My husband and I split everything and I'm glad we did since the portion was pretty big. The cheesesteak had good flavor and the bread seemed fresh. Fries were nice and crispy. Overall, I thought it was decent compared to the other more touristy spots which a not so good.

Shocked to see this stop with less than 5 stars, because we had a great experience. While I wouldn't consider these traditional tots, these potatoes were perfectly crispy and every piece was covered with delicious toppings. And oh my goodness, these toppings are flavorful! I don't think I'd change a single thing on this plate- so good!

I am a regular here and have tried almost every flavor. They are all delicious and the cake is always so moist. They last multiple days. I have bought dozens for parties and everyone loves them! I also bought a cake from here and it was heavenly. I would recommend this bakery to anybody. The staff is great and friendly and can help you prep for any event. I can't wait for their ice cream!

We went on Sunday in the middle of the day and were glad to find they still have live jazz! They were busy but we quickly got seats at the bar. I appreciated how thoroughly they cleaned everything in between patrons. We got the chicken and waffles and the fish and waffles. Both were delicious. We were hungry and I ate before thinking to take pictures of the food but I have pictures of the current menu! 

Like many places these days, they seemed short staffed and everyone was working hard. Just be kind and patient and you'll get a wonderful meal! Thank you, Shugga Hi, for continuing to offer a friendly place to eat in our neighborhood.
Great food truck!  Rented it for a party and EVERYONE was impressed!  The owner is super friendly and very very accommodating!

Bummed the food truck meet-up had been cancelled, we were hungry and wanted something to eat that was close by. Daniel B.'s review echoed in my mind, so we stopped at Back to Cuba. 

Unfortunately, they were only accepting cash during our visit, which resulted in us needing to use the ATM at the Mapco next door. Although, I believe they typically accept credit/debit cards, since there is a sign that reads, "We do not take American Express".

Nestled in a strip mall at the corner of Trousdale and Harding, this place is pretty small with minimal seating. Even so, I was digging the vibe of the place as Latin music pumped through the speakers - of course, making me want to dance. Instead, as I waited for my order, I walked through the place looking at all the neat stuff on the walls.

I am not an expert when it comes to any type of food. Although with my background, Cuban food is one of those I feel I know at least a little about. (Perhaps that is why it has taken me so long to give this place a try?!)

That said, it's rare to find a vegetarian dish at a small place like this, and glancing over their menu board, it made me a little sad they're no exception. I was just hoping for a traditional ensalada de aguacate. No such luck.

Willing to be a carnivore for the meal, I searched for an arroz con pollo, or a black-eye pea dish, but they weren't offering either. Boooo!

I settled for a little less traditional meal by ordering a Cuban sandwich. It is MASSIVE. There is no way I could've eaten that whole sandwich by myself! The bread is phenomenal - the real deal. I hadn't had Cuban bread in so long, so it tasted really, really good.

I also ordered two chicken empanadas. Oh..my..goodness...beyond delicious! And at $1.85 each, you just can't get any better! We had ordered to go, and I was sad to discover there wasn't a side of chimichurri sauce in my bag - which I think would've sent this empanada to "the bomb dot com" level.

I'm anxious to revisit for another empanada and give their batido de mango a try.

I been wanting to go here for awhile. I have heard alot of good things about this place. So me and the girls went for Sunday Brunch, it was a buffet style. One side was breakfast and then the other side was lunch. The breakfast side didn't have that much but the lunch i really enjoyed it. They had fried fish, OKRA i love me some okra and just alot of othet stuff i was really pleased with. The vibe and the whole staff was so welcoming and so sweet. Definitely have to come back to order from the menu. Oh and the guy that was singing and i forgot what he played was good too.

My ac has been acting up lately and decided to take it in before it completely fails. As a woman, I often dread going to any automotive establishment so I took a man with me. It wasn't necessary at all. First of all the owner was a woman who approached every customer respectfully and with no bs and the other guy working there was just a pleasure. I would definitely suggest this place. They were also very quick with several customers on a Saturday morning!

Worst company EVER!! They cant even help there residents out with a letter that will take 2 seconds to type up. All they care about is how much more money they can get from someone! My lease is up in March and i will be certain to NEVER sign another one here! They are rude inconsiderate people and ive never experienced customer service they way they give it! You will get better service at Walmart and that place sucks too!!!!!

I was very pleased to receive same day service. I liked dealing directly with Izzy and not having to go through a middle man.  Pricing for the job completed was very reasonable.  He completed the job promptly, he cleaned up and was very professional!

There is plenty of good shopping to be had up and down the business route of 202 especially at the Concord Mall. While it in no way compares to the mega structure that is the Christiana Mall over in Newark, it certainly has its own positive merits.

For one it has a Chick Filet. Major plus in my book. Second, it has an H&M. My personal clothing haunt. And within the past two years they have seriously upgraded their restaurant game by adding Grub Burger Bar and Bonefish Grill. Plus they have other staples to round out your shopping experience like FYE, Foot Locker and Victoria's Secret. And next door to the mall is a Best Buy, Ulta and Barnes and Nobles. 

The one thing Concord Mall really lacks are more high end/ luxury brand stores. There is a very nice Macy's at Concord and it's pretty much the only store you can go to at this mall for Coach or Michael Kors but other than that you'd have to go to Christiana to get fix.
Awesome, fast, affordable, and honest!  When our air went out, we needed it fixed quick and between trips for work.  Ice Cold was amazing and worked with us.  Thanks!
We order from here a lot. Food is decent at a fair price. The staff is very friendly and the owners even greet me by name

I took my car here when I started having problems with my rear turn signal while driving down from Maryland. Although, they weren't able to fix it, I was impressed with the time and effort they put in. John spent about an hour or so trying everything he could and was finally able to narrow it down. He said that the required service should probably done by the Mercedes dealership because it may involve the wiring which is complicated. In my opinion, they went above and beyond to  try and help. When I asked him how much I owed, he said I owed him nothing. If I were a local, I would have no problem making them my preferred service shop.
Amazing food and I love the atmosphere! I will definitely be coming back for more. Matt

My husband used to frequent this bar and after declining to go several times, I finally gave in. I wish I had stuck to my guns. The age group looked to be around 50, the atmosphere was horrid and their beer selection was beyond terrible. I'm not sure you can go to a less appealing bar in O'Fallon. If you want crappy beer that's cheap, you might as well save your money and buy a 12 pack from your local gas station.
This is a great place of business.  We use the self service side, but get our dogs nails trimmed too.

Stay here if you like smelling like a blend of  vomit, cigarettes, old toilet water, mold, and sweat! Found some cigarette butts under the bed in our non smoking room. The mattresses had stains and sheets didn't look clean. I actually had to go buy sheets and pillows at Walmart. Everything was dusty and disgusting!! The shower drain was clogged and so We couldn't even take a comfortable shower to wash the film of filth off our bodies. The door to our room didn't close properly and so all the drug addicts in the motel could just walk in and murder us if they wanted to lol. When I got home the clothes I travelled with all had to be washed twice because they smell like shit. I should just burn them tbh. You get what you pay for, but you couldn't even pay me to stay here again.
I have had the great pleasure of meeting donna's mother and working with donna.  She is a joy and her shop is a lovely experience.  I wish her continued success.

My husband and I went to this theater for part of our St. Valentine's Day date.  We had planned to see The Grey, but something was broken and that movie unavailable.  The cashier was very accommodating and resolved the problem satisfactorily.  We did not buy any of the concessions, so I can't address that aspect.  We found the theater itself large and comfortable.  The leather seats were especially luxurious.  There were no problems during the movie at all--I couldn't find fault with a single aspect of the experience!  If this theater were a little nearer to the Kirkwood area, it would definitely be our preferred venue.
Comfortable beds , Clean bathroom,easy parking. The staff was professional. Overall I would recommend.
Phenomenal place with fantastic service. They were extremely friendly and had wonderful coffee. Would highly recommend this place to anyone

I'm currently waiting for an order that was due by 6:30. Its 7:45! This store is 3 blocks from me. I called and they had me on hold for 15 mins and when i tried again they said the delivery was "on it's way". I know it's cold out but DAMN!
I play pool league out of here on sunday nights. If you like little quiet bars this is the place to come. They Have great cheap food, slot machines that pay out, and the nascar race is always on.

I waited an hour an half for help.  The two guys at the counted were helping the same two clients all that time. One of the costermers at the counter was super frustrated. 

Reminded me of being at O'Hare and finding out they cancelled all flights indefinitely.  

 I bought their insurance but I couldnt upgrade and they didnt stock the phone I was required to get.  They could not help without me driving across town to another store and starting over.  Understaffed and not helpful at all. A giant waste of time.   Frustrated. Never be back.

Went to visit, sign on one door said open - door was locked so I ventured to the other house walked all around it opened the screen door and found posted hours that were behind a wreath all faded out. 

Don't hide the hours behind a wreath and don't have an open sign on your door when you're closed please!

There were some really cute things outside (which is why I gave it two stars instead of one), looking forward to visiting another time to see what's inside.

My family has been going to this pizza hut location since the 80s/90s when they had an actual restaurant. The pizza has evolved but overall the service has remained the same, even with the updated wing street version. Pizzas come out hot and tasty but it can take a bit of time to get your order. They have a drive through but that's more useful for wing street. If you want your order done, order it online about a half hour before you go to pick it up. Unfortunately that doesn't guaranteed that it will be done. But it's a solid choice for cheaper pizza when the deal is right.

Great budget motel.  The front desk staff was kind and accommodating.  Room was comfortable, with a 42" smart TV and full boat cable package. Good internet, and the pizza next door was really good, too.  No question as to where I will be staying on my next trip.

These people scam you!!! They sell you a coupon on groupon and they come to your house, and find all these problems and up sell you!!! Then they say they don't want to take the groupon coupon because it wouldn't be worth doing because they are not cleaning there whole system!!! They were not professional. They looked like they ex prison cons with a vacuum! Call a real company that has a long standing reputation. Stay away!!!!!!! Run!!!!!!!

Fucking terrible. I went in for breadsticks and a soda and not only did the guy ignore me as i stood there with no greeting, not even a "can you wait a minute" i stood here for about 5-8 minutes. Then he takes my order and it takes another 10 minutes for 1 order of BREADSTICKS and a soda. I wish i knew his name-- oh wait *checks receipt* it was Terrance! Terrance you are extremely rude and unprofessional. Woo chile the ghetto!

It's a local dive bar. No frills. Cash only. The bartenders are friendly and witty. Lots of regulars here, but keep in mind that the age group is typically 50+ during the day and during the week. I like going on weekdays after work to unwind. Weekends get a younger crowd. Pool, darts, and volleyball leagues pack the place seasonally. The food is very good... try the burger or pizza.  The place isn't everyone's scene, but if you like quiet dives that contrast with the other busy bars in town, it might just become your usual place.

I took my 2 dogs there because my neighbor recommended them. First time was ok. Next time terrible !  Both dogs had belly cuts. My Pom needed Vet treatment. The salon paid for it and refunded my money.

Milmont Pizza is great. I've only ever had pickup, but they have a great turnaround time. They have nice specials, too, like a 2 liter soda and a large pizza for under $12.00. We usually get just a plain cheese pizza double sliced (that's the way it goes, it lasts longer that way). It's a great value. It's a hidden treasure.
My daughter took her dog in for FREE nail trim, cost her $8.  And can't even tell they've been trimmed.

I wanted to write a review for the Regency because the few scattered reviews I found after a brief Google search were over five years old, and noted a few unsavory things about the place that were most likely from previously shoddy management (more on that later).

With that said, I had a good experience with this place. Some backstory: The recent blizzard nonsense we've been having forced my job to rent hotel rooms for their employees, with the Holiday Inn Express being the only brand hotel around. Naturally, rooms went quick and our only option was to take a single room at the Regency - I was hesitant at first because 1) I've never stayed a "motor inn," like one of those places where you could rent a room for a few hours or drive your car right up to the door and 2) reviews from 2009 had complained of bad odors on the first floor (the building has two) and one case of a family getting bed bugs. The room was taken care of, so I figured why not. At least I could see if it was worth a shot.

Despite the place looking like a lounge from the 70's or a deleted scene from No Country for Old Men, it's a decent place to stay. The average rate for a room is about $88 which is a little steep to me, but I'd assume they'd have to compete with the nearby Holiday Inn for business (again, I didn't have to pay a cent this time). The staff was friendly, checking me in quickly even when I showed up after midnight. The halls and rooms are filled with furniture which most likely hasn't been replaced in decades, but hey, there's swipe-card entry for the rooms, small flat-screen TVs with HBO and a mini-fridge. Thankfully, the linens were very clean. I even did the mattress lift and check and all. Not a trace of anything the old reviews said. We could have used curtains they were functional instead of decoration, though. But hey, splitting hairs a little.

In the morning the guy behind the desk let me have a free paper and offered to help me clean the snow off my car. I stayed two nights and another the week after when the storm ramped up again. It wasn't the Holiday Inn by far, but definitely didn't live up to any horror stories.

Yummmy in my Tummmmy!

I almost always order my pizza online, so no experience with in-store activity. 

My pizzas are aways delivered correctly and hot.
My bbq boneless wings are prepared just right...the perfect crust taste when biting into it, followed by juicey white meat inside. Their wing sauce makes you wanna run naked on a beach! Gooood stuff!

P.S.
Online, they always have deals. :-)

This mall employs security that harass women for nursing. They have called the cops on women for nursing. they have followed women around after nursing, generally harassing them and threatening to kick them out if they nurse again. They have an area beside toilets they want women to feed their babies in, and if you refuse they will harass you. After it was proven to them that women have legal protections to nurse where ever they are allowed to be, they took to the internet and compared a mother feeding her child to a sexual act between adults. I am disgusted with this malls employees and management.

This place is part of my childhood. My family ate here quite a lot when we were kids because it was the local shop that everyone knew. Every time we go here still I get myself the pepperoni pizza bread and the Milmont fries. The combination always is to my satisfaction.

I ADORE this theater.  It is less then five minutes from my house, it has decent tickets prices, and is always so clean!!! And have I mentioned the seats? Not only are they super plush and comfortable, but they are leather and they recline!!! No other theater holds a candle. This is always my first pick when looking to see a film in theaters.

Ordered a large pizza online and put "EXTRA EXTRA SAUCE" in the comments. Plus I hit the "extra" sauce icon when I created my pizza online. When I got there and the guy went back to get my pizza he actually looked at it and went back to pizza maker and I could hear him ask about my extra sauce so I already knew they messed up my pizza. Instead of fixing it the guy came out and tried to pass off this pizza to me KNOWING it didn't have extra sauce on it. I declined the pizza of course and asked for them to make it again. When he went back there I could hear someone yelling. So the pizza maker comes out with a very nasty attitude. His first words were "Is this your pizza? Cause I'm not making it again it has plenty of sauce on it". I asked to speak to the manager and he claimed that he was the manager, which I doubt. His attitude was so nasty that I wouldn't want him to make me anything anyway. I just walked out. Its sad that places can't follow simple directions. Maybe these places need to start paying people more money so they actually attract employees who know how to read and follow simple directions. Will never go to this hood, ghetto place again.

Professional. 

This place came recommended by my parents who used to take the family dog here. (I never knew.) They groomed my puppy without harming her and were done within the amount of time they said.

I am not from the area and was around town with my young daughter when I stopped in here. I had iced coffee and it was great! The cups and straws are biodegradable and the little shop was so cute. There were toys and books in the back that my 2 year old could play with while I enjoyed my drink and I had a very good experience here!

So much cleaner than the other theaters around town. I may be a little over-excited, because there aren't any other theaters around High Ridge. It has stadium seating, and the tickets are $10 a pop. I get to take my son (who is 2) for free, but I'm not sure what age the cutoff is. They also have much more inexpensive early bird shows and matinees. The big drawback is that the concession food is incredibly expensive - $7 for a small popcorn. Eesh.

A quick review.   A simple mall, and a good time.   What is key here is TAX FREE SHOPPING!!!

A good mall, nice stores, normal mall stores and just a nice place to go and walk around up and back

Normally, I would give this restaurant 5 stars but we did not have a great experience tonight.  Don't get me wrong the food was great.  I always order the farfalle primavera.  And it was fabulous as always.  Tonight, the atmosphere is what left a little to be desired.  I am assuming it was karaoke night because the singing was atrocious.  We were sitting in the dining room which is typically quaint and pleasant.  However, the horrible singing was incredibly loud and distracting.  Not to mention, it was kind of emberrassing because Hilary Duff was there tonight.  I am sure she was expecting a nice, quiet evening and instead she was bombarded with obnoxious music.  Perhaps, if they would have turned it down so that only the bar area was tortured, we could have enjoyed ourselves.
Hit or miss when ordering online,might get what you ordered to the T or might be off a few minute items. food is great 1 day, 2 days later the exact meal tastes like crap. service is really good

I also bought a groupon. I called three times over 6 months with no response. After threatening to report the company for fraud, they called me back. Then I think to be funny, the office girl called me back three times in 10 minutes to schedule an appointment. When the two workmen showed up, they both immediately asked to use my restroom. One of them left a huge dump and stopped up the toilet which I had to fix. One gentleman was a hard worker with their beat-up equipment. Meanwhile, the other man made himself right at home at my kitchen table and later on my couch. He was completely unprofessional and I couldn't wait for them to leave. I would not recommend this company to anyone.

This is one of the two locations that we take our cars to for all our car maintenance and car repair needs. 

I like that I can trust the auto mechanics to be honest and stand behind their work. 

The are even holding a free "Women's Care Care Clinic" this weekend and have on-going education - call them to ask when their next even will be. 

Here's more info in a blog post we wrote about the clinic.. http://www.sandbarstosunsets.com/2009/04/02/clearwater-florida-what-to-look-for-in-an-auto-mechanic-attend-free-womens-clinic/    

We recommend them to all our clients moving to the area or just visiting for the winter months.

For the most part, around here, take out places are mirror images of each other.  I'm just slightly biased as Milmont Pizza is just around the corner from me.  But we'll still drive 15 minutes for so for take out somewhere else if it's worth it.  This place is solid.  Pizzas are good (thick crust).  Sandwiches, burgers and cheesesteaks are above average.  My wife really likes their salads, especially the grilled chicken.  The staff is definitely friendly and the wait times for pickup are acceptable.

$13.50 a person to see a 3D movie. Talk about almost heart attack no wonder I don't go to the movies often. Did prices go up or have I just been out of this world for a while?? Geez. Though this theatre is still one of my faves. Close to home, good service, and rocking seats. :::thumbs up::::
I only order take out from here and the pizza is consistently Pizza Hut quality. You get what you expect from the fast food pizza industry; with that in mind it hits the mark.

I love this grooming parlor and so does my puppy. They do a great job in filing his nails and giving him a bath. He always smells really good when I pick him up and they know him by name. They never upsell me on services I don't need and the price is reasonable. Since visiting this parlor I refuse to take him to anyplace else for a bath.

I've only had their pizza but It was very bland. There were no spices at all anywhere to be found and the quality of the sauce and cheese was average at best. The crust was dry and hard. If it was the only pizza place in town I would just eat frozen pizza but luckily there's at least a dozen or more pizza places within a mile of Milmont Pizza. For what it's worth the staff was friendly but I won't be eating there again.

Always had great service from the guys here. I've taken the following vehicles here: 1998 Dodge Dakota, 1989 Buick LeSabre, 2005 Scion XA, 1980 Chevy C-10. I am a trained technician and I know I haven't been screwed over by these guys. There are certain things I don't do on my cars for lack of tools or expertise. This shop does everything from brakes to engines. Sharon owns this shop and she is great and very honest.

I loooooooooooooooooooooove this place. Rocking/reclining seats...You had my heart right there. They have decent prices. They are never crowded and packed with people. I always buy my tickets ahead of time and then walk right in the doors and print them on the little machine right inside. I've never had to stand in line other than getting popcorn and that line was always short.
Love this place. Just about everyone is genuinely friendly and management is always respectful and thoughtful. Never had an issue, and would recommend this place to anyone.

I admit, as a previous AMC theater snob I was skeptical of Great Escape, thinking it wouldn't be able to hold a candle to my precious AMC. However, while I still prefer AMC, the Great Escape is pretty darn nice. It's definitely my second choice when it comes to choosing a theater. It definitely beats the pants off of any Wehrenberg theater I've been to. Though I confess, I refuse to do Wehrenberg. 

Anyway ... Why do I like Great Escape so much? Well ... let me list the reasons.
--Coke products (I'm not a Pepsi fan, & this is HUGE for me)
--HUGE large popcorn and drink for about $11, and they're both refillable! Popcorn is delish, and soda is always bubbly and sweet.
--Clean theaters - clean halls - clean bathrooms - just clean!
--Ample seating (some theaters seem to have about 25 seats in some of their viewing rooms, but not Great Escape).
--Location ... if you live in Fenton or Imperial it's relatively close, and definitely worth the drive.
--Seats! Yeah, seems odd, but seriously, the leather bouncy, reclining type seats are a definite bonus when it comes time to sit in one spot for 2 to 3 hours, watching a movie. It's almost like being on the couch at home.

I have no complaints about Great Escape, other than to say that concession stand service tends to be on the slow side at times. I think though this is because they're understaffed during the weekdays, and have a single staff member doing multiple tasks. Other than that though, this place is a winner. Check it out next time you're in the mood for a flick! I think you'll be pleasantly surprised.

this company is a rip off and completely unethical in their business practices (they try to sell you something you either don't need or that they say needs to be replaced but doesn't).  they can vacuum out your ductwork okay, but that is it.  don't believe any of the other hype.

This is one of my favorite local antique shops!  I usually try to stop in about once a month to check out any new items they may have. During my first visit, I was suprised how much bigger the store was inside compared to what it looks like from the outside. There's also a small building out back which typically has very affordable furniture. I inquired about renting a space there (spoke to a women who did there too while visiting) and she was so kind and helpful. Always a great visit :)

I've done work with these guys I the past. They do excellent work. I had them do my own house in Carrollwood and as always another professional job complete. I own a plumbing company in Tampa and I've sent numerous referrals to them always knowing my customers would be taken good care of. These guys a awesome. Nevo (Anival) is the nicest guy you could possibly meet. I've really never heard anything bad from him. He's always got such a wonderful positive attitude all the time. If you need a new roof give these guys a call you won't be disappointed.

Worst place to stay ever. I gave 1 star because it won't let me give 0. Smelled like an ashtray. People partying in the hallway all night long. I'm sure the guy at the front desk was part of it since he did nothing about it.. Terrible stay. Will never go back.. If you do stay, beware

I wish I could give no stars, but don't use them unless you make sure to tell them when scheduling that you only want the service for what the coupon states. The contractors will try and get you for a lot more money. FYI don't spend the couple of hundred dollars they will quote you on vice the $50 coupon or whatever discount you have. I took off time from work to make it home for the technician to only have him not do anything quote me a price of $330 to clean the air ducts and vent properly. Mr. Duct thank you, but no thank you. He left without even closing the vent that he had checked even. He also explained to me that the $50 coupon was for maintenance only. He didn't even want to do the work because it was a waste of his time I assumed. 

I will say this, the people that do the scheduling have been really kind about my experience with their contractor and scheduling was easy.

UPDATE- I am going to give them one more chance to see if I get the same experience again. Because I called the company to set up another appointment with another technician after explaining to them what exactly happened.

If I could give zero stars I would. Rodney the manager has HORRIBLE customer service. In addition to being over an hour late with our delivery, the pizzas being cold, our order was also incomplete!  All he was willing to do was either remake half of our order or refund us half of our 40 dollar purchase. It wasn't until we went up to pizza hut that he was willing to give us the full refund! There are many pizza places in the area that provide much better customer service than to deal with a horrible management team at Pizza hut. Pizza hut DO BETTER!

I love the chicken cheese steaks (buffalo sauce on it!) and getting a small pizza for myself here. The wings are better than most places around the area, not too buttery. Pretty awesome lunch and dinner specials for one person or for the family.

Received excellent service while upgrading my phone!  The sales representative was helpful, fast, attentive, courteous, and answered all my questions.  I will definitely come back again for future needs.  Thanks Verizon!

Only giving them 2 stars because of the staff. I called to make an appointment and they requested that I bring my dogs vaccine records to bring there. The man on the phone acted extremely annoyed that I requested the fax number. Also, I gave them my number to have them call me when my dog was done. Instead, they called another number so I had no idea when my dog was done. Absolutely ridiculous and I won't be going back. The dogs hair cut was mediocre at best. And it cost $40 to get his face trimmed, nails done, and a bath.

Every time I go here approach a staff member of the mall they're very friendly. It's pretty easy to navigate around the mall. I never had to really ask help with finding something in the mall such as a store

Don't expect your food to be on time, ever. Over 30 minutes late for a pickup order today and it's far from the first time. No apologies or anything. The food and value is good but consistently very late
Better off at Cocos. This low quality. No slices and expensive. Don't believe me see for yourself
Another nice mall in Delaware, let me see how much deals I can get today.

I've lived in many states across the country and have dealt with a lot of auto repair places. These guys have good customer service, friendly ( don't see that very often) and do a great job. I won't say their cheap but not stupid either. Very happy with the company.

I have lived at 800 Cap for a little over a year now and it is a wonderful apartment complex to live in! My apartment is very spacious with a great view of downtown Indianapolis (even on the first floor). Any maintenance requests that were put in have been resolved in a matter of days. The common areas, like the exercise room and courtyard, are always kept nice and clean. There is even a rooftop that is the perfect downtown hangout. The leasing staff is excellent as well. They are very responsive and every couple of months they provide all the residents with perks like free breakfast, pizza, and even drinks! 

One of the best things about 800 Cap is their location. They are steps away from coffee shops, breweries, and grocery stores. Not to mention a street away from the Canal and the Indy Cultural Trail. I recommend 800Cap to all my family and friends- it is a lovely place to call home!

I didn't have any trouble scheduling my appointment, but had to wait three weeks for the first available.  That was supposed to be today. They just didn't show up. No phone call. Do I really have to give them a star to post this?

This place is my go to! Its a great family owned pizza joint. The pizza is outstanding and the service is friendly and fast. They had a girl that was answering the phones there that was a little rough to deal with but I don't think she is there anymore. If you looking for a great pie from good people this is the place to go.

I really like this mall for a few reasons.

  1) Its not overly packed with kids/teens muddling their way around
  2) Place is well kept, clean and everything is easy to find
  3) Easy bus access for those that use it
  4) Can walk a block down to Best Buy and Barnes & Noble Bookstore which covers most everything else you may not find in the mall.

Now they do not have a food court so those options are lower than some other malls, but you have your staples of Italian, Chinese, Chik-Fil-A, Champs, Ruby Tuesdays and the new Noodles and Company to choose from.  Plus coffee shop, Auntie Anns Pretzels,  Cinnabon (mmmm) and a couple other snacky spots.  

Im a Macys fan so Im content with hitting there and maybe grabbing some food/snacks or taking a quick browse around the other stores.  If you want to walk for hours and have an endless selection of stores/kiosks hustling similar crap then this may not be the mall for you.  If you know what you want and the store you need it from is there then stop in.  Its quick, convenient and a nice mall.
One of my favorite hometown, out of the way bars.  The food has gotten better every year!  Just a good bunch of people always in there.  The owner and his wife are great people.  Love this place!

Very good pizza, just as past reviewers described-- a thinner pizza with a doughy crust.  Excellent cheese.  Tasty wings.  Good price--  $17 for a large and 10 wings, happy with that.  Quick pick up, especially for a Friday night.

I had the privilege of dining at Bartolino's recently with a friend who grew up on The Hill. He had invited me to hear the Italian Counsel speak to the local Italian-America Chamber of Commerce. I was honored to be in the presence of so many St. Louis luminaries. 

Bartolino himself sat at my table. Our meal of homemade parpadelle pasta with perfect Bolognese sauce, and chicken marsala were each a testament to Italy's greatest export...it's food.

Salute Bartolino!

One of the only places I can find that grooms cats on a regular basis.   I have taken my long hair cat to be shaved several times.  This last time was the best cut she has ever had, but I think sometimes it takes a while to get used to how I want her hair cut.  When I call to make the appointment they are always very friendly and usually fit her in quickly.   Upon arrival they are quick to greet and ensure they have the correct telephone number to call when done.  I will continue to take my cat here even though it is a bit of a drive from home.   Just be specific with what you want or give them a photo.

I order a thin-crust chicken medium Pizza and it was terrible the crust was really hard it was no sauce on the pizza and the chicken was really dry! The pepperoni and Italian sausage was good though lol, 3/ & the half stars  but all and all fairplace.

I stopped in to order wings and had to wait for someone to come to the register.  I called out to them and no one came out. I tried calling and they wouldn't pick up the phone.  And there were people in the back. I had to try calling three time for them to come out to take my order.  Imbeciles....

If you're in the market for a noisy overpriced apartment that constantly smells like either sewage or a garbage dump, then this is the place for you. For a one bedroom costing $1200 a month (less than 700sqft) you'd expect better. During my 2 years of living at these "luxury" apartments I've experienced some pretty frustrating incidents. Whether it be the vomit in the public restrooms/elevator/courtyard/and parking lot, dog poop both inside and outside the building, having the fire alarm pulled at 3 in the morning on multiple occasions, shattered glass bottles laying around, and the outdoor spaces constantly littered with garbage. To top it all off the walls are paper thin. You hear EVERYTHING your neighbors do. Including every time a neighbor flushes a toilet or takes a shower. Get used to the sound of flowing water since you'll hear it every day due to the old exposed pipes. I've had water come into my apartment through the walls about 4 times now. 
My next door neighbors smoked inside their apartment which meant my apartment constantly smelled like smoke too. 
Unless your method of transportation is a bike, this probably isn't the place for you. They got rid of the free parking earlier this year. You can however park in the alley behind the street. Just don't make the mistake of going back there at night. I've been harassed by men asking me for money on multiple occasions when trying to park my car.

Perez Plumbing was recommended by a friend with great past experiences.  I spoke with Izzy regarding an estimate to re-pipe our home, he came out promptly, the same day, explained exactly what had to be done, and provided the best quote of three different plumbers.  I was hoping to use Izzy to complete the work, however being that it was part of an insurance claim, I was regretfully forced to utilize their preferred plumber.  After the poor experience I had with the "preferred vendor", I wish I fought harder for the work to be completed by Perez.  I plan on using them in the future when I have a problem.

The Pizza situation in Mt.Airy is awful so decided to give this Pizza Hut a whirl. Order online delivery said it would arrive in 45 mins... Took about an 1hr30mins. The thin crust was over cooked and cold when it arrived. Had about 2 slices bc I was starving and tossed the pizza and directed my focus on the bread sticks with extra marinara... Well... Worst fears realized, they didnt even manage to get the marinara that comes with the breadsticks in there, let alone the extra marinara that I had to pay extra for... So all in all. The pizza took 45 mins over the projected delivery time. Pizza was over cooked amd cold on arrival. No marinara at all with the breadsticks when I ordered extra. So Ill grade the pizza hut with an F for botching the entire order.

Gone are the days of a dark smokey shopping mall with carpet and those little rides for kids that took quarters.  Of course that was 1987....
This mall has had its ups and downs.  
Stores I miss:  The Limited, Woolworths, Strawbridge & Clothier, Sam Goody, The Wall, Suncoast (movie store), the book stores (Walden books?), Rave (a recent departure), Structure, KB Toys, Burger King...the list goes on.  

There's no Gap here.  Hard to believe that a mall without a Gap actually exists.  There was once a Gap and a Gap kids....
There are plenty of shoe stores and jewelry stores.  Department stores:  Macy's, Boscovs and Sears (plus Macy's Home Store).  Hot Topic is still around.  Video game store, FYE (cds/dvds), Lens Crafters.  Hallmark Gold Crown, and another similar store.  McDonalds, Cafe Riviera (pizza), etc...

But to sum up this rambling review....
Tax free shopping
Variety of mall food
Not too many mobs of teenagers the way Christiana Mall has
Traffic getting there is not too bad.

This is a family owned shop in the middle of a residential neighborhood.   I've ordered take out from here several times and they are accurate and provide fast delivery service.   Their pizza is not my favorite as I'm not a great fan of their crust.   The wings are great - nice and spicy or flavorful barbecue.   The thing that I really enjoy from here is the chicken cheesesteak because it's like a real chicken sandwich.

You can't really eat in here as there are only a couple of small tables.   There is no AC in the summer so don't go early to pick up your order as you will sweat to death.

I took my car in for repair last Monday at about 11:00 in the morning and had it fixed and back to me by 2:00 with what I thought was a fair quote. Mike was very easy & friendly to work with and I feel like they are very honest. I will take my car back there in the future and recommend them to friends and family!
I've lived here for about 3 years now, the maintenance staff is quick to answer and the landscaping crew is top notch

I'm really a big fan. Their salads are packed full of veggies and aren't the standard salad you'd expect from a pizza joint. I recently had their gyro platter and I'd have to say it's amazing. The portion is super large, and comes with a greek salad (olives, feta, bell pepper and seasoning) fries, and the sandwich. I couldn't put my fork down eating the salad it was so delicious. Then I started on the sandwich and finally had to put half away since I was so full. The sandwich... equally amazing. I finished the fries and sandwich for lunch today and it was just as good as I remembered it being the night before. My husband had their bbq pizza, he wasn't a huge fan, but I can't speak for it since I didn't try it. 

These are the only items I've had here and we've ordered from here often. I tried the salad based on a review and I couldn't give it up, I tried the gyro so I could eat something different and I'll sure I'll be stuck on this new favorite!

Concord mall is a pretty solid, run-of-the-mill, old school, nothing fancy mall.  I've NEVER been there when it's crowded which is nice.  As others have said parking can be a pain but in my opinion it's just b/c of the entrance/exits on either side with tight spaces in between.  

I like that it's doable in a few hours.  You can do a big loop, hit all the stores you want/need and still have most of the day free to do what you need to do.

Tax-free is the biggest reason I come here.  It could use a better coffee bar and a few more food choices but hey, it's got the basics covered and it's close to the PA line.

i grew up in Newark, DE so this was not my mall. my mall was Christiana Mall. Concord Mall the mall i went to with my friends who lived in the city. it was the crappy mall, but it was the mall with the only Hot Topic at the time. that was about 13 years ago. now it's the only mall in the area with an H&M and Hollister (which the kiddies love). it's super duper small. the crowd is super duper odd. and the parking is a super duper pain in the ass.

This is my favorite mall to go to with my family. It's clean and well lit. Very suburbs. The stores are nothing fascinating, the same thing you would see at every mall. It has a very leisurely, relaxed atmosphere, and that's why I love it.

Of course, it's in DE. Tax-free shopping.

The service at this store is excellent. They are very knowledgeable about you Verizon service and how to craft a plan that works for your lifestyle. They also know their product and will guide you in to the phone and or tablet that you need. I am not technology savvy. I had very implicit instructions on how to use my phone and how to use the Phoenix and tablet together. 
Excellent followup.
I highly recommend this store!

I bought a Living Social Coupon for US Air Solutions.  The hard part was scheduling an appointment.  I called for about a month and left messages and never got a call back.  Finally one day someone answered the phone.  The first available appointment was 3 weeks out.  I took it.

Brian and another gentleman came.  They were nice, worked quickly and even liked my dog.  As expected when you purchase a deal like this, there was an up sell for some AC cleaning, however he made some good points.  I might do it in the future.  

I would recommend them.  I am not sure how much it would cost without the Living Social deal, but for $49 I am pleased, my air ducts and dryer vent are clean!
It has a Boscov's.  That's either extremely frightening or slightly  endearing.

Had a little bit of a time finding this place since they don't have their own website, but turned out to be a pretty cool spot! Thought I was totally lost when I turned into a neighborhood, but this place is pretty nice dive bar. They have sand volleyball here!

Its so casual, a really great neighborhood bar, the sand volleyball courts are nice, and the drinks are cold! I like finding places that aren't totally touristy and off the beaten path. 

Sweet tunes were blasting while playing volleyball, drink specials to keep you hydrated and outdoor seating to enjoy the pleasant evenings!
A nicr little mall. I wish it had more stores. There is only one long hallway of stores. Other than that, it is a clean nice mall.

Not even going to bore you with the details!! This spot gets worse by the minute don't even know how they stay in business as a chain store. If the Pizza Hut corporate office were to see the 3 ring circus going on here they would be HISTORY! I will never go in there again. Sometimes u think ehh bad night...last few times in there consecutive bad nights... read the other reviews for them....And yes agree with Rodney the manager is a problem for sure. Did he even get any customer service training at all??

Wow! What a night! 11/19/17 
They are usually ok however, I Came here to get a simple order and they messed it up. First My order wasn''t ready when I got there. Was told they were backed up. finally after waiting 20 minutes more I got my order. The Pizza was disgusting and the cheese smelled bad. There was no marinara sauce neither on it.  I called for a replacement ank
d now I'm sitting here waiting for it. This place will not get my business anymore.  OMG This place is Ghetto Now.

This is a wonderful coffee shop.  A good selection of hot drinks and the service is fantastic!  Do your self a favor and check out the back room.  This is the perfect place to sit and chat with a friend or have a coffee date.  There are books, toys and entertainment for kiddos- which is great!  This will be added to my list of coffee shops to meet up with friends.
Spectacular deep tissue massage. Victor gets straight to the back issues and relieves the stiffness and tension. I highly recommend him for deep tissue massages/ treatment!

Limited selection of stores. NO FOREVER 21!!!!!!

Upside--no customers so no lines for the fitting rooms at H&M.

I ordered today at 2:40 expected delivery time 3:15 . Called at 3:20 . Employee claimed they never had the order.  Asked for my number and then found my order and said it had been sent out 20 minutes ago.  I live 10 minutes from the pizza Hut.  3:46 still nothing.  Called back the person said I just spoke to you.  It's coming.  Bull shit. It doesn't take over an hour to get a fricking pizza!!!!!!!!!! Never again will I order from them!

Hunters glen is the worst place to live! On several occasion's i have asked them to take care of the speeding in front of my building so i dont get hit one day. Their response was we cant and we are lucky we havent been sued yet! My air conditioner broke in my bedroom and it took OVER 2 weeks and two air conditioners later for it to be fixed. The matanince team is rude and ignorant. And when u call to complain the management team is more concerned about the money they will lose paying them time and a half to come out after hours. The gate house that supposedly keeps this community Private always leaves the arm up for the visitors lane yet they have all my info (ssn, name, dob etc) yet im still using my key to get in. Oh and if u dont want anyone in ur apt when ur not home. ..it really doesn't matter whether or not u sign their do not access my apt when im not home card. They will anyway. I called to tell them the power was out in my bedroom and bathroom and they entered to fix my fridge!!! Really, that has to be a joke!!! Do not move here they don't care about the residents they care how much money they will make! 
The only reason im giving a star Is cuz i cant post without it!

This is a budget motel, so I am basing my review on a budget motel expectations.  I travel regarding my vocation.  I am female, and travel alone.  This establishment was clean and safe, had basic amenities such as laundry, fridge and microwave, and the staff was friendly and accommodating.  

There is a decent Italian restaurant next door, and a Costco a couple of stop lights away.  There were no noise issues or party atmosphere during my 12 day stay.  The air conditioner worked well, the room was clean, and my room looked well maintained.  The hot water was hot, and the pressure in the shower was strong.  

Overall, I was pleased with the accommodations, the rate, and location.  I would stay here again for business travel.

I've seen bigger and I've seen better but this mall is actually A-OK. Nice wide spaces for walking, plenty of variety and while they do have the usual chains that show up in every single mall, there are a handful of new entries that I've not seen before that are mixed in between the anchor stores. You can do some real credit card damage here!

There's a food court but there are also a few other food spots that are not in the food court.

I especially enjoyed the easy and clear exit signs from the parking lot to get back onto 202. The north and south are nicely separated to keep the traffic moving!

From the outside of this Century old house that has been converted into an Antique Shop, you would think it was very small. Once inside, all the charm and wonder of days gone by, comes back to life in many different rooms. 

It can be somewhat of a maze, with rooms scattered on several different floors. Yes Grandmother, they do use the attic. 

When you first walk in you will find vintage jewelry and purses. As you wind your way throughout the many rooms, many dealers offer their latest finds. If your arms get full along the way, they offer to put your treasures aside while you hunt for more. 

From furniture to China and Crystal and paintings to knick nacs, you are almost guaranteed to leave with some new prized possession. 

Behind this house, they have built another store with a very welcoming front porch. I have been in many Antique shops and I love the Brownsville Antique Centre. 

I do and I don't envy my children one day having to go through my obsessive hobby of collecting. I know my son will go straight for the massive Sports memorabilia collection. Other than that, if they throw their hands up in the air and have a yard sale, come running!

Maybe I should open an Ebay account!

I really like this mall for a few reasons. 

   1) Its not overly packed with kids/teens muddling their way around
   2) Place is well kept, clean and everything is easy to find
   3) Easy bus access for those that use it
   4) Can walk a block down to Best Buy and Barnes & Noble Bookstore which covers most everything else you may not find in the mall.

Now they do not have a food court so those options are lower than some other malls, but you have your staples of Italian, Chinese, Chik-Fil-A, Champs, Ruby Tuesdays and the new Noodles and Company to choose from.  Plus coffee shop, Auntie Anns Pretzels,  Cinnabon (mmmm) and a couple other snacky spots.  

Im a Macys fan so Im content with hitting there and maybe grabbing some food/snacks or taking a quick browse around the other stores.  If you want to walk for hours and have an endless selection of stores/kiosks hustling similar crap then this may not be the mall for you.  If you know what you want and the store you need it from is there then stop in.  Its quick, convenient and a nice mall.
Great massage by Victor. He takes his time to get to know what you need during your appointment.   This is probably the best massage I've had in Indy.  Highly recommend him!

There's a huge difference between making a living and making a difference. There's also a difference between success and being valuable.
Sharon and gang here make that tremendous difference and are extremely valuable just being themselves. There is success in being valuable and there's a living in making a difference. These awesome people are both valuable and are truly that difference. You can trust your life will be a little more peaceful and certainly more valuable after taking your car here. 
You really can't ask for more.. You get a great experience in a tough situation and speaking from years of experience on car repair I can tell you this is a very decent place. I got treated like family here. Everyone has their own specific intricacies in their life circumstances and having a trustworthy place to take your car run by people that truly care takes an enormous burden and makes it into a paperweight. 
I am just another person holding up a family on his own and finding a little more peace of mind in life is priceless and I found it here. Value is what keeps giving years after that last big job has been finished and you get so much of it here. You cannot put a price on that. Go ask any person holding up a household doing car repairs on the side to save a lot of gyrations and working a regular job how important it is to be able to trust another person with a job on a car with a failing major subsystem how important Value is. You'll find it here, if your arms are getting tired and your back hurts give yourself a break and drop by. You can relax. 
Sharon and gang are the best!

Great place run by great people... I asked if they could make a cafe Cubano, and without hesitation the barista was whisking up a great cup of syrupy sweet espresso! Will definitely come back... worth the drive from Delaware!

I ate here with a group of people while I was staying in St Louis last Autumn. I'm not sure if people wanted to eat there because they liked it, or becuase we had friends staying in the Drury. 

This place felt like step (albiet very small step) above an olive garden. I usually don't eat meat or dairy and there was nothing on the menu for me. The bartender didn't have any suggestions -  becuase I was starving and exhausted I ordered the Seafood Risotto which seemed the least meaty thing with out being just a pile of lettuce. It was covered in an insane amount of cheese, and incredibly salty.  think I took 4 bites. Ugh.  - I do like cheese and seafood, but typtically don't eat it for ethical reasons - but this dish was just plain awful.

I think being in a city with so many AMAZING Italian restaurants has spoiled us St. Louisans a bit.  I have lived in cities with bad Italian, and I'm tell you, we have it really good here...I mean, really REALLY good.  Just look at The Hill....what down there isn't amazing?  And that's just a sample of the great Italian this city has to offer.  Bartolino's (both of their locations) is just a testament to the great Italian this city has to offer.  

One of the best Italian eateries in the city in my very humble and not Italian at all opinion.  I love going out for Italian..it's one of the few genres of food that is largely veggie friendly.  Bartolino's is absolutely no exception to this rule, and here, I can get a plate full of buttery, thick, garlicy pasta to fill me up for days to come.  

Like most of the places on The Hill, this place can get absolutely packed and it's difficult to get in to eat on the weekend.  That is annoying but the food is so good, you really don't mind once you are seated and munching down on salad.  The service is superb, the ambiance is everything you would want in an Italian restaurant (dark but still well lit somehow, warm, art on the walls, etc.)

I have never had anything bad from this restaurant.  The fettucini alfredo is delicious, the house salad is amazing, and the pizza is awesome as well.  It's your standard great St. Louis Italian.

When the Great Escape was built on Gravois Bluffs, just a short drive from my home, as a patron of film, I was excited. When I attended my first film there early 2009, I was painfully disappointed. My complaints aren't in reference to the service or the personnel, they were just fine. My issue was with the dimensions and accommodations of the theater itself. They have crammed eight auditoriums into the tiny area of the cineplex, resulting in relatively small screens. This is a glaring downside for a cinema that shows exclusively wide-release films. In addition, the seats are essentially padded rocking chairs.
