While they are admittedly comfortable, they are also distracting, not only because I can't fix the chair to one position, but because I can see that many of the patrons in front of me are playing on them during the film, a complaint which brings me to a complaint that can't be regulated by the company: the inconsiderate hicks who attend the movies there. At all three films I've gone to see at the Fenton Great Escape, the audience has been disrespectful, chatty and obnoxious. The perk of discount $4 rush hour shows is a strong upside, and the sound in the auditoriums is actually very good (no doubt a result of their modest size). I have been three times since the theater's completion, no one occasion a better viewing experience than the other two. I go sparingly, in favor of other, more distant cinemas.

Glad there's a Pizza Hut near me--they are few and far between. Although, I seldomly get something from here, it's always good knowing I can grab some good tasting pizza. Pizza Hut has adhered to the same recipe for as long as I know and this place does not deviate. They've improved their menu items over the years offering more of a variety of pizzas, wings, pasta, and desserts. I like how you can customize your pizza such as the crust, sauce, cheese, and of course the toppings. I really enjoy the hand tossed crust. It's not as thick. I like to add chicken on one half, and the other half cheese only. You can get better discounts using online ordering. The employees are kind when going in. There were times where the pizza or wings I ordered was over or under cooked and I had to get it remade. It wasn't a problem and they made my order correctly. 

I've never gotten delivery from here so I cannot speak on that. The store and the kitchen seems clean which is always a plus in my eyes. Overall, pretty good.

I priced shopped this Repair shop with my local car dealer and my usual shop. Ice cold was $300 less expensive than my regular shop had more than $500 less expensive than the dealer. I went with ice cold air and we will see how the repair holds up for my compressor. They offer a lifetime warranty for both parts and labor at no additional cost. They were very meticulous in doing the work and I'm very impressed so far. Would recommend.
This place is right on when it comes to their quality of food. I order here a lot because I live nearby and I don't get tired of their food. Wings good. pizza good. Hogies and grinders excellent.
Nice selection of sunglasses, but their customer service is awful. I sat there for 30 minutes, then they took 2 people who arrived after me.  I'll never shop at that store again
A+. Great service, great staff. Best of all... great deal on Mondays. I came for cryosauna and ended up doing 2 other treatments.

Me and my girlfriend frequent here often. We live an hour apart so when we want to see a movie its a good middle meeting point for us. Its always clean and the staff is friendly enough. The prices are comperable to other places and they seem to keep the teenie boppers in check. I enjoy it.

lovely shop 
helpful staff 
fun place to hunt for whatever tickles my fancy 
interesting unusual  objects 
new vintage and antique items for me to find

This is one of the worst Pizza huts I've been. Every time you call to make an order, no one ever answer the phone. Once you get here to order, the staff is always unprofessional especially with service and they just act as if it's not hard to get a job out here. I come in to order my food and the girl is on FaceTime with another girl, so she sits her phone down and acted as if I was bothering her... like wtf... are you not at work??? Then she so busy trying to get back to the phone, she is smiling at the phone while it was on the counter and ended up giving me the wrong change and walked to the back. I stood at the counter for at least 3 mins saying "excuse me" until another staff member came to the front. I noticed that all this restaurants are hiring kids who just don't care. There should be some type of supervision where someone can have accountability. I understand it might not be their career job but it's still someone's business

Worst place to order delivery. Always late. Multiple times something was missing. Do not order after 7:00pm if you want to eat it at a decent time. This last time I ordered online, the food never came and when I called they said they did not have my order even though I was charged. Had to call corporate.

Victor is the best! I've gone to several other massage therapists in Indy and no one comes close to how great of a job he does. I workout 5-6x every week at a CrossFit gym which can take a toll on your body. I go to Victor every 3 weeks for maintenance to keep my muscles loose and soreness to a minimum. He knows exactly how to fix problem areas, everything from an Achilles' tendon strain to a stiff neck. No two massages are ever the same. Sometimes it's a relaxing massage if nothing is too tight and other times it's cupping to help relieve really tight spots. I would highly recommend Victor if you're looking for the best!

I'd give it a minus if possible. I understand that you get what you pay for, but cheap doesn't have to be filthy. The room stunk like smoking, the bathroom smelled moldy, and the towels were dirty. How can someone "clean the room" and not see that the towels are dirty?  Service was as good as the room was cleaned. This is how businesses go to hell:  when the employees don't give a shit about their responsibilities. I stayed at another inexpensive hotel in the area not long ago and it was as expected, but this place is a pig pen.

Had the stainless steel flex pipe on the exhaust system of my 1998 Toyota Camry replaced. It was loud but now is as quiet as can be. They did an excellent job and were very honest with us and won't rip you off like some others (under $90) I checked out. They even checked our brakes and reset the check engine light that was on. Such nice people, ask for Pete, the owner. You won't find any better person to get you back on the road again in a hurry if you need to be. Out of state from Ohio.
Dave

Ghetto asf . You call in and your still waiting a hour to 30 minutes inside and they act as if you owe them something and like you almost have to beg them for food. I ordered a pizza and wings for my family and I get there to pay. I come in and the fat Bitch at the desk was confused looking on the computer and told me that she couldn't see my order . Then she found it . Then she goes to the back and ask them to get it . She comes and says I have to wait 20 minutes for another pizza because it wasn't the size I wanted . Then the wings were the wrong size . So I left . The dumb bitches answering the phones either can't comprehend or are always too busy talking and laughing to get the shit right . Don't come here . It's too long of a wait .

Voicemail and website says there hours on Tuesday are open until 9pm. I called this afternoon asking if I came in tonight for a spray tan would I need an appointment. I was told no need for one. I got there at 7:20 and the receptionist was rude for first off and she said they already closed down the machine so I couldn't get a spray tan. Wasted 20 min in the car each way. They should update their hours

Absolutely the worst place I ever slept in over 60 years. If it wasn't so late when we pulled in I would have left. The entire place lobby, hallways, room stunk of stale cigarette smoke. Bed was like sleeping on plywood, bath was antiquated and leaking. If I was to rate this on a 1-5 scale I would give it  negative 10. Do yourself a big favor and find anywhere else to stay then here.

What a crazy place...not in a good way. This mall has gone down the tube over the past ten years. It's sad because this was my favorite hang out place growing up. I went in to do some shopping a few weeks ago and basically all the stores were closed. It reminded me a lot of how Granite Run Mall looked when it was getting ready to close. Not much is left but American Eagle for me in there. 
Your best bet is to take the trip down to the Christiania Mall or up to King of Prussia Mall.

When the owner's mother and aunt ran the shop, it was a totally different scene than it is today. They were always present or at least one of them was, the daughter who is now running the business is rarely there and when you ask the unknowledgeable staff when she will be in, it takes two or more to try to figure that one out.

Twice, at two different times and over two different items, my husband was quoted a price by the owner and he wanted to think about it, I had the same experience over a different item, both times Donna Rae claimed that she never would have quoted us the prices that she did, so of course, no deal was ever made.

Also, their hours are very short and when you call and get a voice message and contact number, if you have a question, etc. the contact person asks you why you are calling them and then tells you that you just have to wait until you can contact the owner.

Bottom line, they can keep their very poorly run business, too many other competent and honest dealers around.

Izzy is knowledgeable, personable, and professional.  He spent time with me on the phone to ask questions about my plumbing issue (high water pressure) before even coming out, which was impressive.  He was able to come out quickly and quoted a very fair price for the job and completed it quickly (but didn't rush).   He explained everything he was doing as he worked so I never felt like I was in the dark or that he was doing anything unnecessary.  I would definitely recommend Perez Plumbing and won't hesitate to call them in the future if needed.

I'm a real estate investor who just moved to the Tampa area. It was a nightmare trying to find a roofing coma only to give me a good price that fit my budget and was also a professional. I gave Anival a call and he gave me the best price (out of about 10 roofers) and just made my life so easy from that point on. Soon after I got the price but before they did the roof, a tree fell on my house and crushed my soffit! Anival came out the next day to look at the damage and he fixed my soffit too. Matera roofing even warranties his roofs which is unheard of especially in Flordia with the high winds and heavy rain!! His guys are clean, quick and know what they are doing and as a contractor or homeowner that's all you really want. I would recommend this company to my closets friends and family and to anyone reading this review. Give this company a call before deciding on any quote!

This has quickly become my favorite and go-to theater in the area. We have a lot of choices within a 20 mile radius and this one is by far the most clean and the nicest. GREAT seats...soft and they rock. Like literally. Back and forth. Good popcorn and comparable prices.

So I would just like to point out that Bartolino's USED to be SEPARATE from the Drury Inn. It started out not too far away from the address where it is currently located. I don't remember if that was Sulphur or what the original street was....I know it is now a sports bar called Joey B's or something.....but anyway.... when my parents visited me in St. Louis after my freshman year, they decided to eat dinner at Bartolino's old location with me based on some random googling we did for good Italian restaurants. Their seafood ravioli in the vodka cream sauce was TO DIE FOR. The ravioli was perfectly cooked... a little soft but mostly al dente! They also had delicious desserts either baked in house or from local Italian bakeries. We really loved the family "vibe" we got from eating there and how nice it was to support a local, small business. Not to mention their business name was very similar to our own last name, like an Italian version.

Well, times have changed. The "new" Bartolino's is inside the Drury Inn on Hampton. It is now more like an Olive Garden type establishment than it is a smaller-scale eatery. I wouldn't say it used to be a "hole in the wall" but just a small family-style restaurant. The old location wasn't glamorous but the food was very very well made and you felt "good" about eating there. Now the food is only sub-par for the money and they always bring you way too much!!! It's a shame. I really miss the "old" Bartolino's....it seems so commercialized now and with no regard for the quality of their food. Tsk. It feels way less personal now even though they were really good about waiting on us when we all went as a family to the new location. (BTW it drove us nuts because we thought we'd had the correct address but we had no clue they moved, and so when we arrived at the old location on Sulphur, I think it was, we were beyond confused when we saw "Joey B's on the Hill" instead of our beloved Bartolino's.

Oh well. The Golden Age for Bartolino's restaurant has come and passed. Now they're just another "Olive Garden" wanna-be inside of a hotel.  :-(

This shop exceeded all expectations and provided quick service. Ever bring your car in somewhere and have a mechanic point out, on one of his new 60" screens, how your car is basically going to fall apart if they don't do a couple grand worth of work on it?  Yeah, that is not how it goes here!  I needed an oil change and asked them to do a check up on my AC  They knocked out the oil change and checked the AC.  They didn't find any problems with the AC and sent me on my way after paying $30.  Every time I went to my dealer I would walk out spending $400 on things I hadn't come in for.

If I could give less stars I would. They cut my dog's head last time. This time we went with a different groomer there and she did not follow the instructions and cut all of the fur off of two of our dogs' tails. Then the staff and groomer argued with me and said, "It's just a tail." The groomers excuse was the tail had mats in it, which it didn't. However even if it did, I as the customer should've been given a phone call to see if I wanted them to leave the tail and we brush it out or them cut it. I have gone to this groomer for years but obviously we won't be back. If you want your dog done correctly don't use this groomer. They are extremely rude to customers. I can't imagine how they treat the dogs..
Awesome place to spray tan and close to my house staff was very friendly highly recommend this place

What a relief! I would book another massage with Adelia in a heartbeat. I was traveling and had begun my trip with severely restricted motion in one arm after having slept on it wrong. She was able to alleviate my pain, restore my range of motion and wipe away all the travel kinks. She is a pleasant, articulate professional with the ability to effectively communicate, hone in on problem areas and work them out without causing additional pain in the process. And bonus - she's mobile! If I'm back in the area I won't hesitate to schedule another appointment. If you know a quality massage you will appreciate Adelia and what she can do for you.

Milmont is my comfort food place. I know how the pizza is going to be. Hot, cheesy and good! The wings can sometimes be a bit on the smaller side, but honestly, I have yet to find really good wings. But mainly I go here because I know what I'm getting, love the owners, and it's so close to my house I could walk. If I need a pizza, this is the first place I go. Their salads are huge, and I never eat a whole one at a time! I always save half of it. Hands down, Milmont Pizza all the way!

Great little dive bar. Yes, it's dodgy looking. Yes, I was WAY out of place. But yes, I think I found the new place I want to go for lunch.

The food is pretty good but basic. Weekdays they've got burgers, fried appetizers, chicken, pork tenderloin, etc. Fridays they have a fish fry with catfish, cod, and bluegill! Impressive and very midwest of them to do that. 

The best part? Prices. A burger is $2.25. Fries are $1.50 extra. Not too shabby. Did I mention 16 oz Miller Light drafts are $1.75 every day? Or $3.00 pitchers on Monday? Not bad. Not bad at all!

Service was great and friendly, they've got some big TVs, and they have a number of bar games. I'd like to go dive bar drinking there some night, maybe?

Cash only!
Just got shoulder w a six minute session and thru in a facial so now I'm feeling and looking better .
This is a great little coffee shop. I like that they're open early and the service is friendly. I didn't really see food options besides a muffin or two though. I will definitely be back.

Our order was delivered without everything that was ordered and paid for. When we called back we were put on hold forever. Then when we explained that our order was 
incomplete they asked if we could come and pick it up.  What is the reason for delivery? This so not the first time this has happened at this same Pizza Hut.  I will never order from them again.  I must say the driver was pleasant but the service as well as the food horrible.

Great massage! Two things brought me in the door: the fact I could book online and the fact I could get in quickly. 
One thing made me a loyal client: The customer service! 

Victor and I talked about why I was in and what I was looking for. I felt like I was able to customize and tailor my massage to where I felt stiff, what needed stretched and where I needed to relax. I am an athlete so I need deep pressure but I don't want it so much that I ache throughout the whole thing. Victor did great at providing a hybrid of services throughout the hour - a spots massage, deep tissue and relaxation. We then talked about pre and post competition what we could do to loosen up my muscles even more.

I highly recommend. I was comfortable and I'm confident I will be back!

It's the Saturday after Thanksgiving, for some reason I decided to order from Pizza Hut, I don't normally from here due to the inconsistency and quality of food that this location produces, however I didn't follow my gut like I should've. I actually ordered my pizza to be ready at 9pm. I arrived at 9:15, the young lady at the register asked me if I wanted to see the pizza, I accepted the request and my pizza was horribly dry and cold. I let The young lady know she told me that " the way it works is the pizza came out around 8 something " but wouldn't that defeat the purpose of having a time for your to be ready ? However I should've known better it's Pizza Hut my expectations are minimal to none when dealing with Pizza Hut. The young lady offered a 20 dollar credit on my next order. Unfortunately this isn't the 1st credit I've received. You figure things would change or tighten up but I guess that too much expect. Shame on me for thinking that. Pizza Hut you won again smdh. I also did not make a scene when speaking with the young lady at the register I really do appreciate the gesture, however if the time was followed I'm pretty sure the pizza would not have been dry & cold .
Wait in line forever, unhelpful, couldn't explain why protection covered for past 4 years and suddenly doesn't anymore.

The parking lot can be a pain in the ass but it's a very busy popular place so that is to be expected... I would give some parking lot pointers, but I don't really want to share where the best places to park are, so there are still plenty of spots for me when I get there.  LOL.  Just kidding, but seriously if I'm planning to hit a particular store, I obviously try to park as close to that as I can get because this mall is one super long straight mall and I get tired of walking back and forth. Otherwise, I find that it's easiest getting in and out if I park in the front Sears lot or way at the other end next to Boscov's.  

Anyway, once you figure out where to park, which is apparently a big issue for me, there are tons of great stores in this mall - almost everything you could wish for. The food choices aren't all that exciting, except for our favorite - Noodles and Company. There is a Chinese place that is just so-so, Sbarro's which does smell and look wonderful, Subway, Ruby Tuesday's and a couple other places.  Chick Fil A of course.

The mall is clean and nicely kept.  Overall a great mall to visit, and definitely not lacking in customers!

Excellent communication, service, and fair pricing. I appreciated Izzy's recommendations and they were trustworthy. Will definitely call them
again for future needs.

My husband and I noticed a crack in our kitchen ceiling that seemed discolored, right under our shower drain upstairs, and feared the worst. After seeing a shout out to Fisheye on Nextdoor we called them and Larry answered right away and they arrived same day. Good news: no leak found. Better news: Josh and Larry were prompt, thorough, professional, honest and didn't overcharge. It takes someone who knows what they're doing to determine you DON'T have a leak and why. Have a leak? Think you do?? These are the guys to call. Big thumbs up

This location needs to be shut down. Placed a order for delivery at 3:46. by 6pm nothing. I call the store to check and someone rudely says "ITS ON THE WAY" and hangs up, without asking my name or what the order even was. 647 i get the notification that the food is on the way. its now 1014pm as i write this, and no one never came. Very unprofessional. will NEVER order from here again. i can go to Dominos or little ceasers for all that

It's convenient, clean, and most importantly tax-free.

It doesn't have much in the way of unique stores and the anchor stores including Sears aren't likely to be here in the future. 

Still is trying to be a traditional mall place focus on just retail & too many food court-type restaurants when that concept is rapidly fading. Almost never stop here unless there is a very specific reason. 

It might hang on as people from PA continue to shop here but I wouldn't be surprised if it goes through a big revamp in the next 5 years either especially after Sears closes sooner than later.
Ice Cold Air did a great job with my enclave. Will definitely be a return customer and would recommend them.

The Mall overall is nice and small; this review is specific for 1 store within the mall.  STEER CLEAR of CELLFUN so you do not waste your hard earned dollars.  The products they sell break only after 8 days ... and conveniently their warranty is only for 7 days.  Their customer service is terrible.  They only want to help if it involves spending more money.  Save your money or shop elsewhere for your cell phone products!  You're welcome for the heads up!

I've been ordering from this Pizza Hut for years they come through every time my order is always right on time and delicious. I can't remember the last time I called so I can't talk about their phone service, I always order online.

Fantastic staff. They treat my pups like they are their own pets. They call them by name when we walk inside. They remember that my one dog had back surgery.  They always double check what service we want and the boys always look amazing. The place always smells good and is very clean. I highly recommend this groomer to anyone and everyone!!

I've been to this co-op a few times now, and although there are a few booths that don't move inventory, most of the place is kept up so you don't get tired of seeing the same stuff ( I assume they're selling it and not just moving it around). I say this as every time I'm there I make several purchases.
Now with the cold weather upon us, it's nicer than the flea markets.

Friendly staff and extra parking around back.

Dirty rooms and stains on the sheets. Tiny filthy bathrooms. Could barley shut the door. Room had a "jail" feel to it. Paid $78 a night then had to move. Went up the road to the Best Western Plus on street road near Parx Casino. Paid $89 a night and got free breakfast. Isn't the best either but at least I get a clean bed with no stains on the sheets and a bagel and cream cheese and juice in the morning.

My garage broke at 6 am on a Saturday. I was freaking out because I had to go to work at 630 and I had to leave my garage up. They were able to come to my house by 830 and my garage was fixed in 45 minutes. I am so grateful they were able to come on short notice and on a Saturday!
Another great mall in Delaware, but a little too small for my liking. There's not much of a selection when it comes to items, but it's a good mall overall.

I love living here.  The buildings were built right.  I have a window in my kitchen and the bathroom is large.  Laminate flooring is in the dining area and bedrooms.  The buildings are spread over 80 acres with lots of green space and trees.  I have plenty of heat and super hot water.  Built in air conditioners make my electric bill low. This is the best deal in Burlington County.

It is rare to walk into a coffee shop and ask the person working there about the coffee, how it was processed, sourced and roasted and not get an elitist snobbish brush off because the barista hasn't got a clue about coffee.  I was in Collingswood, NJ for the US Rowing Club Nationals regatta and during our down time we happened upon this new coffee shop.  The first thing I noticed is that the coffee wasn't over roasted and the woman working there (turned out to be the owner and her husband) were almost gleeful that I was asking questions about their coffee.  She was happy to discuss all kinds of aspects of her coffee.  That is so refreshing.  
Being hot outside I went for the cold brew.  I was then offered something that was new to me at a coffee shop.  Coffee Ice Cubes!  Brilliant.  I was offered the opportunity to sample the brew prior to purchasing it.  The coffee was fantastic.  Perfectly roasted and extracted, not bitter our sour.  What a delight.  
My final comment is that for the coffee she sells, she has the date of the roast listed so that you know how fresh the coffee is.  How I wish I had a coffee shop like this near me.  If you are in Collingswood, NJ stop in.  You won't be disappointed.

While I certainly wouldn't drive out of my way to get to this theater, it's a nice option for when I'm in the Fenton area for pet adoption events (BTW, every saturday we have dogs for adoption at the Petco down the road.. stop by!)

Love the comfy seats with plenty of leg room for my supersized self.  The lobby was super clean and there was no line whatsoever.  When I was there the staff was clearly new hires for the summer so it was a little bit of a learning curve for them but I won't deduct points for that.  They were trying!

The theater I was in was small, so I probably wouldn't want to come here opening weekend of a major blockbuster - it seems like the showings would sell out fast!

Tiny little game room but at least there are a few ridiculously over priced video games if you have a kid to occupy for a time before the movie.

We needed an addition as well as replace our existing roof. Matera roofing was extremely helpful and reasonably priced as compared to other roofers. I was concerned as they are based out of Tampa while my home is in Sarasota. They were timely and efficient and came in under what I expected to pay. Our family highly recommends this company.

My review is based on my experience with 800 Cap from September 2014 - August 2015. I lived on the first floor.

Would I recommend this place? Heck no.

1) The paper thin walls. Living here you should expect to hear everything going on with your neighbors - from the convos, to the music, to the tv, to their private business (yes, seriously.)

2) The loud water pipes - it constantly sounds like something is breaking down in the building when a toilet is flushed or a shower is ran. 

3) The "court yard" is a let down - and disgustingly dirty, full of irresponsible pet owner's dog piles of you know what. Gross. Also, people act like outraged fraternity boys and you'll find piles of puke and empty cans & bottles everywhere. Yuck.

4) We lived there for almost 9 months with no working washer & dryer. (And yes, we were told we would have one moving in.) Using the community laundry room is like hell - similar to college dorms. People throw your stuff around and no one cleans up after themselves.

5) The worst part is the management office. Upon moving in, our security fobs didn't work and no one could help us for three days. Imagine moving into a building you don't have access to. And the management never helped solve any issues. For example, my car which I paid $XX to park in their parking lot got towed away by accident, and management would not reimburse me. They could care less. Plus, they were barely in their office during their "open" hours. Funny, huh?

Now with all of that being said, I will say that before we moved out - management was entirely replaced in the building and the new individuals seemed to really be turning the place around. Responsive and actually trying to make a difference. It was nice, but too late for us.

The prices DO NOT match the means of living there. $1,500 for a cheap one bedroom with terrible management & maintenance. No thanks! Look else where.

I don't usually don't write reviews, but when saw that 800 Caps Management had received some negative reviews I felt I needed to share my experience as a resident at 800 capital I have lived here almost 2 years and have been given nothing but excellent customer service every single time I have had any interaction with the Property Manager Marshall or his staff. I have lived in many downtown Indianapolis apartments but this one I feel is truly home, besides loving my apt and the building itself having Marshall as a property manager makes living here the best living experience I have ever had he's so friendly and helpful goes out of his way to drop off packages I don't even have to ask him he just does it. He is so quick to respond to any verbal work orders that I might put in on my way in or out of the building. 800 Capitol overall is an absolutely wonderful place to call home what puts it over the top is having Marshall as a property Manager that's what puts 800 Capitol in my opinion as the number one place to live if you want to live in a luxury apartment in the heart of the city!

I enjoy following the Brownsville Antique Center on their Facebook and watching their videos. I had noticed some things that I wanted to buy so I decided to go into their store to check the pieces out.  When I arrived, there were three people who were standing around the counter. They were doing nothing and blocking the entrance. As I walked by them, they began to talk about the Kavanaugh hearing. The middle-aged heavy set woman with blond hair behind the counter was very loud. She started to say that she didn't care about the outcome of the hearing and then continued to talk about how the woman who testified was lying. She spouted off conspiracy theory after conspiracy theory as the other two sellers nodded and agreed with her. I could hear her as I went upstairs to the second floor. Her voice was shrill and annoying. I could hear her screeching all the way to the third floor. I decided to leave because I do not want to give my money to a business that screams about their political views as I'm trying to relax and shop. I'll spend my money elsewhere.

I LOVE THIS PLACE - Just saw THE EAGLE there the other night.  I love stadium seating.  The management does a great job of curtailing the antics of the teenagers, meaning there is no drop offs so the crew there can babysit like other large cinema's.  

Always has a Police presence also.  GREAT PLACE TO SEE A MOVIE!!!

DO NOT CONSIDER MOVING HERE! My lease is up this month and it cant come soon enough! Jennifer in the accounting office has horrible customer service and does not know how to talk to residents! All they care about is how much more money they can get from u! NEVER MOVE HERE YOU WILL BE DISAPPOINTED!!

Hey, I happen to like this mall. This place is like a nice slice of cake. You don't need a large mall to get the things you need. I found this store that sold interesting party clothes. If you want to dress sexy or slutty, this mall have what you need.

Me and two of my friends went to try and see the Nun and two of us are 16 and the other 17. We had already paid on Fandango thinking it would be no problem. The girl working asked for our ID's which I completely understand the rules of that, but she was very rude, smiling at the whole fact we had paid 40 dollars for the tickets and couldn't get in. Then she told us we couldn't see it (I UNDERSTAND) but NEVER offered money back, I had to ask. I understand rules, but be polite next time, THANKS. (:

Great place, easy to find. I was a walk in and was able to do a full body Cryo and be done in about 15 minutes. Felt great when I left, only disappointment was that I was inquiring about other services and was told I would be contacted and never was. Was a bit surprised since it was a 300.00 service I was asking about.

This has quickly become my favorite movie theater.  Well worth the drive, even if you don't live in or near Fenton, this is a place that you have to check out. 

Most importantly, this theater has reclining leather seats in every theater.  I have never been so comfy (aside from maybe chilling on a couch at a theater or at home) while watching a movie.  My bottom was in heaven.

Also, the place is clean.  Like surprisingly and magically clean for a theater that's been open for a while.  Your feet don't stick to the floor like at Ronnie's, and the patrons don't seem as teeny bopper or (excuse me if I offend) as disgusting as they are at Ronnie's 20.  Even the concession stand is clean, and you get to apply your own butter like substance to your popcorn, so whether you want it drenched or you want to avoid it altogether, it is in your control.  (Bonus points for the popcorn not being so salty it burns your lips).  

The prices to see a movie are as high as anywhere else, but there are some ways to go cheaply here.  Matinees are only $6.50 and all movies are $4 is you are over the age of 55 on Wednesdays (I know, not exactly speaking to the general Yelp demographic, but if I let one person know that can score on this deal, I feel like I have yelped well).  Also, free kids movies all summer long in their summer movie series.  Check out the lineup on their website.  

Altogether, a great little theater buried behind Gravois Bluffs.  If you are tired of the Wehrenburg monopoly in this city, I highly suggest checking it out.

I called these guys on the phone and asked them if they had a selection of men's leather coats. The woman told me "Yes we have plenty of coats!". So I drove there from Pennsylvania and what did I find? They had only one leather coat in the whole freaking store! I have bought leather coats from them in the past. I don't know if I'm more disgusted or just plain angry. Why lie to me over the phone? If they didn't have any leather coats I would have understood. But no, they lied and said they did have them, when they absolutely did not!!! I am supremely pissed at them!!!!!!!!!!

What happened to them? That used to be a great store and now they look like crap!!

Okay... I've lived around Milmont for 37 years+ and can easily, easily say that Milmont Pizza is hands down the best food joint in town. Every item on their menu is the best of that item in comparison to any other place around here. I'm constantly buying their strombolis, chicken salads (packed with beautifully seasoned chicken), pizza, fries and cheesesteaks. Seriously, you can't go wrong with Milmont Pizza and I'll have words with anyone who speaks otherwise! Lol. 

No lie, Milmonts the best and the couple that runs the joint are incredibly sweet people. Give them a try.

I came by in a rainy Saturday. I have a thing for checking out the local pizza places when I am in a new area. This is a small local establishment with very little seating inside. They do not sell pizza by the slice, only small, medium, and large pies. I ordered a cheese pizza. The sauce and cheese were delicious. The crust reminds me more of a chain type crust like Dominoes, or Papa Johns. I enjoy my pizza slightly crispier. Still enjoyable though!!
Fisheye used some nifty equipment to find a challenging water main leak that left me very impressed. Highly recommend!

I have only gone to this theatre a few times when I have gotten free screenings through Gofobo and I have to say its very nice and I enjoy going there.

It hardly ever seems crowded, even on the screening nights because it appears everyone who shows up can get into it.  The seats are rockers which allows you to relax more.  I haven't bought any concessions there but I like how they have a variety of flavors you can add to your popcorn (you pass the big display for it whether you buy or not).

I really like this theatre, different option from Wehrenberg and AMC and somewhat close to my house.  I will be back time and time again.

I have had two different sessions and I can't say enough about the level of professionalism and the truly relieving massages. I was in extreme pain from muscle spasms and Adelia was a pro and was able to relax the spasms. I am impressed with her experience and I will recommend her time and time again. If you need deep tissue work or just want to relax with a gentle massage, she has the training and experience to support your needs as well as being a pleasure to have in our home.

You're paying to see a movie, sit in a leather seat with some decent snack options, not get snarked at by snarky employees..of a theater.

I understand that not showing up 20 minutes prior to the movie may in some way seem insulting to the cinephiles behind the counter, however when I'm shelling out cash for a ticket I don't need the snarky attitude, I swear when I lived by this place EVERY time I went to see a movie, if I wasn't early? I got attitude, once (after purchasing my ticket and going to stand in line at the concession stand) I even got snarky evil eyes, because I was clearly not concerned about catching the previews.   Personally, I don't care about a leather seat, I'd rather have a friendly attitude, Needless to say, I rarely visit this place if I can help it!

Goes to counter. Cashier just looks at me dead eyed. Says nothing. I say "I will have a popcorn and a sofa please". Cashier glares at me... "is that all" she responds in a harsh have beaten tone. 

Will never be coming back to here super rude staff. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
Next time you show an over 3-hour long epic film with an intermission, keep your concession stand open for the intermission.

My dog needed his shots updated and they wouldn't even let me schedule an appointment in advance even though I told them I would bring them the day of appointment. Poor customer service will be going somewhere else!
Great place to have a cold one. Good drink prices and friendly bar tenders except Patricia every now and then. Great person but don't piss her off
Milmont pizza! This place has been in my life for a very long time, try the cheesteaks or wings , best pizza in the area !

DO NOT ORDER DELIVERY FROM HERE. You'll end up waiting way longer than advertised and more than likely, your food will be just "warm". Oh........and according to one of the female manager, their drivers don't get out of the car no matter how close the curb is to your door (because Mount Airy is supposedly so dangerous), so if they don't have  correct number when they call you from the curb, your sh!t out of luck. You've been warned.  

Order take out and everything is great.

The bathroom at this theater was beyond disgusting, I used the restroom upon arriving before the movie I was there to see and one stall had blood on the toilet went to next stall which wasn't the cleanest, but usable, sat down to see puke splattered on the wall. My husband mentioned to the manager, Matt, that the restroom needed to be cleaned in a nice and respectful way. I get it, shit happens and maybe you just didn't know. After the movie was over I visited the restroom once again to find they had not touched it at all in the 2 hours that we had been in the movie. Found another manager, Josh, let him know about the bathroom condition and he said he knows and he's really sorry. Really?? 2 hours and no one could clean the bathroom. Unacceptable. We will not be visiting this theater ever again.
Decent little mall has a chick fil a which is a BONUS!

Recently went here for a free screening of The Wolverine with US Bank and Visa. Had a really good time.

The popcorn was great and mainly the seats were very comfortable. Our recent MX Movies trip left me wanting more from a theater seat and I think I found it. 

I am a stickler for a focused movie experience with the theater being a non-intrusive part of the movie. For example the seat, the sound, video quality and the ambiance. This theater hit everyone perfectly.

I doubt I  will be back out this way but if I do find myself in Gravois and hankering  for a movie, I will be stopping here.

This place was the worst i ever had in area. Called up for delivery and was told 40 min. It was 2 hours and still no food. Called at 90 mintues after order to get a busy signal for ever. Had to go to store and see if it was ready, They only had half the order and the other half was not even on ticket. Told them it was real bad and will never go back again. Place had like 20 people working and had no idea what they were doing.

I waited for 6 months after moving into get a fair impression of the place before reviewing.  Well let me tell you, it is a GREAT place to rent an apartment.  The price is the best in the area, and includes free heat, and bonuses for paying your rent on time.  we have 24 hour security, a gated manned entrance, and very well maintained grounds.  They are constantly making improvements to the place.  They just repainted all the reserved parking place numbers. Which shows they sweat the small things. The litter is always picked up.  Snow removal.  lawn mowing, everything is done right.   As for the apartment itself, its great.  Its spacious, with a balcony.  Everything works as its supposed to, and I am told, maintenance is great, but I've never needed any.  Perhaps the reason this place needs to offer so much, unlike other places, is that because being set back off the highway, its kind of hidden, unlike surrounding places on 130 or 73, you wouldn't even know its here, if you weren't looking, so they try just a little harder.

As a disgruntled Wherenberg's theater customer, this establishment was a huge escape. The location was convenient enough that I didn't have to drive that far to see a nice movie. Once I entered, I was impressed. The floors in the lobby were clean and the restrooms were brightly lit and clean as well! Wow, what a huge difference from the raggedy Arnold 14 Cine! 
I was also surprised at the pricing: seniors and military can come into this theater for $7. Yes, this theater offers a military discount. (Hint, hint: Wherenberg theaters are you listening?) 
When I entered the main theater to watch the presentation, I was also surprised to see a huge amount of red colored leather chairs that were also very comfortable to sit in. The theater was also nicely decorated in circus themed colors that didn't distract too much with the main presentation. And the sound coming from their speakers was nice. 
Is this a theater that I recommend for a once in a while movie release visit? Hell, yes! I will be definitely coming back in the future!

Can I also add that the concession has Coke Zero? Hurrah!

DO NOT BRING YOUR LARGE DOG!

This facility is not equiped to handle large dogs and should state this beforehand. When I arrived to pick my 110 lb hound, I was informed it took 2 groomers to lift him into the 4 foot tall tub. He is still hurting a week after his appointment.
They should have used the self service tubs, normal height bathtubs.......

I'm drooling just thinking about the trifecta of movie food to buy at their food court: blue slushie, popcorn with butter, and Raisinets. It's my go to purchase with a movie. Trust me on this. In order to have a 5 star experience here, you must buy this combo.

Ok. Now on to your regularly scheduled Yelp business review...

I love this theater! It's clean. The staff are courteous. There's plenty of parking. They always have the latest movie listings, and it's close to lots of other well known stores. It's my favorite go to spot for a girls' day out for fun!

Go. Have fun. Spend too much money. And   enjoy the escape from reality with a few hours spent with make believe on the big screen. 

PS Don't forget the trifecta - it's GOTTA be the blue slushie too. There are no substitutes. :)
Tax free I've said enough, self explanatory.....if you want to void lots of people this is the place to go.
Long waits. Who would think to make hotdogs on a Friday night. Been waiting at snack counter for 10 min.

Seats are nice but service is terrible. My movie started 25 minutes late tonight, while we just sat in the theater waiting for someone to fix the screen as it was frozen. Finally, we got up to go ask what was going on, and they were able to fix it. But not until we got up to go ask them to. No one was even watching or paying attention to make sure that the movies work and start on time. No apology from anyone no attempt to make things right. Very frustrating!!!!
The theater is kinda small but, it is a great place to go! I always get a good seat and they are very comfortable. And they are rocking chairs! Go before noon and you can see a movie for $6.25!

I saw the latest Twilight movie here earlier this summer. And, no, I'm not going to tell you why, because it was not my idea. I was just being polite. And, movies is movies, who doesn't like going? 

But, the reason this theater sticks out in my mind from all the other big box locations, is that it has BIG BUCK HUNTER. YES, that's what I said. BIG BUCK HUNTER. And, the game room, albiet small, was not overrun by the children when I went, making it even better that I didn't have to wait for the children to get out of my BIG BUCK HUNTER way. 

Add some Diet Coke, the fact that it isn't Ronnie's in South County, and you've got yourself a pretty good ending to a nice day of shopping on the Bluffs.

This was our second time here. The first time was fine, but this visit didn't go as well. We went to see the limited showing of Allegiance, arrived early, and were pleased they were already seating. We headed up to the top row of seats, and the floor was sticky all the way across the aisle, so clearly it wasn't cleaned properly, even though it was the first show of the day. The show was supposed to start at 12:55, but finally at 1:12pm one of the other guests got up and went to let someone know the audience was still waiting. Awesome!!!

Milmont pizza is the truth. I consider myself a pizza aficionado. Everywhere I go, I need to hit up a local pizza joint to at least grab a slice-- so I can see what the natives consider good pizza. One may ask, who sets the bar? What standard do I hold these foreign pizza parlors to on my pizza tasting excursions? The answer is quite simple, and that is my hometown Milmont Pizza, of course. 

Everywhere I go, I try and find a place that can replicate their perfect crust. Not too thick, not too thin. Crisp and crunchy at the top, but not too rigid towards the flesh of the pizza where others might crumble. Equally important, it's not too flimsy or thin where the cheese and toppings slide right off the pizza when you pick it up-- I friggin hate that. It has the perfect texture and consistency. The crust is at the very core of what makes this pizza so good. It is its heart and soul. I cannot say enough good things about it. 

Almost as important, the cheese to sauce ratio is spot on. Each bite is perfectly proportioned goodness. The sauce is flavorful, and NOT chunky-- which I hate. The cheese is packed with flavor from the oil, and it pulls with stringy goodness after you draw back from a bite like mozzarella cheese should. 

It's also worth noting their "medium" sized (and priced) pizza is what most parlors consider a large. You can get a large 16" pizza here for like $10 I think. And it's GOOD quality pizza. I don't know any other place that can replicate that. Believe me, I've looked. 

Family owned and run, Milmont Pizza has been a staple of this neighborhood for years. It embodies and represents everything pizza, and a pizza parlor, SHOULD represent. If Friday night is your family's pizza night, make Milmont Pizza your Friday tradition. You won't regret your decision.

I left feeling renewed and refreshed and she really helped with a big problem area for me which is between my shoulders. I am confident anyone would have a great experience with any of the massage therapists at Body & Soul Massage Therapy and I highly recommend them if you are looking for this service.

We ordered elotes and the corn was not grilled properly as it was cold on the sides.The Sangria was made with frozen berries straight from the freezer(we saw one of the worker carrying the fruit container),the baja tacos was made with frozen cod fillet, lacked any flavor or character and had a terrible taste to it.Overpriced and terrible food is not a combination that you want to mix when starting a new business.

Do not rent here!!! Their equipment is sub standard and faulty. Rented a boat for 8 hours the bilge pump did not work!!!  The boat started taking on water and started to sink No Flares on the boat!!! The employees had absolutely no concern and thought it was funny didn't even know what the protocol was said owner on way - the owner shows up no concern he never came never asked if we where okay until after we had to have the marina call him!!! We spent over hour floating in the water while boat was sinking in the gulf waiting to be rescued they didn't care only about there faulty equipment. Refused to refund our money and until after insurance investigation did nothing but COA!!!!  This place is unsafe and dangerous do not go here!!!!

Not really a favorite store. Small house with creaky floors. If you have problems doing stairs, this place isn't going to work well. They do seem to have a good mix of antiques. I have always found the owner to be nice, unlike the other reviewer. There isn't much room for large furniture, except in the back building, but it seems to be hit or miss when it comes to finding things I like. The one booth with all the glassware never seems to change.
The mall is the worse mall. It has no security.  Restaurants serve food that is one step away from the trash cans.

Dennis and his team worked in a timely fashion and where honest and treated me with respect 
I'll always return and recommend Ice Cold Air to anybody 
great service great price 
thanks again

Milmont does it right -- pizza, wings, good service. Good people making good food when you're in the mood for it. I've only ever had excellent experiences with this neighborhood gem. Highly recommend.
Exellent place, very tasty and well portioned meals, great service, amazing drinks, I completely love this  restaurant, highly recommended.

We recently have experienced huge water bills which the city suspected was coming from a leak somewhere. We figured out it wasn't inside and first called a different leak detection company who came and couldn't find the problem and ultimately never came back to finish the search. Another month, another huge bill. Next came a recommendation from the local irrigation store to call Larry at Fisheye. Such a great choice! Larry and his son came same day I called and found a rather huge leak deep in our irrigation system.  He is also a plumber so went above and beyond to replace the main line so there won't be more problems in the future. 

These guys know what they're talking about and won't leave until they find the problem. They have a big truck so need to leave to get parts etc., I would highly recommend Fisheye for a future problem or for plumbing needs. They were friendly and professional. I trusted them immediately. Larry also made notes to turn in to city to hopefully get some money off my water Bill.

We'll I've been here once, and that was it LOL. Anyway the mall looks nice just wish i went back. Anyway went to Cafe Rivera with my mom had a slice of pizza didn't have time to check out the stores but i did go to the Christmas Tree Store. Awesome store they have lots of Christmas decorations all sorts of stuff. Anyway give concord mall a 5 star for an great location.

We first called to find out what it would cost to install our water system in our garage with this company. We were shopping. Installing such a $2500 + system is not an immediate decision. There are many factors and so we wanted to gauge the pricing and their advice in the market before making a final decision on any company.

A couple of weeks later we called to set a time and date for the instillation as we believed they were reasonably priced and were familiar with our system. More importantly, the install would have to now be outside as our water main is located on the opposite side of our garage. The call was about the installation outside, a stable foundation to place it on, and the price of it all.

Our call was met with the most rude, unprofessional, and low treatment from the "manager". This woman, this so called individual in a "manager" position chastised me on why we yet have not decided on them and that we already called a couple of weeks ago. I in turn asked the plumber's number so my husband could contact him directly and discuss all of the details as there was no way I would continue speaking to this repulsive individual. She in the end did not give me the plumber's number who would be serving our home and ended up hanging up the phone on me.

I asked my husband to call and settle this issue with the "manager" - the same person answered the phone. The second conversation was also met with unprofessionalism and also hung up.

I came here for dinner with a few friends as they have both been here in the past and had good experiences. This was my first time visiting Maria. The restaurant had a beautiful wall at the front entrance where you can take some nice photos. They had some live music playing which was a nice touch. 

Once we sat down, we took a look at the menu online via the QR code on the table. We decided to share some nachos, and tacos. We also ordered the Horchata to drink. We ordered everything at the same time. This restaurant is short staffed, just like pretty much anywhere right now so we can totally give them some grace. 

Our nachos came first, about 30 minutes after we ordered everything. The waitress did not even bring us any water or drinks while we waited for our food which was a bit disappointing. The nachos were really good, they are layered and packed full of cheese and beans just delicious. Our tacos came about 10 minutes after we received our nachos, we weren't quite ready to tackle those but we decided to eat them because we did not want them to get cold. 

We ordered the beef barbacoa, the baja fish, and the shrimp tacos. All were delicious flavours and really yummy. My favorite would have to be the beef and the shrimp although the shrimp doesn't have much to it other than shrimp and cheese, it was delicious. The only downfall was that our tacos were cold. The inside was cold, and the tortillas were cold as well. My friend sent her tacos back to be warmed because she said this is really not how they should be eaten. I was too hungry at that moment to do that but I agreed. 

We asked for some boxes for our leftovers as it was a lot of food and we didn't finish it all. Once we got our boxes and rested for a little bit from eating everything so quickly, we decided to order dessert. We settled on the flan and ordered it with our server. Well, we waited 30 minutes and no sign of the flan. I know they are short staffed and the restaurant was busy that evening but 30 minutes? We flagged someone down and asked them where it was so they went to check for us. Very shortly after that, our flan came. Perhaps our server forgot about the flan. Anyways, it was good, nice consistency, light and airy but it was SUPER sweet so much so that we didn't finish the tiny flan between the three of us! 

Overall, I think Maria still has come kinks to work out. The prices were higher than most Mexican restaurants and the server did not really explain what the difference is between the "North Mexican" cuisine compared to the rest of the Mexican places in town, that might have helped. I know it's downtown Edmonton so it's a premium location. The decor inside was lacking for me. It felt a bit disjointed except for the front wall, the colors and the very few decor pieces didn't really seem to match. Honestly I could care less about decor if the food is great. I think it has a lot of potential but unfortunately for my first visit being served cold tacos was a bit disappointing. 

I would consider coming back again perhaps not on a Saturday next time to give them a second chance.

On the advice of a friend and some internet searching, I found Victor Reyes of Body & Soul Massage Therapy. His credentials showed that he was well educated and skilled in multiple styles of massage therapy. As an added bonus, you can see what appointment times are available online and book right there. His rates were very reasonable so I decided to book online. I quickly received an e-mail confirmation and intake forms that I could fill out ahead of time. So far? Impressed!

Victor's practice is currently located inside of a trainer-only gym called Fitness by Design. I was a bit worried upon arrival that the noise of the gym would be audible inside the massage room. Thankfully it wasn't. I mean...not even a little bit. Victor welcomed me, discussed my areas of concerns, the amount of pressure I like, my experience with massage and then we were off and running...more like laying!

Victor lived up to EVERYTHING I expected and let me tell you...I expect a lot! Victor has one of the best overall massages I have ever had. Long strokes, firm pressure, attention to areas that need more work. He did it all and he did it well. I believe he ended up combining some different massage techniques to meet my needs. Perhaps a bit deep tissue, a bit sports massage? Whatever it was...it was pure bliss and I didn't want it to end. I booked a 60-minute massage because it was my first time here. Next time...and believe me...there will be a next time....we're going for a full 90 minutes.

Honestly, I can not say enough good things about Victor and his practice. If you're looking for a massage therapist that knows his stuff...give Victor a try. You owe it to yourself!

This laid back small shop is a gem. They do pour overs, espresso drinks and more. Great spot for groups of 4, never crowded but they have a spot in the back for bigger gatherings. Beans are delicious. I love a place that does the pour over well. Highly recommend their Gautemelon. Great location with street parking and a lot behind. Great spot!!

I've come here 3 times, the first was to see Oculus, and the last two times to see The Purge: Anarchy. This theater is beautiful inside and has amazing seating with moveable arms, so if you are like me and don't want to be restricted by the seat arms, you'll love the seating. It's always clean and comfortable, and the staff is always so friendly. I love this theater, it's definitely the best in the St Louis area. As many mentioned, this place isn't Ronnie's, and I am very thankful for that. Tonight I encountered the manager at the concession stand and he was so kind, just as the other employees are. Let's not forget, these employees know the proper way to mix two icee flavors, they don't just do half and half. This place is centrally located near a ton of stores and restaurants and worth the drive- I mean it.

I originally called Perez plumbing to change out the bidet. Miguel, a Perez team member recognize that my tank overflow was deteriorating quoted me a reasonable price and fix the tank replaced the parts and installed my new bidet all within and hour and hung around a few more minutes to make sure there was no leaking or any other problem that would occur. Miguel was courteous,professional and had a big smile on his face the whole time. I would recommend Perez plumbing to all. The price was right the workmanship was superior, they came in and took care of what had to be done and  more. They also left with a new client I will be having them install another bidet next month

If you had asked me what I thought about this place back from 1984-2008, I'd have told you "the best times ever spent throughout my youth and 20s!"  Since I was born and raised in Wilmington, Delaware and spent about 23 years living there, Concord Mall was like a 2nd home to me.  I even worked there in 2001-2003 at their F.Y.E. music/movie store until being transferred to the one at Christiana Mall.

But, from what I have read recently, the mall is definitely not what it used to be.  As times change, money flows, and bigger business have come to take over in droves...

I remember a time when Concord Mall didn't even have a McDonald's!

I remember when they had a Friendly's!

I remember when they had BOTH a Sam Goody and The Wall!

I remember back to a time when they actually had a video arcade that was known as 'Space Port'!  The ultimate 80s video game center to enjoy yourself while spending tons of quarters on games like Pole Position, Pac-Man, and Outrun!

But alas, that was then...and this is now.  

Sometimes I think malls like this are just going to end up dying out.  It seems like the stores/restaurants that take up the space are better suited just for outdoor shopping plazas and don't even need to be housed inside a mall like this one.

Maybe on my upcoming honeymoon back to Wilmington, Delaware I may just take a quick walk thru the place for nostalgia sake, but I'm sure it just won't be the same, like when I went to Christiana Mall back in the Summer of 2010.  That place had changed so much it felt like a huge chunk of my childhood had been taken away.  Like that song 'Big Yellow Taxi', "they repaved paradise and put up a parking lot..."

Here's to the good old days of memories of Concord Mall 1984-2008.

I've been in here several times and just love the vibe! The owner, Debbie, truly loves all things coffee and even I, a non-coffee drinker, can see the passion she has for it! She and her staff have gone above and beyond to accommodate my son's food allergies, and my kids LOVE the backroom with the games and trains.
Best pizza shop in Delco!  I've been going to Milmont for the past 6 years and have never had a bad meal and everyone is always so nice.

The era of the American shopping mall is slowly grinding to a halt - with the demise of the Granite run mall and slow decline of Concord and Springfield Malls (Concord has many empty stores.)

The good part?  Plenty of parking - and at lunch there is a Chick Fil-A and a grub burger bar (have not tried), a Sbarro, Auntie Anne's Pretzels and more.

There is also a Bath & Body works and a Victoria's Secret for when I need one nearby.

Glad it's here but I bet in 10 years it won't be.

Had a great experience here. Clean and slick. Highest end equipment and products. The owner was friendly and informative. He and his manager wanted to make sure my experience there was the best. I got teeth whitening and a spray tan. I love the results for both!!!!   I will be back very soon for all the other services they provide. Highly recommend!!!!

Had a leaking washer valve;called Fisheye Leak Detection and Larry was very professional, courteous, and provided me with an estimate; he was prompt, professional, and replaced the washer valve and hoses; was amazed that he went above and beyond and installed my washer and dryer(made  my day). I will be utilizing his services for any future plumbing issues. Thank you Larry!

Larry helped me with a broken water pipe under my front sidewalk last year and I was so happy with his work at that time, that I called him back this year when I had a problem with my water pressure regulator. Larry and Josh came out the very same morning that I called, which was great, because I had a pretty fast leak.  They zeroed in on the problem right away and fixed the leak which was inside the wall!  They are super friendly and really know their "stuff"! Prices are very reasonable too. When I have another water problem, I know who to call. Thanks guys.  :)

Feeling blissful when I get coffee from here sums it up pretty well. Awesome new coffee place in the wood. I honestly only wanted to come to this place because they posted a picture on Facebook of ice t the rapper on their ice tea....I mean who doesn't love a good pun! So glad that got me in because it's adorable inside, super fresh yet homey. On my first visit I got the iced latte with one pump of mocha. It was so good I debated going back for another. My second visit I got the house blend cold brew which had awesome flavor and I got a great energy bump after. The owner roasts her own beans I believe and you can tell she knows her stuff! Super friendly staff and looking at their social media page they seem very eager to please and are open to recommendations. 

They also offer a great seating area in the back that is separate from the café area. Equipped with a plethora of board games (they have uno, we checked, your welcome). The decor is on point here! Also if you have a pup I noticed they had a water bowl and treats outside. I now look forward to Tuesday lattes with my silver Fox here. I can't wait to see what's to come for this great shop and wish the owners nothing but the best! Give this place a try for sure you'll be hooked!

Stadium style seats.  That's all I should have to say.  The sound quality in every theater I have been in has been extremely high.  No crackling, popping, etc.  The picture has never been anything less than perfect.  This is hands down our favorite theater in the area.  The crowds are usually respectful enough to kill their cell phones before the movie starts.

Concessions are over-priced, but hey it's a theater and expected, right?  Tickets run about a buck more than I remember other places costing, but I haven't been to another place in several years now.  I would happily pay the extra dollar.  The seats are extremely comfortable and you never have to worry about people sitting in front of you.

The staff is always friendly and they burn through any line that may form.  I am guessing on that last one because we have NEVER waited in line there.  We also don't venture out on Hunger Games Opening nights!  If you are in the area and you want to catch a movie, this is the place to go.  They have since rebranded to Regal I believe, but it hasn't changed a thing about the way they were operating or caring for the facility & customers.

The menu items and drinks cost a bit more than other places. But they do give you a huge amount of meat, and offer you more tortillas to finish. Tacos are served Mexican street style (no orange cheese or lettuce a la Texmex), but you get your money's worth of meat. Great margaritas and pina coladas.

Service was a bit slow considering it wasn't busy, this is not the place for a quick meal, but to take your time chatting and enjoying your drinks and food.

Note they use wheat flour tortillas, most other places use corn tortillas. This could be a plus or minus depending on your preferences and dietary requirements.
The mall employees and security violate breastfeeding mothers' rights asking them to leave. Wish I could give them 0 stars!

I went in to have my glass protector replaced (under my current plan) and have an Exchange mail issue looked at.  After a very confusing exchange where Jena tried to charge me $20 for something, I asked if there was a Manager available and she bluntly said no.  I asked if she could contact him and she said that he wouldn't answer her if she tried.  Then she proceeded to text him (Frank).  Long story short, the $20 fee wasn't valid and I endured the worst customer service experience I've had in years.  I have purchased all of my business and personal devices from this store for many years.  I will now be going elsewhere.

Ryan was working at this location (1017 Broadway Ave. in Boise) when we came in. It's my understanding he's usually working in a more corporate customer service office for Verizon versus selling phones, but he really hooked my husband and I up. He provided great customer service and was honest with us when we decided to come back to Verizon (I was a loyalty customer with Verizon before getting temporarily duped by AT&T). Verizon gave us a way better deal than AT&T, the staff was honest with us, and Ryan really went above and beyond to explain deals to us clearly and listen to our needs. He helped us set up a business plan, which saved us even more money, and got us a much better plan in the process. We walked out of AT&T with broken phones that barely worked on WiFi. We walked out Verizon as loyalty customers for life. 10/10

It should first be pointed out that I live in Fenton, so at a minimum when this theater was built I was going to give it a try and be a big fan of the location. But luckily, I can say with honesty that this is one of my favorite movie theaters in all of St. Louis experience-wise (save the Wehrenberg Galaxy 14 in Chesterfield with the Digital Mega Screen and the Five Star Lounge).

Pros:
 - all screens are digital screens - i refuse to watch on regular screens
 - Coke and Diet Coke!!
 - super comfortable seats... some of the best in the city (except for the aforementioned Five Star Lounge)
 - electronic ticketing machines just inside the entrance
 - ticket purchasing via http://www.greatescapetheatres.com/
 - Rarely swamped with ridiculous crowds like Ronnie's 20

Cons (these would take it to the 5-star stratosphere):
 - No Digital Mega Screen (no mega screen at all)
 - Nothing comparable to the food choices or service of the Five Star Lounge in Chesterfield at the Galaxy 14
 - You can't swipe your card and print your tickets at the electronic ticket machine like you can at other theater chains. You have to go through the ticketing line.

My dad and I wanted to rent a boat for some fun after a long weekend of moving and I'm so happy we found this place! The rental process was extremely easy and we were out in the water in no time. Although we are experienced boaters, Captain Stacy was very informative and showed us how to operate the specific boat we'd be using and helped us navigate the area. He was also right there waiting for us when we returned to help us dock. Overall a very pleasant experience and would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a few hours of fun!

Let me start be saying that I have successfully performed my own pool equipment maintenance, modifications and updates since 1974.

Recently, I encountered a problem that baffled even me. My pump was "starving" for water and would not "prime."  I could tell, from the sight gauges, that the pump was sucking air on the intake side of my system. I tried everything in my bag of tricks and still came up without an indication of where the air leak was located.

My home plumber highly recommended Fish Eye Pool Leak detection as the only people to fix this. The owner, Larry, was heavily booked but cut me out a slice of time and came by to analyze the situation. He inspected the Jandy value controlling the input from my pool and spa and said he was 99% sure that it was the problem. Since Jandy claims that their valves are maintenance free I guessed that Larry was wrong. But "against my better judgement" I agreed to let Larry follow his "head."

Larry obtained some very inexpensive internal parts, returned to my home, and in no time had the leak fixed.

I am in awe of this guy and his deftness. You can't go wrong here !!

Dick'll
Newbury Park, CA
Service was fast, courteous, effective, professional, and well-priced. Highly recommend!
I always recommend this place to anyone looking for an honest mechanic. Dennis is awesome and genuine

We're so lucky to have another coffee roaster in town! There are lots of different kinds of roasts to choose from, and the espresso drinks are good, too. The space itself is cozy, especially the "library" space in the back. And the owners are super nice!

Like most American malls there's just little to nothing left here. 25% of the stores are empty, especially post-COVID. A giant Sears, a Lane Bryant, just vacant. Hot Topic is gone. You're basically left with a bunch of chains that are in every mall (Claire's, H&M) and then a bunch of off brand garbage stores like "Cool Topic" and "CellFun".

There's just no point in going.

Dennis and Team did a professional job in resolving my daughter's AC issues. Two mechanics in Gainesville could not permanently fix the AC issues, so we brought the 2009 Honda Civic to Ice Cold Air on Court Street in Clearwater Fl. for service. Although we had to bring the car back a few times because the air would not stay cold, Dennis and his team worked on the vehicle and fixed all issues at their expense, and they made it a priority on a Saturday morning. This shop has a very high degree in quality control and assurance!!! They stood by their work to get it done until it was correct. We definitely would come back and highly recommend them. Their prices were also very cheap.

The owner, Sharon is knowledgeable, straightforward and easy to work with.  She runs her business unlike most other auto repair shop owners / managers that seem to do their best to put up road blocks for a pleasant repair experience.  Her "can do" attitude and reasonable pricing has made her shop my "go to" place for auto repairs.

So when you park in the back there are two buildings to go into and both are worth a visit. There's the main house and then there's the carriage house in the back. There's a delightful variety of things. They are vintage things and then there are some New items that have a vintage feel to them like greeting cards and handmade Xmas ornaments ! As for the antiques and vintage goods , walk around and take a look! And if you need some thing in particular there is a very very nice & helpful  lady named Angel who can help you find what you need.  Whether it's a particular color of Pyrex or whatever!  It's amazing to see how much stuff folks can accumulate! But it's easy and a place like this because there's really sweet oldies music playing and such nice staff like Angel... I start to feel good and accumulate all sorts of amazingly adorable knickknacks!! I definitely recommend this to my friends and family I recommend calling first just to make sure they're open... Because of the statewide /countrywide corona restrictions . Wearing a mask is required.

Owner Larry Fish responded to my house for an irrigation pipe break under my driveway. He was fast, friendly, and very efficient in locating the area of the leak. He also advised me on replacing 33 year old aged galvanized pipe feeding the leak. He is an old school licensed plumber and comes well equipped, ready to work with no B.S. I will definitely use him again without hesitation. Thanks, Larry!!

it was a pleasure to work with perez plumbing. izzy is professional and personable. i prefer to work with self-employed vendors where possible because i am able to build a relationship rather than be a job number, even though sometimes it's unavoidable. 

when you call perez plumbing, will will talk to valerie, who is a delight and an integral part of perez plumbing. perez plumbing is priced fairly, efficient and leaves the job site clean, but the main reason i chose them over others is that they are licensed, insured and they had good and honest reviews. i am glad i chose to go with perez plumbing and i will always call them for my plumbing needs. 
mike d.c.
wesley chapel

My experience with Matera Roofing was excellent.  Everyone I was in contact with was professional, courteous, and very knowledgeable.  I had a lot of questions as I began this process and every question I asked was answered carefully and thoughtfully.  The associates that did the work on my home were very good.  The work is excellent and they were professional and treated my home with respect.  I came home every day to see wonderful progress and a very clean work site.  I would, and have, recommended them to my neighbors and anyone who asks.  Thank you for an amazing job!

My issue :I  experienced it and end of paying 745$ for replacing counters pot . There was one or two  minor bubbling in the counter pot , they have sent pictures to me.which hardly noticeable or can be cleaned or adjusted .But charged  610$ for replacement for whole counter pot ,which is use less, no need to replace that part. Recently our house had a water intrusion in a side room of our house. My wife called Larry Fish, the owner, and he immediately called her back and scheduled a time to inspect the issue. He was on-time to the minute, though we are in Santa Barbara, was extremely thorough with every detail and method to inspect the room, and utilized every tool to inspect the troubled area. Being an experienced general contractor before he started this business, Larry knew where to look and gave advice on how to tackle the issue. Larry deserves this 5 star review and I would recommend him to detect any leak in the house that one may have.

I moved to Florida 3 years ago and am so thankful to have found an auto repair place that I feel I can trust. I have made this my auto repair shop of choice. When I was in Pennsylvania I always took my car to my brother for any work that needed to be done. Being a woman, finding an honest auto repair shop is stressful because so many see a woman as dollar signs. Not this place. I took my car in recently to check a tire that was low on air and they had it fixed in 15 minutes. They pulled the tire and plugged it.

THAT is service! I had no appointment and they gave me back my peace of mind. That is priceless!

Brand new small spot in Collingswood on the other end of town with superb coffee. We only got a couple iced mocha coffees but they were quite tasty. The place is sparsely decorated with a small table and window seating which is def perfect for the small space. We had a long conversation with the owner Debbie about coffee which honestly I've never had with anyone but we were quite fascinated by. 
  We will def come as soon as possible when we are in town next.

Good regal, sitting on top of the hill up from the flooded river. We saw the Avengers, the seats were okay and lots of people talking, we got popcorn and waters from concessions. The sound quality was good and the parking lot was large.

I recently rented Floyd for a little outing with my sister and her two kids. We had some previous boating knowledge and had rented a couple boats in the past. We had originally wanted to go to Egmont key but were unable to due to weather. Captain Stacy recommended Pine Key (Beer Can Island). The boat was clean and ran great. It comes equipped with a GPS that also shows water depth (important!!). We were able to navigate out of the marina and into the bay. We had a great time and caught a few fish and a sting ray. Beer can island is a lot of fun. There was only one other boat when we visited and we were able to explore and look for shells, fish and swim. It did rain for an hour but we hung out on the island under the trees. It is easy to reserve a boat on their webpage. We may look into a pontoon next time.

Perez Plumbing went out of their way for us.
