Don't get a topping I got one little piece of sausage per slice not worth it. There was also very little sauce I mean very little felt like I was eating cheese and dough. Speaking of dough the outside edge of the pizza is ridiculous way to much dough, wish I could return the outside edge and get another pizza plenty of wasted pizza dough or maybe trade it for some sauce. The wings were plain no taste what so ever ordered them medium but they were favor less. Save yourself 30 dollars and disappointment go to Papa Johns for $11 or just get a microwave pizza both will be better. So really funny when I was ordering medium wings the person I was ordering from asked another person if they had medium sized wings. Really think I was 5 when I knew what mild, medium, and spicy wings were......there is your clue Batman avoid.

if it weren't for those freaking garlic knots Id give this place a 3.5. We did half and half pizza of both specials offered that day - 1 was a vegetarian cheese and a bunch of other stuff i can't remember and the other half was more like a meat lovers with ricotta. I thought in general everything was a little soft like borderline soggy. I like things a little crispier though. On the other hand, I was so excited when I saw those knots come out so much bigger then I expected. If its just 2 of you then a half order will be fine! I think there were 4 or 5 of them and they are large. They were amazeballs. The service was perfect too.

I am Editing my previous review because I went ahead and gave it a second try. This time I was still not in the reservation book but I did get the room. I had to request that the chalkboard and table we wiped down but after that everything was great. Service was good and food was good. We had a neighborhood safety meeting and it was hard to hear the speakers because the music was so loud but very much improved from our first visit. 


I am giving this a one star today not because of the food but more because of the un-organization all around. The food was definitely a 4 or 5 . Two or three weeks ago I called to reserve the party room. I was told I would get an email confirmation which I never did so I stopped by just to make sure. They did have my name and information written in the book correctly so I felt pretty good that everything would be ready to go. When we got there it was not ready to go. All the chairs were up on the tables and the chalkboard had writing from the last party. Paper towel holders were empty and there were no condiments. So we set it up ourselves. The bartender came in an apologized and said he didn't realize there was a party because it was not written in the book. And that sentence right there is why they get 1 star. I saw it with my own eyes that it was written in the book. Don't lie to me just explain that you were busier than expected and apologize for it not being ready. I would also like to note that not one employee had on a name tag nor did they mention there name when they said they would be helping us. I guess spending $120 on a Tuesday night is not enough to get good service. BOO!

I had the Zeus Stromboli . Whom ever came up with that combination of ingredients is to be commended. So delicious. If only I lived in the music city. I would be ordering that at least once a week. Sauce was fantastic! Crust was fresh and perfectly cooked. We had knots and pizza as well all highly recommended

What a fantastic spot! I absolutely loved their pizza! I was a little on the fence at first, but I'm officially a fan! The restaurant is small, and tucked away, and has a pretty limited menu, but my gosh was I impressed!!! My waiter was super down to earth, so friendly, and the pizza was great. 

So what makes this pizza so amazing? The flat crunchy bottom! My goodness... each bite was cooked to perfection!! Every bite was as good as my last. I'm looking forward to visiting again!

One of my favorite pizza place to go to. The staff is always very friendly at the store and or on the phone. 

The only negative part is they do not deliver!!! But honestly I don't mind making that 35 minute round trip drive from my house to the store to pick up them delicious pizza.
Best slice of New York style pizza I've had.  Super family friendly, great beer list with lots of local ones to pick from.  Definitely worth a visit.
Surprised to find deccent pizza in this town. Knowing it's an enigma, they charge you for it.  I appreciate the late window.

Stopped in for a late bite to eat with some friends. We were really hungry but didn't want to eat too much for our big dinner later. We were told the best slices of pizza could be found here. They were right. We each got a slice and it was very good. We all said we could have downed a whole pizza each. I got the special vegetarian pizza of the day. This is the first pizza place where the dough was delicious to me. I could have just ate the crust and have been happy. I would never said that about a pizza place but this, I am.

I love 5 Points Pizza. My husband loves it even more. He invited me on a "date" for dinner there one night, and there I found out he'd already been there that same day for lunch!

Great pizza, fresh ingredients, great service (even when something goes wrong), and the best garlic knots around. My favorite is the Dave's slice with prosciutto, fresh basil and parmigiano reggiano cheese. The crust is always delicious and the beer there is good too. Their spinach salad is a nice light choice if you're not in the mood for a slice. With dried cranberries, red onions and blue cheese crumbles--try the viniagrette dressing, it goes great.

We always feel at home here, whether for lunch or dinner. It does great crowded on weekend nights, so if you have a larger group or family, going earlier is better. I do love how many different types of customers there are there. Singles, couples, hipsters, families, everyday Joes -- all are welcome here.

Although I reserved a two-bedroom suite, when I arrived they said I could not get a suite, but two separate bedrooms instead.  My reservation was not honored because, as I was told by the desk clerk, people extend their stay and the hotel was an "extended stay" hotel.  The rooms were adequate and clean.  But don't expect your reservation for a suite to be honored.

It's McDonald's so the food is well...McDonald's food.  The service here is great, though, and the cashiers are friendly, FAST, and accurate with the orders.  The interior is also very clean, spacious, and well-organized despite the fact that it is perpetually busy here.  The parking lot is a bit treacherous but that's not really an issue.

So far the tastiest slice I've found thus far in Nashville as far as NY style goes. Prior to this Two Boots over in midtown occupied the zenith of my pizza rankings. I now have to move it to the second position. However I'd say they're both pretty close in quality and you can't go wrong with either. I'd give a slight edge to Five Points with regards to flavor.

Five points pizza... I want to be inside you. The server was a sweet hippy guy, they have sweet magnolia southern pecan, garlic knots to die for and the pizza... Do-what!? So good.  Great laid back vibe too. Never leave me five points pizza... Never leave me.

Love the atmosphere and the pizza. The service was quick and the staff was friendly. Someone even took the time to show my kids how to play shuffleboard.

We're kind of a plain cheese bunch but it was perfect. The crust was thin and fresh and the sauce was delicious. Really as perfect as a pizza can be. I'm sure I'll try some of the other creations at some point in the future. I hear they have a good happy hour.

Digging this neighborhood pizza joint & bar.

I am going to attempt to sum up the awesomeness that was experienced at dinner last night...great service, very accommodating to gluten free, and amazing food! 

A group of 11 of us made a reservation and upon arriving we were promptly seated upstairs at 2 tables. The server wasted no time in coming around to all of us and taking our drink order and asking if we had any questions on the menu. The atmosphere is very inviting and the seats were very comfortable. The sound wasn't overly loud even when the upstairs was completely full (that may be because we were pretty loud). There is plenty of space between the tables so you don't feel like your sitting on top of the people next to you which I personally appreciate them not packing it in like a can of sardines. 

Drinks~~We ordered a mix of beer, wine, and cocktails. They do carry Tito's vodka for those gluten free. There was no complaint on any of the drinks ordered and we enjoyed a few rounds throughout dinner. Drinks came reasonably fast so guess the bartender was on their game to keep drinks working quickly. Drinks were well made and served perfectly to what I would expect. 

Apps ~~Once we had our drinks the server came and took our order for apps. Our table got a nice variety including olives, spicy almonds, calamari, and sheep cheese. The server knew I was gluten free so he was so nice and let me know about everything that I ordered and if I could eat it. They brought bread for the table which was a homemade biscuit type loaf, everyone raved about these. They brought me a bowl of seasoned gluten free popcorn since I couldn't eat the bread which was such a pleasant surprise! 

Entrees~~There were plenty of dinner choices and I went with the lamb dish with potatoes instead of barley. It came out perfectly cooked to a slightly medium cook. The person across from me got the Amish Chicken and it looked simply amazing and he said it was delicious as well. We got the Kale, Beets, and Mushrooms as sides and all came out what looked to be buttered and all tasted fresh and were cooked perfectly. I would suggest that each side will serve about 2 people so get multiple if with a group like we were. 

Dessert~~Once we all were done essentially licking our plates (and almost literally as the 2 guys with salmon asked for extra bread to sop up the sauce) we ordered desserts.  I got the raspberry dessert since it was gluten free...it was like a custard on the bottom with a light fruit topping with fresh raspberries and little merengue type pieces on it. It was a perfect light summer dessert to finish off the meal. A couple guys got the rhubarb strawberry and mentioned they would prefer the rhubarb cooked a little more.

I've had five points several times now. Other than my first visit, all have been late nights at the pick up window. The pizza really is so awesome. I still want to dine in but this is a delicious and affordable option in leu of Taco Bell 4th meal.

Five points pizza is the best! I love their garlic knots and cheese pizza for a normal meal but Cinco De Pie-o is the most amazing pizza! Trust me- hit them up on the 5th of the month and enjoy a slice of heaven!

The rooms were clean but smelled musty. The worst part was that a wedding party was permitted to party at the pool until after midnight even thought the pool closed at 11 p.m.  This wedding party continued to hoot and holler through 2:30 a.m.  I called at 11:30 to ask if this was a hotel or a frat house and I was assured management was getting the party under control.  I was particularly upset and shared with management that I needed to sleep because I had to get up for the airport at 3:30 a.m. so needless to say no one in the 3 rooms I rented got much sleep. I was truly disappointed in the management team at this location.
Garlic knots for life. I'm not kidding. Go now. Also, a fan of getting two pieces of pizza and making a pizza sandwich. Gluttony at its finest.
Just had a piece of the best pizza in Nashville. My boss ordered in for lunch and I'm pretty sure the one I had was Brooklyn style...I'm already hooked.
Just ate this entire 14" pie - 1 slice myself so yes 5 stars... lol. Ordered garlic knots as well and great.. great pizza place... must stop if in the mood for pizza you won't regret it

We went on the recommendation of a friend and was glad we did!  Great pizza! Nice beer selection!   Also the arugula salad was great!  Casual dining, a bit noisy but that is what a busy pizza place is suppose to be!  We were there on a Tuesday night and the place was hopping!  Had prompt service and the pizza was delivered hot and ready.  Nice New York style pizza in Nashville!   Very reasonable!

So, we have been here twice now. Food is always good! 

First trip was to eat at the restaurant, other than the service at the order counter being slow, the service experience was fine. We ordered a regular salad and a caesar, both a good size for a single order. Ordered a General pizza, and a Pepperoni, all of us liked all the food. 

Second time was to pick up a to go order. Service at the order counter was timely, but the girl at one of the registers was either nervous, or indifferent to being there. One of the pizzas was a half pepperoni, the other a General again. One complaint about the food this time however, half pepperoni was more like quarter pepperoni..didn't realize till I got home with the Za. Tastes much better fresh out of the oven of course, but still pretty good. 

Pizza here is pricey compared to the cost of Pizza Guys to feed my family of 4, but then again, Pizza Guys is pricey compared to Little Caesar's, so it just depends what kind of quality you can afford that week!

I had a phenomenal experience at the Treemont.  I happened upon this spot during Restaurant Week.  It had fairly good reviews and was available at the time I was hoping to have dinner.  What a good choice!

Its easily accessible in Rittenhouse Square, and is a quaint little spot with open air windows.  The staff were attentive but not overbearing.  The drinks were delish. Not cheap, but delish.  Lucky for me, after checking in on yelp, I got a free glass of the house wine.  It wasn't stellar, but it was free!

The food however was wonderful.  It was like having a 3-4 course Top Chef Masters meal.  The best item was the Ricotta Gnudi.  Looking at it, you'll have no idea what it is.  But at first bite - you won't care.  Ultimately, I found out that its like an inside out ravioli, minus the pasta.  Its was delectable!

The dessert course left something to be desired, but it really didn't matte,r because I was so happy from eating dinner!

Enjoyed the pizza and community atmosphere.  If you want beer with your pizza make sure your drivers license has not expired, they do not serve anyone with expired IDs, even 53 year old white hair males.  Luckily I had my passport in the car.

Pricey pizza but absolutely delicious! Occasionally, even I can tolerate being overcharge just because the food is so darn good!  It isn't any wonder this little pizza parlor was on a 20 minute wait, on a Thursday evening.  Oh, can't forget about the service, very attentive and friendly.

They have pretty good specials. Especially on Saturday. They have an "all you can drink" special for $25. Also, it's a good place to have a party as well. The crowd can be ihit or miss at times, but its not bad.
This place always open for business. That comfort pizza so satisfying when you need that carb to soak up your alcohol. I mean I can't pass this place up when I'm in the area.
Best pizza outside of NYC. Lunch special is a good deal. One slice will fill you up. I dream of that blue cheese pizza

I'm not a pizza connoisseur by any means, but this is the best pie by the slice I've had in Nashville. I usually get their special slices of the day, which changes from time to time. And I am never disappointed. Parking is a bit of hassle to get there, but it's definitely worth it.
Great Pizza! Dough is light and airy and sauce is spot on. They serve late night too. Try a slice before you leave town you won't be disappointed.

The pizza is good and the Stromboli is even better.  The garlic knots are a great value as an appetizer.  They have a friendly wait staff.  You can also do slices to go on their side shop which is quick.

Ordered some wings with their regular sauce. I was disappointed. The wings hardly had any sauce on them and tasted way too salty. The carrot and celery sticks that come with the wings were really dry. I would expect better quality from $10 wings. The employees were not very friendly over the phone or in person. However, I must say that their Chicken Parmesan pizza was pretty delicious.

I love pizza and have had more than my fair share of it over the years, but Five Points ranks right up near the top... Maybe even the best I've ever had. The crust is what makes this pizza so great... It's NY style, but not too thin.... It's cooked to a perfect crisp, but not crunchy. Not to mention that their slices are ginormous! I got a couple slices of their pepperoni single slices and added prosciutto and basil to it... I couldn't have enjoyed it more!My girlfriend got a slice of the special for the day, which was a bacon, onion, and banana pepper pie. She loved hers  as well. Also ate at the bar and the bartender was phenomenal. Great place and I can't wait to go back when I visit Nashville again.I love pizza and have had more than my fair share of it over the years, but Five Points ranks right up near the top... Maybe even the best I've ever had. The crust is what makes this pizza so great... It's NY style, but not too thin.... It's cooked to a perfect crisp, but not crunchy. Not to mention that their slices are ginormous! I got a couple slices of their pepperoni single slices and added prosciutto to it... I couldn't have enjoyed it more! My girlfriend had a slice of the special for the day, which was a bacon, onion, and banana pepper pie. She loved hers  as well. Also, we ate at the bar and the bartender was phenomenal. Great place and I can't wait to go back when I visit Nashville again.

We popped in here for a quick pizza and to see the neighborhood. We all got salads and pizzas. The slices were huge and not the typical "cheese slice with half cooked toppings thrown on after the fact". Prices were good too. 

Server was funny and the salads and pizza were great. Highly recommend this cozy place for a quick lunch or cheap dinner.

The meat pizza (sausage, Roma, basil) was wonderful and the crust was thin and crispy. Would definitely go back. 
The prosciutto and basil was good too, but that's because I love basil.
Delicious Caprese pizza! Good beer selection too. The server was friendly and knowledgeable and the food arrived quickly. The garlic knots are a must!

The roast beast sandwich done right period.   You will quickly forget about ol' Arby's real quick.  The beast was done to medium rare perfection.  The horseradish cream was dynamite - I would have loved it with my prime rib.  In fact my wife swiped a small container for later.  14 cent ice cream cones for the kids and cheap custard.  You can't go wrong.

Checked online with 0 min wait. Got there any everyone was taken. Waited 5 minutes but strike 1.

Lady starts cutting my hair and forcefully moves my head to the position she wants. I specifically tell her what to do and she is 75% on but clearly hasn't done mens hair a lot. I use a #0 on the sides and back and my hair looks like Macklemore. It's not hard to understand but she didn't get it. 

So I pay, get home and see that she left a whole strip of hair in the back of my head. I live 40 min from there so I wasn't going back fffff that. I ended up trim my own damn head so it looks always clean. 

Wouldn't recommend. "Nice lady" but we aren't your bratty kids that you can man handle our heads and do a shitty haircut.

One of the best Pizza's I've had and I'm picky about pizza. The crust is hand made and tossed, tastes like soft homemade bread with a crunchy crust. I get the BBQ Chicken pizza and the sauce is perfect, not watery or too spicy, the cheese isn't so heavy that the pizza can't be eaten, but is just right and has the flavor of higher quality mozzarella, not just chewy with no real flavor like many can be. Casual atmosphere with an ale house type atmosphere. Price is a bit higher than you would usually pay for Pizza but you can order a slice combo and it's enough to fill me up for $7.00
Best pizza I have ever eaten! Great environment and lots of beer on tap. Will be a must go when back in Nashville.
Probably the best pizza in town for a traditional slice style. Still really wanting to try their grandma slice- but great fresh out the oven.
Great pizza with honey to drizzle on your end crusts. Might sound strange but so yummy.  We're trying out the cinnamon bread this time. Sounds delish!

Very good meal.over abundance of pasta, little less pasta a salad would be good.excellant music in background good service from overworked  server busboy cutie vety observsnt quick to tske rmpty plates away thsnk you very much   4 people 3 msrgatitas and a beet 1 coke $112
Seriously great pizza. Perfect garlic knots. Service is always great too. Never had a bad experience here. Haven't had better pizza in Nashville.

Love their pizza but ever since our favorite bartender left, things are not the same. The people are not as friendly as I would like at a pizza joint but I can't complain about their amazing pizza and beer.

I ALWAYS get their Blind Hawaiian with white sauce and I'm obsessed!! They have taps they change out every month as well as a good happy hour (pizza and a pitcher or pizza and a beer). Good prices...

This is also a good spot to come to watch sporting events, it's usually pretty causal and a fun time!
Phenomenal pizza! Thin crust and crispy but fresh ingredients and incredible flavor. Don't pass up the garlic knots too

Terrible service .  2 hours for 3 sandwiches.  I wanted to pull my hair out. To add insult  to  injury  the take out order was incorrect, .had to wait for that. Then the soup was incorrect to size that I paid for and in bag upside down.  
The change in the people there  has made a tremendous disadvantage to those who enjoyed going there..  I keep telling my elderly dad some changes are bad enough to move on to a better place! !!!

Best pizza I've had. The Brooklyn with garlic (minced) was incredible. We sat at the bar and had a nice conversation with another couple. The bartender was very friendly. If you are in Nashville take the trip to this place. It's worth it!!!

Tonight was the 1st time my family and I have been to The Blind Onion. Our service was great, the food was delicious. The wait wasn't too bad for a Friday night packed full of basket ball fans and little kids after baseball games. We will be eating here again and I would recommend them to any of my friends.

Flashbacks of the early 2000's had me thinking Blind Onion was no good. (We used to go to the one on Kings Row in high school and I was never a fan). We were hungry one night and I called in a pizza to this place after receiving some coupons- thought I'd give it a try because It was close to home. Ordered for pick- up, the staff advised about 15-20 minutes until ready (on a Friday night to boot) #awesome. I get there to pick up the food I ordered and it was ready when I got there. The staff was super friendly & sent me on my way with a plethora of honey, Parmesan, ranch, and red pepper flakes.. the pizza was delicious. The crust is sweet and the pizza is savory- I've never had anything like it. Needless to say; I'm so glad I put my previous opinions on this pizza behind me because my goodness!! This pizza is darn good!

I've always been a fan of Blind Onion. I must say that each location should be taken into consideration separately.  My ranking in order from best to less:
1. Wild Garlic (Mt. Rose) 5 stars
2. Blind Onion (S. Virginia)
3. Blind Onion (Spanish Springs) could tie for #2 can't tell from one visit.
4. Blind Onion (Kings Row)
5. Blind Onion (Victorian Square) 

I visited the Spanish Springs location on 9/7/15 with my 2 kids and all I can say is wow, it's huge! We chose a table and I prepared to go to the counter to order and was greeted by a waitress who would be taking our order at the table.  My son ordered wings, he liked them (I don't partake). We ordered our usual small pizza with Mozzarella and red sauce. The crust was a tad bit thinner than I usually like, but the braided edge was delish as usual, but not quite as plump as I've found at my #1 and #2 locations. I will gladly venture to this location again and try a beer ans side Caesar (my usual). This would be a great location to take a group or party, but a small family or solo would be just as comfortable.

I read the reviews expecting terrible service. I had already been to this location twice before reading the reviews. I love the pizza. Our service on previous visits was fine. Maybe I'm not a hard ass when it comes to service, as long as my needs are met, I'm cool. This time, after having read the negative reviews regarding the service, I was paying extra attention. I placed my order to go for 3 small pizzas and a beer. I intentionally did not leave a tip when I paid for the pizzas. I would leave my tip after my beer and getting my pizzas. I got my beer within 5 minutes and I settled down to observe the staff (and watch football). The staff did their jobs. Tables were cleaned, orders were taken, IDs checked, drinks served, food cooked and occasionally watch the TV for game scores. My pizzas arrived to me in 25 minutes. The order was correct. I left a fiver. I would have left more if I had it. Good job Blind Onion Staff!

Tasty pizza joint! This place seems to always be busy. I love the fact that they have games for kids to play! When you have a 2 year that can't sit still this is such a genius idea!! Last night their special was "the luau" mango BBQ sauce, jalepenos, bacon... Loaded with it! And pineapples. That was DELICIOUS! I LOVE this place and love that they cater to every age. We will always be back :)

I have to believe that this restaurant's decor, and the buzz surrounding it account for better reviews than the food would deserve. The surroundings are attractive, and the food presentations elegant, but ...  BUT

I don't mind small portions, as I can't eat much at one sitting, but I would imagine that many others would find the tiny portions wanting. So, the food must be really special, yes? No. Three of us had the vegetable salad, which was pretty, but tiny. The beets were sliced wafer thin, and the radishes as well. Very cute. And there was a touch of dressing, thank goodness. Not bad, but the overall dish is bland and simply too precious.

I could go on, but enough already. The other starter I chose (squid) was just okay, but the rest of our party cleaned their plates (easily done, given the portions!). So maybe I'm the odd man out?

So, if you are looking for so-so food at high prices, this is the place for you!

We stopped by the RR on the way home from the beach. A friend recommended us to give it a shot, so we did. We arrived around 6pm and it wasn't very busy for a Friday night. Our server was great! She was pleasant and on top of her game.

The menu is fairly large. They offer your typical bar fare with some entrees. All are priced very fair. We started with the crab balls. They were good! They had a nice amount of crab in them. My wife went with the crab cake and I went with the mushroom cheesesteak. The crab cake was fantastic! Packed full of crabmeat and cooked perfectly. The cheesesteak was good not great. The roll was nice and fresh. The meat was a bit overcooked and dry. They mushrooms were scarce. The fries were hot and crispy. Overall it was a decent meal and we would return.

Good Pizza, nice location, kid friendly, wallet bruising. 

Five Points Pizza is a pretty decent pizza joint all things considered.  I dug the pizza, thought the crispy crust was spot on and had a pretty good time.  Me and the boy split a slice of cheese and a slice of pepperoni and I had a house salad.  It was all good and I imagine we will be back soon for more.  

That being said, the prices are on the steep end.  3.25 for a cheese slice and 4.75 for draft beer is pretty steep in this town.  The quality is there, but I have a hard time justifying $10+ per person for pizza with so many good options in town.  

I consider this a temporary review until I have had a few more exposures.  The place was packed on a Friday night so I imagine they will be around a bit longer to test out. 

If nothing else Five Points Pizza is worth a shot if you are on the east side and want a sit down pizza experience.  Recommended with few reservations

What a fantastic experience.

Went in looking for something to help me completely quit smoking (currently at about a pack / week) and had the opportunity to work with the owner, Derrick.  Not only was he incredibly knowledgeable about vaping and the best setup to achieve what I want, but he was super cool and easy to work with.

You can tell he's put a LOT of time into this shop. It's really clean and well set up. The products are second to none and their selection of glass is about the best I've seen in the area.  It's great to know that there is a great smoke shop so close - I'll be heading back for all of my juices (which he has a ridiculous selection of, including house made) and stopping over for a piece of glass in the not too distant future.

Earned a customer for life in one stop, can't wait to stop back
Best. Yelp won't let me type just "Best", so I am typing more to make Yelp happy.

Pizza is my favorite thing in the world. 5 points has never disappointed me.  I appreciate the big slices and them being open late. I've never actually sat down and ate inside, so I can't comment on the service.  The walk up window is awesome, and we've never waited an extensive amount of time.  Standing outside in East Nashville late at night is a little shady, but it's all god.

Ordering late night food. Pizza is good but they only offer cheese and pepperoni after midnight that's a pretty weak offering for a place that's rated 5 stars. And no calzones after midnight what!!!!!

We went here after some suggestions of some friends. So glad we went. The pizza was absolutely amazing, cannot wait to go back and try more. The knots were really good also. Well worth the drive from Franklin. The large pizzas are HUGE!
Super friendly service from all. Great thin crust and a nice on tap selection. Loved it
My favorite pizza in Nashville. We loved their Mitchell's beef brisket pizza (it was one of pizzas of the day).

The best pizza in Nashville. That is all.

And beer selection. Awesome.

Update:  I've been back SEVERAL times since the new slice window has opened, and I have to say that 5 Points is better than ever.  I like ordering single slices better than a whole pie- they get so much crispier with the par-bake.  I still can't say enough good things about this place.  Hands down, best pizza in Nashville.
Not only do serve amazing pizza, but they're open relatively late. Hands down, this has to be some of the best pizza I've ever had. If you ever get a chance to visit Nashville, go here.

Hands down the best pizza in town and they now offer a walk-up takeout window for all your to-go and late night needs. 

A large pizza is big enough to be shared by four people (paired with the garlic knots and salad) and everyone will leave happy and satiated.  

Their beer selection is nice and changes frequently.  If you need pizza.  You need 5 Points Pizza.
Pretty good pizza, delicious crunchy crust. Veggie pizza could be much improved though, a little bland

My sister in law and I select a new restaurant to celebrate the birthdays of our husbands every year. This year, we picked the Treemont. It is a beautiful, bright, open space across the street from Good Dog. We were seated at a table in the center of the dining room near open windows. It was lovely. Our server was so nice and explained anything we had questions about. We basically ordered almost every starter, with the standouts being the tuna, carrot gazpacho and the gnudi. I had the Amish chicken for dinner, as did my brother in law. My husband had the short ribs (which I snuck a bite of) and my sister in law had the gnocchi. It was delicious. All of it. It is not cheap (250 for the 4 of us) but it's one of those places where your money is well spent and it makes it easier to swallow simply because the food is prepared beautifully and tastes as it should.

Have to say I love this place. Food is pretty awrsome. And the staff has to be some of the friendliest.  They brought cups of black olives and pineapples for out twin one year old boys. Kept them happy until the delicious cheesy garlic bread arrived. The waiter even had the chef cut the bread into toddler sized pieces so we didn't have to do that. So awesome!! We will be back for sure!!

Stopped in for lunch break. It was tasty, fast, professional. I had the Italian special. I probably could have eaten more than the regular meal. Next time I'll keep that in mind

I'll be back for more
We had a pizza craving and heard the Five Points Pizza was the place to go to.. We are thin crust lovers so we were absolutely fascinated by the pizza slices.. also their garlic knots are to die for!

I've always stayed in different residence inns so I have bit of experience ,that being said this property looks pretty run down inside the rooms!the sofa bed was missing springs so the bed was lopsided the toilet flush handle  broke,light bulbs in the lamps are dead!!coffee pot left dirty upon check in,some of the floor tiles were separating not by a little but by a lot,some of the staff not sure about when breakfast closes??really????and it felt like the staff was way too relaxed I mean you still have a business to run!!!!by the way the did give another room when I complained and believe you me it wasn't that much different !!

The red sauce pizza is better than the white. The restaurant is very small, so get there early if you have a crowd, lots a craft beers on draft. I'll try it again, but I'm not sure I would recommend it to others.

We ate there last night, there was a mix up with our pizza and it took a little longer than it should have for pizza. Although the wait was long our pizza was amazing, and our waiter was great! Our meal was on the house since it took so long and it was our first time there. We will definitely be going back!

Great location while traveling on business. Just a hop and a skip to Philly without paying the big city inflated prices. I'm a Platinum rewards member and always stay in Marriott's because they are consistent , clean and friendly. .

okay to start off- such a cool venue. Great for any age group. As for the pizza, i'm a person who likes a lot of sauce on my pizza. This really didn't have much at all. Also, only on my pizza was there a puddle of grease coming off of my pepperoni pizza. My boyfriend's was completely fine. Boyfriend also said the prosciutto and basil was the BOMB. Also the price is amazing! $3.75 for a slice! The garlic knots were to die for! Overall: okay pizza, awesome garlic knots, awesome venue, great service, great price.

Oh hell yeah!  Another St. Louis staple - wafer thin sliced roast beef with a salty seasoning, on top of a crisp warm bun makes Stephanie a happy girl.  
The french fries rival In & Out for the tastiest fast food treat around.  My cholesterol spikes out of control when I go home...probably the 3 sandwiches I routinely pick up here on the way home from the airport....mmmm, mmmm good.
Delicious! Love that I can see pizza made from scratch while I'm enjoying my own. The menu is simple and creative. Decor is super cool.

I've been stalking Chip Roman's Restaurants for a verrrry long time.  Mica has been on my wishlist for years but I haven't been able to make it to the burbs to try it..yet.  When I found out The Treemont was coming to town, you know I had to make a reze!  The food and service was excellent and I rarely EVER say that.  I would also like to note that I noticed the manager Leah, talking to a table for a good 15 minutes.. I assumed that she knew them and when they left they said " Nice to meet you!".  Now I have been to mannnnny restaurants in my day and I have never, ever, ever seen a manager take the time to really get to know their customers like she did.  Very impressive!  We will be back and I highly recommend.

I am a fan indeed.  Well, who wouldn't be.  It's pizza for goodness sakes.  Whats not to like?  I know, its a highly personal thing, pizza, but really people, what else would we all eat during the following events?
*Sports
*Non-Sports
*Sport Like Activities (i.e. wrestling)
*Hiking 
*Fishing
*Weddings

Pizza is the glue that binds us together.  Is there really any other food that is more American than pizza.  (sound of crickets)
I know, falsehood, but really we have made this dish our own.  Five Points Pizza takes this all American tradition to new heights.  While parking is challenging and seating is limited, I promise you this, its worth it.  A few highlights are the Meatball pie and the garlic knots.  Those softball sized mounds of buttery, garlicky goodness are some of the best damn things ever.  I don't know why they add the touch of fresh basil to them, but I guess it adds something because those things are fantastic.  My son (2.5 years of age) likes to shove the whole thing in his mouth and then proceeds to frighten us all while he masterfully devours them whole.  It's like watching a snake eat a small animal whole, jaw unhinged and all.

I will add this last anecdote.  When eating at five points pizza, don't be a fool and ask for thin crust, or deep dish.  You get it the way it comes.  If you wanted healthy pizza perhaps a cracker with tomato sauce is your thing.  Here, tradition trumps all.  It's a hipster paradise, and a damn good one at that.

Was down in Nashville last weekend and checked this place out based on recommendations and was so glad I did. Ordered 2 slices of pepperoni and it was as good as the pizza I had in NYC. Thin Crisp crust with delicious sauce and and toppings.

Best pizza in Nashville!! Hands down.... We like going to New York and eating the pizza. This is the closest thing to real pizza that you will find in Nashville..... The garlic knots are crazy good and the ricotta cheese and spinach Stromboli rock!!

Was contacted by the owner apologizing to me. He said there must have been a miscommunication with his office staff and that we should have been extended the free estimate. Still too late for this company as we have chosen a different roofing company.

If you need a late night snack after seeing one of the best concerts at Mercy Lounge (Thirdstory) or clubbing this is the place.  If you have $5 you can get you a gigantic slice of pizza that's worth it.  Fresh ingredients and and friendly staff.  Service was quick although we experienced a long line.  Parking can be an issue but if you don't mind circling the block a few times, I believe you will be satisfied with the result!!
Yum. As soon as I saw the complaint that it isn't greasy enough, I knew it was for me. The vegetarian is great. Looking forward to the prosciutto asap. Maybe later today even...
Meatball pizza is GREAT!  We love this place and it's become our favorite pizza spot.  Local beer on tap, food is always fresh.
Best New York style pizza in Nashville.  The prosciutto and basil is outstanding.  The jalapeño and pepperoni was excellent as well.  I would recommend this joint to anyone who wants a great pizza.

We ate here on a Saturday night and it was fairly busy. We ordered a super Bianca pizza add prosciutto, and a slice of pepperoni to see what the standard was like. They were fairly busy, but the pizza came out fairly quickly and it was very hot. Beer was cold and the place has a fun atmosphere. Even though we didn't have kids with us, others did and it seemed fairly kid friendly. We will go back!

Great pizza! One of my favorites, it tastes a lot like Joe's pizza in New York. We got a typical mushrooms and tomatoes pizza an it was very tasty, the crust was perfect. We didn't have to wait to be seated but the restaurant does get busy, it's worth the wait!

Best pizza in the world!! My husband and I come here about once a week and we can't get enough. Great beer on tap, amazing pizza and wonderful customer service. Will always be my favorite pizza joint!!!

Hands down best pizza ever !! This is a must have when in Nashville ! I couldn't stop eating, we got 3 pizzas and shared them so we could try as many combinations. We could not decide on our favorite they were all amazing !

Pizza at midnight? Yes please! 
I had just blown into town a couple hours before that time and I decided that after all that plane travel, I was hungry. 
I really recommend this place. Quick window service, excellent prices and pizza that isn't too greasy but is also far from bland. Stop by! You'll like it

Service from the get go was disappointing. Who asks for a tip up front? Before I get served?? To make things worse, we ordered for the 2 of us, a salad, garlic cheese bread, and a medium pizza. We got our salad after 10-15 minutes of waiting with WARM and almost what felt like, microwaved ranch dressing. I went back to ask for a cold one, which they didn't have. Tell me, how does a pizza place not have COLD ranch?!? This is a health code violation in the simplest regards. When we looked at how they were storing it, they had the right principle, but poorly executed. What was supposed to be a tub of ice with containers sitting on top of the ice for the ranch to be stored in, was a tub with water in it, no ice, and no response from the waitress when asked about it. I suggested that there may be more in the back, she checked, and nothing. To make matters worse, we received the appetizer and the pizza together, and the pizza was room temperature, but... the appetizer was oven hot. Here's an idea, get back to the basics of a restaurant, start with SERVICE! We will NOT be going back there, ever! Blind onion disappointment!
This spot is consistently good.  The pizza is top rate.  Calzones are tasty as well.  Great food for the money...

This place was rated best pizza in Nashville 2014, and I personally think they should win 2015! First off this is in East Nashville, which I absolutely love! I found a few spots downtown that were a little... Eh, let's just say not so laid back! This place was great! We walked in and got a seat at the bar and met the most awesome bar tender. He took orders, had great recommendations, and even changed our minds with our drink selection! We ended up getting half meatball and half vodka, from what he said was popular. Unfortunately I didn't get his name , but, let me tell you. It.was.AMAZING! You have to try this place and I mean it. The vibe was good, people cool, laid back, all kinds of people and their open LATE! It's a definite!

The food tasted like the first time I heard the Beatles/Pearl Jam/Phish, what have you. All of the dishes were presented very beautifully and tasted fresh. The carrot gazpacho will stay with me for some time. One miss was the squid, it was a bit salty, but you can't win them all. This is a must try.

Born in New York and raised in Philadelphia there are no pizza joints in Nashville that can compare to those two. So I stopped comparing. There is something different about the pizza here that gets lost between the sauce and crust that keeps it from being similar in taste and texture to the pizza in New York and Philadelphia. Nonetheless there are some good pizza spots here in Nashville and five points being one of them. First off I have to warn you that it does get pretty crowded quick during the lunch hours which could set you back 15-20 mins before getting a morsel to eat. For starters garlic knots you can't go wrong with these monstrous twists of pizza dough piping hot and covered with garlic, parmesan cheese, and olive oil. They were delicious I solely recommend getting a full order that's just how scrumptious they were. Our pizza selection consisted of to 14" pizzas. Because of all the picky eaters that accompanied me I kept it simple and ordered a cheese and a South Brooklyn(my birthplace). The cheese was okay but I really enjoyed the South Brooklyn which had an olive oil base, sauce and basil baked into mozzarella. This was good Nashville style pizza! Prices are reasonable and service was good. Please be mindful of others when you come during lunch hours and not extend your dining experience longer than needed!
Love this place...meatball Stromboli!!!! There is noting better...great beer choices too
MiFirst time ever and i loved there pizza.  Very unique way of combining flavors.  Next time i visit reno i will definately stop by again.  Service was excellent.

I needed a haircut and thought I would try someone new. I went to see David and he was amazing. He was fun, made me feel relaxed and gave me exactly the haircut I wanted. I am so tired of asking for just a little bit off and have the stylist go Edward Scissor hands on my hair. David gave me the layers and body that I wanted but kept the length, which was the most important to me, I think I just found my forever hair stylist! Highly recommended.

Friday nights my wife and I leave the confines of our kitchen and try out different restaurants. This Friday we decide to go to The Blind Onion on Los Altos Blvd in Sparks. We got there around 5:00 and we were seated immediately. Getting there on the early side of dinner it wasn't too busy yet. Our server took drink order instantly and began to browse the menu.

Being a pizza place the menu was very typical with standards plus some specialties. What caught our eye was the special on the chalkboard up front. I can't recall the name of the pizza, but it had bacon, sausage, pineapple, red peppers, bbq sauce, mozzarella, and dollops of cream cheese. Definitely not your typical pizza. 

While we waited for our pizza we noticed they had a variety of simple games such as connect four, checkers and Jenga available. My wife and I set up a Jenga match and began to battle it out. It was pretty intense and completive, and sadly I lost, but after only one match the pizza was being delivered to our table.

For being an off the wall Pizza it was absolutely delicious. My only grip would be that it was a bit pricey for pizza, but in their defense it was very original and super delicious. 

I would strongly recommend you go down and try their pizza. Also, don't forget to pour some honey on your plate and dip your crust. Not normal, but awesome just ask my two-year-old.

I have always loved this restaurant and I'll always come here. The pizza is delicious. The local beer is awesome. But I've always been kind of disappointed at the friendliness of the staff, until now. 
Usually I'll come in and see my server once or twice and have to flag him down. But today, Cody was our server and he was the shit! Never wanted for anything, his personality and attitude was entertaining, he always made sure we had what we needed. He certainly made our experience the best one we've had in all the times we've been here. Go Cody! You're awesome!

Connoisseur Smoke Shop is awesome! Hands down an awesome head shop, they have shelves of juices to choose from for anyone unique preference. The staff all seems to be helpful and interested in helping many people quit smoking and switch to vaping! They have a sick ass display case and hundreds of pieces designed to meet any ones needs! If your tired with your current e juice or just in the neighborhood come check us out!!!

I'm not normally a fan of New York style pizza but this stuff was off the chain good. Wonderful crust, flavorful,  balanced. Good selection of flavors from basic to exotic. Small dining room. No parking.

You guys are the best!  What started as an innocent slice quickly escalated to a Friday night ritual.  This is by far the best pizza in all of nashville.  The crust is the perfect combination of soft and chewy, but stands firm when you hold it and no oil or toppings drip off.  They have fantastic house specials each day, both for meat and veggie lovers.  Try anything with their habanero cream sauce.  I'd eat it on gravel.  Luckily, I don't have to.  If you're not into spicy, then go for the T-Rex, any meat lovers dream!

This is a great local pizza spot. We love to sit at the bar, get a slice of pizza or two -  can't go wrong with cheese or pepperoni - and enjoy their great beer selection. The arugula salad is different and really good, and the Bianca pizza is really good too. Their garlic knots are also great! This place is definitely a favorite of ours.

This is the best pizza I've ever had, and I'm a girl who lives on pizza. I had the Old World and added pepperoni. I was nearly brought to tears upon the first bite. Everything was so fresh and the crust was buttery perfection. The beer selection was decent, and the service was quick. Just thinking about how good the pizza was is making me so hungry. I think I'll go here for lunch. And dinner. And every meal for the rest of my life.

Mixed feelings on this place:

Food would get 5 stars. Pizza is ALWAYS amazing and delicious. We also love to get an order of pesto chips to start off with. They have great ranch (very important detail for any pizza and ranch lover) and of course the braided crust with honey is the perfect way to finish off your meal. 

Service would get 1 star. I'm not sure if we have ever had good service. The last time we tried to dine in we waited almost an hour for a medium pepperoni pizza and when we had to leave it STILL wasn't ready. Also a lot of the staff seems to have a high turn over and seem very inexperienced. 

The decor of the restaurant is cute and comfortable. Mismatched furniture create a welcoming, home like feel. I also enjoy all the games and shuffle board. Very family friendly!

I'm a pizza lover!  And Five Points Pizza is some of the best pizza I've ever had!   When I come back to Nashville next month for the Tyler Bryant and the Shakedown show at Exit/In, I'll definitely be stoping in for some awesome pizza and some amazing garlic knots!!

Ohhh Lion's Choice!!!!!

The best! 

Delicious Roast Beef Sandwiches served warm- consists of Fresh sliced Roast beef, burger bun and a little seasoned salt. Just those 3 ingrdients is all you need! 

Add a little Au Jus sauce and you are about to eat the best little roast beef sandwich ever! 
Fries are a perfect pair. 
They also have mini ice cream cones (plain or chocolate dipped) for under a quarter. (Last time I was there, plain vanilla was 10 cents, and chocolate dipped was 15 cents) Its a fun snack for the kids. :) 

Also, if you prefer your Roast Beef a little rare, you can tell the cook. Otherwise it will be cooked to perfection!!

To truly appreciate The Choice I think you need to have grown up in STL and live somewhere else that only has Arby's.  Arby's is sick.  And not "sick" like, "wicked awesome" sick.  Sick, like, gag me with the closest possible utensil to get this shit outta my system sick.  Gross.

The Choice, on the other hand, can hardly be considered fast food for any reason besides you don't have to wait long after you order it to enjoy inhaling the mouth watering goodness!

I've been enjoying real roast beef sandwiches from here for over 20 years now and they are never a disappointment.  Plus, the fries are always hot and crispy.  PLUS I love pumping horseradish and bbq into a container and dipping my fries in.  Mmm.

I went here the other day during my visit to STL and didn't even have to order the veggie sticks that my mom used to make me eat when visiting this place (I must be all growns up!).  Come to think of it, Lion's Choice was SO ahead of the times...offering carrots and celery as a healthy menu item.

My brother's favorite part? Shots of au jus on the house!
Pizza by the slice. It's a close call to NYC pizza. Definitely in my top three pizza places.

This is a great place for delicious garlic knots and pizza. The large pizza serves 4 easily. The service was super, the place was crowded, and the food was great. They use every inch of space, they offer a restaurant and buy a slice options and they do it all efficiently. Make a trip here, be patient it is worth the wait!

Five Points was overall a really good experience, only reason I didn't give it a 5/5 is because of the service. Pizza was absolutely amazing and drinks were good pairing, not the cheapest though. 

I think we were just there at a busy time causing our server to put our 2-top on his laid-back priority list, which is OK because the pizza was so good. 

Nothing bad happened, just wasn't the best service I've gotten.

I love it when you can buy pizza by the slice!  I mean when you are with a group some is always picky and this way I can get what I want!  At Five Points you not only get it by the slice, its dang good too!   The strombolis, in my opinion are more of a calzone, but still delicious nonetheless.  They are a beautiful work of art, with the perfectly golden crust and the perfect amount filling, not skimpy but not so much you can manage it.  My personal favorite, the spinach and cheese!   Everyone raved about the garlic knots before getting there, they weren't bad but I have had better. 

My only ugh ....was ......they only serve beer and wine,  would of loved to have been able to a cocktail.  I just wasn't feeling beer or wine.

Its a hole in the wall restaurant with a good vibe and  good food

Our waiter was super helpful. We went with a half and half. The 14 inch was more than enough for 2 people FYI!  We did the half vodka cream and half meatball. Both were so good! Atmosphere is cozy. All staff we interacted with were super friendly.  Without a doubt I will be back.

Dang, yo!

This place had been hyped up like mad - and I wanted my first Nashville pizza experience to be a good one, so I figured I'd give it a shot with my friends.

I'm picky when it comes to pizza - it's gotta have thin, foldable, but slightly crisp crust, good cheese, and the right amount of salty. 

We ordered the "Old World," and added pepperoni. Listen y'all - this thing was OFF THE CHAIN! Honestly, Five Points is now in my top five favorite pizza places (in any city).

There was going to be a crazy wait, so we ordered to-go, but they were nice and let me order a beer while we waited. They have a great tap selection!

Stop on by, you won't be let down.

my boyfriend was wanting NY style pizza so we wandered in on a beautiful January day and really loved this place! We had a salad, garlic knots and a large pizza, half cheese, half pepperoni.. yeah not very adventurous but there were so many slices we wanted to try.. loved all the different selections of pizza that was offered.. Can't wait to go back!

This is the best place in our neighborhood for pizza and soft drinks or beer. Great, friendly service, family atmosphere, convenient location and super good pizza. They have a porter on tap that is a welcome alternative to the "5 varieties of IPA and a lite beer" offered at so many other places. We will be back.
Good pizza and good atmosphere. Pizza is a tad overpriced for me to eat their regularly.  Customer service at times has been an issue.  It hasn't stopped me from going back though.
Delicious pizza and garlic knots.  We each got an individual slice and it was more than enough food.  Server was great.

One of the best places to get pizza in Nashville.  I don't find myself in East Nashville very often but when I'm there I like to try the local eateries that everyone raves about.  I was recommended to try Five Points by a guy I worked with and it did not disappoint.  We ordered a Woodstock and some Garlic Knots to go and neither one disappointed.  The crust was on point with an awesome brick oven flavor and the slices were huge!  There is plenty of parking behind the building and the wait once you're inside is way worth every moment.  I can not wait to go back and try this place again!

I've eaten here twice, once at the bar and once takeaway. Both times I split a salad and pizza with someone. The pizza is above average and a decent value. I really enjoyed the spinach and gorgonzola salad. The beer selection is good with local and national craft beer. Nice atmosphere and the staff seemed to be helpful. Great location if you want to hop around to a few different places. I'll be going back soon.

I really wish Blind Onion wasn't so dang expensive because the pizza is really good. 
We've eaten here a few times, so it's surprising to me why I have yet to leave a review! 
This is a family establishment for sure. I love the idea of the mismatched tables and chairs. It gives it a certain character. I like the overall atmosphere of the building. I don't have to worry about my kids laughter being too loud because we're surrounded by other families enjoying each others company. 
I like that they have outdoor seating. It's so perfect for those summer nights or spring afternoons. 
If you're in the mood for an adult beverage they have wine and beer to my knowledge, not positive if it's a full bar type situation. 
The cheesy garlic bread is to die for and pairs nicely with their red dipping sauce. 
I also decided to order the pesto Alfredo "chips" appetizer. It's basically a thin crust pizza, but it was good. 
For the main event I ordered half Popeye's half general or something or rather. It's the one with all of the meat and 3 different peppers. The kids picked off all of the toppings, but we really loved our choices. I wish I had seen the lemon one earlier. It sounded yummy. 
Our server was really sweet and was always prompt. I never felt like we had to sit around and wait for her. 
My FAVORITE part of eating their pizza is saving the crust for later. They place honey on the tables. When I first came, I was like: what the heck for? But now, I am addicted to dipping the crust into the honey. I don't even need dessert. That's treat enough! 
So my verdict: yes, I highly recommend eating here. I feel like it's one of the best pizza places in our area, but be prepared to shell out some moo-lah for the evening.

This is a great pizza place in the middle of 5 points.  The lunch specials are huge!  The pizza is also a lot better than your other fast food pizza joints.  The parking is always a little hard to come by in the area but it is worth the walk.

Every local in Reno has asked me if i had tried Blind Onion yet for the last 2 years, well finally i did and yes there pizza is amazing. The pizza is flat and the crust is is thick at the end so you can dip in honey. Nice vibe for large get togethers, great beer and food menu too.

My daughter and I stopped in for lunch on a Saturday around 1:30. The lunch rush was over but the place was still hopping. We chose to sit at the bar so that my daughter could peek back in the kitchen and watch them make the pizzas. Our bartender was Carrie and she was very polite and attentive. Never let our glasses go empty. We ordered a 14" half cheese and half pepp/much. It was delicious. Perfectly cooked and we got our food fast. Overall it was a great experience and we will definately return. Lots of salads kept passing me and I'll probably have to try that Spinach one on my next trip.

I don't live anywhere near this place but will go the distance to have one of their pies. One of the best pizza restaurants I've been to by far! This is saying a lot since I was once a college student in New York City and used to live off pizza.

My absolute favorite is the vodka sauce pizza. Now for those who are not vegetarians, please listen to my advice carefully. Whatever you order, add prosciutto. You're welcome.

We randomly walked in here on the last night of SIPS and it was a pleasant surprise. Amazing food which was recommended to us by the bartender Justin. He was very welcoming, knowledgable, and friendly. We chatted with him a lot during our meal. The escargot and Cobia were amazing and we had the fish of the day. Which was skate and it was also really good. Very relaxed atmosphere. We will be back!

Wow! what a gem.  Came in hungry and left completely satisfied even by my snobbish pizza standards.  completely affordable.  I think I had 2 huge slices (I'm talking needing to be on two paper plates, huge) which ended up being about 7 or 8 bucks or so.  They have specialty slices every night which had some unique combos.  You may have to wait for a table or you can head to the bar and order there instead.  I also saw some families ordering entire pizzas to go.

Five Points is our go-to pizza joint!  We have been dozens of times and it is always wonderful!!!  We have had most every pizza and our favorites include: Old World, Meatball and T-Rex.  We always share a salad because they are yummy and enough for two!  Love the garlic knots too!  Highly recommend!!

Chose this place off a recommendation from a coworker. Have been back 4 times in the past 2 weeks. Last time, I ordered a whole pepperoni, it took about 15 mins and the place was not dead (it never is). I have also been there around lunchtime (noonish) and it was a few minutes wait for a slice. This is my go to pizza place from now on, forever. 

The only thing that's not ideal is the parking. But I would pay any amount of money to park for a $3 slice of 5 points pizza. 

New York style, foldable, great crust, not too greasy, 10/10. I will never order delivery again as long as this place exists.
The garlic knots are a must buy when you visit. They are the size of a tennis ball with fresh oil and garlic. Love that you can buy pizza by the slice so you can try different toppings on each slice.

We had small plates. The menu is eclectic and fun. The foie gras terrine was fantastic and each of the other dishes were quite good. We did not love them all equally, but they were all unique and adventurous 

I had the best chocolate cake I have ever had, it was on of the best deserts I have ever tasted. 

Great service and casual. A good find.

Definitely try this place. I love there thin crust and big New York style slices. They have differant specialty flavors daily. Hard to suggest what to order because all their pizzas are full of flavor. Lots of people recommend the garlic knots, but it's been my experience that those are inconsistent depending on who's in the kitchen. You can never go wrong with their pizza.

Love the pizza, and since I always sit at the bar I have always gotten good service.

I have seen the looks on the faces of big parties waiting for their chow...  not sure if the staff is just young or there is something else going on there but I would take a big group down to the Victorian Square location if I had to.  

But to be very clear about "My" opinion of the Los Altos Pkwy location: Since I don't have any kids I sit at the bar with just a friend or two, and have gotten VERY GOOD service every time I have been in...
Employees must wash hands before returning to work? Thanks for letting me know the guy in the stall that's about to make my sandwich needs a reminder.

My boyfriend and I come for the great pizza and beer, but stay for the conversations about the Rick and Morty show, sharing Pokemon Go tactics, and overall having a great time getting to know the staff, especially John and Alexander.

It's a great atmosphere for boys and girls all ages - especially for those who love good pizza and like to be interesting.
You MUST provide full name and phone number to get service--no to privacy invasion (they said it was for notes--bs, the same girl cuts my hair every 3 weeks and always asks me to repeat what I want).

Great place was referee by a friend  has two sides restaurant and take out take out open till 1 am restaurant fresh salads must try the garlic balls   Bear on tap and bottle wine by the class on tap otherwise

Possibly my favorite pizza place!  From the toppings, to the crust, to the sauce, my drool just keeps dripping each visit.  

Small dining area and often a busy place.  However, their convenient, separate carry out, by the slice section next door makes up for all of this.  If you're visiting alone or with a friend, grab one of their daily specials and a beer, during the day or even a late night snack (open til 1am most nights). If you're from out of town, I challenge you to try their pizza.  Awesome people and service!

I don't claim to be a local but Nashville will be my home for the next 3 years.  I think I've found my first go-to establishment.

I am absolutely in love with the Old World pizza.  I had a VERY different experience than Scott P.  I think the crust is awesome  - crispy outside and soft inside!  I adore the bottled cider they sell (I can't recall the name).  Garlic knots are yummy.  The salads are HUGE.  And I am not a cannoli fan, but I loved the chocolate one here!
To everyone who said they wanted grease - did you have the pepperoni?!  Mine was very greasy! 
Honestly, my only negative is that it is a little more expensive than I typically want to pay for dinner.  But it is so good that I will be back! 

Oh - also - they don't take reservations like Yelp says they do! Just wanted to throw that out there!

Great foldable NY-style pizza by the slice (or whole pies).  Best to get there early if you want to have a sit-down meal, but they offer a quick carry-out option if you're in a rush or if they're busy.  Lots of great toppings/combos (nice level of spiciness in the basic pepperoni!) and a great selection of local craft beers!

LOVE this place! Especially at 2:00
In the morning when you gotta stand on the street to eat your pizza. Nothing better when your buzzin! Awesome NY style pizza- that from a northern NJ girl!

There's little I can say that hasn't already been said by others, so let me hit the highlights:

- the only good thing to come out of New York was its pizza, and this place does it right.
- parking around here is awful. 
- they are very attentive to kids; our threenager was given some pizza dough to keep her occupied and they cut up her slice into kid-friendly pieces so we didn't have to.
- for a weeknight, this place was noisy.
- get there early or expect to wait.
- considering how busy it was, service was very good.

I'm looking forward to return trips, especially to try the stromboli.

5 Points Pizza has my favorite pizza in all of Nashville. They serve it up NY style with big slices on perfectly thin crust with a wide variety of fresh cheeses, meats, and veggies. They are located in the hipster capital of Nashville in 5 points. My personal fave is the garlic knots served with a side of their incredible marinara. If they have a wait, don't fret. They will take your number and you can have time to go over to 3 crow to grab a drink!  5 points pizza is a must try for pizza lovers!

This might be my favorite pizza place in all of Nashville.  It's kind of a toss up between Five Points and Mafiaoza's and it really just depends on what kind of pizza I'm in the mood for.  Five Points is New York style pizza to a T. Its more of a thin, gooey, cheesy, greasy type of pizza, which is what I like.  If you want some seriously good classic tasting pizza, go here. If you want the fancier, weirder options, go some place else like Mellow Mushroom or Mafiaozas (which are also both very good as well).

Consistently delicious!  I always order the regular roast beef meal. I get the sandwich on a whole wheat bun with no butter to make it a bit more healthy :) 

Oh and a head's up, try their tropical tea!! I think they still have it, and if so, it's unsweetened and so refreshing.

I've always been a fan of Blind Onion -- if you want quality pizza that tastes great, this is the place to go!  My daughter loves the thick braided crust and honey to dip it in.  Whenever anyone suggests pizza for dinner, this is where we want to go!  The locale is convenient (for eating in or getting to go), the staff always friendly and the pizza is always delicious.

Great spot with great prices.  We went on a Saturday around 3-4 and got right in.  We tried their pepperoni  and it was pretty good.  I really loved their thin and crispy crust.  If you want pizza by the slice, they're only $3-$4 a slice
Probably some of the best NY Style Pizza I've ever had. Personally I love the South Brooklyn, but the Blanco is also good. I'm from out of town, and am definitely going to miss this pie
This is literally the best slice of pizza I have ever eaten. Hands down. Crust was crispy and buttery. Fresh basil on top. Yum...even the Greek Salad was spot on.
Best pizza in town! Love loved the garlic knots and really nice staff. Prices on slices good. Little higher on the full pizzas but well worth it for the quality. I'm quite addicted to them now. :)

The last time I went on a gluten binge (aka what happens when I accidentally consume some, get a migraine and decide to make the most of it by indulging myself) my first stop was 5 points pizza after hearing so many people rave about it. It's great that they sell by the slice, have a late night window and the staff is friendly. Props to their business model (except for the lack of gluten free options), but I have to say it was pretty overrated. Maybe it's because I grew up on different pizza in NJ/NY and nothing can compare to V&T's back in the day, or because most people I know only eat here when they are drunk, but I'd say the crust is not worth the migraine if I don't already have one and the flavors are decent at best (the sauce really makes or breaks a pizza for me). Go for the meatball slice.

Good, if not spectacular pizza.  Nice combinations of flavors, if kind of a mishmash on some of their specials.  But it was decent value (about $4.00 per slice though for a pretty big slice) and tasty.

Have eaten at The Treemont 4 times and have enjoyed it each time.  My husband and I had brunch there today and once again we were impressed by the service, food and attention to detail.  The manager aims to please and our server was delightful.  They really listen to what the customer wants and will make modifications when asked.
Our brunch included the Fall Greens Salad. It was fresh, inventive and delicious.  We also had the Parisian-style Gnocchi which is so light and airy, one of my favorite dishes.  My hubby had the steak and grits.  Great flavor.  Steak was tender and the grits were fabulous.  And last but not least, the Pastry Basket.  How can you go wrong with that?
Highly recommended!

Some of the best pizza I've ever had, period.  The restaurant is small so expect a long wait, but there is a quick service counter right next door that serves a few different kinds of pizza and the garlic knots, which are probably the best part of the entire experience.  Parking is a pain, so it's smart to send someone in to get your name on the list while you drive around looking for a spot.  Don't let the wait deter you, the food is crazy good and if you go on a weeknight it's likely to be a bit less crowded.

I am a serious pizza snob as well as a canoli snob, i have only truly enjoyed my homeade canolies, this tastes just as good if not better. Not to mention the pizza, oh my god it is to die for. Best pizza place this side of the atlantic. 5/5 stars.

Not sure where you've been of you haven't tried Five Points Pizza. The ingredients are fresh as is the pizza so don't rush them, especially if there's a full house. Order a beer, indulge in some garlic knots (non - negotiable), and wait on your awesome pizza creation to arrive. 

I've tried quite a few varieties on the menu, but nothing does it for me like Old World (like margherita but better) and my all time favorite topping combo of pepperoni and mushroom on the Woodstock. For a yummy experience add spicy cappicola or find a pizza with it because that stuff is amazing. 

This place is one of Nashville's best for pizza so expect a lengthy wait on Friday nights and Saturdays.

I've had pizza from places all over the US and other countries and this is, hands down, the BEST. The Dave's pie is my all-time favorite, but even the simple Cheese pie is incredible. They also have fresh salads, great garlic knots, and a stellar craft beer selection with great local brews. I'd give it 10 stars, if I could!

This place is awesome!  The server was just ok.  The atmosphere was just ok.  But the quality of the pizza makes up for all of it.  The crust, perfect.  The variety of pizzas to choose from, perfect.  I love not having a small number of pizzas to choose from and then having to build my own.  I'm not a cook.  I can't think of what goes well together.  Isn't that your job?  And boy, they do their joy well.  Tons of options that are original and make your pizza palate rejoice.  If only we lived closer...

This place is my guilty pleasure as an East Nashville resident.  This is a close as you'll come to NY style pizza in the city.  I often find myself dining here after leaving the 5 points area in search of a late night bite to eat.  The service is always friendly and speedy.  My only negative is that they will not let you customize your own Calzone and the wait can be lengthy at times.  That said, this is hands down the best Pizza in East Nashville and a must eat if you're in the area!!

I will add to the chorus of praise here. My husband and I are northeast coasters and are picky about pizza. Five Points is the perfect crust (not too thin but not thick; crispy), great cheese and sauce combo; nice staff. Love em.

First trip to Nashville and friends took us here for our first dinner.  This was a good NY style pizza.  

The garlic knots were good and the pizza was better.  While it was a little greasy that is the best part of NY style.  This is a little hipster place that has a good vibe going.  Smallish on the sitting side but it is worth any type of wait.  The noise level is loud enough to drown out other people conversations but not so loud you cannot talk to the people with you.  

I did not have any of the beer but my friends enjoyed theirs.  Would recommend this as a good place to dine.
Love this place! Good pizza and free shuffleboard....last time we were in my daughter made a joke about a blind minion and they liked it....they named their pizza of the month after it!!!!

I was ready for a late night beer and a snack. Being new to east nash i was walking around and trying to pick a spot to satisfy these needs. 3 crow seemed to busy to order food and chill at so i noticed this place wasnt as crazy inside. I ordered a French Broad IPA and garlic knots, both of which were amazing! Best part was i just happened to sit next to the owner at the bar and we had a real nice conversation and i reccomended him some beers to put on tap. Really cool atmosphere and nice that they stay open till midnight on weekends. I will definitely be back for some pizza next week!

5 stars for Lion's choice (Just go to another location!!)
-1 no drive thru
-1 rude people working there (go to Manchester)
-1 dirty dirty dirty and gross

Never had a bad pizza here.  First timers need to try the garlic knots as well.  If you have a big party it is busy almost every night so be prepared to wait.  I recommend calling ahead and getting it to go.  If you are on a date this place is great if you don't mind sitting very close to other tables.  It is also very family friendly.  They seem to hand kids out at the door sometime but the staff handles it well.  The Dave's pizza is my favorite but haven't had a slice of any of their pies that I didn't enjoy!!

First time going to this location with my husband.  The place was not busy.  Few customers.  We decided to sit at the bar to watch the game. 
Everything started off great.  The guy was helpful.  Got us our drinks. 
Ordered a large pizza with the Pesto white sauce.

Problem... Pizza took an hour to get.  Watched others who came in after us.  Ordered, ate and paid before we got our pizza.  Only reason we stayed is because we asked about our order.  This point 2 servers checked the kitchen.  
The pizza finally came out.  Warm not hot.  No pesto sauce.  Very doughy. 
We had to ask for plates.  When we questioned the server... He quickly gave us our check.  

Working in the customer service industry things happen.  When you forget to take care of the customer.  Try to make them happy.  
An apology would have been great.  Offering something extra would have been great.  

Do I recommend this location to my friends or business associates.  No.
Did I tip them for there service.  No.  There was no service.
Was the pizza good.  No.  No flavor.

I wish this was a better review.  The location is great to where we live.  
I can not give them any stars.  Only reason they are getting 1star is because you have to.

Been to Five Points Pizza a handful of times, despite living miles away, after hearing about how great it is.  Have taken orders to go, and eaten inside...

Casual, cozy environment inside the restaurant.  Staff has been attentive and pleasant each and every time.

The pizza is delicious and blows the various chains away.

Well worth checking out if you find yourself around this area of Nashville.
This is by far the best pizza place is Nashville. I love the variety. Always fresh, always delicious!

Best of the best of Nashville!!  From the appetizers to the drink selection to the pizza, it was awesome!!  Short wait, although I know it can get longer.  We had the caprise salad and the garlic knots as appetizers.  Then my wife and I split a 18" 1/2 Zeus and 1/2 Habanero pizza.  I'll eat until I'm sick!!  This is great!!!  Definitely time to go if you have taste buds.

Nice one bedroom suite for a low price for the Philadelphia area. A door separates the living room from the bedroom, and each room has its own TV. Wireless access is free. But beware the freeway and ventilation noise! The noise was possibly the loudest I've ever experienced in lodging. My poor wife didn't get much sleep.
Damn good pizza, New Style pepperoni slice for $3.50. Also the habanero cream sauce was a great on my pizza.

Finally got to try this place out and was not disappoint.  Loved the location as it is located next to a bunch of local bars.  We got the garlic bread which was my favorite thing on their menu.   Pizzas were were delicious as well.  You can order a whole pie or get them by the slice.  I highly recommend the Zeus pizza!
I originally went with this place for my parents because some of the prices were lower but man you get what you pay for. I won't ever go here again.

Blind onion pizza is by far and away our favorite pizza in town, however, for some reason, this location is THE WORST service of any location in town. When you walk into a restaurant as a customer and literally, I'm not joking, every staff member looks away as if you hadn't just walked into an establishment to spend your hard earned money. When no employee acknowledges a customer entering a restaurant, it's a little irritating. So, since no one even feigned eye contact, and we weren't sure if we were expected to seat ourselves or wait to be seated, we decided to belly up to the bar in hopes that might garner us some attention; no luck. We sat at the bar for a full 10 minutes before my wife walked up to the cashier and asked if we could get some service. Our apparent waitress finally appeared, perturbed by our desire to get some service, and proclaimed, "sorry, I had to deliver food, what can I get you?"  Yes, she was apparently delivering food for 10 minutes. I understand people are entitled to breaks and meal periods, that's not what irritates me, the general lack of employees who give a crap at this location is what irritates me.
