I'll be back because I really enjoy the pizza and they seem to have the beer I like in stock here more often than any other location in town, but if you appreciate good service, pick one of the other locations in town.

Highly recommend.  Consistent quality, fresh ingredients, flavorful, have to go at least once each week!  Garlic knots are yummy on a cold day (or any day for that matter).  Service always friendly.  Sometimes a bit of a wait for seating (15-20 minutes).  If they get something wrong, they do not hesitate to make it right and comp for the mistake.  Love, love, love this place!

Ran in here for a quick slice this weekend. Great pizza! The garlic knots were ridiculous (in a good way)!

Slices were ready to go pretty quickly after ordering. Didn't dine in, so i dont have any input on that side of the restaurant, but the take out servics side was quick and tasty!
We are totally happy with the job cherry hill painters did for us.From start to finish and the great clean-up they did. Thanks doug and linda.
Late night window service where u can buy a slide of cheese $3, pep $3, or prosciutto/basil for $5 - big slices, good pizza, friendly staff.
Great staff and great food. Super fast paced place and it was all fantastic! Definitely want to go back again and again.
Pizza-meat/veggie-was great!  Not too greasy, crust wasn't to thick or thin.  Pretty quick service!

Blind Onion has been some of my favorite pizza for a long time.  Luckily, this Blind Onion held up the delicious food that every other Blind Onion has.  That being said, I don't know if it was because this place is new or what, but it took forever to get our food.  Additionally, I called the make reservations because we were going to have a party of 13.  They said that I couldn't make reservations after 6 on Friday or Saturday (isn't that when you normally need reservations??).  However, when we got there, there was a reservation table for 10 people at 6:00 because they couldn't get a hold of the person to cancel the reservation.  Had I not answered my phone, then would I have gotten my reservation??

Needless to say, I may have to try it again when it's not so busy.

Delicious hand tossed pizza. Just the right balance of chewy and crispy crust. Bacon-pepperoni was a hit with the boys while the hubby and I enjoyed the meatball. Garlic knots were a garlic-butter explosion served with a side of sauce.

Been our very favorite pizza spot since they opened.
I'm surprised to not see about 100 5 star reviews for this place! If you haven't tried it yet, and love pizza, it's time you do.

Killer NY Pizza in Nashville.  This is the real deal.  Those of you in the know of authentic New York style pizza will love this.  Five points has a cool funky vibe inside, very fun.  Service was great, servers were knowedgeable and fun.  You can't go wrong here.  When you realize the line to get into "The Pharmacy" (same neighborhood) is out the door, you will be happy you came here instead!

Ordered a turkey with Swiss and 5 miles away discovered I had received a roast beef. I don't eat red meat so I had to drive all the way back to exchange it. when I pulled up to the window and honked no one came to the window. Finally a food preparer came over with blue gloves on and took the wrong sandwich from me and immediately went into the kitchen and stuck the same gloves he bad used to open the window with into a vat of turkey meat. I informed the manager of the ordeal and she made the worker change gloves and make a new sandwhich but did not seem at all concerned or apologetic. The potential for food poisoning makes this a risky place to eat.
I want to thank my local Butcher for turning me onto this place. Finally found the perfect pizza place when I want a High end Ny Style Pie.

Delicious! No doubt about it. We had the garlic knots (brought some back to the hotel for a midnight snack) and the vodka sauce pie. It was delicious. Only qualm I had is they are a bit heavy handed with the basil. Great service. Great atmosphere. We'll definitely come back on our next trip to Nashville!

Just had my Jetta serviced at Lithia VW. Dealing with them was a pleasure. I want to thank Maya for making it so easy. He was very professional and courteous. They also did a great job washing and vacuuming my car.

Oh man. These guys work hard. I walked over after the Taylor Swift show and they had a consistent line for at least a couple of hours. Great pizza, friendly staff and an all around good experience, even with the long line! Worth it!!

Pizza was good. They were out of the sauce used on the pizza of the month. Service was absolutely horrible (we sat at the bar). Service was rushed and unfriendly. The place was not busy either.
The couple next to us inquired about their pizza after sitting there forty five minutes. Apparently the order was never put in. They left and nobody cared. At least we got our pizza.
I usually have more than one beer but today it was half a beer to get out of the unfriendly and unwelcoming atmosphere. It was a weird hostile and tense feeling. Not going back. We live close but Grimaldis at Legends is much friendlier and tastier. I dont usually do reviews but I was very turned off by this place...

Just left The Blind Onion. I have never left a bad review, owning 2 restaurants myself I try to look for the positive, BUT our service was ridiculously BAD. My daughter and I NEVER get away and are able to have dinner. We work almost 7 days a week from 8 to 17 hours a day. Not that that matters, but we sat for almost 10 minutes before being asked if anyone had helped us. We were ready to order, to go menus were on the table, we ordered and the food was pretty good (only reason I gave any stars at all) and once food was delivered we never saw our waitress again. Waited 15 minutes, yes 15 minutes, never saw any server at all that could help us with a to go box or get our bill! I got up and doing to go boxes, looked at the to go
Menu and estimated what we owed and left that. As we were driving off we saw the waitress at our table in a panic we hadn't left any money. Really, shows you only cared about the money and not your customers. Owner, please pay attention, you were paying quote a few employees and none were very attentive. Even saw more tables come in and never saw anyone bring them menus or acknowledge them either. We were at your establishment on July 1st at 7:00 to 8:00. Oh yea, couldn't have two sandwiches either, only enough bread for one.

I've never seen such a busy pizza place before. The indoor eating area was packed. The take our area was a little less busy. We were hanging out at the bar next door. It was humming but, not like this place. I YELPED Five points and saw that it lived up to all the physical hype. I walked over there and stood in the take out line and ordered some talked about garlic rolls. I sat on a stool and waited and quicker then expected out popped my garlic rolls. 

I'm a fan. The rolls were delicious dipped in the sauce. The people who were seated around me were pleasant and chatted with me as I waited. The majority of the guests are locals. This is a bit out of the way from the tourist crowd.

If I'm in the area I'd come back.

Still loving this place. Not only is the aforementioned server gone but the servers there now are kicking butt. 
 Great service, great food!

My daughter ordered take out tonight 3/6 pineapple pizza, garlic sticks & spicy wings well I was enjoying the spicy wings until I opened a ranch dipped my wing and Out came a large chunk of something along with my wing!  That means Blind Onion reuses ranch.  DISGUSTI NG !

I was looking for pizza on a Saturday...but, NEW pizza...at a new spot (for me).  And that led me to Five Points.

From the moment we stepped into the place, I liked it!  It has that cozy, neighborhood joint feel to it - and I like that!

Another good sign:  the place was packed (~12:45pm).  So many people can't be wrong, right?

Well, simply put, this place was VERY good.  The pizza selections were straightforward and offered enough variety.

We chose the special of the day:  a generous slice of sausage and red bell peppers with feta cheese.  It was on a fairly thin crust and had a perfect combination of flavors.  I opted to add a spinach and gorgonzola salad - a tasty compliment.  Topping that off with a dark brew, it was a wonderful lunch.

Fast and friendly service, too.  This place hits on all points!

I'll return soon!

David is so easy to talk to, and I felt relaxed nought to just let him do what he wanted to my hair.    I'm glad I did, because it is so different than what I had, and I love it!   I wil definitely be coming back!

The pizza is outstanding, especially the crust. Great service. We had a blast.
Our waiters  was curt, rude, but hilarious.  (Sarcasm) She was great.  The way her name was Bree

I actually had pizza from here twice over this past weekend. A friend of mine showed up with some leftovers, so I tried a slice and decided I had to check this place out for myself. 

My wife and I ordered the Greek with Italian Sausage added to half of it, as my better half is a pescachickentarian. It was good, but I think I prefer the classic Pepperoni I sampled earlier. The pizza is NY style with pieces that can be folded, If that's your thing. Also, it tastes like the crust is coated with oil and garlic.

Based on what I've heard, I plan to go back to try the Garlic Knots.

5 Points Pizza is open for business as of today! It is located in the heart of 5 Points in East Nashville right on Woodland. I attended a soft opening last week and I can't wait to go back! The owners are super friendly, the atmosphere is casual, modern, and relaxing. They have a great beer selection and every dish we tried was amazing! We started out with the warm, garlic knots, then a caprese salad, then 2 different pizzas, THEN canoles!! Yes, we were stuffed! The Old World pizza was the table fave. It has fresh mozzorella and fresh basil. The crust is just the right amount of crunchy and soft. As of now they are just open for dining in, but they plan on doing carryout (maybe delivery?) soon. This palce is definitely a must try!!

The Zeus!  One of the best pizzas I have ever eaten.  Their meatball pizza is also fantastic and the slices are huge.  My husband loves the happy hour  slice and beer specials too. The new addition with the walk up window is great for carry out and a quick fix if you can't wait for a seat at the bar
This place is so great. I bring my daughter here for a quick slice on the walk-in side, it's consistently tasty and a beloved neighborhood fixture.

When you can't stop eating the pizza and you know good and well you're past full...it deserves 5 stars. We halved two different pizzas. The hot Hawaiian was our favorite!! Love that it's not just plain ham as the meat topping. Nice touch! 

Service was great as well as the City Winery Pinot noir on tap! I was hesitant at first, but it was perfect with the red sauce! They give a nice pour size as well...win win in my book! We'll be back!

fast, cheap, delicious. 
we didn't do the full service side due to a 45 minute wait but it was still good!

My fiancé and I went here after it was recommended by olan rogers, we were not disappointed. FANTASTIC. We split a small order of garlic knots, that's was fantastic. Then we split a meatball pizza. Please do yourself a favor and get this pizza. It was delicious. Also even though the place was packed we were seated immediately!
Back for a second day. Cleaning out my old apartment 'cause I moved to Clarksville. Nothing like this in Clarksville. I was very pleasantly surprised to that the pizza was pretty close to NY pizza.

Normally, Blind Onion is a great place...maybe cuz we usually order to go. We planned to eat here for dinner tonight. I stood in line to order (I was next in line), when we were asked if we were dining in or taking out. When I responded we were dining in, a gentleman told us to have a seat and someone would be right with us. Two other parties came in after us. They took drink orders for one party who came after us, which I let go cuz they were right behind us. When they took drink orders for another party that just came in, that's when we got up and left. My husband made it a point to let the guy who told us to have a seat know we were leaving. They were a little busy, but had enough staff there to manage. We will think twice about visiting this particular Blind Onion in the future...they just lost a good customer. We're on our way to Grimaldi's now which is way better anyway!

Family owned business. Mostly regulars during the day and an older crowd for lunches and weekday happy hours. It attracts a younger crowd on the weekends though. It has an extensive menu with a lot of choices. I enjoyed the wings, chicken tender wrap, Caesar salad and buffalo chicken salad. My mother loves the tuna hoagie. I believe they do catering as well. The servers have always been really friendly, and overall everyone is pretty nice.

Five points pizza has been busy every time I drive by- and with good reason. Delicious! I thoroughly enjoyed my slice of plain Jane cheese pizza. The atmosphere is great and the staff is very friendly. This will be my new east Nashville pizza fix. They serve beer and are open till midnight on the weekdays and 2am on weekends! I have no doubt this place will survive and prosper in 5 points.

Great Pizza! Great Service! Had to wait about 10 minutes for a seat but it was worth the wait.  Had pepperoni pizza and a large order of garlic knots. $37 for 4 people and we took a slice home with some garlic knots.  Wish they had a Five Points in Pittsburgh!

Visited this joint because I saw the good yelp reviews. I'm from California and had eaten BBQ all week. This was hands down, some of the best pizza I have every tried. The garlic knots were the best I've ever had. Service was fast and staff was friendly. Look no further for the best Pizza in Nashville.
The best pizza I've had in a long time. Came up from Rhode Island to visit family here and we came here before we went to the airport to head home. I never wanted to leave!

-Went on a Friday night at 8:15pm and had to wait a while to be seated, but it wasn't too bad. Decent wait for such a small place on a busy night.

-Great atmosphere. Sat in a booth and was able to carry on a conversation with friends without having to yell.

-Ordered the Meatball Pizza and it is fantastic. Perfect in every way. 

-Be sure to order the 18", not the 14". It sounds like it's only a little bigger, but it is WAY bigger. You'll have leftovers for 2 meals, and it's just a few dollars more.

-Good beer selection

-Pizzas are expensive (over $20), but I still felt like it was a good value.
Best pizza I've found in Nashville. Great price for a wide variety of beer and pizza. $7 flights were awesome! Close to everything. And really friendly staff!

Wandered into the wine store across the street and one of the salesclerks was eating a huge piece of pizza. My husband asks where it was from and the guys say 5 points across the street. Got a pizza the next day. They have a great menu of pies. We got the trex because my husband is a meataholic. I especially liked the capicola. The pie was loaded with meat and cheese. The crust was New York style thin and crisp. Wish we were locals we'd be there often.
Garlic knots are the bomb!!! Pizza was great and the crust was top notch. Definitely will go back next time I visit Nashville.

We have been getting their pizzas for a few years now. Yes, we know they are a little pricey (around $ 18-20 for a medium pizza) but they are totally worth it!!! Trust me, the crust is perfect not too thick not too thin just right!!! with a little sweet in it ...the secret ingredient that makes us keep coming back :)
Are you wondering why only 2 stars?? well, we made a mistake!! we decided to order their wings. We got these tinny little mini wings, flavorless, meatless ...I don't think their were chicken wings...they look more like quail wings. 
Our order was missing a side of veggies and/or any kind of sauce on the side. And they were expensive! Bummer!!
Now you know, go there for the pizzas not for the wings !!!!!

Let me start with saying that I love Blind Onion Pizza, as long as it's not from this specific location. I've gone to the Kings Row location, great pizza. This one charges an extra $2 per super slice for the same pizza! Also, the sausage they use at the other locations is high quality. The sausage I got from this one was like getting the little gray sausage from a frozen pizza at Walmart. Also the honey and ranch at the other locations is flavorful and thick. The honey and ranch at this location had almost no flavor, and the texture was as if it was heavily watered down. I don't know if the owner at this location is really cheap and cutting corners with his store, but it sure seems like it. I now end up driving 5 miles to the Kings Row location, even though this one is right across from my gym that I go to everyday. I'm not going back.
Amazing pizza here! Awesome combinations and inventive pairings! A little on the pricy side but it's definitely quality pizza!

BEST pizza in nashville.  friendly staff.  great beer selection.  eat here at least once a week.  typically i'll start with the spinach salad and grab a slice of pepperoni or their daily special slice.  it's all good.  all of the time.  in fact, as i started typing this, i started debating in my head about whether or not i should drive there to grab myself a slice...right now!

Let me first start off by saying that pizza is for sure one of my top 5 favorite foods, so I take it very seriously. Five Points Pizza meets all the marks and deserves 5 stars, no question.

It's New York style pizza with thinner crust and monstrously large slices, which is great. The crust is very tasty and good quality, just crispy enough without being overdone. The sauce and toppings are both very good quality as well, truly all around delicious. 

There is a sit down portion of the restaurant as well as a to-go area which has few seats if you just want to pop in for a slice. They sell cheese and pepperoni pizza by the slice every day as well as a rotating veggie meat pizza, so there are always good options. They also have a window open late night and a few beers on tap as well. I'm a big fan!

We picked up pizza to go so I can't comment on the atmosphere, service, etc. The pizza was good though. A little bit overpriced ($20 for the smallest pizza they had) but we were satisfied. They also do pizza by the slice.

Is it weird that my favorite thing there is actually their spinach and cranberry salad? That being said, any time I have a choice for pizza, this is where I choose. Their daily specials are always amazing, and their lunch deal with the pizza and salad is one of my favorite things to grab and go while lunching! Whoever thought of that basil-lemonade is a dang genius.

So, we've been here several times now, and I feel like I'm doing them a disservice, since I haven't  given them a review yet. 

5PP is hands down the best non-wood/coal fired pizza I've had in Nashville. I love all types of pizza, but my preference is wood/coal fired, so I tend not to compare them to those that are cooked in a gas oven, it wouldn't be fair. That being said, 5PP makes one hell of a pie. What they lack in fuel, they make up for with fresh toppings, great sauces, inventive combinations and excellent crust. The crust is what I look at above everything, and they do it right: thin and crispy with a light char(a must), and a crisp yet chewy outer crust.

All the slices I've had here have been home runs. The go to Cheese and Pepperoni slices are perfect, with the Pepperoni being just greasy enough and very good quality. The Prosciutto & Basil is another great slice if you're looking for something lighter but still packed with flavor. The whole pies are cooked to order and have yet to disappoint. The T-Rex(think meat lovers on steroids), Meatball Pie, Hot Hawaiian(pineapple/jalapeno/capicola), Supreme, Caprese...all amazing.

Their Stromboli's are just as good, if that's what you're into. They're made with the same fresh dough and toppings, with a side of marinara(house made I assume). I've only had the Zeus(Pepperoni, spicy capicola, black olives, banana 
peppers, red onions, feta) and it was delicious and not small, haha. Our sever was amazed that I was able to eat one and a slice of pizza. Well, he obviously doesn't know me very well.

If you're really hungry, don't skip the Garlic Knots, but they are filling, so try to get a half order if you can't resist.  I like to save as much room for the pizza as possible, so that's just me. If you're still hungry after going trough a few slices, they do make some pretty good cannolis also. I would ask about availability though, the last time we ordered them they were out.

The service is always very friendly and inviting. The servers pay you just enough attention and the food comes out quickly. They have a great beer selection too, so it's not a bad place to start the night, or end it, or hell..both.

I'm really glad that 5PP popped up, it's nice to have such great quality pizza so close to home.

Happy hour consisting of a draft beer and slice of pizza for under ten bucks.. It really doesn't get better than that! The perfect dinner. Me and my fiancé had both the slices on special- his was meatballs n stuff, and mine was the veggie option with olives, feta cheese, artichokes etc etc you know the type. It was awesome, and our waitress was great and helped us pick out a bar to check out. They were busy but she took her time chatting with us and never made us feel rushed.

I don't have much to offer, since I was there over a month ago and forgot what I had, but I figured I'd give them a 5 star review, as they earned it.

All of the food was great. Wine list was decent but not great. Service was also good. The only weird this was that half the place was empty - on a Saturday night.

If you're looking for something new, give this place a go. You will enjoy the meal.

Went and ordered carry out but they had a place to eat along the wall, so we ate in. Super thin crust, excellent pizza. We had pepperoni and beef (sliced meatballs), 14 inch, so we had enough for the next day. When we got there, we realized you could also buy pizza by the slice on the carryout side, $3.50/slice. We were there at 9pm, LOTS of young college aged kids there. They serve beer, soft drinks. Parking limited. Wait was about 30-35 min. Will go again!

Randomly found this place on Yelp when we were in the area and all the other restaurants were closed because it was Memorial Day. It was some of the best NY-style pizza I've ever had! Ingredients were fresh and the specialty pizzas were unique. Garlic knots are a must. Service was fantastic, and the bartender was very friendly. We'll definitely be back!

This is the best meatball pie I've ever had!! It was nice and hot when it came out, the meatballs were perfectly sliced. The place is laid back and our server Patrick was awesome. If you're visiting Nashville you should definitely check this place out.
This pizza is amazing! Huge slices for good prices. And open late. If you want an amazing pizza and top notch crust. This is the place.

The pizza was very good...  we had the Brooklyn pizza and some garlic knots!  I would eat the pizza again hands down!  I would skip the knots it tastes like a pretzel with garlic salt in my opinion... Which is totally fine, I just wasn't a fan!

Everything on the pizza menu looked delicious and I wanted to get a slice. I asked for 2 slices and was told a slice is 2 pieces. I had 2 orders, one General and one BBQ chicken. The crust was amazing and the toppings were great. They had some great beers too!

Went here with a party of 8 and every one of us loved it! We had 3 pizzas, but each half was different, which was awesome bc there was no way we could narrow it down! Our favorite was definitely the T-Rex... (And if I'm being completely honest with you all, we had a bad case of munchies when we got home from dinner/bars, and ordered 2 additional T-Rex pizzas...on the same night...). But the Bianca was also good, and I was personally a fan of the habanero cream pizza, which could have used a bit more spice in my opinion.  Anyway, if you're looking for a chill place with great pizza, you must try it!
Really good za. The T-Rex is amazing.  Ate at this place for dinner two nights in a row.  Highly recommend it.

One of THE BEST places to get a solid slice in Nashville (especially if you love thin crust)!  Five Points Pizza has a great casual atmosphere & friendly staff.  Do NOT overlook their special slices of the day... they're perfect with a salad and half order of garlic knots.
From NJ, we have the best pizza in NJ. This place is definitely in the top 10 pizza places I've ever been to. Great prices tok

My date and I were trying to figure out where to go for dinner last night, as neither of us had much of an appetite, and both have multiple food restrictions/allergies. He went above and beyond what I expected him to do and found multiple restaurants and wrote down menu items he knew i could have. The Treemont sounded the most appealing to me, and while at work I looked up there menu. There were 1-2 appetizers i could have, no entrees, and could have all of the sides. I decided why not, and he made a reservation with a note stating we both had dietary restrictions. I arrived first and spoke with Abigail, who seemed to be the hostess/bartender, and she went step by step through each menu item with me and told me what each of us could have with alterations, no alterations, and what we couldnt have at all due to premixed ingredients. My date soon arrived, we were seated, and each decided on an appetizer and one of their special non alcoholic drinks. We each got the Solitary Cyclist-grenadine, ginger, lime and soda. It was DELICIOUS. He ordered the slow roasted sweet potato without the cardamom and coffee crumble (gluten allergy) and I ordered the charred beets. Before we received our food, we were given a cast iron dish of spiced popcorn (it's complimentary during happy hour) and it was wonderful (im sort of a popcorn addict). We were both blown away by how simple yet amazing our dishes were, and tried each others. The sweet potato presentation was beautiful, and my beets weren't that fancy but SO very flavorful. It was the perfect amount of food for both of us for the night, and were very impressed with all of our decisions, the staffs accommodations, recommendations and help. I would definitely go back to The Treemont

Everyone who's working here on sunday morning are in super slow motion. Like they all did a bag on dope this morning. The manager is the slowest one! Drive thru had 20 cars in line, nobody was moving so I came inside. Its be me andbthe sane 10 ppl eaiting for our food for 15 minutes

I'm a newbie to Nashville. In order to initiate my arrival, I was taken to Five Points Pizza. To my surprise, this place was exceptionally well organized. Keep in mind that if their is a wait, there is no room to wait inside. I mean, you could but it would definitely be around other diners. Let's get this out of the way: really enjoyed the pizza. The crust was four star worthy which is why it's not the perfect pizza. I loved the flavors and combinations though. I was disappointed in the garlic knots. Service amazing. Pizza was really good. Prices were perfect. Highly recommend if you're looking for a solid pizza choice. (blog post at @tableforyou )

So a reviewer mentioned the garlic knots, and my girlfriend says "we should get the garlic knots"  Good Idea.  VERY good idea.  Their marinara dipping sauce is better than most pizza sauces.

The pizza, is divine.  We had a half Meatball/Red Onion/Tomato, the other half was Spinach/Gorgonzola/something else...it was amazing.  What it was doesn't matter.

NY Style, toppings ALL the way to the edes of the crust, glorious toppings.  My rule is always order a bigger pizza, and have leftovers.  My girlfriend and I only ate half the 18".  And I had to help her a bit.  It was great.

DRAFT SELECTION.  My standing rule for Nashville will be that you only get 5 stars, if I like your draft selection.  For me to like your draft selection, I better see at least 1 local brew!  They had Jackalope & Yazoo (DOS PERROS!) on tap.

It's a personal mission, that everytime I visit Nashville, I have 1 pint of Dos Perros.  It completes me.  Please visit this awesome pizza place, if it's a little out of the way, it's WORTH IT.

This McDonald's is in a lot by itself on eastbound Ridge Pike. From all appearances, the interior design looked up to date for this chain. The food was... well, McDonald's. However, at the time of my visit, I thought the service was above average.

OMG! :D
I love this place. I was riding around yesterday just looking for a nice pizza place, one that isn't a chain like Pizza Hut or Papa John's. I wanted REAL pizza, and boy did I get it. I bought a slice of pepperoni, and it was divine! It was exactly what I wanted. And the slice was huge too! I'm definitely going there again!

Solid NY Style pizza. The taste is good, and the price is reasonable for gourmet-ish type pizza. You can tell the ingredients are fresh. Eat the garlic knots! You know you want to. Garlic should be consumed in mass quantities. Knots of Garlic are just...well..your fingers will be all buttery and the basil might get in a bite or two. Bready, garlicy, basily, marinara-y, goodness. And their marinara is some of the best I've eaten. True Story, got the buttery fingers to prove it. Enjoy often, rinse and repeat.
Great pizza, plain and simple. Perfect crust, sauce, and toppings. The garlic knots were delicious as well.

We were in Nashville with friends for a week and visited this place twice!!!  It's THAT good! It is amazing New York-style pizza.  Our hubbys ordered the T Rex which was a meaty extravaganza, if that's your thing.  The wives ordered a margherita-style pizza and had them drizzle it with a balsamic vinegar reduction glaze and it was unbelievable!!!  LOVE THIS PLACE!!!

This place makes a good slice for a good price. You can hop in here for a quick lunch or grab some to go. I don't think its the best in Nashville but a good place especially if you want to have some beers and hangout.

I'm a picky eater and pizza is one of my favorite food groups. Five Points Pizza is great. We had a movie night tonight and ordered a thin crust pepperoni pizza at 6 pm and it's 10:51 pm now and I'm still eating on it because it's so good and there was so much. Also normally I prefer something besides thin crust, but at Five Points Pizza you can't go wrong with their thin crust. I highly recommend checking them out if you love yummy pizza

Since Chicago is my hometown, I've always have had very high standards when it comes to pizza.I was at this restaurant on the day before Christmas Eve as I was heading down to Florida with my family. The service that we received from the waiter was good and the pizza wasn't bad going by Chicago standards!.I also tried the garlic knots and those were good too.

I drove pass this place a couple of times and it always had a packed house. That intrigued me. We finally made it there on a Thursday night, again packed house, a line out the door just to order. We ordered one med. pizza and pesto chips and 2 drinks. We sat down and waited patiently. My husband and I always end up talking and sharing stories of our day when we eat out on a weekday and totally forget the time. Finally I realized we had been sitting there for about 45 mins. and I look over and the table next to us just had their pizzas delivered to them, they had about four pizzas. That table also sat down about 10-15 mins after we sat down. Also a couple behind us sat down about 20 mins after us and they too had their order as well. The place was even more packed and the line even longer out the door. I stood up to try and talk to or even just flag someone down to get some help. That was a chore because everyone was running around all over the place. Finally got someone ones attention and asked them about my pizza he went to check and brought out 2 boxes with our order inside and said they were sitting up there for us to pick up. I explained that we did not order to-go and that we had been sitting here for almost an hour now waiting. He was very apologetic and asked if I wanted to re-do my pizza. I said no, but asked to speak to a manager. The manager also very apologetic and offered me more pizza or a fresh one. I said no thank you, we were starving. But he did refund all of our money. He explained that they were way under staffed and that he was very sorry.  
I am not sure that we will go back to this location. The pizza's were so-so...the pesto chips, (not really chips, but pesto pizza sliced up) were better then the actually pizza. Both things were not horrible, but also not memorable.
Sofa bed collapsed adding injury to my sister's leg. Waffle maker broke. Ran out of waffle mix. Waited over an hour for waffles.

I have been searching for the best pizza in Nashville.   I think my search has finally ended.  Great thin NY style pizza.   Garlic knots are excellent also.  Only downside is that parking sucks.  Going to have to hunt for a parking spot but it is worth it.

Definitely one of the best pizza places in Nashville. The atmosphere is very nice and the pizza is even better. The garlic knots are amazing and the vodka sauce pizza is one of the best I've ever tried. If you are ever in the Nashville area, you must try this place.
Great NY style pizza! Excellent crust, great sauce, and the best garlic knots I've had. I'd recommend this place to anyone.

Absolutely delicious pizza and wonderful staff! Every day, they have different specialty pizzas that you can buy by the slice (vegetarian or non-vegetarian), which is amazing. You can also get other common pizzas by the slice (cheese, pepperoni, etc) or order whole specialty pizzas or build your own pizza! Everything I've had here is amazing, and the garlic knots are worth the extra calories. :)

We ordered two ice cream cones for kids and the woman who looked like a grassy bridge troll came to the window holding two mutilated ice cream cones and said "I'm bad at making ice cream cones" we smiled and said thank you but secretly wished she could master the art of ice cream twirling as it is her job.

Okay okay okay...
This is such an amazing pizza place! Best thing about it, other than the food, is the atmosphere! Felt really at home, like I was back in LA or Chicago. Great vibes. Cute staff. Pizza was amazing! But the knots where astounding! Must eat!

Great Pizza!
Best in East Nashville!!
We had the Meatball Pizza and the tomato sauce was nice and fresh and the pizza was far from greasy (like most).
I was not in the kitchen but my taste buds say that my meal was fresh!
The Garlic Rolls... Guilty Pleasure, Doughy Goodness!
Best pizza in Nashville. The meatball pizza is a must try. Great group of people running this place too.
Garlic knots....yum!! They were absolutely delicious! The pizza was fresh and tasty, but those garlic knots were to die for!

Service was friendly and prompt, atmosphere was roomy and fun. My husband had the small carnivore pizza, had half and enjoyed it. He loves taking home a snack for later. I had the Italian chopped salad. Delicious and I ate every last bite. It was free anchovies Tuesday and I asked for them for the heck of it. They were fun to try. We will be back.

This was my first stop in Nashville, and so far I must say, "I'm impressed!" I went off the recommendation of the bartender (Michael) for both beer and the pizza, and both knocked it out of the park.   Very friendly vibe, and great knowledge about the food and drinks. It sounds like they even made some recent changes based on customer feedback. Nice to know people listen, but in my mind... don't change a thing!
Great garlic knots, amazing pizza. Definitely call ahead on weekends, we waited a good hour on a Friday night around 7:30. Also, great beer selection!
Been wanting to try this place for a while.  Went at an off time and had two good slices of pizza and a glass of beer.  Cool store.  Looking forward to visiting again.
Another lunch staple we could walk to while working in the area. Cheap, superior to all, roast beef sammiches.
Stellar pizza spot in East Nashville. Seriously, the pizza is bomb and the price is a steal. Super kind and helpful staff here as well, will absolutely return!
Tasty pizza! I came here after an art bar crawl. The pizza slice was hot and the crust was crunchy. I would definitely coming back again.

This is the second best pizza I've ever had in my life. The first is a little place in Allen Park, Michigan called Major Tomato (stop by if you're ever visiting Detroit!). I'm from Michigan and I've had NY style pizza in NY countless times, so usually when I see a place claiming to make "NY style pizza," I kind of give it a side eye and set my expectations low.

This place totally blew me away. We ordered a salad and split it between the two of us (which was more than enough, btw), garlic knots, and a basic pepperoni pizza. The garlic knots were huge, smothered, and so, so, good. I think I ate more garlic knots than I did anything else, but I really love bread. The pizza was thin, the crust was perfect, and everything was so fresh. They have a ton of craft beers, if you're into that. Our waiter was on top of everything throughout our entire meal and luckily for us, we went kind of early and didn't have to wait for a table. I've heard the wait can be atrocious, so I'd either go early (around 5ish) or just get take out, which they have an entire separate entrance for.
Pretty good place! They come up with some fun pizza combos and I always like to go there and try something new.

If you like thin, crispy, and tasty pizza, you won't regret coming here. We visited during tomato fest and tried the traditional pizza with fresh tomatoes, basil, and mozzarella cheese. It did not disappoint. The slices are pretty big and one slice is definitely enough for one person. If you're in Five Points, definitely try this spot out!

This place is AWESOME! We came here on a busy Saturday night and our server/bartender Bart was great. We ordered the vegetarian pizza and all the ingredients taste so fresh. The crust was the best part! Crispy, but not overly so. We also ordered garlic knots and they were my favorite. The ranch tastes very fresh and has a hint of dill. So delicious. I love the beer selection as well. Bart was very attentive despite the busyness and was happy to answer any questions we had. They also have board games and coloring books for the kids. What a nice touch! I will definitely be coming back and try their other pizzas.
Awesome veggie pizza with mushrooms, tomatoes, green peppers, feta, mozzo, and oil base! Delicious food and rustic decor grab a slice or an entire pie.
Great pizza and friendly staff! They have awesome lunch specials. I've been here multiple times and never had to wait on a table. Everything tastes so fresh!

So, this place was a recommendation from a friend that recently moved to Nashville. It was around 11:15(they close at midnight) and we were hungry, so we decided to try, and man, did it not disappoint! The place is small, but that's the only thing that wasn't amazing about this pizza joint! They have about 20 local brews on tap, and a small but on point menu! The garlic rolls were amazing with all the butter and fresh garlic(my mouth is watering just thinking about them again)! Then the pizza...oh my, he pizza! New York style and delicious! Soft crust, but not too soft. It will hold the topping as you fold and eat!! Guarantee anyone that comes to Nashville, this place will be a high recommendation and we will be back for sure!!!

Pretty damn awesome!  The Meatball Pizza is as good as everyone says it is...GLAD I tried it...definitely on my list for one of the best pies in Nashville!  Since this was my first trip to 5 Points Pizza...I was torn on what else to try.  Our server suggested getting a 1/2 and 1/2 pizza, this way i could MAXIMIZE my flavor tasting experience...pure genius!  With that said, we also ordered a 1/2 and 1/2 Zeus and Caprese, also awesome, but not as awesome as the Meatball.  So if you are still reading my review, you are probably getting the strong impression that I really liked the Meatball Pizza and you would be right.  Do yourself a favor and try one for yourself...I don't think you will be disappointed.
Went into the restaurant this evening about 7 people eatting very small place the food was awesomeness very big slices with a drink first 7.67 very impressive

Super good pizza joint! We first got there and it was pretty busy and they said it would be an hour wait but it ended up only being 30 mins. Which was well worth the wait. Garlic knots were on point and the habanero cream pizza
Absolutely fantastic cat sitters. They love your pets and it shows. Your pets will love them as well. We always feel completely confident when they watch our pets when we are away.

At 4 p.m., I needed lunch badly, and Lion's Choice was close.

I got a large roast beef sandwich with cheese, regular fries and a large drink for $8.62.

The food was quite good, maybe especially good, because I was so hungry.

The sandwich was hefty with well-seasoned roast beef, a little light on the cheese, and the bun was soft.

The fries were thin, skin-on, crispy and salty.

There are two fountain drink dispensers, so many choices are available.

And there is an abundance of condiments, none of which I used.

OK, I'll buck the trend. I've been there probably 4 times, the most recent being today. I have always thought that the best way to judge a pizza joint is by having a plain cheese pizza, so that is what I had today. The pizza was good, but not great. The cheese was dried out on top, so perhaps it needs some greasy pepperoni on it to keep it moist.

I appreciate that they have some craft brews, but to me their selection is a bit odd. The Porter has blueberries in it?  Guess I'm old school. The stout today was good, but not great.  Their dark beer choices have always been pretty good, but not great.

Anyway, not a bad place at all, but I do wish the crust was softer and the cheese wasnt dry. Perhaps brushing the top of cheese only pizzas with some olive oil? 

I can see why East Nashvillians would be proud of their local joint, but I am not sure its worth going out of the way for.

Update: I went back just a few days later and had another pizza, and it was completely different from the one a few days before. The two pizzas didnt seem to be from the some restaurant, as they were that different. I liked this one more. I asked the server if they serve two types of crusts, and was told there is some variation depending on who cooks. I was told to ask for it to be cooked less if I want the crust to be soft. I appreciated the insight, but would prefer consistency.
Had a great time. Played shuffleboard, had good beers on tap, the pizza was good, and the service was excellent. Can't wait to come back next time we're in Reno.

This place is easily one of the best deals in Nashville. The pizza here is insanely good. After reading all the positive reviews, I was expecting an amazing piece of pizza and they delivered (Not meant as a pizza joke)
At $3.25 for a massive slice of cheese pizza, this is a great deal, especially for the area. The area is great around the restaurant, plan to spend a few minutes walking around.
I like that they serve single slices. Other than that. Nothing to write home about. So that will be the only reason to go back. I am very picky about my pizza and how it should taste. Flavorable!

Sigh. I really wanted to like Five Points Pizza. It's in my neighborhood, I Love Pizza and did I mention it's in my neighborhood? I have been here several times for carry out and it just doesn't cut it. I keep going back hoping I am missing something, alas, I am not. It is not "terrible" pizza just very mediocre. I normally get the cheese pizza but have had other pies there as well, none really did it for me. It is definitely NOT NY style, so if you are expecting that you will be very disappointed. Just because you sell slices does not mean that you are NY style pizza. Stiff crust, so so sauce... a pretty eh experience. The help has always been friendly and the atmosphere is fine, although very small dining area... which is why I carry out. I also found out that their pizza does NOT fair well to being heated up the next day... it was horrible the next day. There are several so so pizza options in East Nashville and any of them are just as good or better than Five Points. I also feel that their prices are fairly high for the quality of the pizza. If you are looking for the best NY style Nashville has to offer try Manny's House of Pizza or NY PIE, both far better options than Five points.. and cheaper. How can you beat that? Better AND cheaper.

Really awesome pizza! The only thing I don't like is waiting to order the pizza. We used to just be able to order then sit down. Know we have to wait for when someone is available to take our order. Sometimes food takes forever. Other then that I love this place! Good quality food!

Short wait on a Saturday night, but there were plenty of seats at the bar to watch the game until the table was ready! We ordered the Greek Salad, Pepperoni slice, and Prosciutto & Basil. Everything as fresh, tasty, and incredible. The service was also great, everyone was so attentive and kind. I absolutely recommend this spot!

Had only been open for a couple of weeks when the two of us went for a birthday celebration.  Menu is somewhat limited, and flavor combinations were adventurous, but we expected that, having looked at the menu beforehand. Had a seaweed salad appetizer (a special) that I wouldn't recommend - mixed too many flavors and consistencies.  Other appetizers (clam ceviche; turnip soup) were good but portion size of ceviche was small  We had the fish for two (Dorad, but it changes daily). It was excellent, but again, portion size much too small for two people.  Drinks seemed like light pours, too.  Dessert (rhubarb/strawberry) was unusual - but excellent. Desserts need better explanations on menu. Felt it was very overpriced given portion sizes.  On the other hand, the service was excellent, and the ambiance is very nice. Could be good with a few tweaks.  For now I'd return to go to the bar, which is very nice, but not for dinner.

This was by far the best pizza I've had in ages! My daughter and I shared the Caprese, and my husband and son shared the Supreme. We started with an order of garlic knots, which were garlicy, buttery and soft. Then the pizza came out and it was perfection. The tomatoes on the caprese were fresh, and the crust was thin and crispy. We had great customer service as well! Best meal we've had in Nashville so far!

I love this place. The girlfriend and I usually make it over here about once or twice a month and it never disappoints. I'll keep it simple. 

Pros: Everything is delicious and they have some great special slices. Also, the beer list is pretty phenomenal and is a good cross-section of local and regional brews. Great value!

Cons: It can get garlicky. I guess that's a con... I guess... Also, sometimes there's a wait as the seating is a little tight.

Overall: Tasty pizza on the East Side with great specials. Go now!

There's a lot of cheap pizza in Nashville and its usually excused do to it. How many times have you shrugged and said, "well, not bad for cheap"? Not so for this place. My experience was great, even if I did pay more. My order was quickly completed and I found the pie quite enjoyable. The hand tossed crust was crisp and chewy where it should be with plenty of flavor without being soaked in grease. Toppings were quality and generous. It floored me that it was less than $10 for a large. If you're in the city and want to carry out, stop by and cruise their extensive menu. If the rest is as good as their pizza, this place deserves more attention than they are getting!
Decent beer selection, and great pizza! Huge portions by the way with average prices. Definitely a must try if you're in the East Nashville area.
Great food and service.  Always on our places to eat when visiting Nashville and we always start with Garlic Knots!
Great Pizza. My favorite item is the spinach stromboli.  Nice and cozy atmosphere.  They have beer which is a plus for most of us guys!!

Service was great. The waitresses are really sweet and attentive.  Parking is truly a nightmare, though.  If you're lucky you'll find a spot nearby.  If not, be prepared to park-n-walk.  The atmosphere is nice enough.  It's a little rundown looking on the inside, but it is a bar after all.  

Ordered garlic knots and a simple pepperoni pizza.  The garlic knots were great. Hot, fresh, and the fresh basil and minced garlic really just brought some amazing flavors to the game.  The marinara sauce is freshly prepared and tastes like real tomatoes... Not something out of a can.  The pizza was great!  Enough for myself and my husband for two meals.  The meat was high quality, tender, and delicious.  The sauce, again, was fresh, sweet, and spiced just right.  Next to DeSano's Bakery, Five Points is my favorite pizza place.

I don't know if I've ever eaten anything better. I'm from North Jersey (they have great pizza) and this blows all those joints out of the water. The Woodstock Classic is my favorite pie along with a Founders Nitro Pale Ale on tap. Unbelievable combo.
The pizza is excellent and the wait staff is top notch.  The mood is energetic.  A great spot for casual dining!!!!

This New York style pizza is incredible! And the location couldn't get any better especially after a long night out at the local bars. The service is great too! 
Immediately upon entering the restaurant I had deja vu! It's identical to a pizza joint I used to go to in the Castro in San Francisco! Maybe even yummier! And yes, the garlic knots are also delicious!

Met up with the Hubs and a friend Saturday night to grab some pizza by the slice. Cute restaurant and great service! Price point per slice was dead on and the pizza was super tasty. Even the house salad we ordered was fresh. Can't wait to come back and to make this our pizza joint .

Best. Pizza. Ever. 

I could also tell you that this place has a cozy feel, while maintaining a cool, hipster vibe.  (NOT like a certain place where they're SO cool and hip that they look down on you.  I'm not naming names here....but the name of that particular place just happens to rhyme with Linegood Nocial.)   

Or I could tell you that the service at Five Points is good, the booths are comfy, the drinks are very cold, the salads/dressing are YUM, and you get your food really fast.  But you don't care about any of that, do you?  You're mainly going to Five Points Pizza for the PIZZA.  

Well, we ordered a 14" pizza today....more than enough.  We got full and brought two remaining slices home with us.    We did one half as the Gorgonzola specialty pizza, and the other half with a custom selection of many vegies.   It was fantastic.  

By the way, their crust is to die for.  And when I do finally die (way off in the distant future), I want a Five Points Pizza buried with me.  Just lay that sucker right on my chest, under my folded hands.  I want to be able to get at it, you know, just in case....
Oh Lion's Choice of my youth, I love to visit you whenever I am in STL - why oh why do you not have a location here in Kansas City?!?!

Today I went outside of the. Box and rocked a Stromboli for the very first time. I will say that it is a challenge to complete the action of eating it all alone, however I pulled it off barely. The service was great as I sat at the bar and enjoyed some wine on tap as well as  the welcoming atmosphere. I have always enjoyed this spot and feel very fortunate to live just .8 miles from this  awesome spot.....love it all!!

A slice of NY in Nashville! Delicious. Crisp crust and the sauce & cheese makes a trio of perfection. The ONLY pizza you should eat if you're within 50 miles. :) We love the walk up window, the paper plates, and the fact that you can order by slice.

Perfect early dinner for my family of 4. Seated & served  quickly w/ great service. Daughter loved her Pepperoni slice, son finished 2 cheese slices, hubby ordered a second meatball slice since the first one tasted so good. My caprese hit the spot as did the half order of Knots w/marinara that my daughter & I split. Wine good & great selection of beer.

Very good pie, service was fair. Sat at the bar with a group of buddies, started with garlic knots and drafts. Goood selection of drafts, knots were very good. Ordered a few pies, they got the order wrong, but all was delicious. Waitress brought out more ingredients to make things right. Would definitely go back.

Massive pizza and great atmosphere? Yes please!

My family and I ordered the garlic knots and the 20" T-Rex pizza. Needless to say, the 20" was plenty enough for a family of 4 (two of the people being 7&1) and then some. The slices themselves are HUGE. I could have easily been full from one. 

The garlic knots:
They come in a full order (4) or a half order (2), with a side of marinara sauce. They are covered in  garlic salt, oil, and garnish. The marinara sauce makes the knots much better, however. They didn't seem like anything special, but we're good enough that we would probably order them next time. 

T-Rex pizza:
Covered in sliced meatballs, Italian sausage, pepperoni, and spicy capicola. This was a mighty pizza, packed with meat. The "T-Rex" is an appropriate name, you'd have to be a monster with an appetite to eat that giant pizza in one sitting. The spicy capicola wasn't super spicy, but added a good little kick every few bites. 
The crust was cooked perfectly. Crispy, but not tough. Next time we will stick to the 18"! 

The restaurant building is split into three sections: 
Take out, window, and dine in. The dine-in area isn't very large, and has a small bar that they direct you to wait by if there's no seating immediately ready. We came at dinner time and ended up only having to wait about 15 mins, not bad at all. 

The staff was super friendly and helpful. Our server was super nice to our two boys (7,1). Our oldest was given some pizza dough to play with while we waited, such a cute idea! 
Our meals came out quickly and was eaten even quicker. We ended up leaving with almost half he Pizza however. So maybe we'll stick with the 18" if it's just us again. 

We would go back again for
Best pizza in East Nashville and possibly the best Pizza. Five points and Joeys are on par with one another. Have been back and will continue to go back.

Best pizza in Nashville. Period. 

I was skeptical about a new pizza place opening in the neighborhood since Pizze Real, Castrillo's and Italia already gave the Eastside good local choices for a delicious slice, but then I came to my senses and realized that your neighborhood can never have too many options for pizza. Let's just say that while those other places can hold their own and make a mean pizza, they are merely the opening act for the spectacular headliner, which is Five Points Pizza. 

Nestled in the heart of Five Points in East Nashville, this unassuming storefront isn't boastful or trendy, but merges beautifully with the feel of this historic stretch of Woodland. Deceptively small from the outside, the inside of the restaurant stretches back and actually has ample seating in booths, tables, or room to belly up to the bar (great locals on tap-Jackalope, Yazoo, and Calfkiller) if you want to get your cold one a little quicker. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful, and the decor is a little rustic and well worn, which lends itself well to the age of the neighborhood and feels like it has been a part of it for years. 

We tried the sliced meatball, the pepperoni, and of course, the garlic knots. First of all, the garlic knots are phenomenal! Nicely toasted and drizzled with olive oil, fresh garlic, parmesan, and fresh basil on the outside, while still tender and fluffy on the inside. Yum...do not pass these up. As we finished our knots, the pizza was brought to the table. As sad as I was to move on from the garlic knots, our gorgeous pizza was there to console me and make it all better. First bite impressions, perfect thickness of crust--foldable, but still crispy without being cracker-like, and still enough breadiness for some chew and structural integrity to your slice. A great balance of fresh sauce, plenty of cheese, and a generous amount of pepperoni and sliced meatballs. The pepperoni was great, but the sliced meatball was AMAHZING! 

If you are in the mood for a whole pizza or just a quick slice, I would highly recommend Five Points. Friendly staff, reasonable prices, a great beer selection, and awesome pizza. What more could you ask for?

As we went to 5 Points, we saw only the dining area first. It was packed at 2 PM on a Saturday. The hostess said it would be a 30-40 minute wait for two people. Little did we know, the window pickup section of the restaurant was right next door. It would have been awesome if the hostess nudged us that way before we waited 15 minutes. We opted out of the dining area and went next door. 

Such a cute and less crowded part of the establishment. We got our ginormous slices in record time at an excellent price. Definitely recommend to people who are visiting Nashville on a budget. I got the pepperoni and hubs got the Meat special of the day. Both were yummo. 

Cute, friendly neighborhood. Ample parking options. $5 parking for 2 hours nearby or I'm sure you can find free parking if you are patient and want to walk a bit.
The veggie pizza with the vodka sauce was delicious! Five Points is a great place to end a night in East Nashville

Our first night in (East) Nashville and we found our way to Five Points Pizza. Wow, what a discovery. We only had a quick meal but it was beautiful yet inexpensive at the same time. We had the cheese pizza slices as well as meatball slices. We'd recommend both - and we may go back before our stay in Nashville is over!

Let's start with this place having the best BBQ chicken pizza in the area. Add that to the fact that you get to dip your crust in honey as an added bonus and you've got great pizza all the way around. The manager, Gina, is awesome. Great service from her and everyone else. Been coming here for a few years and won't go anywhere else. Skip the traditional chains (Pizza Hut, etc) and do yourself, and your mouth, a favor and eat one of their many specialty pieces. Plus, they carry some of the best beers from local areas to compliment those awesome pizzas. I won't go anywhere else unless I want some less than stellar service and food. They've also got great sandwiches and salads! Eat here!

I gotta say I'm biased because I knew one of the owners from high school but this place lives up to the hype.  I have one of those 2yrs old kids that's hard to keep fed and he wouldn't stop eating here.  He's unbiased.

Decent pizza, but overpriced. I hate paying for "hip factor," and there is a little of that built into the price. Still, it's nice to have a place in the neighborhood where you can grab a slice and go, when you don't want a long sit-down meal.
Best Pizza in town hands down! They have a fantastic lunch special! The staff is friendly and fast. This place is a must try if you love great Pizza

A late night hankering for a slice led me to Five Points Pizza. This place did not disappoint. Lined up to the counter and ordered a slice of pepperoni. The crust was thin and crisp but had a chew bite, unlike those pizza Hut thin crust pizzas. 

Have to make another stop back!

I have to say garlic knots and sauce are really good, but the pizza was just okay. Being from Chicago and having access to really good pizza all the time I tried to keep an open mind about five points' pizza. Don't get me wrong, it wasn't bad but it wasn't great either. I actually didn't finish my slice of pizza at the restaurant and took it back to my hotel room. I finished eating it later and it was really good cold.

The night manager was rude upon check-in and the hotel was in disrepair. The carpet in the room was severely discolored and dirty overall. The remote control for the TV was missing the battery cover as well. We had need of the pullout coach and called to ask for additional linens but none were delivered for over 45 minutes so we called again. The linens were delivered 25 minutes later. The rate included a breakfast buffet  but there was little to choose from and what we had was flavorless when we tried it on the first morning but being that it was included with the room we gave it a try on the second morning. On the second morning there was even less to choose from so we opted to go out for breakfast. When I approached the front desk associate to inquire about the breakfast buffet he was on his cell phone and had little regard for me standing there. I could go on for days but I think you get the point. I later found out that this is a "franchise property" and not owned by Marriott International. Thank Goodness!!!

Wow - no ordinary hotel. I was blown away by the kindness and the warmth of the staff here. It feels like you are coming home to family when you walk in the door. Hubby and I travel all over the country for business, including doing customer service training for major companies. These guys deserve 5 stars for the level of customer service. This place is amazing.

The small suite we stayed in was clean, beautiful, and extremely comfortable for long stays. The breakfasts are nothing like what I get at other hotel chains. MUCH more variety and quality. And we were a short drive into downtown Phila during rush hour - about 25-30 minutes door to door. 

I want to give a shout out to John at the front desk, a man with a smile as warm as his heart. Renee, and Angela are angels of kindness and warmth, too. Sorry I'm gushing. But this is a rare gem. HIGHLY recommended.

I really wanted to give it more stars, and I think it's fair to consider the other reviewers that say it's new and I will more than likely give it another shot later on down the road.

The atmosphere: small but charming. Love the interior of the space. Great roomy booths. Really cool place.
The Menu: pretty basic. I'd like to see an expansion with more offerings in the salad category and some other apps. We got the garlic knots and they were pretty yummy, if not a bit coated in oil.
The Pizzas: good offerings-- nothing with chicken really, and pretty much just more of the classic varieties. The crust is very chewy and yummy.  The sauce leaves something to be desired, the hubs + me weren't really into it, but other diners seemed to like it.
The Beer: a decent basic selection. I'm sure that will also be expanded in time.
The Prices: The prices seemed a little high. 
The Verdict: I'll wait 6 months and try it again and revise my review if it needs it.
Fantastic people and fantastic pizza. The prosciutto and basil with some ranch to dip it in on the side makes for a great nightcap after a few drinks. Don't forget the garlic knots. Great spot.
Easily the best pizza in Nashville. Great selection of pizzas, awesome rotating beer taps, and always pleasant service. Long live 5 Points!

G a r l i c     k n o t s. 
All you need to know. They are fantastic and worth every penny. Pizza is ok. Garlic knots are excellent. Love the fact that they've expanded and now have a to go window as well as "by the slice" option. Killer addition and did I mention the Garlic Knots yet!!! 
Go get some now!!!!

Had the prosciutto & basil pizza the other day and was not too thrilled about it. Now sure what meat they put on the pizza, but anyone who has ever had real Italian prosciutto will be very disappointed. They cheese however was tasty and the basil fresh-ish. The Parmesan it was topped with on the other hand tasted like the bottom shelf Costco brand. Yikes

The reason why I gave 3 stars in the end were the dough balls, they were delicious, seasons nicely and came with a lovely dipping sauce on the side. Two thumbs up for that dish.

Oh.... and somehow I ended up paying $30 for the pizza and dough balls. Prices I usually only see in LA... ^^
It's cheap, what can I say?  It's been there (in that location) forever
Pizza was awesome!  The service was just so-so.  Definitely would go again.  Prices were normal.  Didn't have a beer on this trip but, they offer an extensive beer menu both on tap and bottles.
After living in the nyc metro area for 11 years and always having great pizza I was afraid I would never find it here in Nashville.  This place is very nyc style and I love it.
Delicious NY style pizza! Even if you choose a pie with toppings, try a slice of the cheese pizza and you will be glad you did. Very good draft beer selection. Solid 5 pizza.

This has been one of my favorite places since moving to Nashville BUT  what once was a great pizza and beer "joint"  is now off my list.  Food is still great BUT the staff is horrible.  After my last visit, no one to great us (that's ok I will take a seat)  I waited for 15 minutes and then had to flag a wait server down to get a menu.  She never returned.  6 other tables came in during this time and all were waited on.  No servers made eye contact or acknowledge us.  Just too many places to go to overlook suck horrendous service!  NICE while it lasted would suggest taking off your list!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

After my last review of Treemont (mainly regarding the inferior service we received at this restaurant), the restaurant's management contacted me to apologize for the bad service our party of four experienced there. They invited our entire party to come back and retry the Treemont experience.

It was AMAZING. From the beginning to the end - it was truly over the top. They greeted us with a bottle of champagne for a festive start to the evening. 

This time we praised our server and kind of preferred him to sit and chat with us rather than wait on us. Our server was the most food knowledgeable person I have ever met, pleasant and very interesting person. 
He knew the smallest, most specific details about the entire menu, and his recommendations were on point once he got to know our tastes and preferences. 

We sat upstairs (I didn't even know they have upstairs seating). It is a great space and the atmosphere is young, modern and really classy.

And the feast began... 

Scallop Crudo - wow. It was so good and unique we wanted to order more, but more than 5 appts for 4 people is already a little bit too much 
Chick Pea Fritters - because you have to have them
Ricotta Gnudi - if everyone is recommending them, there has to be a reason. They were so fluffy, the filling and sauce were really good and complemented the smooth texture.
Escargots à la Georges Perrier - the waiter recommended and he knows what's what. It's a must order.
Charred Squid - we needed to revisit this deliciousness. 

And to the main courses - we already had the Amish chicken so we knew what are we getting, but we really enjoyed the tender, buttery like short rib for the fist time, who knew that grits can be so tasty? 
The Scottish salmon with its green broth - I never tasted broth with sorrel leaves and it was a great introduction. 

You cant, but CANT pass on dessert - we ordered 2 - the candy and cookies variety and the Sour cream pannacotta. I could have eaten just that (in much larger amount) for the entire meal. Yes it was that good. 

We cant wait to go back and will gladly recommend to our friends. I know they will have a great time.

Average pizza. There was no "wow" factor or much to be remembered. Italian sausage is not very good at all. I wish there were more pictures on their website so I would have been warned about the Italian sausage before hand. Thick round circles of sausage that do not compliment the pizza well at all. However, the place seemed like a good atmosphere with cool pizza. I just don't think I will be returning.

Umm... how have I lived in Nashville for two years and never come here?!?  Truly, a travesty.

I cannot add anything that others haven't, except to say the tagline here is perfect, "Hot Pizza, Cold Beer".  And cheap.  And friendly service.  And delicious.  And a great beer selection and pizza selection.

I cannot wait to come back.  That's really all there is to say.

Five Points Pizza is the best option for dine-in (or carryout) pizza in East Nashville, and potentially in Nashville.

My girlfriend and I went around 7pm on a beautiful Friday evening, expecting any restaurant to have a bit of a wait. We walked into to a fully seated restaurant (though there weren't any spare bodies mingling and taking up space) and were greeted by a friendly hostess. She said the wait was 45 minutes for 2, took our name and cell number, and told us we should feel free to go anywhere in the neighborhood in the meantime. I appreciate this dual-purposed crowd control tactic and neighborhood promotion. We popped next door for a drink and appetizer while we waited.

About 45 minutes later, we were seated. The long and narrow floorplan is small and cozy, but has a nice vibe with tall wooden ceilings. Our friendly, on-point server greeted us with waters, and we ordered from their beer list, which featured a nice selection of local and seasonal draughts (each listing included helpful descriptions!), as well as a slew of bottle and can options.

For pizza, you can order by the slice or pie, creating your own or choosing from a number of specialties. The topping list was above average, including fresh jalapeños, always a good indicator of produce quality. We had it narrowed down to a few pies, and our server made decisive, efficient recommendations, including telling us that you can split specialty pies 50/50 at no extra charge. So we tried the meatball on one half and the hot Hawaiian on the other. Both were delicious.

The pizza here is very good, and (now, after multiple visits) it may be my favorite in Nashville. The dough and crust here have more of a cornmealy crunch than my other favorite pizza spots in town (DeSano and Mafiaoza's). But it's hard to compare, because each is prepared in a different style with different ingredients.

If you're looking for something quick, don't bank on getting a table right away. But if you're looking for a quality dine-in pizza experience in Nashville, Five Points Pizza is one of your best options.

We were actually just here last night and it was our first time. We ordered the knots....and you should too! We actually ordered the vodka sauce pizza and the Zeus Stromboli. The actually brought us a different pizza than the one we ordered, they brought us the Rocket Pie, which was still delicious! We addressed the issue of receiving the wrong pizza and without even blinking, they offered to make it right and gave us the choice of getting the pizza we ordered to go and keeping the pizza they gave us, or a discount on our bill. 

Even if we didn't get the wrong pizza I would have given them 5 stars. The pizza, staff, and atmosphere is awesome. We are so happy we live in the neighborhood and will definitely be back!
Excellent beer, superb pizza, and fantastic flavor. Don't skip the garlic bites! While the food is great, you might find yourself in for a wait if you go at peak hours. Come prepared!

The pizza = amazinggggg, huuuge
The service = speedy, nice (our waitress was fantastic!!!)

Try the T-Rex and ADD bacon; you won't regret it.
(Or even just the cheese, because it's just that good.)

This is a copy and paste from my review from the location in Victorian Square. 

My girlfriend and I have been to both locations and are fans. Great customer service at both locations and great food. From the pizza down to the bread sticks, we have enjoyed our purchases. I really dig the sweet flavored crust. Prices are right and the servinings are on point. Keep up the great job!

This is your typical Great Clips.  You go in get on a list to get your hair cut and you get the next stylist that is available, so it can be hit or miss.  If there is a stylist there that you know, you can request that stylist, but this might increase your wait time.  To avoid long wait times I suggest getting the Great Clips app and do the online check in.  You cannot pick a stylist, but you can find out what the wait time is and wait at home after you have checked in rather than waiting a the shop.  Also the app will let you know the wait time for the surrounding Great Clips.  For example the one in the Fry's shopping center had a 90 minute wait yesterday, but this one only had a 30 minute wait.

This is the best pizza in Nashville. Most recently my wife and I met up with a couple of friends for dinner on a Friday night around 6:00. The restaurant is a little small, and everyone loves it, so there can be a wait on the weekends. We had a 30 minute wait for a table in this case, which we spent at the bar. The bar is in the back with a selection of beer and wine.  It is a small bar with a small-town feel to it. It always seems like people are running into someone they know, and the bartenders seem to know a lot of the patrons who stop in for a drink or a slice. Their beer selection is perfect for a pizza place: 10 taps with an emphasis on local breweries, one of which is reserved for a high gravity selection. On this occasion, they had good people IPA on tap (a fantastic IPA out of Birmingham, AL with a smash of grapefruit and a crisp dry finish. It has become my go-to IPA since moving down south), so we were perfectly content grabbing a seat at the bar and waiting for our table.

Once we were seated, we got an order of garlic knots, which are delicious (and have a ton of garlic) and $3 gets you an order of four. We ordered an 18" Zeus, which is our favorite pizza on the menu. Peporoni, spicy capicola, banana peppers, black olives, and feta cheese. Its got a little bit of kick to it with a touch of sweet, kind of like a good italian sub, and the black olives and feta give it a sort of greek salad finish. It also re-heats really well, so we always get the 18" whenever we go to ensure we will have plenty of leftovers! Our two friends ordered a build-your-own pie with pepperoni and jalapeno. The fresh jalapenos had some serious kick. 

The service was outstanding as always: attentive, kept an eye on our drinks, and patient with us when we kept forgetting to decide on our order. I will say the pizza is a little bit on the pricey side, and seating can feel a little bit cramped, especially in the tables by the doors. But once you have their pizza you will struggle to justify getting a pie anywhere else in Nashville.

Pizza was good, but I'm used to pizza places where you can add whatever toppings you want to the pizza, which they don't do here, and I was a little disappointed. Beer flight for $7 was awesome though.

Gotta get the garlic knots. Hot and dripping with garlic and oil tone dipped into the super rich primavera sauce. Oh my! Although so good I must hold myself back from ordering too many. Is gotta save room for the main item pizza. My faves are pesto pie totally vegan or the vodka sauce pie with prosciutto, spinach mushrooms fresh basil.... I'm here right now and the garlic aromas are totally drool worthy. Be prepared for a wait though. Getting in here is not easy cos soooooo popular.

My best friend surprised me with a manicure for my birthday. Undoubtedly the best manicure I have ever had in my life. It lasted 3+ weeks and only had to come off because my nails had grown too much. 

I gave the artist an idea of who I was and kinda what color scheme I was interested in and she ran with it. It turned out so hecking cool. I've never felt more awesome. 

Such an all around A+ amazing experience. If you've got the money - do it. If I had the money, I'd see her every other week. But for now, relegated to special occasions. 

WORTH IT!!

We were recommended this place by our doorman.
He was on point! We ordered the Czannns Blonde beer , Woodstock pizza and the Spinach salad. Everything was perfectly done and so delicious.
Our waitress was attentive and very sweet.
High Five to this place!

Definitely the best pizza in Nashville. The garlic knots are fantastic, and I love having the option of buying pizza by the slice. The only downside is that if you're not ordering to go, there is always a wait for a table.

Best pizza in Sparks! Their menu has a wide variety of pizza options, so you're sure to find something amazing. The staff is friendly. Plenty of TVs to watch sports. There's also some games around for the kids.
love the yummy garlic knots!  Every pizza we've had has been excellent.  The meatball pizza is one of our favs.

Coming from NY the true home of pizza I want to say Rick and crew at Five Points got it right!!   Ordered the South Brooklyn with pepperoni last night.    Nothing anywhere In Nashville like it!   Great Job guys

We had the T-Rex pizza.  Lots of great meat on top, crust is very good but not super crispy, more like good baked bread.  

I had the basil-infused lemonade. It was amazing and definitely worth trying. I've never had anything like it!

My bf and I stumbled upon this place while bar hopping in east nasty and the place was packed. But as soon as we walked in 2 seats became available at the bar. We sat and examined the menu and ordered the garlic knots and the large Zeus pizza. When it arrived in about 15-20 mins everything was hot and ready to eat lol... I took a bite into the garlic knots and they were so fluffy and light with the marinara sauce and the PIZZA my God was good. The crust had a nice crunch to it and the toppings were spot on. We also had a craft beer flight which was pretty good. Pizza was made to go with a nice cold beer. Overall this place I would say is a must even if you just get a simple pepperoni or cheese through the serving window outside. I will def be back to try the other pizzas.
Fabulous!! Best crust I've ever had. The crust makes or breaks the pizza, imo.  This place rocks.

First off, I'm so excited about this location.  It's a great place to get late night food on the east side without smelling like a cigarette pack when you leave.  

We stopped in yesterday to grab a couple of slices and an app.  The pizza was decent but when you order by the slice, it's obvious they just heat it up in the oven before bringing it to your table... like a Sbarro. Which isn't a bad thing but I was expecting a tad more fresh.  It was good though (I had a slice of artichoke heart and feta) and next time we'll be ordering a whole pie.  They look delicious!

Beer menu isn't too shabby either :)

This place was really good, I lived in New York City for a while so I am definitely a bit of a pizza snob and it does not compare to New York but I did not regret coming here either.  I tried the prosciutto and basil pizza and It had a really good flavor, but the garlic knots were actually my favorite.

Great food and great atmosphere!! I've been going to Blind Onion for the Super Slice special for 9 years and it continues to be one of my favorite pizza restaurants. The people that work there are super friendly plus the atmosphere is really fun and upbeat!
