The order arrived and it was just my wife's sandwich. She took a bite and the chicken in the sandwich was cold and the cheese on the bottom of the sandwich was not even melted. Finally found a manager to express our complaint and he gratefully refunded our money. It took him an additional 5 minutes for him to bring out the refund and the pizza still had not arrived. So I ordered it to go.  If the sandwich had been okay my wife would have been finished before my pizza had arrived. 

The only thing that saves this review from a 1 star  is the professional manner in which the manager attempted to please our situation however I'm not sure even with a free pizza upon my return,  I will think a long time before going back to this restaurant. What a shame.  I certainly have other places to spend my hard earned money.

Maybe the manager should find another resturant to run where his talents would not be wasted by this resturant reputation it is getting.

Do you enjoy fine dining? Do you enjoy a cool place to sit with wonderful service and hospitality? Do you enjoy not being forced to sit outside in the 90 degree heat due to your need for a service animal? Then maybe you shouldnt come here. I entered this establishment at a slower time in the day for some pizza with my service animal who was clearly marked and well behaved. Upon entering I was told "I had to go outside because animals were not allowed" I clarified that my dog is my service animal and two men, ( I did not catch their name) told me it doesnt matter and "you have to go outside" yes i mentioned that it was illegal and they did not care. Hungry and hot I decided to go sit outside, my friend was with me and as we walked out to the patio to sit we were blasted by the heat and the sun. She mentioned how illegal this was and we made our way to our seats. A few minutes passed and the male who kicked us to the patio asked us what we wanted and if he could bring a bowl of water for my dog (very kind) unfortunately he did not, he returned with our drinks and no water bowl, due to the sun blazing on my skin we asked him if we could open a patio umbrella and he ignored us and walked away. One of the men sitting outside overheard our conversation about how frustrated i was at this and went inside to talk to the manager because it was discrimination. I left about 5 minutes after because my dog could not stand the heated concrete and at that point neither could I.

Best pizza by the slice place in Nashville. I think it's the best when you go when they first open see Ashley and get 2 pepperoni cold no shake . It's not really cold if you get there before 12 . It has a more chewy crust instead of being crisp like a cracker if they don't put it back in the oven .

Yes! Come here if you're looking for a good NY style inspired thin crust pizza. Just the right amount of sauce and cheese. The salads are good too. Salad and cheese slice can make a really good meal at around $10 budget. Friendly staff and quick turn around time.
So happy 5 points pizza has come to west Nashville. Fresh toppings, good service. Dont ever do the fast food pizza anymore. I have been spoiled.

Brought my pizza-snob of a boyfriend here and this place earned his stamp of approval!! Great service, plenty of parking, and excellent pizza! Prices are very reasonable and there is lots to choose from.

Holy crap, this place is a mess. The staff need some serious retraining, as about 75% of them are unprofessional and rude. Had multiple bad experiences here. I understand that it's a chain fast food restaurant and I'm honestly not paying for a better experience, really, but I'm entirely positive that as a paying customer I deserve better than to be cut off mid-order and be thrown my food with a flip, "Thanks," (from a manager, no less). He's lucky I caught it or I might be in there still telling them all this to their faces rather than passive aggressively on here. 

Honestly, if you have time, drive to another McDonald's. Especially if you have trouble catching a flying bag of food.

Incredible! Five Points gets Five Stars and it's a no brainer. Quality is everything at this pizza joint located in the Five Points section of the trendy East Side of Nashville. The sit down space itself is pretty small, so be prepared for a wait. However, I've never had to wait an unreasonable amount of time.

Five Points Pizza has a great selection of local beers that always seems to be rotating. It's a good place to sample the local craft brews that Nashville has an abundance of. The garlic knots are fantastic and a good way to kick off your meal. 

Once again, quality is everything and it's very obvious that everything made here is done so using high quality ingredients. The crust always tastes fresh, the sauce is amazing and the toppings are really good. Even when the sit down section of the restaurant closes, the walk up window is still open late offering slices. If you're hanging out at one of the late night hot spots on the East Side, it's definitely convenient. The prices are a little more than what you would pay for one of the big pizza chains, but trust me, it's worth every penny.

Five Points Pizza is the first restaurant that we take anyone visiting us in Nashville to eat. Hands down, the best pizza I've found in the city!

By far, my fave pizza spot in Nashville! I love how you can get a slice of their speciality of the day or pepperoni. The dough is bomb! I also love their lunch special: salad and pizza slice for a great price. They have a great beer selection as well!

There's honestly nothing bad I can say about five points pizza. It's simply amazing and their garlic knots are one of the greatest garlic breads I have ever had. On our adventure exploring East Nashville we stumbled across this pizza spot and boy did we hit the jackpot. The staff are all so sweet and attentive and the restaurant is very clean and well taken care of. The food is simply amazing I definitely recommend the garlic knots a meal is not complete at five points without the knots.. go grab a slice you won't regret it!

Pretty good pizza. Great thin crust that holds it's crispiness. Fresh ingredients. Our waiter was awesome as he brought the kids dough to play with as they waited for their pizza. Got the cheese pizza as well as 1/2 meatball and 1/2 pesto. All was tasty.
What can I say...the love affair with your pizza is real. Best pizza ever. Hands down. No question. Super Bianca, Rocket pie...any pie. You will never be disappointed.

Not worth rating. We checked in on line and were in the #2 slot. After waiting 15 minutes, a father and son walked in verifying no on-line check-in Both we taken back right away. The response when I said excuse me...oh we didn't know you were waiting. Really! I can't trust them to cut hair if they are not bright enough to see customers are waiting! GO TO SUPERCUTS BY NEW WALMART. COMPETENT!
Visited here on a recent trip to Nashville , Great service  and food ! Friendly server . Very impressed for the price !

Wow! This was pretty easily the best pizza I've ever had. Bonus for the fact that they are open super late hours and can accommodate my craving for non-fast-food at midnight. It's thin crusted fancy pizza.. I had jalapeno and sausage, my husband had prosciutto and basil. So good, and good wide slices!

Recently discovered this spot due to moving close to Nashville.  Really good pizza.  Thin and crispy with quality toppings.  Nice beer selection as well and great atmosphere.  The pizza by the slice and carry out option next door is a great option to have if you're in a hurry.

a really excellent pizza joint! new york style pizza in nashville? i was a lil skeptical, but this place really delivers. 

you can buy individual slices of cheese, pepperoni, or prosciutto and basil every day and then there are a couple of daily special slices. when i went, the specials were caprese and meatball pie. 

based on the yelp reviews, i expected the wait to be long, especially at 6 pm on a saturday, but i guess we got lucky! the wait was only 20 minutes. i'm pretty sure this was because it was the tomato art festival and so there were plenty of cool food trucks to eat at instead. also, since there was the event, during the wait, my mom and i walked around while my dad waited for our name to be called. 

the dining area is pretty small, but the turnover seems quick. next door is a window order system where you grab and go, if you don't wanna sit and dine. 

bc so many yelp reviewers loved the garlic knots, we ordered a half-order (comes w 4) and although they were good, i don't think i'd order them next time. they only taste pretty good when you dip them in the sauce. by themselves, they're pretty dry. next time, i would just fill myself up on the pizza! 

i ordered a slice of prosciutto and basil and meatball pie. my mom ordered caprese and meatball pie. my dad ordered the same as i did but added basil to his meatball pie. my dad insisted that the meatball pie was the best, but my mom and i were most fond of the prosciutto and basil. highly recommend a slice of that!! the pizza is really delicious, not too salty or greasy. the crust is actually amazing. i'm not even a fan of thin crust generally, but five points really nailed it. it's crispy and crunchy but still with a little chew and great flavor. 

the individual slices come from a 20" pizza so the slices are pretty huge. my appetite is unrivaled, however, so although less voracious eaters can be full after just a single slice, i think 1.5 slices is the perfect amount. 

the prices are good, too. slices range from $3 to $5. my dad got a local beer on tap for $4.75. i took a look at their happy hour deals too (weekdays from 2-6 pm) and those look bomb as heck. 

overall, really worth the stop by! delicious pizza, great portions, great prices!
A bit small, but the pizza here is second to none. The garlic knots are also the best I've ever had. I just wish it were easier to get seated.

This is really good pizza. The flavor is great. Thin crust, sauce is not spicy, but carries its own weight with flavor.
The only thing I really do not like is the thick crust on the edge.
I really enjoy thin crust. I am not much of a fan of dipping crust in honey.
Next time I may try something different.
Best pizza in Nashville. Excellent crust, sauce, cheese. Pizza perfection. Only drawback is 45 minute wait on a Saturday evening.

Amazing! We were looking for NYC-style pizza in Nashville and found the most delicious pie. And the Greek salad was outstanding. Our server, Scott, was charming and helpful. We ordered his fave flavor and it was delish! 

It was a bit noisy, but...it is a pizza joint!

YOU HAVE NOT LIVED UNTIL YOUR MOUTH HAS GRACED THIS PIZZA. Seriously... we have traveled around the US- and not even New York could compete with this pie back home. You get a lot of food, for a great price and it's the best thing you'll ever put in your mouth.

If you're in need of a pizza fix on the East Side, this is where you need to go. Their daily vegetarian slice special is always delicious.  Recent updates to the space are fantastic. They always have good, local beer on tap.  Highly recommend the Greek Salad.

I was hungry and we had a short amount of time before our flight. We were already in East Nashville and it was a no-brainer to stop at Five Points Pizza. There was a line to get into the dining room but I only wanted a slice and I headed straight for the carry out section. 

All of the pizza options looked tasty but the meat one for $4.50 a slice really caught my eye. Who doesn't love bacon and jalapeños?

They took down my name, heated the pizza, and a couple of minutes later, handed over a perfectly thin, warm, and crispy slice of pizza. I was in pizza heaven as I devoured this slice of goodness.
Malena was nice and my beer was good but pizza sucked! I'm going back to the one on Victorian. Whoever is cooking needs to be retrained

Not gonna lie, I was a little skeptical before coming here because I'm a New York pizza snob, but I really really liked the pizza here. A group of 7 of us ordered two 18" pies -- one was half cheese and half vegan, the other was half pesto and half vodka. At first we thought we wouldn't be able to finish everything, but we had NO problem eating all of the pizza. I didn't try a vegan slice, but the others were so good. They nailed the plain cheese, which I think is the sign of a good pizza place. But I think my favorite was the pesto pizza. I also got a nitro milk stout from the bar which turned out to be the perfect pairing. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for east coast-style pizza in Nashville. Also shoutout to our waiter Stephen -- he was so friendly!

Best pizza in town! Of course parking in the area isnt that great.. When my wife and I picked up our pizza, she dropped me off and circled the block a few times while i waited. But none the less still worth the minor hassle

Great pizza dive!
Had read an article in the media how this spot made the 50 best pizza places in US. 
Headed to visit family they confirmed the legend status and off we went to try it out. 
Sunday afternoon and crowds had died down. The 4 of us sat in a booth along the right hand side. Service was excellent and our waiter seemed happy to answer our food and beer questions. 
We settled on two whole pies with one split into 2 different topping options. The rocket pie was excellent and had prosciutto- case closed!   The other was the Greek and had feta, olives and banana peppers. The split pie had no red sauce as the base the base but we all thought they were excellent. The crust of these pizzas was the kicker. It wasn't thin but also not overly doughy. Pure Pizza bliss!
Beers on tap were great and I enjoyed several crafty favorites I learned of back home. 
Great option and prices were fair for the quality.

Great pizza, great service. Was led there by our host and ended up right back there the following evening. They also have a happy hour special until 6pm. Slice and any draft for $8. Can't beat this place.

The pizza was well worth the wait. Garlic knots were so so but the pizza more than made up for them. The greeter / hostess was very unfriendly and short; devoid of so much as a smile she seemed like she could care less if we dined there.

I've loved this place since it opened. It's been a few months since we've visited this location, which I had deemed as the best in the area, but last night was a little underwhelming. The service was mixed. The beerista was anxious to share what they had on tap as my go to was out. Once seated (& it was a slow nite with only 3 other tables) the waitress finally ambled over to our table. She was nice enough, but in no hurry. My husband ordered drinks for himself and the kids and it was another 10 min before she came back to take the order and then he asked about the drinks again and she huddled to get them. When the pizza arrive (our normal breath buster) it was pretty light on toppings. Overall I thought its usual outstanding reputation fell a little short.
Thank you for having a choose your own pizza toppings option.  I really enjoyed the pizza I created and especially loved your crust.  I will definitely be back to try other combinations.
Awesome pizza and consistent which I appreciate!  Fresh, good quality ingredients and amazing crust.  Love the daily specials.

First let me say, I like this place.  The bartender was super friendly and personable. Unfortunately, I didn't get his name  
We ordered great craft beers on tap & we watched the game at the bar.  
Garlic knots were delicious!  Pizza flavor was very good even thought I'm not a fan of NY style pizza. 
Overall, the beer, bartender and knots were the highlights for me.

Honestly, we didn't eat here. We went in and, bc Yelp said it had GF options, we went to order and they did not have gluten free pizza. I can't say if this place is good or bad, but the description is slightly deceptive bc the GF options are salad.  But it was pretty busy, so I would say their regular pizza is good.
We had the T-Rex pizza. It gave me the meat sweats, but it was well worth the extra bit of moisture and electrolytes expended from my body.

I've had the pizza several times before but after 2 Jack and Cokes on a Friday night, for whatever reason, it was better than I remember. For thin crust pizza...the 2 slices I had were just enough. The pesto pizza was so flavorful. It's not something I'd normally pick but halfway through it, I remember I stopped and had to admire the taste. I've been craving it since and haven't gotten back there to fix it. I am a fan, indeed.

I can't even give it one star but it won't let me post this unless I do.  Don't ever go to this McDonald's.  I have never been there where they get the order right- even after telling them twice.  Ridiculous. And I will never go again to this one.  Today was the last straw- trying to pick up lunch on the way to a meeting and ended up getting some breakfast combo- what the heck!?

Spent a weekend in east Nashville- had this pizza twice! We went to a different place for dinner one night and ordered a pizza to pick up on the way home! Garlic knots are basically a garlic bomb of deliciousness!
Two thumbs up. Late night pizza suggestion from an Uber driver, in a sketchy neighborhood (so we heard), served through a carry out window on the street. What could be better?
Best dairy free pizza in Nashville. I appreciate that they don't charge a huge fee for DF cheese like other restaurants.

Loved the garlic knots and my personalized pizza! I got a cheese pizza with fresh basil, oven roasted grape tomatoes, and banana peppers. I'm a minimalist what can I say. Everything was so good. It totally captured the New York feel. I definitely recommend Five Points Pizza.

Quick review:
A Lot of supplies (mostly bongs and vapes)
Bad customer service

Review:
I walked in there and wasn't greeted, i asked a few questions regarding a particular tank... One of the workers there was very rude to me, he seemed he wanted to end the transaction fast and get on with his day. In the end I walked out furious due to the customer service. I would recommend going there if you want bad customer service.

Finally made it to try out this spot!  

Decent beer selection-not a huge number, but definitely some unique picks including beers from Country Boy, a new-ish brewery from my hometown.  It's pretty cozy in there...and no real place to wait if there's a queue.  We didn't wait long until our table was ready, though, so all in all not so bad.  We tried the spinach salad, garlic knots, and a pizza with vodka cream sauce and prosciutto.  We liked everything and loved the knots...they're so doughy and delicious!  They also come with truly incredible tomato sauce.  It was so very fresh tasting that hubs and I instantly regretted not getting a pizza covered in it.  Great pizza and looks like they have good lunch specials.

Why do I keep coming? Hmmmm I have to ask myself that love the pizza and ranch out of this world they have my fav beer on tap but the service! SUCKs with a Capitol S! We went in on a Friday night last week JUN 10 and it took over an hour for our pizza....that's nothing I've been on a lunch break a dedicated an hour to a slice....today at 1:53 the next place was dead like 3 people I got my slice and beer....and nothing? No how are you or even a check I had to walk up to the front for that while they all talked amongst themselves in the kitchen....I give two stars graciously for the pizza itself.
I miss the one girl who used to be here...black purple hair she rocked customer service think I'll stick with Victorian square they seen to be better
Wonderful service (Carrie), fabulous food and vegan cheese option!

Finally good pizza.. shopped around Nashville for a good pizza joint for a while now.
Went to the take out section, had a few slices of pizza with a beer very quickly even though the dine in section had a 30 min wait. 
Yum, will come back again over and over when I want some pizza.

Service was slow & it wasnt crowded, but the food was super good. We had never been before, but will definitely come back. Its pizza, salads and ital subs but its the bread that makes it yummy. Foccacia bread, made on site and an herbed cream cheese spread. Waitress really should know what bread is served on...its the only one...however Come for the FOOD!!! Reasonably priced for the portion, too.
Awesome pizza! The crust is great with honey and its the best pizza in town by far.

I wish I could give the blind onion a better review. I have eaten here at least 10 times. I love the pizza, it's fantastic. The garlic cheese bread is also really good. 
The service however is not good, not at all. They tell you to seat yourself and half the time they forget you are even there. They rarely come by to check if you need anything and if you do it takes forever to get it. The place has had every table full with only one server for the entire restaurant. 
Most of the time I go now is for the happy hour pizza deal when the place is mostly empty. I'll still continue to go back because the pizza is so good. I would love to give 4 or 5 stars but until the service gets better it's 3 stars.

Great spinach, ricotta and mushroom Stromboli! My kids had single slices of pepperoni pizza which were big enough to count for two slices each. This place is definitely generous with their portions! Family friendly atmosphere. We'll be coming back.

This pizza was DELICIOUS!!! We ordered the garlic knots, South Brooklyn and the Meatball. The knots had the perfect amount of FRESH garlic and the pizza did not disappoint. I highly recommend this place. Don't let the long wait deter you, order this deliciousness to go if you must!!!
The girl behind the counter is a moron but she doesn't have a name tag on so I can't call her out.  She's high on something. The people working in the back are fast and polite

While visiting our daughter and son-in-law last week....they wanted to show us their go-to pizza restaurant.

Our supper at Five Points East was...in a word....perfect! We each ordered an 18" pizza with a plan to take left-overs back to their place to eat the next day!

We ordered the Supreme and the kids ordered the Old World.

Both pies were  just wonderful...and the crust was absolutely perfectly cooked...thin and crispy.

Cost was in-line with great pizza restaurants!

Already looking forward to our next trip to Nashville and another visit to Five-Points.

To be honest i haven't tried New York style pizza ever in my life so i can't do any comparison but the pizza here are so so delicious. If you want to have some good pizza, you have to come to Five Points Pizza.
Very good pizza, fast service and efficient. The smallest pizza is large for two people. We recommend the bianca pizza. It was good!!!
Amazing pizza! Huge slices, friendly staff, good service, and very clean! Pizza was amazing as well as the great garlic knots!

This was my first time going to this place for some pizza and when i tell you that they pizza, garlic knots are the BOMB they are !!!! I been here 3 years and never had good pizza like that. I would recommend this to anyone that love a pizza or especially a New York Style pizza. My fiancé has good taste in pizza. And everyone that works there was so friendly and making guest feel welcomed.

This restaurant upended my decades long feud with pizza. I'm not sure if it was the fact that I came so hungry that I could eat the north end of a south bound bear, or if this place is just a magical portal to flavortown, but I am really into it. Situated in a creative and fun part of town, it was fun to walk around and scope out the little shops and businesses before hopping in. We got garlic knots and a local beer (Jackalope) to start, and I devoured those so quickly that the woman sitting next to us started crying in fear and her husband had to switch places with her so she couldn't see me unlatch my jaw anymore. Anyway, the basil and prosciutto single slices were DELICIOUS. I love the crispy crust. The cannoli was a great way to wrap up the meal. It was giant, and really complemented my maple flavored beer. 

8/10 would bake myself into the garlic knots.
The Blind Onion is one of our favorites. Excellent pizza crust and yummy wings!! Cheesy bread is very yummy too!

Five Points Pizza has some of the best pizza in Nashville!! They have a carry out window where you can buy certain pizzas by the slice, a to go window and a dine in area. We were lucky enough to walk right in and get a table today (rarely happens when I go), we sat at a little two top table by the window and Carter was our waitress. She was wonderful, got our orders out to us quickly and gave us an overall great experience!!

We always walk by the Victorian location but it is usually busy because we go down during events.

But we were over in the shopping center and were looking for a lunch spot that wasn't overly crowded. This was the place.

Open seating, get your own drinks, beer available and a great family vibe. 

We all ordered different slices of pizza and tired each others. I shared with my 4 year old. 

We will be back or will at least do a carry out order.
Great pizza and environment. Got the TREX, tons of meat, tons of flavor. Will be back the next time I'm there. Love the ascetic and music

Very satisfied with Dan's. Replaced the spring and fixed the cables and lubricated the door in under 45 minutes. The speed is not all that was so impressive. It was the curtious, respectful, nice guy that did the work. The price was also very reasonable. I will use and recommend to anyone in the future.
Great pizza !!! We order 2 pizza the veggie and the spicy one...Great service ! The artichoke is the best!! Never tried it before.. delicious!!!!!!!!
Phenomenal. The prosciutto and basil pizza is to die for!! Had a wonderful lunch with my sister. We will be back!

While I know that this is one of the best pizza's in town; the overall professionalism at this location is poor. If you're willing to wait, or have your order made incorrectly, or be promised drinks that aren't on their menu (referring to beers, "sure, we've got!" then find out after you've paid that they don't, and don't appreciate refunds), it could be your place.

It's just a struggle to have to 'relearn' the rules of eating at a pizza place. Order a slice or a pie, grab cold drink, and enjoy. It really shouldn't be any harder than that. But it is.  

There are other great places for pizza in Sparks. I'll go there knowing what to expect. 

It's sad to have a such a great product destroyed by poor customer service.

After all the hype, my girlfriend and I had to check it out. We liked the selection of pizzas. We especially liked the then crispy crust of the pizza. They also have a pretty decent selection of beers. I'd check it out again.

I took my 3 daughters here last Sunday. I have an 18 month old baby. So when I brought in a lunchable for the baby to snack on while we waited for our pizza to cook, the first thing the lady told us was, "NO outside food allowed!" So I took my 5 year old out to the car to put it away. And my daughter slipped on the ice on the side walk. There was No salt to melt the ice. She got a bruise on her hip and she was crying from how bad it hurt. 
Then, when we went to grab some games to play while we wait for the food...all of the games are messed up & broken. The connect four game was missing a leg and the stopper and there were only 4 red circles and 1 yellow circle. It was all beat up and useless. The management should really get new games for the family's to play. Walmart is right there! I even looked over and saw another family attempting to play a broken, busted game too. It was lame. Last time I was here it was over two years ago and it's not how I enjoyed before. The boy bartender was very nice. But I most likely won't be going back. I hope they invest in new games for the customers though.

Wish I had read the review from 2012 that said they don't really give "Free" estimates on new roof installs. Its crazy to think that a business would turn away a potential customer like this who is in the market of buying a 9k-12k new roof install. 

I'm one that isn't looking for the cheapest quote, but looking for the company who has the better service and who are MasterElite certified. 

Arry's runs on the same level as Acoma Roofing and yet they were happy to come out and try to win my business. 

My wife and I are in the process of buying a house, we are closing in 2 weeks and are trying to get a new roof installed within our first 1-2 weeks in the house. We have 2 young kids so we are hoping to cut down on the noise soon after we move in. The current roof on the house is 22 yrs old and we can't obviously do anything until we are the actual owners of the house.

I'm writing this review because they wasted my time with their so called "Free Estimate". Make it clear on your website!!!

I can't speak for the food as I've never had it. The service for drinks is horrible. Once I had to wait 20 minutes for a beer. There are constantly underage kids in there which really bring down the place. I myself have never had to show my ID. This place is fine if you want to pick up a six pack but I wouldn't stay and hang.
Solid work on that whole no cheese thing. Don't understand why it's so challenging to get an order write especially when you're not swamped with customers.
Had the best time at this place. Wait time was shorter than expected and our server, David, was everything we could have hoped for and more; so chill. But those garlic knots.... :)

Way overpriced. Also, I'm not sure if it was the owner or not, but the man with the Russian sounding accent was very rude and ignorant of the fact that I needed help with something. It seemed to me that he was only concerned with making a quick buck instead of expanding his customers and their knowledge. He lost my business for sure.

Just moved here from southern US where service is notoriously slow...until you come here. Came in and there were only 2 other patrons here so you would expect to not have to wait 30-45 minutes for a pizza only to have it brought out burned!! DO NOT GO HERE!!!

During our visit to Nashville, we sought out Five Points Pizza based on all the glowing Yelp reviews.  My husband and I are definitely​  pizza snobs after spending a lot of time in New York.  Five Points is very close to NY pizza.  Our slices were flavorful, thin, and just the right crisp to the crust.  

We had the 2 slice pizza & drink lunch ($9).  The slices were huge an the price was very fair.  We both had the Meat slices.  We are so glad we went to this little gem and it easily satisfied our NY pizza craving with the flavors and crust.
Too busy, poor quality. Checked in, waited 20 minutes.  Those who check in and walked in later went fitst,

Pizza is pretty good but service leaves something to be desired. The guy working the order window (we were there late) was rude as hell but maybe I would be to if I had to deal with hungry drunks all night.

Delicious ! We tried the Habanero sauce pizza and were not disappointed. The garlic knots seem to be a fan favorite and for good reason . Beer selection is good , nice atmosphere . Would definitely eat here again .

I love a decent quick slice. 
Not my favorite but it was quick and i knew exactly what i was getting my self into. Four star for there straight forward approach.

Five Points Pizza - a Haiku:

New York Pie Vendor
Your Knots and Pie are Divine
Refrigerator.

Hey - I had to think of something with 5 Syllables to end on.

Maybe I could have used Snuffleupagus?  Fiduciary?  Errrr.... Maybe congratulations would have been better?  

Screw it.  I'm not a poet anyway.  

But really - that pretty much summed it up.  The garlic knots and the pizza was incredible.  I am very, very proud of the Nashville food scene.  And I am REALLY proud of the fact that we have such good pizza here.  Many cities have just chain pizzas or average independent pizza places.  

I have tried to come here before a long time ago.  If you read my reviews you'll know that I am part of a dinner club and we go out to eat once a week.  One day several months ago - we picked Five Points Pizza.  We went on a tuesday.  Come to find out - they are closed on Tuesday.  So, that time we ended up just going next door to Tenn-Sixteen and fell in love with the place.  We always get together on tuesdays because it seems to work best for most people.  

Except this week.

This time around - it was accidental that we ended up at Five Points Pizza.  We decided this week to go out to Mellow Mushroom for their 40th anniversary which was on a Wednesday instead.  They had super cheap beers, super cheap pizzas.  Basically - they were dusting off the 1974 Menu and whatever items they had and whatever prices they had then - they would be selling for one night only.  When we arrived - the crowd was insane.  It was pouring rain. We still wanted pizza - but decided that - since we were out on Wednesday and hadn't tried Five Points Pizza yet - that we would caravan to east Nashville and try it out.

When they got use seated (which took a few minutes - after all there were 9 of us)- the server came over and started taking drink orders very promptly.  Then once everyone had their drinks/beers - they took our food orders.  They got appetizers and salads out BEFORE they brought the pizza.  And I have to say - the Garlic Knots were the best I've had.  The salads, although I didn't have one - looks great!  

Finally - they bring out the slices of pizza.  And I have to say - these were in the true New York style.  Huge slices of pizza and they were very foldable.  But, I have to say - it was better than any New York slice I've had.  Lots of pepperoni, just enough sauce and cheese.  It really was a triumph!  

Honestly - Its been less than 24 hours since we left Five Points Pizza and I already can't wait to go back.  

Maybe this weekend?  
Who wants to join for a slice?  
Hippopotamus
Tasty pizza for outside of Chicago and awesome brews. Cool neighborhood to visit or just stop for dinner. Can't wait to get back there!
Excellent pizza!  Excellent Caprese! Prices are steep for small half supreme pizza $19.60 and $6.00 for a bottle of beer but pizza was delicious!

I love A Bow Meow Affair!  Sue is fantastic and truly cares about the pets.  I have a busy work schedule and couldn't do it without knowing that my pets were in good hands!  She always leaves detailed notes, so you know what the pooches and kitties did while you were away.  They are attentive and always let you know if something is out of the normal.  I have three dogs, two are large, and they can definitely handle all types of pets.  You will love the service and the price is very competitive.

It is kind of hit or miss at this location. The service is always excellent, no complaints there.   There have been a couple of times that they have misplaced our order, resulting in waiting over 40 minutes for a couple of super slices. The pizza is great. The wait time on the pizza sometimes not so much. 

With that said, I would definitely recommend.
Really good pizza! The Super Bianca is sooooo good, and the garlic knots are seriously good!

It was so bad. My milkshake was half filled. I was given half of the sauce I asked for. After My drink was filled low, other customers complained too!!! My milkshake wasn't even fully chocolate. No whip Cream or Cherry. Super rude. AND NO KETCHUP?!?!??

I've been going to this shop ever since they opened and have had nothing but great experiences. The owner Derek is a really nice dude and everyone he hires is professional as well as knowledgeable. I've only ever had an issue with one tank I bought from here. It was a Smok cloudbeast. I took it in to the shop and Derek wasn't there but the guy that was working informed that sometimes those tanks can be a little tricky to put back together. They're not allowed to touch customer equipment in case they break it I guess but he went and got a new seal kit for my tank and walked me through how to put the seals in. I put the tank and coil back together the way he showed me (rub a little bit of juice on the edges of the glass that touch the seals)and I've never had a problem since! Apparently the tanks seal very tightly and if you don't lubricate the glass first, it won't seal all the way because you can't spin it against the rubber that tight without something to help it. Thanks for always being there for me guys!

My husband and I had just hit up The Soda Parlor when we realized we were hungry. We asked the guys behind the counter and checked Yelp and both options were...Five Point Pizza. This was good enough for us and happened to be a block over! On the way a local bar behind it had live music, in love. 

Five Point Pizza has a dine in and window for pizzas. We opted to head inside and got spots at the bar instantly. Apparently this place tends to be busy but we were told it was worth it. 

We told the bartender we'd never been there before and he rattled off some options he thought were awesome and talked about the single slices. That seemed right up our alley so we each ordered a Veggie of the Day and Meaty of the Day. These slices came out so quick and were HUGE! Like bigger than my head! 

Both were AMAZING. I had really wanted the thin crust and I was so happy with the vodka sauce. The meaty was also a classic pizza vibe with garlic all over it. YUM! Defiantly an awesome spot to hit up for pizza on the go. I ton a slice and we wandered around. Loved it.

This place is overpriced and the pizza is horrible. Driving home with the pizza in my car it smelled like crap. It didn't taste that good either. I've had better pizza that is less in price and better quality. We got one pizza with bell peppers and the peppers were huge like they didn't want to cut them anymore. I'll never go back to this place again.

Been here a few times and I've always gotten the carnivore which is great. They also have my favorite beer which is Jackelope Bearwalker. Tried a normal slice of pepperoni and had to get another. It's officially my go to in Nashville for pizza. The place has a fantastic vibe and service is great.

I've been coming here for a while now it's time to let people know it's great pizza and garlic knots! Nice ambience, friendly server and the basil lemonade is bonkers! Also there's another area a pickup for quick bite. The only bad thing I can say about this place is that there are no wait area. You have to wait outside and cold
Excellent pizza. Thin crust with tasty edge crust.  Tone of topings.  Really cool atmosphere

Easily, and I do mean easily, the best Za in the Ville.  The beer list is great, the hipster vibe is cool but unpretentious.  The service is good and the pizza is great.  I've had many a pizza, New York, Chicago, Naples and what these guys do is pristine.  

So don't wonder why it's always busy, just go try it and you'll understand.

I mean absolutely fantastic.

Our Uber/Lyft driver recommended this place to us. We were down the street so we decided to give this place a try. When you walk in... omg, the place smelt amazing. There was a bit of a wait so make sure to put your name on the waiting list! If you go next door, you can just buy pizzas by the slice but it's limited on the pizza selection so we decided to dine in.

There was 7 of us and we were very hungry. We ordered 2 full garlic knot appetizers to start our meal. Omg I was picturing bite size garlic knots but that was not the case! The knots were HUGE!! It's VERY garlicky so beware. Very delicious though. I definitely recommend getting it. We also ordered two 18 inch pizzas: the vodka sauce pie and the rocket pie. OMG... the pizzas were HUGE! We were not expecting the pizzas to be so big! They were MASSIVE!! Good thing the pizzas tasted so good- we were excited to have leftovers! I'm vegetarian so I only had the rocket pie, but it was delicious. So good and flavorful. I loved the roasted chunks of garlic. The pizza was just perfect. My friend said it was the best pizza she's ever had. I agree- it's definitely one of the top pizzas I've ever had. I highly recommend it! My friends who had the vodka sauce pie also said it was really good! I definitely recommend getting two kinds of pizzas and sharing them!

The only thing I hope they change is their use with plastic. We wanted lots of ranch for our food. They were very kind and gave us a lot of ranch!! However, all the ranches came in plastic containers. It was super wasteful and not environmentally friendly using plastic containers when we're dining in. They should serve their ranch in little glass containers or bowls! I understand the plastic use for to-go orders, but not dining in... Please change this!!!

Other than the plastic use, I highly recommend coming here! Food is delicious, lots of variety, and amazing service!
Best pizza and service in Sparks. Came in like an hour before closing and the staff was more than happy to feed us!!

Over all the pizza is pretty good, however the order of cinnamon sticks we received (delivered via Uber Eats) were raw in the middle, which can make someone sick. Not sure how pizza can be cooked but not the cinnamon sticks. Disappointed.

The quality of their pizza has not disappointed me in the 9 years I have been frequenting blind onion. The crust is delicious all on its own but of course it's a little more heavenly with honey to dip. The customer service is very friendly and welcoming. They do get pretty busy around lunch and dinner but hey that's a good thing. I like to grab a super slice (it's 2 big slices) and a beer and sit at the bar. My go to pizza spot!

Lions Choice is my go-to fast food restaurant. I like that it is not fried. My usual is king roast beef with Swiss and horseradish! So delicious!!! I'll go out of my way to get Lions Choice for lunch! But I recently tried the pulled pork sandwich. It was very good too!! Good service too.

Great pizza! Garlic knots were awesome! Ordered a 14 inch "Zeus" we cut onions and added fire roasted tomato's. So much flavor it was delicious! The crust is more of a thin crust but perfect not too thin. Their homemade marina sauce had great flavor! Great atmosphere. Would highly recommend trying!!

A local recommended this place to us. The Zeus pizza was delicious. Came out steaming hot and cooked to perfection. Good draft beer selection as well. Would highly recommend this place if you're looking for pizza in East Nash.

My wife and I live within walking distance and love the food here unfortunately since our favorite bartender left the service has really gone downhill. We would frequent this establishment more often but restructureing is needed here.

Sue is a godsend.  She takes such great care of our dogs and truly cares about them.  She is careful, prepared, and professional.  She is even comfortable with my crew of three bigger dogs and two cats.

If you've ever been to this pizza place it's no secret that the later at night it gets that the longer the line gets. Fortunately, that's a good sign. Whether it's somebody that's sneaking out of one of the many bars nearby or a tourist in town looking to grab a late night bite there's a warm seat or a place in line here for you ( for the record the restaurant next door has some of the best chicken and waffles in all of Nashville and is also open late). Half this restaurant is dedicated to being a restaurant and the other half is where people can walk up and order by the slice. Both offer wonderful service and pizza the comes in large sizes and packs value.

If you've eaten a lot of pizza across the country Five Points probably won't stand out, but the size of the slice and the affordability of it makes it taste even better. And who doesn't like a large slice of pizza after spending hours in a bar, which is a big portion of the late-night crowd here. The good news is their salads are much better than average and taste they come with fresh greens. And even better is the price. You can't beat the value and the portions that come alongside with a fun late night atmosphere here. For the people watching alone this is a great place to grab a slice.

Employee took my food tray when he saw I was done eating. My car key went into the dumpster. To narrow the search, I held each trash bag up to the car until one of them unlocked it. 5 mins later after washing cheese off the key, I was back on the road.

The other day we stopped in here to grab a snack on the way home after seeing the baby animals and we live on the other side of town. I thought we could just order 3 slices of pizza and be on our way after eating these. I'm only posting this so others don't make the same mistakes as me. First off the price apparently for slices of pizza is like $7. Three pieces of pizza for me and 2 kids aged 10 and 12 was $25 not including tip. I almost choked when they told me that amount was for 3 slices of pizza. If I had been smart I would of cancelled the order right then but the 2 kids were hungry and pizza smells were in their sights. Needless to say for this price for a slice of pizza I will never go back. 

I didn't realize until later that the girl at the counter never asked if we were to go or eat in. I also learned later that if you eat in, you don't order at the counter you sit down somewhere and then order. 

The other issue was how long it took to get our pizza. Now granted the slices are what they cal super slice so it's quite big. Either way we just wanted a simple slice of pizza. It took almost 30 min to get 3 slices. I don't want to sound like a snob or impatient but it just seems crazy to me. Maybe I'm spoiled because I grew up on the east coast and I can get a pizza slice that is huge for $1-2 and it comes out in a minute but this just seems crazy to me. 

So our quick stop to get a snack cost me the same price as a whole dinner and we got home much later than expected. It's no ones fault there, but that pricing and wait time is just too much for me. The pizza was ok. I think there is better pizza is Reno so it just wasn't a win for me.

Always fun.  Unfortunately, don't expect fast service.  Sometimes the bartenders can't be bothered to notice you, even if you're right at the bar.  The "sheriff" can be a bit gruff and snippy, particularly if you play selections on the jukebox that he doesn't like -- he does like the eject button.  Still, the other customers are friendly, and all are welcome.  Just watch out for the cross-dressers....

We walked here from the soda Parlor which was nearby. The place is a bit small there's limited of seatings and the line are long good thing we got there when there was barely anyone in line. I've been on a Keto diet for about 4 months now and this was the first time I've cheated and let me tell you it was worth it at the time. I ordered a Dave's pie and it was good wish they would cut the prosciutto smaller and spread it through out the slice and not in one spot. They sell pizza by the slice and have different type of pizza on different days so it's not they same except their main 3 or 4. I would definitely come back before we moved.

I'm so bummed I have to leave this review.  Blind Onion is my favorite pizza place of all time and we've been going there for over 15 years. My wife and I stopped by for a quick lunch date as our kids were at a friend's house. We ordered a slice of Greek and a slice of barbecue chicken. Before our slices came out, our waiter let us know that they were a little burnt on the underside and to let us know what we thought about them. He brought out our pizza and they were quite burnt, he offered to bring us something else or make us new pizza but we didn't have time because we had to pick our kids up. I ended up scraping off the toppings and just eating that while my wife was able to eat most of one of her pieces. Our waiter offered us a discount and I told him just to do whatever has manager thought was fair because we had to leave and pick up our kids. They offered us 20% off, which felt a little low based on the pictures I've attached.

Overall, I would give this place a 7/10.  Service was kind and pizza a bit above average (I tried garlic knots and the prosciutto/basil and supreme pizzas), but I wouldn't exactly recommend this place hands-down.

I think seeing so many 5-star reviews had me thinking my friends and I definitely would be leaving without leftovers or something, which was not the case.
This place should be called Five Doofus's because their food is stupid good. Five stars for Five points y'all

it's as simple as this...
I am 6/10 stoned and 4/10 drunk when I call a pizza place i expect my pizza order to be decently correct. I asked for no onion, even my friend that picked the pizza up said they told her it had no onion lo and behold guess what undesired topping I am currently picking off my pizza.
I know i shouldn't be so choosey, but this isn't really a good pizza topping regardless. Seriously I can't thing of one person I'd invite to a party that, given a first choice of pizza toppings, would ever select onion.

This being said the pizza is still very good.

tall fake blonde waitress with ponytail very rude and lies to get her way- be careful if you go here !! she pushed people around all night - finally on dance floor she pushed me twice from behind and when i turned she screamed im trying to cleanup a spill- i called her a rude c---- for not saying excuse me and she told bouncer i pushed her !! so be careful if you go here she is very rude and will lie to get her way !! everyone else here was very polite and nice. i will go back but if she is still working here i willnot stay !!  im 54 years old and have never been thrown out of a club my entire life before ! she deserved to be called what i called her !!

Visiting Nashville and we were looking for a quick bite for lunch and found this on yelp with good reviews. We were pleasantly surprised by how good it was! The garlic knots were so chewy and garlicky and the veggie slice of the day was perfect with a nice crunchy thin crust and the perfect amount of toppings. So glad we stopped by - just wish you were in Texas too!

My favorite pizza place while visiting Nashville. A really thin floppy Brooklyn style pizza crust.  The toppings are always delicious.  My go to random pizza toppings are garlic, basil, and jalapeños! Can get pretty busy inside and at the counter, so don't be supposed if you have a wait.

Great pizza! We came from so cal and picked this place blind. We also showed up with 50 people after winning a baseball game. They did a GREAT job handling our large party with no notice. Tab was about 100 with tip for two pizzas, breadsticks a salad and a pitcher of beer. We do a tournament every year up here we will definitely be back

Wow. This place has really surprised me, it was absolutely amazing! I had the garlic knots which is something you should try! I shared a pizza with a group of friends we had the vodka pizza I believe it was called. It was amazing we all ate one slice and that was all we needed since the slices are so big! Writing this review makes me want to go back for more! This place will not disappoint!

Their vegan pizza hit the spot! We called ahead and ordered to-go as we were driving in to town for a wedding - it was ready on time and piping hot. The next night after a late wedding and lots of alcohol we swung back by and got seated quickly - just as great of pizza and service inside as well. 

The vegan has daiya which I'm not always a fan of but what really makes this pizza great are the unique veggie toppings that melt together with the cheese! They even bring fresh basil to sprinkle on. Must get any time we're in Nashville now.
Good place to sit and unwind. Great atmosphere and food is outstanding. They don't scrimp on the sauce and it's delicious too.

I have to say that this place is a true Testament to the fact that there are better pizzerias outside of New York in 2019. I had a pizza with the habanero cream cherry tomatoes cilantro and onions it was pretty fantastic.

With being new in town, we are still exploring all the eateries close by. We've tried a few of the other pizza companies & most have fallen into the "I won't eat there again" category.
I can say that the Blind Onion is the first pizza place we've tried since moving that made it to the Favorites list.  
The crust is the best!! It was a damn near perfect pie! 
We also sampled some of the breadsticks and the cheesy garlic bread.  Wow! I could make a meal off of the cheesy garlic bread alone- the focaccia was awesome!  And the breadsticks- YUMMY!
If you haven't tried this place out- I highly recommend. Great food at good prices!

So I never make reviews about businesses because I feel it is a waste of time. I for sure didn't think I would find myself making a bad review for this pizza establishment, since it has always been top notch. However this time has bothered me so much I just can't get over it so im writing a review about it. First off we called and instantly put on hold then as the girl was taking to us she was trying to rush us off the phone and to just go to the online website. I then had to place my order abrupt and fast and when I did we were told a 30 minute wait which isn't a big deal. The thing is when we got there they charged us for the pizza and then go to tell us that they messed up our order and put the wrong toppings on the whole thing. This place used to be a really good pizza joint but it has gone down hill! If you want a good pizza start downtown Reno not at this crap shoot.

Wandered into this place Sunday night for dinner. They have NY style pizza by the slice and a ton of beer on draft. What really makes this place though is the garlic knots. I'd come back just for that.  $3 for 4 knots with marinara sauce. The pizza is not as good as NY.
Amazing staff, great food, and a fun ambiance!  My bf and I head down here when we decide to stay to stay close to home on the weekends and it never disappoints!
Excellent authentic NY style pizza. Try the South Brooklyn.

The pizza is good here. It's nothing spectacular but it is good and close to home. However the people who work here are rude. I almost cancelled my order when I called because the girl was so rude. She answered the phone with a "hello?" Not identifying her self or the place I called. When I asked to make a to go order she said " ya go ahead what do you want". If I hadn't already planned on this being dinner I would have hung up. 
When I arrived I expected everyone else to be different. Nope. Just as rude. As I was completing my payment she put my card in, gave it back then said you do the rest- pointing at the iPad in front of me. Then as I was completing the purchase a waitress walked up wanting to use the register and glared at me. As soon as I chose no receipt she angrily took over. So I went to sit down and wait for my pizza. No thank you for coming or your pizza will be right out. Another gentlemen walked up and said "hey how's it going" and the lady said "what's your name? Do you have a pick up" 

Just overall so rude and uncomfortable here. My family certainly won't be back. There are a million pizza places to choose from and with the customer service at this place it will not be my choice every again.

They have free slice cards apparently I might be wrong about that.

Five stars for five points. I bet no one's ever thought of that before ^^ ;

Okay I'm not going to give you my 5 but you have my general recommendation for everyone to b there

Best pizza. I heard from worker there this is their only location but their pizza tastes different because they have standards they like to keep.

The quality is a mystery to me. They say the quality ingredients give the taste. The pizza is noticeably different from others.

Normal pizza is good. Pizza Hut, and all those things. This is better if you like a sharp taste

They tend to only do one type regardless of flavors and only have a small menu

But five points while / if you're in the area then you got to be here
Yum! Any time of day, always great slices ready. Best NY style pizza in Nashville, IMO.

Want a whole pie okay or how about just a slice? The pizza slice was a good size. 
Got the veggie of the day which was roasted garlic, and my friend got classic cheese. 
Ordered half order of the garlic knots since it was a popular item. 
Gotta be honest I wasn't thrilled at all. They are presented nicely. 
But flavor-wise just not digging it. Way to doughy like enough to give you an upset stomach.
The atmosphere is chill, typical pizza joint. Clean and quick service. Prices are reasonable.

Pizza slices are quick - if you want a whole pie go in and order it- they tell you on the phone it will be over an hour but when you order in person it is only 20 mins- guess they have more business than they can handle.
Food is always good but our server tonight went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. Thank you Evert :)

Uninviting employees. I felt so out of place. Not welcome at all.. I used to live close by and now live 95 miles away and stopped by to bring home a pie and I feel like I wasn't even appreciated as a customer.

I eat here at least twice a month. The sandwiches are good to very good. I love the ham sandwich with the chipotle ranch dressing!! The fries are good. Good choice of sauces for sandwiches. Love the crushed ice for my Dr. Pepper!

This place is amazing in every respect!!! The food is phenomenal, the service is fantastic, the drinks are great, the atmosphere is legit and the music is befitting! 

This is my new pizza destination.

Mmmm pizza, Susie and Loop de Loop....it doesnt get much better than that.
There may have been some snaffooooz there, especially since the facility is much larger than the other locations, but they are definitely working through them. The staff is awesome, the pizza is the best and is out a lot faster now that they put in the additional oven....and the beer. Dear lord the beer is glorious!!!! Give them a chance...

We were told by several Locals to try this pizza place as it is one of "the best" in Nashville. What is cool about this place is you can buy pizza by the slice at ANY time.  This was nice for us as one member of our group wanted plain ol' cheese pizza whereas the rest of us wanted the "hot Hawaiian." Our pizza was delicious.. thin/crispy crust with a sweet and spicy kick. We also ordered a side of garlic knots which were also very good.  my husband and I enjoyed a local craft beer while another individual had a glass of wine. This place is perfect for groups and it is easy to please everyone. I deducted one star as the seat arrangements are a little cramped and our server was not very interactive. Overall though, great price and great pizza.

Just go for the garlic knot!

Seriously the garlic knots are to die for! The pizza is average and the place is tiny and service is meh but goodness gracious those garlic knots.

This is one of our favorites pizza places. Cool friendly staff, neat atmosphere, plenty of craft beers on tap, and one of the best pizzas in this region. We typically order the South Brooklyn with Roma tomatoes and meatballs. We always order large so we can snack on this delicious pie later.

We stopped here for breakfast after Church. We got coffee and then had a very lengthy wait until our order was taken. a larger group received most of the attention even though they arrived after us. another lengthy wait and the waitress said there are no potatoes, and delivered us some cold stale toast. She said we could have French fries or a scone, so soon a scone arrived, as well as the eggs which were ok. The scone we had to split between the two of us. Too bad Andonios, was so crowded, that's a real breakfast place, not a bar with inflated prices, that can't even make toast, so we won't make the mistake of coming here again!

I have been at this particular Marriott and this has been the worse by far. The staff had been probably the only thing pleasant about my week stay. I'm one the bottom floor near an exit where there is an air conditioner that had leaked all weekend. Granted there was a wet floor sign places but why let it leak so bad that the carpeting near it is soaked? Which leaves me to believe that is the reason my room smells of mold. My room wall is connected to the leaking air conditioner. I've had congestion and have been sneezing since the second night staying here. I've never had allergies so I know it's not that. Hopefully I'm not getting some type of reaction from the moldy smell. My room is in serious need of new carpeting and the hotel itself is in need of an update. I went to go work out at the gym and the elliptical is clearly in need of repair and the room itself seems to have special scent also. I've stayed at several Marriotts this past two months and this has been the worse. It literally is on the same level of a motel 6. I hope Marriott takes this mold problem seriously and I'm seriously going to get a check up as soon as arriving back home.

Stopped here for the pizza and a few drinks. The pizza was good, did have a little longer wait then normal but it was worth the wait. Add the honey to the crust and it's a win! 

The service was a little under par. We waited quite a while before we got served. Overall it was still a good experience and the food was worth the wait. Will go again!
OMG! OMG! OMG! Best pizza in town! Service is wonderful and I love that I can just buy a slice!

So we went downtown with our 2 families of four each. Bad news, which I did not know, most eating establishments allow 21 and older only. Call ahead if you have under 21 in your party.  Five Points Pizza has 2 separate entrances. One is dinning room, small and quaint. The other entrance is the carry out section. There is a bar along the glass that you can sit and eat. We waited for a table (actually 2 four tops). 
We ordered a few pizzas for each table and ate it all. It was great. This place had great food and wonderful service. The atmosphere was that of a nice pizza joint. 
I would not change a thing. They all remained polite even after people were waiting 45-55 minutes.

One if my favorite pizza joints. Blind onion is always consistent great tasting pizza. If toy haven't tried the pesto chips, I highly recommend them.  We got half the General's and half Breath Buster... so good.

I was visiting Nashville last week and this place was recommended by friends. Glad I went. The pizza here is fantastic. Great flavors and fresh ingredients. Couldn't ask for better. In addition to the great pizza I had one of the best customer experiences I have ever had. Our server was Mitch and he took excellent care of us. Not just us, the tables around us too. Mitch went above and beyond to make sure we were well taken care of. I highly recommend you request him as your server. Kudos to Mitch! Keep up the great work. I'm definitely coming back here next time I'm in Nashville.

Best pizza ever!! Also, if you want you can buy just a slice,  which is awesome! The best pizza is rafiki:
Franks drizzle, red pizza sauce, onions, chicken, pineapple, mozzarella, cilantro, bell peppers, and garlic.

This is one of the classic staple locations in the St. Louis area to get your roast beef and cheese fix. There is not a drive through at this location so you can go inside and get the full St. Louis roast beef experience. This visit I went with the roast beef and liquid cheddar this visit. I usually go with that or add provel cheese. Keep up the good work Lion's Choice off Olive.
Amazing!!!! After a day of partying around Nashville this place was the most pleasant surprise we'd found all day!  The garlic knots were unbefreakinleavable!!!!!!

Blind onion has the best chicken wings by far. They give you 10 and the size of them is perfect for a meal. I havent had wings like this since I had been to my favorite wing place in LA! Top notch. 
Their pizza ingredients and toppings are always the freshest Ive ever seen. Surely beats any pizza place around town. If you want REAL pizza and wings, you should come into Blind Onion. The service  i have received at Los Altos has not failed me yet. I am always greeted with a smile. And i always leave with a full tummy and a big smile on my face. Thank you Blind Onion for all you do!!!

This is the absolute WORST place you can possibly get Dish Network from. Go anywhere, but here (this is assuming you MUST have Dish, which I will get into further in this review). I signed up with these guys 90 days ago. My first receiver box was broken. I endured days upon days with Dish Network's miserable (and rude) technical support people only to find out it was a faulty box. Meanwhile, I was paying for this stupid satellite service all along. They finally switched out my box, and decided to issue me a FIVE DOLLAR credit for "my trouble." They refused to do anything more than that. Gee, thanks. Also, turns out, the bone heads at Anything Wireless totally set up my dish incorrectly, so the next 60 days after getting my new receiver, I had a bad picture, kept losing satellite reception...it was absurd. I kept asking myself, why oh why did I EVER leave cable???  Not worth saving a few bucks...do not listen to those stupid ads! You get what you pay for, trust me on this! 
By the time the technical bugs finally got all ironed out, I had to move out of state for work. I was told at the beginning of my contract (by the Anything Wireless guys), NO WORRIES, you just take your box with you, and get re-set up in your new state, no hassles, no charges. And if you move to a place that doesn't let you set up your dish, they will let you out of your contract. Easy Peasey.....Well, the latter happened (I am moving into a new downtown high-rise)....and low and behold, Dish Network is leaving me on the hook for a $350 cancellation fee. Absolutely nothing I can do about it. Not only did Anything Wireless lie through their teeth about the terms of the contract to me....the 90 days I did have service, it was a miserable, worthless, expensive exercise. I didn't get to record or see any of my favorite shows....what a waste. I could have gotten more out of just watching HULU for FREE.

Stay away from these people. They are LIARS and incompetent. Also, STAY AWAY FROM DISH NETWORK!!! A miserable company to deal with, with unreliable products, snot-nosed customer service reps who try to make YOU feel stupid when THEIR equipment doesn't work....and charge HUGE fees to get out of their contracts.

I guess at the end of the day $350 is a bargain to be DONE with this miserable group of people. I assure, when I am done posting reviews on both of these companies, it will cost them ten fold that in business. Thanks to the internet, there is some accountability for companies like these!

Kery  and Sara are amazing, they made sure my table was clean and ready.  They both were very nice and very attentive.  Food was amazing as always and beer was cold.  My favorite local pizza pub by far!!!

I thought it was good. It's definitely got a lot of hype going and is one of the better pizzas in the area. The second time I actually took a cab from my hotel downtown to pick up an order. Give it a try!

Snack time at @fivepointpizza in #EastNashville. Cheese pizza slice, half order of garlic knots, and a Greek salad. The garlic knots were savory and full of bread-y goodness!

Pinky rating: * * *
Proppy rating: * * *

Was out and about with the family and wanted to get some pizza. My wife looked on yelp to see what was close and Five Points Pizza came up. So we decided this was our spot. 
 There were people lined up outside and told it was about a 30 min wait. But it ended up more like 10 min. 
 The pizza is awesome, best I had in a while. It's thin and the ingredients are fresh. We had half T-Rex and half Zeus. Both were amazing and full of good flavor. Wash it down with a local Yazoo and Friday has begun. 
 The service was fast and with a smile. This is now my #1 pizza place
Kept waiting for Jerry Garcia from the Grateful Dead to walk through door. What a great atmosphere and the pizza is great. Place was packed and service was excellent.

THIS IS A MUST STOP WHEN IN NASHVILLE! We almost didn't come here being that we love our pizza and Houston has some amazing spots we didn't think anyone could top and also felt like we'd miss out on traditional "Nashville" food. We were so so wrong. We ended up having time to stop for an early dinner before heading to the airport and we are SO glad we did! The garlic knots are phenomenal! We shared a half T-Rex half Bianca pizza and it was life changing. LIFE CHANGING. Especially the Bianca which isn't usually a go to type pizza for us but I saw someone else review it. The pizza holds up perfectly to any toppings and the crust is not something to be skipped - light and airy yet perfectly crispy. Pair it with a delicious beer and it will be your best meal while in town. Friendly staff to boot! Five points you have exceeded any pizza place in Houston or New York we've eaten at - keep it up!

Our driver in Nashville insisted that this was the best pizza in town and I cannot say that he was wrong. Came here for lunch on a Thursday and were seated immediately at the table of our choice. The service was great! Our server was nice, attentive, & knowledgeable about the menu. I got the prosciutto-basil slice with arugula salad and a basil lemonade. Everything was delicious! In fact, I have regrets about not ordering a whole pie to-go because I started craving it the moment we left. But the good news is that I no longer have to go to New York to get a real New York style pizza. I can just come to Music City.
Delicious Pizza! I has Bianca and David's pie.. both were so so good!! Prices and great, and staffs are nice. We must have their garlic knots.. sooo goooood!

Great pizza and salads at a fair price in East Nashville. Public parking behind the establishment. Fresh ingredients atop a thin crust and a delicious tomato sauce base make the difference. Order the salad without the cheese and allow the fresh vegetables and balsamic vinaigrette to shine. Strongly recommend the roasted red peppers as a topping, and suggest skipping the Romano finish that is sprinkled over the pie-you just don't need it. This New York style pizza is best when kept simple.

WOW!! Absolutely incredible pizza!! We took several others' advice and got the T-Rex and it was SOOO delish. Perfect amount of toppings and the red sauce is to die for. I could eat there again already!! Skip Joey's and go here. You will not be disappointed!!

I have been coming to this Los Altos Blind Onion for almost 5 years ! They are a 5 star no questions asked. The pizza is always consistent and amazing. Always good beer on tap. Though the employees come and go they always have the same level of service. VERY KID FRIENDLY location. I have used and reserved the back room for birthday parties on 3 occasions. (If you reserve it during their happy hour you can order large pizzas at a great discount.) This location stands out among the other blind onions for its larger size and open floor plan. My family and I will always be regulars!

The ladies who work the front desk are amazing! I want to give a shout out to Stefanie, Tanisha and Nisha. I showed up thinking I had a reservation, but did not. They went above and beyond to get us a room. Customer service at its best!

The staff at Blind Onion are great!! We sat at the bar Saturday night of Labor day weekend. The bartender/manager, Kerry, gave us great service starting with a few beer tasters before we decided on which ones to order. Then we ordered pizza slices which were great! Kerry was very friendly and personable! Will definitely return in a couple weeks.
The service was excellent.  Loved the salad and the pizza.  They give you a BIG slice ... love the crust.  I think this is definitely a "must do" when visiting Nashville!!!

My husband and I were in Nashville for a long weekend and he had the pizza (pepperoni) twice. I had stromboli which was great, but I think the pizza was better. It was thin but not crispy thin, with very flavorful sauce and pepperoni.

Five Points Pizza is an excellent thin-crust pizza place.  Parking is tough in the neighborhood.  As you arrive, there are two entrances--one if you are looking to order pizzas for carry out and another if you want to dine-in (then they also have a walk-up window if you want slices).

They offer a variety of pizzas.  We ordered the Old World and Meatball Pi pizzas.  The Old World is your classic cheese pizza--but the mozzarella is not shredded but melts in streaks on the pizza.  It is a great mix of the nice crisp crust, tasty sauce, and melted cheese--really great.

I loved the meatball even more.  The meatballs are cut into slices so that they are similar to Italian sausages.  The mix of the meatballs and sausage was wonderful.

They also offer slices of the day.  My nephew had a slice with bacon and jalepeno which he really enjoyed.  Other family members ordered the garlic knots and absolutely loved them.  Many great choices here.

Went to Red Rooster in Harlem NYC on father's day and although I had a great brunch experience with my lovely wife I found the food bland and forgettable. Nonetheless the atmosphere was great, the pictorial display of Harlem's history was well showcased and the gospel soloist did an excellent job entertaining the crowd. However, everything was tempered by a not so exciting meal thus resulting in this subpar review.

Loved their thin crispy pizza. It was delicious! For carbs night definitely get you a whole pizza. 

They're always busy pack. If you can't get in for dine and sit. Go next door order a slice to go or eat at the bar top area. $5 for a slice is so satisfying to your taste buds. One of my favorite late night spots
the best pizza i've ever had, no doubt. such a cute place too!! amazing price for the quality too, so worth it.

Apparently,  this McDonald's is doing their own thing when it comes to serving up burgers.   Ordered two double hamburgers,  only had catsup mustard combo, NO pickles and NO onions on either !   Ordered a small soda, was only filled 3/4.... ????????

I came here last year on the 4th of July, and where I live the pizza is the best in the country. This pizza place gives my state a run for their money tho!!! I can't even begin to describe how amazing it is, so if you're in Nashville, whether you live there or are just visiting, and you want pizza... this place is the place to go to!
The pizza was amazing, I had the veggie pizza on thin crust. Absolutely delish, crust so thin and crispy. Can't wait to go back

We came to blind onion on 7/7 1:30pm  and normally it's an excellent place to be and delicious food. However today we came in and nobody had food and nobody was being served. After a short time of sitting for our order to be taken a gentlemen came in with two very loud and obnoxious kids who were clearly misbehaving. To make matters worse they were visiting there mom who worked here. Numerous times she has had to tell her kids to shut up and be quiet. They were so loud that me and my girlfriend could barely hear each other having a conversation. If your kids are being that loud and disrespectful at your work place you should bite the bullet and ask them to leave otherwise your job may be at stake. Not to mention their food came out first just so she could shut her kids up and we sat down first. We also have now been waiting for about 45 minutes for our food.

Best garlic knots I've ever had. Highly recommend the spinach ricotta pizza - was the veggie slice of the day special. Only downside - has separate entries for carry out and dining. We didn't realize we were only in the carry out (granted there were plenty of signs) and we weren't allowed to bring our food into the dining room then. Be careful which door you enter but highly recommend the food!

I called to simply ask a question because I work in the same shopping center but I work by myself and the guy who answered the phone was a dick and hung up so quickly before I could place an order for pick up instead of for delivery

We don't normally eat fast food that much but my husband and I decided to get a little snack for lunch. We split a 20 piece chicken nugget and he got a sausage biscuit sandwich. We placed the order online before we left our house and did the mobile curbside pickup. 

I will never do the curbside pickup again. It was the longest we've ever waited for McDonalds food. It should be called slow food not fast food. It took 15 minutes for them to come out and bring our food, and we only got 2 easy items. We could have gone through the drive thru, went  inside the store, gone home and come back again in that same amount of time any other day. I don't know what was going on with that place today. Not planning on returning anytime soon.

Cute little hipster pizza place in Five points. The garlic knots are on point and the homemade Bloody Mary has the perfect amount of spice in it. 

Overall great place to eat.

This is the closest to a New York slice you can get here in Nashville. They sell by slice or pie. Slices are pretty good. It's on the thinner side, but not too crispy. Slight flop upon feel. Their cheese is excellent, sauce is middle of the road. All in all it's a slice I think of if I were in New York. It grade A middle of the road prototypical New York slice. Not the best New York slice, but the most similar that you can get locally.
Horrible service. One waitress and she pours a beer leaves it on the counter and helps someone that walked in and we where here first and been waiting on our drinks.

Now this is how pizza is supposed to be! 
Crust- amazing
Sauce - Amazing 
Toppings- fo'geta bout it 
Service- outstanding 
Beer selection- badabing badaboom! 
Parking- not too shabby 
Waiting- we had a group of 4 and were told wait was 30 min but we only had to wait 15 min 

If you love pizza this is the place for you!

Great neighborhood  NY pizza place with a huge offering of craft beers. We stopped here while on a trip and it didn't disappoint. The garlic knots and Roma tomato dipping sauce were phenomenal, too. Service was spot on and there wasn't a seat in the place while we were there. We'll stop on our next trip.

the treemont was a beautiful space with friendly service. the manager continually came around to check on all the patrons, and when our drinks took slightly longer than they should have (really- not even a big deal), they gave us two extra desserts and took off the round of drinks! they truly went above and beyond and their space is great for a small group dinner.

Pretty bad experience! Granted they took care of us. in my opinion time is everything. It's not my fault three people called in and it took almost two hours to receive our order . The manager bless her heart took care of us. Still damn good pizza. And we definitely will be back. Pretty cool she took good care of us.

I haven't been in a Lion's Choice in years and this one was like every other fast food joint.  The food was good and the place was clean.  I found the staff to be pleasant and I felt like that I got my monies worth, but it is a fast food joint.

Probably one of the best pizza in town! We ordered the 18" pie and its way bigger than I expected it to be. They have the option to do half and half which is great because we wanted to try the supreme and the pesto. The pizza tasted so fresh and the crust is so crispy!
