Highly recommending for tourists to dine in instead of carrying out so you don't miss out on other flavors!

Went here on a Sunday afternoon with my girlfriend and another friend, the pricing was not bad at all. We each got one drink, we all three split an appetizer, but then got two pizzas for the whole table and I got an additional Stromboli. The garlic knots came out first and were quite large, really good sized portions especially for one dollar each, then we got our pizza which came out super fresh and all the toppings were also really fresh and gave the pizza a unique but amazing taste,

The only complaint I would have is that our server really didn't show up to the table except for once or twice to take orders and deliver the food.
It's really frustrating that I can't substitute the toppings I want on single slices or stromboli's. Lame.

I am moving back here to Sparks from Iowa and I am here house hunting. I decided to eat pizza at a new place one night and I chose this one. The pizza is absolutely delicious and the people working that night seemed to be friendly as well. This will definitely be my favorite pizza place for now on. I truly appreciate the manager coming up to me asking how my food was also. I love that he cares. Thank you for the great experience. My favorite pizza is my own creation. Alfredo sauce, sausage, onion and spinach and mozzarella on top.

Our favorite pizza in Nashville.  If you're looking for delicious classic pizza this is your place.  We love the Hot Hawaiian or just a classic pepperoni.  Also the garlic knots are incredible!  They are always very efficient and the staff remembers us because we frequent so much!

5 stars just for their Garlic Knots! Salads are fresh and defiantly some of the best pizza I had since Boston. We always order to go so we don't rack up a crazy bill drinking some of the tasty beers on tap and it gets quite crowed for dinner time. But it is a cool little pizza joint with great food!

This place was heaven! We sat at the bar because there was a longer wait for tables, but rightfully so. Our waitress gave us such great service and was happy to answer any of our questions. 

We got half orders of garlics knots and caprese salad, and then split a Bianca and T-Rex. It was alll so delicious with lots of real flavors. 

Without a doubt the best white pizza we have ever had.

If you're craving good pizza and chill place this is for you. We're from out of town and met some locals that told us to try 5 points pizza. The garlic knots are DELICIOUS!!! Procuttio and basil is great. Local beers on tap too.
Awesome product. Now an addiction. Love to buy by the slice. Simple pepperoni or veggie of the day

I gave this McDonald's a 5 star rating because I LOVE surprises. I drive through every morning at around 8:42 and I am out by 8:44:50. My very first morning I was just shocked at how quick they were, there was no drive through line and I got my $3.45 bag handed to me so quickly that it almost was like I never even got off the main road.   But then I got to work. And I opened my breakfast. Well, now it was my breakfast. It must have began as someone else's pick?
The first day I essentially got chocolate milk when I took a sip of my "small coffee with 1/2 and 1/2 and 1 Splenda." Yesterday I got no sausages in my burrito, so I allowed myself to have dessert! This morning, I was able to learn that I like black coffee (I think my half & half order was taken to mean black coffee mixture?) But anyways, it's the unknown that I crave. Shishito peppers on the menu? I'm in every.single.time. Remember those candy Airheads? I'll buy the white ones. White shark bites? You're not sharing my pack. The 90's puppy surprise, where OH MY I can't believe my eyes! I got 5 puppies inside! (You bet I did.) The unknown is a HIGH.

And what do I love more than a mystery? I'll solve that one for ya: It's BREAKFAST. I love breakfast (all types). And I don't love waiting in lines. I also like friendly people. So all in all, what more can I ask for? I've found myself a trick-or-treat-esque daily morning high where I can buy WHATEVER I want, excuse me, whatever I *get*, simply by digging through my change stash & performing one simple *POP* of my arm out the window. (Pro tip: leave arm extended out the window between checkpoints A (pay) and B (collect food) for ultimate efficiency).

*Sigh of morning happiness* I just feel like it can't go wrong. Everyday is a new, and the very worst is that one day I am given the opportunity to try a McGriddle.

I absolutely LOVE Blind Onion food.  But staff seriously needs customer service training.  I frequent the restaurant because I love the food, but I am consistently ignored by the staff, who seem to be consumed by their personal worlds, rather than by who is in their restaurant at the time. This could be an amazing restaurant if it were customer-focussed

We came a couple of times for slices, and really this joint pumps out slices as fine as I've had anywhere else. Every bite is tasty, the crust is thin and snappy, the classics are classic and the specials are intriguing!  We tried something with red peppers & Gorgonzola, that even my wife who hates blue cheeses found tasty!  This review is just for the slices / takeout side of the place, but it was fast, casual, hipster bright and funky, and definitely a great choice for a super quick bite.
The perfect blend of unique menu items along side your favorite traditional cravings. Waitstaff is attentive and entertaining!
Love love love this place! The food is always amazing. Tonight was particularly great with Sarah taking such good care of us. The salad was the best I've ever had I and I will be back very soon.

This one of first pizza restaurant i have been for pizza in nashville and the best pizza joint in the town i can say that...Being foodie i love to eat different style of pizza but the pizza i tasted here was just awesome we went two week on row for same pizza and we make sure one in month we are here for pizza. If anyone is travelling Nashville this is the one food joint to must visit after joeys pizza (if ur lucky to visit that on time) the service environment and music everything is really great they have bar too and take away separate counter also...just love this place i can go on and on
Arrived during happy hour. Great menu and assortment of adult beverages. Pizza was very good! Service was great in spite of the place being packed.

Yes! So good. I love pizza and this is just heaven!
Great location, awesome staff too!

I'm never disappointed anytime I come here. The staff is super friendly, the service is quick, and the food is fresh and delicious. They have a great beer selection as well! One of the best pizza places in Nashville.

It seems like yesterday that we moved to Nashville, and there were hardly any local pizza places in the core area. There was DaVinci's and Pizza Perfect and that was it. Now there is an overwhelming selection, and while Five Points Pizza is a little late to the party, they've made a fashionable entrance into the scene. 

We have a baby, so we wanted to come at a time when it wouldn't be difficult to find a seat and we wouldn't have to barge through with our baby carrier. That proved difficult, because this place is really popular. 

Here's how it works. There's a menu with a few appetizers and salads. There are three everyday options for pizza-by-the-slice: cheese, pepperoni, and what's called "Dave's Pie"--it has prosciutto and basil and some other toppings. Then there are "special slices."  I had a slice of meatball pizza and a slice of cheese. I also opted for a Yazoo Gerst on draft.

The beer was the coldest I've ever had at any restaurant. That was definitely a good start. We didn't get any appetizers, but the pizza came in about ten minutes. Here's what you need to know about the pizza:

-it's not greasy at all
-the ingredients are very high-quality
-you can tell that the crust and sauce are well thought-out. 
-the crust isn't floppy, it's thin and firm, but not dry and crumbly. It's not stereotypical "new york style," but it gets the best features of the style correct.

Some people are really picky about their pizza, so FPP can't please everyone. But it pleased me! We'll definitely be regulars, albeit at off-peak hours.

Cool little hipster pizza joint. Their lunch specials are well priced and you get a great portion of food for the price. We got there at the end of the lunch rush. We got our food pretty quickly but it took a while to check out, despite it being less crowded than when we got there
Wow. Compliments all around. Pizza was amazing. We could tell the ingredients were house made. Salad was fresh. Keep up the good work.
I travel a lot and had someone recommend Five Points. Well worth it, great pizza and a good price. I will be back when im in Nashville.

I just moved here from Brooklyn, NY. 

Pizza in NYC is a religion for most and for me it's definitely something I enjoy!

The standards are high and the purveyors are plentiful where I come from so when looking at places to live here in East Nashville I was a bit worried when our agent told us that we would be let down by the pizza here. 

I guess our agent has not visited Five Points Pizza yet because it was spot on.

We sat at the bar while waiting for a table (it was after 10pm) and ended up staying. 

The service was great and the folks sitting beside us were lovely company too. 

Enough of that... We are here for pizza and it did not disappoint. 

I ordered a cheese slice(wanted to assess with the basics ). 

The cheese, sauce, and seasoning were on point and the crust had the perfect amount of crunch. 

We ordered some garlic knots and in addition to being the largest knots I've ever laid my eyes on they were delicious. Perfect amount of chewiness to the dough and straight fire on the garlic, oil, & herb. 

Beer selection was dope and I can't wait to return. 

Well done Nashville!

Just had lunch at 5 Points Pizza in Nashville and have to say they have the best pizza we have had since moving to this area 14 years ago.  They make a true New York pizza.  All ingreadents were fresh, server was great and it didn't take long.  They actually toss the dough.  Parking can be a problem but worth the effort.  The garlic knots were great but save room for the pizza.  I didn't order a salad but they looked great.  I almost forgot, you can purchase by the slice or stop by the take out area.

Recently my neighbor and I decided to give this location one last chance.  We have been going here for a long time and the last few times the orders were wrong, pizzas burned, etc. This time we explained to our server, Kerry, the problems we had been having and he promised to make the pizza himself. Kerry was friendly, brought the drinks promptly, and really gave us a great experience. And...the pizza was perfect.  Way to go Kerry!!  We'll be back next week!  Thanks for everything!

So I, for the most part, hate pizza. It tastes all the same, it's boring and generic, and white supremacists seem to REALLY wanna be photographed with it. However Five Points Pizza breaks the mold. If this place was more accessible I would eat here 2x a day (they don't serve breakfast). The toppings taste INCREDIBLE! Decadent and delicious. The bread is moist and fluffy without being too thick. A wonderful atmosphere and staff. This place is not to be missed!
The Best pizza ever. Friendly helpful staff. Excellent bartender. Great beer selection.
5 dollar appetizers and the portions are huge! Friendly staff always takes care of the customers. Highly recommend!

This place is great! One of the best pizzas in Nashville - there are only two or three. I would, especially, like to commend the service. Everyone was so sweet and accommodating. Five points made for a fun Sunday.
All I have to say is--yum! And of course we LOVE the vegan options. We always get our pie to go but it never disappoints even after a 10 minute drive home.

Best pizza in all of Nashville hands down. I love to stay by to grab a pie to or just get a slice when walking by with the pups. The ingredients are amazingly fresh and the pizza is always cooked to perfection. I am fortunate to have this place so close to the house.

Five stars for Five points. Because by far the best pizza I had when visiting Nashville. Service is superb. Quick and friendly customer service. Food was ready in under 20 minutes, and came out hot and taste fresh. We started out with their garlic knots so garlicky, greasy, and soft  paired with marinara sauce. Pizza is delicious from the toppings to the crust. Perfectly cooked and crispy all the way! Definitely worth the stop.
Recommended by a local. Did not disappoint. Delicious crust! Get half and half for only $1 to try two flavors.

The Red Rooster is one of our Favorite neighborhood restaurant and Bar. The food is great and beer is always cold!   The Red Rooster has always been a go to place for my family and friends. They have great local bands and DJ's. Liz and her team make everyone feel welcome.  Definitely a place to frequent. Ang is one of the best servers/ waitresses. She is always working hard to make sure everything is going well.

Five points lets people know that pizzas are a lot better than the huts, domino and johns we always keep eating. This is one hell of a quality pizza you find in Chicago or New York. Their meat options are limited to pepperoni and meat ball so for those who do cannot eat that the veg options one hell of a bite to eat.

Always start off with the Garlic knots and you will not be dissapointed, they come out fresh and with some sauce which you cannot stop eating at all and will forget that you ordered a pizza.

Great job guys and hell of a atmosphere with great food.

A bare-bones interior -- the most stripped-down McDonald's I've ever seen. No reason to go inside unless you have to sit down or use the bathroom. Their focus is the drive-through. Best to use that if you want a quick bite from a McD's. Food is routine McD's.
Was so so so delicious! Such a great vegan option. Really crispy crust, friendly staff, and clean! So yummy!
Yum yum yum. Such a good go-to for a late night snack. They have slices available all the time with some great flavors. Good deal considering how big the slices are.
Friendly welcoming atmosphere... pizza was amazing... and it came out hot and fast. Service was exceptional.

The best pizza joint in Nashville, as far as I can see.  I don't usually give 5 star ratings unless something blows my mind.. and the service here certainly did.  We come every month or so usually on a Sunday.  Last week the place was insanely slammed and I have never seen servers hustle the way they did.  One hipster-esque server was literally jogging from the tables to the back register to get people their bills.  

Previous reviews have covered the fantastic pizza in detail, so I wanted to give 5 Points props for their consistent and great service.

Went here because the oyster bar at the nugget was busy and the Rosie cafe does not serve the awful awful anymore.  It is confusing how to order as the menu was outside.  I assumed since no one was there to greet me you order up front and then they server you the pizza or whatever you ordered. That was the only thing really confusing.  I got the special and thank god it is something I am familar with, a steak sandwich, but the steak was like a meatball type. Maybe it was steak.  It was very cheasy and it does take 20 minutes for them to cook it as it is fresh.  The sandwhich was a big on the dry side for me, but the service was excellent.  I would come back here again but maybe try the pizza next time.

Great pizza, good wine. There usually seems to be a wait, but there are many distractions in the neighborhood to occupy your time. The garlic knots are fantastic, and pizza was superb. We asked for ours to be well done, and it was perfect. The small pie was more than enough for 2 people - could have fed 3-4. And the price is fair for the area - well worth a visit.
Love this place!  The Woodstock is a can't miss.  Five Points is our new go to pizza joint.
Best pizza in Nashville. I recommend the Habanero or the vodka cream. These are my two favorites. The garlic knots are excellent as well. Don't  forget the cannoli

Oh Choice, how do I love thee?  Let me count the ways!
This stuff is great.  The best.  Arby's?  Take a walk.  How could you resist a real roast beef sandwich, cooked medium rare, with that special seasoning?  Don't forget that the condiment table offers both real creamy horseradish and HOT au jus.
I eat this stuff at least twice each time I travel to St. Louis.

I highly recommend Cherry Hill Painting.  They recently completed an exterior trim and column job at our home and it looks great!  Workers were very clean and professional also.  You will not be disappointed!

very solid pizza, so good we went back for a second order.

Tried the: Plain Cheese Pie, Spinach Gorgonzola, T-Rex, South Brooklyn.
Was a little worried that the Gorgonzola would be overpowering, it was not, in fact it was a great balance.

Would recommend and return.

This is literally the best pizza in Nashville, and I've had pizza basically everywhere in the US and its among my favorite pizza in the country. It's New York style, delicious, and the specialty pizzas are amazing. The vodka cream sauce is to die for and the garlic knots are delicious.  The beer selection is fabulous, they make great salads and the service is excellent.

Great place for great pizza.  I especially liked that you could order two different types of specialty pizzas on one pie. We ordered half spinach gorgonzola and half pesto pie, and both were to die for! They also have a nice beer selection. I couldn't decide which beer to choose and went with a flight instead. They were all very good.  The service was also very good during a busy Saturday night.

Amazing. Fresh. Great atmosphere. 

Start with the garlic knots. They are warm and delicious, served with a side of marinara sauce. Definitely a good way to start a meal.

We all ordered a Greek salad. Dressing was amazing and it was a huge portion for such a small price. 

We decided to order a 14" pizza with half supreme (pepperoni, italian sausage, mushrooms, red onions, green peppers) and half vodka sauce pie (House­made vodka tomato cream sauce, prosciutto di parma, spinach, mushrooms, red onions, fresh basil, fresh mozzarella). The pizza is the reason to eat here. It was hard to decide which flavor we liked best because they were both so good. 

Also our waiter Scott was great. He was attentive and sweet making sure we were enjoying our food and getting us anything we needed.

A solid 4 stars for this place.  Prices are about average for pizza in this town.  They have a good selection of beer on draft and some very tasty wings.  I've seen quite a few reviews that seem to complain about the service.  We've been twice now and both times were promptly seated and a waiter appeared shortly thereafter.  The time it took to get our food was about average for a pizza place.  I really enjoy the crispy thin crust combined with the thick chewy crust...and yes, adding honey to the crust makes a nice pseudo dessert at the end of the meal

Thin crust pizza heaven for a couple of bucks. Greasy, cheesy, and affordable.
I got the plain cheese and it was like eating ninja turtle pizza. 
So delicious.

This place is hit or miss for me. We use to frequent Blind Onion at least once a week to take advantage of their happy hour pizza prices. But we have been here 3 times in the last couple months, and each time has left a bad taste in our mouths (at some times literally....) First time was on a Friday night for a birthday party. It took FOREVER (about an hour and a half) to get our food. When we finally did, it tasted like it had sat under the warmer for 20 mins because it was completely dry. 

The second time I came in for a pick up order. I sat and had a beer while my pizza finished cooking. When they brought it out, the bottom was completely burnt. I had to ask them to remake it. So I sat for another 20 mins to wait for a new one. No one even apologized, and they didn't even comp the beer.

Last time was last night. We came in for a pizza party for our basketball team. Most of us called our orders in ahead. The only accommodation they made for us was to let us use the back room. They decided to charge us all 20% gratuity (without telling us, until a friend of ours asked why a large pizza and 4 drinks cost $40)  just because we had a large group (even though we all ordered separately, and we received zero service other than them bringing our pizza). On top of that, the young girl who helped us had the worst attitude and was completely rude. 

Sorry Blind Onion, three strikes you're out. We won't be back anytime soon.
Been wanting to try this place for a while.  Went at an off time and had two good slices of pizza and a glass of beer.  Cool store.  Looking forward to visiting again.

Why is this the best pizza I've ever had in my life??!!! The sauce is amazing, the fresh ingredients in it really stand out. With every bite I could taste the tomatoes, and basil. The pepperoni has a hearty taste. My husband usually orders lite sauce on his pizzas was so happy with this sauce he ate 4 slices. 
You guys really know what you're doing!!

I asked the hairdresser to take off 4 inches and add a slight angle to the front. Look at how much she took off and how horrible and chunky the front is! I explained to her how long my hair took to grow and told her I was too scared to go short right away and look at what she did. Horrible horrible place, will NEVER go again!!! I made sure to let all my friends know to AVOID THE GREAT CLIPS AT 9080 E Valencia Rd!!! It went from below my breasts to the front being so short it wont stay in a ponytail. I HATE this place!!!

Who would've thought that would be good NY-style pizza in Nashville?! I was skeptical when my friends told me that multiple uber drivers recommended this place. Also, why would I want pizza in the land of Nashville hot chicken? BUT TRUST ME, YOU DO. 

We ended up here for an afternoon snack & ordered to-go. I ordered garlic knots (Hand-cut NY style dough tied in knots, tossed in olive oil, fresh garlic and parmesan, served with a side of marinara) and had a bite of the Farmers' Market as well as the (vodka cream sauce based) and a proscuitto+basil pizzas.

The garlic knots were freshly warmed and slathered in garlicky butter goodness. I loved that it was a dense garlic knot with a crusty outside and soft inside. As a testament to its delicious density, I was full after having 1.5 garlic knots. The piping hot marinara sauce was tasty too.

The pizzas were fantastic. Flavors were harmonious especially on the Farmer's Market pizza. That vodka sauce is incredible. Vodka sauce is also part of a staple (Vodka Sauce Pie) pizza so if the specific special isn't available on the day you go, try that one instead! And of course, per usual NY style pizza, the crust is thin, crispy, but not burnt!

Sue Brooks, Owner of A Bow Meow Affair pet sitting service in the Clearwater/ Dunedin, Florida areas, is the best pet sitter I have ever had.  She is an extremely compassionate animal lover who is reliable and conscientious.  She spends at least 30 minutes with my cat at each visit, writes notes to me about the visit, how my cat seemed, what his behavior was like, how he was eating, etc..  Sue also writes down everything she did while she was there at my house, i.e. she doesn't just dip the litter box---if it smells, she empties and cleans it!  She sweeps up the litter, and wipes out the sink at every visit.  When I get home from my trips, I always find a happy cat and my house in very clean condition.  I have used A Bow Meow Affair for over a year now for approximately 5 different trips.  I can't say enough good things about Sue Brooks and this company.
Garlic knots. Bianca (white pizza). Excellent. 5 stars for 5 points. What more can I say?
Very fast service. The pie were crispy on the bottom and loaded on top. Excellent pizza for Nashville. We will be back.

We had half Super Bianca half Zeus. Both sides were excellent but Zeus was my favorite. Second trip here and both visits were excellent. Great local and various craft draft beer selection   You can split any two pizzas for 1$ extra  which I highly recommended so you can try more variety.

We hadn't been to Blind Onion for a while and we decided to stop in for a beer and pizza. We sat at the bar where we normally sit and had the absolute best service that we've ever had. Kerry helped us and was absolutely fantastic. He had a great positive attitude, was super friendly, and provided great customer service hands down. The food came out very quickly and it was so delicious. We had the opportunity to also meet Sarah who was an absolute joy to talk with. The dynamic of this store is on point. We will definitely come back more often now knowing that these awesome people work there. 

Definitely recommend this restaurant and this location above all the rest. Love our local store!

There is this lady there with black hair and she may be in her mid 40s or so but she is SO rude! Very unwelcoming! I actually left because I felt so uncomfortable while waiting. I don't want someone who is that rude to cut my hair. She should not be cutting or dressing anyone's hair in any way. Fire her, and maybe I'll go back!
Haircut was not what I was expecting. I told him what I wanted and did not do a good job. Super nice though.

This pizza was pretty good! Got into Nashville pretty late & it was one of the few places still open. There was a line outside, but it didn't take long to order or receive our food. They started to run out of some flavors bc it was so late, but even just the cheese was delicious. Ended up returning a second time!

My first visit to this location of The Blind Onion was a few weeks ago so I'm due to give it a review.  

The Blind Onion is known for quality ingredients and unusual combinations thereof.  The fam and I stopped in at lunch for their first taste after my rave reviews at home.  The pizza of the week was Vote for Pedro that was about a 2 out of 5 on the spicy scale and a 6 out of 5 on flavor due to the Mango Habanero sauce.  I don't recall all of the toppings but they played well together.

Our server, Andrew, was a champ.  He was quick, helpful and professional.  Nice job!

While it might be expected in a joint that offers honey for dipping crust, the sticky tables were unpleasant and justification for hold back a fifth star.  Other then that, the decor was cool.  

Yes, the prices are a bit steep, but I've resigned to the fact that good pizza, really good pizza (like many things in life) will set you back a few.  Keep that in mind, be open to new flavors such as the pizza of the week and enjoy.

Ehhhh. We waited a while to get our order taken. Ordered a pepperoni combo. When we got it they had forgotten to put pepperoni on it, so we had to wait even longer for another. The pizza was pretty bland. Maybe if they seasoned their sauce it would be tastier. The honey that they give you for the crust tasted like honey and plastic. Maybe they should store it in glass jars.
Our favorite spot for pizza and a cocktail or beer! Kerry was awesome! Loves his attitude and service!

The pizza here was pretty f#$@ing good. Don't get me wrong- I still think Old Chicago has the best tasting pizza. However, since I don't think there is an Old Chicago in Nashville, It's OK to say that Five Points Pizza is the best tasting pizza that I've had in Nashville. 

The prices are reasonable and the pizzas are huge. I love that you can split a pizza with two different choices for each side. I like the different combinations as well as the speciality pizzas. I came at a time where business was slow so that worked out great for us. 

Service was good and the food was great. I'd definitely come by and I would bring friends, too.
Pretty good pizza! I was sooooooo hungry and wanted something to eat late night and they were open until 3am I believe. Quick service and nice staff.
Pizza was worth the 25min wait. Beyond good, definitely would recommend to any pizza lover!
Great place to grab a whole or even a slice of pizza. Awesome taste and saucy, with whatever you want on it, or you can even customize your own pizza.

The refrigerator broken multiple times.  When you inform them about it, both front desk and the mechanic says 'why didn't you inform us earlier '?.    When things break, they put a bandaid on it and it breaks again in a few days!!! Horrible service!  There are 30 dollar motels wit better working appliances and cleanliness...

Sunday June 22, 2014. I'm in the city visiting a friend so we decided to scour Yelp for a new pizza shop. You know it'll be an experience when Christmas lights wrap the air conditioning duct. 

Following reviews from others, we started with garlic knots and those did not disappoint. Buttery, garlicky basil goodness served with a hot dish of fresh marinara. 

Since we are carnivores we had to get the T-Rex but add prosciutto. This pizza isn't for the recent coronary patient. (I recently had to visit a cardiologist but learned I have perfect heart health.) 

My friend stayed the driver so I could sample some local brews. There were a few Nashville beers on tap and even a Huntsville brew (not a great one though).

Come here for local food, beer, and a funky vibe mixing NYC and East Nashville.

This is your average local bar. They do ha e a nice happy hour special on Friday nights, $20.00 all you can drink well liquor and domestic beer from 6-9pm. Also, on Friday nights they have all non seafood appetizers for $5.00. The appetizers are all fried foods, which were good, just not if you are trying to eat healthy. They also offer various sandwiches and wraps. 

There was a DJ that night and the music was so loud it made the experience not enjoyable. The music he played was from the 50's & 60's. I'm not sure if it was just that particular night or that's the music selection every Friday night. 

They had a lot of people in the bar & everyone seemed very respectful.

If you love cheese thinner than paper and charred burnt crust, then this is the place for you!  I rarely leave bad reviews, but after it took almost my entire lunch break to get my pizza, I was greeted with burnt pizza that would make a frozen Totino's pizza look gourmet. I'd say I'm disappointed to say the least.
The garlic knots, beer selection, and pizza by the slice keep me coming back time and time again.

Best pizza I've ever had. Go here. Don't regret it. 

Tried the garlic knots and they were a little overrated in my opinion. 

BUT GET THE PIZZA. 

Great thin crust with a nice crisp. Absolutely perfectly cooked. 

I got the pie with their homemade vodka tomato cream sauce with some veggies on it. Unreal.

Great pies -- pretty close to a NY slice. Thin crust, nice and crispy bottom. We got a whole pie; half plain and half Dave's. Started with the arugula salad. Everything was fresh!! Would definitely come back.

So we went downtown with our 2 families of four each. Bad news, which I did not know, most eating establishments allow 21 and older only. Call ahead if you have under 21 in your party.  Five Points Pizza has 2 separate entrances. One is dinning room, small and quaint. The other entrance is the carry out section. There is a bar along the glass that you can sit and eat. We waited for a table (actually 2 four tops). 
We ordered a few pizzas for each table and ate it all. It was great. This place had great food and wonderful service. The atmosphere was that of a nice pizza joint. 
I would not change a thing. They all remained polite even after people were waiting 45-55 minutes.
Rude staff. Think the only leg to stand on is pizza which is good but overhyped (esp for the price).

We went to the Treemont about a week or so after it opened. We arrived around 9pm on a Friday night and were seated right away.

The bar is beautiful; we sat near the windows and a cool breeze was blowing through. It was a really nice and romantic spot for a date. Our waitress was very professional and friendly.

We ordered the chick pea fritters and deviled eggs as appetizers. Both were good, and definitely were different from anything we've had before. For entrees my fiance got the gnocchi and i got the veal tenderloin. The gnocchi was delicious, and again, not what you'd expect. It was a bit chewier but had great flavor. The veal was AMAZING and definitely the stand out dish of the night in both of our opinions. It melted in your mouth and the whole dish delicious. The portions were just enough.  I look forward to returning!

Ehhh, actually my first time to a Lion's Choice, and people were sayin, "imagine Arby's, but wayyyy better all around." 

This one in particular was nice and cozy, good amount of seating and not too cramped.

I got the large roast beef combo with cheese fries for 10 bucks. Pretty pricey overall for the amount of food you're getting. The roast beef was tender, cooked to a nice medium rare, but it wasn't flavorful at all. Had to add their "au jus" sauce and other toppings for some type of flavor. 

The good thing is they have unlimited "au jus" sauce and a bunch of other sauces that complement fries well. They also have like unlimited jalepenos, onions, and other condiments if that is your way of enjoying a roast beef. 

All in all, a good place to eat that doesn't take too much time but not too impressive.

Me & my friend from NYC checked this place out because she wanted NY style pizza. She was skeptical but was very very pleased after we left. The crust is definitely NY style and the topping choices delicious. (Prosciutto & basil - yum!) You can get individual slices. The lunch special is good - 2 huge slices and a drink for $8. We went on back to back days because we liked it so much. Will def be back.
By the slice, cracker like crust if you like that.... worth the stop.

Excellent place to eat.  Great pizza and wonderful atmosphere.  I would recommend to anyone who is in the mood for great authentic pizza.  Wait times can be a little long during busy times...but we'll worth it!

Went here at 830 on a Saturday. Full house but was seated immediately. Had local jackalope beer which was great. A+ beer selection / variety/ local.  A for pizza varieties. The pies were delicious. The waitress was pushy to get us in and out. But the food came quick and we didn't even take any slices of our 14" pie home !

Recommend the south brooklyn pizza 

Will be here again
Good New York style pizza. I suggest getting drunk at a neighboring bar and then recovering here with a slice...or two. Cute and friendly bartender is a plus.

This place was packed but we got seated quickly by a very apologetic host. Our waitress was so quick and attentive - and also apologized for the wait to be seated. (But it wasn't even an issue! It comes with the territory of a well known place during busy hours!) the pizza was delicious and the garlic knots are so good!

This was very delicious pizza! Rated 3 stars because we ordered Pepperoni pizza, cheese pizza, and garlic knots and they said it would be ready in 45 minutes. We got there in 45 minutes and it still wasn't ready, but when it was (15 minutes later), they forgot our order of garlic knots so we had to wait even longer

Far and away the best pizza in Nashville. The daily slice is always on point. I mean seriously, they do it right. The crust is always the deal breaker on most pizza and this crust is perfection. 

Great bar, 16 taps that rotate all the time with mostly local or border state brews. 2 nitro taps. Staff is super nice and a pretty hip crew that is obviously proud of what they're serving. 

Never been disappointed and I bet I never will. Stellar, absolutely stellar.

It was very good!!
Dough was thin and crispy. I ordered different flavers.everything was good.l love it^^
Wow!  Food orgasm:)  had the vodka cream sauce pizza with prouchetto, spinach, red onion.  Awesome!  Best pizza I've ever eaten in my life

Came here for restaurant week and loved it! Great food and atmosphere. The gnudi was a big hit but the chicken-yes chicken- melted in my mouth. What else can I say? It was a 5 star meal for all at my table!

Wow. Wow.

Best pizza I've EVER had.

Wow.

I stopped in when it was jam packed to the bone during Tomato Arts Fest and only got a slice...holy wowwww it was so GOOD!  I joke not when I say that I truly wished it would never end.  I had the Caprese (margherita but with dressing) slice and the tomatoes whole & huge slices, not cut up pieces.  The tomatoes were SO sweet, the cheese was amazing, and the balsamic (was it fig??) was amaaazing.  

I didn't love the crust, but because of the toppings, I would get this again in a heartbeat. 

Like I said, I went when it was jam packed, but I didn't wait very long...definitely not more than 10 mins, and the bartender(s) were really nice, calm, and apologized for the wait, even though they didn't need to!
Great Pizza place and the customer service is good. They really accommodated my party of 11 on a short notice.

The best pizza in Nashville. Go now and order a local draft, followed up by garlic knots, a greek salad and the white pizza. This is my favorite night.  Friendly service, great atmosphere and the pizza is SO GOOD. I spent the last 8 years in Brooklyn and this place lives up to the hype of a Brooklyn slice. The other night, I was sitting outside at another restaurant in the Five Points vicinity and kept getting whiffs of their goodness. I immediately regretted my decision to not eat there.
We love coming here. Becca (not sure if I spelled that right) was great and really took care of us. More than just a pizza parlor.

I like pizza. I F'n love pizza. I F'n love NY Style pizza. 5 points pizza has these things, so I naturally gravitated to it. I gave it some time and a few visits before I decided to review, as reviewing a brand new restaurant isn't really fair to them. I've dined in and carried out several times, each being a pleasurable experience. I did once order a white pie that came out overcooked. Before it even arrived I was notified by our waitress that the pie was overcooked and they would be glad to cook me another one. Being understanding and supportive of locally owned eateries I didn't get angry at the mishap and declined the new pie. 10 minutes later I have a properly cooked pizza in front of me anyway. That's service. I carry out a couple of times a month too, and Allison is always bright and cheery when getting my order ready, or serving me a pre-takout beer. She's obviously providing great service as I never remember anyone's name. Ever. Especially with pizza on my mind. How's the pizza? Great. The marinara is outstanding. Tangy, fresh, chunky, just a hint of sweetness. Possibly my favorite marinara around. The ingredients always seem fresh and high quality. The crust is great, but in my own personal taste I think it could be a little more moist. To each their own however. Also, don't go across the street to the other pizza spot on the block. I won't support anyone who complains about food trucks and runs them out of the area. The pizza made at non-dick managed places tastes better anyway.

okay, but nothing special. In Nashville, Sal's pizza on Stewart's Ferry Pike is still my fave.  (btw, all I had was the pizza at Five Points. no garlic knots or anything.  it's not necessarily thin & crispy & it's not sog-city.  somewhere in between....and still very chewy).  just not my fave.

Stop reading.  This is the best pizza in Nashville, East Side or otherwise.  This place is consistently on point.  NY style crust, high quality toppings (especially the meats.)  Just great crust over all, basically the highlight for me.  Close as you can get to legit NY style pizza in the South, and in my opinion would and does stand up next to most northern pies.   I don't make a habit of paying $6  a slice after a night of drinking in five points but $17 for a 14" "Zeus" (Capicola, pepperoni, Fetta, black olive, Pepperoncini, red onion) is worth every fucking dime. Believe that!

I was told by almost every uber driver and friend I have in Nashville that I just had to try this place - "best pizza in Nashville".  My friend and I stopped by late night last weekend, after a night of dive bar hopping in east Nashville.  The pizza was good - not great.  I wish I had the opportunity to get the full experience and would definitely go back to give it another try!   Quick and easy ordering at their outside pickup window.  Long line, but friendly people to chat with while we waited.

It's absolutely ridiculous that this hotel claims to be "pet friendly" yet they charge a $150 fee per pet. This is not a "deposit" as they claim but a non-refundable charge. Why would I pay $150 a night PLUS $150 fee on a "pet friendly" hotel? 
Candlewood Suites is amazing and charges $15 ..Red Roof in doesn't charge at all.
They do not disclose this fee until you arrive at the front desk and they point to a sign on the wall.
I left, did not stay here and never will.
I'm shocked that this is a Marriott hotel.
Nice room, big bed to bounce on. Turn the heat up to 81 and sleep over the covers :]

The crew was very friendly. The food ok.. not as good as the food at the blind onion on Victorian Ave. We waited a very long time for our pizza (45 mins) but it came out very hot. so I know it wasn't waiting around in the kitchen to be served to us.

By far, the BEST pizza my husband and I have ever had. Atmosphere is casual and service was great. We started off with garlic knots... YESSSS, then ordered a pizza, 14" 1/2 vodka sauce and the other 1/2 T-Rex, everything was EXCELLENT. 5 for sure!
Fantastic! We all shared a pizza with Italian sausage, pepperoni, and fresh basil and it was a big hit. One of the best pizzas I've had in Tennessee for sure!
This place always satisfies my munchies. So many delicious food options with a great selection of adult beverages ;)  also the young gentlemen that work their are cute as a button.
Pizza. Four stars. Salad maybe twoish. Not a good dressing. Service five stars. Very good New York style pizza. Cheesy weird music but upbeat. Would come back.

Best pizza in Nashville! 

Slightly overpriced- yes. Do I care? No. 

The crust is consistently perfect - crisp and thin with a nice chew. 

I'm a big fan of the vodka pizza but you can't go wrong with a classic either. The garlic knots are pretty fantastic too. 

We usually do take out and the wait is around 20-30 minutes. What's great about this place is they are open pretty late serving slices so you can always stumble in from a nearby bar. Sometimes they even do free slice nights!
Let me tell you about this pizza I had! It was a special, spinach onions gorgonzola and pineapple, and it was phenomenal! And they sang my name lol

I love this pizza!  Definitely amongst the top in my favorites. The parking I'm not as fond of, but it's nice to park on a neighborhood street (Russell or fatherland) and walk around the five points area. I usually opt for the counter service entrance, rather than waiting for seating in the dine in side. I have been when there's a huge line and I have been when there's no line at all. The line moves rather fast though and there's usually a spot on the small bar by the time you get ready to eat. I get a piece of pizza by the slice- pepperoni, and it's always fantastic. Thin, large, plenty of peps, just the way I like it. I've always had friendly service here, too. Must try in Nashville if you like pizza!

I really enjoyed this place! I stopped in while on a road trip from Texas to North Carolina, and I'm so glad I did. They had local craft beers and great pizza! It was inexpensive and delicious. Even the beer was reasonably priced!

Working with Anything Wireless to get my DirecTV service setup has been a hassle free and cost efficient transition. They are extremely professional and dependable. I was able to get all my questions answered about the service requirements and how I could receive eligibility for the Amazon Gift card as a new customer. They did a good job being fully transparent, personable, and knowledgeable about all aspects of my cable service. Thanks again!

Mike
Best pizza!! You have to come here and try anything. Staff was really friendly and nice. So glad we came last night of our Tennessee vacation

This place is fantastic. That is really all that needs to be said. I loved it and my server was not very good. That says something. I will say I saw other servers that looked to be very nice and attentive. The guy we had clearly didn't want to be at work that day. I'm thinking he does not get how the whole tip thing works.

I grew up in NJ, so NY-style pizza is one of my passions. And this is probably some of the best you will get in Nashville. It's not the best pizza I've ever had, but there are a few things that make this place special... one is the atmosphere and location. Five Points is a cool area and the vibe in the restaurant reminds me a ton of all the little pizza parlors I used to go to growing up. The second thing that sets Five Points Pizza apart is simple - the Prosciutto & Basil pizza. You can get a whole pie of this, or get it by the slice. But either way... oh my lord. It's really delicious. The regular and the pepperoni are both serviceable - and I would MUCH rather go here than say Papa Johns or Pizza Hut. I would probably give this place 3 and a half stars if that were an option. But 4 stars seems appropriate enough. If you're in Nashville and you want something resembling good NY pizza, this is a pretty good place to start.

What Sucks: Finding parking, waiting for a table.

What Doesn't Suck: Everything else. 

Our family visited with friends to this pizza place after not being able to get a table at Pharmacy Burger, and left feeling like we found a gem. The pizza was great, waitress was fantastic, and garlic knots were worth the visit alone! 

We'll totally visit again!

I'm bucking the trend here.  And maybe, just maybe I expect more from Chip Roman than I've been getting lately with Blackfish falling in my opinion also.  It seems like he phoned it in at The Treemont, or at least when I was there.

For an appetizer, the six-hour cured Cobia, had wonderful texture.  However the red beet vinaigrette was more like beet sauce, there was no zip nor any bite to it.  What a waste of a terrifically prepared fish to just go naked tasting on the pallet.

The crispy skin on the Dorade (entree), how I love crispy skin, was the highlight of the dish.  The wheat-berries were cooked well, but little flavor.  The fish cooked perfect,  but other than the 2 caper-berries and 2 charred baby onions holding it's own, the flavor wasn't anywhere near above average like I expected.  I wasn't expecting "bursting" but at least "interesting".

A side of grilled cauliflower was oh so boring and tasteless.  The color and presentation was excellent though.  

Well, everything was presented well as is Chef Roman's forte.  

I did not want to disappoint myself further by ordering dessert.  

Service from Jameson behind the bar was excellent throughout the entire dinner, and his expert help and politeness was appreciated.
The Stromboli was by far the best I've had.  This is a very casual place with dine in separate from the take out.  It must be a good thing when there's so many people lining up to order.

Perfect spot for a craft beer / craft pizza lover!  We need places like this in NJ!  walking distance from our air bnb in east Nashville. My wife and I each had a beer sampler and we liked them all. They also allow you to get 1/2 pie of anything on the menu (minus 2 pies) which is nice when u and your wife can't agree on ANYTHING!  Highly recommend and would have gone back if we stayed a few more days in town.

Tight seating but well worth it. This pizza is true New York style. Foldable thin perfectly cooked crust. Great tomato sauce. Mozzarella was perfectly chewy. Service could improve a bit but its a pizza joint so i don't expect much.

Ok two things this place has, the best pizza in Nashville but easily the worst server in the city. I've no idea what his name is (tall guy, hilarious feathered hair) but he not only clearly hates his job but he's incredibly bad at it. Forgets to bring beer orders almost every time we've had him (had him about 5 times this year) really unfriendly and is incredibly slow in general. I've been coming to this place since day one and love it but this guy makes walking in Russian roulette. Recently we just leave if we see he's working.

Easy, laid-back atmosphere - almost dive-bar feel. Wonderful bloody Mary option on the weekend. Nice beer list. We had the caprese salad to start - perfect with summer heirloom tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, a glug of olive oil and a drizzle of balsamic. We got a Bianca pizza with spinach, tomato and artichoke heart. Scrumptious - crispy crust,fresh toppings - delicious.

If you are in East Nashville and want a no-fuss meal and beer, this is the spot.

Best pizza in Nashville.
Service is great, super friendly and fast.
Stopped searching for a pizza place once we tried here.
It's hard to stand out in the world of pizza and they succeeded.
Parking is somewhat of a pain, paying lot across the street or street parking.
Often busy so prepare to wait. It's worth it.
Yum!!!  I consider myself an expert on pepperoni pizza and this place is fantastic!!! Visiting from Southern California, it came highly recommended and did not disappoint.
Excellent food (the escargots appetizer and lamb entree are amazing), wonderful wine selection, great service, and lovely ambiance---highly recommended!!

Pros: 
-Very informative 
-Quoted me actual cost
-Taught me basics about garage door maintenance.
-Fixed springs respooled cables, fixed light, greased everything.
-upfront honest hardworking

Cons: late to appt:
-The guy did say he was working on a big project, and took a little longer than expected. He did make up for that with service and honesty.

I will use and recommend to anyone with garage door issues.

Support small business!

It's hard to believe there is room for yet another pizza place in East Nashville but alas, there is.    My positives are that the pizza was pretty good but I agree the crust was pretty crunchy so not the NY style foldable pizza.   The ambiance is good and they offer the kiddos some dough to play with.     They also have a decent offering of beers.

Recently a friend of mine was going to purchase some pizzas to pick up for our gathering.  She stopped in on her way to run another errand prior to the dinner rush to make the order and pay for it and then another one of us was going to pick it up.  The server said "well I guess we could do it that way but it will be really annoying."  After 10 minutes and  a few other people reminding her of the inconvenience, she gave up and got our pizza somewhere else.  weird....

My biggest beef though is that I think it's pricy for what it is.    I mean it's pizza and beer and I just had some sticker shock with a couple of pies and a couple of beers coming out to $60.

This place continues to be amazing! I actually tried their pizza this time, and that's why I bumped it up to 5 stars instead of 4. The Zeus is absolutely the way to go. The combination of all the different ingredients is just fantastic. I also tried a little bit of the Habanero Cream (at least I think that's what it's called) and that one is excellent as well, although just a touch spicy for my taste. I will absolutely be back!

I dug it, but I agree with Kristen G's review about the grease. At first I thought she was just a Jersey/NY pizza elitist with a penchant for extra grease on her pie, but after trying it myself I agree! This is the healthiest seeming 'NY Style' pizza, well...ever? I guess I can paint a picture by explaining that I only used ONE NAPKIN the entire time I was there.

All that aside, the marinara was delish and the fresh basil on my garlic knots was the meow. 

They have a rotating French Broad on tap along with some local and domestic selections. I think it'd be my new favorite joint should the pizza be $2 cheaper (18 inch veggie is $22) and the beer about .50 cents cheaper (draft runs $5 for a microbrew, which isn't too too bad) - but maybe the 5 points address runs steep? 

Husband and I showed up around 6:30 and were seated right away with a friendly smile and beer & garlic knots soon thereafter. About 30 minutes later was a different story as it started to get pretty packed. I recommend eating early!

The place was full of families, but as a non-breeder myself, all of them were staggeringly well-behaved and I didn't mind it at all! I'm sure the scene changes a little as the night wears on - open til 11pm or midnight every night. Nice!

I've lived in Nashville for almost 3 years, and I tried it last night for the first time with my SO. I got the T-Rex or all meat pizza.  He got the prosciutto and basil. It lived up to its hype. Both were sooooo good!
Usually we just grab a quick slice, but we ordered a whole customized pizza this time.  Delicious!

This is definitely a contender for best pizza in Nashville. The pies are spectacular and there is always a rotating list of delicious craft beers. They even have wine on tap if that is your thing. Also, you must get the garlic knots. Just be prepared to wait a minute to grab a seat if you want to eat in. The meatball pie and the South Brooklyn are two of my favorites.

Excellent pizza and a top-notch beer menu. Dozens of craft beers on tap. 

Try the knots as well!

Garlic Knots! You must try them.

Everything we had here was very good. Crust was thin and crispy but not too crispy. Crust was very good! Would be a staple if I lived in Nashville!

Our family loves the Popeyes pizza! Also the ranch is stellar! When they are busy they can confuse things but everything always taste great and I've never had horrible service. Sometimes the wait is long but that's because the food is good and fresh! 
I wish the ranch was free, we go through a lot!

Cute pizza place. We got there about 30 minutes after they opened and was able to get seat but the dining area filled up very quickly so I would suggest eating there early on a weekend. The workers were very friendly. We had two beers, two slices of pizza, and a half order of garlic knots for $21.00. The pizza and garlic knots were good (the garlic knots were huge) but it just wasn't as flavorful as real New York style pizza. Still really good for the area. 

They didn't mention they put parmesan cheese on top without asking if I wanted that. I would have said no so that ruined my pizza a little.

I did it! I finally made it to Five Points Pizza. A bit embarrassing that it took me over a year of living in Nashville to do so, but hey, I did it. Five Points Pizza has been at the top of my Bookmarks for, well, probably a year and it just never lined up with my schedule. I found myself in East Nashville for Small Business Saturday and seized the moment. Parking in this area can be a bit tricky. I just walked from the Shoppes on Fatherland so didn't really have to worry about it. The building is pretty small and always packed. I went for lunch around 1:00 and all of the tables were full. However, since I was by myself, I easily found a seat at the bar. Sometimes eating out solo has its advantages. The bartender was friendly and provided me with a menu right away. They have more than just pizza and I saw a good number of people ordering salads. I don't like green stuff but they looked really good if you do. When it comes to pizza, I'm a classic cheese kind of girl. I promise I'm an adult (with the whole not liking vegetables and eating plain pizza). I have also heard amazing things about their garlic knots so I got a half order of those (4 knots) and a slice of cheese. Five Points has an impressive selection of beer but I needed a caffeine boost so I just got a Coke. Next time I will definitely sip on a local beer with my meal. My garlic knots were out in no time and wow, they were huge. I did not think they would be that big. They come with pizza dipping sauce and were dripping with oil. Not in a gross way. In a fantastic way. Those suckers are goooooood. My cheese pizza soon followed and again, it was huge. They definitely have the New York style down. I stopped myself from filling up on the knots and dug into the pizza. Yep, it lived up to all of my expectations. Delicious. Thin crust, gooey cheese, and great flavor. I somehow managed to finish 2 garlic knots and my whole slice of pizza, but had to throw in my towel after that. The bartender kindly provided me with a box for my leftover food. I'm not going to complain about having more Five Points to eat later that day! All of this goodness for under $10. Ok Nashville, I get it. This is the place to go for pizza. I might find myself making more trips to East Nashville just for this pizza. Or West to try their other location. I'm hooked!

Awesome pizza and kids will love it. I'll explain later on in my review why...
Don't expect thick crust. Thin crust (but not cracker thin) is their game. Service is good. The garlic knots are awesome while you wait for the pizza to come out. Decent selection of craft and local beer on tap. What's really neat and something i have never seen anywhere else is that they bring out some raw pizza dough for kids to play with while they wait. Its special dough without eggs so if they swallow some, there is no chance of them getting sick. 
Always a top contender when looking for food in nashville!

This is probably the best pizza I've had anywhere in the state of Tennessee.  I love the atmosphere and the friendly faces of the employees.  My friends and I usually head here after a night of bar hopping in East Nashville.  

They have so many options and even right before they are closing, they are just as nice and I've seen some DRUNK messes come to order at the window.  

Believe the hype! This place is amazing!

Went here for lunch. Service was excellent and attentive. We ordered the spinach and Gorgonzola salad which was just average with spinach, walnuts, mushrooms and Gorgonzola crumbles. It came with a balsamic
Vinaigrette. All in all, it was a decent salad and nothing to write home about. I wasn't in the mood for lunch so my kids tried pizza by the slice - cheese and pepperoni. The pizza was excellent. Very NY style thin crust pizza with a lot of flavor and the crust had a nice chew. Again not the best pizza I've had but it certainly was above average. I tried a beer called "The Boulevard" which was a lemon ginger infused beer that tasted like a Moscow mule. We then finished off with some garlic knots. These were certainly very well prepared. I thought it was very tasty. Again nothing here was bad, but unfortunately for my palate, nothing screamed out five stars. That's why I'm a little surprised with all the reviews here. Either I have a highly discerning or poor palate, or the typical Nashvillean palate is too easy to please. Solid three, maybe even four stars.

This. Place. Is. Awesome! The host was friendly and charming, Cooper was a fantastic waiter, and the food was on point! We went with a half and half with basic pepperoni and meatball. All of the meats available here are pork and the sliced meatball is just perfect! It's thinly sliced...I was expecting giant meatballs on my pizza,but I was pleasantly surprised! Must go. Cute, fun atmosphere, go now!

New in town, my husband and I went in for lunch on a Saturday. The place wasn't even half full, but the service was horrible--slow to order, get our food, get our check. The paninis were tasty, though, especially the bread.

My review of the poor service was taken down.

I don't have my original review saved (why would I - I wouldn't expect it to be taken down). 

I wanted to have some work done for my parents. The appointment kept getting canceled. Finally they said we would just have to call someone else out. I didn't care for this, it was rude and unprofessional. I called someone else out. They came the same day and fixed it in a short amount of time.

The food here is awesome...  we have been here a few times and the pizza is really really good..... wings are great, beer too..  there is a guy Kevin, who is a great waiter...  we walked in on Friday  22nd, 3 girls at the counter, we looked around for a minute wondering where to sit... not one acknowledgement from them , like Welcome, hello, sit anywhere, etc....  WE found a table, (it was not busy, except for a Bd party in the back),  sat there for a good while while the girls looked extremely bored at the counter.... walked up to the bar and asked if we could get some help..... he said Kevin was our server and he would be right with us...  i said, looks like Kevin is the only one working, these girls looked bored.....  seems that generation does not work hard and then there are those that work hard...... 
Kevin waited on us and did an excellent job, while the girls were bored.... girl in ponytail spent many trips to the bathroom looking on her phone.....  
i was a waitress for years, hostess, etc...... welcome people in, everyone helps everyone, no matter what...  we asked Kevin why he was the only one working (besides bartender), and he he said he usually is, while the girl in the ponytail napped at the counter.........  
this pizza place is delicious and we are looking forward to many nights here as we are moving to this area......  definitely need a manager on the floor who can move these girls into caring about every customer there.......thanks Kevin for working sooooo hard and we had a very nice night with family......

Very honest business  who I explained to that I couldn't afford a new roof even though my roof is 20 years old and does need replacing they fixed the leaks  on my roof and until the economy turns and my finances turn the repairs are perfect. they are a great group of guys that went out of their way to let me know when they first arrived and gave me the courtesy to let me know the repair was done when they left. Even though they incurred a little bit more work than they thought they stay true to the estimate right on the money as far as I'm concerned they are the only roofing company that I will use! Chris Neumann

Five points Pizza is one of the highlights of the Five Points area. It is a little tough to find parking, but everything else was great. The service was excellent, food tasted amazing for everyone. I got the meat lovers Stromboli and it was absolutely amazing, probably the best Stromboli I've had in town.
Loved Dave's pie, excellent crust. Service was awesome too, especially since our group was 10+.

We dine in or carry out from Five Points Pizza every time we visit Nashville. The garlic knots and greek salad are awesome, and the pizza is very good! The only reason I'm not giving them 5 stars is because the cheese pizza could be a little more flavorful, but it's good. I recommend checking this place out!

I was pleasantly surprised. The food was excellent & served hot.The service was very good. I went at 4:30 so it wasn't very crowded. I had the French onion soup which was very good with lots of cheese, & the Special which was Shepherd's Pie. Both were better than I expected. My friends had the fried Shrimp platter which I sampled & it was very good too. I will go back again. I had my eye on the Yankee Pot Roast before I heard the special & I still want to try that.
Best pizza I have found in Nashville! Also loved the garlic rolls and salad. I wish the restaurant was bigger, so the wait time was less.

We stopped at this place on our way to a family get together. The pizza here is by the slice and so amazing. My hubby keeps asking if they will deliver to California now.  If they had the option to order and ship around the country, we would definitely order from here over and over again. Yum!

Last minute on a July Saturday night, it was perfect.  We had four apps.  (1) chick pea fritters, (2) gnudi, (3) cobia and (4) tuna. One side: charred beats.  Cheese dessert and cookie chocolate desserts.  We loved each and every thing.  Wines and beers were great too.  We had tried a lousy chain restaurant down the street just before going, so the contrast was exceptional.  This is a great option for Rittenhouse Square.  Service was fantastic and we look forward to trying the olives and the mains.  Great atmosphere (good date place).

I am SO glad that East Nashville has this restaurant, it is really good! I know that we have PizzaReal but this place is definitely giving them a run for their money! The pizzas are awesome and the crust is thin, which I like. The atmosphere is nice, but go early or later or else you'll be in there with tons of kids and families. That being said, it is a good place for any age. 

I wish they had a few more specialty pizzas to choose from, but of the ones they have they are really good. I've been back several times and will continue to go there!

Five Points about Five Points Pizza:

1) If Nashville Yelp CM Johnny T. says it is worth checking out then it is so.

2)  As forewarned, it was hipster infested.  (Nashville has hipsters?)

3)  When they say your pick up pizza will be ready in 30 min., they really mean 15 min.

4)  I don't get why the pick up window was closed and the girl at the counter kept referring to me as "ma'am."

5)  The 14" 1/2 Supreme and 1/2 Veggie Pizza for our night in and early bedtime was on point.

(Hmm, maybe this is why I am now a ma'am...)

Good stuff. My boyfriend and I sat at the bar and had great service. He loved both the beers he got and I enjoyed my cider! They had tons of beers to choose from which was nice. We started with the garlic knots. You really shouldn't pass these up. The extra garlic sauce is great to dip your pizza crusts in! They were perfectly cooked, crispy all the way around! We got a 14" half Old World and half South Brooklyn. The pie came out pretty soon after we ordered. It was crispy and delicious! My only complaint was that my boyfriend got sausage on his half (the South Brooklynn), and it added quite a bit of grease to both our sides unfortunately. The fresh mozzarella is really a nice touch too. I will definitely be eating here again when I'm in the neighborhood!

I've been back three times since the first trip and it is consistently great. After my last review the owner reached out to me which I thought was really awesome. This and 3 Crow have become a Sunday ritual for me. See you Sunday!

I've had the pizza several times before but after 2 Jack and Cokes on a Friday night, for whatever reason, it was better than I remember. For thin crust pizza...the 2 slices I had were just enough. The pesto pizza was so flavorful. It's not something I'd normally pick but half way through it, I remember I stopped and had to admire the taste. I've been craving it since and haven't gotten back there to fix it.
The service was amazing, the pizza divine and the atmosphere was so nice. I would recommend this to anyone and everyone even if you don't like pizza!

I've now been three times and the pizza was very good but the value for what you get is missing.  I'm tired of East Nashville being the place where people feel they can open restaurants that are a little overpriced and get away with it.  I live in Lockeland Springs and want to eat in East Nashville.  

My biggest complaint is that a slice of pizza should not be $3.50 especially for the size you get.  If it were a large ny style slice but tasted like "five points pizza" perhaps, I would gladly pay that because one slice is a meal. Instead my bill for 2 slices and a soda is about $10.  

I recently went to my first Preds game a week ago and bought a slice of pizza there.  It was 50% bigger and cost $5, so basically the same price. A slice of five points pizza is way better than Bridgestone pizza but neither should cost more than $2.50 in the real world.

Everyone was super nice and friendly. When I was in a room with terrible ventilation noise, they moved me no problem. My room was always clean and smelled great. There is free wifi and their breakfast was really good! I normally got a fresh waffle with blueberries and a yogurt. Pretty fancy for a free hotel breakfast! I recommend this hotel.
By far the best pizza in Nashville.  This place gets really crowded so come early or be prepared to wait.
This is for the pickup window and it gets a million stars. It's fast, tasty and they have choices acceptable for everyone. I will be visiting the window again after a night out.

Quintessential "I want fairly greasy pizza but to hell if I'll get dominoes" place. I have to say... the Stromboli is the actual winner of the menu (sorry 'za). The cheese situation, guys.. at times, I thought I was eating a mozzarella stick. So, you CAN have it all (pizza, mozzarella stick, daily veggie intake (?)) 

Important to know: for TAKE OUT be prepared to wait. This is not the typical 15-20 minutes. This will take approx 40 mins so plan your appetite accordingly

I recently had my roof replaced on my home in Clearwater. After talking with several roofing companies about the project on hand, I decided to go with Acoma Roofing out of Oldsmar. From day one, they made me feel like their number one priority. Ryder, their top notch salesman kept me informed throughout the project, letting me know what to expect as the job progressed. His knowledge and honesty made me feel very comfortable and confident that we were in good hands. The finished product looks fantastic!!  The crew did an outstanding job from start to finish. Very professional, friendly and did an outstanding job cleaning up. My fiance and I sleep much better at night now that our roof isn't leaking during this extremely wet summer we're enduring. I would definitely recomend Acoma Roofing to anybody looking to repair or replace their roof.

This is the real deal NYC pizza outside of NYC! We weren't sure if the hype would be worth it but it really was. We came here around 1AM for some late night slices. The pepperoni is hands down the lightest, best slice they have and you can easily inhale 2 slices. We also tried the proschuitto and it was pretty good. Service is good but ranch is .50 extra!

Best pizza in TN
Love the beer selection
Great friday night atmosphere with crowd and lively noise
Love the protuitto and arugula pizza

Super chill place. It's not your average wait-on and dine. The staff is super friendly though. Drinks are self-served but that's no big deal. The pizza comes in 3 sizes I believe. The part I like most about their pizza is the crust! It's fluffy, and almost like its own breadstick. Definitely a nice place to try-out

We stopped in before leaving for our 9.5 hour drive back home to Milwaukee. Pizza was great, I loved their daily special slices. And those garlic knots.. ugh so good. Beer on tap, plus a good crowd and mixture of people. Reminded me a lot of Classic Slice (for anyone familiar with local Milwaukee pizza places) - except even better. Glad we found time to stop in before leaving town. We'll be sure to stop in again the next time we find ourselves down south.

One more thing though! When we were hitting the bars, we would have loved to have grabbed some pizza from here afterwards. Wish they were open later!

Reno has a lot of pizza places to offer, and The Blind Onion is one of my favorite options. I've never had a bad meal here, and the staff is friendly and good at their jobs. Skip the Domino's and go local!

Visiting The Blind Onion, you can either build your own pizza or choose from the menu. There are lots of options and a featured "Flavor of the Month," and I know this location has a binder full of past monthly specials that they can generally make again at your request. I'm not always a big crust person, but their crust is amazing. You can also dip it in honey for a sweeter treat -- it may sound weird, but it's good. Blind Onion makes their own dough, pizza sauces, and ranch dressing as well (and the ranch is soooo good). Aside from the pizza, you can't go wrong with the wings or cinnamon sticks. 

Saving the best for last, I recently learned about what may be one of the best pizza deals in Reno. Blind Onion offers a "super slice" of pizza (which is two slices) and a soda ($7) or beer ($10) for a ridiculously low price. You can build your own slice, too, and it's made fresh -- for just SEVEN DOLLARS. Slap down a $10 bill (because tipping makes you a good person) and you've got a complete meal that'll leave you full and happy.

Great pizza and great service at a great price. What are you waiting for?!
Very professional.  Prompt and courteous.  Work exceeded our expectations.  Would recommend to friends and family.
Sooo yummy!! The best of this style pizza I have ever experienced. The super Bianca is amazing. The crust is perfectly crisp. Michael was our server and he was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable.

Always have loved five points pizza. Specials are interesting and beer selection is great. After a recent trip with my three year old, I'm reminded that this place is family friendly as well! Planning on ordering some carry out tonight

Always ignored this place due to the crazy lines that would form over the weekend.

Got to sample what all the hoopla was about, now I get it. Delicious pizza, nice portion sizes, garlic knots and a nice selection of beers.  Nom nom indeed! Did I mention fresh tasting?

cool, and glad to have you as part of the Nashville dining scene!

Five Points Pizza is just the right spot when I'm looking for dine-in pizza and beer, minimal strings attached. If ordering to my house, I'll likely choose a less expensive option, but this is a fun atmosphere with high quality food and service.

Usually one standard slice will suffice: cheese, pepperoni, and prosciutto & basil; special slices are also worth exploring, in the name of variety. Garlic knots might seem redundant in preceding more sauce and dough, but they're so wonderful that it's hard to say no. Sometimes I wish there would be more light appetizers offered, but the knots keep me coming back.

The best dish from the menu that I've tried is the stromboli--two of us shared the Zeus. Baked perfectly with a crunchy exterior and oozing interior of meats, vegetables, and cheeses, this thing is amazing. Like it will amaze you. For a while.

Beer selection is good; servers and bartenders are happy to explain what's available.

Check out the weekday happy hour and lunch specials--you know I love a good bargain.

Just moved to the Tucson area. Went to the Valencia location because I was shopping at Fry's. Walter cut my hair and he was great. Excellent haircut, and suggestions. I will be back and ask for him again.

Real pizza from a real pizza joint.

A must on anyone's schedule who is looking for a great pizza.

Yumm.. I am now going to have pizza tonight.
Yes yes and more yes to this pizza! It was so good, and honestly just as good the next day! Our service was wonderful and I would recommend this place over and over!

Great stylist at this Great Clips. Allie really listened and gave me the style I wanted. She even tested the cut before I left to make sure I was satisfied. Online check-in was simple, fast and easy, so my wait time was very minimal. Thank you.
The pizza is so good and worth every penny. It really lives up to all the hype. Service could be better, but the food is so good I'll let it pass. I just get it delivered anyways.

I had a positive experience dining here, and the pizza was a pleasant surprise. We started out with the garlic knots which in my opinion were alright but I can live without them, but be prepared to have major garlic breath after eating them. For the main dish I ordered the T-REX pie and added banana peppers in the 14 inch. The 14 inch is big enough for a group to share. This pie was shared between two people  and we still had some leftover we ended up taking some back to go. The only issue I had is that I wish there was more pizza sauce on the pizza, but that is just my personal preference overall it was very tasty.

My friend went here a couple weeks ago and would not shut up about how great it was -- "it's the best pizza in Nashville!" I'm not super big on pizza but I tried it to get him to shut up about it.

Honestly one of the best pizzas I've ever had. I got the Habanero Cream Sauce pie, which was so good. Even though it was the most expensive pie on the menu, it was definitely worth it. About a 20 minute wait for them to make it fresh, which was completely fine. The carryout area was pretty cool and lively, with some seating along the windows if you don't want to get a table next door. For sure will go again.

I probably would have rated them with 4 or even 5 stars but let me tell you why I did 3.

First off the salon is great, you can tell it's been there for at least 20 years. The hardwood floors, the vintage mirrors, it's all very intimate and gives a very family style vibe.

I enjoyed watching the busyness that was happening, five stylists, a receptionist, everyone had a spot and it all worked. (With that said, make an appointment!)

My stylist was David. He was great, I told him exactly what I wanted and what I didn't want and he seemed very comfortable with my expectations. The oils that he used for the scalp smelled lovely, were relaxing, and home made too, but the technique felt a little like sandpaper on my scalp at times. I would suggest a little less of the follicle stimulating micro-circles and more of whatever other techniques you (David) were doing because the rest felt good! 

The wash was good, and the cut was fairly easy. It felt effortless and I felt secured about what he was doing. Here's where the three star rating comes in. He answered a call midway through the haircut and was on there for about two minutes...I get it, family first, but not 2 minutes later, a fellow stylist told him it was time to move his car and he ran out! I was left sitting there, mid-sentence, while he did that. It was unprofessional and really disrespectful too. You want to feel pampered when you get a hair cut, you're splurging on yourself, and you kind of expect the undivided attention of your stylist. Maybe that's just me, but I would have really enjoyed the experience a lot more if the last couple of distractions didn't happen because my hair was exactly what I wanted
A Nashville must! great grab and go quick pizza for late nights or random pizza cravings.

Ordered at the counter since we didn't see a hostess. Super friendly and quick counter service. Pie was ready in under 15. 

However, turns out if you order at the counter they won't seat you in the restaurant. Only at the window or bar. Ask to be reseated. They won't. Policy. Bad policy. Good pizza.

We were in Nola for a wedding and found this place near our hotel (Intercontinental) and they got us right in! Super cute place with amazing service and reasonable prices. Highly recommend, they even offered to let us come back for a touch up if for sole reason they got messed up while we were exploring the city!
Favorite pizza in Nashville! Wish the dining room was bigger as there is often a wait for a table. Otherwise very good experience!

I ordered a buttermilk crispy chicken sandwich with ONLY lettuce, and they put pickles, mayonnaise, and tomatoes. The lettuce that they put for me was kind of purple and I also ordered a frappe with no whipped cream, and they filled it 3/4.
