We were visiting from out of town and this place had the best ratings near our hotel. The restaurant closed at 11 but we were able to pick it up at the carryout window. We ordered the T rex which was an all meat pizza. The 14" was more than enough for 2 people.  We ate 2 pieces each and still had  half of it left. Very nice crust with quality meats on it. They don't skimp either. Very good  pizza. We would try it again if we are back in the area.
Pizza in Nashville? Only from this place! The meats are amazing, the crust is crisp, the staff is super friendly.

Well I can't top the story of that epic essay that enticed me to go,buuuuut.....
Yes! The garlic knots were amazing. The old world pizza was out of this world. The new york style crust was that of piefection. The beer? Uh the beer..matched wonderfully with my food. As for the staff...friendly and hospitable. As one of the reviews mentions...they have truly earned the name 5 points pizza.

Great pizza! Had the 14" supreme. It was pricy, but it's worth it.  Far better than your chain shops.  East side - pay for parking.  And it's crowded because of all the other joints there.  Tip: Order ahead, park at the liquor store across the street (free), get your beer/wine there there, and then run across the street and pick up your pizza!

Five stars for the pizza. The thin crust to the tasty toppings. I would go here again. As to the service there wasn't much service. The Host was a better server then our server. The TRex pizza and the garlic knots are great. I would recommend them.

I was a little disappointed both with the service and the food. I used to love coming to this place because the pizza was always good. But today, the pizza crust was paper thin, it couldn't even hold up the skimpy ingredients that were on it. Our waitress was a bit odd. She delivered our food and from the looks of it, was done with her shift immediately afterwards. We wanted honey with our crust, but they no longer put the containers of honey on the tables. I'm assuming it's due to the cost of the honey and people probably stealing the bottles. We never got our check either, we sat around waiting until finally we gave up on waiting and just went up to the cash register and paid. I'm hoping the food was just a fluke and that they haven't switched to paper thin pizza crust and really skimpy ingredients. I could barely taste any pepperoni on my Breath Buster pizza. Let alone any sauce. I will write an updated review when we come back, I'm hoping the service and the food improve in the future. I don't want to stop coming here because of one bad experience, after all, one bad experience doesn't outweigh all the other good ones I've had eating here.

Yummy pizza recipe with amazing crust. Super friendly, down to earth staff. Kara Julia and Josh took great care of us. Popeye Pizza is a favorite. Restaurant needs neon signage on top of eaves to more easily find it in the shopping center.
Can always count on a slice for dinner or later at night. Hard for me to decide between the veggie and the meat slice of the day.

Best in Nashville. Great cheese, great sauce, perfect thin NY crispy crust. I also LOVE the pizza window. Late night pizza by the slice. I travel often and it has become my post-flight tradition when I arrive home. I can always rely on a great quick slice no matter how late my flight lands.

Five Points about Five Points Pizza.

1. The service is really nice. The guys here are cool, especially the one serving me.

2. The pizza is pretty decent, but nothing to write home about, especially if your home is, for example, New York or Buffalo.

3. The prices are a little high for slices, but the slices are large enough to make it worthwhile.

4. Some British tourists were hanging out with my cats while I was inside grabbing the slices. I know, I know, why would I leave my cats with British tourists. I was desperate. What can I say.

5. I'm giving it 4 stars, which makes the fact that "5" is part of the business title somewhat ironic. But this place will always have a pizza my heart.
T Rex was really good( husband and son approved) selection could use some improvement.  The stromboli (zeus)was really good just wish you could build your own. We will be back.

Last minute decision to eat here while in Nashville. We really liked it. Super casual small place with great garlic knots and NY style pizza. Our server was very friendly and helpful. They offered a nice flight of beer also and had fun music playing the whole time( mostly Michael Jackson) which was fine with us. I would definitely recommend!

Pizza and garlic knots were amazing! My hubby got a Greek salad and he said it was very good! Place was a little small with not a lot of seating. But their food was definitely worth it and we'd go again!!!

The Blind Onion in Sparks is somewhat of a disappointment.  I have been here numerous times and I don't know what you have to do to get service but twice now I have had to actually go up to the bar to get someone to take our order.  The bartender even apologized and said he would be out to check on us.  Nope never happened.  Had to get his attention for him to come check on us.

The pizza is ok.  I like it and I love dipping the crust in honey but it isn't good enough to get this place more stars.  

Overall, I wish they could get their act together because it would be nice to hang out there more often.

I absolutely LOVE Blind Onion food.  But staff seriously needs customer service training.  I frequent the restaurant because I love the food, but I am consistently ignored by the staff, who seem to be consumed by their personal worlds, rather than by who is in their restaurant at the time. This could be an amazing restaurant if it were customer-focused.

We arrived in Nashville late at night after a 5 hour drive from St. Louis. We were staying not too far from here, and it was the easiest option for us to hit up for dinner. I came here based on the reviews and am so happy I did.

The pizza was delicious... we went with the veggie pizza, minus mushrooms (not a fan) and minus olives (wife is not a fan). I can't say enough good things about the taste, it really hit the spot. Loved the dough, sauce, and cheese ratio. The place was packed, but we ordered a whole pie beforehand, so it was quick. 

The only thing I was not a fan of were the garlic knots, but those don't usually travel well. I didn't put them in the oven when I got home, so that was my fault. If I put them in the oven, I think that they would have been exactly what I was looking for. 

Anyways, this has been some of my favorite pizza, and I would definitely go back again and again!

Keep up the great work Five Points Pizza!
On a recent trip to Nashville, I was pleasantly surprised to be near Five Points Pizza.  Hard to find a good thin crust pizza that rivals a NYC slice, but they do a great job. Will be back!
High quality and very good fast food.  Fresh rare roast beef sandwiches with crispy hot fries.  A St. Louis original and standard.

Went in at 5 today, the hair stylist wasn't the friendliest or really personable for that matter, especially with my daughter, unfortunately in that type of atmosphere I don't necessarily except the best service. I couldn't even tell you the lady's name because she didn't introduce herself like they normal would. I have very thin hair and I asked for a specific hair cut and let her know I am aware of my hair and asked her if I did bangs would it look fuller , and she ensured me it would work. I also purchased product from the establishment and it made my hair  feel greasy and gross. After I washed my
Hair i styled it and noticed that my bangs were cut extremely short and my layers are very choppy, I'm already self conscious because my hair is thinning and fine, now I'm extremely upset, I will never return to this location.

So update.... apparently this place has become too cool to offer decent service. The last few times I've been.... the wait staff as been RUDE and not bothered to get my order correct much less give a crap about the fact they screwed it up.   The pizza is still good but I'm sure there are friendlier more accommodating places to sit and chill with the family or friends. Seating is very limited. Don't even think you'll get lucky with a party larger than 4. You'll be out in the aisles or halfway out the door.  Also, the bar and the service at the bar could be better.  Selection is limited to mostly just beer, not much of a choice if you're not a beer drinker.  Parking is non existent as well, you'll need to use the pay lot that's across the street and slightly down the block.   So GREAT food, but the inconvenience of the location, lack of beverage choices and rude AF staff shaved off 3 stars for me.

Such a great place! A group of 14 of us went here last night and we sat right down in a back room. This was the perfect accommodation since we had 3 kiddos who needed some space to move around. Service was fantastic as we had people checking on us and asking if we needed anything while we waited for our food. Stephanie was our main server and was great about applying coupons, splitting checks, and taking our order correctly the first time around. She did all this with a pleasant smile and a genuinely positive attitude. Then when the food came out it was game over because the food looked and smelled AMAZING!!!! Kerry and Sarah brought out our food and were awesome. Kerry even mentioned using risers for the pizzas so we could enjoy it easier since there was a lot of plates, cups and toys from our large party. They even brought out extra amounts of sauce and ranch (which we used every bit of)! Then they came out with the honey for the crust and that was hands down amazing! Who would've thought honey for the crust was a thing?! The drinks were free (not the beer,of course), but they have the soda machine that dispenses multiple flavors of drinks so that was convenient. 

Overall super happy I finally tried this place! Highly recommend the Popeye pizza (Stephanie our server was right about how delicious that one was) and the cheesy breadsticks. 

*****GREAT SERVICE, FOOD, & ATMOSPHERE!
You can buy pizza by the slice or whole pie. Great selection of craft beer on tap. You sit in the dinning area, or grab a slice if you're on the go. Laid back atmosphere and staff is very friendly.

Great pizza.

But what I like most about Five Points Pizza is the service. Always friendly and attentive, something lost on a lot of service industry folk these days it would seem. Even getting an order to-go the guys behind the bar are consistently very pleasant and provide awesome service. Small stuff like hostesses or even servers opening the door when you leave with your hands full are not ignored and go a long way for me as a customer. 

Would certainly recommend to anyone in the area. Price is fair for good pizza. Clean. 

Get the garlic knots.

Pizza is outstanding.  Bartender is excellent.  And the beer my cousin had (Good People IPA) was really good (and he's a tough grader.)

Atmosphere is perfect for a date or a late night slice.  Oh, and the art 'installation' is impressive on multiple fronts.

I'll be real here, pizza is not my most favorite (I'm a disgrace to my Italian lineage, I know)... but this place was on point! New York pizza by the slice, with fresh basil and light on the grease? Yes please! I can see why this place is a Nashville staple. 

Shop is small, and they don't offer any fanciness - pizza is slapped onto a Dixie paper plate, but trust me - it is oh so good. Be sure to get the garlic knots! We ordered a round to much on during the wait, but ended up getting a second order. We still talk about them 2 years later...

I could not be happier with the service we received from the Acoma staff.  From Ryder, their very knowledgeable, responsive salesman to the crew that replaced, repaired and set the tiles. They showed up on time when they were scheduled, they cleaned everything and they were very respectful and courteous. The roof looks fantastic. I highly recommend this company.

First time eating here and the pizza was great, the garlic knots were great but the service was the best I've seen in a while!  We walked right in and sat at the bar and was waited on by the best waiter ever, "Dave"!!!! Hope to be back again soon.

This is our new favorite pizza place!  Great crust, great topping combos.... you should definitely try the Vodka Sauce pizza!  So why the 4 stars instead of 5.  Seating is very limited. Don't even think you'll get lucky with a party larger than 4. You'll be out in the aisles or halfway out the door.  Also, the bar and the service at the bar could be better.  Selection is limited to mostly just beer, not much of a choice if you're not a beer drinker.  Parking is non existent as well, you'll need to use the pay lot that's across the street and slightly down the block.   So GREAT food, but the inconvenience of the location, lack of beverage choices and seating just shaved that last star off for me.

Fun spot! I got the prosciutto and basil and the veggie slice of the day. Both great but highly recommend the prosciutto slice. They also have full size pizzas, but the individual slices were huge and two were very filling. They even gave us a coke for the road!

This was my second time at this restaurant and exceeded all of my expectations today, which were not lowered one bit by my sad experience yesterday at the Blind Onion on S. Virginia and Neil Rd. 

My server smiled and greeted me when I entered, she was super nice and brought my glass for the self serve soft drinks and took my order in less than a minute! 

The super slice (Italian sausage) arrived in about 10 minutes, super hot with an amazing crust that was crispy and had a nice char to it. 

If you like pizza you will LOVE the pizza here!

WHOA NELLY!!! I'll admit - I was skeptical. I have lived in New York and still go there for work quite often, and I love pizza. I wasn't expecting it to measure up. It DID. Five Points Pizza is truly a 5 STAR pizza establishment. It is addictive - you won't want to have just one slice. The pepperoni is perfect. I don't have really any qualms - it was quick, it was SUCH. GOOD. PIZZA, and the people were kind. Only in Nashville.
Seriously!!! THE best server I have ever had! Kerry was freaking awesome definitely coming back to this location just to enjoy his energy! This guy needs a promotion  just throwing it out there!

The beer selection is awesome with Jackalope & Yazoo on tap. You can see (and taste) the thought put into their pizzas. The service was wonderful. The space was cozy. I can't wait to return.

I noticed a stack of high chairs so I'll be bringing my toddler during the next trip.

This one's been on my list to try for years. Didn't disappoint. Excellent NY style pizza and garlic knots. I'm not a big fan of ground sausage, so will probably go with cheese next time, but otherwise, no complaints.

I found this company on Google and called them this morning to ask for an estimate for a roof repair. The website says "call for a free estimate" and the word "free" is in bold letters. 
After giving all my personal information to the lady over the phone, she told me that because I am purchasing the house, the company charges $124 to give me an estimate, which is then applied to the cost of the repair if I decide to go ahead with it. When I asked her why they do so only for those who are buying a house, she said that it is the company's policy.
I fully respect the company's policy, however, I believe that the information given on their website is inaccurate and misleading, given that it clearly says FREE estimate, without stating that there are exceptions.
This company may do a great job repairing a roof but discriminating those who are buying a house and charging us for an estimate when they don't charge others, is not, in my opinion, a good way of doing business.

Very disappointing service. Excellent pizzas. 

We have been to the Blind Onion on many occasions, you do have to wait a little longer than you might expect but the food is always good.

However, today was a joke to say the least.

As always, we arrived and seated ourselves at a table, there is a sign as you enter which tells you to do just that.

There were at least 6 tables that needed clearing and still needed clearing by the time we left...

It took a good 10 minutes to get any service from any of the 4 staff stood behind the counter, when I did finally get someone's attention, she came over to our table and asked what we wanted...err...menus would be nice! She eventually came back with our menus and told that things have changed, we have to go up to the counter to place our order. (Then change your sign by the door).

We placed our order and our food arrived. It was as good as ever, we can never complain about the food. 
Shortly after we got our food another couple came in and took a seat, wherein a different waitress who had just arrived on shift, attended their table with a smile and menus. Then she came back to their table and took their order. In the meantime the sour faced waitress that couldn't be bothered to do her job, left. I guess that was the problem, it was shift change.

We were there around a hour, by the time we left the tables that needed clearing when we arrived, plus our table and a couple others still needed clearing.

In summary the service was shocking, but the food was excellent.

Came to Five Points on a Friday night. The wait was around 45 minutes for a really bad seat (got it switched later.) Went next door while I waited to get a quick slice of cheese. This is some of the better tasting thin crust pizza in the city and I know good pizza (family from NY, deli business.) It's not saying a whole lot because I don't know many great pizza joints in Nashville but it has good flavor and each bite makes you want another. I think the food is overpriced and the atmosphere is really tight and everyone is on top of each other watching me take photos of my pizza for these posts..ha (and the cute girl I was with). I do think the meatball pizza is worth getting, I can't say the same about the others that don't have meat on them. It's hard to spend $20 on a 14 inch and not get protein. Nonetheless, I think the good bargain here is the pizza by the slice and the specials they have. I would go back, but it's also something I could live without. Huge upgrade from Papa J, but still miles short from good NY pie

As a native New Yorker, born and raised in the city, coming to Nashville for college has proven quite difficult when it comes to finding a pizza place that matches up to my standards. Five Points is the only place that serves a NY style slice that is this close to authentic this far outside of the actual city of New York, at least in my experience. The only reason I am giving them 4 stars instead of 5 is they could use improvement on the crust. Way too dry and crunchy in my opinion. If they made a softer less over-cooked crust, they would have a perfect rating.

Just a fun little addition: when I was given the opportunity to meet Taylor Swift after her Reputation Stadium Show at Nissan Stadium in Nashville, she gave everyone pizza from Five Points which is how I found out about this place. So if you want to eat the pizza Taylor eats, now you know!

I love the guard here and most of the staff. Jonathan the guard is always so kind and helpful and sean is always pleasant and attentive. I love coming here and appreciate the staff always but even more so during this time.

I had to come back and update my review based on tonight's experience.

After a few crummy visits in a row, we had a coupon and decided to try Blind Onion again after not coming back for a year. I am SO glad we did. 

We were immediately greeted by Karry who was extremely friendly and helpful. He got my kids set up with drinks and helped us find a table (it's had been so long since we had been in that I was awkwardly trying to order at the counter, and he was so patient with me). 

Julia waited on us. Talk about a girl with some hustle! She was running around making sure everyone in the restaurant had everything they needed. She was so sweet. She even took the time to hang up my daughter's picture that she drew on the wall in the midst of the dinner rush. 

The vibe in this place has completely changed, and I am so glad. The customer service was 5 stars and the pizza was also. We will definitely be back soon as long as Karry and Julia are there! Thanks for a great night guys.
Just found my pizza joint here in Nashville! Solid pie that has a great balance of cheese and sauce. Nothing else to say except damn that was good

This place rocks! The pizza is so good!!! One of the owners is originally from NY and half the restaurant is in the same style as pizza places in NY. With the showcase window and everything! The food is always fresh and the service is fast. They take such pride in their business and even took their whole staff to Italy for a work trip and pizza making classes!!!
What is there to say? Great pizza in Nashville and they're open late? I think I'll go for lunch now.

Passing though Nashville and decided to try Five Points. Had a long wait, which tells me on a Saturday night that it's worth the wait. I was correct. The pizza was phenomenal. Probably my favorite Non-Chicago style pizza To date. Do yourself a favor and try it. Oh word to the wise, don't try and defeat the T-Rex, he will hurt you.

We used to love this restaurant but after today we won't be returning. Sticky tables, filthy menus,  bottles of honey left open on our table and others,  tacky and nearly empty covered in fingerprints.  No portion control on served salads. Even the pizza crust was smaller and not as tasty! The bathrooms were not clean. Inattentive service.
This place was recommended by several folks in the area and the pizza was fantastic. They have really good lunch specials too. I forget of the name of the beer I had but it was decent.

Well Dean C, I left message on FB, no response yet.  
Guidelines are strict for restaurants, but that doesn't stop skimping here and there..
What a wonderful place to get dinner!  The drinks and food were fabulous!!!  I've had to switch to white sauce lately and I have to say that the Popeye pizza is to die for!!!

This place is really good.  I stumbled in here during a work trip lunch break because I had heard it was some great pie.  The place did not disappoint.  Everyone was really friendly and helpful.  This operation was a slam and go type of experience, so I can't speak for the restaurant bar next door (I was in the trenches chopping up with the pizza makers while taking down a meat slice).  To me the pizza is probably a 4 out 5 but my entire experience was a 5.  Place was clean, quick, friendly and delicious.  If you're in the area and need a slice, don't hesitate stopping in.  Cheers

We had a great experience. The staff was friendly and attentive, the drinks and food arrive at our table timely, and both drinks and food were delicious. Our server, Kerry, was a delight. He really knows how to treat a customer. Thank you so much. We will definitely be back for more.

I've now dined at Treemont twice and cannot WAIT to go back.

I'll start with my favorite items: Brussel Sprouts, sour cream pannecotta, apple wood smoked salmon (blew my mind), lobster ravioli, pork loin..... 

I just listed everything I ate because they were all that good! The chickpea fritters (appetizer) were yummy. Additionally, they're gluten free although they're fried. They come with a really good dipping sauce!

Beautiful food presentation, accommodating and sweet staff, awesome beer list, and wine list. Glasses ($9-14) and bottles (wide range).

The ambiance is very nice. Upstairs can accommodate a large party, but there are also cozy spots for a romantic date. I really appreciate that their tables aren't too close together so you don't feel like you may as well dine with the table next you!

I plan on coming back, and definitely plan on trying their brunch menu.
love the pizza and the staff very nice people very good pizza and big portions, not too pricey either
We Love this place! The food is great and Kerry is the Best Manger ever! He is so personable and great with customers!!! I give this place 5 stars for food andservice! Thanks Kerry & team!!!!

It's Wednesday at noon may 1. If the BO team read these reviews I believe the young lady behind the counter needs retrained. 
Your pizza is good but I'm never coming back here. I truly feel her attitude is - it was the least she could do and if she could have done less she would have. 
This is the 8th stop in my quest for my favorite local pizza. And as I said it's good but I can say with confidence it's not the only good pizza in town. 
The best thing about your pizza is by far the crust.

Omg I love this pizza. We found a reason to come to the area just to get some garlic knots and a slice of pizza. Great flavor, thin New York style pizza and fresh toppings. Not much else to say as they do this well and I will return!

Having recently purchased a house, I learned during a good rain that my back lanai leaked in multiple places.  I gave it a try myself, in the heat with some advice from Home Depot, to little effect.  I had heard about Acoma from some people that thought they were clearly the best. I reached out to them and was glad I did. They were professional, identified the spots to seal quickly and considering the job done were well worth the money. Without hesitation I would recommend this company to my family and friends. They do roofs, lanais, everything.

This is probably one of the more higher-end pizza places in the Spanish Springs area. Their Super Slice deal is always good for filling up on the cheap. Pizza is always tasty and they have honey for dipping the crusts which isn't my bag, but my wife loves. I've concluded that honey is the glitter of food because once you open the container, it's stickiness gets EVERYWHERE. It's not uncommon to find a clean-looking yet sticky table there. Just a minor quibble as the food and service has always been good.

I definitely was expecting a lot of barbecue and fried chicken on my recent trip to Nashville, but I was surprised that my favorite meal was actually at this pizza place! My coworkers and I came here for a quick lunch and it definitely didn't disappoint. 

I got one of their specials, a slice and salad combo. I had the arugula salad, which consisted of arugula, house-cured orange peel, walnuts, grape tomatoes and feta cheese. The orange peel was my favorite part! Tiny little sugary slivers that melted in your mouth and paired with the peppery arugula fantastically. For the slice I got the prosciutto and basil and it was great! I loved how thin and crisp the crust was and the pizza wasn't greasy at all. 

Lastly, I had the basil lemonade to drink. This was SO GOOD. Slightly sweet and floral, but definitely not overwhelmingly so! Definitely get this if you come here!!!

It was my first time here and didn't know what to expect. When you walk in someone asks to see your patient card and driver's license. The place is super clean and cool. There's sofas around so you can wait comfortably while waiting for your order to be ready. There's a pharmacist on duty if you have any questions. The people that work here are very welcoming!

I'm not sure why this place has received so many rave reviews. 

Since we're new to the area and were longing to find a local pizza place we ordered a large, half cheese and half pepperoni pizza from Five Points. We figured that if we liked the basics we could try something more adventurous in the future. 

The entire pizza can be summed up in one word: bland.

The crust was thin and tasted like cardboard. The sauce was bland and there wasn't enough of it. The cheese also had zero flavor and again, there wasn't enough of it either. 

We were thoroughly disappointed. I love pizza and there have been only 2 occasions in my life when I have been unable to enjoy a pizza and didn't want to eat it. Sadly, Five Points was one of those times. 

I guess if you're a Nashville native this is your place to go for great pizza but as Nashville newbies we'll keep looking.

P.S. if you're ever going to Cleveland, Ohio check out Antonio's Pizza for a great, award winning pizza.
Excellent roast beef!!   You will never want to eat at that other roast beef place again.  St Louis original restaurant!!
Stopped in was. Very busy. Had to get a slice to eat at the takeout counter. Thin crust , good sauce and meat was fresh. Didn't quite live up to the reviews.

The pizza was very good. The toppings were fresh, they didn't skimp on ingredients, and it was hot and ready on time. My only criticism is that the crust was slightly doughy but that's a personal taste. I definitely recommend this place and, when I return, I may well upgrade this to four stars. Now, it's three and a half. Subject to further review.

Stopped in for a pepperoni slice and some brews Sunday afternoon! We also got an order of garlic knots that were very tasty. Marinara sauce had a nice mild flavor and complemented the great dough perfectly.

We will definitely be back on our next time to W. Nashvegas for live music. We met some really friendly folks at the bar who gave us great tips on other places nearby to checkout during the remainder of our stay.

The bartender we had was extremely attentive and made the experience very enjoyable. Keep it up y'all!!!

Fantastic pepperoni pizza! Thin crispy crust, huge slices, perfectly fresh and spiced pepperoni, delicious cheese & all for a great price! It was so easy to order at the pick up window late at night, thanks! We'll definitely be back!

As a tourist from NYC and a bona fide pizza snoot, I scoffed at the prospect of finding a decent pizzeria outside the Big Apple. But when our Tennessee host and both of our Uber drivers included Five Points Pizza in their lists of top must-visit eateries, my husband and I resignedly gave it a try. 

If you get there past 11 pm as we did, know that they only take orders through the window (think pedestrian drive through), but our slices were shoved into a screaming hot oven and ready on dual paper plates in minutes. Because I'm a purist, I ordered the cheese pizza, which was respectably thin and well toasted throughout, providing the perfectly rigidity with which I could execute the traditional New Yorker fold and hold. If I had any complaints, it would be that the layer of cheese was just a tad too thick (the smattering of Parmesan cheese notwithstanding), enveloping that beautiful crust with an adipose blanket of mozzarella that ended up smearing oil over my mouth with every bite. Then again, most people would hardly consider that a minus. 

Take it from the converted New Yorker - Five Points knows how to do a slice right. If you're looking for pizza, this should be your first and only stop.

Sunday July 6th, after swimming at the Cedars of Lebanon State Park Pool in Lebanon, I had to have a pizza fix. Since Noel recently moved here, I hadn't shared this location with her yet...so we HAD to GO...
This is MY PERSONAL FAV Pizza in Nashville..There are several I like and enjoy but this is my FAVORITE...only CON...they have a small location with on the street parking and always crowded ( a good thing cause the food is AWESOME !!!) but hard to accommodate large groups.
So if I was in a large party of more than four or five, I would choose another location...but only because of that...ONLY that reason...

The food is AWESOME!
The wait staff is FRIENDLY and ATTENTIVE !
The prices is Moderate but Really a great value when you think about the Quality of the end product...HEAVEN IN A SLICE...

Today, since there was three of us, Noel, Tony and myself..we opted for a whole pie...My favorite is their GREEK PIE called "ZEUS" and it is Terrific...with Feta Cheese, onions, black olives, banana peppers, pepperoni and spicy capicola and the tomato marinara is divine.. I love this pie..but it is large 18 inches and a little pricey ...$25 I believe..or maybe a little more..but worth every dollar..but very large. The slices are New York style so they equal two slices really..

I have never had a slice or a pie I didn't like here. I love to try their special slices of the day..but today I wanted Noel to enjoy the ZEUS for her first experience at Five Points..
we also ordered a whole order of the Garlic Knots with Fresh roasted garlic and basil with parmesan cheese (fresh grated I believe but either way delicious and hot) I love the melted butter oozing over the knots with the garlic and basil...I could LIVE ON THESE KNOTS...literally live on them but I would be as big as a HOUSE...they are fattening but OMG worth every CALORIE or CARB..depending on what you count..
I had soda and Noel had Sweet tea..and Tony believe it or not HANNAH had a PBR instead of a Budweiser....lol !!!! We had a really great meal..with taxes and tip I signed away $45 ...but there was so much leftover for takeout we now have dinner..so $45 for lunch and dinner for family of three..NOT TO DAG ON BAD...

I can't wait to go back again..I love their sauce free slices and white pie slices too..I already need another Five Point Pizza Fix...
YOU HAVE TO GO and try them out...and let me know what you think...

Visited five points on a Sunday around 3pm when there was a home game for the Titans, but we still got seated right away.  

We started with the spinach salad which was just ok. We went with the a split of old world and the vegetarian pie as a 14inch (Althea smaller size) the portion is pretty big for two so unless you are super hungry I recommend sharing a small pie between two people. They were good specially for the price but nothing special. 

A decent place for decent people. 

Spinach salad: 7/10
Old world: 8/10
Vegetarian pizza: 7.5/10

We took the quick route and did the walk in side as a late dinner! The line and service were fast! Local beers on tap and very friendly service. Pizza slices are huge and very delicious! Pre selected pies or a full selection menu. Definitely lived up to the hype!!
I really don't understand the love for this place.  The dough was undercooked, and the sauce was bland.

Yummmmm! Today's special: meatballs, onion, garlic, mozzarella and red sauce.  so good.. but definitely taking home left overs. As always, great atmosphere, great music, service is on top of it. I  Five Points!

Best pizza I have ever had (and like most.... I've eaten a lot of pizza). Our server Kari was perfect. She made my little girl's night by bringing her a dough ball to play with. Dining out with a 3 year old can be tough sometimes, but this experience couldn't have been better. Thanks for a great night.

We just had two beautiful garage doors installed, one double and one single; and we are just thrilled with both the product and the installation! Dan's crew showed up as scheduled, they were friendly and competent, both on the job AND in the office when we were shopping and then when we signed the contract. Office staff very knowledgable and willing to spend the time to make sure we understand our options. Job site crew did a great job and left the site neat as a pin. We chose Dan's for this project, because they had put new door openers in for us in the past; and they did a nice job with that, too. Reasonable prices, great service. Highly recommend.

A great start to becoming a friend of the East End.  The pizza and the pints are on spot.  The Salads are generous, fresh and fantastic.  

We started with Garlic knots.  They were fresh and flavorful with fresh garlic butter and basil garnishing the plate. Fresh marinara with sweet tomatoes were a nice touch but the bomb was the garlic.

Greek Salad  bowl was enough for two to share.  Great fresh olives, cherry tomatoes and feta with a great vinaigrette garnishing a deep cold bowl of fresh romano.  

Then the pie.  The crust is spot on.  The sauce is sublime,and the imported prosciutto and fresh basil was finished off very well with light cheese.  I would 

Accompanied by great pints from the rotating taps, this place is a great gateway to the area!

Five Points is always awesome. The staff is always super nice, fast, and on top of it, even when there's a huge line at the window. I've never had anything but perfect service and a great experience. Also, the pizza is something I dream about.
Such an awesome joint, great food, great crows in the bar area.  Would definitely be back here whenever im back in Nashville.

Love Five Points! The pizza was great! The vibe of the place was awesome!! Gives me a reason to go back to East Nashville!!! The staff all friendly and attentive. Can't say enough good about this place.

My mom and I come to the blind onion every few months for a lunch date.   Today's service from Josh was exceptional!  He greeted us with a smile, and made sure we were taken care of the whole time!  Thank you!

Five points pizza is on point. We came here on our first night to Nashville and I am glad we did. We probably would have been to stuffed by the end of our trip to have pizza. The food was so fresh and we had our pizza in about fifteen minutes. My boyfriend and I split the habanero and meat pizza. I loved how savory and spicy my side was. I had a bite of his and it was equally as good. The service was really great. We were told to get the garlic knots, but we would not have had room to eat them if we did. We still left with a few slices of pizza to take home (don't worry they were consumed later that night). I definitely think it is worth checking out.

My favorite pizza in Nashville - by a landslide. In their carryout/za by the slice half of the restaurant they've got pepperoni, cheese, and prosciutto and basil slices available everyday. Along with those, a daily speciality slice that is sure not to disappoint. The crust....oh, that deliciously thin, NY style, crispy, chewy crust. Not only is the crust outrageously good, but the slices are the size of your head! Packed full of flavor and freshness with every bite. They have many different creative combinations of flavors. They even have a vegan pizza option for you trendy hipster folk.

If you're nearby during lunch, be sure to take advantage of their 2-slice + a drink for only $8.

This place is always rocking so you better call ahead unless you fancy watching dough getting thrown nonstop. There are two entrances. One side is dedicated to carryout and za by the slices and the other for dine in.

Why are you still reading this? Go get pizza already!
FPP is good / service is very Nashville. Buy the dough and go home to make it in your own oven. It's so goood.

Where do I even begin? The pizza was amazing. We ordered an 18 inch pizza, garlic knots, and a salad.  We placed order online and went to pick it up. I was pleasantly surprised that online orders have a separate pick up window. I was able to get my food quickly and get home to eat it. We ordered four garlic knots covered in garlic and olive oil and they came with a side of marinara. The salad was just ok. I was excited to see however they had a creamy balsamic vinaigrette dressing which was delightful. For our pizza we ordered a half cheese for the kiddos and half Super Bianca. OMG  it was delicious. We were in pizza heaven as we gobbled down the huge New York cut slices. I would absolutely recommend this place if you are looking to have pizza for dinner.

While visiting Nashville, I initially thought we would be seeking out only barbecue and hot chicken places, but this pizza place came so highly recommended, we had to take the ride over to five points to check it out. We walked in the quick slice to go side, not even realizing that there was a sit down option next door. I might have enjoyed a cold beer with my pizza if I knew we could dine in. The to-go side was packed and with no place to sit down so we ended up eating in the car. However, this pizza really was amazing. Perfectly thin crust pizza with high quality toppings. I had the vege pizza of the day which included vodka sauce, onions, mushrooms, spinach and fresh basil on top of the cheese. Really worth going back to again and again.

I've been going to this location once a week since July 2020, generally between 8 am and 11 am. Every time--every single time--there is a problem. They can't scan my app coupon, they can't print receipts, they don't have coffee carriers, they don't have coffee cuffs. Are they seriously unaware of the multi-million dollar hot coffee settlement? Why would I not be able to get a receipt until today, 9/30/20? Rather fortuitous I must say.

This morning was the last straw, 8:10 am. Again, at the first window the woman "couldn't" scan my app deal. There was a line, it was $2, I let it go and she was happy that I didn't push it but she didn't apologize or offer any other solution. At the second window the woman hung the bag out of the window and then the two large coffees. No greeting, no nothing. I asked for a coffee carrier. 'We're out". No apology, no alternate solution, no coffee cuffs, just a look and silence. But I did get a receipt for the first time since July!

When I got home I called the store (#1322, 209 213 RIDGE PIKE, CONSHOHOCKEN, PA 19428) and was greeted by a clearly bothered woman who said "McDonalds". I asked to speak to a manager--"Why?". You can see how this is going and I urge you to listen to the recordings. Apparently you have no managers and no franchise owners. They are not there and they will not be coming in ever. You should probably know that.

It's funny, this location was my first job when I was 15-back in the mid-80s. I worked the drive-thru and counter and would never have treated a customer the way I've been treated here. I would have been fired. Obviously.

I called the corporate number, 800-244-6227, and spoke to Mary about my experiences with this location. Mary was super pleasant and helpful. When we were done speaking she asked me if I would take a survey. I said yes and she tried to connect me. I was disconnected. I called back and got Mary again, she thanked me for calling back, let me know she would report the problem and tried again. Again, disconnected. I called back and got Rhonda who also said she would report the problem and tried again. Disconnected again. Called back and got a thoroughly unpleasant woman who didn't identify herself or McDonalds until I asked. She didn't want to give me her name but eventually said her name was Tiffany. Highly doubt that's her name. I told her what happened and she couldn't be less interested. I asked to be sent to the survey, she told me there were no surveys. When pressed she accused me of trying to incite her into being rude. What? Seriously? It's a McDonald's survey, not brain surgery. Again, please listen to these calls. 9/30/20 between 9:05 and 9:35. Tiffany should be terminated immediately, she is not suited for customer service at all.

I will be looking up the franchise owner and getting in touch. This location needs a clean sweep of employees and a manager on site at all times. The employees are consistently lazy and incompetent--I sure hope you're not paying these morons $15 an hour. I made $3.35/hr there and was pleasant as can be! Now that I have a receipt I see I can take a survey online. Look for that.

So my husband and I went here tonight. We sat at the bar and there wasn't many in the restaurant. I ordered a glass of Chardonnay which they poured out of the beer tap, i then asked to have a vodka tonic instead because the Chardonnay was basically foaming. My husband ordered a beer, and we ordered a small pepperoni pizza. They then asked if I wanted to pay for it right then and there. I've never been asked that, but agreed to pay anyway. She came back and asked if I wanted a vodka water. I told her no I wanted a vodka tonic, but could I just get the pizza to go since the drinks were taking a while. They then brought out the pizza and it wasn't cooked on the top and then asked if I wanted my beer. I then mentioned to her since I ordered a vodka tonic and the pizza to go. She told me we don't have tonic water and since I was already charged for a drink I asked I could have a beer and the pizza in a box to go. I went home and put the pizza in the oven. Not a good experience tonight.

I like pizza. This place has good pizza. If you like good pizza you'll like this place.

Meat slice was exceptional (sliced meatball, red onion, minced garlic, mozzarella, red sauce).

Wow! We have been here in the past and have had really good service and pizza!
Today... completely different story.... the gal that is bartending is VERY rude! Acting as though we are an inconvenience to her! NO personality at all! Just found out she's the manager (Colleen) Wow!
Not coming back here again.
Recent visit They had  plenty of staff and food was out quickly and quality was on par. Will be going back soon. Staff was also friendly and paid attention to detail.

Pretty good. The table was kinda sticky I asked her if she could wipe it again but she forgot. I didnt really want to make a thing of it so didnt remind her. She was friendly so I dont want to mention her name or anything. An ok experience though.

I decided this location instead of the Fairfield next door just based on my want for a full kitchen. The place has been remodeled and is very nice. The gym is awesome and one of the best I've used at a hotel. The lobby holds mixers 3 night a week which is very nice but I did not take part. Nice grill in the courtyard. I got a nice goody bag upon checking in. Breakfast downstairs had a lot of options. My room was very big and very clean. Kitchen is awesome and so convenient for anyone staying multiple days and likes to cook their own meals. Shower has strong water pressure. Great central location to get anywhere you'd want to go. Decent food options close. A few downsides are the elevators suck. They are painfully slow and I found myself just taking the stairs everyday instead of wait on 1 of the 2 elevators. I was told they were working on it The other thing that was inconvenient was my room was kind of dark. Even with all the lights on it was on the dark side. All things considered I am very pleased with my experience and plan to stay here next time I'm in town.

If you like pizza reheated in the oven and paying top dollar for it, this is the place for you. Not that good in my opinion. There's better pizza in Nashville. Look in the frozen food section at Kroger. Digiorno is pretty good...

We love the Blind Onion! By far the best pizza in Sparks - we get takeout almost once a week. Sometimes we have a beer at the bar while we wait, they are really taking the Covid policies seriously so it feels clean and safe. The staff is friendly and helpful even though things are crazy right now. Try the Breath Buster, it's delicious!

I live in New York, where pizza, bagels, and bacon eggs and cheeses are to die for!
This pizza right here.... 14 inch with pepperoni cooked crispy, omg!!! Beats some of the places I've had pizza at in New York!!! I loved this pizza, loved the atmosphere and the waitress was a sweet one. 
Staff was friendly too. 
But the pizza..... omg!!!! To die for! I recommend 100% if you're down in Nashville!!!

I've been frequenting Blind onion for years now and IMO it's either the best pizza in the area or just meh depending on the day lol. 80% of the time it's great, but i feel like every 3rd time or so it's pretty terrible pizza for one reason oof another. Too thin, pizza falling apart, burnt, not cooked enough, etc. one or those things usually happens. But... the rest of the time seems to make up for it since we keep coming back lol so there it is. Love the ambience of the place, staff is always friendly and the pizza is usually great. Good beer options as well.

Since this virus I have ordered online and paid online and came in to pick up my pizza only to have the girl at the counter tell, me they somehow lost the order.
Yes, I have have my printed receipt with me. The girl stares at the receipt for a long time then goes to talk to someone in the back, only to come back out and tell me they will start the pizza now.
I do get my pizza twenty minutes later. You'd think that with the virus this online ordering would be pretty straight forward. I love Blind Onion pizza's, but the casual unprofessional help is hurting your business.
You need to solve that before you wonder why business is down.
Don't change your pizza's, they are great
Definitely good food and service. On arrival I had to wait for fries to be cooked fresh. Black owned business in a urban area. Prices Reasonable!
Great pizza, quick service! Coming from Chicago it was more of a NY pizza style. I'd go back
Worst ever, don't know how to use the app for curbside. Waited forever and they couldn't figure it out. Picking up shake shack as we speak

Best pizza I've ever had! We had the habanero cream sauce pie this time and it was incredible! We've never been disappointed and there is also a good selection of draft beers.  This has easily become one of our favorite spots in Nashville!
One of the reasons we come to this pizza joint is because we love the dill ranch dip.  But apparently if you order out and order extra you get none!  So no more!  Sorry!
Couldn't get anyone to answer the phone to take my order and I called 7 times. Yes they are open, but Couldn't get anyone to come to the door.  Arrggggg!
It is easily the go to Pizza in Nashville.  I like everything I have had, and we have been a lot. Even late at night,  the salad are fresh!
I love lions choice.  Ive been eating it all my life. However, am I the only one thats been getting super rare bloody meet the past month?? Whats going on at this location??
Good solid place. A bit more upscale then a chain pizza joint. Good pizza and good service.
Wonderful environment as well as staff needless to say the food was GREAT. The location is great too

My go to late night pizza craving. Their pizza by the slice is amazing!! The crispy bottom crust holds up by it self even though it's thin. I always get the daily veg pizza and I'm always left full and satisfied. And their staple pepperoni, prosciutto and basil, and cheese pizza. They always have friendly staff. They will not disappoint!

Nice atmosphere, friendly staff, fast service despite being very busy. 
I have a few issues with the pizza. On the plus side, the toppings were high quality and the pizza was hot and fresh. My main issue is the crust. Not sure why they describe this as New York style. Far from it - it's more like a Chucky Cheese crust. Flat, and perfectly round with no character. It's akin more to cracker crust than floppy NY with big chewy crust.  If they didn't swear they make it in-house, I might even say it's frozen or par-baked. 
I was really hungry, so it probably spared them from an even lower rating. 
I would never seek this place out, but if I was really hankerin' for a pizza and was in the area, I reckon I'd go again.
Great pizza place best in town in my opinion. I've had it many times and it never disappoints! Their meats are so good.

We were staying at a nearby B&B and popped in for a late lunch. The vibe is awesome. Casual, trendy, and totally Nashville! We had the salad/slice combo and it was delish! Big fresh salad and the pizza toppings (BACON!) we wonderful.
Kerry is a GOD. Best service I've had in ages. Great place, with great service. Kerry, you're the. GOAT.
Five Points has remained "on point", after having survived the tornado, and then COVID. Their pizza really is a Must Try when in Nashville!
Quick service! The pizza was decent and super thin. Nothing spectacular but I definitely liked the place. Nice little hangout spot.

Sunday, May 18, 2014, Tony and I went walking around Nashville checking out some sights and we got hungry. It was about 1pm so we decided to go to our favorite Pizza place...Five Points Pizza. We love this restaurant.

 
Never had a bad meal here, never had bad service here and the prices are always awesome..Very Budget Friendly. Today the special pizzas were a Pepperoni with tomato sauce, feta cheese and spinach...and the veggie pizza was a white pizza with smoked mozzarella, onions, jalapenos and heirloom tomato slices.. They used a olive oil with garlic to put on the crust for a base. It was really good!!! 

I think I enjoyed the White Veggie Pizza the best..
We also got our usual half order of fresh garlic and basil covered knots with fresh parmesan cheese.  It is really good and our favorite served with a side of some awesome tomato marinara sauce. LOVE LOVE LOVE the Garlic Knots...half order of four is only $3 and full order of 8 is only $5

 
Tony got a tallboy PBR for $3 and I got a coca cola. We love this place.  Love to go here. It's a small location and always packed. The food is so good. Sometimes, you have to wait for a table but its worth it. Our waiter was Erik. He is very friendly. The check with taxes and tip was only $23. I can't wait to go here again...Noel will love this place. When she gets here!!!

If you want a workout that not only kicks your butt, but also puts a smile on your face (somehow), this is your spot! I've been to tons of gyms over the years and I've never felt a sense of community and support like at the SHAC. It all starts at the top with Coach Karen who is one of the most supportive and encouraging coaches, and that trickles down to all the members who will also support and encourage you. 

There are absolutely all levels of athletes at the SHAC. Everyone is encouraged to do their best and the only competition is your own self. They modify every single workout depending on your ability and limitations and when we are done we celebrate a successful workout, regardless of who lifted how much or did it in what time. 

I've never heard a negative review from someone who stopped in and worked out with us. Give it a shot!

My first time visiting The Blind Onion at the Galleria. I came with 4 other adults. Upon entering we saw the sign that said seat yourselves! So we found a nice table. We found ourselves sitting at the table for a while, yep, still sitting here, without being greeted or taken care of, so we started wandering up to the bar and ordered our drinks up there. Finally got that chick to be our waitress. She tried, at least. She forgot to bring my brother his meal, but at least she entered it into the system and his food was indeed made for him. 

None of the employees seemed to want to do their job but also simultaneously seemed "busy." We basically did half our waitress's job. She brought the food (some of it) and we gathered the drinks, pizza stand, and honey. For some reason, she didn't bring it to us, even though we had heard this was a common thing they did at this restaurant. She didn't offer us water or napkins either. 

Only about half the tables were clean. Less than half the employees cared if we were there or not. Over half of our group was disappointed in the experience. But, the whole pizza sure did taste pretty damn good. That must be the only reason they're still around. Only one type of crust on the menu seemed strange to me, but it was a good crust. 

More than likely will not return. Thanks!

I've been to this particular location a few times and although I cant say the pizza is the best but it's also not the worst. The waiting staff are pleasant and seem to be friendly.  The order took a bit considering we only ordered 1 med pizza. It wasnt terribly busy at this time of day.  The pizza itself was semi hot on arrival and the order was correct. The taste of the pizza of a whole was just mediocre. There wasnt a huge amount of wow or appeal to it. The crust was alitle overdone.  Tables are a bit sticky due to the honey all other the place so we had our waiter clean it. In all, not a bad place for a quick pizza but there are better in Reno.

Wow I really wanted to love this place but I can't begin to tell you how disappointing this pizza it was artificial the cheese was definitely  not real mozzarella and it was very reminiscent of Manny's pizza downtown which is not high class but is average at best! this place is definitely nowhere near a true New York pizza experience I hate to say it but as a lifelong New Yorker  this place really let me down I was really hopeful that it had a true New York type of pizza and it was far from that!! MAYBE IF THEY USED 100% REAL MOZZARELLA IT WOULD BE A GOOD PIZZA
Their pizzas are freaking huge! Took me like three days to eat one. Can easily feed 4. Fyi: very thin crust. Was not a fan of their meatballs. But definitely the best pizza I've had here so far.

I hate leaving negative reviews but I have mixed feelings about this restaurant - the Pizza is great and they have a nice selection of craft beers. Lunchtimes are not busy and as a result the service is poor. They have one person - friendly enough but doing everything from being the bartender to serving the Pizza. As a result I had to wait 15 minutes before I got any attention. If you get one hour off for lunch this is not the place to go because you will not make it - I know they are trying to save money but at the very least they should have one person behind the bar and one waiting tables. It would cost more but I think it would pay for itself because they would get more business from people wanting to grab a quick lunch - just a thought.

Yummmmm. 

You can get table service on the left of the building, or grab a quick bite on the right. There are single slices available in pepperoni, cheese, and a select few slice(s) of the day. Otherwise, you're going to have to order a whole pie. You can't go wrong either way. Their New York style dough has the perfect amount of crunch and chew. I don't care much for overly sauced pizza, but their's is a perfect balance. I'm already thinking about the next time I can have another slice. 110% of the time,I would say it's worth the carbs.

Ordered ahead for large pepperoni, when we arrived she said she hadnt got the order(same girl i talked to on the phone).  After i got my pizza asked for extra ranch, she tells me they are out of ranch and honey!  How can you be out of ranch and honey?  You have one signature product and you didnt order enough ranch and honey?  I love this pizza but needless to say am very disappointed in the service in this instance.  Not to mention i was there the day before and got ranch and honey.  Wont be recommending this location.

Went to this pizza place with high expectations...left with my hands and face covered in grease. It was literally the greasiest pizza I have ever eaten and I like greasy pizza. It was so bad that my friend and I who are pizza fanatics and have never left a slice uneaten were both done after eating 2 slices of an 18"

We both felt like shit after because of literally eating dripping wet pizza

All of the waiters wear skinny jeans and think they are cool because they call the customers "dude"

Make sure to wear a sweatshirt because they blast the AC even if it's pouring rain outside

Also a fly was bothering us the whole time

Was considering a move to the music city prior to eating here, but if this pizza is the best Nashville has to offer, I'm straight.

Amazing store! The employees are even better. They make sure you're happy before your purchase and they talk to you like a person and not just a sale. Honestly, I'd say it's thee shop to go to in all of south jersey. Seriously, if you're thinking about getting a new heady check them out over all competition in glassboro. The guys working today; 12/07/20, were very helpful and honest. Just want you should want and expect to see at a professional establishment.

Really good pizza! It wasn't really hot when we got it but that was probably our fault since we were :10 late. ‍ 

I had the T-Rex, the meatballs were really good and the capicola added a nice spice but was a bit overpowering.

I wouldn't hesitate to go again if I was nearby, I'd probably not go out of my way though.

Probably my first and last review. It shouldn't take 30 minutes to get inside the damn building if no one is in there. The staff gotta be smoking some of this shit with how slow they move. Ffs it's fucking terrible.

Since March and the beginning of the pandemic, I have stayed at home and made every meal that I have eaten, with three exceptions. Tonight we decided to get delivery from five points. We did it to NOT have to make dinner and clean up. Our salad came without dressing and basically without toppings, so I had to make one myself. Everything was (stone) cold so I had to turn the oven on and use dishes to heat it up.

The pizza was just okay, but I have a high bar. That's on me. But, my order was incomplete. 95% of the reason we ordered was so we didn't have to cook and didn't have to clean. I'm down $80 and still had to cook and still had to clean.

Lesson learned: when you don't want to have to cook your own food, just make a bowl of cereal and save yourself the hassle.

First and foremost I'm from NYC. That being said, along with all the other A**holes that have moved here, we think we know pizza, and we kinda do.

Five points hits the spot. Their pepperoni slice is greasy in all the right ways. You're not eating real pizza if when you fold it, grease doesn't drip down your arm. Special slices are always great, and the service can't get any better.

Five points Pizza is the real deal, i'd pay $100 for the right pizza, so the price doesn't bother me.

If you dropped this place in the middle of NYC it would still be good pizza.

There's a few spots in Nashville but my go to is five points.

I regularly would order a large pizza for pickup as their special was always a good deal at $15. It seems to be that 60% of the time the crust comes out burnt even when I specifically asked for a light bake on the crust to ensure that it's not burnt. It also seems as though their employees are regularly changing as one week I will be able to order my pizza to my liking and the next they do not do that anymore. For example today I called to order a pizza and for the past year I've been able to do half pepperoni and half pineapple and a girl on the phone said that they never do that and that's how it's always been. Which makes no sense because I've been ordering it this way for a year. It's very inconsistent service and food and I will not be coming back here. I tell everyone I know good luck it's a 50-50 chance if it'll turn out good. This is at the Los Altos location.
I have been several times!! Always a hit! I love the Bianca pie and end the meal with a cannoli!!!

After having 3 paint companies come out and give me quotes and then never getting back to me I happen to run into Doug one day. I have known him for years and asked him if he could paint my house. Over the next few days he came out, gave me a detailed incredibly thorough quote and scheduled me just a few weeks out.  The painters finished yesterday and they were Amazing! Always on time, friendly and incredibly neat!
I will recommend Cherryhill painting to everyone I know.

Greatly enjoyed the trendy atmosphere, being an east Nashville native. This area has changed soooo much and I think for the better. This pizza place is absolutely right where it needs to be. Staff were friendly and inviting. Was quickly attended to and the server knew a lot about the beer options and was able to help this not so beer savvy taster. When trying new beer I highly recommend their affordable beer flight. I love the veggie slice of the day! Garlic Knots certainly compliment the pizza well. Pizza was very tasty!!! Only downside is having to pay to park..

Great late night pizza joint! The full service dining room was full so we decided to do take out next door. Service was extremely quick (3 minutes for 5 slices) but available slices were limited.  I'm sure you could order off the menu though because I did take note of their availability.  There were a few stools if you wanted to eat in. We got both the meat and veggie specials and both were unbelievably delicious!  The crust was great and it was thin New York style.  Highly recommended!  Prices were right on point too, less than $25 for 5 large slices.... I'll be back!

Legit pie, yes, pie, as us Jersey folks call it.  My only complaint and it's not a big one, is they put grated parmesan on the pizza...don't like that so we ask for none.  The toppings are very fresh and the pizza is made to order unless you're getting their slice of the day.  Slice of the day flavors are typically something really different, so gives us a chance to try new things without ordering an entire pizza.  Thin crust, great sauce, freshly grated mozzarella, and tons of toppings to choose from.  Just what you'd expect from a great pizza spot.  I sure wished we lived closer as I'd be there multiple times per week.  They have beer and wine as well as mimosas and bloody marys on the weekend. We typically sit at the small bar in the dining room for quicker service.  Booths galore, but you'll have to wait for one.  They have a dine-in area as well as a takeout window and dining room for takeout or to grab a quick stool for a slice.  It's a small place but worth the wait...

I've been waiting to try this place for a while since it took a long time for them to be able to open. I got the egg white signature sandwich on a plain toasted bagel (would have preferred more bagel options). Overall it was just okay, and a little messy. But the service was very good and I would probably go back to try a different sandwich.

Had the Supreme tonight as it was our last night in Nashville and we were wanting to watch the football game and were exhausted from a long day so we got our pizza to go. The toppings were very fresh and it had a soft thin crust which is what we tend to like. Overall the pizza was really good, but I can't say it is the best I have ever had. Definitely worth getting and giving a try.

Stopped in for breakfast.  Curious what a Montreal wood oven baked bagel is like.  Well it's like a roll.  Too soft, zero crunch.  Also the bagels themselves are $2 each.  It's just not my jam, but overall the bagel sandwich wasn't terrible.

I got a Standard which is a bagel with, egg, cheese and choice of meat.  I got turkey bacon.  The sandwich was filling, and everything except the bagel was delicious.

The coffee drink was really good too.  I got an iced mocha.  That was as perfect as can be.

The bagels just weren't my thing.  I know some people like soft bagels, but I need some NY crunch.

Was very disappointed in the Blind Onion this time! Had to order up at the counter and the credit card reader asked for the tip amount before we had even been served.  One person's salad came and he had eaten it before the second person's pizza arrived.  My pizza came next while the second person had eaten all of hers that she wanted.  Bad service?  Maybe they were short handed!  Food was very good as usual but wish the service would improve.  Won't be back for a while!

I ordered from here last night because I one didn't feel like cooking on a Saturday night, but I also wanted to show support for a local business during this difficult time. It was awesome! We got the crab balls, wings, buffalo shrimp and the rooster combo. The delivery was quick, the driver was extremely friendly, and the food was hot and delicious! I also really appreciated how they made sure there were sauces/dips for everything in our order. I would definitely order from here again, but hopefully once this is all over we can actually come in to enjoy the delicious food!

If I could leave a zero star review, I would. This location has been a local favorite for many years. I understand that working in a pandemic is very new for a lot of people. My husband went to grab an early lunch before our trip on Friday evening. He told me when he walked into the establishment, a short pregnant woman greeted him with "what do you want?". She had her mask down underneath her chin. Proceeded to take my husbands order without a mask over her mouth and nose. The two women (one pregnant and one with short black hair) told my husband to wait 20-30 minutes. He came back into the store roughly 25 minutes and as he walked in the woman with short black hair said that there was no order under his name. After arguing with her coworker in the back, there was magically an order with his name. 10 minutes later our order was ready.
Unfortunately that's not the end of our terrible experience. As I'm eating my cinnamon twists I pull a black hair out of my food. Neither my husband or I have black hair. I am sad to say we won't be returning to this business, we wasted $50 on terrible service and average quality food.

***Five Points is a good New York style pizza spot; it is located in a very hipster part of Nashville***

Nashville has many neighborhoods and a lot of them have their own feel.  East Nashville is a very hipster, Portland-esque part of Nashville.  There is a fun little collection of small and unique shops housed in little bungalow-esque buildings.  There are also quite a few casual eateries in this area focusing on housemade food at reasonable prices.  Five Points is one of these eateries.

Five Points does not have the farm to table approach of many Portland restaurants (or maybe it just does not advertise that approach on its menu), but this pizza spot does showcase pizzas with housemade toppings as well as lots of beers in a rustic and casual atmosphere that has kept a lot of the previous building's brick and pipes exposed.

Pizza can be made to order as big pies or you can order by the slice.  They have a few always on the menu slices like cheese and pepperoni as well as some daily specials written on the chalkboard that feature interesting ingredients like habanero cream sauce.

Their pizza by the slice is good.  Their pizzas are big New York style thin crust pizzas that have a little bit of crispiness but also a good fold--great cheese and tomato sauce too.  If Five Points was in Los Angeles, it would be one of the best spots for New York style pizza.  It is less greasy than Mulberry and the crust is not too crispy like the crust at Joe's.  It is similar to Vito's on La Cienega; it might even be better than Vito's.

I also tried their stromboli.  This is baked to order and calzone-esque (they have a few choices and they are inspired by some of their pizzas).  I went with their sliced meatball, which also came with red onion, melted mozzarella and marinara sauce on the side.  The bread was great; its was similar to a garlic knot. The bread had a great crispy crust that was also buttery while the center of the stromboli was soft.

There was a lot of mozzarella too as well as a generous portion of sliced meatballs.  I wish the sliced meatballs were full meatballs so I could have had a more true meatball experience, but the meatballs were still moist and had a good flavor.  The well-seasoned, nicely chunky and not-too-sweet marinara sauce was necessary to balance out the overwhelming amount of melted mozzarella. 

Service was good--friendly, attentive and quick.

Prices were reasonable.  The stromboli was $8 and it was more than enough for two people (as long as you also order a salad to split).  Their pizza by the slice prices were just okay, but the slices were also very generous portions.

Five Points is a good pizza spot and it is one of the easiest places to get into on a Sunday afternoon in this area (Marche Artisan Foods was incredibly busy).  I am not sure how Five Points rates against other Nashville pizza spots, but it would definitely be popular in Los Angeles.  If you are looking to find the best pizza in Nashville, Five Points has to be one of the places you try.

Free street parking is available in the nearby residential area.

Cherry Hill Painting has done several jobs for us, including rooms/walls and kitchen cabinetry. Our extended family has used them for many projects in homes and businesses over the years. They have always done a wonderful job for us. We have been extremely pleased with the workmanship and attention to detail. The owners are efficient, honest, professional and easy to work with. The painters are skilled and knowledgeable, as well as friendly and courteous. They are very thorough from start to finish, and clean up when the job is done. I highly recommend them and will continue to use their services myself.

I thought this place was so-so. I can appreciate that they are trying to mimic a NY style pizza joint but they lacked in overall quality in my opinion. I actually really did like the crust. I thought it was a good combo of crispiness on the bottom yet chewy on the crust. However, the toppings are where it went downhill for me. It tasted like they used a poor quality cheese, definitely not fresh mozzarella. The red sauce was also not a typical tomato sauce that you would find on a NY slice. They over complicated it and the flavors just didn't deliver. Not terrible, but definitely wouldn't be rushing to come back.
Tasty pie and fast. Pep, mushroom was fantastic and staff was friendly. Will be back.

I really, really wanted to like Five Points, especially since everyone I knew raved about it! Being the Yelper I am, naturally I had to scroll through reviews before dragging my boyfriend and friends here on a Saturday night. There was an hour wait... so if you come on the weekends, be sure to come at an odd time (i.e. not a typical meal time) otherwise you'll be waiting for a WHILE. The host took our name and a phone number, so we actually went to wait and have dessert before dinner at Soda Parlor but after an hour, we were confused as to why our table wasn't ready yet (mostly because they told us it'd be a 45 minute wait) so it was only when we actually got back and asked that they told us they were cleaning off a table for us. So be wary when waiting, and be sure to ask if it's been a while. 

We ended up ordering a 14" pizza (half T-Rex and half 
Hawaiian) and a half order of garlic knots. The garlic knots were good! The ingredients were fresh and there was plenty of garlic for my boyfriend to not want to come near me afterwards. The pizza was subpar. It really isn't as good as everyone keeps saying it is. It was way over cooked, even burnt, and honestly, I've had better pizza at Pizza Hut. It kept falling apart and there was zero cheese pull. What kinda pizza doesn't have cheese pull!? It was disappointing and I was just sad because I love NY style pizza and this just wasn't it.
INCREDIBLE! Such a neat spot nestled into the 5 points area. Our server Spencer was so nice and helped us make a date night a great night. If you like garlic, try their garlic knots as an appetizer!!

Food: 3.0/5.0
Service: 2.5/5.0
Value: 2.5/5.0
Decor: 2.5/5.0
Overall: 3.0/5.0 

As expected, I thought this place isn't worth the 4.5* rating it has as of March 2017.  Too much salt, and the rating may be inflated by the 12-3am customers too inebriated (or unaware) to tack on a lower figure.  However, it still met or beat my expectations for pizza in Nashville.  I'll admit it may be more like 3.2/5.0 for food.

My fiancee and I probably come here once a week for the pint and slice happy hour and we love it! I honestly think it's the best pizza I've ever had! The slices are huge and absolutely delicious, the price and variety (with the daily changes in meat and veggie slices) is great, and the staff does a good job of handling the crowd, of which Five Points has no shortage. Definitely worth the visit, and if there's a long wait to sit down, you can always try the counter line next door for much faster access to your food/drink.

so yummy! I love lots of pizza places in nashville, but this one is one my favorites. the prices are reasonable, and they have an option to just walk-in and grab a slice! which I think is adorable and also convenient :) gotta try!
Well crafted pizza, with an attention to detail on the ingredients they use... Excellent !

What a joke this sad excuse for a dealership is.  How VW lets this place sell their vehicles is beyond me.  

Pathetic salesman who smelled like cigarettes and beer lied from the start.  The sales manager, if thats what he was tried to block the door so I couldnt leave.  

The  selection is 10 cars and the price mark up was absurd.  Since this is the only VW dealership in town there will be no more VW's for me.

The service department does not even have a waiting room.

Better deal at Reno Toyota and a better car.
Pizza was great and the service was awesome.  Kerry was very hospitable and fun. We will definitely be coming back.
Coming from NYC: I've never had better garlic knots EVER! The staff is friendly and i like the beer selection. The pizza is great. This is my nashville go-to for pizza for sure.

I think this place has some of the best bread of anywhere I have been. The garlic knots, the Stromboli and the pizza were fantastic!!!! Great food. Their seating staff was horrible. We had 5 people. There was a guest before us that had 2. We wanted to inquire of the 2 would be willing to move  and the staff said they could not do that because the servers would be confused. Further while we were there, a 5 person group had "called" ahead and we were unable to sit at another table because it was reserved !? What? We are 5 and we are here spending money. While we are the other group never showed up!!!

Blind Onion is my family's favorite pizza so we frequently eat at this location. My Sister In-Law reserved a table for our party of nine Adults and four children days before our visit tonight. We were there celebrating my Brother In-Law's Birthday. They sat us in the back room which was great. We sat down at 4:50PM and placed our order by 5:05PM since we have little kids that were hungry. Anyone with kids knows that timing is essential for ordering when you are out to eat so you can feed them so they will behave. Our group ordered three large pizzas(one Cheese, one half cheese and Hawaiian, one half Hawaiian and Meat Lover), one Small pizza (pepperoni), two salads and one order of wings. The wings and salads came at 5:45pm. At 5:55PM I got up and went to the front and asked if our plain cheese was almost done because my three year old son was crying because he was hungry. When I was up front our waitress was just standing in the back leaning up against the wall. I also looked around the restaurant and there were many open tables. We finally got our pizzas at 6:05PM. Our waitress brought out our two large and one small pizzas. My Brother In-Law asked our server where the third pizza was. The server looked confused and left and then came back and said that the kitchen had dropped the pizza and they were putting another one in the oven. Twenty minutes later the third pizza came out and they started to eat. My Sister In-Law asked for a knife so we could cut the cake. Five minutes went by and our server came back. She told us that she would need us to leave because the 7:00PM reservation was there and needed the table. We nicely told her that we had just received the third large pizza and we were finishing eating it. She rudely commented back that it was not her fault that she did not make the reservation for the next party of people so we would need to go. We told her that is was not our fault that we had been there for an hour and a half and had just received our final pizza and once we finished it then we would leave. Even though we were in the back room there were three open long tables.
