Due to our circumstances of just receiving our pizza we would have thought that we would have been treated differently because it was the kitchens fault for dropping the pizza. Not to mention that there were many open tables in the restaurant and the next reservation arrived thirty minutes early. The manager came over a few minutes later and rudely told us that she needed us to leave because the next reservation was there and could she take any of our finished plates. We told her that we were finishing our pizza and we would leave once we were done so we didn't need any plates taken. The manager rudely argued with our entire party and made it sound that it was our fault that we were there still finishing our third large pizza. I have never heard a manager talk so disrespectfully to the customer. She never took any fault for her kitchen messing up and dropping our pizza and then having to remake it. If she had proper training on talking respectfully and treating her customers like they are appreciated when they were treated badly for waiting I would be writing a nice review. Instead I am only giving Blind Onion Los Altos a one star for the worst service I have ever had in my life. As a paying customer we should have been spoken to differently. Shame on you manager for your poor communication skills and closed minded thinking. You need to learn that kindness and taking fault goes a long way. Not to mention that you screwed up our bill by charging us the wrong amount for a pizza and again acting like it was our fault. I refuse to ever give you any business again!!!

Kerry was super awesome to our party! Very accommodating, met our requests ASAP, made us feel super special! Pizza was fresh and delicious, I loved the honey on the combo pizza. Restaurant was also spaced out and masks were required while ordering. Thank you so much!

The service is always awesome. I have never been when I didn't have to wait for a table though. It's because it's that good! The garlic knots are delicious, fresh and a great deal! The pizza slices are huge and delicious. Everything is fresh and the flavors are awesome. The salads are huge - also fresh and delicious.

Went to Blind Onion for lunch today and loved it. Great food. Awesome atmosphere. Good selection of beers. 
Super nice and welcoming staff.
Very efficient and organized. I liked my shape, colors and designs. I came with a color scheme in mind and the artist was very creative with the vision.

From our first contact with Max to the finished job, Acoma Roofing was professional, efficient and reliable.  They identified, fixed the roof leaks on our tile roof which was installed just 5 years ago by a competitor and also replaced the rotted wood framed chimney with Hardie Fiber Cement Board.  Thank you Acoma!!!!!
Amazing pizza. Somewhat New York Style as it's thin and big slices. They have high end toppings like prosciutto and artichoke hearts. It's expensive for pizza but the quality is there.

I have 't even tried the food yet. However, my experience or lack thereof, to this point, earns this place a one star. Called at 1120am to order lunch for a group of healthcare workers caring for patients that normally do not have access to health care. The website said the location opened at 11am, but the phones stated they were closed. Called for 10 mins, still closed according to the voicemail. Decided to walk in. Upon arrival the girl working at the front counter didnt acknowledge us. She continued filling plastic cups with dressing for at least 2 minutes, until my colleague said "excuse me, we would like to order." I informed her that the phones stated they were closed. She said "oh" and shrugged her shoulders. We proceded to order. We were then informed that they no longer have the paninis that are advertised on the website. Great! We stepped away from the counter and called 12 people to get new orders from the limited menu. Overall, a very off putting experience that even the worlds greatest pizza couldnt make up for. 

For the person or people who have invested hard earned money into this business, it's time to change the approach. The concept is great but the experience is lacking. We will never order here again.

Okay last week, on Sunday 12-7, Tony and I went again..I love the pizza here and then Noel and I was out today, and YES I had to go again!!! I always enjoy getting whatever pizza they have on special by the slice..I like trying new ones...Last Sunday it was a marinara sauce with feta cheese, green peppers  and black olives ...not bad..but today it was a white pizza with Vodka sauce, green peppers, black olives, spinach and mozzarella cheese. I love the Abeta Root Beer made in Louisiana...

If you can only eat pizza in one place in Nashville, this place is a must!! I love it here!!!
I love the food, I love the location, and I love the servers...I love parking a few blocks away and strolling to the location..I love it!!!!

The garlic knots are a favorite too!!
Can't wait for my next visit...
Wow. What a gem. We found this place on a whim. Pizza and Stromboli was awesome. Sorry we didn't take photos before taring in.

The pizza was good, but it wasn't great. The service was, essentially, nonexistent. See, there's a sign at the front counter that tells you in-house business will be handled by the wait staff, but the wait staff wants nothing to do with their job, apparently. Took forever for the dude to get our drink order, even though all we needed was cups because everything is self-serve. Once we had our food the dude *disappeared*; I waited close to 30 minutes for my check before I just went up to the counter and demanded to pay. Don't waste your time.

Possibly the best pizza I've ever had.

Ordered the garlic knots + a single slice of cheese pizza.  Both were to die for!  I managed to eat the whole slice of pizza, but be warned - they are huge slices. I didn't even make a dent in the garlic knots so I took them to go.  Only got water to drink so can't really comment on drinks, but the beer selection looked decent.

The bartender was attentive and sweet, best service I've gotten so far in Nashville!

My only negatives are the hours - they're open till midnight on the weekends, but that's it.  I feel like they're missing a lot of late night business, myself included!  Also, the parking situation confused me, but I'm not from here so maybe that's why... found a spot on the street pretty easily though.

This is our absolute go to place for GREAT Pizza in Nashville, TN. I wish it was just a little cheaper so I could afford to eat here once a week, but it is worth every dime. I also wish they would do a GROUPON..I would definitely buy a Groupon for this pizza joint...please if you are in the Nashville AREA..go here and eat some delicious pizza..Any pizza here is great pizza.....open late!!! Small location so come early, be prepared to wait for a seat but you will not regret one minute of it...

Do not book for events.

I stayed here 7/23/21 for my cousin's wedding at Valleybrook Country Club. We booked a block of rooms for our family. Almost every room had an issue, despite our family planning in advance for our event. 

We were given a contract stating guests could check in at 3:00pm. Many rooms weren't ready at 3:00pm. The afternoon desk clerk said she was given an old contract and check in was actually at 4:00pm. By 4:00pm some people did not have rooms and we had a bus leaving for the event at 4:30pm. The delay caused a huge amount of stress as we rushed to the ceremony. Our rooms were also not in the same block/area of the hotel as promised. None of us were close to one another. 

2 rooms were booked with a queen bed and a pull out couch to accommodate 4 guests. Upon check in, those rooms had 1 bed and no pull out couch. The hotel tried to make it right by giving 2 free rooms to fit additional guests. 

1 of the comped rooms smelled like mildew/feet, had water damage on the ceiling, and old popcorn under the couch cushions. I also found dirt spots in the sheets.  The 2nd comped room didn't have working central air, a few outlets that did not work, and a broken TV. 

My cousin's bridal suite was different from the original room she was shown. The new room she was given had water damage on the ceiling. This appeared up in her professional pictures while the bridal party was getting ready. One comped room had the same water stain and we were told it wasn't normally booked due to the damage. I don't understand why she paid full price for the same issue in her room. 

There were other guests staying here for a different wedding. My theory is that the original rooms were given away and we got what was left, although the rooms we booked didn't accommodate our number of guests.

I had high hopes for this place. I am in town on a family trip and thought I would give a local chain a try. I got a chocolate milkshake with the french dip. This is one of my favorite sandwiches. There was nothing special about theirs! It was just bread and some meat. There was no onions or any offer of toppings. It did come with a small cup of the au jus. Unfortunately most of it spilled in the bag. There was nothing special about the flavor of it or the sandwich. It didnt have much seasoning at all. It wasnt a bad sandwich. It was just very plain. 

The meal couldnt even be saved by a milkshake. It was not mixed properly (See Photo's) The first drink was pure chocolate syrup. I love chocolate but not all in the first sip....lol.... It looks like a swirl of chocolate and vanilla. The place itself was fairly clean and the employees were polite. There is no drive through. My experience Unfortunately was just underwhelming to say the least. Its too bad because who doesn't love a beef sandwich! The few review photos by customers are buried under around 30 stock photos from their advertisements. That should have been my first clue.

Horrible service. While ordering the person taking our order was more concerned about texting on her phone than taking orders. Of course this led to my husband getting the wrong food. He ordered the Carnegie breakfast sandwich on a plain bagel. He basically got a pile of pastrami on an everything bagel. We had taken our order to go so not way too know until we sat down to eat. No way to eat there as very loud music is blaring and the tables probably hasn't been cleaned since yesterday. Had to ask for my coffee twice as again, the person working the counter was more involved with her cell phone than paying customers. For $30+ on two bagel sandwiches, a coffee and juice, it was quite a disappointing experience. Would not return.

This place is an all around no for me. My favorite high-end pizza chain is mellow mushroom and my favorite low end pizza chain is Pizza Hut followed by Papa John's.  I don't consider myself a picky eater, but as I'm consuming the 1 and only piece of pizza I had, I struggled to find anything positive about it. Not the crust, not the ingredients. And just mediocre pizza isn't enough to warrant 1 star but we got the rudest waitress. She looked like an idiot with a thick wool beanie and belly shirt on on an 80+ degree day but her personality sucked and she made no effort to be pleasant. She needs a new career. Oh and avoid the pizza wine at all costs.

I was extremely surprised by the service and food! It's been a while since we have found a good pizza place! This was our first dine in experience and I wish I would have got the name of the lady helping us. She always made sure to check in with us and the other tables around us as well. She brought my kids a nice snack to eat (veggies and fruit). I felt spoiled by her kindness! It's hard coming across good customer service. Honestly, the environment was nice and family oriented, which I like. The pizza was delicious! Loved that she brought us honey to dip our crust in! The best! We will be back for sure! We drive all the way from Susanville Ca to shop for food, now we have a yummy pizza place to come to.

We recently had Cherry Hill Painting paint the interior of our home in preparation for putting it on the market.  The painters did an excellent job, putting everything back as it should have been so all was ready for selling the home.  We gave the painters access using the realtor's lock box.  Doug Andersen, the owner, checked on the finished work and made sure all was up to HIS expectations - which I think are even higher than mine!  We were very pleased all the way around and recommend them.

This and their other location in Sylvan Park make the best pizza and garlic knots. This is as good as the NY pizza joints I grew up with and the staff are very friendly. I grew up in Queens NY and they're from the Five Points area of NY, and am happy they've settled here in the Nashville area.
i kissed ray romano on the lips here the cops are still looking for me

I've been coming here for years for the standard trim-off-the-shaggy-bits job on my shoulder-length hair. But in January, I decided to go short and add bangs for the first time since second grade. One month later, the bangs are so long that they keep catching in the hinge of my glasses (ow!) and it's time to do something so I don't look like Justin Bieber.
I grabbed a pair of scissors and a comb, plunked myself down in front of the bathroom mirror, and got to work. BAD MOVE! Too short and terribly uneven, I look like a toddler who as left alone with a pair of craft scissors. Even worse, I have a job interview tomorrow and don't want to look like a dork!
Cue a quick run to Great Clips. Nobody laughed at my foolishness, the stylist simply whisked me over to a chair, evened things out, shortened everything else a little bit for an "intentionally short all over" look, and had me looking lovely in a matter of minutes.
Memo to self: just come straight here next time instead of going DIY.
Best pizza ever! Love the atmosphere of this little pizza spot, and the food is great! Definitely recommend.

Best pizza in nashville! 
The pepperoni is impeccable.
Very good service as well! 
Had a friend come into town and we went here and it was the best pizza they have ever had. 
Myself included.

I do low carb, but I have had the pizza at a different location. However, this night I went with my boyfriend and his daughter, they got pizza, I got a salad. I like this location because its bigger and more open and has more seating than the one on Victorian Ave location. However. The table we sat at, which at first looked clean, was covered in honey and stickiness. It's obvious the towel used was used to wipe other honey covered tables and not rinsed. We asked the server to wipe the table again, which he did, but it was equally as sticky. We gave up on it. The problem lies with the gigantic bottles of honey on the table. Their spouts to do not allow for a clean break. You pour, and they leak all the way down the bottle onto the table. Even we left a mess after we left, and even though I had a salad, my arms were covered in sticky honey from the table. Boyfriend and daughter were covered too and the table was an even bigger sticky mess when we left, and we tried to be as clean as possible.  They need to keep small bottles with appropriate lids like a honey bear bottle. This huge jugs are just a mess. 

On a side note, the pizza was fine, the salad was ok. The chicken is not fresh grilled, so it's very salty, which is fine on pizza, but on salad was overwhelming. The pizza took quite a while, and it wasn't busy and we only ordered a medium. It wasn't super hot on arrival which means it sat for a bit before it was delivered to our table. Our server was friendly enough

This place has delicious pizza. We waited around 20 minutes to get a table on a Saturday night around 5 o'clock. We got a full order of the garlic knots and wow were they delicious. Then we got a white pizza with prosciutto and wow was it good! If craving pizza next time in Nashville I would go back!
The newer man with the glasses and the blonde at the front desk were extremely helpful and polite.This place is a lifesaver!
Worst place ever they gave me burnt wings... They have no standards and ill never eat here again..

We received excellent service. Our pizza was amazing.  Perfectly made. Julia went above and beyond to make sure our experience was perfect.  We have a specialty pizza that they offered one time as a special and we remembered the ingredients and Julia made sure that it was made perfectly. Thank you for the delicious pizza with a fun atmosphere.
Came back again and had their pepperoni pizza and a Greek salad. Much better then the first time I was here. Service sucked this time though. Pepperoni may be one of the best I've had though!

The pizza is always great! 

KARA is our favorite server. Whenever I get off work on Thursday's, no matter how good or bad my day was, KARA is always there to make my family feel special. 

Unfortunately today, we walked through the doors and found out that management shortened her hours. It's a HUGE loss for their business, unless KARA gets back to work. We will no longer give those LOSERS our business (3 personal pizzas, a medium pizza, and a handful of alcoholic beverages). Luckily there is a Round Table Pizza around the corner and I will be destroying an XL Triple Play Pepperoni. 

Thanks for reading. 

KARA gets 5 stars
Blind Onion gets 1 star (they are truly "Blind")

I'll start off by saying that I am the great great granddaughter of a wonderful pizza parlor owner in Aptos California. So I've had a crap load of pizza and I try it nearly everywhere I go.
Recently relocated to Nashville and I asked around to see where the best pizza near downtown would be and I was told three different locations with this being one of them.
I loved the exterior and the initial entrance. Myself and a coworker sat at the bar and we each had the slice and salad. For starters the salads here are awesome! His Greek salad looked great and I had the spinach, cranberry and Gorgonzola salad. It was very fresh and tasted great!
The slice we both had was the meat of the day pie and it happened to be meatball with red onions. It was good. Very fresh. I am big on the dough though and the flavor as well as the sauce. So, here we go- 
They do not put sauce on their pizza it's like plopped on in spots. If you're a sauce person like myself you will want to order a side of sauce which does cost extra. They're sauce is very full of garlic which I love! Now their crust does leave something to be desired. It was flavorless and really really hard on the edge. I didn't even eat it and I'm a bread freak. 
Service was good and the place was packed when we left. 
Sadly, it did not rank in my top 5 or even 10 pizza parlors.

I moved to East Nashville 2 years ago on Mother's Day and the only consistent thing in my life since then, is their Friday night veggie slice. I can't name a week in Nashville that I haven't been here. All of the staff is incredible and they are well connected enough to know where the local talent is playing in town. If I was a tourist, I would come here for the food and ask my server where to go. Avoid Broadway at all costs, and respect the space you're in when visiting a local business. Bring your friends, tip well, and always be kind.

Probably one of the best pizzas I've had! I'm from NY and I love NY style pizza & Five Points definitely comes close. 

They have a restaurant and next door is a carry out area. I've never eaten at the restaurant only have gotten carry out or from the window late night. There's a ledge and some bar stools on that side if you do want to stay and eat a slice.

The have the traditional cheese and pepperoni and also have the prosciutto and basil most of the time on their menu. They also have a veggie and meat special daily. All of those can be ordered by the slice if you don't want a whole pie. You can also order their other specialty pizzas but it would be the whole pie. I have had tried all the toppings they have for by the slice and you can't go wrong. The last time we went we ordered a pie (spinach, mushroom, and Gorgonzola) we added Italian sausage and it was delicious!! The crust is thin, the tomato sauce is tangy, and all the ingredients are fresh.

My absolute favorite and a must stop whenever I'm in Nashville.

Pretty solid pizza place with above and beyond service. My friend thought their pizza was amazing but it tasted a little undersalted to me. Other than that really good. We also got garlic knots, Greek salad, and veggie stromboli. We shared but still had way more than enough leftovers. Also they're open late which was helpful

We have been patrons of this restaurant for a while, and we are finding out this place is no different than any other restaurant when it comes to service.  We ordered our food around 6:20 pm, a little after 7:00 we got half our order, the rest came approximately 10 minutes later.  If you can't make and serve an entire meal TOGETHER, you should rethink how you do business.  I get Friday nights can get busy, but they come every week, without fail and, of all places, a pizza place should know what its like and provide its services accordingly.  The entire hour and a half we were there, tables remained dirty and staff were busy talking instead of working!  We watched food sit under warming lights, waiting to be served, but minor things became more important than actually serving food and cleaning up.  As patrons thinned out and things appeared to be slowing down, the service became more unacceptable.  With a minimum of seven people working in the back making food, and a full waiting staff, one would think they would be able to serve an entire meal, all at once, and in a reasonable amount of time.  Tonight they failed miserably in doing so!  Even when speaking with the manager about the service, she had no clue how to deal with it, other than covering her mouth and having no words to say but looked around for something to do other than having to take responsibility for the poor service.  One pizza, three sandwiches, four sodas, three drinks and a bill of $75.00 (tip included), isn't worth the time, taste and money.  While the food is good, it wasn't the best, the service was horrible and, in my opinion, giving two stars is over rating them.  They can do much better!  Saying "I'm sorry" is no longer acceptable with me, it becomes to easy to say but very difficult to actually mean!  In watching the unorganized and poor service we witnessed tonight, I will take my business elsewhere and will not be returning anytime soon!
Very good service, loud atmosphere, food is above average.  I'm a pizza snob from NJ so I lower my expectations when it comes to pizza in the west.  The pizza here is different and quite edible.
Staff is really friendly ordered garlic knots and a pizza pie the t-Rex. Both amazing definitely is strong like.

Awesome place. Chill vibe, quick friendly service. We tried 3 different slices. Veggie very good very cheesy, meat of the day (yum), and the Prosciutto. Crust is perfect not too much sauce. We checked this place out because barstool sports review the pizza. I think they gave them an 8. I can go with that.

After hunting them down and finding out they had a location closer to me than I thought, I was excited to place this order. Upon arriving to pick it up I was advised my order had to be refunded because it was ordered under. 69 Tuesday. Now, as a paying customer I advise that isn't my fault, I simply found the amount of wings I needed and ordered them. The little girl at the counter got mad that I voiced my opinion and took on a smart alecky attitude talking about its not their fault and that I needed to pay the higher charge for the wings. She was completely disrespectful and nasty,, so in an effort to bring her down a notch and get her to understand I was only giving a complaint,, as a customer, I explained to her I wasn't trying to be smart at all but that I should be able to voice a complaint when being asked to pay more than what I already paid. I asked for a manager at which time she said she is the manager. She definitely doesn't need to be managing anything. I asked for someone else I could talk to so she called her mother. After she went to the back I'm assuming to talk to her mother first she comes out and hands me the phone. Her mother was completely opposite her, and was very nice and understanding. She explained this isn't the first time this has happened  and they were considering closing the website because it keeps happening. She was extremely apologetic and completely understood where I was coming from. I paid the higher price for the wings,, although I strongly feel they should have honored the price I was originally charged. Unfortunately, they have lost what would have been a regular customer and I will not order from them again, nor suggest anyone else does simply based on the way I was treated by an employee that was supposed to be acting as a manager. Customer service is everything to me and this experience was completely horrible. This was the Ewing Lane Location

Service so slow. Took like 10-12 minutes for a bacon egg n cheese when i was the only person in there. They take forever to make a simple order. Need to prioritize in-person orders instead of online ticket

got set up with these guys for internet and satellite TV the sales team was very friendly and had great customer service. the technician was very knowledgeable about the service and also got me hooked up and installed in my RV. they did it all in the same day didn't have to wait two weeks for the 1800 number to come see me. glad we went with the local people will recommend

Terrific pizza
We saw customers buying takeout pizza as soon as the store opened at 11 am so we had an inkling that the pizza was good.  We went back at lunch time and ordered just a slice to try.  That one slice became three slices, arugula salad and garlic knots with hot marinara sauce.  It was just delicious - thin and crispy base with minimal toppings!

Walked into MAD because my local AirBnB host said they were fantastic. Yup! They're fantastic. The service is excellent, the decorations were very chic, and they did a great job with my overlay.


I'd highly recommend and I loved the atmosphere. I needed help picking colors and the girls got so excited to hello me. I would definitely come back.

#PATIENTSAGAINSTLIBERTY 
This is the worst dispensary in the state. I can say that because I have documented and recorded some of my dealings at 2 of 3 Krewstown and Bensalem, not the brightest people in MMJ  biz, but when it comes to ripping u off, or bullshittin you they are second to none. Report these crooks to the DOH like others are doing...oh YEAH if you're at Krewstown don't forget to say HIGH to the in house celebrity ELMER FUDD the security guard he's a real LOONY TOON !! !! !!

Not my favorite pizza,but it is good. I am not a big fan of thick crust, but this pizza other than the crust is good.
Many people dip the crust in honey, i am not a big fan of that. The crust itself if braided and looks awesome but for me it is just to chewy.
The lunch special is 7 dollars and includes one slice of pizza with one topping. The one slice is huge and they slice it into two slices.
The pizza is thin crust with a generous amount of sauce and cheese. 
The restaurant is very inviting with seating on both the inside and out. 

On this day i ordered a personal size pepperoni pizza. Perfect size, six small slices with gooey mozzarella and pepperoni.
This pizza is good, it is just my preference to have thin crust. Additional toppings are suggested and just add to the pizza flavor

Every time I have this spot, I fall in love! Their slices are huge and quick if you're dying for something fast. Or order a whole pizza, you can beat this. 

So far my favorite pizza spot in Nashville!

We went to this location for a birthday party. Food was fantastic! Chicken wings were nicely cooked and meaty, with just enough spice. The super slice open was perfect!! The vegetable platter was a hit with the kids. Only issue with the food was all the food came out except the chicken wings.... took over half hour to get them. 
Another issue is people smoking right by the front door.... nasty smelling walking in and walking out. Can you make a policy to have smoking at least 25 feet from the entrance?

Great quality pizza with fresh toppings and thin, but chewy crust. Picked up takeout a couple times and it has never disappointed.  Look forward to trying their other pizzas. 
 
Garlic knots: 4/5
Supreme: 5/5
Old South: 5/5

This was suggested to us by our bartender at a local brewery. It was delicious! Great crust, thin with crisp bottom but still thick enough for some chewiness. Generous toppings and lots of different combinations to choose from. Looked like a good beer selection, although we passed on drinking because we'd just finished up trying a few breweries out today. Really wished I'd tried the cannoli!

Oh my goodness this pizza is fantastic. When you're looking for real NY style pizza, this is THE place. We had the meat special pizza, which was sliced meatball, fresh garlic, red onion, mozzarella, and dollops of red sauce. It was outstanding. The crunch on the crust is PERFECT. We recently moved to Nashville from Florida, by way of NY. This is the best pizza I've had in years. My family and I are thrilled that there is pizza this good in Nashville. Can't wait to go back!

This place is amazing! Hands down the best nail salon in the city. They can do whatever design you want. They have cute shop in the CBD and play awesome music. My nails lasted a full three weeks but they have a 2 week guarantee which I've never heard of another salon doing.
Got a half vodka half pesto pie with garlic knots and couldn't have been more impressed with the place. Now I know why everyone recommends this place. Definitely give it s try!

Well if your from the northeast and you're craving an "authentic" NY slice, this is about as close as you will get. Greasy (in a good way), cheesy, thin crust and huge slices.

The restaurant was clean and had fun decor inside. Classic pizza joint that feels like it should be tucked away in some small NY neighborhood, not Tennessee!

The service was exceptional, we were seated right away and our server checked in on us multiple times throughout the meal to make sure everything was up to our expectations. Service was quick as well, in and out in probably 45 minutes total including beers, the garlic knots as an appetizer and a large pepperoni pie.

This will probably become my go-to spot for pizza when I'm missing home in the northeast!

This is one of the best pizza places in Nashville. Period. 

Why are you still reading this? Get in your car and go now! You'll thank me later. Even their salad is great. Their ranch dressing is made fresh in house!

I called in my order for pickup.I gave my credit card number four times and she still couldn't get it.So I said I would pay cash.
I called when I arrived but they couldn't bring to my car.I went in and paid for it with my credit card and asked for my order. They hadn't even made it and was told get in line.
They were totally unorganized and I waited until all the walk-in patrons were taken care of.
Not a happy camp

Love the Zeus pizza, arugula salad with candied orange...amazing...garlic knots obviously and the basil lemonade. Definitely a favorite among Nashville pizza places. 

Love the pickup window too so you don't have to go inside, etc.

I have vowed not to review fast food but Lion's Choice is a cut above the rest.  I have been going for over 20 years now and have seen this place through the ups and downs.  I have seen multiple locations in both Illinois and Florida shut their doors and have also seen many Missouri locations collapse into disrepair.  But through the bad years the company, though scattered and inconsistent, managed to hold on and weather the storm.  In the past few years new ownership has cleaned up the brand and replaced the inconsistencies of the past and finally I can see the results.  We are now living in the second golden age of the Lion's Choice brand and thank God because we were running out of time.  This location and a few others should be held up as examples of what Lion's Choice stands for and what it can be in the future... which is to be a clean, wholesome, and  inviting quick service restaurant that serves delicious, unique, and real roast beef with great service.

Forever and ever, Amen

I feel like this was the closest thing I've ever had to a real New York styled slice. So glad I live so close to this joint and I love how they do their flavor of the day for both vegetarians and meat lovers. Very clever and very good. Will definitely become a regular here!

Normally this would be a positive review for my favorite pizza spot but this is for a terrible employee that i encountered tonight. I come to this blind onion location very often, atleast 20 times. I dealt with the rudest employee named Becca today. My total for my order was $27.01 and i had $27.00 in my hand, i asked her if she could use the penny sitting on top of her register and she said no. Ok, i walked all the way back out to my car for one penny. Fine. The thing that was very rude was the fact that she over charged me for ranch, like i said i have been to this location at least 20 times and never once have been charged. I asked her why i was being charged $.50 per container when i have never once been charged and am always given atleast 7-8 ranch for free including honey, when i order a large pizza. Not only did she racially profile me but had the worst attitude. Horrible disrespectful employee. Smh.

This is the best pizza I have ever eaten. I never eat leftovers, but we got this huge pie on Sunday and I ate it until Wednesday. We had the Vodka pie and added pepperoni and it was outstanding. The place is divey, hip and trendy. The staff is great and the beer selection is great. Try Calfkiller beer here -- great small brewery out of Sparta, TN.

I loved my first experience at 20th street and expected the same at the new location on 16th.  I was wrong - horrible experience.  I wanted 14 bagels and the server obviously couldn't count / we went through my request at least a half dozen times  and I still checked my bag to make sure she got it right (she didn't). If that wasn't bad enough, about half the bagels were burnt and I didn't notice until I got home.  Won't go back.

Best Pizza in town. Too bad no one was wearing a mask when I went in to pick up an order Monday night. 
I'll go elsewhere.

FRAUD ALERT! they're criminals at Lithia. I'm from san Francisco. My audi a4 transmission went out while I was in Tahoe. I had it towed to the nearest authorized dealer. Lithia in Reno was it. 

Flew back to sf for 10 days while they replaced the clutch/ trans.  Picked up the car and was on 80 30 minutes outside of Reno when my exhaust system fell out and was dragging on the ground. Just like the fricken movies.

I made it back to lithia dragging and scrapping the exhaust whole way, talk about a migraine. They banged and hammered it back together and promised it was fixed. It never really ran well after that. More on that later.  

6-8 months go by and take my a4 to sf audi for oil change. The lithua bill was in the glove box, so i asked the sf tech guy to look it over and see if there was any thing unusual. He said they charged me the labor for rate a 4wheel/all wheel a4. The thing is, my a4 is only two wheel drive. They totally scammed me and overcharged me for the extra labor. That's FRAUD! The difference was around $500. 

Like I said, it never really ran well after that. In the end, after sinking an outrages amount of $$ to get it still wouldn't smog. It never did pass so I had to trade it in cause they wouldn't give me tags. The cool guy at the smog place said it was the only car in about 10,000 that he couldn't get to pass. Ouch.       

Fraud & incompetent. Lithia sucks! I'd give them no stars if I could.   

I feel better. :)
Love the garlic knots and the pizzas are great.  A little on the pricey side...but if you are treating yourself, go ahead and spend the extra dough to eat theirs!
Best pizza spot in east nashvIlle. Love the vibes. Pizza is yummy. I'd recommend eating in and enjoying the neighborhood:)

I don't know who the heck is running this sh*t show here, but someone sure needs to.  I have read several reviews on here that love the pizza but bash the service.  I have to agree and that is the reason for my 1-star.  Pizza is yummy, always has been, but last night's service was utterly awful.  Arrived at 6:30, party of 8, ordered 3 pizzas by 6:45. 8:00 and still no pizzas.  Server, not ONCE, came over to tell us what was going on.  In fact, she seemed to be going out of her way to avoid us.  Finally someone from our party tracked her down and she informed us that the kitchen had lost our ticket and the pizzas were just now in the oven.  Oh, and she was far too busy to come and tell us what had happened because she had been in the back making pizzas cause they were short staffed.  Oh boy, those 3 or 4 other tables in the whole place had her hopping!! I didn't end up paying the bill, but I'm pretty sure not even a discount was offered for our long wait.  She's lucky I didn't pay cause she ended up with a tip that was far too generous.  I could see if the place was slammed.  I was in the restaurant industry for over 20 years and I get it.  But when there are 3 or 4 other tables in the whole place, there's no excuse for crap service.  If she'd have just come over and told us what had happened...and don't ignore us!!   I have loved Blind Onion pizza for years and was so excited to have one a few miles from my house but I will never go back here again.  Do yourselves a favor people, don't go here, ever, if you want even decent service.  Trust the reviews about the service in this place.  The Blind Onion on Victorian is awesome, great service and it will be my pleasure to drive those few extra miles to avoid this joke of a place.

For the amount or business they do the pizza is always old.   I've been curious about this for a long time and it tastes like it looks stale and tasteless.     

If you want to have a great pizza in Nashville this isn't it.

I trust Yelp reviews, and check them out first. 
Very infrequently do they fail me. But this is one case. 

We had a large pizza for take out. One Yelp compared to NY pizza. I grew up on NY pizza, but also know Chicago and real pizza from Italy etc . Compare vs ny: rule 1- this was DRY. rule 2: spices- not even close. Sauce was plentiful though. Yes the toppings were good but that doesn't  make good pizza alone 

Price: expensive vs other Nashville pizza. 
Service: took as take out, but guy taking order on phone needs to be customer focused. No patience for questions as this was our first and last time

What's the point of paying for extra when you don't get it? I paid for 2 extra ranches and didn't get anything. It's this attention to detail that doesn't exist in customer service anymore. It must be very difficult to remember to add to an order when it's part of it. Disappointed.

GREAT pizza! Not 5 stars because, well you have to wait. It's just one of those places that is always busy and popular and without question live up to the hype.

Coming from Texas and living in Austin, it has similarities to setup and style to Home Slice Pizza.  From the one dining area to the take out area to the side and to the way the pizza is cooked and prepared.  Love them both so I can't really choose a winner as if I was given both, I would gladly eat them simultaneously.

Order before to save some time and get a pizza and go grab a drink elsewhere while you wait and come back.  Or join the hype and nosh on some 'za.  It's simple ny-style pizza that doesn't need fancy toppings but they have those if you want them.  It's just good.

I'm originally from atlanta but I'm Nashville for school. I haven't found a good wing place yet since I been here until I came across this beauty! 1st I would like to talk about the customer service! Amazing! I didn't know how their lemon pepper tasted so the woman working allowed me to try all the flavors. When I tell you it was good, it was good. My food took about 10 minutes to make. I took that first bite and I felt like I was in HEAVEN!! Everything was delicious!! Will definitely be back!!

Can't say enough good things about the awesome pizza here!  Normally I prefer Chicago deep dish and thicker pan-style crust, but the New York-style pizza here is outstanding.  The crust is really well done with a good chewiness, the sauce has a great flavor, and the toppings are generous and high quality (especially the cheese!).  We typically get an 18" cheese pizza, extra cheese, and add whatever toppings we want (usually veggies, though one time we got the sliced meatballs and really enjoyed them).  We also love the garlic knots and the Greek salad.  We've been here countless times since moving to the Nashville area last spring, and we look forward to our next visit!

Pretty damn good place.

The garlic knots were fucking amaze balls, 
I mean the chunks of yummy garlic and little pieces of basil atop yummy oil rolling down the sides of the crispy yet soft inner rolls of the bread was almost orgasmic. 

Veggie pizza was very tasty with a sprinkle of basil and light on the sauce, so you can taste the veggies and crunchy yummy crust, not just sauce.  

Pretty good find after going to a place that was to trendy to open for lunch, who the fuck doesn't open for lunch.

The place I planned on going to for dinner was closed and my backup was also closed, so I ended up scrambling to find some place on Yelp and saw high ratings for this place. I was starving so I came here as a pre-dinner meal.

I ordered the prosciutto and basil ($5) which was unique and I really liked it! The prosciutto added a nice saltiness and the basil was nice and fresh. I've surprisingly never had prosciutto on pizza but I might have found my new favorite pizza topping!

It is a large slice of pizza too! It takes two paper plates to hold it up so you definitely get your money's worth. It really does remind me of the pizza that I had in NY with the thin crust.

Excellent pizza. They've got a great deal for lunch, and they sell it by the slice late at night when you want something to soak up the beer you drank next door. They have the standard rotation of slices as well as a daily special. It's just great thin, foldable pizza.
Love their thin slices of pizza.  My only beef is I like a little more marinara or wish theirs had more flavor.  So I get extra on the side or ask them to add more.  Great pizza.
Great place to come and enjoy family and friends. Good service and they always take care of us. Not to mention the pizza is excellent!

Blind Onion is one of our favorite pizza places. It's always so fresh and their crust is to die for. Make sure you ask for honey & ranch it makes it that much better. We love the staff and environment at Blind Onion. Everyone is so kind and there is always a board game to pick up and play! Highly recommended!

I Bought close to $100 worth of pizza tonight from them and they forgot my Greek salad.  After driving to our dinner host home 20 minutes away, and realized that one person's dinner was left out I called the Los Altos location and they were like "oh, ok.  No We are sorry, how can we make it up", NOTHING.  
I finally said I will come back and pick up a salad before they close at 9pm.  Again, I walk in I had to ask 3 different people before someone even acknowledged what I was asking about.  Then they didn't give me a freshly made salad, they gave me a wilted salad, and again no "I'm sorry, how can we make it up to you NOTHING!!!

If the management of this location has any concept of customer retention or correcting this wrong, I would love to hear from them.  My temp cell is 205-394-8000.  If I hear back I'll be glad to post what they said or actually do!

UPDATE:  Josh the manager personally called me and apologized and we had a great conversation.  I appreciate his desire not only "right the wrong" but also he seemed very concerned about creating a great customer experience.  He knows everyone in this area has well over 30 other pizza restaurants.....he just wants to be the one that offers the best quality and value.

Thanks Josh, I'll be back!!

I eat at Blind Onion about once every other month.
They do a pizza here called the "Breath Buster" that has an absurd amount of garlic on it as well as linguisa and onion that is one of my favorite local pies. People have pretty strong opinions on the half dozen of really good local pizza places here but without taking side I will say there is a pie or 3 from each one that is worth trying at least once.  

  The beer selection inside is a modest selection of local and classic brews.  The Dirty Wookie, when they have it, is one of my favs.

  I'll also add that the one time they forgot something on my to go order(breadsticks), the manager drove it over to my house in less than 10 min.

Pizza is delicious. However when ordering through the app the pickup time was a hour out (no problem) figured it was fine since it's such good reviews. They make it very clear not to walk up until you receive the 2nd email. I waited 10 min after my pickup time still no email so I call and they say yes it's ready. Then when I walk up to get the pizza I receive it and it's cold. It had to be sitting on their rack for a half hour. With their reputation I wasn't expecting to microwave their pizza when I got home.

Want a specialty coffee? Get out of town. Want a milkshake? Go pound sand. What about some cookies? Take a hike. 

You'll find none of these things here. I went to grab a latte (you know, one of the things they're advertising) and they tell me the machine is down. I said, "let me guess, so is the milkshake machine?" You bet ya. How about some cookies? Nope, they're "all out."

Find yourself another Mickey-Ds.

Always a favorite. My family enjoys their "parbaked" pizza that we cook at home. Our favorites are the Hot Hawaiian and Dave's pie. Also love the garlic  knots and Greek salads. The salads are so fresh and crisp.

On vacation from NJ, and was looking for a simple dinner option. I was blown away with how amazing their food is. From the simple salad to our out of this world meatball pizza, I have no complaints. The crust was perfect and the ratio in toppings are on point!!! A must go to spot. You may have to wait for a table, but well worth the wait!!!
The pizza was mediocre. Garlic knots were over cooked. Service sucked. Waiters seemed to be deaf. Will not be back!
Great food friendly attentive server.. will come again since I live close by and love this place. Good beer choices

There isn't better pizza in Nashville and trust me, I have tried it all.  Five Points Pizza just hits every mark - best quality pizza, perfect amount of toppings, always cooked exactly enough.  The pizza is more NY style, long triangle shaped and thinner crust.  Prices are reasonable and you can also get pizza by the slice - unlike any other spots.  They have a takeout door and an eat in door.  The pizza is fast and when you do takeout it is always ready when they say it will be.  Additionally, the garlic knots are amazing and I'm not a big garlic person.  Only negative is the place is always crowded and it's in busy 5 points area of East Nashville.  It's worth going to though...

This my favorite pizza place in Nashville.

I love most of the speciality slices and love that they roatate daily. I'm also a big fan of the garlic knots. 

Great spot to come in with friends or just grab some slices to go.

This pizza was absolutely lights out.  Totally fresh and so many flavors.  Get the garlic knots  solely so you can eat the delicious,  hand made marinara sauce.  

We are a big pizza family,  and have had many types. This places in the top 3. We aren't from here,  but will eat here again when we drive through Nashville.

Blind Onion is always good. 
More on the expensive side, but good. 

Regular order:
16" (L) cheese pizza $19.95
12" (M) Popeyes $18.95
-White Sauce with a splash of Pesto, spinach,
mozzarella, chicken breast, red onions & fresh Roma
tomatoes
10 Wings $10.95
-House BBQ & Roasted garlic paste 
-celery, carrots & ranch 
Soda $3.00 (free refills)

The pizza here is delicious. This is my usual order, but I can guarantee that anything you order here will satisfy any craving. Eat the crust with their signature honey and now you have dessert. That's probably my favorite part!

The wings are a must every time I go! Even my young kids chow down on them. 

Crayons & plates for the kids. 

They have bar, booths and tables. 

This one is located in the Spanish Springs Galleria shopping center, nearby Ross, Ulta, Walmart, Walgreens, Sprouts, etc.
really good pizza isnt easy to find. this place has really good pizza. desano is the best . knead dough in hendersonville and five points are neck and neck.
Nashville's finest single slice. Not a ton to say. A must stop in town. The meat slice of the day is always interesting and solid, but can't go wrong with pepperoni either. Amazing prices!

Ladies... If you aren't getting your nails done here, you're doing it all wrong. I am so shocked that there aren't any reviews, because I cannot say enough good things about my experience. 

I'll start by sharing that I was not asked or paid to write any review.

The location was hard to find, as its one woman (feeling so bad, but I'm blanking on her name). She rents space in a residential building, so it's a white door with no sign. (See photos below)

You also need to make an appointment online! If you've read my review to this point, my best advice is to go to the Instagram page: M.A.D. Nails... She has hundreds of the best nails I've ever seen done. On that page you can also find her contact info in order to schedule an appointment.

I will say that I experienced some of the most patient, attentive care to my acrylic nails, ever! If you're looking for a cheap fill- look elsewhere. It's not cheap ($95 after tax, and 20% tip for an acrylic fill with gel nail polish and a design). ITS SO WORTH IT. You will not regret it!

Once again they got the call in order incorrect. Ordered pepperoni and they onlybmade cheese. Could have easily been corrected, but instead of them offering to correct it, mr hipster who answers the phone comes over and says " that's what was ordered on the phone."

Very bad service. I will never eat there again. They have lost a long time  customer.

Just saying, WOW This place has the best pizza ever. Everyone in our party enjoyed the pizza so much we all talked about going back as soon as we can. The crust, the sauce everything was just perfect. The staff was very accommodating and professional. I would highly recommend

Blind onion continues to be the best pizza in town. My visit this Friday with my family was by far the best visit due to Kerry. He was super friendly and made our visit a relaxing and enjoyable time. I will definitely be coming back soon for more!

Great spot...bar seating, 4 booths, table seating plus some high tops as well. Ambiance is nice with some background music and friendly staff. The Garlic knots are yummy an ordered the Bianca and T-Rex pizza...cheered with Wiseacre Tiny Bomb & Einstok White Ale. Definitely will come back again!
Pizza use to be the best in Sparks.  Price keeps going up and toppings keep becoming less and less.  No more Blind Onion for me EVER.

This salon is just off the main drag of Coast Village road.  In fact, I walked from home and got a little lost bc it's just around the bend from the gas station on Coast Village.  Tucked away in the left corner of a  cozy business plaza.  The cool part was I was in and out, took less than 30 minutes and the hairs on my head were in proper order again.  As a girl there are annual health commitments which are required to function normally in society: dental cleanings, hair trims, and women's wellness exams. Yep. Please see photo attached for said result. David was quiet and efficient. Also, I wholly enjoy that you can schedule yr appointments online, AND he sends text reminders. Huuuraaay.

If I could give a super review once a year - it would hands down go to Five Points Pizza. Hands down this is the best pizza I have ever had in almost 30 years on this earth. I'm sure I'm not the only one who struggles with "hmmm pizza sounds great, but then I'm going to eat 4 slices to fill me up or also order a salad for $10 and just eat part of both and then leftovers and next thing you know I'm eating pizza every day for the rest of the week" Enter Five Points Pizza. You can get 2 slices, a half order of garlic knots and salad or a slice and salad for under $10. Incredible! Thank you for letting us have both Five Points Pizza - we don't deserve you! 

Now a review of the actual food:
1. GARLIC KNOTS - holy garlic lovers dream. I could have eaten just these and been fine. We split a half order (4 knots) between 2 and it was more than enough with our pizza and salad. 
2. The lunch salad is a serious portion and not some wimpy side salad. I loved getting some veg in today in addition to eating pizza. 
3. The pizza itself (we had the by the slice pepperoni) and it was just slightly greasy for my taste but the pepperoni was plentiful and flavorful and the pizza dough was crispy and hot and the sauce sooo good. Cheese ratio was just right. The whole thing was entirely on point. I can only imagine getting a build your own pizza and I hope to try in the near future. This was a SOLID lunch spot and will bring out of town family and friends here without hesitation. Friendly staff, cool east-Nashville "hipster" (but not snobby) ambiance. Oh and did I mention they have a plentiful tap beer selection?! Pizza On!

Why have I lived here for 8 months and never tried this place before?  There isn't anything to do right now with the whole pandemic thing, so we hopped in the car and drove from Franklin up here to give it a whirl.  

Now I feel like I know good pizza... and I appreciate ALL pizzas!  I had an entirely new pizza experience today!  We were in the car and ended up pulling over to an empty parking lot because we couldn't wait.  

The garlic knots... will prevent anyone from kissing you but I promise it's worth it!  The fresh garlic was soo good!  Most places use powdered garlic but not here!!  They were huge and freaking amazing!!

The pizza... talk about huge!  I ordered the smaller size and assume they got it wrong and gave me the largest possible pizza.  Even if it's the largest size, it is ginormous!!!  The fresh mozzarella cheese, fresh basil and super yummy tomato sauce all blend together perfectly.  First time trying new pizza I usually stick with a simple classic margarita like pizza.  This was legit in the top 3 pizzas I've ever had (sorry but I'm a Chicago girl so deep dish has my heart).  

This is totally worth the drive and I genuinely hope you open a location in Franklin.  Come on, all the coolest kids are opening locations here!!  But if not, I will still love you and still come visit!

The pizza is amazing!!! The staff is friendly and very helpful. The only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is my personal taste. I didn't like the garlic knots, there was far too much garlic for my liking. If you are looking for good pizza look no further.

I thoroughly enjoyed the hot lemon pepper shrimp tossed in the sauce, the deep fried oreos, and the deep fried twinkie! These are all must haves at Strikeout Wingz on Ewing Drive. The staff are super friendly and helpful. Strikeout Wingz is located where the original Prince's Hot Chicken place used to be. I have had their Strikeout Wingz and and it's flavorful and hot! It is not for the weak. I would only get that flavor if you are off of work the next day. Haha. Their fries are ok. I think I will ask for mine to be fried just a little crispier as I didn't like them soft from the last times that I've gotten them with my meal. I would definitely come here again.

I have not had a crust this thin and crispy since Brooklyn! Major props to this place for having more than just the usual cheese and pepperoni slices available- their Proscuitto & Basil slice was really great, and they also have featured veggie and meat slices, maxing out at $5 apiece.

Service was quick and friendly. Location has a slice counter with takeout or a small dining counter, as well as a separate dine-in area for the full restaurant. Late-night hours and lunch specials are available, as is a highly recommended habanero-cream sauce for dipping your crust.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. I've never been a very athletic person, and finding a gym that I like enough to continuously go  has been a problem for me over the years. Coach Karen and her SHAC family have managed to motivate me about actually wanting to work out to the point that I've even been sad about missing some of the days when I couldn't go. Everyone is so welcoming and encouraging; which really makes a difference for someone like me who can get intimidated by going to a gym. Karen is great about modifying the workouts so that everyone is able to get something out of it and pushing you to go beyond where you thought you could. This is a great place for people to become a better version of their current self.

4.5

The reviews speak for themselves. Location, product, word of mouth, and service all amount to a business that's earned the good rep it has. I'd heard of Five Points Pizza almost as soon as I moved to a nearby neighborhood. I've been a faithful customer ever since.

If you decide to brave 5Points on a Friday, know this: come early. If you arrive by 7 with more than 2 people, you're already too late. Either do as the old folks do (points to self) and plan your dinner outing at 6:30, come solo or plan on eating late (if you decide to eat in). Like bees to a hive, hipsters the mid-South 'round congregate on this pizzeria and they.never.leave. Seriously. Trying to get some breathing room in this place is a journey but it's worth it. Do as I do and come early. Get a table and start thinking about the beer you're going to try. Pizza and beer is a match made in heaven and 5Points makes sure that match is well done. Something I love about the beer list is that it isn't all hops all the time. Nashville, as a beer lover and connoisseur, I beg of you: lay off the hops. There are other elements to consider when drinking beer. Expand your horizons. Here, take advantage of the well-curated list and enjoy any one of a number of local delights (tasted by first Czanns here), poppy imports (Stiegl rocks my summer world) and, most importantly, browns, stouts and other dark beers. 

But don't get too full on beer; you're here to eat. I ordered the famous garlic knots... and I could have left them. While I'll never shy away from hot, crispy, buttery bread, I didn't pick up the 'garlic' part of the knot. I saw them. I felt them on my tongue. But, I didn't taste them. Save your stomach real estate for the pie. The style here is more typical of NYC so expect wide, floppy slices with distinctive, chewy crust and light sauce. I split my pizza between a Zeus (pepperoni, capicola, black olives, banana peppers, red onions, and feta) and a Supreme (pepperoni, Italian sausage, mushrooms, red onions, and green peppers). To be expected, both sides were awesome but the combo was even more so. The ingredients are fresh, the cook takes pride in his work (coming out to visit the tables) and the dish is served piping hot on a tray with a pie server. Perfect. I have also grown fond of their stromboli (the marinara sauce is addictive).

What takes 5Points over the edge, though, is the management. When you're on top of the food chain, you don't always have incentive to do right by your customers. I came in one night to pick up a medium veggie pizza. Coming at the time quoted, I picked up the pie and discovered it was cold. The fellow working the take out room couldn't be bothered to give any [redacteds]. Despite my reservations, I left. I got home and couldn't bring myself to eat a 'fresh' cold pizza. I called back and asked to speak to a manager. After a while (and initially speaking with no-[redacteds] lad, I got Josh on the phone. He apologized, asked if I lived nearby and offered to make another pizza for me, free of charge. He asked the type and size, gave me a time to be there and apologized again. I arrived at the right time, asked for Josh, shook his hand, heard him apologize AGAIN, and received a large veggie pizza for my troubles.

This. This is the reason Nashville loves 5 Points. Josh saved the day. The food is fantastic. The business makes good sense. All you other pizza joints, take notice. The microphone has been dropped.
Being from Chicago, this place helps ease the pizza pain here in Nashville. Even though its New York style. The pizza is good. Yes, I recommend.

Local Nashvillians have been telling me to try Five Points Pizza ever since I moved here. I assumed they were telling me this, because it represents their best pizza. But it seems as if they were all in on some sick joke to trick me into eating the worst pizza I've ever had in my life. Seriously. It was like someone had put a paper towel on top of my pizza, sat a book on top of it, and let it sit for like an hour (lol... see pic). It was dry, cold and flavorless.

Amazing pizzas. I love that it was thin crust, had a great crunch to it. Had a beautiful setting and the waiter was great. Super busy though, we had to wait 30 mins not sure if it's always like that since it was out first time there. 
 We started off with 8 garlic knots the. I chose to 8 over 6 because I thought it would be small and we wouldn't get to fully enjoy it, but Wow O Wow the knots are huge and tasty !!! And the marinara sauce was tasty !!! The pizza we got was the meatball pizza I forgot the name sorry. & one thing that bothered me was that we ordered lemonade, & it literally was just full of ice and you can tell that it was just maybe HALF cup of juice but with the Ice it makes it full, & the taste was honestly not so good ‍ it was more of I " diluted " lemonade juice.

When in Nashville, this is THE place to grab a NY-style slice. 

It's not all hot chicken and BBQ when in Tennessee. This Five Points establishment sits in a great part of East Nashville. Constant foot traffic, and always busy, considering the few times I've been. 

One side is order at the counter, while the other half of the restaurant is a more substantial dining room if you're looking to hang out. On this last particular visit, we opted for the quicker in-and-out experience.

If it's your first time, I'd recommend the Prosciutto & Basil slice. It's one of their signatures, plus not a classic combination you see at many pizza joints. However, their Pepperoni slice is one of my favorites. Loaded with thinly sliced pepperoni and baked to the perfect NY crisp. Red pepper and Parm go a long way with this slice, so go crazy with it. Once you see that beautiful sheen of grease spilling onto your paper plate, you know you're in the right place. 

I can't imagine visiting Nashville and not making a brief pit stop here. It's quick, cheap and undeniably delicious. My three favorite things!

At the Los Altos location,  I arrived to a pickup order that was incomplete. But, Tiffany made sure that this was corrected and went out of her way to take care of us, while we waited for the other pizza to be made. She was efficient, kind and provided great customer service. While tending to the line of pickups and doing the food server role. The great customer service that Tiffany had provided is one reason that I will be back, along with a good quality product.

One of my favorite local pizza places in town but sadly i was extremely repulsed by the attitude of the host Elizabeth. My friend and i got sat at a booth where the girl who sat us just asked if we wanted drinks so we ordered those and on return of the drinks she left menus and did not come back for roughly ten min. The host Elizabeth is walking by so naturally we excused ourselves in asking if we had someone taking care of us. Her response was "well how did you get drinks then?!" We were shocked and said someone grabbed them maybe a host whoever sat us.m but no one has been back for more than several minutes. Her response yet again was "well I'm the host soo... Im sure whoever brought the drinks will be back. I'll check on that " 

Didn't know that was the standard off speaking to guests.. especially as the face that greets the second you walk in. 

Needless to say our server was very attentive once she came back but extremely inexcusable and unpleasant attitude from Elizabeth the "hostess"

I'm from NJ and love NY style pizza. I'm pretty picky with pizza but I can confidently say that Five Points is my favorite pizza place in Nashville. I've been coming here for years and highly recommend trying it to satisfy your pizza craving! Their garlic knots are always a good idea too.

This place was recommended to us and we went with high expectations. The food was good but we did not find it to be 'knock your socks off' good. The garlic knots were delicious but not the best I have ever had and the pizza was also good--but not something that will stand out in my memory. Is it better than a chain pizza--yes it is.

I've been visiting this location now for about 5 years and am always happy with the friendly service and great pizza! They have a deal for 10.50$ where you get a tall beer and a big ass slice of pizza. I have yet to see a pizza place with a better deal than that. Kerry the bartender/server always welcomes you right when you come in and has a great attitude. The baked wings are always good if you're not feeling pizza.

Just don't get the great reviews. This is average pizza which is way overpriced. I could not wait to get there after our driver compared it to the best pizza houses of New York and Philadelphia. Not even remotely close. Tasteless and reminiscent of the pies you get at a mall. Great venue in a cool neighborhood but the sauce and spice combo are only of mass production quality.

Absolute killer slice shop. Right in the heart of east nashville this small place does pizza the right way. The slices are huge and the specials are awesome. If you are lucky enough to come on a day with the meatball pie special you will not be disappointed. Love that they cut the meatball into round to make them easier to eat not weigh down the slice.

We got into Nashville late at night and decided pizza was the way to go back to our hotel with.. we got a capricola pie with pineapple. They were very friendly at the pick up window and maintained a very clean environment. When we got to our room, the pizza was still crusty and perfect.. there was plenty of meat on it and just the rite amount of cheese. Honestly, a little on the higher cost pizza wise,but none the less very delicious.

Fantastic gym, fantastic coach, fantastic people! I can't say enough about this place! Karen (coach) is all about proper warm ups, good form and preventing injuries which is a big plus for me. I'm a beginner and she walks me through movements and lifts so I know exactly what to do, and makes sure I'm doing it correctly. I actually look forward to my daily workouts now! Give SHAC a try, you won't be disappointed!

My boyfriend and I religiously grab 5 Points every Sunday after a long days work and the staff is always the most accommodating! I swear, they can turn the entire day around in a heartbeat. Highly recommend the Super Bianca and any pizza with their meatballs

Pizza is pretty good but really turned off by the rude host. We were on a 45 minute wait so my sister went to buy a beer and we decided to stand outside against the window because the place is packed. The host came out and said we couldn't stand out there so we moved inside by the door. Apparently we couldn't stand there either and she made us move towards the bar. Every seat was taken, so we were waiting for someone to get up. The SAME host comes over for the third time and looks at us and rudely says, "are you even from here?" and rolls her eyes. I was taken aback because I have probably lived in Nashville longer than she has. My sister left her full beer on the bar and we ended up leaving cause that was ridiculous. Why didn't she tells us where we could stand in the first place instead of shuffling us around the restaurant and then getting annoyed at us. Get better staff five points! I'm a host at a popular restaurant in Nashville so I totally understand the stress of the job but I would NEVER talk down to a customer like that.

Heard so many good things about this place we had to try it. Went in a weekday and I was expecting a letdown with all the hype. I was pleasantly surprised to find the place warm and inviting and the pizza was fantastic. Ties for my favorite outside of NJ    Great crust, excellent sauce/cheese ratio....just everything a pizza should be. Prices were right in line with the average. Would gladly drive 30 minutes to visit again and hope to soon. Interesting that many locals don't like pizza the way I grew up eating it, that is, they have been raised on chain stores like Papa Johns, etc. To me, that stuff isn't edible and belongs in a supermarket freezer. 
I suggest sitting in for your first visit and just go for a cheese pie. If a pizzeria screws that up, then you know. You won't be disappointed at 5 points.

Great pizza, friendly staff, really, really good beer! It was my first time so I got the slice and salad special. Thinking these would be the usual sized slices, I ordered an extra. But the slices are huge! As big as the platter grandma serves her turkey on! Anyway, I ate it all. Delicious pizza. I don't know the local beers, but I wanted to try what they had on tap. The server in the Peanuts sweatshirt knew her business, gave great descriptions and I ended up with a very tasty beer. I don't know if I'll ever make it back to Nashville, but if I do I would definitely return to this pizza joint.

First pizza I've tried since moving to Nashville and was a little apprehensive after being told to get my pizza before leaving Chicago, but I was very pleasantly surprised. The Supreme shown includes Italian Sausage, Pepperoni, green pepper, mushroom and red onion. Isn't exactly like a Chi-town pie but very good and I thoroughly enjoyed it. Service was solid and beer choice was excellent.
David is really easy to talk to and is a very talented hair dresser. I really like my haircut and will be back again. He's my forever stylist for sure! Give him a try, you won't regret it :)

This place by far is my favorite place for pizza. It's not over priced, and you get a pretty good amount of quality made pizza. What brought me in originally was a voucher for a free slice (I got it for donating blood). Well, I've never ordered or bought a slice of pizza in my life, only because I feel like it's a waste of money (like why buy a slice when the pizza ends up being cheaper?). Well, this place sure changed the way I view pizza for many reasons.

1. When you order a "slice" they literally will make you a big ass slice, fresh! It's not just a slice from some earlier made pizza that's been sitting under the lamp or anything.
2. What's up with this honey thing? This is new to me! And, I sure am hooked now
3. The crust! The pizza itself isn't super thick, but the crust is made for dipping! The way they make the crust, it's like you're getting bread sticks. 

All of the staff here that I've encountered are super friendly and they have a great happy hour pizza deal!
2/12/21 - Just moved to Nashville and this was a perfect pie after a long day of moving. Had the T-Rex and Arugula salad. Both were great and the pickup quick!

I am very, very impressed with Dan.

I knew that the problem I had was not an easy fix because several people has told me I would need to replace the entire opener unit.

Dan was willing to take his time to repair, and honest when he said that he would not charge me anything if he wasn't able to repair the issue.

From the way he explained the problem to me and offered a few recommendations, I could tell that he was thinking about my interest, not his.

I would hire him again if I have another garage door issue.
Usually 5 Points Pizza is GREAT, but horrible service at the bar tonight. Received the wrong beer and the bartender just shrugged and said he poured it from the right tap.

This place was really good this time. We had the chicken barbq pizza the Popeye's pizza and a house salad. The barbq chicken had barbq sauce chicken and red onion with mozzarella cheese. The barbq sauce was a sweet kind. Very good. The Popeye's had spinach, Roma tomato slices, chicken, white pesto sauce, and red onion. It was a little garlicky but very good. I loved this pizza. We also got the house salad and I had them add mixed Pell pepper slices. Very good. I really enjoyed this visit.

Whenever I'm in Nashville, I MUST have at least one slice of Five Points Pizza. On this most recent visit, that is exactly all I could fit into my trip, but that is still worth it for me. It is not "the best" pizza I've ever had - but it is always "the most perfect slice". It is always the right amount of everything - cheese, crust, toppings, doughiness, crunch, and even the right size for a slice. Great for grabbing a late night snack or the right choice for having a seat at a table with friends and sharing a whole pie. There's a walk-up window, a small space for walking in to order and eat quickly, or a dine-in space. You can grab a brew or a soda too. It covers all of the bases. My favorite go-to in Nashville.

If you want a new York  style pizza this is the place in Nashville.   The salad alone was over the top. They cook the pizza perfectly. Not to ruin it but there prices are excellent. You will get more foor than what you paid for.

I recently just moved to sparks area & i had came in on Sunday night , i had a problem with my card ' for some reason it just would not work but i have plenty of money on it . I had a guy name Keri assist me , first and foremost HE DESERVES a raise . His costumer service was amazing , he provided the best service I've had in a while . He didn't give me a hard time about my card not working , he simply turned around and paid for my whole entire meal . He's amazing and you guys definitely need more keris around , bless him even more because he's already blessed . Thank you so much KERI

I did a takeout order over the phone, and had an amazing experience! I believe his name is karry at the Los Altos location. He got me a great deal, saved me money and was very professional over the phone. I went in and he was very fast and efficient. My pizza was perfect. Over all great customer service from karry. Customer service like that is why I come back to that location.

Okay, I am not going to try to be so EXCITED about this pizza since I am a huge Pizza Perfect Fan..but I have to admit...This pizza was really damn good Pizza..I loved it.
We went in and it looked a little small from the outside but rather big inside, or at least bigger than I thought..There were plenty of tables and some booths and the staff was very friendly.. We were seated immediately and for 12:30 on a Saturday that was wonderful..
We told the waitress who was all smiles and she made some great suggestions. I liked the fact you could order by the slice or whole pizza and we took the slices..We chose their Meat Slice special of the day..it was Capicola, onions, roasted red peppers, Kalamata  Olives and  Feta Cheese..only $4.50, a slice of Proscuitto and Basil Slice for $5.00 and the Pepperoni and Cheese for $3.75..the slices are large and huge...so we split all three slices down the middle so we could try all three out..
I ordered a Cola and Tony ordered a draft " Czanns Blonde"  crafted Brew right here in Nashville for only $4.50 all of it was $26 with tip and taxes..awesome New York Style Pizza..and we are definitely going back here again..
It is located on the East End in a great neighborhood area, with parking lot behind it beside the "Beyond the Edge" Bar and Grill ..
I can't wait to go back here again!! 
To enjoy the neighborhood, walk around, try out a few pubs and eat some Great Pizza..
When My daughter comes down here, she has to eat here!! She is going to love it..

My wife called in the order before I went to the store, so the person taking the order said "15 minutes until ready." I arrived and they forgot to make the slice of pizza. I waited 15 mins and was offered a free soft drink for them not admitting that they forgot the order. Then, when my order was finally ready, the hostess called me up to go pick-up the food. Why not bring it to me? The restaurant has servers, but I have to go grab at the counter like a little Caesar's! After they see that they see that my order was forgotten, at least, bring to my table. In the end, it was 45 mins for a slice of pizza from when it was 1st called in. At least, offer me a pint for my time or a free slice. The place looks great inside, but I would rather take a better product and great customer service over appearance. Not to mention the pizza that was requested to be well done was a little undercooked. Maybe if I could only have waited another 15 minutes, then maybe it would be correct?

Took the wife for wings, pizza, and a beer. We got The General pizza which was decent, I probably wouldn't ever go back for it. The wings were great, probably the best I've had in Reno. Overall, I'd say to check them out.

I was a little underwhelmed. I got a split pie of the vodka and south Brooklyn. South Brooklyn was tasty but more on the simple side. The vodka was revolting. The mushrooms overpowered the sauce and the prosciutto was a weird grayish pink color. Almost like it had gone bad? I know it's cured pork but it tasted off. Garlic knots were fantastic though. I took it to go so maybe it's better in house. I'll come back to try the other ones but it'll be awhile until then.

I have only been here for happy hour, but it was a nice place with friendly service. Generous pours of wine for $5, a bourbon cocktail for $5, and I think a beer special or two also. They even gave us free bread since our friend raved about how good it was. I'd definitely like to find my way back here soon.

I shared the Garlic Knots & Zeus calzone with my friend. It was a satisfying meal. I wish they'd allow substitutions with the calzone though because I definitely would've got it without the red onions. The garlic knots were perfect though!! It was all very yummy, we also did feel pretty rushed by the waiter though despite it storming outside & there was no wait in the restaurant.
Wack they closed super early. Visiting from Phoenix and this is the only time I could smash some pizza with the honey sauce. Open fast!

The Red Rooster is one of our Favorite neighborhood restaurant and Bar. The food is great and beer is always cold!   The Red Rooster has always been a go to place for my family and friends. They have great local bands and DJ's. Liz and her team make everyone feel welcome.  Definitely a place to frequent. Ang is one of the best servers/ waitresses. She is always working hard to make sure everything is going well.
