Some of the best pizza in Nashville. You definitely have to try it. The last time I went there, they didn't serve wings, which was a little upsetting. But the pizza is definitely worth it.

Me and my famIly absolutely love eating at Five Points Pizza. The service wassfriendly and casual. Then they greeted us within a minute of being seated. Try the garlic knots, you will truly enjoy while your pizza is being made by hand. Love that  you can order by the slice. Enjoy one of Nahvilles hidden gem of a restaurant.

The pizza is just ok and the stromboli is absolutely bland and soggy. I don't get the high ratings. If you want excellent pizza try desano's, 312 Pizza, and tailgate Brewery... even NY pie serves up a better Pizza than five points... and I just hate the sausage... Not good at all ... but, I suppose if you're a college student up all night and want some late night pizza, this would be the place

Visited for the first time yesterday. I've been wanting to try for a long time after following on Instagram. We tried a few different pizzas and they were all amazing!!! The crust....., so delicious. Even my husband and my son who never eat the crust devoured every last bite. I didn't look at their beer list but they have Tahoe Amber which is one of my faves. Our waitress was very attentive and super nice. Can't wait to return!!
Really solid pizza! Great taste & gives me a bit of the NY pizza feel which I've yearned for, lately. I'll definitely be back.

I was disappointed in the pizza taste of the pizza and the quality of the cheese it didn't taste what I was expecting granted I'm a New Yorker and a half high expectations for pizza but I have found other pizzerias in the Nashville area that are far superior than five points I'm not sure what the attraction is to most people but for me this place just didn't cut it hi I prefer several other options the area

Not sure what the hype is about this place? Maybe due to the fact that it's in a hip area?  But, it was extremely underwhelming.  I just moved from New Orleans and I'm from the Northeast and this pizza is nowhere near what a decent pie should be and certainly does not come close to what I know of as a New York style pizza.  The flavor was extremely bland and the crust was soggy underneath and lacked that balance of chewiness and crunchiness on the edge.  I also order the garlic knots which were too big and also lacked anything special in terms of dough texture and flavor.  The arugula salad I ordered was an extremely small amount for the price.  I'm looking forward to finding a better pizza option in Nashville because this is not it if you know what top notch pizza is supposed to taste like...
This was how my fries were served. It was the only thing I ordered and the box was barely filled... for $3??

So good! Ordered here last night and got some delicious pizza. I've eaten here a few times before and they honestly have some of the best pizza I've ever eaten. Our favorite toppings are: garlic, pepperoni, red onion, basil, & artichoke hearts. 

The pizza dough is delicious, and they offer ranch or honey for dipping. I recommend dipping the crust in the honey, it's so yummy! 

We also ordered their veggie plate which was only so-so. The veggies were dried out and the garlic crisps were 'okay'. It is definitely not something I would order again, but I will definitely keep coming back for their delicious pizza.

So I was a bachelor party and we decided to order some pizza . Yelped to see what was best then went for it . Pizza was good but definitely not what i would consider the best . Price was kinda high it was about $48 for to X-large pizzas with a couple toppings. However they did have it ready fast and time is money so it all worked out .

I just got take out at this store. I got a supersized 1 with coke. When I got to pick up window (I already payed at first window) I asked for a spicy mustard. Please note, I asked for nothing else such as ketchup, salt, or other sauces. I was told no. I then asked if I could buy one. I was charged 27 cents and had to wait. This is petty and ridiculous. I would likely not return to this store because of this. Theres a Burger King next store Ill use next time. Super weird and poor customer service.

Ordered 2 large pizza's and I'm really struggling to understand why these pizza's cost $25 each and not $10. You can get better pizza at papa johns. Don't waste your money here. The cheese is gross, reminds me of chucky cheese. The sauce has absolutely no seasoning or flavor, and the bread is thick, doughy, and tasteless. I'm going to be thinking about how I spent $60 on these tasteless pizza's for the rest of the month. Maybe if you get drunk here it'll taste like an ok pizza, except the service is horrible so just don't waste your time. If McDonalds made a pizza, it would taste better.

So, I finally took my New Yorker husband to Five Points Pizza last night, which I've been meaning to do for about 2 years now. To say he's a pizza fan...is an understatement. Give him NY style pizza, and sushi, and he will live off of those two foods essentially forever. 

He was highly impressed with Five Points - both their slices and their garlic knots. The garlic knots are a must, y'all. So good, and the marinara they serve with it...well, if it isn't made in house, they're doing a really good job of faking it, because it definitely tastes fresh made, haha. 

My friend (who is gluten free - note: they do NOT have gluten free crust) opted for the caprese salad, and it had these amazingly gorgeous, clearly local and fresh, green tomatoes instead of red tomatoes. It looked ridiculously good, and she confirmed that it was! 

Hugeeeeee beer selection here, and they have a house white and house red wine, as well. I was super excited to see that their house white was a Sauvignon blanc, which basically never happens (it's usually always a Pinot Grigio or a Chardonnay...bluhhh), so we were thrilled by that and ordered a carafe. Really great sauv blanc!

Lovely service, great pizza, excellent drinks. We'll be back!
Nashville pizza staple and still some of the best. Get the meatball and add ricotta and thank yourself later. Also, The habanero cream sauce goes on everything.

Never a problem there until today. My wife ordered and I went to pick it up. They had no knowledge of order, said maybe she ordered at wrong location. Turns out they had both name snd order completely wrong. They made no attempt to rectify. We ordered s Zeus, ended up with a cheese Only pizza.

Every now and then you still find someone that cares about quality vs quantity!   Acoma did a fantastic job on an apt. of ours and didn't "half-bake" the job. They used the correct thickness plywood on the roof, reinforced the truss and installed the ridge vent professionally and warrantied the work for two years.

Did your roofer do that ?

Above and beyond is what I'd call it .

Use Acoma and do yourself a favor - so much better than my old company.  I will stick with Acoma!

Many Thanks!

My sister has lived in Nashville for around 5 years. When I come to visit this place is always on my list of food choices. Nashville has great restaurants and five points has the BEST habenarõ cream sauce pizza! I wish they would deliver to STL!

Came here after a night on Broadway. Love that they keep they window open til 3 am. A slice of pizza is around $4. We ordered a whole pepperoni pizza which was $21. It was so simple and delicious. Their tomato sauce is so good and the dough was perfectly made. I'm only giving it a 4 because I didn't get to dine in and try the garlic knots. I will need to come back and try those.

The only reason I give 4 stars, is the wait for getting food.  Although they did advise that there was at least a 45 min wait for the food.  The wait isn't so bad, if you have good Company and good conversation.   We ordered pizza, wings and I ordered a chicken salad. Everything came except salad, our waiter came back and said somehow the salad did not get on the order in the kitchen.   He re-ordered the salad, and comped it.  Our server was great. He kept us updated with our order.  Everything we ordered was so good.  Bbq wings, the pesto wings.. OMG they were so good,  the wings are cooked perfectly, love them. The garlic cheese bread...again so delicious.  I would recommend Blind Onion.

Obviously the best pizza  in East Nashville. Love popping in the to go  part on my way home. The only bummer is how long the wait can be at the sit down part, but that's just because of how great it is.

I love this place!  I have been there almost weekly for the past month or so.  The beers are great, the staff is fun, and of course the pizza is amazing.  Everytime we go in, we are greeted by the staff.  They remember who we are and I have never had any trouble getting a drink at the bar.  The time it takes to get a pizza is reasonable too.  I highly recommend!

Small, casual dining room, but one of the best pizzas we have found in Nashville.  We waited a while on a Friday evening at the bar, but scored the cute table for two in the front window - best seat in the house for watching all of the beards and skinny jeans - uh, I mean East Nashville - walk by. Have a drink at the bar while you wait on a table.  We loved our Greek salad and it was big enough to share. I had the Supreme on my pizza half and it was great. Parking sucks at Five Points but there is a large pay lot across the street if you're lazy and have a little cashola to burn.

BEST pizza place in town!! Customer service is top notch- Julia made us feel like family. Not to mention the pizza was absolutely amazing. 10/10 going to keep coming back! 
PS: the new beverage manager has some super exciting changes coming soon. Definitely suggest you check it out!

I visited this place for the first time around 2 months ago, and let's just say I am hooked and go there at least once every other week. The garlic knots are to die for. Normally I like toppings all over my pizza, but this pizza is so amazing that I just get the cheese. If you are not super hungry, you can get it by the slice which is bigger than your head! If you are a pizza lover like me, you must go here. Blows every other pizza place out of the water!

My husband and I were meeting up with some friends for dinner nearby and wanted to grab a drink but the spot we originally wanted to go to, Sparks Public House - was closed. So in a pinch we ended up at Blind Onion. We sat at the bar and were attended to fairly quickly by who we later found out was the owner. I ordered a Pinot Noir which ended up not being that great, like it was bad almost but he noticed and asked if I liked it or if it felt off. I am not one to complain but since he asked, I was honest that it seemed off. He happily replaced it for me and made sure I was happy with what I was having. This was a really kind gesture. As we got to talking he also explained how it is hard to move wine with people not dining in as much and with the limited capacity - totally makes sense. Overall, it was a great experience and we hope to go back and have some yummy Blind Onion pizza.

This used to be my wife 's and my go-to pizza joint. No more. We gave it two more visits before we decided never to return. Ambiance - dirty, Service - slow (but friendly), Pizza - undercooked & ill-prepared, value - nill.

Cherry Hill Painting has done several jobs for us and has always done a great job. We have been extremely pleased with the workmanship and attention to detail. The owners are reliable and honest. The painters are skilled professionals and are very courteous and trustworthy.

Delicious pizza! Fast service! great beer selection! stopped by this shop on a cold day for a quick bite and I am happy I did. Growing up in NYC makes me a pizza snob and I am here to say this pizza joint is legit. TOO LEGIT TO QUIT! The service was pretty fast and every one was very friendly. There is some seating but I got the sense this was more of dine and dash kind of place. A bit hipster but not painfully so, hipsters make some good food! Next time I am in Nashville I will def be back there.

Well constructed thin-crust pizza and salads here!  I also love the garlic knots.  The take-out service is speedy and efficient, which we took advantage of multiple times.  A hip and relaxed vibe inside, which compliments this neighborhood.

I ordered a double quarter pounder with cheese and a large frappe and was charged $9.84 on my debit card. I drove away and opened my burger and it was a single quarter pounder in a double quarter pounder box. Then I noticed I didn't get a receipt.  What's going on McDonald's?  I was definitely overcharged!
I'm not sure what happened here, but this has not been my experience.   Sounds like you had a bad experience.   But, just so everyone knows, Anything Wireless is a class act company in my book.

So glad Morgan is finally on Yelp- I should have reviewed her months ago. I have had her do gel art for me over a dozen times. When I leave her I'm not only satisfied but often times giddy. Her original work is always impressive. When she does minimal (simple) art it can be equally impressive. I have done my own nails for years, so when I decided to find somebody in town to do gels I won't just go anywhere. I encourage you to check out @madnails on Instagram - that's how I found her. 
Morgan is up on all the latest trends...chrome, shattered glass, holo, etc. I've brought her multiple designs to replicate - whether it be a photo, cartoon, or my Mardi Gras krewe logo. She really does it all, and you can be sure that she'll put her own twist on it.
She uses OPI gels which I've worn for 3-4 weeks. I know that's pushing it, but the point is that they last. She's a pro at removal as well. I attribute my long, strong, healthy nails to her!
Sometimes she's still working on a client when I arrive so don't be in a rush. It's a one-woman show, not your standard manicure mill. Bring a beverage, relax and get ready for some fresh nails. Good art takes time!

Ordered a pie before a trip to the airport and was pleasantly surprised by:

+food was ready in 10 minutes
+fresh ingredients, great tomato sauce and cheese on the south brooklyn pie
+abundance of basil on each slice
+reasonable price for a medium pie ($16 with quality ingredients)
+ thin yet chewy crust 

super excited to have found this place... foresee a lot of visits here in the future!!

Love the environment such a great place for families.
Pizza was amazing and would definitely recommend the pepperoni pizza and cheese bread sooooo goodddd.
Just passing through Reno and saw they were open. We had a great time. Cute little space very nice bartender, over all a fun experience. Next time I'm in town I'll come back.

Been here a few times pre-COVID.  Food was always decent but not great.   Service is always good.  We went in on a Monday night because we wanted to dine out and be waited on.

Wanted to dine in so we placed our order, 16" pizza with half garlic, half pepperoni & olives.  Also a Caeser salad and two drinks.  Our food was brought out in a timely manner as usual.  About halfway through our meal, my wife realized that her side of the pizza (pepperoni & olives) didn't have any olives.  Our receipt didn't have the toppings broken down nor the price of the drinks and salad.  I went up to the counter and asked if we were charged for the olives because they weren't on the pizza.  The counter person was a little confused but was able to find our order and sure enough, we paid for olives.  She offered a refund of $1.25 but I told her to keep it.  She also said that her manager rung up the order so she didn't know what he did. It was obvious to me that the person making the pizza screwed up.  It wasn't a big deal but for a so-so premade pizza, I've had better in the Reno area.  A bit on the pricey side too.  Probably won't be getting my business anymore.

The vodka sauce is superb here. I hit this place up every time I'm in town. They have pizza by the slice on the right side of the building and dine in on the left side. Watch out for parking. My friend got a $60 ticket for parking in the lot behind the building for only 5 minutes :/
Ridiculous prices for below quality Pie!20$ for a pepperoni pizza? Try a hot n ready. I don't mind paying for quality and something unique, this wasn't it. Try Sam's sports bar!

Nice casual ambiance.   Came in around opening  time.   Seated immediately and place filled up pretty quick. Waitstaff very friendly.  Food came out fast and hot.   We had the garlic knots and the T. rex. This is a must eat when in Nashville.   This was our first trip to town but we will for sure be frequenting this place.   Would have better pics of the pie but it got devoured pretty quick
I've had such a lovely experience each time I've visited M.A.D. The staff is great, and I'm always happy with the outcome of my manicure/pedicure. Very atmospheric and hygienic. I love this place!
Purchases a 6 piece chicken nugget, which 2 were severely under cooked. My fries were lukewarm. I hope I don't get sick!

This place is super delicious and amazingly well priced! The parking could be better but it's nashville and not their fault really lol. 

Everything we ate from there was absolutely amazing and the garlic knots are fantastic.

Employees walking around Publix on McMullen & Enterprise obnoxiously & defiantly not wearing masks. Wouldn't use a company who has employees that do not give a crap about your safety... especially the large Polynesian looking guy and the scrawny guy (who walks around thinking he's a bad ass) with the man bun and dyed blonde hair.
It was surprising quick! My parent's are from New York and stingy about pizza and this passed their test. Would definitely recommend. Garlic knots were top notch as well.

Awesome pizza. 
They have a something for all tastes. They will exceed your expectations on all fronts. Their choices range from traditional to foodie. Through the use of the highest quality ingredients and preparation they make the best pizza in Nashville!
The interiors are clean and well decorated. 
The wait staff is as eclectic as the pizza and they are always polite and helpful

I've been a long time customer of Liberty Dispensary Krewstown locations. I recently purchased a Rso syringe applicator. This item after using a small amount twice stop working and is is as hard as cement. I've had RSO before and I know it's thick but not to the point where it stop coming out. I tried different things to help nothing worked. I called liberty at Krewstown and spoke to a very nice lady who apologized and told me I can bring it back for exchange or return with no problem. 
I then asked to speak to manager  for him to be aware of the problem as well. When I spoke to the disrespectful passive aggressive & rude manager name KEVIN*. He was very dismissive after I told him I did all the things he was talking about to help the RSO to come out to no avail. But he literally told me he can't exchange it or return it. Now I'm flabbergasted because the the lady before said I could return or exchangr it and was aware how too thick it can be to work, now the manager is giving me a hard time and being rude.  After I expressed that how unprofessional he was being with me and I will definitely be writing a review of my horrid experience at this location. Not only was he was dismissive, nor he did not exercise good customer service at all, he just threatened to hang up on me. I was professional, didn't raise my voice  and yet he threatened to hang up on me because I was making a complaint. If that's Liberty Dispensary Krewstown location Manager Kevin is Liberty Dispensary idea of good customer service then I ENCOURAGE EVERYONE TO GO TO RESTORE* DISPENSARY* which has better and more respectful customer service and great managers.  RESTORE DISPENSARY ALSO OFFER YOU A 15* TO 20* PERCENT DISCOUNT way more than Liberty Dispensary. LIBERTY DISPENSARY IS HORRID, RUDE, & UNPROFESSIONALLY. VERY DISAPPOINTED!

I would not suggest going to this place on a Friday night. As I saw a couple families standing around waiting for a seat to open up like a pack of vultures. Maybe if they had a host it would take care of that, but even then you might be waiting a while for your pizza. Luckily I was by myself so there was a seat available at the bar. The bartender took my drink order right away and was back for my food order immediately. He offered up as much conversation as he could in between running all over the place like a mad man trying to get every ones orders in and out on time. My pizza took about 30 minutes which I felt like too long to make a pizza, however, that was before I tried it. Amazing pizza fresh ingredients and they all blended together very nicely. The bartender had to explain to me what the honey was for and why it tastes so good on the crust and that was almost as good as the pizza. So minus the wait time the service was great and the pizza was awesome!

I live down the street so I went in for a beer and catch the end of a Flyers game.  Fairly large crowd considering it was the Sunday of St Pat's but I wouldn't say it was packed.  I waited about 10 minutes and was completely ignored by the bar staff (too busy talking and drinking to take orders).  I flagged down the bar back who was nice enough to grab me a bottle.  I wasn't planning on staying for another drink so I went to the ATM for some cash to pay my bill.  When I got back to my seat they threw out my beer so I just left without paying.

Get your shit together!  This is a really nice neighborhood spot but the staff is awful.  If you have 5 staff talking and drinking with patrons there is no excuse to keep people waiting to be served, sorry!

The Habanero Cream Sauce pie is one of the best pizza pies you'll ever eat. It's a gourmet style approach, fairly thin crunch crust, and bursting with flavor. 

Wait staff was great, price was also reasonable, and the garlic knots (although not as mind blowing as the pie) were more than legit. If you're a Nashville resident or just passing through, check out 5 points.

First time here today, the Los Altos location reminds me of Roundtable Pizza in decor.  I ordered the super slice of cheese pizza to go which is really two slices.  First of all, they burnt the slices of cheese pizza, and second, the tomato sauce on the pizza tasted like Hunt's canned sauce.  Nothing special about the canned sauce or what tasted like day-old reheated pizza. I know their signature crust is like a knot or something but rather than putting terrible tasting sauce throughout the crust may be put cheese in the crust instead.  The crust was two layers and way too thick compared to the cheese slices.  Note to Staff:  Never give burnt day-old pizza to a brand new customer, you will always get negative reviews in addition lose a family of customers.

I truly don't know why you'd go anywhere else. I can't say enough great things about the Rocket Pie, their Greek salad, the garlic knots, and their service! How they all stay so kind and patient no matter the line is beyond me. Pro tip: order a side of garlic oil.
I mean, what do you say? It Five Points Pizza. Simply the BEST!! Every. Single. Time.

Just thinking about writing this review is making me hungry! This is hands down, my favorite pizza place in Nashville. It is soooo absurdly delicious and if you haven't indulged yourself in the foodie heaven that is 5 points pizza, then honestly, have you truly lived???

Everything about this place is pure perfection. Follow my advice and you will leave satisfied.....I promise!

1) Get yourself a local brew.....actually make it 2
2) GARLIC KNOTS aka little pieces of bliss. Seriously, these things are out of this world. Butterly and garlicly and parmesany and just A+++++++++. 
3) Pepperoni extra cheese pizza with basil. The basil makes the pie, so don't forget to ask for it! Just everything about the way that 5 points makes their pizza is wonderful. THe crust, sauce, cheese, everything!

There is a downside (but I didn't dock them stars for it), and thats parking. It's a nightmare. I would recommend going for a late lunch or early dinner so you can get a spot. You might have to pay.

While I prefer not to write negative reviews, I'm going to have to give Liberty Philadelphia 2 stars (not Bensalem they are awesome). Yes the place is clean and there are like 8 staff members there, the front entrance staff members are rude as hell. Today I put in online order, received a text message stating the order was being prepared. I go in, and as soon as I walk in I was asked do I know how to show my ID I stated "yes" b/c I thought I just had to show them, well no I displayed it wrong and I was made aware. However this is not my complaint, my complaint is the lady in front, I didn't get her name, told me if I didn't get a text message stating my order was ready I shouldn't have came to dispensary until I received a message stating my order was ready. I was kind of in shock because I have gone before and there was no issue. Then she tells me I should read it on the website, sarcastically and rushes me into dispensary. I go in there and like 20 seconds later I get a text stating "order ready" mind you there are 2 cash register staff, 3 in sofa area and 2 more near display cases. 7 staff members and yet I'm being penalized for going in without a "order is ready" text. I was so upset I asked to speak to a manager, Sam came out and asked me what happened, I explained he offered me 10$ discount and stated that sometimes they tell customers this when the get busy. Yet I got there at 12pm and no other customers were there. Bottom line is I read the website info and clearly nowhere does it state you can not enter the dispensary until you receive a text message. I wrote a letter and hopefully someone can see that the staff here are not compassionate, not understanding of patients needs, yes we are all suffering from COVID but that doesn't give you the right to belittle patients. Not all staff are like this, there are a few that are cool. Hopefully some type of staff meeting or education can take place so the rude ass lady in the front can stop telling patients wrong misleading information. Either update your website to include accurate information or update your front entrance lady. Too upset to get her name.

I did a bit of research before I chose someone to come and check out my roof. Acoma won. They also were able to come out earlier that previously scheduled (within a week). Ryder, representing Acoma, came over, took me outside, and showed me the situation. He went up on the roof and found slipping tiles as well. He verbally told me a ball park figure but would send me a proposal within 48 hours with work to be done within a week after I approved it. There was never any talk of fee for estimate BUT this is a house already owned. I get the policy. 
At this point, we are looking to approve the work with visions of replacing the entire roof in the next couple of years. I will be able to state, after the work is done, definitively that I will go with Acoma to do the roof replacement. The key word is confidence and My wife & I are feeling it with Acoma! The stress from not knowing where to go next has been resolved. I will followup this review after the dust has settled!
UPDATE Aug 13,2015: Read your own reviews! I should have since I couldn't remember the followup! Yes, Acoma did my vet replacement & patch work. Fast, efficient and fair price!
Since the annual rain season decided to go for a personal best, I've had to bring in the troops again on a couple of problem areas. Ryder O'Brian came back, did a tour in the crawl space, and is taking action to establish the issue. Trust me when I say I'm comfortable with the methodical plan to resolved the issues! Acoma will take care of me AND I just elevated my star count! Yes, I recommend them!

My boyfriend and I love roast beef, and St. Louis knows roast beef. Lions choice is great for a quick meal. You have multiple cheese options which is awesome, but the meat can be a little dry. Locals will tell you to get the au jus to dip, I'm a little iffy on that because if I wanted a French dip, that's what I would order, but a roast beef should naturally be moist. There's definitely some better textured roast beef around, and places that load their sandwiches with more meat. Prices are pretty on point for a roast beef sandwich. My favorite part is the 50 cent dipped ice cream cone, the best way to end your meal. This place is a St. Louis classic and is super convenient, so I recommend it for everyone to try at least once. We aren't regulars by any means, but definitely take advantage of the local business from time to time.
New York pizza in Nashville. Any New Yorker having a slice here will think their home. Cheese pizza as good as you can find. Great service as well.

Great place to do your nails, Sally is such an amazing nail Artist, truly a perfectionist. Every time she does my nails is just true art. This last time I went I was not very happy, it was my fault I didn't make an appointment so Someone else had to do my nails. I guess she was rushed and did an okay job. I was disappointed because it was Nothing like what Im used to. My advice make an appointment so they have time to do a great job.

I love the concept---walk up to a window after a night of drinking and grab a slice. who wouldnt? and pizza comes out pretty quickly too!

however, the pizza just isnt amazing. its okay, ill give them that. the basil has no flavor what so ever. listen, my location says im from jersey so i have high standards when it comes to pizza, and i mean it when i say the pizza was alright. i just feel at 3.25 per slice, its like im back in NYC getting a good slice..and this slice just wasnt that great. if im ever back in 5points, i will gladly stop on by and give them another try.
Laurie was the most incredible waitress we've ever had in our lives. The pizza was delicious and the beer selection was great. Awesome restaurant.

My family and I visited the blind onion for the first time in 2017 and every time we go they never disappoint. They have specialty beers which my husband enjoys. The pizza is always fresh and so good. The crust is very different and I recommend dipping it in the honey they provide. The staff is friendly and make sure you are pleased with your food. During covid you could still sit inside and enjoy a meal with your family or friends. We will continue to come there. I highly recommend the 3 little pigs pizza. It's one of our favorites!
I just ordered a pizza from here.  They tried charging me an extra $2.50 for toppings listed on the pizza! Shame on you. I LOVE you pizza but I will never come back after this bs!
The pizza is delicious and the service was excellent. We got half supreme and half T-Rex. the T Rex is an all meat pizza with sausage, pepperoni and ham. It was soo good.

Delicious pizza slices & fresh fresh salads. Good local beer options. I would definitely recommend it & come back on my next visit to Nashville.
I do consider myself a pizza connoisseur & 5 Points is AWESOME.
I had a daily slice with cappicola, pineapple & fresh jalapeño slices. Great combo. I also had to try a plain slice & it did not disappoint!
Crust is crisp & light. Cheese was the perfect proportion & I even got a little marinara for the last bit of crust which was too good to not eat!
2 slices & a salad was a perfect lunch with a draft of a local brew. Everyone in my party had the same great opinion.

Like u assholes really give a fuck about the flu, what bullshit you gonna give patients now, by the way them stars keep going down, wonder why?? KEEP ON FUCKIN EVERYONE LIBERTY, KEEP ON FUCKIN EVERYBODY!!! YO,YO,ASSHOLES!

One of the best pizza places in town. They're also linked to Wild Garlic so you won't go wrong with going to either place. The Blind onion locations all over Reno never disappoint. 
I got a few pizzas from them (ordered over the phone for pick up) and one of the pizzas was the Pizza of the month. I asked the kid on the phone to let me know what the ingredients were, I even had him repeat it. 
Unfortunately, he left out a really important topping... broccoli . To my disappointment, the person who grabbed the pizzas didn't check them but if they did then we would have had the pizza remade right there. 
Anyways, we ended up bringing it home and it was an instant bummer. 
I ended up calling and telling the manager that I would have definitely heard the ingredient of broccoli (it was a buffalo chicken macaroni pizza, why would you put broccoli?!) the manager had them make a new one, without the greens and was very apologetic and wanted to make sure that we were taken care of. Thank you guys very, very much. We really appreciate you trying to go above and beyond to fix it and the second pizza was absolute perfection. 
If it was bad service and a bad experience, I would not be sitting in this location right now, writing this review while waiting for my pizza. 
You guys are the best, keep the tasty pizza and the outstanding service up!
Every time our friends come over from Franklin, we have to order Five points. It's a staple.

We have had several large parties at Blind Onion in the private backroom. Their food is amazing and service is outstanding!  Kerry takes care of us every time and is attentive to everything!!!  We love coming here!!

Best pizza no matter what flavor you choose. A slice from the window at 2am was the once a month treat after dancing the night away at Funky Good Time at Five Spot. Extremely friendly staff & the safety precautions added for everyone's safety is great to see. Since COVID19 has limited our friendly gathers, we had to grab a couple pies- always delicious!
Best pizza in Nashville, hands down. Get a double pepperoni and thank me later.

After ordering from the blond onion 3 times in less than two weeks I thought it was about time that I write a review. I've been making attempts to try different pizzas each time I order and have yet to be disappointed. I've tried the breath buster, Hawaiian, chicken parmasan, Greek and the General's. They were all delicious, but my favorite was the Greek with kalamata olives, artichoke hearts and sundried tomatos. I added Italian sausage! 

If you don't like crust these aren't the pizzas for you. They have a pretty thick outer edge of crust that takes us a considerable amount of the pie. I love it though especially with honey! 

These pizzas are pricy, but worth it in my opinion!

Blind Onion is the best pizza in the world. Plus Carry was the best. He hooked us up with the sauces and was a very nice guys. We love coming here and strongly recommend their food. You can't go wrong with any pizza but there Veggie pizza is absolutely the best.

$3 for a slice of pizza bigger than my head AND on thin crust? Down!

Five Points came highly rated on our Yelp search for East Nashville pizza places and the second we got our menus we knew why. The topping options were endless, the beers on tap were all local, crafty and delish, and the staff were more than awesome in helping us find the best options. 

After sampling a few beers the waitress recommended, as a table we ordered two IPAs (forgive me I forget the names) and loved them both. For pizza we all ended up getting different slices from the specials board. Honestly I can't tell you all the toppings but basically they were freakin delicious and perfectly filling. Not too salty or greasy, and no short handing it - they give you all the goods!

The bathrooms smelled very nice and were gender neutral. Parking was easy and free on the street or in the back lots. There's tons of unique, small business shopping nearby. The staff are incredibly kind. The prices are amazingly affordable. They have, what seems to be, every local newspaper and magazine on hand. There's a big bulletin wall will all upcoming events..

Overall definitely a must visit for good beers and pizza, easy parking, and rad staff!

This nail shop is EVERYTHING I ever wanted from a manicure. They are truly artists AND they care about keeping your natural nails healthy. Yes, it's expensive, but you're supporting a small business owner who pays people a living wage. And you're supporting the sheer artistry of these women. Yes, they're mostly appointment only, but that's respectful of my time. I love coming in to the shop and checking out the accessories or candles or whatever other funky stuff Morgan has for sale. Deja pours me a glass of wine while I'm relaxing. Belinda is awesome. She's my girl and always has me getting the most compliments on my nails. The rest of the crew is also great at helping you choose colors or decide if you want to change shapes. The shop is so chill and welcoming, the music is always great. MAD Nails really is one of my favorite spots for relaxing self care!
I got my hair trimmed and layered. My bangs were sooooo long!! My hair grows quick too so next month it'll be longer.

I had my 50th birthday party at the Blind onion recently. I was completely amazed by the excellent service we were provided by Karrie and Sarah!
They were absolutely amazing. They took care of everything for us and made sure we had everything we needed and they provided us with excellent food and great drinks. My 50th birthday would not of been the same without this excellent experience. I highly recommend the blind onion to everybody !
Thank you so very much Karrie and Sarah!

Dino

Five Points Pizza is ranked in Yelp's Top 100 Nashville restaurants and shockingly the Top 10 on TripAdvisor. I've rarely been this underwhelmed in my life! Terribly unimpressive.

The garlic knots were impeccable and I get the appeal of the hipster vibe to millennials. But I wouldn't even rank the actual pizza among the top 10 pizzas in East Nashville! Short review, but there's nothing else to say!

I'm speechless. We heard from multiple friends this was the place to go in Nashville for pizza. The reviews would indicate they were correct but...our experience wasn't  good at all. 

It's a cool place with a regular dining area or a carry out section. I ordered carry out. The pizza took 25 minutes so I enjoyed a pint while I waited. 

I ordered a large. Half meatball and half super Bianca. The meatball was definitely the better of the two but I would not order either again. The Bianca was absolutely flavorless. We had a slice of each type and threw the rest away. Pizza is typically not something I ever throw away.

Super Slice and a Pint has been one of my fav deals in Reno deals I moved here almost 7 years ago! It's a quarter of the "small" pizza, which is like two regular slices anywhere else! I think it's like $5 for a slice with one topping and a soda, $6 with a pint, and $7 with a tall frosty beer, and of course you can add additional toppings if you like. All the locations have the same great pizza and offer a fantastic selection of microbrews. I used to frequent the NW location on Kings Row when I lived in the area, especially after a great night out! Victorian Square and South Virginia are close to me now, but I really like the atmosphere in this location near Spanish Springs, so I'll often make the drive.

This pizza is the perfect combination of a crunchy bottom with the chewy, doughy deliciousness of the braided crust around the edge. My favorite part has to be the honey they have on every table. It's great to dip the crust in (I like mixing it with parm and hot peppers), but it also goes really well with the pizza itself. I used to order green olives and their house italian sausage, but they stopped offering the olives, so these days I go for red onion in their place. You really cannot go wrong with anything on the menu but be sure to check out their special offers as well, like $10 large pepperoni from 4-6PM for happy hour, Free Anchovy Tuesdays, and my favorite, Free Beer Tomorrow (it's a joke). 

My GF and I decided to go this past Tuesday with some friends for their October "Scary Movie" night. They put out popcorn and red vines and show a scary movie on the big screen in the bar area. Sipping the perfect brew, eating some delicious pizza, and watching a movie is a fun way to spend a Tuesday. I wish the turn out had been better. 

If you haven't been in a while, or at all, you owe it to yourself to get in and try this pie. You won't be disappointed, and you may even leave with a new favorite in town.
The best pizza in Middle Tennesseei thought I was in NY. Small inside and usually packed but service is good and pizza is great I wished we had one in  Franklin

My go-to pizza place in Nashville! Always quick, fresh, and delicious. I especially love the Bianca and the garlic knots. The salads leave something to be desired, but otherwise I've always had a great experience. Would highly recommend.

We absolutely love coming to Blind Onion. The pizza is 100% always delicious. The service is always phenomenal as well. This time topped all times before though. We sat at the bar with Sarah as our server. Her customer service is phenomenal. But her Caesar salad is even better! She made it special with pesto, onions, feta, and a sweet glaze. BEST SALAD EVER!

Great atmosphere, staff is amazing and the food is great! I'm pretty picky with pizza but we will definitely come back here again before heading back home. The staff is is super friendly and on top of everything. Pizza and Garlic Knots came out quickly and we're delicious. I would give them more stars if I could.

i recently got a medical card and Im going to say the security guards are all a joke, not professional at all. the employees most of all great but a few that are sarcastic some employees they wont say hi when there's a bad day. They ask you sarcastically but i mean weird , you kind of feel uncomfortable but overall the best dispensary with good products.

MY ALL-TIME FAVORITE PIZZERIA IN NASHVILLE!!! I'm a Jersey Girl so I grew up on pizza and love it, so when I stumbled on Five Points... like I found a piece of Heaven! I'm telling you everything is good!

I really enjoyed their pizza both pre- and post covid-19. Granted, they're different experiences, but the pizza still has the same greatness and no compromised on quality both in freshness plus ingredients. 

I think the main reason for my 4 star review opposed to 5 stars is that I feel that customer service can sometimes be a bit wonky. It is hit or miss. Sometimes, it is a great experience and sometimes it is just a bit weird. I find to have better experience than not. 

They have a good beer selection and pizza offerings for any palette. I would push you to try their basic offerings along with the specialties.
Atmosphere was very nice and service was excellent. Food, however, was very mediocre.

My wife and I went to the Blind Onion for the first time today and it was exceptional! We had the Popeye's pizza, which had a delicious white pesto sauce with chicken breast, fresh tomatoes and basil. The service was very friendly and attentive! The ambience was super family friendly with plenty of room for even a very large group. Highly recommended!!

I love M.A.D.! Everyone is friendly and their work is great. My gel nails lasted for a full month and the beautiful design drew so many compliments. I visit Gabriella, but a number of artists have jumped in to help me choose colors and prep my nails. 

Make an appointment and visit this great artists!

Date of Visit:  12/19/19 - When you're getting ready to head out of town for holiday travel, you don't wanna fill your fridge, amirite?  You DO want good eats, and while my kids may like that toga-wearing cardboard pizza, Hubby and I do not.
We've never had a bad pizza from Blind Onion!  We love all the fresh, "grown-up" toppings my kids won't eat, and the fresh ranch cups & honey for the crust is the absolute best way to finish a pizza!
The service has always been friendly, the restaurant is clean and the food is good!  The pies are a little more pricey than the average cheapo pizza, but if quality counts for you, then it's worth it to pay for for it!

The food was great. Curbside service and they were working hard, however no masks or gloves we are older and won't be back because of lack of distancing and no gloves or masks. Wouldn't rate them lower because of this everyone is learning and pizza was a 5 star.

I love love love Mad Nails! I love the ambiance first of all. If you like good vibes and good music, Mad Nails supplies it! The artist are exactly that!! I love trying wild and different designs and Morgan has always topped my expectations! I've tried multiple applications and have maintained healthy nails with each set. I do recommend scheduling your appointment before hand and also give yourself time to find parking. The wait may be long because of their popularity, but it's worth it. Just a heads up, make this a pampering session. Don't be in a rush! Sit back, relax, and watch your hands come to life.
Poor slow service.  Nothing but excuses from management. Seems as though constant drama. Cannot get beers etc.

I've been to several different dispensaries in Philadelphia. Now sometimes this specific location will have some of the better products then others around, but I really do try my best to avoid having to go there due to the fact of how rude most of the staff is. Not all the staff but most! Specifically there is an older gentleman that I've encountered with twice and also overheard him with another customer and he just speaks to everyone on such a smarts as matter. I've also been to that location on two different times where they were busy and anytime they are busy they clearly don't know how to handle it because they get agitated towards their customers and do tend to show it.  
One star and it's only for some or their product

Never again... Lesson learned harshly. I made an appointment almost one month before. I was interested in going to this salon because of the show CLAWS. I had to cancel the appointment and did so with 24 hours. MAD Nails refunded my 20.00 deposit. But, after my 20.00 deposit was refunded MAD Nails promptly disputed the charge and I was left to pay it back through paypal. I will never ever again make an appointment with MAD Nails or for any services ever that require a deposit. This left a very bad taste in my mouth. I feel so used and scammed. I cannot even explain the way I actually feel it just feels awful. But, I'm done with MAD Nails, deposits, beauty services that require a deposit, paypal  and even the show CLAWS. I'm just so done!

Edit- and before anyone has questions I reached out to MAD Nails by phone no answer and also sent a text message and no response.

Reward system is incredibly unclear, causing me to go here twice unnecessarily during a pandemic. For anyone who doesn't know since they don't state it anywhere until you go to redeem, on the 4th visit you must make a full price purchase to redeem your reward points. Rude staff as well, trite/glib attitudes all around.

Went back in and there's more Chinese glass than ever and the kid working there doesn't know any well know American artist to tell you know all they deal with is imports but just go to dhgate.com if you want what this place has for 3 times cheaper

We love Blind Onion Pizza, however the one on Los Altos always has the worst service every time! We usually sit at the bar which at most places has better/quicker service but not at this location. We came here today for a quick beer and slice of pizza. It took the server at least 10 mins to acknowledge us and then she tried giving us beer we didn't even order and forgot to add in our pizza order. I would understand if it was busy, but there were 3 other people at the bar and 2 small parties in the dining room. There were multiple tables still completely dirty. The bar tender has zero personality and has the history channel playing in the bar area. We didn't even get a chance to ask her to change the channel because she never came back to check on us. Needless to say we will not be back :(

Morgan is truly a gem for the city of NOLA. Her nail salon is such an experience from the time you step foot in her establishment. She was so flexible with my last minute request and I am so happy about it because I LOVE my nail designs. She's also quick which is a plus.

I have ordered several times from this location from Uber eats as I do not want to gather in places and am being safe about Covid as my husband has lupus and my grandma is 82. With one 18 inch pizzas and garlic knots and drinks for my family of 5 i was willing to spend the 100 something dollars a few times a month but not now. Uber doesn't give an option for anything in the side and my husband doesn't enjoy pizza unless he can have spicy so I always have to call for a side of jalapeños but now the manager has told me this will be the last time he will accommodate it and I said that I wasn't asking for free and he told me that even so he wouldn't do this again and I said that I wouldn't order again and was told that's fine as they have other customers. I am appalled. My elderly grandmother lives this pizza and is afraid to leave the home . I supported them as they are a local shop and to be treat like this is inexcusable in a world that a lot of restaurants are struggling and we as patrons look to support them .

Omg! This place can't seem to figure out how to charge people for a cheese pizza with extra toppings. Can't order a beef pizza :(. Really!!! The pepperoni pizza is good but my boyfriend can only eat cheese because he doesn't eat pork.

Traveled to Nashville for the Jags game (I don't want to talk about that travesty), and the highlight of my trip was being able to have the veggie slice of the day four days in a row. Large, well crafted slices. Had vodka sauce on it one day. Excellent. Had a habanero sauce with Gorgonzola and pineapples  another day. Really good and pretty spicy. Pesto and jalapeños another day. Delicious. Great space. Great service. I will never travel to watch the Jags again but I may make another trip to Nashville for the pizza.

Hell. Yes.
Fresh and top quality ingredients. Great owners, servers, and pizza makers. 
The owners just added a whole other side to the restaurant, which is just a slice and go side. That side has no tables, just counters. It's open real late, so it's perfect for those late night cravings!

Order 363  5/2/20 at 636pm   Staff member contaminated my food by using her phone, touching her mask and touching her face area before touching and serving my food.   No foodservice gloves or hand washing evident.  Supervisor was standing next to staff member, was fully aware of contamination behaviors, and did nothing to correct or alter.  When I complained, the supervisor refused to talk to me or do anything.  In fact they seemed downright unapologetic and hostile.   Fearing food contamination, I threw away my order as I left the restaurant without a refund.   Just disgusting, dangerous and discomforting situation and service.

Great clean place, with nice people. Great discounts but I'm noticing a price hike of between 5-10 $ in the last few weeks. I know they were looted once, but this pandemic has kept all of us clinically anxious and depressed toking on our shoes, man!  They are probably not suffering so why increase prices?  Not cool.

Highly recommend take-out for a night in! After hanging out all day in Franklin and surrounding distilleries and a late afternoon nap, felt like a night in enjoying a movie in our beautiful vrbo! Salad and garlic knots were both amazing, and pizza was SO good!

I've had this pizza a few times! 

It's always sooooo yummy! No matter what kind you get! They have some very awesome combos!

Service has always been excellent! 

It's a very fun cozy atmosphere :) 

I prefer to eat here when I'm in this part of town, five points never lets me down!

I looked through reviews for "best pizza in Nashville" and Five Points Pizza had many 4 and 5 star reviews.  Maybe I had my hopes too high, or maybe pizza is just that bad in Nashville because if this was as good as it gets, I'll stop looking and give up on finding great pizza here.

Service:  Not very attentive, but it was crowded.  

It was fairly early on a Friday night, not quite 6:00, and the FPP was crowded.  We got one of the last open seats (good thing we only needed to seat 2 ppl).  After a few minutes, our waiter greeted us and gave us water and apparently didn't hear us when we said we were ready to order because he walked away and didn't come back again for about 10 minutes.  Our food, half order of garlic knots and a 14" pepperoni pizza came out in a timely manner.  We didn't see our waiter again until we caught him delivering drinks to a nearby table to tell him we could use some more water.

Food:  I've had better.

Garlic Knots-very good, very garlicky.  Could have used some more butter.
Pizza-Crust was crispy but not very flavorful. I guess my overall impression was meh, it's good but not great.  If all you want is to taste garlic, than this is the place to eat.  Sure, we had a plain jane pepperoni pizza, but come on.  The pizza itself-dough, sauce, cheese should be flavorful; unfortunately, this pizza was just boring.

Chesters Pizza in Fairfield, OH and Papa Leno's in Berea, KY are my pizza and garlic bread benchmarks.  Sorry Five Points, but you didn't come close to measuring up.

I couldn't be happier with the service I received from Acoma Roofing. Every person I came in contact with was courteous, professional and very helpful. They showed up every time they said they would. They were very fast, and cleaned up well, they have a lot of workers. They old saying is true, You get what you pay for. Acoma is worth it! Thank you! 

Lisa Neumann

I truly don't understand why these guys got so many low reviews. I stopped in today as a new patient and was politely and graciously guided through my entire visit from start to finish. All of my questions surrounding the rewards program and perk program were clearly explained. 

I almost didn't stop here at all due to all of the negative things I saw people commenting on. I'm glad I gave them a shot. Whatever issues they had with customer service previously were not present in my visit today.

Will be a return customer. Thanks Liberty!
Always great pizza ! Loud family oriented atmosphere. Their toppings always seem fresh and that crust and honey to dip is amazing. But my favorite is that dill ranch ! Sooo yummy.
Pizza is getting really inconsistent here and depending who is working, seems like they are doing me a favor by taking my order.

40 minutes for pie
15 minutes in line to pick it up
Definitely not NY style
Too Salty, crust was terrible and pepperoni was not good quality.
1hr out of my life I won't get back

We ordered a large Pepperoni Pizza, Arugula Salad and Garlic Knots to go. When we picked up the order it was the wrong pizza, which we noticed as soon as we got back to the car. 

Went back to let them know about the mix up. The person at the window asked why we didn't check our order before we left. He said they have a lot of orders to give out and we should be more careful. 

He reshuffled some orders and couldn't find a Pepperoni Pizza. Then another customer came back with our pizza and the cashier said they mixed up our boxes. He told both of us to pay more attention, in the future. 

Everyone is entitled to a bad day, but that was pretty wild. 

3 stars for otherwise good pizza, salad and garlic knots.

Knocked it out of the park again Five Points Pizza!  This place doesn't disappoint!

The garlic knots are a steal and are a great spilt between a 4 top. Half order is $3?!?

Again, get the meatball pie....it's a sure bet and such a win for pizza lovers!

Go go go!

My first time trying the wings and they were horrible..  lacked flavor and the sauce was not present at all sooo disrespectful to hot wings!! The customer service was nonexistent the young man was trying his hardest it was his first day so he did exceptionally well considering his circumstances. There was a middle age lady who was rude. I won't be returning!!  Buffalo Chicken Fries Combo

Not a good experience. The pizza is okay. Nothing special about it. However, beware a veggie pizza isn't a veggie at all. We asked to change it because it was also very spicy with hardly any veggies at all and the lady who we spoke with responded in a snarky manner when we asked to change it. She pointed at the board and said the ingredients are listed there (like we are somehow supposed to know). Just very pretentious, entitled, and snooty. Not the friendly homey experience at all. Not ever going back again.

Sigh...I wanted this to be good, and we've had good pie from FPP, before, but we ordered the Old World w/ Italian Sausage for take out. They said 18-20 minutes. We were there right on time, but the pie was already lukewarm, had insanely small dollops of tomato sauce with poorly scattered sausage, and the mozzarella certainly didn't seem like it was born from fresh mozzarella balls, but, rather, scattered, shredded mozzarella. This was a simple pie, but we, basically, had to remake it, at home, as we were hungry, and it wasn't worth going all the way back to wait, yet further.

Like others have said the Philadelphia location was great when it first opened. Now, the staff is downright rude and arrogant. For some reason they walk around with a chip on their shoulder and act like your bothering them. They have a "you need us, we don't need you" attitude. Also, there have been multiple occasions where I've ordered something online only to arrive and be told it's out of stock. To top it off, during the snow storm we had in December I ordered online for curbside pickup. When I arrived I was told that curbside pickup was temporarily suspended and I had to wait in a loooong line in freezing cold weather. I expected to pull up as usual and be gone in 5 minutes but instead I had to wait in line for 30 minutes and ended up being late for another appointment I had that day.  I understand that it wasn't safe for the staff to be walking through the snow and ice to get to the cars but they should have updated the website alerting people that curb side pick up was suspended. I politely mentioned this to one of the staff but she acted annoyed and couldn't have cared less. Every time I go it's amateur hour at this dispensary.
Great pizza and from what I've experience great service! Nice staff and solid beer selection. Good location too with many things to do before and after while only parking one time.

The Blind Onion is the best pizza place in the Reno - Sparks area. They offer great specials and a $15 large 1 topping pizza during happy hour 3:30-5:30 7 days a week. 

They have the best pizza crust and have honey on the tables to use as dipping sauce. Their pizza thickness is perfect... not too thick and not too thin. They have plenty of TV's to watch all the games and a great selection on beers. The place is family friendly with ample seating. The staff is super friendly and very attentive. Give me them a try, you won't be disappointed!

The girlfriend brought me out here for date night. "I know you miss it up north, but you gotta believe that there's good pizza south of Ohio!" She was right! Dave's pizza (not stolen from someone named Dave, to be clear) was fantastic. The garlic knots are a breadier than I'm used to, but still fantastic. And a solid beer selection. I'm a little upset about prices, but not enough to keep me away.

4.5 stars because this place deserved it for excellent customer service from all crews. Soda machine was out of Diet Soda and immediately fixed by one of the managers. You can tell that employees love what they are doing hence customers get that great vibe. Thank you Anastasia for your excellent service during our visit. Food was fresh and delicious too.

Stopped in last night on the glowing recommendation of a friend.  I have to say, the pizza was mediocre at best.  We ordered the pizza margherita and the General. Both took an extremely long time to come and the place wasn't half full. From our table we had a good view into the kitchen and the staff seemed more interested dancing around and laughing than actually making pizzas. The pizzas themselves were swimming in sauce and the General had burnt crust.

 Our server, although friendly enough, never came back to let us know the status of our food, nor once it arrived, came back to ask about drink refills.  There were a ton of kids running around through the tables and actually knocked a plate off a neighboring table and it shattered on the floor. Staff just swept it up and no one said a thing to the parents.  Honestly, I can't see how this place gets good reviews. If this is 'good' pizza in Sparks, I'd hate to see what bad is like.

This is a very sad dispensary the people in here will most of the people in here are on a very high horse they talk to you like s*** and then expect you to not do nothing about it I am in process of contacting my lawyer regarding several different issues I've had in this place last week I purchased Salmon River number for RSO pills well when I picked up my order and got outside and open my bag that's not what I've got so I went back in and try to replace them with the correct product that I did select they told me no and that I was stuck with what I had "you bought it and that's what you got".  "Now,  I'm going to have to ask you to leave" in a very rude way I was told. They didn't try to fix my issue they did not try to help me with my issue all they wanted me to do was leave and kept saying it in a very nasty way. This is caused me to feel as though I'm going into a panic attack

Bought a beer while waiting to get a table.  Tried to go outside because didn't want to crowd the door but the hostess told me I could stand outside because of the beer. Then I stood by the door because there was no where else to stand and she came up to me again and was like you can't stand here either. I was starting to get frustrated so I went and stood by the bar but every seat was taken. She came up to me again and said "are you even from here?" In a snarky tone because she obviously wasn't happy with where I was standing for the 3rd time. Got so frustrated that I set my beer down and left. Terrible hospitality. Will not be back.

Above and beyond FANTASTIC!

I truly cannot heap enough well-deserved praise on Cherry Hill Painting.  My husband and I were moving to Mount Laurel after four years in Toronto. We had purchased our house but knew it needed "updating."  We had a narrow window of ten days between closing and move-in dates.  Since the furniture would impede painting, I really wanted to get certain rooms done before we arrived; but that required coordinating everything remotely, including color selection.

From the moment I contacted Doug, I progressed from overwhelmed to hopeful to relieved to overjoyed to grateful.  

Within a week (prior to our move in date -- woo-hoo!), Doug & Team had completed everything on my wishlist: wallpaper stripped, three rooms + two bathrooms painted.

Not being in town, I had no fewer than a dozen sticky obstacles, and Doug & Team conquered one after the other.  At any point, they could have complicated my already-complicated undertaking; instead they completely unburdened me, making my life easier at an especially critical time.

Cherry Hill Painting does exceptional work -- everything looks absolutely gorgeous.  On top of that, the "ease of doing business" with Cherry Hill Painting ratchets them into a category reserved for the best of the best.

Next up...  I'm hiring Doug & Team to paint my foyer. :)

This place is great! This was our first time in and we will definitely be back. We are new to Sparks and have been exploring the area for good food. The Blind Onion has a great selection of beers, wine and hard seltzers.  Their baked wings where really good we had them tossed in honey garlic. Also had garlic cheese bread and chicken ceasar salad. Everything was amazing!! Wish they had a dry rub for the wings but otherwise no complaints. Highly recommended!!

Blind onion pizza is only like 5 minutes drive from my home and I just visited this location in 2018. Shame on me!! I had their pizza before, but I just became a huge fan of it this year. 

The Place:
The restaurant is located in Sparks in a shopping center. There is plenty of parking. They have bar and table seating. Their menu is mainly pizza, but they also have wings, sandwich, salads, and paninis. They offer wine, beer, and sodas to accompany the pizza. When you dine in the restaurant, the tables have a big jar of honey to dip the borders in.  

The Food:
I have their pizzas and they are really good. I love their Hawaiian pizza with Canadian bacon, pineapple, and red onion Y-U-M-M-Y!! 
During my last visit, I had the "General pizza" it is like a combination type. It was really good. I saved my borders and ate them with honey, loved it!
I like to have my pizza with a glass of Cabernet or a beer. 

The Service:
Service is great! They have this a super nice server called Kiara; she is really sweet, attentive, and hard-working.
Kiara always takes good care of us, brings us whatever we need in a timely manner.

Overall, a lovely restaurant and delicious pizza! 4.4 Stars.
Great for both dine in or to-go orders.
Tried this pizza joint and I have to say it's really good pizza, full of fresh topings and really saucey it a great place to hang out and enjoy a slice or order a whole.

Everything here is yummy. You can split your pie with two different toppings! The garlic knots are the best. They also have a great selection of unique beers and ciders. Service is friendly and fast, but it's a smaller place, so expect a wait, or grab your pizza or slice to go next door!

Pro - Pizza was good!  That's about it.

Con- Everything else!  Service was horrible!  Sat for almost 20 mins before someone gave us cups for the soda fountain.  40 mins before someone came by to check on us, and brought us our food.  The appetizer, which should have came out first, was luke-warm.  Which means it sat there for a while.  Pizza was warm but not hot, so same deal.

Unless you're a large party or sat close to the front counter, don't expect service.  Food was good, but just not worth it.

A friend and I  stopped in for drinks and once again Kerry was working the bar.  Kerry is amazing, he is attentive and funny...he also is an amazing bartender, I was not sure what I wanted, just knew I wanted something fruity, Kerry made me an amazing drink, that was both refreshing and fruity.  I will definitely make this a favorite go to spot
Yum yum yum!!!!  It's the best pizza in Nash Vegas!  Get the special or get traditional pepp. You can't lose!!! The get four stars because of claustrophobic atmosphere.

We've been enjoying Five Points Pizza since 2019 and it truly is our favorite pizza spot in Nashville. The quality ingredients make their delicious pizza and garlic knots perfect every time! The marinara is the tastiest sauce! I could eat it with a spoon (shoot I sometimes do!!) We love y'all. Keep up the awesome work.

This place used to be amazing.  Totally worth the money and parking hassle.  Not tonight. Hopefully it's an off night because this is usually our go to place.  Tonight, quality of ingredients and quantity of toppings was subpar to be kind.  Cheese tasted different, more oily.  Super Bianca barely had any vegetables or ricotta cheese.  It was all garlic and mozzarella.  We may give it one more try otherwise I guess they are banking on the tourists....

I don't really expect much from McDonald's but I do think they should offer the products that are advertised and that they have available.  I asked for a vanilla shake and that was fine but when I asked for a shamrock shake I was told they didn't have them.  I'm unsure for shamrock shakes are made (is it something added to a vanilla or does it require an entire new machine and mixture?).  Regardless I watched as someone sitting in a mobile order pick up spot was handed their shamrock shake after being told they didn't have any.  I asked the associate if it had literally just broken before I asked for one since the other customer was being handed one right then and she looked surprised and gave some roundabout excuse.

   I understand that some things are harder to make or a pain for the workers but it is an offering and advertised everywhere.  If you were actually out I would understand but blatantly lying and then doubling down is rude, unprofessional, and horrible customer service.

If you're here looking for a review on the rest of my order... the food was mediocre at best as most McDonald's are - thrown together and sitting under a heat lamp slowly becoming the cardboard from whence it was created.  I do frequent McDonald's on rare occasions but being lied to (to my face) is new.

At first everything was great but then I met the bartender forest. The guy did nothing but judge me. I'm a very open minded, good looking, young dude and I just wanted to hang with some other gay guys that understood where I was coming from. This guy treated me like shit. He wouldn't serve me a drink after 4 hours because I had too many. 3 drinks in 4 hours, yeah I'm a real boozer. If you don't believe me then go in and order drinks from him. He should be fired. Jerk.

We were (yet again) looking for a late-night place to grab some food after a long day near where we were staying in Nashville.  We decided to try Five Points based on their great reviews.  

We went to the dining room side and ordered a meat pizza with garlic knots and garden salad.  The pizza toppings were high-quality and the pizza was perfectly cooked.  The garlic knots were ok (I realize that this may not be a popular statement as everyone else on Yelp raves about them).  The salad was fresh and a great addition to the oil and carbs of the knots and pizza.  

The service was exceptional and we didn't realize that we had gotten into the dining room right before they closed.  We apologized to our waiter, who said it was no problem and he didn't mind staying a bit longer.

Don't miss out on Five Points Pizza if you are in the area.

I just don't get the hype. I want to, but it's just ok. I've given it a fair shot- it's just not that good. There is better pizza elsewhere throughout the city at a better price point. Worst part is the lines, wait for pizza when it's just not worth it for bland, thin pizza that always seems to be missing something. Garlic knots are clutch but marinara seems to be missing something. If you're a boring person, you'll probably love this place and think of it as flavortown. If you want good pizza: 312 Pizza or Night Train.

Well as one of the residents have said to me many times. The pizza here is like the best addiction you could ever have, and you crave this pizza at all hours of the night. I really like their fresh ingredients & unique pizza style. I had the garlic basil. Absolutely loved it. It's got this great hometown feel & it's perfect for a quick pizza fix or a date night. It feels like it's been around forever but the pizza always feels like it's new & different. Probably thanks so much for being apart of the Nashy community!!!!!
OMG!!! The BEST pizza of my entire LIFE! EVERY time I visit the Reno Area I eat at the Blind Onion. Excellent bar full bar too. Super nice & efficient staff.

What's better than pizza and beer ? Answer: pizza and beer with more pop culture commentary than Alec Trebek could handle! The pizza is out of this world and the staff is exemplary. I've never met a bartender I didn't like, but John is one of the greats.
Always yummy! I'm a simp so I get the the 14" pepperoni pie! But I love it and it's perfect the next day on 350 in the oven for a few minutes!
This place has gone down hill.  The last three times I've been there the pizza was horrible and so has the staff.  Three strikes your out.....

After a night out in downtown, my girlfriends and I came here for some late night eats. There were a good amount of people here even at 2 AM, so you know this place must be good.  Late at night, they only do a pick up window so you can only eat outside. Also they didn't offer whole pies but instead offer slices of 3 choices (cheese, pepperoni, and some other one... I forgot but it was a fancy expensive slice lol). It was a little pricey for a slice ($4-ish) but they were pretty big and very tasty. It was definitely comparable to a NY pizza slice as it is on thin crust, has simple ingredients, and oh so yummy. I would definitely come back here for some late night pizza munchies in Nashville.

In what seemed to be a never-ending car repair saga, my trusty Subie was not functioning normally. After a shaking steering wheel that required all my strength to keep the car in control, I pulled into Lithia Motors on a Saturday evening, plans shot, hoping to just park the car and save my life and others on the road. To say the least, I was a little hysterical but Drew calmed me right down, asked specific questions about the car's performance, and asked to see it. I waited in the lobby and much to my surprise, they did a diagnostic and put the car up on the lifts, right before the shop closed on Saturday night. His guess was a bad CV joint or wheel bearings. He explained the pricing clearly and assured me that my car wasn't a disaster and they could get to the bottom of things.I got a call early Monday morning that the car was fixed (replaced CV joint). The car drove better than it did off the dealer's lot when I picked it up. An amazing job, fair price, and top-line customer service. My Subie and I are up for more adventures thanks to the incredible skill and expertise of Lithia Subaru.

One star:

Experience with the company.  Called the place, asked if they repair double shingles roof.  The phone rep said they do.  Did some venting and explaining my frustration with many other roofing companies about how hard it was.  Then I asked, "do you do service near Busch Blvd and North Blvd?"  The rep told me they do not service that area.

No service could be established with them.  That is the reason for the one star rating.  No rating for an actual service can be written about.
