New York style pizza in Nashville?! I was so excited to try this place in hopes that it would answer my native New England era pizza needs, and it did! 

FPP offers pizza by the slice or by the pie. They also have a daily meat and veggie slice. We opted for a traditional pepperoni pizza and a slice of their daily meat pizza, which was pepperoni/meatball/red onion. The pepperoni was SPICY but I have tolerance for that so I really enjoyed it! The crust on the pizza was good and thin, but a little undercooked for my liking. The specialty meat slice was also enjoyable. 

My favorite part of the meal was the garlic knots - you HAVE to try them! Garlicky, just greasy enough, with a delicious marinara dipping sauce...mmmmm. 

Definitely worth a stop if you're in East Nashville!

Pizza is pretty good but really turned off by the rude host. We were on a 45 minute wait so my sister went to buy a beer and we decided to stand outside against the window because the place is packed. The host came out and said we couldn't stand out there so we moved inside by the door. Apparently we couldn't stand there either and she made us move towards the bar. Every seat was taken, so we were waiting for someone to get up. The SAME host comes over for the third time and looks at us and rudely says, "are you even from here?" and rolls her eyes. I was taken aback because I have probably lived in Nashville longer than she has. My sister left her full beer on the bar and we ended up leaving cause that was ridiculous. Why didn't she tells us where we could stand in the first place instead of shuffling us around the restaurant and then getting annoyed at us. Get better staff five points! I'm a host at a popular restaurant in Nashville so I totally understand the stress of the job but I would NEVER talk down to a customer like that.

Mmmmmm the meatball pizza is sublime and the cheese just melts in your mouth, you get plenty, I always order the large deluxe and sometimes I'll have a few slices left over to take home, lol sometimes but typically none is left over, that's how good it is.  Check it out, you'll see.  Customer service is great too!

Eh, it's alright after 11pm.  I am not a fan of the air puffed crust.  It reminds me of cheap pizza, like Papa John's or Chucky Cheese.  Maybe it's great to those who love New York style, but I am not a fan.  
The staff is great and the beer is good.  However, I have yet to find a good pizza place in Nashville.

Came here on Thursday and had a large happy hour one topping pizza and if im being honest it was pretty good. I had some friends with me and they thought it was good aswell. There happy hour is 3:30-5:30 and only $15 for a large with any one topping. I think its a good deal for such a nice sized pizza. It was 12 slices and fed me and all my friends. Definitely coming here agian.

We have gone to this location 3 times now and have had a great time on all visits.  The pizza is great.  They have beers that you don't really see at every bar and are delicious.  Every time we sit down we are greeted by more than one person.  We never have to wait for our drinks to be refilled.  Every one is very friendly and we have never had to wait that long for our pizza.  Also, it's in a great price range.  We usually get out of there for about $32 for a medium pizza and two large beers.  I will be going back for sure, delicious!

I am not a pizza fanatic. Sure, I love a good slice on occasion, but I am typically underwhelmed by pizza in general. Five Points may be the place that changes that for me. I don't live in Nashville, but I'm close enough that I travel often, and have for almost all of my life. Somehow, I've managed to be in Nashville more times than I can count, but I had never ventured over to Five Points until recently. The pizza we ordered was so simple, yet so amazing. It seemed like there was almost nothing to it, yet it was so fresh and flavorful. My beef with pizza is I think all pizza sauce tastes the same. I found myself eating this pizza and not hating the sauce, or anything about it, for that matter. I appreciate a good pizza without all the frills, and that's exactly what I got. There is a 100% chance we will be visiting again soon.

Fantastic.  I look forward to going back and trying other options on the menu.  House salad was large enough to be shared.  A half order of garlic knots brought us an order of of 4 very large knots, covered in garlic, and a side of marinara.  They were fantastic.  Pizza was great.  I went the easy route of just plain cheese, but I look forward to more creative orders in the future.

Everyone said this place is great and they were right.  Only suggestion, if you are dining in, try to get there before 6pm or there will be a wait.  Regardless, I would have waited if I needed to.

Ok. So what can you say about a McDonalds? What I will say is on Monday October 10th 2016 @1:41 in the afternoon they have a kid working behind the counter that needs one of two things. 1) A good old fashioned out to the woodshed for a come to Jesus meeting or 2) See ya you're fired. The food was on par with a McDonalds, the place is clean but the ownership of this location needs to pick their front of the house representatives a lot better. Ugh! This kid is something else.

We have a wonderful friend Arnie from Charleston that said this was a must try pizza place so we of course took his advice!  The pizza slices are absolutely delicious!  Thin crispy crust that doesn't flop which makes me happy!  Highly recommend!
Perfection. We have been twice now. Great service and the food is the best.

Five Points Pizza, the name literally speaks for itself. This is honestly the best pizza in Nashville. 1. It's convenient. 2. It's creative and absolutely delicious 3. Open late night so it makes for a great place to go for a night out 4. They're slices are huge and only $5 for the classic toppings and 5. It's authentic 

Ha! Did you see what I did there? 5 points lol.

Literally blown away by this place! 

I was with a group of 8 so we thought pizza would be a safe bet, and this place was close to our rental. 

I love that they have a meat and veggie pizza of the day, it makes this simple and it's nice to change things up. I ordered the veggie pizza of the day and my sister and I split the greek salad. 

The salad was SO good. I was not expecting it to be so fresh and delicious since salads tend to be lackluster at a pizza place. 

The veggie pizza was perfectly thin with crispy crust. Great cheese to sauce ratio and the veggies mixed so well together. The balsamic on top was the real star. 

We wanted to go back before we left but didn't have time. Add this place to your Nashville list ASAP!

After reading the reviews I should have known better than to even try to book a stay at this place. We met with a representative from the hotel at a bridal Expo, and in December set aside 10 rooms for a block for my wedding that was in February. After having reserved a room myself and about 10 of my family and friends (several of my family members who are coming in from out-of-state) I get a call from the Marriott stating that they overbooked and they don't have room for any of us. This was only TWO weeks before my wedding. They put us at another hotel which was 20 some minutes away from where I was getting married 40 minutes from my home when they're Hotel was only 7 minutes. I went as far as to try to file a complaint with corporate  all they did was forward the complaint back to the manager at the hotel that I had already spoke with. The corporate complaint didn't even warrant a phone call to me I guess, because all they did was reiterate the same email that I had gotten before. 0 Stars if I could leave the review without marking any

This spot is YUMMY. Got this pizza after the bars one night as it is right around the five points / East nashville bars. The pizza was medium sized and the toppings were amazing. We also got a calzone with a ton of cheese which was equally as great. Would definitely recommend if you are looking for good pizza in the area!

Good option for pizza by the slice in the East End. They have super late hours open until at least 1am every night!

A slice of cheese will run you just $3.25 while their more signature flavor prosciutto & basil is $5. They do sell full pizzas, as well, but it seems like most just pop in for a slice or two.

Even better, on weekdays between 2-6pm they do a happy hour special! Slice of any pizza and a pint for $8. Or for just $5, a slice of cheese or pepperoni and a PBR Tall Boy. Hipster dream!

You can take it to go, sit inside or order at their little window. All good options and you'll almost always find some people dining inside.
Pizza here is always good. Nuff said. They have a wide range of pizza and all of them exceed our expectations. Always hot even when you pick up laer than 10-20mins.
Always a favorite and close to home. Fresh flavorful toppings and variety. I have eaten there multiple times. Highly recommended!

We had the specials for the day. Huge slices, super fresh pizzas, and fast turnaround. It was good pizza, just no great. I tend to like a sloppy New York style, but again it was still super fresh.. a little overpriced tho- two slices for $10.  I think it's simply just up to what you prefer.

I went last Saturday. Everyone was polite. Quickly moved through the process. However, the fries were lacking. I feel like maybe they spilled out or something and there wasn't time to refill the container. I was in a rush and never went back. And probably won't be back.

Always a great time at five points pizza!

Been here twice and had a fantastic time each time. We ordered a variety of their pizzas the Hot Hawaiian was my favorite but trust me it gets very spicy. Similar to the "Hot" flavour at Hattie B's. Pizza is well made and super tasty here!

There is a decent amount of seating. For larger groups you may have to wait a while. We waited around 15 minutes for a table of 6. The servers are super prompt and changed our plate a couple of times. 

Prices are also amazing. Expect to spend around $10 per person before tip.

Ok I am so surprised I have never reviewed this place as this is my go to pizza spot!!  The staff is amazing, food phenomenal and the beer is so expected good beer!!  Kerry might just be the most amazing server, order taker, multi tasker and ultimate friendly person I know!!  They are doing everything they can to enforce social distracting and keeping everyone safe.  Love this place and their amazing pizza, wings and beer!!

Went to the East Nashville location, which has a great vibe to it.  Millennial pulse, action on the streets, and a cool urban feel.  The pizza is the best in Nashville. Period.  Only thing that resembles pie from up North.  No need to write a 1000 word review.  If you want the best, come here.

Definitely the best pizza in Nashville. There's often a really long wait for dinner (especially on weekends) but you can call ahead to pick up a pie or just grab a drink nearby while you wait for a table. There's also the slice window which is great. The South Brooklyn pizza is my favorite by far. They also have a good beer selection. I think this location has better food than the location on Charlotte.

My husband and I have not been out in a while and I was craving this pizza so bad!!!! I love this specific restaurant. The manager Tiffany is amazing and her staff is very friendly. It's clean and everyone is helping each other make things smoothe. The food was amazing as usual. Love this place

Decent pizza. I've had better for the price. But overall everyone raves about this place so I'm sure it's just a matter of preference. New York style pizza. Huge buy per slice option or full pizzas. Great east nashville location. The garlic knots are good! :)

This restaurant needs some serious staff retraining and professional management oversight. Many staff are friendly and the fast food is great 75% of the time  But the entire restaurant suffers from chronic under cleaning and attention.  And the men's bathroom is abysmally dirty and unsanitary ALL THE TIME.    I have seen the owner or top manager there when this bathroom is a mess and NOTHING GETS DONE...they leave without dealing with it.
Hands down the best pizza in Nashville! Great salad and a great selection of craft beers.

I hired Cherry Hill Painting to repaint the shutters and front door of our new house as soon as we bought it. They were here within days of closing and did a beautiful job from start to finish. Some snow interfered with our schedule but Linda communicated with me every day about when they planned to return and they still finished the job before Christmas, in time for all of our out-of-town family. The crew was extremely professional, polite and I hardly noticed they were on our property. They cleaned up after themselves every night and the finished product is outstanding - our house looks like a completely different home. Reasonable pricing, quick response time and an overall very pleasant experience. I look forward to working with them again and highly recommend.

Really yummy pizza and the pickup process during covid has been solid and safe. We order from here once a week and their pies always taste fresh and delicious, they don't cut corners on quality! Get a Dave's pie you won't regret it.

Trying to supporr local businesses during these times, but apparently this one doesn't need any business. Called multiple times to place a takeout order as their website shows no dining in.  Called several times no answer and 2 hang ups then put on hold for over 8 mins. Other local places that truly want and appreciate your business.

Do not go to this lions choice because there is no drive thru.And if you have someone that is so so crazy in the car and just wanted to get it. You have to go inside to order.  Which takes forever. But the  food is okay. And the place didn't have a lot of parking spots.  But that's because barley anyone was there.

Me and my fiancé sat at the bar and we were lucky enough to have 2 people help us out. Cara and Josh were awesome, super friendly and not just to us, to everyone which was cool to see. They treated everyone like they were a regular and just wanted everyone to enjoy their time while there. Plus Josh also changed the channel on the bar TV from NCAA basketball to the Warriors/Sixers and I got watch them actually win one! Go Warriors!

I mean I'll eat it, It tastes okay, but I don't like eating here when I know I can get better NYC pie somewhere else. If you want real deal NYC pizza, checkout Joeys House of Pizza. They are the only ones with real NYC pizza in or around Nashville.

We waited 20 minutes and were never served drinks or anything else. The waitress walked past the table at least a dozen times. Never got "I'll be right with you" or "can I get your drink order." We finally just walked out, obviously they don't need our business.

We love this place and have been many times since moving to Nashville several months ago. The pizza is a huge and delicious New York style thin crust. They offer tons of toppings and it never takes very long for your pizza to bake. The garlic knots are garlicky without swimming in sauce and soft on the inside with an outside crisp. I would recommend a half order if you don't want to bring home leftovers. They offer an excellent variety of local beers and ciders. Bearwalker and Diskin have become some of our favorites because of this place. It's a large space with decor suspiciously similar to Mellow Mushroom, but less hippie themed. There's a small parking lot with a parking garage in the back and I've never had a problem getting a spot. 

There are some downsides, but the fact that I'm still saying they deserve five stars should tell you how good the pizza is. They don't deliver to their neighborhood which is very odd for a pizza joint, but I guess with their popularity they don't feel the need to. You can use a third party delivery service, but from my experience that's an awesome way to pay a ton of money for cold food. Severs are polite enough and do their job, but they are typically aloof and aren't the type to go out of their way to offer a great experience. I know this is an odd complaint, but on our first visit a customer dropped a glass parmesan shaker and ever since all the tables have the cheap plastic ones. They're near impossible to use and make the place feel cheap like a Chuck E. Cheese. All in all I'd say this is the best and most consistent food I've found in Nashville so far. If their staff were a bit more personable and knew the menu better I'd say this was a solid five star pizza place. As it is I think the current four and a half rating they have is just right.

Love this place! It's a no frills neighborhood bar and grille. The prices are good and it's the kind of place you can just kick back in. Really good drinks and burgers as well as a good selection of craft beer. 

The servers and bar tenders are super sweet and there's a huge parking lot. What more can you ask for!

We used to go here a lot but it's not as good anymore. We always like the baked wings, as the MENU says they come with carrots and celery, but we never seem to get them. One time we asked and they said yes they do come with the wings "You just have to ask!!!" Well once again NO CELERY AND CARROTS!! Come on people, simple and on the menu.

Not my first time, I like the Onion. First time Post Covid19 to their Victorian Square. Discovered they have a happy hour pizza and drafts special 3:30 to 5:30 and I found out Sunday at 7pm is open mike  free comedy night! Loved the pizza, and it's fun to meet comedians before they get funny.

I just tried out Spread Bagelry for the first time today. I believe this is one of their newer locations. I placed a pickup order for the Nova Classic Sandwich on a whole wheat everything bagel. The store is very clean and organized with a modern interior. The staff was friendly. I was able to pick up my order right on time. My first impression of the bagel sandwich in the bag was bigger than your typical bagel, and boy I was right. I was pleased with the toasted bagel, though I wished there was a little less onion and to have it diced instead of sliced so it's less likely to fall out of the sandwich. The nova lox tasted great, but I also think some capers would take the sandwich to the next level.
I ordered their hot buffalo wings today and they were perhaps the best I've ever had. Also on Tuesdays they are 69 cents each.

First off, I don't know how they did it, but the beer there tastes better than anywhere I've ever had beer on tap, and I've been to plenty of places that just opened.

The pizza - decent tasty toppings, seemed a little healthy feeling. Not sure if they didn't use oil or baked the fat right out of it or what but it felt like it needed a braising with some olive oil to reduce the slightly crackery texture. Not bad mind you, just a pizza that makes you want water shortly after. The pizza was solid, enjoyable, not quite perfected but feeling like they're on the right path (had some of theirs before they opened and thought they were on the wrong path then). $22 for a large pie you won't be ashamed of, that will work.

The garlic knots - there are only two places I have been in Nashville that I've had garlic knots that were almost right. This is one of them. Main complaint is the ones I used to love in NY universally had chunks of fresh garlic pasted on by butter or something... mmm... 5 Points had the knot part solid, but the garlic was a little underwhelming.

As we went to pay we noticed the checkbooks were provided by Discover.. I should have known we were in an alternate reality at that point... I was trying to pay with my American Express and was told they did not accept them. I'm completely used to places not wanting to take AMEX, but to take Discover... it was like I was paying in the mid to late nineties... k-razy.

Pizza survived the night with no refrigeration, tasted quite decent the next day. This is perhaps 3 steps away from being the best pizza I've ever had, however these are some significant steps, but I think they're heading in the right direction.

Place appeared to be kid friendly, and the waiters were cool.
My wife and I frequent FPP at least 3 times a month, take-out of course during the pandemic but often dine-in before that. South Brooklyn, Bianca, Pepperoni are the favorites.

Some background, our HOA hired this company to re-roof our townhouse buildings - 20 buildings, 114 units.  I did not choose this company, but as a property owner my HOA payments helped pay them - which I am certain must have been a half million dollar contract.

Nails littered the yard and sidewalks, and they were not cleaning up between working day to day.  I have dogs and worried for their safety stepping on these loose nails.

Their crew had 10 generators on site, but they were still pulling drop cords into my porch and plugging in to my power.  (My electric bill is paid by me, not the HOA.) These crews make a huge mess, they don't clean up said mess in a timely manner, and they don't fix what they damage.  Not to mention the fact that they are stealing electricity, too?  Not a fan.  Not a fan at all.

Reno has so many good restaurants now that I kind of forget about the staples, like Blind Onion.  I helped a friend move yesterday and naturally we needed food after so our party of 6 headed to the Spanish Springs Blind Onion...I didn't even know such a thing existed...but let's be real if you don't live in Sparks you have ZERO clue what's going on out there...sorry tangent over...back to the experience.
We were greeted IMMEDIATELY and told to sit anywhere we like.  We were a party of 6 and to my surprise, they had a few tables already made up for large parties.  Huge plus.  We grabbed a table and perused the menu when only a moment later the gentleman that told us to have a seat came over with drinks cups and let me rudely order an appetizer before he asked.  In my defence I was HANGRY, did I mention we just finished moving?  The server went to put my order in whilst we decided what kind of pizza to get.  He came back over to tell me that they didn't have the pesto garlic chips I'd ordered....adn then do you know what he did? He snickered!  Because he was kidding.  I refrained from killing him and laughed at his joke.  It's been a good long while since I've had a server with some personality!
We ordered a Veggie, a Hawaiin, and an Alfredo and ALL of them were amazing.  They seriously have the best crust in town.  I know they give you honey for it but this girl firmly believes that pizza and ranch are best buds that can't be broken up.  Plus, their ranch has dill in it.  It's unexpected and quite tasty.  
Our party of 6 was pleased as punch with zero complaints.  Service, quality, atmosphere, EVERYTHING rocked!

I have had many awesome experiences at this salon. The nail artists are extremely talented and Apres nail extensions are my go to (they last longer than acrylic and don't have the chemicals either!). I'm looking forward to my next visit!

I have been a five points fan for a long time and it's our goto place for some of the best pizza in Nashville. The garlic knots are my wife's favorite. They are always fresh and the marinara sauce is so fresh it can not be beat. We order extra because it's just that good. The pizza dough has great flavor and is crisp their red sauce is fresh and has a ton of flavor. My favorite is the Margarita pizza with fresh mozzarella it's and amazing combination.

I think the quality of the ingredients was good, and the menu had good options. Pricing seemed a little high ($46 with taxes and delivery/tip). Don't do delivery, just go there.

I have been going to the walk up window for a while but eating inside is SO much better! We got the garlic knots. They were huge! We then got a large pizza and split it between the Bianca and the supreme. Both were very delicious! I enjoyed the Bianca more!

After attending a YELP event at the Blind Onion in Sept. of 2016 and meeting one of the owners Dean Christopher, I find that I am becoming a Pizza Connoisseur. I have always just thought that pizza was just that pizza. There are a variety of items to consider when deciding great pizza.

There is the regionality (New York, Chicago etc.), crust thin or thick, sauce, cheese, toppings etc. These are the things you need to think about and decide for your self what your favorites are and then you to can become a pizza connoisseur. 

I do prefer a thinner crust to a thicker crust. But I found that I was craving Blind Onion and there unusual idea of dipping the crust into honey. Dipping honey on Pizza crust sounds like a cultural Mediterranean idea. Who knows where it started. It may sound odd but believe it or not it does become something you crave. This is the only thick crust pizza I really like it and the only one I dip into honey. The crust looks almost braided and make the pie appear more appetizing. 

This Restaurant is located in Sparks Crossing Shopping center. It has a very quaint and happy feel to it. Location is clean and easy to find. They have their own specials how ever we all have our favorites and mine is Hawaiian. I have yet to eat at the restaurant here. I ordered take out and the waitress was friendly. 

My daughter is dairy free and so they were kind enough to substitute spinach for the cheese. It was a super yummy pizza this way.

As for the review , let's starts with something short:

Price : about $4.50 per slice 
Costumer service: friendly (they don't bite)
Variety: many (however,don't expect after midnight)
Payment: cash and credit card 
Parking : street (free)
Hour: restaurant closed early but window pick up usually open extra late
Must get : prosciutto and basil/ vegetables 

More details version : 
As we were carving for a good slice to sit on the alcohols, knowing five point is a must get from the local. Since we were around the strips , the windows pick up section is actually Open till 1am just not the restaurant itself(However, do recommend to double check by calling them before you head over there). 

Midnight pizza is perfect but only with one issue, that many others flavors are sold out by then. We were trying to also order the signature item (the garlic breads) which it was gone already (I did went back for it !) 

Anyway, we got the prosciutto pizza, pepperoni and vegetable, it was all amazing: thin, cheesy with just the perfect amount of ingredients with no greasy drip. The crust was thin but still had a chewing texture to it. 

The garlic breads looks like a regular size cinnamon buns, where you can place a order of 4 pieces or 8, we had 5 girls in the group and we only finish one box with 8, which is quite filling . 

Overall our experience are good and we see why we should get a slice from five point.

Pizza is good but the service is terrible.  I have brought my kids in a few times and you can tell they don't like kids in their restaurant. They try to discourage people with kids from coming in. They treated us like garbage because of our kids. Don't believe me?  Bring your kids in and see what happens.

Five points is AMAZING. My top 5 in Nashville for sure. They don't, however, have anything for keto or gluten free folks. No wings and no gluten free crust options. But the pies are killer, the knots are awesome, and the beer is excellent. There is no free parking that I know of, the place is small inside, and there can sometimes be an extremely long wait. But if you can get in when it isn't busy, it's worth a stop. Also keep in mind five points is on the more expensive side. But tasty!!

Friends and I got pizza by the slice as a snack.  One was cheese and one was 'meat lovers' which was bacon, onion and jalapeno. Not sure how that is meat lovers, but ok.  I'm not a huge bacon fan (hubs ordered the slice) so I took all the jalapenos and gave him all the bacon and most of the onion.  The crispness of the crust, flavor the sauce and cheese was about as good as it gets.  If I were local, I'd totally come back and try different slices, pies, etc, I can tell the underlying quality is there.
One of the best pizza joints around. Just wish there were more options. Great location also. Near some local bars.

Shame on me for not reading the reviews. The staff was friendly, the room was nice except tHe mold in the tile grout. The hIghway noise was incredible loud and lasted all night. It is impossible to sleep through. I feel deceived not being made aware,  highly unethical practice of this chain.

There was only one other client present during my appointment whom was literally on the other side of the salon. I felt very safe from their Covid protocols to sanitation of their tools. Everything was opened in front of me. Used tools never placed with new items even if from the same new pack.

The Parking here suck ass, but there pizza is top notch. one of my favorite pizza places in Nashville. Giant slices, a bit of a wait, but totally worth it. If your new to Nashville check this place out.
Best pizza in East Nashville if not all of Nashville. Plenty of options for everyone tastebuds. Garlic notes are a must.

What a welcomed meal after days of strictly southern cuisine!! Split a house salad, half order of garlic knots, and a slice of prosciutto with basil and a slice of pepperoni. 

The garlic knots are for those who love garlic (aka, my people) and as I ate each garlicky piece, I hoped the garlic would work some magic in my gut and body, helping to clear all the lard from my arteries. At the very least, I knew it would smell out of my pores later and I felt bad for my future airplane seatmate. Didn't stop me from grabbing every piece of garlic off the plate! 

The salad is quite large and a meal in itself so I was glad we split that. I was quite full already after the half salad and one knot but I powered through and ate one more knot and all pizza because I'm not a quitter and make somewhat questionable eating choices. There was plenty of toppings on the different pizza slices so you could get some goodness in every bite. I appreciated that nothing was skimped on! Our water cups never ran empty, which was much appreciated because I needed the hydration to battle the humidity. 

We left extremely full and it was all less than $20 before tip. Not a bad deal!!
They have social distancing down! Thanks for always being there for my late nights you guys!

Acoma Roofing provided excellent service and demonstrated that they are a company that can be relied on and trusted. Their work ethic is highly commendable and their integrity was clearly noticeable. I needed some roof repairing done after a recent storm and there was an issue on both sides of my house. Acoma realized that part of the issue was their doing, but part of it was not. While they could have charged me to fix the problematic area that was not their doing, they completed a complete roof repair free of charge. I've shared a bit of my story to illustrate the strong word and guarantee of Acoma Roofing. If a customer has an issue or is not satisfied, they will go above and beyond to resolve any problem or concern and are beyond fair in their response. Ivan, Hiva, and Ryder were super helpful, considerate, and delivered exceptional service. I highly recommend Acoma Roofing's services and would certainly use them again.

This gym is awesome! Great workouts and a great way to meet friends/neighbors. The coaches really care about the members and take safety very seriously. Everything is scalable and it's at totally judgement free zone. I'm an athlete who has been in great shape and not so great shape, and this gym has been a really welcoming place to get from the latter to the former. The coaches make it really easy to scale if you're having an off day or if you're injured. The members make it fun to push yourself a little harder! Highly recommend this gym for all ages and skill/fitness levels.

Well this evening I am very sad....I ate for the last time at Five Points Pizza. After 6 1/2 yrs living in Nashville, it is time to go home to Charleston, WV...what started out as a 3yr contract lasted 6 1/2 yrs...and I fell in love with this pizza establishment. I remember the very first day we stumbled across the doorstep of this great pizzeria!!

Tony and I was out exploring our new city and we found Five Points and fell in love with the neighborhood. Then we found the best restaurant in the city...and have been coming back about every 2 months. We live on the other side of town, so we have to fight traffic and travel about 20-25 minutes one way passing tons of restaurants to get here. We have stood in line down the sidewalk waiting for a table in the cold drizzling rain just to have some hot buttery Garlic Knots. I always order a slice each of the special pizza of the day. There is always a meat and a veggie...and I get one of each. 

Tonight for my farewell to Five Points Pizza dinner I had a cold soda, a slice of the Sausage, Jalapeno, Red Peppers and Vodka Sauce and a slice of the veggie with Artichoke, Spinach, Mushrooms, Garlic, Mozarrella and Feta with oil base no sauce pizza..both AWESOME...
Noel went with her usual go to Pepperoni ( 2 slices) and a Abita Rootbeer of course !!! and Tony had a Pepperoni slice and 2 PBR's and we shared a large order of the Garlic Knots with Marinara sauce...

I didn't want to leave!! I will truly miss this Pizza Place..hate to call it a pizza joint...but I am one of their biggest fans and if I am ever again in the area, MY FIRST STOP will be FIVE POINTS PIZZA....the best in Nashville !!!!!

Dear Five Points:  FOOD ALLERGIES ARE NOT A JOKE!!!   Based on the Yelp ratings, we decided to drive 25 minutes to try their vegan pizza.   I have food allergies, and vegan pizza is within my safe, non-dairy diet.   I told the waiter that my allergies were severe and he assured me that our order would be safe.   Several minutes later, he returned to tell us that the cooks had declined the order because the cooler had broken the night before and, as a result, they were using a substitute dough which contained milk.   Almost at the same time, our appetizer was delivered, which we therefore had to refuse.   Within a minute or two, he returned to the table to report that the cooks had 'joked' to him about the milk, and that all of the food in our order was safe.   I am sorry, but a restaurant should take food allergies seriously.   We asked to speak with the manager, who reiterated that it was all a joke.  Food allergies are not a joke, and we could not trust a kitchen staff who would treat any food allergy as such to not add a bit of the offending ingredient as another 'joke'.  Food allergies cannot to be taken lightly, and the management and staff there clearly need training in food allergy safety and customer service.  We left and enjoyed an excellent, allergy-safe meal at the seafood restaurant next door.

Acoma Roofing fixed my leaking roof! Everyone involved was courteous and caring. Further, the workers came out in the rain to tarp the area until it could be repaired, which I greatly appreciated. I'm very pleased with Acoma Roofing's professionalism and skill. Thank you Acoma!!

Really enjoyed the  South Brooklyn and Habanero pizzas. They also reheated surprisingly well on the panini press so I feel less terrible for ordering way too much. We've always enjoyed eating in and are thankful that they're offering delivery while we're stuck at home.

(I ate 6 slices tonight )

Very beautiful salon, they offer warm and cold beverages while you get your service. Woman owned, which is awesome. They have amazing weekly gel specials for only $55 dollars, they come with a design on every nail. All of their nails come with a 2 week no chip Warrenty. I recommend them to all of my friends here, and I myself refuse to go anywhere else.

As many times and as much money as I've spent here, I've never encouraged someone rude or as gross as the blonde lady who handed me our food. She stood there picking her nails, or what was under her nails. Then, she proceeded to open and look at my food to make sure it was correct. Thankfully she didn't actually touch my food. I always tell people to go try five points but after that, even I probably won't be back. Also, maybe have one person take money and a separate person check the food for accuracy.

This is the 4th time that I have ordered an mobile pick up order through the app & they have forgotten one or two items from my order. I checked the bag and there were 3 sandwiches and a box at the bottom which I thought was another sandwich, and it wasn't. All I want is for the individuals to double check thee bags before bringing them out.

The SHAC makes going to workout fun! The coach, Karen, is great at scaling the workouts for every fitness level. Each workout starts with a warm-up and ends with stretching. There is a good mixture of cardio and strength in every class, and you can mentally prepare yourself through the mobile app which posts the workout the night before. Options for classes are Work Out of the Day (WOD CrossFit-inspired), boxing, family workout and team WOD.

We have been coming here since the day you opened your doors! It's always a hit or miss, sometimes it's great and sometimes it's not, the last 3 times were horrible but tonight takes the cake! We had the rudest most incompetent waitress I have ever had! I get being new, I've been New and I've trained New but she was the worst, everything was wrong our food came at all different times all the tables around us had to go get their check then go back up to pay, she was horrible! We are not going back! She didn't even try! The other waitress trying to help her was also extremely rude! Sitting there for 2 hours and leaving so angry is just not worth it! Never ever again! If it wasn't for the poor gentleman trying to fix everything, he deserves a medal! I don't know if this is a management issue or what! But this place is horrible the pizza was horrible the salad was bad and the service just plain sucked! Shame on all of you!

Garlic knots and pizza - that's what Five Points Pizza does!

Ordered a small round of garlic knots and they were perfect, very similar to a NY style knot. Apparently they are hand-cut dough tied in knots, tossed in olive oil, fresh garlic and parmesan, served with a side of marinara - pretty tasty.

Finished with an Old World Pizza Pie to go.  This pie had Fresh mozzarella, sauce dolloped on top, fresh chopped basil (no shredded mozzarella). The pizza smelled delicious all the way on the ride home and boy did it not disappoint. The sauce, cheese and crust were all perfect.  I have very high standards for NY pizza and I would give this spot a very high rating for a New York Style Pizza.

This is hands down my favorite pizza. It's thin, it's crispy, and it's full of flavor! They constantly change their daily meat and veggie option so you can keep coming back for more! The service is not the best but I honestly could care less because I'm just there for the pizza.
Delicious pizza and their garlic knots are amazing! Great service and fun, quaint environment.

This definitely qualifies as what I call "DGP" (Damn Good Pie).  Cool little location and has that cool urban vibe going. Excellent selection of TN and various microbrews on draft.  Our waitress was great with suggestions on beer and pizza options. They focus on specialty pizzas with various unique sauces and toppings. The nice thing is you can split a pie in half and do one specialty on one half and another on the other half. We got half Vodka Sauce pizza and half T-Rex. Both were awesome, TRex was my fave. The garlic knots appetizers are good but a little too much garlic for all of our party (although we still ate them all ). If u are in the area or not, its worth making a trip to stop by for some DGP.
Ridiculously good pizza especially if you are into crust texture and unique topping combos. My go-to is Gorgonzola, Habernero Cream Sauce, Pineapple & Roasted Red Pepper. It's amazing
This $hit is bomb ! Best wings around Nashville (so far). Not much of a sit down atmosphere, but the wings are legit. Wish I had taken a photo. I will be back

LOVE LOVE LOVE. Everyone is chill af and nice. Nail art is always . Nobody else is touching these nails. I get compliments on every set I get. I get the apres set, usually with nail art and they stay on for weeks and look incredible.

Love this local pizza joint. I've tried just about every pizza and you can't go wrong. Beat kept secret is their habanero cream sauce. If you dig spicy food get a side of this to go with your pizza. You're welcome!
SUCH GOOD PIZZA. Crust was amazing and the service was very pleasant and quick! Perfect spot to grab a late night since of pizza before heading home.

Hey, good pie, not great pie. I like NY pizza better. Nice flavors, good combos, decent service, but nothing to blow me away. Just ok to good. Nice and hot and speedy. Not five stars, not even four...sorry dudes.

As reported by the Wingdom™
THERE I WAS CRUISIN DOWN Memory Lane, actually Ewing Dr, peepin on OG Princes when Ho, What Dis, but a Strikeout Wingz! I'd heard of SOWz but never pilgrimaged south to try, and now they've repurposed/same-purposed this former fried chicken mecca? Only a few minutes from my domicile? On eWING Drive?? The only more appropriate street name would be a megachurch on Escam Dr am I right people okay I'll see myself out.
SO I CALL EM AND tell the man I WANT WIIIIIINGS and he says "that's what's up" and I order 15 with the "Strikeout". FOTW™ Z orders 15 "hot". Both extra crispy. I always say "if that's a thing" even though I know darn tootin it is a thing and SOWz passes the test cause he says "yeah that's a thing."
PULLING UP TO PRINCE'S triggered nostalgia, walking in to the newly-painted bright red, crisply clean Wingery summoned joy-tears, and my Wingspectations™ soared. I tell the cashier I called in, she scans through the names, and asks the nearby shopkeep, is this Dude? Yeah, he chuckles. Since I never gave a name he plugged me in as Dude. Into it. When the Wings come out, he opens the container to present the product, connoting a mafia-like transaction. Into it. After a minor hiccup of FOTW™ receiving the Sweet & Sassy (seemingly their signature sauce) instead of hot, quickly remedied, we were on our way.
THE WINGS ARE FRIED PERFECTLY, crispy (even after 10 minutes in styrofoam), steaming moist white chicken, sauced the way the Wingdom™ demands. Into it. And then: strikeout sauce struck me! It real. It hot. It real hot. However, I fear the heat is from extract, which masks flavor. While I was happily tortured, I have questions, like, this is extract, right? Will I ever taste again? Why was no cooling bleu cheese provided? Thankfully I had some BC but unthankfully, I didn't have much. I made it through 11/15. Safely can report that these are the best trad Buffalo Wings I've had in Nashville, but would love to experience something between hot and Strikeout that is more flavorful and less pure pain. If the Strikeout is NOT extract, what is it?
WE'LL DEFINITELY BE BACK, and are psyched about a top notch Wingery so close, wanna try the Sweet n Sassy, and wanna know if I've falsely accused them of the dreaded Extract Wingfraction™.
ALL IN ALL: four two-boners and one one-boner (9/10)
PRICE POINT: 15/$15.95 comes w fries which were good

I called in my order for pickup.I gave my credit card number four times and she still couldn't get it.So I said I would pay cash.
I called when I arrived but they couldn't bring to my car.I went in and paid for it with my credit card and asked for my order. They hadn't even made it and was told get in line.
They were totally unorganized and I waited until all the walk-in patrons were taken care of.
Not a happy camper

We were maybe once a month customers - and we would take our order to go.  Then we dined in and had the pleasure of meeting Julia.  She is truly one of a kind and is the consummate "people person."  Now... we are dining in every Thursday night.  ANYONE can bring us a pizza and beer... but when she does it, it is an experience.  Great personality and great vibe!

Love love love! Got my nails done by Draiya and they were perfect! The experience is amazing, from the time you walk in, to the time you walk out. And the glass of champagne was great too! 
Highly recommend!

Amazing Pizza! 

I was speechless after I took the first bite out of both of these pizzas. I've traveled to Italy and had pizza, tried Chicago pizza and I would've never expected that my favorite pizza place would be in Nashville. We ordered these pizzas before going out to the honky tonks and it was incredible before going out and just as good when we came back home as left overs. 

Unfortunately I don't live in Tennessee so I can't eat this as often as I'd like but I really encourage that you do. I'll be thinking of their pizza throughout the rest of my life. 

My friend picked up the pizza so I can't comment on the ambience or service but based on taste alone, 5/5.
Best pizza in Nashville by far. We get it every Friday in our house and eat an entire large pizza every time. Love it!
Excellent food and service. We had the meat special with sliced meatballs and who knows what other goodness. Plus a salad and ginormous garlic knots. Really good! Excellent variety on tap as well.

Today, I purchased a rythm cannabis vape cartridge , lost coastal tribal diesel and was completely unsatisfied. The prescription was half way full, so you are paying for something to come out half. When I told the employees and asked for an exchange or refund he said sucks to suck. Super uncaring and unprofessional. the cart was never taken out of the plastic that was in the box so they HAVE no reason not to take it back or just exchange it for another , if it was really because of covid 19 than why are your employees not even wearing gloves?

This is the place in Nashville if you want thin crispy crust deliciousness. Their slices are a bit on the pricey side... BUT their Strombolis are a great deal. If you order a large pie be ready for leftovers. Good thing is it still tastes amazing the next day. This place does get crowded quick, especially for dinner and late night. So be prepared for a wait.

Nice casual ambiance.   Came in around opening  time.   Seated immediately and place filled up pretty quick. Waitstaff very friendly.  Food came out fast and hot.   We had the garlic knots and the T. rex. This is a must eat when in Nashville.   This was our first trip to town but we will for sure be frequenting this place.   Would have pics of the pie but it got devoured pretty quick. Oh and the marinara sauce that came the garlic knots was amazing

The Yelpers have spoken. It's true, this is the best NY style pizza in Nashville. Honestly, the best pizza I've had PERIOD. Super thin, crispy, perfect sauce to cheese ratio slices that are as big as my face. I love this place. 

The cheese pizza here is the quintessential, no frills deal where each bite makes you stupidly mouth "oh my god" to your neighbor. I don't like sausage but the sausage green pepper mushroom pizza was delish. You really can't get these flavors and texture in other pizza places.

I also got the garlic knots which are huge (one was enough for me) but tasted like any other blob of dough so prob wouldn't get it again. 

I waited for a seat to open up at the bar or you can be on the waitlist which can run super long. I also saw a separate to-go area. Either way, the wait is WORTH IT!!!

Best nail salon ever!!! Started there in November when my nails were in bad shape. They helped me get them back together. I have had my nails done by almost everyone there and they never disappoint. Weekly special is where it's at. I faithfully and loyally book every two weeks no matter what! (I have my appointments scheduled up to October). Couldn't imagine going anywhere else!

This place is amazing! I had been here once before a few years back when I lived out of state. Since moving here it became one of my instant favorite places. The servers have always gone above and beyond. On the rare occasion there has been even a small possibility of mistake on their part, they go over and above to fix it.

The food is absolutely amazing. Good mix of salads and other items as well and just pizza. Honestly the pizza is the consistently the best I have had anywhere.

The food and service here really make this such a unique place. You have got to try it!
One of the best white pizza's I have had.Will be back when I'm in town again. Everything about it was great from the crust to the regatta cheese dropped on top!

Where do I begin with my love Five Points Pizza? 

When I first started eating Five Points, I would declare that it was a "spiritual experience." Their pizza is the best, and I was always amazed by how their slice of the day could always be so delicious. Everything about their pizza is perfection.

I got to know my now husband while eating Five Points after running club. The staff always accepted our sweaty-ness after hot Nashville runs.

My husband and I got married in Nashville in January. We had a very short list of what we needed for our wedding, and serving Five Points was one of them. Neither the church nor our reception venue would allow food inside, so we served Five Points after our ceremony on the lawn of the church. It was the BEST. All of our guests raves about the pizza. 

Five Points worked with me to order a bunch of pizza. They delivered it DURING our ceremony without a hitch. And despite the excitement of my wedding day, I still almost cried over their perfect pizza.

Daily drink specials and tons of activities for the weekends. The bartender served us promptly and was very funny!!! Full bar with just about any whiskey, vodka, or mixed drink you could want. They even serve mules with the actual mule cup and not in a regular glass.... because the best part of a mule outside of the liquor is the cool chilled cup!! 

The drinks are free poured so they definitely don't skip on the liquor. Overall the bar was decently cleaned including the bathroom. Pool table and darts available to enjoy.

This place is a joke. I've lived here for the last seven years and the quality of this pizza has gone drastically down. We ordered to go had to wait in the same line as everyone having to order that didn't place to Go Orders. Then since we waited so long, our pizza was cold and poorly made. Didn't even bother finishing the whole pizza we ordered. Don't waste your time for over done and over prized pizza.
Everything has been fixed since my last review.  I want to thank the owner and managers for your help correcting this.  I'll be back soon once again. You're pizza is the BOMB
Excellent service and pizza!! Garlic knots were amazing!! Very friendly staff!! Would highly recommend!!

Perfect pizza every time!!! My second time there and the pie's never disappoint. Had my son and his girlfriend with us and he heard about the Dave's pie situation... all eat , no talk so you know it's good ... our server was great and she gave great recommendations!!! If you are ever in Nashville, hit the Five Points... you won't be disappointed at all!!! A couple of pics to support the notion that Five points is awesome!!!

Five points is hands down the best pizza I have had in Nashviile. We came here on a Tuesday evening around 7:30 and there was a 30 minute wait. Luckily the hostess was super accommodating and took down my phone number and said we could go to the bar next door and she would call me when our table was ready. The table became available before we had finished our drinks, but they saved it for us anyways which I really appreciated. 

We ordered some wine and garlic knots to start out. Our table of 4 originally started to order individual glasses of wine and the waitress told us it would actually be a better deal (cheaper and more wine) to get the carafes instead, which again I appreciated! 

The garlic knots were super but the real stand out was Dave's Pie, pizza with basil and proscuitto. Its also just as good cold the next day, I might even prefer it cold. The staff is really friendly and engages with your table, but not too much. The pizza comes out quickly and its a fun, lively environment.

I'm sure sad! I was generous with three stars, we had ours delivered and I paid way too much for their pizza. I used to love blind onion pizza, I didn't mind spending the extra money, I will not do that again. Bummer

Came here after a bad dining experience nearby. I was just hoping to get something edible and I didn't have high expectations. I'm from Chicago, my pizza standards are very high. I was blown away! We got the pizza by the slice and it was delicious! This is now my new favorite pizza spot in Nashville and I look forward to my next visit.
This place is amazing. I love that they care about growing healthy nails without having to compromise fabulously stylish, cute designs. I'm in love with my nails every single time I leave here.

Visiting here from California so it was our first time. The place itself is modern. The food was delicious! First we ordered garlic knots which were amazing! If you like garlic do yourself a favor and order you some knots, you won't regret it. In regards to the pizza we ordered two 14" pies that you could split in half's to different types. We ordered half Bianca and Pesto on one, the other pie was habanero cream sauce pie and T-Rex. All 4 of these were delicious! My personal favorite was the Bianca, if you are a cheese lover this is a must to try. 
Pizza here was great the only thing not so great was the attitude of the workers. Our server was quick however not talkative and didn't have a very pleasant attitude. If you're ever on this area don't hesitate to visit, it will not disappoint.

Best pizza I have had in years.  The Meatball was delicious.  Go where the locals go --- not crowded with tourists.  Spencer made some great recommendations.  Garlic knots...amazing!  Had a flight of beer samplers and had a stout for the first time and liked it a lot!  Definitely going back!

Really big place and service is awesome!   The woman taking our order was also cleaning tables and bringing out the ready food.  She was really on top of things.  We had the General's combo (medium) and wings with sauce on the side.  The pizza is pretty filling but very tasty.  The wings are oven baked and we asked for sauce on the side.  Really meaty and juicy oven-baked wings.  They brought out ranch and honey for the crust.  I would not have considered honey, but it was good!  $2 sodas with free refills.  A good place overall!
Friendly staff and amazing  food. The garlic rolls are delicious and they have a pretty good beer selection. Highly recommend checking this place out!

Josh (the manager) and his crew are incredible there. They are always so friendly yet professional at the same time.. Not to mention the pizza is delicious.  Even with all this coronavirus madness, these folks are still treating their customers right. Even though you cant go inside the pizza parlor, you can order to go and they will bring it outside for you. I highly recommend Blind Onion and more specifically this location on Los Altos.

Saw this place had good reviews so I figured I would try it. Pretty disappointing. The crust was poor quality and the ingredients on the actual pizzas had zero flavor. Kind of confused as to how so many people rated this place so highly. Also the price for one slice of pizza is pretty damn high.

The wait was kind've long but they threw in some Garlic Knots for free that are ACTUALLY the best I've ever had. The service was pretty good but the only thing was it was REALLY cold inside. Like very uncomfortably cold. When the food came however it was amazing and the portion sizes for your buck are GREAT. Would definitely come back.

My entire family is obsessed with this place! Best pizza in Nashville. I don't eat red meat and the Bianca is amazing! My father and husband are crazy about the Zeus! Love the atmosphere and employees are sweet and attentive. Every time we go here I do a Facebook check in just to bring them some biz! As an owner of two small businesses in this economy, you must understand do anything, something great and people will come! Our Nashville businesses must stand out in today's market and this one does! Kudos! We will keep coming back as long as they are open! Beers are awesome too! You can't substitute anything which may annoy some but Five Points is running on great recipes, efficiency and a quick serving model!

Great first impression. Then the rest of the experience was the same. Fair and very good free quote and of the 4 bidders went with them. Everyday on time and very professional in work practices and clean up. Walked around every day with us to address anything we thought was missed or didn't look correct. This company is great to work with and I would recommend

Blind Onion has always been my go to for pizza, but after today they are hands down the best in town. Our office enjoys the pizza the crust is AMAZING!! Today we ran into a jam and did not have anyone to pickup our order for our meeting not only did the manager Kerry, come in early to guarantee the order was ready by 11 (when they usually open) he even offered to deliver it for us!!! This is by far the best service we have ever received (and it's always excellent) they truly went above and beyond for us! 
We will forever be loyal to the Onion!!!
#blindonionsparks #aboveandbeyond #onionshowslovetoo

I had a great experience at Mad Nails! They were really great about confirming my appointment before I showed up. They had the door open and good circulation and COVID precautions so I felt safe there. My nails looked amazing too at the end, and they lasted for almost 3 weeks with no chips!! I will definitely be back.

Can't say enough good things about this company.  I had a sort of "painting emergency" and they were able to help me out very quickly and at fair prices.   The gentleman they sent to do my house was meticulous and the final result had far exceeded my expectations.   He quickly patched nail pops, fixed lousy tape lines that were showing through, and made the room look brand new.  I'll definitely use them again for all my future painting projects!

The food is delicious and the location is perfect- but I wish the building was bigger. It's always so super crowded. I've been upwards of 10 times (various days of the week) and I'd say there's an average wait time of 30 minutes or more. If you don't mind the wait, be sure to order the garlic knots! Their beer selection doesn't disappoint either.

If you're looking for a great pizza night, you've found the right place. The unique varieties and flavor profiles at Five Points Pizza are the best! Oh and don't get me started on the RANCH sauce! It has a prominent dill flavor and is absolutely incredible.  I'm excited to try this one again and taste the garlic knots. Another great tip is they are on Postmates for delivery. :) Enjoy y'all!

We got a Five Points pizza delivered to our Airbnb on our first night in Nashville. We were pretty impressed! The crust is thinner but not traditional "thin" crust - it wasn't super crispy, or overly chewy. Just right in my opinion! The sauce and toppings all tasted very fresh. Delivery through UberEats was easy enough and pretty fast. We would order again next time we're in town!

Best place to get your nails done in town, PERIOD. No one will ever care for your nails as Morgan and her team does. Besides caring for your actual nails, cuticles and such they are extraordinary artists.  Your nails are basically their canvas to create.  Whether you want something neutral and classic or some crazy colorfull art- this is the place to go to!

Attended a celebration of life for a very important man in the gay community. The place was packed! Great drinks with such friendly bartenders. This is a happening place for anyone interested in going out and enjoying the gay scene. Thanks for such a wonderful time Mr Michael, the greatest bartender ever.

This place is hit or miss. I prefer it to the one near Rittenhouse Square. This one is clean and uncluttered. The bagels are good. I've had better luck going to the store and ordering rather than ordering for pick-up. Sometimes they are out of things that are on the website and it seems there is no way for them to notify about that. Also the menu in the store does not include everything on the website, but if you ask they can make it. 

A while back I went to the store and ordered a bacon and egg on a plain bagel and it was PERFECT. Meanwhile today I ordered one online for pickup and the bagel was burnt (they tried to scrape off the burnt part) and also tasted some onion. I don't know if I was actually a plain bagel or there was just a mix in the knives cutting the sandwiches. They didn't have the diet soda I ordered from the website so they had to return my money since there was nothing else suitable.

Some of the best pizza in Nashville. My wife and I order from this place way too often. When I heard the tornado hit the five points neighborhood my first thought (after "are my friends ok?") Was, did Five Points Pizza make it? And they did! 

My go to is the Woodstock (pepperoni and mushroom) with an order of garlic knots. The salads are also on point. The spinach salad is my jam.
Simply the best pizza in Nashville. I don't know what else to say about it. The meatball pizza and the Zeus are my favorites.
Delicious pizza, friendly staff every time. I love coming here to eat in or take out.

I came in to a big smile from Michael the bartender.  Very nice cool spot  to have a refreshing beverage. If you like to play pool  this is a great place to come.  Lots of seats and friendly people.  Had a great time

We stumbled upon this place in search of Sunday night dinner after discovering so many of the places on our Nashville must-try list are closed Sundays. When we walked in, the place was packed! The friendly hostess was cleaning off a table and told us it would be 10-15 minutes for a table for two, but smiled and said it wouldn't be too long. We waited outside and it seemed to be only a matter of 5 minutes when she stepped outside to grab us. 

I'm not a beer fan, but this place seems to carry a large selection and wide variety of beer. For only $7, you can order a beer flight--four beers of your choice. What a deal!

On to the food--we started off with an order of garlic knots. Honestly, I don't even like bread much, but after seeing everyone's steaming garlic knots arrive at their tables, I knew I had to have some! The garlic knots were good but not excellent--some pieces were very hard and not the softer, light texture you would expect. The knots were also sitting in a pool of olive oil, and I'm not sure if that's ever cool. Maybe it was an off-order, but I would probably save the calories next time. We also ordered the spinach gorgonzola salad: Baby spinach topped with mushrooms, red onions, walnuts, dried cranberries and gorgonzola--pretty straightforward and hard to mess up, pretty good. 

Based on the server recommendation, we chose a half-and-half pizza: the server's personal favorite, the vodka sauce pie: Fresh mozzarella, house-made vodka tomato cream sauce, spinach, mushrooms, red onions, prosciutto di Parma, garlic, chopped basil, pecorino romano (no tomato sauce) and supreme: Pepperoni, Italian Sausage, mushrooms, red onions, green peppers. The vodka sauce pie is very, very delicious--you can barely taste the house-made vodka sauce because its flavor is bursting with so many other ingredients! The fresh basil and prosciutto are the highlights of this pie. I did have one concern with the pizza--in some parts, I noticed a doughy consistency under the ingredients, which might be an indication that the pizza was slightly undercooked. Not willing to chance it, I only ate one slice of this pizza. 

The supreme is also delicious, although a tad salty from the combination of pepperoni and Italian sausage. However, it seemed more cooked than the other half. You can really taste the freshness of the ingredients in both pizzas. This place was a good pick and I'm glad we accidentally stumbled here for a meal! Is it the best pizza and garlic knots I've ever had? Hardly. Does it pass for the best pizza in Nashville? Very likely!

It's been weeks since I had the breakfast sandwich with corned beef, but I still think about the sandwich and my warm memories fondly.

Bought a couple bagels to take back to Texas because we're deprived in that area.  Was readily consumed when we got home.

This place has good pizza. It really does. The staff is rude though and the food takes forever to get out. Seriously, ordered two pizza's and it took an hour and half to get it. So honestly dominos might be better with service and speed.

Took our 11 year old jeep to Lithia Jeep for repair and they wrote up an estimate for $1500.  Didn't want to spend that much money and questioned the need to totally replace the rear end.  So called around Reno, and found rear end expert who diagnosed a completely different problem and fixed it for $500.  I believe all the other reviewers---STAY AWAY.

nekiyah williams asst manager was rude as hell she told us to leave hotel she provided very unprofessinal service while we stayed at the hotel she screamed at me by calling into my room hotel because she had problem with fire and she blamed my kids for it just because she thought they were running in the hallway they were going to one room to another and i was with them and she bragged it upon my kids and then she had a nerve to call police at my room! also thier cleaning staff never cleaned my room good worst service ever! i would not recommend this hotel unprofessinal and rude customer service. thier manager nancy offered a resolution and we told her we are moving and going to another hotel becaz of what nekiyah did we cant stay here and do not charge us for 1 day for sunday sept 6th and she still did matter havnt resolved i had to pay another hotel for same day out of pocket where i moved. she needs to reimburse my insurance company because of the level thier staff provided and blamed us with no proof we had to leave because of her!

The wonderful bartender helped us so well. I believe her name was Melissa. She had a bubbly personality and being my first time there it was definitely a welcoming face. Will definitely be there again thanks to her

Let me start by saying I know I was going to pay extra having my car serviced at a dealership.  I'm a girl and I don't know crap about cars, but it was convenient to leave my car there rather than at the airport while I went on vacation.

I needed: an oil leak fixed, new front brakes, my jacked up sunroof shut and something to do with a power steering hose.  Ok, German car, prepare to sign over you Roth IRA for all that.  Out the door at $3291.57.

I picked up my car, got about 30 miles out of town only to have my power steering completely crap out in a Trader Joe's parking lot.  Are you freaking kidding me? You have my car for 9 days for what I originally only thought was going to be the sunroof and steering noise and somehow this slips through the cracks? So on the flatbed goes my car, towed back to Reno.  To their credit they paid for a rental car so I could get home (five hours behind schedule and exhausted from a cross country flight) Using my powers of persuasion  I got them to have one of their employees to drive my car to Mammoth, pick up the rental and drive it back to Reno.  But I was still out the cash for gas (NOT CHEAP in CA in the summer, think $4/gallon) for the rental car's 350 mile round trip, plus it took another week before my car was even fixed (again).  16 days in the shop.  My poor baby.  And poor me, $1173.20 for the pump and labor.

And now, here I am in Portland mere months later to have a familiar noise return.  Oh yeah, that power steering pump that was put in is failing, to the tune of $800 (interesting price difference, no?).  Is there a word that is stronger than irate?

So I came to five points pizza based on friends' recommendations. I got the meat and the veggie specials and i wasn't too fond of them. Not much taste and quite plain for being a special. 

Prices are pretty nice and I like how you can get a take out slice or pizza or sit down at the restaurant! 
Very fun casual environment and great staff. 

Kind of disappointed, but it makes sense, that you only have 4 single slice options : pep, cheese, veggie, and meat. You can order a full pizza with all the other options though. 

Overall, I'd only recommend the cheese or pepperoni. However, now that I've visited a handful of times, I can say that the food is very inconsistent on taste and it's disappointing to not be able to expect the same quality every visit. 

A good visit, but nothing im craving or wanting. Only if I'm passing by. Would rather travel to another pizza place in the Nashville area.
Always a great meal when I go hear!  I even look forward to the crust because it taste amazing with some honey!  Staff is always very friendly and welcoming!

Not my favorite pizza but it is close. Placed a to go order. The crust was a little soggy when we got it home. I think it wouldn't have been if we had eaten in. 

Nice quick service. We will be back.

I've been hearing about Five Points for FOR-EV-ERRRR so I am happy that I finally made the trek to East Nashville to try it out. As I was heading to the airport to pick up friends that were visiting I was racking my brain to think of something which would be quick, easy, affordable and a crowd pleaser. Five Points Pizza fit the bill on all of these stipulations. This New-York style pizza spot has a late-night window and a restaurant. Their menu has salads/starters, stromboli and pizza. They even have vegan pizza which was a selling point since I could bring one of my friends here. Five Points Pizza has beer, wine and cider on their drink menu. 

My friend and I split the Greek salad ($6) as a starter which is the perfect size for 2 people. The Mediterranean feta dressing works well on this salad. To appease my vegan friend three of us shared the 'Vegan pie' which is Daiya vegan cheese, spinach, artichokes, red onion, whole roasted garlic and chopped basil (they don't sell vegan pizza by the slice). We ordered the 14" of this pie but when they brought it out it was actually the 18" ($25) which ended up being fine so we could take some home. My friend ordered the meatball stromboli as her entree ($9) which was delicious (she gave me a bite). The dough was baked to a beautiful golden brown and the fillings were great. This is served with a side of marinara sauce. 

Service was okay but the server we had was a bit of a smart aleck. When my friend ordered she said "We'd like to split the vegan pie, the one with the vegan cheese on it" and he responded with "Well that's what a vegan pie is...it has the vegan cheese on it". He kind of made her feel stupid for saying that, which wasn't necessary. As I mentioned above the pizza size was incorrect but we were fine with that. 

I would definitely come back here as the pizza is great. I have yet to try every pizza place in Nashville but this has to be up there at the top. I heard that they will be opening a second location off of Charlotte Avenue in West Nashville so I will eagerly await that day! Also just a note-parking can be a bit tricky in this location. We got street parking on S. 11th street but we were lucky.

I understand the ratings at this location. They are often understaffed and slammed with orders. Sometimes bagels are burnt. I've had times too where they have run out of bagels -- how is that possible for a spot whose namesake is bagels?

Definitely my favorite pizza spot in town. The prices are very reasonable, service is always great, and the food never disappoints. I'm a big fan of the crust, which goes well with their huge container of honey. Their pesto wings (dipped in the buffalo sauce and ranch) are also amazing. I like to try their monthly pizza special, which always impresses me. Ask to peruse their binder that has all their previous specials in it. The options are endless!  A special thanks to Kevin, who always provides us with friendly and attentive service. We'll be back again and again! 
Dec 2019 Update: Simply still the best! We sat at the bar and received exceptional service from Kelly. His service was truly five star in every way. The Naughty or Nice Pizza Special is worth a try! We couldn't decide which one we wanted to be so got them both!

I've been going to MAD Nails for about a year now and have never once been less than thrilled with the results. The technicians are true artists, creating beautiful paintings on the tiny canvas of your nails. Anything you can dream up they can make happen. 

Beyond that, the vibes and energy cannot be beat. I always feel comfortable and content in this den of powerful and lovely women. Such a great place to get a little self care and a fresh set.

Well, it turns out the folks at Lithia didn't put in a bad pump after all.  THEY PUT IN THE WRONG SIZE SERPENTINE BELT.  It was too big and had been squealing around in my engine.  I called and let the service manager have it - he offered to refund the cost of putting the new one in.  Hey buddy, I want you to refund the cost of what I paid YOU as it is far more than what the mechanic in Portland charged me.  He said something about it being computerized to pull the part and that the computer matches my VIN to the part.  Either the computer's wrong or their mechanic is blind but the belt they put in was for a 2.8 liter single turbo not a 2.7 liter biturbo.  

The manager, Tony, gave me his direct line to call him with the amount I paid to have it fixed correctly.  And here is the real kicker: I've called him twice and he won't return my call.

This makes me so irate that every time I see a car with a Lithia license plate frame I literally weep for the other driver and raise my fist in solidarity.

Never again, Lithia.  At any of your locations.
Checked back in and looking for rolling papers and there was a kid passed out sleeping behind the counter and he smells like cat piss
While I did not order a bagel at Spread Bagelry, I enjoyed the experience here. I'll have to get a bagel next time.

Visiting with some family and they wanted to come here. It was a Monday evening and it was CROWDED. We had to wait outside for them to text us when a table was ready. The inside was LOUD, with people talking and practically yelling over one another. Not sure how much had to do with acoustics versus rowdiness of the clientele versus just how many people were packed into a small area. It just wasn't very pleasant and made conversation among us difficult. It was also very hard to hear the waitress and place our order.

I got a slice of cheese pizza and my aunt and uncle got a whole pie and it took a long time to prepare. I would've thought they'd have slices of cheese in reserve but maybe they delayed bringing it out so it would all be ready simultaneously? The crust is more of a crisp, thin style, which I like, though I felt my slice should've had a lot more cheese for being $3.50 a slice...

The bathrooms are clean and gender neutral. The establishment itself was in decent repair inside and the outside sports a fun multicolored mural. I know it's called "five points" because of the roads it is located on, but I think it'd be hilarious if they specifically cut their pizza into five slices.

I don't live anywhere near Nashville, but if I did, I doubt that even then we'd come back. Decent one-off experience, but not worth ever repeating.
You really can't go wrong with Five Points. It's one of those spots that is staple in Nashville and one that will consistently deliver high quality pies.

New York style pizza. Went on a lunch break while on a business trip in Nashville area. 

Service was quick and the pizza was yummy. Pricing was pretty average so no real complaints from me.

With some colleagues in town from Yelp's San Francisco and New York offices, I knew I wanted to impress with my dinner selection. I rolled the dice with The Treemont, since I had never been, and it worked in my favor! 

We started at the bar with wine and cocktails. The complimentary popcorn is delicious! I could have happily munched on that all night long. But, we headed upstairs to our table and began our feast. To start, chickpea fritters, charred squid and squid ink gnudi. The fritters were light and fun, the squid worked really well with everything else on the plate, but the gnudi with brown butter and raisins were off. the. hook. I wouldn't think twice about ordering that dish again. And not sharing.

My dining companions seemed very happy with their fluke entrees. I went with the strip steak and was surprised to receive two large hunks of beef instead of, well, sliced strips of steak. I would have preferred the latter. I really liked the barley and mushrooms on the plate, and the red wine sauce was nice. I thought this dish went well with the lemony crushed potatoes. 

While I didn't partake in the desserts, they went over well with our group. I'm interested to see the next version of the menu and I'd definitely like to return.

Insanely overpriced. Costs of service is never made clear. You will only know if you ask in person at the nail salon. I say this because the price on the website does not reflect what it costs when it comes to paying after you get your nails done. 

Client- Custom Nail Art Manicure states on the website that it starts at $110. As stated on the website:

"you choose every detail, all ten fingers"

I had no idea this was the appointment I had. The email confirmation stated it was the 'artist choice' appt. (cheaper price) I first made the appt via Instagram dm with the owner. I was asked what I wanted and sent multiple photos for ideas/inspiration. In person the artist asked which photo I wanted to use as the reference. I showed the basketball reference photo of what I wanted done. The nails looked nothing like the photo. For some reason my set cost $145 instead of $110. I wish the artist stated they weren't comfortable doing the set instead of getting something completely different then asked. 

When I emailed after the service questioning the price I was charged next day I received a text message from the salon to figure out a solution. They offered a full refund if I came in to remove the nails. Moments later they took it back and said they would only return half. 

Extremely disappointed in this service. The job was not done well at all especially by the lead artist of the salon. Will not return.

Apparently famous in the East Nashville area! I really enjoyed the experience and will try to return here!
I really can't out vote Joey's pizza! But this place came closer not only for the tasty pizza but also the accommodation. You have tables, booth or even the bar!
 Looking forward to another visit soon. Maybe a date night, since it is romantic.

Ive heard about the Blind Onion for a few years now from friends and family all telling me I had to try it and tonight I finally did. Even though the place was packed, I got my food surprisingly quick. First off I was very pleased with the beer selection. I went with an IPA and it was delicious.
