As a bit of a beer snob I can tell you when the beer lines have or have not been cleaned in a while, and this particular beer was perfect! Not to mention a tall glass of craft beer was only five dollars! I ordered a greek salad that was just beautiful and a very generous size followed up by a personal sized bbq chicken and my buddy got himself a "Generals" (Combination). When our food arrived I was taken aback by the way they make their crust, it was kneaded like you see in gourmet pizza commercials and I could smell the quality of the ingredients! These guys know what theyre doing. As soon as I took my fist bite I knew I had made the right choice by coming in tonight. The best part was giant bottles of honey on the table which I had kept on hearing about was for the crust, I can tell you ill never et pizza the same way again! The staff seemed genuinely concerned on our experience and very gracious for our business. Ive eaten a lot of pizza in a lot of different cities and this is absolutely on my top 3 of all time. Theres something about the taste of the dough that's just so unique. I was also incredibly impressed with the cleanliness of the joint. I recommend this spot to anyone that loves a good pie and a great atmosphere!

To start, I feel it's important for me to note that we ordered out from here. So I can't speak to the ambiance, table service, or anything else that one would get in the restaurant. I can only speak to my husband and I's experience with take-out/carry-out. 

We ordered an XL pepperoni pizza and the knots for pickup (after a failed Postmates attempt - but this rating is no way tied to that debacle). My husband claims that the best way to compare each pizza place is to get a simple, classic pepperoni pizza from each place we go. But that's besides the point. 

My husband ordered over the phone, no issues there. We were told 30 minutes. When he went to pick it up, he did have to wait another 20-30 minutes because they were running behind. Understandable for a Saturday night. Overall, he said the host/hostess was pleasant and empathetic. 

My rating primarily comes from the pizza. We really just didn't think it was that great. Very VERY heavily garlic-y and salty sauce. And don't get me wrong, garlic is good, but this was ALL I tasted. All I tasted in the pizza was garlic, salt, and cheese. The bread didn't have an especially pleasant flavor so there just wasn't a good balance in the pizza. 

It wasn't a "bad" pizza at all. It just wasn't a pizza that I wouldn't want to have again. 

I'll update the review if we ever do dine in and enjoy it better.

Best pizza crust and toppings I have ever had.  Including NYC and PA.  The server made great suggestions on beer options for the flight.  Also ordered the garlic knots.  FANTASTIC. It was great and complimented the pizza very well.  Great atmosphere, great location.  Love hanging out there.

Picked up 2 large pizzas yesterday. Crust and toppings were around 3/8" thick. Something was obviously wrong with their pizza. The most miserable, sickly looking tasteless pizzas for $45+. What an embarrasement for "Blind Onion".  Toppings were scarce and mushrooms were thin pieces, not slices. Worst pizzas I have seen and tasted in years. Not my first time there, matter of fact we had my daughters graduation party in their back room several years ago.The pizza has always been one of the best in the area.The clerk opened the pizzas to show me they were what I ordered.  If this is a product change, it is a fatal move for the pizza joint that we have enjoyed so much in the past. My family, my sister-in-law, my mother-in-law, and friends that have frequented the "Blind Onion" with confidence in the past: color us gone.
This place is so good! I bookmarked it for the next time I'm in town. The garlic knots, veggie pizza, and the south Brooklyn were delicious.

Let me preface this review with I was in town on business and I have experienced some of the best pizza there is to offer from NY to South FL. 

The PROS

-pizza is fresh tasting
-slices are big, delicious and just the right amount of grease
-garlic knots are yum
-friendly service
-good beer selection, especially local brews
-lots of pizza options and vegan/vegetarian friendly


Th CONS

-parking can be a bit of a pain
-not the best for a large group


Overall this place is amazing!  If you're in Nashville it is a must go!

Solid pizza by the slice joint! Loved that they had both a walk in, order, sit + order via window + actual sit down and have a waiter/tress come to you! All 3 options for any occasion.

I walked in and ordered a prosciutto and basil slice which was $5 and some change. Not bad for the quality and size of this! Was really happy with the fresh ingredients and quality. Also can't beat the quickness of it as well!

Solid place in 5 points where options are plentiful :)

I moved here from Austin, Texas and in Texas there is a place called Homeslice that is the best pizza and my most favorite. Until this place. This place is amazing!!! It's so delicious, its pretty quick, and it has a fantastic beer selection!!!!!

We came on a Sunday a little after lunch. Got right in to a table, quickly got our beers, and our came not too long after that. We shared a slice of pepperoni and the Stromboli. Amazing. I know I keep using that word but it really is.

It even has an area if you just want to grab a slice real quick and eat. Try this place!!!!

Definitely my favorite pizza spot in town. The prices are very reasonable, service is always great, and the food never disappoints. I'm a big fan of the crust, which goes well with their huge container of honey. Their pesto wings (dipped in the buffalo sauce and ranch) are also amazing. I like to try their monthly pizza special, which always impresses me. Ask to peruse their binder that has all their previous specials in it. The options are endless!  A special thanks to Kevin, who always provides us with friendly and attentive service. We'll be back again and again!

I really haven't been to McD's much since I was a college student.  But we were across the street at REI at closing time and realized we were hungry and the big sign out front said the lobby was open for indoor dining so we parked the car and headed in.  Except the door was locked and the lobby was not open.  

Back to the car and into the drive thru.  Since I really don't go to McD's anymore, I needed to peruse the menu.  And was surprised to find that hamburger and cheeseburger were not on the menu any more.  The smallest burger option was a $2 double cheeseburger.  The price was right so I went for it.  My boyfriend also ordered the $2 double cheeseburger along w a big mac. Our meal for 2 was well under $10.  Can't beat that!  The McD workers were surprisingly friendly and fast w the paying and delivery.  

It was hard to maneuver the car to a spot from the drive thru and we wanted to not drive while we ate.  So we just went to the parking lot across the street to indoor dine in the car.  I must say - McDonalds is NOT as good as I remember.  Like when I was a kid and I was a college student I thought McDonalds was really good.  It really isn't.  It's edible but it's not good.  I'm not sure if they changed or if my tastes changed.   The 100% all beef patties are paper thin.  The one pickle that was so small and thin I could probably see thru it.  There was almost no ketchup.  

I won't be rushing back to McDonald's for another meal.  I mean I can't say I won't ever be back.  I'm sure there will be a day that I'm on the road and hungry and see the golden arches and decide to pull in like I did tonight.  I just won't go out of my way for it.
Some of the best pizza in town but it always take much longer than you would expected/they tell you.

These guys are liars and crooks who need to take a course on business ethics and customer services. Took my car there twice and the servies I paid for were not performed ie change air filter, top off fluids etc. From now on I am driving to Carson city for all my required maintenances.

We got the 18 inch pizza, for three people and there were plenty left overs. We did half Bianca which was delicious and other half T-Rex. I ate the Bianca first and I must have been too I'll for the T-Rex but it just felt a little too meaty. Still good but like I said I was too full to probably enjoy it. The garlic knots were good bit I don't really see all the hype in it. The line was an hour wait but you can walk around and they will call your cell when table is ready. Great service and really good pizza. Very filling and very affordable
Fantastic pizza, best I've had in awhile. Service was quick when we needed it as well

Why do we drive 20-30 minutes to eat at Five Points Pizza?
1- Quite frankly, it's one of maybe 3 places in town to get anything that resembles a NY-style pizza. We crave a couple of slices of prosciutto and fresh basil it at least once a week.
2- The waiting staff is always polite and attentive.
3- You get more for your money. (reasonable lunch specials).
4- The beer selection is great for the size of the place, and constantly evolving.
5- I'm sick of everyone in Nashville supporting chain restaurants. Support small businesses that genuinely care about you.
6- The atmosphere is fairly basic, but we personally find it to be cozy. 
7- If we have out-of-town guest, they all love the place.

If you can't park for free on the street, there's a inexpensive pay lot across the street next to Woodland Studio.

My boyfriend and I got the veggie plate to start which is small so the price is fitting. I got the mild chicken wings and they were drenched in sauce and not cooked enough. Super soggy and some of the wing's meat wasn't even stuck to the bone. It looked unappetizing so I didn't eat them. The celery and carrots served with the wings were dry. I had a slice of my boyfriends pizza because I was still hungry and it was pretty good. I wouldn't eat here again just because they don't have gluten free as an option.

Not the traditional tasting vodka pizza found in the tri-state area, but no bad. Two 18" pies are more than enough for 6 hungry people because the slices are loaded with toppings. Garlic knots & beer flights are good apps for sharing and a great way to try local brews. Smaller shop so not ideal for larger groups but takeout is an option. Great location, with plenty of eateries nearby, it's perfect for strolling around and grabbing dessert, etc

Service was phenomenal. Pizza and garlic knots were just A-OK. 

During our stay in Nashville, we found ourselves craving pizza. So, I searched the Yelpternet and came across this pizza place with fabulous ratings. We pulled up in our Lyft, and it looked promising. The place was pretty busy, and our group of three agreed that it was kind of cool that they had different sections for takeout, window, and dine-in. We went to the dine-in. Luckily, there was no wait (Monday night around 7:45pm). 

Our waitress was really great. She was super friendly, checked in on us a bunch of times, made sure to refill our cups whenever they were low, and even let me switch from basil lemonade to regular lemonade, when I discovered I really really don't like basil lemonade. 

So, since we're on the subject of lemonade... Basil lemonade is weird. There is a lot of basil, not that much lemonade. In fact, there wasn't much lemonade flavor in the regular lemonade either. 

We ordered half a dozen garlic knots to start with. The knots were huge and the bread itself was fluffy and tasty, however, they were very light on garlic/oil. I love garlic, so this was a huge disappointment to me. I still ate two knots though-I just made sure to dunk them in LOTS of marinara sauce. (Side note: we didn't finish these, so I decided to take them back to the hotel. The awesome waitress gave me a box with a new dipping cup of marinara.)

Now, the pizza. I ordered a slice of pepperoni and a slice of prosciutto and basil. (Basil is a big thing here. They put slivers of it over the knots too.) The pizza was good. The crust was thin (NY style) and the toppings were evenly distributed and tasty. However, that's it. Good pizza, but nothing that makes it stand out enough to deserve a higher rating. One of the members of my group was actually disappointed, considering how I told him it had rave reviews. He noticed that some of the cheese on his slices wasn't fully melted. 

If I lived in Nashville, I'd probably grab a slice again if I were in the area, but I wouldn't go out of my way or wait in some crazy line for this pizza.

I wanted to get a gel manicure with a little flair so I decided to go to M.A.D.  I worked with Belinda who was incredibly thorough and knowledgeable. She answered all of my questions about the process and her attention to detail was top notch. I love how my nails turned out! It was a great experience and I will be back to see her. Check out the pics - cute AF, right? Go to M.A.D. Worth it!

Acoma Roofing was referred to us by a neighbor who had a positive experience with a new roof installation.  Our experience from quote, to installation, to later a repair (after the hurricane) was nothing but professional, prompt and pleasant.  There was constant communication throughout the process and whenever we had questions our sales person or a staff member at the front office was quick to respond.  Thank you for our beautiful roof and peace of mind.

They will LIE, LIE  and LIE some more.  NEVER will I return to this shop, and never have I experienced such apathy when it comes to a complaint.  I hear they are going out of business and I believe it.  STAY away from Lithia Motors of Reno because they are so desperate for money they make up stories about needed repairs.  BEWARE!!!!  

There are many reasonable, ethical competitors willing to be honest when working on your car.  Lithia is NOT one of them.  Don't take the chance, read all of the reviews online.  There are several and I WISH I had done the same thing BEFORE taking my car to them.  I never would have if I read all of the negative reports online.

I hope this helps at least one person from being ripped off!!!!
We did take out! Just a cheese pizza and garlic knots! Really yummy staff was super nice! Kinda New York style pizza! I just wish the ranch was a little better :)

Dis plase iz rlly gud,
1 star for every point
Gud fod




Aaaaaaa aba a. A a. A a a. Aa. A a a a. A a a a a

I am in town visiting Nashville for my 30th. We were recommended this place by a local and folks.... I'm a lover of good pie. We walked in and were greeted immediately by Cody. Great service and my prosciutto and basil slice was fantastic!!
I've been eating here for years now, and it's definitely one of the most consistently exceptional and flavorful pizzas in town.

I literally stumbled upon this place late night and went in for a slice. It was slammed pack, but they were able to take my order quickly, and the slice was out in no time.

I would have to say that it's the best NY style pizza that I've had anywhere this year. The crust, sauce, and toppings were perfect. If you're around East Nashville, I highly recommend.

Ordered the chicken parmesan pizza but ended up with alfredo. The guy who took our order corrected it immediately and made it right. My pizza was delicious as was my wife's (forgot what she ordered). It's close by our house so we will probably become regulars here.

I think about this pizza a lot. There's just something crave-worthy about the taste and texture of it. It doesn't matter what toppings you put on it. It's floppy yet crispy and chewy yet tender all at once...and you don't feel disgustingly full after eating it. Plus, the prices are decent considering it's in a prime location and the service is always superb. 

Yes, I know it's crowded. But it's crowded for a reason. When you eat the pizza, you will understand.

The first thing I noticed about The Treemont was its chic interior, like something out of an Upper East Side restaurant in New York. My friend Chris W and I had drinks at the bar in the past, so we felt it was time to dine at this remarkable place. Chef Chip Roman had cut his teeth in such fine dining establishments as Blackfish, Mica, and Ela. His newest residency has dishes displaying elements from all of them. My dorade, two tender filets that reminded me of sea bass, was tender, flaky, and oh so juicy. The combination of veggie crunch, quinoa chew, foam bubbles, and cream with the dorade was a wonderful titillation of the senses. Chris' pork loin was brilliant comfort food made to look elegant. Chef Roman definitely channeled Chef Daniel Stern with that dish. The cavatelli with lamb ragu was another winner with tender slow-cooked lamb enhancing the flavors of a delicious pasta dish.

For a fast food restaurant, this place is beyond my expectation. Sandwich was served hot with real and flavorful meats. They have a variety of dipping sauces including chipotle ranch, sweet BBQ, hot BBQ, horseradish, and ketchup. They also have dispensable au ju sauce to dip your sandwich in. Prices are reasonable too and restaurant is clean. We'll come back.

I saw so many great post of girls getting their nails
Done and decided to book my appointment. 
I had the most basic nail design ever. 
One nail needed a tip, and feel off the next day. 
My nails were decorated with one pearl on each nail, and all fell off. I was so disappointed because I paid $50 for getting gel nails, and $40 for the manicure itself! The manicure is very basic, no massage, or frills. Literally dip your hand in some water, and she cleans and designs. 
The price of service was not disclosed before service, I was told to just come and it would be decided depending on the design. Had I known I was paying $90 for something I hated I would've never came! 
Needless to say I will never be back!

Very average. Maybe my expectations were too high as it was highly recommended? We had two different kinds and I was not impressed by either. Very basic. Plus, they didn't have ham on any pizzas and I'm a sucker for ham on a za.

That's A Great Pie!
Love this place and the delicious pies with a great hand-tossed  crust! The right amount of toppings and cheese! We live the garlic- heavy knots!  We tried the Vodka Sauce Pie and it was The Best!!!!
Call ahead to order, bring a driver and a friend to hop out and get the pizza while the other circles the block...., parking is tough!

Love this neighborhood pizza place and I'm here often.  I can't believe I've never checked in or reviewed!  I usually sit at the bar and enjoy whatever sporting event is on.  Great service and friendly, attentive staff.  The Super Slice specials are always the perfect meal.  I usually get the pizza of the month because they are always unusual and always good.  I've even made my own combinations.  It's obvious that only the freshest, best ingredients are used and the crust is amazing.  It's a treat to dip into the honey provided, and the ranch dressing is great as well.  
This is a great place for solo diners, couples or families.  I'm so glad Blind Onion is close to home and I will keep coming back.

While there is no doubt this is some of the best pizza in town, the lines and the wait are brutal. I have ordered from here three times and every time it took 30/40 minutes longer than I was told over the phone.

After trying to shop local I gave up and called Lithia, I made an offer they accepted and I made the 2.5 hour trip up the hill to Reno. When I got there they claimed there had been a mistake and they didnt understand what "out the door" ment, and the cost of the car was now almost 2K more. Of course this is the short version of the story. I have the letter I sent to Subaru of America saved on my work computer, I will update this post later.

Lithia, I will never buy another car from you. And I will make it my personal mission in life to take away as much business away from you as I can.

Update: I was just contacted by Lithia to ask me when I was going to finish my registration paperwork. This is confusing to me because I have already paid my DMV fees, smoged the car, etc. On the day of my purchase the finance manager told me once the check cleared they would sent the paperwork for title and the title would be sent to me. 

Well oh no that's not enough, apparently they need the DMV print out, smog cert, application for registration and title, and a vin inspection sent to them....

Well Mr. finance manager this would have been great info the day I bought my car! I did my part, I paid my registration and smoged the car. I have been waiting for 2 months because you couldn't do your job. You could sure as hell call me the day after I bought my car to ask if I could let you know when the check cleared my bank account, and I sure did that for you. But you cant be bothered to do your job?

I have gone from annoyed and disappointed to pissed. I'm off to find the number for Subaru of America......
Tonight was our second time getting a over done cheese pizza,  person actually asked me if the pizza looked ok,  they offered to remake but I'm done with the place

Love this place! The garlic knots were spectacular!!! I'm a huge fan of garlic and this place loads the garlic on their knots! The whole order was ambitious for 3 of us, definitely will get the half order next time. 
Next we ordered just a slice of pepperoni pizza and it was exactly the style of pizza that I like, thin crust and greasy! It was perfect! I also got the basil infused lemonade and it was so fresh tasting. Really don't think you can go wrong with anything you get from here!

This place has been one of my go-to's in COVID. The pizza here is incredible, and the pick up window is great since you don't have to go inside to get your food. As always, the pizza is incredible no matter what I've gotten.
Apparently appetizers dont always come out first. I shit you not, thats what the server said.....uhhhh so then what are appetizers? Mid meat treats,  yup.

Amazing pizza and great service! My fiancé and I were in Tennessee visiting his family during the holidays and we were looking for a quick bite to eat after we landed at the Nashville airport. We were tired after a long flight across the country so we just wanted something that wouldn't be too complicated. We found Five Points Pizza and we decided to give it a try since you can rarely ever go wrong with pizza! 

We ordered a house salad, garlic knots, and a regular size pizza with half Supreme and half Dave's. Everything was very tasty and the price was so reasonable for all the food we got. We'll definitely be back again when we're in town!

4.5
I am not sure how I have never professed my love for Five Points, but I'm about to make up for it. Wasn't my first time visiting, not will it be my last. I am a New Yorker raised on this style of pizza and in my eyes, Five Points is the only pizza in Nashville that lives up to the New York style pizza hype. 

Visited this time with a party of 5 on Tomato Arts Friday, so it was a little more crowded than usual...definitely expect a wait on any weekend evening though. The half star missing here is for the front of house. I feel like we were forgotten about in the herd, and were only seated (after over an hour wait) when we went back to inquire about the table. 

Please do yourself a favor and order some garlic knots. Yes, they're huge...but I could drink the side of sauce as a meal and be happy. I always order the specialty slices of the day...there will be a meat and a veggie option and generally speaking both are to die for. I have never ordered a full pie, but feel like individual slices are the magic that I miss from the North East. They are cooked perfectly, a beautiful thickness, served on doubled paper plates. Never too greasy, or even worse, not greasy enough. The beer selection is also top notch and this was the first time I noticed they actually do flights of beer here as well. Everyone I introduce to this place becomes a believer at first bite. Not to be missed.

Thank you for making it possible for me to skip the trip back home just for a pizza craving!
Good pizza, garlic knots are huge and service was okay. We ate the vodka pizza and it was delicious.

I love this place for a late night slice of pizza. Good price for a big slice. It always hits the spot especially after a night of drinking. Love that it has a place just to order for a quick takeout or you can choose to dine in next door. If you haven't had pizza here you are sure missing out!!!
Pizza is legit!  I would highly recommend this spot for dinner or lunch.  Solid beer selection too.

After a long 9 hours in the car to Nashville, my friends and I were desperate for a place to catch some late night grub. Not expecting anything special to be open at midnight, we found Five Points and I can say that it blew my taste buds away.  With a dive bar atmosphere, they offer a large selection of specialty pies and local craft brews. Naturally, my group decided to start with a $7 beer flight of local beers based off the recommendation of the waiter (awesome brews) and some garlic knots. For the main course we decided to go with the meatball pie and Zeus and both were delicious. We ordered two 18" pies for 5 of us and we had enough for leftovers. Everything was so good and I would defiantly recommend!!

I usually give this place a 5 star but hadn't been since Covid shutdown.  But today we decided to treat ourselves.  When we got home it was way greasier (Pepperoni/mushroom) than we've ever remembered.  Box full of grease, moved to lid which became soaked in grease. Even after using at least 4 paper towels to soak it up too.  Don't know what's different but we found ourselves unusually disappointed.  We still recommend it overall but if something has changed with ingredients we hope the manager gets this feedback. Not sure if anyone else has noticed this. Sorry 5 points but we want to stay in love with you!

I worked for McDonalds in the late 80's and early 90's in every capacity.  Even worked Grill from dinner to close alone, and I never gave the kind of poor quality food that I have received upon multiple occasions from this location.  One thing that is most disappointing is the quality of the Fries, I ordered through the App., making sure to be as close to the switch over to lunch as possible to get the best fries that wouldn't be sitting long.  Well, the fries looked like they had been left over from the night before and re-heated.  Very disappointing, I will never be going to this location again.   Show a little pride, it maybe a fast food job, but work like you care.

Well, my bestsisterfriend ZOOMZ started working her a few MMXX the ago  and I went to support her. AND CAUSE she said that's where the CLAWS shows got their ndd as old or girls or something so I wanted to check it out. Obviously I can't handle the cool long nails from the show or on display atCthe salin but I got some pretty  blinged out ones. I  had SOOOOOmany compliments over the past 2 weeks I went back snd  got them done again. Definitely recommend.
Really good pie but wasn't a fan of paying $10 for parking. Just don't park across the street, there seemed to be free parking a couple blocks away.

The locals definitely know this pizza place is the best.  They sell pizza by the slice as well as whole pizzas.  The pizza by the slice is HUGE! The garlic knots are a must! Also, if you like salads... you've gotta try a salad. So yummy. I ordered the Greek salad and it was amazing. Our server was great. He was very patient and explained everything to us and answered all 75 questions everyone had at the table.  Definitely returning :)

Stopped in to pick up a half dozen bagels and cream cheese. Was "greeted" by a cashier who didn't even say hello but told me it was a 30 minute wait to get food. Since I was only getting dry bagels and packaged cream cheese she reluctantly let me order. I was then told I couldn't get an 8oz plain cream cheese as that was "reserved for customers who are getting sandwiches." I am also a paying customer and should be entitled to plain cream cheese... anyway 3 stars because the bagels are decent. Will be back to Spread but probably not this location.

Best pizza in E Nashville and probably all of Nashville! Super awesome friendly service, great food, great prices. 

Lunch visit - got the slice, salad, drink for $9. Love the flexibility to build your meal - any salad, 5 different pizza slices (cheese, pepperoni, prosciutto & basil, and then 2 daily options - 1 veg (mushrooms, jalapeno, roasted red pepper, ricotta), 1 meat (meatball, fresh garlic, red onions). I got the daily veg, greek salad, and basil-infused lemonade - loved them all! BF got the meat, house salad, and coke and was super happy too. Pizza slices are huge. We also ordered 1/2 order garlic knots - best ever! Loads of garlic and great marina - must try. We were totally packed when we rolled out the door. Can't WAIT to go back.

I LOVE MAD NAILS! Morgan perfectly executed on my birthday nail design. She has a way of making a birthday girl feels special. I agree with all of the positive reviews. For every special occasion it's MAD Nails for me! Give them a try!

The customer service at this location is always spot on, and the pizza is exactly the same as at the other Blind Onion locations. I came here early on a Friday night to place a takeaway order, and 30 minutes later, it was ready. When I placed the order at 6 pm, there was no line. When I returned at 6:30 pm, it was 15 people deep. Thankfully I was able to nab my takeaway pizza easily, and the two front desk people looked as calm and collected and friendly as they did when it was less crowded. 

I think this is the cheeriest Blind Onion location if you want to dine in, perhaps because it seems like the newest building of all their locations. Lots of open space, nice wood, good and lighting. 

Parking is tight because there's a lot of other restaurants in this corner of the plaza. I usually save myself the stress of navigating the tight turns in the dark and just park in the large open space and walk a little bit of a further distance rather than trying to get a very close parking space. The location is also a bit hidden, so if you're coming here for the first time, look for the Jalapeno's on the corner and the Panda Express opposite the Blind Onion.

I first discovered Five Points Pizza after dinner at a (now closed) restaurant didn't satisfy. FPP filled the void. The stromboli, the awesome beer list, and ohh the garlic knots... comfort was found in this food.

I came back with friends and we enjoyed custom pizza plus garlic knots plus a shared spinach stromboli. The dough is tasty and fresh. The toppings are always fresh. Whether I come for an early dinner, dinner at the peak of busy, or a late night snack, the staff is always friendly and accommodating. Prices are reasonable, especially when sharing among a group.

Tip: if the wait is long and your group is small, look for a seat at the bar to eat. Elevated above the rest of the restaurant, you get prime people watching and the bar tenders are friendly without being annoying. Plus the beers and food come fast since you're closer to the source.

Parking can be a little tricky you you go looking in nearby lots, but by parallel parking on the street, I've never have to park more than a couple blocks away.

I love pizza. I have lived in this town for almost 10 years and I'm ashamed to admit I had never tried Five Points Pizza until it arrived on the west side of town. We were over here for lunch so both decided on a pepperoni slice and some garlic knots.

The good and the bad:

The good: The pizza was very good. Not the best pepperoni pizza I've ever had, but it was very cheesy and satisfying. The garlic knots were ok, and next time I'd give the room in my stomach to more pizza instead, but we had to try them. 

The bad: Service. Our server was noticeably upset that all we ordered was a slice of pizza each and the garlic knots. She kept coming back and asking us if we were ABSOLUTELY SURE we didn't want anything else. She was really pushy about it. I get it, it's between lunch and dinner rush, but sometimes all you want is a single very large slice of pizza.

Also, not food related, but if you are worried about parking there is a lot and a small garage on the side/back of the building so no worries there.

I definitely plan on coming back to try the white pizza, I've heard so many good things about it and enjoyed what we had to enough to go back for another taste in the near future.

Oh my!! There is a reason it has a billion 5 star reviews!!! Get the lemonade! Get the garlic knots!!! They are life changing!! 

We were searching for a quick bite to eat before heading out for the night, and found this gem!  The server recommended the lemonade!  It was fantastic!  Get it!!!!! So we ordered a round and some garlic knots while we looked over the pizza options!  If I lived in Nashville, I'd be the fattest person alive, because all I would eat is lemonade and garlic knots!!!! It's best for my health that I don't live near this place!!! We ordered a combo pizza and a white sauce pizza, they were both good! The combo was better then the white sauce pizza(but honestly, I'm not a fan of white sauce pizza, so do not take my opinion!  Everyone else liked it! If you like white sauce pizza, order it!)   We left full and had pizza to enjoy at home later!  I would come back here in a heart beat!!

I like Blind Onion for the most part.  Every now and then the crust is not quite cooked all the way. But, people working there are always very nice. They have an outside patio that usually needs a good wipe down. Tv's are too high up on the wall. However, the one at the bar is a large screen. I would give this place a 3-star, but since I am a customer-oriented person (and they have good customer service), I gave them a 4-star.

Absolutely classic. Authentic slices every time. I ordered a large cheese and although I was a bit earlier than I was told, it felt as though it had been sitting a bit. It was slightly cooler than room temp. I was expecting a little more flavor out of the cheese pie and it was a little lacking but I'm sure many of the other more loaded pies pack more flavor. Regardless fast service, correct order and the garlic knots are wildly delicious.

Best. Pizza. In. Nashville!!!

I've been a big fan of this place since they opened their doors. Now they even have a second location! 

I love the way this pizza tastes. I don't really go into the dining area much anymore cause it's usually a craving for that Prosciutto and basil pizza that I just need in my life sometimes. So I run to their new by-the-Slice counter they opened a year or so ago and grab a couple. Slices for lunch or on my way home from work. 

The place is always packed, always fun, but always gives me some of the best tasting pizza I've ever had. But I can't get away from the prosciutto basil to say I've tried much else!

In the battle of best pizza in Nashville, Five Points Pizza will ALWAYS be in the discussion. 

Because of the pandemic, we aren't eating IN restaurants right now. But we are FOR sure supporting local by doing pick up/carry out. 

Incredible specialty pies, amazing lunch specials, and always great if you have leftovers. (Hey, pizza for breakfast!)
The pizza and garlic knots were amazing!! Highly recommend checking this place out. Would definitely visit again.

The pizza was delicious! It was by far one of the best pizzas I've had in Nashville, in my opinion. I had the pepperoni Pizza slice and my girlfriend has the vodka pizza slice. We came too late to eat at the restaurant itself but the cool thing is they have a walk through window you can order from and take the pizza Togo. The pizza is rather thin but the slice is real big. Toppings and everything we're pretty moderate, could've used a little more sauce but overall it was really good. The big plus about this place is, that it's open till 3am on weekends!

M.A.D. Nails was a wonderful spot to visit. They offer a variety of nail services and have very artistic abilities. The spot is eclectic and well maintained, quiet and peaceful, and staff very pleasant and accommodating. I needed a manicure for a 1920's Gatsby themed wedding and they brought my idea to life. My only complaint is that for the cost of the Russian manicure and gel/design the polish only last for about a week.

Had lunch at the Los Altos location. Last time I went there we had to order and pay at the counter. They have changed it and now they come to your table and take your order. The waitress was very friendly and helpful with the menu. We ordered the bbq chicken pizza and pepperoni. The bbq chicken was absolutely the best pizza I have had in a long time. They have honey on the tables for the crust which is so yummy. I had a soda and they have the new soda machine that you can put different flavors Dr.Pepper vanilla cherry soda was very good. They have board games and a shuffleboard table so the kids were having a good time and occupied. Very clean restaurant.

I used to good haircuts here and now it's getting to the point where it's terrible. I got a haircut and it was completely different from what I asked for, and the barber her name was Linda she cut my hair and it was literally terrible and now I have to wear a hat from now on and it's so annoying. Another thing is that I used to get my haircut for $14.99 and now it's almost $18 like it can't be because of the inflation but I don't know and it shouldn't be that expensive. Honestly I would've gotten my money back but it's a haircut and there's nothing I can really do about it, so thanks great clips

I like this pizza.  Not my favorite, but the employees are nice (Carey - bartender Thanks Carey), and previous bartenders have always been nice.  

It's close, they have a big tv (needs a o be updated). I am a fan of their pizza crust, except when it's not cooked completely (probably needs to be 'risen' longer.

Restrooms are clean and they have outdoor patio.

I would and will come again!!

This is some solid just ok pizza. Is it better than the chains? Yes. But each time I've ordered from here I am underwhelmed. It's bland and pretty tasteless. But on the positive, it is fresh and if you order it "well done" the crust is much better and less doughy.

This is probably my favorite pizza place. I've been to a lot of big cities including NYC but the pizza is so good and garlic knots too. To boot the service is consistently good which is extremely hard to find in Nashville. Moved away but every time we're back we go.

So despite being listed as wheelchair accessible, they aren't. Their wheelchair ramp leads to a door they refuse to open. They say it's "broken" but from the signs on the door it looks like it hasn't been usable in a very little long time. The bartender was very dismissive and didn't not seem like he cared at all that my friend couldn't get in because the only entrance that did not require climbing up stairs was  unusable.
I have been here for the "artist's choice" gel nails three times and each time was a fun experience watching my nails transform with Sally + my nails were done with such attention to detail.

I went here for my girlfriend to buy her vape juice and they had a lot of favors to pick from. It was small but clean in there I asked for help two times and the guy behind the counter skipped me to go to someone else and the other guy comes to me and I ask him questions and tell him what I need he try's selling me things I don't need and was not friendly I grab some juices and have another question about a battery for her mod and I don't know a lot about vaping but the guy was talking down to me. Then the two of them started talking to each other and I asked for both their names and one said it doesn't matter and the one said he was the manager and asked me whats up and when  he said he was the manager I knew I wasn't going back I just paid for her juice and left.

The service is always spectacular. I'm always satisfied with my services. Unfortunately on my last visit I was scheduled for a 5pm appointment. Around 2pm I revived a message asking me to push to 5:30pm? I agreed. I arrived and wasn't seated to begin my services until 6:44pm. I had plans after my appointment that I did not get to make it to due to the extended wait time I had. This was the first time I've experienced this here so I won't hold it and I will be back soon but I hope that it was just a random one time unfortunate happening.
Best pizza in Nashville! The pepperoni lunch combo is perfect. Great vibes and atmosphere also.

Okay, I know I know.  Why write a review for a fast food restaurant.  I usually don't unless something definitely stands out.  
First of all Lion's Choice is one of my all-time favorites.  If you think that all "roast beef" sandwiches are the same you are mistaken.  There is a reason everyone craves it.  

We've dined at this location for the last few weeks on a Tuesday night after my daughter's soccer practice.  
The service was impeccable.  Each and every evening we've been greeted with a smile and wonderful attentiveness.  I think in this day and age it is rare to find manners and politeness in a fast food restaurant.  

Overall the classic roast beef with swiss is my favorite and you doctor it up anyway you like.  My favorite is with au jus and horsey sauce!  
Its even crazy to mention it but get the "crushed ice".  And don't forget to kid a 25cent cone to finish up your meal!  

Can't be beat!

We were told it would be 30 minutes for our pizza and two salad's received a number and were told that they would get the salads right out to us.  

After 45 minutes we asked why we didn't have our food yet. We were told that it was ready, to go!  They had it sitting in the to go area waiting for us. We told them that we had not ordered it to go. They said they would bring it to us.  When we got it, the salads had the wrong dressing and our pizza was cold.

The Staff that delivered the food looked like they were totally clueless when we asked to see the Manager.  They said they would send him over.  We waited and the Manager did not come, so I got up and went to the counter and asked for him. 

When I finally got to speak to the Manager, I explained to him the situation and he immediately started making excuses.  I told him that why it happened didn't really matter and I asked for our money back so we could leave. The Manager wanted to keep trying to make excuses. I finally told him I just wanted my money back and that I would not be returning. 

I have no idea if their pizza is good, but I can for sure tell you that the service is horrible.  We will not return and I recommend that you do not go their either.

I'm so excited to show off my nail art! I'm more of a "Plain Jane" when it comes to my nails, I decided to step outside the box and Morgan at M.A.D. Nails delivered. My cousin scheduled our appointment online and submitted our "inspo" designs. Her nails, SUPER BLING for her upcoming nuptials and "rainbow vibes" for me. We were greeted, temperature checked and directed to wash our hands. The salon is nicely decorated with artwork, pink sofas and animal print rugs. After a few moments we were directed to our nail station. There was Plexiglass at each station and the nail artists/patrons all wore masks.  Morgan was my nail artist/owner and she was super sweet, warm, creative and spot on with executing my desired design. The appointment lasted for about one hour and 15 minutes. I'm very, very  pleased with my service, I'll be back next month. There's also a two week nail warranty, for broken, chipped nails repair at no additional cost. Great CBD location. Prepare to pay for parking at the meter or download the ParkMobile app ahead of time. Give them a try, ask for Morgan!

This place is great! I highly recommend the super slice! I LOVE that you can design your own slices with whatever toppings you want as my husband and I like totally different things. At first I was afraid it wouldn't be enough food, but they really give you two slices and it is totally enough for a full meal. Also the pizza sandwich is killer!!!

Very disappointed. The last 2 times we ordered pizza from here it was black - as in burned. The last time I refused it & they had another customer's pizza that they substituted. But no apologies. Don't think I will go back for a long time.

An employee was wearing a Defund the NYPD shirt. If the employer allows this it's a disgrace. I realize the employee's freedom of speech, but then I say Defund Five Points Pizza. I'll let all law enforcement know how this employee feels. Pizza was just ok.

Horrible service dept.!!! Very rude , refused to explain repairs and was told I couldn't be help by a young lady that was trying to leave early, but the cute guy that came in after me got helped right away. Will not take my 2 jeeps there again for service!

There's sooo many options to get your nails done - i mean they're on like every corner but this place is a hidden GEM. i started following them on insta from a friend and was thrilled when they opened a shop! The ladies in here are FABULOUS. What they do is art and they are as kind as they are creative! I went in and got the weekly special (which they post on their Instagram - and it's completely customizable) and was not disappointed! Courtni did my gel mani and was so kind and has great attention to detail! I received a text prior to my visit to confirm and was offered water or wine when i arrived (plus plus). They offer a huge variety of colors and check out their insta (@madnails) for their creative looks! Oh, I'm sorry did i forget to mention, THEY DO THE NAILS ON THE SHOW CLAWS on TNT! Yes. Ma'am. Honey. 

They do take walk ins but scheduling an appointment is the way to go here. They are a little pricey, but my gel mani (which usually comes right off) lasted 3 weeks which is so worth it. You get what you pay for!

Carls is an establishment in Reno. It has been around for over 30 years, and is a great bar.  The bartenders are fast and courteous.  Love when the DJ is there and taking requests, she will always play your favorite music.  It is a little of a dive bar, but if you are looking for someplace to spent time with friends over a drink then Carls is that place.  Go and experience it, you won't be sorry you gave it a shot.  
PS come to gear night!!!  It has been happening more frequently and is a great time to chat and meet new people in a casual, fun environment.
Best Pizza in Nashville! The supreme pizza  is my personal favorite but you really can't go wrong. I will probably be doing carry out next time because this  location is on the small side.

Two words - DON'T GO!!  Should have known when I walked in and it felt like I was a piece of meat being circled by dozens of hungry vultures - EEEEK!!

Walked in knowing exactly what I wanted and exactly what I wanted to pay for it.  Made that very clear to the salesman (Scotty) and also mentioned that I hate pressure sales and am very price sensitive.  Scotty was a pleasure to deal with - he did all the sales work (showed me the car, test drove it with me, etc...).  Told him that I had two requirements; 1- the car must be red; 2-it must have heated seats.  Then it came to talking price.  They found a car that was almost what I wanted but had some packages with it that were of no interest to me and the price was too high.  When Scotty saw that I wasn't going to be easily persuaded to pay the ticket price on the car he invited his manager Sam to come chat with me.  Well Sam and I didn't see eye to eye so to speak.  Told me the only way to get my price was to go with the BASE model - which did not come in red or with heated seats, offered me eff-all for my trade and lied to me (as I have been told) about the fact that I would not qualify for the free winter tires and rims program being offered unless I went with the upgraded model.

I found that the pressure sales guy, Sam, was rude and condescending.  The fact that I hate car salesmen to begin with did not bode well for Sam's attempt to pressure me into buying something that was more than what I needed or to settle for something that was less than what I wanted.  The last thing he said to me was if you can find a better price then go for it because you won't get it here.  Well that's exactly what I did.  Gotta say, the next FORD dealership who actually SOLD me the car I wanted for the price I wanted to pay was a completely different/pleasant experience (review for Sherwood Ford to follow).  All they had to do was expand their search and find my dream car in BC...Oh, and offer me a little more than peanuts for my trade.

I find it interesting that when it comes to the 'go-auto' group I have yet to hear of one person who has had a pleasant experience.  I hear the same thing - slimy pressure sales techniques used and terrible customer service.  I have also noticed that management at 'go-auto' is quick to respond to a complaint but nothing EVER seems to really come of it.  (March 16, 2012 - as per the owner comment below I did email this guy.  Surprise, Surpise I did not hear a thing back LOL!!  Who called it...?)

Since I can't give this place no stars - this entire star belongs to Scotty (who like I had mentioned was a pleasure to deal with)!  Rob at Sherwood ford appreciates all the effort you put into selling me my car!
Got there right when the doors opened. Served cafeteria style, so make your decisions quickly! The food was really good. The Mac and cheese was my fav!

My groomsmen and I rented our tuxes here. Fantastic experience. The staff gave me (the groom) lots of personal attention and advice. We all looked great. The process of returning the tuxes was very easy. Prices were reasonable. And the people who work here are very personable. Highest recommendation.

Never watched the show but my husband did/does. He talked about eating here for over a year now. We finally decided to visit St. Louis this weekend and couldn't resist stopping by. Now I've heard mixed reviews about this location and the one in Uppercrust but we wanted to try out the original. I had the catfish, macaroni and spaghetti. The catfish was really tasty, I didn't need the hot sauce. The macaroni had a basic home style taste. The spaghetti was different a little sweet but ok. My husband had the fried chicken, macaroni, cabbage and yams. The fried chicken was ok, nothing to brag about. The yams and cabbage were delicious. I had water but after taking a sip of his lemonade I had to order a glass. The lemonade was very good!

Our waiter was Calvin, my husband recognized him from the show. The staff were friendly and the atmosphere was nice and pleasant. I expected it to be crowded but it wasn't. We went around noon on a Saturday. I would definitely visit this place again.

These guys are great.

It's always a challenge to find a new mechanic when you move. (Can I get an "amen," ladies?) My car was in desperate need of new tires, so after Yelping and Googling to the ends of the internet, I finally crossed my fingers and went with Indy Tire.

I'm so glad I did. They were exceptionally helpful, worked around my schedule, and made sure I understood the work that they were doing. I only set out to get two new tires, but I liked them so much that I went back the week after to get two more.

Don't look any farther!

If I can give no star, I would but yelp doesn't allow that. 
I came to St. Louis to visit and heard this was the best. Unfortunately, I can't agree. This place had THE WORST service I've ever had in my entire life. I was in the front, ready with my tray and waited 1hr for them to bring out fried chicken. They don't allow substitutions for your chicken so it's either all or nothing. There was a huge line waiting on this chicken. I asked the server on the line how long for it to be ready, he said 5 mins. So I waited. 15mins later, I asked again, same answer. 20mins later, same thing. 45mins later, same thing. I've never been so livid. Then, to top it off, I go to my seat and my waiter is no where to be seen. I pretty much ate all my food and finally received my water that I had to flag down from another waiter. All in all, worst place ever. I will NEVER come back to this place again!

If you want to wait 3 hours in line and then 1 hour for your food then this is the place to go. If not, this is not the place for you.

Maybe I have been hiding under a rock but I had never even heard of Sweetie Pie's until my brother mentioned this placed to me. Apparently the store has a show on the OWN network-- but after visiting here, I am trying to figure out why they have a show. Although, my brother went to the other location during his last visit to St. Louis and just felt the meal was O.K. he still felt the the need to drag me and my family to try this place. This was the worst $40 bucks (on two meals) that I have spent in a while and I was upset for DAYS! First off the line was to the door when we arrived . For this to be considered a buffet style service, I am not sure what took so long. We waited in line for an hour-which was ridiculous! As we were standing in line I noticed they had rules like "do not touch" around the wall written on computer paper or t-shirts and other merchandise they were selling hanging around the wall. It was just really bad decorating for a place that has a television show on a major network. When we finally got to the front the process was still taking a very long time and the prices were ridicules for what they were selling.  They would place our meat on a plate and the plate would be on the bar line in the cold while we stood there a while longer waiting to get our two sides, drink, and/or dessert.  For my husband's plate of ribs and my plate of fish, two sides each, one bottle of water, and two desserts it was $40 bucks! What a rip off! And my food was cold by the time I sat down at my table. Finally when we dug into the food I was even more disappointed. My husbands short ribs tasted gross and my fish was hard and not seasoned well. As a southerner from the deep south of Mississippi, this is a horrible representation of what southern cuisine tastes like. I am not going to waste any more time writing about this place, my advice---if you truly know what southern cuisine taste like don't go to Sweet Pies. In my opinion, this is one of the worst meals I have ever wasted my money and time at.

Food was OK, but the service was awful!  We waited for an eternity before someone could be bothered to take our order.  Our waiter then went on break before we even finished our meal.  We wanted more coffee, but he was too busy sitting at a table reading.  When we finally did get our bill, they charged us for each refill of coffee!  What place does that???!!  Obviously the customer doesn't come first in this establishment!  I cannot be bothered to come back!  The food wasn't bad, but the lousy service and the fact that you are charged for each coffee refill makes this a place I would never want experience again!

I didn't quite understand the line system...it took my party about an hour and a half before we were able to get food and seated (this was on a Saturday around 2pm).  I ordered the whole fried chicken with mac and cheese and green beans on the side.  As a soul food joint, the fried chicken met my expectations, but I wasn't a big fan of their sides.  Both Mac and cheese and green beans were too sweet for my taste.  

All in all, I wasn't all that impressed with Sweetie Pie's.  I recently moved from Houston, where there were lots of soul food options, so I don't think Sweetie Pie's did anything that much more to impress me.  I certainly don't want to wait that long again to get food.  It was an experience, but I won't be a regular.

I was in town for the Christmas holiday and decided to visit Sweetie Pies. We initially went to the Upper Crust location but unfortunately it was closed, so we headed to the one on Mangrove. When we arrived, we stood in line for about 40 minutes and it was well worth the wait. I absolutely love the show on OWN and the food tasted as good as it looks on television.  I ordered the catfish, mac-n-cheese, and cabbage. The sweet tea was delicious...tasted as good as it does in Atlanta. Our waiter was Tim's best friend, JR, and he was quite entertaining.  JR was very attentive and worked hard to make sure we all were satisfied with our experience.  I didn't order any dessert but my wife ordered the peach cobbler and thought it was delicious. She also ordered the fried chicken and loved it.  The food was so good...but it's sad that we can't get this kind of good food in Atlanta. Anyway, if you are up to waiting in line and you're in the STL area, you must visit Sweetie Pies on Mangrove...you will not be disappointed.
This would have been rated 5 stars, however, I found a piece of hair in my catfish. JR was very apologetic and immediately replaced my entire meal. I personally think that I should have been refunded for my meal but hey, no big deal, I'm not that hard pressed for a free meal.

The food is amazing and the staff are so kind and hospitable. I love the decor. This is cafeteria style dining. The tip jar are for the food servers and it is recommended that you leave tip for the wait staff. Also the menu options change daily so if you are looking for a particular item, you may want to call ahead. I had the fried fish, black eyed peas, mac n cheese, peach cobbler, fried chicken, and ribs. Excellent.

Omg, Omg, OMG!! I should stop here but I won't. Mustve come before there was a show here so didn't see any cameras. Portions were ginormous. Catfish and fried wings were flavorful, crispy, and HUGE. I really shouldn't have ordered that much. Sides were great, I wish I wasn't so full I wanted to fit more in my belly.

So when you walk in, it's a bit different bc its kind of cafeteria style. If you are a muller like me you better take some time to decide before you head to the line! "cafeteria crew" moved you along fast and were a bit sassy, but definitely not in a bad way. They crossed out the tip part when I paid, I don't know why so when we sat down to eat I couldn't leave our server/busser a tip so I felt bad. Will def bring some cash next time because he was very friendly. It was quite packed so we had to share a round table with strangers, but that was ok. 

Liked the black Jesus on the wall!

We've eaten at Sweetie Pie's At The Mangrove numerous times, but haven't been there for a few months. We were in St Louis on business Saturday and decided to go there for lunch. SO DISAPPOINTED!! I had fish, macaroni and cheese, black-eyed peas, and cabbage. The fish and mac and cheese were good. The black-eyed peas were sweet like every cook who walked by added a cup of sugar to the pot! The cabbage used to be wonderful, but what they had yesterday was lukewarm and tasteless. Husband had chicken wings, yams, cabbage, and black-eyed peas. He said my fish was better. The yams were good. He agreed with me on the cabbage and black-eyed peas (and this from a man who likes sweet food!). He enjoyed both of our pieces of cornbread. I like cornbread, but I like Southern cornbread. While this place specializes in Southern-style soul food, the cornbread is all Northern. Sugar does not belong in cornbread!! It's supposed to be bread, not cake.

Sweetie Pie's used to have the BEST sweet tea -- it would quench your thirst in a heartbeat. That stuff they have in the bottle now is pure nasty. The label says "tea", but that's about the only thing that's even related to tea. Good grief. Brewing tea is so easy and it's got to be less expensive than those bottles! Until they bring back "real" tea, opt for water, lemonade, or Coke.

Went to Sweetie Pies for lunch & got a side of greens. I like onion with my greens & found out they charge $.30 for onion. I opted not to pay but after we sat down, my mom said she wanted them. I went back to get the onion & the young lady rang me up & said that'll be $.55. I said the lady (who was still standing there) told me it was $.30. The lady then says "it's $.30  but you paying cash & that's a different cash register, so it's $.55." so I repeated what she said & she confirmed that paying with cash is $. Since when do you pay more to use cash than credit. Then.25 higher, not to mention, they have signs all over that say you can't charge less than $10. First of all, I just spent $30 for a lunch, why do I have to pay for a pieces of onion (mind you it wasn't even a whole slice? I handed her back the onion & cashier said ma'am I'll pay the difference. I went back to pack my food up, cause I'm upset & I've lost my appetite. One of the workers paid for the onion & brought it to me. I politely declined, packed my food and left. Customer service clearly isn't a priority and I'll be spending my hard earned money elsewhere at a place that appreciates my business.

This was hands down my worst experience at a restaurant. My wife and I went in for sandwiches on a sunday afternoon. After waiting for 40 minutes and no sign of our waitress Aimee, I went to the counter to see when the food might be coming. I was told in a very rude manner that "It's a sunday and they are busy." and since there was also an 11 top that mine and my wife's food had to wait. She then told me (40min after we ordered) that they may or may not have one of the ingredients for my sandwich. "Does that make a difference?" Yes! It does! You also could have brought that to my attention after i ordered! The thing that got me aggravated the most was that this woman never once used the word SORRY. That is all that it would have taken to make the situation better. She then proceeded to talk about us to the owner. The conversation took place almost right next to us. She did mention to him that "he would have trouble with table one" (us). After we got of food I did tell her that it was very good. Her reply was just "Worth the wait." After we were finished she tells us that "it's ok, we can pay. Don't worry its ok" Whatever that means. The problem was that she never brought us a check. I go to the counter and I did not get a word from the owner. Not how was everything, or a sorry about the wait. It just shows that it is more than just Aimee with the bad attitude. It runs through the whole place. I worked in restaurants for 10 years and I never have acted the way she did or even met anyone who acted the way she did. From me and my wife a 20% tip means that you were an ok waitress. We normally tip 20-30%. This is the first time I have ever not tipped. Yes the food was good, but I will never go there again. I will also make sure no one else has this miserable experience.

Oh Chipotle, I think our love affair is coming to an end.  I've noticed in the past few months that you are serving considerably less food in your bowls than in the past and this makes me extremely sad considering I'm paying about the same cost.  

Let's be honest for a second here, I cheated on you and went to Qdoba the other day.  I got my regular - the bowl (er, "naked burrito") - with the same toppings and add-ons for $3 less that was overflowing with deliciousness. 

This is so hard for me, but I'm sorry - it's over.  I'll miss you and your snazzy music selection

I went here twice. The food was good. It has a cafeteria feel to it. The chicken is rather good. It's not the best I've had. In fact, I didn't take my relatives to Sweetie Pie's when they visited. There were better restaurants to go to. Their collards are great and so were the candied yams...Delicious.

I have been using TC for a few months now and have been so impressed with the service. Their employees are held to RIGOROUS standards - TC's owners Rozy and Caroline are super strict about how they hire, but it's so important when you're letting people into your life and home. They show up on time and ready to work, are courteous and considerate, and go above and beyond. I have been impressed with every single one of their nannies. Highly recommend without reservation!

We were so excited to try Sweetie Pies upon recommendation that upon our arrival in St. Louis, we were already planning dinner at breakfast. We arrived around 7pm to a corner diner with so much character. The service is designed to be ordered at a counter which displays hot foods prepared and served on plates and placed on a cafeteria tray. You have quite a few selections such as catfish (which was my choice) along with fried chicken, BBQ ribs, spaghetti, etc. Sides include but not limited to Yams, Mac and cheese, okra, collard greens, etc. 
The portions are very large. I recommend caution here because the food is high in fat content and it will create a very bloated feeling making you miserable like it did me within 30 minutes. I didn't recover until 7 hours later. Also the food was lukewarm. However, because the flavor was amazing, the temperature was easily overlooked. 
Would I eat here again. Sure. Next time my guest and I will share a meal. Just too much food. 

Cost $38 for two people entrees included (1 soda, 1 water, dessert). 
Parking curbside FREE
Recommendation on improving chances for a good dine in experience:
Do not go around closing when choices are limited and temperature lukewarm

Let me preface this review by saying that I've never seen their TV show on OWN. I tried them because I am a food connoisseur of soul food.

My strategy was to arrive around 3:45 p.m., in an effort to miss the lunchtime crowd and avoid the dinner rush. Mission accomplished.

Unbeknownst to me, the food is served cafeteria style and not cooked to order. I was taken aback a bit, but I can go with the flow. The entrees included pork, fried chicken and fried catfish. With that being said, the candied yams lacked any spices, the macaroni and cheese was overwhelmed by black pepper, and the fried chicken lacked flavor. On a positive note, the caramel cake was moist and delicious.  Sadly, the cake was the only item the menu that was noteworthy, in fact, all the desserts looked very tempting.

Sadly, Sweetie Pie's left a bitter taste in my mouth. I was told that their last television season was filmed at their other location, so maybe they have the best cooks there.

Delicious! I got the fried catfish, sweet potatoes, and macaroni and cheese. It was all great! The restaurant was clean and cozy and the staff was very friendly. The only complaint I can make is that I left way too full! Good job Sweetie Pies! I will definitely be back and spread the word! :)
good reliable food, fast and easy.  and pretty tasty too
The service was great, and the food was to die for! It should be a sin to eat this good!! Every time I go to St. Louis, I now have to go to Sweetie Pie's!

My coworkers adore Chipotle.  At least three of them get a burrito at least once a week if not three times.  There's good reason for this. 

First, Chipotle has the cleanest look and feel of any Mexican fast food joint around. It's classy, modern, and the offerings are very similar.  Second, the food, as you will read on their menu, is locally sourced and organic (at times).  Third, the food looks and tastes fresh-- easily the biggest positive.  Finally, the proportions are filling.  

The reason for four stars is less about  the fact it's a fast food joint that doesn't have a second to slow down.  You enter the assembly line, you order your food, and the cashier is more interested in getting to the next person than serving your needs.  That's expected.  It's about the fact that regardless of the clean, modern feel it's $7 for a burrito that is mostly rice. Sure, it's the size of a small child, but it doesn't justify the ratio of rice to meat/veggies. 

It's true. I'm a fan of Chipotle. I'll go back, but I wish they'd double up the veggies for me and limit the rice.
I live for the vegan sofritas and eat here way more often than I should.

We came here for dinner on a Sunday night. the line was not out the door but was still pretty long when we arrived. The line moved pretty fast.

I got the chicken wings with a side of sweet potatoes and rice. Ooh and the banana pudding. The wings had a nice flavor. they were fairly large. the sweet potatoes were good but a bit too sweet for me. The rice was just white rice with gravy. I am not a fan of cornbread, but the cornbread was good. 

I thought the music was a bit too loud. I could barely hear across the table. the service was friendly for the most part. the dessert lady was really friendly. the bread lady not so much. the guy bringing us drinks and such was super friendly. 

it was good and i would go back, but i don't know if it is a place that I would just go to because i felt like it. Meaning i would not be like OMG I HAVE TO GO TO SWEETIE PIE'S!

Ok, the line is long, often really long. But it's worth it! If you're in the mood for some home-style cooking, the kind of food that will make you want to take a long nap then head straight for Sweetie Pie's.

The fried chicken is amazing, so good that i can never pass it up so i can't comment on any of the other options The sides are really good, all the usual classics like mac and cheese, cornbread, thick and creamy mashed potatoes. But don't fill up, because you absolutely have to have dessert. The peach cobbler and pear cobbler are to die for but the king is the banana pudding. It's out of this world. Hands down the best i've ever had.

Service is cafeteria style but all the staff are really friendly and helpful. The sweet tea is far too sweet for my liking, but that's about the most negative thing i can say about the place.
I had ribs, mac and cheese, green beans....everything was amazing.  The best mac and cheese (even better than Mom's), thoroughly licked my fingers clean.

Best fucking soul food I've had in my entire life. 

I had the fried fish. I don't know what kinda seasonings she puts on that fish, but God damn it was good. 
Mac and Cheese=excellent
Candied yams=excellent
Fried Chicken=excellent
Green Beans=excellent

Damn I'm hungry now just thinking about it.  5hr drive from Chicago but I'll make the trip again.

My partner and I come here often for lunch when shopping on Walnut St. The vegan options are limited, but good. I usually get a black bean burrito, however, once I ordered the pinto beans and did not know they were cooked in lard! I tasted it immediately and the manager was kind enough to replace it and give us coupons for a future visit. I will definitely continue coming here!

Meatloaf got me like 
Oxtail 
This is real food. So yummy. Service is great. The workers have a good sense of humor.
Wow, this food is outrageously great! Buffet style. Ribs and Mac are so great! Service was nice, manager stopped by to check how things were going.  I was very impressed. It made me miss home!

Trusting Connections provided 8 nannies to keep the children entertained at the 350-person wedding of our son and daughter-in-law on April 1. There were 45 children there, 20 of whom were under the age of 3! Rosalind helped us plan everything out, including providing age-appropriate crafts and activities for the children, with stations according to age groups. The parents and the children all had a wonderful time, and it was a joyful event that kept the children happy and integrated in an easy way without sacrificing sophistication for the adults. The nannies who came to the event never stopped working and conveyed a warm and fun attitude to all of the guests. There is no way we could have pulled off a wedding with this many kids in a way that maintained a great environment for both kids and adults without Trusting Connections!

Maybe a little too Hollywood and a tad bit overrated? Visited Sweetie Pie's about 3 weeks ago and the crew was there filming. If you don't want to be on TV, be warned, you might be without your consent (so warning ladies if you're traveling through St.Louis and want to try Sweetie Pie's) Now let's get into the food, the chicken was nothing special. Macaroni and cheese was just okay, kind of rubbery. Would have liked to try the collard greens but they didn't have any. The cabbage was alright, again, nothing special. Can't speak on the dessert, didn't try it. The customer service was just okay, the servers make it kind of obvious that they want some camera time. Assuming Ms.Robbie is at the Upper Crust, I'll go there next time. Really wanted to see her! Seen a glimpse of Tim. All in all,  if you want to try Sweetie Pie's go for it but just to say you tried it. Not because the food is worth traveling across the country for.

I have to say this is a decent little hotel. We paid 67 dollars total for one night. TALK ABOUT A DEAL. 
We stayed in a room with a king bed. The room was a decent size with a couch , microwave and small refrigerator. The room appeared to be clean and well taken care of. Let me say that this is an older hotel and does show sign of such. If your expecting a Hilton level of room and ambiance look elsewhere. The room does show some small signs of upgrades IE flat screen tv and white sheets. The rooms are not as terribly outdated as depicted. For what this is its a great deal. 
The front desk agent was pleasant and helpful. The hotel has a small pool and hot tub. Once again this is not a super high end place so don't expect more than what it is. For 67 bucks this is worth the money. Hotel offers a free breakfast but as the recurring theme don't expect 150 a night service for 67 bucks.
Over all a decent place. Nothing special but will stay again for a one nighter.

I'm  going to Sweetie Pies, I'm going to Sweeties Pie come on. Sing it with me...I'm  going to Sweetie Pies .  

We live in the KC area and had to go to St Louis for business.  I've watched a reality show called Sweetie Pie the past couple of years so of course we made plans to go to Sweetie Pies.  

We went to the Mangrove location.  Unfortunately the singing was not necessary.  "Insert a sad face here - sniff, sniff".  The tea that is touted to be "wonderful " was a mouth full of sugar.  Don't  get me wrong, this girl likes her sugar and sweets but I had to call foul on this glass of sugar and switched to water. 

The food was average. I had chicken, mac & cheese, green beans and banana pudding.  Everything  was good but average, I have definitely had better mac.  The cost for the meal was pricey.

So post Sweetie Pies my new song is been there done that, I want my money back Ha ha - Kidding but in all honesty, I wouldn't pay those prices again for average food.
We are fans of their good pizzas.  The garlic know in a local favorite. Today we had pasta.  The Alfredo with broccoli is now my favorite and the best around by far.

Visiting family in Spring Hill for the past few Thanksgivings, and this is the best pizza we've found in the area. Good sauce, nice chewy crust. Might not win best of the Northeast, but definitely a winner for this area.
Great experience! Perfect scoops of rice, nice portion of chicken. They treated me like a king, offering me any of their additional toppings --even guacamole (but it is extra)!

Why was my experience 4 star?  The day I went it was just a vibe in the air that made it fun, even if I had to wait in line for an hour that was going out the door. Reading the history behind the owner (very cool), listening to the music and watching trays of food go by.  I was really hungry to and this was around 7pm on a Saturday night, about 8 by the time I picked up a tray.  As many were waiting for the chicken wings I was able to skip past about 10 people, which was nice.  Be ready to order fast but there aren't many choices either so that's easy and be ready to pay so you don't hold up the line either!  I opted for the ribs (very good), okra (okay), mac and cheese (excellent!), and peach cobbler (which was very good and by the next day, out of my fridge, excellent).  I also had some lemonade which was good but the sweetness was too much for me at the time.  Excellent service.  I will definitely go back.
Ordered a cheese pizza on a whim tonight. We normally frequent another pizza restaurant in the area. We now have a new favorite. I will be driving a little further now to get to Rocco's. Well done.

Sweetie Pie's is a unique experience, especially when a tv show is filming. I visited with some friends who were in town and wanted to go. I don't regret it! It was a little chaotic and crowded even for a weekday lunch. We were surprised to see the tv show filming, which interfered somewhat with service. However, the staff was very accommodating and helpful. 

The food was fantastic, especially the banana cream pie and Mac and cheese. A college choir happened to stop in for lunch on a road trip, and they broke out in song several times. I know this isn't a regular occurrence but it was a nice touch!

Four fried chicken wings plus two sides for $9? Nice. 

Love the easygoing nature of the place... get in line, get your food! And much better food than any other cafeteria you'd fine. 

Did I mention the fried chicken wings? 

I will say I came relatively late in the evening one night, so they were running low on some meat and sides. 

The mac and cheese was good (but not best-ever). The stewed cabbage was also good. Green beans were just okay. 

The space is fantastic. I loved the bar and the tables. Much old-school charm. 

I want to come back to try the duck. 

Everyone was fantastically nice.

I was disappointed.   The service was GREAT and everyone was very friendly and helpful. The food was a letdown, though.  The fried chicken was average, the mac n cheese was good.  The cornbread was very SALTY!   No desire to return.

I eat at Sweetie Pies when I don't want to get in the kitchen and cook my own soul food. I have been going there before the whole tv show thing. I do agree with a couple people who have said as they got more popular the food lost some of its flavor. However, I was surprised when I got my chicken today to realize instead of four wings, I only received three wings for the same price. Now I don't mind receiving three wings but I definitely should not be paying the same prize.

I work down the street from Sweetie Pie's so I come here for lunch every once and a while.  I always get either the fried chicken or the baked chicken.  Both are delicious, but I think on my last visit i made the decision that I prefer the baked.  

I am a yankee born and bred and I just can't get into greens and okra and black eyed peas, although I have tried my hardest!  The mac and cheese is dreamy and definitely the best that I have had in a long time.

The staff is so sweet and they always put a smile on my face. Needless to say, I always leave smiling and stuffed...

was there a few weeks ago, on a sunday afternoon...i was fully prepared to wait in the 'after-church crowd' line; luckily there was none!  i ordered fried chicken wings, mac n cheese, greens, cornbread & banana pudding for dessert...i ordered it to-go...my ONLY complaint is that i KNOW i told several people (at the beginning of the line and at the end of the line) that my order was to-go; the young lady that bagged my food even asked if i needed to-go utensils; i said YES...when i got to the car and opened my bag, guess what??  no eating utensils!! ppffff!!! really??? so i had to go back in and get some...i made sure i went to the SAME young lady that asked me if i needed any...i told her that she did NOT give me any to-go utensils...no apology, no nothing.
