Her fried chicken was pretty and brown , but it lacked SEASONING. No salt or pepper. Just chicken. I hate that! The mac and cheese to sweet! I could taste the sugar. Maybe I'm so biased because I can cook and don't rely on others for a good meal?? The price range is good tho. $14 for 4 wings, 2 sides, drink, and peach cobbler. I will come back to sweetie pies because I want to support local businesses and I'm very happy for her success. I just know my granny can throw down in a kitchen better than she can. =)

What's to love about Chipotle in Center City?

 - space
 - signage
 - ingredients
 - staff

The space is beautiful. A row of tables bisects the restaurant vertically allowing for two paths: to and from the counter. There are also stools overlooking Walnut Street and a wood-paneled booth. It has high ceilings and gets plenty of light. For such a narrow space, it is efficiently arranged.

The signage is simple and clear. You may choose from tacos, burritos and several different types of meats. The first sign states the local, organic, sustainable nature of the meats available: a huge selling point. 

The staff are knowledgeable, accommodating, yet still fast. I told them that I was allergic to lime, and they immediately confirmed with the manager which dishes had lime and what I my options were. There is lime in the rice, guacamole, corn, and all variants of beans. 

I went with the carnitas (pulled-pork) tacos on soft shells with lettuce and spicy salsa. The pulled pork was juicy and tasty, and the spicy salsa was flavorful yet not too hot. The soft taco shells were also moist.

Overall, the space is beautiful and the food is tasty, quality, and cheap. Solid.
Yum! I love Sweetie Pie's! Definitely try the Mac n cheese with your chicken!

Absolutely the best Mac & Cheese ever...in fact I don't really like most macaroni and cheese but this is something special! Fried chicken wings, corn bread, green beans, sweet tea and great live music made this an awesome lunch and we ate so much there will not be any reason to have dinner. Friendly staff and even though it is cafeteria style there was a waiter that brought the sweet tea and the fresh lemonade, cleared the table and brought the to go box. We are so going back to try the rest of the menu though the mac & cheese will be an always have.

Fast service and quality food! Definitely recommend downloading their app, and earning points with every visit (new feature). Also, right near a Starbucks if you need that caffeine kick after the burrito sleepiness kicks in. Pro tip: order ahead via the Chipotle app to skip the line, they do get VERY busy during rush meal times (especially lunchtime during the work week).

Man, oh, man!! A friend turned us on to this place and we've been hooked ever since! An unassuming little pizza joint in a strip mall. The servers are all just super friendly right off the bat and you can grab a seat wherever suits you (or that's available at the time)  The kitchen area is open so you can see them bustling around putting pizzas in the ovens right there, which I personally like bc you can see it's clean and what's going on. But the food...omg, the food is just down right delicious! Don't pass up on a chicken garlic knot. You can spilt one between 2 ppl as an appetizer to start you off. It is out of this world! Then good luck on ordering after that as they have an extensive menu to choose from. Their pizzas are as close to NY pizzas as you're going to get down here in FL. But all their food is great so don't be afraid to explore the menu!

It's a chain and it's tasty, what more do you want?

This Chipotle has really mastered the art of fast, healthier food.  If you walk into this Chipotle (I pronounce it chih-pot-tull) and you see a line reaching to the door, don't fret.  You will be at the front in about 5-7 minutes.  They have an assembly line working back there and they know how to move a crowd.

I go for the veggie burrito bowl.  With the veggie option, you get the guacamole (pronounced wack-a-mohl) for free.  If you want it as a topping, it's going to cost you a couple bucks.  It's pretty easy to keep vegan too which is the normal route I go.  It's under 9 bucks and it doesn't leave you hungry mid afternoon.

In the fast food world, I think Chipotull is winning and I'll continue to support them.

So I've been twice. Both times I left wishing I hadn't eaten the food. 
This is not a place where I was expecting a grand experience, service, ambience, etc. It is just about the food - southern style, home cooking style food. 

I'm a Southern boy. I grew up on catfish, fried chicken, bar-b-que, greens, cornbread, etc. I know southern style food and it is not supposed to taste like the slop you get at the Golden Corral. 

Perhaps I just hit the two days when the quality control guy was home sick but both my experiences were remarkably similar. The chicken was greasy, the catfish was dried out and the mac and cheese was flavorless. I can't remember what the slaw tasted like.

First trip: we ate about half our food and abandoned the rest. We had dinner some where else. Second trip: thought we'd give it another shot, same thing. Ended up leaving a bunch of food and getting dinner down at the Scottish Arms.

I am really disappointed because I had heard so much good and I have been looking forward to real southern style food lately. Oh well, I think the hype is over done.

Was "gifted" this experience by my boyfriend for my birthday last weekend. When we arrived and there was a bit of a line at the door; which was rather strange to me because there was not very many folks sitting in the dining area. FIRST ALARM went off. Stood in line for bout 35-40 mins. and saw that this was a cafeteria style joint where they put the food on your plate. OK, after deciphering the prices and how they charge ya, SECOND ALARM went off. I got two pieces of reg. chicken because those wings were HUGE 3rd alarm!!!! What the hell are these antibiotic fed alien chicken wings NO THANKYOU! Mac and cheese and sides were good, but way too much damn pepper!! WHYYYY so much pepper in EVERYTHING??? Anywho, It's clear that Miss Robbie and Tim are not putting much money into this particular building because its raggedy and kinda unkept. Not good! Service was very slow and the most troubling thing to me was they were definitely frying the chicken in the same oil as the fish, because you can taste it (and the fish was fried so hard that I really couldn't cut it open). I've never experienced that in my life! Anyway, it was a great experience because I am such a fan of the show, but after paying 45 bucks for 2 plates of food, I can comfortably say that I'll never return to this place again.

Trusting Connections has stuck by my family through thick and thin. Every nanny and office employee is kind, reliable and professional. I would recommend their services to anyone, especially those without relatives close by and in need of a backup. Trusting Connections has been a fantastic addition to our life

Absolutely phenomenal pizza. All fresh ingredients, sauce is great, crust is crisp and very light. Changed from our old pizza place. The service is excellent as well. You can't stop with one slice.....plus they have a loyalty program and their own app...Great Place

EDIT: Lakeside has CLOSED.  If anyone has any recommendations for dim sum or know of any restaurants that do general tso's half as good as Lakeside, please please PLEASE contact me!

Can't beat this place for great dim sum at an even greater price.  The food is prepared fresh and quick.  Service is very friendly.  Stuffed eggplant, baby bok choy in garlic and squid satay are some of my favorites.  Their take on general tso's is the best I've ever experienced.  And they have the pencil clock I had as a kid.

I saw the triple D episode and had to go when I got to St Louis. Great experience. Staff was very friendly, but ordering is a bit rushed and confusing when you get to the front of the cafeteria line. Food is fabulous. Highlights were the Mac & Cheese and the Fried Chicken wings. Get there early. I will return next time I am in town!!!

First & last visit to this place. They can't handle being busy & their waitresses get rude. They mess up your order & then get shitty with you because they can't multi-task. She snapped at my mom half way through her sentence. Food takes way too long to come out & then it's luke warm. You get better fish at McDonald's & better service too. They tried to charge us twice for a drink, I took two sips of my drink & then left it because it sucked. They took 45 minutes to bring us our bill. Actually they never brought us a bill, so we guessed our total pitched in cash & walked up to pay. You are better off at Murrietas or La Fuente. Way better food & way better service. I'd give them zero stars if I could.

Only stay if you must!!! Internet is Too slow!!!
They gave me a single bed in the smokin section...i almost puked when i walked into the room.
Took a different room 2 min later and still couldnt get the smell out of my hair.
Internet was like non existant even though they say its free.
What a dump!!! and the people hanging aroung the bar were some truckers stopping on their way to their next stop.

The employees at this Chipotle are nice and attentive. When so went into the Chipotle, there was no one in there except people that have already ordered and seated. By the time I was about to exit the line, the line had extended far back to half the room! It gets very busy during the lunch hour. Most of the time, you can get in and out fairly quickly. 
My only issue with this location was the serving sizes. When ordering my bowl, they would only put on scoop of rice and then shake it to even it out. This would give the appearance that the entire bottom of the bowl is filled with rice. I just kindly asked for more and they seemed to be okay with giving more.

Going to Indy Tire always feels like you're welcome! Brett and his entire team are personable, humorous and give it to you straight. I recently had what could have been a customer service nightmare. But do to Brett being a true professional and a man of his word, my issue was resolved to my satisfaction. I've been going here for 5 years and wouldn't take my vehicles anywhere else. Thank you team!

All I have to say is that when I die, I hope Heaven is like Sweetie Pie's!   We decided to come for lunch today after our return from New Orleans and we just wanted real cooking food.  OMG to die for!  We walked right in on a Friday at 1:30p.  It's buffet style, prices are good, servings were more than generous, food was amazing, like Thanksgiving dinner whenever you want!    Banana pudding was awesome and I only got to have a bite because I was so full-when you don't have room for dessert, you know it's good!  However, it's in a to go box and stuffed with all that was left!  The sweet tea was a tad too sweet, but once the ice melted it was perfect.  Everyone was very nice and Otherwise, amazing. We will return!

Was not impressed, tried them out via a Livingsocial deal.  The Hairstylist did not do a great job of cutting my hair as it has really grown out horribly ( i did not ask for much just a trim and some layering)

Then the color, i showed her a couple of pictures in the magazine of the color and highlights i would like and it ended up looking nothing like what I showed her, the highlights looked brassy and she ended up giving me a purple shampoo to try and wash the brassy look out of the highlights.. Not a good first impression

Fried chicken was great, as was the green beans and sweet potatoes. The showstopper was the peach cobbler though. Amazing. All for a very reasonable price too. Don't be intimidated by the line, it moves fairly quickly. At least by the time you sit down you know you'll have food in front of you to devour.

Sadly, this gem of a Sandwich shop was destroyed by fire on Christmas eve.
They had the most interesting sandwich selection in the area.
Apparently the owners plan to rebuild so I look forward to eating there again.

Here's a link to an article about the fire:  http://www.swarthmorephoenix.com/2012/01/26/news/countryside-market--deli-plans-to-rebuild-after-fire

My husband and I went to Sweetie Pie's because we saw the show in the Oprah Winfrey Network.

I was super excited and It was well worth the wait (we drove from Milwaukee on a road trip so there was a long drive involved). 

The food was amazing - very yummy. The service was very good as well. It lived up to my expectations, for sure!

This is my favorite place to hit up for some good ol' fried chicken. Actually they serve fried chicken wings, but they are significantly bigger compared to most wing places.  And I like that. 

Because the restaurant is set up as a cafeteria serving line style, sometimes, you could get your fried chicken right off the fryer (Simply the BESTt!) or get 'em semi-cold off the serving tray.   Either way, it's definitely worth making a trip for their perfectly seasoned crispy fried chicken and other mouth-watering main dishes like fried catfish, pork chops, etc.  And their quality sides -  candied yams, corn bread, steamed cabbage (I don't even like vegetables!), and their Spaghetti (which is only served on Fridays is again the BEST!) -   set them apart from their competitions - if there are any.

The restaurant also has an unique style of their own -  live Jazz music, authentic staffs & mamas, and   loyal customers - which makes it a great place to take out-of-town-guests to show a glimpse of the fine eating at St. Louis!

This place hit the spot. The best collard greens I've ever had, the best mac and cheese I've ever had and delicious fried chicken seasoned perfectly and nice and crispy. The greens had excellent texture and taste and the mac and cheese was rich and cheesy-- done right rather than an afterthought like at some palces.

Tara was flexible and easy to get in contact with short notice. I reached out to Tara the week of a family wedding I was in for false lashes. She was able to work me into her schedule. Lash application was quick and reasonable. I will definitely return to Tara if I need make up services in the future.

Me and my family really like the show.  Last wk while in St. Louis for my nephew's graduation, it was the perfect opportunity to go to Sweetie Pie's.  From the airport we met family and headed to the Mangrove location.  After a 1hr wait outside we made it inside.  The greeter was trying to rush us in (we had a handicap family member in a wheelchair); I called him out for rudeness.  Because of the crowd we were routed around the bar, and it was lined with a lot of dirty cups.  Odd thing, 4-5 staff were standing around at the bar dancing and playing around (why didn't they clean this up); my brother mentioned it to staff.  Floors were also really dirty/broom would have gone a long way. Co-owner (mo-hawk guy) was hanging out in the kitchen area w/the cooks (should have been out greeting customers/helping on floor).  The poor manager looked as if she was about to fall apart when busing tables.  She was very friendly when my brother was talking with her, and discussing our initial impression of the place.  She appeared to REALLY BE TRYING BUT RECEIVED VERY LITTLE OR NO RESPECT (my impression, this is nothing she said).  My wife said it best, the food and experience were like the Roller coaster ride of a lifetime that really lets you down after standing in line for an hour then getting on the ride and reaching the climb that you were sure would result in your greatest rush when it dropped on the other side; but end up going straight (no drop) and then you are told to get off the ride.  WOW the line staff; I thought I was back in Army Basic Training, and that was over 20 years ago when it was really rough.  They yelled at you, "WHAT DO YOU WANT, WHAT SIDES!," and then yell it out again after give them your order. At the end of the line, the heavy plates are PUSHED at you. I had to catch the one coming at my 12 yr old. The food was ok/chicken was good.  I would not go back again unless CUSTOMER SERVICE improved 90%. Our waiter was great; we tipped him well.

Tara was flexible and easy to get in contact with short notice. I reached out to Tara the week of a family wedding I was in for false lashes. She was able to work me into her schedule. Lash application was quick and reasonable. I will definitely return to Tara if I need make up services in the future.

GOOD EVERYTHING!----greens, mac, sweet potatoes, peach cobbler, pancakes, cabbage, porkchops, turkey legs, fish and neck bones. The fried chicken could use a little more love, however. 
   My belly just growled.

My first time in, the rep was friendly and helpful so I decided to return for some minor service work.
I dropped my vehicle off the night before scheduled service which was to take about an hour plus an oil change. At the end of the day I had to call them only to be told to leave the vehicle yet another night. Mid afternoon two days in I finally get a call to get it back but it's still not fixed!
They charged me $240 for an OLF and to "allegedly" replace a part that didn't fix the problem. 
They didn't seem to recognize that they failed to fix the problem that brought me in but they billed me for it!
They clearly didn't care that they inconvenienced me for 48 hours on a booked two hour job. 
I was on vacation and dressed down...perhaps I should have worn a suit.
I found them cold, dismissive and unapologetic.
Overall a poor experience not unlike the other reviews.

This is the BEST Mexican food I have ever tasted in the Reno/Sparks area!  The menudo is better than any that I've had anywhere-just superb.  The tacos & burritos were fantastic as well; this is as authentic as Mexican food gets.  This is the first time I've eaten at Lupitas, but have been on a quest for truly great Mexican food in my area for many years.  We will definitely make this a regular favorite restaurant for our family!

I bought my first car at Kentwood in 1989 and have been visiting ever since.  These days most of my business is with the Service Department.

Most of the time my vehicle is ready either on time or a little earlier than expected.  Lee Papirny is knowledgeable and always very helpful.

So I'm a fan of the fast food burrito-kill me. I let my friend in on my little secret, and now we're both crazy fans of the fast food burrito.

First of all, it's really hard to find a seat here during the lunch rush and the dinner rush. That's just the way things are. Second of all, you'll defiantly have indigestion and mad diarrhea if you try eating this before you wait 5 hours from when you ate before. 

The burritos are huge and cheap (it's fast food) and you can build them yourself. I recommend pinto beans and white rice.

The food was excellent!  We came from Chicago and we all enjoyed the food. Folks was dancing, praising, crying and feeling emotionally drained when we left because we got filled with all good stuff.  The live music was the icing on the cake.  In fact the water was good.  I have nothing bad to say except they need more staff to get the line moving

Ate here today for an early dinner. It was only my table an another table being acupied. After getting seated our drinks an salsa and chips came out right away. There salsa was extremely spicy hottest iv ever tasted at a restaurant which for some ppl that can be a good thing for me it wasn't tho it was to hot to eat. After about ten or so minutes the food came out. I ordered a carne asada burrito with rice an beans on the side. It was all pretty good the price was reasonable overall it was alright I would probably go back but maybe order something different.

I spent almost 2 months in trying to get a new vehicle within the city of Edmonton and went from dealership to dealership looking for help. My 1999 Dodge Durango was almost at 275,000 and the engine was nearing its last legs. The drivers window no longer went up or down, the rear defrost no longer worked, and I was using close to $75 a week in fuel .......... BOTH of us were a hurting unit.

I first went to Londonderry Dodge because I was a Dodge owner. The salesrep I worked with was awesome and with a limited budget and my trade in on the Durango we started with a few vehicles and after a week of negotiating back and forth ........ I walked away when they wanted my truck for $500 ..... a deposit of $1,000 AND a co-signor (even though I have been employed with the Canadian Forces for 13 years).

Then I tried their competitor ........ CrossTown Motors. I contacted them by phone and explained everything. I explained I was looking to trade in my truck and was willing to put a deposit down. They offered me one vehicle, and ONLY one vehicle - a 2009 Neon, at a stupid price with an outragous interest rate. Moving on ..........

A friend of mine suggested to try City Ford because they were a HUGE supporter of those in the forces and so I thought I would give them a try. I first contacted them by phone and again explained everything. I told them I was NOT going to the dealership unless we did the credit thing first and then we could work from there. 4 hours later, I got a call back from a dealer and this was the conversation ........
"I am sorry sir, but we can't help you" ........... Now why should I mention this? Because the entire time he spoke to me - HE WAS LAUGHING!!!!

Last but not least - one last kick at the cat. I went to Kentwood / GoAuto because my neighbor just bought a Dodge Charger and said the service was awesome; so I hit their website. I ended up speaking with a salesrep and he was helpful. So I went to the dealership and explained everything, yet again. I was told that they would do everything they could to get me in a better vehicle. It took 1 day to get the approval and I was offered 3 different vehicles.

Now I wanted to stick with my Dodge, because I've never been much of a Ford fan, but I shouldn't complain. I am now driving a '09 Fusion, V6 Manual, loaded - and with all taxes and such ........... walked off the lot with a final price of $16,5

Amazing food that is SO GOOD! 
So coming here, it is cafeteria style so you will stand in line but it will be worth it even though it is TORTURE to do so as you stare at this awesome smelling and looking food the whole time!  Everything looks so good!

The fresh homemade lemonade was wonderful.  After you sit down the waiter will give you free refills on your lemonade or sweet tea.

I had the chicken wings/thighs, macaroni & cheese, green beans, candied yams, and cornbread. Best wings/thighs I have ever had!  
All the sides were great!

My husband had much of the same sides but had the meatloaf. He loved it. He had the banana pudding and he loved that too.
When it is busy there it is pretty chaotic but the tables are big enough that you don't feel imposed upon. It is surprisingly not that loud for the amount of people that are there.  You can still carry a conversation.
Everyone was really nice and we are coming back!

Believe the hype!
Was in town for Scentsy convention and we looked up good places to eat. We were intrigued by the souls food and high reviews, and it paid off!!! Great food, great service, fun atmosphere.
I had the 1/2 fried chicken special with sides of mashed potatoes, beans, and cornbread (only negative i had was the cornbread was slightly dry...).  The fried chicken was among the best I've ever had, great flavor, crispy skin/breading, moist and tender inside.  OMG sooo good! Some of the other items consumed by our group included the macaroni and cheese, and the yams (both of which sold out while we were there, they're that good).  It was one of the cheapest restaurants I've gotten food from and way better than I expected. Food is served cafeteria style and then the waiters/bus boys take to your table and check in and make sure you are good while there. Save some room for dessert: I had the peach cobbler, friends had the banana pudding. Excellent all around. Highly recommend!

I used Trusting Connections by way of the Raytheon Back Up Care Advantage benefit. I needed last minute care for my sons, a 6 month old and a 3 year old. I have so far had 3 different in home nannies through this service and have been nothing but pleased. 

Each nanny has been prompt and attentive to the boys and there is only peace and quiet when I arrive home. Which if you have been around 2 young boys will know can be a rarity. 

Their nannies are background checked and CPR certified. Two things that help give a parent peace of mind. Their quality is exceptional and I wouldn't hesitate to use them again.

Gastronomy is the art of craving. Most of it is not physical; senses are merely the warming embraces of the hidden desires. Sweetie Pie's penetrates all such embraces and arouses one's most deeply embedded cravings. Something very primal is being touched by the pungent smells, humid smokes, and almost grotesque appearance of the food items that await their transpiration. But the rawness of such embodiment and catalyst of craving only revives the remoteness of their sublime origins. Their barbeque ribs are the harp of Venus, their fried catfish is the boat of Neptune, and their fried chicken, the wings of Mercury, You can't escape the seduction of heavenly bodies. You end up craving the remaining traces of their water, grass, mud and stones. 

In short, the food is divine. So is their sweet tea of course.
The best Mexican restaurant  on sparks & reno área the service it's good and the food it's very good
I loved the food. The fried chicken wings, Mac n cheese and collard greens were really good. I also had the cobbler which was awesome. I would definitely visit again if I'm ever in STL!
The food is outstanding! I had the fried catfish and it was great! The sides were awesome! The place didn't have parking lot so you have to look for a spot. I will be back for some more!

After getting a flat from curbing my tire, I needed to find the same model of tire I had.  I called Indy Tire, and not only did they have the lowest price in the Carmel area, but it arrived the quickest too!  

I was told that my new tire would arrive the following day around 11.  The next day, I called at noon, and they said they hadn't seen it yet, but would call me as soon as UPS arrived.  Less than 10 minutes later, they called me and said my "necklace" had arrived.  I had been impressed with their customer service this far, and their sense of humor was the icing on the cake.

I dropped my car off, but was unable to get a ride back to work. I mentioned I'd just take an Uber, but they offered me a ride back to work to Main and Rangeline.  SUCH CUSTOMER SERVICE.

They called me about 2 hours later saying it was done.  When I arrived to pick up my car, they were all very wonderful again, and the price was even cheaper than when I was quoted the previous day.  

They have a customer for life, and I'll be recommending them to everyone.  Indy Tire Carmel is the whole package - cost and excellent customer service.  Thank you!!!
Don't go here! I brought in two pair of shoes. Some shoes for my stepfather and a pair of boots that needed a heel repaired. They took forever to fix the shoes and they LOST my boots!

I have been wanting to come here ever since I've seen the show. I had very high expectations and I'm a little disappointed. 
Catfish- there was too much breading on it and not enough actual fish. And I hate to say it but it was a little over seasoned.
Mac n cheese- it was ok. I've tasted better but it wasn't too bad.
Cabbage- it didn't have much flavor.
Yams- the yams were very good!!!
Corn bread was ok. 
We waited for a very long time to be seated. Overall I'm glad I had the experience but it was just ok to me.

We are new to Trusting Connections but so far our experience has been great! They have been able to provide extra coverage for us that our regular nanny has not been able to work. So date nights and weekend commitments have been easy to cover now that we have Trusting Connections!

1st and last time we ever come to this place. The waitress didn't want to refill our drinks. Spilled the drink on us after she was upset I went to the bar to ask for a refill. Never said sorry.  Wait 1 hr for the food that was mostly tacos. Waitress kept coughing while handling our dishes. Never again!!!

We booked Tara for our wedding this past weekend in New Hope, PA (May 25).  She was wonderful.  All the ladies, myself included, LOVED they way they looked.  The quality was great.  The style was fantastic.  And Tara was very professional and kind.  She took care of 8 women with ease.  We couldn't be happier.  I will recommend Tara to everyone!!!  Thank you, thank you for making our dream day start on such a high note.  

Warmly,
Rebecca (from Los Angeles)

I left the gym, went by the liquor store on the way home, wanting to pick something up but not quite sure what I wanted. Texted a few options to a friend and struck up conversation with a couple guys looking for whiskey. Guess that made the old blonde worker suspicious of me and started trailing me. She brought up how other liquor stores in the area have been robbed and implied that I was up to no good. I guess it's because I was still in my gym shorts/hoodie or my skin tone, who knows. Getting profiled and kicked out was definitely humiliating. I just wanted to buy a damn drink.

Service here was horrible!! I had to get a waitress to take our order, not only did she take it wrong she brought us wrong drinks. Waitresses were just hanging around the cash register not paying attention to costumers.  Food was cold. Just an overall bad experience

Some of the best fried chicken I've ever had, and I know my fried chicken.  Good mac n cheese as well.  Large portions for the price.  The collard greens had a sweetness to them, which I don't like, but overall great soul food. On the Sunday afternoon that I visited, there was live jazz music which made the experience even better!

So we try to get out at least once/week to get away from the BBQ or oven in the house.  I always have to pick so this time it had been awhile for some Italian at supper.  

You cannot see their sign next to Publix due to the trees at the mini mall but it's well worth the effort.  Been some time but had the Medium Stromboli this time. I thought I was a big eater too.  What was I thinking?  I could only eat 1/2 of it and it was supper for the following day too.  Excellent flavor. They give you a proper sized sauce dip too.  Wife had grilled chicken salad and she was actually able to finish hers and was very pleased also.

Very reasonable and friendly staff.  A lot of regulars even mid week here and now I know why.  Excellent.  Last time I was there the pizza was excellent too.  They even sell pizza by the slice.  

We will be back more frequently in the future.  Very affordable.

Every year at our organization's national conference, we take one night to have a staff dinner. Our conference took place in St. Louis and Sweetie Pie's was on the list of suggested eateries. When we chose it I was thrilled. I will never pass up a chance to eat some soul food, especially as I haven't exactly inherited the ability to cook soul food like my granny.

So, we did wait in line for about a half hour on a Tuesday evening around 7 pm, but it was worth it. The menu is a lot more limited then t seems online, and they serve certain meats on certain days. The Tuesday meat options were Salisbury steak, pork steak, pork chops, and fried chicken. Every single one of us ordered the fried chicken out of 10 people. I think that means something lol. Alright, so, the food is served cafeteria style. You wait in line and grab a tray and silverware and let the servers know what you want as you move through the line. The fried chicken looked the best to me. It was fresh hot and seemed to be the most popular choice. You can choose to add 1-3 sides to your meal. I got three sides which made my meal $13.25. The portions are great so I felt it was worth it. Sides were boiled okra, white rice, creamed corn, green beans mashed potatoes, mashed sweet potatoes, black eyed peas, and of course the famous macaroni and cheese. I got the Mac and cheese, black eyed peas, and mashed potatoes. All plates come with a large square of cornbread. You can also get a dessert for $3.25. I got banana pudding, my favorite! You order your drink at the end, pay, and the servers will bring your drink to the table. The servers also carry ladies' trays which I thought was a nice touch. Our server was one of the nicest people I have ever met at a restaurant. He was super attentive, and just very friendly. We really appreciated that. 

So now getting down to the nitty gritty- the food. Fried chicken-crunchy, crispy, very well-seasoned, huge portion when you get the breast, chicken thigh, and wings. Black eyed peas were a solid good. The mashed potatoes were smooth, yummy, but I did think the gravy was slightly salty. I still gobbled it down though! The corn bread was a little misleading- I thought it was going to be sweet but it was unsweetened cornbread. I guess it makes sense since everything else was flavor packed, it balanced out the meal. Now for the stars of the show- the Mac and cheese and the bread pudding. Man. I loved the Mac and cheese. Thick, browned cheese crust in the top, gooey, cheesy macaroni on the bottom. I should have gotten two sides of that! I could have eaten that macaroni and cheese forever! Like on and on and on. It was so good. I loved it! The banana pudding was so good. Like, perfect ratio of pudding to bananas to cookies. 

Please try Sweetie Pie's at least once. You won't regret it!

I had the pleasure of dining at Sweetie Pie's At the Mangrove on Sunday afternoon and the fried chicken was great.  Fried Chicken, Green Beans, Black Eyed Peas, Sweet Tea and Cornbread . . . WOW, I feel like going back for lunch today.

I am a fan!

It took my buddy from undergrad for me to try this joint out and I'm glad I did. We went on a Sat and it was a night the show was taping. It was  the longest I have ever waited for food .....almost hr. and 45 mins just to get to the food lol but it was well worth it. Love the ambiance of the old classic building and great soul food 

Double order of mac and cheese 3/5.... I would give it a 4.5 but I don't like sugar in my mac and cheese

2 chicken breasts:..... 4/5   Juicy hot and so much soul u feel it in the taste of the food !!!

FYE: there is usually a long line after 4 pm on Sat and Sun... Thank you to Stefany and the Kentwood Ford team for making the purchase of my dream vehicle so easy! Stefany helped make sure I was happy with every aspect of my new vehicle so that I was able to get exactly what I wanted! The finance team were great and helped me to make informed decisions during the purchase.

I've even here twice and it's just not good. The fried chicken is not season well. We had to douse it in hot sauce to get some flavored. As the catfish last night and it was fine. Also the system and flow is disorganized and chaotic. It is cafeteria style with the staff on one side giving you portions. The height of the station is such that you have to literally crouch down or stand on your tip toes If you're tall to hear or see the person asking you want you want. This place is always packed now that they have a TV show about it. I went here a long time ago too. I can't believe I never reviewed it. 

They have a changing menu per the day. Some days chicken, some days ox tail. So just because you don't like the food one day, you might want to come back. Now as far as their staples. Their Mac N Cheese!   I could probably come and just eat this. It's absolutely yumminess melt in your mouth goodness. I also had the smothered pork steak. This thing was so tender you wouldn't even need the fork to cut it. Yum! 

If you want to try Mississippi style Southern food, then this is your place!

We booked a king sized bed sleeps 3 room online... you would assume this is a king sized bed with a pull out couch, but it's not. They expect 3 people to sleep in a king sized bed. So do not be tricked by this!

I brought in a pair of Nicola cowboy boots to get them resoled. The half sole and new caps on the heels ran about $80. The repairs took about a week, which I do not think is unreasonable. I managed to take my mom with me to this charming restaurant off of Manchester Rd. right across from the LGBT community center. I have heard a ton of reviews about this place, especially since the restaurant has its own TV show on the OWN network. It was mother's day and the place was packed, I mean rock solid packed. We had to wait in line for quite a bit, for more than 2 hours, and we were worried if the place would close or run out of food, thankfully, neither happened to us.
When we were in line, we noticed the waiters dancing and singing to the customers! They were filming the show that day! How amazing just to see a live taping in action! So many people were very friendly too in line and we had some amazing conversations. One lady is a constant regular to the restaurant knowing the owner personally. 
When we managed to get in front of the line, we both ordered pork chops, mac & cheese, mashed potatoes, I had a pear cobbler while my mom had a peach cobbler. We both chose sweet tea for the drinks. 
This has to meet the definition of soul food because bite after bite and sip after sip, I was praying to the baby Jesus. This place had the best mac & cheese I have ever eaten from a restaurant. 
The only negatives I experienced was that I wasn't allowed to add a tip onto my debit card when I made the purchase so I can tip the waitress. Nor when I used to bathroom, there were no paper towels. But to hell with the paper towels: I was there for the food!
The food was good until I found a piece of wrapper inside. Lost my appetite. The lemonade was good and the food was good up until that point.

Their service (waitresses) are horrible. Blonde-hair older one always looks like she hates being there, every single time! But we enjoy the food so we still go once in a while. Went today with my three kids and we ordered the chicken Parmesan entree, cheese pizza and the kids chicken fingers with fries. We had ordered ahead by phone so when we got there it was almost ready. My 4 year old was in the mood for mac & cheese and they did not offer this on the kids menu and I wasn't going to leave him hungry so I got a small side from next door. As soon as he started eating his mac & cheese the server came (blonde-hair one) which by the way never came to greet us or take our drinks orders since we sat down, to advise us he couldn't eat that there cause it wasn't theirs. I was perplexed. We ordered plenty of food from them, what's the problem with a toddler having a small cup of mac & cheese? should he stop eating while we ate? How can you do that to a toddler? She mentioned he couldn't have it out period and walked away. A gentleman from the kitchen, I'm assuming a manager or owner, came right after making the same demands. Horrible attitude too. We were kicked out for bringing an item (a small cup) from another business. So here we are eating in our car at a parking lot, humilliated.
Certainly not like good New York Pizza. Heard restaurant changed owners. There are much better places locally for pizza

I travel the country and taste food. Thats what I do. I know soul food and I'm not from deep south. First off, when examining a review, one  must take into consideration, WHO is giving the review. Someone that breaths soul food or someone that trys it every now and then. With that said you must trust me on this review. 

This food is served cafeteria style. Any time food is served in this manor there is so much room for error. Either food will sit in grease too long or temperatures will go up and down. Some foods don't taste good after the original heat has left it and taste quite different when reheated. The guards covering the food were kind of high up which means with just a slight bend, hundreds of people can now be breathing on all the food.( People with colds, flu, etc..) 

The food : It appears and taste like sugar is one of the main ingredients in all of the dishes, including mac and cheese. Putting sugar in mac and cheese is not needed to bring out great flavor. Just tasting it threw my taste buds off big-time. I had a serving of short ribs with potatoes. I gave up looking for meat as most of it was fat mixed in with shreds of meat. The candied yams were loaded with sugar with a heavy taste of molasses. I had a cup of it and I had maybe 2 or 3 pieces of yam and the rest was mashed up sugar and potato. I could not take more than two bites before I gave up. I wanted fish but they only do fish on Fridays. ( anybody can fry fish or chicken without any great skill )  The chicken was the only solid tasting thing I got. I held on to that piece like it was the last piece on earth. Not because it was that damn good, but because I was trying to stall on eating the rest of this crap that they piled on my plate. (enough for 3) Plus, I had to figure out a fast exit strategy because this location is surrounded by empty and boarded up 2 and 3 story buildings...First time I've ever seen a neighborhood in this kind of shape..If you do go anyway, please make that trip in the day time. You will thank me later...

They are true makeup artists. They were here right on time, worked well with the 2 hairstylists and finished all of us in time for pictures. I would definitely recommend this business.

Can we all say one thing "El Presidente" these tacos are to die for. An here lupita's they are doing things well. These are hand made tortillas with Steak stripes, lettuce an some housemade taco sauce.  They are on the Ala Carte menu. I only have ordered this  and will continue to only order these. Other then that the chips an Salsa are that good too. The Salsa is housemade an is very well made that I can drink it an not wanting to waste an ounce of it. Here is a brief rundown of my beastly experience at Kentwood Ford:

I was interested in the limited edition Mustang that they had in their lot. My wife and I met with the salesman who came to greet us and after a quick test drive, we went inside to discuss price. The salesman (Ryan) was easy to get along with and personable. No pressure, good guy. 

I mentioned a price that I could not go over. Here was my first mistake: They asked for a credit card number as a show of good faith to let them know that I was serious about my interest in the vehicle. They said that the $500.00 that I authorized would only be charged to me if I bought the car. Not true, as I was to find out later, the hard way.

The salesman went to get his manager (Guy) and we talked price some more. The manager agreed to come down in price some more but not to what I was able to pay. I thanked them for their time and said that I would think about it and call the next morning with my decision. I could see in the manager's face that he was not happy with my leaving. Good thing he's not a professional poker player. He would starve.

Later that night, my wife saw the exact same vehicle model with literally half the amount of kilometers for $6000.00 dollars less on an online classified ad site. It was no choice at all. I went with the private sale. Too easy.

I called this same manager at Kentwood the next day, as I had promised him I would, to give him my decision. I could not believe his childish, unprofessional reaction. He warned about the unreliability of private sales and how I could be buying a car that didn't work (it was still under warranty, by the way). He was a total whiner about not making the sale and he couldn't get off the phone fast enough.

That still was not the worst of my experience. When my credit card statement came in at the end of the month, I saw that they had taken the $500.00 from me. I called to ask for the money to be returned. I was still totally calm, understanding that mistakes happen. They referred me to someone in the business department. This person didn't return my call. I asked for someone else to help me. I was given the name of another person who never answered his phone and didn't return my calls either. Finally somebody contacted me a week or so later after I left an angry voicemail. By this time it was several weeks after the credit card transaction. I had to fight tooth-and-spit to get my money back. I don't doubt that if I didn't call them back (several times) I wouldn't have seen my money again.

The car that I bought from the private sale works great and I haven't taken it to Kentwood for any maintenance or recalls. It's too bad, because they are close to where I work and it would be much more convenient for me to drop it off there. I had such a bad experience with this place that I go out of my way to bring it to another Ford dealer.

I think it's awesome that when you Google Kentwood's name, one of the first hits you see is Yelp's one star average for the place. It's well deserved.

Recommend the corn bread, Mac n cheese, and of course the succulent friend chicken. My friends had the ribs and fried catfish -- they said it was delicious. I tried the fried chicken wings, macaroni and cheese, cabbage, corn and cornbread. Everything LOOKED really tasty but looks can be deceiving. The fried chicken wings were nice and crispy but had no flavor. The "famous" macaroni and cheese didn't really impress me either. The cabbage and corn were good but definitely not worth waiting in line for. Even the cornbread was dry.

Everything's good, at Sweetie Pies! Although I don't like the bottled tea. Liked the real stuff better!

Queso rah so rah, whatever they make I will eat, there prices they can't be beat, Queso rah so rah.
I really think I have found my new favorite Mexican restaurant.
Lupitas is located on the corner of McCarran Blvd and prater way, in the same strip mall as big lots.
When you walk in the front door and almost all the patrons are speaking Spanish, and parts of the menu are in Spanish, that is a good thing.
We arrived about 10:45 and were seated right away.
There is a separate bar area, and a rowdy crowd was watching soccer.
I ordered two shrimp Enchiladas, and one pork tamale. I did not order the combo, just ala carte.
Like I said earlier, the food was fantastic.
It was incredibly fresh and full of flavor.
The presentation was incredible to. Since I ordered ala carte it was just the Enchiladas.
The Enchiladas had chicken inside and on top was a green sauce, onion, slaw, and tomato.
Drizzled on top of the tomato was sour cream.
The pork tamale was to die for. I am married to a Mexican, and Deb always tells me how her grandmother would make tamales, very little mass, lots of meal.
The tamale was delicious.
Most definitely will be back.
I forgot to add, total bill for two people, lunch and drinks, twenty one dollars.
