A while back I gave Kentwood a solid four stars.  Today I would give them zero if that were an option.

My very first experience with Kentwood was in 1989 when I bought my very first vehicle:  A brand new Mustang.  I paid a good price and over the past 22 years the service department has been good to me.  Until today.

My latest vehicle is a 2008 F-150 crew cab.  Power steering failed at 63,000 km.  Three thousand kilometers past warranty but still within the 3 years allowed.

Kentwood Ford and Ford of Canada absolutely refused to fix the power steering under warranty. Their reason:  My last service was not at Kentwood but rather at a quick lube.

Power steering pump failure at 63,000 km is premature.  Work order says they replaced the power steering pump, rack, lines, and did a four wheel alignment.  At a total cost of over $2,300.

I launched a complaint with CAMVAMP, a federal government organization that oversees vehicle manufacturers and their warranties.

Today was my last visit ever to Kentwood Ford.  I am sad at having to end a 22 year business relationship.  This will also be my last Ford vehicle purchase.
Love Roccos the food is always super good. Been going here for about 6 years now, I take my baby girl just about every year on her birthday. Never been disappointed
Your typical delicious chipotle. Good for quick Mexican. Friendly staff, but I've had better chipotle elsewhere

Excellent service and friendly staff who explained what I needed or not needed for the car. For a person with limited knowledge of car mechanics and maintenance, I felt cared for and not taken advantage of. Thank you, Bret, especially who was patient explaining everything i should know about my car.
Some of the best pizza we've ever had everybody loved it we ordered ordered five pizzas to feed like 20 people it was really really good

I don't know if it was the fact that we were waiting outside in a line for 90 minutes plus another 30 minutes in a line inside before we got to order our food and get seated at a table, but this was some of the best food I've ever eaten. 

I had the chicken wings which were HUGE, and a hefty portion of them given as well, for the money. I also got to have two sides to go with them and I had the mac and cheese (some of the best I've ever had) and candied yams (which were about average). I washed it down with some lemonade (which was excellent -- it's easy to mess up lemonade, really, but this was some of the best I'd ever had) and finished the meal with some peach cobbler (mmmmm). 

The place was packed and it was very loud but our server took care of us quickly and frequently, making sure we were completely satisfied, and when I asked for another lemonade, even though they say that refills are extra, he did not charge me for it... I was sure to tip him a little extra because of that. 

We sat by the front window so there were lots of people looking in as we were trying to eat which was kind of unnerving but the meal was very good. I would probably go here again if I weren't in a hurry and had time to wait in a line....

I had a great experience with Wilson's. Took a nice pair of boots that were missing one rubber heel cap. In less than a week I picked them up and they look AMAZING. They actually replaced both heel caps so they match perfectly and added a shoe shine at no extra cost. Wilson's has been in business many years and you can feel the history when you walk in. This is the type of small business that must be supported and recommended.

I have reviewed this Burger King before as horrible and have went back for another chance and it is still awful.  The employees do not listen and when you tell them the order is wrong or something tastes bad they respond in the most negative way as to let you know that they are irritated.  They do not know how to make a chocolate shakes to save their life.  Also, when I asked for cheese on my whopper, they did not put it on.  I went back so that they could fix it and they still did not put cheese on it.  AND.......their double cheeseburgers are the size of a White Castle slider.  Their service is awful and the food portions are so small, it is not worth the money.  I am surprised they are still in business.

I ordered a dozen roses and 6 sunflowers for my wife on Valentine's Day. She only received 6 of the 12 roses and there were a bunch of other not so nice looking flowers in the bouquet which completely changed the look I was going for. I called to find out why my order was screwed up and all they told me is that they wouldn't charge me for the stuff that was in there that I didn't order.... thanks for that.

My hometown is St. Louis, but I currently live in Chicago. When I was in St. Louis this past weekend, eating here was at the top of my list. I was not disappointed. The food was outstanding, and Tim the owner was so kind and gracious, not to mention super cute. The show has become infamous by being on television on the OWN network and I am happy this restaurant lives up to it's reputation. The only drawback was the long line, but let's be serious. Please expect the wait for this type of restaurant with it's notoriety. You will not be disappointed. Superb!

Good customer service. Brett and staff were very informative and careful with my two sets of wheels and tires. 21" wheels and rft can be difficult to mount/dismount, and Brett did it very fast with no scratches. 

I would highly recommend. Other customers appeared to be satisfied, as well. No complaints.

What a disappointment. Literally just probably had my worst experience ever at a chipotle. I finally ordered the app to save time picking up orders. What a mess! Wasn't close to being ready when I walked in and there were no customers. A bunch of staff just staring at each other having their own conversations. Then as I'm watching a girl work on someone's order, literally watching in horror at the concoction she was making, I realized that was my order. I couldn't believe it. I just got back to work to try and salvage the bowl but it's a complete soupy mess. A complete waste.

So I thought I was being a bit anal with the emails, making sure everything was ready and I had all my ducks in a row for my tire install this morning. Sadly I was not thorough enough, after booking time off work (at considerable cost) making sure I had the rims and my wife had a vehicle to get her to work, receiving the confirmation phone call regarding the appointment, I arrived all set this morning to discover that the tires had not been ordered from storage. I didn't realise I had to make sure that whoever was in charge of ordering tires from storage knew what they were doing.

Now I realise for Kentwood Ford it's a minor inconvenience and maybe a little bit embarrassing but for your customer it is unacceptable. If I had come in from out of town I would be a lot madder than I am but regardless of where I am coming from for Kentwood Ford to "forget" to order the tires from storage is totally unacceptable. As such apparently the tires will now arrive tomorrow at which point I will come pick them up and take them somewhere else to get done. Small loss of cash to you but word of mouth and recommendations are worth a lot more than cash.

We have used Trusting Connections several times for our 3 children. Each time we have benefited from this very professional nanny service! The nannies have been kind, on time, flexible, professional, and ready to work with any age range. Additionally, as a mom of a child with special needs I worry about having a nanny who is knowledgeable enough to care for my child well so I don't have to worry about leaving him. Each nanny has been more than willing and able to care for our son (who often requires an extra dose of patience!) in addition to our other children. That in and of itself has been invaluable. Thank you TC for giving our family some peace of mind and for being a resource we can count on!

Hands down the best place local to get real deal New York Pizza. I used to order like twice a week before covid struck. And sadly took a pay cut so i am not a regular customer! They are wonderful professional and amazing !

DELISH!

I'm from MS so when I realized Sweetie Pie's is home cooking Mississippi-style, I had to drop in. Restaurants often miss the mark on Southern cooking. Sweetie Pie's does not disappoint between entrance & exit!

We were there 15 minutes before opening on a Monday and a line had already been formed. Once they open, they move you through quickly and get you set up for seating. While you go through the line, the staff secures your table and gets drinks. We had Calvin as our server and he was phenomenal. 

It's cafeteria style so you let the gals know what you want. The portion size is massive so go hungry! The price was great, especially for the amount of food you get! The fried chicken was divine as was the mac & cheese--make sure to get these! I also had greens, black eyed peas, and sweet potatoes. None of us really cared for the desserts. 

I'd definitely stop by Sweetie Pie's if you are in the area! It's worth the trip!

We recently moved to Brooksville and we searched far and wide for our new Za joint. We've had Roccos 3 times now and each time we look at each other and say "Damn, I'm glad we found a great pizza spot!" They're employees are personable and honestly blew me away by their level of appreciation for us returning  to their business. I know the Spring Hill area is full of NY transplants stuffed full of their "I know pizza" hubris but Roccos gets it done every time. I grew up in NY too and this place is just as good as what everybody says they're searching for. See y'all again soon!

Visited the store today unstopped, uncapped, blasting disco music, and the kid behind the counter never want to pick up his head up off his phone.  Was planning to purchase a case of wine, two cases of truly's and a case of beer, but I'll take my transaction somewhere else this place looks like a poorly ran establishment.  If I owned.  this place I would literally be embarrassed

I contacted Ashley Roy, Manager of Kentwood Ford as per his note.  We talked on the phone and went back and forth a bit in e-mail.

He offered me a $500.00 store credit which is pretty much a slap in the face considering a store credit costs him much less and I don't intend to shop at Kentwood ever again.

Bottom line is I feel I have been ripped off to the tune of $2,300.  Not only is Ashley Roy is Manager of Kentwood Ford he is Vice President of the Go Auto Group.

My opinion of Kentwood Ford and the Go Auto Group is even lower than it was before I contacted Ashley.

It is my opinion that Kentwood Ford, Team Ford, and the Go Auto Group simply cannot be trusted.

The car lot next to this hotel BLASTS shorty country music ALL. NIGHT. LONG. 

Also, it should be noted that the front seat attendant doesn't give a flying f***.

I stopped in here with my niece, we had gone on a girls day out and ended up in Spring Hill.  Both of us were hungry so Rocco's was a natural stop. 

Upon entering, I swear both of our stomachs growled in unison, we both felt our mouths watering, it smelled THAT good.  We were sat, and our waitress took our drink orders, both of us went for Diet Pepsi.   We placed a simple order, a Large Cheese Pizza.  ($12, is very reasonable for a large pizza)

I watched it be made, put in the oven and taken out, it came out in less than 10 minutes and was delivered to our table piping hot and delicious. 

It was REALLY good pizza.  If I lived close by, I'd come agian and again.

You would think that walking away from a dealership with a brand new car will make life a little easy but not with my experience. Very intense atmosphere when you walk in. Be ready to get down to business. No thinking here. That's the very first threat. Salesman will give false information about a car just so it catches your attention. Do you research and call them out on the misinformation. Pushy sales. Finance dept isn't well organized either. It's been a month since the trade and still waiting for a miss-payment. Will not recommend coming to this dealership again. I could probably write a long frustration review here that its so madding its becoming so hysterical.  I get it its a business, at least treat your customer with professionalism and honesty. In general population this is why dealership are not trustworthy.

They have the best ceviche ever! Micheladas are also really good! 
I definitely recommend this place if you want some good ceviche and a drink.

I went to the Chipotle in Havertown, next to Panera at Township Line and WC Pike.  The food here is awesome, but you already know this.  Organic and local ingredients, who can argue with that?  There is a good variety even for my kids, who are very picky about what they eat.  The only reason I won't give five stars is because parking is pretty challenging with the Giant and all the other stores in the lot.
Nice selection of deli sandwiches.  Good food, but pricey.  Service can be slow.

I couldn't agree with Alex more. After reading all the glowing reviews of this place I decided to give it a shot. I had the baked cod while my boyfriend had the fried chicken. We each had two sides. I simply couldn't see the appeal? Don't get me wrong here I love soul food, both at restaurants and fast food joints, but everything we had were mediocre. The chicken was too dry and not really spiced. There was nothing special with the fried cod (I have gotten tastier cod at Long John Silvers! And that was for under four bucks!) We each paid more than $11 for a meal with sweet tea and walked away feeling like we could have enjoyed Lee's chicken from around the corner more. This was definitely an anti-climatic experience

How sweet it is!

There are few things that I miss about living in the Central West End, and almost everything that I do was just outside of the CWE.  Sweetie Pie's at the Mangrove is one of those things!

Forget about the hype.  Disregard all the Oprah nonesense brought upon this restaurant.  Sweetie Pie's should be bronzed and marked as an StL landmark!  This establishment is as important to St. Louis history and tradition as the statue of Stan Musial in front of Busch Stadium III.

Once we started hanging out down in The Grove, everyone that we'd encounter would talk up SP, so we tried it out on a Sunday around noon.  Big mistake!  The masses had just came out of church and headed straight to the true cathedral!  

Feeling overwhelmed by the spirit, I went straight for the Gospel According to Sweetie Pie, the chicken wings.  I watched the worker pile on the those whole wings, and I was sanctified!  My plate runneth over!  For sides, I went with homemade mac n cheese and mashed potatoes.  Sweetie Pie's soul food had saved my soul!

We barely have the chance to swing by these days, but I haven't forgotten about Miss Robbie and her heavenly chicken wings.

I agreed to a smoking room simply because it usually doesn't matter. We walked in the room after check-in and the smell was so disgusting we had to change to a non-smoking. The desk attendant was rude and exasperated when I asked to switch. She switched me right away though, and surprise, the non-smoking room still had a weird funk-odor. The whole building must have water damage issues never properly remediated. 

The toilet clogged at first use. I called the desk for a plunger because I'd rather do it myself than wait for them to find a plumber. 

The ceiling of the bathroom is cracked and convex like it's gonna collapse, undoubtedly from the bathroom on the second floor having a problem as well. 

Every fixture that's mounted looks like it's the third or fourth one and they never painted or patched the holes from the last one. The fake-wood furniture looks very worn. There are many vintage elements that look dilapidated and trashy, as opposed to charming or stylish. 

On the upside the Countryside Cafe is right next door in the big office building and the food is very good and very cheap. Like, small town prices and service. It's in a corporate looking building with no storefront so a little hard to find but it's there. They do takeout. 

You close the door and the window of the room rattles loudly. The bathroom is very small and I had allergic reactions when I'm there. 

The first room did not have a working phone to call the front desk. 

The lampshade has stains all over it next to the bed. It compliments the stains all over the place, to include the back of the bathroom door which is the only likely place to hang your towel. 

I'm not even that picky generally, in Atlantic City NJ the Howard Johnson may be a cheap hotel but I don't remember it being an out-and-our dump. 

I suppose if you want to have a hotel party and not give a fuck, trash a trash-place, or get a rock-bottom price hotel in Clearwater, then this is it. But I'd rather sleep on the ground at a campground.

I had a really good expierence when I first bought my vehicle from Kentwood but going back for maintenance was a different story. I bought a maintenance package so everything was covered, until I got back and was told there was a piece of metal stuck in my tire. I'm very suspicious that the piece of metal going into my tire happened there considering the piece of metal was a tire balancing weight. When I came back to pick up my car the service department was busy and took forever to get my car back and to even get a quote on a new tire. I wasn't even thinking about buying a new tire from them considering I'm pretty sure my tire was punctured while getting serviced. After all that I got a new tire elsewhere for a fraction of the cost they quoted me on the phone on MONDAY and they wanted me to also pay 40 dollars to install the tire. If I didn't have a maintenance plan I would never go back here.
Great pizza ! They seemed busy and short staffed but our waitress was amazing despite them being so busy. We will be back for sure .
This place has such a great selection of local wines. By far our favorite place to go for our favorite beverage.

I applied with this company as a nanny and went through the whole process of a phone interview, a background check, giving references, an in person interview, and a 40 question multiple choice test on babysitting. In this line of business time is very important and wasting time with one company can lose you other job opportunities. With that being said I am not satisfied with their services. The lengthy interview process combined with the lack of communication skills is extremely ridiculous and unprofessional. Im not sure how the program works for the parents trying to find a nanny but from the perspective of a nanny trying to find a new job I feel like my time was wasted and the lack of professionalism with an actual nanny agency is truly mind boggling. I am not satisfied in the slightest.

I generally poo poo fast food restaurants however if I must partake in QSR I typically go to Chick-fila that being said I have been to Chipotle twice in the past week. 

This Chipoltle is in an extremly busy part of CC however they move very quickly and the food fills you up. You can choose three different tacos whether it be soft shell or hard for $9.99 not bad not bad. Also, you can put almost any topping in it but be advised if you want queso cheese your looking at another dollar.

Also be advise the hot sauce is pretty freaking hot and imo ruins the taco/burrito unless you really like hot sauce on your meal.

I bought my 2016 Mustang from this dealership with smooth and friendly transaction. Unfortunately with my first service after few months I bought the car,  I went for an "oil change" and the mechanic at Kentwood Ford broke my lug nut of my wheels. I honestly don't know how that happened. They should've just stick with the oil change and not touch the rest of the car. I get that they want to do the full inspection but I only asked for an oil change. What's annoying about it is, they want me to pay for their incompetency, blame it on someone else and won't take responsibility. Is that a services you can really trust? I don't think they really care about costumer service. Like they said, they just see you as  business and I hope people will have less business with this group.

TERRIBLE, now! I've been here several times years back & the food was delicious but this trip was terrible and embarrassing. 

Brought guests from NYC to the "famous" sweetie pies for lunch. The food was gross and the facilities have fallen into disrepair.

The chicken was OK at best - way to greasy & the breading wasn't stick & was almost too moist. 

The macaroni was a salty watery disaster! So bad that I asked for our portions to be taken from another pan. The manager assured us that it would & came back with 3 bowls that didn't seem as watery & asked us to taste it. The first bite wasn't watery & so we immediately said ok as she said she wasn't leaving until we tasted it. She said the cooks didn't wait for it to settle & put it on the line making it more watery than usual but these were servings from the same pan - AND IT TASTED LIKE IT! Still WAY TOO SALTY ( and I like salty food but this was gross) not creamy & seemed like they've reduced the quality of ingredients to cut costs. It pissed me off even more that she tried to get over after she said she'd get us some from a different pan & laughed :(

NASTY A-- FAKE CHESS PIE - I don't even want to describe this but I just took 2 bites, let my boyfriend try it & left it on the table. The consistency was nothing like chess pie & I'm thinking maybe it had been sitting out too long. 

My guest, boyfriend & I ALL experienced gastrointestinal DISTRESS after this meal & luckily we were in a location that had multiple bathrooms!!! 

I used to defend Sweetie Pies as having good food because at one point they did, but this experience has completely turned me off. I won't be returning & will be urging other people not to do so! 

RIP to the hype!

It's not always easy trusting someone new with your hair.  I typically find a cosmetologist and stick with them...well...forever.  Unfortunately, my long time girl became a bit unreliable and after several reschedules and reschedules of those reschedules, I decided to 'end the relationship'.  

Lucky for me, I found Black Orchid.  I had visited before for massages (which are awesome too) but had never tried their other services.  The front desk booked me for an appointment with Chelsea within 24 hours of my call - not weeks out like I was used to.  

Chelsea listened to me, paying careful attention to my needs.  She had me colored and cut within just over an hour.  What!?  I was averaging 2-2.5 hours at the "old" place. The price was comparable (although the price for a brow/lip wax is a little crazy).  

I'm sold.  You've got a new, regular customer as far as I'm concerned.

Great food  great service!!   we had our first visit there yesterday because my husband was craving lobster ravioli for some reason... Anyway it was really good here and for the price it had a very very good quality. More interesting there was the chicken knot!   The garlic was amazing on that thing and I will definitely go back for that. We ordered a pizza that was pretty good as well so we could have food for leftovers last night. The anti-pasta salad for one was more like enough for three!!    The staff including the cooks and the servers all seemed highly engaged and they all seem to get along very well and we liked the music they played!!! Good team work !!!

I came here and got the roast chicken, and if you eat man-sized portions like I do I would suggest going for the fried chicken wings(4wings) or the fried fish(2 whole fish).

I'm a big fan of cabbage, but when you cook that with globs of pork, you have just won me over.

They were extremely rude about my mental health issues and did not give any support towards my issues. They knew about it for multiple weeks and did not care. They were also very rude about it and told me it was my fault. Don't work here if you have mental health issues that you are concerned about.

I set up an appointment Wednesday for an alignment on Friday. I was told it would be less than an hour. Got there at 1230--at 130 the car had not been pulled in yet. Appointments apparently are not appointments. So 30 min drive over and back, and the hour in the middle of a busy day...lost. 

Merriam-Webster says an "Appointment is an agreement to meet at a specific time." Everyone's time is important. This is probably a good company--needs to work harder to become great.

The worst fast food I've ever had and I'm 58yr old,I asked for no mayonnaise and got extra, the only thing I ordered was 2 whoppers and the only thing I could taste was a little pepper on the burger no flavor at all on enything else tomatoes pickles onions even the mayonnaise that I didn't want had no flavor, it was like eating soggy bread,   to bad Burger King has gone this bad

The 2 stars are merely for the tastiness of the food. I'll began by saying I did enjoy my meal. I had catfish and jumbo chicken wings with mac n cheese and cabbage. The cabbage was not great but everything actually was. 

The service overall completely sucked! We stood in line for over an hour. The staff was not equipped to handle the large crowd that congregated at the restaurant. We stood in the cold and were even asked to get out when we entered during the "doorman's" brief absence. The service was mediocre. That alone ruined the experience for me. I'll never return. Glad I got to try it once.

Sweetie Pies you embarrassed yourself on 7-7-10!! Maybe it's my fault for thinking I could get the same service on a Wednesday evening at 730pm that I get on Sundays after church, but I was horribly WRONG! I'd never seen most of the workers that were there today b/c I have only come on weekends the past 2 years. It was made PAINFULLY obvious that they were closing soon even though there was still time left. It was like being at McDonald's...our waitress had an attitude and the food was not even warm (not to mention that most of it was already out for the day). One person in our party had to wait almost 20min to get her food then was rudely asked if they could make it a to-go platter (she came with us so she wanted to eat with us!). You can still clean up &handle your closing duties while people are eating. Making loud, purposeful noises with dishes, denying us a refill on water, and snatching up plates and glasses before everyone is finished is just unprofessional!! Shame on you! Sweetie Pie's is one of my fav spots too. Have some class.

I have been getting my service done at Kentwood ever since I bought my car. It was convenient to where I use to live on the North side, but now that I am on the west I still find myself going here for my service. I really like how easy it is to book my service appointments. I just go online and put what I'd like and within 20 minutes I normally receive a call back to confirm. Dropping off my car is super simple as well. You just drive up and a service person who is available will help right away. 

Today I dropped off my car and my services were complete within 45 minutes. They also made sure to explain everything to me completely before doing any work to my vehicle. They ensure that I know if there's extras that will be helpful and if they are additional charges. I recommend any ford drivers to check out kentwood. They've been nothing but wonderful when I have gone in.

Ate there last night, heard the hype for years and finally thought we should try it. 

The fried chicken and fried catfish fish were cold when served; mashed potatoes were barely warm, and gravy was too salty for my taste. The corn bread was basic. The sweet potatoes were warm and very sweet. My wife said her green beans were great, just like g-ma used to make (which means over cooked to me). The pear cobbler was great, just like we made back in boy scouts, when I was 10 or 12.

The atmosphere was rather strange, chinese round paper lanterns wired together with extension cords, pics of musicians and celebs thumbtacked to the walls, two cheap suits of armor "guarding" the door, and numerous signs taped up regarding employee and staff rules or codes of conduct. There were even a few warning patrons not to complain about the food or service, probably just in jest I guess, but wasn't sure based on the attitude given by the serving line staff when asked for fresh black eyed peas by the gentleman in front of us at the cafeteria counter.  
With all that said, it was the best ice water I'd had all day!

Had an appionment to have a tire fixed, when I went in there I asked how much would they charge to obtain my vehicles factory door code
 I was told that the only way to do it was to hook it up to a computer and there would be a charge of $50.00. I cancelled my appointment right then as the factory code is listed in the driver's side fuse box. The dealership said that Ford did not tell them that it was there, however, the new car sales people were aware it was there. So either Ford is keeping secrets from their service departments or this particular service department will buckle and dime you for every single charge then can. They are not only not trustworthy, but the service manager called me names. Not only that, but when I told the general manager the situation, he pointed to my 2009 Ford edge and said"you mean that old car? ". So apparently they don't respect you unless you drive a certain level of vehicle.

Well, up until last night, I would have had auch better review of Roccos. Called and ordered a medium pizza with extra cheese and an antipasto
 As always, the antipasto was very good. However, the pizza was horrid
 There was hardly amy cheese on the pizza, nevermind extra cheese. The crust was dry and tasteless. I would have done better going to Publix and buying a frozen pizza. Don't know what happened to them, but it will be a while before I visit th again.

Pizza had very uneven thickness, some areas very thick, other places thin. The crust was slightly overcooked and dry. Toppings were average except the cheese, which was sparse. I ordered extra cheese and it wasn't quite what you get on a regular pizza from most other places. Prices were average. The service was friendly and accommodating. Overall, a middle of the road experience.

My Family dined at Rocco's since we were staying nearby. The staff was very friendly, polite and helpful. The waitress was very polite and quick with our orders. The food was delicious and well prepared. This is an unexpected gem.

It has been years since I have dealt with Kentwood Ford and no matter, how many times I tell them to STOP calling me ........ they continue to harass me. Every 3 or 4 months I get phone calls asking if I'm happy with vehicle and now ........ they have started texting me!

If you ever want to be harassed by a car dealership, call these guys! Cause they do NOT respect the word ...... NO !!

I am pretty disappointed.  I ordered a chili relleno and queso fundido through door dash and the menu options were 2 choices on the queso fundido.  Beans or sliced jalapeños.  I selected the jalapeños because I can not eat beans and paid an extra 2.00 to add chicken to it. .  When my order arrived, the queso was filled my chicken and with both beans and jalapeños. After the first bite and noticing the beans through out the entire thing, I wasn't able to eat any more of it and had to throw it away.  It was a waste of $8.50 and i'm pretty upset about it.   If they don't advertise something as simple as melted cheese dip correctly then I'm not sure I can trust anything else they have on their menu either.

I love everything about this place, starting with the fact that they have a reality show on Oprah's OWN network. And if you know me, you know I love my Lady O. This is what made us stop here on our road trip (plus the fact that it was on Man v Food), but it was more than Oprah that will keep us coming back here.

Next, I just love the ambiance the ambiance of this place and the long line. I had some great conversations with locals and otherwise in the line for my fried chicken. There are a lot of friendly people who come here and are fun to talk to.

Next, I love the menu and the pricing that seems a bit ambiguous at times. They will have pricing listed by meat only and then the price with two sides. What didn't make sense is when two items will have the same price for meat item only, but then have different prices for when two sides were added. Why would the price not be the same with sides added? It's endearing.

Next, I love the ridiculous shirts and other apparel they sell here.

Next, I love the cafeteria style of this place. It just makes the food taste better in my opinion. 

Next, I love the price. I got the fried chicken plus sides and it was only $10 or so. 

Next, I love the portions. For $10, you get 4 pieces of fried chicken (YES! 4 PIECES!!!). It's outrageous, but amazing. Most of the pieces (if not all) were wings, but I still appreciated the fact that you got so much. On top of all that, in the $10 is included a nice piece of cornbread, which was the cherry on top....a little unexpected surprise. You will have two meals worth with all the food you get here.

Next, I love the dessert. Banana pudding is one of my favorite desserts that isn't prominent enough in restaurants, so when I saw it here, I had to get it. I wasn't disappointed. It was awesome.

In conclusion, go here. There are so many things to love. If you're lucky, you'll get on TV and if you're even luckier, Oprah will be there when you are (doubt it, but you could dream).

It seems our search for really good pizza ended Saturday evening when we found Rocco's! Hands down the best pizza we've had since we relocated here. We ordered 2 large pizzas, one was a vanilla pepperoni and onion, the other was the "ultimate" pizza and let me tell you, this pizza was to die for! If you're in Spring Hill or Hudson you owe it to yourself to check this place out!

I bought a new f350 in 2018 from them, and recently reached out to them as i was in the market for a new f350 and figured with beeing a repeat customer maybe i would get some kinda incentive to buy another truck but instead i was told that there would be no incentive because"people are paying full value"  well i bought another truck and i will again and this market won't stay in the greedy dealers court forever, ill never buy another truck or any vehicle from these clowns again!

Hands down the best tuxedo and suit rental establishment in south jersey, the knowledge of the staff really shows and they always go above and beyond to make sure everything fits absolutely perfect. Have been a customer on 3 separate occasions and the service and quality have been nothing short of perfect.

First visit to Sweetie Pie's.  This place is amazing, period.  Everyone enjoyed everything we had.  Catfish and baked chicken were exceptional...but the sides, cabbage, sweet potatoes, Mac and cheese, green beans, black eyed peas, other worldly!  Will definitely be back.  If consistently this good, could be regulars.

The long-awaited, anticipated, favorite show of mine from OWN's network - Sweetie Pies!! After seeing many seasons of this show and finally being able to be there and EAT, I was in awe! We arrived a little before noon and there was already a line but not out the door. The wait was about 20 minutes. Seeing this place in person was a breathtaking experience that I had 2 soak in before I ate LOL. I recognized several of the staff from the TV show and they were even nice enough to take pictures. 

So, the main part - The FOOOOD!!!!!! I ordered the fried chicken with macaroni and greens. Macaroni was my favorite! All meals came with cornbread and they had sweet tea (not Ms. Robbie's creation), soft drinks or water. I also got some meatloaf and peach cobbler to go. The food was good but not great, like I expected (my opinion). I definitely love the business and all the employees but maybe my expectations were a little to high. Nonetheless, it wasn't bad just lacked some seasoning on the chicken and the meatloaf. I added my share of hoy sauce so that helped a little. I wanted this to melt in my mouth but it just didn't do that. But that peach cobbler was to dieeeeeee for! OMG! It reminded me of the way my Grandmother used to make it and boy how do I miss her cobbler. I plan to return and try the other locations. All in all, great experince and BOMB.COM customer service!!

I was pleasantly surprised with my stay here. I spent three nights at the hotel, somewhat last minute, and have no complaints. It was clean, quiet and the room was very spacious... with a kitchenette and desk area, it seemed like a good spot to stay for several days if needed. The price was also very reasonable, and the location is pretty central to everything in Clearwater.
This location is no longer open. The phone is still in service with no message about both locations being closed.

Holy cow, I can't tell you how wide the grin on my face was when I stepped in here. My boyfriend took me here after I spent almost a week feeling sorry for myself and being homesick (I just moved here from Atlanta a few months ago, and I've been craving some fried mac 'n' cheese like you wouldn't believe). 

Unfortunately, they didn't have that, but my spirits still lifted immediately at the smell, which hits you as soon as you walk in. Undescribeably amazing.

My favorite thing about this place was (aside from the fact that it serves soul food) the very friendly serve staff. Even though the place is done cafeteria-style, an employee came up to me while I was paying at the register and carried my tray to my table for me. Mac 'n' cheese was delicious, and I'll even call it healthy since it wasn't fried.

I do have a few complaints, though ... The food is undeniably overpriced for what it is, and they don't have Tabasco sauce. That may seem petty, but let me assure you that what I'm about to say next is the truest thing you'll ever hear: Collard greens are nothing without tabasco sauce. That shit would not fly down South.

All in all, I was very satisfied and I would definitely like to come back.

I'm having to remove my original review because I claim that there was animal abuse and criminal negligence.  Apparently I'm not allowed to have that opinion.  But you all know how we feel.  The cease and desist letter also names the "nannies" which we never did because obviously they just weren't trained to care for animals or had the help from their Superiors when they needed it.  Trusting connections should have followed through instead of turning around and making excuses why they would no longer clean our carpets and furniture.  The reason was because they didn't like that we claimed animal abuse.  You would too if you would have come home to that nightmare.

Went to Wilson's Shoe Repair 3/23/21 with the intentions to have the heel of my wedge shoes repaired...the lady at the front counter was very rude and had poor customer service.  I really wanted to cater and support black owned business but it didn't happen yesterday. 

So I'll take my shoes and my money on Maple St. Uptown NOLA. 

I have no tolerance for poor customer service and neither does my MONEY!

The pool was not heated, the rooms are very outdated with not enough parking near our room so had to lug everything from the back parking lot. , Little in the way of towels or toilet paper. When we opened the door the room reeked of mold and urine!! Paid almost 350 for two days in season. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY!

If you're looking for delicious soul food/comfort food in Saint Louis, you must come here. You receive an instant feeling of happiness and comfort as you eat your meal. We ordered the fried chicken, meatloaf, mashed potatoes, mac n cheese, sweet potatoes, and peach cobbler.  The fried chicken was perfectly crispy/not greasy and the skin was very juicy. The mac n cheese and mashed potatoes were amazing (5/5 stars).
The food is served cafeteria-style, so try to make your selections quickly and don't hold up the line! The servers and staff are very friendly and make sure you enjoy the food/experience here.

Okay so the food here is pretty good. I ordered the fried chicken with yams and Mac n cheese. Fried chicken was great. Yams were okay but the Mac n cheese was below average. My wife ordered the chicken wings and thought they were great. She also had the yams which she liked more than me and the black eyed peas which she loved!

My problem with this place was the service. It took forever to get through the line. I have never eaten anywhere with service this slow. The whole point of a buffet line to serve customers is efficiency. This is supposed to cut down on waiting time etc. Not the case here. Employees working the line would turn to each other and have a 5 minute conversation while customers were waiting to get food on their plate. As I was next in line to place my order the employee waiting on me got into an argument with another employee and it took 8 minutes before anyone took my order. Not okay.

Also, their website says they deliver. They don't. The phone number for delivery is never answered and when you call a different number they tell you they don't deliver. Very odd.

Also, they don't let you call ahead to place orders for pick up.

The restaurant its self is strange and has weird decor and none of it matches. Feels like I was eating in a hoarders house!

Went in for a test drive. First thing i was offered coffee or a water and a chair. Second was we were made to do a credit check. After this our salesperson asked if we were prepared to business today. I told her we came in for a test drive and then I felt our service level drop. Was not told any numbers and basically felt she was keeping the prices a secret and felt we could only see her perception of what we could afford and felt she didn't have our best interests in mind. I also felt I have no idea what different options and choices I had between a 2014 and a 2015 and learned more in a 30 second commercial then a 30 minute meeting. I would not recommend this dealership unless you want to be judged.

Ill keep it short an sweet. We have been to Sylvia's in Harlem,Gladys&Rons in Atlanta,Mikkis in Houston,and this by far was the best souls food we've had. 

Food was seasoned very well and the macaroni had a slight sweetness to it that was awesome. The only con is the wait in line which you should already be aware of. 


 We waited from start till we sat down to eat about 2Hrs. That's the only reason I didn't give this place 5stars. They got to get a better way to control crowds. 


 We were visiting because my wife loves this show on the OWN network and to see the Arch.

Nice, easy to work with, courteous, and delivered in spades!!!  It was my 10th anniversary and I wanted a bouquet to be waiting for my wife and I to arrive at the Hermitage Steak House for our dinner reservation... I stopped in to BoF at about 11:30, and walked out in about 10 minutes putting my faith in the 5 minute conversation with the proprietor...  we arrived at dinner and my wife was amazed at the flowers awaiting her at the table!  I couldn't be happier, or recommend them enough!  Brilliant!
Excellent work and customer service!!   Mr Wilson was able to make my old shoes look new.

NEVER AGAIN!  being relatively new to StL I read the yelp reviews in hopes of some guidance but unfortunately when it comes to true soul food- opinions vary widely.  but this place fails on many levels. I will discuss the ones I find most pertinent.

Service
the way the servers speak to you and each other is something akin to what you may witness in a cafeteria or chow line.  "What u gettin?" (include a head sway and lip smack). "if you want to eat in, you need a TRAY" (her emphasis not mine).  I am not feeling the love (as a sign on their wall boasts of ) As I select food from the array of buffet items, I am disturbed by the servers constantly reaching over my food to get other buffet items for other patrons- ex. I do not want wet green bean juice that you are getting for another patron dripping on the fish I just selected.  Plus one of the servers takes the plastic gloves she uses to serve people food, takes a dirty rag to wipe the counter off and has the nerve to get upset when I request to change her gloves when handling my food.   

Food
I got the catfish fillets which looked good one the outside but UNDERCOOKED on the inside.  I'm pregnant and this is a big NO NO. i told the server who told me "oh dont worry, I've been hearing this all day, I got you."  and he proceeds to get me another fillet- which to be honest I didn't even want, my appetite completely spoiled and I get nausea thinking about how much undercook fish I actually consumed before I recognized it.  
Sweetie pies, you are not worthy to be called a soul food restaurant- it does not take a rocket scientist to know how to fry a fish.

Ambiance,
there is none. the place is a madhouse.  the servers are constantly bumping into patrons and each other. such a poor layout.  There is supposed to be someone to help you find a table after you get your food from the chowline but often there is no one. which was the case for us. we had to navigate with our tray through the madness.  our server gave us attention immediately but took 15min to get us hot sauce and water.  

never again.  would never go back and would not recommend to anyone.

Went to sweetie pie's on Saturday, Stood outside in line for about 2 hours, waited inside for about another hour... The restaurant from the outside looked very unpromising, but to our surprise the food was so delicious! I had ribs, very tender and they fell right off the bone, mac and cheese, was so cheesy and amazing, best i have ever had, corn bread was good, and mashed potatoes, the gravy tasted kinda burnt so wasn't too happy with that overall very good dinning experience except for the line, that's only because of the tv show. Recommend it for sure! It's quite an experience.

We need to have a "0" Option for stars. 
I will NEVER EVER AGAIN bring anything here. I went there 3 times to pick up my shoes after the date he promised each time and they were never ready. So on this last attempt I was asked to wait for them while he completed the repair. Once I finally got them I noticed that the left shoe had multiple stains that weren't on them when I brought them in. I'm very angry about it. I'm not going to even waist my time bringing them back him. I'll have to see if there's anyway to salvage them. Good money down the drain. He can't keep up with all the work his has. So I guess that's why he closes the shop down for a week at a time.

I used Trusting Connections for a group of four 3 and 4 year old boys and girls and was extremely pleased with the service. The nanny was very pleasant and professional, arrived a few minutes early, had extreme desire to learn what was expected and necessary for the evening and even played hide and seek with them before I left. When I returned, I was surprised to find all the toys cleaned up off the floor and put away and nothing was broken! My child keeps asking for her to come back. I will definitely use Trusting Connections in the future.

Shortly after Kentwood's damage control guy responded to my review below, I decided to take him up on his offer of contacting him in an effort to work things out. I guess I'm just a glutton for punishment. I don't know why I expected these people to be any more humane than they were before. I wrote Mr. Pilip (if that is his real name) a polite, thoughtful email about my experience at the dealership. That was almost a month ago. He has not responded. Not even so much as an out-of-office reply. Imagine that. 

I suspect that Kentwood are only responding to our negative reviews for show - to make it appear to the public that they give a rat's ass. There is something about Mr. Pilip's wording below that implies he never wanted to talk to me anyway: "I'll understand if you don't want to contact me regarding your experience..." It looks like he was trying to put it out there that he didn't want to hear from me. I picture him typing that line with his fingers crossed on one hand as he hoped I wouldn't respond.

Notice in Kentwood's response to Gary C's review that the person who contacted him is named Ashley Roy. Casey Pilip responded to Amanda F's review as well as mine. Note how Ashley and Casey are using the same profile picture. Does anyone else think that that is weird? Maybe it's not the same photo and they just look a lot alike.

Dear Kentwood Ford,

You've made it clear to us that customer service is slightly higher on your priority list than getting shipwrecked. Don't bother responding to this review. I'd tell you to delete my email too but I'm sure you already have.

I took my 2018 Ford F-150 Lariat in for it's regular servicing to Kentwood Ford on Friday June 28th as I have many times before.  There was also a recall notice to get done.  I had also asked them to check a few other minor things.  When I took my truck in, it was in pristine condition, there were no nicks, rubs, scratches, or dents.

During the time my truck was in their care and custody, my wheels (tires and Rims) were stolen and truck body was damaged.  I asked how it gets handled and the response was 'We're looking into what we can do for you".  I was told the police had been on scene and started a file.

I went to the dealership to speak with the service team and spoke with 3 separate people including the operations manager.  They immediately wanted me to go through my insurance as they claimed they had no responsibility for the damages or theft,  I disputed this adamantly as my truck was on their lot and under their care and control.  They advised me that they have ZERO INSURANCE TO COVER CUSTOMER UNITS.  But also said they're a business so they will do service but if something happens, that's on the customer. 

It was also during this time that they informed me that the police had not been called and in fact no report had been made at all.  They advised and tried to convince me that making a comprehensive claim wouldn't affect my insurance rating.  I did talk to my insurance provider for advice though.  I was advised to push a little harder to get the the service owed as they see these kind of things all the time.  I went back in and advised I would not be going through insurance and that they should return the vehicle back to me in it's original condition.  They agreed that they would take tires off of a new truck off of the lot, to do an inspection for any hidden damage.

On  inspection of my vehicle, very quickly, I found that there was more damage to the vehicle than was originally told to me.  They fought me on what was pre-existing damage despite looking at their own pictures that they took when I checked the vehicle in showing no damage at all.

A few days later, July 10th, I decided to call the police to find out more details of the event.  I spoke with an officer who was able to confirm a report was made on JULY 9th at 2:08PM, This means, Kentwood did not call the police to report the incident for 6 days after. the theft. I don't know about you, but if my business was broken into, I would be calling the police pretty quickly.

I got a call on July 10th and was advised that my truck was ready for pick-up. I was told that the body damage & flare had been repaired, new wheels were put on and as a courtesy, they had put locking nuts on the truck.

Upon arrival I saw my vehicle parked outside the service bay. I pulled out my phone to make a recording of how it looked; There were now nicks, scratches and rubs EVERYWHERE.  To their credit, there were new tires and rims on the truck and the flare had been replaced.  The original body damage hadn't been touched and as mentioned there was new damage on both sides. Of course, the promised locking lugs were also not on the truck.  I refused to sign the documents agreeing that the contract was fulfilled as clearly it was not.  I DID NOT get my vehicle back in the same condition as I given it.

All I wanted was my truck back in the same condition in which I gave it to them.  I guess that's to much to ask of the Kentwood Ford service team.  

I have been dealing with Kentwood Ford for YEARS and GoAuto for even longer I have purchased 3 trucks with Kentwood and NEVER had a problem with the sales team. ALL of my service and parts orders have gone to Kentwood.  Thousands upon thousands of dollars over the years. That all stops now.  

To anyone reading this.  I STRONGLY urge you to steer clear of Kentwood Ford's service team.  It is my opinion that they deal underhandedly, dishonestly and in bad faith.  They will push responsibility to you, the customer, even when the fault is their own.
Fried chicken and Jack Salmon are the bomb!  Cornbread and peach cobbler keep you wanting more!

I used to eat at Sweetie Pies on Mangrove quite often and the food was amazing. I'm not sure if they changed their recipe but the sides were horrible and taste like a pound of sugar. I'm not sure how other people eat their greens and macaroni but the sugar is horrible. The cashier was rude and had an attitude, there was a long line but what can you expect on a Sunday. I wanted soul food so bad and was very disappointed. Please bring your old recipe back and stop with all the sugar.

Terrible communication. When confronted with mistake complete lack of accountability and passing of the buck. Assistant manager (Lori?) immediately combative and defensive. Confused and disorganized team that were very unhelpful and delayed problem solving in an effort to waste my time to the point of me giving up and leaving. Garbage. This is on top of me having to come a second time because they didn't have the part in time for the first appointment but didn't call to tell me until after dropping it off. Hours of work time scheduled off and pay wasted due to incompetence. Staff seem well meaning but overall a disorganized mess.

Its good food and cheap... but because its cheap, service is terrible. Took us and hour and half just to get our food watching others get our food before us. No comp on the food as it was the waitress fault. Come on a slow day or expect a long wait time. But if you have time and on a budget... this is your place.

I highly recommend using CHADMORE for any occasion that a tuxedo is needed. 
My son went to the prom on June 4,2021.
 I didn't know the first thing about renting a tuxedo.  I was going to go to Men's Wearhouse  but I read the reviews and was less than impressed.
 I googled tux rental and saw CHADMORE Formal and the reviews were good so I called them and a young man answered. He was polite and informed me that he would help me select a tux so I made an appointment.  
  I was so happy  I decided to go there. 
My son and I were greeted with friendly faces upon our arrival by EVERY MEMBER OF THE STAFF.  The employee took the time to listen to my son's requests and guided him in making a decision.  

Again ALL THE STAFF were great but I have to single out AIDEN who was Personable and respectful.  

I'd give CHADMORE FORMAL 10  !!!

My sister and I live in Rocco's it's about time I left a review. The service is excellent, the staff is always cheerful and friendly. If I am there without my sister they always ask about her. They now how she likes her food and they always aim to please when I order take out for her. We are originally from NYC so we like good pizza and I can honestly say Rocco's is tops. It goes without saying the food is excellent. I highly recommend Rocco's to everyone that likes Italian food with reasonable prices.

What can I say about Mexican fast food? Well, I think the fact that I gave it four stars to begin with says a lot. I mean, 4 stars for a place where you order your burrito over a pane of glass? And it's a chain with locations in all major metropolitan areas? Is that blasphemy? If it is, I don't care. These cats do a fine job of making burritos and bowls and salads and tacos, and I want everyone to know it. 

The thing that drove me to finally head to yelp and review them was the other day I decided to order pinto beans instead of black beans for the first time, in I don't know, ever? I knew for a fact, from a vegan friend, that the pinto beans have bacon in them. But the burrito chef let me know as I was ordering, so I would not get something I didn't want! My friend had been up in arms saying that they didn't tell you about the bacon and Chipotle be damned. But, I guess they've changed they're wily ways and they're now on the straight and narrow. 

The backbone of the 4 star review is that, for the most part, every meal I've gotten from this establishment has been tasty, made from quality ingredients and well put together. I don't think I've been disappointed more than once, and that was from some steak that was more on the rare side. They just gave me the option of getting my money back or getting a new bowl. I chose chicken and I was a-ok. Might be good to ask how new the steak is, since they seem to take it off the grill while it's still rare and let it cook while it waits to become a part of your lunch.
I found Chadmoore has excellent service.  My son rented a tuxedo this week.  There was a wide variety of styles to choose.

ok so yes I am really picky with my food these days, and as I get older I get pickier. I am even more pickier with my pizza and italian food. Today we tried a place called Rocco's. I have to say it was the BEST pizza I have had in over 25 years! Also, the chicken Marsala was AMAZING! I hope they stay in business and stay making it so good! We will definitely be repeat customers.  Cant wait to try the chocolate italian ice!!!

We were getting married and I needed flowers.  I wanted colorful flowers, to go with my dress, and asymmetry. I also wanted the boutonnieres to compliment the bouquet. The Basket of Flowers expert came up with precisely what I wanted and did it in record time. I was so very pleased with the previous results, that when I needed flowers for a dear friend's funeral, I called them. Both my mother and I ordered bouquets and they were so lovely! They are my go to florists from now on.

Crowded. Always during lunch. Keep that in mind. I would have given 4 stars if not for the lack of seating. Most of their tables sit four. Most of the time I go there is one person taking up a whole table. So you either wait, take your food to go or eat across from a stranger. This is probably the only thing I don't like about this place. Otherwise food is great, employees are nice and the place is clean. 

Oh.. Never ever eat the lemon wedges they have waiting near the soda fountain. You should know why...

I loooooove me some Chipotle!  I don't discriminate.  I'll eat it ALL at any location.  Problem here: THIS location is suuuuper STINGY WITH THE MEAT!  One girl in particular who's on meat duty at around noon on weekdays.  When she's on deck, it's like playing the claw game in the arcade: the claw comes down, grabs the stuffed animal you've always wanted, looks like it's coming up, then DROP! Nothing.  See, I typically order a salad with no beans and no rice; so basically nothing but lettuce and salsa.  You'd think with that order she'd provide the full 4 oz. of meat Chipotle says comes with it.  I'm one of those crazies who actually weighs everything I eat so I know what 4 oz. of meat looks like...  With this chick, I get less than 2 oz. every. damn. time.  She whips out the tongs, actually grabs the right portion, I immediately get my hopes up, then riiiiight before she goes to put it in my bowl, DROP!!!! She shakes off half it back into the pot.  So I look at her and go, "Can I get a little more than that, please?"  She fires back, "So you want double meat?," which in Chipotle-speak translates to: "So you want to pay even more for this already overpriced bowl of lettuce?" It's like a threat.  Anyway, my life's mission is to figure out how to make their barbacoa at home so I can get my own god damn 4 oz.!  SUGGESTION BOX:  Get a measuring cup and scoop that sh** so it's not so subjective and we don't have to get into a polite fight every time I question your knowledge of what 4 ounces looks like.

I'm not sure what happened to this Chipotle but it is slowly getting more and more disgusting. The rice is always very mushy and every time I go it they are out of something. I went around 3pm so you'd think they had enough time to replenish from the lunch time rush but they seemed to be just standing around having side conversations. Stations are a mess. Just generally disappointing :(

I went at the invite of some acquaintances. 

Struggled to find anything low-carb. Ended up getting the gluten-free small pizza. It was okay. 

The waitress was pleasant. I was with a large group at lunchtime (large groups aren't something I'm fond of anyway), and I was impressed that the waitress kept everyone's order straight and rang it all up separately.

After reading the reviews, my husband and I made a special trip to Rocco's. We decided to try a variety of items as well as the pizza to give a fair review. The chicken cutlet pesto sandwich was outstanding, however, the pizza fell a short of that. As a self-proclaimed pizza snob, this is just meh. The crust was ok but even worse there wasn't a decent selection of beer to wash it down. Sadly, it wasn't worth the drive but as full as the restaurant was, obviously I stand alone in my pizza aloofness. I gave it three stars because the service was very attentive but the pizza is just average.

LOVE.

Love the show, love the Florissant location, love the Mangrove location.  I ate like I eat at Christmas and Thanksgiving.  I was so full by the time I was done, I didn't want to get up to leave!  the portions are huge, the food is wonderful and you get to see the real same people that are on the show!  I am such a nerd, I was a little star struck.

I cannot go to Sweetie Pies and not get mac n' cheese.  It was the first time I had tried the fried chicken wings and they were so yummy. Perfectly golden fried! Hodak's used to be my favorite chicken place, but I'm going to have to go back and try Hodak's again.

The Infamous Sweetie Pie's.  What can I say.  Well, after a loooooong wait, I finally hit the counter and was faced with one of the toughest decisions of my life - do I have the fried chicken I had been dreaming about all day, or do I have meat loaf, which is my favourite food on the planet. In the end, I couldn't say no to the half chicken special and ordered up.  I also got the mac and cheese, cornbread dressing, and mashed potatoes, plus a pear cobbler for dessert.  Naturally, I planned on taking half of this home.  If you're going to wait an hour and a half for food, you're going to order up and get two meals out of it.  At least, I was.

And so, the food.

Fried Chicken - not the best in St. Louis, but darn close. It was crispy, juicy, flavourful.  A pure delight. I still give the top prize to King Edwards, but this is some mighty fine chicken.

Corn Bread - pretty sure it was just Jiffy mix.  Nothing special.

Corn Bread Dressing - it was Stove Top.  Edible, but disappointing.

Mashed Potatoes - a true disappointment. Nothing irritates me more than being served instant mashed potatoes at a restaurant. If I wanted to eat that gunk, I'd make it at home for a fraction of the cost.. But since I despise instant mashed potatoes, I won't even make them at home on my laziest day. Just...ugh.

Mac and Cheese - now this was special. I really don't care for most mac and cheese, this being the one food where I take great delight in eating the fake stuff from a box.  Most homemade seems bland to me. This was far from bland.  It was delicious. 

Pear Cobbler - this was delightful. This was one of the items I took home, so when I reheated it, it was warm, spiced well, a true comfort dessert. 

So, all in all, I'm impressed with their homemade products. I'm just disappointed that half the items I ate were from a box.  

Someday I'll go back for that meat loaf though...

Legit soul food, trays of it for days.  They have everything you want: chicken - smothered & fried, catfish, oxtail, greens, okra, cornbread, red beans & rice, black eyed peas, ..etc, etc, etc.

I'm getting very hungry.

This is the best place for All-Around Soul in St. Louis.  However I must confess I like London's better for their liver (liver fans take note).   I think Sweetie Pie's is the best soul mac and cheese I've ever had.  Sometimes soul mac n cheese has too much mustard for me - Sweetie Pie's is the happy medium, straddling comfortingly bland and zesty. 

Some people have mentioned the cafeteria style of Sweetie Pie's - I just wanna state I find it more legit when they do it that way...soul food of any stripe - African-American, Filipino, Hawaiian, German...low and slow, baby....low and slow.  'Nuff said.

Prices are great (meals cost $9-12 with 2 sides and are available a la carte), the staff is personable...If you love soul food - you need to stop by and say hi!

They are serving rotting food.  I ordered a chicken sandwich with extra lettuce which they charged me $.08 for.  The lettuce had brown rotted pieces in it and the rest was yellowish, tasted gross and I had to take all of it off.  I called and told manager so they would put fresh stuff out for customers.  She said this lettuce looks fine.

I got a chance to experienced both the mangrove and the upper crust location yesterday.  Let's start with the first stop - mangrove.  Tuesday, 11:31, doors open.  Incidentally, while waiting to get in, the aromas were amazing.  However, going through the line, the workers need more training in how to get the customers served.  I wanted to tried everything.    I ended up with the 4 chicken wings with cabbage and black eye peas for my sides.  I also got the short ribs w/cabbage and okra.  Now for the review.  The perfectly cooked cabbage was mmmmmmgood.  The chicken was one of the  best I have ever tasted.  I could only devour one.  I ate a fork full of the short ribs.  It was absolutely fabulous.  Now the down side.  The okra was over cooked and the black eye peas were bland.  Overall I would rate the food with four and half stars out of five.  The servers, thanks Deke, with a 10.

To The upper crust,  we wanted to compare the two establishments.  We arrived at 6:00p.m.  Incidentally, no wait.  I chose the smothered pork steaks w/cabbage and the macaroni and cheese.  The items of the steak and Mac were both good. However, the overcooked cabbage didn't need sugar added to them.   Incidentally, the dishes that you serve your side in are much smaller than mangroves.

If upper crust really want to evolve to the quality of mangrove, 
1.  Prepare with your food that need sugar to your desserts only.           Diabetes is a killer
2.  Train others to provide service that Deke gave us.

I rate this restaurant with a two out of five stars.  The server get a three.

Finally, everyone who worked at both locations were beautiful, especially
Charles.

Thank you for unique and rewarding experience.

I'm writing this review on behalf of my father who visited the restaurant. I'm not sure if this is the exact location or the other one in St. Louis, but I do know Sweety Pie's son spoke to him in a negative, rude manner. 

First of all, my father is elderly, 80 years old. He came to the restaurant by himself because he was hungry and wanted some soul food. He sat in an area and was served his food, but then the son came up to him and said, "Oh no, you gotta go. You need to get out of here, get out of this area!" 

It seems as though they're was a big party of people coming in. It is understandable that he needed the area for the people, but my father didn't understand the way he was approached and spoken to ESPECIALLY when the area wasn't roped off nor did it have a sign saying it was reserved. My father proceded to tell him the way he was speaking to him wasn't necessary and the son proceeded to tell him that he could get out and get his money back, which he agreed and will never be returning. 

I've never seen the TV show and never plan to see it. I've heard it was ghetto, especially the son, but I am totally appalled at the way they would treat an ELDERLY PAYING customer. I think it's absolutely despicable!

The first time I had Chipotle was when I was in Chicago for a conference. I thought it was really good at the time. Somewhere along the line, I guess I saw Chipotle for what I think it truly is...Qdoba with a different name. I won't do the whole Chipotle v. Qdoba battle, but I find it interesting that this particular Chipotle is located a few feet away from Qdoba on Walnut Street.

I ordered a chicken burrito the last time I ate here and it wasn't bad, but I truly do not see the difference in taste between a burrito from Chipotle and one from Qdoba. I'm convinced they're under the same ownership.

MORE BULLSHIT FROM THIS DEALERSHIP

I have finally been able to get the car into Kentwood to get repaired and the bullshit with them continues. Its amazing how this company stays in business and let me assure anyone reading this new update - Customers are FAR from being treted with respect and as a possible returning customer.

1) First, I went to Kentwoods competition and got a low down on everything in regards to my deal / paperwork / and the car itself. I spent almost an hour with Bruno, and by I was tempted to trade in my car towards the pruchase of a 2012 vehicle. In regards to the repairs not being done, or the way both myself and wife were treated ......... unexcusable.

Anyways, the service tech was very nice and immediated stated to me and the wife, that he noticed the problem with the power steering. Shifting problem? Nope.
3) On Aug 17th, I called down to Kentwood and left a message on the tech's voicemail - inquiring about how things were. Little did I notice on my cell, that he had left a message for me explaining that a) still no problems found with the gearbox and shifting; and b) the Power sterring pressure line was on order from some place in Ontario and would be here the following Tues / Weds.
That night, we stopped by Kentwood, because my wife had accidentaly left some medication behind, and we noticed that the car was buried behind some cars, and there was a fairly noticable puddle of fluid under the hood, which I chaulked it up to the power steering problem. Service department was closed at the time.
4) The wife stopped in on the 20th, and got her medication. She asked about the puddle under the hood and yes - it had to do with the power steering. The car was still buried behind other vehicles.
5) TODAY!
I once again tried to call the tech, to get a run down on the car because I was told that the part should be in yesterday / today and all I got was the tech's machine ....... again. I left a message asking for him to call to give me a run down, and if I didnt answer - to leave me a message. Someone called back 15 minutes later, which I missed to do being in a meeting, and NO message was left. I went home for lunch and because of my frustration with the servcie department, the wife called ........ She got through to him and this is what I am currently dealing with:
a) They will NOT leave a message because they feel its not worth it because of the message I did not see last Friday .........
b) Only NOW, is something being said about an individual accussing us of hitting their car with our doors, in which happened Friday night at the movie theatre ........ I'm sorry but I think something like THIS - requires my immediate attention!! Voicemail or not
c) She asked about the car again and was told that they tried shifting again and found nothing ....... THE CAR WAS IN THE SAME SPOT AN HOUR BEFORE SHE CALLED!! Because I made the comment that I noticed the problem more first thing in the morning when I back out of the driveway - they took it a gospel and thats what their doing. They are not actually moving the car, their just going through the gears!!
d) The tech then DISMISSED my wife on the phone, saying that "We will call you when your car is done" and then hung up the phone on her!!!

I am 30 seconds from calling Bruno at City Ford and sayingt hat once this car is fixed, I want out of my financing with Kentwood and I'm getting a car with him. I have NEVER been treated so badly from a dealership, then the crap I'm getting from them now!

So I'm a native St Louisian and of course I can cook soulfood, but why should I bother when I can just stop by Sweetie Pies, when I want fried chicken and fish.

We have been eating at this location since it first opened and I still love it.  I'm told that if I had tried the No Co location first, I would never have gone back (service and food like night and day from Man-Grove spot).

The one negative is that the mac & cheese is sweet (condensed milk perhaps?) - whatever the reason, I skip it!

Friendly staff, worth the wait.

We love this place! My Mom and Uncle order their favorite, spaghetti and meatballs, most of the time. The sauce is to die for, and the portion is awesome. THREE meatballs! I enjoy the calzone, with it's many choices for fillings. Their pizza is great, the fresh bread served with dinner and plentiful salads are delicious too. We've never had bad service. Tonight our server was Dante. He was excellent with his friendly nature, observant of drink refills or boxes needed, and most important, the 3 minute follow-up once the first bites were taken that all is good, and was anything else needed. Like I said, we love going to Rocco's!

MMM MMM this is some good shit.  I visited several times with a friend of mine and enjoy the food each time.  Now that it has been on Diners Drive-Ins and Dives I am sure the wait is even longer.

Sweetie Pie's is served cafe style.  Walk on up and tell the counter staff what you'd like.  I usually get the fried chicken wings along with the macaroni and cheese.  People swear by the macaroni here.  Me?  I just think its okay.  I need to go back and try the smothered pork chops because they look delicious.  

The only downside to this location is the loud music.  I am okay with music playing, but there is usually a singer accompanied by an electronic piano and it is AMPLIFIED.

The food isn't bad, but I will often get a burrito that's only about half as long as when I get it from another location. Also if you come after about 8:30 pm, be prepared to not get what you want. They run out of food quite often and have to close an hour or two early. The employees seem a bit disorganized, mobile orders don't ever get put on the pick up shelf on time and just sit on the counter behind the register.

Have been to Lax for the past year. Great local, community barber shop. You leave feeling great not just because of the way you look nor the great prices, but because of the friendly, and respectful service you receive. 

Would recommend anytime.

At 63,000 my Ford F-150 developed steering problems.  Kentwood replaced the steering rack, lines, and pump.  They refused to help me get it covered under warranty with Ford.

Now at 75,000 the truck is sitting at a dealership in Red Deer.  The mechanic here tells me the vehicle needs a steering rack.

Based on information from an electronic tachograph I know that Kentwood had my vehicle in their shop for no more than 3.5 hours.  They billed me for 8 hours for the original job.

The fact the steering rack has failed a second time has me more upset with the Service Department at Kentwood.

I called Kentwood and discovered Ashley Roy is no longer General Manager.  His replacement is Kevin Allison.

Kevin is fairly easy to talk with and was helpful.  The steering rack will be replaced under the Ford Service Warranty.

No money out of my pocket though I have the hassle of being without my vehicle for three days in a city that is two hours from where I live.

This incident supports my theory that Kentwood Service did not do a proper job in the first place.

Please read my previous reviews of Kentwood for the background to my story.  Though my experience with Kevin was positive, I am not quite ready to increase my star rating or visit this dealership again.

Awesome.  The fade he achieved was perfect.  I finally managed to get a cut and style done in Philly that didn't take a second mortgage to fund, and was really great.

The trim on the facial hair was spot on, and the shop is clean, neat and organized.

Dropped by on a whim cause they are offering free guac to celebrate National Avocado Day! Convenient location and the food is consistently fresh! The staff are super friendly and attentive. Ordered my usual half chicken and half steak burrito bowl with a side of chips on the side. Their guac is a hand-mashed masterpiece that really hit the spot. Chipotle never disappoints!

So everybody kept saying we needed to try some true soul food when we moved to STL about a year ago! Well let's just say that if Sweetie Pies isn't some true soul food then I don't know what is! 

I had the fried chicken, macaroni and cheese, corn bread, and mashed potatoes and gravy. I personally don't care for spicy or anything that's even slightly spicy, so I was surprised to fine the gravy and chicken both to be a bit spicy. I still enjoyed them but didn't finish either because of that. The cornbread was dry so I can't say much about that. The best part of the whole meal was the Mac and cheese *to freakin die for* my husband and I loved it! 

Overall the food was good we'll definitely bring our friends there, but because of the spicy, very long line (waited about 25 minutes) and dry cornbread I could only give it 3 stars.

Oprah made this place famous. And when I am busy, stressed, and more stressed - I need pie and fried chicken. This is a cafeteria style soul food venue. It's very very busy on the weekends and you need to know what you want when you are in line. So - come for the fried chicken, cornbread, and duh PIE. I skip on the green beans and veggies - b/c it's general just too cooked/too much grease/butter. This place is very very heavy and once every other month meal for me. Bu - this is a STL staple.

We went here with friends who li e in the spring hill area but do not usually go out for dinner or pizza.  
My husband and I split a pizza with sausage, peppers and fresh garlic on it. It was delicious!
Our friends had a calzone and a stromboli. They were both pleased with their choices. My girlfriend loaded her calzone up with vegetables while her hubby had the meat waters stromboli.  
The service was excellent. Our server was helpful, not intrusive and overall knowledgeable about our questions.  
We'll be back when we visit spring hill again.

I'm glad that the owners started this company up as we can use this service, however it's overall an ok and average experience-- definitely not "premier."

Pros:
They are usually (though not always) able to find nannies on short notice which is very helpful.
The office staff is helpful, polite, and professional.


Cons:
Very expensive!
Unfortunately I found the nannies to be average-- not "premier." 
One nanny didn't change my baby's soiled diaper at all.  Another nanny left early without asking me if it was ok.  Yet another nanny talked to me about her problems and may have taken something from my house.
