(I'm not accusing her of stealing as I have no proof, just stating that she *may* have taken something from my house because the item disappeared after she was in my home.)

Overall it's okay but not the kind of experience you'd expect from a "premier" agency.  

I wouldn't mind hiring them if I was in a bind but I've found better nannies through the other company in town.

We bought my husband's Ford truck from Kentwood over 4 years ago.  We were treated very well and my husband is STILL driving his Ford and has been very happy with it.
When we are ready for a new truck for him, we will definitely go back to Kentwood because we were pleased with the service and the vehicle we purchased.
I know it is possible for an individual to have a bad experience at a particular business but I wanted to point that our experience with this company was very good.  If Kentwood Ford were as bad as these other reviews indicate, I think they would be out of business by now.
Trusting Connections helped me to find a spectacular part time nanny for my son. The process was easy and so is ongoing scheduling. It's a bit expensive but worth the cost to me.

I take road trips sometimes and when I do I look for a deal when I stop for the night, mainly because I do not spend a lot of time in a hotel, just a place to crash, and then I go out again in the morning.  So keep in mind that I am writing this in comparison to other budget hotels.  I stayed two nights in two different rooms, both were nice.  The remodeling was a little sloppy in the bathroom, in my mind that is a minor detail.  There was a microwave and a fridge, unfortunately, I left my Greek leftovers from Tarpon Springs in the fridge.  The rooms are far enough from highway 19 so that the road noise didn't wake me up in the middle of the night.  There was a decent continental breakfast in the morning.  Cereal, fruit, bagels, juice, etc.  Wifi is included as well.  

The location is fairly convenient unless you are in rush hour traffic it doesn't take long to get to the Tampa area.  So with the location, wifi (granted I normally wouldn't think about listing this as a benefit but a Motel 6 I stayed at in Charleston still charged for it), and the free breakfast (Didn't have to spend the $7-10 elsewhere to eat), and the fact that it is waaaaaaay cheaper than the surrounding hotels, I give this 4 stars and my recommendation.  If you are used to a 4 star establishment and that is what you are looking for, you may want to pass.  For the price sensitive consumer, this place is it!
The flavor of this pizza is immaculate according to my boyfriend, he works at a pizza place and says this is very good pizza and tasted fresh!

I waited in the drive-thru for 20 minutes.  When I got to the order speaker nobody spoke, i had noticed there wasn't the sound of ordering when the car in front of me was sitting there for 5 minutes.  I asked if they were going to take my order back here?  ( I thought they may have been taking orders at the window.)  A girl replied that they would take my order when they were able.  I waited a few more minutes and when the car in front of me was out of sight I drove around and when I found that there weren't any cars waiting at the windows I just drove away. 6:10 pm
Very poorly run.

Let's just say, the canned beer was good. Can't go wrong with canned beer, right? As far as the food goes, it could have been loads better. We've come here more than a few times and the service, cleanliness and food just keeps getting worse.

This time, we ordered a campechana. No flavor. We also ordered the shrimp pozole. No flavor. The oysters were far from fresh and the side of al pastor tacos tasted like boiled meat tossed in sauce too late for it to hold on to any flavor. We might be too demanding but this is definitely not what good, authentic Mexican food should taste like. Needless to say, that was our last visit.

Amazing the difference in what your staff and employees make. The other day I came in and met Mendy who was fabulous and had an excellent meal. Today I thought wow gotta go back since the experience was wonderful. Well so disappointing to find some "clueless and carefree" staff working front who acted like everyone in line was nothing but a bother. These kids working need to understand customer service- its a common theme anymore. Most youth think they deserve higher wages and not have to do anything to earn it. At least teach all employees to smile and thank the customer for them choosing BK.  Chic-Fla is a good model, always feel appreciated and treated with respect and kindness there. I will give it another try soon since I am working in the area, but must be transparent and honest I will consider going to Wendy's instead. Time heals....but let's not repeat

The service here is horrible, my friend who is from Germany had asked the lady behind the counter if they have beef, and she was so rude because she didnot understand her nicely. She then gave her chicken! 
Awefull....

It was better than expected for the price. The AC actually worked, the door locked, and no major stains. The bed was decently comfy and they had a pool and free breakfast. Definitely nothing luxury and there were a bunch of things that could have been better maintained, but for the price and convenient location, I'd use it again.

I just took delivery of my new Ford Expedition 2021 platinum... Did the whole deal over Emails with Avery in the sales department.. I live in Vancouver BC and he shipped my new vehicle out and we loaded up my trade in on the transport trailer... all smooth  no problems .. also worked with Anne in the financial department very professional with all the paperwork back and forth.. if you find a vehicle like I did on auto trader don't hesitate to deal with Kentwood Ford to have it shipped out to you .. could not be happier..

Zero stars if possible. I went there today to get food but the staff told me it is online ordering only. Not a big deal considering the covid circumstances and other Chipotle's operate the same way. Once again I understand. They told me the app does not work so I need to use the browser. I then sat down at a table to place an order, the browser would not let me place an order either and said online ordering is unavailable on the website. I then walked up to the staff and I showed them on my phone showing unavailable. I  asked the staff what we could do since all 3 options are off the table.

They told me there is nothing they can do and denied me service.

Terrible service, close the doors if you have zero options to order food and your staff is unwilling to serve your customers.

This is my favorite Chipotle I've ever been to. It's fast, the staff is awesome, and if you request a lot of peppers they won't go stingy on you.

Another thing I like about it here is that the mild salsa  (appears to be pico de gallo) is fresh. I've been to locations such as the one in the Radnor area where something was off about it - including the texture.

Again a shout out to the staff: you guys are the best.

We have used this service for about six months now and stuck with it in hopes that things would get better. After all, we had already paid the annual fee that they charge up front. They have sent us over a dozen sitters in just a few months. We have a young child and were uncomfortable with having different caregivers all the time. We were concerned this could happen and asked about it before we joined the service. We were assured that if we had a consistent schedule they would send us the same person with some exceptions (nannies take time off, quit, etc). We understood this but we have been getting a new nanny every other week. One nanny couldn't soothe our son and we came home early because he was so upset. Another nanny couldn't get our son to eat. I have taken to hiding the remotes so the nannies won't use the tv to entertain our child. I think this service could be useful in emergencies. For example, your regular babysitter can't make it and you have to go to work. I wouldn't recommend them at all for regular childcare since the quality of care is so inconsistent, the nannies disregard your instructions, and the owners are dismissive when you bring concerns to their attention.

Giving a one star rating is even too much.  I am tired of Kentwood Ford calling me every few months and telling me that they can help reduce my payments with another vehicle.  Every time  I tell the staff what I want, they say they will see what they can do and then no one ever gets back to me following this.  I don't care if they can't get me a better deal or not.  STOP calling me to harass me.  

Further, I just want to say the service department at Kentwood Ford is no better.  Just recently I had some work done.  They did a horrible job and not to mention the mechanics left their grimy hand prints on the inside of my roof.  I had asked this to be cleaned at the time I brought it in a second time to be serviced and this did not occur.  My vehicle still has the fingerprints.  There are other issues that I asked to be fixed and they were poorly done.

Long time Customer since we've moved here,and roccos its our go to place for Pizza. Typically order the shrimp,garlic and fresh basil pie. It has always been excellent. Well that's changed, they used to use whole chopped shrimp on the pie. This pie is not cheap but who cares it's great. Today I ordered the pie picked it up only to get home and opened the box. There was salad shrimp extremely small scattered about. They have no flavor whatsoever. Folks you need to return to what you were doing before. If you need to charge more that's understandable but unfortunately with this decision quality has dropped significantly. The rest of their menu items are good and this will not stop us from going, but it's a critique that's necessary.Needless to say we won't be ordering this pie again unless they go back to the original recipe.

This place is great!  (You don't have to know a thing about soul food to love Sweetie Pies!)  It's a cafeteria style ordering system, some folks may not be used to that, but it's nice to see what you are ordering.  They are not stingy on portions either, go hungry or you're wasting the experience.  Only thing I didn't like was the Okra, but i let it get cold so that was my mistake!  Can't wait to go back!

All I can say if you're a Soul Food connoisseur you will love Sweetie Pie's. 
The food tastes like your moms or grandmas food the food is cooked fresh all day long. 

I was able to see Turkey, Chicken, Pork chops, Fish with all the sides imaginable Collard greens, Yams, Macaroni and cheese, Black eyed peas, Banana pudding, peach cobbler, pound cake.

Sweetie Pie's is a nice clean establishment they played good music the staff was personable they carry your food to the table and seat you. It's worth the drive to St. Louis, Missouri. If ever in St. Louis indulge and enjoy like I did.

Wilson's shoe repair service while you wait is a winner all day every day. 

I love high heels but I kinda sorta feel like they are not in love with me or my penchant for walking distances in them. While most heel wearers will tell you they do not walk distances in their "good" heels, I rarely shoe swap and I often pay the price for it. No matter how hard I try to walk carefully, I always manage to step in a crack or two and it cuts into the leather on my heels often causing it to detach. For anyone who has experienced this first hand, you know you have three choices (1) buy a new pair, (2) have the entire heel cover replaced or (3) have it glued back in place if (its not too bad).

I brought in my heel cut and  Wilson fixed it in a matter of minutes. While there, I also purchased adhesive grid pads to eliminate the slippery feel on my sole.  

The repair and pads for $12.05 was a bargain in my book. There is no question this lifesaver will be my go to whenever I am in town and am in need heel help. Wilson was most certainly a true friend in my time of need.

This place will charge you 100 dollars just to pull codes.  They are a business first and a service second.  They are good for tires.  Overcharge for oil changes. Manager is nice (Brett) but obviously a company man.  This is based on years but f experiences but this last one really rubbed me wrong.

Omg! I booked this room on hotels.com the day before we needed to use the room. My family had to evacuate due to hurricane Matthew. Understand that we have a disabled child who has a service dog. When we arrived at the hotel, (bare in mind it was 11:30 pm.) The lobby had a sign that said this is a pet friendly hotel as well mind you, that we clearly pointed out when all the drama hit. When we showed up for our reservation and was told by Cara at the counter that I needed to pay extra for the dog. So I told her ok charge it. Right at that moment another woman next to her at the counter who had curly black hair turned and looked at Cara, yelled at her and told her they can't stay here! (I was embarrassed for her!) She immediately turned around and told us no, and said you can't stay here. That room was just remodeled and it's brand-new. She then slide my credit card back to me, and told us to leave. I was absolutely in shock at this moment. I could not believe that this was happening. Not only did we have to leave our home and come to a hotel to stay for three days and worry about whether or not our home was going to be destroyed now are being told that we don't have a place to stay. The very sad thing was, is that there was nothing we could do, but go to an empty parking lot, pull out our iPad and try to find another place to stay. We could not find anything, everything was booked. We luckily found one place and I'm embarrassed to say it was such a roach of the place that nobody would've stayed there but we had to because of the current situation.  So thumbs down to this Ho Jo. I have never had such bad service ever. I can't believe they did what they did in our current situation!!!

I honestly don't know HOW anyone could give this place a bad review! I'm a very impatient person but it was WORTH the wait. It wasn't that long for us though... we came at a good time because right after we arrived people started to flood in. I didn't particularly like that people stood in line and hovered over my food... but what can you do and say! I was back in town and my and my BF decided to treat my grandparents to this place... they had been before. We had not. Our waiter was Calvin BONUS points cause I remembered his name. I rarely remember my servers name. He was super friendly and made my grandparents laugh! MORE bonus points! He even joked with my BF at how big he was (my BF has a football player build) Calvin really made us feel like it was... home. I didn't really feel like I was out eating at a restaurant. Even with all his tables he was very accomodating. The portions are big. I say that usually all the time because I rarely finish my plate... I didn't here either. I ordered a lot! I had about 5 sides along with my fish... when it was time to pay Calvin came and took my tray to the table which caught me off guard because he gave no notice. All in all I had a great time. Jokingly at the end Calvin told my grandparents how pretty I was walking back to the car they informed us he didn't want to say it infront of Charles (my BF) in fear of getting hit. We had a great experience all in all and will be going back again when I'm back in town!

This hotel proves an old hotel can still be A nice hotel. I stayed here because the price was right but I will be back because of the quality of my stay. The room was well cleaned, they have a nice breakfast bar in room to eat and work at and I felt like I was in a new room. I was really impressed with the overall value for this room at this location. I highly recommend.
The atmosphere is not very fancy but the civeche is the best. It comes in the molcajete and tastes so good.

Disclaimer: we visited two days in row as we were from out of town. 

Now that's outta the way, I will say that my first meal was delish. It consisted of the three wings, yams and Mac & Cheese. Wasn't too fond of the cornbread, guess I'm just a Jiffy cornbread lover. Other friend had the smothered pork steak but it was cold but her sides (black eye peas, yams and mac & cheese). Other friend had the same meal as me except she had other chicken pieces. Two of us had peach cobbler and one banana pudding. 

Sunday: it must have been good cuz we came back for some more to take home, four hours away. Meals included meatloaf, baked chicken(good) and of course, wings again...Mac & Cheese(better than Saturday), greens(ON POINT), yams...all good. Peach cobbler was good but that banana pudding was right on the money!!!

Downside: on Saturday, while in line, the line staff is a bit rough in tone. We had picked up their brand tea and from outta nowhere we hear someone yelling, "CAN YALL LAY YALL TEAS DOWN ON THE TRAY FOR ME?" We were like what the hell just happen. We were feeling like Seinfeld's soup nazi episode, like obey the rules or get out. 

Side note: bottled tea was not good at all

Sunday: back in line, since we were traveling, I asked could my yams and greens be put in the side containers. Out of nowhere, some lady comes with a EXTRA bad attitude, yelling that any side the line lady put in those containers would be $3.69 a piece. SAY WHAT!!! I'm traveling, I don't want soggy chicken when I get home. The issue is that she was extra rude to my friend and I and it was completely unnecessary and it could have been handled much better. Even when we asked the staff her name, they even shrugged and rolled their eyes like, "huh, she's one of the managers"

Good food..bad customer service tendencies...need some retraining!!!

We visit Tucson at least twice a year and finding a nanny for a week was impossible. Then, I discovered Trusting Connections and have used them for the last four years. Katie is a joy to work with and always communicates the schedule clearly and effectively. We have had several different nannies over the years and I have been happy with every. single. one. It's a relief to know that my two daughters are safe and happy. As an added bonus, I always come home to a clean house and a fun crafting or art project. Extremely happy with the TC service!

Disappointment. 

I've had better soul food and I have definitely had better service. Here my family were treated like bastards at a family reunion by the staff. The Sweetie Pie owner (who seems so fun on TV) visited every.single.table but ours, even looked at my father and gave him a dirty look. My sweet 70 year old pop, who never goes anywhere where he does not make a friend. Everyone loves him. Seriously.

Where was all the charm? My St. Louis pals love it here. I have seen the show myself and yeah that is not the experience what we got. Gosh knows I'm an enthusiastic diner, a freaking restaurant regular, look at my reviews overall. The food here was nice-ish enough but not mindblowing but none of us would be obvious on our feelings about that. Heck I am grateful for anyone who will cook for me! We were all happy when we went in. We were excited to try the food. No one on our side was rude in the slightest. I don't get it. At all.

This is strictly a service/attitude issue. We came all the way from Detroit where we are soul food joint regulars for this shit. Never once have we felt so unwelcome. Shame. Oh and for the record the reason I am mad is the kids had their feelings hurt, you don't have to say shit to me but a hi for the three extremely well behaved kids would have been nice. 

I guess my mom won't be tuning in for the new season.

Great employees and great service!  I just returned from having a leak in my tire fixed.  I purchased these tires from this location have had them balanced, rotated, and aligned here.  I have always been met with a friendly greeting by the manager and great customer service.  

The leak was caused by corrosion around the edge of my wheel caused by the salt on Indiana roads in the winter.  They cleaned it up and aired up my tire...all for not cost.  The manager definitely knows how to treat customers and win business for the long term.  I plan to start bringing my vehicle here for all future maintenance.

Bought a used 2014 truck from Kentwood Ford three weeks ago. The next day I thought it was riding rough, and it turned out that one of the rear shocks had leaked out all the oil and there was oil all over the back bumper. The sales guy I bought from said to book an appointment with service, tell them I just bought it, and bring it in. They were good enough to find me a loaner car, and assured me they would call the next afternoon. Didn't get a call the next day so I waited until the next morning. I called and they said they replaced one shock, but the other one was starting to leak as well and that I had to pay to replace that one. I disagreed. The service advisor was good to deal with and understood where I was coming from. It was not fair that I was being pressured to pay to replace the other leaking shock. I needed my vehicle back as I was going out of town so the service advisor agreed to contact the manager and let them know where I stood on the matter. Never heard back. I called back almost a week later, and was told they were not returning her calls or voicemail messages. I get the feeling the service advisors hands were tied on this issue, and it was the manager that was dropping the ball. I also contacted my sales guy, but he quit responding to me too. 

I even offered to have the shock installed myself if they supplied it to me, as I live quite a distance from Kentwood and it would be easier to deal with it myself elsewhere. No response to this either. 

Not happy with Kentwood at all. I have a bad taste in my mouth for Go Auto and Kentwood Ford. I like the truck I bought, but not happy with the service I received after they "got my money". I paid a serious amount of money for this vehicle and they can't even replace both shocks that failed the next day? I could see if I put a bunch of miles on that truck, but they were observed as failed within 30kms of the dealership, and were likely leaking when it was still there. You would think in the interest of customer satisfaction this would have been taken care of swiftly and sent me on my way. Instead I feel my hands are tied as they are completely ignoring me.
Walked out after waiting today in a line for 15 minutes that simply wasn't moving,  as staff was making food for pickup and delivery orders instead.

Not the best not the worst. I find they move quickly and 50% of the time get the burrito ratio down. It's the other half of the time that keeps me from coming back and picking the other across broad. 

Today I got all the way through ordering (hello spicy salsa!) and then found out they were out of cups for water. I asked for just a normal sized cup and the cashier mentioned it messes up their inventory.

I get that but I think management should have found a way around this or ran a block over for some water cups. I would have gotten my meal to go or not gotten the spiciest salsa. C'est la vie.

Do not book with them! They have poor and professional staff that will make you regret it!
I booked an appointment to get winter tires installed a couple days prior to my actual appointment. My fiance had already found a quote for me online so the lady was very helpful on the phone to get everything set up. I work early in the morning so I dropped my car off the night before.

I left two contact numbers for them but they only tried the one in the afternoon, which I couldn't answer because I was working. When I was able to call them back it was after my shift and I was on my way to pick up my car. I was informed the that only 3 of the 4 tires were ordered in the correct size. They gave me two options, have 3 winter tires installed now or come back in two days to do it over again. It was irritating as I had to rely on someone else to take me there since I lived on the other side of the city to now have to make multiple trips. I decided to pick up my car now and try again on wednesday.
On the phone I tried asking the lady what happened, was it an error my fiance and I had submitted with our quote or was it an error on their part? I didn't get a straight answer.
Upon arriving at the service desks I stood there for at least 10 minutes while staff either stood around or walked right past me without acknowledging myself as a customer who needed assistance. Finally I walked up to the guy at the cubicle less than 5 feet from me and asked for help. He told me they were very busy and I had to talk to the lady two desks down from him. I went and stopped in front of her desk and waited while she finished her phone call.
 That entire time she did not wave, smile, nod look or talk to me in any way. She then got up and walked out the door behind her without saying a word.
 She came in a few minutes later and finally asked what I wanted. She sent someone to bring my car around. I asked her what happened with the tires and again she could not give me a proper answer. She said the service guy ordered the wrong part then corrected herself to say it was my fault for submitting the wrong information! After I left I checked the website on how we obtained the quote and it only gave us one option for tire sizes so I don't see how we could have made a mistake on entering the information for a brand new vehicle. I will not be going back to this location ever and I would advise you to stay away from their terrible customer service and lying staff as well!

This place is disgusting. The walkways and walls are crusted over with dirt. The room was gross. We stayed there because we just moved to town and didn't want to dig the mattresses out of our truck late at night. The woman at check in was miserable. Definitely wouldn't ever want anyone I know to stay here.

Took my vehicle in for a standard oil change, tire rotation and oil filter change. Received vehicle back with greasy marks all over, rims scuffed (not the lug nut, this was agreed upon) and was slapped with an extra $10 on my bill because the labor fee went up. When I inquired about why it went up I was given "prices go up, that's why". Also, it was very concerning that my dash cam was unplugged during the service. I found out when I noticed my power cable dangling from above. When I asked why this was done without contacting me I was told it was policy and for no other reason. Dubious answer at best. When it came time to pay it took about 20 minutes since my points were somehow on someone else's card. This was my 3rd and last service here. Don't go here for vehicle service or to buy a car.

Where to start. 
Just to drop my truck off over night the security guard that was working at the time took illegal picture of both my boyfriends truck and mine. We weren't doing anything wrong either, my boyfriend was parked waiting for me to finished writing my information of my truck down so I didn't need to walk back and forth from my truck to the key drop off box. He refused to delete the images and provide his number so we could make sure it was him we were complaining about, not to mention he was argumentative and very disrespectful towards my boyfriend and me.  
I originally took my truck there (got my truck there) to get the rear pax fixed and yes I agreed to a inspection and low and behold they "found" a big list of issues that never cause any issues before hand. Well the next day after I picked my truck up my check engine light turned on due to the "Cadillac converters, which they only used a computer to reset the issues." Well the next day after that the check engine light comes right back on and they are now ordering the part. I will allow them to fix that then after that I will NEVER be going back there for anything again. 
Such terrible service, before taking my truck in just needed the one thing fixed and now I am having more issues then before hand. 
Makes me feel sketchy to drive with my kids in the truck or to help my boyfriend move this weekend. 

My suggestion to other individuals is to stay away from kentwood. My boyfriend will be suggesting to his clients to not take their vehicles there because of how much the screw up, he normally brings them lots of service since he is a tow truck driver but that's not happening any more. I know he wants to see his clients get they best service possible even down to the recommendations.
This location doesn't pay attention to delivery orders at all. If you order delivery from here, expect that it will take 2+ hours to deliver if you're lucky enough to receive it at all.

Hands down I love this location. The fried fish is everything. The restaurant was very clean and they served the best sweet tea I've had in a while. The line moved pretty quick for a convention to be in town. We waited for maybe 20 minutes. All of the sides and peach cobbler was excellent.

I was really disappointed in the food. Im not a huge meat eater I only like white meat chicken. So I got a dish of green beans, cabbage and macaroni and cheese cornbread, sweet potato pie and a sweet tea. $$20 Later. Everything was sweet cabbage sweet beans. I only liked the pie. Been there done that wont do it again.

Just like any other Chipotle (point of chains) so I won't go on and on.

1. They offer sofritas. For my fellow vegetarians or alternative eating friends, try them! They're very well sauteed! Apparently they have a ton of sodium (thanks Mayur C.) so if you're sensitive, check it the deets online. 

2. During lunch time, this line is basically at the door and ridic intimidating. It goes go by VERY quickly though. Pros: goes by quickly. Cons: You better know wtf you want to order cause there is no time when you are up there to ponder between black bean or pinto.

The staff was friendly but when I scheduled my appointment they told me to expect 30-40 minutes and when I arrived I was told it would be over an hour to get it in.?  What good is making an appointment if they are just taking walk ins and putting off appointments?  Anyway, 2 hours later and they had the oil changed and tires rotated but no time to check the main issue I was there for...  I only went there bcuz I bought tires from them and they needed rotated.  I think I'll pay for the rotation at CarX from now on.  Might not even go back to buy tires.  D rating.

Worst chipotle in the city. It was the best a year ago, but the staff can't keep up with the orders. It's obviously the owner's fault because there's never enough staff. Those web orders are what's killing them. I ordered at 7 and it said the earliest it would be ready was 8. It's 8:45 and there are literally 20 people waiting for their orders. I think I'll be here for a while too. This is Chipotle. Do not come to this one.

I won't make this long since I reviewed them once before. Still great food (Mac n' cheese, spicy cabbage, fried chicken, peach cobbler, etc.) and the servers try VERY hard to please. We arrived 30 minutes early on a snowy day with 25 people to be first in line. Even though they weren't open yet, they came and invited us to sit inside. Real decent since it was cold and blustery outside! A very unique restaurant.

I hate this location. I eat enough Chipotle to know I'm getting skimped hard on the meat at this location. Whenever I have any requests, some tall blonde schmohawk has to come in and turn down my request. If it weren't that every other Chipotle provides the same exceptionally great service, setting the bar high, I would think I was being unreasonable. Instead I just cry on the inside and die a little while I bite into mostly tortilla. This place basically makes me a vegetarian but I'm probably slowly becoming anemic from iron deficiency. GIVE ME THAT MEAT BABY!!

Extra stars given because the blonde guy wasn't here today and the rest of the team (sans meat provider) were efficient and polite and wrapped one fine "steak" burrito.

Greatly disappointed in this Indy Tire location. Normally I do not take my car to a chain-type repair service, but on he recommendation of my FIL I took my '09 Subaru Forester to Indy Tire's Carmel location.
My first experience was an oil change in he spring of 2010 where he tech suggested a new air filter. I agreed and waited for the part to be delivered. After waiting an extra hour he incorrect part arrived. The manager ordered the filter for an ' 08 Forester because he noticed I purchased he car in '08 rather Han paying attention to he fact that I had indicated my vehicle was an '09 many times. On my way home from this appointment I noticed on the sticker that all weather oil had been used. Called back to Indy Tire and was told that was recommended for '08 Foresters. I explained, again, that I drive an '09 and it was throughly explained to me when I purchased the car that synthetic oil was only to be used. This fact I also pointed out before the service took place. They apologized.
Returned for another oil change where I asked, again, for synthetic oil. It was used on this visit. A new air filter was recommended, I agreed, but yet again the wrong part was ordered.
My husband and FIL insisted hat I continue to use Indy Tire because they have been going there for over 20 years and this was just the mistake of a new manager.
So, I returned for a third oil change, they got it all right this time. Guess the third time is he charm.
In July of 2011 we were preparing for a trip to Florida. Mentioned to my husband that I was going to ask about the brakes because I had been noticing some squeaking throughout the spring and summer. I had also taken note that they had never mentioned the state of my brakes on any other visit. My past experiences with service centers is that hey normally tell you that your pads are a certain %, good or bad, at every service visit.
Took the car in for an oil change and asked about the brakes. I was told they were "just fine". On my way home I noticed the incorrect oil was used again. Had no time to deal with this before leaving on our trip. 
While driving from Indiana to Florida we hit the 30,000 mile mark on the vehicle. This meant the warranty was no longer valid. We never needed to make a major claim against it, thank goodness. I say that because I had found, while researching the oil mixup, that Indy Tire had essentially voided the warranty by using he wrong type of oil. This made me very upset, but not sure what could be done about it. 
My husband did most of the driving and noticed the squeaking brakes, but said it was just dust because Indy Tire said the brakes checked out ok. (think he was brainwashed in his 20 years of going there)
When we arrived at our destination we noticed the brakes had become very noisy and he next day they were grinding. The car did stop just fine, so my husband decided to ignore the sounds and drive us all home a week later. He insisted that it was brake dust and he would take it to Indy Tire immediately upon returning home.
After a 27 hour drive we dropped our luggage at home and drove the car right to Indy Tire. I was not surprised to find out that he rear brakes were completely gone (including rotors and calipers) and the front were near 10%. My husband finally stopped defending IT at that point! The breaks were repaired and we paid the large bill which would have been much less just a week earlier if I had honestly been told about the state of our brakes. It seems as though the manager at IT cares more about making a few bucks than the safety of a family.
It is my opinion that I was not told that I needed new break pads so that I would drive the car around town until a much larger repair was needed. The manager of this Indy Tire location should thank his lucky stars that we had 10% of our front brakes left! His greed and unethical business practice could have cost a lot more than money. 
Please do not give Indy Tire, in Carmel, on AAA Way your business!

Chadmoore is a must go to store for all Formal Wears. Their customer service is top shelf. You feel like one of the family when you are there. Their experience is what really separates them from other shops. Thank you so much!!

I like the shrimp tacos here, they're pretty spicy, but they're pretty good. I've also tried their shrimp dishes and they are tasty. Their food is a bit pricy, and as most of the other reviews have noted, the wait time is pretty long. You get seated right away, but it does take a long time to get your food. The waitresses are nice, and attentive. I come in here whenever I get a shrimp taco craving and other places aren't within reach, but I do prefer other places for shrimp tacos.

While in st. Louis the other day we went to this place...the lines are long and some of the serving staff arent very nice..but the rest of the folks are very nice...and the food..well...

-fried chicken...it was crisp but not very seasoned and flavorful...I hook up better chicken

-the greens...were sweet!..ugh not savory as they should be.

-the sweet potatoes...not bad..general fare

-the cornbread...my own and jiffy is way better

-black eyed peas...standard..not flavorful

-peach cobbler...greasy and not good at all..just a sugary mess

Here's what I think...this place has gotten too big and too well known, therefore the quality of the food has paid the price..

A true taste of heaven! I went to Sweetie Pies Mangrove location with every intention of seeing what all of the hype was about. Let me be the first of many to say - it's well worth the trip, the time, and the money. 

On arrival there was already a small line of people out the door, eager to taste the many dishes Sweetie Pies has to offer.
On entry I was greeted by a couple of familiar faces I had seen on the restaurant based TV show. As I made my way to the food service area, another round of salutations and greetings roared from the service line followed by huge smiles and genuine hospitality.

Food service is done cafeteria style. You grab a tray, push it down the line, and each station has a server that plates various parts of your meal (meats, sides, desserts). If you are a lady, southern hospitality is taken one step further and a dining room attendant grabs your tray, places your food at a table, and gets your beverage while you pay. You are then shown to your table to enjoy your meal. Sorry guys, tray service is for the Ladies only!

The food was fresh and delicious. I had the fried chicken wings which were cooked to perfection. They were crispy, hot, and not greasy at all! The sides were also very delicious - I had the sweet potatoes, and the macaroni and cheese. Both sides were perfectly seasoned, and cooked. The sweet potatoes were tender, buttery and sweet just like you'd hope. The macaroni and cheese could have been hotter temperature wise, but was still delicious. Top that off with the most amazing cornbread, and you've got one of the best soul food meals this side of the Atlantic.

An added bonus was that they had live music playing in the restaurant - a great jazz singer along with a pianist. 

Thanks Sweetie Pies crew, and staff for such a wonderful experience! I highly recommend this place!
Excellent work and service at a reasonable price I take all of our family cars there for tires and most service needs.

I had a relatively good experience at kentwood Ford. I saw the vehicle I wanted online and it basically sold itself to me. Dil was the salesman, not pushy at all. I took one star off for the truck not being detailed enough (there were dirt smudges all over)and one star for the fact the manager drove this truck as a demo and did not take enough off the price tag considering that fact (most likely was his dirt)and I think a better deal could've been given to me for being a #ymmfire victim. However loui in finance was nice and I'm enjoying my truck. I would suggest they get away from their inhouse Go Card and give cash. In hindsight I should've pushed them to throw in a Bed liner or tonneau. My only other complaint was it seemed to take an eternity for the paperwork. For a $500 dollar go card I'd tell each and everyone of you to buy at kentwood Ford.

Please don't review this business if you received a freebie for writing this review, or if you're connected in any way to the owner or

Its not my first time using INDY TIRE in Carmel, either its for alignment or tire patch up. Love the place, wonderful customer service and fast reliable service. Its hard to find dependable auto repair shop these days, but Indy Tire in Carmel is one of them. Good prices and defiantly deserve 5 star service. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Definately not the same experience as in Incline. Although the food was good this place is extremely run down. It needs a remodel. It does have a nice patio area though. 
Our service was fine but they began vacuuming while we were eating grrr!!  It was only 6:45 and they were getting ready to close. 
My margarita was terrible, however, the homemade tortilla was great!!

Knowing I would need a couple of tires, I was given the news that I needed all four tires replaced on my Buick Encore. My sadness quickly turned to a pleasant surprise for the price I was quoted was what I had thought I would spend on just two tires - not four (shhh, don't tell them that)! Good Prices, Excellent Service, Pleasant and Honest folks to deal with. Would return if I was staying in the area, however, Oregon does not have any Best-One of Indy :(   Keep up the good work and may your business grow and prosper!! From one completed satisfied senior-type lady!!

This is a review of the Lindbergh location.  I haven't had Sweetie Pie's since the West Florrisant location closed. (Will that location ever reopen?) So I'm driving down Lindbergh and low and behold there's a Sweetie Pie's restaurant. So I whip into the parking lot and go inside. There was no waiting I had just missed the lunch rush.  I ordered the 3pc fried chicken, breast, wing and thigh and mac and cheese to go. I could hardly wait to get home so I could tear into that mac and cheese.  I think they have changed their breading on the chicken because this was rather spicy. I just couldn't eat it. I was very disappointed in the mac and cheese. The noodles were WAY over cooked. The dish was very mushy. I couldn't tell where the noodle stopped and the cheese started.  Maybe if I go to the one where Ms. Robbie actually has her office the quality maybe better.  I was thinking about order some mac and cheese for Turkey day, but now...I don't think so.

My all time favorite music store. I've been shopping and hanging out here since 1991. In every incarnation of the shop it has been the heart of the West Chester PA music scene. Great vintage stuff, killer new stuff, all great prices. I can't say enough about this spot!

Just want to say these guys are awesome! Came to Santa Barbara from LA for a couple of days. had a blow out my first ride here coming down Gibraltar which destroyed my rear wheel. After checking out a couple of other shops I ended up here, glad I did. They set me up with some wheels and tires cheaper than I would have got in LA. These guys are great easy to talk to and listen which is rare in bike shops. I definitely recommend them!

Nice place, great rooms, good parking. I would stay here again when I come back. Only about 4 blocks from Bourbon Street. The free breakfast was "ok" but it's free! The beds are nice and the sheets were very comfortable too.

Seems like a pretty standard facility. Ample parking, a large waiting area, well organized area for giving blood and good clean restrooms for urine samples and other tests. 

I've only been here once but I didn't have to wait long and got to see a phlobotomist quickly. This is where things become a bit odd: she was unable to see any veins on my arm (which is odd to me as I've never had trouble with that), so instead she took the blood samples from the back of my hand which was very painful and bruised a bit. But still the appointment went well and if I'm in the area for bloodwork etc. I'd still likely return. Not my preferred location but it works.

Dave and Luke are amazing.  Best and most knowledgeable service I've ever received.  Same praise for their product knowledge.  I'm constantly amazed at the lengths they'll go to meet the needs/expectations of their customers.

Clean facility, friendly staff and short wait times make this lab worth the extra drive compared to other locations. 

Make an appointment if time permits (especially if fasting is required) or otherwise bring a book. 

Also be sure to have your requisition form, AB Health Card and ID.

Super close. Has what we need. But also stinks like bad potatoes! And is fruit fly paradise.. We shop here only when we need last minute things or do Not want to drive over to Winn-Dixie! There is one lady that works at this location heavy set, with a knot type hairstyle on top . Seems has worked here some time. Bi polar!!!! Some days she is laughing and having a good time with her fellow workers and customers.. But God forbid she be working a Holiday or late in the evening or early in the morning she is evil and will tell you alllll about how she deserved to be off or how tired she is.. It is a little on the awkward side to say the least.. Just overall bad attitude..

Literally the best place in Pinellas County to get your nails done I've been going here for four years and they always take care of me Kim is amazing, but I've had other girls doing my nails and they are also just as good! It is very clean and nice inside and you feel as if they take care of you no matter what you need. I recommend this place to many people and every single one has been satisfied

It is an affordable, quaint, boutique hotel with more room amenities than other guest houses. The two pools and dog run make this one a top spot!  FYI...the streetcar construction on Rampart was the only negative.

Save-a-Lot is our staple for poor week shopping. always has most everything on hand, but it's touch and go. I like it because it's small and not overwhelming or crowded like Wal-Mart. Be sure to bring your own bags, or snag an empty box off the shelf to pack the groceries in. Come on in, save some dough and get some grub.
Class act. Cashier was pleasant, food was delicious, and the establishment was very modern and clean!

I went to this place due to a referral (I simply asked if her shellac stayed on and if they got the shellac on her skin or not) She said yes it stayed on a few weeks. I went and the woman who did my nails acted as if I was causing her to stay late/not friendly. She did not prime my nails therefore the shellac did not stay on for more than 2 days. Each nail began peeling at that point. I called and spoke to the manager who told me to come in and she would fix them. When I sat down in the chair she literally began picking the remaining shellac of my nails with her fingers. She peeled one (which peel my actual nail) causing me to flinch and pull my hand back. I asked her "Is this how you normally remove shellac?" Her response was, "Well you said they were peeling off." I am a licensed esthetician and have done shellac previously on clients. I know how to do it and I know how to remove it but I'm not skilled enough to paint my own nails hence me going to have them done here. I was blown away that people were in there and that they somehow stay open. My friend now knows not to refer people here and she's now going to a new place as well.

If you've never been to a real music store.  One that you will actually meet and interact with the owner, a place that encourages you to stop by to learn about the products they sell, has stuff for sale that you'll be hard pressed to find elsewhere, and a great staff to boot... you have found it.

I've been a customer of West Chester Music Store for about five years now.  I've seen the store go through an owner change, and it is better than ever.  I've purchased two guitars, two amps and a gaggle of other items here.

Great selection, prices, service and a staff that will remember your name and help you make a personalized choice.
Best customer service! And they were able to handle a large order and got everything right.

The waiting area is large, however the area to talk with staff is small and I had to literally wade through chairs and waiting clients to get to them. The interior is extremely clean and employees are friendly enough, albeit their demeanor and attitude make it appear that they all wish they were somewhere else. Parking is abundant.

I had my blood drawn which was quick; I was in and out within 10 minutes which was nice as most times I've gone to other locations for blood work, I'd have to wait a good half hour after my scheduled appointment.
Waited 10+ minutes after we ordered in the DRIVE THRU! 3 other people in line left in that timeframe. Ridiculous.

Three stars at best, only because my pedicure was average. This is my second time back at Sunshine nails because I thought my first experience was just a bad day for them. I was wrong. I sat in the pedicure chair for almost 15 minutes with nothing, not hot water to soak my feet in or a greeting. I got up to walk out and the owner walked up to me to say she will have two people do my pedicure and full set at the same time. All of it was rushed. Do NOT see Tracy, she's snappy and never does a good service. I have had her both times now. She treats me like I'm an idiot every time I come in no matter how I tell her how I want my nails done. She rushes and never meets expectations and when you ask for something other than regular color she gets nasty. Every time my nails are crooked and there are parts of my nail left unpainted. This time parts of my glitter polish were transferred to all of my other nails because she was too lazy to wait for my glitter to dry. When I ask her to fix my acrylics and make them straight or not as thick she proceeds to tell me that it's my nails that "do like that." VERY dissatisfied with this nail salon. I am disrespected every time I go in, meanwhile I look young but I work in the service industry so I know how it should be. They have great prices which is why I thought I'd give them another chance but I will NEVER be back.

HIGHLY recommend Dr. Harvey. My family and I have taken multiple dogs there for almost 20 years. Dr. Harvey (Doc) cares so much about every animal, never wastes your money, and is very educated. The staff is also amazing & always so sweet.

We originally booked a "mystery" Groupon for a hotel. When we found out it was a chain hotel by the convention center I was like nah... I wanted something with more of a Nola vibe. That is exactly what we found at The New Orleans Courtyard!!! I loved it! It was exactly what we were looking for. And being a couple blocks away from bourbon you are able to relax in peace without all of the craziness. The courtyard was adorable. I liked that the rooms had old hardwood floors and we had a four post bed. They were small but who cares they were cute. The staff was super friendly and helpful. There is a complimentary breakfast with waffles, bagels, pastries and cheeses. This is were we will be staying every time we come down! Loved everything about this hotel.

Meh. I'd say keep on looking if you've not decided on a place yet. 

The location is great and it's an easy walk into the French quarter. The hotel, as many hotels are in Nola, is old. 

Our room was tiny - which was fine with us. The mattress was so old and hard that we struggled to sleep each night. The springs had no more give or something - it was pretty bad. 

The bathroom had an overall dingy look and feel to it. 

The pool area was nice for hanging out but man, everyone smokes down there by the pool making it unbearable for a non-smoker to enjoy the area. The rooms didn't smell like smoke thankfully!

I know all of the bike shops in Santa Barbara and Goleta, but the only place I go for my road bikes is Fastrack.  Dave and Luke not only know their trade, but are real problemsolvers on my side in providing fast, cost-effective service.  I'm always surprised by the reasonableness of their service charges.  Best of all, rather than follow the custom of other shops to queue bikes for service and keeping my bike in the shop, Dave and Luke try their best to turn the bike around while I wait if at all possible.  If I could give more stars I would.

We stayed here on a recent trip to NOLA and while it is true the walls are REALLY thin, it's still a clean, cute hotel. It's not like it's loud 24/7, I found that at night it was relatively quiet...but anyway, I liked that I was within blocks of the French Quarter, because I did not feel like driving around in an unfamiliar town. I also liked that there was private parking...and while there is a fee, it's worth it. Would stay here again!!

Bought the living social deal to have my bike cleaned and tuned up. I procrastinated but Dave took it on the last day, and cleaned her up super nice. I came in to pick it up and ge remembered me and which bike was mine right off the bat. I know where I'll be bringing my bike from now on!

I absolutely love this place! I always take my bike there for tune ups and whenever I need to purchase bike gear. The guys that work there are really friendly and they always take care of my bike quickly and I ride away happy. Great place with great people!

Wow a 3 hour wait for a walk-in, make an appointment they say.  I went on line to make an appointment at any of the 4 locations around my house/work.  I was looking for a morning appointment .... not for 4 weeks!  As I have to take time off work waiting 3 hours is not feasible.  As there are no other options for blood work I made an appointment in 2 weeks for a lunch time appointment so that I did not lose wages.  Guess my Dr will have to wait for the results to determine if medication is required.  There really needs to be more technicians or clinics to get blood work done.
I ended up with giant bike, but the service I received in fastrak is definitely the best in town.  Luke was very nice and helpful..  If I need a trek I would buy it from them.

Beautiful hotel, the building was built in 1876, the rooms overlook the courtyard, with a nice size swimming pool. Very friendly staff, Michael took care of us and got us in our room early. We had just come off a cruise ship. Free Continental breakfast in the mornings. A nice walk to Bourbon Street, but far enough away where you don't have all the noise. Very clean and comfortable.

This isn't your typical McDonald's. Whoever manages this one hires only excellent people, day shift and even overnight. The only thing I eat there is Egg McMuffin and always substitute real bacon which makes it ten times better. They NEVER burn the muffin, unlike one down the road which I will not name out of the kindness of my heart. Their Diet Coke is the only reason I get out of bed.

We stayed for five days and four nights. The location was great we were able to walk everywhere and not worry about parking. The waffles for breakfast were really good. The night before checking out we saw a cockroach by the toliet. We were grossed out but thought it was just an isolated incident. Come the next morning as we are getting ready to leave, there was another big cockroach on the wall by our luggage. I took a picture and showed Jack the front desk attendent while checking out. His idea on how to remedy the situation was to say "we pour stuff down the sinks to try and kill them but they are difficult to manage." He didnt offer a discount or any compensation. He seemed the least bit concerned with it. Jack seemed to accept that he works at roach infested hotel. We paid over $600 for our stay which we paid in full. As customers, we cant say "we want to pay the amount in full but it is too difficult to manage, so here's the best we got." The same should be expected of them. Cockroaches could have gotten into our luggage so now we need to disinfect everything we took with us--no thanks to the hotel or Jack.

These guys are awesome! They brought my bike back from the dead and never were anything but professional. Definitely a life customer after getting exactly what I need for a really affordable price! Don't go anywhere else in sb
My boyfriend ordered flowers for me from Seattle to be delivered to my room at the Hilton Riverside/New Orleans. They were absolutely beautiful!

Walking in to the salon this morning I thought I was in the wrong place... over 4th of July weekend the salon was completely updated. Everything was new, new new!

Shiny, colorful bottles of Opi nail polish were displayed in a beautiful shelf like a work of abstract art. New beautiful massage chairs beckoned to me to sink into their glorious leather softness.. new nail stations with comfortable chairs lined the right side with a large flat screen TV above. Beautiful wood plank floors inviting you to stroll deeper into the salon to be pampered. 

The service at this salon has always been excellent, the interior update makes this salon a 5 star in my book! Lookingforward to my next visit soon!

Crepes can often take a bad turn... at The Crepist you won't be disappointed. This is Based off many visits and variations. Creative ingredients and super friendly service every time. I really like the simple packaging too.

CarrieLu is consistently parked outside of Bibo coffee on Record street Weds- Friday. She has a small menu of sweet and savory crepes (think Brie and honey, chicken and garlic) , but it's worth asking if she has anything special. Sometimes she has a breakfast burrito that is absolutely delicious, or fresh fruit to add to any crepe. I love having another lunch option on south campus!

Barbara's florist was very easy to work with. Her flowers were beautiful and delivered on time. I was spending the weekend in NOLA from out of town and she took exactly what I requested for my girlfriend... my girlfriend luv them... if you want Flowers in the NOLA area choose Barbara for cost effective and a beautiful arrangement.

I took my bike here to get the front and rear derailleur set up. A full tune up is quoted as $100 but I was only charged $30 because there wasn't anything else really wrong with my bike besides a couple bolts that needed tightening. That was definitely a pleasant surprise. 

I worked with Dave when I took my bike here and he was all smiles and super friendly. You can tell he has a passion for his work. He's very knowledgable and answered every question I threw at him. 

If you need something worked on your bike, I'd highly recommend this shop. It took less than 24 hours to fix, they were open on Memorial Day (what????), service was super friendly, and I was charged a very reasonable price.

Based on the pictures on the website and around the store, Dave is clearly proud to be associated with Lance Armstrong.  Once the customer gets over that, Fastrack is a decent shop for both enthusiasts and beginners alike.  

The store is extremely unorganized, but they seemed to know where everything was.  I was impressed by the fact that in terms of help with bike fit, they treated their $300 bike buying customers the same as their $1500 bike buying customers.  I was less impressed that one of their sales associates tried to sell me an aluminum Trek without even asking what kind of riding I do.

They have limited inventory based on their size, but they appear more than willing to order anything you want and have it shipped to the store in a matter of days.

The mechanics' bike knowledge seemed respectable.  They were friendly and courteous, but seemed to ignore a man standing at the back of the store for some reason (maybe they knew him?).

Love, Love, Love! The staff is super friendly (especially Betty) and also very knowledgeable. I loved the size of the room as well as the balcony with little tables. The pool is very clean and had a few little fountains. Access to the action in the French Quarter is quick as well. There is also great coffee and breakfast is included. If you're looking for super fancy with mints on pillows and turn down service, this is not the place for you but if you're looking for an otherwise clean, relaxing stay with friendly people then this is your place.

Great place to workout--lots of squat racks :) it can be a bit busy from 5-7pm, which can be frustrating, but it's because a lot of people like to workout here. You also get PT sessions and nurse screenings with your membership, which is a huge plus. Take full advantage of these opportunities, as these resources normally cost a chunk of change.

Ordered flowers for my wife's birthday.  I don't know much about flowers, so I put myself in their hands on what to get.  They just asked me about what I wanted to spend and they made it happen.  The bouquet was beautiful and my wife loved it!  Highly recommend!

Place is nice but managed poorly. First month was a disaster and clearly was not ready to open. Missing many amenities commonly found in similar places (e.g. Springfield Healthplex) although it is much cheaper. Signed up for swimming in lap pool but it is often taken up by aqua aerobics despite the fact that they have a therapy pool that they don't use. Hope it gets better.

We just got back from a quick vacation in New Orleans and I thought I would write a review about our stay at the New Orleans Courtyard Hotel. I was a little worried about the location, since I grew up in NOLA, but this area has come a long way and it was very safe. It was an easy walk to all the great spots the city has to offer so the location was very nice. The secure parking with in and out privileges was a huge plus to us since we drove this year. That is one of the first things I look for because the parking situation in the French Quarter is brutal. The hotel itself was a beautiful historic building that was clean and had a beautiful courtyard area with a pool. The continental breakfast was nothing fancy but a nice touch with fresh fruit, waffles, coffee and pastries. On the down side the beds were a little too firm for my taste but not a deal breaker. The price was great and the parking fee was very fair. We would stay here again!

I liked this place. The bed is a bit tall, but I'm 6'2". It may be hard for some to get into and out of. 

There is no elevator, so you must bring your luggage up a long stair case. I had overweight luggage so this was a little rough, but my fault.

It's in Treme, so some feel it's dangerous. I didn't know it was in Treme, until I checked in. It is close to the 1/4. I wouldn't go exploring after dark. But that's every city. 

I'll probably be back.

I had a fantastic pedicure here and I will be back. Clean setting. Relaxing pedicure I like that they have different pedicure options for your needs or goals of relaxation. Lots of colors to choose from and they listened to me when I was specific on my design. I am surprised to read the negative reviews I have an appointment Saturday so if for some reason the experience changes I will update.

The nice guy here (didn't catch his name) took the time to discuss the virtues of a few different chain lubes. When I asked about comfort saddles, he told me to break-in the seat on my new bike before throwing money on a new one. An honest salesman: that to me is a sign of a business that deserves my business. Although I only bought chain lube, I would recommend anyone to check this place out for their fine selection of bikes, especially the sweet Treks that I saw. And, of course, if you're buying a new ride you'll be getting top-notch knowledgeable and friendly service.

Despite my bad experience on the 1st visit I decided to give it a 2nd chance and I went back for a pedicure. It was a better experience this time. She spent a fairly good amount of time making sure it looked good and did not injure me with the clippers or nail buffer like what happened last time I went. I walked out satisfied with the experience but it still won't be #1 choice in the future.
The people at the drive thru were rude to my 86 year old grandmother. And she comes there every single day!! They are always rude on a daily basis.

Dave and Luke are true professionals. On the bike and in the store. They were so welcoming and charming. I came in to buy a Garmin Edge 520 and Dave was nice enough to set it up for me and school me on the sweet features. Bike shops are usually very intimidating to me. The people who tend to work at shops are dry and unimpressed. Dave's enthusiasm was so refreshing and totally inspired me to become a better cyclist. I will be spending all my money here.

Hands down the best bike shop in town, and it's not even close.

Great shop, employees, service, everything. They're very respectful, genuinely happy to help you, and a pleasure to share stories with. Dave is a former racer and Tour de France mechanic (Armstrong's), and prides himself on his shop having the best road bike selection in town.

He also does a bit of XC mtb riding, and they carry some of my favorite lines there. I guess it should say something that I only ride mountain, and that I try to only shop at Fastrack.
Dave and Luke really went above and beyond to help me with a broken Sidi. It was a small repair but they were resourceful and helped quickly, my next bike will come from Fastrack

The price was right $8 for a manicure is a deal in Florida but she cut my nails with the cuticle remover !!!!! And then didn't make sure they were filed smooth....how does a salon owner allow that ?? I don't know but the place was busy so I'm sure I just got a bad technician. She had an attitude and was not friendly. The drying station was sticky  and dirty.  air pressure on the drying fan wasn't strong enough. They didn't care when I told them , then as I walked out I had someone who didn't do my nails ask me if I paid???  Really??

Friendly and fun to work with folks at Fastrack. As their name implies they are fast and efficient. I had my back tuned up and then my back tire mysteriously went flat again and they fixed me back up in jiffy. :)

This is the best vet we've gone to, no question. Staff is helpful, knowledgeable, and always accommodating. Their easy-going demeanor allows them handle our two high-strung dogs with ease and patience. Other vets have used restraints and medications on our dogs for check-ups and vaccinations; we've had no problems like that here. We also go here for boarding and neither dog is nervous at arrival or pickup. The kennel is area it clean and spacious and the dogs are happy after their overnight stays. Can't say enough good about Animal Hospital of Tampa!
I joined with my friend 4 months ago and I love it. The classes are amazing and the group fitness trainers are the best! Love Ericka and Sarah C.!

Stayed 3 nights and it was perfect for me. Just needed a quiet, safe, comfy, affordable place to sleep and that's exactly what I got - once I figured out how to turn off the noisy, chilly air conditioner (I prefer the ceiling fan). My small room was on the third floor and the desk clerk brought my suitcase up and down since there's no elevator. Continental breakfast was more than that, with fresh fruit, DIY waffle machine, and many kinds of breads including yummy biscuits. Excellent service, beautiful decor and surroundings. French Quarter starts across the street; I walked the entire district in a couple of hours. I only wish I had time to use the pool. I hiighly recommend it.

I moved to this area 4 1/2 years ago and started using this vet for convenience.  At first it was just shots and basics for my 3 pets.
My dog hates anyone including me to touch her paws! She is super well behaved and listens and responds to commands wonderfully,  but ever since she was a pup no one could touch her paws.
I have always had big dogs, German Sheppard and I have been to many vets that want to sedate them to trim their nails or clean their ears...NO WAY!!! Here I have found a compassionate vet and staff that treat all of my animals individually according to their personality and with care and compassion. 
My dog knows what is coming and her nails will be clipped when she goes to the vet. She hates it and squirmes her 86 pounds all over, but with no pain or sedation her nails get clipped.
This is a clean facility with a truly caring staff. My pets are very important to me and so is the doctor and facility that I entrust with their care. No problems, no worries at this facility. 
What's a girl to do? My pets are precious and deserve great treatment and respect.

Dave and Aaron are simply the best.  I have been shopping at West Chester Music for years, and I can honestly say that after the closing of Medley Music in Bryn Mawr a few years back, there is LITERALLY...no better music in Philadelphia region, period.  They carry incredible equipment lines, and they know their stuff.

These guys are just great.  Yes, Luke is good at sales.  Why?  Because he is passionate about bikes, has good depth of practical experience, and excellent intuition.  The out of town guy ragging about his experience must be a real case.  I don't know him, but I know Dave and Luke.

My families first contact with them was through my wife, who was looking for a gift for me.  She is a spender, but what I got was a pair of bike socks.  Must be a lot of pressure around there!  Plus, she is very sensitive to bull and she loved Dave.

Dave helped me get the bike of my dreams when I was ready for a road bike.  It was special order and he gave me great service.  They really take care of me.  Dave is a direct guy.  You can sense his integrity and good will.  He has awesome cred:  who do you think knows more?  A guy from the pro circuit, or some clown with an antique bike?

And speaking of antique bikes, I have one, an early '80s Stumpjumper.  It is rusting away but I still use it for knock around.  They told me flat out:  save your dough, there is no cure for it.  I know that they are right, instead of charging me to tune it for $100+, they just help keep it alive for peanuts.

One last thing, when I need shorts, Luke "up-sells" me to singlets.  For a very few extra bucks, I get a more comfortable ride.  To me that's what good service is about, making cogent recommendations.

Ran across this mobile crepe artisan at the 2016 Gateway Gala.  The service was excellent,  she even took credit card payment making it easy to get a savory late night treat.  The quality of the food was well worth the $9.00 price tag for a huge filled crepe that turned into two meals.  I can't wait until I get another chance to get this treat!

Knowledgeable and friendly people. Good products. I had a good experience buying a Trek Domane. Dave took the time to make sure the bike was set up right. Made spending $2K less painful. I'll be back.

We made a reservation and were promised free parking. When we arrived we were advised that nobody gets free parking. I would have let it go but the daytime desk clerks were very rude and condescending about the issue. We were charged an additional $100 for a deposit for "Incidentals", we have yet to see a credit card refund. The other staff members were polite and seemed to care about the guests. The hotel is defiantly starting to show its age due to a overworked and limited support staff. The TV signal was weak and the picture was quite fuzzy at times. The amenities in the room were limited to an alarm clock, a non-functional wall safe, small ironing board and a plug-in iron. The hotel isn't a bad place to stay but I would defiantly suggest looking elsewhere before making a reservation. I've also made a review on Facebook and a couple other sights.

I bought my first carbon road bike from these cats 5+ years ago for a fantastic price (discounted demo bike). They've serviced the bike regularly and it still feels like it's in near new condition.

Both gents are kind, helpful, and very knowledgeable. All the accessories I've bought here have been top notch (gloves, glasses, tape, tubes, etc) and the prices are super reasonable.

Definitely check them out if you're looking to get a new bike or bike related doodad. I'm happy I did on a friend's recommendation.

If you care about a quality selection of both premium instruments,amps an effects both new and used AND a knowledgeable and friendly NO-PRESSURE sales staff - look no further . They also have an excellent pallet for all genres of music and the gear in stock vintage or new . I've not had better experiences anywhere I've shopped in the past 30 years of playing guitar and I keep going back ! Support your local business, shop here!!!

I went in the first time and a man did my nails, which was, of course, fine. The problem was, all of the other ladies were sitting around on their phones. Whenever a new customer came in or they got a phone call, they stayed put while the man working on me kept having to get up to help or answer calls. 3 stars just because he did a good job on my nails.

Short version: 

If you are in the market for a new bicycle just go to Fastrack and you'll be happy you did.

The long story:

A friend of mine recently got a road bike and after a couple months of thinking about it, I decided I needed one for myself.  Now, I am the kind of person who spends maybe an excessive amount of time researching and deliberating over any sort of big purchase like a bicycle.  I researched every brand and style of road bike.  I visited many shops, rode bike after bike, I read every bicycle website and blog, watched a bunch of youtube reviews, etc... This is all to say that given how much time I spent learning about the bikes and knowing that I had so many bike shops in Goleta/Santa Barbara to choose from, I had high expectations. 

Fastrack was actually the last shop I visited in my bicycle search and I have to admit that, at first, I was kind of apprehensive about the place.  It was smaller than any other shop I had visited and seemed to be stocked with very expensive bikes out of my price range.  That being said, in addition to the more exotic makes, I knew they also sold Trek which was the brand I was leaning towards after my research process.  Once I began talking with Dave Lettieri (the proprietor of the shop) I realized I was in the right place.

[Side note: you know when you meet someone and somehow in the first 60 seconds you get the impression that that person is really good at what they do?  Well that person's name is Dave Lettieri.]

Right off the bat, Dave resolved a concern I had about which frame size was right for me.  He picked out a bike, fixed it to this trainer contraption thing and adjusted it and right away determined the right fit for me.  No other shop I had visited went to the trouble to do that for me.

After discussing my budget and letting me know about a stellar deal available to Santa Barbara Axxess Card members, Dave gave me some quotes and soon afterwards I ordered a Trek Madone.  

Less than a week later, I came in to get the bike and buy my accessories.  My friend had warned me that accessory purchases can easily add up to more than one might expect.  So before going back, I made a list of things to get thinking I wouldn't go "off list" and buy anything that wasn't crucial to getting me on the road.  When I got to the shop, I was greeted by Luke, Dave's right hand man / cohort.  [Side note: Luke is very helpful / professional but also very funny... he dispenses bicycle wisdom and insight with a lambent wit.]  Luke advised me against some of the accessories on my list and, in doing so, saved me time and money.  

The best part of the "Fastrack experience" is the service.  With this shop, you don't feel like  livestock being herded through a system designed to extract money from your bank account.  Rather, every question or concern and every little mechanical issue I've had was dealt with swiftly, courteously and professionally.  They even got my bicycle back in working order after I, ahem... "gently crashed it" after having it for less than a week.  No charge, no fee... just a simple request that I not crash it again.  :)

If this review isn't an indication then let me explicitly convey to you that: I am a huge fan of Fastrack/Dave/Luke.  After my experiences at Fastrack, I would self-identify as a "pathologically loyal customer" and ALL of my future bicycle purchases will be made there.  I don't even live in Santa Barbara and there are at least 5 other bike shops between where I live in Goleta and Fastrack. What does that tell you?

In fact, the only negative thing that comes to mind regarding this business is that parking can be a real "female dog" at this location (canon perdido between de la vina and chapala).  Of course, this is a very small thing that shouldn't dissuade you from letting the folks at Fastrack help you find the perfect bike!  What are you waiting for?!

If I could give it zero stars I would. I went in as a new customer thinking I'll try a full face thread considering I just moved here from out of state and haven't found anyone near me that threads. I walk in and they take me right away EXCEPT for the fact this lady Kim - was sitting in a pedi chair playing on her phone and her with her toes barefoot. I didn't know this lady was going to do my thread. She just said follow me and sat me in a chair infront of the whole salon. This should be a pretty private thing I mean I've never had a wax or face thread infront of an entire salon. So anyway, she sat me down without washing her hands she started going full throttle on my face and grabbing my head hair with the thread. I kept holding my hair back and once she got sick of me moving she tried throwing a child's head band on me. Ummm GROSS no!!!! How many people have used that head band? Finally I told her it would be easier if she had me lay down instead of sit up and she started arguing with me over it. So I kept my mouth shut. She stopped 5 min later and got up and walked to the back like should I follow you miss personality or what? Finally she ended up finishing me in a dirty bed with a dirty couch pillow (super sanitary). SO gross. Never ever ever ever going back again.

I came here because a friend said they do good work on her pedicures, but good god this place is DIRTY. There wasn't even the illusion that anything in there had been recently sanitized. 

I had my legs, underarms, and eyebrows waxed. After 45 minutes, half of the hair on my legs was still there and my underarms were bleeding. The only reason I gave 2 stars instead of 1 is that my eyebrows look great. At $48, it was inexpensive, but I'd rather pay more and not have to shave my legs immediately after a wax.
These guys are great. Got my girlfriends old bike that had been sitting outside put back together. They gave us a great deal, and were really friendly. Thanks!!
The young man that works there occasionally is wonderful. Just had him give me a pedi and he was the best.

Let me start with I booked this through Expedia. A few days after I paid I check my credit card activity and saw that I had been charged twice for the room and had to dispute the second charge with the credit card company. Upon arrival the staff was very friendly and helpful. Now for my room, imagine the smallest child's bedroom in your house and that was the size of my room. The bathroom sink is exactly that a sink with no vanity to put your toiletries. Just so your aware, there is no refrigerator or room safe. To store your valuables   The ceiling fan wobbled all night long. The AC was good and cold but sounded like a jet engine when it kicked on.
