As for trying to sleep, I might as well have left the room door wide open because I literally heard every car that passed by, the dog barking in the neighborhood and some people walking down the street talking loudly. The breakfast buffet consisted of "you make your own waffles" some fruits, cheeses and breads.  I booked this thinking it would be a good deal, close to everything, continental breakfast included but I really wish I had spent the extra money and stayed at a brand name hotel.

The owner seems like a nice guy, helpful and knowledgeable. I bought a brand new bike, kits, accessories and referred them to friends and coworkers who also bought new $$ bikes.

Now, I don't expect a red carpet when I get in but the last few times I've been there for a repair I couldn't believe the attitude I was getting from the mechanic. It seemed like he was doing me a favor to fine tune my bike. ($110 favor btw)

I understand they make more profit selling fancy Pinarellos as opposed to troubleshooting or supporting a customer seeking for advice.
I'd gladly fix the bike myself but I'm not able to. That's why I pay a professional to do that, and from him I'd expect a professional treatment, not the attitude.
One a side note, I would also expect a clean and organized shop but this piace is far from it. Can't believe they can find they're tools in there.

I love to shop local and I gave this place more than one shot. Fortunately they're not the only place in town so I'll bring my business elsewhere.

Good luck to you guys.

This place is terrible! First, the lady soaked me with the jacuzzi thing. Of course she just laughed the whole time, because she didn't know what to say. Then, she put this mint stuff on my legs, which i usually like with a warn towel. The towel this lady put on my legs was SCALDING! I have a blister on the top of my foot. Lastly, I had my phone in between my legs all safe and sound, until she almost knocked me over and my phone fell into the water. Needless to say, its still broken. She didn't offer to replace my phone, and still charged me full price for the pedicure, which is mediocre at best. I came in, waited 10 minutes, let my paint dry, and I was out in under 30 minutes. Not the best place to go!

I have been going to the fitness center here for about 4 months. It's the best gym I have ever held a membership to! It's constantly being clean and everything is new. They have basically any machine you could think of. Getting to work with a personal trainer once a quarter, which is part of your membership, has been really helpful and I learned a lot in just my 2 sessions. They also have a sauna and steam room in each of the locker rooms that I love to take advantage of after a good workout.

It was busy, and I get that. However once we were ordering, we had two different people take our order and we were asked three times "what can I get for you today" (or whatever their script is), point being, it wasn't an issue in hearing.  

Once they finally did get our four item order in, of course it's a wait to the window, because it's busy. Finally get to the window to THEN be told it's a 12 minute wait. Normally waiting is fine. But it was the in consideration of not communicating that earlier. 

I will give them another chance, but this time was showing how little they care for their customers.

I have been a customer at Fastrack since it opened and Dave ran it himself seven days a week. I have watched this shop grow, but not overgrow. Years back, Dave added Luke to the team, a perfect addition. Those two are like brothers who can communicate on a whole different level.

The bottom line with this shop is that they really care about getting people set up on the right bike and/or equipment. You go to a bike shop to get expert advice, and these guys are experts. They are great at laying out the best options one has when choosing a bike or equipment and letting the customer decide. Fastrack has a very good inventory compared to the other Santa Barbara shops, and they can get most anything you need in a day or two from multiple vendors.

I have to laugh at the bitter guy that mocked the fact that Dave was Lance's mechanic. Hello fool.... Lance Armstrong asked Dave to come over to the Tour de France to be his personal mechanic despite the fact that his team has a staff of guys to work on bikes. Is there a better endorsement than that? Also, every pro racer that comes through town stops into Fastrack. I was in there today and saw that Liquigas ProTour rider Ted King had shipped his bike ahead to Dave to assemble ahead of a training block here in SB.

The prices at Fastrack are competitive with online vendors AND you get the greatest service. Almost all tunes and repairs are done on the spot or same day. Try to find that anywhere else in SB. Unless you are a good mechanic yourself, it is crucial to get good service on your machine. After purchasing bikes at Fastrack, they did follow-up adjustments and tuning free of charge. I couldn't be happier!

This is the place to go for riders of all levels.

This place doesn't look that stellar. It's old and outdated on the outside and inside, but don't let that fool you! The staff is awesome. I worked with two doctors to help my dog with a bacterial infection and both were incredibly professional and knowledgeable. They seemed to really care about my dog and made a few recommendations for general health aside from the bacterial infection. There was a little bit of wait, but it was still a pleasant experience, and I'll be going back.

Talked to Barbara. I wasn't sure what type of flowers or arrangement I wanted but Barbara asked me a few questions. Trusting Barbara's choice of flowers and unseen by me until I was texted a picture of the flower bouquet along with a wonderful thank you from my girlfriend. Delivery was within a few hours and the entire experience was perfect. Thank you.

Yeah these guys will bust your chops and tell you that you're riding an old bucket around. If you can't handle friendly banter, then go somewhere else ya pansy!

I finally purchased a new road bike from these guys, after getting my old bucket fixed many times. I went to every bike store around  SB and asked a million questions, and milled over it for months. These guys answered my questions every time, and let me test ride like 5 different bikes. Dave was extremely helpful and honest with my build. I actually spent a bit less than i planned to based on Dave's advice. (I mean, not that much less.. my bank account is on fire at this point but whatever)

I travel regularly for work and see a variety of nail salons across the country. This was the most hospitable location I've ever been to, they have great prices, and great work. Caitlyn is a wonderful
Manager that runs the shop!

Probably one of the dirtiest nail salons I've been in. Saw no tools get sanitized what so ever and was charged 37$ for a fill, granted it was gel but 37$ before tip....didn't match prices on the website and to top it off my lady was beyond rude and snappy EVEN after i expressed I was new to the area and it was my first time there. Never going back.

I used to head to this Save a lot all the time back when I used to live in Metairie. I was in the neighborhood about a week ago so I stopped in again.

The customer service was the same as I dealt with the last time I was here. Not rude, but not over the top friendly either. Somewhere in the middle to be precise.

I like the selection here because they tend to have more items to choose from than most of the other Save a lot stores in the area. That and they keep the store cleaner too.

Just a little FYI this is a bring your own bag kind of grocery store. If you don't have any bags you get charged 5 cents a bag. I guess its a small price to pay for saving some money.

In short decent customer service, decent selection, and decent prices for the Metairie area. But remember to bring your own grocery bags.
Saw this place on Yelp a few weeks ago and ran across it on my way to Bibo. Great crepes! Got the one egg crepe, and it was delicious! Can't wait to try more.

Honestly, if I could give the hotel no stars I would. First off, this hotel was a little over $100 a night...so I was expecting something pretty decent. When I got into the room I was disappointed. The floor is so uneven, which I guess you can expect from a historic hotel, but there was a section where a floorboard that was missing that was covered with duct tape. A window that was partially broken covered with masking tape. Another window had 50+ little insect eggs sitting it. The bathroom was good at first glance, but there was hair stuck all over the wall behind the door and then the neck the to the shower head spewed water! For a $100+ a night you'd think they would be able to fix that.
Don't even get me started on the $28 a per night fee for parking, yes it's gates shut after 10pm, but it was not a real parking lot...it was grass! 
The breakfast was good, they had waffles you could make yourself. But the fruit wasn't fresh, it was from a dole can. And the cheese slices were definitely Kraft singles cut into threes. Not impressive for the price I paid.
Lastly, during checkout I asked some questions about charges to the individual at the front desk, who immediately got defensive and rude. Then almost forgot to give us our cash $100 deposit and rudely (not jokingly) tried to blame it on me asking the two questions.
If you're looking for historic, go for it because there's not even an elevator up the three talk flights of stairs. But if you actually want to enjoy yourself, get a hotel closer to the French Market/ Bourbon street because this hotel was unimpressive beyond belief.

I used to visit Dave's shop when I attended UCSB.  As an experienced cyclist and mechanic for major events, Dave has a natural ability to fit someone to the right bike. Why would Lance Armstrong choose him as his mechanic for the Tour de France if Dave was not good at what he does? haha.. I mean really??

As a smaller shop than most, it feels very comfortable to be there. You get to know the people in there and share experiences. Other shops always try to sell you something you don't really need, but Dave and Luke were always honest and never let me spend more money than I really needed to. You will never feel cheated, instead you will feel confident and more educated than when you came in. I believe that's a true local bike shop.

All the staff are very nice.  The parking out back is nice. Love the French Quarter type brick in the room.  Adequate continental breakfast, but wish there were apples and bananas as well as oranges and grapefruit.  The bath tub looked like it needed a deep clean the hot water is on the right.  What would keep me from coming back, since I go to bed at 10:00 p.m. Is the the drunks and lovers making noise till 1 a.m.  If you go to bed after reveling at the French Quarter till 3 a.m., it was pretty quiet in the morning.  There is a $100 refundable deposit and parking is $25 a day that is not mentioned on the internet, during the booking process.

When i moved to Santa Barbara nine years ago, I asked around for a good bike shop.  While the reputation proceeded it already from friends in Oregon, Fastrack had rave reviews.  Thanks to some trusted connections, I met Dave immediately and have never looked back or ever stepped into another shop in Santa Barbara since.

In nearly a decade, I've purchased two beautiful, high end bikes from Dave [along with a litany of apparel and accessories].  My first Fastrack bike was an innovative rocket ship and the subsequent service was always speedy, thorough and with some really  fun banter [thanks Luke]!  ;)  My most recent, second Fastrack bike purchase is a custom one.  Dave spent hours with me throughout the process, measuring, explaining the steps, picking colors and equipment, and much, much more.  I couldn't have felt more prepared AND at ease with such a significant investment.  One of the best investments I have made.

Recently this custom bike developed a few cracks in the frame - undoubtedly from normal wear and tear.  Of course when I shared this with Dave, he immediately took control.  He promptly called the vendor, disassembled the bike, packed it like a crystal vase, shipped it back and ushered the process along with great efficiency.  As a result of his caring and wonderful work on my behalf, I have a new frame - completely reassembled by Dave [and Luke] and fit again [by Dave].  Needless to say, shopping locally has its benefits and i'll continue to not only give Fastrack my business but I will refer any/and everyone who I know to them for best-in-class service and products [as I have for years].

While i'll never ride as fast as Lance, there is something that gives me great pride knowing that his ex-right hand man keeps my safety and comfort top of mind.  There is additional satisfaction knowing that I am supporting a local business which is extremely community-minded and also gives back to our glorious little city and its people, too.

The stars speak for themselves.  
Huge thanks to Fastrack for all you do .... on and off the bike.....!!!

What a great stay. Price was decent. Location was great. Room was kept very nicely. We were on the 3rd floor, so no complaint about neighbors noise. Hotel was beautiful though, had great visual history. The walk to Bourbon St was give or take 15 minutes, so the location is what won me over. Staff was friendly. Would stay here again.

I am new to Florida from New York and I found this nail place on Google. I called to see if I could come in for a pedicure and a fill in the woman on the phone who turned out to be Caitlin the owner was accommodating and said I could come in right away. When I arrived I was taken to a pedicure chair and a tech started on my feet right away. Another tech began to talk to me about my nails. I always had acrylic done and she suggested a colored powder which I didn't even know existed. She ended up doing some lovely hand-painted designs on my nails which came out great. My pedicure was great my feet feel smooth and I also got my eyebrows threaded. I felt very satisfied with the service and I believe the prices are reasonable. They were nice and personable and I will definitely return in the future.

Good stuff, specially after a long night.

 This cart was parked outside Loving Cup on Friday night.

 Crepes had chicken, ham, cheese, chocolate options.

Luke is the bomb! I can not thank him enough for all of his help during my search for my perfect bike. I am a short gal so my whole bike shopping was stressful from the start. Once I got to Fastrack Luke took all  the time I needed to get me set up and make sure I had the best fit possible. If you are looking for a bike make sure to make this your first stop and be sure to ask for Luke!

I've been here twice and I've been really happy with the service. They have a great variety of shallac colors to choose from and the price is consistent ($24 for a fill with shellac). Everything looks clean and the employees are nice. I'll def return!
I am so happy with my nails! I'm also getting my lashes done for the first time. The staff are wonderful, highly recommend this cute nail shop.

Great Starbucks with awesome staff. The coffee is always fresh, and it is served with a smile (seriously). The only thing that keeps this one from being a five star in my book is how small the store is inside. It's a good spot to grab a quick cup of coffee, but not so great to chill for a while.

I Googled several shops in New Orleans as I was calling from California and had no clue who was good in New Orleans. I stumbled upon Barbara's so I called. Barbara answered and was so kind on the phone - I knew I found the right florist. The flowers were delivered within hours to a hotel nearby and the quality of flowers was incredible. Great service, fast delivery, and superb quality!

I went with my daughter for a manicure with Gel polish. I was immediately impressed with the decor as we walked in. I am deaf and they were more than happy to move things around so I was able to sit next to my daughter. The ladies were very nice and did an awesome job. It was also amazing  that when they found out I was deaf they did not ignore me. Something that is very common with many other services. We will definitely be going back!

Very nice eclectic type person checked us in.   They do add a $100 deposit on your card that comes off in 48 hours, if you don't damage the place.  Audubon room for breakfast, tables and chairs available all day.  Computer with internet available, as well as free WiFi.  Nice room off of a kind of noisy courtyard.  Wood floor and brick walls, heavy wooden doors, sitting area, then bedroom and bathroom.  Modern decor while maintaining the NOLA flavor.  TV, phone, hair dryer, shampoo and conditioner provided.  Pool, laundry, breakfast.  Complementary coffee and ice water available in Audubon room.  There isn't good water pressure in the shower.  Parking behind the hotel is an extra $25 a day.  Street parking is available.  It is in easy walking distance to the French Quarter.  It would probably be safe for a woman alone at night, but I wouldn't recommend it, you have to use common sense.

This place is very much like most places.  They have some techs that are really good and some that are just okay.  Every shop will have new people from time to time and it takes a while for them to get up to speed.  For me, I have been here about 6 or 7 times.  Mary has been excellent. and has done a very good job every time.  She is friendly, but doesnt talk much, but is very focused on what she is doing.  Overall .... i would have to rate her as the best i have received in a long time.  Go here and ask for Mary .... you wont be disappointed.

I have been going to Sunshine Nails for over 12 years.  I moved to Clearwater and was not familiar with the area.  A friend recommended  I try this salon and I couldn't be happier.  Caitlyn, the owner, is pleasant and professional and makes sure you are happy with your manicure or pedicure.  Kim has always done my nails, I would never go anywhere else.  A new salon has recently opened up in the same LaBelle Plaza, so make sure you choose Sunshine and you will not be disappointed.!

I'm on the hunt for my new go to place for nails,  my lady sold her shop.I went to her for 5 years. I was right next door at America's Best for a follow up appointment for my son.  Well, this place caught my eye so I decided to walk in....WOW! Glamorous atmosphere, fit for every woman.  Men pay attention! If your girl, wifey, shorty, your mama, or anyone special in your life you have to treat them to services at J'adore! What better way to show them that you appreciate them. Also,  this place has a private room for bridal parties, girls day, private parties, its absolutely stunning in here! The staff is professional, kind, and so welcoming! My nail tech was Wen and I will be back! I just found my new spot!  You will not be disappointed, also all their first time clients got a great surprise. Whatever I spent today,  they have me the same amount back in a gift card! Who does that!?  What a great way to gain return consumers.  Thank you so much!  Keep up the great work! LOVE THIS PLACE!

This place does not disappoint! We had a courtyard room overlooking the pool - gorgeous! The breakfast buffest aimed to please! The fleur-de-lis waffles, breakfast sandwiches, local coffee was superb! Found a deal on Hotel Tonight and it was well worth it!

OMG. Barbara does an amazing job! We spoke on the phone 2 weeks before my fiancé and I arrived in New Orleans for our chapel wedding. She doesn't do email so I was a little nervous relying on a description alone. I knew exactly what I wanted and described it to her on the phone. She must be magic because the bouquet and boutonniere were perfection. She had them delivered to our hotel just as requested. The photos show the flowers as they looked upon delivery and then after 3 days, packed in a suitcase and flown across the country from New Orleans to San Francisco. We highly recommend her.

What is there to say about Save A Lot?  It is where I go when I'm broke as a joke and I can't get groceries at Winn Dixie or I'll choke.  I have to drive quite a ways to get over there, but I make it worth the trip by hauling the kids along with me and hitting up the Cici's close by or going roller skating at Airline Skate Center.  But alas, I digress.

This is a good place to come and stock up on staples: canned goods, dry items like canned drinks, noodles, chips, crackers, cereal and stuff, and dairy.  Their produce is pretty ok most of the time, if you don't mind a couple of bruises on your apples.  I bruise easily myself, so I don't mind.  The meat is touch-and-go; it sort of depends on the day as to the quality there, but I usually pick up some ground turkey and maybe a pack of pork chops at least.  The frozen food selection is great, and it is a fantastic place to pick up some bread.  Hell, buy two and stick one loaf in the freezer.  Times are tough.

I can get over a week's worth of groceries here for about $40-$50.  It's no ALDI (don't get me started on that mecca), but, for the price, that'll do, Donkey...that'll do.

12/8/18 ‍Enzyme Facial 
I wish I know a word to use to describe the experience I had today. The level of professionalism, the care, and the knowledge was simply impeccable! I am now a regular at J'adore Nail Bar for my nails and pedicures which I also taste a 5 Star! However, today I was there for a facial, an enzyme facial. Let me just begin by saying the last time I had a facial I went to , which it was nice but Doesn't even come close to comparing the facial I had today. I was so relaxed from head to toe. Wen is AMAZING to say the least! This is by far the BEST facial sevices I have ever received. $ well spent! Every minute that you pay for is 100% worth the $. This will definitely become a monthly routine for me. I went to heaven and came back! Thank you Wen, you did an amazing job and my son feels amazing!!

Stayed here for a three day getaway for my sister's Bachelorette weekend in April. It was my first time in New Orleans and wasn't quite sure what to expect but this hotel did not disappoint. 

It is small and quaint, what would be considered "boutique." The room we had was a queen double. The rooms do not have carpeting, so I and my germaphobe sister had to wear something on our feet the whole time, but it was nicely sized and clean. The beds were firm but comfortable, and the shower had hot water (no problems there!) The room opened out to the central pool (which was awesome to see when you come home at night and when you first wake up,) as well as a community sitting area with tables and umbrellas and chairs (perfect for smokers since the rooms are all non smoking.)

The free breakfast fare was okay. Croissants, ham and cheese were plenty, as was the coffee and fruit. 

It is a little ways away from the hustle and bustle of New Orleans proper, but I quite enjoyed this. It was still walkable to all the tourist spots, still got delivery from all the takeout places and had a fabulous little cafe nearby where we always had breakfast. At the end of a busy day touring, I wanted someplace quiet to lay my head down at. Speaking of which, there was a family reunion of sorts one night when we were there and there were people singing outside at the communal area, which, I could see would be completely unacceptable to some guests. However, it did not run too late, and both my sister and I were able to sleep. 

The staff was friendly and helpful. The hotel room was comfortable and clean. All in all a great value and I would stay here again.

I've only been a member for a little over 1 month but I'm very pleased with clean facilities, hours of operation, number of cardio machines, extensive group exercise classes & great teachers/trainers. Worth the money.

Great ambience, great service and quality work! Been to quite a few shops, but the service and the attitude of the staff sets this one apart from the rest. Ask for Vivian, she's awesome! A shop that cares about what you want, not what they want for you. Will def be back!

After years of riding used bikes and hand me downs that cost me more in repairs, I decided to buy a new bike. After visiting a few shops, I stumbled upon FasTrack on my way to lunch. Luke was actually eating his lunch, but got up to greet me and show me a hybrid Trek after I told him I wanted to commute to work. It was a size too big for me so he said he would order a smaller one to try, with no obligation or upfront payment. It arrived a few days later and Dave adjusted the bike for me and I test drove it around the block.I bought it the same day. I am very happy with my purchase and the excellent service I received from them. Will be back to upgrade!

Always impressed by the Owner Dave personally helping me with my bike issues.  No hour wait or drop off your bike for a week stuff like other bike stores.  Dave bikes daily and is a true mechanic and good person.

They plated my cheese danish - the first of 8 Starbucks in the area to do that. 

Great service and very friendly people.
Great service and my pedicure is always perfect.   I've visited this location several times and found the place clean, team members are friendly and great results.  Keep up the good work!

This was my first time here. Everyone was very welcoming and helpful. The salon is gorgeously decorated, and very clean, which I am a stickler for, especially in a nail salon. The $25 pedicure was to die for. Can't wait to try one of their "special " pedicures. I also had my brows waxed, and was very pleased. I will be going back for more!!

The best bike shop in SB. Went in because my tube went bad 4x in a row, the guy at the front diagnosed the issue. These guys know bikes, and are friendly.

Keep it up!

First time coming to this nail salon and I loved it so much! They were very nice and helpful, Connie hooked my nails up! I just moved to the area so I was hesitant to try a new spot in Clearwater but this is the place to go to. They take sanitation very serious which I appreciate which is why they probably are a bit pricey. I got the bubbly pedicure by Connie which was amazing, she cleaned my cuticles very well. She took her time. Then I showed her a picture of what I wanted for my nails and she executed it better than the picture I showed her. She was very attentive and friendly. I will be back to the salon and will request for her. Thank you Connie

Had a very positive experience here, even though i'm not a carbon bike kind of guy.  Went here to pump up my tires and to get a bike lock.  Was super happy that they had ABUS bike locks!  The guy that helped me was super friendly and even helped me install my bike lock.  The even had some amazing bike helmets that I might come back to purchase.

Great ambience, great service and quality work! Been to quite a few shops, but the service and the attitude of the staff sets this one apart from the rest. Ask for Vivian, she's awesome! A shop that cares about what you want,  not what they want for you. Will def be back!
Staff and the vet, Dr. Kermit, seem to really care about animals. The business is secondary, the animal is their primary concern. Wonderful people.

I'm so happy I discovered this place since its so close to home and dare I say it, the best salon in the area! It's no wonder they're always so busy - their service is top notch and their prices are unbeatable. I can't afford to go as often as Id like, but I frequent this place when I can and they do such a great job. Usually I get the gel manicure since I want long lasting nails and I'm scared of acrylic. I've tried SNS once before at another location but the nail tech scared me off because the powder was way too thick! For my wedding day, I showed a picture of a white to pink ombre look to break away from the traditional French manicure. Vivian said she could do it using the sns powder and I expressed my concern. The last thing I wanted was big bubble nails on my big day. She talked me into it saying she'll make it thinner so they looked more natural... I trusted her and let her do her thing... They turned out amazing and looked even better than the picture!! She even added some bling - three vertical jewels- to my ring fingers. Nothin like feeling like a fabulous bride stepping out of the shop! I'm glad I gave SNS another chance and think I'm going to switch to this as my go to service!

Brand new everything! Exceptional service and my pedicure was super relaxing and not rushed at all! Kim gave me an amazing dip manicure that looked natural not thick like another place I tried. I highly recommended Jadore Nails! I was completely 100% satisfied from beginning to the end. They will most definitely have my repeat business!

Fair prices, great service, excellent selection, beautiful store, talented artists.
They get you in quickly even if you don't have an appointment. I definitely recommend going here for your nails.

I loved this location until this past Friday. 

It was always clean and the staff were always friendly,  they were exceptional about pain free blood work,  and it was never more than an hourish wait. 

This past Friday I met a staff member who was so much of a bitch I will never go back to this location. While I was standing in line I watched her yell at people, roll her eyes,  and just present this nasty demeanor. When I got up to the front of the line I was lucky enough to be dealing with someone else (a pleasant younger Asian woman) and this old haggard greasy bitch dropped her hand on my requisition and started yelling at me for making small talk with the nice woman while she was entering my info. What?  Seriously ridiculous. I grabbed my req,  and went to the nearby gateway location,  which was pleasant.
Very friendly and knowledgeable. Great service at a reasoanble price. My go to spot for anything bike related!

Ordered two drinks waited about 20 mins and when 2 ladies about 15 min. behind me got two drinks handed to them I asked where my drinks where. Come to find out they never actually purchased drinks and where given mine.  I ended up finally getting mine after the employees realized what happened.
The nail tech I had gave me a bunch of tiny cuts on my fingernails, and there website said $25 for a gel fill in and I paid $45.
I don't live around the area but I needed my nails done. I can say that Wen did a great job with my nails. Definitely recommend this nail salon.

Fantastic salon, great options and good prices too. I went in after work excited to see they were open later than most, only to find out an hour after they closed at 8:30 pm that the hours are wrong in their website AND on yelp! I felt bad for asking for my services but no one told me! I did come in around 6:30 without an appointment and was seated and helped right away. Great customer service and I'm happy with the results. I'm always picky about nails but they did a pretty perfect job. I got the classic pedicure with gel polish and dip powder French tip nails. Very nice, professional staff!

Awesome facility! Especially for being right on the busy streets of New Orleans. The staff was very friendly and helped my family and I navigate the streets of New Orleans. It is placed in a very good location, we were able to get everywhere by foot and not have to deal with having to park on busy street sides (have a nice hidden parking lot that you pay for a small fee, especially if you are military). The room we stayed in was very quaint and clean-although we had toilet troubles- it was a nice place to stay.

Even though they are 24 hours... They do not respond in the drive-through after a certain point. Half the time they respond when they do with our systems are down it's going to be about 30 minutes. I get so frustrated with this place and they seem to not care they don't care about their customer service.

Ok so the reviews on this place date back a bit & after my recent visit I thought an update was in order. I went in without an appointment on Saturday afternoon, over the holiday weekend, for a pedicure. 

I was seated right away in a pedicure chair & a nail tech came over immediately.  She asked about the water temperature & made adjustments to it to be more comfortable. The nail tech made the usual small talk during the pedicure but she made me comfortable & was gentle. 

I opted for the deluxe spa pedicure for $30 which included removal of existing color, trim, shape & buff of your nails, a hot stone massage, paraffin wax treatment,  a regular massage and the application of the new color. The massage chair relaxed me even further during this great pedicure.

The nail color selection at the salon was large & they offer shellac for an additional $10. They offer waxing service & the tech asked if I wanted my eyebrows done but I passed. She also asked if I wanted a manicure but I was only there for the pedi so that was a no too.   

The nail salon itself is older & could use a facelift. Others commented the place looks dirty but I saw the techs scrubbing & cleaning each pedi chair basin after a customer was done. The floors were being swept & tools cleaned. 

I will definitely return for another pedicure, especially for the price & great service.

Absolutely love the gym!!!! On my way out I usually like stopping for a coffee with a dash of almond milk. However, they are now charging $0.65 for a dash of almond milk in the coffee....yet offer complimentary creamer and reg milk.... not much but just kind of ridiculous. Skipping the cafe from now on.

This was a lovely hotel walking distance to the French Quarter.  Its an old building so things aren't perfect but definitely comfy and cozy.  Myself and 2 teenagers shared a double room and were very comfortable.  There was a sitting area with tv and then the beds and a spacious bathroom.  Everyone who worked there was super nice and helpful.  Courtyard and pools were very inviting.  

Hot water had to run a long time to heat up and I wish breakfast had more than waffles some eggs would be great.
Dirtiest Starbucks I've ever been in. Barista got my order wrong and was rude about fixing it.

Best bike store in town, these guys have good prices, they are super friendly and help out in whatever way they can.  This is an example of when I would prefer to spend a little more money locally than shopping online because of the service you get with them.  Plus Lance is a fan...

Very nice place like everyone has mentioned in previous reviews. I decided to do the VIP it is a bit pricey for pedicure but they didn't cut any expenses. It was a full relaxation of foot relaxation separate from the salon. It was peaceful. Along with a decent red wine. Not out the of the box wine if you know what I mean. My nails were done by wen and she put special touches and made sure they were perfect. We tried a new product that is known to be natural and stronger than dip. Being a huge dip fan I was sceptic  but in the end I really liked the out come. My nails feel so natural and in a couple of weeks I will see how well they hold up. Every month they have a special and they honor their work. So if anything should go wrong with your nails you can come back and they will fix I was told. I can't wait to go back. One more thing... I noticed they definitely take their appointments seriously so I would make an appointment and it's really very easy on their website. Plus they send you reminder texts and confirmations. Never has that before.
not a very good gym, I found it to small and the equipment seemed a little outdated. The main issue was they kept billing even after I resigned. I had to call each time I saw a charge on my cc...

Dr. Harvey always makes time for us cause we're his favorite. Blazing Starr







Thanks

Absolute worst place I've gotten my nails done. I decided to give this place not 1 but 2 tries thinking maybe the first time getting a manicure completely wrong was just the result of an employee having a bad day.However after going there a second time I realize it wasn't just the one employee.My first time getting my nails done at this location was a disaster.The woman didn't listen to what I wanted done with my nails from start to finish. I told her i wanted my nails more square and she gave me rounded, asked her for them shorter and she left them long and crooked. I complained when her drill made me bleed on multiple different fingers only for her to get an attitude and basically make me feel like I was in the wrong for telling her. Her polishing skills were terrible as the French tips I was expecting were very crooked and the white polish was everywhere. Also the light pink acrylic I wanted was more of a bright hot pink after telling her I knew the pink she was using would come out brighter than what I wanted. Needless to say 4 months ago I walked out with bare, half on shellac'd nails after getting tired of the terrible experience I asked for a soak to get it off which in turn left me with chemicals burning my cuticles and nail beds due to all the drilling to my fingers. Not to mention the woman didn't care to completely take off the chemicals so I drove home with burning fingers. Today I go in to use the gift certificate someone got me for my birthday dreading it but hoping this will be a better experience. Horrible decision! I went in for a deluxe pedicure and got a half ass scrub, and a polish that was terrible. You ever go to a nail salon and get your nails polished and it looks like they decided to relocate your toenails. Not one of my toenails are painted completely, NOT ONE! And I was left with some sort of oil lubrication on my toes to walk out with as if slipping around in your sandals is ideal. It got one star as I don't see an option for 0. I can't even tell my boyfriend about my experience cause then he will feel terrible about his gift. If you want my opinion, take your money elsewhere cause this location is awful.

#lovethisplace. Super cheap we paid 69 bucks! So cute we had a balcony overlooking the brick draped pool and courtyard. Most "budget" rooms have no windows and are on sketchy streets with overpriced parking. This place is a welcomed retreat from typical New Orleans BS. The staff was so nice .. Let us check in early, let us change our reservation, let us keep our parking spot until long after we checked out! 
2 block walk to lil dizzys (great poboys) . Everything in the French quarter is walking distance with out being smack dab in the middle of crazy town. 
We truly loved our stay. Highly recommended. #bikenola

I should have listened to the other reviewer. I went here for a basic pedicure and my nail beds got infected. I'd heard of that happening, but it's never happened in my 15+ years of getting regular pedicures. Gross. This place is disgusting.
Beautiful and very clean, relaxing atmosphere. Staff is attentive and polite. Prices are reasonable.

Short review and long review.

Short: Be prepared to be upsold and talked down to.  High-end selection for road and XC MTB, but limited.  Attitude was the big turn-off here.  Velo Pro and Hazards have same quality inventory, more of it.

Long review:  Took my bike in to have bottom bracket looked at and, without looking at the bike, the mechanic on duty told me it wasn't my bottom bracket. Told me to re-do my dropouts then re-try. C'mon. I'm not that big a dumb ass. Did it anyway. When that didn't work, he told me it's probably my seatpost and 10 other things not in the BB area, except the noise was quite obviously from there.
 
When he finally rode it himself he conceded its the BB. Rather than saying they can fix it, though, he says: "What you ought to do is get rid of your bike and get that Trek Commuter over there." This came after he insisted to the previous customer that his wheel was crap and its time to upgrade to something way more hardcore than the customer wanted.
 
He told me he'd fix my BB and call me in 2 days. 4 days went by without word, so I went in. He told me he broke my rear derailleur hanger dropout. 1st of all, the bike was shifting fine when I took it in, and I have trouble seeing what the rear drop alignment has to do with a BB that creaks regardless of if the bike is being pedaled or not. Second of all, its a 1994 Cannondale. Not easy to find replacement hangers. After inquiring at length why they were messing with the rear der, they said don't worry about it, they'd take care of it. Wasn't happy.
 
Came back in about a week later, asked for my Cannondale and they said, "Ooh, bad news: we broke the derailleur." I was beside myself, but when I asked how they could break my bike twice, they looked confused. They were referring to a different Cannondale...that they broke.
 
Finally go in to pick up my bike and they try to charge me for the rear der hanger. This sparked a whole run of attitude about how my bike is too old, that I should expect things to get broken (the hanger that was on there was a replacement that wasn't as old as the bike), and that I shouldn't be upset they were trying to make my bike better. I wouldn't be upset by that except I didn't bring it in for a rear der adjustment and I don't believe that had anything to do with the BB, which they initially argued had no problem to begin with.
 
In the end they charged me for just the labor. But the whole interaction combined with seeing how they treated other customers and hearing how they broke another bike is enough to make me sit here and type this review.

I had an amazing time at this salon! I don't normally like to go to nail salons, but this one was an amazing experience! They had complimentary margaritas! Everyone was so nice, and the girl who did my nails was super gentle. I would definitely recommend to anyone!

Had a great experience coming in on a regular to get my nails done here for the past x3 months... only to make an appointment for the morning of Father's Day. And have the most worst experience at any nail place I've been too. It started off by me simply sitting where the receptionist had me seated to wait for a nail tech.. and was approached by the rudest nail tech , I simply said hello.. only for her to look at me with disgust with cold reply "you pick color" I was shocked because I never had this happened here before. I continued to try and ask of everything is okay, because she didn't look to happy to be seated across from me. I asked her if I came in too early, she replied no.. Then I ask if she was okay because she seemed upset. She replied rudely "you pick color, I go get it, ARE YOU OKAY?" I was so uncomfortable I just got up and left. I don't want  no one holding sharp objects close to me that simply didn't even like me trying to be friendly to them. I'll never come back just because of her. I hope the owners are reading this. I drive all the way from st.pete just to get that service not to be treated like I was making someone do me any favors. I might not have gotten a name. But I'll never forget a face.

I love this salon! It is quiet and peaceful. The employees are kind and courteous. Lin did an awesome job on my mani/pedi. I asked for a special design on my big toe, she did a fantastic job! My nails look fabulous!
Great place to get healthy. We love it. Pool is great, outstanding staff and very pleasant atmosphere. Highly recommend for all ages

Knowledge and courtesy is what you'll get at Fastrack. First, are there less expensive places to buy a bike, helmet and socks? Yes. But what you get here is a relationship with a local business. 

Personal reviews drove me into the shop but I was warned they team will push the sale and try to upgrade your decision. I would totally agree based on my experience. Was it worth it? You bet ya.   

Looking for information only, Luke was quick to assess my skills and pull a bike from the back for a test ride. A few adjustments later and I was out the door. Great pick! The price was right and the feel was good. I made my decision to buy but was planning on stopping there.

Would you call it persuasive selling or just good business, I'm not sure but I left with more than I planned. The only ding to the whole ordeal working with Luck and having Dave fine tune the adjustments, was the bike I rode and said I'd take, was misquoted by about 8.5% and not in my favor. A little of the ol bait a switch or just unfamiliarity with my model. While I was shocked at the mistake, Dave met me half way and I still feel like I got a deal.  

Dave and Luke rock
Went in with questions
Rode out with a bike
I feel like I now have friends in the bike business. Only time will tell

I've been looking for some new cycling shoes for a few months now and nothing seemed right. I wasn't willing to drop a ton of money without proper knowledge about the shoes and what would work right for me. After rolling into Fastrack I was greeted by Luke who spent more than enough time with me. Luke explained everything I needed to know about the fit and listened to my concerns and spent a lot of time with me to find the right shoe. I even went back in for a readjustment and he was happy to help. I never felt like anyone took their time to explain such important features and mechanisms to me like Luke did. Thank you!!

Reno's best place to get Crepes!! I love Carrie, Lu, and Shandra! You can feel the love these miraculous women put into your food and their service is exemplary! Go go go!! Currently every Sunday at The riverside Hub location!
Dave is incredibly knowledgeable and has this amazing ability to remember the name and face of just about every one who walks through his door. Fantastic shop
The staff is always friendly, it's easy to get in and out of, and there's never too long of a line.  It's not the fanciest Starbucks you've ever been to, but they do a great job.

This turned out to be a fantastic place to stay!  We were looking for a place that allowed dogs, which several did, but only tiny "purse sized" dogs not our 80 pound mini Dane!  It is within walking distance to the night life, the Jazz/Armstrong park, lots of great food and several geocaches!  You could even get a tattoo next door. The staff was very nice. It was a $25 fee for parking and same for the dog,but meant not having to find a spot and having some grass to walk the dog. (Before we realized the park was just blocks from us). I would absolutely recommend and return to this place should we get the chance.

New customer here. Found Caitlyn on living social. Did microblading. I was scared since I have very light sparse eyebrows, looking non existent. Caitlyn took such good care of me and it was a collaborative effort to make my eyebrows AMAZING! I did eyelash extensions while I was there because she made me feel so good about myself. So I came in without eyebrows or eyelashes since I'm so fair, and came out feeling glamorous in the best way. I will be back and will be sending others here for Caitlyn's artistry. Thank you!
Great little place. Everyone is super friendly and helpful. They don't try to oversell or anything just extremely helpful. Will be going back

First thing you see when you walk in the shop: a mess  Second thing you see when you enter: one of 20 yellow jersey's from the Tour De France worn by Lance Armstrong given to Dave Letteri, his chief mechanic during the 2000 TDF and owner of Fastrack Bicycles. 

Although the shop appears cluttered, don't let it fool you. It's the best shop in Santa Barbara for the serious cyclist.  Dave will give you outstanding service and tips on the local riding scene.  

Every time I have visited the shop, I have walked out with a new bike, or bike part.  Recently, I purchased a Campagnolo Record carbon crank and two hours later it was on my bike.  

Visit Fastrack if you are a visiting cyclist or new to the area.  It's located in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara.

Can't say enuff about Dave and Luke...these guys are very personable, helpful and knowledgeable. I bought 2 Trek FX2's for my wife n I at a good price, delivered next day n was out the door. Great location just off State St downtown.

With the recent remodel over the 4th of July weekend, the place is relaxing, comfortable, and stylish.  I have had several Pedicures there and always get my eyebrows done.  Waxing isn't the most comfortable beauty routine, but they are quick and competent.  I travel to NYC often for work, and always get complemented on my brows.
I recently had the milk and honey pedicure and it was divine!  I spent most of the day just feeling my lower legs and feet, they were just lush.  They spent a good hour doing the full deal, paraffin wax, hot stones, exfoliating.  I have sensitive toes from previous chemo treatments and they are always very gentle.
I would highly recommend this business to anyone in the Clearwater area looking for a nicely, modestly priced place to have a relaxing pedi with friends.

I came to Florida from Hawaii to visit family and was looking for an inexpensive house lace for nails/ microblading/ eyelash extensions (since everything in Hawaii is so expensive). My family lives in Ellenton/ Palmetto and I initially went to a local salon to get my nails done they took FOREVER and cost Hawaii prices. I then searched Groupon/ google and found Sunshine nails!  They were running a special. Caitlyn stay d late to get me in for microblading and i had a super inexpensive manicure while i waited ($16 for gel!!!) 

Eyebrows were amazing!  I came back a few days later with my daughter and i got her manicure/ pedicure and my eyelash extensions all for $100!!!! 

Flash forward to today (3 weeks later) and she got me, my sister, daughter and son in last minute. We drove an hour to come back because the staff here is so kind and professional and not to mention the price is the cheapest I have EVER SEEN!!!!

I'm a glutard. There's so many food experiences I miss out on because of my food allergies. 
Fortunately Carrie caters to people like me!
Her crepes are delicious!!
Savory or sweet she's got me covered.

The microblading done by Caitlyn was fabulous.  Absolutely "pain-free!"  She showed me the color she had blended for my approval.  She is all about making her clients happy with their procedures.  I was so happy with my brows, I went ahead and had my lashes done.  Again, done to perfection.  I'll return in June for a touch-up to my brows and enjoy my time with Caitlyn at Sunshine Nails.

I wanted to send some flowers to my boyfriend, who is in New Orleans for a conference. The hotel, Westin Canal Place, suggested Barbara's Florist (aka B&B Flowers and Gifts) or Tommy's. I general prefer to order online, so I can "see" what I am getting, but I took the chance of ordering over the phone. I gave B&B a call and told Barbara how much I could spend and what I was looking for ("something that smells good"), and she made some suggestions and told me she'd take care of it. She was courteous and helpful. The flowers were delivered on time, the arrangement is just gorgeous, and my boyfriend loves them! The whole transaction was fast and simple, and the flowers exceeded my expectations for what I could afford.
If I could, I would have given a negative rating.  The sales manager was rude and discourteous.

Returned for another facial followed by a touch up on my micro bladed (tattoo) eye brows. My third facial gave beautiful results. My first touch up since March 2017. I should have been back sooner but it is what it is. I love my new look. Heading back in two weeks for tattoo eyeliner

If I could give this rating a 0 I would!! I get to the salon and the guy at the front desk is very nice. When the technician comes to get me a few minutes later, her whole demeanor was awful. Scowling, body language and attitude. I told her I needed a pink fill and she snapped we have to take everything off then since you've never been here before. I told her I was fine with the pinks not matching perfectly, but this was a new set and I would not be taking them off. She then tosses a ring of colors at me and says try to find a pink then. I asked to see the powders and she starts arguing about how I just needed to figure it out from the ring. At this point I got up and left. So much for wanting to have a new customer. No way I would let this lady do my nails after this interaction!  You are much better off to go across the parking lot to TNL nails. Very nice and did an amazing job!

I was a walk-in at Jadore and I didn't even have so much as a 5 min wait! I got Linda and she did a really good job on my acrylic fill. She was super sweet and accommodating when I said I wanted a different shape than what I had previously asked for! This place is great, and they made a great first impression. I'll definitely be back.

All the staff are very nice.  The parking out back is nice. Love the French Quarter type brick in the room.  Adequate continental breakfast, but wish there were apples and bananas as well as oranges and grapefruit.  The bath tub looked like it needed a deep clean and the hot water took at least 4 minutes to heat.  What would keep me from coming back, since I go to bed at 10:00 p.m. Is the the drunks and lovers making noise till 1 a.m.  If you go to bed after reveling at the French Quarter till 3 a.m., it was pretty quiet in the morning.

Our stay here was good. The hotel staff is incredibly friendly and helpful.  We stayed in a room around the pool courtyard, second level. There's a few French style seating and tables just outside the rooms in the pool courtyard for hanging out, eating, etc. The room we stayed in was relatively small, but decent. This is especially if you're just using the facilities to rest your head after a day of hanging out in the French quarter. 

This hotel definitely has some history to it. Though this may not be as important to some people as it is to me, it didn't have an old building smell which was great. They keep the facility generally clean and fragrant for the most part. 

They do serve complementary breakfast in the morning. Food-wise, think of a typical Holiday inn breakfast, but slightly worse. I would recommend going out to a restaurant if you are looking for a quality breakfast. 

 The location is right at the northern border of the French quarter and the Tremé neighborhood. Also walking distance to the Louis Armstrong Park. It's a bit of a walk to get to Bourbon Street and other popular streets within the French quarter, but you get to see a decent chunk of the French quarter on your way to any destination within. 

If you're looking for a quieter location with some historical value, close enough to the French quarter, then I would recommend this hotel.
So clean and relaxing! Red wine and a chair massage during pedicure! Only $10 extra for a ten minute leg/foot massage!

Do not stay here!!!
I booked this hotel 2 months ago to spend my 19th anniversary with my wife. We have been living apart from each for the past 2 year because I'm in Navy currently stationed in Mississippi on a ship being built. 

I booked 5 nights for a room with 2 queen beds and a sitting area through hotelplanners.com. when we arrived to check in and got up to the room, we noticed that the beds were full size beds, not queens. When I went to talk to the night clerk, she was really friendly and upgraded us to a suite because she had no other rooms available with queen beds. We moved all of our stuff at 1am to this suite.

10am that same morning, we get a message from a day manager stating we need to move out of that room because it was just booked and into this other room which they claims had 2 queen beds. We got up and started packing and was consistently asked by management to leave the room so they can get it ready. We were trying to hurry and move to another room. 

Once getting to the new room. It ended up being smaller then the first room and had full size beds which we were told they were queens. I asked the day clerk for a general managers contact info. I was given an email number which it has been 4 days and no response or I can wait to speak to angie the operations manager. 

3 days went by and Angie switch her shifts. Our room did get the toilet paper refilled, trash taken out, or other stuff restocked. Just beds made and extra towels. We were locked out of our room 3 times and made it very hard to get up to our room to use the restroom. We were forced to use the lobbies restroom which didnt look like it was cleaned or maintained in a few days.  

Today, 24FEB2020 I was able to reach Angie working at the front desk. Told her my story and asked for a price reduction on the room cost or other means of compensation. I was told by her I request to move and was given a suite I shouldnt have and that wasnt her fault. I told her as a manager, rather you are at work or not, the people who work for you, you are still responsible for their actions and decisions. Angie just proceeded to tell me she not responsible for this. It was hotelplanners.com fault. Take it up with them. This booking was 100% paid out to the hotel by now and currently showing the charges on my statement.

After I calmly talked to her for 30 minutes, she decided to stop talking to me. Helped other customers and didnt want to discuss this any further. I have filled a claim with my credit card company in regard to this matter. 

This would have to be the worse experience I ever had at a hotel. Angie, the operations manager should not be in a manager position because she does not hold the skills or the mind set to deal with customers. 

I hope everyone who is interested in staying here reads this review and thinks real hard before staying here.

V/r
BMCS Brian Bunch, USN

Good looking newly reconstructed building.

While the chain is undergoing a complete overhaul that makes them look very nice. They have had this design in Europe for quite a while. Many TV's, power stations for people with electronic devices and free wifi.... yea!

This location has a staff that is currently doing a decent job. Fast food places typically have a pretty high turn over, so if the management keeps up the expectations from their staff, this location will remain to be better than the typical standards for this chain.

Wonderful place to stay!! The staff is very friendly Rot , Quantisa, sorry don't remember how to spell this young gentle man name. Breakfast was wonderful here. And it's close walking to Burbon St.& Alot of stuff. We went to the flea market on Saturday then walked to our cruise ship. I would definitely  stay here again.

Stayed in the New Orleans courtyard hotel for 3 night and four days, check in and parking was easy, friendly staff and easy walk (about 10 minutes) to bourbon. There were a few hiccups with his place but let's start with the good: the staff was super nice over the phone and in person and was very explanatory of every fine detail fee. No hidden fees at all. Pay for parking pay for room and that's pretty much it. The room was clean and tidy. Very organized and has a lot of space. They have free WiFi (which was actually pretty fast)  so if you're in the area on business and need to have that access then no worries. Other than that it was like any normal hotel. Bear in mind it is in the French quarter, it's not gonna be super sleek and modern; it has an old/vintage feel to it but I still loved it. They do offer breakfast from 6:30-11 and it's pretty good. Not a HUGE selection but good. Nothing super amazing that can be said but I definitely was satisfied. Now for some cons: the bed...super squeaky. (And I know what you're thinking you dirty minds)but getting in and out of bed to use the restroom while my partner is sleeping was difficult. Speaking of beds, it is quite firm, pillows are nice! If you need a lot of cushion to sleep comfortable forget about it. I however didn't mind, I was comfy. The floors in some areas are squeaky and walls are very thin but it's an old building what do you expect. I could hear everything outside but I'm a city person so I don't mind it. I could however hear every footstep and conversation that was made outside my door. Me and my partner laugh a lot and are noisy so I'm sorry to my neighbors. So if you're wanting some peace and quiet maybe try a different hotel in the quarter. (But if you're looking for peace and quiet then the quarter isn't for you anyway hahah)  The main annoyance was waking up in the morning to shower (and it wasn't just in the morning) and having to wait what felt like 20 mins for the hot water to tap on. That's one thing they need to fix or get replaced because I am NOT one for cold showers. Shower head was also powerful but honestly felt good and if you toggle with the middle knob you can adjust that. Over all I would definitely stay again if need be but I would love to try out other hotels in the area, but at least I would come back.

This place squeezed me in last minute for a nail repair and a fill the day before New Years! Seemed a bit pricey but you get what you pay for and my nails are shaped perfect and the woman did a great job . I will be back for sure!

I ended up needing one broken nail fixed and after coming in decided to get a pedicure as well. At first the lady said a thirty minute wait however it was more like 15 or 20 min. They are very accommodating however it is very busy and the lack of attention to detail is killing me, especially in a nail service business where originality and design and comfort is everything. My one broken nail on my hand does not look like the rest. She shaved the underneath layer and now it looks burned. I've posted a picture to show. What makes this nail shop stand out? It's one of the few ones open on Sunday in this area. Their prices are fair but it seems more like. Sweat shop style, get em in get em out, if you will. The lady is currently finishing up my pedicure and she just started. However living nearby, I will keep them in mind as a backup but definitely not a nail home for me. 3 stars because they offer refreshments and I was a walk-in on a Sunday however the speaking of another language with eye contact with the customer makes it seem as if the customer is being discussed. Also I told the lady exact what number I wanted and she still got it wrong and had to start over. So so experience.
Vivian is awesome  my feet and nails are perfect everytime! I highly recommend jadore clean and professional

If I lived locally I'd absolutely frequent this lovely salon! For sure the best shellac job (black matte) I've had in years - 2 weeks later and no peeling or cracking. Got the green tea pedicure as well and it was lovely. Very pleasant experience and the gals are super sweet and provide great services - definitely go here!

I came here for a weekend birthday celebration with my girls, and I must say we enjoyed ourselves. The hospitality was great, and I love the decor here.
One of the staff members here offered us a downstairs room since it became available, which came with a sitting area and a porch. I literally felt like I stepped outside my home and into the French Quarters, so that was truly nice. We were also close to the pool, breakfast and parking area, so definitely convenient.
My only complaint was the toilet, thus the 3 stars. First night we realized that the toilet kept running and wouldn't appropriately flush on its own. We tried fooling with it the first night, but the next day we decided to call someone out. They came out quickly, but the problem was only temporarily fixed. Maybe if I was staying longer I would have said more, but I didn't this time around.
I'd like to also note that if you're on the first floor you might be awakened to hearing the footsteps of your neighbors from above. I woke up to those noises around 5 a.m., so that was a bit of a bummer.
Otherwise a nice little spot close to everything within a trolley's ride.

I really enjoyed my experience here. It was a last minute decision to come here for a mani/pedi prior to leaving for a cruise. It was a busy Saturday afternoon when I walked in (without an appointment) asking for full service. I don't think I even waited 10 minutes!!! 

I paid extra to have my pedicure in the VIP room. It's optional & pricey but worth it if you want relaxation & quiet. The bench style seating in the VIP room almost changed my mind but I was happy to learn they had a massage feature built-in, side tables for my complementary wine, and a place I could plug my phone in if I needed to. I mean really top notch!

I got a coffee pedicure and it really exfoliated nicely.  The tech did overheat my oil just a tad...it felt REALLY HOT when she put it on my leg. I'd still go again, so hardly even worth mentioning.

What IS worth mentioning is that my dipped nails lasted FIVE WEEKS!! Yes, you read that correctly, 5 whole weeks before I needed my nails done again. This is insane! 

I'm very happy with my visit & this location is super close to my office so I definitely plan to make my way thru their extensive pedicure menu! 

On a side note: every tech I observed while I was there spoke excellent English.

Catlin was wonderful, I was a little nervous going in for permanent make up. She out me at ease as she listened to what I wanted to have my eyebrows look like. She made sure She numbed the area and made sure she I was not in pain. They look amazing! Don't mind the hair as She had it covered to make sure the area she was working on was clear. Everything went so well had a full in and a pedicure!I will be back!

If you like clean, then this isn't the place.  The rooms are adequate however the beds are beyond hard...more like bricks covered by a sheet.  The bathrooms are disgusting.  They make a gas station restroom seem like a palace. The baseboards looked as if they had never been cleaned...covered in hair of all kinds) and who knows what else.  Gym showers are cleaner and more sanitary than the showers at this hotel.  The walls and floor of the shower were covered in mildew and mold.  We had to put towels on the floor just to take a shower. There is no way we would stand on that nasty floor.  The only redeeming quality is the lady that works the front desk....Ms Betty.  She was so sweet and the most helpful lady ever.  She went out of her way to offer recommendations and advice.  Bottom line...spend the extra $20 or so a night and book elsewhere.

Ordered flowers for my girlfriends birthday . Had to get them custom made and delivered to the hotel . They did a wonderful job and the flowers came out amazing . Maybe the best bouquet I have ever purchased . My girlfriend loved them so much she said she wants this florist to do our wedding .

Nice ambiance and the front desk team greeted as soon as you entered the establishment. As a walk-in, I was able to be seated with no wait. I truly enjoyed the deluxe package; especially the warm scrub and hotel towels. Unfortunately, the nail tech talked, laughed and giggled none- stop with the nail tech next to her. Although the establishment was classy the attention was unprofessional. This is my second review of this place and it remains the same.

Excellent and fast service. I had a flat tire and called if I could come over. I was told they could look after it right away, so 15 min. later I was there. It took him 5 min. to repair the tire and only cost 20$. Perfect service, thank you again.

This is the first time visiting this place. My wife and I were looking for something new and not too far from home. We decided to try out, based on the reviews and pictures and I'm glad we did! They close at 7:30pm and we showed up there at 6:15pm as walk-in. We were welcomed immediately. Less than 5mins after we were already taken to the back to start our pedicure. They offered us complementary drinks, including wine. Seats have a massage pad you can set to your preference. 
All ladies there were very friendly and enjoyable talk with. I think Connie went above and beyond with me. I went there for a simple mani-pedi but changed my mind on last minute and asked her for acrylic nails. I had my natural nails. She suggested me gel nails, for my nails not to suffer the damages of acrylic. She could've easily just do acrylic since it takes less time and they were about to close but instead, she took her time to do my gel nails and to try to match the color she already did on my feet. She could've messed up since we were last minute walk-in but I love the color she helped me pick, the length and the shape she gave them and all in no hurry.
I will definitely return and next time get an appointment with Connie.

I went in to get my tire repaired and I was helped right away. Everyone at Fast Track was kind and helpful. Best of all I was in and out in less than 5 minutes. They kept a safe distance and wore their masks the entire time. A great place to do quick repairs.

When J'Adore opened last October, I was thrilled to find a salon that I loved. I loved their look, the customer service, the limitless nail color options, and my results every time. Helen and Wen were my go-to techs. I thought it was such a nice touch that the owner was friendly, well-dressed, energetic and engaged with clients, offering little extras like snacks and desserts throughout the nail experience. I even saw an employee light up with joy once when the owner bought her a designer clutch for her birthday. It just exceeded expectations and I happily paid more for it.

I'm writing to help the owner understand my recent experiences there to see where adjustments can be made to get back to what I used to love. The last two times my gel manicures have been very rushed by different techs. Two weeks ago was Tiffany who was so pleasant and friendly but in a rush to leave, so my nails reflected that. Today I went and had a gel manicure with Tam that left me disappointed again. My cuticles were barely touched after 10 seconds in water and the gel polish is light near my cuticles and darker/thicker at the ends. My mom's nails finished just before mine and there were 3 employees hovering over us quietly as if to get us out the door at 6:45pm. I'm not a complainer by nature, but I did share with them that I was unhappy with how the nails turned out (which I never do typically.) They asked if I wanted another coat added and I said no because I didn't think it would fix the problem, and I knew they were closing soon. The response was that if I refused to offer the extra coat there was nothing they could do. I'm really disappointed because I used to LOVE this salon and tell all my girlfriends. I hope the owner reads this and sees that I'm just a customer offering some insight to help improve the experience to get back to what it was a year ago when it opened. Thanks for listening.

I went in for an acrylic fill in because a friend of mine goes here regularly and recommended I try it.

The pros: $14 for a fill in, one of the cheapest places around. I also thought my nails did come out looking pretty good considering the service wasn't that great

The cons: The customer service. The woman doing my nails burned my fingers from using too much force with the buffing machine. I pulled my hand away and told her my fingers felt like they were on fire, yet she just said "I don't know" and kept working just the same. Later I asked for her opinion on a polish color and again she said "I don't know, I'm not you, I don't know". 

I'm not sure if she didn't understand what I was saying or just didn't care. If it wasn't for that I would have given this place 3 stars instead, but because I had to go home and soak my burning fingers in a bowl of ice, that definitely knocks it down a star.

It's just the best.  Do you want good prices?  Do you want on the spot service?  Do you want informed advice about what is best for you, from a bike to an inner tube?  Fast Track is the place to go.  I'm an avid cyclist and I've been to many shops around southern California over the years, from pro to consumer level, and never experienced better than Fast Track.  The Owner (David) spent a lot of time with me and let me take a bike home for a few days to test out what worked best for me. He ultimately put me on a fantastic bike (to replace and blow away my beloved Colnago).  Luke is a super cool, will wrench your bike beautifully and will give you great information about everything related to what you're riding and about what you might want to ride in the future.   There are some good bike stores in Santa Barbara but this is the one to go to.

Slowest drive thru EVER. Came in on a flippin Sunday and waited like 10 minutes with hardly any other cars in line. Ugh. Sucks that this is the ONLY Starbucks even remotely close to anything else in Hendersonville. Really glad I don't live up here!

Came here while in town for the weekend a couple of weeks ago. Saw that they did the dip powder and requested that service. Kim was my tech and was nice at first but as soon as I asked her to fix the thickness and the glitter pieces that were mixed in with the clear dip she gave me attitude. She also drilled my nails down and this seemed odd to me as I thought dip powder was to be better and healthier for your nails. After doing some research it's true it's healthier BECAUSE IT DOESNT REQUIRE NAILS TO BE DRILLED DOWN. 

So after her attitude I had nothing else to say and didn't bother with her with anymore requests even though my nails looked bulky, uneven and had specks of purple glitter in them!

I called them after leaving, told them about Kim's rudeness, lack of detail and poor customer service. The receptionist was nice and told me to come back for their best nail tech Wen to redo them. 

This was acceptable and Wen was sweet, listened to what I wanted and had to remove and reapply the dip. The only thing is that she drilled down my nails again...and I didn't think that was necessary, but didn't say anything as (again) didn't realize my nails didn't need to be drilled down. 

So Now my nails are thin and sensitive, the dip powder has cracked because the nail underneath is too thin to support it and this crappy/ great experience at Jadore cost me $45.  Yes I tipped Kim a little because everyone needs to make a living. But hopefully she reads this post and starts to be  nicer to clients no matter what is requested.

Neutering my large dog here was an absolute nightmare. My dog almost died. Let's start with the good. I went to this place on two separate occasions before having my dog's neutering surgery here. They were great the first two times. Very very caring for your animal, everything was great.

Then came the nightmare. I have a golden retriever puppy. AHOT told me for large dogs they do a scrotal ablation surgery to prevent it from filling back up with blood after the surgery. They confirmed this over the phone before I came in. When I picked my dog up, the Ablation was not done and as a result his wound opened up on the car ride home. We were rushed to the ER where he spent two days going through thousands of additional procedures (and ultimately the ablation surgery) to make sure he's okay. The ER said not only was there a couple stitches missing and that it didn't look like it was done properly, but that had the ablation been done like they said, this would have never happened. When I asked Dr. Kermit why the ablation was not done, he responded that they do not do the Ablation and that I should not have been told that that is something they do.

To their credit, they covered all the ER bills, but I should not have been in that position in the first place had they done what they said. Regardless of ablation (some places don't do this), the surgery and stitching was very poorly done as I found later. I couldn't see my little guy for two days because of COVID and not to exaggerate but it's been one of the worst experiences I've ever had, for a simple routing neutering surgery.......

I've filed a complaint with the FL Board of Vet Medicine however I feel it's very important to share what happened so other dog owners can make an informed decision on where to take their loved ones. While these types of things can happen anywhere, I recommend you stay away especially if you have a larger dog. I think this place specializes more in cats. Nobody should spend over $400 to go through what I went through, especially given how many places can fix a dog correctly.

If I could give a minus 5 star I would.  Just got home with a bag of 19.00 crap.  I just live down the street.  I thought I would give them one more try.  Choc shake was vanilla, both sandwiches were cold.  The fries I don't think were even cooked.  They were white and cold.  We give up, nobody ever answers the phone or their website.

DO NOT. Go to this salon! They are under new management and are adding a chemical into the top coat to make it wear off faster so you'll come back sooner to get your nails done. If you enjoy spending money then by all means go for it! But after the first week of getting my nails done they were already peeling. Idk about you, but I don't spend $100+ for them to be ruined after the first week! Find a new salon!

I went in shopping for an electric bike, ended up buying two.  David was excellent, made me comfortable with the info I received on the bikes and more importantly, comfortable with service I could expect after the sale.  As it turns out my bike had a minor issue and so I got to experience the service after the sale. Which was important because electric bikes are much more complicated that a traditional bike. It was everything he promised and more.  I would highly recommend Fastrack as a choice for a bike and get service. Great people, great doing business with them.
All they care about is your money. They don't do a good job and they will up sale without letting know.

Pedicure was decent as far as massage went. Manicure water off money. All Polish in toes and toenails chipped within 1day waste of money!!!!! They kept pushing dips and everything else, when all I wanted was a natural manicure and pedicure.

This is my go to spot!
Awesome pedi and mani and shellac!
I guess some people go to be pampered and relax but I want my things done well and quickly. If you are in a hurry they will do your mani and pedi at same time. My shellac last 2 week minimum. Several options with pedi types. 
The prices are amazing! Normal price shellac mani is $20. Right now they have a 20% off all services. So it's only $16. 
I've tried other places In the area because they were new. I always regret it and come back here. I'm going to try the eyelash extensions next week. Only $30
I highly recommend this place.

I had a really great experience! My nail tech was very detailed and made me feel super relaxed! They are a about $5-10 higher in price for their services but it's definitely worth it! This is a brand new salon and it looks gorgeous. The owner is extremely friendly and willing to ensure that each guest is happy with their service! 

I recommend this salon to everyone I know and will continue to attend this salon. It's my new go to place!
I need some coffee and some internet.  The store had music so loud it was painful.  I packed up and left after I could not get employees attention to turn down the noise.

By far the worst nail salon I have been to. I've been getting acrylics with gel polish for about 2 years now so inevitably I've tried out more than a handful nail salons in the Clearwater area. I had friends raving about how good the prices were so I decided to give it a try. Shortly after arriving, I was directed to a seat and the nail tech set to do my nails sat down.
