The set I had on was only a week and a few days old, but they were still grown out and a few had come off. The lady(I'm unsure about her name) proceeded to tell me that my set/tips were too old and needed to be removed and I needed a whole new set if I wanted my nails done. Not realizing I would be charged for a service I didn't even want, I allowed her to remove the week old set. She was not careful about removing the nails, and didn't seem to care that she was ripping off a lot of my natural nail along with the tips. She put new tips on, and when it came time to apply the acrylic powder, she was VERY sloppy with it, which resulted in acrylic stuck to all of my fingers. To get this off, she used her nail file on my SKIN, which made almost every single one of my cuticles bleed. Aside from the ridiculous nail service I got, her customer service was a joke and I was treated like an inconvenience to her the entire appointment. Working in customer service myself, I do not like not leaving tips, so when it came time to pay and tip, I tipped $2. Not much I know, but considering how rudely I was treated, it seemed to me as though it was more then she deserved. She wasn't happy about the tip though, and scoffed when she saw that was her tip and then proceeded to snatch it out of my hand without any kind of gratitude. I would give this place 0 stars if possible. Will definitely NOT be returning.

I love coming to this gym, but the other day my friend and I were on the row machines, and one of the personal trainers (don't know his name but he had a kind of a Mohawk, and tattoos) came up with his client and made the comment "you're going to be doing a lot more than them" I find it extremely unprofessional to make a comment on someone else's workout like that... I've never seen this guy until last night so I think he might be new. If anything, a trainer should be displaying positive reinforcement, not bringing other people down...especially when we are not even his clients, and we were only just warming up before a class. Very disappointed in the behavior of a staff member who is suppose to be encouraging others, if making any comments at all.

I go to sunshine Nails whenever I am in town.  Many visits become field trips as I often bring guests that are in town to enjoy the Sunshine State.  We have manicures and pedicures, brow waxing and I even got permanent make-up from Sunshine Nails.  The technicians are very kind and professional.  I've had many wonderful visits and recommend this nail shop to others.

DO NOT STAY HERE!!  Worst hotel I've ever stayed at in my entire life. Crackheads everywhere. Filthy common spaces (room seemed clean).  Front desk personnel are RUDE and hostile if you so much as ask for an extra pillow to supplement the garbage pillows they have in the room. Seriously, Motel 6 is like the Ritz compared to this dump!

Went to go get a back light and the service was awesome! I was in a rush and they were closing but they were super nice and super quick and gave me a really good price for a light that works great! They also even separated it out from a package for me so it was cheaper. Would highly recommend and it's definitely going to become my normal bike shop!

Friendly and helpful. I stopped in to buy new handlebar tape; I got a quick, honest review of the options on hand as well as helpful advice on how best to apply it. I don't live in SB but I'd come here first if I'm in the area and need anything to do with bicycles.
Fantastic service. These ladies are so professional, fast, and detailed! I can't recommend enough

I'm giving Save A Lot 5 stars for several reasons. 

1. Value

The bargains here are crazy good.  I mean, 39 cent avocados?!?  And I found a 6 pound slab of spare ribs for $8!  

2. Inventory

They carry most of what you'd find in the larger chains.  Granted, lots of the goods are their own brand, but they definitely carry a few brand name items.

3. Staff

The staff was friendly and helpful.

4. Cleanliness

This place was clean.  No complaints in this department.

Note to all - they don't give you bags. It's like the old Sack and Save if you've ever been to one of those.  Bring your own bags and you're all good.

If you want to be a cyclist on the weekend or race the road, track, mountain or cross you won't find anyone with more experience...Grassroots to Olympics and Pro. Fast turn-around and Santa Barbara cycling clothing to wear on local rides or when you return from a trip here. Ask about the great rides to go on. And don't forget the Bro-deal!

Not great, but not awful either. My pedicure was ok, I also had powder dip nails done. Slightly overpriced for what you get. If you're in a pinch, this place is ok. If you've got options you should go elsewhere.

Best bike shop in Santa Barbara hands down. As a former professional mountain biker and Cat 1 road cyclist, I wouldn't trust my bikes with anyone else in town. Dave and Luke are the guys to go to! Professional, quick, honest, funny, and kind. Look no further than Fastrack for all your cycling needs.

Just bought a Trek Allant e-bike from Dave. He is a great guy, excellent customer service and super knowledgeable. This is my first e-bike and I absolute LOVE IT! Great supply of bike gear too. I would highly recommend Dave and his shop for all your bike needs.

On my first appointment as I was getting my pedi and manicure, at the same time. I felt like they ganged up on me. The 2 women doing my mani and pedi were talking together the entire time speaking in their language in front of me. This was so rude!!!! The massage chairs were ancient. The massage chair had bars going down my back. Then a nail lifted after 2 days. When I went back they made me feel like I was a burden. Once again, speaking together in their native language in my presence.  Bad service, sloppy and extremely rude!!

Visiting for the holiday, stumbled into the salon.  As an African American hair stylist, often other races assume I can't do thier hair....so walking into Textures I had to remind myself of that.  I do have naturally curly coarse hair and the little concern I had was erased by Kookai....she was quick (45 min) and had my hair straight from the root yet bouncy! Not a bunch of product, just enough so it wasn't dry but keeping its light bounce. LOVE IT KOOKAI! THANKS!

I went to this gym a couple times on a guest pass to see if i like it enough to sign up.The pool area is nice and they do offer many of classes. The cardio area has great equipment but feels very boxed in with the low ceilings and everything being lined up in a row with no big windows or tvs. I do have a membership to another 24 hr gym but i was looking for a gym with a steam room and sauna. I work late and get to the gym the last hour before they close. So Sat i came in at 6pm and worked out and usually the last 10 minutes before i leave i sit in the steam room. So my first complaint is that there is never enough steam or none at all in the room. There is always an excuse as to why it is not working.The next thing is as i was sitting in the steam room a cleaning lady came in and started spraying a hose full force against the opposite wall where i was sitting.I got soaked and started yelling at her that i was in there thinking she did not see me.She yelled back that she needed to clean and they close at 7 which i was well aware of. I told her it was 6:50 and it was not past closing,i still had 10 minutes left. This was the second time this happened to me.I could not believe a staff member would come in and purposely spray someone with a hose! Totally unacceptable!! So i called the next day and after several attempts was able to speak to a manager named Rachel.She was very rude and kept cutting me off until i finally said to her let me know when i can speak without you talking over me.I explained the situation and she defended the cleaning lady and told me maybe i better not join because she cannot guarantee that i could use the amenities to the end of the night. I told her there are several of us thinking of joining but because of our schedules we would be coming in the last hour .I would never keep anyone a minute past closing as i make sure i am out in the parking lot by 7pm weekends/11pm weekdays.So she told me they have a job to do and she even recommended other gyms! Who does this?? I think all the members should have FULL ACCESS to all the amenities a gym has to offer regardless of what time they come in. Funny thing, she told me she used to be at the Healthplex,where i was a member for years and the reason we all left was because they ran the place into the ground with poor management. So i guess we will look around at the other gyms that she suggested in the area.

Do not go here! Okay, the front office staff were nice(except for one rude, uninterested young woman) but everything else was horrible! Continental breakfast: supposed to be coffee/tea and muffins. NO cream for coffee, no muffins (ran out or whatever and we went down early!) bread you had to make into toast but not even paper plates to put it on! Rooms small and seedy: rusty fixtures, dirty, bathrooms needed caulking. Cleaning staff only made bed and cleared trash. Did not clean sink or straighten anything. Walls paper thin. Holes in very thin, old towels.
I usually do not complain, but this place was not good at all.
horrible job not what i asked for, i came in asking for dip acrylic but she did gel acrylic instead , the males at the salon do good nails though...

Our appointment was scheduled at 3:45pm, but for some reason there were still 5 people ahead of us waiting when we showed up and we weren't seen until 4:50. Communication by the staff was minimal to lacking from a healthcare establishment. We agreed to have our cat tested for worms, which apparently was interpreted by the vet as our consent to shove a pill down her throat without asking first. He also assumed, based on dental observation, that she was 6 months old, when based on the information we provided anyone could tell she is at least 8 months of age. Overall, the service felt minimalistic to us and we will probably look for a better place next time.

One of the worst dips I've ever had done. All my nails are uneven and the top coat PEELED off within 3 days. 

On top of having to wait for 25 minutes at the front when they weren't busy, while two techs sat over at the bar on their phones. The man at the front finally yelled at one of the lady's to set me up but only after they stopped to chat for another 5 minutes in front of me.

Horrible.
This is my review based on the last 2 weeks.
1st order: My order was spot on.
2nd order: They forgot the raspberries syrup I ask for.
3rd order: they gave me someone else's order.
4th: I thought I was ordering something simple, but they didn't get it. 

I

Awesome salon with the nicest stylists.  My husband and I have been happily cut & colored by Adrianna for years - we followed her here!  All they stylists do great work and have devoted followings.  The atmosphere is casual and filled with locals and the prices are very fair.  I highly recommend Adrianna and Textures Salon.

Many many classes to choose from, and there's something for every fitness level and age of participant. Classes are in line with today's trends and there are tons of them and they are included in your membership. The cycle class is interactive, which is so cool. Machines are in abundance, you'll never wait for anything. If you have injuries, there's a machine for it.  I never saw so much equipment in all the gyms I've been to.  The equipment has apps so you can log right into Netflix or live tv.  Mainline has an interactive app that allows you to log in all your exercise and keep track of your work. There's saunas, pools, steam rooms, a day care, stretching room, weight rooms, etc.  There is so many different kinds of equipment, you'll never get bored. I highly recommend this facility. I really don't know how anyone could have a complaint, it's the best thing to happen to this area. It opens very early in the morning and is open to 11:00pm on weekdays.

My rambunctious pup hurt his shoulder in the yard the other day, our regular vet was not open so I took him here. The doctor and nurses/techs were all so incredibly nice, patient, and listened to all my concerns. I have never had a vet examine my pup as thoroughly as Dr. Harvey did. They were able to get us in the office the same day and we hardly waited in the lobby. Great, great establishment. I highly recommend.

I've been a member for over 1 year & have only good things to report. Great exercise classes, clean gym floor & pool, & most importantly, safe & reliable childcare. Melissa, the childcare manager, is A++++.

I had an appointment here with Nanette. I was referred bc the owner lives in my apt complex and heard many "great" reviews. I show up 15 minutes early for my apt and was greeted VERY poorly. They had no other customers just myself. None of the stylists knew why I was there and kept telling me I was wrong and didn't have an appt. Finally a stylist recognized I actually had an appt however "there was a misunderstanding" and Nanette had left for the day. If I'd like tho I can "reschedule". EXCUSE ME!? I took a vacation day as they have horrible hours. Plus NO ONE was there! I recommend NOT going there unless you want to be treated horribly

I moved here in August 2020, and I have given J'Adore so many chances. I had a great person that I worked with for a long time there named David, but unfortunately, he left. I've tried so many other people, and they've all either messed up my nails, messed up my heels so that I had to wear Band-Aids (Mary), and the management has been terrible. I've tried and tried over and over again to give them a chance. I've communicated my concerns and none have been alleviated or corrected. On my third try there, it was my wedding and I brought in my bridesmaids for mani/pedi's and unfortunately the manager Kong set one of my bridesmaids up with David instead of having him for me as I requested. The person I had (Louis) goofed up my French manicure and lost the polish I had chosen for my toes, he spent 15 minutes looking for it and then chose something else. When I realized it was the wrong color, he re-did it but charged me an extra $15! Not only did I have a terrible looking French manicure for my wedding, but I wasted so much of my day before my wedding having my nails done and re-done.  Every time I've spoken with the manager, Kong, he's been unprofessional, argumentative and clueless. He told me he can't help me with my problems! Can you imagine a manager speaking to their clients like that? One other manager, Angela, was once helpful.  I tried to go to a different manicurist once David left with someone who had helped him on my nails before who was decent. Once, I had to leave early midway-through for a business meeting. I paid for it and the manicurist I had said no problem, come back and she would finish the polish. I did go back after calling for the polish appointment with her. When I came in for my appointment, they told me she didn't work on those days! When I told the manager, Kong, what had happened, he refused to acknowledge their mistake in scheduling and refused to have someone polish my nails. I've had this happen once before at my prior salon, and the manger actually did the polish for me. In 30 years of salon services, I've never had such bad service repeatedly until J'Adore. I found a new place called Bay Nail Spa, and I highly recommend that everybody in the Largo area go there instead of J'Adore. Bay Nail Spa has excellent service, it has an extremely calm and quiet atmosphere, it's meticulous about their cleanliness, the management (Tina) is phenomenal-highly professional and my mani/pedi's and service there is flawless!
Wonderful nail salon!!   Very clean and super friendly. Did a wonderful job in the dip nails. Will definitely be my new go to salon.

The only reason I continue going to this salon is because of Angela. She's an absolutely amazing nail tech and extremely sweet. If you show her a pic, you get exactly what you show her. Her attention to detail is amazing. The actual salon itself is not ran very well by management and ownership. You are made to feel like an inconvenience with an appointment and then wait when you get in. Not very friendly but highly recommend seeing Angela.

I really wanted to like this salon. It is beautiful inside and the staff are nice. Professionalism is lacking with regard to respecting clients' time. This is my second time here WITH an appointment that I have had to wait an extremely long time for a service. I had an appointment for a manicure today at 3:00. It is 3:50 and I am still waiting. The last time I was here I had an appointment to get my brows waxed after getting my nails done and I had to wait over an hour to get into the waxing room. We left and got lunch and they said they would call me when they were ready but they never did. That being said, my gel manicure turned out nicely the first time I was here. I won't be back, though. My time is valuable and this salon doesn't respect their own appointments.

Neutering my large dog here was an absolute nightmare. My dog almost died. Let's start with the good. I went to this place on two separate occasions before having my dog's neutering surgery here. They were great the first two times. Very very caring for your animal, everything was great.

Then came the nightmare. I have a golden retriever puppy. AHOT told me for large dogs they do a scrotal ablation surgery to prevent it from filling back up with blood after the surgery. They confirmed this over the phone before I came in. When I picked my dog up, the Ablation was not done and as a result his wound opened up on the car ride home. We were rushed to the ER where he spent two days going through thousands of additional procedures (and ultimately the ablation surgery) to make sure he's okay. The ER said not only was there a couple stitches missing and that it didn't look like it was done properly, but that had the ablation been done like they said, this would have never happened. When I asked Dr. Kermit why the ablation was not done, he responded that they do not do the Ablation and that I should not have been told that that is something they do.

To their credit, they covered all the ER bills, but I should not have been in that position in the first place had they done what they said. Regardless of ablation (some places don't do this), the surgery and stitching was very poorly done as I found later. I couldn't see my little guy for two days because of COVID and not to exaggerate but it's been one of the worst experiences I've ever had, for a simple routing neutering surgery.......

I've filed a complaint with the FL Board of Vet Medicine however I feel it's very important to share what happened so other dog owners can make an informed decision on where to take their loved ones. While these types of things can happen anywhere, I recommend you stay away especially if you have a larger dog. I think this place specializes more in cats. Nobody should spend over $400 to go through what I went through, especially given how many places can fix a dog with no issues.

The gym is awesome, always something to do! Want to shout out to the daycare who make it possible for me to workout! The team is amazing and we walk in and the know my daughter by name and play with her even if that means pretending to make cookies! Melissa the manager and her team are awesome and there is always a member that is cpr certified so it's put me at ease. Great team and great gym!
Make sure you get a price before hand. Confirm with the nail tech what you are getting.

Staci Smith was amazing! Her attention to detail, caring attitude and dedication to creating what is desired is unsurpassed. I took a risk, asked for something "outside" the norm...wanted to create a peacock coloring to try something different. Staci researched colors, finding the he most vibrant...and did an outstanding job. I am a dedicated client now. Give her a try.

Why? I request one thing and they do what they want and how they want it it doesn't matter what you say  you will be ignore, and on top of that i told both to stop gossiping bc she was distracting the other and she was messing up later i found out she's new and i had to wait for somebody else to fix the mistake 3 he's later i left with something i didn't like and in top of that they over charged me. Be aware!! and to put the icing in the cake one tech was arguing with the costumer bc she wasn't doing what she was told to do and she told the customer,, that she was driving her crazy so avoid aggravations by avoiding this place

My MIL and I were on vacation in the area and had two places lined up until last minute we saw this place. It was top notch! The place was so clean and didn't smell like an average nail salon. It was absolutely beautiful in there. The complimentary cocktails and wine was such a great touch. The prices are amazing and the scrubs they use are incredible! 

The woman I had was named Lynn and she was amazing! She knew exactly what to give me for a pedicure and she did fantastic. They don't use the same utensils! My MIL had another gal which I think her name was Tiffany and she did a fantastic job on her. The women there are so nice and love to have fun! I definitely recommend this place for a really relaxing day and also for beautiful nail art! This will be my go to spot for any beauty salon when I'm in town!

Seriously? What's the point of having 2 drive thru lines if there's only one person taking orders? Waited in line 18 minutes here. I asked for a large Hi-C and got a Fanta, didn't realize until I got home and took the first sip. Ridiculous! Get it together!

The lady i had seemed to have no interest in doing my nails and seemed rude. She cut two of my cuticles and left them dangling and also never put any lotion on my hands. She made me feel uncomfortable and like i was bothering her. $50 service! Won't be going back

I'm not sure who the gentleman was at the window- but he paid for my drink due to my card not working. I showed him I was trying to unlock my card but the internet was not working. Story of my life lol but instead of being rude-  he gave it to me Instead. It was so sweet. This is now the second time an employer has paid for my drink. Literally everyone there is so kind and my drinks are always delicious! It's a fun treat for my daughter and I to go. Never had a problem ever we love you guys.

I have been here before and it was good service i came recently and i got a gel pedi and then came in a few days later and got a gel mani the pedi was great color still looks good a week and half later however my nails started chipping two days later. I am very disappointed because gel polish should last minimum 2 weeks.

I wish I had a better experience.

I paid $30 for a gel manicure which is fine- the normal around here is $25-30 for a gel manicure. 

My issues:
1) no hand massage, no lotion, no hot towel at the end of manicure.
2) Not offered a beverage like they claim 
3) nails were not filed or shaped at all -So my nails have all different shapes right now because she decided not to file
4) she did not clean underneath the nail 
5)when I called to tell them about my experience, they apologized but seemed in a rush to get off the phone with me and didn't seem to care about my poor experience. 

Pros:
1) Beautiful, relaxing atmosphere -Everything is brand new
2) Extremely Sanitary -clean tools opened in front of you 

I think that if I paid $30 I should get the entire manicure I paid for not half of it. When I called the manager she told me "You should have had a massage with lotion and hot towels included in your manicure." 


If I ever go back, I will make sure to be with a different nail tech who will be more thorough and detailed.
Love this club, clean, great facility, lots of amenities and equipment is modern and updated. Easy 5 stars!

This McDonald's needs a complete change in management. Every time that I visit this location they keep getting my orders wrong. The dispatcher that usually works in the mornings shifts always has a bad attitude. Today when I double checked my order and told them that I was missing an item, the dispatcher grabbed my bags and proceeded to touch the food with her bare hands (in the middle of a pandemic with no gloves on). She then proceeded to argue with me, even though I showed her my receipt for my order.

Avoid this location at all costs unless you want to catch Coronavirus. These people should be ashamed of themselves, there are so many people currently loosing their jobs in the food industry who would love to get a decent work opportunity.

Ok, this place is beautiful and quaint, and if you're a partier this is really a nice place to stay. That being said, we wound up with a room on the bottom floor, and for the first night we didn't have any noise. The second night was definitely not the same, and we could fully hear people's conversations happening above us. Any time they did anything we heard it. Didn't get any sleep the second night.

Also, the mattresses were hard. I've slept on concrete softer than this...
I'd give this place 0 stars if I could. So sick of waiting in the drive thru line for 20 minutes and they only do one speaker at a time. If you're in a rush or have somewhere to be, go anywhere else.
Great music store and great service. Collection of merchandise. Friendly staff. Good prices.
I usually love my nails when I leave but my dip manicure started peeling almost that night. I had it done on Wednesday for the 4th of July and today is the Saturday the 4th. So disappointed.

Yeah this place pulled the old bait and switch routine. I asked for the buy one match one deal and of course that's what she rang up but I get to the window to pay and all of a sudden it's twice the normal amount I explained to her again what my order was and she ended up giving a ton of attitude saying that's what's wrong you white boys wanting something for nothing. All I wanted was what was on the advertisement board when I placed my order. So I told her to forget it that I would go to her closest competitor. Sloppy rushed work, overpriced with hidden charges tacked on at the counter. $75 extra charge without asking me prior. Terrible communication and zero desire to correct the work that is now lifting. I've never had such terrible service literally all around. The shitty communication might be acceptable if the work was quality. Fail on all levels, don't waste your time or your money. I had to get mine fixed after I spent $150 on a dip mani and pedi. Extreme and ridiculous. Shoddy work.

This place is very large and beautifully decorated.  You can make an appointment online and choose who and what you need or you can just walk in. They do much more than nails, such as waxing, eyelash extensions and eyebrows.

Textures is such an amazing place, I was surprised when I didn't find it already on Yelp.

I always love going here to get my hair/eyebrows done - it is definitely my go-to salon in Plant City. Just for reference, they also do nails, but I have never gotten them done here before so I couldn't tell you much on that.

On there website there is a little more information about their stylists and technicians; however, I personally recommend Kookai. I have gone to her for the past 8 years now and am never disappointed. She is super sweet and always seems to understand exactly what I want. 

Definitely check this place out if you are looking for a new salon - Textures is one of the best.

OMG!!! These crepes are incredible!  I heard a gentleman in line say they were life changing.  I woofed my down.  We both got the hot chick.  Loaded with chicken, cheese, garlic, green onions,  and aioli for $8.00. CarrieLu is the crepist!  I literally want to walk back across the street for a dessert one.  The crepe itself is the most delicate flavorful crepe ever.  At $8, she must be losing money with the amount of goodies inside.

CarrieLu herself is extremely friendly and chatty!  Lucky for all of you, she can be located on Friday and Saturday nights at the Loving Cup from 10pm and 2am and Sundays for brunch at Pignic from 12 to 5 pm starting May 1st!  Both are will provide the alcoholic beverages to accompany.

We will definitely be returning soon, probably when I walk back across the street for dessert now!

Went across the street!  We had a chocolate chimp with hazelnut spread and banana and one with brie and blackberry.  We have died and gone to heaven!  We loved them both, but we LOVE the brie and blackberry!  CarrieLu's crepes ARE A MUST BEFORE YOU DIE!!!

I may be a guy walking into to get a mani - and carry a purse - but doesn't mean I'm looking to have my nails done trashy. Clearly walking in my nails were polished with barely there color and when I was asked what color I want, I said something similar - barely there pink. The condescending women next to my stylist gives her this hot pink with sparkles in it. Really? Could you guys be any less professional. Couldn't WAIT for my visit to be over. Told her to skip the polish I just wanted to leave. She did a horrible job filing my nails, completely uneven. I came in square nails - left with unmatched rounded ones. Horrible salon, horrible job, horrible customer service.

This is by far the best gym I've ever joined. The equipment is updated and diverse, the staff/trainers are incredibly friendly, it's always clean, and I rarely have to wait for equipment. The recurring trainer and body composition check-ins are a unique added perk I've never encountered anywhere else. Highly recommend checking out Main Line if you're in the area!

The gym is beautiful.  Clean, bright, well kept and everything you would need to work out.  Price is not cheap, but more than reasonable for everything that is offered.  Client base is really a mix of young, old, in shape and new to exercise and are very pleasant to be around.

The reason for my review is the atmosphere of the trainers.  There are A LOT of personal trainers at all times.  The other morning I was there and counted 11 working with clients at once.  I love personal training and use it often, but this becomes a problem because there are so many at one time.  Most times I am there they are taking up all of the areas, moving equipment around and setting up mats and clients in the middle of weight machines so you cannot get to anything.  I would also say 85% of these trainers are very young and not customer service oriented.  They butt in on machines (with their clients) and I had one reach for the same kettle-bell as me and tell me I could not have it because he needed it for his client.  I've belonged to many gyms in the last 20 years where training is offered, but have never seen it to this level.  I am sure this is how they plan to make a big chunk of their money, but they need to keep in mind the non personal training client base who are trying to use the areas they are paying for.

I realize the place is new so maybe some limits to the amount of trainers on the floor at times and some extensive customer service training for all staff would go a long way.  I hope they adjust things, but for now I have canceled my membership as it is too much to pay to wait around for changes.
Everyone was so nice and welcoming. Best pedicure I've had. I almost fell asleep, it was that relaxing. My nails look great too!

I've been going to this place consistently for a few months now and never had a problem until my last trip here. I asked for a french manicure and the nail tech suggested to do the dip powder since it lasts much longer even though it is a more than a shellac manicure. (Little did I know they would chip within 2 days) While she was doing the tips I let her know I really did not like the shape and how inconsistent the nails were. Some were long and some were short, some tips were thin and some were thick. She told me to "trust the process". She didn't clean up the nails before putting on a top coat, causing there to be nail file dust trapped on my nails. I repeatedly told her I didn't like them and all she told me was that I can come back and they'll take it off for free. I was going out of town for a few days so I couldn't go back immediately. Now today I called and explained to the manager that I was unhappy and didn't want to come back. She once again offered to take them off for free but since I really did not want to return I told her that I would prefer a refund and to take my business else where. The manager gave me a bit of an attitude and just kept repeating that there's really nothing she could do about it. If I could give this place negative stars I would. So disappointing that all they care about is taking your money regardless if you leave unhappy.

Great bike shop.. Dave the Owner is super knowledgeable and experienced.. He took great care with my bike purchase, and has everything riders/racers may need (including repairs:) Positive experience, thx!

I just joined this gym a few weeks ago and I love it! From the first second we walked in everyone at the front desk is very friendly. We met with Rachael to sign up she was really great! 

The gym is clean with every machine you can think of. 

I love the fact they have a nurse evaluate you and do a full body scan, with this you can see your progress every 3 months. 

I loved the fact they were having a special to start with 3 training sessions. 
Wasn't sure if i would use them, I've worked out for 7 years I knew what i was doing right? I took a year off from working out and thought I would give trying a trainer a shot. Boy was I glad I did!  I met with Kurt who was very professional he took his time with me, he took time to get to know me and personalize a routine for me. Kurt showed me equipment in the gym I never knew existed, so many new ideas and routines it was great. Kurt  made going back to the gym exciting for me again. I left the gym every time excited to go back even though I was sore  it's a good kinda sore. Kurt motivates you and cheers you along on some really tough moves but keeps ya going. Kurt is a huge asset to mainline if you get him as your trainer you would be very fortunate and ripped if you can afford to keep up the sessions 

The only downside to this gym is the training sessions are pretty $$$ for me. I wish they had smaller personal packages that were not as $$$

Very happy with this location I have passed many times while shopping at Largo Mall. I got in quickly without an appointment. They are following COVID protocols. My So Soft Pedicure was fantastic. David went above and beyond. Best leg and foot massage I've had at any local place. I will definitely be visiting again!

If you like an over priced gym with a pool that is closed more than it's opened- this is the place for you! 

If you like a gym that shuts off the TVs and Music well before they close-this is the place for you!

If you like a gym that is 90% cardio- this place is for you!
Fantastic service!!!!  Love Kaitlyn and her staff!  They take care of pampering their customers.  Great prices too!  Highly recommend!

I used to be faithful to this salon.  Used to.  The final straw was being pressured into getting my brows waxed. I went in for only a pedi. Next thing I know, the girl is telling ME I needed a wax. Ok fine, I'm too tired to argue.  But wait, let's back up a little to an occurrence from last year....

I had gotten a mani/pedi. One lady down at my feet, another up at my side working on my fingernails. Yeah, it's efficient for them, but I don't care for that. At that point you're just being processed, not pampered and it's for THEIR benefit, not yours.  When I went to pay, I paid, and gave the girl $16 singles to split the tip. I tend to overtip sometimes.  I have NO idea if she shared the tip. After I got done, I sat down to wait for my hubby to pick me up and the pedi lady approached me and said I underpaid. I owed $7 more dollars. She actually blamed me for underpaying. What?  No, you effed up because you failed to give me your full attention. Instead she was talking across the salon, laughing and checking her phone, most likely talking about us customers.  I begrudgingly paid the other $7, and I was so blind with rage I walked out. A few minutes later I went back in to confront her. In front of the whole shop. I said that I had already paid, that you should NEVER blame the customer for your mistake, and did you even give the mani lady her share if the tip?  She really had nothing to say instead I know, I know, but you need to pay more......you know what exactly?   I wasn't trying to rip them off, I signed the credit card slip like usual, trusting that they itemized it properly. Their mistake. Not mine. 

"Caitlin" was not there that day, I think it was a Sunday. I wonder how and if she would've intervened. After that I stopped going.  But months later I though what the hell, give them another chance.  

Again, for a pedicure. I picked my color. The girl insisted on a different one, saying that it's a better choice. Seriously?  I'm the customer, I'm paying you! I have never felt so disrespected and undermined. Then the wax thing, ushering me to the wax chair without really asking me IF I wanted that. This was the end of my going there. 

Also, put your phones away and kill the stupid TV AND Pandora. One or the other, not both. On down time, there shouldn't be 4 techs lounging in the pedi chairs pecking on their phones. Unprofessional!  And stop talking amongst yourselves and give your clients the respect and attention they deserve. They've lost my business forever, even though they're literally 2 blocks from my house.

I have bought two bicycles from Fastrack and gone to them numerous times for repairs as things wore out (I ride a lot).  Dave Lettieri and Luke Johnston are always friendly, but most importantly are two of the best bicycle mechanics I have ever encountered. Also, they don't gouge their customers for repair work.  I don't want them to raise their rates, but I am always pleasantly surprised by the labor cost of repairs. This is where I will buy all my cycling gear as long as I live here.
My favorite place in Hendersonville, the hand crafted drinks are always perfect, very friendly staff

I had a really great experience! My nail tech was very detailed and made me feel super relaxed! They are a about $5-10 higher in price for their services but it's definitely worth it! This is a brand new salon and it looks gorgeous. The owner is extremely friendly and willing to ensure that each guest is happy with their service!

Mind and body relaxing spa using quality products within their services.

Had an appointment on a Friday afternoon while in town with Amanda. Pink and white SNS looked so elegant and classy and the pink was not too dark nor too light, as requested. She took her time and tried to be as gentle as she could with my recent hand injury.

Great experience and another appointment with Amanda will be made my next staycation. If you are a local, check out the VIP Club.
While visiting Santa Barbara, I walked in to check out their bikes. Their inventory was low due to the pandemic but the staff was friendly and informative. Would definitely recommend this bike shop.

This is my first time I've come here, after seeing pictures of it online and the reviews were great. First off the "receptionist "are no older than the age of 14. They were very unknowledgeable of what they were doing and had no clue how to help me book an appointment. At 2:45 PM I asked when the next appointment is for a full set of acrylics and they said we have six bookings at 1:30 PM. I don't really understand how that's relevant? After waiting for over 25 minutes they told us to pick nail colors. I was with my friend and specifically asked on the phone to be sat next to her, that is why I called ahead because I know it is difficult for two nail techs to have openings right next to each other. Once they started they said there was no way that we could sit next to each other and it caused a commotion. I asked for coffin shape nails which I've had the shape over the course of three years and I do not think that these nails represent a coffin shape. Every single nail looks like a different Shape, thickness , width. My ring finger it looks like a square oval and you cannot tell in the pictures but in real life the edges are very crooked and lumpy and un-uniform. The nails are extremely thick and she charged me five dollars extra for coffin shape without telling me. She would refuse to let me have regular nail polish and insisted that I got gel, so I had to change my colors and not even get the colors I wanted. It was $45, I am just very picky but I did not think the service was great at all especially compared to the reviews on here.
Best nail salon I've gone to in YEARS!! Kaitlyn is the sweetest and she really cares about her customers. Everyone goes above and beyond. I'm so glad to have found a good nail salon down here.
Same day service!  Quick and easy EBike repairs as I walked around the Paseo Nuevo just nearby. Another time I ate at the Blue Owl while my ride was fixed!

I just got the best experience ever! Caitlyn did an amazing job for me. She made sure I got exactly what I wanted and really paid attention to details. The size shape, inside the nails etc. She made me feel very welcome and also gave me great recommendations since I'm new to the area. Also loving the pedicure and great attention to details not to mention the nice foot massage and all that while using the chair massage. I can't wait to go back!
It was my first time here! Loved Mia and Helen! Red Carpet Treatment! Clean, efficient, Excellent!
This was my first time going here and i'm definitely coming back. I got a dip and powder and i love them! Amanda was so nice. Very nice salon.

Fast order and pickup. Kid who punched my order was cool kid. Cheeseburger was decently 'soft', not flat like a pancake. Too much of a wait. Nice sunset from parking lot in Hermitage!

Rebel review: 4

Horrible.. It took everything in me not to laugh with how bad my service was. She legit flung my dead skin from the bottom of my feet into the footpath my feet were still in.. other stations were dirty and not clean. The tools looked dirty in my option.  Did not feel good at all.

I stopped in to this location for the first time, and was blown away not only by how clean it was, but how beautifully decorated it was, and how incredibly nice the staff was. Everything was exceptionally clean, they used liners in all of their pedicure tub's, and I saw team members cleaning the entire time.They assisted me right away, and I sat down in a pedicure chair with Maria. Maria was amazing asked me all sorts of questions about my preferences and then also got to know me almost like a friend. It was one of the most thorough pedicures and manicures I've had in a very long time. I would highly recommend this location and even more so recommend Maria! I will definitely be back.

I loooove this place. Caitlin and all the girls are amazing. They are very respectful of your time. If you are in a hurry they can do hands and feet at the same time. Or you can fully relax and get separate. They do waxing and eyelashes. Best prices I have ever seen. I've been coming exclusively here the past 8 years. They are sanitary and safe. Always wear a mask and have plexi glass at nail stations. The honey and milk pedi is incredible!

I have been there 3 times now and each time they quote a different price...I was made to feel "cheap' when I questioned it..this last time ..I think it was the manager...she rushed through it all..caught my finger with the electric file...cut my nails really short..did flat top when I asked for round..tried to talk me out of nail polish..just powder color..and left me feeling very unsatisfied. There is  a sign in the window saying 20% off so they dont take your coupon...I will be looking for another nail salin in future.

I went to Sunshine Nails on Highland Ave to get a mani/acrylic and pedicure. In two days I lost a nail. I went back to get fixed and I was treated like a burden to them. Now 5 days later, I now missing 4 more nails. On my pedicure, they didn't even do a proper service!! I do not recommend this shop unless you want to go back 10 times to have missing nails replaced. I did not like that I was getting a mani/pedi at the same time. I felt ganged up on. This was not very relaxing. Not to mention the two women talked the whole time in their primary language. This was so RUDE!!! Not to mention the massaging chair was so ancient that there was a bar that was going up and down on my back. This was miserable experience!!! Rude, shitty work, and not at all relaxing!! Save your money and go to a more reputable establishment!!!!!! One more thing, their nail art looks like a 1st grader did     it!!! Please think twice before considering Sunshine nails!!!!

My wife and I belonged here for a little over a year. Like many gyms it is a little pricey. However you get a lot of value if you use its many amenities. It has a huge hot pool, a warm therapy pool and a cool lap pool. All inside. It has a steam room and sauna in both men's and women's locker rooms. It also has family locker rooms which would make it very convenient when going to the pool together. It has babysitting which I believe is free. It has a ton of free classes in 3 studios and a cycle room, with everything you can imagine.There are a few paying classes including Pilates. Every 90 days you are eligible for a very thorough nurse evaluation and personal trainer evaluation. The personal trainers identify weaknesses and areas that you want to improve and tailor a workout plan for you. Overall a very great gym if you are willing to spend a little. I believe our membership ran about $112 per month for both of us.
Food poisoning!!! My husband and I have been beyond ill and in the bathroom since we've ate here in the morning.... thank goodness my son didn't want to eat!

I would give this place negative stars if it were allowable. The service was terrible, my order was not right even after I had to repeat it for separate times, I was overcharged, and even then Everything that was listed on my receipt was not in my bag. I tried calling the store and after being put on hold forever and a day, the person then said I could come back by bring everything in and then they could try to figure out what was wrong. I had to work, so I told him you know what I will never come back to you again and I will never stop at this location again. Very poor service all the way around

I mean come on it's Starbucks and Starbucks is amazing !!! This is got to be the best place to grab a bite to eat or the main purpose COFFEEE !!
Forever a customer

This is the best bike shop. Everyone is knowledgeable and friendly. We had a bike with a broken chain and I walked in and it was fixed in less than 10 minutes. I highly recommend this place for anyone who needs bike repairs or maintenance.
Love this gym. It definitely has everything you need and then some. Super clean and the staff is so friendly. And there are a great mix of age and body types.  It makes me feel like I fit right in.

OMG. This LBS. My husband and I got into Santa Barbara for the century and discovered his chain had a broken link...30 minutes before all of the shops closed. We frantically called around and no one had the chain we needed. This was the first shop I called, and I was told they didn't have any in stock but if we found one elsewhere and were told it couldn't be installed immediately to bring it in and they would do it. Again, right before closing! My husband had all of his extra links in the toolkit he brought for the trip so we ended up bringing it here to Fastrack to try a last option chain repair and when we arrived they had located what we needed and they had us in and out the door within a few minutes. Service is obviously outstanding, and the guys were so nice. I live 4 hours away but I can tell you this would be my go to if we lived in the area.

Overpriced and not good quality of work. It's been 6 days and my dip nails are already chipping. The nail tech who was also the manager destroyed my cuticles and did so AFTER the dip was done creating an already noticeable gap between nail and beginning of the dip. He also missed almost every edge of each nail with the dip by not painting the entire nail (as you can see in the pictures). Charged $15 for a "manicure" which only consisted of cutting my cuticles so badly and also bled. Then had an issue at the end with the pedicure tech who said I pointed to the $50+ pedicure when I infact showed her the "menu" and pointed to a different one. Completely over priced for awful work. Don't go here because it looks luxury like I thought.
Kaitlyn is great! The shop is clean, and they worked me in graciously. I will be back!

I had to go here once just because my usual go-to Dynalife Dx isn't open Saturdays. I usually go to the one in Old Strathcona because it is more handy.

This location has a much smaller waiting room which can make it very crowded on a Saturday morning when everyone is sick and this is one of the few open on the weekend. When I went it was around noon on a Saturday and most of the chairs were taken and the line-up was about 15 people deep. I only had to drop something off so I didn't have to experience the wait. I did here the front staff tell the woman in front of me the wait was well over an hour though.

The staff seemed nice with my limited interaction and there is a ton of parking here.

It's a cool place. I suggest joining if you will take advantage of the classes or amenities, otherwise it's the same as any other gym. I would ideally like more to be offered since it's expensive but all in all I do like the facility. They have a good café and the urgent care was good too. My biggest reason for the review though is the trainers. There's one in particular that's a tool. He's flirted with my girlfriend and some other girls I know. He's just a little inappropriate in general. Because of this I steer clear of the trainers even though I think there's just the one bad egg.

I have come to this location several times before and they have told me that they are cash only after 10 PM. I have come with cash and they have told me that they are card only. Tonight I have been in the drive-through for 15 minutes without a single car pulling forward. I keep trying this location because it is the closest to my home and I keep thinking that it will be easy for when I am randomly coming home late at night, but it proves time and time again to be inconvenient and terrible customer service.

If you don't want your nails filed until they are burning, super thick acrylic, cuts from the file on your fingers, and rude nail techs, GO SOMEWHERE ELSE. I can't say enough terrible things about this place. One star is doing them a favor. I paid $125 for the ugliest white tip set and the most unrelaxing pedicure.

Found this place near where we parked since my gf and I were going biking in the area and her tire had a flat. 

The service here was very friendly and they were quick to repair the flat which was $20. 

They also pointed out some defects when the bike was assembled and offered to fix it which was another $20. Overall a very nice bike shop with knowledgeable staff. Too bad this place is so far from us or I would go back for anything bike related!
Caitlyn had amazing service. Very quick and well done.
A bit loud, dark and booths small, the service & the cheese fondue was exceptional

My hs friends met up here and had a good time. We started with calamari, which was a little oily so not crispy. My ribs and chicken combo was good, but my chicken was a little dry. The salads were delicious though.

It is official, I have become my parents.  I never really saw myself shopping at Homegoods, but my how times have changed.

I was looking for a couple of last minute items for Christmas and Homegoods delivered.  I was really surprised with the merchandise in Homegoods.  They had some really cool items for the home, especially the kitchen.  I got some jalapeno and garlic stuffed olives which were a great add-on gift.

While I did not pick any up, they also had a nice selection of reasonably priced knives and cutting boards among other goods.  There was a nice set of bamboo cutting boards that I had my eyes on as well but there was no way I could come home with a gift for myself.

In addition to kitchen goods, the store has all the other levels of the home covered as well.  I thought that the prices were pretty reasonable but with anything, it probably pays to shop around.

I was impressed with Homegoods and would definitely visit again.
Perpetual long lines because they can't figure out how to create or utilize an express line

Went here with my girlfriend and her daughter. 

First, no one sat us. The host pointed at me and then at a table from across the room. 

Then, we sat waiting for someone to come to our table as 5 other groups (not an exaggeration) were seated and served. We left before anyone ever even spoke to us. 

Our child was well-behaved and there was no obvious reason that someone would not want to serve us. They were actively ignoring us, and it wasn't even busy. I don't know whether it was because we had a child with us, or because I'm white and my girlfriend is Indian, or maybe they just didn't like us. 

I suggest the Oyster Factory across the street. Everyone is very friendly and no one will be rude to you.
Got the banana cream smoothie at wawa. It was expensive at $4 but it tastes great. Try it next time.

This restaurant was the last place my boyfriend and I were to eat at together... pending we were on the verge of breakup.. we dressed up very nice.. 
I tried the vodka infused pineapple martini...beware! THESE ARE SUPERB. could not taste a lick of alcohol in it! this is the type of drink all should be careful of though... b/c it sneaks up on you later on.
For dinner we started off with the mushroom soup WHICH I GIVE A FULL 5 STARS TO!!!!!! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT!!!!!
then we had steak with blue cheese topping and a baked tomatoe...very good. and alot of wine to drink......
end result... a very pricey last dinner!!! and this was the night we conceived.... and we're still together and stronger than ever. :)

so 4 stars out of 5 only because I cant go back there again and keep trying the rest of what they have to offer..need to save money...
but it was a good meal and something beautiful came out of it. :)

My husband and I stayed here for a getaway without our small kids. We enjoyed our stay. Not as close as we would have liked, we took a $7 can ride to down town, that night we walked back. The next day we walked to and from downtown... about a 1.6 mile walk, but what else did we have to do, right?!! Continental breakfast was better than others we have had. I would recommend this place! Oh and HOT showers were a plus too!!

1st time visiting this restaurant 6-7-18, Thursday night ay around 8:00pm.
Were seated immediately by a very professional greeter at a nice table with 1 spotlight over it affording a nice ambience but bright enough to see each other and what we were eating. This was date night for my wife and I and we enjoyed the near romantic atmosphere.
Our server was prompt and knowledgeable and took our drink order as well as our appetizer and entree order as we were ready at the time.
Drinks came out promptly and were correct, my wife had lemonade which she said was excellent.
We had ordered the French Onion soup and it cam out in about 10 minutes in a nice crock and was obviously steaming hot. After letting it cool for a short while we dove in and discovered it was, possibly, the best French Onion soup we had ever had. The broth was not the usual "onion water" you get but had some substance to it. There was certainly no lack of onions which were quite sweet and delicious as well as the bread and cheese which topped the whole thing. I usually don't finish the soup but this one didn't stand a chance.
My wife and I both ordered the Prime Rib dip which came out about 10 minutes after we both finished our soup. They obviously have dinner timing down to a science.
The Prime Rib dip was quite tasty on a nice bun with crispy fried onion strips and a horseradish mayo which was a perfect combination. Although the bun was toasted, it was by no means crispy except for the very edges which was great. We had mashed potatoes as a side which we had no complaints about but were fairly mundane. Garlic mashed would have been much better.
For dessert my wife ordered the banana cream pie and I ordered the Key Lime pie. Mistake! We should have just shared a dessert as both desserts were too large to consider finishing. My wife loved her banana cream pie and the Key Lime pie I had was almost the best I ever had, surpassed only by a restaurant in Baton Rouge, LA.
Overall - a GREAT meal and we will definitely return to dine again.
Finally - the service was the best service I've experienced since I ate in the Pen & Pencil restaurant in NYC many years ago. (By the way - the Pen & Pencil is one of those no prices on the menu places -posh posh)
Alexis K. was our server and she couldn't have been better. She appeared when necessary and was absent to allow us to enjoy our meal. She was extremely knowledgeable, courteous, quick and very pleasant to speak with. You have a great experience awaiting you with Alexis K. as your server. Thank you Alexis!

One of my favorite places to eat at. Whether its brunch, lunch, or dinner, I have never had a bad meal here. I will never understood why this place draws so many well heeled yuppies and cougars, I mean, its a mid-priced chain restaurant.  With a look and feel similar to Cheesecake Factory, and similar prices, Redstone is by no means fine dining. However, you wouldn't know it looking at the parking lot full of Audis, Bentleys, and Range Rovers, not to mention hour+ waits on Fridays and Saturdays. Probably because the wealthy, and wannabes alike, all appreciate execution.

We usually go Saturday afternoons, although recently we went for a late brunch on a Sunday. The brunch is not to be missed - $17 gets you French toast, incredible scrambled eggs made with cream cheese (OMG), thick bacon, country sausage, and the most unbelievable hashbrowns that you couldn't replicate if you tried. On the surface, $17 sounds like a lot, however, its basically all-you-can-eat - Redstone is classy so the menu says "extra servings are complimentary." Don't forget COMPLIMENTARY mimosas and giant sticky bun with your meal. Yes, you read that right. 

If your leaning more towards the lunch spectrum of brunch, you can savor a brunch burger. It starts as an already stellar Redstone burger, but gets topped with thick bacon, a fried egg, as well as some shredded rib meat. I could've done without the rib meat... Now that I think about it, it doesn't even make sense to be on that burger... Probably just a way to unload leftovers. Anyway this burger has a lot going on, but is quite satisfying. Comes served with the aforementioned hashbrowns. Twelve bucks. Yes please.

Now, if you miss brunch, don't fret. The jerk chicken fondue on the appetizers menu is fantastic... Practically a meal itself. For me, this is the one item that brings us back, time and time again. Seriously, bring a friend or a date, and start with the fondue. Then, you go ahead and order yourself the meatloaf, with the bbq sauce. Your moms got nothing on this dish. I would also vouch for any of the burgers, they are almost always cooked perfectly, generous in size, and very flavorful. I've never had the ribs or steaks here, as I prefer to go to an actual steakhouse or bbq pit to enjoy such specialties.

For dessert, do yourself a favor and get the giant cookie sundae. It comes to the table in the cast iron skillet it was baked in, covered in vanilla ice cream, whipped cream, and chocolate sauce. Easily in my top 3 desserts I've ever had.

Of course, if youre not hungry, you can always go to have some overpriced drinks and people watch. There's no shame in that...you don't even have to cross the bridge!

I've eaten here a number of times before and keep coming back and getting the same item every time, rotisserie chicken chopped salad.  Their rotisserie chicken is excellent. For appetizer, I highly recommend the buffalo shrimp.  They are jumbo shrimp and have just the right amount of spiciness. While they are a little pricy they are worth it.
I ordered here the last time I was in Lansdale and thought the food was really good. The pizza is tasty as are the calzones.

Stopped in this place because it was way too hot to continue walking to the place I originally had planned. Not impressed. I got an average breakfast that didn't seem to hard to mess up. Over medium eggs with bacon and potatoes. Eh nothing special about it. It was brunch time so I got a screw driver which was over priced for the not-so-heavy hand and size of the glass. Don't recommend. I'm giving it 3 stars because of my choice of food and also because the staff is friendly.

This restaurant has a great atmosphere...very lively and festive. I really enjoyed being here and we had a great waiter. The food, however, was mediocre. I ordered the blackened chicken salad...$14. The chicken was dry and it lacked great flavor. It was okay. Overall a decent experience.

Extremely costly ripping off tourists. Services is not good and the quantity is so little that might leave you hungry even after lunch. This place is close to a Public Car park and crowded with tourists. Trust me, its not worth it. Keep away.
Very goo gumbo!  Great drinks.  Excellent service!

How has it taken us so long to come here? On this rainy, chilly April morning my husband I headed to The Gallery Pastry Shop for some brunch. We were welcomed in by a cheerful hostess who invited us to take a seat briefly (in some comfy retro furniture near the entrance) while she got a table ready. 

Since it was packed on a Sunday morning, we got to sit at the bar which has an open view of the kitchen, where you can see all the staff preparing the crepes, omelettes, and hashes that are a prominent feature of the weekend brunch menu. Normally I'm not a fan of this style of seating (I'd rather not see my food made!) but the kitchen staff was friendly, efficient, and seemed to love what they were doing.

As it was our first time here, our server explained the weekend brunch menu to us- in addition to the delicious pastries + sweets in the case, and extensive coffee menu, there were paper "build your own" menus to fill out. You could build your own crepes or make your own omelette. My husband opted for the egg hash, and I built an omelette with an unlimited amount of ingredients.

While we waited, we ordered drinks- I had a beautiful caramel macchiato, and my husband ordered a vanilla latte. One disappointment is that they weren't able to deliver on the vanilla latte (no vanilla syrup- kind of surprising given their extensive drink menu!). The drink sizes were a bit small in my experience- not the ginormous mugs that you might see other places, but still a delicious drink.

Our food arrived shortly there after (along with the chocolate croissant that I had scoped out at the pastry case!) and was phenomenal. The chocolate croissant came warmed and was flaky, delicate, and chocolate goodness all rolled into one. We took one home as well!

We waited awhile for the check- not sure if that was because we looked engrossed in conversation, or if there is some "unwritten rule" of asking for the check here. Here, the server brings you a check and you are rung up by the hostess at the front who seated you. 

We enjoyed our time here! We will definitely be back for more brunch, but might make a reservation next time (especially if we come in a large group) and will opt for water or drip coffee, rather than a specialty drink.

Went for Brunch... Sent eggs & steak back...weren't close to being cooked properly... Watching the wait staff working and rubbing their noses and messing with their long hair, then serving... Not eager to go back after hearing so many good things, quite disappointing...

Bleh. 

We arrived for lunch on a Saturday afternoon in the middle of summer, anxiously awaiting a delish Cajun lunch in the French Quarter... Oh boy, were we disappointed...

After waiting outside in the hot summer heat for a good 10 minutes, we were seated by the host in a pretty big hurry. (No big deal, it's a lunch rush... Right?)

We were given about 20-30 minutes to look over the menu... (About 30 times over) until my evil glares finally caught the attention of a passing server that asked "have you been served yet?" .... Commence evil glare
(Mind you, every other table had their drinks refilled or orders placed while we continued to stare off into the distance)

My gumbo ya ya was pretty good... My boyfriend's catfish and oyster platter was just mediocre. Pretty disappointing given we waited that long

Although our experience was subpar, the other tables around us seemed to have very friendly and attentive servers. Guess we lucked out

Very happy to see another restaurant in this neighborhood. Tried the lobster ravioli with the salmon cream sauce. It's not on the menu but I was given the recommendation and went with it. The strawberry fields pizza was great, something different. I can't wait to try out other menu items once they update their options.

Service was TERRIBLE! Our waitress took forever to come and greet us/take our drink orders, it seemed as if she hated the fact that she was working their, food was pretty bad. 

I ordered the red beans and rice -Straight out of the box red beans and rice has more flavor than this. Extremely bland, mushy and gross! we were starving and this was the first place we could find, wish we would have yelped it first as their was other places down the street with much better reviews. 

My friend ordered the gumbo and that was pretty bad too, she ended up not eating it. We were bloated and nauseas for the rest of the day! 

Worst place we experienced in NOLA, STAY AWAY!! BAD SERVICE, EVEN WORSE FOOD!!

Love this new place. And their macaroons.... YUM. 
Have been a few times and tried other desserts including bread pudding, pastries, all very good. 
Tip: if you can, sit up on the counter to watch them in action.
The ribs are the best! Also try the banana cream pie ! Awesome!

I went here for the first time this past Saturday.

Positives:
- Ribs were great, really great.  Many people tell you that their ribs fall off the bone but they are mostly full of it.  These actually do fall off the bone.
- Barbecue sauce that comes with the ribs was also great.
- Very generous amount of fries with the meal.
- Brianna, our waitress, was really nice and attentive.  Our orders were a little picky and they all came out right.  

Negatives:
- It was PACKED.  We had a 6:15 reservation and weren't seated until 6:45.  I guess that might be the norm with this place but since it was my first time I didnt' know.
- The indoor seating is pretty limited.  The bar takes up virtually 75% of the inside.  I'm guessing the wait times are much better in warm weather because of the outdoor seating.
- Dark.  I get ambiance but I also enjoy seeing what I eat.  A mining helmet could come in handy here.
- Much of the clientele is quite full of themselves. 

All in all I'd definitely go back but I'd have to hit that right time to avoid any prolonged waits.  The food and service were very good and in the end that should be mostly all that matters.

Definitely a tourist trap! I needn't say more - but I'll elaborate.

Mr. J, myself, and another couple decided on the Gumbo Pot for dinner on New Year's Eve. Not wanting to wait in lines, we were excited when we were quickly seated. Let me point out - this should have been our first red flag. We waited for what seemed like an eternity to order. Our server, who was almost pseudo-excited to wait on us, took our drink orders and then never came back with them. We had to ask about the beverages, flatware, and napkins. Mr. J had ordered a salad and still had not arrived after we finished appetizers and we had to ask for it as well. They gave us complementary cups of gumbo for the inconvenience of waiting. It was tasty, but probably a 4 on a scale of 1-10 when compared to other gumbo I've had in NOLA.

Once our entrees arrived, the disappointment peaked. Two of us had ordered the New Orleans Special which had jambalaya, creole, and ettoufe. The ettoufe had no flavor except for 'burnt'. The creole was watery, glorified tomato sauce, and the jambalaya tasted like it came out of the Zatarain's box. 

Mr. J had ordered chicken parmesan since he was in the mood for something different and the marinara sauce was almost a spot-on match for the creole. Gross! With the hundreds of restaurants in the area, there's no point wasting your time or money here.

Best brunch...fresh baked cranberry and orange bread and a complimentary mimosa to kick start the meal. Menu selection is full of traditional options with a gourmet twist!  We love the all you can eat breakfast the remains fresh as they serve it as you are ready to receive it. Must go- guaranteed an amazing brunch every time!
Gumbo yaya is meh-meh. Nothing exceptional. Try other places before coming here, cause New Orleans is supposed to have the best Cajun/creole cuisine and this isn't the best example of it.

This is a low 2 stars. 

Went here for breakfast and ordered a banana blintzers. They were out of bananas and let me know 5 minutes after ordering. So I got the apple and cinnamon one. The blintzes was good. The topping was not. They were not real apples or if they were they were soaked in the syrup. Not cool and not good.

Hubby had the St. Peter omelet. The portion was huge. The grits were good. The omelet  was filled with ham was not fluffy.

We each had a 8oz glass of orange juice. I had s hard attack when k received the bill to learn they charged $5.75 for each (with no refills). Are you serious? The 2 juices cost more than my meal. 

The prices are insanely high and not worth the service, food quality or timeliness of the kitchen.

Came in on a rainy afternoon not sure about the concept.

So you can choose a bittle.of wine from the market and then drink it at the tables or counter. Our bottle.of malbec  was all of $13 and quite decent. Good is an over statement for this wine snob.

You also order at the counter and the bring the food to you. 

We chose to sit at the counter and chat uo the help while enjoying our wine and pondering th e menu.

I have to say..our experience did not start of good. The girl couldn't work the computer system...they were out of several toppings..she forgot what I ordered after 3 feet. Luckily  we were not in a hurry and assured of this so she relaxed some.

After a bottle we ordered a ceasar salad and arancini for me and a meatball parmigiana for him. My salad was good..fresh and crisp with large shavings of parmesan. The arancini was one huge ball stuffed with ground beef..cheese..peas.and was good as well. Filling as well.

His sandwich was panini style so a little odd but he enjoyed it. The meatballs were a little too garlicky for me. 

After the help relaxed some and we got talking everything stepped up. The girls here were super friendly..tried super hard and consistently checked on us without being pushy. 

Super clean...great prices
.fresh food.

We'll  be back

Have not been here in a year. Service seems a lot different now and food quality has diminished from what I remember. Doesn't seem to match the price point anymore. Ambience is great though definitely a good place to kick back and gave a drink. I see lots more younger people witch is nice.

We came late and had a late checkout. The front desk was friendly and helpful. The bed is very comfortable. The breakfast is ok, nothing special , although the blueberry waffle is delicious. 
The location is great, close to downtown , probably a good walking.

This was such a waste of money and my palette in very unhappy with what I ate. I had the "taste of N.O." Which consisted of "bland red beans and rice, crawfish étouffée which tasted really fishy and old and a gumbo which tasted like sour milk... How does tomato taste like this is unknown to me". My rice was undercooked and still crunchy. This was such a waste of 55$ (included 2 drinks) for me and my man that we still tried to eat most but couldn't do it. I'll see if I can add the picture. I haven't left a review ever, but really had to, because this place was a waste of money. More of a tourist trap. The waitress, however was very friendly, so not extremely overall bad experience. Still only 1 or a 0.5 star worthy. Horrible, please don't waste your time trying to obtain authentic, seasoned food here, the regular breakfast platter is perhaps a better choice. Who can mess up French toast? Or grits.

I've wanted to keep The Gallery Pastry a secret, it's such a hidden gem! But it's obvious everyone knows about because it's always a full crowd!
I've been for just amazing croissants- always hard to choose between the almond or chocolate! They also have some amazing drinks, I would recommend the lavender coffee. Today my sister and I did brunch a savory and sweet crepe. The savory you can pick from a list of fillings, we chose spinach, tomatoes, asparagus, bacon and cheese. So good! Our sweet crepe was the Banana Foster- WOW! A delicious ending to our meal. We also had the 2 egg hash with chorizo from Goose the market, YUM! 
The decor is super cool too. Such a great place!

My favorite Mexican restaurant! I believe that the Smyrna and Murfreesboro chains are owned by the same people, but this particular location is the best. Their food is always amazing, and I absolutely love them!

Went here to pick up my package for the final four fan fest. The building was very interesting just to walk around in. The different decorations and trophies caught my eye, and I got caught up wanting to see more even though I was in a time crunch.
The food was YUM! We got the catfish platter which melted in your mouth!! And a large bowl of the yaya gumbo, delicious! My first visit to New Orleans and the food left a great impact! Will return!

WE go here often. Went one Wednesday night and it was impossibly crowded and noisy and wait was 45 mins. I would of given 5 stars but that one visit was unfortunate. Saying that other times like lunch are usually doable. Love atmosphere when it isn't happy hour or whatever was going on. Prices are moderate and good varied menu and bar selections
Fun place for brunch or to enjoy colorful and favorable macaroons! I have eaten there on a number f occasions and the service is as good as the menu. Of course the pastries are the stars!

Staying in the neighborhood overnight few things opened late, we weren't expecting much only the late night menu was available but the crab dip and jerk chicken founder were great!!! Nice ambiance and service too!

I am actually here right now writing this... Waiting for the last 15 minutes to get a refill on my soda or water. Waitress has a bad attitude. Prices are ridiculous for what you get. 10 little fried shrimp on a roll for 17$ Gumbo had a scoop of rice in it... Some of the rice was dried out and hard as a rock. Since it was stirred in, every bite had pieces of hard rice in it. Certainly can find much better than this place in New Orleans.

The Gallery is such a gem and I really wanted to like it more. The setting is just beautiful as are the pastries and service. My experience here was wonderful but I just couldn't overlook the problem I saw in the display. We came here for the macarons and I was shocked to see that they were out in the open, no sort of barrier between the macarons and anything that happens to be flying in the air (namely flies). 
Putting that aside, the staff took time to talk about all the pastries available and made some recommendations. She was so detailed, we decided to get macarons and the chocolate pillow. 
Lemon macaron was disappointing, very crunchy shell and the salted caramel was just alright. Texture wise it was slightly more chewy but I wasn't too impressed. The chocolate pillow is rich and has a very smooth flavor, I would recommend this to chocolate lovers. 
All the other cakes looked so gorgeous and I would love to try them but maybe next time I'll pass on the macarons.

We've only done dessert but we keep coming back, again and again. I absolutely love their chocolate pillow and my kiddo loves the macaroons. I highly recommend this place, and I do plan to have other foods here eventually. I love the space - it's warm and inviting, and I don't feel as if I'm going to break something here, unlike other fancy dessert locations.
Worst staff ever, dangerous bus drivers. Not kid friendly. If you like dirty hotels then stay here
Very long wait for a simple lunch order ( soup and a burger). Fries were overly salted, burger was mediocre. Won't be back.

What a delightfully adorable place. Popped in for a decadent treat-yo-self moment, and split a couple of items with a friend. It being First Friday we were also able to take advantage of some delicious drink specials; hot toddy and mango Bellini - amazing!

Dear NCAA,

Thank you for an awesome March Madness weekend.  Tons of upsets and super close games.  Pre/halftime/post game shows with Barkley rocks.  

Today, the tournament was shown on ABC, ESPN, TBS, and TNT...all shown in HD!  Mahalos for the entertainment.  Now get rid of the BCS system and adopt this format for crowning college football's best team!  

Next, Sweet 16 baby!

-Avid Sports Fan Dude

This place is awesome! Made reservation on the same day and got seated immediately especially when it was so packed when co-workers and I got there.  Thanks goodness we made reservation earlier and on the same day!!! The food was excellant! It was so good. Everyone said that their dinner was really good. Definitely will go back here again when I am in NJ again. :)
Redstone, aka "The Cougar Den" is upscale and good food.

The Yelp coupon for a free glass of wine was a summer promotion no longer available.  It is mid October maybe they should remove it.  The food was okay our server was a little forgetful but nice. Th did serve as be in pretty dirty glasses.  A little pricey for what you get though.

I brought my Gmc truck to the service department at  the Barlow dealership hoping they could fix  the problem  of not starting. I left the truck there more than two weeks because they claimed they couldn't find the  exact cause why it wouldn't start.So, they finally said they knew what the problem was and they ordered the part that they would replace. Pick up my truck  and drove it home and it hasn't started since.Meanwhile,I'm still waiting for the part to come  and it's almost been two months now. And my truck is still out of commission. I have yet to get a call from the service department  to tell me if or when the part has arrived at the dealership. The service writer told me that it should have been at the GMC parts warehouse on September 22, 2016. It is now October1st, and I still have not heard from the  Barlow service department . Boy,' I've been patiently waiting, Mr. Ed Barlow, but this is just ridiculous! I am asking you to please help me get my truck back on the road. Please! And thank you!
