The sides really are enough to split so don't feel bad about sharing a thing of the potatoes either.

All-told, Gallery is one of our absolutely Indy favorites!

This is one of my most favorite places in Indy.  I love their $1 Mac Wednesday, their pastries are amazing, their cake is sooo good.  They did make my wedding cake - it tasted AMAZING. My husband and I were a little disappointed/underwhelmed with how it looked.  We thought it would look sooo cool and artsy bc we gave them lots of ideas for different textures/colors.  I let them take full control and we wanted them to work their artsy magic.... So we didn't know what it would look like till day of the wedding.  It all ended up being one texture and one color and was boring. We did have different sized tiers, that was neat, but overall, we were disappointed.  Looking back, I should have followed up to see what they were planning to do, but I didn't want to stop their creativity. Learn from my mistake if you get a wedding cake from there!  I have purchased other cakes since then, bc they are delicious.

And just another FYI.  4 stars bc their customer service usually kind of sucks.  So please make this one of your stops in town bc they have great food and pastries, but be patient and know the customer service can be off.

Dear Taco Bell,

I've loved you since the first day I wrapped my mouth around your soft hot Burrito Supreme. You may remember me. I was the size of an Ewok and had footed jammies to match. For the longest time my typical order would be two Burritos Supreme and a Mountain Dew, but then your tortilla Jedis debuted the Mexican Pizza! Genius! But this also made things difficult. Sure I could get one Burrito Supreme and one Mexican Pizza, but that's short one Burrito Supreme. You can't have just one! My flavor holes are only just hitting a plateau stage by the time I finish the first one. I need the second one to peak, damn you! So what's a Bellboy to do? There was only one solution. Go more often. Possibly this was your plan all along?

That worked until college, where you officially became my cafeteria. Oh Taco Bell. To this day I'm grateful for saving me from that hellhole of a barren wasteland called my actual cafeteria where the only saviors were breakfast (which was even more impossible to wake up for than 8 a.m. Geology) and the Cap'n (who should really be an Adm'ral by now FFS). However, eating you every frigging day eventually forced me to be more diverse in my menu selections, and being poor forced me to eat your cheaper options. (Bean Burrito and Crunchy Taco I'm looking at you.) After I left college, I had to visit you less, and focus on actual sustenance, but then you went and came up with the Crunchwrap Supreme. Come on now! That's unfair! How am I supposed to leave you in my past when you make things so hard? You just keep adding things I need to eat! You're like Walmart, except instead of falling prices, I'm enticed by new and exciting ways to fill my colon.

Anyhow, I visited you after catching Thor recently and have decided I will always try to stop by and say hello before or after all future visits to AMC Elmwood Palace 20. It was meant to be, Taco Bell. You and me. 

Forever.

Love,
Scott's Gastrointestinal Tract

I like Redstone.. Just wish they would stop asking " How's everything is it delicious?" So tempted to say NO just for the sake of answering such a stupid question. 
 Sometimes, the servers are offering to tell  the customer just too much without them being asked. The customer can read.

Stayed at this Clarion this past weekend for a girls trip. Going into my stay at this hotel & reading the reviews, I was pretty excited given the amenities, location, and benefits such as free parking and the shuttle-however, I was disappointed with my stay. 

Checking in was a breeze. When we got to our room, as soon as we walked in- we could tell the air conditioner was not running (no big deal- just changed the settings and hoped it would start to kick in). Sadly, the air conditioner was not turning on, so I called down to the desk and they said they would send someone up shortly to take a look at it-great!! In the meantime- my friends and I got ready for our night out on the town- probably an hour and a half has passed at this point. Called down again to check on an update- the desk said he was on his way up. At this point we were okay to just go ahead and leave our room & just trusted it would get fixed. Later that night, we returned to our room and it was still humid and hot as we left it :(. Unfortunately, there is no maintenance/hotel workers on nights-only security. So we spent our first night in 90 degree, hot humid air trying our best to get a blink of sleep--didn't happen. In the morning, I went right to the desk and asked if someone could come take another look at it. The front desk lady was so unempathic knowing we had no air conditioning all night and didn't get sleep but anyways--This time, a maintenance guy brought up a whole new air conditioning unit---this time the air conditioner worked! Yay! Why it couldn't be fixed the first time, I'm not sure. To add to our first night- when we returned to the hotel (roughly 12am) the security guard stopped the elevator as we got on and rudely told us that people have to work in the morning (which would be a Saturday) and if he gets any complaints- we would be kicked out. Let me -remind you- I was with 3 other 24 year old tired girls who just wanted sleep after traveling all day, and had no plans but to sleep nor were we even being loud when we walked in-so uncalled for how he made that statement. Other than some rude staff that thought fixing an air conditioner was an inconvenience to them at the time and a security guard that didn't want anyone to have any fun, everything else was decent. Breakfast was average, rooms were average. Location was a little sketchy around the hotel but only a 5 min drive to downtown which is nice. I definitely won't be staying here again as they don't put there customers first--very sad!

I was hesitant to go here because there wasn't anything vegan on the menu and I didn't was to be "that guy" but some friends were going and I figured I would just have some drinks... I am SO SORRY I waited so long to come here! The staff was awesome and they made me an incredible assortment of food and snacks! Definitely recommend!
The service was superb!  Keisha was attentive and warm.  The food, on the other hand, was horrible and overpriced .  I'll be sure to check Yelp in the future.

I love Redstone!! I've been here countless times and their meals have never disappointed me. Please go for brunch on Sunday's. Their never ending breakfast is honestly the only way to go. It's delicious. I've never had a bad meal here. Beautiful seating outside when the weather is nice too.

My friends and I traveled many hours to stay at this hotel and enjoy a fun Nashville trip. We called 2 hours ahead of time asking if we would be able to check in a little early and also what time we would arrive and they said yes. We arrived at the hotel and we were told to wait 2 hours. My friends and I had rooms each and each of us had to wait an extra half hour even after 3pm which was the original check in time. We asked if we could wait at the bar but she said the bar didn't open until 4pm so we were told that we can bring drinks on their patio. After a long trip on the road no one wants to wait to get into an air conditioned hotel room. A couple of our Uber drivers told us to not walk around the area especially alone because it's a bad area. The great thing about this hotel is how clean the rooms were. The shuttle was also great to have during the day. If they could change anything about this hotel would be the communication through staff and customers. I expected a little more then what I experienced on this trip.
Tastes just like homemade dough (or very close to it)...smores flavor was very good. It is very dense, i could not even get halfway thru the small. Maybe they can make a junior size?

A hidden gem, in SoBro. Close to Good Morning Mama's, down in what looks more like an office park, across from the toy store, you can miss it if you don't know where to look. Amazing desserts, super fancy with edible gold. Macaroons seems to be a specialty.  A nice chef's menu as well. Charcuterie options. Wine selections, coffee drinks.  They are extremely popular for Brunch. Fun eclectic vibe. Outdoor seating when the weather is right. And a fun bar view of the bakery/kitchen.

Took a date here.  Overall atmosphere was good, a little dark.
We both had margaritas which were good.
For dinner, ordered the Chilean bass.
The sea bass was cooked perfectly, served with pineapple salsa.
Had the chocolate mousse cake for dessert...was ok
A little pricy but would return.

YOU GUYS!!! Ohmygosh!! This place is a little taste of heaven. First of all, location is great. It is tucked into an alleyway in SoBro where there is plenty of parking. I went on a weeknight but I imagine on a weekend this place gets pretty packed parking wise. Secondly, the shop itself is beautiful! I feel like I'm walking into a Paris bakery shop when I step inside! Plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. Finally, the best part of all, THE DESSERT! No amount of words will be able to describe how good these pastries are. You have to try them for yourself. The presentation is beautiful and they tastes just as good as they look! They also have specialty coffee drinks which are, surprise surprise, delicious as well. I cannot write enough good things about this place. Oh and they serve brunch too! Yum!

Ate breakfast here, was like warm except for the eggs, and one of my sausages was dried out as if it had been under the heat lamp for hours. Potatoes have good flavor but are not hot :/ service is good, food came out quickly, but would be nice if it were hot. Also they were out of stuff for blintzes, then they had no biscuits, so I had to settle for 3rd choice...it's a Thursday and most other places were closed. Was the food horrible? No...would I eat here again? For breakfast, definitely not. Perhaps I'll take my chance at dinner, but after my breakfast experience I think I'll venture elsewhere.

Redstone is a hot local hang out for a more mature crowd.  The food is exceptional good for a chain, we especially enjoy their buffalo shrimp and chicken sandwiches.  Their drinks are top notches; the  pineapple infused vodka is a must have.  The chocolate cake desert is hands down the best chocolate cake I've ever had.  The thing that keeps you coming back to Redstone is the ambiance; the outdoor deck is a summer favorite. Brunch is also delicious though I miss their pecan cinnamon roll.   I gave it 4/5 because the food is overpriced.

We needed some lunch and figured we would give it a try. Yuck. The service was poor, took forever to get seated on a slow off time during the week, and the overpriced bland food was less than desireable. Save your money and time.

Came to Nashville for a concert and the Clarion was a great spot to stay in very close proximity to downtown. They even offer a shuttle service to the river walk area. The rooms were clean, and their breakfast is larger than a typical continental breakfast! I will def stay here again if we visit for another concert!

Great service and food. Highly recommend their buffalo shrimp and their braised short rib with mashed potatoes!!! OMG, this is my go to for special occasions. Only 4 stars because the wait is forever, which is the only down fall!!

Great food, very busy with long wait time without a reservation (this was a saturday night). The hostess and our waiter were great. Once seated we weren't looking to stay all night and our waiter was very understanding of it. The kitchen is open and the atmoshere is relaxing.

All the staff here are really friendly and very accommodating.  We enjoyed our stay so much and a lot of the credit for that goes to our hotel bartender Justin.  He was AMAZING.  It was our first time to Nashville and his recommendations and direction was beyond helpful.  In all of our travels we have never done so much with not one bad experience.  It was AMAZING.  Thank you so much Justin!!  We will come back to see you again.  We gotch you ;)

Definitely one of my new favorite places in the city. Love, love, love it here! I never have a wait to be seated (and the seats are adorable). Service is super friendly-the manager remembers me and introduces herself to all of my friends every time I bring a new one to visit. I enjoy the laid back atmosphere and the open concept kitchen so I can be entertained with cooking adventures while I relax. Brunch has become my favorite in the city with 1/2 price bottles, create-your-own omelets, and an occasional piano player! I've tried a new dessert every time and have not been disappointed. I'm so happy they are located in my neighborhood because I will be back again and again.

The Gallery Pastry Shop is everything I want brunch  to be. Cozy, fun, imaginative, bright, fresh, and delicious! I had so much fun designing my own sweet and savory crepes (one of each). You can't help but notice the skill and finesse with which everything is executed, too, so you just feel fancy :-D

This place pretty good. Tip, order the Lomo Saltado in the Peruvian section of the menu. It is to die for. The service is why I took away one star, they are polite not rude at all, but not as attentive as they should be, sometimes I have to wait for a drink for a little too long.
I love this place! Great drinks and food is delicious.  Staff is friendly even in the peak hours when this place jumps.  Good girlfriend spot.

I came here for a business meeting, and nothing says "successful business meeting" like ohhhhing & ahhhhing over a plate of yummy desserts. 

The short: you need to come here. It's SO amazingly cute and delicious. The charcuterie, desserts and croissants are all phenomenal. 

The longer: this place is very nestled in the back of a shopping area. From the second you're in front of the spot it's totally adorable. There's tables outside and the front was open because it was a beautiful fall day. 

Allison did such an incredible job with decor. Inside and outside feel so homey, and the open kitchen concept allow you to peek in and ask questions to the pastry chefs. 

It wasn't on the menu, but we used the charcuterie menu to craft sandwiches. I selected the duck prosciutto and the beer cheese. It came with whole grain mustard and tomatoes. It was served on a perfectly crispy croissant. I had no idea duck prosciutto was a thing, but I'm now super glad it exists.

Then, we shared some desserts. The chocolate pillow is next level delicious. It's soft, creamy & super chocolatey. The star for me was the s'mores macaroon. That macaroon puts ladurèe and all other NYC macaroons I've had to shame. 

The service was great, vibe is relaxed, and I would definitely return here on my next visit to Indiana!

Have to say I'm very disappointed with Poochini's Pet Grooming and the services received today. Took my dog in for bath and cut, Received call 30 minutes later she was ready. Really? Bathed dried and cut in that short amount of time? Normally she's there close to an hour. I go pick her up and her hair is not evenly cut looks chopped and uneven. Called after and the man says she moves a lot and she isn't easy. Needless to say I won't be taking her back disappointed that they are supposed to be the professional dog groomer, Even if she does move "a lot" try spending more than 30 minutes for the services. The outcome might look better. Have been taking her there for almost 2 years, didn't seem to be a problem before. Now you want to blame the dog? How about holding the groomer accountable?

3 1/2 stars more accurate.
Above average food for a chain. Friend and I had their rotisserie chicken chopped and waldorf salads , stolidolis.  Lettuce, fruits & veggies were fresh and crisp, yummy dressings and shaved cheeses. Service was attentive.
In the area for business and one of the few places we could find that was open after 10:30pm.

Hands down one of the best in this town! Period. 
Great service. Clean restaurant. Love love love this place!
Great place to meet up with friends. Good food and atmosphere. Waitstaff extremely friendly. Lunch specials are priced right and delicious.

Best pastries this side of the pond! Hard to find, but worth the effort. Always gracious, and a delightful variety of things you just don't get around here. Christmas gift certificates are a nice way to turn your friends on to your "secret stash" place.

Honestly, I debated between three and four stars. The food was phenomenal but the spotty service left me wishing for more. It wasn't too bad of an experience, though, so I'm giving them the benefit of the doubt. Four stars it is.

Half-price bottles on Sunday to go along with my brunch? Yes please! Good thing we thought ahead and made a reservation for our group of seven because otherwise we would've been waiting forever.

The food is incredible. I had two crepes, one savory and one sweet, and I was able to load 'em up with as many fillings and toppings as I wanted. Other items available were omelettes and classic scrambles with hash browns, eggs and sausages. When giving your custom order, such as with a crepe or omelette, you fill out a half-sheet and circle all the ingredients you want added. This took us a second to understand how to order and what the prices were since no one explained it to us for a while, not even asking if this was our first time here.

There were long periods of time between when we saw our waitress. We had lots of questions, from asking for a wine list to getting a real menu with prices and not just the half-sheets. It felt like we were bothering her with our questions, and she all but ran away as soon as she answered one question per visit. 

The food is where this place really excels, and I hope the service staff can catch up soon. I'll likely be back for the crepes, pretty chocolates and the Britney and Beyonce playlist that graced our Sunday morning.

Very rude. Not helpful. Horrible smell when you walk in. Don't eat here. There are flys all over the place and when I asked if they were doing anything about that. The manager looked at me like I should mind my business. Poor customer service. And this was from the girl manager who would rather be talking to her friends at work instead of helping customers at a fast pace. Don't eat here!!!!! Read the reviews and those are from the friends of the.people who work there. lame!!!!

Stores like this have you spending your whole paycheck and you are not evens ure on what you bought and what it is for!

I like this store and they have a very large selection of furniture along with home decorations. Good place to pick up gifts for people.

Spent a lovely Saturday afternoon here on the patio with friends. Everything was stunning! We had the dark chocolate caramel macaroons and the chocolate pillow. Both top notch. They also have a great beer and wine selection and high quality, flavorful hot teas! The decor is fantastic and they usually have top notch tunes playing. Highly recommend this spot!

If I had to rate this restaurant on service alone, I'd have to rate it a 1 or 2, at best.  The folks in charge seemed to really care, but there wasn't much support from the wait staff.  Maybe some staff called in for the Halloween holiday or the football game today?  Not sure.  The food was good, once we got it.  But it wasn't so amazing that I was able to overlook the service. 

Give it a shot if you're nearby and have time to spare.  In their defense, I didn't get to try out the actual gumbo.  So your rating may be higher than mine.
Best Mexican in Smyrna. A variety of things I like to get there. Best salsa in Smyrna. My mom is picky about salsa and she likes this kind most.

Great atmosphere and good wine selection - we only had wine and the cheese platter, and I definitely enjoyed their Malbecs. We sat by the fireplace and it had a familial and rustic feel to it. I'm excited to try Redstone in warmer months to take advantage of their outdoor seating.
Great people here. Gave us advise on an issue and even took our phone apart to show us. No charge! Thank you!
Such a cool experience for a really small fee. Definitely come here when in town. You won see some really cool memorabilia and learn a lot about the history of college athletics.

Find a better choice. I took my mac there. It took months to get it back and it does not function properly and was missing a lot of things. When i emailed them for help with this, they ignored me. So they took my $400+ and basically ripped me off!!!
I eat here regularly. It never let's me down. Can't wait for the buffalo chicken sandwich again!  Service and food are great. Brunch is my favorite.

Mesmerizing! That is what the Galler Pastry Shop was for me. I went here on a date night (pre-COVID-19) with my husband for coffee. We had never been and I've been wanting to check them out. I was pleasantly surprised to find out they are so much more than coffee and pastries, they serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner as well! 

As I was watching the pastry chefs work their magic (behind plexiglass, but viewable for customers), I was tempted to try the Tiramisu they were cutting. It was delicious! We were there in the afternoon, the non-busy time when they were restocking their desserts from a busy morning and lunch. 

They serve Lavazza coffee (and Bee Roasters for cold brew). My husband enjoyed a bottomless drip, while I prefer the more flavorful coffee and opted for a latte. They also have an outdoor seating area on their patio. It's a cute place with lots to see and take in.

Love Poochini's, it's a little far but definitely worth it. I've tried Petsmart, Petco but the quality and comfort that I feel leaving my Chip at Poochini's can't compare. I've never had a problem with rude staff they were very friendly. My Chip (Morkie) can be a little over protective and aggressive at times but the young lady that handles chip knows just how to handle him and they do a good job of making sure he is well taken care of. I absolutely love going and their prices are great. :-) would recommend them to anyone with grooming needs.

I've been here twice now, once for lunch and once for dinner. The food and service delivered both times. This place is pricey, but as I've said in past reviews - I'm fine with expensive so long as the quality of the food and service justifies my money spent. Redstone does just that. The inside is nice, the lighting is ambient, the drinks are strong, and the food is consistently good. Our server Ron was one of the best I've had in recent memory. Killer service, good sense of humor, and attention to detail. I'll definitely be back!
It's Taco Bell, they're open hella late, and they don't screw up your order. Like Marisa said you can expect a long line at the drive through but it usually moves pretty fast.

This place is one of my new favorites. It's been here for years, but I always passed it by as it doesn't look like much from the outside. I usually get fajitas or chimichangas when eating at a Mexican restaurant, but here they have a fajita chimichanga!
They have Peruvian food on the menu that i keep meaning to try, but I'm addicted to the fajita chimichangas :)
Next time.. next time..

They have trivia nights here on Monday nights at 7pm.

The service has always been good and friendly. Porfirio was our server this visit, and he was great. Thanks!

We ordered a margherita pizza with roasted chicken and bacon. While we were waiting, we were told that the kitchen had a problem with our pizza. NO BACON!?!?!  We were a little upset but they offered to remedy this with any other topping they had. We went with a type of pepperoni that I don't remember the name of. They also gave us a free round of drinks due to the complications, which was nice of them to do. In short the pizza is actually amazing and is one of the absolute best in all of Saint Pete. The chicken was very tender and the pepperoni had a perfect spice that didn't overpower everything else. The sauce was just enough sweet but not to the point of being too much. The cheese was stringy and melted to perfection (I think they use very fresh mozzarella, and you can taste it). The only objection I have, is the price. $43 for a normal sized pizza is insanity. The service saved them from getting 3 stars. If you have the time and money to throw away, go visit them and enjoy a great slice of overly expensive pizza. You will not be disappointed.

This place is a hidden gem! The servers/staff are friendly and the food & drinks are delicious! I had the pear lavender latte, glazed croissant, and the chef special 2 eggs over easy with chorizo and fresh veggies! So good! Of course we could t leave without grabbing some pastries to go! The feng shui is perfect!

I went to Sheffield's on my sister's recommendation after a bad experience elsewhere, moments after walking through the door I was pleasantly greeted and asked if I needed any help. I was told to ask for Eric, he promptly came out and was happy to help me start my search for the perfect engagement setting. I explained that I had a diamond that was passed down to me from my great grandmother who passed away at 104 years old. Obviously, it was very important to me that the stone not be damaged or lost. Eric started off getting to know me, never pressuring me in any way, shape, or form. Eric spent countless hours working with me over several weeks, even though I wasn't a "big spender" and his profits would be slim on me. On the day I had to bring the stone in to be sent off to New York where it would be placed in its custom setting, Eric was very transparent with me and explained every step, in great detail. Eric showed me my diamond under a microscope before it was to be shipped off so I could identify that I received the same stone I sent off. I am fairly ignorant when it comes to knowledge of diamonds, Eric was very patient with me and took the time to explain the different cuts and what made my diamond unique (identifiers). It wasn't until about halfway through the process that I realized I was dealing with Eric Sheffield (the owner) this entire time. I couldn't be happier with the customer service I received from Eric and his entire staff, not to mention the way my family was treated when they came in with me to help my pick the ring. Eric has earned my repeat business along with my family and anyone I can send his way. I never thought buying an engagement ring would be "fun", but Eric made it as painless and stress free as possible. I can't thank Eric and his staff enough for everything they have done for me. I HIGHLY recommend Sheffield's for any jewelry purchase or repairs you may have!
I used to love coming to Red Stone, but not anymore. The food came out cold and we found hair on our plate. Also very slow service!

My boyfriend and I enjoyed our stay here. Four days and three nights.

Pros: Friendly bartender. Free shuttle every 30 minutes to downtown until 9pm. Breakfast was good, especially the potatoes!! Nice staff. If you wake up late you still get a chance to get your room cleaned before 3pm. Close to airport..about 10-15 minutes. 

Con: The food from room service was not good. It's from another company? So we waited about 45 minutes to get it delivered to our room.

Other than that, I would stay here again!
Everything is great here. Service, food quality and temperature are consistenly tight. I love the buffalo shrimp and filet. Gf got the salmon on cedar with crisp vegtables on the side. Excellent.

The Gallery Pastry Shop encompasses everything I could want in a brunch spot/pastry shop. To start off with, the ambiance is amazing. The restaurant looks like a shed from the outside but the inside is decorated very cutely with colorful paintings, interesting light fixtures, succulents handing from glass bowls, and more. There is a mix of table sizes from small tables seating 2 people to large group tables that can sit around 10 people. Even the seats have adorable cushions that are comfortable at the same time. To add a little more, the indie music they play fits the ambiance exactly. Now to the food. OH MY GOSH. So good. The menu is simple offering items such as omelets, eggs & bacon, crepes, and an egg hash. However, the Gallery Pastry Shop makes these items spectacular. I ordered the egg and chorizo hash which was delectable. It has the perfect mix of flavors and was just the right amount of food to make you full but not overly full. I also tried an omelet which was probably one of the best omelets I've had. And the hash browns were perfectly crisp. Now for the $2 mimosas on the weekends. YES PLEASE. You can choose from orange, blood orange, or grapefruit mimosas. I ordered the blood orange mimosa which had delicious blood orange juice with the pulp included. They definitely don't skimp on the amount of champagne they give you. 

As for the pastries, they are beautiful. I've tried the almond croissant which is amazing and the best one that I've had. I've been here twice and the service has been superb both times. You can make reservations for brunch which is definitely helpful on the weekends. Another thing to mention is that it has a cute outdoor sitting area which is really nice when it's warn outside. The Gallery Pastry Shop has so much offer if you want to just get dessert, sip on coffee while doing some reading, or get a delicious brunch. I absolutely cannot not wait to come back.
The food was absolutely delicious. My husband and I really enjoyed this restaurant when we visited. We are definitely looking forward to it again once we make it back to NOLA.

Found these guys to be just what the doctor ordered.  My wife and I both had problems with our Galaxy S6s at the same time.  My phone had a cracked screen and hers the charging port stopped working.  The trouble with my phone was, without the screen I was unable to unlock the phone to transfer the contacts to a new phone.  So the doctors were able to combine the internal workings from my phone and the screen from my wife's phone to make one working phone that allowed me to recover my contacts, pics and other data.  All of this the next day and at a very reasonable charge.  Any similar problems in the future and will definitely be going back.

We have been to this restaurant dozens of times and have spent thousands of dollars. Tonight they sat us inches from the kitchen. There is no wall or glass separating the restaurant from the kitchen. Waiters are constantly sprinting by and all you hear is pots and pans and dishes banging. My wife and I were yelling to each other at one point just to be heard. We requested to be moved and the only table they would move us to was the next table over which had the same ambiance. If I am going to spend $100 on 2 meals, I don't expect to be in the middle of chaos. We will never return. Their loss.
Great food.  Lively crowd.  The service here is always good.  Can get a bit too crowed at times, but this is a popular place.

I love this place! I never have a bad meal or dining experience here. Whatever I'm in the mood for (dinner, drinks, app at the bar) I can get on each visit. The smoked and jerk meats are fantastic. Super flavorful while still keeping calories low. The drinks are delicious, and the wine selection is decent for a chain. My favorite food items: jerk chicken fondue, prosciutto & fig flatbread, jerk chicken salad, wings. They also offer a gluten free menu, even if it is a bit small. For a nice relaxing night out, check out the outside patio. They have fans/heat lamps for the summer/fall. I'm looking forward to a visit for brunch in the near future.

One of the nicest hotel so close to our event. We were going to a Titan game versus Saints and came down a day early to go out in Downtown Nashville! We found the room very roomy, clean and decor was off the charts. The shower was amazing with strong pressure and hot hot water. All the staff here are friendly, outgoing and fun!  You will not be disappointed here, breakfast was free and there was a variety of plenty of food. I had eggs and grits while Lindsey had the 8 teeny pan cakes so cute!

Such an adorable cafe with beautiful bakery and pastry items. Outdoor seating had gorgeous flowers and the inside tables were very trendy. I had the pumpkin mousse dessert, which was perfect for fall and tasted delicious. Kind of pricy ($8) for the pumpkin dessert, but nice for a special treat.

The rooms are nice and clean. The bar area however is a joke, the food wait was like 45 mins to an hour (for bar food) we were there for a football game, we were NOT Titans fans. The bartenders ignored us, one of them made himself a drink and clocked out! The bar was packed. $12 dollars for 2 beers that took an hour to get... later that night 3:30am people were partying and carrying on. Nobody did anything about it either. Finally got to sleep around 4:00am, woke up around 8 and checked out, will not stay here again! There's better options around.

My fiance and I are looking at wedding bands for our upcoming wedding and I cannot say enough good things about the people at Sheffield. They have an excellent collection of bands (and other jewelry as well). It is the customer service that really won me over (Rose and I think Nick?). I am forever indecisive and stuck between two rings. I never once felt pressured to pick a specific ring or walk out that day with a ring. They definitely cared about the customer and wanted me to make the right choice for myself. I highly recommend them and can't wait to finally make a decision on my band.

We dropped in for lunch and were pleasantly surprised. We all order side dishes and the amount of food was just enough plus the price was about half of that of the entrees. The chicken and andouille gumbo was terrific! It was light, and very flavorful with a hint of spice that didn't overpower the whole pot. The cabbage and jambalaya were also not lacking in flavor or texture. These people know what they're doing!

After receiving no response from my numerous emails and calls over a 6 week period, my complaint was responded to within 48 hours after posting this review.  I was told that the requested repairs would be made immediately.  When I was away from my home 2 weeks later, I got a call from the owner informing me that the workers were there and ready to make the repairs.  I immediately returned home to find that the workers had jumped the fence and started the repairs when I was not home and without my permission.  At that same time, they broke a brand new sprinkler line. The sprinkler line was repaired, my requests regarding the fence were addressed and I received an apology for this horrendous experience.  I'm still not happy with how everything happened and would not recommend their services.

This was a cute little market we stumbled upon while walking to get dessert. It was really cool seeing some of the local artwork. I wish I had enough money to actually afford something because a lot of the paintings and sculptures were really nice. I know the artist put a lot of work into their piece but it's gonna be really difficult for people to want to buy it if it's so expensive.
I've only eaten here once after a Spartan Super Race and the food and service were so good! It made a perfect day even more perfect! Can't wait to go here again!

We recently stayed here as we are pcsing with the military from coast to coast and thought it would be a good option to be close to downtown Nashville and based off the reviews, it seemed like a great hotel with friendly people. Either those reviews are from employees or the people that left them stayed in a different hotel then we did. The customer service seriously lacked friendliness (other than our bartender). The lady that checked me out didn't say one single word to me and acted like I was bothersome and went on chatting to the other 4 employees that were hanging behind the desk with her. 

The room was so dark, dingy and felt beyond dirty. There was crap spilled all over the cabinetry. The fridge was so tipsy it almost fell out of the cupboard it was in and the lights had blood splatter on then. There was also an old, Rusty, lint filled grate of some sort in the shower that made me feel like there was a camera or something hidden behind it. You can tell they have attempted to make the room look more modern and updated but have done a horrible half **s job. The food from the bar was not great and the price is way too high for the accommodations. You're also in an industrial, back alley feel type area. 

The pool however, was nice and deep and the breakfast was your standard hotel breakfast and nothing to praise. 

If I had to stay in Nashville again, it definitely won't be at this hotel.

I will not return nor do I recommend this place to anyone. The service is absolutely terrible. The waiter simply did not care and knows nothing about service for others or hospitality. When we asked for the manager, it took her awhile to come over, and this was after asking several times to speak with the manager. 
After we told her that the waiter neglected us during the entire meal, she was like "oh, I'm so sorry (with an I'm about to leave work so I don't care attitude).
If you are a person of color, expect to be treated like garbage, because it seems they are only interested to smile and be personable with white people.

Horrible experience. Our waitress brought out the wrong orders for more than half of our table. One entree had a long ass piece of hair on it. Took forever to get our drinks out. Can't split the checks which is so dumb.

When a friend suggested we go to the Gallery Pastry Shop for our book club, I didn't even know where it was located. So glad that I was introduced to this little gem! We went on a Sunday during brunch time. I, unfortunately, didn't know that others planned to eat so I had already had breakfast. Needless to say this didn't completely prevent me from ordering something, but there were many more items if substance that I would have ordered if I was hungrier. For brunch they have separate menus for crepes and omelettes, all of which looked fabulous. I ended up getting a croissant, trillium, preserves, and nuts. To top it off, I was a chai tea latte. Everything was fabulous! I will certainly come back again.

We pretty much only go on Dollar Mac day, but the bakery is great! I've tried about half their menu and I have no complaints. The prices are fair for a fancy bakery, but it's more expensive than I normally like to spend. The staff is always super personable when we go in and I like the environment.

I was waiting for a table at Good Morning Mama's and decided to walk down to see what was in the display case. Knowing I wouldn't be able to immediately eat the awesome looking tiramisu, I opted for macaroons. 

I have been here before for Macaroon's and was a little disappointed that there weren't any new flavors. I went for two salted caramel macs, which were easy to take with me for a post brunch treat. A little pricey, so I will definitely need to have my cravings on $1 Mac Wednesdays!

Although I didn't eat brunch here, I did take a look at the menu. I will plan to try them out soon, as the options looked good. Additionally, it wasn't too crowded, which can typically be a problem for brunch locations in Indy. (It was 12:30 pm on a Saturday)

Used to be a great place for brunch, the family went today and it was less than average.  Noise levels were extreme, service was mediocre and the food was average.  Appetizer came with meal, eggs were runny, and second cup of coffee was luck warm.  We will not be back.

Mom has been been a patron of this place for at LEAST a decade and the service has ALLLWAYS been BEYOND impeccable!! John is a GENIUS! MOS DEF a HIGHLY recommended place to take all your gadget repairs!!! They are VERY reasonable and are ALWAYS honest! If I could give MORE stars I WOULD!!

This was our first trip to Nashville and we were very happy with our stay at Clarion. We had great customer service and were treated with smiles, laughter, helpful hints (like how much our cab ride should cost), and prompt service. I am surprised to read reviews of rude employees because we had the opposite experience. In fact, they are the reason for giving the hotel 4 stars. The hotel itself is standard and nothing fancy. But our room was clean and comfortable, which is all I really wanted since I was there to explore Nashville, not sit in a fancy room. I appreciated the free parking and the free breakfast. Many hotels in this area charge for both. I will absolutely consider this hotel again. Thank you Clarion staff!

Cool little brunch spot. 
We went for a little mimosa and brunch action on the weekend when it was pretty cold and snowy outside. It is a very cool little place at the end of a strip mall. I would really like to come back when it is a little warmer and enjoy the outdoor seating. I went with the omelet and the gf ordered the hash. Both were excellent. They were pretty busy so our service was not the most attentive, But I forgive. My biggest complaint is how cold it was in there while I was eating. Probably not much they can do, but it definitely effected my experience. 

We will definitely come back though.
Poor customer service. They lie to customers and talk in circles. Not professional at all. They do not know what they are doing. DO NOT bring devices here.

Ron our server was Great, knowledgeable  and professional. Suggestions were perfect. Even my picky kid was impressed.  Fun experience!!! Ask for Ron!!!
---

After our recent 10 night stay at the Clarion in downtown Nashville, TN my roommates and I had several unusual experiences. Things seemed to be going well until we came back from 12 hours of volunteering, the room had a strong scent of cigarettes, and the bathroom fan and light was left on. Just when we thought things couldn't get any worse we noticed hot cheetos next to the bed. We would also like to point out none of us had hot cheetos the entire trip so either an employee was eating them in our room, or they hadn't cleaned our room from the last guest. Although all those things were upsetting, the worst had to have been when we came back to the room and I noticed one of my 2 pieces of dubble bubble were missing. Shoutout to our man Deandre who was very accommodating and made our trip more fun!

I had a slice of plain cheese pizza and homemade chicken vegetable soup.  Both were delicious - plenty of sauce on the slice, thin crust, good amount of cheese...the soup was loaded with vegetables/chicken, and the broth was excellent.  Service was excellent as well.  Family friendly.

I don't think I can say enough about this little hidden gem. Tucked behind an alley of other businesses, the Gallery offers everything a typical pastry shop except that it's so much more than just a pastry shop. While, their sweets are divine, they also have a tasty menu selection, offering vegetarian or meat options for anything.
Their indoor eatery has a farmhouse urban feel complete w an electric Jimi Hendrix artwork. Outdoor seating has long picnic tables in the sun or shade, and beautiful umbrellas in a private section w a butterfly mural. There is an oversize chess board that kept my son very entertained so I could enjoy the cool breeze of a September brunch. 
The staff is accommodating, patient and pleasant which means a lot from one busy mom on the go. I truly appreciate the clientele, walking in, I saw professionals doing business and students writing essays. Prices are right on point for a home grown business being reasonable w fresh cooked, healthy choices. On Wednesday's, they offer $1 macaroons so I'm sold!
Clean and close to downtown w/free shuttle. Needs updated. Very friendly staff. Wish they had a hot tub!

I love their salads, take out is easy, parking is easy, etc.

Highly recommend making reservations on OpenTable.

Love their chicken rotisserie salad. Lobster Bisque is delicious too.

I will say that the prices are a little higher than at times that I would rather go to Iron Hill for better prices.

Overall, it is definitely worth checking out. The bar is always packed and during the summer the fire pit and bench seating is the place to be.

Horrible Service All Around. Do not get your iPhone (of any type) serviced here. 

I took my iPhone XS here to get the cracked back glass repaired. There was NOTHING wrong with it internally, just cosmetically. They damaged my camera & my GPS never worked again. Their lack customer service & sarcastic rude attitudes during the 6 weeks of trying & waiting to get it fixed were horrid. I ended up having to purchase a new phone at full price because mine was DESTROYED after taking it to Ur Gadget Doctor!

They make you sign a waiver before working on your phone so they are not responsible for any damages. But what's worse is that they don't care about the work they do or how they treat customers 

I went to apple first to get a quote on fixing the crack. They recommended that I buy a new phone bc the back glass is hard to fix. But I've seen so many iPhone repair stores so I figured one of them would be able to help me out. I was turned down by 3 others because of how new my phone is - they said they didn't have the experience with fixing the XS yet. I SHOULD HAVE TAKEN THE HINT. But Low and behold I found UR Gadget Doctors. Jonathan was extremely confident and almost cocky about being able to fix the phone, he said he worked on a few iPhone Xs' before with success, so I trusted them. After $160 a 4 hour wait my phone was ready for pickup. It looked perfect..until my camera lense fell out and my GPS was not working!!!! 

I took the phone back to the store & they explained to me what they did to "fix" it. Come to find out they un-welded the camera and were unable/unwilling to weld it back on so they decided to take it upon themselves (WITHOUT ASKING ME) to GLUE it back on! GLUE! On a $1,400 iPhone!

As for the GPS I told them if they weren't able to fix it I want my payment of $160 refunded back to me as well as the money to replace what they damaged. And Jonathan  said "No" following up with the response, "I will not give to the full refund of your phone back but I will do everything in my power to fix the phone, it might take a while but I will fix it". ONLY TO MAKE IT 10 TIMES WORSE. 

This is now going on week 3. I have left my phone over night twice and once for two days. Coming near the end of this ridiculous service they email me after having my phone for 2 days saying they 1. THEY RE-BROKE THE BACK OF THE PHONE (originally why I brought it in to begin with) and 2. They weren't sure if the GPS is working but if not they'd give me $100 for the trouble but its costing them too much money to keep troubleshooting so please come get it...IT WAS COSTING THEM TOO MUCH MONEY. The GPS didn't work and they didn't even apologize!

This is a warning to anyone that considers taking their phone here. DO NOT DO IT, They take on jobs that they cannot actually do. They treated my phone as a technological Guinea Pig and had HORRIBLE attitudes.

I have been frequenting $1 Mac day for quite some time now and am always impressed. The macarons are always the perfect consistency and the filling never disappoints. Today I decided to get the almond croissant and holy wow! The croissant itself was great! Incredibly flaky and good sized. There was an almond filling inside the croissant that absolutely blew my mind. It was incredible! I'll be looking for reasons to travel to broad ripple just to stop by for that croissant now.

I have 3 very simple requirements when staying at a hotel. The hotel has to be clean .... no one wants to pay for or stay in a dirty hotel. It has to be quiet .... if you can't rest and relax it is a waste of your time and money and can ruin your trip. Then it has to be comfortable ...not just a comfortable bed. The room size, bathroom and other amenities also figure in to the comfort of my stay. The Clarion checked off all those boxes and much more. The staff was polite, courteous, and professional. The location and design of the hotel was great, the pool was enjoyable and a very nice bar. The room we had was as nice as any traveler would want with a comfortable bed and just about anything you could need. I do want to say the shower was excellent and a wonderful surprise with hot water that was HOT, great water pressure and a shower head with multiple settings that deifnately helps a sore back. They lost a star for the complimentary hot breakfast. It just wasn't that good in my opinion ..... but it was free. It doesn't affect my overall opinion of the Clarion and does not  deter me from staying there again. Of course it didn't help that we found an awesome breakfast place at 417 Union.

3.5 Yelp Stars, right smack in the middle of A-OK and Yay! I am a fan.

This was my second time dining at Redstone, both times were for dinner. It is very nice inside with a a lot of stone and wood. Maybe classy rustic is a good description. It is comfortable and not overly noisy. The kitchen is open and there are line chefs on both sides.

Our server was great. He took a lot of time to explain things and gave us some very interesting details about wild caught Salmon. God help me, but my wife is obsessed with wild caught seafood as of late. We started with a Fig & Prosciutto flat bread. This was very good and the combination of flavors and wood fired pizza worked well. I had the rotisserie chicken which I enjoyed. The chicken was moist and tender but it wasn't anything incredible. My brother in law had the grilled meat loaf and that was definitely special. It had that grilled wood taste that was mouth watering. 

I feel Redstone is on the pricey side, especially for basically American comfort food. With one appetizer 4 entrees and 2 drinks without dessert we were around $140.00.

First time staying here and the staff is very friendly, they took care of our needs, the place is pretty clean, no real complaints there. The only thing that was an issue is evidently the walls and floor are very thin, we could here everything's from both walls and I swear we could here people through the floor. They did have a shuttle which is nice but it stops running at 9pm, night life in Nashville doesn't end till way after midnight. The noise issue is so bad I doubt we would stay here again, I'm a lite sleeper and I can't handle hearing people coughing, talking, and even their TVs all night long. This Hotel is a great price but I would've paid more to stay in quieter room.

Best gumbo in New Orleans for sure! I had the Ya-Ya Gumbo and it was amazing! Zesty, thick, full of meat. Yum! I tried gumbo a few times after this experience as I was having "gumbo withdrawals" but the other restaurants don't make gumbo this thick and yummy. Service was overall very good. We had a big group and they got through our orders in a timely manner and we got everything we wanted. It's real nice to sit outside here eating a cup of gumbo and people watching on a sunny day. Close to the riverboat cruise, city bus tour, etc.

I do have to say that my husband and I enjoyed our stay at this hotel and it was not bad at all. 

We arrived yes it was a little crowded and if you arrive a few minutes early they will not allow you to check in early.  Only at 3 and on.  But okay I guess. 

This place upon arrival was clean,  staff was super friendly and greeted us. 

Room was decent,  plenty on towels and basic supplies for a hotel room,  I was surprised to find even make up remover wipes. 

Not sure what was with the bed bugs reviews because I sure did my inspection and there was nothing.  I was able to sleep just fine with no bugs lol. 

They have free breakfast served In the morning not bad for complimentary,  staff keeps up with it pretty good and always cleaning up after guests.  

BAR area was decent,  staff very friendly. 

Indoor pool and fitness center. 

I did not get to visit the fitness center but the pool was neat and clean looking.  
 
Also during the day as late as 9pm they have the shuttle that will take you to downtown.  Free ride Yaay!  

I enjoyed my stay here.  I just wish the bar was open til later so we could have hung out longer at the lounge for drinks.  Bar on Saturday closed at 11.
the best brunch in town. the freshest food and the cutest/tastiest pastries. worth the wait and the price (-:

My family and various friends gave enjoyed this place many times as it is walking distance from my house. 

We often stop in here for a treat when we have a sweet tooth.  The chocolate pillow is AMAZING as are the macrons. 

They do not have an extensive menu but everything I have ever ordered has been delicious!   The menu layout (very hard to figure out) and service are why this review gets 4 instead of 5 stars.  I've almost always had to flag a server down for service. 

This place gas been a wonderful addition to our neighborhood!

Had there been an opportunity to give a 4.5 star rating, I would. As I drive for Uber, a client told me that this is not a regular Mexican restaurant, they have a Peruvian menu as well. She went from work, to pick up her order from here and the aroma had me convinced to try it. 

When she heard my compliments on the aroma, she invited me into her home to sample some. Wow! it MUST be great.

Had this been a hoity-toity stuffed shirt restaurant with servers in tuxedos, I would give it five stars. I'm assuming the tuxedos came with a more adventurous and creative menu. What a great find this was!

My wife had the "Tallarin Saltato de Pollo" and I had the "Seco de Carne". Both were great. Here come the reviews of those dishes and accoutrements. 

Fresh, hot tortillas were served without asking and they and the salsa were very good. I was also impressed with the fact that when I ordered club soda with limes that my second serving came with limes and I did not have to ask for them.

From previous experience with Peruvian cuisine, I suggested that my wife try Saltato dish. I learned that this was a regular dish, if not a national dish of Peru. This dish blew away my previous experiences. Sampling the first bite of chicken, I was blown away with how tender the meat was. Spices and flavors were great. The pasta could have been more "al dente", but that is my preference, not what may be tradition.

Seco de Carne was an interesting presentation. A cone of white rice offset the brown beans and the very dark gravy from the beef stew. Color came from the pickled red onion. 

On first taste of the beef, my wife said, "Ooo, that is GOOD". She does not like cilantro, so this was a rave. I found the meat stewed to perfection. While there were three "hunks" of beef covered in a thick, dark gravy, they were wonderful. Stew meat fibers fell away under my fork they were so tender. It was fun combining the meat and stew on the fork with rice, beans or gravy.

This place is on my list for a revisit, which is rare for a driver working or Uber who is working on sampling dining experiences to help my clients.

From the interior to the patio and great music vibes.  One of the best places indy period. Hard to find and hard to park! But damn! Try their macaroons donuts and croissants. Everything was 5 stars. A great place to come back over and over again. One of those places only locals would know.

Literally a hidden gem of Broad Ripple for breakfast and brunch! Hands down, for all crepe lovers it's the best spot in Indianapolis.  Both sweet and non-sweet crepes were delicious, just like the ones you can eat in France or Russia. Our server was awesome and everything was reasonably priced! There's also a plenty of parking next to the restaurant. Now it's our Top-3 breakfast/brunch place along with The Garden Table and Cafe Patachou.
Great outdoor place to get drinks.  The service is good.  The food is good and the drinks are great.  If it was not in a shopping mall it would be a great outdoor place.
You can never go wrong here.  The drinks are wonderful the service friendly and the food is amazing.   Steak Cobb salad is one of my favorites for lunch or dinner.  Cornbread is very very tasty.

Turning on my computer one morning, I discovered that my mouse didn't work and my cursor was stuck. Nothing I tried worked. Even buying a new mouse and moving the connector to a new USB port didn't work. So, I called HelloTech. The appointment was easy to schedule, the service price fair and the tech they sent...Jose...was amazing! Within an hour, he had diagnosed the issue, solved it, ran a scan on my computer to clean up any malware and showed me a few shortcuts to get better use from my computer. I wasn't sure what my experience would be, so, getting a tech as sharp and nice as Jose proved that I made the right call. From my experience, I believe that you can expect a great result from HelloTech!

Although I think Redstone is good for dinner, my five stars is for their brunch. Dinner at Redstone, while very good, is too expensive in my opinion when compared with like restaurants. 

The brunch, however, was very good and very reasonably priced. You get a free mimosa and blueberry pastry with your meal. The pastry was delicious!!! I got steak and eggs and would definitely recommend it. The scrambled eggs were above average. 

Their bloody Mary's were good but not the best I've had. They do come with great garnishes. 

Our server was good but there was confusion over the wrong food being dropped at our table and we didn't get our pastry until after our food was served even though we asked a few times. It is supposed to come before your meal. It was worth the wait though!

The bathrooms were not that clean, which was surprising because it is a nice restaurant.

The food was among the best in the French Quarter.

Out server Kinesha was outstanding, friendly, fast accurate and very accommodating.

Breakfast was delicious eggs, cornbeef hash $11.99, and eggs.  Also Poor Boy Roast beef $16.99, yes for breakfast.

I highly recommend stopping here.
Have you ever wanted to get the worst food poisoning of your life? Well look no further than professedly edible cookie dough

Talk about a hidden gem! The hype hasn't hit the masses yet but this place is delightful. Has a vintage-classic style...last thing we need is another dang hipster cafe. This place is refreshingly original. Handcrafted wood tables, mismatched upholstered chairs, bold and beautiful light fixtures, and an open kitchen where you can watch the masters create decadent desserts...simply wonderful. Wednesday's are $1 macaron day! (PS their macarons puts Cake Bake's to shame). Perfect spot for meetings, a casual date, and even for groups. Has a beautiful patio with tiny string lights and i hear they serve brunch on Sundays. 3 macarons and a cup of Bee Roasters coffee was only $4.50. Um what more do you want?? I'll be back...like every week.

I would never stay at this hotel again. They list having a restaurant but it's the hotel bar. No real restaurant. The room e
Was okay except for all the trucks at the gas station next to it. It's not a walkable area. Very disappointed.

Been going to Redstone for several years and absolutely love it! We normally have Gary as our waiter - he is simply outstanding! I love that this feels like an "adult" restaurant. Food is always great but prices are starting to increase on all menu items...

My husband and I stopped in for lunch on January 10. Jerk chicken fondue was great. 
While our server was polite, it too way too long to receive our sandwiches after our appetizer. 

My husband's burger was very good; French fries were over salted. My turkey sandwich was a bit tasteless and while the bread is good, it's too thick for my liking.

The hotel and staff were amazing. We were snowed in but they did their best to keep us entertained. Zach and Mike were on it for every breakfast and dinner and so polite. Dustin at the bar kept us entertained since we couldn't go anywhere. Great people!!!

This place has such promise, but has some really bad things going against it. I'll start with the good:
The good:
The pastries
The atmosphere/decor

The bad:
The service*
The management
The parking

*I made a reservation for 6 people TWO WEEKS in advance. I called that morning to confirm. When we arrived -- no record of any reservation, and no memory of the phone call I had made that very morning to confirm. And no apology from the host/manager. We waited about 15 minutes to be seated-- no big deal.  
Our waiter came by to greet us, but then left when he couldn't get all our attention-- again, understandable. But he didn't come back for 15 minutes-- we had to wave him over. He did apologize for making us wait to long. 
We ordered food and drinks: several bellinis, a wine and 2 coffees. AN HOUR LATER, we received our drinks! After politely asking/reminding them twice. My friend didn't get her simple cup of coffee though.. we had to ask again and wait a while longer for that. 
The food came out piecemeal a long while later -- except for my meal and my friend's croissant. I had to get up to find our waiter to tell him I never received my meal. He said, oh that's  my fault, went to the kitchen, and they rustled up my dish and he brought it after everyone else in my party had finished their meals. 
If I ran the place, I would have apologized up and down and at least comped something. Nope. Not an apology nor a comp. They screwed up at every stage! 
I will no longer recommend The Gallery due to horrendous service and management. I sincerely hope they improve.

Worst meal of the trip and left me feeling sick afterwards.  I had a side salad and the gumbo yaya.  The gumbo was good, but nothing compared to the others I've had.  The service was a bit slow too.  This is the TGI Fridays of Cajun food in NOLA.   Skip it!

Macaroons are such a weird dessert. I've had them in the past but they were never "oh my god" worthy. They always just left me feeling meh, not worth the sugar intake for feeling like I was just eating air. Side note, one can judge how much I enjoy a food dish by the amount of times I say "oh my god". Now back to the story, The Gallery Pastry Shop left me saying "oh my god" after eating their macaroons. By far the best I've ever tasted and oh so beautiful too. They come in a variety of flavors but the dark chocolate left me wanting 27 more in my mouth in that moment. So Wednesday I'll be heading back to buy 27 more macaroons when they are only $1 a pop. Yes, Wednesday is the day to go and get them cheap! You are welcome. Now I can't wait to check out their Sunday brunch.

I have purchased several items from these folks and the experience was terrific.  They were very patient and willing to spend time educating me on various gun options, differences, advantages, etc.  I highly recommend these folks.

This is probably one of the best restaurants I've been to since moving to the east coast. My girl and I shared the brussel sprouts (to die for) and the Mac n cheese (another great choice). I don't think we went wrong with any of our choices because the food all came out fantastic, especially the pizookie for dessert

Night out with the guys. What's better than dining outside on the patio under the stars. Lucky for us Medford holds night out celebrations during the week so the square had a live band playing to entertain us. 

Very nice seating very nice server made sure we were not thirsty or hungry. We decided on appetizers only tonight. Tried the bbq wings and the grilled wings. The vote went to the grilled wings. Add the seared ahi-tuna very good. 
The grilled shrimp cocktail might skip this one next time.

On to the flat breads. Went for the margherita style. I say style because it was different. They use thin sliced tomatoes not sauce. It was actually very good. Could not resist trying the fig and prosciutto. The margherita was the better choice. 

We moved over to the fire pit for some after dinner drinks and cigars. Good night out

I will caveat that my review is only for a dessert visit.  I still have the best of intentions to check this place out for brunch or lunch.  It looks amazing.  I first came here for behind-the-scenes Yelp event.  I was very impressed with the quality of the ingredients they use, the cleanliness of the kitchen, and how much painstaking care is taken to ensure that every ingredient and every element is incorporated correctly and beautifully in their desserts.  

Our favorite seats are the "sushi bar" seats.  They have a glass half-wall around the kitchen and it is really fun to sit there and watch the magic happen.

The macarons are why you come.  But the atmosphere, cocktail list, and homemade ice cream are why you stay.  They have a rotating array of ice creams with funky flavors like strawberry balsamic, sweet corn, and Tulip Tree trillium.  They have wine, beer, and wine cocktails.  I love their Fizzy Lifting Drink, a wonderful homage to Willy Wonka.  It's raspberry lambic over your choice of ice cream and garnished with a macaron.  On the day I had it, they offered raspberry praline ice cream and raspberry macarons, so it was a no brainer to combine them.  Heaven in a glass!

It pains me to only give four stars, but the lost star is for service.  We have a habit of going on Wednesday nights.  I'm sure it is more crowded that night than normal nights ($1 macaron's, y'all!), but it's never been PACKED when we are there. Service is always super friendly, but very slow.  Super slow to get seated, excruciatingly slow to provide menus, and I usually have to get up and track someone down to get our check.  Again, very VERY nice and friendly people and very helpful with menu suggestions.  Just very slow.

I  have been here one 2 other occasions, sat near the bar. It's little too dark, but couple girlfriends like it here . It had a pretentiousness I really didn't care for. 
Last night, reconfirmed it yet again. After leaving 1st spot, we walked over to Redstone. We each got drink, $37.00 in, unlike first spot, which was great in prices..
Two ladies sitting on the corner that my friend knew,Wow..Little Nip, little Tuck(more like alot) These are women trying so hard hold on to 20-30's.. their faces didn't move, foreheads, it was awful..
Getting back to bar & service. They had these huge glass jars, Pineapple stoli,fruit was still in them, and one of my buddies had it, said it was just pineapple juice..lol.
Looked good, I had Riesling, but wasn't the best, but Overall the bartenders were very attentive to us. Excellent..

Return factor: Maybe..I prefer the other one-a walk away.

Absolutely the worst Hotel customer service experience of my life. 

Waited 45 minutes as an unapologetic, unresponsive employee tried to check us in. He locked himself out of his own computer system after finding our reservation and having us sign paperwork and was unable to give us a room keys. He said our only option was a refund and that we find another hotel (at midnight). 

We literally had to leave and find another hotel day of despite the fact that the hotel admitted to having our reservation and had us sign for our room.

We were not apologized to once. Just terrible.

Blessed by their $1 macaroons on Wednesday! The salted caramel is my favorite. In addition to tasting amazing, they are photo worthy for all you Instagrammers out there. Such a cute little spot with a ton of space for large groups.

Does it get any better than unlimited mimosas? Gallery Pastry proves it does--for many reasons. One being that on select weekends, unlimited mimosas go for $5. Another is that they're paired with an amazing brunch menu that will cater to anyone's taste buds. Try an omelette or crepe with unlimited add-ins. 

The atmosphere is also a big selling point. Diners can sit at the bar and watch the chefs at work, and they have some killer jams playing in the background to keep the vibe going. 

They have pastries that are almost too pretty to eat, but on $1 macaron Wednesdays, I have no problem snacking on a few. 

Their outside dining area is pleasant and chess players can get their game on with the giant chess board in the middle of the dining garden. All around win, Gallery Pastry Shop!

People around here talk about this place as if it's holy, worthy of worship.  It's not bad, but it's also not great either.  Nice decor, though they keep it really dark in there. The food is fine, though the staff seems to have trouble listening to directions.  Say something like "no onions" on your burger, and it will probably come with onions.  Happened to 2 of us in our party.  Sent back the burgers with fried onions on them, and they returned with burgers with raw onions on them.  Onion happy much?  Once we got our burgers, they were very good, not great though.  I wouldn't call them any better than one you'd get at say, Fuddruckers or Chilis.

And expensive?  Wow.  Hold on to your wallet.  Expect about a 50% uplift on the cost of wine ($150 for a $100 bottle of Silver Oak Cab), and mixed drinks priced as if they were located in NY.

Like I said, good food, but coupled with so-so service and expensive spirits, I'd rather spend a few more bucks and go somewhere impressive like The Chop House.

Also notable is the fact that the place is a major meat market.  If that's not your bag, spend your bucks elsewhere, or time your visit appropriately..

My son and I had lunch here during all star weekend.  The host of the air bnb we were staying at recommended this place for gumbo so we both ordered a cup of the seafood.  The gumbo was ok..not great and for $8 a cup, had very little seafood in it. Also had to pick of pieces of shells on one of the shrimps.  I think next visit to Nola well try the Gumbo spot which several friends have now recommend I try if I want really good gumbo!

Rude, overrated and need to come up with a better system of dealing with their customers they claim they take care of. For what they charge and the quality of services, I found a better place. I was 10 minutes late for an appointment , because of traffic , and their attitude was they were doing me a favor by allowing me to keep the appointment .

I've been here many times. Dropped lots of money on this establishment. Then on March 17, 2018 they decided to use the term "carbomb" to describe one of their pastries and promoted this, unapologetically, on their facebook page. This term has a very distinct and specific meaning celebrating the IRA terrorists from the 1960s through the 1990s and the fear they instilled on people. So they've lost me and my family as a customer. Never going back.
This is my favorite brunch spots in Indy. If you're going to treat yourself then look I further. The omelettes are great and the coffee is always on point. Plus free parking.

This place has such great reviews and I don't know how I had such a different experience with the desserts! I didn't know it was a brunch place prior to coming, I thought it was more of a dessert place. They were out of macaroons so my fiancé and I tried some mousse desserts with macaroons in them. I can't remember what the purple one was but the yellow one was a passion fruit banana mousse. They were just strange... not overly sweet or anything, just really strange and weird tasting. I couldn't even finish mine and my fiancé forced himself to finish the passion fruit banana mousse. I would come back if my friends invited me there and I'd try something else but I don't think I'd come back on my own.:/ how disappointing!
Everything here is always yummy. Definitely on the pricey side but a nice option when celebrating a special night out. We love the decor. It's cozy and classy.

I was very excited to eat here the menu looked fabulous. Ordered 2 crepes and was so disappointed when they were served.....stone cold. The rest of the tables had hot food so I don't know what happened to me. ‍ First impressions matter.

First, I love the food here.  Brunch to baked goods to drinks are always amazing.  That's why I keep coming back. 

My gripe is the wild time suck that always seem to accompany my visits here. I give them a great deal of credit for adapting to the crazy pandemic situation with online ordering, scheduling, and takeout specials.  But what good are all these things if I'm still sitting outside 45 minutes after my scheduled pickup time with nothing?  There are also about 30 other people with their arms crossed in the parking lot in the same boat.

I get that these are uncharted waters for everyone but let's add a little reality to the system.  If you can't get the order out within 15 minutes of the scheduled time, you shouldn't have taken my order for that block.

I try not to be "that guy" with a snooty review like this, but it ends in up being a very unpleasant experience that could all have been avoided with a little planning and realism on their part.

And as I click post review, still no food.

Edit: food was brought out and set on a table 1 hour and 12 minutes after my scheduled pickup time.   Their poor staff is taking a beating today.

Dropped in for a pastry and coffee while visiting Indy recently. The pastries were beautiful, skillfully made and delicious--although they were out of my first choice, the recommended replacement was fine. The pastry is precise and the presentation is very professional. I didn't think the mismatched hipster decor fit well with the offerings but that is very subjective. The reason this place isn't getting 4 or 5 stars from me is the staff. We were seated quickly but from there on it was very slow. It took quite awhile just to get water and it was a very hot day. The water was lukewarm and we had to ask for refills. We had 3 different servers and none of them were very friendly but one stood out for her attitude and lack of people skills. The indifference to our patronage was disappointing.
I've been goin. Here for over 10 years. Everything is always consistent. 9/10 times I have ZERO complaints. Always been one of my faves.

The staff at the Clarion hotel were great!  They were super-friendly and treated us like we have been friends for years!  Definitely need to single-out Teri for going above and beyond!  She was also a basket full of sunshine!
Highly recommend!

Stayed here on our first visit to Nashville.Location is good , pretty close to downtown. The reception was friendly and gave us all info we needed. The first room we got was at 5th floor with a view of downtown, but the AC did not work so they changed us to 3rd floor immediately. Rooms are good spacious, with two queen beds and huge windows. The appliances are little old though, coffee maker took a while to get a single cup of coffee. Breakfast is standard american breakfast with eggs pancakes toast bagels bacon and biscuit with donuts. They do provide shuttle to downtown upto 9 pm. Rooms have basic amenities like microwave , TV refrigerator included. For the cost of room this looks to be a good option to stay in Nashville.
This Taco Bell has improved on the speed of their service (slightly,) however they need to work on the cleanliness of their fountain.

What a fun place to go for a pastry and a cup of coffee! My friend and I went for a quick bite late Sunday morning and were seated at the bar. Where we were seated, the head chef was directly in front of us. In addition to being entertained watching him cook, he answered our questions about his techniques and thanked us for coming in when we left. Everyone was friendly and efficient and I will definitely be back for a meal soon.

I had lunch here and was expecting steak on the menu and did not see any. I put steakhouse on search on Yelp and this was on the list of restaurants, to my surprise there were no steaks on the lunch menu when we arrived. I had their version of the French dip sandwich and was disappointed. It was sloppily put together and over broiled to the point the top part of my baguette was hard and the roast beef was dry. We also had the fig and prosciutto flatbread, which too was over baked and overly sweet from the fig jam or glazed at the base. It over powered everything on top.

I brought my iPad mini with cracked screen to this shop to replace the screen. First of all the service was not so great - when you enter the shop they even do not great you immediately ("hello, I will be with you in a minute" is a simple sentence). It took them a few days to fix it. When I pick it up they did not tell me anything about issues they faced. When I came home I saw that in the middle of the screen there is a pressure point (screen touching the glass). I came back to them and they tried to convince me that there is no isssue... finally they agreed to take an another look. In a few days they call me and told me that they did not open iPad but the issue disappeared. I was suspicious but came and saw by my own eyes - the issue disappeared. When I came home I found out scratches on the new glass!!! It was not difficult to see, I was probably too focused on the pressure point when I looked at it in the store. So they opened iPad, scratched the glass, bent the body and did not tell me... they actually used a glue to put it back as they bent a body. How do I know? The glass was cracked again in few weeks later and I fixed it in other place (much better place) and they told me.

The bottom line:
1. The service is not good, 
2. The fix itself was not a quality fix
3. They were not honest with me

I will not use this shop in the future.

Alex.

The service is horrible. If you go, you definitely do not want the blonde who is not originally a blonde. She is the worst. Your drinks will not be filled and she doesn't care if your order/food was horrible. I've been twice. I thought maybe the first time was her bad night but got horrible service the next time as well. It was happy hour and specifically told her I was mainly the for happy hour but she still didn't check on me for drinks. Very very poor service. I'll never go back until I know they have new servers for sure. Until then the place next to bargain hunt is it. Plus the place next to bargain hunt makes twice as strong drinks every time!!

This museum doesn't get all the credit it deserves!  We went on a field trip tour with my daughter's high school and the tour guides were wonderful.  They were very informative and funny, they got the kids engaged and answered all questions without hesitation.  The building looks much bigger than the actual tour itself - it's a huge place!  Plan to spend about 90 minutes here.  It's located in the White River State Park and is next door to the Indiana State Museum.  You can park for free in some spots downtown and walk to the museum or they have a parking garage available for $10 (I believe). 

The kids enjoyed the interactive sports activities and challenging each other in who could jump the highest.  The interactive soccer was cool.  You can find admission on Groupon for affordable tickets.

Had Hawaiian Fajitas and Chimichanga... unexpectedly delicious. Then we had Flan and Sopaphita as desserts to satisfy our sweet tooth...they were also very very tasty. Would again eat over here in a heartbeat.

RUDE,RUDE,RUDE!!!! Our waitress took forever to come take our order and we finally found her walking by and told her we were ready to order. She ran by the table maybe 4 times to see if we needed anything, but literally ran by while she was asking to the point where she was already 3 tables down by the time we were trying to tell her what we needed.
