It just seemed like we were a inconvenience for her. Then we went to check out and we had bought one of the smart cards from my daughters school that had a coupon for this location as well as the free download of the coupon book for your phone. I pulled up the coupon on my phone on my way to check out (keep in mind you can only redeem coupons once) the man at the register pushed a button that redeemed the coupon but did not get the code he needed to put in the register for the discount. He asked me to pull it up again and I told him I could not, that it could only be redeemed once and he redeemed it when he pushed it. He tried to say he didn't push anything and my husband told him " yes you did, I saw you" then he said "well I did, but it's the button I'm supposed to push to get the code but no code showed up". I told him just wait I would run to my car (in the pouring rain) and get the actual coupon, which I did. While I was looking for that coupon in the book and after I had gotten back in from the pouring rain he decided to tell me, "oh I went ahead and applied the coupon ". Like really dude after you made me go out in the pouring rain to get the coupon cook because you messed it up on the phone to begin with and wanted to blame it on us!

We got really great service at the gallery. You walk up and can either order at the counter or be seated. The person who helped us was super friendly. 

I got an eclair and a macaroon and coffee. My friend got a chocolate pillow and a macaroon. Everything was great. They also had champagne and wine. 

I would say that the drawback is that it was too expensive to go everyday. My bill was around $12. The atmosphere was great, and I felt like it was a good splurge. 

There are specials on certain weekdays. Wednesday is dollar macaroon night. 

Hours change daily, so check before you go. I enjoyed it.
The most amazing spot to sit, enjoy and unwind... Wednesdays have easily become my favorite day with it being 1.00 Macaroon day. I haven't met a flavor I didn't enjoy yet.

We stumbled into The Gallery on a Saturday afternoon, and didn't realize that in addition to the pastries, they also served brunch. When we sat down the server brought each of 3 pieces of paper with menu items/omelette ingredients and asked us to just circle what we wanted. We found ourselves shuffling all these papers around and then decided to just get drinks and dessert. While I understand the concept, thought it looked tacky to have menus on half pieces of printer paper made in Microsoft Word. It's such a cute little place and deserves better menus to go with their theme. 

The pastry selection is very small, but delicious. I had the best almond croissant with almond paste slathered on the inside.

Wednesday is dollar Macaroon day, definitely go then. The macaroons are incredible and the flavors vary weekly. The shop is cozy and rustic, and all of the desserts look delectable. You seriously cannot go wrong with the macaroons though.

Ate here with my family on vacation and thought it was fine.  Fried shrimp were on point. Good location.  The staff were fine.  I'm sure there are better meals to be had in NOLA but this one was fine with me!

Second time there was even better than the first. We sat at the bar and watched the chefs good which was neat. We had $2 mimosas - a Saturday special. Can you beat that?? The food was amazing. I got an omelet and hash browns. The oil the hash browns were cooked in was so good! Of course we had to get a pastry on our way out. They were all gorgeous but we settled on a chocolate Carmel one with white chocolate mousse filling. It was delightful! The place definitely fits in with the broad ripple hipster vibe.

This is our second visit and I am both impressed and unimpressed.  Redstone Grill probably makes the best corn bread I have ever had.  Just plain outstanding and I could eat it for a meal.  This time I had the Gruyere & Ham omelet. It was just plain awful - dry and virtually no gruyere taste.  How do you put Gruyere cheese into anything and not have any gruyere cheese flavor.  A magical cooking skill from the kitchen of Redstone Grill.  I know that most rate this place high and it just might get to that level on my next visit (probably in another year). BUT, I must not forget the cornbread - as good as it is, cornbread alone does not make for a good restaurant :).  Also, service was ok but she spent most of her time talking to some friends on another table and not waiting on her customers.  Oh well, can't ask for everything.
Nice food, went here for a couple birthday celebrations- the candle is like a cool sparkler thing.

I'm a HUGE college sports fans, but this was one of the most boring places I've ever been to. The fact that it's next door to the NCAA offices, and is such a terrible museum is a shame. Here are some highlights:

Oh, there's an interactive game thing where you can play soccer or baseball......but the sensors are so off, you'd have a better chance of winning the lottery than making the game worthwhile.

Oh look over there, it's a computer that you can basically do a google search to figure out who was the Lacrosse champion in 1972. No information about the team or whatever, just the name of the school.....cool, I could have done that on my phone.

Oh neat, a little gymnasium where you can shoot hoops.....but it's completely boring and not interactive.

If you've got time to kill and want to be inside somewhere warm.....sure, give it a shot, but I got in with a free ticket and I wanted my money back.

Whoever is in charge of decorations here is beyond amazing. The Halloween decor was on point. From the doll heads to the hanging baby bodies to the hands coming out of the wall. Incredible! It was nostalgic for me to have an ecto cooler drink!! It would have gotten 5 stars, but due to the fact that the drinks were grossly overpriced for 6oz plastic cups. I would make a visit once for the season but probably no more than that.

Across the street from a Knight Inn and razor wired lot! Not exactly downtown or stadium location; it's actually an industrial area across the bridge from the stadium. 

On the other side was the interstate, so you get to hear trucks all night and even more in the early morning.  Do I even need to say the view was scary? 

Most of the staff was super friendly, but house keeping knocked on our door two hours before check out with the Do Not Disturb sign on the door!

This hotel is not a good choice, especially for the cost. I can't believe they have the audacity to charge more than $80!!
It has great service and fast service. The Peruvian menu is the best I have had in Nashville.
Delicious pastries in a cozy corner in broad ripple. Charcuterie boards are so fresh and delicious. Big fan of their cake -- special order but so worth it!
Great customer service and prices. Good, solid folks behind the counter. Buy with confidence here.

Definitely has become my go to place for a quick dessert. I love bringing guests from out of town and seeing their faces when we walk in. It's such a cute location and the pastries are almost too pretty to eat. Almost. Sunday brunch is pretty legit too, if you can get a seat. Service has always been top notch, though it can be a little slow during the busy times. Well worth the wait though.

Have been seeing any foodie friends checking in here often. Had to go in to give it a try myself. The location is a little hidden and tucked away. I missed my way and had to make a turn around. Limited but sufficient parking spots available for free which is a plus. Right off the Monon trail on 54th, so for those joggers, walkers and bikers..this shop would be a cool spot to stop by for a sweet bite or coffee fix. Loved the outdoor seating setup, very chic and warm. Indoor is sleek and classy. Love the mix and match theme of furnitures. Reason for a 4 Star, as I walked in..I was clueless on where to go and how to get started. There was no clear setup to distinguish the coffee bar vs kitchen. My sole purpose for the trip was to try their pastries and coffee.  I had to ask a waitress to get some clarity. She mentioned we could give our orders in at the coffee bar and it would be brought to the table. I tried their raspberry eclair and caramel hazelnut mousse cake. Pastries were phenomenal. It wasn't pure sugar like most of American desserts are, these had flavors. I regretted not coming here sooner. As we were enjoying our dessert, noticed the chefs in the kitchen started kneading dough and etc. Curious mind wanted to know what all were there on the menu, which was when I realized we weren't offered the menu. It was too late by then to start over so left it there. I hope this can be improved, hope they are able to market their menu or offering better for new customers. Overall, a cute and fun place for anyone to come hangout. If you're into pastries, you need to visit this place!

This is a place that makes you rethink every other brunch spot you've ever visited. We were initially hooked on the $1 macaron Wednesdays and then got drawn there for brunch after seeing their Facebook post advertising bottomless mimosas.

I don't think you can go wrong with anything you order here. The omelettes are heavenly (I especially recommend getting one with chorizo), crepes are mouth-watering, and pastries are perfect. It's fun to sit in front of the kitchen and watch the magic happen while you're waiting for your meal. 

Occasionally they do $10 bottomless mimosa Saturdays (they usually advertise it on Facebook or Instagram the day before). Every time we've gone the staff just comes around with bottles of champagne to top off your glass. It's awesome.

Recently had dinner here for the first time. Bar area is super loud but once we were seated in the back it wasn't too bad. Lighting is very dark - I luckily grabbed the seat under the light. Others in my party pretty much ate in the dark. We got a few appetizers - the fig and prosciutto flatbread was too sweet. Fried calamari was good. Breaking bread was good. Everyone liked their dishes but I was too stuffed from appetizers to enjoy mine. I got the shrimp fra diavolo and the shrimp were HUGE. I definitely want to return to try other dishes.

Sobro (South Broad Ripple) at its best! This place has done a fabulous job of transforming this small section of a warehouse building in South Broad Ripple. They are locally famous for their macaroons. On Wednesday's they run a special of $1, per macaroon. I went here for brunch and had the crepes. They have a variety of sweet and savory crepes, and they're all beautifully presented and delicious! The staff was extremely friendly and the service was great!

Hands-down one of my favorite brunch spot in Indianapolis! Not only is their food delectable, but their vibe is chill and chic. I highly suggest their rose and lavender lattes, there is something so comforting about floral infusions. My favorite dish is the brulee trillium (tulip tree, berry compote, honey, pecans- $12). It is INCREDIBLY delicious!
Yum!! Super yum!! I absolutely love the ambiance, food & mimosas! Super cute, swanky shop with a great vibe!!
The buffalo shrimp appetizer was really good. But the braised beef short ribs were amazing!!!
Overpriced, unfriendly service... won't be returning!  While it tasted okay, customer service goes a long way.

Very saddened with our experience at this resturant tonight... We have came here on quite a few occasions and tonight made me really not care to come back. They brought us out cold fajitas with no shrimp in it and had a huge chunk of uncut pork thrown into it it was very sloppy and cold. I don't know about you but I would rather stay and eat at home than eat cold food and have to repeatedly ask for things that I shouldn't have to. 
Service was slow too :( 
Won't be coming back...
Also our server said she would try to take something off our ticket but that did not happen as we received our check with no modifications for having to wait an additional 30 min for our food to be HOW ITS SUPPOSED TO BE hot with shrimp..with our six month old baby there with us and you know if you have kids you don't have time for screw ups time is of the essence so will go to Margarita house next time...

Remains one of my favorite spots in broad ripple. The staff is warm and welcoming. The atmosphere is quiet and unique in that you get to watch the pasty chefs. 

Their baked items have not disappointed yet. Everything is so fresh, and you can truly taste the difference. They offer a limited menu, but they do their menu well above par. 

Only pitfall is a limited hot beverage/coffee menu. They are a pasty shop though; so be mindful they stick to what they know and kill it!
The crepes are delicious especially the BANANAS FOSTER! Awesome staff, great vibes, and good food!

Not bad for the price. It's a bit of a hike downtown and the neighborhood is kind of sketchy but they do have a free shuttle every 30 minutes to Broadway. Only runs until 9pm though so after that you're on you're own. Rooms weren't bad. Bar/restaurant doesn't open until 4pm which is a little annoying but it's not bad. Free breakfast is good, lots of choices.

I had brunch here a couple days ago and although the food was great the service was not. Our waitress was pretty unfriendly from the moment we sat down. She made our group of four ladies feel so unwelcome and uncomfortable that it soured the experience. Even though we enjoyed the food I likely won't go back or recommend to others.

Great place to get your computer and cell phone fixed - 
I was in and out in less than an hour !!

Long story short ... they broke my phone.  I needed my screen replaced then had all kinds of issues and ended up coming back numerous times for Johnathan to try and fix it it.  Then my phone turned off and wouldn't come back on.  When my husband went to the store to find out what they could do for us, since they in essence broke my less than one year old phone, they informed him that we apparently signed a waiver that would not hold them responsible.  While they did try to fix it again and again in the end you are better off leaving your phone to be fixed by your provider and keeping your phone warranty intact.

I'm really glad I read the reviews about the long lines and big crowds before trying to come here on a weekend. My husband and I came this past Thursday and arrived a little after 5:00. We had to wait about 5 minutes to get in, which I was a little surprised about on a weekday afternoon. I guess a lot of people might have came in right after work. 

Yes it was crowded, but not so obnoxiously crowded that you can't move. Yes the drink prices are high for small drinks in plastic cups. $16 for a blood bag. $14 for a pumpkin bourbon drink I got. But you are paying for the experience and all the time spent putting up all the decorations. It was very well decorated and we enjoyed our time here. Loved how the decorations were very over the top and every inch of the place decorated. We came a few years ago when it was tinsel, and plan to come back around Xmas time for tinsel again. I told my husband I want this amount of decorations at our house next year, haha.
I've been bringing my dog here for 2 yrs and they have always been thoughtful, loving and great grooming for my scared, shy little girl.

Hi how are you? No. It's yea, what you need.
Thank you. Haha. No. 
You are a bother to these people. The money you spend pays their checks, but they could careless. 
Fire all these useless people and hire older people. 
The place is filthy.  
Food took over 20 mins and there was only one person in front of us.  

To whom ever own this place or manages it, why don't you care about it or this community?

Truly such a fun time! I love a good theme and must say the spooky vibes were even better than the Christmas Tinsel vibes. The decorations are incredible and the staff is in costume. Good photo opp. To drink, you gotta go with the blood bag. It's a twist on vodka Red Bull But actually good, and not as overpriced as I anticipated. Hoping they'll come back next year!
One of my favorite spots for brunch and pastries. We got seated immediately! Great selection of pastries and great seeing the staff do their thing in the open kitchen! Highly recommend.

You have to walk into this bar with the understanding that 1). You absolutely will not be able to move and 2). You will be paying an extremely ridiculous price for a gross drink. With this knowledge, the entire appeal of this bar comes down to how absolutely amazing it is decorated. They take "theme bar" to a new level. I can't imagine the amount of time that goes into making this bar looks like it does, so kudos to whoever is the mastermind behind it. If you're a Halloween lover like me, it totally worth stopping by and taking a look around!

We live two hours away now, but lived in Indy our whole lives and miss the lovely one of a kind places. We made arrangements to stay in Indy for our anniversary so that we could experience $1 Mac day, and ended up staying for lunch- our food was amazing, and we treated ourselves to a Province- lavender mousse perfection. We sat at the bar and watched our meals being prepared, and got to witness macrons being made while we enjoyed the most delicious brunch I've had in ages. The staff was very welcoming and I felt like a regular. The atmosphere feels like home, and I would absolutely recommend stopping in, even just for a coffee and croissant. A must!

I gotta say there was a lot of hype surrounding this place and it didn't disappoint. The flavor really comes through with their farm to table ingredients and food. It's a very easy going vibe and I enjoy the kitchen is right in the restaurant so you can see what's going on. Highly recommend this place and dropping in ASAP!

Excellent weekly specials and lunch specials. The tiramisu is outstanding!! Good selection of craft beers and sweet deals during happy hour! I had the meatball parmigiana muffuletta. This sandwich is very flavorful and could feed two people!
They water down their bottles here . We caught them when we asked for a new bottle of Stoli Raspberry to be opened at our table to compare to the drinks served to us . SNAGGED !!!
They helped resolve a technical issue I was having with a software download when no one else could.  Thanks for the help!

This hotel was great! Justin (the bartender) was second to none. One of the best bar experiences I have ever had- funny, entertaining, protective, and talented! My friends and I had a great say, and don't plan to stay anywhere else. The driver (from the hotel to downtown) was also super sweet and helpful! Highly recommend.
Love this place their chicken and Mac and cheese are good here. Worth the money. Not that many vegetarian options ):

I think is a great hotel! So what if it's an older building and the elevators are a bit clunky. It's convenient to downtown the stadium and the interstate. They have an excellent bar, you've gotta ask the Viking bartender (look for the red beard) how he got his name! It's Justin btw. He makes a mean margarita! The rooms are clean and spacious. There's plenty of lit parking and the staff is super super nice! I recommend this hotel if you're not gonna get hung up on the building being older. OH and I LOVE the furniture in the lobby area!
Why on earth do some restaurants chill Cabernet. That is insane. Worse yet, the bartender here just stated "That is how cabs should be served" OMG. So wrong.

Nothing but good words to say regarding Truly Nolen. Xavier, The service tech I interact with, has always been courteous and professional and the products he uses are quite effective. He's also very thoughtful with the application.  I would not hesitate to refer Truly Nolen based on my experiences with Xavier.

The ambience alone makes it worth a visit, but the food and staff are great, too! The ambience: it's like someone looked at my Pinterest "decor" board and exploded it into this shop. The food: crepes were solid, but not the best thing I've had. Bonus: Dog friendly patio seating makes this a must stop detour when you're walking, running, or cycling the monon on a nice day.

My food was fair.  I ordered a fried shrimp and oyster platter.  It was filling and tasty, though nothing special.  My friend ordered an etouffee.  He's polite and doesn't like to complain about food in public. But he only took two bites of his seemingly soupy plate of rice and decided he was done.  Our waiter, a young man with dreadlocks, acted like he didn't want to be there.  It felt a bit rushed and he didn't make himself approachable for questions or even desert requests.  I wish I hadn't given him the low tip I gave him because he was nasty.  

There are other fabulous restaurants to dine at that where the food is good and the service just as good.  Check out Huck Finns on Magazine Street.  Stay away from Gumbo Pot!

WOW!  This place is amazing.  We own a Marco's down the street and don't get out much, but tried this Sunday.  If you want to see a show sit up at the cook bar and watch Ben crack eggs!  Our crepes and hash was so good.  We will be back!  Jessica helped the "first timers" through the menu perfectly.

This hotel staff is so great. Terri at the front desk made us feel welcomed and would make sure we had everything we needed. The shuttle service is amazing and so convenient! The free breakfast is out of this world! From eggs to sausage to biscuits n gravy to waffles and pancakes! The hotel itself is cozy with comfy beds and pillows. I was very pleased and satisfied with our stay, Thank you Clarion!

I can't explain how much I love it here! I am a frequent visitor and enjoy the experience every time.  The staff is laid back and friendly, the food is always amazing, and you can never pass up on the desserts.  Sunday's are great with half priced bottles of champagne and options of juice.  Their outside seating is great! I can't wait to go back :)
Great service, excellent food! Would highly recommend this Mex restaurant. The salsa is a little spicy but it was really good!!

The food was ok, our server was awesome as well. When you present your yelp coupon for a free glass of wine they will tell you it's not valid lol, just a heads up if you try getting a free glass of wine.

Eclair was disappointing.  The pastry and chocolate were fine, but the filling was bland and had the texture of pudding.  If you've ever had a really good eclair, you will understand why this is just wrong.  And at that price, it had damn well better be perfect.

Really love the outdoor seating / bar area at the Marlton location. Although right along the highway, they have used shrubbery and the adjoining lake to create a tranquil atmosphere. The food is always good and the service top notch. Was happy to hear of fresh cod as part of a daily special, and it did not disappoint. My absolute favorite here is the cornbread skillet. Yum!

We decided to try this place, but it wasn't worth it. Granted, we went when it first opened, but still won't be back. We were greeted at the counter to order. When we looked at the menu, 3/4 of it was blacked out with sharpie as unavailable. We settled on an 18 dollar 13" pizza and two bottled sodas and chose a table. The soda was pop top and the girl didn't open it for me, I had to go back up and ask for it to be opened. It must have just been put in the fridge, because it was warm. I had to ask for two glasses of ice. We received our pizza without any plates or silverware. I had to go to the counter to ask for them.  They also don't know their table numbers because Three times during our meal, the server came out asking if another tables food was ours. We left still hungry because the pizza was so small and The flavor wasn't good enough to get us to try the place  again.

I used to think this was the oddest store ... pillows and bedspreads on the left, seemingly random food items on the right, various furniture and goods in the middle and why I thought it was a discount place where things end up from other stores I do not know but as it is one of my daughter's favorite stores, I've come to really like it (shopping is often our time to get together).  I always carefully check out the food area because they always have things I've never seen before and on this last trip my daughter pointed out some tapenade and said she loved that stuff ... and now I do too.  Stuff like that, never saw it before (although now I know it's fairly common) and it's here.  There will be one more trip before Christmas to check for stocking stuffers.

La Siesta is what I would expect from a Mexican restaurant on the eastern side of the US. Perfect for what I was craving after being on the rock for months and months. I like the inclusion of a Peruvian menu and a vegetarian section! I enjoyed chowing down on the veggie plate with cheese enchilada, chalupa, chile relleno, rice, and beans. Hit the spot! Left feeling so happy and satisfied!
Delicious food.  Great service.  Try the steak...it's incredible and definitely an underrated chef.  Highly recommend

I really like Redstone for dinner.  It's a bit pricey but a nice night out.  However, we went for Sunday Brunch on 2/16 and were very disappointed.   We would have had a better meal at the dinner.  $80 for cold, mediocre food.  Now I know better.

Red stone is a great place to go out with your friends or for a first date. It's both a restaurant and a bar, but classy at the same time. Food selection is great with good presentation. 

I especially love the outside bar and patio- especially the fireplaces (super cozy in the fall). 

I always get a chuckle because the place is filled with 40 some year old divorcées lol.

Went to the new one in the Deptford Mall and omg I'm in love. I got the birthday cake flavor and I felt like I was Eatin the real raw cookie dough . As a kid I always use to beg my parents for raw cookie dough and cake batter and this store brought back my old school memories . This place is like a childhood dream coming true. I'm sure I'll be there once a week. Expensive but worth it . Lady said the dough last two weeks in the fridge and I was so happy I didn't have to finish it all right then and there. This place is worth 5 stars!

Love this place! Not only for brunches with my fiancé, which can get pretty busy (almost too busy to be honest). But I also love having a cup of coffee with one of their delicious desserts, read a book or just watch chiefs make some delicious magic things on a weekday night while on a date with myself. Or share a plate of smoked meats and cheeses with a glass of nice wine while catching up with a friend! Hidden (or maybe not so hidden anymore) gem!  Such am amazing atmosphere too! Cannot get more of this place!

This pastry shop is a gourmet gem, tucked away in a quaint area just south of Broad Ripple. The ambiance is perfect for a brunch with friends, but also has a counter of pastries to go. The highlights for me so far include the $1 macarons on Wednesdays and the chocolate pillow... the chocolate pillow is incredible! If you're a connoisseur of chocolate, you will not be complete until you've tried this dessert. I can't wait to go back to try more of the main menu!

Redstone is a very trendy little spot off rt. 73 in Marlton. The decor and ambiance is amazing. The outside bar is cool in the summer, and toasty in the winter (thanks to the multiple fires and heaters running). The food is good and all things are reasonably priced. Definitely a must-see if you are in the area and are dressed up, looking for some good food and drink.

Spent last night there!!! Check-in was fantastic!!! The young gentleman was fantastic, we talked Michigan vs Ohio St football rivalry. I got my disabled father and my mother up to the room with no problem!!! My mother and I got a great shuttle bus ride to Downtown Nashville, she's never seen it before and neither had my sister. We then got back to the room around 9 pm and then at 2am, it began. We smelled marijuana smoke coming from the hallway and people knocking on our door at 4am, I know it is a party town, but for $165 I would like a good night sleep. Then at 845 am, we get a knock at the door and there is a Hispanic lady yelling room service, you must leave!!! Then 15 minutes later, A black lady did the same!!!!! Checkout is 11am!!!!! Now I am pissed!!! I spent $165 for a night and a grand downtown at the bars and this is the service I get!!!!! No way!!!!! I am down here for a family vacation and looking at jobs and housing, this ids the response I get!!!!!! Then we go to leave and there is only 1 elevator because the other 1 was out, GREAT!!!!! I was one of 100s yelling about this too!!! Thanks but no thanks Clarion !!!!

Had the seafood gumbo and my son had chicken and andouille.  His was much better, better flavor.  Got the shrimp po boy which was good, bread was solid.  The fries were not good at all.  Also, it was a pretty long wait, which wasn't impressive.

Wandered in while on Frenchman and I am glad I did. This market is fantastic. There are so many funky, hip local artisans, selling a variety of creations. My favorite was clearly the jewelry, but I truly loved all of the art. And the creators were so friendly. It's open daily, which is helpful for mid-week visitors like me, who otherwise might not have been able to visit a local market. 

Supporting local artisans wherever I am is so important to me and I'm happy I found this market where I was able to do so. I will definitely return to Palace Market.

Tough review here because the end product is solid but unfortunately their customer service is bad. Had some very similar issues on timing as other reviewers. Overall horrible communication and service but end result is solid. On top of the poor service, the did leave our yard/driveway very dirty. We will need to replace the rest of the fence in our yard at some point and when we do, we'll be going with another company.

I love Redstone.   Always can count on a solid meal with good service.   They have had a happy hour which I have yet to visit until tonight.   There is a limited food menu with varying prices and also limited drink options.   I have to say their Parmesan truffle fries where amazing!!!   Thin and crispy with lots of different amazing flavors.  A must have.    Good drinks.  Great service at the bar ask for John.   Also I love their steak Cobb salad and buffalo shrimp which are my usual go to items.

I have never been disappointed at Red Stone. I typically sit at the bar. The bar staff are friendly and attentive. The drinks at Res Stone are awesome. They have a great wine list and my favorite cocktail is the manhattan. I have yet to have a bad thing on the menu. I can't seem to get past the appetizers. The grilled chicken wings are so flavorful and juicy. The buffalo shrimp is always a favorite. The shrimp are large and filling. The Brussels sprouts are a fave too. I can name so many more. I've always enjoyed the ambiance as well. It's a large restaurant but has an intimate feel. I love to go when the weather is good because they outdoor seating is beautiful.

Ah, this place is amazing! I stopped in today after getting a massage to complete my day of treating myself and it was such a good decision! I got 4 macarons and the opera cake...literally so good! The girls working the pastry counter were extremely sweet and helpful as well. Can't wait to frequent the gallery!

We had our wedding rehearsal dinner after-party at Redstone American Grill on Friday night, and it was a fantastic time! We had about 25 people there having drinks and appetizers...  our server Lauren was amazing!! We were not the easiest group to manage as we were a bit boisterous and obnoxious but she was so delightful in getting what we needed and always a smile on her face! The outdoor patio area just to the right as you enter the front door is a very nice, and cozy place to have a large group function. Lots of fun!

Ok you can sit right down and a server will take your order or you can order at the counter and then sit down. We went very late at night... so the selection was slim with the macaroons. These were a lot smaller than I expected(which didn't stop me)... I'd say palm sized or smaller for $8 ea. They were definitely tasty and if you aren't looking for something heavy then this is the spot. The macaroon I had was super good.

My only complaint was I didn't get coffee when I wanted it so I didn't order it. The server didn't confirm with an adult before letting a 7 yr old order something. Finally they didn't have more macaroon flavors .

I will be back to try more because it was delicious... just a bit pricey for what you get.

First of all, these chairs are adorable. You've got to snag a picture in them. Palace Market off Frenchman is a must-do for me. It's a smaller version of an open market where individuals come to sell their art. I love browsing local artists and supporting the locals. You'll find some fantastic paintings, jewelry & people! There's just something about shopping at dusk for the perfect souvenir to commemorate classic New Orleans and this is the perfect place to do just that.

I really like  Redstone for its outdoor area and Dirty Martinis. They have blue cheese stuffed olives, which I LOVE. 

My boyfriend and I usually go thinking we'll just have drinks but after  two or three drinks, we get hungry and order food. I consistently order the Seared Tuna appetizer and Crab Cake appetizer. Both very good. A little on the pricey side, but it's the area and I don't mind paying since its good food. Not sure about the burgers though...my boyfriend ordered once and he didn't even eat it...I think I remember him saying it was undercooked and had no taste.

We also started going here for brunch on Sunday. Good food...GREAT Bloody Marys! The Bloody Mary is like a meal in itself with celery, pepperoni, olives, tiny pepper, and I think there's even cheese on the stick placed in the drink.

Overall, really nice, classy, clean place...especially for a drink.

I'm not really into sports, but I thought I would check out this place to report back to my sporty friends. The bottom floor was okay, a lot of random facts about each sport but I didn't really see a pattern. The upper floor was more fun, I loved the interactive simulator where it sounded and looked like I was in a real stadium or field shooting goals. The football one was tough! I think kids and older adults both would enjoy this place. However, I would probably not go back again.

This was on a busy Friday night. The service was fast, and accurate. My food was okay. I had the fish special of the night, and my wife had the ribs. The ribs were very good. The couple we went with enjoyed there food.

Fantastic experience! As someone who is relatively unfamiliar with hand guns, I wasn't exactly sure what I was looking for, even after hours of research. The gentleman who assisted me went above and beyond in helping me, truly. I walked in feeling overwhelmed and walked out feeling completely confident, not only in my purchase but in knowing how to handle it as well.

This place looked so cool. The place was decked out with Halloween decorations, it looked awesome.  There was cool a small room decorated with dolls, perfectly creepy for selfie. Even the bathroom had cool decor. The drinks were halloween theme too. Definitely recommend this spot.

Very disappointing!  After reading the other reviews, its obvious that we were scammed also with the added gratuity that they do not tell you about.  We only had a party of two, our waiter was horrible and the food was just so-so, one dish was so bad (shrimp pieces floating in a dish of watery grits), that it had to be returned.  Although we were seated instantly, the service was so slow and the waiter seldom checked on us, he had to ask three separate times about my salad dressing choice.  For service this bad, gratuity should not be added, they already have you walking in the door, so giving "good" service doesn't matter.  Two people=no alcholic drinks=salad and small gumbo=$66.70 (unbelievable) Dont waste your time, too many other selections in which the food is good, better prices and servers that care about their job.  One last thing, the be sure to count the shrimp in your gumbo, it seems only one per cup/bowl is allowed.

My favorite things about this place is the atmosphere and the strawberry doli! The waiter was amazing (shout out to Gary:-)) the good was also pretty good. You could tell everything was fresh and made to order. We only got the Korean chicken wings and Cajun penne pasta to share. The pasta was pretty good but I could have passed on the wings. It wouldn't be my first choice to return if I were back in the area but definitely not opposed to going again.

Fun themed Halloween bar!
I believe this is the first year that they have revamped the space into a Halloween nightmare.

We arrived on a Friday night and waited in line for about 30 minutes. There is a $5 cover some nights, or you can get in for free if you have a costume. Entering the bar you walk under a web of spiders. There is a bar to the right and a smaller bar in the back. Of course we had to order the blood bags which is a cocktail with Red Bull and vodka- not my favorite, but it was drinkable. 

The whole space is decorated in classic monsters, body bags, hanging dolls, and creepy masks. It wasn't frightening, but it was definitely a creepy Halloween vibe. Really the space is decorated for one big Instagram photo-op. "Satan's throne" is in the back and is the main photo-op for the bar. 

They played some spooky music and some hits. The theming was fantastic. This is a bar that you can spend up to an hour in enjoying one drink, but the drinks are too expensive and the bar is too crowded to spend your night here.

This was one of the best stays we've had at a hotel! The staff was amazing! Friendly, helpful and accommodating to all of our needs. The room was clean and every day during our stay staff would come by and ask if we needed anything or restock as needed. Big breakfast selection waffles, muffins, fruit, eggs, sausage, potatoes, biscuits and gravy etc. My boyfriend and I would definitely recommend this hotel at this location . Thank you staff for all of your hard work, it was much appreciated! You guys made our vacation so enjoyable!

This place was okay. It gets 3 stars for the neighborhood it was in and the lack of communication during check in. They had no rooms and just told us to sit in the lounge area but never came
To tell us when our rooms were ready. The rooms were clean but kinda run down. But Nashville is very expensive and these rooms were affordable. The bar tender jermey was great! And people (customers) were friendly! Breakfast was standard free breakfast. And dinner served there was average but affordable! Cool was nice and the bar and night restaurant ads run independent from more. Which accounts for the difference in friendliness.
Always perfect service, food and environment. We've been going here for years and never had a bad experience.

Great establishment! Service gets an A! The ambiance is warm & cozy, great for dates! There's a large selection of everything from fish to steak. The appetizers are a must! My sister loves their homemade flat bread as a starter & I normally go for the buffalo shrimp which are to die for.. I try something different almost every time & I have never left disappointed! I love going in early spring or early fall because they have nice outdoor seating with beautiful fire pits.. Awesome experience!

One of my favorite restaurants! Everything is made to order n from Scratch! Loved everything! We had the pear n Brie flat bread, delicious but just not for me! Everyone else loves it and ingredients were fresh! Breaking bread is one of my favorites!! Come with garlic butter, chimmicuri sauce and ground up olives for dipping! Yum! A must have everyone! The lodge corn bread OMG! My fav it comes with a semi sweet butter! Yum! Fondue is absolutely unbelievable! Apples, grapes, croutons, jerked chicken with melted cheese! Oh my! No one else has this on their menu! Bf has the bacon creame sauce with gnocchi he said they were told but nothing to write home about or that he had to have again! I always judge by that and ask him, "would you order there again?" Mom had the pork chop with garlic  mashed potatoes and Mac and cheese! She said the mashed was the best she was vet had! She ate every bit of the chop and she is a small old lady who is very picky! The Mac and cheese was for
Me and it was delicious! Creamy and cheesy melted on top! For desert, as it we didn't have at enough and could barely roll ourselves to the car, we got the chocolate cake! It came with joy chocolate syrup that you pour over the ice cream to create a hard chocolate shell and the best whipped cream I have ever had! The cake itself was amazing! Chocolate fudge layer cake! Mmmmm! The piece was big enough for the 3 or us! We absolutely loved our meal and mom is still thinking about it the next day! I can't wait to go back! Never had a bad  meal here!
Good place it's a bit off a pick up joint but not bad the outside dining is pretty nice drinks are a bit much
Every time I go, I am pleased. Good food, good service. This last time we dined there, Katerina was our waitress. She was outstanding! If you get here, please tip her well. She deserves it!

We stayed at the Clarion Nashville this past weekend and had a great experience! Updated approximately 8 years ago per the staff, it seems much newer and in great shape. The room was comfortable and clean with a friendly and courteous staff. Everyone we encountered from the front desk, housekeeping, bartenders and shuttle drivers were all super kind and welcoming. Even though this isn't right downtown we feel it's a much better value! You avoid the downtown hassle, free parking, free shuttle to the heart of broadway and a great complimentary breakfast. 10/10 would stay here again anytime. The only con... the bar pricing is OUTRAGEOUS they aren't on broadway but the prices reflect they are. Also, check out the local Shugga Hi cafe for breakfast!

I highly recommend using Gallery Pastry Shop for your wedding desserts! We received so many compliments from our guests on how delicious and beautiful everything was. We had an almond and vanilla cake with a sweet cream filling (that we got to custom design), macaroons with our hashtag printed on them, mini-cloud pastries, and pear tarts. The Gallery team was extremely professional, creative and laid back on when we selected our wedding desserts. We absolutely loved our cake and desserts; truly, they were perfect. We could not be happier with our decision to go with them.
Great location seafood a plenty. But no oysters on the half shell. On with the quest.

1. My engagement ring... Its beautiful. But when I went to have it sized they told me it would take a week to have to back. One week later I still had not received a phone call, so, I called. They had forgot to send out my ring! Another week later, I finally got my ring.
2.My wedding band...since my ring was custom made, I was told I needed to send my engagement ring with the band order to insure to diamonds matched up on the sides of each band. (I should have learned the first time) They forgot the send my engagement ring with the order. Luckily, the diamonds are really close to matching up on each band.
3. His wedding ring... (Again, you think I would have learned my lesson by now.) We ordered his wedding band a little late, about 3 weeks before the wedding. They said it would be fine it would in the Tuesday before the wedding (the wedding was on Saturday). This made me nervous but we went ahead anyway. Well, Tuesday came and went. So Wednesday my fiance called. He was now told the ring wouldn't be here until Friday. I freaked out...the day before the wedding?!?! So...I called. I was told, by the owner, "Oh, it should be here by the end of the day." I responded with, "Really because my fiance just called and told it wouldn't here until Friday" A couple seconds later (think fast), "Oh yea you're right, I thought today was Thursday." In the end the ring didn't come in until Saturday morning, which the best man had to go pick up. 
The whole process added additional stress to the wedding. I will not be a returning customer.

***EDIT 3/8/17***
I recently had a side diamond fall out of my engagement ring. I was heart broken. My husband said we should take it back to Sheffield's Diamonds to see what they can do. I immediately thought "are you kidding me?" but went ahead with it. 
Arriving at Sheffield's (with our now 1 year old son) we were pleasantly greeted and offered coffee, water, and snacks for our son. Eric Sheffield was more than accommodating to help with the loss of my diamond. He actually had the diamond replaced at no charge! We had our other jewelry items cleaned and while we waited had a great conversation with another employee about his family and camping. 
My ring was fixed and returned within the timeframe given. 
It was an overall great experience. I am so happy that we decided to give Sheffield's another try!

I stopped by for a Sunday brunch. I had 2 crepes-1 savory and 1 sweet. Both were fantasy, but I enjoyed the savory one best. I sat at the counter so I could watch the chefs at work. I highly recommend sitting there as it is great to see how fast and precise the chefs are at getting food out to tables. Be ready for an hour wait on the weekends as it is quite popular.

If you like their gumbo, then you haven't had good gumbo! I grew up in South Louisiana...a true Cajun who speaks Cajun French. Everything we ate, not just the gumbo was terrible!!! On top of that the waiter gave us room temperature white wine!

Not memorable, but not bad either.  I was excited after the chips and salsa.  Great homemade salsa which awesome variety of flavors.  Then it went to the bland side.  All the "fixins" seemed a bit watered down.  The refried beans were runny, the cheese sauce was runny, the sour cream was runny, and the chicken in my "burrito supreme" was just watered down and bland.  Did it fit the bill as a mexican restaurant? It did.  Am I itching to return and come back and brag to everybody else that visits down there? Not really.  Would I go again if I saw it and remembered it? Maybe.  They served well prepared food, with a good level of customer service, at a fair and decent price.  It was just another average place though.

1. Somehow sound from another guest's room was seeping into mine...vent? I could hear every word of her phone conversation into the early morning hours, although she wasn't yelling. 2. Clarion misleadingly advertises a downtown location. This hotel is not within walking distance of restaurants and shops, although it schedules a shuttle with last pick up at 9. 3. I was traveling with my mother who is mobility-impaired and a minor son. I asked to pay for a cot which was no problem when I stayed at the Quality Inn. Clarion said that, because I already had a double, I could not purchase a cot. I slept in a small, hard chair since my son is bigger than me now. I slept very poorly and woke up with an aching shoulder.
This place has amazing brunch!!! Great coffee. Friendly staff too. We love to sit at the counter and watch the chef and team cook!

Great little guns and ammo shop. Quick and friendly. Pete was the best. We met him the night before at our neighborhood bar and then next day saw him at work here. Had no idea he worked there lol. My favorite thing is they were the only shop out of 3 other ones we went to that had the Govt. 45-70. was so stoked they had not only one but multiple ones. Definitely going back there maybe even this weekend now.

My mom and I popped in here on a Wednesday afternoon for a little treat. It was a bit hard to find (at the far end of a strip, south of 54th St. and east of the Monon trail). But once we found it, we were SO glad we did! We were greeted warmly and lucky for us, it was $1 macaroon day, so we sampled them all! Each one was quite delicious! We also ordered the Opera and the Provence cakes as well as 2 mimosas. Everything was delicious! I had the apple, ginger and lemon mimosa and it was so good. I really liked the vintage-y decor and the open kitchen where you can see the pastry chefs working away! I'd love to come back and get some croissants, and if we still have a warm day left, enjoy some sun on their patio! It's a great addition to the SoBro neighborhood!

One of my favorites in Indy!! Their brunch is to die for! I love the banana fosters crepes and of course all their macaroons and glorious gorgeous pastries! Super cute place as well and you can sit outside when the weather is nice!

A complete waste of time and money. I cannot believe the super-rich NCAA promotes this lousy attraction. A few banners and a couple of cheesy exhibits. No memorabilia at all and nothing interesting at all. Even the souvenir shop is lame, with only XXL sizes for most apparel. The NCAA should be ashamed of this , as it does nothing to honor champions

Giving this place a one because I have to, otherwise I would give it a zero! The manger herself was trying to force us to make payment for a meal that hasn't arrived,which is a thing that is very popular in New Orleans. Even though we were tying to cancel the order to meet friends. After politely telling her we do not want the food. She then said said after " I hope you guys don't do this to the next restaurant y'all go to". I thought that was inappropriate.I then realized why this place had 2.5 stars. Keisha however, our waitress was amazing! I felt really bad that she was in the middle of all this. So what I realized this trip was MAKE SURE you read Yelp reviews before purchasing, which was my mistake in the first place. I was just over excited with all the other restaurants my boyfriend and I tried. DO NOT COME HERE!

Wowowowow. I had heard great things, but never gotten to experience it for myself. We were here for a rehearsal dinner. And the menu was absolutely spectacular. They had a delicious charcuterie board for when we arrived. For our meal we had a butter green salad, mashed potatoes, green beans, Brussel sprouts, and a duck pot pie. There was not one bad thing on the table. I only wish I was able to eat more of the food. Tha I fully they gave us boxes to take home the left over food. 

 For dessert the had a variety of macarons, tarts, and some sort of pillow dessert that put me into a state of bliss. The staff was very friendly and polite. Especially when dealing with a room full of people celebrating. It was also fun for us to watch them prep the food.

Made an appointment to drop off a lease return with Dave Barlow and called a few hours prior to let him know that I wouldn't be there until an hour after the scheduled time. When I got there, he inspected the vehicle and took the plates off of it, but then told me that my account was flagged in the system. He then called GMAC to find out that they are closed in observation of the holiday. I am not sure why you, 1) Don't know your brand financing center is closed for the holiday, and 2) Why you didn't ensure all due diligence was done prior to said appointment. When I became justifiably irritated and I said I was not coming back another day, he tried to place the blame on me, saying I made the appointment through someone else(which was untrue). When I left, I made it a point to stop in John Barlow's office and make him aware of what had just happened. *Disclaimer- I have been a customer of Barlow GMC since 2014. This was my third leased vehicle with the dealership*. 

I explained that I had already purchased another vehicle elsewhere. He said that was fine.... and then said, "You know what, we will not do the lease turn in", and I needed to LEAVE and TAKE the vehicle with me. I refused and explained that I made an appointment two days prior and at no point was I informed that the account was flagged. I had called GMAC and was on hold 3 days prior.. I had the accurate account information, confirmed the last payment had been received ,and was made aware that I needed to call and arrange for return.  

I proceeded to leave, as instructed, at which time John came out into the parking lot and again demanded I take the car with me. Maybe he should have talked to Dave Barlow, because he took the tags off and had both keys in his possession. He insisted on yelling at me and said, "Who do you think you are?!" I replied ,"Have a great evening", and he continued!  

I cannot believe this man is 
Management, running out of a dealership and threatening me while he took his mask off to berate and demand that I take back a vehicle, in which I already made the proper arrangements two days prior to return! They did not provide me with any paperwork and now I have to be inconvenienced to deal with their financing, and hope & pray that they do the right thing and arrange for it to be picked up! 

Unprofessional and serious customer service/ management deficiencies at this location. I bet If I had bought another vehicle from them, they would have bent over backwards to make the sale.

* I will add that there was not one customer in the dealership and now I can see why! I have never had an issue with the service department and I do not believe one bad apple should spoil the bunch!

So this was my first time going to this shop and I was overall very impressed. 

1) the staff was super friendly and helpful. They answered all my questions and were very patient with me. 

2) $1 macaroon Wednesday's are my new favorite day of the week. They had four different flavors and you could buy as many as you wanted. 

3) the do have a lunch menus as well as other desserts that I'd loved to try. 

4) the only con I have is that their location is a little obscure and there isn't great signage for it. However, google maps does a great job getting you there and once you find it you can't miss it. 


I can't wait to go back!

Pros:
-We made a reservation on a busy night and got right in.
-Ginger cocktail was good.

Cons:
-Dark
-Loud
-Weird-tasting bbq sauce on the rotisserie chicken
-Expensive

I will not be back. I would rather have Boston Market.
Waiter was good but the management is rude.   He needs to find a new line of business.  I would not recommend eating there based on his attitude.
Your tech worked all day on my pc and eventually was able to solve the problem. Much better service than I received from Geek Squad.

First time visiting.  This was very yummy. I had the fondue app for my lunch along with a glass of their featured chardonnay.  Very good meal, good wine - oakey, buttery. Great customer service!  I enjoyed the visit and would go back

Very cool chic rustic ambiance with an open kitchen concept. This Cafe with Bakery counter is a very cool brunch and lunch restaurant. We spend our time visiting with each other at the Live Edge wood table and playing a game from their collection off their bookshelf. The food was interesting and very delicious. Perfect for a girls trip or a cute date.

I recently moved to Milwaukee after living in Indianapolis for 21years. I mean this with my whole heart: I came back to Indy this weekend just to have Saturday brunch at Gallery. This place is truly the most incredible pastry shop I've ever found. I've had croissants/macarons/coffee in multiple countries and from the most well-known names, but this place takes the cake. I've had the privilege of having two birthday cakes done by the amazing folks at Gallery. You will truly not find a place with more amazing food, delightful service, or enchanting atmosphere. You are missing out if you haven't treated yourself to a day at Gallery.

Erich is great. Very talented and sincere.  
You can definitely find quality and service.

I love their macarons!!

Mac Wednesday is my favorite day.  Macrons for a dollar?? Yes please! Every flavor I've tried has been wonderful, and I've tried a few...

My favorite at the moment is their Earl Gray.  I love Earl Gray tea and this mac tastes like you're drinking a cup of tea.  So crazy, so good.    

Check them out!

When I'm feeling a little travel sick for Paris, I now have a place to go that's much more cost effective than a plan ticket. 

That place is the Gallery Pastry Shop! I stopped in on the not-so-secret $1 macaroon Wednesday. We didn't get there until 8pm, so the two options they had left were a pretty purple dark chocolate and I think lemon? I got one of each and was enchanted like I was sitting on side street cafes in Paris. The decor practically forces this enchantment on you. European chic probably isn't the official stylistic term, but after enjoying a macaroon I couldn't help but describe it as such. 

The Gallery Pastry Shop is like the best of France. Like Allison F. said, elegant but not pretentious. I felt like I was welcomed to come curious, ask questions and leave enlightened and happily fattened by the desserts.

The space is open, well-decorated and is one of those places that will stand out all year round.
Ron so attentive during our whole meal ... we had a wonderful experience Everyone enjoyed their meal from brunch to fondue

What a wonderful brunch place in Indianapolis!  The crepes are excellent and the brulee fruit blend is out of this world.    The blood orange juice was very fresh!   I loved the service and the croissants.  Can't wait to him back again and try the macaroons!

The Gallery was tucked away in the back making it a little difficult to find. When walking in the sweet aroma of the pastries hit you in a way that makes you hungry before you are even seated or have had the chance to see the menu. We were a decent size group of 5 adults and one baby, easily accommodated with the larger tables towards the entrance. The group settled in with the half off champagne deal. I did not partake but the general consensus was that it was good, the only downfall was the waiter took away the bottle before it was empty and asked if we would be in for another which we nodded for another. Food wise we got the Egg Hash and 'Merica. It was all smiles once again, until the waiter came over to grab plates before one of the table guests was finished. We finished up with Eclairs, Turtle and Chocolate. Would definitely recommend to check out on a weekend morning!

I've visited NOLA three times, and all three times, I've walked at Frenchman Art Market. I love seeing other peoples innovations and ideas, so this place naturally draws me in to their stories. You can find things from handmade jewelry to paintings and lamps that are made of musical instruments. There are different vendors every night, so you'll always find something new and unique! And when I say handmade jewelry, I'm talking about super cute stuff you'd never be able to just think of on a typical Sunday. 

Even if you're not looking to buy anything in particular, this place is a must visit at least once on your trip. They're open at night, and I recommend going when it's darker because the string lights will turn on and the street looks much prettier then.

We stopped in today for a quick brunch and for some to-go dessert, and were welcomed with abundant outdoor seating and a menu full of yummy items. We tried the banana foster crepes which were so tasty that I forgot to snap a picture of how elegant and beautiful the plate was! They also have a selection of omelettes and savory or sweet crepes to choose from. We tried the iced latte, chorizo egg hash, and the Tiffany's omelette, both of which we scarfed down too quickly to snap a photo (SO good). Our service there was awesome and we felt right at home. There was little-to-no wait despite coming at 11am on a Saturday, and tables were properly spaced a part for COVID restrictions with plenty of outdoor seating available. Parking was free in the adjacent lot which is always a bonus. We will be back for sure.

Horrible experience.  I had my fence install scheduled for Monday morning and the owner (Adam) calls me to tell me my permit is not ready on the morning of the install.  I asked him if I can help push the permit through by contacting the local office and he said not to bother because it's very difficult to get through and that he's going there in person.  Well I ended up calling the permit office and reached them easily.  When I followed up on my permit they told me that there wasn't even a request for a permit.  Metro lied to me and they never even submitted the permit paperwork.  To make matters worse after I called the office (Adam wouldn't pick up or return my calls) to relay my message to Adam I never heard from them.  I had to follow up again with an email.  The office told me that their permit guy was out of town and that I can go get the permit myself for them to install the fence the next day.  I requested a refund and the refund cleared in a few days.  I was just shocked at the poor customer service.  No apology, no follow up, they lied to me and I didn't want to take the risk of them installing my fence.  Beware.  I'm almost positive that if I had issues after my fence was built I would have been treated the same way so this is why I canceled.  Not to mention look at all the snarky review replies.  Someone needs to teach this company some customer service.

Went here today for brunch. I got the croissant and gravy and the Brussel sprouts . Both were amazing! The croissant was yummy and buttery and the gravy was very meaty! The egg on top was a nice touch. I felt the portion was more than I expected, so I was pleasantly surprised. The Brussels were unique! I loved the combination of salty bacon with the dollops of creamy feta. I would highly recommend both! The trillium croissant was okay, but it cost as much as my meal. I felt it looked better in pictures than it tasted in person. I'm glad I tried it but probably won't get it again. 

The servers were very friendly. Only giving 4 stars because it was literally freezing in the annex (mass ave toys,) where we were seated. Be sure to dress warm!! I had to wear my coat the entire time and I was still cold. I'm definitely going back, but will request the main dining area next time.

I am leasing a new gmc sierra slt.  I worked with John LaSala.  The entire deal was done over the phone due to covid and due to the distance between where I live and the dealership.  After agreeing on a price and credit approval we met at a train station in the middle to sign paperwork and deliver the truck to me.  At that meeting he spent about an hour walking me through all the features and made sure I could program my phone and garage transmitter and set up OnStar. I have had the vehicle for about 3 months and everything is great.  It did take longer than expected to get the tags (as previous reviewers have written), but John was quick to FedEx me dealer tags prior to expiration when I needed them.  I eventually got the tags and all is good.   The only minor complaint is that they did not top off the diesel exhaust fluid.  It came to me half full, which John explained was standard practice from factory and that I'd get a fill up at my first complimentary service appointment.

The receptionist, the nurse Michelle, and Dr. Angeles are all very friendly, kind, considerate and helpful.

Went for a bacterial infection, both the nurse and Dr. A ask lots of questions about my condition and was very open and helpful in explaining everything.

All around excellent service!
Whether we're stopping in for a few macarons or purchasing multiple pastries we always receive exceptional customer service.
The food is delicious, the atmosphere is wonderful, and the service is excellent.   They are also very good about wearing masks and socially distancing you.
Locally owned, they make everything from scratch. Beautiful cakes, the best croissants, amazing brunch.

Great little gun store!!

Love this place! Unfortunately they were out of my ammo, but I found some clips I needed!  Staff was helpful, knowledgeable, and friendly.  The gun selection was impressive! 

Parking was tight but this place is worth your time!

My mom and I have been fans of the Gallery Pastry Shop since they opened. We go here for sweet treats for special occasions, so I thought this would be the perfect surprise for Mother's Day. I placed my order on Monday for Mother's Day pickup at 9:30am. I ordered the Petite Fours Sampler (pretty easy, premade desserts put in a box) to keep it simple. 

I arrived at 9:25 to get ahead of the crowd (only about 4 of us there) and my order number was written down and they told me they were grabbing it from inside. About 10 minutes later, no desserts in sight, a different person comes out to rewrite down the order numbers, with a crowd of about 30 people. 15 more minutes go by and still nothing. People who call in get their desserts immediately, while I am still standing outside waiting on my alleged 9:30am pickup. Of course, everyone starts calling and thus stops anyone from getting through. The crowd gets tired of standing in the cold and begins to form a line inside, again allowing those who push to the front to pick up and go. After about 20 additional minutes of waiting in this line, they tell people to step outside again. (Of course, there's no mandating of masks for a crowd of about 40 people in their parking lot). After an hour of waiting (now 10:30am!) I step in and repeat my order number for the THIRD time. About 5 minutes after that she asks what type of sandwich I wanted. I didn't have a sandwich with my order. I tell her it was only a sampler. A few moments later the box finally comes out nice and cold, indicating to me it was probably sitting in the fridge waiting for me over the past hour. 

I understand how busy this place was today but if you can't handle the number of pre-orders then set a limit. Don't bring out random orders with no rhyme or reason to the order of deliveries. Don't tell me 9:30 am when its actually 10:30 (only after being persistent). I'm a very patient person, but some system needed to be implemented. Almost all of the orders were pre-ordered, you had time to plan. I like Gallery Pastry. I left a nice tip on my pre-order because I knew they'd be working hard. But an hour wait? On premade desserts that only needed to be boxed? Absurd.

I'm in LOVE with this place! I can't rave about it enough. Disclaimer: I don't know if their brunch is always like this but I can only go off of my experience.

I was actually here for a brunch wedding reception and OMG amazing! The servers were great and super knowledgeable! We had Anya and she was seriously perfect. She gave her recommendations and they were spot on!

Their mimosas were really good and even had fruit to put in em. The crepes- AHH! I had a savory (bacon, chorizo, parm cheese, spinach, basil, mushrooms, and red onion) and a sweet one (peanut butter banana foster with chocolate mousse and homemade whipped cream on the side). DELICIOUS! The sweet one is super sweet so be ready. I could literally eat these crepes everyday!  We also had breakfast potatoes, a salad, and fresh croissants with fruit to share with the table. 

You can see all of your food being prepared as there is basically an open kitchen. Met one of the managers and he was a cool guy.

I really liked the vibe here. Cute little place with outdoor seating, tucked away along a strip of other shops, right off of the Monon Trail.

I'll definitely be back for brunch, on the weekends, during open hours. I would also host a little gathering here because I was that impressed. Such a great venue for a brunch reception. I've told everyone about this restaurant since Saturday!

Did I already say I was in love with this restaurant?

We've been coming here for 10 years. Absolutely loved it. Today, that all changed. We ordered the buffalo shrimp and usually it is fabulous, but today we were served buffalo shrimp that had the legs still on. It was disgusting. Not one, but all of them. So after telling the bartender she went to the kitchen. She came back and said "the chef said that's how we get them". Really??? Okay, so they don't clean them?? She knew I was upset, but instead just walked away. When paying the bill I asked her if she told the manager. She said she told Dave the manager. We were the only two people at the inside bar and the staff was hanging around talking at the service station. Outside was somewhat busy, but not that bad. For a manager to know customers were upset and to choose to let them leave upset is totally unacceptable. Goodbye Redstone, we will miss you, but obviously you don't care about losing business.

This place is actual pastry heaven. I cannot say enough amazing things about their pastries and food. Croissant sandwiches with local meat and cheese? Yes please. Tiramisu? Uh... yup! Macarons? Ten, please! 
Whether you're just grabbing a few $1 macs on a Wednesday or coming in for a full meal, you will NOT be disappointed! 
Also, you can sit at the counter and watch them create beautiful pastries behind the glass. This is a favorite for my 8-year-old!

This was hands down one of the best dinners i've had while dining out! All of the food was fantastic. I've been to redstone many times before, but this visit topped all of the others. The brussels sprouts appetizer was delicious, my mahi mahi was grilled the perfect amount, there was a nice serving of vegetables and the quinoa/farro was crispy yet cooked and seasoned so well! As for dessert, I almost always get the cookie sundae. It was just as yummy as usual, but i think the wonderful appetizers and entrée made it taste even better! Not to be forgotten, our server Michael was very attentive and the service was great. Awesome experience!!

A almost hidden corner of escape and funky bliss right in our backyard.  I only sought it out because I had met the guy and tasted his delicious treats.  

Quirky and cool, nice days outside especially cool with almost a pop up hippy/bohemian party vibe.  

Pastries and limited menu offerings are a great accompaniment to the scene that invites a great date conversation or, in my case, coffee and tea for me and my teenage girls after a dinner in Broad Ripple.

Soon to be classic on the Indy food scene.  Also more than fabulous to cater a special event if looking to impress

Given how much money the NCAA makes every year, I'm very disappointed with this museum.  It could have been so much better.  Yes, you can shoot a few hoops and play some interactive games although the sensors didn't seem like they were working too well on my visit.  I kept looking for any signs of sports or games memorabilia or displays, but couldn't find anything too interesting worth recommending.  Sure, I can look up information about teams and games on their computers, but that is something I can do at home. It is an easy place to walk through, not more than a half hour is needed.  It's cheap admission, but you get what you pay for.  It could and should be so much better.

This is one of my favorite places to come for food and for a good drink.  We've been coming for a while now,  and the atmosphere is great.  Bartenders are ok .. writing this because we had a great experience with Jessica the bartender.  If you are there ask if she is working, she'll make your night that much better, and her drinks are A+

I have tried to come here on several occasions I understand why they are always crowded on the weekends. Walking in the door the aroma was amazing. The menu may not have a lot to choose from which makes ordering great. My food was delicious . I even had to take some pastries home for later. I will definitely be back for the mimosas

I love their buffalo shrimp but the obnoxious bartender hitting on my dining companion the entire time? I could've definitely lived without that.

This actually happened a couple weeks ago and I'm ashamed and embarrassed that I didn't tell him to knock it off.

If you're skeptical about going here, follow your gut and don't. Their customer service is horrible, like most other people have stated on this site. They are overpriced, and have zero communication skills. If you don't want your time wasted, I don't recommend.

Great little Mexican place here in Smyrna. Here on business and looking for a great Mexican meal and we found it. The chips and salsa was great, chips fresh made, at least seemed to be, and the salsa was my dream salsa. Flavorful, but not to flavorful, medium spice, fresh, so goood!  Got a side of guac, it's pre-made but it was pretty good too.  I had the veggie fajitas and they were very good.  The other two had the fish tacos and while they weren't expecting the spice that ensued they both agreed they were good. From my vantage point I was impressed by the size of the fish filets in each taco. The beer was cold, service was good even if it wasn't over friendly and overall a good experience. If I'm ever back in town I'll be sure to stop back for some great Mexican flavors and an ambiance to go along with it.

My husband and I have mentioned going to brunch at Galley Pastry Shop so many times but had zero follow through until last weekend. Wow! We will definitely be back. 

First off, we were a bit surprised how chaotic things were when we arrived. There was not a clear place to put our name in for a table as everyone was standing in the small entrance and claiming they were all waiting to request a table. After we finally got through this process, we decided to get coffee while we waited for our table. This was also a confusing process as there was an employee coming around asking if we needed any drinks but also someone taking orders at the coffee bar. We both ordered a Pear Lavender Latte, which were beyond amazing! I'm fairly certain we would not have been charged for the drinks if we had not went to the front to give our used mugs and advised we needed to pay. 

The wait was rather fast, but we didn't mind since we had our beverages to enjoy. We were seated outside and the area is so relaxing. We both ordered a make your own omelette and a side of fruit. Kudos for having a great assortment of fruit and not the typical melon that many pass off as a fruit option. My omelette was delicious and there were so many items available to add. 

I can't wait to return and try other menu items!

Lets talk brunch. 
I rarely get out for brunch these days (two kids under 4), but this Sunday I made plans with a girlfriend for a kid free ladies brunch. I was counting down the days for this, and the posts from the gallery pastry shop on insta made the wait even harder. I made reservations via phone for two, and when I arrived I was glad we had! The place was packed, but our table was ready and waiting. We were seated quickly, and had a number of menus and pencils. Basically you can order a la carte, or you can order a create your own omelette, crepe, or select from one of their rotating breakfast options like a seasonal hash. We both did the omelette, adding all of the veggies, bacon AND sausage, and cheese. Then we added sides (extra $), hash browns, brulee fruit, and the croissant with tulip tree trillium cheese and bruleed fruit compote. I also enjoyed two blood orange mimosas (this was a must). The food was AMAZING. The show stopper was the trillium cheese with croissant and bruleed fruit compote, yes it was $12, but it was worth every dollar. We finished all of our food, and the servings were not small- but everything tasted so amazing we couldn't let a bite go to waste. Service was good, but we were so engrossed in conversation and enjoying our meals we hardly noticed anyone else. I wish I could eat this well every weekend- but my wallet is grateful I cannot. This is a wonderful spot for a fun and delectable brunch experience- but please, make a reservation!

The name of this place is quite deceiving. If you're looking for something honoring great players and coaches, this is NOT it. This is more of an NCAA Hall of Propaganda, with all of the information talking about how great the NCAA is and all of the great things it does. So if you're interested in seeing a lot of information on how great the NCAA is, check it out. If you want to see shrines to John Wooden, Magic Johnson, Coach K, Tom Osborne, Tim Tebow, etc., don't expect to find that here.
Good food. Loved the Peruvian steak and French fries thing. Vegetable Jalisco was also pretty good. Service was friendly but vanished after the first 10 minutes. Would define try again.

Outstanding meal...we started with Bang Bang shrimp which were huge, cornbread which was probably one of the best we have ever had. Dinner was prime rib, loaded mashed potatoes and the Brussel sprouts. Monique our waitress did an amazing job, made great suggestions and was very attentive even though it was a full house. MAKE A RESERVATIONN

Poor Responsiveness and Bad Service

We had a packrat inside the house a year ago, they came out and were very helpful in signing us up for a year contract. They were not out consistently to check on nests, some months they marked nests for removal and then didn't come for 1- 2 months after to remove them. After the year was up they started charging us monthly at which time we called the office 3 times asking for Anthony to call us back which he has yet to do. I will not be using this company again.
Try the corn bread appetizer it is awesome.

My new favorite brunch spot! I absolutely love all the garden areas outside that keep it tucked away. Also the life size chess area gives me the Alice in wonderland vibe. The indoor ties it all together with all diff table and chairs. I love being able to watch the chefs make your food in the open area. The caramel macchiato it to die for. They make all their own syrups. A pastry is a must whether it's a chocolate croissant, eclair, or macaroon etc. I also ordered the 2 eggs hash... couldn't believe all the fresh veggies, and how tasty it was. A really great spot in Indy.

The best place for Saturday morning brunch. The build your own crepe gives you the option to choose between sweet and savory. The macaroon ice cream sandwich is to die for! Also 1/2 priced bottles of champagne on the weekends make the mimosas taste even better. The staff is always friendly and makes you feel at home! You can easily access it off the monon trail and there's even a bike rack out front. If you haven't been yet, you're missing out!

Had the worst experience ever!From the very beginning the communication was very poor, the office staff very unprofessional, schedules were constantly moved, promises never fulfilled. My fence was poorly installed and i was promised the resolution, but after 2 weeks of me trying to contact them and resolve the issue my number was blocked, emails and voicemails ignored, even by the owner! Dishonest and bad company!

Sort of a let down if I am honest with myself. It was boring with a lack of information, memorabilia, or interesting items. Sensors are often not working for the interactive displays while the overall place is feeling worn out. 

The only upside? It's cheap to go there.

What a gem! Why didn't anyone tell me about this place??? Saturday brunch ! Bottomless mimosas, design your own omelet and macaroons to die for? Truly enjoyed our experience here! The eclectic artwork, open kitchen and cozy seating made for great ambiance!!'

Wow this probably marks one of the worst museums I've been to.
