The only weird thing in the process was staffing changes. We worked through it but no one contacted me as I had been promised and it took a few days to find out who I should be talking to. I assume they will get this worked through in the future though. And when I did get ahold of someone it went fine. 

Highly recommend going with them for any of your wedding bakery needs!

This place really fell off I don't know if management is failing but I do know for sure the employees are definitely failing. This is the fourth time in a row they screwed up my order and I was the only one in line, so did they screw it up by accident or did they do it on purpose? I'm starting to wonder. I'll never come back. But to be fair, ALL of the Wawa's around here have developed a real laissez-faire attitude about their job. But this one is terrible. FIRE THEM AND HIRE ME! I'll show you dorks how to make a fuckin hoagie!

Went here for their Valentine's Dessert Series and couldn't have been more disappointed.  I guess for $65 per person (plus $25 for the wine pairing) I was expecting more than 1 dessert that was actually a pastry.  For a pastry shop to serve 2 of only 3 desserts with no pastries -- affogato (essentially ice cream with espresso on top) and strawberries with chocolate -- and at this price point seemed lazy.  This is a pastry shop, not a creamery.  Show me your pastry making skills.  I was also expecting this to be more of an experience.  The servers didn't even describe what they were serving, they just dropped the dessert and didn't engage.  I will never go back here and I heard several other couples say the same thing as they were leaving.  This was not even close to the culinary experience I'd hoped.  You would be way better off going to any Cunningham restaurant and indulging in 1 of everything on their dessert menu.

Beautiful ! I had never been to the shop it's so cute  I had ordered to go and just went to pick up I had crepes and a croissant  i love the presentation even for to go everything tasted amazing I will be back for sure and these are the best crepes I've had in the city I have tried nearly everywhere for one this is my #1 place for them now

If I could give this review 10 stars I would. Wonderful local spot in the SoBro area, from the space and the environment, to the menu, to the service. We shimmied up to the bar and started out with a couple of drip coffees and an order of the fruit brûlée. They came back and let us know that they were out of the fruit brûlée, but suggested the brûlée trillium, which we were happy to try out instead. From there, we ordered a 2 Egg Hash and a Breakfast w/ Tiffany (1 crepe), both of which were delicious without being overly filling. My only regret is not grabbing a macaron to go!

I ordered a birthday cake for my niece from Gallery, and it was seriously one of the best desserts we've had! I requested to have "Happy Birthday" written one top, which they forgot... but man did they make up for it! Within 45 minutes they delivered a gold board with macrons and a little cheesecake that said happy birthday (from Broad Ripple to the Southside!) I cant say enough good things about the quality and customer service. Hands down a 5-star place!

Oh Gallery Pastry Shop, you never cease to wow me! Love this neighborhood spot! Gallery accepts reservations and I would highly recommend snagging some. My niece and I arrived around 930a on Sunday, so just after they opened. Most of the tables inside were already taken and they had not yet started seating outside or in their overflow area inside the former Mass Ave Toys. Sidebar, their outdoor space is just lovely. It feels just like a secret garden so add it to your patio list for the summer! We got a bar spot which was so much fun because we got to see all the hustle and bustle of the culinary magicians. There are no behind the scenes at Gallery. The creation area is all open so you can see the art unfold. And what they do here truly is an art, y'all.

We ordered:

Croissant and gravy: Not sure how I'll ever eat biscuits and gravy after this. We were meant to share all our dishes but hmm that didn't really happen with this. Sorry, Mikayla! The croissant was so buttery and flaky, and tasted like it just came out of the oven. The gravy was silky and rich but not overly so. Perfectly balanced.

2 crepes: Formage + added chorizo and bananas foster. The crepes were light, airy, and perfectly filled. Those were both pre-selected options but you can also make your own so I'll be back to try the lemon curd.

Grits: The corn, pepper, and microgreens really elevated this dish! So good.

My niece ordered several pastries to go but you can check out the pastry window and order to enjoy when you're brunching. Our service was excellent and prompt but didn't rush us at all! All around fabulous.

Absolutely worst experience ever.. gave a deposit to the owner of over $5000 back in February.. long story short, after numerous excuses and many rude encounters, our fence was never installed and I haven't received a penny back from my deposit. Used the court system and still nothing. Would NEVER recommend..

Gigantic chess set and fun atmosphere, delicious pastries and treats... fresh croissants? Yes! I can see why The Gallery is expanding with a 2nd location downtown. 

They make delicious treats! I was first introduced to them at a Yelp event. What keeps me coming back?  The food speaks for itself.. plus $1 Macaron Wednesday helps! 

 I just found out that they also do cooking classes. I wish they had more classes... but I understand that it could interfere with regular business hours etc. hoping with the new location they have additional classes!

GINGER MONROE FOR PRESIDENT!!  
So I randomly walked in on Saturday to look for a new vehicle and Ginger came my way and helped me.  I wasn't exactly looking to purchase right then and there but Ginger got me the best deal that just made sense for me and my family right now.  
She really listens to everything you say and picks out the best vehicle for me. I told her I never had a brand new car before.  I wanted a black-on-black-on-black GMC Terrain with a hot pink pin stripe.  I also told her how I'm hoping to become a mom in the next two years, and all of that good stuff. So she let me drive my dream car and explained all of the features but then she grabbed a 2020 Buick Envision for me to try out, with even more features, in a different color but with metallic flake in the paint- it was love at first sight. 
She explained how it's a luxury vehicle. What better way to buy your very first brand new car than to buy a luxury car?!  Also, it was dark which I wanted, since I hated my white car at the moment, it's one of the safest vehicles in the world so it's perfect for kids, it's so roomy and spacious so my 6'4 fiancé can sit in the passenger side perfectly. But it also has the metallic flake in the paint so I get the sexy look I was going for. I didn't even know this car existed! But I was in love with it.  She answered all of my questions and also helped me get insurance. 
I can't thank Ginger enough and I plan on giving Barlow Buick GMC all of my business from now on.

The staff here is great and they were very sweet to my dog. When I told them my dog was a pit bull there was no problem and they took good care of her. 
I got the bath and de-shed package and added teeth cleaning and nail clipping to my appointment when I called and made the appointment. 
Before she went back the groomer that came out asked me what we were doing today and I told her but thought it was kind of weird that information was not communicated to her from the front of the house. 
They said it could take an hour to an hour and fifteen minutes. I was waiting in the lobby when she came out about 40ish minutes after she went in. I thought this was great because the less time she spends in there the more business they can do and the less time my animal might spend in what might be a slightly stressful situation for her. 
I had already paid but noticed that her teeth had not been brushed and she still had big patches of hair on her shoulders that were ready to come out. She took her back to the back to brush her teeth and came back about two minutes later. 
Once I got her back to my mother's house where she lives. The first thing my mom said was "She smells great but why did you just do the wash and not the de-shed?" She broke out a brush and was able to get out a large amount of hair in just a minute or two. The groomer gave me the toothbrush she used to take home with me. I used the brush on her for a few more minutes and her teeth were so much cleaner than when she left. 
I don't know if this lack of quality was from them being over scheduled and trying to rush through jobs or a lack of experience by the particular groomer that was assigned to my dog. 
All that being said this place seems like a great place for breeds like Maltese, Bichon and Poodles etc but (from my experience) is not a good fit for short haired animals.

So happy we chose to try out Poochini's for our puppies first grooming.  We took our babies to Petsmart for what we thought was a puppy grooming but all they did was bath them and cut their face hair crooked!  The groomers at Poochinis were very professional.  They did a great job of trimming them up and making their first real grooming a great success! You could tell the puppies loved the experience because their tails were wagging like crazy when we picked them up! They were so fast too!  Great Job....Thank you ladies! :)

We enjoyed a fantastic brunch at the Gallery Pastry Shop this past weekend. They had an excellent set up that allowed you to sit outside or inside with socially distanced seating. We have two beautiful croissants and a variety of macaroons. The presentation was always beautiful. The service was great! Our waitress was polite and accommodating to all of our questions. We can't wait to go back!
I really like this place. The food is consistently very good and the service is always superior. They seem to truly value their reputation and want to ensure that the customer is happy.

So cute. Fun location.  My wife and I came here one afternoon for a dessert and a coffee.  It was fun and relaxing.  We sat and talked while drinking our coffee (and tea for her).  We decided we'd come back fro breakfast.  We did, but it is not an early breakfast place.  I really wish it were.  I think it opened at 10am, which was too late for our day.  So, in the mood for brunch?  This is your place!  I still give it a full sheet of starts because it was a nice place that is was local, small shops should be :)

What a cute place! Very eclectic digs
I had been wanting to try this place for awhile and today was the day!

When I arrived, the hostess greeted me and one complimented me as well. I felt very welcome even though I was dining alone.
I took my waitress's suggestion and had the pear lavender latte and enjoyed it very much.

I ordered the 2 eggs and hash and took the waitress's suggestion and got the Jowl bacon as well. It was delicious and rich.

The waitress,Katy, was very attentive and checked on me frequently. I appreciated it. My eggs came out over done but before I could say anything Katy stopped by and asked if they were all right and took them to get them redone. Everything was very well done and tasted very fresh.

I ordered the opera torte to go and had another, salted caramel to eat. Had to have boxes to enjoy later. Sizes were generous for the breakfast and the desserts were rich and delicious

Will definitely be back. Thank you all, especially Katy, on making this a wonderful experience! Just what I needed on a Sunday afternoon.

Visited on 11/17/19
I had visited RAG a number of years ago but couldn't remember how the food was.
We were invited by cousins S and S and met at just before 1:00 and the place was completely full, it was a good thing that our cousins got there a few minutes, (like 20) before we did. Our server Alishia, was great throughout our meal which complimented the beautiful ambience, and the quality of the food. A little bowl of four mini croissants with jam was brought to our table, and were very tasty, MDW was trying to watch her carbs a little so after asking, and finding out that no one wanted the last soldier, I made short work of him.
I found rave reviews on the house corn bread and this diffinitely did not dissapoint, it had a hint of jalapeno peppers, not overpowering, just enough to give it a little complexity, I loved it with the flavored butter that came with it.
Two orders of Redstones very popular Rotisserie Chicken was nicely presented and was well received. A Redstone burger was reported as  tasty. I ordered the French dip prime rib, which I liked, but, I was prepared for sliced prime rib, and not the shaved meat that I was served, I was a little dissapointed with the meat to bread ratio also, garlic mashed were very good.
I had heard good reports about the key lime pie, the slice came out and was large enough for the three of us to share, that pie is a winner.
The RAG is middle high end restaurant, and if your looking for a special place to treat yourself this is it.

Absolutely loved the food and service here. I really thought everything was extremely delicious and the coffee was something to comeback for! I thought the area was really nice as easy to find (the back of alley/street). I also noticed that price was really good for the quality and the staff was nice plus recommended great food!

I went once a week for about a month, and it was as good as the first time every time! The almond croissant is my absolute favorite thing on the menu, it's so good. The crepes are delicious too! You really can't go wrong. There are bottomless mimosas available some days, and the macarons are as yummy as they are beautiful!

Was driving through the state and found this place on Yelp. Nice clean restaurant. Great salsa and chips!! They have quite an extensive menu including a Peruvian menu. We ate the Chicken Fajita Salad and the Veggies Fajitas. Both were very fresh and delicious!! Large portions, had to get a takeout box. Thank you for the excellent service and food!!
Went there hoping to eat two days in a row only to told condescendingly that they decided to close the kitchen over an hour earlier than published hours, but that I should "please come back!" Eeesh.

Nothing gets me more irritated than when u order something during your 30 min break and they get it wrong. All I wanted was a plain cheese burger. Too much to ask???  Of course I get it and there's mayonnaise on one side of the bun and mustard on the other. Like get it right. I would've been better ifff at McDonald's and would've saved $15 .

Our Mother's Day delivery was over 3 hours late and missing important item (how do you eat biscuits and gravy without biscuits?). The scheduled delivery time was the first of the day.
If the customer service had been more apologetic or accommodating, I'd be back. They weren't.

Jim and Katheryn are the best of groomers.  We love to visit them, get bathed, brushed and spoiled.  It is so pretty in the shop and Jim and Katheryn love us.  We come out like sparklers and our Mom is delightfully happy.  Please bring your pets there...they will love it!
Tootsie, Mellie and Fleura Bell

Eric was extremely helpful and educational. A pleasure to deal with!  I went in just to look around and left two hours later with a ton of information and the intention to return when I'm ready to purchase.  Never pressured at all and felt appreciated.

Pretty much love everything about the spot. Really sweet location cool atmosphere delicious food!! Can't wait to go back and try out some of the incredible desserts. I have an 18-month-old and it was really nice bc it's tucked back in a corner away from street and I could just kind of let her play, they have a huge chessboard that's fun for the kids.

I ordered my mother a gift from here for Mother's Day at the recommendation of a friend and she loved it! Yes, it was delivered a little later than expected, and they did need to substitute something, but they were so sweet and professional and my mom loved her gift. When this virus nonsense is over I will visit in person, but until then, I hope to take advantage of their carry out services. Thank you again to Gallery for making my mom's day so special!

Super fun little museum. We spent about 90 minutes visiting here. We used a Groupon so it was $2 a person. The trivia downstairs was fun. It was nice to shoot some hoops for the first time in forever. The other interactive exhibits were fun as well. The trivia reminded me of jeopardy. Normal price is $5 and I'd find it worth that. Make sure to get your parking validated for $5 cost. It doesn't seem like it gets crowded on most days so that is a plus with covid right now.

It's been a minute since I've reviewed a restaurant and this time my travels take me to New Jersey. You know the Garden State?  Right?

This trip takes me to a place called Redstone and let me tell you the service to the food are top notch and I have 3 data points, er visits to support it!

This time I had their rotisserie chicken which is what they're known for and it was outstanding.  Juicy and Smokey flavor until the end. In fact if I had to make one criticism it would be the asparagus was a bit stalky but hey, it's out of season for most regions!

I've also had the sea bass, scallops, and the Brussel sprout appetizer. My work associate thinks the Brussels are the best he's had on this earth in his 50 plus years on this planet. I would agree. The Brussels are a force to be reckoned with!  Give it a try and tell them Matt sent ya!!  Nah, they don't know me!

Cheers!

I love every minute of this restaurant! First let's start of with the Buffalo shrimp, this is a must have. Do not skip out on this appetizer!! Next I got the Redstone burger and it was unexpectedly very good, the burger was juicy and the taste was Exquisite. I ended the night with WARM CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE SUNDAE and that was fantastic! Love this restaurant and I will be back.

Checked online to make a reservation. The information section had a wait list feature and when I tried to be added to a wait list, it said  there was not a wait.... perfect! Upon arrival we were asked if we had a reservation! Since we did not think there was a wait and did not make a reservation we were seated in "the annex". Which is across the parking lot in a big brightly painted yellow empty  room with picnic tables. No attempt at atmosphere and sadly very  disappointing. Part of the charm of Gallery is the restaurant itself. The food is the same excellent food but I felt like I was at a  camp mess hall.   
   The hostess  did inform us to call for reservations next time. By going actually on their website, I would have read to call for reservations. Had I known we would be seated in "the annex" I wouldn't have bothered. So before anyone comments how Pastry Gallery is trying to survive during the pandemic, I fully acknowledge and appreciate this. However, on the other hand I am going out to dine and trying to help them survive during said pandemic. I just don't care to spend at least $15-20 per person on breakfast to eat in "the Annex". Lesson learned.
I only go to Barlow for my Buick service. The staff is very customer service oriented, the work is great and they never disappoint!

Seriously... A-Ma-Zing!!!!

The Gallery Pastry Shop - ooohhhh indulge!!! 
Their desserts and SUCH works of art! I thought I'd seen amazing desserts... until today. Wow! If nothing else, go LOOK at these in the case. And if you want to be blown away, try one, or two, or three!! 

To sit and watch the pastry chefs work their masterpieces, fantastic and amazing! 
And oh yum, had a raspberry macaroon = Decadent! 

And next... I hear their weekend brunch may be the best in town!! Sweet, I'm there!!!

I can't believe I have never written a review for this place. My wife and I starting visiting Red Stone Grille together when were living in the Mercer County area.  We drove down a few times a year just to eat at Red Stone Grille.  Now, one of the benefits of moving to Voorhees is Red Stone Grill is down the street; Good thing there is a track in between.

I can honestly say that I have never had a bad meal here; including an entrée I really didn't enjoy. The ribs and steaks are good, and the Chicken is awesome!! Do yourself a favor and order the signature items like the buffalo shrimp and the cornbread. 

Due to a few disappointments, I am not much of a specials kind of guy. When I visit a restaurant, I like to try the items that they make daily, the things they are known for. I am always open to trying the specials at Red Stone. Could it be that I tried just about everything on the menu and need change? No, that's not it.  I can eat anything off that menu every day. Or could it be that I trust whatever they whip up is going to be full of flavor, and quality.

We went to brunch at Red Stone for the first time Sunday. It was pretty good. We did the family style breakfast. It is a plate with one piece of French toast, a helping of scrambled eggs with cheese, hash-browns (which are pretty damn good) two pieces of bacon, and a piece of sausage. Not what comes to mind when it says family style, as I am used to family style being sharing items from various items so we each had our own family style plate.  Wife was not happy as she only went with the family style to please the Yelper here. She really wanted her Salmon omelet. You can order another helping of each individual item as much as you want. So it's pretty much a sit and serve buffet without all the lines and snotty nose kids touching everything. 

I am a huge breakfast fan so I tend to critique it a little harder so here are my issues.  Another piece of french toast could be on the plate and the eggs are a little soft for my taste; that's it. Think I am going to try Ala Carte next time; what...heck yeah I am going back.

This was our first trip to Nashville and after searching through dozens of hotels, I felt the Clarion was the best deal with as many amenities that were offered. We were definitely not disappointed! 

Check in was at 3 but since we got there earlier than planned, we got to check in a few minutes early. The shuttle is super convenient and the drivers were so nice! The breakfast was great! They have a waffle and pancake maker, but my favorite were the biscuits and gravy! Every staff member that we came in contact with during our stay was super nice! We got dinner at the bar on our last night instead of going out and it was very convenient and the beer was nice and cold. The room was very clean, the shower had great water pressure, and the bed was comfortable. Plus, free parking! 

We will definitely stay here again on our next trip to Nashville!

Here's the thing. The fondue is literally everything. I love it so much. The chicken is really juicy and the fruit is always fresh. Let's not talk about the croutons otherwise I'll have to own up to eating them before the rest of my party eats it. It's better they not know.

The service is generally very good. There are a few waiters/waitresses that are a bit pushy for ordering. I like to take my time - I'm not a marathoner and definitely don't hog tables- but after eating my weight in fondue, I have to really have a conversation with my digestive system. Can it handle a round 2? Should we get the flatbread or burger I want? 

The one complaint I have is their younger hostess which is why I unfortunately have to give this place 3 stars. The hostess is the first person I see when I walk into a restaurant, and the last person to leave a good impression on the way out.  There have been numerous ocassions where this specific hostess goes out of her way to be rude to people (not just me and my party) entering and exiting the restaurant. I was with someone who was out of commission because of a severe arm injury and requested a table where this person could place their arm on the table in an effort to make them more comfortable dining. I overheard a conversation between two of the hosts regarding this matter and the attitude and lack of compassion for someone experiencing an injury was disappointing. I thought younger people were better than that. Alas, I digress. The matter is over, but it definitely made me a bit sad to hear. 

During the warmer months, the patio is beautiful. 

All in all - this place is clean, the service is good, and the food is very good. The salmon is a favorite as is the short rib entrée. Maybe just avoid the hostess. Is there a back or side door where one can enter next time? Asking for a friend.

Love this place so cute. Gives off classy yet rustic vibes. I recommend this place if you're out with your friends and just want to hang out. All the pastries are made at the place and it's so cool to watch the bakers but care into the things they make. A little bit pricey but overall a good experience.

The Gallery Pastry Shop is truly a place of awe and whimsy. Whether you spend a Saturday morning brunch alone at the bar and lucky enough to indulge a Beyoncé Hour with Courtesy Champagne or spending a birthday with your closest friends in the Patio, you will have a thousand reasons to return. My family and I often come here to spend time together when we are all in town because the crepes + omelette a customize-able and to die for! Uh and let's not forget the real reason why we come... PASTRIES!
Croissants, macarons, opera cake, and the gelato ... OMG ! There's not another place in the State that comes even close to compete! 
Alison Keefer & Chef Ben  truly love what they do and you feel the love right when you walk in and taste the love with every bite of that brûlée'd trillium croissant.  For a little preview of heaven, try a dessert board but come with an appetite. I rarely write recommendations but I feel like I'm doing a disservice to anyone who likes to eat by not speaking about how satisfying this GEM is.

And when u park - park across 54th street so you can walk those calories off lol. I like to leave those few spots to the elderly or people with kids! Be considerate!

This is a total Jewell.  Great spot for brunch  short menu but everything was super Delicious   The crepes are a must have .   The croissants are beyond good.  The parking is a bit tough.   Lots of shops to visit after brunch.
If only the cheese were melted. And I'm not taking about once or twice. The cheese is never melted. It's just crazy. Every time the food is cold! Like dozens of times. And they're slow

This place is adorable! My friend and I tried it for the first time and loved it! The inside reminds me of a bit of a hole in the wall restaurant, but it was also very clean and charming. It was a little hard to find, but if you go all the way to the end of the building it is in, you'll see it pretty easily. They also had outdoor seating and plenty of parking. 

We arrived at a good time and were able to be seated immediately. It did get busy towards the end of our visit, but they were good about getting people seated as soon as they could. We sat at the bar seats that faced the kitchen. These seats were actually pretty cool because we could see all of the food being made. One of the gentlemen making the food was very friendly and even made small talk with us for a little bit. 

We both ordered two crepes. I got the Fromage which had 3 types of cheeses, pesto and I added tomatoes. For my second I wanted something sweet so I went with the Bananas Foster one. They were both amazing. They were so good, I can't decide which I liked more. Looking forward to going back and trying the Greenie as well!

The best Chilean Sea bass dish. Hong Kong style.  Brussel sprouts yummy.
Great food great severs

I bought a TV at BestBuy. I tried for 1 h to contact them to send their Squad to install, impossible. So i searched online and Yelp, found HelloTech. I scheduled in 5min online, received a confirmation and request for photos to make sure that i had all they needed. The tech was ON TIME, did exactly what was needed. Was professional, installed the TV, DVD player, made sure that all was hooked with my wifi and that it was working. Oh and the cost was much cheaper than Geek Squad... So i do recommend Hello Tech, and will use them again if needed.

I've been going to Dr. Angeles for well over 10 years. I have chosen to remain a patient here despite the long wait times for appointments because I strongly believe that the quality of care I receive here is beyond my expectations. I've had routine skin checks to cosmetic procedures and I have always been impressed. I've referred multiple friends and family members here who have also had similar experiences to my own with this office. Dr. Angeles always returns my calls, spends time with me during each office visit and I can honestly say I've never once felt "rushed." I believe she truly cares about her patients and doing things well.

My absolute favorite spot in Broad Ripple!! I'm a sucker for a good macaron but the lovely people at the Gallery Pastry Shop absolutely kill it!! Every flavor I have tried has been incredible, but lemon is my favorite for sure  I also LOVE their lavender pear latte. I make it a weekly trip for $1 Mac Wednesdays and will continue to do so!

Cute brunch spot to take girlfriends or family that are out of town! Very cool Instagram aesthetic . The service was good and so was the food. Slightly overpriced, but that's what you get downtown Indy!

The Gallery Pastry Shop is European style meets local products. I believe they have achieved this.

I couldn't decide between two choices and based on my server's recommendation I had the Trillium Brûlée, since that is only something you would find at The Gallery Pastry Shop. The Trillium Brûlée is perfect for those who prefer sweet over savory. It was definitely a nice change from the usual eggs served with veggies that has saturated brunch. I also had the seasonal fruit (good, but the little amount is overpriced for $5). To drink I had the pear & lavender latte (great, but the drink was luke warm by the time I got it).

I got one of their pastries to-go, and it was the Black Forest. Each pastries' presentation is what you would find in high-end patisseries in Paris like Laudrée. The pastry was delicious and was the perfect amount to satisfy my sweet tooth.

Overall, the service is good and I would put it in my rotation for brunch spots.

The outside atmosphere is amazing and the blood orange mimosa was delicious! Menu items for brunch were staples like omelets and crepes, but with a fancy flair (think tulip tree trillium). A really good experience, though don't expect to get in/out quickly
I enjoy visiting this place but I wish they had more options. The pastry's were yummy but very pricey so be ready for that.

The Hall of Champions is nice to visit once and you are good. Total time to zip through the exhibits and video presentation is right at about an hour. Check Groupon prior to visiting. They have 2 for 1 visit coupons. I wish there were more exhibits and a thorough view of the NCAA. The banners for some of the major sports were cool to see. However, football was missing from the banners. I was bummed, being a Clemson fan. The interactive portions, on the second floor, were nice. You can shoot hoops, and play a few interactive sports games. Total time through the museum is about an hour, depending how long you stay and read the different exhibits. It's worth to visit one time. It is small and I expected a bit more from the NCAA but, it is cool to visit once.

Very Very Good.

Drink 5/5 : I love the grapefruit soda so much. My friend loves her coffee as well.

Pastry 5/5 : I don't think we have a lot of French style pastry here. I didn't try macaroon which looks good because I'm not a fan. I love my eclair though.

Ambience 4.5/5 : I was my first time and a lil difficult to find the place. The kitchen was open style and I can smell food instead of bakery.

Parking 4/5 : not so much of parking spot. (Friday)

Overall 5/5 : I will go back.

Reason number 1001 why I take my pups to Poochini's: My little boy wasn't feeling well today. Instead of forcing him to endure a haircut and blow dry, Kathryn felt it was best to keep him calm and gave him a warm bath, snuggles, and love instead. She even found a way to schedule him for a haircut for when he's feeling better. Wouldn't you take your puppies to someone who cares about them as much as you do? My heart is filled with joy that I have such a professional, loving way for my puppies to get beautified!! Love this place!!!

I popped in quickly after hearing from a friend that this sweet little place had $1 macarons that day. I stepped in and immediately fell in love. What a beautiful space!

The macarons were delicious and delicate, and generous in size. 

I'll be back for more than a few macarons to-go.  Next time I return it'll be for a relaxing chat w/a friend, a date night, or one of their baking classes ($75/person, includes adult beverage!).

We (2) went on a Friday at noon and it was our first time. Busy but not overcrowded. The service was great and our server answered all of our dumb questions. I had the JLT on a croissant and it was great. My friend had the vegan hash & said it was amazing. We got croissants & some desserts to take home. I will say that if you want desserts, go early as there wasn't much left but our server saw a whole group come in and go straight for the dessert case and ran and grabbed ours before they were gone. My friend loved everything so much he took his partner back the next day. I have another reservation for next week!

Came here for my birthday and Nick was our server.  I had no idea that this location existed because I always go to the downtown location.  We were super happy because this location was closer and went over and beyond for the bday. Nick was amazing, he made sure my birthday was sweet. He took time to explain the menu and offered me all the vegetarian options! The mimosas... were amazing! Love how they have the packages. Having bottomless would be even better! I ended up getting the broccoli and the pesto vegan breakfast. It was super tasty. I loved the plants and environment, and I really thought it was cool how you could watch the cookers cook the food! Score. 

Pros
Nick
Customer service 
Decor

Cons
N/A

Pleasant service, lots of information, and light creamy pastries of assorted colors and combinations!  Yum!

I stopped in after lunch to pick up some tasty treats to go.  Since it was my first visit, I stood to the side for awhile and let the hostess behind the pasty bar help several others, explaining as she went.  

Since the appearance was somewhat hypnotic, I simply bought a sample of lots of things!  There were large crispy croissants, both plain and almond flavored filled with almond butter.  Macarons were on sale today, so I picked up some of each flavor:  Rose Raspberry and Salted Chocolate Caramel.  These are fresh and dissolved in my mouth when I ate them, not the brick hard kind I find too often at the grocery.

The Chocolate Pillow was a flourless chocolate cake covered with a chocolate mousse glaze and hazelnut crunch (and a touch of gold leaf!) and the Provence is a beautiful half sphere of macaron base topped with lavender and white chocolate mousse.

I also tried the Opera:  an almond sponge layered with coffee buttercream and ganache.  
Sure the prices are about the same for each of the specialty items as you would pay for a dessert in a restaurant, but if you have will power, you can get just a few and refrigerate the ones you don't scarf down right away to make the prices seem more affordable! :)

But these aren't tastes and textures you get from a mass produced bakery.  My photos don't do them justice since they got a little knocked around on my 50 minute car ride home.  Trust me, these treats are something special and can help make your day a little nicer!

Review #162

I have been a serious collector and shooter for many years. I am very maticulus with every firearm I own, 100+ .  With that being said I have been nothing short of impressed with Idaho Gun. The staff may not tell you what you want to hear but it is always truthful and honest which I very much appreciate. I have seen many gun shops where fair prices and honest staff are nowhere to be found. At Idaho Gun you will experience great service, honest sales staff, and fair prices.  All of the staff have been helpful and respectful.  If Ray is there you will be treated to a wealth of history and interesting facts. Scott has always been pleasant and reliable with grading and value on his firearms from new in the box to vintage collectables. This is also true on the guns you may want to trade in.   I highly recommend stopping in and see what is on the shelf when in that part of town. You won't be disappointed.

Incredible restaurant! We go here for every special occasion! The strawberry doli is a must. Had their new Korean BBQ short ribs dish and I'll never be the same. I still think about it! Cannot wait to go back

Best service you can find! Every waiter is amazing. Great work !

I was such a nervous Mom about having my Beagle Shi Tzu mix Agatha go to another groomer. I went to what was supposed to be one of the best groomers in the Tucson area, even drove quite a distance to have her groomed there. She hated it. It took most of the day before I could come back and pick her up. Poor little thing looked so pathetic in this CAGE. Hardly ever got the same groomer. No personal touch at all.

I decided to groom her myself and have for the last three years.....not an easy task, even though I tried to study proper grooming on the net as much as possible. I still had to take her to the vet for her nails and a butt check, so what I saved grooming her myself, I spent at the vets.

NOW.......comes Poochini's........what a difference, they are all I have dreamed of having as groomers for my little furry friend. Katheryn really knows what she is doing and asked a lot of questions, even followed some earlier photos I brought of Agatha to groom her the way I wanted. She gave her suggestions which were outstanding too.

No matter how well I brushed her and kept her groomed every 4 or 5 weeks she shed everywhere. Now finally she has been properly groomed and not a hair in site where it doesn't belong. I am so relieved.

I thought Agatha would be nervous and dislike the process as she wasn't crazy about being bathed or groomed when I did it, but Jim was so gentle and loving that she didn't mind at all.

They are a fantastic team and run an outstanding establishment. I felt like I was in someones calm and beautiful home while sitting in the lounge area. They treat the owner's of the pets as good as the pets. Agatha loved finding a treat and just curled up on the rug in lounge just like home. She was totally happy.

PS.......this did not cost any more than I was paying at the former groomers four years ago!

All I ask is that you just stop by like I did and you will know immediately that if you really care about your furry little creature, this is the ONLY place to take them.

When you live in  Voorhees, NJ, you quickly learn that there is a lack of decent restaurants from which to choose. We use to love Redstone because of the buffalo shrimp but even that can't carry this place any longer. The last four of five times we have eaten there have been more and more disappointing.  Order chicken wings with no blue cheese and mention "NO BLUE CHEESE" several times and it comes loaded with blue cheese and extra blue cheese. Order barbecue ribs well done - they come out horribly undercooked. Tonight we tried one last time. My wife ordered chicken marsala and when she tried it - it was inedible. So I took a bite to see what she didn't like and - it was inedible and I spit it out.  We told our server who we really liked that it was terrible and were trying to be kind to because she was kind. She asked if we minded it she felt it and she did and said, "Oh gosh - that doesn't feel right." Which was validating but - stuff happens. So we took it in stride and she asked if my wife would like something else and my wife ordered the buffalo wings. Always good. Tonight, they were not up to par but they weren't awful so she ate them anyway and didn't complain.  Our server asked if we wanted dessert and we ordered two lattes and a slice of chocolate cake. Both lattes came out first and they were cold. I don't mean lukewarm, I mean straight out of the refrigerator cold. So when our server came to the table I kindly smiled at her, gently took her finger, the same one she felt the chicken Marsala with, and very playfully placed it in the latte. She said - "Oh my gosh. You guys have the worst luck."  She took them back and a few minutes later the cake came to the table, which was good - so we started without the lattes. Several minutes later, when we were nearly finished with our dessert, fresh hot lattes were brought to the table. So, me never gave our server a moments grief or made her feel bad but we just weren't going to eat and pay for subpar food. We asked for the check and were blown away when the chicken Marsala was still on the bill. So when our server once again returned to the table, again, I very gently took her finger and and pointed it at the chicken Marsala. She laughed and apologized again and brought the check back without the chicken Marsala on it. We tipped her very well as we always do. However, in conclusion, my wife and I have live in NJ for three years now. We have spent a literal fortune at this restaurant but can honestly say that this was the final straw that broke the proverbial camel's back.  We just can't do it anymore. I don't know if the restaurant is under new management but it has gone down hill faster that Chris Christie on a tobaggan sledding down the Matterhorn. We're done!
Adorable patio and Cafe. The almond croissant was the best thing I've ever eaten. Made to order every meal is made to order. Very attentive  wait staff. You'll feel like you are in Europe

I was researching "Best" dog groomers, and came across Poochini's. Unfortunately, I will not be giving this establishment my business, as they very ignorantly state Chow Chows as "aggressive". I seriously cannot believe that they would say this.  On to the next!!

The Gallery Pastry Shop certainly never disappoints!  I ordered the 2 made to order crepes (one vegetarian, one with berry complete and lemon curd). They were absolutely delicious!  My fiancé ordered the chorizo hash and it was fabulous as well. Definitely order the grits to share...they were worth it!!  And the $25 mimosa kit was a perfect addition. We'll be back!

I had a quick trip to the Gallery Pastry Shop to grab some quick dessert to take to a dinner. I live very close to the GPS, which is both fantastic but, also could lead to an addiction to really quality desserts. I was astounded by the activity happening when I walked in. The kitchen area was enormous with four or five workers dishing out high quality pastries. I could have watched them for hours but, I was on a mission for a dessert. I was blown away at the mastery and visual appeal of all of the desserts/pastries. They were definitely Insta-worthy. I decided to go with the special chocolate mousse eclair. They were $5 each, which isn't the highest price. The packaging was fantastic and unexpected. When I took my first bite, I couldn't speak for a few seconds, due to the flavor of the chocolate and pastry. I had to take some time in between bites to really savor the flavor of the chocolate and pastry. I will be back and I will cross some of these pastries off of my dessert to-eat list. I've also heard great things about the brunch here! Highly recommended for any dessert lover!

This place is truly a hidden gem.  I am not a big quiche person and after having theirs, I actually dream about it.  Don't get me started on the macaroons!  Lemon and raspberry are perfect for a summer day and you can't go wrong with any of the chocolate flavors.  The service is fantastic and I enjoy the open kitchen and eclectic vibe.  This is one of our "go to" places!

Tucked away off the Monon, this little spot is cute inside and out. 

If you're only stopping for an instagram moment, you will be majorly missing out. Delicate, buttery, perfectly crisp croissants and pastries await you. The brunch has a nice balance of sweet and savory options. Plus, an assortment of tasty drinks.

A wonderful place to visit with friends or family.

One of my fav places to get brunch. Very unique entrees and the best pastries in Indy!  I've never had a pastry from here that I didn't love. The staff is always kind and welcoming. The atmosphere at gallery is to die for, despite seating being limited due to covid.

This place has the worst customer service.  We planned on purchasing more guns but now we won't be buying them here.  We purchased a 9mm from here and when we went to the range to shoot it, the mag arm fell out so the magazine wouldnt lock in.  We took the gun back and THREE employees treated us like crap.  They talked down to us and acted like we did something wrong.  It turns out we have to return it to the manufacturer so I was right when I told them I was afraid it was defective and wouldn't work in case of emergency.  They were so rude and disrespectful. My husband is a veteran and to treat us like that is very unamerican.

My 3 girlfriends and I love this cute place. A least one time a month we meet there for brunch. We enjoy very delicious food and mimosas. I enjoy trying something new each time and one friend gets the Brûlée Trillium
Croissant, Tulip Tree Trillium, mixed berry compote, honey, pecans. She is obsessed over it!!! Their desserts are amazing as well and if the have one with pistachios we will get it. It's a really cute cafe and we enjoy walking around the area after we have a great filling meal. I highly recommend you give it a try!

I decided to go to The Gallery Pastry Shop since the DJ was playing some Beyoncè songs called the Bey Brunch. The restuarant does offer takeout, and at the moment we can only eat at patio outside which is big enough, enough spacing, hand sanitizer stand, and all staff were wearing masks. The weather was nice, I sat in the back, the Server gave me a menu to look at, but I had to walk up to another person so they could put in my order due to what's going on. I ordered a grapefruit mimosa, and sausage and gravy on a  Croissant with bacon on top. The brunch was delicious, and the sausage had a little too much seasoning for me, but other than that the meal was good. I'll definitely be back especially since it's close to the Monon Trail, and other fabulous shops in Broad Ripple. Also, on the weekends they offer $15.00 mimosas I was going to get that, but I went by myself.

This place is incredible. I had a birthday party here and we all got crepes and dessert. I had tried some of their desserts beforehand, and the savory food was just as good. Their little cheesecakes are the best I've ever had. Their desserts are so creative and so delicious. I would highly recommend this place for a date or special occasion.

My first impression of this store was not very good and progressed to horrible very quickly. I initially drive to their location on W Overland Rd in Boise to purchase a Holosun gun sight. When I walked in they were not very busy (one other customer). I was told they didnt have the item and that it would come faster if I ordered it myself then if he ordered it. I thought this was odd, most stores will offer to order for you, waive the shipping charge and have it delivered to your home. 
I ordered it that day, Dec 16. Received an email that said it would be shipped within 1-3 days.  Kept looking for a shipping email and even went to the website looking for a way to check on my order. No way to do that.  Kept holding out hope it was being shipped as it said. With it being Christmas time I kept forgetting about it during business hours to call and find out where it was. 
Fast forward to Dec 25th and still no gift for my husband. I found the Contact email address and sent an inquiry about my order. 
Received an email back with a lame excuse saying the manufacturer wouldn't allow it to be shipped to my home and that it was being shipped to their store. No contact name of who sent the email or a phone number. It would miraculously be at the store the next day, Dec 27th. (This was not a gun, just a sight)
I asked for them to let me know when it arrived. No phone call. I checked late in the afternoon and it was there.  Spoke with the Manager who couldnt answer any of my questions as to how this happened because he was "just" the manager and the owner took care of the website. He also didn't understand why it couldn't be shipped to my home.  My husband picked up the sight and asked that we be refunded the cost of shipping since we had to drive to their store to pick it up. The manager couldn't do it. He was just the manager and couldn't do anything that had to do with the website. He took my number and said he would have the owner call the next day.  SURPRISE! No phone call from the owner.  
We will never do business with this store again and will let our friends know of the unprofessional and poor customer service we received from start to finish. 
If I do eventually get a phone call and shipping charges refunded from the owner the post will be updated.

I recently revisited Gallery Pastry Shop for Sunday morning brunch with friends and it's just as quaint and unique as I remembered. We managed to snag a table on the patio and while we were there, it quickly filled up with patrons. The later in the morning you get here, the longer you will have to wait.

The mimosa and two egg hash were delicious. 

My only complaints are 1) difficult parking, which I realize isn't entirely their fault but is a challenge nonetheless and I imagine deters some customers and 2) once we were finished eating, our waitress hovered in the hopes of hustling us out so she could flip our table for new customers. I get it, but it seemed like she was a little too eager to give us the check and get us out of there.

Visited this gorgeous shop during our Macaron Day tour. Tucked away, close to the Monon Trail - this place is a hidden gem. Offering pastries that are stunning to the eye and no less amazing to eat. The macarons were perfectly made (and beautifully displayed) and come in an array of colorful choices. The colors are fun, but the flavors are also very neat! We opted for Matcha Green tea and a Salted Caramel. The decor here is an Instagramers paradise! Complete with a beautiful bar set so that you can sit an enjoy your bounty, while looking in at the kitchen working diligently to prepare their beautiful treats! The service was lovely - even though we were simply there for our free macaron for Macaron Day. We will be back very soon for what looks to be an amazing brunch with mimosas. This has become a new favorite for us!
We absolutely love coming here. Food is almost always amazing for the price and the atmosphere is great! Good parking always available.

After looking around at several other gun stores in the area I came to find out that I was highly over charged for one of the guns I purchased here, and only slightly over charged for the other, at least I got screwed with a smile..... 187.95 At impact for a gun I paid $259.95 for here.... $499.95 for a gun I paid 549.95... I'm disappointed because I truly thought I found a good honest gun store that I could take all my business to, I guess I should have looked around a little more.

We shall see...... I knew I had come here before and thought .. "Meh" lol.. but seriously it is just that. The staff and service are great but the food is, well over-priced and not all that. If you just keep walking a little further and deeper into the district you will get some really great food and really affordable prices. 

I knew not to stop a second time but I had a cousin with me who said she was gonna pass out if we didn't stop to eat like NOW.. (oh the dramatics) so that is the main reason we just stopped here.. But I knew better from the first time I came years back.. and it still hasn't changed. I mean it isn't the worse but it isn't a must try. 

I mean when you come to NO you are really looking to find some good eats that you will only find when you come and I'm Sorry Gumbo Pot, but you are not it. I wish I could say something different.

Overall amazing. Great food and great service!

We went here for the first time today to have brunch. We were very impressed by the quality of everything we ordered.  Usually we try to eat outdoors due to the pandemic but it was a little chilly today so we chose to eat inside. They took our temperature before we entered and all the employees were wearing masks. We felt very safe! We will most definitely eat here again!

I am livid with this company and at the owner, Adam Cronenwett!  We paid a $2200 deposit about a month ago for a vinyl fence install that was supposed to happen yesterday.  They never showed and just like everybody else, this guy is not answering calls, emails or texts.  When we started seeing negative reviews pop up and people posting that Metro Fences may have went out of business, we drove over there.  Adam was out front.  We asked him what was going on and he said he was behind in jobs due to the weather.  When we brought up the negative reviews and "no shows", he had the audacity to tell us that he is NOT Adam but is Adam's twin brother and tries to "stay out of the family business".  What a joke!

We used them back in 2015 at our old house and loved them!  When we needed a new fence for our new home, we didn't even call anybody else.  We have referred a lot of business to Adam and his company and this is how he treats loyal customers.  I have already contacted the media and an attorney.  I may never get my money back but this man should not be allowed to do business anywhere!  He is way too dishonest to be trusted with anybody's money.  Stay away from anything this man does in the future!
customer service sucks, very overpriced, and rude  staff with very little knowledge. Don't waste your time, I went to cabelas the same day and had a great experience!

Sign on door says dining room open so I park and get handicapped child out of car only to find the doors locked. I can understand the dining room being closed but not with a sign saying it's open. I can only imagine the employees inside laughing at every fool believing the sign and trying to open the door. Paint over the dining room open sign. Jerks.

We have been taking our dogs to poochini's for 5 to 6 years and today was the last time.  They have been getting worse every time we go.  Sometimes they call when our dogs are ready and sometimes they do not.  The cuts get worse every time we go.  Today I was told one of my babies fell off the table.  Why would anybody leave a baby unattended on a table!  They acted like it was no big deal, but it was a huge big deal to us.  He brags about his groomers, but that was very irresponsible.  One day we got home with a letter, which was attached to our invoice, from another one of their customers who was upset because they let his dog out of the shop into the parking lot and was maybe missing for a while.  Irresponsible!  Today when one of the groomers told us about the fall, the owner stood there with no response at all!  All the comments below about the owner are true and for him to attack the customers back just shows what kind of business owner he is and the lack of concern he has for our pets left in his care.  If you love your pets stay away from poochini's!

I was walking around the mall last night and noticed Dough Life. I know the edible cookie dough trend is big especially the continually swarmed Dō in Manhattan so I was happy I could try this trend close to home. It's honestly not that hard to make edible cookie dough at home and there are tons of recipes online, but who has the time!? 

Initially I walked by, but on my way out of the mall I walked in to try some. The guy behind the counter offered samples of the flavors I asked. I tried Brownie Batter, the original flavor, and a funfetti looking dough I can't recall the name of. They were all yummy but I settled on a small of the Brownie Batter. It is pricy, the small (one scoop) was about $5 but it is a hefty scoop. They offered toppings I'm not sure if this is included in the price or extra. I got mine without any toppings because it was pretty sweet already. 

Honestly, I hope this cookie dough trend sticks around. It's a less risky way to consume all the cookie dough you want (who wants salmonella poisoning)! I'll definitely be returning to try out some of the other flavors. There was a s'mores one with my name on it!!

I went her because of a work outing one time for dinner and it was so fabulous! 
Their service is absolutely top notch, the ambiance is beautiful with all the different pieces put together, and the dessert is lovely. 
They have an open kitchen concept, so you can see them making everything while you're sitting in the restaurant. The chef, Ben, is great at cooking and making macaroons! 
On our menu, we had breakfast choices for dinner. I chose to go with the make your own crepes. I added some seasonal veggies to make them savory. They were nice and warm when they came from the kitchen and tastes splendid. For dessert, we had a platter of a few different desserts come out; the stuffed churro was my favorite along with the fresh macaroons, wow! 
TIP: Every Wednesday, they have $1 macaroons!!!

What a gem! Definitely check out this place. They have awesome specials: $1 macaroons on Wednesday, bottomless mimosas on Saturday, half off wine on Sunday's...come on. It doesn't get any better! Their atmosphere is so beautiful and welcoming. The owner and staff are so fun. I can't wait to go back!

Why haven't I been here!?! This easily has to be one of the BEST pastry places in the city. I had the pear tart with a berry compote and it was incredible. My friend had the bread pudding and used one word to describe it- amazing! We also had Lavender Pear Cider and it was the perfect accompaniment. I will definitely be back many times and bringing people with me!!

I have now been here a few times and tried several macarons (all amazing), a couple pastries, and an omelette.  Have loved it all!  It's very cute, being able to watch the chefs work is fun.  Indoor and outdoor seating.   Very friendly and helpful staff

Redstone is awesome! I've eaten here several times over the last 6 months, and it's been outstanding. I find the service great, I've not had to wait despite looking for a table at lunch or dinner prime times, and the food has been excellent. I find the food to be a bit overpriced, but still, excellent.

My denial is over.  I'd completely given up on getting my dog groomed appropriately.  So much so that I'd simply not scheduled a grooming for six months, thinking that my dog still looked okay, just needed a little brushing.
Hmm...but when the new sign appeared by Sprouts "Poochini's -- the Ultimate in Pet Grooming," I had to go in and check it out.  I was pleasantly surprised by the calm and soothing decor on a human scale and warmly greeted by the groomer, Katheryn.  We quickly got talking shop and she immediately asked if I wanted my dog "hand-stripped" since he's a Cairn terrier with an undercoat.  My eyes went buggy.  "I've been looking for someone to do that and I'd given up."  "It's becoming a lost art," she replied.  The next day I brought little Stanley in and he looks gorgeous.  His beautiful overcoat, for the first time, was kept in tact and it's amazing how hand-stripping makes him appear better without any signs of a cut or a snip anywhere.  And he had a pile as big as a Thanksgiving Turkey of undercoat hair on the table.  It was a good thing afterall I waited for him to get another grooming as the guardhairs had time to grow back so the hand-stripping could be done effectively.  Stanley was so happy and didn't seem stressed at all; and that's saying a lot for a feisty terrier.  This is the best grooming my dog has ever had and it's so close by.  The place is clean, small, the groomer personable and, most importantly, fantastic at her job.

Car buying is painful, but out of all the bad experiences I've had at other dealerships, I would say my experience at Barlow Buick GMC was quite pleasant. I worked with sales person, Ken, who was really amazing to work with. He made me feel comfortable, and was very willing to find me the right vehicle. He was also upfront about all numbers. I would certainly return to this dealership for my next purchase in a few years.

Prior to Covid-19, I was somewhat of a regular customer at this place.  Due to the pandemic, I'd been away for about a year.  But as I was passing through the area today, I glanced over at its parking lot, and noticed some "signs of life."  I decided to stop in for a light lunch.  I walked up to the reception area, where three employees were standing around.  There were 8 or 9 people dining indoors, and 6 people dining on the outdoor deck.  There was a light drizzle, but the weather was otherwise nice.  I asked one of the three hosts if I could have one of the small, unoccupied tables outside.  She replied that although there was a server assigned to those tables, the chairs were wet, and there was no one wiping them off.  I was surprised by her reply.  The Redstone is among the most expensive dining establishments in the area.  Certainly, one of its idle employees could have taken 30 seconds out of his/her day to wipe down a table and chairs.  After being denied the outdoor table, I offered to sit indoors, where only a couple of tables appeared to have been occupied.  The hostess replied that it would be difficult to accommodate me at that time.  I went elsewhere for my lunch today, where I was treated like a VIP.  Hopefully, what happened at the Redstone was merely a "Covid" thing, and not a trend.  I'll most likely give this place a few more months to "find its way back" before I return.
Best Pom cut my little LULU has had , Dana is the BOMB , I will b back !!!

An unfortunate incident occurred this Sunday at this establishment. 

My boyfriend, the driver, turned into the parking lot to look for a spot when a blonde woman and her husband were walking in the middle of the parking lot. I, the passenger on my cellphone, looked up as my boyfriend made a comment about how he was trying to get around them for quite some time as he thought they were being rude and he managed to circle around them with a little wave (with plenty of room to spare) to drive to the entrance of the restaurant to drop me off as I have a knee injury and can't walk long distances. As I was waiting in line to put my name down, the blonde lady and her husband quite literally shoved past me and stood directly in front of me. I was shocked. I told the person at the front "excuse me, but this woman just walked right in front of me." The blonde lady whirled around and said "yeah well YOU JUST ALMOST HIT ME WITH YOUR CAR!" Her husband said "yeah you , or your boyfriend or whatever just almost hit us, yes we're those people you almost hit!!!" Again....I was shocked. Thinking back to the very  brief encounter of driving past them, where they did not look upset or angry? The person behind the register was shocked also and clearly did not know how to handle the situation. The couple again loudly stated "she just tried to run us down." She catered to the white older couple and told them they were able to talk to the host at the stand to be seated. I responded with "this is a really mature way for adults to act." The blonde lady, assumingely felt some sort of remorse for her actions, then told the host with a roll of her eyes and not even looking at me that she "thinks I was here first, so to go ahead." 

I was so excited to take my boyfriend to this restaurant,  as a Butler alum and it's been more than a few years since I've been to the Broad Ripple area. Now I was embarrassed and shaky and trying to hold back tears. The host was so nice when I told him what happened and checked back on us later into our meal, which was great. Our waitress, Liz, also made the rest of our experience extremely pleasant. And I was so glad for them. 

I guess I just wanted to say that just because someone looks a certain way or is a certain age or looks like they "have money," doesn't automatically put them in the right. Which is why I took a star off. This lady was pulling a classic white victim card and I'm sad that she felt entitled to walk in front of me and yell at me for something that 1) DID NOT EVEN HAPPEN and 2) even if it did, as a passenger, I have no control over. However, just for the record, my boyfriend isn't driving around like a maniac trying to run down civilians just for some scrambled eggs. 

Maybe it's because I walked into the restaurant before them that pissed them off? Maybe it's because I am a young Latina woman that she felt privileged enough to exert some power? Maybe it's because of their socioeconomic status? Either way if something like this ever happens to you, keep your head held high and don't stoop to their level. Chances are if they're making up this kind of drama, reasoning with people like that will never go anywhere fruitful.

Theres a lot of love for Redstone in this area and I didnt get at first. Brunch is huge here and surprisingly I think brunch is OKAY. Great bloodies though so thats a huge plus. Dinner though, HELLOOOOOO REDSTONE!

Love, love, love, coming here for dinner. Outside dining or indoor, they have have a ton of space. Amazing staff and great quality food. My husband loves their ribs! Fall off the bone type. I've tried so much stuff and honestly its all delicious. Even my two year old loves their kids mac and cheese. 

Thanks for being awesome Redstone. After quarantine, you did not disappoint. :)

Was really looking forward to going here being that it had outdoor seating with a huge fountain outside. Clean environment, friendly wait staff to greet you. 

Parking is sparse particularly during mg happy hour or on a weekend.

Prices: The prices are pretty high relative to the food you get. Not too bad but not great. Elected to go with the Buffalo shrimp as an appetizer which was $18 for 4 shrimp. They weren't really jumbo but they were tasty. The bang bang cauliflower was just ok. The sauce that accompanies it was just meh.

Entrees: Fresh vegetable grain bowl was underwhelming. No flavors at all. Pretty disappointed. Although everything seemed fresh, the Korean sauce that was advertise with it was nonexistent.
Nonetheless, the biggest s disappointment was the Buttermilk Fried Chicken. In most cases chicken sandwiches are generally consisted of a chicken breast being used however upon receiving our dish, my wife noticed it was a chicken thigh which was confirmed by the wait staff. Upon revisiting the menu it makes no mention of a chicken breast but my wife and I generally expect an advertised chicken sandwich to be a breast (Even fast foods use breast pieces). The manager was very kind and explained that thighs are used because they preserve juices more than breast. I think that's a horrible excuse to use to justify this as an alternative. Even she uttered when she walked away that it should be mentioned what piece of chicken is used. Moreover, we generally had the biggest issue with our waitress whom upon returning to our table to take our food back once my wife expressed displeasure appeared to be upset. She asked if my wife wanted to order something different. I kindly asked for a menu and was told that no menus are being provided due to covid and that we could look online. Mind you, we were initially given paper menus so I expected that another one could be provided. After the exchange and lack of interest in wanting to assist any further, we decided to just ask for the check and leave. 

Beautiful place and I can see the potential with some of the food and choices but I can't say I'd be rushing to go back here. I never came here prior to covid but it seems the prices are high for what you get and I don't mind at all paying a hefty price for good food but this just fell below my expectations.

This was our 5th anniversary and our experience was amazing! Loved the food and sheer ambiance. Service was excellent! Highly recommend. Shout out to Ryan our server who took care of us in the bar area!

We made a mistake of coming here after the aquarium because we were so hungry and didn't get a chance to read the reviews. We came in through the patio and they said that we had to find the host, we didn't know where the host was, so finally the waitress seated us after telling us we had to find the host.

We ordered some food and had questions about the food, but she didn't seem too sure about anything and she was all over the place. She asked if we wanted the kids food to come out first, so we said yes, but then came back and asked again and didn't have utensils for our kids. We asked her for utensils, she went to get it and left for 10 minutes. At this time, our food arrived and no one at our table has utensils, except for me, since my gumbo had a spoon on the side of the plate. 

The plate is huge, I wished I got the cup of gumbo. The gumbo was ok, but for it being named after the Gumbo, you would think it'd be the best thing to order on the menu. My husband had the catfish po'boy and it was ok. Nothing impressive. My kids had the fried catfish, again, nothing unforgettable. I was so disappointed spending $55+ with tips here, for mediocre food.

Ordered a Birthday Cake for my girlfriend here (a week in advance) and  I came in a week later to pick up my cake exactly at 3 (my scheduled pickup time). Apparently they messed up their orders and I find out they haven't even started on my cake. I'd have to come back in a hour so they could make it. To add even more bad news, they didn't have chocolate ganache filling that I ordered (the only reason I wanted the cake because she and I love ganache). So they offered a chocolate mousse filling instead, and I should've said no to the mousse because it wasn't very good. It honestly made the cake worse. Never been here before and I was so excited to try this Bakery! They let me down very badly today and it's gonna be hard to want to come back. Also, they told me when I arrive back to pick up the cake an hour Later, I would receive a $25 gift card for my troubles. I came back and no gift card. I've never left a bad review anywhere, it's just not something I've ever cared to do. But this really brought down my day.

I no longer live near the Redstone Grill so going there is a special, planned event (I recommend calling for a reservation anyway.) my most recent visit was on my birthday July 9 and we had superb service and a wonderful meal, as always. If you haven't been, try it. You won't be disappointed. 
Oh and order the prosciutto with fig jam flatbread. Picture below (only half the order pictured as we gobbled up the rest)

Surprised at all the bad reviews.  Granted, every time I've been here I've had a hangover, and maybe that makes me a little less discerning...but I've never had a "bad" experience.  Our server was super nice to us out on the patio.  Very attentive. Smiling. Talkative but not too much.  Friendly.  We had breakfast and it was...breakfast.  Unless you're getting something that requires lots of ingredients and skill to put together, breakfast is breakfast to me.  The scenic view of Decatur and the riverboats made it more than breakfast though.  Yes, I had a hangover.  Yes, that means I wasn't going to complain.  No, there wasn't anything to complain about.  

For all of you tourists bashing the help...stop.  It's you guys constantly expecting Emeril to be at your table to wipe your spoiled little mouth that's making them not be in the mood you think they "should" be in.  Try being nice.  You're in the south.  It goes a long way.
This place seems to really try to avoid  taking peoples' business. A facade of dining for important people. Really for self-important types, lol.

After hearing such great things about The Gallery Pastry Shop I was very anxious to check it out!  My first impression was excellent.  I liked the decor and the layout of the space.  I think the "open air" kitchen is unique and a conversation starter if you have a seat at the kitchen bar.  I ordered a chocolate croissant to start and it was very tasty!  Once we were seated, however, things started to go downhill.  The servers, although well intentioned, seemed generally confused.  Five different servers approached our table to attempt to take our order.  When we placed our order it took a long time and several reminders to get the order to actually be delivered to our table.  There were several items on the menu that were not available, which is a problem when the menu is small to begin with.  The lack of available menu items also added to the confusion of the servers and slowed the ordering process.  We were not the only patrons that were unhappy with our experience that day.  I could overhear the table next to us talking with the server about how they wished they had a better first impression.  I attribute a lot of these issues to the shop having only been open a few months and to it being a weekend morning.  I hope my experience will be better next time, because I think this place has a lot of potential.

Terrible dealership, predatory pricing for AC repair during summer. Charging $$$$ and doing zero work, just converting small jobs into big jobs to charge customers. It's unethical and unnecessary.... Will never go back there again, will never buy GMC again for that matter.

New limited menu leaves a lot to be desired. Portions are tiny but prices still sky high. Ordered $17 calamari for the kids and half of it was sliced hot peppers. Shrimp app now consists of 4. Meals were ok, just doesn't justify the price/experience anymore.

I just keep trying and am more disappointed every time I visit. 
Now just 4 Buffalo Shrimp Are 18 dollars ... used to be less than that for 5... used to be Maytag blue cheese.. no more... 
tonight was a half rack of ribs for 19 dollars...quite possibly the most dried out pork I've ever had... like overcooked chicken breast... I almost choked with out water....
Redstone appeals to the people who don't know food.....
With the volume they do, they just don't care.....

In my opinion, one would enter a jewelry store specializing in overpriced jewelry for only one of the following reasons:

1.  Robbery.  (Good luck.)
2.  To use the bathroom.  (Tough luck.)
3.  Marriage/engagement.  (You're in luck.)

We stumbled into Sheffield's with the sole intent of getting our fingers properly sized, so that we could purchase wedding bands inexpensively online, because we are cheap ass and immoral.  We had absolutely no intention of buying anything from a jewelry retailer.

Less than 4 hours later, we purchased 2 wedding bands from this jewelry retailer at $200 more than an online retailer, because we're idiots and because our sales associate deserved our business.

Chad, the sales associate who helped us, was very patient as we tried on ring after ring (the damn bands all look the same) and gave us absolutely no pressure, because, as he explained, "We're not paid commission." 

Chad didn't try to push the more expensive rings on us.  He'd even suggested that I go with a thinner (cheaper) band than I was trying on, as it might look better on my size 4.5 finger (which is, unfortunately, attached to a size XXL body that apparently houses a size XXXXS brain).  

After the jewelry store (to which we didn't commit right away) we checked prices online.  The two rings were an average $400 LESS online than at Sheffield's.  My tiny ring was abominably overpriced by almost $300.  Getting the rings engraved online costs $25 versus the $35 in-store.  And there wasn't even enough gold there to make one dismal filling for a 2-year old.

Called Chad back and told him we're not going with him (to which he said, "Hey, that's OK.")  - but then my fiance had a change of heart and offered that, if Sheffield's was able to meet us a little more than halfway, we'd buy the rings with him, even if they were higher than online.  And lo and behold, within half an hour, we were the proud new owners of wedding bands that I'm pretty certain will one day fall off my finger and down the ground toilet in some godforsaken third-world country.

For newbies to the fun and sexy world of high-priced jewelry that costs the same as your first offspring, Sheffield's is a great place to visit.  The budget conscious could shop around online and negotiate with the store for better pricing.  Sheffield's offers follow-up service in the form of re-polishing and resizing the ring, which isn't so easy to do when you buy something online.  

Final note: At the same time we were choosing the rings I had my watch battery replaced... for which Sheffield's didn't charge me, so that they could establish goodwill.  Smooth, Sheffield's.  Smooth.

I just want to thank our east side representative, Adi for the excellent service. He knows what he's doing and welcome him each year for our inspections. Recently, we had a minor pest control issue (bed bugs) and Christian and the 22nd street branch manager, Anthony came to treat the house and they were so professional. They explained everything, what to expect and we were so happy and impressed with their customer service. Those reading this review: please call the 22nd street Truly Nolen for impeccable, courteous service with a smile. You won't find better service than with Anthony, Adi, and Christian. Well done guys. Update: still have bed bugs, and I called Adi and explained this to him and they sprayed agin with their follow-up inspection. I will update till resolution .

What a fun little spot! We went in for lunch on a Sunday afternoon and it was busy but not out of hand-there was a wait but it went quicker than we expected. We sat at community style seating which was a great time. Having never been there we admittedly had some questions and were hoping for recommendations from our server but we didn't get those- she shared that when it comes to savory crepes there was no consistency in what people ordered...so we went with it and everything turned out just fine! Definitely try the kombucha, Circle City Kombucha is SO yummy! It's a fun atmosphere, laid back and very instagramable! It's pretty casual so where what you please, I feel like this is a place where everyone is welcome! And the pastries are SO good, get anything...literally anything they have, it will not disappoint!

If you're a dessert lover like me, you'll love this place. This place has a great vibe, open, clean, and tons of space. 

I tried the lavender, vanilla mousse. Oh my goodness, to die for! Not only is it gorgeously created and designed, every bite is like an extravagant vacation to southern France. 
If you're driving there, it's at the very end of the street.

The nicest crew working the bar yesterday. Stopped by with a friend before catching the train and it was so fun. Bartenders were nice, attentive, polite and kept dancing  , because they we're having a good time!
The decorations were amazing. I highly recommend this place.
