It was more than enough food for me. They, of course, have beautiful pastries to choose from in the pastry case. I had a chocolate pillow, which I took home to savor on my own time. I liked the atmosphere here. It was busy, but not so loud that I couldn't hear. The kitchen is wide open, so you can watch them work. They seem to have a very efficient crew in the kitchen. It was very entertaining to watch. I plan to eat many more brunches here!

This should be a one but the building is very nice. But, the old time basketball court was the only thing that was of any interest to me here. Go to the Indiana State Museum next door to see and learn something....

Do not come to The Gallery Pastry Shop if you're looking for an extensive menu with many options for a picky group - you will be highly disappointed.

Listen, I am a sucker for sitting at a counter and watching chefs cook the food. I love that dining experience. My better half knows this and took me here and got us two seats at the counter. Great choice! Highly recommend for us, I do not recommend for you because then there won't be any seats for us.

I ordered the 'Merica breakfast which had scrambled eggs, hash browns and jowl bacon. The eggs and hash browns were good but the bacon was the star of the plate. It's a large portion of all 3 items for the $10. 

Michael got two crepes (you can mix flavors) - bananas foster and lemon curd. He liked them both equally, but we watched the chef make the bananas foster so that was a plus, but he did say if I put a gun to his head, he'd order the lemon again. I'm unsure why I am putting a gun to his head and if I did, why he'd order crepes but here we are.

We also ordered the seasonal vegetable which was EXCELLENT. It was brussel sprouts to which Michael said "this is the best vegetable I've ever had." Rave reviews, except I'm the chef at home so slightly offensive. I think I know why I'd put that gun to his head now.

Sign up on Google to be added to the waitlist before you go!

Overpriced, their repairs are poor quality, they don't honor the warranty. Horrible experience, they charged me $1700 for a belt replacement after my engine overheated. They did a bad job on it, after a few hundred miles my engine overheated again due to the very same belt going bad. When I reached out to them regarding the warranty I got a big runaround from Dawn who promised to reimburse me for having to replace it again and for the tow I needed but I got nothing... their warranty is worthless, they don't actually honor it.
Luckily the other place I went to the change the belt when I got stuck only charged me $380 for the same thing Barlow charged me $1700 for

Awful experience.  No ability to cater to food allergies (although they can for dinner?).  The food took 50 minutes in non-crowded restaurant and had obviously been sitting under heat lamp for some time. Waitress was miserable. Just an awful experience for my daughters graduation lunch.

$5 cover to get in and a long line when we went. The decorations were great and a real spooky vibe. It's pretty small and was packed and really hot so keep that in mind. We got the blood bag which made me feel a little nauseous. Wouldn't be back but it's worth checking out once!

This restaurant host was very racist to my family & I. It's disgusting that in 2020 Hispanic and black peoples still get treated this way in establishments. I pray no one ever experiences this as well
I picked up a bunch of macaroons for a friends birthday and was amazed they do $1 macaroons on Wednesday what a steal! The workers were so seeet and the macaroons delicious!!

A walkable spot for me, I love to slip in here during the week. The desserts are clearly spectacular as a piece of art even before you bite into one. The croissants literally melt in your mouth. Im personally a fan of the hashbrowns- is it cool just to eat a bowl of hashbrowns? Ok, awesome.  It's a great neighborhood spot that gets quite the waitlist during the weekend.

I have been going to Poochini's with my two  Coton de Tulear's for about three years. They do a great job and there's not a wait once they are done which is usually within an hour or so . They  call and I pick them up. There is no stress and they know our dogs and their needs. Not being in a cage helps because the girls get very stressed very easily!! Love it here and the groomers all do their job well and care!
Donna Cochran 
Tucson

I originally thought there weren't any bad places to eat in the French Quarter.  That is to say before I ate at Gumbo Pot.  When I took a bathroom break and as I entered the restroom I was greeted by a restaurant employee doing whippets.  He quickly ran into the nearest stall.  On a positive note our server did a fine job.  However, all of our dishes were considerably overpriced, and yes, the fries were lukewarm at best.  The "B" squad wait staff showed up as we finished paying the bill and that's when the restaurant went from bad to worse.

Nice bakery tucked away on 54th street. The atmosphere is really enjoyable, big tables and lots of space to get comfy and spread out. We all loved the opera cake, but I thought the chocolate pillow and the salted caramel creme brule were just ok. The desserts are also extremely small for the price (around $8). I thought maybe a small cake that size might be better priced at $6? Our service was excellent and I did enjoy the coffee and tea selection, I imagine mimosa brunch would be great fun. Looking forward to sampling more pastries!

I visited because I saw that it had good reviews, but I'm more than disappointed. There were only a few pastries to choose from (I went at around noon, so they definitely weren't the leftover picks). I got two pastries and some croissants to go, all of which were average, no better than the stuff I could pick up at Starbucks.

I had previously visited The Gallery for dessert one evening and discovered they served brunch on the weekends, it immediately went on my Indy Foodie Bucket List.

Today starts brunch season for me and I decided to visit The Gallery for the build your own crepes. I was fortunate to grab one of the counter seats to enjoy the show of the kitchen. Once seated I was greeted with a breakfast pastry. I ordered my Mimosa (with blood orange) and I was on my way. Each crepe was light and dense just the way a crepe should be. The ingredients were top notch, and as local as possible. Their lemon curd was just the right amount of tart. 

Sitting in front of the kitchen I know that I will come back to try the croissant with brulee cheese and fruit compote next time. 

Oh yeah and the desserts are amazing as well.

I want to warn anyone considering this company.  The tech Adi came out, told me a bunch of false information that was later discovered and had me enter a contract on false pretenses.

Everything from service to amount was untrue.  No apology or accountability from this company and I am considering legal action as their methods are predatory and based again on the hook and sinker approach.

To any prospective customers-proceed with extreme caution.

This place is solid and good, but nothing outstanding. It's a high class Applebee's, but the prices could def be cheaper. The waiter Frank was really nice and he definitely made the meal. 

**key lime pie is a must

This is the best Taco Bell ever ! They are really nice, and they don't hand out tiny burritos like the other Taco Bell's around, take my advice and never go to the one on airline, just come here.........

I purchased two gift certificates here on 2/13/14 and mailed them out with Valentine's to my daughters in college. The manager who sold them to me did not activate them and my daughters found this out trying to use them.

We went to the Gallery Pastry shop in broad ripple on an insanely busy Sunday. We waited for about an hour for our food, but we didn't even notice because we were enjoying the patio and our amazing waitress kept the mimosas flowing and even gave us some free macaroons for our wait. This place is perfect for a summer brunch!

We did not actually get to stay here, we chose the hotel for its close proximity to Nissan Stadium for the Music City Bowl. Unfortunately it was cancelled. We spoke with Gloria at the hotel this morning , explained our situation and she fully understood. Cancelled our reservation with no hesitation. This makes us want to stay the next time we make it to Nashville. Thanks Gloria!

We went there to get a latte.  . .they make there lattes with what looks like keurig cups. I should have cancelled the order knowing it was going to taste terrible. I was right, tasted like hot water, we threw them away 2 blocks down.

There's a reason this company has such a solid reputation. Josh came to check my carpet beetle problem and to help identify what is biting the heck out of me.

I mentioned I had a termite alate problem last year which was treated by another pest company then, but they returned. Josh searched high and low to find where they were coming from without me asking.  

SO patient, as I'm on little sleep, literally bugged out and dealing with other health issues. 

 Rather than charge me a huge cost to get rid if the carpet beetles, he saw I had what I needed and was handling it. No other bugs, and the biters unfortunately are scabies, probably from pigeons + my pool. 

Thanks for the peace of mind and the integrity.

Great food!  Seating was on the slow side, however we did not have a reservation for our group of 6. We were called in with a message notification saying our table was nearly ready, but it was still about 20 minutes before our table was cleared.  The restaurant appeared understaffed for a busy Saturday afternoon lacking waitstaff and people willing to clear dirty dishes. Additionally, beverages were served out of improper containers that spilled on the table and smaller details like utensils and extra napkins were overlooked. Most issues seemed to be the result of being a little short staffed for a busy weekend afternoon. The food was well worth the wait, and the patisserie looked beautiful (I was too full after a generously portioned entree to try any)! Bonus points for the overall aesthetic of the restaurant and for playing an exclusively Lady Gaga playlist while we were there.

Our tech was great! He arrived on time and upon arrival he found that my 84 year old mother's tv stand was not the proper length. He moved the tv stand and placed the tv on the coffee table as an alternative, placed the old tv in the garage for her, and he spent as much time as needed getting her set up. He really went above and beyond for an elderly person, and I will be forever grateful. Because of him I will always refer your company to anyone looking for a setup!
Waitress was rude. Service was not any better. The crab cakes tasted fishy and now I feel sick. Thanks for the horrible experience Redstone.

Another great night and Redstone. Caesar salad and fried calamari were excellent starter. Sever was pleasant and made our outdoor dining enjoyable.
Had the half rack of the ribs, fall off the bone good, cornbread (which is to die for) and fries.
The meal was amazing, as usual.
Rachael is the best server ever! Had great recommendations for drinks and super nice! Also drinks and guac were so good!!!!

They really did go all out with the Halloween decor. Every inch is decorated and unbelievably scary through out. Sights and sounds are 100% Halloween which I love! Went early on a Sunday & I was the only one there for about 30 minutes. Definitely go on an off night if you want to see the decor. Wasn't interested in the $12 - $14 concoctions but I had a pumpkin ale that was good. Great photo opts.

The BEST breakfast in Indy! I love this place. It is hidden away in the back of an alleyway/strip mall, but the patio is a little oasis. Their staff is usually very friendly and attentive. The food is just absolutely incredible. Their Breakfast Sandwich is perfectly buttery and the egg is always cooked just right. Their Hashbrowns also come with tons of flavor. They do have impossible meat options which is nice. Their mimosas are all you can drink on Thursdays! I love their Blood Orange one. They also have a DJ on many Saturday mornings! Check this place out!

Let me just begin by saying how pretty this place is the decor, the atmosphere everything! I went with a friend on a Saturday morning with no reservations our wait time was very short about 5-10 min tops for a table. 

The service was amazing! Our waiter Ben was very helpful! Food was delicious ! The dessert is incredible! you just gotta make sure you leave enough room for it. I definitely recommend the gallery pastry shop to anyone looking for an amazing brunch! 

I listed the items pictured down below. 
-Banana Foster Crepe( pecans, bananas, gold dusted blueberries)
-Breakfast w/ Tiffany crepe (mushroom, onions, spinach, sausage and sour cream) 
-Strawberry macaroons
-Provence (Lavender white chocolate mousse)
-Carmel Macchiato

Tucked away, off the Monon Trail, just down from Mamma Carollas and the Dancing Donut, the Gallery Pastry Shop is the newest place in Indy to enjoy delectable, swoon-worthy macaroons and pastries. 
The decor is a rustic modern, with wooden tables and chandeliers hanging about. The kitchen is the centerpiece of the restaurant, with a bar that backs up to it for customers to enjoy watching the owner/chef create his artful masterpieces. Outdoor seating is also available for those perfect weather days.

I've been into this shop a good handful of times and have never done business with them. I will admit they have great inventory however a large chunk of that inventory is used and they're selling them over MSRP on new. I tried giving them my business one last time by bringing in a couple firearms I had bought new from another local shop and had only fired once to see if they'd at least be a good business to sell to(considering the prices they sell their used firearms at) and they offered me $1,100 for 3 firearms I had paid over $2,800 for just a couple months prior. I'm going to stop wasting my time driving into Boise for this shop and stick to my local shop here in Meridian.

Came here for lunch with a group and had great service.  Chips were brought to the table along with some fresh, tasty salsa. We were on a bit of a time constraint, so I figured we'd have to take most of our food to go, but our meals came out so quickly that everyone had time to finish! I got the burrito supreme lunch special with chicken, which was the perfect amount of food without sending me into a food coma. It comes with beans and rice, and the burrito is topped with guacamole.  The guac was a little saltier than what I'm used to, but still tasty.  Food was cheap, and the menu has a wide selection of options, including a Peruvian section.  Overall, it was a satisfying experience.

I wrote a previous review in january about my overall experience of the resturant. I was tickled pink last time I went in, there were some rough spots but overall a gret experience. This eatery was first recomended to me by a friend of mine. She dines in often. I called ahead to the restaurant to place a reservation but there was none, he told me I could walk in, but didn't know how long the wait would be. The guy on the phone had a nice voice, I was looking foward to coming in. Once I arrived there was a guy and girl host pair waiting for guests. I don't remember the girl's name but the male's name was Justin, he was the gentleman from my previous review as well. Anyway, the girl was quite snippy and brushed me off. The restaurant must have hit a peak around this time and she looked quite flustered. She took my information and place me on a 40 minute wait. Once I recieved a table Justin showed me over and gave me the usual schpeil, he talked a little fast but was sweet. I was waited on  a waitress who was very sweet, we talked about her hair. The service, minus the hostess, was good but the food was unforgivable. The steak was raw, the chicken rubbery, and the grilled cheese barely had any cheese in it. Maybe I am overexxagerating but the redstone I know can do better. I'll try it out once more, hopefully next time they won't dissapoint.

This review concerns the service dept.  They will NOT see me again. Started when I booked a noon appt at their website. Then they sent me note that 12 was not available...offered opt of 1pm, I took it, NO acknowledgment. 
SIMPLE oil change no addl service. OVER 90 mins lots of excuses...DONT GO HERE FOR SERVICE

Red stone is by far my favorite restaurant ! They have such a unique style with their food and it's always amazing.  Definitely get the fondue for a app and the warm chocolate chip cookie sundae for dessert!

I brought my boyfriend here for his birthday brunch and boy was I disappointed. I have only been here for brunch so I don't know how the rest of their food is. Our waiter was great and attentive. He was probably the only good part other than my bellini. The food is expensive so I had high expectations that the food quality would match the price, but the food was terrible. I had a ham and cheese omelet which seems so simple, but it was tasteless and so were the breakfast potatoes. The beignets were just okay. Not worth the money AT ALL. I would maybe be willing to come back for either lunch or dinner, but MOST DEFINITELY NOT brunch.

The doctors are true gentlemen and computer wizards.  I have used them on numerous occasions with all of my families and businesses computers.  They fixed the issue and even went above and beyond my requests by informing me of additional issues that I was not even aware of.  I will continue to use these guys time after time.

Barlow service is The Best! We have 2 cars serviced regularly at Barlow starting with our GMC Sierra up to our current General Motors crossover and sedan. Service writers are knowledgeable, friendly, courteous and customer oriented - always eager to provide details up front about parts, costs and warranty as well as after the repairs or the service is performed. Prices are reasonable and maintenance is completed on time as promised and they have experts on site for Cadillac and Chevrolet vehicles.
Super great staff and super yummy food! All in a beautiful scenery with both inside & outside dining

i've been meaning to stop in here for months, and finally got a chance to come in. i ordered the salad niçoise as well as a chocolate mousse crepe. the salad is served in a smaller bowl than im used to, but it packs a big punch. i ate about half before turning to my crepe. the mousse was fluffy and light, with the perfect balance of sweetness and bitterness from
the chocolate. again, i underestimated the crepe and only ate half. on my way out, i dropped the box with my crepe. i've had a really rough week so when they offered to remake it i was so thankful. it's been a long time since ive had either of these dishes, and i'm so glad i came out today. i can't wait to come back and try more delicious dishes!

Lobby and room were fine. But every time we went to the desk, the employees were busy visiting with each other or on the phone which appeared to be personal calls. We were here for 4 nights with Friday and Saturday costing 50 percent more. I expect these nights to cost more but on Friday housekeeping didn't come and then Saturday there were no glasses in the room. On Friday, the desk delivered us towels (1am) but on Saturday we asked the desk to deliver glasses (10pm). There were 2 people at the desk and neither would deliver the glasses.

Took my family of 4 to this restaurant as it was close to the hotel and right off the riverwalk.  The server we had was very pleasant.  As for the food,  the price is pretty high for the quality they are serving.  I live in Louisiana and the food was quite bland.  Definitely a tourist trap,  be wary.  To top it all off they added gratuity to our bill even though we had only my wife and I and our two children.  There are plenty of other places in and around the quarter if you're looking for good food.

I am a sucker for a good theme, so I had a blast at Nightmare Before Tinsel! This is usually a Christmas pop-up bar, but this year they did a Halloween pop-up as well. It is not a huge space, but every inch of it is covered in Halloween decorations that are horrifying in the best possible way! I came here with a group of friends on a Monday night. Apparently it can get pretty crowded on the weekends, but it was pretty empty when we went, which allowed lots of opportunities for photos with the cool backdrops that they had. It also gave us plenty of room to look around and really see all the decorations.

The fun part is that all the cocktails are halloween themed! I had the vampire's kiss, which was essentially a blood orange margarita with a hint of jalapeno. It was super tart, which I loved. Not only do they have Halloween cocktails, but they also have some Halloween themed beers! 

I had so much fun here! If you are looking for something to do around Halloween to get you in the spooky spirit, this bar should definitely be on your list!
The best brunch in Indy! Macarons are amazing. Omelette is incredible. Grits are out of this world. Coffee drinks (and all drinks) are beautiful. Patio and space in general is just lovely.

I came across ur gadget doctors a few years ago after being frustrated with the service of the Apple Store. My phone was having issues so I went to get it looked at at the Apple Store in the Cherry Hill mall and after waiting about 2 hours to talk to anybody they told me they didn't know what was wrong but that I should buy a new phone. I googled "who fixes iPhones" and gadget doctors came up. Within moments of arriving there I was told " this is what's wrong with your phone, this is how long it will take me to fix it, and this is how much it will cost."  Within 20 minutes phone was working better than ever. I work in construction in a position that usually requires me to keep my phone on me in all situations. It's constantly getting cracked or exposed to the elements in ways that should've left it dead long ago, but I show up at gadget doctors now when anything goes wrong with it and the guy I usually see working the counter, Jonathan just asks me "what did you do this time" I explain what the phone is doing and then he just gives me an estimated time and cost for repair. There's a planet Fitness a few doors down in the shopping center too. If I need a repair, I'll usually just try to get a quick workout in while I wait.

5 stars for the OG HQ for Chef Ben! Nestled in a cute complex around the corner from the Monon is the mothership to some of the best brunch and pastries you'll find in Indy. The owner is a classically trained chef / competitor / culinary instructor / all around awesome entrepreneur. The service here is always top notch and you can see dedication of the kitchen team to their craft. Chef Ben definitely gets some of the best talent in the area for Gallery and you can feel the love from the moment you walk in to till your last bite of whatever you're eating here! The Macarons are a staple, the cakes are all phenomenal & the crepes are amazing.

So far so good. I was very impressed with Ari when he came out to do a walk around and give us a quote. He was pointing out so many things our previous company did not, things that matter a great deal when trying to control pests in our home! He was clear and concise with no pressure to switch companies. As a matter of fact he told us he doesn't like stealing clientele from others if they don't want to leave their current provider. We weren't happy with our current provider which is why he was there in the first place.

We had the first part of our termite treatment done last Friday and I was happy with how thorough they were. They have to finish the outside when it is not raining but they did drill our porch already. Not super impressed with the patch job which is why I am only giving 4 stars instead of 5. Otherwise they have been great and the price is more than reasonable comparatively. I appreciate how passionate Ari is about his job and how knowledgeable he is. I would definitely recommend Truly Nolen, and have already, to anyone looking for termite and pest control services.

Jim, you have an excuse for all your errors!  You personally did not say a word!  You just stood there hanging your head!  Everyone that I have told was shocked - even the vet!  You dang sure took our money without telling us!  The groomer at least was professional enough to tell us - not you!  I have been taking dogs to groomers for 40+ years and never had one pet fall off the table so it is not as common as you say!

This place has a great atmosphere and great food! My daughter and I had the smoked Gouda cheese fondue which was excellent! We both had the 1/2 slab ribs which were out of this world!! Literally fall of the bone ribs! But the best about this place is the service. The waitress Alicia, was excellent! She was friendly, professional and we didn't have to ask for extra drinks. She came to the table and asked us if we needed anything else, she asked us how we liked the food and she noticed when we were finished with our root beers, she automatically brought more!! She even brought us hot moist towels with lemon to clean our hands after the delicious ribs! Now that's service!

I love the Gallery, it's my go to spot for business and pleasure and usually impressive especially to business associates visiting. Truly unlike anywhere else in Indy. The food is delicious and the atmosphere is immaculate. 

Unfortunately, they have expanded and the experience is not the same. Great food, but if you want the true Gallery experience you may want to go downtown so you get beautiful scenery and a good vibe. 

The picnic table room is cold and uninviting. In temperature and aesthetics. Be sure to make a reservation for inside if you do decide to go to the Bripp location. The online format for their waitlist and reservations doesn't work on google apparently (beware you may think there is no wait and truly availability) so be advised you must to call instead to affirm availability to get the Gallery experience. Otherwise it's just not as special. It's called the Gallery because it's an art gallery of pastries/local art and you can watch their employees making pastry art as you eat, that's what makes it so special. 

My associate thought my choice of restaurant was unappealing and sadly won't be returning again. To ensure a one of a kind experience, call ahead for inside or just go to the downtown location! You will not be disappointed.

Nice services.."A very nice stay"

We stayed here for part of our honeymoon and we really loved it, the best hotel out of the five we stayed in on our trip. When we arrived we were a bit tired and stressed from our six hour drive but the staff were very welcoming and helpful, even assisting when my new husband couldn't work out how to start the hire car again!

We had sooo much fun. Be sure to book reservations before your visit they are required. Very pleased with Covid protocols throughout facility. There may have only been 3 other families visiting while we were there. The lower level is more education, trivia, history and upstairs is a more interactive level. Even this 40+ mom participated. Test your skills to score your gpa on a large what looks to be candy crush machine. See how fast tennis balls come to you. Practice throwing the football, measuring your vertical jump and testing your sports trivia. Just for the record, I bet out my husband and son with sports trivia!! The official NCAA offices are located on the other side of the building. Park in park parking garage under ground. Flat parking rate of $5 with voucher from museum. When you come off elevator walk down and Hall of Champions will be on your right. It's location was tricky when using maps or Waze. It takes you to the front of the building which is the offices not hall of champions. Follow signs on the streets versus your map apps.

Mi primera ves comiendo pues yo respeto cada restaurante por que yo soy cocinero , mi queja es que no tiene buena calidad de atender a la gente mi mesa sucia en plato tenía pelos bueno muchas cosas más , solo que deberían de cambiar

Yeah I paid way too much for drinks in a rather narrow and cramped bar to wait in line for a photo op in a closet lined with baby doll heads. Do I regret it? 

Not at all--I look like I had a great time in my snaps, and honestly, looking back at the photos, I'll probably remember that I did, and I really kind of did, even though you can photo op your way through in 10 minutes if you show up early enough and be out of there stat to somewhere where the drinks are cheaper, better, and there's food, and you can sit, or dance, and hear yourself talk.

Much like the smoking shot glass of dried ice I drank--gone so quick, mostly just ice, and definitely cooler-looking than it tasted--Nightmare Before Tinsel was about the visuals and much more enjoyable in hindsight.

I'm glad it exists for that niche purpose.

My family went there on 12/24 drugs thru around 6 pm. We offer 2 boxes of $5 special. The hard shell tacos was hard and chewy. The soft burrito was dry and chewy. We didn't want to eat it but we are half and 4 hours later we all have food poison. I  had the worst sweating stomach ache. I  was screaming for an hour and I was sweating cold. I had diarrhea for the night till next day. There was no medicine available so the Christmas day was ruin for me. I couldn't eat but playing on heat pad. I need to report this location to the health department.
The food is excellent, ambiance is loud but vibrant and welcoming. All is great. I recommend to reconsider the $5 price on the cup of tea. I will be coming back with friends.

So I called and got a quote. They said they needed to send someone out to look over my home and tell what the cost would be. I told them, if the person is pushy, I'll push him right out the door. I agreed to an appointment, with my mind made up that I wouldn't be signing with them. I had already found another who was coming out to give me a cheaper quote. 

They send out Adi. After talking with him, and how he talked about the company, I couldn't use anybody else. He spoke so highly of the place he works. I've never met someone with so much pride in his job. To say he lives his job, is an understatement!!  Needless to say, I signed with him. Because of him, or I would've gone with the other place! He is what all people should strive to be at their jobs! Take pride in it and love it. Even if it's bugs!
Love this place it's always consistent. Had many birthdays and other celebrations here.

I've been going to Poochini's for a few years now, they are by far the best pet grooming salon in town! The staff is very friendly and it makes you feel like your part of the family. I have a German Shepard/Labrador mix and he has a lot of hair. They always take EXCELLENT care of him! I would definitely recommend Poochini's to any Breed long or short hair they do it all!

DO NOT TAKE YOUR CAR HERE FOR SERVICE OR SALES!!! I took my car in for an engine code regarding my catalytic converter. The business promised a loaner car once I dropped my car off for service. I took my car in earlier than scheduled due to engine misfiring, and they were not able to provide a loaner until my scheduled date which was a week later. They finally ran a diagnostic test 4 days after I had dropped it off. Being that the part I needed, a 2015 Chevy Cruze Catalytic converter was on a TWO MONTH BACKORDER, they revoked their promise of a loaner car. Clearly no normal person is able to go a week, let alone TWO MONTHS without their car. Being a college student, with an internship and a second job over the summer this is highly unacceptable. They expect me to pay $1,100 for the catalytic converter replacement, as well as paying for a rental car for TWO MONTHS (about $42/day). This is absolutely unacceptable.  My great-grandfather was an employee at General Motors for 27 years and my Aunt was an employee for General Motors for 18 years.  With their guidance, I bought a GM car; in fact this is my second GM car.  I cannot believe that GM or Barlow GMC cannot do anything to help my situation since my family has been loyal GM car owners.  If this is how you treat your loyal car owners, then you should be ashamed.

I will say this over and over again. Poochini's is awesome. I use the limosini service every time and my doggies always come home beautiful and handsome and very, very happy and gorgeous! I love Kathryn and Jim. I wouldn't use anyone else for grooming services. Love them!!

This brunch spot is amazing! I had the pleasure of being here for a wedding brunch. The staff is super accommodating, the space is adorable, and the food was 5Star! I had the Smoke Salmon Crepe with feta, mushrooms, and red onions topped with arugula! The smoked salmon was sooooooo good and locally purchased. Their grapefruit mimosa with fresh berries is also delicious! Another thing I loved were the large wood tables!  This is definitely a place you could come for an intimate outing or with a large group of friends. I highly recommend trying this place! But call before you go because they do rent out their space for weddings and other gatherings!

This place is the worst. I leased a 2015 Yukon xl Denali and have had nothing but issues whenever I deal with the dealership. First they told me the lease would be one price and that they even threw in a tire and rim package without changing the price. Well when I get my first bill it's $15 more a month. When I called they said it was explained incorrectly to me and they would talk to the owner and see what they could do for me. That was September and I never heard back.  Then I take the car in for an issue with the air circulation. They have to keep my car over the weekend and gave me a loaner. They gave me an Acadia!!!  I have a Yukon XL how do u give me something half the size of my car!  When I called, Mr. Barlow calls me back and tells me that is the biggest they have. I'm sorry but that's BS. How do u give someone with a $80k truck a $30k truck and say that's all u can do!!  I even told Mr Barlow my double coach won't fit he tells me to put down a seat. It STILL doesn't fit!  To top it off when I get my truck back they couldn't even wash it for me!!  Stay away far away. If I get another GMC believe me it won't be from here.

RedStone Grill is probably one of my favorite spots for buffet brunch. They only host their buffet during Mother's Day, Father's Day & Easter, so I try to catch it at least twice a year.

It's a spread of their breakfast menu and lunch/dinner menu. Pancakes, French toast, bacon, "create your own omelette", grilled asparagus, garlic mashed potatoes, ham, prime rib, brownies, cookies, dessert cups... you name it! I could certainly keep going, but it'd end up being the longest Yelp review I've ever written, lol.

I've also dined here for their dinner menu on a few occassions and a few of my faves are the buffalo shrimp and their grilled wings. The buffalo shrimp are mentioned a few times in previous reviews, but they are worth mentioning. I guess I should also mention that I've eaten a skillet of the cornbread by myself as well, huh? Lol. So good - bread and butter are certainly my weakness...

This restaurant was really delicious. Their Covid 19 precautions were top notch. Felt safe eating and dining.  I enjoyed my meal. The seasonal veggies was amazing! The Heirloom Tomatoes were so good,  side was delicious I can't wait to eat there again! They have dessert and cakes. The menu was very hard to make a decision because everything sounded so good. The drink selection was very good. This spot is really a great weekend brunch spot. They have Bottomless Mimosas.

I brought my Gmc truck to the service department at  the Barlow dealership hoping they could fix  the problem  of not starting. I left the truck there more than two weeks because they claimed they couldn't find the  exact cause why it wouldn't start.So, they finally said they knew what the problem was and they ordered the part that they would replace. Pick up my truck  and drove it home and it hasn't started since.Meanwhile,I'm still waiting for the part to come  and it's almost been two months now. And my truck is still out of commission. I have yet to get a call from the service department  to tell me if or when the part has arrived at the dealership. The service writer told me that it should have been at the GMC parts warehouse on September 22, 2016. It is now October1st, and I still have not heard from the  Barlow service department . Boy,' I've been patiently waiting, Mr. Ed Barlow, but this is just ridiculous! I am asking you to please help me get my truck back on the road. Please! And thank you!
I think the parts  department in your dealership does not know  what their doing .

Redstone never has disappointed me or my family. What a great place for a drink,a snack or delicious meal. The food is always prepared well. Try it you will love it. There are waiting lines though. Tells you it is excellent!

Gave this place three chances and never had a good experience. Poor service, missing food in my take away order, and bad vibes from staff. With so many great options in this area, there is no need to ever return.

My book club wanted to switch things up so we decided to meet out for brunch instead of out monthly house hosting rotation. I'd heard a lot of hood things about the Gallery so we booked a Sunday brunch to give if a try.

I absolutely loved this restaurant, their brunch, and the entire experience! 

I has such a hard time choosing my entree because there are do many tasty choices. Almost everyone at my table opted for the hash bowl do i decided to try the crepes. You get two crepes with your meal and there is a selection of both sweet snd savory crepes to choose from. I ordered a breakfast at tiffany crepe filled with meat and veggies followed by a peach flambé crepe. Both were absolutely delicious! The peach one was very very sweet, but in a good way! And I found the savory crepe yo be very filling but light and fancy.

I ordered a side of hash browns, woah! I could feed three people so be prepared to share!

We also ordered their mimosa package which gave us all the chance to have drinks for about $5 a person.

I'm going back, and coming often!

I finally was able to check this gem out in SoBro, and I am still dreaming about it. The shop is so cute and so well decorated! For starters, everyone was wearing their masks properly and our temperature was checked.  We were seated accordingly to the 6ft distance.  Our server Ben was so amazing. He was able to suggest things for us and guide us on what we should try since it was our first time. Everything tasted AMAZING!! No food went to waste here. The dessert "Provence" is a MUST. It so light, delicious and not too sweet.. it honestly was almost too pretty to eat! I cannot wait to go back there for my birthday in January!

Visited for a special event, The World Food Championship Dessert Bar.  This was an eight course heavenly experience!!!!  We had seats right at the counter so we had front row to all the action.  

The tomato tart was by far my favorite! These chefs though are absolutely amazing and the food was delish!!

The Gallery did our wedding cake. It was absolutely beautiful in addition to being delicious. We got so many compliments throughout the night regarding it. 

The tasting process was also a lot of fun. They really go out of the way to make it special. There were so many variations and flavors to chose from. Everything was made in house. 

The price was also really affordable compared to some of the other options in the area where

Never had a bad experience at Gallery.  From the time we ordered the big dessert board on our anniversary to stopping in on $1 macaron day to getting a yulw log for a Christmas gathering, Chef Ben and his team always deliver.  Last night was French press coffee and a chocolate eclair after dinner elsewhere.  Everything was delicious.  I love the interior here as well, the eclectic furniture and cool light fixtures just add to the ambiance.  You will want to keep coming back so you can sample all of the amazing creations.

I have to say that Redstone is one of the better chains.  I have gone here twice and both times my meal was higher than expected.  Long story short.

1. good atmosphere
2. Good service
3 good food.

The atmosphere.  Nice darker setting with dark wood and as posh as booth seating can get for a chain.  

From the Hostess, to the bartender and the server... the service was actually much higher than I have had at higher-end restaurants than Redstone.  

The food and drinks:
The Drinks.. try the drinks, they are very good.  From what I saw of the wine list, it had enough to cover the general population. (but i didnt have any wine)
 I had the pomegranate martini.. (not too sweet, but def good). 


The NOSHING menu is great!  I HIGHLY recommend the Shrimp and Avocado Ceviche.  
I have had TONS of ceviche in my day.. and this one is at the top of my list.

Dinner.  I have had the Scallops (special), and Halibut (special), and some of their steak.  All these things were very good.
Fish is one of the best ways to rate a restaurant (in my opinion).  The fish was so fresh that I was actually suprised.  It was very, very good.
The steak.. think about 2 notches about outback, but I am going to have to go back to try a different cut again. 

Sides..
Definitely get the lodge cornbread with maplebutter .  It was an amazing combo of chili peppers ( just trust me) and sweetness..
SO good.

no room for dessert.. but will definitely come back.

This place is nice I've been here twice. I am in that giant rotisserie with the fire coming out of it looks like the end of Wizard of Oz and sometimes I just stand by it and get hypnotized. Food has been very enjoyable. Happy hour is nice. They've got a little man-made lake.And everyone there is very cool

They were great!!!  They notified me of the appointment time and price.  They were half the price of the Geek Squad.
The tech, Henry, was very nice and really knew his stuff.
When he left we were up and running.
I'm extremely satisfied.

Ok - I want to go here just to watch the kitchen at work...I could sit all day and watch them make food, spread butter, etc. Just an art - and their pastries really are art...some things are better than others for sure but boy, they know how to cook some bacon so it is flavorful. Some day, I will get a cake from here but then, it would be too beautiful to eat!

My gf had no desire to cook for Easter Sunday and ran across Redstone doing a brunch buffet for a paltry $35 (ish) a person. Even though I had worked in the Promenade for 5  or 6 years I had only eaten here once and to be honest I wasn't a fan because of the prices and the clientele. Maybe it was because I went at happy hour and the tools were out in force. 
  We were both expecting a limited selection for that price but boy were we wrong. A good mix of breakfast and lunch items with ham and roast freshly sliced. To be honest none of the food was amazing but for a buffet I we were both very happy with it. The Easter Bunny was also making the rounds so that was quite nice to see especially in the kids faces as...he? came around. 
  I will most def be heading back here especially for the patio before it gets super disgusting.

After hearing so much about the macarons and pastries, I had to check out Gallery Pastry Shop - did you know they serve brunch? Apparently, a lot of people know this - because on a Sunday around 11 there was a ~30 minute wait. 

The space is intimate and cozy with the mismatched furniture and dim lighting. I love that you can see Chef Hardy and his team in the kitchen working away - you can even sit at the bar area for a front row seat of the action.

I ordered the 'Merica (eggs your way, Smoking Goose bacon and hash browns) and the bacon was probably the best I've ever had. Next time, I'm getting a sweet/savory crepe combo - and maybe a delicious treat to go.

Just know that parking can be tough to find since it's tucked away with a lot of other businesses, and you might have to wait for a table.

Just wanted to say the Thanksgiving Meal ordered To Go for Curbside Pickup was REALLY Delicious!! Our favorites were the juicy Turkey, Cornbread Stuffing and Sweet Potato! Looking forward to leftovers. Thanks Redstone!!

This place is one of my favorite spots in Indy, let alone Broad Ripple. 

Whether you are stopping in for a pastry or brunch, the menu is excellent! Their pastries are beautiful and their food menu is a little avant-garde, which I love.

My four-year-old and I stopped in there for lunch on a Sunday at 1:30 and only had to wait about 10 minutes. The people were super nice and accommodating. The menu is a little tough for kids, especially if they're picky, but my son got a plate of bacon and the fruit and he was more than happy. The bacon was excellent and you got six large pieces for six dollars. I was very pleased with that.

I tried the crepes. It's two crepes for $16. I can't make them, and I understand that they are a labor of love, so I totally think that price point is perfect. Especially considering you can get two different flavors. I got a Savory Crepe (fromage) and the Banana's Foster Crepe! They were excellent. The fromage crepe had pesto, mozzarella, trillium, and feta cheese. Such a good savory combo. 

I got the Pear Lavender latte. It was interesting. They use Lavazza as their coffee, so it was good, but I don't know that I would pick that combination again. It was beautiful though! 

I cannot wait to go back and try more things!

Ur Gadget Doctors were extremely helpful. Although I was unable to recover my computer due to me spilling a HUGE glass of hot tea and milk on the keyboard, they were able to recover all my data. I found them to be professional and thorough and recommend them to others everytime they have an issue.

I've only been here once. We waited forever for a table. 

The vibe is more of an older crowd. It's a darkly lit restaurant so it could be cute for date nights.

The food was better than TGIF or Applebees but nothing drool worthy. The drinks were good too. The service was average. 

I would come back to try more of the menu options.

The Gallery Pastry Shop has the most beautiful desserts!  While I stared through the glass case, trying to pick just one, I was questioning whether each was too pretty to eat.  

I also enjoyed the eclectic vibe with the decor.  All types of seating was available from large tables to smaller cozy ones to enjoy a little bit of heaven.  Outside dining  ranged from traditional picnic tables to garden, wrought iron tables.  I loved the huge chess board painted on the ground with extra large pieces for play.  It gave the area a real Alice in Wonderland feel.  

Desserts here are a special treat.  I have yet to try the croissant sandwiches or any meal food.   

Tip:  French Macaroons are only a $1 on Wednesday's!!!   They are packaged in very attractive sleeves.

I don't even have the words to describe how absolutely amazing this place is. My boyfriend and I have gotten macarons here for the last year or so, but their brunch is TO DIE FOR!!! I got a blood orange mimosa and was over the moon with it. I got an omelette with fresh local ingredients (red onion, bacon and cheddar) and it was perfectly cooked and served beautiful with an olive oil drizzle. My boyfriend got the crêpes- one savory and one sweet and I about fell out of my chair after having the Carmel Apple crêpe because it was the perfect balance of tart and sweet with a light, fluffy crêpe. His savory crêpe was chorizo and vegetables and was excellent, but I'm more of a sweet over savory kind of girl. I can't wait to come back here for brunch. This is easily one of our favorite brunch spots now!

Stay far away from Hellotech.   Hellotech damaged my front door when installing my SimplySafe system. I had to pay to have it repaired.  I submitted the receipt 3 1/2 months ago and have never received reimbursement for the damages.  I have called, and emailed the company.   They are giving me the runaround now. They aren't honest.
The best dealership I have ever been to. I tell all my friends and family how great they are. I have now bought five cars from them between my wife, my son, and I. Best of the best!!

I have never had better service than at Sheffields.  They have been very patient and helpful...and my fiancé and I have been in numerous times!  A first we went because my soon to be mother in law takes all her jewelry there and we met Chad.  He was very informative and gave us many options in different types/prices etc.  My fiancé went in to make the final selections and Chad helped with finding him the perfect band as well as the loose diamond.   The final result is overwhelmingly beautiful and I could not be happier.  I have been back a few times to have my ring sized, free, and they even found a solution to a skin reaction I had, again free.  They do send their rings out to their jeweler but the result was beautiful and on time...i only waited 4 days.  We have also begun looking for our wedding bands and again the staff there has been so helpful...even offering to order a band in for me to "see if I like it" matched with my engagement ring.  We have met most of the staff I think by now and everyone is just great.  From the owner, Erik, on down everyone is so helpful.  There is no pressure to buy and so many choices and my fiancé and I feel so welcomed every time we go in.  I am a forever customer of Sheffields!
Amazing experience every time we go! Definitely recommend! Whether it's just my fiancé and I or bringing our family & friends it has always been a fantastic time!

Asanti was a wonderful hostess and made us feel very welcome! She wasn't lying when she said it's a judgment free zone. The atmosphere is BEAUTIFUL and you can come here to just hang out with friends or even a small business meeting. It's very homey and warm feeling, which is always nice. The art work is gorgeous and you can watch the chef make all the pastries while you enjoy your drinks and goodies. The food and drinks?! OH MY! So DELISH! Honestly one of the best little dessert shops I've ever been to. The portions are perfect and made beautifully. The beer and wine selection is great, along with their hot coco & teas. You must stop in here!

Spooktacular! 

This Halloween-themed bar shares the same space as Tinsel (Christmas-themed bar). We enjoyed "ho-ho-ho-ing" it at Tinsel last year, and we enjoyed our creepzilla jaunt at Nightmare as well. 

The drinks are sugary-sweet (it IS Halloween, after all) and the Bag of Blood cocktail looks downright gnarly (in a good way). I flip-flopped between being intrigued, to being grossed-out as my better half enjoyed this blood-red drink out of a mock medical bag. The Candy Corn tasted like a (very) sweet Malibu Bay Breeze, and the Ecto Cooler Shots were donned with dry ice and a surprise gummy eyeball at the bottom. I "see" you! 

Props to the gentlemen at the door, as crowd-control was fantastic. We were able to walk around the space and marvel over the festive decor without our toes being crushed. Tinsel was PACKED, but Nightmare was comfortably busy without being a fire hazard. 

Try arrive early to avoid the astronomically long lines (we did). Expect long bathroom waits, so practice the "PBYG" method (pee before you go). 

Go get your creep on!
Went here for dinner and it is so good! My friend and I ordered the calamari, chicken chopped salad and smokehouse steak Cobb. Highly recommend!

Yup, so just like another person on here, I got the same standard response from the owner and I immediately replied via email as requested. It is now 3 weeks later and no response or care from anyone at Barlow. I would never recommend this dealership! How do they plan to stay in business when there is no customer service or customer retention? 
I have taken my truck to Pellegrino Chevrolet, who did not only try not to waste my money, but they were thorough and found the problem in under the estimated time given. 
As for Barlow Buick, shame on you for being such a non-caring, sheisty location!

It pains me to write this because Gallery Pastry Shop was by far my favorite brunch place in Indy. Not sure if they are focusing everything on Gallery Bar downtown or cutting corners due to the pandemic. Set up a birthday celebration for me with the family and hyped up how great the place is. Service was mostly inattentive and disjointed. Ordered a bottle of champagne and pitcher of orange juice for mimosas. Champagne sat on the table with no ice bucket and nobody knew who was supposed to bring the orange juice so it sat warming up on the table. Food was disappointing for the most part. Bacon used to be a unique ,thick cut of deliciousness and now could pass off as part of a Denny's grand slam. What happened? Hash browns were mostly tasteless. The food used to warrant a premium price, but not what we had today. I felt embarrassed having my whole family out for mediocre food and service when I had told them how great it is, Especially with the premium priced final checks. I hope it was an off day, if not Gallery needs to focus again on the broad ripple location for food quality.

I purchased a new Pontiac Solstice from Barlow some years ago. I was very happy with the sales department and the service was excellent. I continued to have the car serviced there on a regular basis. Always satisfied.
     Several months ago, it was once again time for a new car. I headed back to Barlow. Not so happy with sales department this time. I walked around their show room for at least ten minutes. Absolutely no one approached or greeted me. In disgust and anger, I left and purchased a Verano elsewhere that night. 
     But I still take my car to Barlow for service. In a few years, when it is time for another new car, and if I am considering a Buick, I will again test their sales department. But in any case, regardless of where I buy the car, Barlow is my servicing dealer.
    If you are in the market for a car, I do recommend this place. If you can not make a deal with the sales people, you should still consider using the service center.

It was lovely! The bread with garlic butter and basil pesto (nut free) was amazing. The calamari was also a hit. We all loved our entrees (grilled salmon, Cajun salmon, sea bass, and crab cakes) and we also got the key lime pie (HUGE portion) and the cookie sunday for dessert! Ron was our server and was so attentive. Couldn't have asked for a better waiter.

Addicted to The Gallery Pastry Shop!

Situated in a cozy corner off Broadripple's Monon Trail, this place has it all! Breakfast, brunch, lunch and treats galore! 

My go to order is the crepe combo. Pick two crepes, savory or sweet or one of each. My favorite savory crepe is Breakfast at Tiffany's. 

Some if the crepes rotate out with the season. My all time fave is the peach! Today I had the lemon poppy and it was just as delicious! 

Pastry treats like their croissants and macarons are must try items as well!

This is, easily, my favorite restaurant in New JerZey. 
I came in here with low expectations and was VERY pleasantly surprised. 
I like to sit outside and have a few drinks by the fire before eating. 
Now, in all fairness, I have only been here in the April-September timeframe and I have never sat inside the main restaurant. It may be an awful and evil pit of woodpaneled hell in there ... outside is quite pleasant. 
Must try if you're nearby.
Walked up to the door and the bouncer didn't let us in because we were drinking out of red solo cups before we went to a bar? We each had one beer and aren't rookies. Won't be going back.

I will cut someone to get a good quality macaron (mac-a-RON, not ROON) and having had some of the best macarons in NYC, GPS is the only place in Indy that I feel hits the nail on the head.  A light crispness surrounds the soft cookie center floating in the middle.  Everyday there's a incredible list of flavors that are constantly changing.  If it couldn't get any better it does with $1 macarons on Wednesdays!!!   Try the Lavender, and the Cookies/Cream. 

The space is decorated with heavy wooden tables, big gorgeous chandeliers all of which is almost, but not quite, as beautiful as all of the deserts on display.   I have yet to order any because I don't want to ruin their look by eating them.   One day I will. 

See you next Wednesday

I've been here a few times. Most of the time it's been pretty average. Good enough service. What you expect for a local Mexican place. This week I went with another couple and a guest, 5 total. No one was blown away. But we will likely come back because of location and lower cost.

I had high expectations for redstone American grill. Sadly, I was disappointed with the whole experience. The food was not what I expected. No flavor terrible drinks. They tried to accommodate. But the food is terrible.

We were getting hangry for lunch but knew it had to be a light one based on dinner plans. Neither of us had been here but we were both curious after passing by many times. This seemed to fit our needs and was very close. 

We walked in on a Friday just about 1:30, not a large crowd but perhaps half full. A darkish and hardwood prolific ambiance, possibly even romantic. We both liked and hoped food would be as attractive. The prices are on the high side but many menu items sounded tasty. We agreed on a few and asked the waitress about a special, the chicken salad stuffed avocados. Based on her description we ordered that, a flatbread and the crab dip. 

The salad arrived first, this was a portion suitable for 3, 3 halved Avos stuffed to overflowing with very good chick salad, with fresh baby romaine leaves dressed up somewhat Caesar - ish. Very good and something we'd get again. Just as we were finishing both other dishes arrived, we would have preferred them to
Be spaced, but didn't specify. The margarita flatbread was ok, not as flat as some with herbed dough, fresh mozz and fair toms. The crab dip was excellent, real crab in a perfectly browned on top cheese sauce. The pita chips we very good as well. 

After such a nice lunch here we are planning on going back for dinner.  This seems like a good choice for special occasion, date night or a splurge. Oh, and the swanky framed TVs in the men's room turned to financial news was neato too.

3.5 this time. Underwhelming after the great food I had last time. Ordered two egg hash and the veggies selection underneath was predominantly red onions and green peppers. The hash browns were too done and crispy. I ordered over medium eggs and they were over-cooked and dry yolks. The flavors were good, just some overpowered the others. I wanted to love it, but I could only like it. Tracy M was very helpful and attentive.

The staff is welcoming and very helpful so I will still be back for the atmosphere.

Ok the bad first, how is this downtown? Hotel is near nothing and is about a 5 minute drive to downtown.  (They do have a free shuttle every 30 minutes going there and back from 9am to 9pm)
The air conditioner was so loud I thought a diesel truck was outside our window. (Trains did go by as well and were visible from window.) 
When we arrived our room had a heavy scent of cleaning chemicals. Great they cleaned not great I had to smell it for a full day afterward.
The good, the staff was so friendly. Our flight was delayed and we didn't arrive til 1:45 am. The lady at the front counter was waiting, very friendly and welcoming. 
Breakfast was excellent! They didn't scrimp and blame it on covid. So many choices and fresh fruit options too. Plenty of seating and no mask BS (if that bothers you don't even come to TN. I spent 8 days here and saw less than a dozen people wearing a mask...
Pricey for what it is but that's Nashville. You will see homeless outside your window but the Hotel was clean and I felt safe there. Appreciated the free parking.

Poor excuse for a General Motors Dealership.  This company does not care for the customer beyond the sale.  I purchased a Vehicle in November, I waited over two months for my tags.  I called almost daily, never received a call back from owners, or sales person.  
The company owes me a refund of $100, I have been promised by John Barlow (owner) that the refund is coming, this promise was made 5 weeks ago.  I have called his brother Matt (owner), as instructed by John, no return phone call.  I called the sales person, and John again, no return call.
Once the sale is made they can care less, so do not purchase a vehicle here unless you want aggravation.  
GMC should be made aware of their practices, I do not believe this is how all GMC dealerships operate.
Dr. Z

Went for the Halloween pop up and it was so nicely decorated! The place gave off great halloween vibes w the baby heads and hanging corpses! It's a great place to go to! Only complaint is the price of the drinks, which were a bit too sweet, but it's the price you pay for the amazing pictures you'll get!
Took $1,400 deposit for a July 24 install.  No show.  No refund.  Skipped town and we are out of our money.  Classic case of deception and theft.

If you aren't from Idaho, don't bother frequenting this business.  I chose to go here while visiting my son at BSU.  They refused to sell me .45-70 ammo because I'm not from Idaho.  Drove the 5 miles down the road and bought it from Sportsman's Warehouse.  So much for supporting local businesses.

I light my cigarette and take in the smoke.
I put the pizza in my mouth. It tastes like warm dreams of a fond memory.
I hit the open road.
Nobody knows where I'm going.
Nobody knows where I've been.
I'll remember you, bruschetta slice. You did a nice job. Maybe you'll see me again.
Great store. Great customer service. Great selection. Been many times and have always had a positive experience

Clarion was a nice stay just under a ten minute shuttle drive to Broadway.  The after noon/ night shuttle driver, Raul, was awesome!! He was very helpful with directions and even dropped us off closer to where we wanted to go.   He is very friendly and personable. We were a few minutes late to the shuttle stop and he saw us and stopped to let us on so we would not have to wait for him to come back! Hotel was clean and staff was friendly.  Raul is the best!

It was thanksgiving and we thought with my fiancé that we would get a table at this spot, it was in a new locality and we did not know a lot of people and the people here seemed very selective of the places that they dinned. At first we were not enthusiastic to meet more people and taste the food in the area but were also afraid of what the reception would be. This was made worse by the fact that this was an area that uses a different lingua from us. This language barrier made the situation more challenging. Our fears were however proved unfounded. Not only did the staff handle us with a lot of professionalism but we were also given a complimentary desert as a way of welcoming us to the place. Everything including the music, ambience and food was top notch. We were surprised to find out that most of the members of staff were had learned at least one foreign language in order to be able to respond to situation such as the one involving us. The expertise was so good. It was more than we could expect.
Overpriced, food is average, ambiance is nice. That pretty much summarizes my visit. I literally paid $30 for a salad that was poorly dressed. Will not return.

I am going with 4 stars because we really, really like the food. The menu is eclectic and different, and we have not had a bad meal. The only downside is that we have always had extremely slow service. There is always a lot of people working, but it seems pretty standard for us to be a forgotten table. If they could figure the service side out, this would be one of the best breakfast places in the city.

After my scathing review of Barlow Buick, I received a message from Ed Barlow, President of Barlow Auto Group. He apologized for my negative experience and asked me to email him personally. He said he'd answer any and all questions that I may have. I wrote him immediately (June 17th) and unfortunately I still haven't heard anything from him. Call me crazy but it seems like his intention was to let all of the potential car buyers who may read my negative review think that he was actually concerned about the dishonest tactics employed by his business and that he'd rectify the issue. I gave him six days to respond to my email before writing another review because I didn't want to jump to conclusions but he gave me now choice.  I guess dishonesty runs in the Barlow family. Just to recap, Barlow Buick advertised a car for a certain price and refused to honor that price when I inquired about it (after I wasted time test driving it). So, please DO NOT BE FOOLED.  BAIT and SWITCH and FALSE ADVERTISING are serious and illegal tactics used by Barlow Buick and condoned by the owner. 

Do yourself a favor, there are so many other Buick dealerships in the area...stay away from this one...

NOTE: Like the good Yelper I am, I will update this if I ever hear from someone from the company. But I'm not holding my breath.

It's hard to find this restaurant because it's tucked away off the road but I am so glad we ended up spotting it! Cute little building with outdoor space that would be fun in the summertime. We went for the breakfast sandwich and bottomless mimosas after a recommendation from a friend. Everything was delicious! Adding bacon to the sandwich is an extra $2 but it was worth it! They have a lot of vegetarian options, including impossible sausage. 

The bottomless mimosas are truly bottomless. I don't think I ever saw the bottom of my glass until it was time to leave because they kept topping it off. No disappointment from me there! 

It's definitely a little higher end than other brunch options in the city but I'm glad we tried it out. Definitely will be back for breakfast or one of their amazing looking pastry options!
Got the order right on the ticket, opened the bag and wasnt the right stuff. Wrong/missing items... too bad i was home by the time I noticed

I had a lovely brunch this weekend with my friends at Gallery Pastry Shop. The food and company were wonderful. I have been before and would highly recommend any of the following options - any of the crepes, omelets or the croissant and gravy. Their brunch food is wonderful and the sweet treats are even better. Loved the tea presentation. It's a good experience with the garage doors open and fresh air coming in. Though it was busy we still grabbed a table quickly. The service was good as well. The price point feels a bit high on certain items but the quality is good so I buck up on that one point.

This is my new favorite brunch place! Everyone on staff was kind and helpful. It was especially neat to see the open kitchen and the process of the food preparation. The menu has a little something for everyone, and I look forward to trying the bananas foster crepes next time I'm in. I was impressed by the extensive drinks menu, and, of course, all the delectable treats in the dessert case. Don't worry if there's a little bit of a wait, there are several shops around the area to peruse or window shop.

The meal was fantastic. It was obviously fresh and had that homemade taste to it. The atmosphere was upbeat and modern. Unfortunately the waiter must have been having a bad day. It was confusing on who was actually our server. Our actual server was a bit all over the place. Probably just one of those days!

Every pastry from The Gallery is a work of art and almost looks too good to eat!  Beautiful creations have made this a new hot spot!  French macaroons in daily flavors make excellent gifts.  The space is also very cool... tables with tufted chairs, open air seating and  place to see as the chefs work on their latest exquisite masterpiece!  Such a fun, fun place !!!

The Gallery is at the end of a row of businesses and can be easy to miss. Directly off of 54th Street, turn south into a long row of shops,  on the opposite side of the road from Posh Petals and Dancing Donuts...make The Gallery one of your next stops!

Hellotech damaged my front door when installing a SimplySafe system at my home.  I had to pay to have it fixed. I was promised that hellotech would reimburse me. They have never sent the check they promised to reimburse me for the damage I had repaired two months ago.  Also the technician they sent to install my system totally messed up the installation breaking 3 pieces of the SimplySafe equipment. Beware of this company.

I went for Sunday brunch with 4 other people! We had a really great time in the outside seating section. The location is small so make sure to call ahead for a reservation. Tracy was our waitress and she was so friendly and gave us suggestions since it was everyone's first time here! The only reason I give a 4 rating is due to the wait on the food. It took a long time for the food to be brought to our table- we ordered breakfast food too so nothing crazy. 
The food I ordered:
- Croissant & gravy 5/5 the gravy wasn't too salty it was just right and the croissant was perfect amount of flakey. I chose to add an extra over easy egg. I was hesitant about the egg but it everything tasted really good! 
- Fruit with lemon curd: 5/5 I'm not a fan of lemon flavor things but the custard was good mixture with the fresh fruit.
- Triple Chocolate pastry: 4/5 it was hard even when I had to cut it with a fork& knife, but the flavor! Wow, the layers mixed so well & I'm not much of a chocolate fan. I just really wanted to try something! 
- $25 Mimosa Package: 4/5 we had 4 people drinking and the amount of juice that comes with the package is so small. I personally like to pour a good amount of juice in my mimosa but the other three were fine with the amount. Personal preference.

RUDE AF- I've been following The Gallery on Instagram for quite a while because their desserts always look interesting. They often times have really unique offerings. So when I saw that they posted this today, I questioned if they were hopping onto the dessert ramen trend. I've seen a lot of places using ramen as a base with coconut milk or coconut pudding and various other additions. However when I asked about it, I was insulted, and felt disrespected. Instead of answering my question, they threw negativity my way. They ended up deleting my (ooops typo'd desserts) comments and blocking me. If this is the type of customer service that they provide, then I won't be (and urge others to not) giving them any of my money. There are plenty of other pastry shops in town that treat their customers and followers with respect.

Missed half our order, after telling us its all there. Guess it's my fault for believing fast food workers.always check your food before leaving l. Fast food workers cant be trusted. Ok.....went back to get the right order and they still fucked it up DONT GO THERE. Just called to talk to a manager 9/30/18 @ 2:ooam and was on hold for 10 min with no answer. They do care about their customers. Not a place to go.

The place deserves a zero rating.  Let me first start off by saying I was absolutely starving when I arrived to New Orleans and was in hopes for some really great food.  I was referred to this place by a security gaurd on the street.  She swore by this place so, me being a foodie I wanted to try it.  I was in town on a bachelorette trip and had about seven other people to join me here.  Right before we placed our orders the waitress told us that we could not split our check and that we needed to get cash out of the atm out back.  My sister and myself were the only ones who did not have cash on us so, proceeded to the atm.  

We came back and placed our orders.  Our order took about 30 minutes to come.  In the midst of being so excited to be there we didn't complain about how long it took for our food to be delivered.  After, we got our plates the waitress came to check o us to see if we needed more water.  While enjoying my time with my friends and attempting to eat another bite of the craw-fish etoufee I noticed a roach in my food.  I started screaming and that roach began to crawl over the table.  I ask the waitress to come over to show her the roach and she became very upset with me and said that the roach was not there before.  She grabbed my plate and stormed off.  

My friends along with myself waited around 10 minutes for a  manager to come by and apologize.  We never received an apology however, the manager came over with the check and told us that if we didn't pay for the food he would call the police.  Instead of him calling the police,  I took it upon myself to call them before they could.  About 10 minutes later, the police arrived.  We explained our situation to three of the cops and the cops seems to be on the managers side saying that we needed to pay for our food.  We were very disturbed with how to cops treated us, even after showing him the picture of the roach on my plate. We even saw one of the cops high five the manager and stated "we will see you later on tonight."  

The cops made us pay for our food and told us that we were not in Georgia and that we were in Louisiana and that Louisiana laws were completely different.  

I really wish that we had seen all the terrible reviews of this place before coming here.  DO NOT GO HERE!!! THIS PLACE IS VERY UNSANITARY AND CORRUPT!!!!!!!!!!!! PLEASE READ THE REVIEWS AND FOLLOW THEM.

In search of a great brunch spot with great outdoor seating, amazing food, and mimosas to wash it down? This little gem is five star in so many ways! Their outdoor seating is cute and intimate, and additional seating is available inside. For a cool experience, you can sit at the bar facing the kitchen, and watch them work their magic as they put together some delicious brunch favorites! I chose the croissant with sausage gravy and eggs over easy....so good! I may never want a biscuit with this again the croissant was so good with the gravy! My friend and I shared an order of the fruit brûlée, which might have been my favorite thing I had that day! Fresh fruit with a crispy glaze, I love a good bougie extra! She ordered the greenie omelette and added smoked salmon. Everything in the omelette tasted so fresh, like it just came out of the garden! I had to try the pear lavender latte and I was pleasantly surprised at how much I liked it! They have milk alternatives so I was able to sub almond milk with no problems. Last, the blood orange mimosa is a great choice! But then again, doesn't a mimosa make any brunch better? Beware, there's usually a wait for a table so find a spot to sip a coffee and wait outside, it's worth it!!

We have had several experiences with Sheffield's over the years and all have been positive. The most recent one involved making a custom ring from a combination of my mother's and my engagement rings' diamonds. It is hard to make a ring from two large, but different sized diamonds, but the results were extrordinary. Eric Sheffield came up with the idea and we were extremely happy with the results.They are now our only jewelry store. They are in a class by themselves.

We have been taking our Cairn Terrier here for approximately 2 years. I appreciate that the dogs usually only need to stay for 60-90minutes on average. This isn't like a Petsmart where you drop your dog off and they sit in a crate for an excessive amount of time before grooming. 

My dog is also never wary of the grooming staff who take her back which is really positive. They have a window from the waiting room looking into the grooming room. I feel like this really inspires confidence in those dropping off their dogs because we can see how kindly the doggies are treated. 

Also rather than waiting in cages in the back, like a big box groomer. Their after-grooming kennels are up front and are more like fences so the dogs can see what's going on up front and have a human with them.

I took my car there when it first started acting up and they said it was the grounding wire, took a few days to fix it. Picked it up on a Friday, that sunday my car shut down while I was driving on a main highway and would not start again. After waiting an hour on a main highway, AAA towed the car back to Barlow. They looked at it and was told it was the catalytic converter and they placed a new battery and spark plugs and such. I pick it up on a Saturday after only having it back for not even an hour, while I was making a left turn the car shut down(if another car was coming the other way, I would have been hit.) My husband was able to start my car again and take it back to Barlow. We dropped the car off on Sat, they call us on Tues to tell us that it is a timing belt. So we do not hear again from Barlow, call on Friday for them to tell us that they were not able to get it on a lift to fix it due to other cars having to be fixed and it should be done Tues(8/26), well here we are on 8/30 and I still have not heard about my car or have gotten my car back. I am very dissatisfied, I was placed in dangerous situations 2 different times because of Barlow, and they do not seem to care. My car should have been priority over the other cars because they were not fixing what needed to be fixed!! I do not trust them and I don't know if I would ever buy a Buick again!! I will definitely pass this on to everyone that I can, I do not want anyone having to deal with what I am going through.

Gallery pastry has a wonderful unlimited mimosa brunch, do I need to say anymore? Ok, I will, their brunch was delicious, built your breakfast to your preference. Not going to brunch? On Wednesday's they have $1 macaroons!

I typically love Redstone, maybe I was having an off day, but who knows. Reservations were filled til past 8pm on the day I was trying to go but I gave a call early afternoon and they were able to fit us in later that day.

Sweet & spicy calamari. Good but didn't seem like a whole lot on the plate for the amount paid? The braised short rib, flavorful, the chive polenta wasn't exciting, the carrots could have been cooked a little longer. He enjoyed the ribs, no complaints there. Got a glass of Sauv blanc, nice & fruity. The banana cream pie.. I would have called that a deconstructed banana cream pie. Tasty, yes, an actual pie shape or piece, no. But delicious. Of course I had to get an espresso martini, loved that.

Would have gone with my favorite the jerk chicken fondue but the dippers on it changed from apples and grapes to mushrooms, cauliflower and broccoli.. no thanks. I'll be back though.. need to keep trying the menu out.

This is my favorite Taco Bell location!! I go out of my way to go to this Taco Bell when I'm craving it! The drive thru moves pretty quickly & the food is usually fresh! I always order the nachos and they always give me extra guac without having to ask!

One of the best brunches I've ever had, and definitely the best brunch I've had in Indy. My friend and I treated ourselves by sharing the bruleed brie-like Tulip Tree Trillium cheese on a croissant with jam, berries and pecans; a croissant smothered in sausage gravy; the Breakfast at Tiffany scrambled eggs over veggie hash with whipped Tulip Tree Nettle cheese; and exquisite pistachio macarons with lemon curd.
